name: SerpApi
description: SerpApi provides a real-time API for structured search engine results, allowing developers to scrape, parse, and analyze SERP data for SEO and research

tools.name: Amazon Search
tools.description: Search Amazon by keyword or category for products, prices, and ratings. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Search Baidu with Query
tools.description: Search Baidu (Chinese search engine) and retrieve search results. Requires a search query string in the 'q' parameter. Returns organic search results, answer boxes, and pagination info in JSON format.

tools.name: Bing Maps Search
tools.description: Tool to scrape Bing Maps results using SerpApi. Use when you need to find local businesses, places, or get detailed location information including addresses, phone numbers, ratings, reviews, and more. Supports searching by query or specific place ID.

tools.name: Bing Search
tools.description: Retrieve Bing Search Engine Results via SerpAPI. Throttle to ~1–2 calls/second and apply exponential backoff on HTTP 429. Supports query, location, language, and device parameters. Set `location`, `mkt`, or `cc` explicitly when local relevance matters — result ranking is highly sensitive to localization.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo Light Search
tools.description: Tool to access the world's fastest DuckDuckGo Search API via SerpApi. Scrapes DuckDuckGo search results in JSON format with critical data for faster response times, without extra-rich results. Use when you need quick DuckDuckGo search results with essential information. Supports location-based searches, date filtering, and pagination (15 results per page).

tools.name: DuckDuckGo Maps search
tools.description: Scrapes DuckDuckGo Maps results via SerpApi. Use when searching for location-based information like businesses, restaurants, or services in a specific geographic area. Returns structured data including ratings, reviews, addresses, operating hours, and contact information.

tools.name: DuckDuckGo search
tools.description: Performs a DuckDuckGo search via SerpApi to retrieve SERP data, including organic results, ads, and structured information. Results may be localized by region by default.

tools.name: eBay Search
tools.description: Retrieve eBay Search Results via SerpApi. Supports parameters like nkw (query), location, etc. Returns product SERP data in JSON format. Listing prices and fees may be incomplete or inconsistent; verify total cost on the source page before comparing results.

tools.name: Search Google Events
tools.description: Searches for events in Google Search's structured event results.

tools.name: Search finance
tools.description: Retrieves structured financial information (e.g., company data, stock details, market trends, news) from Google Finance via SERP API based on a query. Empty results for delisted, illiquid, or newly listed assets are valid 'no data' responses. High query volumes may trigger HTTP 429 rate limits; apply backoff on retries.

tools.name: Get SerpApi Account
tools.description: Return plan, usage, remaining searches, renewal, throughput, and extra credits. This endpoint is free and does not consume search quota. Search requests count only when successful and not cached. Speed modes price at 1x, 2x, or 4x for Best Effort, Ludicrous, or Ludicrous Max; the returned hourly limit is the account rate limit.

tools.name: Amazon Product
tools.description: Retrieve Amazon product details, variants, sellers, and related items by ASIN. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Get Location Options
tools.description: Tool to get available location options for Google searches. Returns location names, codes, and identifiers that can be used in the location parameter. Use when you need to find valid location values for search queries.

tools.name: Get Facebook profile information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve public information from a Facebook profile or page using SerpAPI. Use when you need to fetch profile details, bio, photos, followers, ratings, or contact information.

tools.name: Get Google About This Result
tools.description: Tool to get Google 'About this result' information for a website. Use when you need detailed information about a specific URL including company details, social profiles, web citations, and reviews.

tools.name: Google AI Overview
tools.description: Retrieve the full AI Overview referenced by a fresh Google Search page token. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Get Google Hotels Autocomplete
tools.description: Tool to get autocomplete suggestions for Google Hotels destination searches. Use when users need to search for hotel destinations, properties, or locations before performing a full hotel search.

tools.name: Get Google Images Related Content
tools.description: Get related content for a specific Google Images result. Requires a related_content_id obtained from a Google Images search. Use when you need to find similar images or related visual content for a particular image.

tools.name: Google Jobs Listing
tools.description: Retrieve employer ratings for a job_id returned by Google Jobs Search. Removed legacy salary, apply-option, and similar-job fields are not returned. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; one-hour exact-query cache hits, errors, and failures do not. Throughput is the hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Get Google Patent Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific patent or scholar document from Google Patents via SerpApi. Use when you need patent details, claims, citations, inventors, assignees, legal events, or scholar publication information.

tools.name: Get Search Archive
tools.description: Tool to retrieve results from a previous async search using its search ID. Use when you need to fetch results from searches submitted with async=true. Searches can be retrieved up to 31 days after completion.

tools.name: YouTube Video
tools.description: Retrieve YouTube video metadata, chapters, comments, and related videos. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: YouTube Video Transcript
tools.description: Retrieve timestamped transcript content for a YouTube video. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Google Domains List
tools.description: Retrieve the list of supported Google domains for search queries.

tools.name: Google Forums Search
tools.description: Tool to scrape forum results from Google's Forums Platform using SerpApi. Use when you need to search forum discussions, get forum titles, dates, links, answers with voting data, and related searches.

tools.name: Google Jobs Search
tools.description: Retrieve Google Jobs Search Results via SerpApi. Returns job SERP data in JSON; key attributes like `work_from_home`, `posted_at`, `salary`, and `schedule_type` are nested under `detected_extensions` per job object and are often absent — treat as optional. Results may include stale postings; verify recency via `detected_extensions.posted_at`. Supports pagination, location filtering, and remote-job filtering.

tools.name: Google Lens search
tools.description: Performs reverse image search using Google Lens to find visually similar images, products, and related content. Use when you need to identify objects, find similar products, or get information about images. Requires a publicly accessible image URL.

tools.name: Google Light Search
tools.description: Retrieve Google Light Search Results via SerpApi. Supports q, location, gl, hl, and other SERP parameters. Returns lightweight JSON SERP data; results are in organic_results (handle missing/empty gracefully). Snippets are shallow — follow citation URLs with BROWSER_TOOL_FETCH_WEBPAGE for full content. Rate limit: HTTP 429 under heavy use; keep to ~1–2 requests/sec with exponential backoff on retry.

tools.name: Google Maps Posts
tools.description: Scrapes Google Maps Posts for a business location via SerpApi. Extracts local posts published by business owners including titles, descriptions, links, images, and publication dates. Returns 10 posts per page with pagination support.

tools.name: Google maps search
tools.description: Performs a Google Maps search via SERP API. Takes a query, optionally using specific GPS coordinates and pagination, returning structured location data.

tools.name: Google Play Product Search
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed Google Play product information using SerpApi. Supports apps, movies, TV shows, audiobooks, and books. Use when you need product details, ratings, reviews, or media for Google Play Store items.

tools.name: Google Scholar Author Profile
tools.description: Scrapes full Google Scholar Author page including articles, citations, metrics, and co-authors. Use when you need detailed information about a specific researcher's publications and academic profile.

tools.name: Google Scholar Cite
tools.description: Scrapes full Google Scholar Citations with multiple citation formats. Retrieves MLA, APA, Chicago, Harvard, and Vancouver style citations along with download links for BibTeX, EndNote, RefMan, and RefWorks. Use when you need formatted citations for a specific research paper identified by its Google Scholar ID.

tools.name: Google Videos Light Search
tools.description: Tool to scrape Google Videos results using SerpApi's ultra-fast Google Videos Light API. Use when you need video titles, links, thumbnails, snippets, upload dates, and durations from Google Videos search. This lighter version excludes rich results for faster response times.

tools.name: Hotel Search
tools.description: Retrieve Google Hotel Search Results. Supports parameters like q (query), location, etc. Returns hotel SERP data in JSON format.

tools.name: Image search
tools.description: Searches Google Images via SERP API for a given query, returning structured image results. The number of results can be controlled using the 'num' parameter (1-100). If not specified, it defaults to 20 results.

tools.name: Google Maps Reviews
tools.description: Retrieve Google Maps place reviews, topics, place data, and pagination. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Naver Search
tools.description: Tool to search Naver (South Korea's leading search engine) for Korean web results and content. Use when searching for Korean-language content, news, videos, images, or shopping results. Supports various search categories and filtering options including time periods and sorting.

tools.name: Search for news articles
tools.description: Searches Google News (via SerpApi, `tbm=nws`) for articles matching a query; precise key-phrase queries yield best results. Composio handles authentication; do not pass api_key as a parameter. Results returned under `news_results` field (~10 items/page). Rate-limited: throttle to ~1 req/s; HTTP 429 on bursts — apply exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Covers news content only; pair with SERPAPI_SEARCH for broader web sources. Headlines/snippets only — use EXA_GET_CONTENTS_ACTION for full article text.

tools.name: OpenTable Reviews Search
tools.description: Tool to scrape OpenTable restaurant reviews using SerpApi. Retrieves user reviews, ratings, restaurant responses, images, and AI-generated summaries. Use when you need detailed review data for OpenTable restaurants.

tools.name: Google Play Search
tools.description: Retrieve Google Play Store Search Results. Supports parameters like q (query), gl, hl, etc. Returns app SERP data in JSON format.

tools.name: Google AI Mode
tools.description: Query Google AI Mode for generated text, references, and follow-up data. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Search Google Scholar
tools.description: Searches Google Scholar via SerpApi for academic literature, papers, articles, and citations based on a query. Response results may include `inline_links.cited_by` and `resources` (PDF links), but these fields are not guaranteed; check for their existence and type before accessing.

tools.name: Serp API search
tools.description: Performs a real-time Google search via SerpAPI. Returns ~10 organic results per page nested under results.organic_results — not a flat list; handle missing/empty arrays. Paginate via start offset or serpapi_pagination.next; max num=100; stop when domains plateau to avoid quota exhaustion. Rate-limited: throttle to 1–2 req/s; HTTP 429 on bursts — apply exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s). Derive result rank from array index (absolute rank = start + index; no explicit rank field). Lacks date-bound controls — embed recency terms in query or use SERPAPI_NEWS_SEARCH for time-sensitive queries. Results may include ads and sponsored content; prefer authoritative domains. Use vertical tools (SERPAPI_IMAGE_SEARCH, SERPAPI_NEWS_SEARCH, SERPAPI_YOU_TUBE_SEARCH, SERPAPI_GOOGLE_JOBS_SEARCH) for specialized query types.

tools.name: Search Apple App Store
tools.description: Tool to search Apple App Store for iOS and Mac apps. Returns app details including ratings, reviews, descriptions, and developer information. Use when you need to find apps on the Apple App Store or get information about specific apps.

tools.name: Google Images Light Search
tools.description: Tool to scrape Google Images results using SerpApi's Google Images Light API. Use when you need fast image search with thumbnails, titles, sources, and original image URLs from Google Images. This lightweight version provides faster response times compared to the full Google Images API.

tools.name: Search Google Local Services
tools.description: Search Google Local Services for service providers like electricians, plumbers, HVAC technicians, and more. Use when you need to find local service professionals with Google's guaranteed badge and verified business information.

tools.name: Search Index
tools.description: Search SerpApi's preview LLM-first web index for grounding results. Successful non-cached requests count against the plan; exact-query cache hits within one hour, errors, and failed searches do not. Throughput is the account's hourly plan limit. Speed-mode multipliers are Best Effort 1x, Ludicrous 2x, and Ludicrous Max 4x.

tools.name: Search public Google ads
tools.description: Find public Google advertisements by advertiser or domain. Returns one page of public creative records; does not access or modify a private ad account.

tools.name: Search Yelp businesses
tools.description: Tool to search Yelp for businesses and places using SerpApi. Returns business listings with ratings, reviews, hours, contact information, and location details. Use when you need to find local businesses, restaurants, services, or read customer reviews.

tools.name: Shopping search
tools.description: Searches Google Shopping via SerpAPI for a specific product, returning structured listings in results.shopping_results. Response fields such as rating, review_count, extracted_price, and extracted_old_price may be absent; null-check before ranking or computing discounts. Discount percentages in listings may reflect aggregate promotional claims, not per-item pricing.

tools.name: Google Trends search
tools.description: Fetches Google Trends data; returns relative 0–100 interest indices (not absolute volumes) meaningful only when comparing queries within the same request. The `query`'s format (single/multiple terms) must comply with the selected `data_type`.

tools.name: Walmart Product Reviews
tools.description: Tool to scrape full Walmart product reviews using SerpApi's Walmart Product Reviews API. Retrieves ratings, review text, user information, and helpful votes for a specific product. Use when you need detailed customer feedback and sentiment analysis for Walmart products.

tools.name: Walmart Search
tools.description: Retrieve Walmart Search Results. Supports parameters like query, location, store ID, etc. Returns product SERP data in JSON format.

tools.name: Yahoo Search
tools.description: Retrieve Yahoo! Search Engine Results. Supports query, location, language, and device parameters.

tools.name: Yahoo Videos Search
tools.description: Scrape Yahoo! Videos results with position, title, thumbnail, link, preview, source, duration, date and more. Use when you need to search for video content on Yahoo! Videos.

tools.name: Yandex Images Search
tools.description: Tool to search Yandex Images for image results with advanced filters. Use when searching for images on Yandex with filters like size, color, type, or performing reverse image search.

tools.name: Yandex Search
tools.description: Retrieve Yandex Search Results. Supports parameters like text (query), location, etc. Returns SERP data in JSON format.

tools.name: YouTube Search
tools.description: Retrieve YouTube Search Results. Supports parameters like search_query, location, etc. Returns video SERP data in JSON format.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your SerpApi private API key, a 64-character string. Sign in and copy it from your Dashboard under 'Your Private API Key' at serpapi.com/manage-api-key.

name: Jira
description: A tool for bug tracking, issue tracking, and agile project management.

tools.name: Add Attachment
tools.description: Uploads and attaches a file to a Jira issue.

tools.name: Add Comment
tools.description: Adds a comment using Atlassian Document Format (ADF) for rich text to an existing Jira issue.

tools.name: Add Field to Screen Tab
tools.description: Adds a Jira field to a screen tab. By default, Jira also updates field associations for projects linked to the screen; set skip_field_association to true to avoid that side effect.

tools.name: Add Users to Project Role
tools.description: Adds users and optionally groups to a project role.

tools.name: Add User to Group
tools.description: Adds a user to a Jira group.

tools.name: Add Watcher to Issue
tools.description: Adds a user to an issue's watcher list by account ID. Requires the authenticated user to have permission to view the issue and manage watchers; insufficient permissions may result in silent failure or an error response.

tools.name: Add Worklog
tools.description: Tool to add a worklog entry to a Jira issue. Use when logging time spent on an issue.

tools.name: Analyse Jira Expression
tools.description: Analyses Jira expressions for syntax validation, type checking, and complexity analysis. Use when you need to validate Jira expression syntax before using it in automation rules, custom fields, or workflows.

tools.name: Assign Issue
tools.description: Assigns a Jira issue to a user, default assignee, or unassigns; supports email/name lookup.

tools.name: Bulk Create Issues
tools.description: Creates multiple Jira issues (up to 50 per call) with full feature support including markdown, assignee resolution, and priority handling.

tools.name: Bulk Move Issues
tools.description: Moves up to 1,000 Jira issues to one destination project, issue type, and optional parent described by provider mappings.

tools.name: Check User Permissions
tools.description: Check user permissions for global and project-level operations in Jira. Use this action to verify whether a user has specific permissions at the system level or within projects. Useful for authorization checks before performing operations, or for auditing user access rights.

tools.name: Create Board
tools.description: Creates a new Jira board (kanban, scrum, or agility) with optional filter and location configuration. Use this action when you need to set up a new board for a project or create a personal board for tracking work. The board will organize and visualize issues based on the specified filter or project context.

tools.name: Create Component
tools.description: Create a component in a Jira project.

tools.name: Create Custom Field Context
tools.description: Create a project and issue-type context for a Jira custom field.

tools.name: Create Filter
tools.description: Create a Jira saved filter with a required name and optional JQL query.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Creates a new group in Jira with the specified name.

tools.name: Create Issue
tools.description: Creates a new Jira issue (e.g., bug, task, story) in a specified project. IMPORTANT: Different Jira projects may have custom required fields beyond the standard ones (summary, project_key, issue_type). If issue creation fails with 'field X is required', use JIRA_GET_CREATE_METADATA_ISSUE_TYPE_FIELDS (requires projectIdOrKey and issueTypeId parameters) to discover available fields for your project, or check your Jira project's configuration. Custom fields can be provided via the 'additional_properties' parameter as a JSON string (e.g., '{"customfield_12345": "value"}'). Rapid bulk creation may trigger HTTP 429 rate limiting; throttle calls and use exponential backoff on 429 responses.

tools.name: Link Issues
tools.description: Links two Jira issues using a specified link type with optional comment.

tools.name: Create Issue Type
tools.description: Create a global Jira issue type.

tools.name: Get JQL Autocomplete Data
tools.description: Retrieves JQL autocomplete reference data including reserved words, field names, and function names. Use when building JQL query editors or validating JQL syntax.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new Jira project with required lead, template, and type configuration.

tools.name: Create Screen
tools.description: Create a Jira screen with a default field tab.

tools.name: Create Screen Scheme
tools.description: Create a Jira screen scheme with optional operation-specific screens.

tools.name: Create Sprint
tools.description: Creates a new sprint on a Jira board with optional start/end dates and goal.

tools.name: Create Version
tools.description: Creates a new version for releases or milestones in a Jira project.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Permanently deletes an attachment from Jira by its ID. This action is irreversible — the attachment cannot be recovered once removed. Use this action when you need to remove an unwanted file from a Jira issue.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Deletes a specific comment from a Jira issue using its ID and the issue's ID/key; requires user permission to delete comments on the issue.

tools.name: Delete Issue
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly deletes a Jira issue by its ID or key. Obtain explicit user confirmation before calling.

tools.name: Delete Issue Link
tools.description: Permanently deletes a link between two Jira issues by link identifier.

tools.name: Delete Statuses
tools.description: Deletes one to fifty Jira workflow statuses by identifier.

tools.name: Delete Version
tools.description: Deletes a Jira version and optionally reassigns its issues.

tools.name: Delete Worklog
tools.description: Deletes a worklog from a Jira issue with estimate adjustment options.

tools.name: Edit Issue
tools.description: Updates an existing Jira issue with field values and operations. Supports direct field parameters (summary, description, assignee, priority, etc.) that are merged with the fields parameter. Direct parameters take precedence.

tools.name: Evaluate Jira Expression
tools.description: Tool to evaluate Jira expressions using the enhanced search API. Use when you need to extract or transform data from Jira using Jira expression language. Useful for complex data queries, transformations, and building custom objects from Jira data.

tools.name: Bulk Fetch Issues
tools.description: Tool to bulk fetch multiple Jira issues by their IDs or keys (max 100 per call). Use when you need to retrieve details for multiple issues efficiently in a single API call.

tools.name: Find Users (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_FIND_USERS2 instead. Searches for Jira users by email or display name to find account IDs; essential for assigning issues, adding watchers, and other user-related operations. Broad queries may return multiple matches — always disambiguate using full email before selecting an account_id. Results may include app/bot accounts; verify account_type is a human user before use in downstream operations.

tools.name: Find Users 2
tools.description: Tool to find users in Jira by query string, account ID, or property search. Use when you need to search for users to assign to issues, add as watchers, or perform other user-related operations.

tools.name: Find Users For Picker
tools.description: Find users for picker components by matching query against user attributes like display name and email.

tools.name: Get All Groups
tools.description: Retrieves a page of groups from the Jira instance. Useful for resolving correct group names or IDs before passing them to other tools. Some returned groups are system-managed and may be inaccessible via other group operations. Use `start_at`/`max_results` to page through results.

tools.name: Get All Issue Type Schemes
tools.description: Retrieves all Jira issue type schemes with optional filtering and pagination.

tools.name: Get all projects
tools.description: Retrieves all visible projects using the modern paginated Jira API with server-side filtering and pagination support. Results reflect only projects the authenticated user can access — small or empty result sets may indicate permission restrictions, not absence of projects. An empty `values` array means no projects matched the filters; relax `query`, `status`, or `categoryId` if unexpected. Project keys are mutable; prefer the stable numeric project ID for durable references in follow-up calls.

tools.name: Get Issue Statuses
tools.description: Retrieves all issue statuses associated with workflows from Jira. Returns global statuses that may not be valid for every project or workflow scheme; verify a returned status is applicable to the specific project before use.

tools.name: Get All Users
tools.description: Retrieves all users from the Jira instance including active, inactive, app accounts, and system accounts, with pagination support. On Jira Cloud, fields like `email_address` may be redacted due to privacy settings — never treat them as guaranteed present. Successful responses may silently omit users due to permission restrictions; a smaller-than-expected result set may reflect access limits, not absence of users.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Retrieves the binary content of a Jira attachment by ID. Use when you need to download a specific file attached to an issue.

tools.name: Get Attachment Meta
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Jira attachment settings including upload limits and enabled status. Use when you need to check if attachments are enabled or determine the maximum file size allowed.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Retrieves a specific comment by ID from a Jira issue with optional expansions.

tools.name: Get Component
tools.description: Tool to retrieve components from Jira projects with search and filtering. Use when you need to list or find components across projects, optionally filtered by project IDs/keys or search query.

tools.name: Get Create Field Metadata for Issue Type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve field metadata for a specific issue type in a project. Use this to discover required fields, allowed values, and field configurations before creating issues of a specific type.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated Jira user. The returned `accountId` is the correct identifier for fields like `lead_account_id` in JIRA_CREATE_PROJECT, JIRA_ADD_WATCHER_TO_ISSUE, and JIRA_REMOVE_WATCHER_FROM_ISSUE — never use email or username in those fields.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Item Properties
tools.description: List property keys for a dashboard item or retrieve one property's value.

tools.name: Get Dashboards
tools.description: Tool to list and search Jira dashboards visible to the current user. Use when you need to discover available dashboards, filter by ownership or favorites, or retrieve dashboard details including permissions and popularity.

tools.name: Get Favorite Filters
tools.description: Tool to retrieve favorite filters for the current user. Use when you need to discover which saved filters the user has marked as favorites.

tools.name: Get fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Jira issue fields metadata. Use before editing an issue to discover custom field IDs and names. Custom fields are addressed as customfield_XXXXX in API calls and cf[XXXXX] in JQL; using display names instead causes 400 Unknown field errors. Returns global metadata — cross-reference with JIRA_GET_ISSUE_EDIT_META before editing, as globally visible fields not listed there will also cause 400 errors when sent to JIRA_EDIT_ISSUE. Results are scoped to the authenticated user's permissions, so field sets may differ between users.

tools.name: Get custom fields paginated
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Jira fields in pages. Use when you need to filter or page through custom and system fields.

tools.name: Get Filter
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Jira saved filter by ID, including its JQL and sharing metadata, to reuse in subsequent searches. Use when you need to fetch filter details or extract the JQL query to run searches.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific Jira group by name or ID. Use JIRA_GET_ALL_GROUPS to discover valid group names/IDs first. Some system-managed groups may be inaccessible due to permission restrictions even when name/ID is known.

tools.name: Get Service Management Info
tools.description: Retrieves runtime information for the Jira Service Management instance. Use when you need to check the version, build date, or license status.

tools.name: Get Issue
tools.description: Retrieves a Jira issue by ID or key with customizable fields and expansions. Request only needed fields and expansions to avoid large responses. Use specific `customfield_*` keys in `fields` to verify updated values programmatically.

tools.name: Get Issue Changelogs
tools.description: Return one oldest-first page of an issue's complete change history.

tools.name: Get Create Issue Metadata (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_GET_CREATE_METADATA_ISSUE_TYPE_FIELDS instead. This action wraps the deprecated query-based GET /issue/createmeta endpoint. Tool to retrieve issue creation metadata for Jira projects (available projects, issue types, and required fields).

tools.name: Get Issue Edit Meta
tools.description: Tool to retrieve editable fields for a Jira issue. Use before running an edit action to fetch custom field metadata and required fields.

tools.name: Get Issue Link Types
tools.description: Retrieves all configured issue link types from Jira.

tools.name: Get issue picker
tools.description: Tool to get issue picker suggestions from Jira. Use when you need to search for issues and get auto-completion suggestions.

tools.name: Get Issue Property
tools.description: Retrieves a custom property from a Jira issue by key.

tools.name: Get Issue Resolutions
tools.description: Retrieves all available issue resolution types from Jira.

tools.name: Get Issue Type
tools.description: Retrieves one Jira issue type by its unique ID.

tools.name: Get issue types
tools.description: Retrieves all Jira issue types available to the user using the modern API v3 endpoint; results vary based on 'Administer Jira' global or 'Browse projects' project permissions. Response includes two shapes: global issue types (no scope field) and project-scoped types (include scope.project.id); deduplicate by id, not name. Always use issuetype.id (not display name) when referencing issue types in other API calls to avoid validation errors.

tools.name: Get Issue Watchers
tools.description: Retrieves users watching a Jira issue for update notifications. Watcher data access may be restricted by Jira permissions. Returns all watchers; filter client-side by `accountId` to check if a specific user is watching.

tools.name: Get Issue Worklogs (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_GET_WORKLOG instead. This action is deprecated because it lacks the expand parameter for worklog properties. Use JIRA_GET_WORKLOG which provides the same functionality plus the ability to expand worklog properties using the 'expand' parameter. Legacy description: Retrieves worklogs for a Jira issue with user permission checks.

tools.name: Get JQL autocomplete reference data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve JQL autocomplete reference data. Use when you need to discover available JQL fields, functions, and reserved words for building queries.

tools.name: Get JQL autocomplete suggestions
tools.description: Tool to get JQL field auto-complete suggestions. Use when building JQL queries to discover valid field values or predicate options.

tools.name: Get My Permissions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user's permissions in Jira. Use when checking what actions the authenticated user can perform in a specific context (project, issue, or comment).

tools.name: Get User Locale Preference
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the locale preference of the currently authenticated Jira user. Use when you need to know the user's language and regional settings.

tools.name: Get Permissions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available Jira permissions. Use when you need to list all permission types that exist in Jira, including project and global permissions.

tools.name: Get Permitted Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve projects where the current user has specific permissions. Use when you need to find which projects a user can access with certain permission levels.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieves details of a Jira project by its ID or key.

tools.name: Get Project Roles
tools.description: Retrieves all available roles for a Jira project. Role IDs are project-specific and must not be reused across projects; call this action per project to obtain correct role IDs.

tools.name: Get Project Templates
tools.description: Retrieves available Jira project templates for creating projects. Returns template keys that can be used with the Create Project action. Use this action when you need to discover valid project template keys before creating a project.

tools.name: Get Project Type
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Jira project type by its key. Use when you need to get metadata about project types like software, service desk, business, or product discovery projects.

tools.name: Get Project Versions
tools.description: Retrieves all versions for a Jira project with optional expansion. Use version IDs from the response (not names) when setting fixVersions or affectedVersions on issues — submitting names alone causes 400 validation errors.

tools.name: Get Recent Projects
tools.description: Retrieves a list of projects recently accessed by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get Issue Remote Links
tools.description: Retrieves links from a Jira issue to external resources.

tools.name: Get Server Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Jira instance server information. Use when you need details about the Jira version, build, deployment type, or server configuration.

tools.name: Get Service Desk Request Type Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve JSM request type field metadata for filling out portal requests. Use when you need to know which fields are required and their valid values.

tools.name: Get Sprint
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific sprint by its ID. Use this action when you need to fetch a single sprint's details directly by ID, such as checking sprint status, dates, goal, or metadata. For finding sprint IDs, use JIRA_LIST_SPRINTS first.

tools.name: Get System Avatars
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all system avatars for a specific type (issuetype, project, user, or priority). Use when you need to get a list of available default avatars that can be assigned to Jira entities.

tools.name: Get Transitions
tools.description: Retrieves available workflow transitions for a Jira issue. Always use the numeric `id` from the response when calling JIRA_TRANSITION_ISSUE — transition IDs are project/workflow-specific and must not be hardcoded or reused across different issues or projects. When multiple transitions share similar names, use `id` to disambiguate.

tools.name: Get Universal Avatar Type Owner
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all avatars (system and custom) for a specific type and entity in Jira. Use when you need to view available avatar options for projects, issue types, or priorities.

tools.name: Get Universal Avatar View Type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the default avatar image for a specific type (project, issuetype, or priority) from Jira. Use when you need to download the default avatar for a type.

tools.name: Get User Groups
tools.description: Retrieves all groups for a specific Jira user by account ID. Use this action when you need to check group membership for a particular user, verify permissions, or audit user access. Essential for understanding which groups a user belongs to before performing group-related operations.

tools.name: Get Avatar Image
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific avatar image by type and ID from Jira. Use when you need to download avatar images for projects, issue types, or priorities.

tools.name: Get Issue Votes
tools.description: Fetches voting details for a Jira issue; requires voting to be enabled in Jira's general settings.

tools.name: Get Worklogs
tools.description: Retrieves worklogs for a specified Jira issue.

tools.name: List All Projects (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_GET_ALL_PROJECTS instead. Tool to list all projects accessible to the user. Wraps the deprecated GET /project endpoint; prefer the paginated JIRA_GET_ALL_PROJECTS (GET /project/search).

tools.name: List Assignable Users
tools.description: List users eligible for assignment in Jira project, issue, or transition contexts.

tools.name: List Boards
tools.description: Retrieves paginated Jira boards with filtering and sorting options. Use `start_at` and `max_results` together, looping through pages to retrieve all results.

tools.name: List Comments by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple comments by their IDs in a single request. Use when you need to fetch specific comments efficiently. Supports up to 1000 comment IDs per request with optional expansion for rendered HTML and properties.

tools.name: List Custom Field Context Default Values
tools.description: Return one page of custom field defaults grouped by context and issue type.

tools.name: List Custom Field Context Options
tools.description: Return one page of options configured for a custom field context.

tools.name: List Custom Field Context Project Mappings
tools.description: Return one page of project mappings for a Jira custom field's contexts.

tools.name: List Dashboard Gadgets
tools.description: Lists gadgets on a Jira dashboard, optionally filtered by type, URI, or ID.

tools.name: List Field Scheme Fields
tools.description: List fields via an experimental endpoint requiring Jira field-schemes beta enrollment.

tools.name: List Jira Filters
tools.description: Tool to search and list Jira saved filters (saved searches) visible to the current user. Use when you need to discover existing filters, find filters by name or owner, or get filter details including JQL queries and sharing permissions.

tools.name: List Group Members
tools.description: Return one page of users belonging to a Jira group.

tools.name: List Groups (Picker)
tools.description: Tool to search and list groups using Jira's picker endpoint. Use when you need to find groups by name or get a filtered list of groups.

tools.name: List Issue Comments
tools.description: Retrieves paginated comments from a Jira issue with optional ordering. Paginate by incrementing `start_at` by `max_results` until the cumulative count reaches the `total` field in the response. A response with `total=0` and an empty comments array means the issue has no comments.

tools.name: List Issue Property Keys
tools.description: Lists the keys and URLs of properties defined on a Jira issue.

tools.name: List Project Types
tools.description: Retrieves all Jira project types available in the instance. Use when you need to discover available project types or list all types without filtering by a specific key.

tools.name: List Sprints
tools.description: Retrieves paginated sprints from a Jira board with optional state filtering.

tools.name: Move Issues to Sprint
tools.description: Moves one or more Jira issues to a specified active sprint.

tools.name: Parse JQL Queries
tools.description: Parse and validate JQL queries, returning their abstract syntax tree structure along with any errors or warnings. Use when you need to validate JQL syntax or understand query structure before execution.

tools.name: Remove User from Group
tools.description: Removes a user from a Jira group. This is a destructive operation that revokes group-based permissions; confirm intent before calling.

tools.name: Remove User from Project Role
tools.description: Removes a user or group from a project role.

tools.name: Remove Watcher from Issue
tools.description: Removes a user from an issue's watcher list by account ID.

tools.name: Search Approximate Count
tools.description: Count issues matching a JQL query using approximate count endpoint. Use when you need a fast count of issues without retrieving full issue details. The JQL query must be bounded (include at least one search restriction).

tools.name: Search Dashboards
tools.description: Tool to search for Jira dashboards with filtering, sorting, and pagination support. Use when you need to find dashboards by name, owner, sharing permissions, or status. Supports filtering by owner account ID, group, project, and dashboard name.

tools.name: Search Issues Using JQL (GET)
tools.description: Searches for Jira issues using JQL with pagination and field selection.

tools.name: Search Issues Using JQL Enhanced (POST)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use JIRA_SEARCH_ISSUES instead. Searches for Jira Cloud issues using Enhanced JQL via POST request; supports eventual consistency and token-based pagination. Use this POST endpoint for long/complex JQL to avoid HTTP 414 errors on GET-based search. IMPORTANT: This action is for Jira Cloud only and will not work with Jira Server or Data Center instances.

tools.name: Search issues
tools.description: Advanced Jira issue search supporting structured filters and raw JQL. At least one filter parameter (e.g., jql, project_key, updated_after) is required; calls with no parameters will be rejected.

tools.name: Send Notification for Issue
tools.description: Sends a customized email notification for a Jira issue.

tools.name: Set Issue Property
tools.description: Sets a named JSON property on a Jira issue.

tools.name: Transition Issue
tools.description: Transitions a Jira issue to a different workflow state, with support for transition name lookup and user assignment by email. IMPORTANT: Only fields that are on the transition's screen can be set during the transition. Which fields are available depends on the Jira workflow configuration and varies per project. Use JIRA_GET_TRANSITIONS with expand='transitions.fields' to check which fields a transition supports. If a field (e.g., assignee) is not on the transition screen, use a JIRA_EDIT_ISSUE action after the transition to set other fields.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Updates text content or visibility of an existing Jira comment.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the Atlassian (Jira) sites accessible to the connection. Identity is workspace-level.

triggers.name: Comment Created
triggers.description:
Triggers when a comment is posted on a Jira issue. Can deliver comments
on issues the connected account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Comment Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when a comment is deleted from a Jira issue. The deleted
comment's text still arrives. Can deliver comments on issues the connected
account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Comment Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing comment on a Jira issue is edited. The payload
carries the comment as it now reads, not what it said before. Can deliver
comments on issues the connected account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Issue Created
triggers.description:
Triggers when an issue is created in Jira, including a sub-task. Can
deliver issues the connected account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Issue Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when an issue is deleted from Jira. The deleted issue's full
field set still arrives, so the filters below apply to it as usual. Can
deliver issues the connected account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Issue Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a field on an existing issue changes — its status, assignee,
or anything else on the issue. One edit can change several fields and arrives
as one event; creating a sub-task also updates its parent. Commenting does not
fire it. Can deliver issues the connected account cannot open in Jira itself.

triggers.name: Sprint Closed
triggers.description: Triggers when a sprint is completed and moves into the closed state.

triggers.name: Sprint Created
triggers.description:
Triggers when a sprint is created on a Jira board. Creating a sprint does
not start it — watch Sprint Started for that.

triggers.name: Sprint Started
triggers.description: Triggers when a sprint moves into the active state.

triggers.name: Sprint Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a sprint's name, goal, dates or state changes. Starting a
sprint also fires this when the same call changed another field; closing one
does not.

triggers.name: Version Created
triggers.description: Triggers when a project version is created in Jira.

triggers.name: Version Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when a project version is deleted outright. A version that
disappeared because it was merged into another one fires Version Merged
instead.

triggers.name: Version Merged
triggers.description:
Triggers when a project version is merged into another one, carrying both
the version that went away and the one that survived.

triggers.name: Version Moved
triggers.description:
Triggers when a project version is reordered within its project's release
list.

triggers.name: Version Released
triggers.description: Triggers when a project version is marked released.

triggers.name: Version Unreleased
triggers.description: Triggers when a released project version is put back to unreleased.

triggers.name: Version Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a project version's name, description or dates change.
Releasing and un-releasing a version each fire this as well, alongside
Version Released and Version Unreleased.

name: Firecrawl
description: Firecrawl automates web crawling and data extraction, enabling organizations to gather content, index sites, and gain insights from online sources at scale

tools.name: Cancel an agent job
tools.description: Tool to cancel an in-progress agent job by its ID. Use when you need to terminate an active agent operation. The API returns a success boolean upon cancellation.

tools.name: Bulk company enrichment with apollo
tools.description: Enrich up to ten companies in one call, billed 30 Firecrawl credits per matched company; unmatched records are free.

tools.name: Company enrichment with apollo
tools.description: Use when you have a domain or LinkedIn company URL and need the company behind it. For a company you can only name, search first.

tools.name: Complete company information with apollo
tools.description: Look up a company by its Apollo ID; use companies/enrich when you have a domain instead.

tools.name: Company job postings with apollo
tools.description: Find current hiring activity at a known company. Each requested page costs 30 Firecrawl credits.

tools.name: Company news search with apollo
tools.description: Find news about known Apollo companies, optionally filtered by category and dates. Each requested page costs 30 Firecrawl credits.

tools.name: Company search with apollo
tools.description: Use to build a list from a shape: size, location, industry, technology. It bills per page, so ask for the page size you need rather than paging through the whole market.

tools.name: Bulk people enrichment with apollo
tools.description: Enrich up to ten identified people in one call, billed 30 Firecrawl credits per matched person; unmatched records are free.

tools.name: Complete person information with apollo
tools.description: Retrieve a known Apollo person by ID. Use people/match to unlock contact information.

tools.name: Person match with apollo
tools.description: Use to resolve one person you have already found. Prefer the id from people/search, then a LinkedIn URL, then email; a bare name needs a domain beside it or it will match the wrong person.

tools.name: Batch scrape multiple URLs
tools.description: Tool to scrape multiple URLs in batch with concurrent processing. Use when you need to scrape multiple web pages efficiently with customizable formats and content filtering.

tools.name: Cancel a batch scrape job
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running batch scrape job using its unique identifier. Use when you need to terminate an in-progress batch scrape operation.

tools.name: Get batch scrape status
tools.description: Retrieves the current status and results of a batch scrape job using the job ID. Use this to check batch scrape progress and retrieve scraped data.

tools.name: Get errors from batch scrape job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve error details from a batch scrape job, including failed URLs and URLs blocked by robots.txt. Use when you need to debug or understand why certain pages failed to scrape in a batch operation.

tools.name: Consensus ratings with benzinga
tools.description: Use for where analysts stand in aggregate right now on one company. For the individual changes that moved the consensus, use calendar/ratings instead.

tools.name: Mergers and acquisitions with benzinga
tools.description: Use for who is buying whom, at what price, and whether the deal is pending or closed. For the coverage and commentary around a deal use news/search.

tools.name: Analyst ratings with benzinga
tools.description: Use for how analysts have moved on a stock: upgrades, downgrades, initiations and target changes. Filter by parameters[analyst_id] or parameters[firm_id] to follow one analyst or firm. It carries the ratings, not the reasoning behind them.

tools.name: Analyst roster with benzinga
tools.description: Use to resolve an analyst by name, or to judge how accurate a particular analyst has been, and to get the id you then pass to calendar/ratings as parameters[analyst_id]. For the ratings themselves use calendar/ratings; for the list of firms rather than people use calendar/ratings-firms.

tools.name: Research firms with benzinga
tools.description: Use to enumerate the covering firms or to turn a firm name into the id that calendar/ratings filters on as parameters[firm_id]. For an individual analyst and their track record use calendar/ratings-analysts; for the ratings themselves use calendar/ratings.

tools.name: Removed calendar events with benzinga
tools.description: Use when you keep a copy of the ratings or M&A calendar and need to know which previously returned events have since been withdrawn, which Schedule C.10 requires you to act on. It answers only what disappeared; for the events themselves use calendar/ratings or calendar/mergers-acquisitions.

tools.name: Press releases with benzinga
tools.description: Use this for company-issued announcements as distributed over the wires (PRNewswire, Globe Newswire, Business Wire, ACCESS Newswire, Newsfile), the primary-source wording behind a story. For Benzinga editorial coverage and the wider newswire use news/search, and for the one-line explanation of a price move use news/wiims.

tools.name: Removed news with benzinga
tools.description: Use this when you keep a copy of Benzinga news and need to know which stories have been withdrawn so you can delete them, which Schedule C.10 requires. It never returns story content; for the stories themselves use news/search.

tools.name: News search with benzinga
tools.description: Use for what was reported about a company or subject, and when. Scope it to tickers or a date range: unscoped it returns the whole newswire. For the analyst reaction to a story use calendar/ratings.

tools.name: Why Is It Moving with benzinga
tools.description: Use this to answer why a stock moved: WIIMs are the short attributed explanations Benzinga files against a ticker's price action. For the underlying coverage use news/search, and for the company's own announcement use news/press-releases.

tools.name: Unusual options activity with benzinga
tools.description: Use for positioning: large directional bets before a catalyst. It reports orders, not outcomes, and a sweep filled at or above the ask (execution_estimate) is a stronger signal than one at the midpoint.

tools.name: Start a web crawl
tools.description: Initiates a Firecrawl web crawl from a given URL, applying various filtering and content extraction rules, and polls until the job is complete; ensure the URL is accessible and any regex patterns for paths are valid.

tools.name: Cancel a crawl job
tools.description: Cancels an active or queued web crawl job using its ID; attempting to cancel completed, failed, or previously canceled jobs will not change their state.

tools.name: Cancel a crawl job
tools.description: Tool to cancel a running crawl job by its ID. Use when you need to stop an active crawl operation. The API returns a status of 'cancelled' upon successful cancellation.

tools.name: Get crawl job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and results of a Firecrawl crawl job. Use when you need to check the progress or get data from an ongoing or completed crawl operation. Returns crawl status, progress metrics, credits used, and the crawled page data.

tools.name: Get errors from a crawl job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve errors from a Firecrawl crawl job. Use when you need to understand why certain pages failed to scrape or which URLs were blocked by robots.txt during a crawl operation.

tools.name: Get all active crawl jobs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all active crawl jobs for the authenticated team. Use when you need to see which crawl operations are currently running.

tools.name: Preview crawl parameters
tools.description: Preview crawl parameters before starting a crawl by generating optimal configuration from natural language instructions. Use this tool to understand what crawl settings will be applied based on your requirements before executing a full crawl operation. The endpoint intelligently interprets natural language prompts to configure crawl parameters like include/exclude paths, depth limits, and domain scope.

tools.name: Start a web crawl (v2) [NEW]
tools.description: [NEW v2 API] Initiates a Firecrawl v2 web crawl with enhanced features over v1: natural language prompts for automatic crawler configuration, crawlEntireDomain for sibling/parent page discovery, better depth control with maxDiscoveryDepth, subdomain support, and full webhook configuration. Polls until crawl is complete.

tools.name: Get team credit usage
tools.description: Tool to get current team credit usage information. Use when you need to check remaining credits or billing period details.

tools.name: Get historical team credit usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical team credit usage on a monthly basis. Use when you need to analyze credit consumption patterns over time, optionally segmented by API key.

tools.name: Company enrichment (base) with datalegion
tools.description: Use the base Data Legion product by default for company enrichment. Choose the premium action only when the caller explicitly requests premium enrichment. Name matching is global, so include a domain or social URL for ambiguous names.

tools.name: Company enrichment (premium) with datalegion
tools.description: Use only when the caller explicitly requests Data Legion premium company enrichment; otherwise use the base action. Name matching is global, so include a domain or social URL for ambiguous names.

tools.name: Person enrichment (base-no-contact) with datalegion
tools.description: Use the base Data Legion product by default for person enrichment when personal contact data is not wanted. Choose a with-contact action only when the caller explicitly requests contact data.

tools.name: Person enrichment (base-with-contact) with datalegion
tools.description: Use the base Data Legion product when the caller explicitly requests personal contact data. Contact entitlement comes from the dedicated credential, never from field projection.

tools.name: Person enrichment (premium-no-contact) with datalegion
tools.description: Use only when the caller explicitly requests premium Data Legion person enrichment without personal contact data. Otherwise use the base no-contact action.

tools.name: Person enrichment (premium-with-contact) with datalegion
tools.description: Use only when the caller explicitly requests both premium Data Legion person enrichment and personal contact data. Otherwise use a lower-tier or no-contact action.

tools.name: Perform deep research
tools.description: Initiates an AI-powered deep research operation that autonomously explores the web to investigate any topic and synthesizes findings from multiple sources. Requires an active Firecrawl connection. The research process iteratively searches, analyzes, and synthesizes information across multiple web sources, providing comprehensive insights with source citations. Results include a final analysis, detailed activity timeline, and curated source list. Billing: 1 credit per URL analyzed. Control costs with the maxUrls parameter. Note: This API is in Alpha and being deprecated after June 30, 2025; prefer FIRECRAWL_SEARCH + FIRECRAWL_EXTRACT or COMPOSIO_SEARCH_WEB for durable workflows. Reserve this tool for cases requiring synthesized multi-source analysis — it is slower and more resource-intensive than FIRECRAWL_SEARCH.

tools.name: Extract structured data
tools.description: Extracts structured data from web pages by initiating an extraction job and polling for completion; requires a natural language `prompt` or a JSON `schema` (one must be provided).

tools.name: Get extract job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and results of a previously submitted extract job. Use when you need to check the progress or get the final results of an extraction operation.

tools.name: Company directory with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to discover what is covered, or to resolve names to identifiers when you do not already have a ticker. Check the per-company dataset list before assuming a costlier capability will answer for it.

tools.name: Company profile with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call first when starting from a ticker or stable company or security identifier. It returns every other identifier, peers, and secondary listings. Use company/list when starting from only a company name.

tools.name: Segments and KPIs with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for the numbers a business is actually run on - segment revenue, units, subscribers - which never reach the three statements. Coverage is narrower than for financials, and varies by company.

tools.name: Shares outstanding with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when a per-share figure has to be computed, or when a dual-class structure means the headline share count is misleading. Point-in-time, not a series.

tools.name: Earnings calendar with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to answer who reports when. Omit every company identifier for the whole calendar, which is what makes this the one capability here that answers a question not about a specific company. Read `eventStatus` before relying on a date - an estimated one moves.

tools.name: IR event resources with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find what exists for a quarter before asking for any of it - the deck, the release, the report, the transcript. Rows sharing a fiscal year and quarter are one event, so group on that pair rather than on the date.

tools.name: Earnings call transcript with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for what was said on the call, attributed and timed. The speaker mapping is what makes it worth more than the raw text: management's prepared remarks and an analyst's question can be told apart, and the Q&A boundary is given rather than guessed.

tools.name: Company filings with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find out what exists and when it was filed, and to get the document links. The filing bytes themselves are not retrievable through this provider - see its page for why - so treat `pdfUrl` as a handoff.

tools.name: Adjusted metrics with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when comparing against analyst estimates or consensus, which are quoted on an adjusted basis rather than a GAAP one. Not a substitute for the statements: these are management's adjustments, and the exclusions are theirs.

tools.name: Balance sheet with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Balance sheet, as reported with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Cash flow statement with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Cash flow statement, as reported with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Income statement with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when comparing companies, screening, or computing anything that has to mean the same thing across two filers. The mapping is visible: each standardized metric names the as-reported lines behind it, so a surprising figure can be traced rather than trusted.

tools.name: Income statement, as reported with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when fidelity to the filing matters more than comparability: the labels and groupings are the company's own, so two companies cannot be lined up against each other. Use the standardized view for that. Each value carries a link back to the filing page it came from.

tools.name: Companies in fund letters with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find which companies professional investors are actually writing about, and how heavily, before asking what they said.

tools.name: Theses on a company with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for the qualitative case on a company as professional investors put it, with the stance and conviction attached. The one capability here that answers what people think rather than what was reported.

tools.name: Fund letter with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for what one letter actually argued. The narrative sections are the investor's own words; the theses are the extraction, and each names what it was based on so a thin mention is not mistaken for a conviction.

tools.name: Investor profile with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to understand how a firm invests before weighting what it says about a company. The profile is derived from its own letters rather than from marketing material.

tools.name: Fund letter investors with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find the investorId for a firm, or to pick firms by style or sector focus before reading any letters. Sorted by coverage, so the most-covered firms come first.

tools.name: Fund letters with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to see what was published in a quarter. Returns the letter index rather than the letters - take a letterId to fund-letters/detail for the content.

tools.name: Ratio definitions with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find a ratio id before requesting a series, and to check `hasDailyData` before asking for a daily one - not every ratio has it.

tools.name: Standardized metrics with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to find the standardized metric id for a concept before requesting statements, rather than guessing at a name. Free, and takes no company.

tools.name: Standardized metrics by template with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call rather than the full list when the template is already known - it is the only place the prose definition and the sub-component breakdown of each metric are published, which is what settles what a line actually includes.

tools.name: Holdings by institution with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to read ownership from the investor's end rather than the company's - what a fund holds and how it is weighted. The counterpart to institutional-holders, over the same 13F data.

tools.name: Institution directory with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to resolve an institution's name to the holder id that ownership/holder-holdings needs. Free, and takes no company.

tools.name: Insider holders with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for the current standing position of officers and directors, including holdings held through trusts and other vehicles. Use insider-transactions for what they have been doing rather than what they hold.

tools.name: Insider transactions with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to see insider activity over time. Read `transactionType` before drawing conclusions: an option exercise or a tax withholding is not a market sale, and they sit in the same series.

tools.name: Institutional holders with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to see who institutionally owns a company and who moved last quarter. 13F data lags: the report date is the quarter end, the filing date is up to 45 days later, and both are returned so the lag is visible.

tools.name: Daily prices with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for a daily close series. Prices are split-adjusted already, so no correction against prices/splits is needed; the series is per listing, so a cross-listed company answers in whichever listing the identifier denoted.

tools.name: Intraday prices with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when the question is about movement within a session - a reaction to an announcement, say. Rounded to two decimals, so it is not a tick feed for execution purposes.

tools.name: Stock splits with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call to explain a discontinuity, or to reconcile against a price series from elsewhere that is not split-adjusted. The series returned by prices/daily already is, so this is not needed to correct it.

tools.name: Daily ratio series with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call when the question is how a ratio moved between reporting dates rather than what it was at them. Each day is recomputed against that day's close and the then-current fundamentals, so it is a real series, not a step function.

tools.name: Ratios by period with fiscal-ai
tools.description: Call for valuation, margin and leverage ratios already computed against the reported statements, rather than recomputing them from financials and risking a different denominator.

tools.name: Company lookup with fullenrich
tools.description: Resolve one company from its domain, LinkedIn company URL, or LinkedIn company ID. Returns firmographics, technologies, social profiles, and locations.

tools.name: Company match with fullenrich
tools.description: Use only for strict exact-match semantics with a LinkedIn company URL. For broader resolution from a domain, LinkedIn URL, or LinkedIn ID, prefer companies/lookup.

tools.name: Company search with fullenrich
tools.description: Find companies by industry, size, location, technologies, or founding year. Combine filters and page through the results. Use companies/lookup when you already have a domain or LinkedIn identifier.

tools.name: Mobile number with fullenrich
tools.description: Find a person's mobile phone number from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. The most expensive line by far: ask for it only when a phone is what the task needs. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Personal email with fullenrich
tools.description: Find a person's personal email from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. Schedule A bars marketing to personal addresses; use contacts/work-email for outreach. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Reverse email lookup with fullenrich
tools.description: Identify the person and company behind a work or personal email address. Returns a professional profile; use people/lookup when a name or LinkedIn URL is already known. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Work email with fullenrich
tools.description: Find a person's verified work email from a LinkedIn URL, or from their name and employer. Use contacts/mobile for a phone number and people/lookup when only the profile is needed. To enrich multiple contacts, send up to 10 separate calls in the Firecrawl /v2/scrape alexandria array, each with its own provider, capability and options. Each call accepts one contact, runs as a separate upstream job and is billed only for a result found. Inspect each call for errors; this is not a single bulk job. Concurrent enrichments share poll capacity and can hit rate limits; spread large batches out. Do not pass a contacts array in options.

tools.name: Person lookup with fullenrich
tools.description: Resolve a person from a LinkedIn URL or ID, or a full name combined with a company domain, LinkedIn URL, or ID. Returns a profile, not verified email addresses or phone numbers.

tools.name: Person match with fullenrich
tools.description: Use only for strict exact-match semantics with a LinkedIn profile URL. For broader resolution from a LinkedIn URL or ID, or from a name plus company identifiers, prefer people/lookup.

tools.name: Get agent job status
tools.description: Tool to get the status and results of an agent job. Use when you need to check if an agent job has completed and retrieve the collected data. Agent jobs autonomously search, navigate, and extract data from the web.

tools.name: Get deep research status
tools.description: Retrieves the status and results of a deep research job by its ID. Use when you need to check the progress or retrieve the final analysis of a deep research operation.

tools.name: Get the status of a crawl job
tools.description: Retrieves the current status, progress, and details of a web crawl job, using the job ID obtained when the crawl was initiated.

tools.name: List interact sessions
tools.description: List standalone Firecrawl Interact browser sessions, optionally by status.

tools.name: List monitor checks
tools.description: List recent check runs for a Firecrawl monitor.

tools.name: Generate LLMs.txt for a website
tools.description: Initiates an async job to generate an LLMs.txt file for a website, converting web content into LLM-friendly format. Returns a job ID to check status and retrieve results. Use when you need to create a standardized, machine-readable representation of website content for language models.

tools.name: Get LLMs.txt generation job status
tools.description: Tool to get the status and results of an LLMs.txt generation job. Use when you need to check if a job has completed and retrieve the generated content.

tools.name: Map multiple URLs
tools.description: Maps a website by discovering URLs from a starting base URL, with options to customize the crawl via search query, subdomain inclusion, sitemap handling, and result limits; search effectiveness is site-dependent.

tools.name: Look up Instagram post or reel with oriane
tools.description: Resolve a canonical Instagram post/video URL against Oriane's index. Instagram uses the post shortcode; TikTok uses the numeric video ID. Empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search Instagram posts and reels with oriane
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed Instagram posts, captions and engagement. Platform is fixed to Instagram. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up Instagram profile with oriane
tools.description: Pass a canonical Instagram profile URL to look up account details in Oriane's index. Returns profileUrl with each match. Short links and post URLs are unsupported; empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search Instagram profiles with oriane
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed Instagram profiles, bios and follower counts. Platform is fixed to Instagram. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search TikTok videos with oriane
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed TikTok posts, captions and engagement. Platform is fixed to TikTok. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up TikTok profile with oriane
tools.description: Pass a canonical TikTok profile URL to look up account details in Oriane's index. Returns profileUrl with each match. Short links and post URLs are unsupported; empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Search TikTok profiles with oriane
tools.description: Search Oriane's indexed TikTok profiles, bios and follower counts. Platform is fixed to TikTok. Coverage and freshness depend on the existing index; this is not a complete live feed. Results include profileUrl; an empty result does not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Look up TikTok video with oriane
tools.description: Resolve a canonical TikTok post/video URL against Oriane's index. Instagram uses the post shortcode; TikTok uses the numeric video ID. Empty results do not trigger ingestion. Choose projection: basic 20 credits, default 30 credits, full 40 credits per nonempty call. Search limit is at most 100; URL lookup targets one record. Empty results cost zero.

tools.name: Company profile with particle
tools.description: Use for the company record behind a sponsor, an entity or a companies/search hit. For its podcast advertising footprint use advertising/company/overview; for firmographics or funding, a company data provider is the better source.

tools.name: Company advertising profile with particle
tools.description: Use for a company's podcast advertising footprint in one call, across all its brands. For the show list use advertising/company/shows.

tools.name: Company ad placements with particle
tools.description: Use for the feed of a company's actual ad reads, episode by episode, to read or audit them.
