Catches all DMs across all DM channels, including thread replies.

triggers.name: Message Reaction Added
triggers.description:
Triggered when a reaction is added to a message in Slack.
Supports optional filtering by channel and emoji name.

triggers.name: Message Reaction Removed
triggers.description:
Triggered when a reaction is removed from a message in Slack.
Supports optional filtering by channel and emoji name.

triggers.name: Reaction Added Trigger
triggers.description:
DEPRECATED: use `SLACK_MESSAGE_REACTION_ADDED` instead.

Triggered when a reaction is added to a message in Slack.

triggers.name: Reaction Removed Trigger
triggers.description:
DEPRECATED: use `SLACK_MESSAGE_REACTION_REMOVED` instead.

Triggered when a reaction is removed from a message.

triggers.name: New Bot Message Received Trigger
triggers.description:
DEPRECATED: use `SLACK_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_RECEIVED` with
`is_bot_message=true` instead.

Triggered when a new bot message is posted to a Slack channel.

triggers.name: New Message Received Trigger
triggers.description:
DEPRECATED: use `SLACK_CHANNEL_MESSAGE_RECEIVED` instead.

Triggered when a new message is posted to a Slack channel.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the bot

optional.name: verification_token
optional.description: Verification token required to verify the request is coming from slack. You can find it in the slack app settings just below the client id and secret. It is required to enable Slack triggers.

optional.name: generic_id
optional.description: Optional Slack workspace ID used to scope the OAuth authorize flow to a specific team. When provided, Slack will only allow installation in this workspace. Leave unset to let users pick any workspace they have access to.

name: Canvas
description: Canvas is a learning management system supporting online courses, assignments, grading, and collaboration, widely used by schools and universities for virtual classrooms

tools.name: Abort Quiz Report Generation
tools.description: Aborts the generation of a quiz report or removes a previously generated one. Use when you need to cancel a report generation request or clean up an old report.

tools.name: Add conversation message
tools.description: Tool to add a message to an existing Canvas conversation. Use when sending a follow-up message to a conversation thread with specified recipients.

tools.name: Add course to favorites
tools.description: Tool to add a course to the current user's favorites. Use when you need to favorite a course for the authenticated user. If the course is already in the user's favorites, nothing happens.

tools.name: Add group to favorites
tools.description: Tool to add a group to the current user's favorites. Use when you need to mark a group as favorite for the authenticated user. If the group is already in the user's favorites, nothing happens.

tools.name: Add last attended date
tools.description: Tool to add or update the last attended date for a student enrollment in a course. Use when tracking student attendance by recording the last date a student attended the course.

tools.name: Add recipients to conversation
tools.description: Tool to add recipients to an existing group conversation. Use when you need to add new participants to an ongoing conversation. Response includes the latest message showing who was added.

tools.name: Add users to content share
tools.description: Tool to send a previously created content share to additional users. Use when you need to add more recipients to an existing content share.

tools.name: Answer quiz questions
tools.description: Tool to provide or update answers to quiz questions for a quiz submission. Use when submitting answers for a quiz attempt. Requires a valid validation_token from quiz submission creation and the latest attempt number.

tools.name: Assign unassigned members to group category
tools.description: Tool to assign unassigned members to groups within a group category. Use when you need to distribute users who are not yet in any group within the category. Returns a Progress object for async tracking by default, or group memberships when sync=true.

tools.name: Clear Course Nicknames
tools.description: Tool to remove all stored course nicknames for the current user. Use when you need to clear all custom course name preferences.

tools.name: Close notification for user
tools.description: Tool to excuse/close an account notification for the current user. Use when the current user no longer wants to see a specific notification. If the `remove` parameter is set to true, the notification is permanently destroyed for all users (admin action).

tools.name: Conclude, deactivate, or delete an enrollment
tools.description: Tool to conclude, deactivate, or delete an enrollment in a Canvas course. Use when you need to end or remove a user's enrollment. If the task argument isn't given, the enrollment will be concluded.

tools.name: Copy File to Folder
tools.description: Copies an existing Canvas file to a specified destination folder. Use when you need to duplicate a file to another location.

tools.name: Copy Folder
tools.description: Tool to copy a folder to another folder in Canvas. Use when you need to duplicate a folder structure with its contents to a destination folder.

tools.name: Create account notification
tools.description: Creates a global notification within a Canvas account, ensuring `end_at` is after `start_at` and any specified `notification_roles` are valid.

tools.name: Create a user content migration
tools.description: Tool to create a content migration for a Canvas user. Use when you need to import content into a user's files from various sources (zip files, cartridges, etc.). If the migration requires a file upload, the actual processing starts once the file upload completes.

tools.name: Create appointment group
tools.description: Creates a new appointment group in Canvas for schedulable time slots within specified course or group contexts.

tools.name: Create an assignment
tools.description: Creates a new assignment within a specified course in Canvas LMS.

tools.name: Create assignment via GraphQL
tools.description: Tool to create a new assignment in a Canvas course using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to create assignments with detailed configuration options including peer reviews, moderated grading, or assignment overrides.

tools.name: Create assignment group
tools.description: Create a new assignment group for a course. Use when you need to add a new assignment group to organize assignments in a Canvas course.

tools.name: Create assignment override
tools.description: Creates an assignment override to adjust due/unlock/lock dates for an assignment in a course, targeting specific students (requires `title`), a group, or a course section; at least one target (`student_ids`, `group_id`, or `course_section_id`) is required.

tools.name: Batch create overrides in a course
tools.description: Tool to batch create assignment overrides for multiple assignments in a course. Use when creating multiple overrides at once in a transactional manner (all succeed or none are created). Each override requires assignment_id and one of student_ids, group_id, or course_section_id.

tools.name: Create blackout date for course
tools.description: Tool to create a blackout date for the given course context. Use when you need to define a period during which certain activities are restricted or unavailable for a specific course.

tools.name: Create Bookmark
tools.description: Creates a new bookmark for the authenticated user. Use when you need to save a shortcut link to a Canvas page or external resource for quick access.

tools.name: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Creates a calendar event with options for recurrence (finite `rrule` series only), section-specific timings, and blackout dates within a specified context.

tools.name: Create communication channel
tools.description: Creates a new communication channel (e.g., email, SMS, push) for an existing Canvas user to receive notifications.

tools.name: Create content share
tools.description: Shares a Canvas content item to specified users, if the sender has necessary permissions and receiver IDs are valid.

tools.name: Create conversation
tools.description: Use to send messages in Canvas by creating a new conversation or adding to an existing one; an existing conversation with the same recipients (and matching scope/filter, if specified) may be reused unless `force_new` is true.

tools.name: Create conversation via GraphQL
tools.description: Tool to create a new conversation (message) between users in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when initiating a new conversation thread with specified recipients.

tools.name: Create a course
tools.description: Creates a new course in Canvas within a specified account, with comprehensive configuration options. Returns a course object including `id` (course_id); retain this for subsequent module, page, and upload calls.

tools.name: Create Course Grading Standard
tools.description: Tool to create a new grading standard in a Canvas course. Use when you need to define a custom grading scale with grade labels and percentage thresholds for a specific course.

tools.name: Create a custom gradebook column
tools.description: Creates a new custom gradebook column in a course. Use when you need to add custom tracking fields like participation scores or extra credit to the gradebook.

tools.name: Create discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new entry in a Canvas discussion topic. Use when posting a message with optional attachments to a discussion topic.

tools.name: Create discussion entry (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new entry in a Canvas discussion topic via GraphQL. Use when posting a message or reply to a discussion topic with optional file attachments.

tools.name: Create discussion topic
tools.description: Creates a new discussion topic in a specified Canvas course, allowing comprehensive configuration of its content, type, publication settings, engagement features, and associations.

tools.name: Create discussion topic (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new discussion topic in a course or group using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when creating discussion topics with the GraphQL interface.

tools.name: Create enrollment
tools.description: Enrolls a user in a Canvas course with a specified role and status; `associated_user_id` is required if `enrollment_type` is 'ObserverEnrollment'.

tools.name: Create ePub export
tools.description: Tool to initiate an ePub export for a course. Use when you need to export course content in ePub format. Track progress using the Progress API URL returned in the response.

tools.name: Create External Feed
tools.description: Creates a new external RSS or Atom feed for a Canvas course. Use when you need to import external content into a course feed.

tools.name: Create External Feed for Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new external RSS or Atom feed for a Canvas group. Use when you need to import external content into a group feed.

tools.name: Create external tool
tools.description: Tool to create an external tool in a Canvas account. Use when you need to integrate an LTI tool or external application. If a client_id is supplied, Canvas will attempt to create a context external tool using the LTI 1.3 standard.

tools.name: Create external tool in course
tools.description: Tool to create an external tool in the specified course. Use when you need to integrate an LTI tool or external application within a course context. If a client_id is supplied, Canvas will attempt to create a context external tool using the LTI 1.3 standard.

tools.name: Create Files
tools.description: Tool to initiate file upload to Canvas (Step 1 of 3-step process). Use when you need to upload a file to a course, user folder, group, or account. This action returns upload_url and upload_params needed for the actual file upload. After calling this, POST the file data to the upload_url with the returned parameters, then follow any redirect to complete the upload.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Tool to create a folder in the specified context. Use when you need to create a new folder for organizing files in Canvas for a user.

tools.name: Create Folder in Group
tools.description: Tool to create a folder within a Canvas group. Use when you need to organize files in a group context.

tools.name: Create a group
tools.description: Tool to create a new community group directly. Use when you need to create a group without specifying a group category. Groups created using this endpoint will be community groups.

tools.name: Create a group category in a course
tools.description: Creates a new group category within a specified Canvas course. Use when you need to organize student groups for projects, study sessions, or collaborative activities within a course.

tools.name: Create a content migration for group
tools.description: Tool to create a content migration in a Canvas group. Use when you need to import content into a group from various sources. If the migration requires a file upload, the actual processing starts once the file upload completes.

tools.name: Create group discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to create a new discussion topic in a Canvas group. Use when creating a discussion for group collaboration or communication.

tools.name: Create group in set
tools.description: Tool to create a new group within a Canvas group set. Use when adding a new group to an existing group category.

tools.name: Create a group set
tools.description: Tool to create a new group set (group category) in a Canvas course or account. Use when organizing students into project teams or study groups.

tools.name: Create Learning Outcome
tools.description: Tool to create a new learning outcome in Canvas using GraphQL. Use when you need to define a new learning objective or competency within an outcome group.

tools.name: Create/Link an outcome in course
tools.description: Tool to link an existing outcome or create a new outcome within a course outcome group. Use when associating outcomes with outcome groups in a Canvas course context. If outcome_id is provided, links the existing outcome; otherwise creates a new outcome with the provided details (title, description, ratings, mastery_points).

tools.name: Create an LTI resource link
tools.description: Creates a new LTI Resource Link in a Canvas course. Use when integrating LTI 1.3 external tools that can be launched or embedded in rich content.

tools.name: Create a membership
tools.description: Tool to join or request to join a group, depending on the join level of the group. Use when you need to add a user to a Canvas group. If the membership or join request already exists, it is simply returned.

tools.name: Create Module
tools.description: Creates a new organizational module within a specified Canvas LMS course, with options for availability, sequencing, and prerequisites.

tools.name: Create module (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new module in a Canvas course via GraphQL. Use when creating a module with basic settings (name) through the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Create Module Item
tools.description: Create and return a new module item within a Canvas course module. Use when you need to add content (assignments, pages, quizzes, files, discussions, external links, or subheaders) to an existing module.

tools.name: Create or Update Timetable Events
tools.description: Tool to create or update timetable events for a course or course section. Use when you need to set up a complete schedule of events directly, rather than generating them from a timetable pattern. If a code is provided for an event, existing events with that code will be updated; otherwise, new events are created.

tools.name: Create a page for a course
tools.description: Creates a new wiki page in a specified Canvas course, with options for title, HTML body, editing permissions, publication, and designation as front page (which also requires publication).

tools.name: Create a page for a group
tools.description: Creates a new wiki page in a specified Canvas group. Use when you need to create documentation, notes, or collaborative content for a group.

tools.name: Create a planner note
tools.description: Create a planner note for the current user. Use when adding a personal to-do item or reminder to the Canvas planner.

tools.name: Create a planner override
tools.description: Tool to create a planner override for the current user. Use when marking planner items as complete or dismissing them from the opportunities list.

tools.name: Create Question Group
tools.description: Tool to create one or more question groups for a quiz. Use when you need to organize quiz questions into groups for random selection.

tools.name: Create Quiz
tools.description: Creates a new quiz with various settings in a specified existing Canvas course; `assignment_group_id` applies only to graded quiz types.

tools.name: Create a quiz question
tools.description: Creates a new question for an existing quiz within a course; if `answers` are provided, their structure must align with `question_type`, and any `quiz_group_id` must be valid for an existing group in the quiz.

tools.name: Create Quiz Report
tools.description: Tool to create a quiz report in Canvas. Generates either a student analysis or item analysis report for a quiz. If a matching report already exists and is current, it will be returned instead.

tools.name: Create quiz submission (start quiz)
tools.description: Tool to start taking a quiz by creating a quiz submission. Use when a student needs to begin a quiz-taking session. Returns the quiz submission with workflow_state indicating the session status (e.g., 'preview' for teacher previews).

tools.name: Create Rubric
tools.description: Tool to create a rubric in a Canvas course. Use when you need structured assessment criteria and optional association after confirming course context.

tools.name: Create Single Poll
tools.description: Tool to create a new poll for the current user in Canvas. Use when you need to create a poll with a question and optional description.

tools.name: Create a single poll choice
tools.description: Tool to create one or more poll choices for an existing poll in Canvas. Use when you need to add answer options to a poll.

tools.name: Create Single Poll Session
tools.description: Tool to create a new poll session for a poll in Canvas. Use when you need to create a poll session associated with a specific course or course section.

tools.name: Create a single poll submission
tools.description: Tool to create a new poll submission for a poll session. Use when submitting a user's choice(s) for an active poll. The poll session must be published before submissions can be created.

tools.name: Create Subgroup in Course
tools.description: Creates a new empty subgroup under the outcome group with the given title and description. Use when you need to add a new subgroup to organize outcomes within a course's outcome group hierarchy.

tools.name: Create submission draft
tools.description: Tool to create a draft submission for an assignment in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when a student needs to save work in progress before final submission, or when pre-populating submission content.

tools.name: Create user inbox label
tools.description: Tool to create new user inbox labels in Canvas. Use when organizing inbox messages with custom labels.

tools.name: Create Users Custom Data
tools.description: Tool to create or update custom data for a Canvas user within a specified namespace. Use when you need to store application-specific JSON data for a user. The namespace parameter (ns) is required to prevent data collisions between different applications.

tools.name: Create User Token
tools.description: Tool to create a new access token for a Canvas user. Use when you need to generate an API access token for authentication purposes.

tools.name: Delete an access token
tools.description: Tool to delete an access token for a Canvas user. Use when you need to revoke or remove an API access token. The ID can be the actual database ID of the token, or the 'token_hint' value.

tools.name: Delete messages from conversation
tools.description: Tool to delete messages from a Canvas conversation. Note that this only affects this user's view of the conversation. If all messages are deleted, the conversation will be removed as well.

tools.name: Delete a discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a discussion entry. The entry must have been created by the current user, or the current user must have admin rights to the discussion. Use when removing an entry from a discussion topic. The entry will be marked deleted, and user_id and message will be cleared.

tools.name: Delete a group discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a discussion entry in a group discussion. The entry must have been created by the current user, or the current user must have admin rights to the discussion. Use when removing an entry from a group discussion topic. The entry will be marked deleted, and user_id and message will be cleared.

tools.name: Delete an external tool
tools.description: Remove the specified external tool from a course. Use when you need to delete an external tool integration.

tools.name: Delete an outcome group (courses)
tools.description: Deletes an outcome group from a course. Deleting an outcome group also deletes all descendant outcome groups and outcome links. Linked outcomes are only deleted if all links to the outcome were deleted. Aligned outcomes cannot be deleted; if all remaining links to an aligned outcome are in this group's descendants, the deletion will fail.

tools.name: Delete appointment group
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing appointment group by its ID; associated appointments may also be canceled or affected.

tools.name: Delete an assignment
tools.description: Soft-deletes a specific assignment within a course, returning the assignment object with its `workflow_state` updated to 'deleted'.

tools.name: Delete assignment override
tools.description: Deletes an assignment override and returns its former details. Use when you need to remove date exceptions or special accommodations that were previously set for specific students, groups, or sections.

tools.name: Delete blackout date
tools.description: Tool to delete a blackout date for the given course context. Use when you need to remove a previously scheduled blackout period.

tools.name: Delete bookmark
tools.description: Deletes a bookmark from the current user's bookmarks. Use when you need to remove a saved bookmark.

tools.name: Delete a calendar event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event from Canvas and return the deleted event details. Use when you need to remove a calendar event, optionally providing a cancellation reason for participants.

tools.name: Delete comment bank item
tools.description: Tool to delete a comment bank item from Canvas. Use when you need to remove a previously saved grading comment that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete a communication channel
tools.description: Deletes an existing communication channel for a user. Use when you need to remove an email, SMS, or push notification channel from a user's account.

tools.name: Delete communication channel by type and address
tools.description: Deletes a communication channel by type and address. Use when you need to remove a specific email, SMS, or push notification channel from a user's account using the channel type and address instead of the channel ID.

tools.name: Delete conversation messages
tools.description: Tool to delete specific messages from a Canvas conversation. Use when you need to remove one or more messages from a conversation thread by their message IDs.

tools.name: Delete conversations
tools.description: Tool to delete one or more Canvas conversations. Use when permanently removing conversation threads. Returns the deleted conversation IDs on success.

tools.name: Delete custom data
tools.description: Tool to delete custom user data for a given namespace. Use when you need to remove arbitrary JSON data stored for a user in a specific namespace. Without a scope parameter, all custom data in the namespace is deleted.

tools.name: Delete a custom gradebook column
tools.description: Permanently deletes a custom gradebook column and its associated data from a course. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete custom grade status
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom grade status from Canvas. Use when removing a custom grade status that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a discussion entry. Use when removing an entry from a discussion. Returns the deleted entry details.

tools.name: Delete discussion topic (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to delete a discussion topic in Canvas via GraphQL. Returns the deleted discussion topic ID upon successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete external feed from group
tools.description: Deletes the external feed from the specified group. Use when removing an RSS/Atom feed that was previously configured for the group.

tools.name: Delete file
tools.description: Tool to remove a file from Canvas. Use when comprehensive, irretrievable destruction of the file is needed. Set `replace` to true to destroy file previews and replace contents with a placeholder (requires special permissions).

tools.name: Delete a folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing folder specified by its unique ID.

tools.name: Delete a group
tools.description: Deletes a group and removes all members. Use when you need to permanently delete a Canvas group by its ID.

tools.name: Delete group discussion topic
tools.description: Deletes the discussion topic from a group. This will also delete the assignment, if it's an assignment discussion.

tools.name: Delete outcome links
tools.description: Tool to delete links between outcomes and content in Canvas. Use when removing outcome associations from course content.

tools.name: Delete page for a group
tools.description: Deletes a wiki page from a Canvas group. Use when you need to remove a specific page from a group's wiki.

tools.name: Delete a planner note
tools.description: Delete a planner note for the current user. Use when removing a personal to-do item from the Canvas planner.

tools.name: Delete a planner override
tools.description: Delete a planner override for the current user. Use when removing customizations or dismissals from planner items.

tools.name: Delete poll
tools.description: Permanently deletes the poll identified by `id`; returns 204 No Content if successful.

tools.name: Delete a poll choice
tools.description: Tool to delete a poll choice from a Canvas poll. Use when you need to remove a specific choice option from an existing poll. Returns a 204 No Content response if the deletion was successful.

tools.name: Delete a poll session
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a poll session from a poll. Use when you need to remove a poll session. Returns a 204 No Content response on successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete quiz
tools.description: Permanently deletes the quiz identified by `quiz_id` from the course identified by `course_id`; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete submission draft
tools.description: Tool to delete a submission draft in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when removing a draft submission that has not been finalized.

tools.name: Delete user inbox label
tools.description: Tool to delete user inbox labels in Canvas. Use when you need to remove one or more custom inbox labels from the current user's inbox.

tools.name: Delete user custom data scope
tools.description: Tool to delete custom user data at a specific scope path. Use when you need to remove data stored at a particular location within the JSON structure for a user's custom data namespace.

tools.name: Get current grades
tools.description: Fetches current, aggregated grade data from Canvas analytics for a specified account ID.

tools.name: Get term grade data
tools.description: Retrieves department-level aggregated grade data for a specific academic term within a Canvas account.

tools.name: Post discussion entry or reply
tools.description: Posts a new entry or reply to a Canvas discussion topic. Creates either a top-level entry (when entry_id is omitted) or a nested reply to an existing entry (when entry_id is provided). The entry is posted immediately and becomes visible to discussion participants.

tools.name: Duplicate group discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an existing discussion topic in a Canvas group. Use when you need to create a copy of a group discussion topic with all its settings and content.

tools.name: Edit assignment
tools.description: Updates an existing assignment in a Canvas course (identified by `course_id` and `assignment_id`); only attributes explicitly provided in the request are modified.

tools.name: Edit a conversation
tools.description: Tool to update attributes for a single conversation in Canvas. Use when you need to star/unstar, subscribe/unsubscribe, or change the workflow state (read, unread, archived) of a specific conversation.

tools.name: Edit a quiz
tools.description: Modifies an existing Canvas quiz; only attributes with provided values in the request are updated.

tools.name: Edit User
tools.description: Modifies an existing Canvas user's profile and settings. Use to update name, email, timezone, bio, pronouns, and other profile fields. To modify login credentials, use the logins API instead.

tools.name: Export content
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous export of course content from Canvas. Returns an export job ID and progress URL that can be used to track the export status and retrieve the exported file once complete. Supports exporting full courses (Common Cartridge), quizzes (QTI), or files (ZIP).

tools.name: Export group content
tools.description: Tool to begin a content export job for a group. Groups only support ZIP format exports of files and folders. Returns an export job with a progress_url to track the export status using the Progress API. Once complete, the exported file can be downloaded via the attachment URL.

tools.name: Export user content
tools.description: Tool to begin a content export job for a user. Use when you need to export user content from Canvas in Common Cartridge, QTI, or ZIP format. Track progress using the Progress API via the progress_url returned in the response. Once complete, download the exported file via the attachment URL.

tools.name: Fetch Data
tools.description: Fetches a specific category of Canvas data (e.g., accounts, courses, users) by setting exactly one `get_*` boolean flag to true and providing any associated IDs. Supports pagination with per_page (default 100, max 100) and page (default 1) parameters to fetch large datasets.

tools.name: Find recipients
tools.description: Find valid recipients (users, courses and groups) that the current user can send messages to. Use when searching for message recipients or looking up specific users/contexts by id.

tools.name: Get a single course from account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on a single course from a Canvas account. Use when you need to get detailed course information including optional data like teachers, term, permissions, or course progress.

tools.name: Get account (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account information by ID or SIS ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch account details via GraphQL interface.

tools.name: Get Account Notifications
tools.description: Tool to retrieve global account notifications for the current user in Canvas LMS. Use when you need to check announcements, alerts, or system-wide messages that admins have posted to the account.

tools.name: Get accounts outcome groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific outcome group from a Canvas account. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific outcome group including its title, description, parent group, and management URLs.

tools.name: Get Accounts That Users Can Create Courses In
tools.description: Retrieves Canvas accounts where the current user has permission to create courses; typically returns results only for administrators.

tools.name: Get a content migration for group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data on an individual content migration from a Canvas group. Use when you need to check the status, progress, or details of a specific group migration.

tools.name: Get a content migration for user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data on an individual content migration from a Canvas user. Use when you need to check the status, progress, or details of a specific user migration.

tools.name: Get a late policy
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the late policy for a Canvas course. Use when you need to check the course's policy for handling late and missing submissions.

tools.name: Get aligned assignments for an outcome
tools.description: Retrieves outcome alignments for a student or assignment within a course. Use when you need to see which assignments are aligned to learning outcomes, optionally filtered by student or assignment.

tools.name: Get assignments for a specific course (requires course_id)
tools.description: Retrieves assignments for a specific Canvas course. IMPORTANT: This action requires a course_id parameter - it does NOT retrieve assignments globally across all courses. You must first obtain a valid course_id (e.g., from CANVAS_LIST_COURSES) and provide it to retrieve that course's assignments. Results may be nested under a `response_data` array; inspect the JSON structure before iterating. `due_at` values are ISO 8601 strings in UTC. Filter on `published`, `locked_for_user`, and `has_submitted_submissions` fields to identify actionable assignments.

tools.name: Get All ePortfolios for User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ePortfolios for a specified user from Canvas LMS. Use when you need to list a user's ePortfolio collection.

tools.name: Get All Outcome Groups for Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all outcome groups for an account context in Canvas. Use when you need to list learning outcome groups.

tools.name: Get all outcome groups for course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all outcome groups for a course context in Canvas. Use when you need to list learning outcome groups for a specific course.

tools.name: Get All Outcome Links for Context
tools.description: Retrieves all outcome links for a Canvas account context. Use when you need to fetch the relationships between outcomes and outcome groups within an account.

tools.name: Get All Outcome Links for Context (Courses)
tools.description: Retrieves all outcome links for a Canvas course context. Use when you need to fetch the relationships between outcomes and outcome groups within a course.

tools.name: Get all peer reviews for submission
tools.description: Retrieves all peer reviews for a specific submission within a Canvas assignment. Use when you need to view peer reviewers assigned to a student's submission.

tools.name: Get all peer reviews for section assignment
tools.description: Retrieves all peer reviews for a specific assignment within a Canvas section. Use when you need to view all peer review assignments for an entire section's assignment.

tools.name: Get all peer reviews for section submission
tools.description: Retrieves all peer reviews for a specific submission within a Canvas section assignment. Use when you need to view peer reviewers assigned to a student's submission in a specific section.

tools.name: Get all users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users for a specified Canvas `account_id` (use 'self' for the current user's root account), supporting filtering, sorting, and pagination.

tools.name: Get an assignment group
tools.description: Retrieves the assignment group with the given id from a Canvas course. Use when you need to get details about a specific assignment group, including its name, position, weight, and optionally associated assignments.

tools.name: Get notification preference
tools.description: Fetches the notification preference for a specific notification on a given communication channel. Use to check how often a user wants to receive a particular type of notification.

tools.name: Get notification preference by type and address
tools.description: Fetches the notification preference for a specific notification on a given communication channel using channel type and address. Use when you need to check how often a user receives notifications for a particular event type on a specific communication channel.

tools.name: Get a single external tool
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific external tool within a Canvas course. Use when you need to get configuration details, settings, or metadata for an external tool in a course context.

tools.name: Get a single group membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single group membership by its membership_id or user_id. Use when you need to check membership status, moderator privileges, or workflow state for a specific user in a group.

tools.name: Get a single group membership by user ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single group membership by user_id. Use when you need to check membership status, moderator privileges, or workflow state for a specific user in a group.

tools.name: Get assignment (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific assignment by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Returns assignment details including submissions connection.

tools.name: Get assignment group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific assignment group by ID. Use when you need to fetch details about an assignment group including its name, position, weight, and state.

tools.name: Get Assignment Rubric
tools.description: Fetches the detailed rubric for a specified assignment within a Canvas course; returns has_rubric=false if the assignment has no associated rubric.

tools.name: Get Audit Logs
tools.description: Tool to access Canvas audit logs for a specified asset using the GraphQL API. Use when retrieving mutation logs to track changes and operations performed on accounts, courses, or users.

tools.name: Get a user's most recently graded submissions
tools.description: Retrieves a user's most recently graded submissions. Use 'self' as the user ID to get graded submissions for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get Authentication Provider
tools.description: Retrieves a specific authentication provider configuration for a Canvas account. Use when you need to view the configuration details of a specific authentication provider.

tools.name: Get Bookmark
tools.description: Retrieves the details for a specific bookmark by ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular bookmark for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get brand variables
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all brand configuration variables for the Canvas account. Use when you need to access theme colors, logos, watermarks, or other branding customization settings.

tools.name: Get content share
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a single content share by ID for a specified user. Use when you need to view the details of a specific shared content item.

tools.name: Get content shares unread count
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the count of unread content shares for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check how many content shares have not been read yet.

tools.name: Get course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific course by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when querying course details with either GraphQL or numeric identifiers.

tools.name: Get course activity stream
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current user's course-specific activity stream, paginated. Use when you need to see recent activities in a specific course such as new discussions, announcements, assignments, and submissions.

tools.name: Get course activity stream summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a summary of the current user's course-specific activity stream. Returns aggregated counts by activity type (discussions, conversations, messages, etc.) for the specified course. Use when you need an overview of activity in a specific course.

tools.name: Get Course Activity
tools.description: Retrieves daily activity analytics, such as page views and participation events, for a specified Canvas course.

tools.name: Get course nickname
tools.description: Retrieves the nickname for a specific Canvas course. Use when you need to get the user-defined alternate name for a course.

tools.name: Get Course Permissions
tools.description: Returns permission information for the calling user in the given course. Use when you need to check what actions the authenticated user is authorized to perform in a specific course.

tools.name: Batch retrieve assignment overrides
tools.description: Tool to batch retrieve assignment overrides in a course. Use when you need to retrieve multiple assignment overrides at once by providing paired lists of override IDs and assignment IDs. Returns null for overrides that were not found or target sections/groups/students not visible to the current user.

tools.name: Get Blueprint Subscription Migrations
tools.description: Retrieves blueprint subscription migrations for a Canvas course. Use when you need to list sync operations from a blueprint course to an associated course.

tools.name: Get course settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve settings for a specific Canvas course. Use when you need to check configuration options like student permissions, grading settings, or display preferences for a course.

tools.name: Get courses folders by path
tools.description: Tool to retrieve folder hierarchy by resolving a path within a Canvas course. Use when you need to traverse a folder path or verify a folder exists at a specific location.

tools.name: Get course root folder
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the root folder for a course. Use when you need to access the root folder from a course context by using 'root' as the folder identifier.

tools.name: Get courses (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to get all courses viewable by the current user using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when retrieving the list of courses accessible to the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get courses outcome groups
tools.description: Retrieves a specific outcome group for a course. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an outcome group.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated user from the Canvas LMS.

tools.name: Get Custom Color
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the custom color that a user has saved for a specific course or context in Canvas. Use when you need to fetch user-specific color preferences for a course or other context.

tools.name: Get Custom Colors
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom colors saved by a user in Canvas LMS. Use when you need to fetch color customizations for courses or other Canvas objects.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Positions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all dashboard positions saved for a user. Use when you need to see the current order of dashboard cards for a specific user.

tools.name: Get department-level completed statistics
tools.description: Retrieves department-level numeric statistics for all completed (concluded) courses within the default term for a specified Canvas account. Returns aggregate counts including courses, subaccounts, enrollments, discussion topics, media objects, attachments, and assignments. Note: Requires Canvas Analytics to be enabled on the instance.

tools.name: Get department level current statistics
tools.description: Fetches a snapshot of current numerical statistics for a Canvas account, requiring its valid ID.

tools.name: Get department level completed grades
tools.description: Retrieves the distribution of final grades (0-100, binned to whole numbers) for all completed courses in a Canvas account, where each data point represents one student's final grade in one course.

tools.name: Get department level term statistics
tools.description: Retrieves department-level statistics for a specific academic term, including counts of courses, teachers, students, discussion topics, media objects, attachments, and assignments. Requires the Canvas Analytics feature to be enabled.

tools.name: Get document annotations read state
tools.description: Retrieves the read state of document annotations for a student's submission. Use when checking if a student has viewed feedback annotations on their submitted document.

tools.name: Get enrollment by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific enrollment by its ID within a given account.

tools.name: Get Enrollment Invitations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve pending enrollment invitations for the current user. Use when you need to check course invitations that the user has not yet accepted or rejected.

tools.name: Get feature flag for account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific feature flag for a given Canvas account. The flag may be defined on the account, or it may be inherited from a parent account. Check context_id and context_type fields to determine the source; if these fields are missing, the flag represents the global Canvas default.

tools.name: Get feature flag for course
tools.description: Get the feature flag that applies to a given Course. The flag may be defined on the course, or it may be inherited from a parent account. Check the context_id and context_type of the returned object to determine which is the case.

tools.name: Get file
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed metadata for a specific Canvas file by its ID. Use when you need information about a single file including its name, size, content type, URLs, and optionally the user who uploaded it.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific folder within a Canvas course. Use 'root' as the folder ID to get the root folder for the course context.

tools.name: Get Folder By ID
tools.description: Retrieves the details for a specific folder by its ID. Use 'root' as the ID to get the root folder for a context.

tools.name: Get Full Topic for Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full cached structure of a group discussion topic. Use when you need all entries, their authors, and message bodies in a hierarchical format. Note: May require that the user has posted in the topic; if required and the user has not posted, will respond with 403 Forbidden.

tools.name: Get Global Outcome Group
tools.description: Retrieves a global outcome group by ID from Canvas. Use when you need to get details about a specific global learning outcome group.

tools.name: Get gradebook history days
tools.description: Retrieves a chronological list of dates with grading activity and the active graders for a specified course.

tools.name: Get a group
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single Canvas group by its ID. Use when you need to get information about a specific group including optional permissions and tab configurations.

tools.name: Get group activity stream
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current user's group-specific activity stream, paginated. Use when you need to see recent activities in a specific group such as new discussions, announcements, and other group-related activities.

tools.name: Get Group Activity Stream Summary
tools.description: Retrieves a summary of the current user's group-specific activity stream. Returns counts and unread counts for different activity types within the specified group.

tools.name: Get Group Folder
tools.description: Retrieves the details for a folder within a Canvas group. Use 'root' as the folder ID to get the root folder for the group context.

tools.name: Get Group Permissions
tools.description: Returns permission information for the calling user in the given group. Use when you need to check what actions the authenticated user is authorized to perform in a specific group.

tools.name: Get account help links
tools.description: Retrieves help links configured for the specified Canvas account. Use when you need to access help resources available to users in an account.

tools.name: Get Internal Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all internal settings from Canvas using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to query system-level configuration settings.

tools.name: Get Kaltura config
tools.description: Tool to return the config information for the Kaltura plugin in JSON format. Use when you need to check Kaltura integration status or retrieve Kaltura service endpoints.

tools.name: Get learning outcome
tools.description: Tool to retrieve learning outcome information by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific learning outcome including its title and description.

tools.name: Get learning outcome group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve learning outcome group information by ID via GraphQL. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific learning outcome group including its title and description.

tools.name: Get Legacy Node
tools.description: Tool to fetch Canvas objects using REST-style numeric identifiers via GraphQL. Use when you have a legacy numeric ID and need to retrieve the corresponding object data through the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Get manually-created courses sub-account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the manually-created courses sub-account for the domain root account. Use when you need to identify the sub-account that contains courses created manually (as opposed to SIS-imported courses).

tools.name: Get Module Item
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific module item by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when fetching details about a module item including its content, parent module, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Module Item Sequence
tools.description: Tool to find the module item sequence for a given asset in a Canvas course. Returns the current item, previous and next items in the sequence, and applicable mastery path rules. Use when you need to understand the navigation context of a course asset.

tools.name: Get my inbox settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve inbox settings for the current user in Canvas. Use when you need to check the authenticated user's signature settings or out-of-office configuration.

tools.name: Get next appointment
tools.description: Retrieves the next available appointment from Canvas appointment groups. Returns a single-element array if an appointment is available, or an empty array if none are available.

tools.name: Get node by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch Canvas objects by their GraphQL global identifier using the node query. Follows the Relay Object Identification spec and works for most Canvas object types including courses, users, assignments, and more.

tools.name: Get outcome calculation method
tools.description: Tool to retrieve outcome calculation method information by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch details about how outcomes are calculated for assessments.

tools.name: Get outcome proficiency (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve outcome proficiency information for an account using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch proficiency ratings and configuration for learning outcomes via GraphQL interface.

tools.name: Get outcome result rollups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve outcome result rollups for users and outcomes in a specified course context. Use when you need to analyze learning outcome performance data, either for individual users or as a course aggregate.

tools.name: Get Outcome Results
tools.description: Tool to get outcome results for users and outcomes in a course context. Use when you need to retrieve learning outcome assessment results for students.

tools.name: Get Page for a Course
tools.description: Retrieves a specific content page (wiki or content page) by its URL or numeric ID from a specified Canvas course.

tools.name: Get proficiency ratings for course
tools.description: Retrieves course-level proficiency ratings for learning outcomes. If not defined for the requested course, it will return proficiency ratings from the account or nearest super-account with ratings defined. Use when you need to view the performance level definitions used for grading outcomes in a specific course.

tools.name: Get public inline preview URL
tools.description: Tool to determine the URL for inline preview of a Canvas file. Use when you need to access the public URL of a file.

tools.name: Get a quiz report
tools.description: Retrieves the data for a single quiz report. Use when you need to check the status or download a previously generated quiz report.

tools.name: Get Quiz Statistics
tools.description: Tool to fetch the latest quiz statistics for a Canvas quiz. Use when you need statistical data about quiz submissions, including per-question metrics and aggregate submission statistics.

tools.name: Get quiz submissions
tools.description: Retrieves all submissions for a specific quiz within a course; ensure `course_id` and `quiz_id` are valid and the quiz belongs to the course.

tools.name: Get Quota Information
tools.description: Retrieves the total and used storage quota for a Canvas user. Use when you need to check storage space availability or usage.

tools.name: Get quota information for group
tools.description: Returns the total and used storage quota for the group. Use this to check available storage space and monitor usage for a specific group.

tools.name: Get report status
tools.description: Retrieves the status of a previously initiated report in a Canvas account, specified by its type and ID.

tools.name: Get Root Outcome Group for Course
tools.description: Retrieves the root outcome group for a specified course context. Use when you need to access the top-level outcome group hierarchy for a course.

tools.name: Get rubric
tools.description: Tool to retrieve rubric information by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch detailed rubric data including criteria, points, and configuration settings.

tools.name: Get Rubric Assessments Read State
tools.description: Tool to check whether new rubric comments/grading made on a submission have been seen by the student being assessed. Use when you need to verify if a student has reviewed their rubric feedback.

tools.name: Get Rubrics Upload Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a CSV template file for importing rubrics into Canvas. Use when you need the template format for bulk rubric imports.

tools.name: Get running batches
tools.description: Tool to retrieve any currently running conversation batches for the current user. Use when checking the status of bulk private messages that were sent asynchronously.

tools.name: Get section information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Canvas section within a course. Use when you need section details including optional student lists, enrollment data, or permissions.

tools.name: Get section information by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Canvas section by section ID alone. Use when you have the section ID but not the course ID, or when you need section details with optional student lists, enrollment data, or permissions.

tools.name: Get section assignment submission summary
tools.description: Retrieves submission summary counts for a specific assignment within a section. Returns the number of submissions categorized as graded, ungraded, and not submitted based on gradeable students in the section.

tools.name: Get sessionless launch URL for external tool
tools.description: Returns a sessionless launch URL for an external tool in Canvas. Prefers the resource_link_lookup_uuid parameter, but defaults to id, url, or launch_type if not provided. Use when you need to generate a launch URL for an external tool without requiring a user session.

tools.name: Get sessionless launch URL for external tool in course
tools.description: Returns a sessionless launch URL for an external tool in a Canvas course. Prefers the resource_link_lookup_uuid parameter, but defaults to id, url, or launch_type if not provided. Use when you need to generate a launch URL for an external tool in a specific course without requiring a user session.

tools.name: Get a single account
tools.description: Retrieve information on an individual account by ID or SIS account ID. Use when you need detailed account information for a specific account.

tools.name: Get a single assignment override
tools.description: Retrieves details of the assignment override with the given id for a specific assignment in a course.

tools.name: Get single calendar event
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single calendar event or assignment by ID from Canvas. Use when you need detailed information about a specific calendar item.

tools.name: Get a single conversation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a single conversation including all messages and extended participant information. Use when you need complete conversation data beyond what's available in list responses.

tools.name: Get a single course
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Canvas course using its `course_id`, which must be valid, and allows for including additional data fields in the response via the `include` parameter. Concluded or unpublished courses may have restricted visibility depending on the caller's role; include 'concluded' in `include` to retrieve richer metadata for such courses.

tools.name: Get a single external tool
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific external tool within a Canvas account. Use when you need to get configuration details, settings, or metadata for an external tool.

tools.name: Get a single grading standard in course context
tools.description: Retrieves a single grading standard for the given course context that is visible to the user. Use when you need to view the complete configuration and grading scheme of a specific grading standard within a course.

tools.name: Get a single poll
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single poll by its ID from Canvas. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific poll including its question, description, creation time, and aggregated results.

tools.name: Get a single poll choice
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single poll choice by its ID from a Canvas poll. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific poll choice option including its text, position, and correctness status.

tools.name: Get a single quiz
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific quiz in a Canvas course. Use when you need to view quiz settings, questions count, due dates, or other quiz metadata.

tools.name: Get single quiz submission
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single quiz submission by ID. Use when you need details about a specific student's quiz attempt. Returns submission status, score, timing, and optionally related assignment, quiz, or user data.

tools.name: Get single submission
tools.description: Retrieves a specific submission for an assignment made by a particular user within a designated course.

tools.name: Get single submission by section
tools.description: Retrieves a specific submission for an assignment made by a particular user within a designated section. Use when you have section_id instead of course_id.

tools.name: Get a single discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single discussion topic in a Canvas course. Use when you need to fetch data for a specific discussion topic by its ID.

tools.name: Get a single group discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a single discussion topic within a Canvas group. Use when you need to fetch data for a specific discussion topic by its ID from a group context.

tools.name: Get Single User
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a single user in a Canvas course. Accepts the same include[] parameters as the list users endpoint and returns a single user with the same fields.

tools.name: Get Status of Last Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status of the last generated report for a specific course in Canvas. Use when you need to check the completion status, download URL, or progress of a course report.

tools.name: Get sub-accounts of an account
tools.description: List accounts that are sub-accounts of the given account. Use when you need to retrieve the organizational hierarchy of Canvas accounts.

tools.name: Get submission
tools.description: Tool to retrieve submission information by ID using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch submission details including state, attempt number, and associated user/assignment data.

tools.name: Get assignment submission summary
tools.description: Retrieves submission summary counts for a specific assignment. Returns the number of submissions categorized as graded, ungraded, and not submitted based on gradeable students.

tools.name: Get terms of service
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the terms of service for a Canvas account. Use when you need to access the terms of service content, acceptance requirements, or registration settings for an account.

tools.name: Get quiz submission
tools.description: Tool to get the quiz submission for the current user in a specific quiz. Use when you need to retrieve submission details for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get Unread Count
tools.description: Tool to get the number of unread conversations for the current user. Use when you need to check how many unread conversations the authenticated user has.

tools.name: Get uploaded media folder for user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the details for a designated upload folder that the user has rights to upload media to, creating it if it doesn't exist. Use when you need to access or manage the media upload folder for a specific course.

tools.name: Get uploaded media folder for user (groups)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the details for a designated upload folder that the user has rights to upload media to within a group, creating it if it doesn't exist. Use when you need to access or manage the media upload folder for a specific group.

tools.name: Get user activity stream summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a summary of the current user's global activity stream. Returns aggregated counts by activity type (discussions, conversations, messages, etc.) across all courses. Use when you need an overview of the user's activity across their entire Canvas account.

tools.name: Get user assignment analytics
tools.description: Fetches detailed assignment-level analytics for a specific student in a designated course, including submission details and class performance statistics.

tools.name: Get User Avatars
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available avatar options for a Canvas user. Use when you need to list all avatar choices for a user, including uploaded images and default options.

tools.name: Get user content export
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific content export job for a user. Use when you need to check the status of a user's export and get the download URL when the export completes.

tools.name: Get user course progress
tools.description: Retrieves the academic progress of a specific user within a given course.

tools.name: Get user file
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed metadata for a specific file owned by a user. Use when you need information about a file in a user's context, including its name, size, content type, URLs, and optionally the user who uploaded it.

tools.name: Get user folder
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific folder in a user's Canvas file space. Use 'root' as the folder ID to get the root folder, or 'self' as user_id for the current authenticated user.

tools.name: Get user migration issue
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific migration issue for a user in Canvas. Use when you need to investigate issues that occurred during a user's content migration process.

tools.name: Get user participation analytics
tools.description: Retrieves page view activity and participation details for a specific student enrolled in a designated course.

tools.name: Get User Profile
tools.description: Retrieves profile information for an existing Canvas user.

tools.name: Get Users Custom Data Scope
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom data stored for a Canvas user within a specified namespace and optional scope. Use when you need to fetch application-specific data that was previously stored for a user. The namespace parameter (ns) is required to prevent data collisions between different applications.

tools.name: Get users self files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all files for the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to list files in the user's personal file storage. Supports filtering by content type, searching by filename, and sorting options.

tools.name: Get User Token
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific access token for a Canvas user. Use when you need to inspect token properties like expiration, scopes, or workflow state.

tools.name: Get visible course navigation tools
tools.description: Tool to get external tools with course_navigation placement that are visible to the requesting user. Use when you need to see which external tools appear in the course navigation menu for one or more courses.

tools.name: Get visible course navigation tools
tools.description: Retrieves external tools with course_navigation placement that are visible in the course navigation for a specific course. Use when you need to see which external tools appear in the course navigation menu for a given course.

tools.name: Grade or comment on a submission
tools.description: Updates a student's assignment submission with a grade, comment, sticker, or status change; requires `course_id`, `assignment_id`, `user_id`, and at least one update field. Rubric assessments are not supported and require a separate Canvas API call.

tools.name: Grade or comment on submission (sections)
tools.description: Update grades and/or add comments to a student's assignment submission. Use when you need to provide feedback or scoring. Requires permission to manage grades when updating grades or rubric assessments.

tools.name: Hide all stream items
tools.description: Tool to hide all activity stream items for the current user. Use when the user wants to clear their entire activity stream.

tools.name: Hide assignment grades for sections
tools.description: Tool to hide assignment grades for specific sections in Canvas. Use when you need to conceal grades from students in particular course sections, typically during grading periods or before releasing final grades.

tools.name: Hide stream item
tools.description: Tool to hide a stream item from the user's activity stream. Use when you want to remove a specific activity item from view.

tools.name: Import an outcome group (courses)
tools.description: Tool to import an outcome group into a Canvas course. Creates a new subgroup with the same title and description as the source, then creates links to the same outcomes and recursively imports subgroups. Use when duplicating outcome groups within or across courses. Set async=true for large imports to track progress.

tools.name: Invite others to a group
tools.description: Tool to send invitations to all supplied email addresses which will allow the receivers to join the group. Use when you need to add new members to a Canvas group via email invitation.

tools.name: Leave a group
tools.description: Tool to leave a group by removing the specified membership. Use when you need to remove a user from a group they are allowed to leave. Note: Some groups, such as sets of course groups created by teachers, cannot be left.

tools.name: Leave group
tools.description: Tool to leave a group if allowed. Use when a user needs to exit a group membership. Note that some groups, such as course groups created by teachers, cannot be left by members.

tools.name: List account notifications
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all active global notifications for a Canvas account. Use when you need to check current announcements for the user. Closed notifications are excluded unless include_past is specified.

tools.name: List Accounts for Course Admins
tools.description: Retrieves Canvas accounts visible to the current user due to their course-level administrative roles; no request parameters are needed.

tools.name: List the activity stream
tools.description: Retrieves the current user's global activity stream from Canvas, paginated. Returns recent activities across courses including discussions, conversations, messages, submissions, conferences, and announcements. Use to display user's recent Canvas activity or notifications.

tools.name: List all courses (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all courses that the user is enrolled in using the Canvas GraphQL API. Returns information about courses on the user's dashboard.

tools.name: List all folders
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of all folders for a specified Canvas course. Returns a flat list containing the root folder and all nested subfolders. This action is scoped to courses only.

tools.name: List all folders for group
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of all folders for a specified Canvas group. Returns a flat list containing the root folder and all nested subfolders.

tools.name: List all folders for user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of all folders for a specified Canvas user. Returns a flat list containing the root folder and all nested subfolders. Use when you need to access or browse a user's folder structure.

tools.name: List Announcements
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated list of announcements for specified courses and date range. Use when you need to fetch course announcements with optional filtering by dates and inclusion of additional context.

tools.name: List appointment groups
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Canvas appointment groups based on specified filters; any provided `context_codes` must be valid and accessible by the user.

tools.name: List assignment groups
tools.description: Returns the paginated list of assignment groups for the current context. Use when you need to retrieve assignment groups for a course. The returned groups are sorted by their position field.

tools.name: List assignment overrides
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of overrides for an assignment. Use when you need to see which sections, groups, or students have custom due dates or availability settings for a specific assignment.

tools.name: List assignments for assignment group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of assignments for a specific assignment group within a course. Use when you need assignments grouped by assignment group rather than all assignments for a course.

tools.name: List assignments for user in course
tools.description: Tool to list assignments for a specific user in a Canvas course. Use when you need to retrieve assignments visible to a particular user, with optional filtering by due date, submission status, or search term. This endpoint respects user permissions and returns only assignments the specified user has rights to view.

tools.name: List assignment submissions
tools.description: Retrieves submissions for a specific assignment within a course, optionally including related resources or grouping by student group for group assignments. Supports pagination to retrieve more than the default 10 submissions.

tools.name: List assignment submissions by section
tools.description: Tool to list all submissions for an assignment within a specific section. Use when you need to retrieve submissions for a section-level assignment rather than a course-level assignment.

tools.name: List Authentication Events for User
tools.description: Tool to list authentication events (logins and logouts) for a given user from Canvas LMS audit logs. Use when you need to track user authentication activity or investigate login/logout history. Events are stored for one year and returned in descending chronological order.

tools.name: List available account calendars
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of account calendars available to the current user. Includes visible account calendars where the user has an account association.

tools.name: List Available Reports
tools.description: Lists available reports (including those that can be or have been generated) for a valid Canvas account ID.

tools.name: List Available Tabs for a Course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve navigation tabs for a Canvas course. Use when you need to see available navigation options for a specific course.

tools.name: List Available Tabs for a Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve navigation tabs for a Canvas group. Use when you need to see available navigation options for a specific group.

tools.name: List Available Tabs for User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of navigation tabs available in a user context. Use when you need to discover what tabs (like Home, Assignments, Grades, etc.) are accessible for a specific user.

tools.name: List blackout dates for account
tools.description: Retrieves the list of blackout dates for a Canvas account context. Blackout dates prevent scheduling assignments on specific dates in course pacing.

tools.name: List Blueprint Imports
tools.description: Tool to list blueprint migrations imported into a course associated with a blueprint. Use when you need to see a paginated list of sync operations from a blueprint course to an associated course, starting with the most recent.

tools.name: List Bookmarks
tools.description: Returns the paginated list of bookmarks for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve all bookmarks saved by the current user.

tools.name: List calendar events for current user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of calendar events or assignments for the current user. Use when you need to fetch upcoming events, assignments, or both with various filtering options like date ranges, context codes, and event types.

tools.name: List calendar events for a user
tools.description: Retrieves calendar events and assignments for a specific user from Canvas LMS, supporting extensive filtering options detailed in the request schema. Returned due_at values are ISO 8601 UTC; convert to user's local timezone before display. For pending task identification, exclude items where locked_for_user is true or has_submitted_submissions is true. Results may be incomplete even when assignments exist; do not use as the sole source for pending task lists.

tools.name: List Enabled Features for a User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of enabled feature names for a Canvas user. Use when you need to check which optional features are currently active for a specific user.

tools.name: List external tools for course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of external tools for a course. Use when you need to discover LTI tools available in a course context.

tools.name: List closed poll sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all closed poll sessions available to the current user. Use when you need to see which poll sessions have been closed and their results.

tools.name: List communication messages
tools.description: Retrieves communication messages from Canvas.

tools.name: List communication channels
tools.description: Retrieves a list of communication channels associated with a specific user in Canvas.

tools.name: List Conferences for Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of conferences for all courses and groups the current user belongs to. Use when you need to get conferences for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List content exports
tools.description: Lists all content export jobs for a course. Content exports are snapshots of course content that can be downloaded as Common Cartridge (IMSCC), QTI, or ZIP files. Returns exports in reverse chronological order (newest first), including their status, type, and download URLs when available.

tools.name: List content exports for groups
tools.description: Lists all content export jobs for a group. Content exports are snapshots of group content that can be downloaded as Common Cartridge (IMSCC), QTI, or ZIP files. Returns exports in reverse chronological order (newest first), including their status, type, and download URLs when available.

tools.name: List content licenses for a course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of content licenses that can be applied to course content in Canvas. Use when you need to know what license options are available for a specific course.

tools.name: List content migrations for user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated content migrations for a specified user in Canvas. Use when you need to view the list of content migration operations initiated by or for a user.

tools.name: List content migrations for groups
tools.description: Lists all content migrations for a group. Content migrations allow importing group content from various sources like Common Cartridge files or external systems. Returns migrations with their current status, progress URLs, and any associated files or issues.

tools.name: List Conversations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of conversations for the current user, most recent ones first. Use when you need to fetch user conversations with optional filtering by scope (unread, starred, archived, sent) and context (courses, groups, users).

tools.name: List counts for todo items
tools.description: Get counts of different todo items for the current user, including assignments needing grading and assignments needing submitting. Note: Only counts the first 100 todo items.

tools.name: List blackout dates for course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of blackout dates for a Canvas course. Use when you need to check which dates are blocked for assignments in course pacing.

tools.name: List Course Nicknames
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all course nicknames set by the current user. Use when you need to see all custom course name preferences.

tools.name: List courses
tools.description: Retrieves a list of the current user's courses from Canvas, optionally filtered by enrollment type and state. Excessive request frequency may return HTTP 429; respect the Retry-After header before retrying.

tools.name: List course sections
