tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of sections for a specific course. Use when you need to get all sections or search for specific sections within a course.

tools.name: List Courses for a User
tools.description: Retrieves a list of courses in Canvas for a specified `user_id`, requiring observer or admin permissions to view courses for others.

tools.name: List Course Subgroups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of immediate OutcomeGroup children of an outcome group in a course. Use when you need to explore the hierarchical structure of learning outcomes within a specific course.

tools.name: List courses with their latest ePub export
tools.description: Tool to list all courses a user is actively participating in and their latest ePub exports. Use when you need to see which courses have been exported and their export status.

tools.name: List Course TODO Items
tools.description: Returns the current user's course-specific todo items. Use this to get assignments that need grading or submission for a specific course. For full documentation, see the API documentation for user todo items in the Users API.

tools.name: List Course Users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users for a given Canvas `course_id` (which must be an existing course), supporting various filtering, sorting, and data inclusion options.

tools.name: List custom gradebook columns
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of all custom gradebook columns for a course. Use when you need to retrieve custom columns that instructors have added to the gradebook.

tools.name: List Discussion Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated discussion entries for a specific discussion topic in a course. Use when needing to list all posts and replies under a given topic, supports pagination.

tools.name: List Discussion Entry List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of discussion entries by their ids from a group discussion topic. Use when needing to fetch specific entries given their identifiers. May require that the user has posted in the topic; if required and user has not posted, returns 403 Forbidden with body 'require_initial_post'.

tools.name: List Discussion Topics
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of discussion topics or announcements for a specified course.

tools.name: List discussion topics for group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of discussion topics for a specific group. Use when you need to list or browse discussion topics within a group context.

tools.name: List Enabled Features for a Course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of enabled feature names for a Canvas course. Use when you need to check which optional features are currently active on a specific course.

tools.name: List Enrollments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of enrollments for a course, section, or user. Use when you need to query enrollments with filters like type, state, or role.

tools.name: List Enrollment Terms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all enrollment terms in an account. Use when you need to query terms with filters like workflow state or search by name.

tools.name: List Entries By IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific discussion entries by their IDs from a discussion topic. May require user to have posted if topic requires initial post (responds with 403 Forbidden if not met).

tools.name: List entries for a column
tools.description: Tool to retrieve entries from a custom gradebook column for a course. Use when you need to view data entered in custom columns. Note: Only returns entries for students with associated data; students without entries are excluded.

tools.name: List Entry Replies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve replies for a specific discussion entry in a course. Use when needing to list all replies to a particular discussion entry.

tools.name: List environment features
tools.description: Tool to return a hash of global feature options that pertain to the Canvas user interface. Use when you need to check which features are enabled in the Canvas environment.

tools.name: List Environment Settings
tools.description: Retrieves global environment settings for the root Canvas account. Use when you need to access instance-wide configuration values.

tools.name: List external feeds for group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of external RSS feeds for a group. Use when you need to discover what external feeds are configured to automatically create announcements in a group.

tools.name: List External Tools
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of external tools for the specified Canvas account. Use to discover LTI tools available in the account context.

tools.name: List favorite courses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of favorite courses for the current user. Use when you need to get the user's favorite courses. If the user has not chosen any favorites, then a selection of currently enrolled courses will be returned.

tools.name: List favorite groups
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of favorite groups for the current user. Use when you need to see which groups a user has favorited.

tools.name: List Features for Course
tools.description: Retrieves all feature flags for a Canvas course. Use when checking which features are available or enabled for a specific course.

tools.name: List Features for User
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all features that apply to a given User. Use when checking which features are available or enabled for a specific user.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Fetches metadata (ID, name, size, type, URLs) for all files within a specified Canvas course.

tools.name: List files in folder
tools.description: Tool to list files within a specific Canvas folder. Use when you need to retrieve files from a particular folder by its ID.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: Retrieves a list of immediate sub-folders within the specified `folder_id`.

tools.name: List Global Subgroups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of immediate OutcomeGroup children of a global outcome group. Use when you need to explore the hierarchical structure of global learning outcomes.

tools.name: List gradeable students
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of students eligible to submit a specific assignment. Use when you need to identify which students can submit work for grading. The caller must have permission to view grades in the course.

tools.name: List grading periods for a course
tools.description: Returns the paginated list of grading periods for the current course. Use when you need to view grading period configurations for a specific course.

tools.name: List Grading Standards Available in Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve grading standards available in a Canvas course context. Use when you need to list or view the grading schemes configured for a specific course.

tools.name: List group categories for a course
tools.description: Tool to retrieve group categories in a course context. Use when you need to list all group categories for a specific course.

tools.name: List Group Entry Replies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated replies to a top-level entry in a group discussion topic. Use when needing to list all replies to a particular discussion entry in a group. May require that the user has posted in the topic depending on topic settings.

tools.name: List external tools for group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of external tools for a group. Use when you need to discover LTI tools available in a group context.

tools.name: List Group Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of files for a specified group in Canvas. Use when you need to access or list files within a group context.

tools.name: List Group Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of members in a Canvas group. Use when you need to query group memberships with optional workflow state filters.

tools.name: List groups available in a context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of active groups in a course context that are visible to the user. Use when you need to list all groups available in a specific course.

tools.name: List Groups in Account
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of active groups in the specified Canvas account (use 'self' for current user's root account) that are visible to the user. Supports filtering by user membership and collaboration state.

tools.name: List group's users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users in a Canvas group. Use when you need to see all members of a specific group.

tools.name: List Licenses
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of licenses that can be applied to content in Canvas. Use when setting usage rights for files or determining available licensing options.

tools.name: List licenses for a group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of content licenses that can be applied to group content in Canvas. Use when you need to know what license options are available for a specific group.

tools.name: List linked outcomes for outcome group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of the immediate OutcomeLink children of an outcome group. Use when you need to list outcomes linked to a specific outcome group within an account.

tools.name: List linked outcomes for course outcome group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of the immediate OutcomeLink children of an outcome group in a course. Use when you need to list outcomes linked to a specific outcome group within a course context.

tools.name: List LTI Launch Definitions for Course
tools.description: Retrieves LTI launch definitions for a Canvas course. Use to discover LTI app placements available in the course context. Note: If placements parameter is not provided, an empty list will be returned.

tools.name: List Manageable Accounts
tools.description: Retrieves Canvas accounts where the current user has permission to create or manage courses. Use when you need to see which accounts an admin can manage. List will be empty for students and teachers.

tools.name: List Media Objects
tools.description: Tool to list media objects associated with a Canvas course. Use when you need to retrieve video/audio attachments for a specific course.

tools.name: List Media Objects 2
tools.description: Tool to list media objects created by the user for a Canvas course. Use when you need to retrieve video/audio content associated with a specific course.

tools.name: List Media Objects for Group
tools.description: Tool to list media objects created by the user in a Canvas group. Use when you need to retrieve video/audio attachments for a specific group.

tools.name: List Media Objects for Group
tools.description: Tool to list media objects associated with a Canvas group. Use when you need to retrieve video/audio content for a specific group.

tools.name: List Media Objects for User
tools.description: Tool to list media objects created by the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve video/audio objects uploaded by the current user across all courses.

tools.name: List migration issues
tools.description: Retrieves paginated list of issues that occurred during a content migration. Use this to identify problems, warnings, or items requiring attention after importing content into Canvas. Issues are returned with details about their severity, current status, and links to investigate or resolve them.

tools.name: List migration systems for group
tools.description: Lists the currently available migration types for a Canvas group. Use this to determine which content import types are supported before creating a content migration. Migration types vary by Canvas instance and may include Common Cartridge, Canvas Cartridge, course copy, QTI, Moodle, and other importers.

tools.name: List migration systems for user
tools.description: Lists currently available migration types for importing content into a user's Canvas context. Use this to discover which migration systems are supported before creating a content migration.

tools.name: List missing submissions for a user
tools.description: List past-due assignments for which the student does not have a submission. The user making the request must either be the student, an admin, or a parent observer using the parent app. Use this to identify assignments that are overdue and still need to be completed.

tools.name: List module items
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of items (assignments, quizzes, pages, files, etc.) from a specific module in a Canvas course. Use when you need to see the contents and structure of a module.

tools.name: List Modules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of modules in a Canvas course. Use when you need to see all modules in a course, including their structure, items, and completion requirements.

tools.name: List My Admin Roles
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the current user's admin roles in a Canvas account. Use when you need to check what administrative permissions the authenticated user has within a specific account.

tools.name: List notification preference categories
tools.description: Fetches all notification preference categories for a specific communication channel. Use this to discover which notification categories are available for configuring user notification preferences.

tools.name: List notification preferences
tools.description: Tool to fetch all notification preferences for a given communication channel. Use when you need to retrieve how a user has configured notification delivery for a specific channel.

tools.name: List Observees
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of observees for a Canvas user. All users can list their own observees; administrators can list observees for other users.

tools.name: List observers for a user
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of observers linked to a given user. All users can list their own observers using user_id='self'. Administrators can list other users' observers by providing the specific user_id.

tools.name: List opened poll sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all opened poll sessions available to the current user. Use when you need to see which poll sessions are currently open.

tools.name: List pages for a course
tools.description: Retrieves a list of wiki pages associated with a specific, existing course in Canvas. Supports pagination via `page` and `per_page` query parameters for courses with many pages.

tools.name: List pages for a group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of wiki pages associated with a Canvas group. Use when you need to list pages for a specific group.

tools.name: List planner items for a user
tools.description: List a user's cross-course Planner items (assignments, discussions, quizzes, etc.) within a date range, including Planner override/completion state. Use this to retrieve items from the Canvas dashboard/to-do planner view.

tools.name: List planner notes
tools.description: Retrieve the paginated list of planner notes for the current authenticated user. Use to fetch personal to-do items and reminders from the Canvas planner.

tools.name: List Planner Overrides
tools.description: Retrieves planner overrides for the currently authenticated user. Planner overrides allow users to mark plannable items as complete or dismissed in the Canvas planner.

tools.name: List poll choices in a poll
tools.description: Returns the paginated list of poll choices in a poll. Use when you need to retrieve all available choices for a specific poll.

tools.name: List polls for current user
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of polls for the current authenticated user. Use when you need to view all polls created by or accessible to the user.

tools.name: List poll sessions for a poll
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of poll sessions for a specific poll. Use when you need to see all sessions associated with a particular poll.

tools.name: List notification preferences
tools.description: Fetches all notification preferences for a given communication channel. Use when you need to see all notification settings for a specific user's communication channel.

tools.name: List questions in a quiz
tools.description: Returns the paginated list of QuizQuestions in this quiz. Use when you need to retrieve all questions for a quiz, or questions from a specific submission attempt.

tools.name: List Quizzes in Course
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of quizzes for a specified, valid Canvas course, optionally filtering by a search term in the quiz title.

tools.name: List received content shares
tools.description: Retrieves content shares received by the specified user from other users or courses within Canvas. Use 'self' as user_id to retrieve your own received shares.

tools.name: List Recent History for a User
tools.description: Return a paginated list of the user's recent browsing history in Canvas. History entries are returned in descending order, newest to oldest. Use to track recently visited assignments, pages, discussions, and other Canvas items.

tools.name: List revisions for a group page
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of revisions for a specific page in a Canvas group. Use when you need to view the history of changes made to a group page. Callers must have update rights on the page to see its revision history.

tools.name: List Roles
tools.description: Retrieves all available roles in a Canvas account. Use when verifying enrollment roles or mapping user capabilities.

tools.name: List Section Enrollments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of enrollments for a specific section. Use when you need to query section enrollments with filters like type, state, or role.

tools.name: List sent content shares
tools.description: Retrieves content shares sent by the specified user to other users or courses within Canvas.

tools.name: List Students
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the paginated list of students enrolled in a Canvas course. Use when you need to get student information for a specific course. DEPRECATED: The Canvas API recommends using the course users endpoint with enrollment_type='student' instead.

tools.name: List Subgroups
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of immediate outcome subgroups for a specified outcome group. Use when you need to fetch the child outcome groups within an account's outcome group hierarchy.

tools.name: List submissions
tools.description: Fetches gradebook history submissions for a specific course, assignment, grader, and date from Canvas.

tools.name: List submissions for multiple assignments
tools.description: Retrieves submissions from a Canvas course for specified assignments and/or students; the course must be accessible.

tools.name: List submissions for multiple assignments in section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve submissions from a Canvas section for specified assignments and/or students. Use when you need section-level submission data across multiple assignments.

tools.name: List the activity stream
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current user's global activity stream, paginated. Use when you need to see recent activities, notifications, or updates across all courses and groups the user is enrolled in.

tools.name: List the current user's TODO items
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of the current user's todo items in Canvas. Use when you need to see pending tasks that require action, such as assignments needing submission or grading.

tools.name: List Topic Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve paginated top-level entries in a group discussion topic. Use when needing to list discussion entries in a group. May respond with 403 Forbidden if the topic requires an initial post and the user has not posted.

tools.name: List uncollated submission versions
tools.description: Retrieves a feed of uncollated submission versions from the Gradebook history for a course; any provided `assignment_id` must be valid for the course, and any `user_id` must be for a user enrolled in the course.

tools.name: List Upcoming Assignments Calendar Events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of the current user's upcoming events and assignments. Use when you need to see what's coming up on the user's calendar, including both calendar events and assignment due dates.

tools.name: List user content exports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of past and pending content export jobs for a user. Use when you need to view export history or check export status for a user. Exports are returned newest first.

tools.name: List User Enrollments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all enrollments for a specific user. Use when you need to query a user's enrollments across courses, with filters like type, state, or term.

tools.name: List User Files
tools.description: Retrieves the paginated list of files for a specific user. Use when you need to access or enumerate files uploaded by or accessible to a user.

tools.name: List user logins
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of user logins for the specified Canvas account. Use when you need to see all login credentials associated with an account.

tools.name: List User Logins
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of logins for a specific Canvas user. Use when you need to see all login credentials associated with a particular user ID.

tools.name: List users in course
tools.description: Tool to return the paginated list of users in a Canvas course. Use when you need to retrieve users enrolled in a specific course with optional enrollment details.

tools.name: List users in group category
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of users in a group category. Use when you need to see all users within a specific group category or filter for unassigned users.

tools.name: List your groups
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of active groups for the current user. Use this to retrieve all groups the authenticated user belongs to, optionally filtered by context type (Account or Course).

tools.name: Mark all conversations as read
tools.description: Tool to mark all conversations as read for the current user. Use when you need to mark all conversation messages in the inbox as read.

tools.name: Mark all entries as read
tools.description: Tool to mark the discussion topic and all its entries as read. Use when you need to mark all entries in a discussion topic as read for the current user.

tools.name: Mark all group discussion entries as read
tools.description: Tool to mark the discussion topic and all its entries as read in a group. Use when you need to mark all entries in a group discussion topic as read for the current user.

tools.name: Mark all group discussion entries as unread
tools.description: Tool to mark the discussion topic and all its entries as unread for a group. Use when you need to flag an entire group discussion and all its replies as unread.

tools.name: Mark all discussion topics as read
tools.description: Mark the initial text of all discussion topics as read in a course. Use when you need to mark all discussion topics in a course as read for the current user.

tools.name: Mark all group discussion topics as read
tools.description: Mark the initial text of all discussion topics as read in a group. Use when you need to mark all discussion topics in a group as read for the current user.

tools.name: Mark bulk submissions as read
tools.description: Marks multiple submissions as read in a single operation. Use when you need to mark several submissions as read at once instead of marking them individually.

tools.name: Mark bulk submissions as read (section)
tools.description: Marks multiple submissions as read for a specific section. Use when you need to mark several submissions as read at once for a section instead of marking them individually.

tools.name: Mark document annotations as read
tools.description: Marks document annotations on a submitted assignment as read by the student. Use when a student has viewed feedback annotations on their submission. Only the student who owns the submission can mark annotations as read.

tools.name: Mark document annotations as read (section)
tools.description: Tool to mark annotations on a submitted document as read by the student. Use when a student needs to acknowledge they have viewed feedback annotations on their submitted document. Note: Document annotations are automatically marked as read when viewed in Canvas web.

tools.name: Mark group discussion entry as read
tools.description: Tool to mark a discussion entry as read in a group context. Use when you need to change the read status of a specific discussion entry to read within a group discussion.

tools.name: Mark group discussion entry as unread
tools.description: Tool to mark a group discussion entry as unread. Use when you need to change the read status of a specific discussion entry in a group back to unread.

tools.name: Mark module item as read
tools.description: Tool to mark a module item as read, fulfilling the 'must view' requirement. Use when accessing external content directly without using the html_url redirect that normally fulfills view requirements.

tools.name: Mark rubric assessments as read
tools.description: Tool to mark rubric comments/grading on a submission as read by the student. Use when a student needs to acknowledge they have viewed their rubric feedback. Note: Rubric assessments are automatically marked as read when viewed in Canvas web.

tools.name: Mark rubric assessments as read (sections)
tools.description: Tool to mark rubric comments/grading on a submission as read by the student within a specific section. Use when a student needs to acknowledge they have viewed their rubric feedback. Only the student who owns the submission can use this endpoint.

tools.name: Mark submission as read (sections)
tools.description: Marks a student's submission as read for a specific assignment within a section. Use when you need to mark a submission as read in the context of a section rather than a course.

tools.name: Mark submission as unread
tools.description: Marks a student's submission as unread for a specific assignment. Use when you need to reset the read status of a submission to unread.

tools.name: Mark submission comments as read
tools.description: Tool to mark submission comments as read in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when tracking which comments have been viewed or when updating read status for instructor feedback.

tools.name: Mark group discussion topic as read
tools.description: Marks the initial text of a discussion topic as read for the current user in a group. Use when you need to flag a group discussion topic as read to indicate it has been reviewed.

tools.name: Mark group discussion topic as unread
tools.description: Marks the initial text of a group discussion topic as unread for the current user. Use when you need to flag a group discussion topic as unread to track it for later review.

tools.name: Set quiz accommodations
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Sets quiz-level accommodations (extra time, extra attempts, reduced choices) for one or more students on a New Quiz. Sends a JSON array body; may return a partial success.

tools.name: Set course quiz accommodations
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Sets course-level accommodations (extra time, apply-to-in-progress, reduced choices) for one or more students. These accommodations apply to all New Quizzes in the course. Sends a JSON array body.

tools.name: Create a new quiz
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Creates a New Quiz in a Canvas course with the specified title, dates, grading type, instructions, and nested quiz settings (attempts, result view, IP filtering, shuffling, time limit, etc.).

tools.name: Delete a new quiz
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Permanently deletes the New Quiz identified by `assignment_id` from the course identified by `course_id`; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get a new quiz
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Retrieves a single New Quiz from a Canvas course by its assignment ID. Use when you need to view settings, dates, instructions, or other metadata for a New Quiz.

tools.name: Create a quiz item
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Creates a new QuestionItem in a New Quiz. The `entry` object describes the question body, interaction type, scoring, and feedback.

tools.name: Delete a quiz item
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Permanently deletes a single quiz item (question) from a New Quiz; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get a quiz item
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Retrieves a single quiz item (question) from a New Quiz. Use to inspect item body, scoring, and interaction data.

tools.name: List quiz items
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Lists all items (questions) in a New Quiz. Use to enumerate items with their positions, points, and question data.

tools.name: Get items media upload URL
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Retrieves a presigned URL that can be used to upload media (images, audio, etc.) for use in New Quiz items.

tools.name: Update a quiz item
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Updates an existing quiz item (question) in a New Quiz. All body fields are optional; only supplied fields are modified.

tools.name: List new quizzes
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Lists all New Quizzes in a Canvas course. Use to enumerate New Quizzes along with their settings and metadata.

tools.name: Create a new quiz report
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Creates a report for a New Quiz. Starts an asynchronous job and returns a Progress object the caller can poll. Report type is 'student_analysis' or 'item_analysis'; output format is 'csv' or 'json'.

tools.name: Update a new quiz
tools.description: EXPERIMENTAL: Updates an existing New Quiz in a Canvas course. All body fields are optional; only supplied fields are modified.

tools.name: Post assignment grades for sections
tools.description: Tool to post assignment grades for specific sections in Canvas. Use when you need to release grades to students in particular course sections.

tools.name: Post group discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new entry in a Canvas group discussion topic. Use when posting a message with optional attachment to a group discussion topic.

tools.name: Post group discussion reply
tools.description: Tool to post a reply to a discussion entry in a group. Use when you need to add a reply to an entry in a group discussion topic. May require that the user has posted in the topic.

tools.name: Preview processed HTML
tools.description: Tool to preview HTML content processed for a Canvas course. Use when you need to see how HTML will be rendered in Canvas after sanitization and link processing.

tools.name: Preview processed HTML for group
tools.description: Tool to preview HTML content processed for a specific Canvas group. Use when you need to see how HTML will be rendered after Canvas applies group-specific processing and security policies.

tools.name: Query progress
tools.description: Tool to return completion and status information about an asynchronous job in Canvas LMS. Use when you need to check the status of a long-running operation.

tools.name: Rate group discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to rate a discussion entry in a Canvas group. Use when you need to add or remove a rating (like/unlike) on a group discussion entry.

tools.name: Redirect to Assignment Override for Section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the assignment override for a specific section. Use when you need to fetch override details for a particular section's assignment. Returns 404 if no override exists.

tools.name: Redirect to Root Outcome Group for Context
tools.description: Retrieves the root outcome group for a specified account context. Use when you need to access the top-level outcome group hierarchy for an account.

tools.name: Remove content share
tools.description: Tool to remove a content share from your list. Use 'self' as the user_id to remove your own content shares. Note that this endpoint does not delete other users' copies of the content share.

tools.name: Remove course from favorites
tools.description: Tool to remove a course from the current user's favorites list. Use when you need to unfavorite a course for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Remove Course Nickname
tools.description: Tool to remove the nickname for a specific course. Use when you need to clear a custom course name and revert to using the actual course name.

tools.name: Remove feature flag for users
tools.description: Remove feature flag for a given User. The flag must be defined directly on the User. After removal, the user will inherit feature flags from a higher account if any exist.

tools.name: Remove group from favorites
tools.description: Tool to remove a group from the current user's favorites. Use when you need to unfavorite a group for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Remove usage rights from group files
tools.description: Tool to remove copyright and license information from one or more files in a group. Use when you need to clear usage rights metadata from group files.

tools.name: Remove usage rights from user files
tools.description: Tool to remove copyright and license information from one or more files for a user. Use when you need to clear usage rights metadata from user files.

tools.name: Reorder custom gradebook columns
tools.description: Reorders custom gradebook columns in a course. Use when you need to change the display order of custom columns in the gradebook.

tools.name: Reorder pinned topics for group
tools.description: Tool to reorder pinned discussion topics in a Canvas group. Use when you need to change the display order of pinned topics in a group.

tools.name: Reply to discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to reply to a discussion entry. Use when you need to send a message to a discussion entry with optional attachments.

tools.name: Reset Course Favorites
tools.description: Tool to reset the current user's course favorites to the default automatically generated list of enrolled courses. Use when you need to restore default favorites.

tools.name: Reset group favorites
tools.description: Tool to reset the current user's group favorites to the default automatically generated list of enrolled groups. Use when you need to clear custom group favorites and restore the default selection.

tools.name: Reset link verifier
tools.description: Resets the link verifier for a file. Any existing links using the previous hard-coded verifier parameter will no longer automatically grant access. Requires manage files and become other users permissions.

tools.name: Resolve Folder Path
tools.description: Resolves a folder path and returns the complete hierarchy. Given the full path to a folder, returns a list of all Folders in the path hierarchy starting at the root folder and ending at the requested folder. Use when you need to navigate or verify folder structure within a user's files.

tools.name: Resolve group folder path
tools.description: Tool to retrieve folder hierarchy by resolving a path within a Canvas group. Use when you need to traverse a folder path or verify a folder exists at a specific location within a group.

tools.name: Retrieve All Quiz Reports
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all available reports for a specified quiz. Use when you need to see what quiz reports exist or check their status.

tools.name: Retrieve assignment overridden dates for Classic Quizzes
tools.description: Retrieves the actual due-at, unlock-at, and lock-at dates for Classic Quizzes based on assignment overrides active for the current API user. Use this to get personalized quiz dates that reflect section overrides, group overrides, or individual student overrides.

tools.name: Retrieve assignment overridden dates for New Quizzes
tools.description: Retrieves the actual due-at, unlock-at, and lock-at dates for New Quizzes based on assignment overrides active for the current API user. Use this to get personalized quiz dates that reflect section overrides, group overrides, or individual student overrides.

tools.name: Retrieve enrollment term
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific enrollment term within a given root account in Canvas.

tools.name: Retrieve Internal Setting
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single internal setting by ID or name from Canvas LMS using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to fetch configuration or system settings.

tools.name: Revert Group Page to Revision
tools.description: Tool to revert a Canvas group page to a prior revision. Use when you need to restore a group page to a previous version, undoing recent changes.

tools.name: Save enabled account calendars
tools.description: Tool to save user preferences for enabled account calendars and mark the feature as seen. Use when updating which account calendars a user has enabled or marking that the user has viewed the account calendars feature.

tools.name: Set course nickname
tools.description: Tool to set a nickname for a specific Canvas course. Use when you need to assign a custom name to a course that will appear in API outputs and the Canvas web interface.

tools.name: Set extensions for student quiz submissions
tools.description: Tool to set extensions for student quiz submissions in Canvas. Use when you need to grant students additional attempts, extra time, or date extensions for a quiz. Returns success status (200 OK if successful, 403 Forbidden if not allowed to extend quizzes for this course).

tools.name: Set feature flag for course
tools.description: Tool to set a feature flag for a given Course. Use when you need to enable or disable a Canvas feature at the course level. This call will fail if a parent account sets a feature flag for the same feature in any state other than "allowed".

tools.name: Set feature flag for user
tools.description: Tool to set a feature flag for a given User. Use when you need to enable or disable a Canvas feature at the user level. This call will fail if a parent account sets a feature flag for the same feature in any state other than "allowed".

tools.name: Set friendly description
tools.description: Tool to set a friendly description for a learning outcome in Canvas using GraphQL. Use when you need to add or update a user-friendly explanation for an outcome in a specific course or account context.

tools.name: Set module item completion
tools.description: Tool to mark a module item as complete or incomplete in Canvas using the REST API. Use when tracking student progress or updating module item completion status. Uses PUT method to mark as done, DELETE method to mark as not done.

tools.name: Set override status
tools.description: Tool to set an override status for a student's enrollment in Canvas. Use when applying or clearing a custom grade status for a student.

tools.name: Set usage rights for group files
tools.description: Sets copyright and license information for one or more files in a Canvas group. Use when you need to specify intellectual property rights for group materials.

tools.name: Set usage rights for user files
tools.description: Tool to set copyright and license information for one or more files in a user's account. Use when you need to specify intellectual property rights for user files.

tools.name: Show an observee
tools.description: Tool to get information about an observed user. Use when you need to retrieve details about a user being observed by another user. Note that all users are allowed to view their own observees.

tools.name: Show a planner override
tools.description: Retrieve a specific planner override for the current user. Use when you need to check the completion or dismissal status of a plannable item in the user's planner.

tools.name: Show content export
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific content export job for a course. Use this to check the status of an export and get the download URL when the export completes.

tools.name: Show ePub export
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a single ePub export for a course. Use this to check the status of an export and get the download URL when the export completes.

tools.name: Show Front Page for Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the front page content for a specific Canvas group. Use when you need to access the main wiki page of a group.

tools.name: Show group content export
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific content export job for a group. Use this to check the status of an export and get the download URL when the export completes.

tools.name: Show Group Page Revision
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the metadata and optionally content of the latest revision of a page in a Canvas group. Use when you need to view the most recent version of a group page. Note that retrieving historic versions requires edit rights.

tools.name: Show an outcome
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific outcome in Canvas using its ID. Use when you need to view outcome details, ratings, or mastery settings.

tools.name: Show page for a group
tools.description: Retrieves the content of a specific wiki page by its URL or numeric ID from a Canvas group. Use when you need to fetch the full content and metadata of a group's wiki page.

tools.name: Show a planner note
tools.description: Retrieve a specific planner note for the current user. Use when fetching details of a personal to-do item from the Canvas planner.

tools.name: Show revision for group page
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the metadata and optionally content of a specific revision of a group page. Use when you need to view a historic version of a page. Note that retrieving historic versions requires edit rights.

tools.name: Show Temporary Enrollment Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the temporary enrollment status for a Canvas user. Use when you need to check if a user is providing or receiving temporary enrollments, or if they have permission to provide temporary enrollments.

tools.name: Show User Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific Canvas user by ID. Use when you need to fetch profile data, permissions, and other user attributes for a given user.

tools.name: Start a Report
tools.description: Initiates an asynchronous report generation for a Canvas account, using a valid report type for the account; the response confirms initiation and may include progress tracking details.

tools.name: Submit assignment
tools.description: Tool to make a submission for an assignment in Canvas. Use when a student needs to submit their work for an assignment. You must be enrolled as a student in the course/section to do this. All online turn-in submission types are supported (text, URL, file upload, media recording, LTI launch, student annotation).

tools.name: Subscribe to discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to subscribe or unsubscribe from a discussion topic to receive or stop receiving notifications. Use when managing discussion topic subscriptions via GraphQL.

tools.name: Subscribe to a topic
tools.description: Subscribe to a discussion topic to receive notifications about new entries. Use when you need to enable notifications for a specific discussion topic in a course.

tools.name: Subscribe to a topic in group
tools.description: Subscribe to a group discussion topic to receive notifications about new entries. On success, returns 204 No Content with an empty body.

tools.name: Translate File Reference
tools.description: Resolves a file's migration ID to its current representation within a specific Canvas course.

tools.name: Unsubscribe from a topic in group
tools.description: Unsubscribe from a group discussion topic to stop receiving notifications about new entries. On success, returns 204 No Content with an empty body.

tools.name: Update a content migration for user
tools.description: Tool to update a content migration for a user in Canvas. Use when you need to modify migration settings, handle file upload problems, or configure selective imports. Note: migration_type cannot be changed, and most settings changes after the migration has started will have no effect.

tools.name: Update a membership
tools.description: Tool to accept a membership request or add/remove moderator rights for a group member. Use when you need to approve a user's request to join a group or modify their moderator status.

tools.name: Update an entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing discussion entry. Use when editing a discussion entry's message content. The entry must have been created by the current user, or the current user must have admin rights to the discussion.

tools.name: Update a planner override
tools.description: Update a planner override's visibility and completion status for the current user. Use this to mark planner items as complete/incomplete or dismiss/show them in the opportunities list.

tools.name: Update Appointment Group
tools.description: Updates an existing Canvas appointment group by its ID; only provided fields are modified, but `publish` defaults to `False` if omitted. The `appointment_group_id` must be valid.

tools.name: Update notification preference
tools.description: Tool to update the notification preference for a single notification on a specific communication channel. Use when changing how frequently a user receives a particular notification type.

tools.name: Update Bookmark
tools.description: Updates an existing bookmark for the authenticated user. Use when you need to modify the name, URL, position, or metadata of a bookmark.

tools.name: Update Calendar Event
tools.description: Tool to update an existing calendar event in Canvas. Use when you need to modify event details like title, description, timing, or location.

tools.name: Update comment bank item
tools.description: Tool to update an existing comment bank item in Canvas. Use when modifying the text of a previously saved grading comment.

tools.name: Update a content share
tools.description: Tool to mark a Canvas content share as read or unread. Use when updating the read state of a content share.

tools.name: Update conversation participants
tools.description: Tool to batch update conversation workflow states in Canvas. Use when you need to mark conversations as read/unread, star/unstar, archive, or delete multiple conversations at once.

tools.name: Update course
tools.description: Updates an existing course, specified by its ID, with new attributes or triggers a lifecycle event like 'conclude' or 'delete'.

tools.name: Update course settings
tools.description: Updates various settings for an existing course in Canvas, identified by `course_id`.

tools.name: Update/Create Front Page for Groups
tools.description: Tool to update or create the front page of a Canvas group wiki. Use when you need to modify the title or contents of the group front page.

tools.name: Update Custom Color
tools.description: Tool to update the custom color for a user for a specific course or context in Canvas. Use when you need to set or modify user-specific color preferences for calendar and other UI elements.

tools.name: Update a custom gradebook column
tools.description: Updates an existing custom gradebook column in a course. Use when you need to modify properties like title, position, visibility, or editability of a custom gradebook column.

tools.name: Bulk update custom gradebook column data
tools.description: Bulk updates custom gradebook column data for multiple students. Use when you need to set or update content in custom columns for multiple student/column combinations in a single operation.

tools.name: Update discussion entries read state
tools.description: Tool to update read state for discussion entries. Use when marking discussion entries as read or unread.

tools.name: Update discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing discussion entry in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when editing the message content or file attachments of a previously posted discussion entry.

tools.name: Update discussion entry participant
tools.description: Tool to update a discussion entry participant's read state or rating. Use when marking entries as read/unread or changing ratings.

tools.name: Update discussion read state
tools.description: Tool to update the read state for a discussion topic in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when marking a discussion as read or unread for the current user.

tools.name: Update discussion thread read state
tools.description: Tool to update the read state of a discussion entry. Use when marking a discussion entry as read or unread.

tools.name: Update discussion topic (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to update an existing discussion topic using the Canvas GraphQL API. Use when modifying the title or message of a discussion topic.

tools.name: Update file
tools.description: Modifies an existing file's name or relocates it to a new parent folder; the target folder, if specified, must be valid and in the file's original context.

tools.name: Update Folder
tools.description: Updates an existing folder's properties (name, position, lock state, visibility) specified by its unique ID. Use when modifying folder attributes.

tools.name: Update a group content migration
tools.description: Tool to update a content migration in a Canvas group. Use when you need to modify migration settings, handle file upload problems, configure selective imports, or specify which content to copy. Note: migration_type cannot be changed, and most settings changes after the migration has started will have no effect.

tools.name: Update group discussion entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing discussion entry in a Canvas group. Use when editing a group discussion entry's message content. The entry must have been created by the current user, or the current user must have admin rights to the discussion.

tools.name: Update multiple notification preferences
tools.description: Update multiple notification preferences for a single communication channel at once. Use when you need to configure how often a user receives notifications for multiple event types on a specific communication channel.

tools.name: Update multiple preferences by channel ID
tools.description: Tool to change the preferences for multiple notifications for a single communication channel at once using the channel ID. Use when you need to configure how frequently (immediately, daily, weekly, or never) various notification types are sent to a specific communication channel.

tools.name: Update notification preferences
tools.description: Tool to update user notification preferences in Canvas using GraphQL. Use when configuring how and when a user receives notifications for specific categories through a communication channel.

tools.name: Update page for a course
tools.description: Updates an existing wiki page in a Canvas course; if setting as front page, it must also be or be made published.

tools.name: Update a page for a group
tools.description: Updates the title or contents of an existing wiki page in a Canvas group. Use when you need to modify group documentation, notes, or collaborative content.

tools.name: Update a planner note
tools.description: Update a planner note for the current user. Use when modifying an existing to-do item or reminder in the Canvas planner.

tools.name: Update notification preference by type and address
tools.description: Tool to update the notification preference for a single notification on a communication channel identified by type and address. Use when changing how frequently a user receives a particular notification type on a specific channel.

tools.name: Update preferences by category
tools.description: Tool to change notification preferences for all notifications in a category for a single communication channel. Use when updating the frequency setting for an entire notification category at once.

tools.name: Update quiz submission scores
tools.description: Updates scores, comments for questions, and/or applies fudge points to a specific quiz submission attempt; the attempt must be completed and referenced by valid, existing course, quiz, and submission IDs.

tools.name: Update rubric assessment read state
tools.description: Tool to update rubric assessment read state for submissions in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when marking rubric assessments as read for specific submissions.

tools.name: Update Single Poll
tools.description: Tool to update an existing poll belonging to the current user. Use when you need to modify a poll's question or description.

tools.name: Update a single poll choice
tools.description: Tool to update an existing poll choice for a poll in Canvas. Use when you need to modify the text, correctness status, or position of a poll choice.

tools.name: Update Single Poll Session
tools.description: Tool to update an existing poll session for a poll in Canvas. Use when you need to modify a poll session's attributes such as making results public or changing the associated course section.

tools.name: Update SpeedGrader settings
tools.description: Tool to update SpeedGrader settings in Canvas via GraphQL. Use when you need to configure SpeedGrader options such as enabling grade-by-question mode.

tools.name: Update split screen view deeply nested alert
tools.description: Tool to update the split screen view deeply nested alert setting for a user. Use when enabling or disabling the deeply nested alert warning in split screen view mode.

tools.name: Update submission student-entered score
tools.description: Tool to update the student-entered score (what-if score) for a submission. Use when a student wants to set or modify a hypothetical score to calculate potential grades.

tools.name: Update submission what-if score
tools.description: Tool to enter a what-if score for a submission and receive calculated grades. Grade calculation is costly, so use sparingly. Use when students want to test hypothetical scores to see their impact on overall grades.

tools.name: Update group discussion topic
tools.description: Tool to update an existing discussion topic for a group. Use when modifying the title, message, publication settings, or engagement features of a group discussion topic.

tools.name: Update user discussions splitscreen view
tools.description: Tool to update user discussions splitscreen view setting via Canvas GraphQL API. Use when enabling or disabling the splitscreen view for discussions.

tools.name: Update User Settings
tools.description: Updates a Canvas user's preferences for various interface elements and content interaction behaviors.

tools.name: Update user text editor preference
tools.description: Tool to update a user's text editor preference. Use when you need to change the default text editor for a user in Canvas.

tools.name: Update User Token
tools.description: Tool to update an existing access token for a Canvas user. Use when you need to modify token properties like purpose, expiration, scopes, or regenerate the token value.

tools.name: Upload a course file
tools.description: Uploads a file to an accessible Canvas course, optionally to a specific folder (created if a non-existent `parent_folder_path` is provided) and with defined behavior for duplicate filenames.

tools.name: Upload a file to group
tools.description: Initiates file upload to a Canvas group (Step 1 of 3-step workflow). Returns upload_url and upload_params needed for Step 2. Only users with 'Manage Files' permission can upload to groups.

tools.name: Upload submission file
tools.description: Uploads a file for an assignment submission in Canvas (step 1 of submitting); the returned file can later be included in an actual submission. The specified user must be enrolled in the course with access to the assignment. Use 'self' for `user_id` to upload as the authenticated user, or specify another user's ID (requires masquerade permissions).

tools.name: Upsert custom grade status
tools.description: Tool to create or update a custom grade status in Canvas. Use when you need to add a new custom grade status or modify an existing one.

tools.name: Upsert standard grade status
tools.description: Tool to create or update a standard grade status in Canvas. Use when customizing standard grade status labels and colors. Standard grade statuses include: late, missing, excused, and none.

tools.name: Validate quiz access code
tools.description: Validates a quiz access code by checking if it matches the configured access code for the quiz. Use when verifying student-provided access codes before allowing quiz access.

triggers.name: Canvas Assignment Graded
triggers.description: Polls Canvas for newly graded submissions for a specific assignment.

triggers.name: New Canvas Assignment Submission
triggers.description: Polls Canvas for new submissions to a specific assignment.

triggers.name: New Canvas Discussion Message
triggers.description: Polls Canvas discussion topics for new messages.

triggers.name: New Canvas Discussion Topic
triggers.description: Polls a Canvas course for new discussion topics.

triggers.name: New Course Created for User
triggers.description: Polls Canvas for newly created courses for a specific user.

triggers.name: New Canvas File Upload
triggers.description: Polls a Canvas course for new file uploads.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL of your Canvas instance (e.g., https://canvas.instructure.com).

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: full
required.description: Your school's Canvas web address, e.g. https://myschool.instructure.com — copy it from your browser address bar. Include https:// and no trailing slash.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Canvas API access token. In Canvas, go to Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token, then copy it right away — Canvas shows it only once.

name: Bitbucket
description: Bitbucket is a Git-based code hosting and collaboration platform supporting private and public repositories, enabling teams to manage and review code through pull requests and integrations

tools.name: Approve Pull Request
tools.description: Tool to approve a pull request as the authenticated user. Use when you need to formally approve changes in a pull request review process.

tools.name: Browse repository path
tools.description: Tool to retrieve content for a file path or browse directory contents at a specified revision in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need flexible access to repository content - returns raw file data for files or paginated directory listings for directories.

tools.name: Create a branch
tools.description: Creates a new branch in a Bitbucket repository from a target commit hash; the branch name must be unique, adhere to Bitbucket's naming conventions, and not include the 'refs/heads/' prefix.

tools.name: Create an issue
tools.description: Creates a new issue in a Bitbucket repository, setting the authenticated user as reporter; ensures assignee (if provided) has repository access, and that any specified milestone, version, or component IDs exist.

tools.name: Create an issue comment
tools.description: Adds a new comment with markdown support to an existing Bitbucket issue.

tools.name: Create a pull request
tools.description: Creates a new pull request in a specified Bitbucket repository, ensuring the source branch exists and is distinct from the (optional) destination branch.

tools.name: Create pull request comment
tools.description: Creates a new comment on a Bitbucket pull request. Supports top-level comments, threaded replies, and inline code comments. Use when providing feedback on a PR, replying to existing comments, or commenting on specific code lines.

tools.name: Create commit report annotations
tools.description: Adds multiple annotations to a commit report in bulk. Use when you need to add code analysis findings (vulnerabilities, code smells, bugs) to a report attached to a specific commit.

tools.name: List commits from revision (POST)
tools.description: Tool to list commits from a revision using POST method. Identical to GET endpoint but allows sending include/exclude parameters in request body to avoid URL length limits. Use when include/exclude parameters are too long for query strings.

tools.name: Create repository
tools.description: Creates a new Bitbucket 'git' repository in a specified workspace, defaulting to the workspace's oldest project if `project_key` is not provided.

tools.name: Create snippet comment
tools.description: Posts a new top-level comment or a threaded reply to an existing comment on a specified Bitbucket snippet.

tools.name: Create team pipeline variable
tools.description: Creates a team-level pipeline configuration variable in Bitbucket. Use when you need to add environment variables or configuration values that should be available to all pipelines within a team.

tools.name: Create user pipeline variable
tools.description: Creates a user-level pipeline variable for Bitbucket pipelines. Use when you need to create account-level configuration variables that can be used across all repositories owned by the user.

tools.name: Decline Pull Request
tools.description: Decline a Bitbucket Cloud pull request via the REST API. Use this action when you need to reject a pull request that should not be merged. This action is irreversible — once declined, the pull request cannot be reopened and must be recreated if needed.

tools.name: Delete commit comment
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific comment on a commit. Use when removing outdated, incorrect, or unwanted feedback on a commit.

tools.name: Delete issue
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific issue, identified by its `issue_id`, from the repository specified by `repo_slug` within the given `workspace`.

tools.name: Delete pull request comment
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific pull request comment (top-level, inline, or threaded reply). Use when removing outdated, incorrect, or unwanted feedback from a pull request.

tools.name: Delete commit report annotation
tools.description: Deletes a single annotation matching the provided ID from a commit report. Use when you need to remove a specific annotation from a code analysis report.

tools.name: Delete repository
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specified Bitbucket repository; this action is irreversible and does not affect forks.

tools.name: Delete snippet watch
tools.description: Stops watching a specific snippet. Use when you want to unsubscribe from notifications for a snippet.

tools.name: Delete user pipeline variable
tools.description: Permanently deletes a user-level pipeline configuration variable identified by its UUID. Use this to remove pipeline variables that are no longer needed at the account level.

tools.name: Download repository archive
tools.description: Download a repository revision as a zip, gzip, or bzip2 archive.

tools.name: Get branch
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific branch in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get branch metadata, the commit it points to, or verify a branch exists.

tools.name: Get Commit Build Status
tools.description: Get a specific build status for a commit in Bitbucket. Use when you need to check the status of a particular build/CI run for a commit.

tools.name: Get Commit Changes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a page of changes made in a specified commit, showing all changed files with their change statistics (lines added/removed, status). Use when you need to enumerate files modified in a specific commit or commit range.

tools.name: Get commit comment
tools.description: Retrieves a specific comment from a commit by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a particular commit comment including content, author, timestamps, and inline location.

tools.name: Get Commit Diff
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the unified diff between two provided revisions or for a single commit in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to see the actual code changes in a commit or between two commits. Supports filtering by file path and various diff options.

tools.name: Get current user (v2)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve complete profile information for the currently authenticated Bitbucket user. Use when you need comprehensive user details including account_id, username, nickname, and other profile fields.

tools.name: Get deployment environment variables
tools.description: Retrieves deployment environment level variables for a specific Bitbucket repository environment. Use when you need to view or audit environment-specific configuration variables for deployments.

tools.name: Get file from repository
tools.description: Retrieves a specific file's content from a Bitbucket repository at a given commit (hash, branch, or tag), failing if the file path is invalid for that commit.

tools.name: Get hook events
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all valid webhook events for a specified entity type (repository or workspace). Use when you need to discover available webhook event types for subscription or webhook configuration.

tools.name: Get OpenID configuration for OIDC in Pipelines
tools.description: Retrieves the OpenID Connect discovery configuration for Bitbucket Pipelines OIDC. Use when integrating Bitbucket Pipelines with resource servers (AWS, GCP, Vault) using OpenID Connect authentication. Returns issuer URL, JWKS URI, and supported capabilities.

tools.name: Get pipeline step
tools.description: Retrieve one pipeline step and its available execution details by UUID.

tools.name: Get pipeline step log
tools.description: Retrieve all or a bounded byte range of one pipeline step's execution log.

tools.name: Get Pull Request
tools.description: Get a single pull request by ID with complete details.

tools.name: Get pull request activity
tools.description: Return one pull request's comments, updates, approvals, and change requests.

tools.name: Get pull request comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific comment from a pull request by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a particular pull request comment including content, author, timestamps, and inline location.

tools.name: Get Pull Request Commits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve commits for a specified pull request. Use when reviewing the commit history of a PR or analyzing changes included in a pull request.

tools.name: Get Pull Request Diff
tools.description: Tool to fetch the unified diff for a Bitbucket pull request (follows 302 redirect to repository diff). Use when reviewing code changes in a PR. Supports optional truncation for large diffs via max_chars parameter.

tools.name: Get Pull Request Diffstat
tools.description: Tool to get the diffstat for a Bitbucket pull request, showing all changed files with their change statistics (lines added/removed, status). Use when you need to enumerate files modified in a PR.

tools.name: Get pull request merge base
tools.description: Resolve a pull request's refs and return their best common ancestor commit.

tools.name: Get raw file content
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use BITBUCKET_GET_FILE_FROM_REPOSITORY instead. Tool to retrieve the raw content of a file from a Bitbucket repository at a specified commit, branch, or tag. Use when you need to read file contents from a specific revision.

tools.name: Get Repository Branching Model
tools.description: Return the branching model as applied to the repository. Use when you need to understand the repository's branch workflow configuration, including development/production branches and branch type prefixes.

tools.name: Get Repository Commit
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific commit in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get complete commit details including author, message, date, parents, and related links.

tools.name: Get commit comments
tools.description: Retrieves all comments on a specific commit in a Bitbucket repository. Returns both global and inline code comments. Use when you need to view feedback, discussions, or notes left on a specific commit.

tools.name: Get commit report
tools.description: Returns a single report matching the provided ID from a commit. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific analysis report (e.g., security scan, code coverage, test results, or bug report) for a commit.

tools.name: Get Commit Reports
tools.description: Tool to get reports linked to a specific commit. Use when you need to retrieve analysis results, test reports, security scans, or code coverage data associated with a commit.

tools.name: Get commit report annotation
tools.description: Returns a single annotation matching the provided ID from a commit report. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific code analysis finding (e.g., vulnerability, code smell, or bug) identified in a commit.

tools.name: Get commit statuses
tools.description: Returns all build statuses (e.g., CI/CD pipeline results) for a specific commit. Use when you need to check build status, verify test results, or monitor deployment pipelines for a particular commit.

tools.name: Get effective branching model
tools.description: Retrieves the effective branching model for a Bitbucket repository, showing which branching model is currently applied (including any inheritance from project-level settings). Use when you need to understand the repository's branch workflow configuration, including development and production branches and branch type prefixes.

tools.name: Get Repository Environment
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific deployment environment in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get environment configuration, deployment settings, or check environment properties like locks and restrictions.

tools.name: Get file commit history
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of commits that modified the specified file. Use when you need to track file changes over time, find who modified a file, or determine when a file was created or last changed.

tools.name: Check if user voted for issue
tools.description: Tool to check whether the authenticated user has voted for a specific issue in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to verify if the current user has already voted on an issue before attempting to vote or unvote.

tools.name: Get Repositories Merge Base
tools.description: Get the merge base (best common ancestor) between two commits in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to find the common ancestor commit between two branches or commits for comparison or merge operations.

tools.name: Get specific pipeline
tools.description: Retrieve a specified pipeline from a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific pipeline execution including its status, build number, and results.

tools.name: Get repository pipelines caches
tools.description: Retrieves the repository pipelines caches. Use when you need to list all caches configured for Bitbucket Pipelines in a specific repository.

tools.name: Get repository pipeline runners
tools.description: Retrieves the list of self-hosted runners configured for a repository's pipelines. Use when you need to view available runners for pipeline execution.

tools.name: Get repository pipeline schedules
tools.description: Retrieves configured pipeline schedules for a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to view scheduled pipeline runs and their cron patterns.

tools.name: Get repository SSH known hosts
tools.description: Retrieves repository-level SSH known hosts configured for Bitbucket Pipelines. Use when you need to list or verify SSH known hosts that Pipelines can connect to during builds.

tools.name: Get repository pipeline variables
tools.description: Retrieves repository-level pipeline variables for a specific Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to view or audit pipeline configuration variables that are scoped to a repository.

tools.name: Get pipeline steps
tools.description: Retrieves all steps for a given pipeline. Use when you need to inspect the individual steps of a pipeline execution, including their state, duration, and commands.

tools.name: Get pull requests activity log
tools.description: Get paginated activity log for all pull requests in a repository. Returns comments, updates, approvals, and request changes. Use when you need to track pull request activity history.

tools.name: Get pull request comments
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of comments on a specific pull request in a Bitbucket repository. Returns global, inline, and threaded comments. Use when you need to view feedback, discussions, or reviews left on a pull request.

tools.name: Get pull request statuses
tools.description: Returns all build statuses (e.g., CI/CD pipeline results) for a specific pull request. Use when you need to check build status, verify test results, or monitor deployment pipelines for a pull request.

tools.name: Get repository refs
tools.description: Returns the branches and tags in the repository. Use when you need to list all refs (both branches and tags) in a single API call with optional filtering by type, name pattern, or commit hash.

tools.name: Get tag
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific tag in a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to get tag metadata, target commit details, or verify a tag exists.

tools.name: Get repositories src
tools.description: Lists the contents of the root directory on the repository's main branch without needing to specify a commit or branch. This endpoint redirects to the main branch automatically.

tools.name: Get repository watchers
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all the watchers on the specified repository. Use when you need to see who is watching a particular repository.

tools.name: Get repository
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific repository in a Bitbucket workspace. Use when you need to get repository metadata, settings, or details.

tools.name: Get Repository Patch
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the git patch content for a Bitbucket repository at a specified revision or commit range. Use when you need to review code changes, generate diffs, or analyze modifications between commits. Returns raw patch in unified diff format.

tools.name: Get snippet
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Bitbucket snippet by its encoded ID from an existing workspace, returning its metadata and file structure.

tools.name: Get snippet watch status
tools.description: Checks if the current user is watching a specific snippet. Use when you need to verify watch status for a snippet.

tools.name: Get SSH keys for user
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of SSH keys for a specified Bitbucket user. Use when you need to view or audit SSH keys configured for a user account.

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Retrieves public profile information for a specific Bitbucket user by username or UUID. Use when you need to get user details like display name, avatar, creation date, and links to related resources.

tools.name: Get user emails
tools.description: Returns all the authenticated user's email addresses, both confirmed and unconfirmed. Use when you need to retrieve all email addresses associated with the current user's account.

tools.name: Get user email details
tools.description: Retrieves details about a specific email address for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check if an email is primary, confirmed, or verify email ownership.

tools.name: Get user permissions for repositories
tools.description: Returns an object for each repository the caller has explicit access to, including their permission level. Use when you need to discover which repositories the authenticated user can access and their specific permissions.

tools.name: Get user permissions for workspaces
tools.description: Retrieves workspace memberships and permission levels for the authenticated user. Returns an object for each workspace the caller is a member of, along with their effective role (highest privilege level). Use when you need to determine which workspaces a user can access and their permission level in each.

tools.name: Get user workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all workspaces accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to list workspaces the current user can access, optionally filtered by workspace slug or permission level.

tools.name: Get workspace
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Bitbucket workspace. Use when you need to get workspace metadata, settings, or details.

tools.name: Get Workspace Pull Requests by User
tools.description: Tool to get all workspace pull requests authored by a specified user. Use when you need to retrieve pull requests created by a specific user across all repositories in a workspace.

tools.name: Search code in workspace
tools.description: Tool to search for code in the repositories of the specified workspace. Use when you need to find specific code patterns, function definitions, or text across all repositories in a workspace.

tools.name: List branches
tools.description: Lists branches in a Bitbucket repository with optional server-side filtering by name pattern (BBQL) and sorting. Use when you need to discover available branches, search for specific branch patterns, or navigate repository branch structure.

tools.name: List commits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a page of commits from a Bitbucket repository. Returns commits in reverse chronological order (newest first), similar to git log. Use when you need to browse commit history, filter commits by branch/tag, or restrict to commits affecting a specific path.

tools.name: List commits from revision
tools.description: Tool to list commits starting from a specific revision in a Bitbucket repository. Commits are paginated and returned in reverse chronological order. Use when you need to retrieve commit history from a specific commit, branch, or tag.

tools.name: List commits on master
tools.description: Lists commits on the master branch of a Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to retrieve the commit history for the master branch, including commit messages, authors, dates, and parent relationships.

tools.name: List deployments
tools.description: Lists deployments for a specified Bitbucket repository. Use when you need to view deployment history and status across environments.

tools.name: List issues in a repository
tools.description: Lists issues in a Bitbucket repository with optional filtering by state, priority, kind, or assignee. Use when you need to discover issue IDs or get an overview of repository issues.

tools.name: List pipelines
