tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific webhook for an event type, halting its real-time notifications; this operation is irreversible and leaves the event type and other webhooks untouched.

tools.name: Delete webhooks for event type
tools.description: Call this to irreversibly delete all webhooks for a specific `eventTypeId` if the event type exists; details of deleted webhooks are not returned.

tools.name: Disconnect calendar using credential id
tools.description: Disconnects a calendar integration by its provider name and credential ID, irreversibly revoking Cal's access; external calendar data remains unaffected.

tools.name: Edit attendee by ID
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing attendee in a Cal.com booking. Use when you need to update attendee details such as name, email, or timezone.

tools.name: Edit availability by ID
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing availability by ID on Cal.com. Use when you need to update the days, start time, end time, or schedule association of an existing availability.

tools.name: Edit booking by ID
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing booking by its ID. Use when you need to update booking details such as title, description, status, or time.

tools.name: Edit event type by ID
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing Cal.com event type by ID. Use when you need to update event type settings like title, description, duration, locations, or booking configurations.

tools.name: Edit selected calendar by ID
tools.description: Tool to edit a selected calendar by its composite ID in Cal.com. Use when you need to update an existing calendar integration.

tools.name: Fetch all bookings
tools.description: Fetches a list of bookings, optionally filtered by status, attendee, date range, or by event/team IDs (which must belong to/include the authenticated user respectively), with support for pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Fetch event type details
tools.description: Fetches all configuration settings and characteristics for a single event type (identified by orgId, teamId, and eventTypeId), which must exist and be accessible; this read-only action cannot list, create, or modify event types.

tools.name: Fetch organization attribute by id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific attribute of an organization, useful for fetching a single data point instead of the entire organization record.

tools.name: Fetch provider access token
tools.description: Fetches an OAuth access token for the specified `clientId` to authenticate API calls; this action only retrieves the token, not managing scheduling or calendar events.

tools.name: Fetch schedule by id
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for a specific, existing schedule using its `scheduleId`.

tools.name: Fetch user schedule by org id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific user's schedule within an organization, returning availability windows, timezone settings, and date-specific overrides. Requires organization-level access permissions.

tools.name: Fetch webhook by event type id
tools.description: Retrieves details for a single, specific webhook using its `webhookId` and associated `eventTypeId`.

tools.name: Force refresh user oauth client
tools.description: Forces an immediate refresh of OAuth tokens for a Platform managed user. This is a Cal.com Platform API endpoint (deprecated as of December 2025 but still functional for existing customers). Use this endpoint when you've lost a managed user's access or refresh tokens and need to obtain new ones. Prerequisites: - A registered OAuth client application with Cal.com (provides clientId and x_cal_secret_key) - The managed user must exist and be associated with your OAuth client - Valid OAuth client credentials (clientId and secret key) Token Validity: - Access tokens are valid for 60 minutes - Refresh tokens are valid for 1 year Important: Store the returned tokens securely in your database (e.g., as calAccessToken and calRefreshToken fields).

tools.name: Get all timezones
tools.description: Retrieves all supported time zone identifiers (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London') and their associated metadata, excluding specific DST changes or precise UTC offset details.

tools.name: Get available slots info
tools.description: Retrieves available time slots for scheduling by considering existing bookings and availability, based on criteria like a specified time range and event type.

tools.name: Get booking reference by id
tools.description: Tool to find a specific booking reference by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details about a single booking reference that links a booking to an external platform or calendar.

tools.name: Get booking references
tools.description: Retrieves external references for a specific booking within an organization's team. Use when you need to get calendar or video platform integration details for a booking.

tools.name: Get conference OAuth authorization url
tools.description: Generates an OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for a supported conferencing `app` to initiate or refresh its integration with Cal.com.

tools.name: Get default schedule details
tools.description: Retrieves the Cal system's global default schedule configuration, not custom or user-specific ones.

tools.name: Get destination calendars
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all destination calendars configured for the authenticated user. Use when you need to find where new bookings will be created.

tools.name: Get event type by team id
tools.description: Retrieves a specific event type by its ID, requiring that the event type is associated with the given team ID.

tools.name: Get event type private links
tools.description: Retrieves all private booking links for a specific event type. Private links allow sharing event booking URLs with restricted access, either time-limited or usage-limited.

tools.name: Get google calendar oauth authentication url
tools.description: Generates the initial Google Calendar OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for user redirection to begin the authentication and authorization process.

tools.name: Get oauth clients user
tools.description: Retrieves all managed users associated with a Platform OAuth client. This endpoint is part of Cal.com's Platform API for managing users created through OAuth client credentials. Requires a valid Platform OAuth client ID and secret key, which are obtained when creating an OAuth client at https://app.cal.com/settings/platform/oauth-clients. Use this to: - List all users managed under your OAuth client - Audit user access and permissions - Retrieve user profile details (email, timezone, locale, avatar, etc.) Authentication: Requires both Bearer token (from auth metadata) and x-cal-secret-key header.

tools.name: Get organization attribute assigned options
tools.description: Retrieves all assigned attribute options for a specific attribute within an organization. This action returns the list of attribute options that have been assigned to users, along with which users have been assigned each option. For example, if you have a "Department" attribute, this will show which department options exist and which users are assigned to each department. Use cases: - View which users are assigned to specific attribute options - Monitor attribute option assignments across teams - Audit user attribute assignments for reporting - Filter results by specific option IDs or team IDs Prerequisites: - The organization must exist (use get_organization_id to retrieve your orgId) - The attribute must exist with options assigned to users

tools.name: Get organization attribute assigned options by slug
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all assigned attribute options for a specific attribute by its slug within an organization. Use when you need to see which attribute options have been assigned to users, filtered by the attribute's slug identifier.

tools.name: Get organization ID
tools.description: Retrieves the organization ID associated with the currently authenticated user from the Cal.com /v2/me endpoint.

tools.name: Get organization schedules
tools.description: Retrieves availability schedules for an organization. Returns schedules that define when users are available for bookings, including working hours, time zones, and date-specific overrides. These are not individual events or appointments, but rather the availability templates that determine when bookings can be made.

tools.name: Get organization teams event types
tools.description: Retrieves event types, including names, durations, and custom settings for team scheduling, for all teams within an existing organization specified by `orgId`.

tools.name: Get organization team workflows
tools.description: Retrieves workflows configured for a specific team within an organization. Returns workflow configurations including triggers, steps, and activation settings. Use when you need to list or inspect workflow automations for a team.

tools.name: Get organization user schedules
tools.description: Retrieves all availability schedules configured for a specific user within an organization. Returns detailed schedule information including time slots, timezones, and overrides. Does not include booked events or appointments.

tools.name: Get private links for team event type
tools.description: Get all private links for a team event type. Use this to retrieve both time-based (with expiration) and usage-based (with usage limits) private links for scheduling.

tools.name: Get schedule for user in team
tools.description: Retrieves all availability schedules for a specific user within a team and organization. Returns schedule configurations including working hours, time zones, weekly availability patterns, default schedule designation, and date-specific overrides. Use this to understand when a team member is available for bookings. Requires valid userId (from team memberships), orgId (from organization list), and teamId (from teams list).

tools.name: Get selected calendar by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a selected calendar by its compound ID (userId_integration_externalId). Use when you need to fetch details of a specific calendar that has been selected for synchronization.

tools.name: Get stripe connect info
tools.description: Retrieves Stripe Connect account details (ID, charges/payouts status, verification, settings) for the user's linked Cal.com account; response may be empty or indicate no integration if no account is linked.

tools.name: Get Stripe Connect URL for team
tools.description: Tool to get Stripe Connect authorization URL for a team within an organization. Use when you need to obtain a URL that allows team members to connect their Stripe account for payment processing on Cal.com.

tools.name: Get team bookings
tools.description: Retrieves all bookings for a specified team, optionally filtered by status, attendee details, date ranges, or event type IDs, with support for pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get team default conferencing app
tools.description: Retrieves the default conferencing application configured for a specific team within an organization. Use this to check which video platform (e.g., Zoom, Google Meet) is set as the team's default for scheduling meetings.

tools.name: Get team details by organization ID and team ID
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific team within an organization, including team metadata, configuration settings, branding options, and timezone/week preferences. Use this to get team information like name, slug, bio, timezone, branding colors, and visibility settings.

tools.name: Get team event type webhook
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific webhook configured on a team event type. Use when you need to inspect webhook configuration, verify settings, or troubleshoot webhook deliveries for team-managed event types.

tools.name: Get team event type webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for a specific team event type. Use this to audit webhook configurations or troubleshoot webhook delivery issues.

tools.name: Get team information by team ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Cal.com team by its ID. Returns team configuration including name, slug, branding (logo, colors, theme), timezone settings, and privacy options. Requires the authenticated user to be a member of the team. Use 'get_teams_list' to find available team IDs.

tools.name: Get team routing forms
tools.description: Retrieves routing forms for a specific team within an organization. Routing forms are used to collect information from potential bookers and route them to appropriate event types or team members based on their responses. Use this to fetch routing form configurations, fields, and routing logic for a team.

tools.name: Get team schedules
tools.description: Retrieves availability schedules for all members of a specific team within an organization. Returns schedules that define when team members are available for bookings, including working hours, time zones, and date-specific overrides.

tools.name: Get teams list
tools.description: Retrieves all teams the user belongs to, including their names and members.

tools.name: Get verified phone numbers
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of verified phone numbers for a specific organization team. Use when you need to get phone numbers that have been verified and associated with a team.

tools.name: Get webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves details for an existing and accessible webhook by its ID; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Handle conferencing oauth callback for app
tools.description: Processes an OAuth 2.0 callback for a conferencing `app`, exchanging the `code` and `state` for access credentials; ensure an OAuth flow was previously initiated.

tools.name: List all attendees
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attendees from Cal.com. Use when you need to get a complete list of all attendees across all bookings.

tools.name: List booking references
tools.description: Fetches one page of booking references in Cal.com. The Cal.com v2 API does not expose `/booking-references` for Bearer-token auth, so this action paginates the v2 `/bookings` endpoint and extracts each booking's `references` array. ONE Cal.com API call is made per invocation; pagination is caller-driven via the `cursor` parameter (Cal's keyset-by-booking-ID cursor) and the `next_cursor` field in the response.

tools.name: List event types
tools.description: Retrieves Cal event types, filterable by `username` (required if `eventSlug` is provided), multiple `usernames`, or organization details (`orgSlug` or `orgId`).

tools.name: List organization memberships
tools.description: Retrieves all memberships for a given organization, including user details, roles, status, and membership dates.

tools.name: List team event types by org and team id
tools.description: Retrieves all event types for a specific team within an organization, optionally filtering by a specific event slug.

tools.name: Mark booking absent for UID
tools.description: Marks the host and/or specified attendees as absent for an existing booking, typically used after a scheduled event to record no-shows.

tools.name: Modify organization membership by id
tools.description: Updates an organization membership's status (accepted), role, or impersonation settings, identified by `orgId` and `membershipId` in the path; requires at least one of these fields in the request to apply changes.

tools.name: Modify org attribute by id
tools.description: Partially updates an organization attribute using `orgId` and `attributeId`, allowing modification of its name, slug, type, or enabled status; changing the 'type' may affect existing data.

tools.name: Patch organization attribute option
tools.description: Partially updates a specific option for an organization's attribute, modifying its 'value' and/or 'slug'; at least one of 'value' or 'slug' must be provided.

tools.name: Patch organization user details
tools.description: Partially updates details for a user that exists within the specified organization.

tools.name: Patch team details by ID
tools.description: Updates specified details for an existing team identified by `teamId`; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Patch webhook event type
tools.description: Updates configuration (e.g., payload template, active status, URL, triggers, secret) for an existing webhook tied to a specific event type.

tools.name: Post calendar credentials
tools.description: Use to submit/update authentication credentials (passed in the request body) for an existing calendar, enabling Cal to connect with external calendar services for synchronization.

tools.name: Connect conferencing app
tools.description: Connects or reconnects Cal.com with a specified conferencing application to enable future virtual meeting scheduling, but does not itself create or schedule meetings.

tools.name: Create a new booking
tools.description: Creates a new booking for an event type at a specified start time. Use this action to schedule a meeting with a Cal.com user. Prerequisites: 1. Get a valid event type ID from list_event_types 2. Find an available time slot using get_available_slots_info 3. Provide attendee name and email in the 'responses' object 4. Specify timezone and language preferences The booking will be created with status 'ACCEPTED' if no confirmation is required, or 'PENDING' if the event type requires host confirmation.

tools.name: Assign or create attribute option for user
tools.description: Assigns an existing attribute option (using `attributeOptionId`) or creates a new one (using `value`) for a user, linking it to a specified `attributeId` which must already exist within the organization.

tools.name: Add selected calendar
tools.description: Links a new external calendar or updates an existing link to one, enabling synchronization with the Cal application by specifying the `integration` provider, the calendar's `externalId`, and the `credentialId`.

tools.name: Post user to organization
tools.description: Adds a new user to an existing organization (identified by `orgId` in path), requiring user's `email` and allowing extensive optional profile customization.

tools.name: Create webhook subscription
tools.description: Creates a new Cal.com webhook subscription to send real-time notifications for specified calendar events (like bookings, meetings, forms) to a publicly accessible subscriber URL. Supports custom payload templates and webhook signature verification via HMAC-SHA256.

tools.name: Reassign booking to another user
tools.description: Reassigns an existing booking to a specified user. Requires cal-api-version 2024-08-13. The booking owner must be authorized to perform the reassignment.

tools.name: Reassign booking with uid
tools.description: Reassigns the specified booking to a new team member, who is determined by the system rather than being specified in the request.

tools.name: Refresh oauth token for client id
tools.description: Refreshes an OAuth access token for a specified `clientId` and managed user using their `refreshToken`. This is a Cal.com Platform feature for developers building applications that manage users. Prerequisites: - A registered OAuth client application with Cal.com (provides clientId) - The OAuth client secret key (x_cal_secret_key) - A valid refresh token obtained when creating a managed user The endpoint implements refresh token rotation - both access and refresh tokens are returned. Access tokens expire after 60 minutes; refresh tokens expire after 1 year. Note: This endpoint is marked as deprecated in Cal.com docs and may be replaced in future versions.

tools.name: Request email verification code
tools.description: Request an email verification code for a team's verified resources. Use this action when you need to verify an email address for a team. The API will send a verification code to the specified email address. After receiving the code, you'll need to use it with a separate verification endpoint to complete the email verification process. This is typically used to verify email addresses that will be used as verified resources within a team.

tools.name: Reschedule booking by uid
tools.description: Reschedules an existing booking (identified by `bookingUid`) to a new time. Requires the booking UID and the new start time in ISO 8601 format. Optionally, you can provide a rescheduling reason and the email of the person rescheduling.

tools.name: Reserve slot for event
tools.description: Temporarily reserves an available time slot for an existing and bookable event type, useful for high-demand slots to prevent double-bookings while the user completes the booking.

tools.name: Retrieve attribute options for org
tools.description: Retrieves all available options for a specific attribute within an organization. This action returns the list of selectable options for SINGLE_SELECT or MULTI_SELECT type attributes. For example, if you have a "Department" attribute, this will return options like "Engineering", "Marketing", "Sales". Note: TEXT and NUMBER type attributes do not have options and will return an empty list. Use cases: - Retrieve available departments, locations, or other categorical options - Display attribute options in a user interface for selection - Validate that a specific option exists before assigning it to a user Prerequisites: - The organization must exist (use get_organization_id to retrieve your orgId) - The attribute must exist (use retrieve_organization_attributes to get attributeId) - Only SINGLE_SELECT and MULTI_SELECT attributes will have options

tools.name: Retrieve booking details by uid
tools.description: Fetches comprehensive details for an existing booking, identified by its `bookingUid`.

tools.name: Retrieve calendar busy times
tools.description: To find busy calendar slots for scheduling/conflict detection, call this with a valid `credentialId`, an `externalId` accessible by it, and a recognized IANA `loggedInUsersTz`; returns only busy intervals, not event details or free slots. Use credentialId/externalId for single calendar queries.

tools.name: Retrieve calendar list
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all calendar summaries (no event details) associated with the authenticated user's account.

tools.name: Retrieve current team for organization
tools.description: Retrieves details of the team(s) for the currently authenticated user within the specified organization `orgId`.

tools.name: Retrieve default conferencing settings
tools.description: Retrieves an account's or organization's read-only default conferencing settings in Cal.com (e.g., video platform, meeting duration) to inform event creation or ensure consistency.

tools.name: Retrieve event type by id
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific, existing Cal.com event type using its unique ID; this is a read-only action and does not return associated events or bookings.

tools.name: Retrieve membership from organization
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific membership within a particular organization.

tools.name: Retrieve my information
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's core profile information (e.g., name, email, timezone); does not retrieve related data like calendar events or schedules.

tools.name: Retrieve OAuth client user by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed profile information for a specific managed user associated with an OAuth client. This endpoint is part of Cal.com's Platform API for OAuth client management. It requires: - A valid OAuth client ID (clientId) obtained from the Cal.com Platform dashboard - A valid managed user ID (userId) that was created via the create managed user endpoint - OAuth client secret key (x_cal_secret_key) for authentication Returns the user's profile including email, name, timezone, schedule settings, and custom metadata. Note: This endpoint requires Platform API access which is available to registered OAuth clients.

tools.name: Retrieve oauth client webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed configuration for a specific webhook by ID from a Platform OAuth client. This Platform API endpoint requires OAuth client credentials (clientId and x-cal-secret-key) to access webhook settings including subscriber URL, active status, event triggers, payload template, and verification secret. Prerequisites: Platform OAuth client created at https://app.cal.com/settings/platform/oauth-clients with both client ID and secret key. Note: Platform offering deprecated Dec 2025, available only to existing enterprise customers. Use cases: Verify webhook config after creation, check active status for troubleshooting, retrieve secret for signature verification, audit settings.

tools.name: Retrieve organization attributes
tools.description: Retrieves detailed attributes (e.g., configurations, settings, metadata) for an organization, identified by its `orgId`, which must correspond to an existing organization.

tools.name: Retrieve organization attributes options
tools.description: Retrieves all attribute options assigned to a specific user within an organization. Attribute options are customizable organizational metadata (like department, role, location, or team) that organizations define and assign to users for flexible categorization and management.

tools.name: Retrieve organization webhook by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information, including configuration and status, for a specific webhook by its ID (`webhookId`) within a given organization (`orgId`).

tools.name: Retrieve organization webhooks by org ID
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for a specific organization, returning an array of webhook objects with their configuration details (ID, triggers, subscriber URL, active status, etc.). Supports pagination via `take` and `skip` parameters. This is a read-only operation that does not modify any webhooks.

tools.name: Retrieve provider details
tools.description: Verifies and retrieves details for an OAuth client (provider) in Cal.com's Platform API. This endpoint is part of Cal.com's Platform API for managing OAuth clients. It verifies the OAuth client credentials (clientId and x-cal-secret-key) and returns provider details including the client ID, associated organization ID, and provider name. Use this to: - Verify that OAuth client credentials are valid - Retrieve the organization ID associated with an OAuth client - Get the registered name of the OAuth client/provider Authentication: Requires both the OAuth client ID (path parameter) and x-cal-secret-key (header). These credentials are obtained from https://app.cal.com/settings/platform/oauth-clients.

tools.name: Retrieve schedules list
tools.description: Retrieve all availability schedules for the authenticated Cal.com user. This action returns a list of schedules that define when a user is available for bookings. Each schedule includes availability time blocks, timezone, and whether it's the default schedule. Use this to: - List all configured schedules for a user - Find the default schedule (isDefault=true) - Get schedule IDs for use with other actions like updating or deleting schedules Returns an empty list if no schedules are configured.

tools.name: Retrieve team details in organization
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of teams and their details for a specific organization ID; individual team member details or schedules are not included.

tools.name: Retrieve team event types
tools.description: Retrieves event types for a team within the Cal scheduling system; this action does not provide details on scheduled instances or member availability.

tools.name: Retrieve team membership by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific team membership by its ID within an organization's team. Returns membership details including the user's role (MEMBER, OWNER, or ADMIN), acceptance status, impersonation settings, and user profile information (email, name, username, avatar, bio). Requires organization-level access permissions.

tools.name: Retrieve team membership details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed attributes for a specific team membership by its ID and the team ID, such as member information, role, and status; does not list all team members.

tools.name: Retrieve team memberships
tools.description: Retrieves all memberships for a team, including member details, roles (MEMBER/OWNER/ADMIN), and invitation acceptance status. Supports pagination via 'take' and 'skip' parameters. Use this action to list team members and their roles. The authenticated user must be a member of the team to access its memberships.

tools.name: Retrieve team memberships for organization
tools.description: Retrieves all user memberships for a specific team within an organization, including each member's role (OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER), acceptance status, impersonation settings, and detailed user information (email, username, name, avatar, bio). Supports pagination via 'take' and 'skip' parameters.

tools.name: Retrieve users in organization
tools.description: Retrieves users associated with a specific organization ID, excluding individual scheduling or calendar data; the `orgId` must be a valid identifier for an existing organization.

tools.name: Retrieve v2 conferencing info
tools.description: Retrieves an authenticated Cal user's or organization's video conferencing configurations, capabilities, and installed apps, useful for understanding options before scheduling or verifying setups; provider availability may vary by subscription or settings.

tools.name: Retrieve webhook details for OAuth client
tools.description: Retrieves all webhook configurations for a specific OAuth client with optional pagination. This endpoint is part of Cal.com's Platform API for managing webhooks associated with OAuth clients. Use this to: - List all webhooks configured for an OAuth client - Audit webhook configurations and their active status - Review subscribed event triggers for each webhook - Retrieve webhook URLs and payload templates The response includes webhook details such as: - Webhook ID and creation timestamp - Target subscriber URL for notifications - Active/inactive status - List of subscribed event triggers (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, etc.) - Custom payload templates (if configured) Pagination is supported via `take` (limit) and `skip` (offset) parameters.

tools.name: Retrieve webhooks for event type
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks (including URLs, subscribed events, and status) for a specified, existing event type ID, useful for auditing configurations or troubleshooting.

tools.name: Retrieve webhooks list
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks from the user's Cal scheduling system account, which are used for real-time notifications on events like new bookings, cancellations, or updates.

tools.name: Save calendar entry
tools.description: Saves or updates a calendar's settings using a GET request, typically for data already on the server or simple updates via query parameters.

tools.name: Save calendar ics feeds
tools.description: Imports and saves one or more publicly accessible external iCalendar (ICS) feed URLs into the Cal.com calendar system.

tools.name: Save OAuth credentials via GCal API
tools.description: Completes the Google Calendar OAuth 2.0 flow by exchanging the `code` and `state` (received from Google's redirect after user consent) for access and refresh tokens.

tools.name: Save stripe details
tools.description: Completes the Stripe OAuth flow by saving Stripe details; call this when a user is redirected back from Stripe with an authorization `code` and `state`.

tools.name: Set default conferencing app
tools.description: Sets the specified, valid, and configured conferencing application as the default for new meetings for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update destination calendar integration
tools.description: Updates the destination calendar for syncing events, using `integration` and `externalId` (typically from `/calendars` endpoint).

tools.name: Update OAuth client user settings
tools.description: Updates specified profile and scheduling preference fields for a user associated with an OAuth client; `defaultScheduleId`, if provided, must be an existing, valid schedule for the user.

tools.name: Update oauth client webhook
tools.description: Updates specified properties of an existing webhook for an OAuth client; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update private link
tools.description: Updates a private link for a team event type within an organization. Use to modify maxUsageCount for usage-based links or expiresAt for time-based links.

tools.name: Update schedule by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing schedule by its ID, allowing partial modification of properties; providing `availability` or `overrides` replaces them entirely.

tools.name: Update team event type
tools.description: Tool to update a team event type in Cal.com. Use when modifying settings for a team's event type such as duration, description, scheduling, locations, or any other event configuration.

tools.name: Update team event type webhook
tools.description: Updates a webhook for a team event type. Use when you need to modify webhook configuration like active status, subscriber URL, triggers, or payload template.

tools.name: Update team information by id
tools.description: Updates an existing team's information by its ID within a specified organization; the `slug`, if provided, must be unique within the organization.

tools.name: Update team membership by id
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing team membership. Supports partial updates - only provided fields are modified while others remain unchanged. Requires appropriate team permissions (admin or owner role). Use 'Get teams list' to find teamId and 'Retrieve team memberships' to find membershipId.

tools.name: Update team membership properties
tools.description: Updates attributes like acceptance status, role, or impersonation settings for an existing team membership within an organization. Only provided fields are changed (partial update). Requires organization admin or owner privileges. Use list memberships endpoint to get valid membershipId values.

tools.name: Update user profile details
tools.description: Updates the profile information and preferences for the authenticated user, affecting only the fields provided in the request.

tools.name: Update user schedule in organization
tools.description: Modifies an existing schedule for a specified user within an organization by updating only the provided fields; the organization, user, and schedule must already exist.

tools.name: Update webhook by id
tools.description: Updates an existing Cal.com webhook by its `webhookId`, allowing partial modification of its attributes; only explicitly provided fields will be changed.

tools.name: Update webhook for organization
tools.description: Updates an existing webhook for an organization. Use this to modify webhook settings such as the subscriber URL, activation status, event triggers, or verification secret. Requires admin access to the organization. Only fields provided in the request will be updated; omitted fields retain their current values.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL for the Cal.com API.

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL for the Cal.com API.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: API key used for authenticating requests to Cal.com. Use 'cal_' prefix for test mode and 'cal_live_' for live mode.

name: Wrike
description: Wrike is a project management and collaboration tool offering customizable workflows, Gantt charts, reporting, and resource management to boost team productivity

tools.name: Bulk modify group members
tools.description: Adds or removes members for multiple Wrike groups in a single request; all specified user IDs must correspond to existing Wrike users.

tools.name: Copy folder
tools.description: Copies a Wrike folder synchronously to a specified parent location with customizable options. Use when duplicating folder structures, optionally copying descriptions, responsibles, custom fields, statuses, and rescheduling tasks.

tools.name: Copy folder async
tools.description: Duplicate a folder asynchronously in Wrike, creating a copy in a specified parent location. Use when copying large folder structures that may take time to complete. Returns an async job ID for tracking progress.

tools.name: Create account webhooks
tools.description: Creates a webhook for the current account to receive notifications about changes. Use when you need to set up real-time event notifications for tasks, folders, or other Wrike objects.

tools.name: Create equipment asset
tools.description: Tool to create equipment/asset in Wrike. Use when you need to add new equipment or assets to track in the system.

tools.name: Create custom field
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom field in Wrike. Use when you need to define a new custom field for tasks, folders, or projects.

tools.name: Create a folder
tools.description: Creates a new Wrike subfolder within the specified `folderId`, optionally as a project if `customItemTypeId` is given; the folder is auto-shared with its creator.

tools.name: Create folder booking
tools.description: Tool to create a booking in a Wrike folder. Use when you need to allocate resources (users or placeholders) to a folder for a specific date range. Either responsibleId or responsiblePlaceholderId must be provided, and bookingDates must include at least two of: startDate, finishDate, or duration.

tools.name: Create approval in folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new approval in a Wrike folder. Use when you need to create an approval workflow for folder content review.

tools.name: Create folder comment
tools.description: Creates a new comment on a specified Wrike folder. Use when adding feedback, updates, or notes to a folder.

tools.name: Create timelog lock period for folder
tools.description: Creates a timelog lock period for a specific folder. Timelogs on or before the specified period date will be locked and cannot be edited. Use when you need to prevent modifications to timelog entries up to a certain date.

tools.name: Create a webhook on folder
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook for a Wrike folder or project. Use when you need to set up real-time notifications for events occurring within a specific folder or its subfolders.

tools.name: Create a group
tools.description: Creates a new user group in Wrike with a specified title, optionally setting members, parent group, avatar, and custom metadata.

tools.name: Create invitation
tools.description: Invites a user to a Wrike workspace by email, optionally with name, specifying EITHER `userTypeId` OR a combination of `role`/`external`; custom email subject/message available for paid accounts.

tools.name: Create space timelog lock period
tools.description: Tool to create a timelog lock period for a space to prevent time entries from being edited. Use when you need to lock timelogs for specific dates, typically before creating payrolls or preparing invoices.

tools.name: Create space webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook on a Wrike space for receiving notifications about changes to tasks, folders, and projects. Use when you need to set up event-driven integrations for space-level changes.

tools.name: Create task in folder
tools.description: Creates a new task in a specified Wrike folder; if setting priority with `priorityBefore` or `priorityAfter`, the referenced task must be in the same folder or project.

tools.name: Create task attachment
tools.description: Tool to upload a file attachment to a Wrike task. Use when you need to attach files to tasks.

tools.name: Create task comment
tools.description: Tool to create a new comment on a Wrike task. Use when you need to add a comment or note to a task.

tools.name: Create task approval
tools.description: Tool to create an approval on a specific task in Wrike. Use when you need to add an approval workflow to a task.

tools.name: Create task dependency
tools.description: Tool to create a new dependency relationship between Wrike tasks. Use when you need to establish that one task must be completed before another can start or finish. Both tasks must have Planned scheduling type (not Backlog) for dependencies to work.

tools.name: Create task timelog
tools.description: Tool to create a timelog entry for a specific task in Wrike. Use when you need to log time spent on a task.

tools.name: Create timesheet
tools.description: Tool to create a timesheet for a user for a specified time period. Use when you need to initialize or retrieve a timesheet for a given week.

tools.name: Create workflows
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom workflow in Wrike. Use when you need to create a new workflow with a specific name.

tools.name: Delete approval
tools.description: Cancels/deletes an approval by its identifier. Use when removing an approval request that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete asset
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Wrike asset/equipment by assetId. Use when removing equipment that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete attachment
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Wrike attachment by its ID. Use when removing an attachment from tasks or folders. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete booking
tools.description: Permanently removes a resource booking allocation by its ID; use when deallocating resources from projects or tasks.

tools.name: Delete comment
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Wrike comment by its ID; this action is irreversible and the comment must exist.

tools.name: Delete custom field by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a custom field by its ID; this action is irreversible and requires a valid, existing custom field ID.

tools.name: Delete dependencies
tools.description: Permanently removes a task dependency relationship by its ID; use when unlinking predecessor/successor task relationships.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Permanently deletes the folder specified by `folderId` and all its contents (e.g., tasks, documents, subfolders) from the Wrike workspace; this irreversible action is for when the folder is no longer needed and has no active tasks or dependencies that would block deletion.

tools.name: Delete timelog lock period for folder
tools.description: Deletes a timelog lock period for a specific folder. This unlocks timelogs on or before the specified period date, allowing them to be edited again. Use when you need to remove a lock period and allow modifications to previously locked timelog entries.

tools.name: Delete group by id
tools.description: Permanently deletes a group by its `groupId`; this action is irreversible and does not affect user accounts that were members of the group.

tools.name: Delete invitation
tools.description: Permanently deletes an existing invitation, specified by its unique `invitationId`; this action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete job role
tools.description: Permanently deletes a job role by its identifier; deleted job roles are removed from all tasks and users and cannot be restored.

tools.name: Delete space
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Wrike space and all its contents by spaceId; this action is irreversible and should be used with caution.

tools.name: Delete spaces timelog lock period
tools.description: Tool to unlock (delete) a timelog lock period for a specific space in Wrike. Use when you need to remove a previously set lock period that prevents timelog modifications.

tools.name: Delete task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Wrike task and all its associated data by its ID; this action is irreversible and the task must exist.

tools.name: Delete timelog
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Wrike timelog entry by its ID; use when removing an incorrect or obsolete time log entry.

tools.name: Delete webhook
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a webhook by webhook_id. Use when you need to remove a webhook subscription. You can only delete webhooks created with the same API token.

tools.name: Fetch all tasks
tools.description: Fetches tasks from a Wrike account, allowing filtering by status, due date, and subfolder inclusion, with customizable response fields and pagination.

tools.name: Get account information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed Wrike account information, where the response content is influenced by selected fields, account subscription, and user permissions.

tools.name: Get all custom fields
tools.description: Retrieves all custom field definitions (including ID, name, type, and settings) from the Wrike account; this returns the definitions themselves, not their specific values on Wrike items, and is useful for obtaining custom field IDs.

tools.name: Get all webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all webhooks created using the same API token. Use when you need to view all webhooks configured for the authenticated API app.

tools.name: Get approvals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all approvals accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to list approvals or check approval statuses across the workspace.

tools.name: Get approvals by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific Wrike approvals by their IDs (up to 100). Use when you need to fetch approval details for known approval identifiers.

tools.name: Get async job status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve status and details for an asynchronous job in Wrike. Use this after initiating async operations (like launch_async endpoints) to check job progress, completion status, and retrieve results.

tools.name: Get attachments by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple Wrike attachments by their IDs (up to 100). Use when you need to fetch details for specific attachments using comma-separated attachment IDs.

tools.name: Download attachment
tools.description: Tool to download a Wrike attachment file. Use when you need to retrieve the actual file content of an attachment by its ID.

tools.name: Get attachment preview
tools.description: Tool to download a preview version of a Wrike attachment. Use when you need to retrieve a preview image of an attachment by its ID.

tools.name: Get attachment URL
tools.description: Tool to get a public access URL for a Wrike attachment. Use when you need to retrieve a temporary URL to access or share an attachment. The returned URL is valid for 24 hours.

tools.name: Get bookings
tools.description: Retrieves one or more Wrike bookings by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch specific booking details for resource allocation and scheduling.

tools.name: Get colors
tools.description: Tool to query the list of available colors in Wrike. Use when you need to retrieve color options for tasks, folders, or other Wrike entities.

tools.name: Get comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comments accessible to the authorized user. Use when you need to fetch comments across tasks and folders, optionally filtered by date range or text format.

tools.name: Get comments by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple Wrike comments by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch specific comments using comma-separated comment IDs (up to 100).

tools.name: Get contact hourly rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve hourly budget rates for up to 100 Wrike contacts. Use when you need to fetch budget rate information for one or multiple contacts.

tools.name: Get contacts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Wrike contacts (e.g., team members, clients, collaborators); response includes contact details but not their detailed task or project involvement.

tools.name: Get contacts history
tools.description: Tool to access field modification history for Wrike contacts. Use when you need to track changes made to contact information over time.

tools.name: Get contact timelogs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all timelog records created by a specific contact in Wrike. Use when you need to query time tracking entries for a particular user.

tools.name: Get custom item types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom item types from Wrike. Use when you need to discover available custom item type definitions for creating work items or understanding the custom item type structure.

tools.name: Get dependencies by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve one or more Wrike dependencies by their IDs (up to 100). Use when you need to fetch details for specific dependencies using comma-separated dependency IDs.

tools.name: Get folder bookings
tools.description: Tool to query bookings for a specific folder in Wrike. Use when you need to retrieve booking information for resource allocation within a particular folder or project.

tools.name: Get folders
tools.description: Retrieves folders and/or projects from Wrike, with filters; when using `nextPageToken`, all other filter parameters must match the initial request.

tools.name: Get folder approvals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all approvals from a specific Wrike folder. Use when you need to fetch approval details for a folder using its folder ID.

tools.name: Get folder attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attachments from a specific Wrike folder. Use when you need to fetch attachment metadata and optionally download URLs for files in a folder.

tools.name: Get folders by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple Wrike folders by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch details for specific folders using comma-separated folder IDs.

tools.name: Get folder comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comments from a specific Wrike folder. Use when you need to fetch all comments associated with a folder.

tools.name: Get folders history
tools.description: Tool to access field modification history for Wrike folders. Use when you need to track changes made to folder information over time.

tools.name: Get folder hourly rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve hourly budget rates for a specific Wrike folder. Use when you need to fetch budget rate information configured for a folder or project.

tools.name: Get folder rollups
tools.description: Tool to query rollup settings for items in a folder. Use when you need to fetch rollup configuration for a specific folder. Pagination is supported for folders with descendants=true, applying to the entire folder hierarchy.

tools.name: Get folder tasks
tools.description: Query tasks within a specific folder. Use this to retrieve all tasks contained in a folder, with optional filtering by status, due date, and metadata.

tools.name: Get folder timelog lock periods
tools.description: Tool to query timelog lock periods for a specific folder. Use when you need to check which time periods are locked for timelog entries in a folder.

tools.name: Get folders timelogs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all timelog records for a specific folder. Use when you need to query time tracking data for a folder and its tasks.

tools.name: Convert legacy v2 IDs to v4
tools.description: Tool to convert legacy Wrike API v2 IDs to current v4 format. Use when you need to work with numeric IDs from the Wrike interface or legacy integrations and convert them to the alphanumeric v4 IDs required by the current API.

tools.name: Get specific contact information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Wrike contact using their unique `contactId`, optionally including `metadata` and `customFields` if specified in the `fields` parameter.

tools.name: Get job roles by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for one or more Wrike job roles by job role IDs. Use when you need to fetch information about specific job roles.

tools.name: Get placeholder hourly rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve hourly budget rates for one or more Wrike placeholders. Use when you need to fetch budget rate information for placeholders, supporting up to 100 IDs in a single request.

tools.name: Get placeholders by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for one or more Wrike placeholders by their IDs. Use when you need to fetch information about specific placeholders, supporting up to 100 IDs in a single request.

tools.name: Get space by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a single Wrike space by spaceId. Use when you need to fetch complete information about a specific space, typically after listing spaces to select one.

tools.name: Get space custom item types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom item types scoped to a specific Wrike space. Use when you need to discover available custom item types for a space before creating work items based on these types.

tools.name: Get space folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the folder tree for a specific Wrike space. Use when you need to list all folders and projects within a space, optionally filtered by project type, authors, owners, title, or custom statuses.

tools.name: Get space custom fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom fields defined for a specific Wrike space. Use when you need to discover what custom fields are available in a space before querying tasks or folders with custom field data.

tools.name: Get spaces tasks
tools.description: Tool to query tasks within a specific Wrike space. Use when you need to retrieve tasks from a particular space, with optional filtering by status, importance, title, and other criteria.

tools.name: Get space workflows
tools.description: Tool to query workflows for a specific Wrike space. Use when you need to retrieve the list of available workflows and their custom statuses for a space.

tools.name: Get space timelog lock periods
tools.description: Tool to query timelog lock periods for a specific space. Use when you need to check which time periods are locked for timelog entries in a space.

tools.name: Get specific user
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific user in Wrike using their unique user ID.

tools.name: Get task by id
tools.description: Retrieves read-only detailed information for a specific Wrike task by its unique ID, optionally allowing specification of fields to include in the response.

tools.name: Get task dependencies
tools.description: Retrieves all dependency relationships for a specific task. Use when you need to see which tasks the specified task depends on (predecessors) or which tasks depend on it (successors).

tools.name: Get task approvals
tools.description: Retrieves all approval records for a specific task. Use when you need to see approval workflow status and decisions for a task.

tools.name: Get task attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attachments from a specific Wrike task. Use when you need to fetch attachment metadata and optionally download URLs for files attached to a task.

tools.name: Get task comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comments from a specific Wrike task. Use when you need to fetch comments associated with a task.

tools.name: Get tasks history
tools.description: Query task field modification history for up to 100 tasks. Use when you need to retrieve the history of changes made to task fields. Returns information about who changed what fields, when the changes occurred, and the old and new values.

tools.name: Get task rollups
tools.description: Tool to query rollup settings for a specific task. Use when you need to retrieve the rollup configuration that determines how custom field values are aggregated from subtasks.

tools.name: Get task timelog lock periods
tools.description: Tool to query timelog lock periods for a specific task. Use when you need to check which time periods are locked for timelog entries on a task.

tools.name: Get task timelogs
tools.description: Retrieves all timelog records for a specific task. Use when you need to see time tracking entries for a task. Supports filtering by creation date, tracked date, and user.

tools.name: Get timelog categories
tools.description: Tool to query the list of timelog categories in Wrike. Use when you need to retrieve available time tracking categories for categorizing timelog entries.

tools.name: Get timelogs
tools.description: Retrieves timelog records from Wrike with optional filters for dates, users, and task scope. Use to query time tracking data across tasks and projects.

tools.name: Get timelogs by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for one or more Wrike timelogs by their unique IDs (up to 100), optionally including export and lock status.

tools.name: Get timesheets
tools.description: Tool to query timesheets from Wrike. Use when you need to retrieve user timesheets showing weekly tracked time, approval status, and timesheet periods.

tools.name: Get timesheet submission rules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve global timesheet submission rules across all work schedules. Use when you need to check timesheet submission configurations globally.

tools.name: Get API version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current Wrike API version information. Use when you need to check the API version being used or verify API compatibility.

tools.name: Get webhook by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific webhook by webhook_id. Use when you need to inspect webhook configuration including the hook URL, status, events, and scope. You can only access webhooks created with the same API token.

tools.name: Get work schedule timesheet rules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve timesheet submission rules for a specific work schedule. Use when you need to check the configuration of timesheet submission requirements for a work schedule.

tools.name: Launch folder blueprint async
tools.description: Asynchronously launches a new project or folder structure in Wrike from a specified Folder Blueprint. Important Notes: - The folder_blueprint_id must be an actual launchable blueprint, NOT a BpRoot container. - Use WRIKE_LIST_FOLDER_BLUEPRINTS to get blueprint IDs. Look for child blueprints within the tree structure. - Blueprints with scope 'BpRoot' are root containers and cannot be launched directly. - The blueprint must fit within 250 items (subfolders, subprojects, and subtasks count towards this limit). - Returns an async job ID that can be used to track progress via the Async Job endpoint.

tools.name: Launch Task Blueprint Async
tools.description: Asynchronously launches a Wrike Task Blueprint to create tasks/projects, requiring either `super_task_id` (parent task) or `parent_id` (parent folder/project) for placement.

tools.name: List all attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attachments from the Wrike account. Use when you need to list attachments with optional date filtering and download URLs.

tools.name: List Folder Blueprints
tools.description: Retrieves all account-level Folder Blueprints, which are templates for standardizing folder/project creation with predefined structures, custom fields, and workflows.

tools.name: List all placeholders
tools.description: Retrieves all placeholders accessible to the authenticated user; placeholders are templates used in Wrike for creating standardized tasks or projects.

tools.name: List space folder blueprints
tools.description: Lists all folder blueprints (templates for new folders/projects) within a specified Wrike space, requiring a valid and accessible space ID.

tools.name: List spaces
tools.description: Tool to list spaces the authorized user can access. Use when you need to discover valid spaceIds for downstream space-scoped operations like listing space blueprints.

tools.name: List space task blueprints
tools.description: Lists task blueprints (templates for creating tasks with consistent structures) available in a specific, accessible Wrike space.

tools.name: List subfolders by folder id
tools.description: Lists subfolders (metadata only, not their contents) for an existing Wrike folder specified by `folderId`, supporting recursive descent, filtering, and pagination.

tools.name: List Task Blueprints
tools.description: Retrieves a list of defined Task Blueprints (predefined task templates) from the Wrike account, supporting pagination.

tools.name: Update account metadata
tools.description: Updates or adds custom key-value metadata to the Wrike account, useful for integrations, storing app-specific data, or mapping external system identifiers.

tools.name: Modify folder attributes
tools.description: Modifies an existing Wrike folder: updates title, description, parents (not root/recycle bin), sharing, metadata, custom fields/columns; restores, converts to project, or manages access roles.

tools.name: Modify group
tools.description: Updates an existing Wrike user group's attributes like title, members, parent, avatar, or metadata, using its `groupId` and specifying only the fields to change.

tools.name: Modify task
tools.description: Modifies an existing Wrike task by its ID, allowing updates to attributes such as title, status, dates, assignees, and custom fields; `priorityBefore` and `priorityAfter` are mutually exclusive, and parent folder IDs for `addParents`/`removeParents` cannot be the Recycle Bin.

tools.name: Retrieve custom field by id
tools.description: Retrieves a Wrike custom field's detailed information (e.g., type, possible values for dropdowns), properties, and metadata; the `customFieldId` must correspond to an existing custom field.

tools.name: Query invitations
tools.description: Retrieves all active invitations in Wrike, useful for viewing and auditing pending invitations or managing user onboarding.

tools.name: Query job roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available job roles in the Wrike account. Use when you need to discover job roles or get a complete list of roles without knowing specific IDs.

tools.name: Get group by id
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific Wrike group using its `groupId`, optionally including 'metadata'.

tools.name: Query workflows
tools.description: Fetches a list of all workflows with their detailed information from the Wrike account; this is a read-only action and does not support pagination or filtering through its parameters.

tools.name: Retrieve list of groups
tools.description: Retrieves a list of user groups from the Wrike account, supporting metadata filtering, pagination, and inclusion of specific fields; this is a read-only operation.

tools.name: Search eDiscovery
tools.description: Tool to perform eDiscovery search across Wrike items (folders, projects, tasks). Use when you need to find items matching specific search terms across different scopes. Supports wildcard searches and filtering by item types.

tools.name: Update approval
tools.description: Updates an existing Wrike approval by its ID, allowing modifications to the title, description, and due date.

tools.name: Update asset
tools.description: Tool to update a Wrike asset/equipment by ID. Use when you need to rename or modify an equipment asset in the system.

tools.name: Update attachment
tools.description: Tool to update a Wrike attachment by uploading new file content. Use when you need to replace an existing attachment with a new version.

tools.name: Update booking
tools.description: Updates a Wrike booking's date range by ID. Use when you need to reschedule a resource booking by modifying its start and finish dates.

tools.name: Update comment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Wrike comment. Use when you need to modify the text content of a comment. Supports HTML formatting with limited tags.

tools.name: Update custom field by id
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing Wrike custom field by its ID, such as its title, type, scope, or sharing settings.

tools.name: Update dependency
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing Wrike dependency relationship between tasks. Use when you need to update the dependency type or change which tasks are linked.

tools.name: Update folder rollup settings
tools.description: Tool to update rollup settings for a folder. Use when you need to enable or disable field aggregation from descendant items.

tools.name: Update invitation
tools.description: Updates a pending Wrike invitation (`invitationId`) to resend it or change user's role/type (use EITHER `userTypeId` OR `role`/`external`).

tools.name: Update job role
tools.description: Updates an existing Wrike job role by its ID, allowing modifications to the title and short title.

tools.name: Update metadata on a specific contact
tools.description: Updates metadata, job role, or custom fields for an existing Wrike contact specified by `contactId`; if `jobRoleId` is provided, it must be a valid ID.

tools.name: Update a specific user
tools.description: Updates specified profile attributes (e.g., account ID, role, external status) for an existing Wrike user; unspecified fields remain unchanged. Note: The current API user can only update users they have permission to modify. Account owners, robot users, and the current user themselves typically cannot be modified. This action requires the 'amReadWriteUser' OAuth scope.

tools.name: Update task rollup settings
tools.description: Updates rollup settings for a task. Rollup settings control how field values aggregate from child tasks to parent tasks. Use this when you need to enable or disable automatic rollup calculations for specific fields like start dates, due dates, or custom fields.

tools.name: Update timelog entry
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing timelog entry in Wrike. Use when you need to update the hours, comment, tracked date, or category of a time log.

tools.name: Update timesheet row
tools.description: Updates a Wrike timesheet row by its ID, allowing modification of the timelog category. Use when you need to change the time tracking category for a timesheet entry.

tools.name: Update timesheet
tools.description: Tool to update a timesheet's approval status in Wrike. Use when you need to submit, approve, or reject a timesheet.

tools.name: Update webhook state
tools.description: Tool to update the state of a Wrike webhook. Use when you need to re-enable a suspended webhook or suspend an active one. Wrike automatically suspends webhooks after 3 failed delivery attempts. Call this with status=Active to re-enable.

tools.name: Update workflow
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing Wrike workflow. Use when you need to update a workflow's name or description. Requires amReadWriteWorkflow scope.

tools.name: Update work schedule timesheet rules
tools.description: Tool to update timesheet submission rules for a work schedule. Use when you need to configure or modify how timesheet submissions are validated and enforced for a specific work schedule.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL of your Wrike instance (e.g., https://www.wrike.com).

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Exa
description: Exa focuses on data extraction and search, helping teams gather, analyze, and visualize information from websites, APIs, or internal databases

tools.name: Generate an answer
tools.description: Generates a direct, citation-backed answer to a clear natural language question or topic using Exa's search, adept at both specific answers and detailed summaries for open-ended queries. Response contains an `answer` field (summary) and a `citations` field (supporting URLs). Citations may include low-credibility sources; verify authoritative references for factual use.

tools.name: Batch Search Monitors
tools.description: Delete, pause, or unpause one batch of matching Search API monitors, not Websets monitors. Defaults to dry_run=true: previews matches without changes. Set dry_run=false explicitly to apply the action; deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. When has_more is true, repeat the request until has_more is false to process all matches. Dry-run previews do not consume matches, so repeating a preview does not advance the batch. Does not automatically process further batches.

tools.name: Cancel Agent Run
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running Agent run immediately without returning results. Usage accrued before cancellation is still billed. If the run is already terminal, Exa returns the existing run unchanged.

tools.name: Cancel Webset
tools.description: Cancel all operations on a Webset, stopping searches and enrichments. The Webset is marked idle; this does not delete the Webset.

tools.name: Cancel Webset Enrichment
tools.description: Cancel a running Webset enrichment and return its updated state. All running work for the specified enrichment is canceled. A canceled enrichment cannot be resumed.

tools.name: Cancel Webset Search
tools.description: Cancel a running search in a Webset and return its updated state. Cancels only the specified search, not all searches in the Webset.

tools.name: Create Agent Run
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Exa Agent run for multi-step web research or enrichment. Save the returned ID and poll Get Agent Run until the run reaches a terminal status.

tools.name: Create API Key
tools.description: Create an API key for the authenticated Exa team. Requires Team Management enabled for the team (contact support@exa.ai) and a service API key, not an ordinary search key. Treat the returned key record as sensitive; never log credentials. Creating keys is not idempotent.

tools.name: Create Import
tools.description: Tool to create a new import to upload data into a Webset. Use when you need to initialize an import before uploading the data file.

tools.name: Create a Monitor
tools.description: Tool to create a new Monitor. Use when you need to schedule automated updates for a Webset without manual runs.

tools.name: Create Search Monitor
tools.description: Create a Search API monitor that delivers new, deduplicated search results to a webhook. Omit trigger for manual runs only. Save webhookSecret securely: it is returned only at creation. Not a Websets monitor.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook delivering selected events to your URL. Store the signing secret securely: it is returned only on creation, not on later retrievals.

tools.name: Create Webset
tools.description: Tool to create a new Webset with search, import, and enrichment setup. Use when you need to configure and seed a Webset in one call.

tools.name: Create Webset Enrichment
tools.description: Create an enrichment task for items in an existing Webset. Returns the enrichment's current state; creation does not imply completion.

tools.name: Create Webset Search
tools.description: Create a search for an existing Webset and return its initial state. Searches run asynchronously. By default, existing results are reused and evaluated against the new criteria; override replaces items, append adds items.

tools.name: Delete Agent Run
tools.description: Delete a stored Exa Agent run by ID and return its deletion receipt.

tools.name: Delete API Key
tools.description: Delete an API key belonging to the authenticated team using a Team Management service key. Never delete the key authenticating the current connection. Use only a disposable key for testing; deletion revokes the target key's access.

tools.name: Delete import
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing import. Use when you need to permanently remove an import by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Search Monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a Search API monitor and return the deleted monitor. This cannot be undone. Not a Websets monitor.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete a webhook, making its status inactive and stopping future deliveries to its URL. Returns the webhook's updated state.

tools.name: Delete webset
tools.description: Tool to delete a Webset. Use after confirming the Webset ID to permanently remove the Webset and all its items.

tools.name: Delete Webset Enrichment
tools.description: Delete a Webset enrichment and return the deleted enrichment. Cancels running enrichments and makes all results generated by this enrichment unavailable.

tools.name: Delete Webset Item
tools.description: Delete an item from a Webset and return the deleted item. Cancels any enrichment process for the item.

tools.name: Delete Websets Monitor
tools.description: Delete a Websets monitor and return the deleted monitor. Uses the Websets API, not the separate Search /monitors API.

tools.name: Find similar (Deprecated)
tools.description: Find related web pages by using the source URL as an Exa Search query. Migrated from the provider-deprecated /findSimilar endpoint to /search. Keeps the legacy input and response fields; search ranking replaces legacy embedding similarity scores, which may be absent. Prefer EXA_SEARCH for new code.

tools.name: Get Agent Run
tools.description: Retrieve an Agent run to inspect its status, output, citations, usage, or cost.

tools.name: Get API Key
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific API key by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about an API key in the team management context.

tools.name: Get API Key Usage
tools.description: Get an Exa API key's total cost and cost breakdown for a time period. Requires Team Management enabled for the team (contact support@exa.ai) and a service API key, not an ordinary search key. Defaults to the last 30 days.

tools.name: Get contents from URLs or document IDs
tools.description: Retrieve text / highlights / summary / subpages from URLs. The endpoint returns HTTP 200 even when individual URLs fail — always inspect `statuses[]` for CRAWL_NOT_FOUND, CRAWL_LIVECRAWL_TIMEOUT, SOURCE_NOT_AVAILABLE. Control freshness with `maxAgeHours` (0 = always livecrawl, -1 = cache only). Use `subpages` + `subpageTarget` to crawl linked pages within a site in one request.

tools.name: Get Event
tools.description: Tool to get details of a specific event by its ID. Use when you have an event ID and need its full details.

tools.name: Get Import
tools.description: Retrieve an import by ID to inspect its status, entity count, and failure details.

tools.name: Get Search Monitor
tools.description: Retrieve a Search API monitor's configuration, status, and next scheduled run by ID. Not a Websets monitor.

tools.name: Get Search Monitor Run
tools.description: Retrieve a Search API monitor run's status and full output when completed. Not a Websets monitor run.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieve a webhook's status, events, destination URL, and metadata by ID. The signing secret is not returned; it is available only on creation.

tools.name: Get Webset
tools.description: Retrieve a Webset by ID or external ID, including its status and operations. Set expand to ["items"] to include up to the first 100 items. This does not retrieve additional item pages.

tools.name: Get Webset Enrichment
tools.description: Retrieve an enrichment configured on a Webset, including its status, description, format, and options.

tools.name: Get Webset Item
tools.description: Retrieve a Webset item by ID, including its properties, evaluations, and enrichments.

tools.name: Get Webset Search
tools.description: Retrieve a Webset search by ID to inspect its status, progress, and recall metrics.

tools.name: Get Websets Monitor
tools.description: Retrieve a Websets monitor's status, schedule, search behavior, and last run. Uses the Websets API, not the separate Search /monitors API.

tools.name: Get Websets Monitor Run
tools.description: Retrieve a Websets monitor run's status, type, timestamps, and failure reason. Uses the Websets API, not the separate Search /monitors API.

tools.name: Get Websets Team Info
tools.description: Get the authenticated Websets team's identity, current concurrency usage, and limits.

tools.name: List Agent Run Events
tools.description: List one page of stored Exa Agent run events as JSON. Pass nextCursor as cursor when hasMore is true; pagination is not automatic. SSE streaming/replay and its Last-Event-ID header are not exposed.

tools.name: List Agent Runs
tools.description: List one page of your team's Exa Agent runs, ordered newest to oldest. Pass the returned nextCursor as cursor to retrieve the next page when hasMore is true. This action does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List API Keys
tools.description: List the authenticated Exa team's API keys, or retrieve one by API key ID. Requires Team Management enabled for the team (contact support@exa.ai) and a service API key, not an ordinary search key. Returns apiKeys without a filter or apiKey with api_key_id; the endpoint has no documented pagination. Treat returned key records as sensitive; never log credentials.

tools.name: List events
tools.description: Tool to list all events that have occurred in the system. Use when you need to paginate through the event history.

tools.name: List imports
tools.description: Tool to list all imports for the Webset. Use when you need to paginate through and monitor import jobs.

tools.name: List Search Monitor Runs
tools.description: List one page of a Search API monitor's runs, newest first, including status and output. Not for Websets monitors. When hasMore is true, pass nextCursor as cursor to retrieve the next page. Does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List Search Monitors
tools.description: List one page of the authenticated team's Search API monitors, not Websets monitors. Filter by status, name, or metadata. When hasMore is true, pass nextCursor as cursor to fetch another page. Does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List Webhook Attempts
tools.description: List one page of a webhook's delivery attempts in descending order. Filter by event type or success status and pass nextCursor as cursor to retrieve another page. Does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks for Websets. Use when you need to view existing webhooks and paginate through results.

tools.name: List Webset Items
tools.description: List one page of a Webset's items, optionally filtered by source ID. Pass nextCursor as cursor when hasMore is true. Does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List Websets
tools.description: List one page of Websets, optionally filtered by ID, external ID, or title. When hasMore is true, pass nextCursor as cursor to retrieve the next page. This action does not automatically paginate.

tools.name: List Websets Monitor Runs
tools.description: List one page of runs for a Websets monitor, including status and timestamps. Uses /websets/v0/monitors/{monitor}/runs, not Search API monitors. Returns hasMore and nextCursor without automatic pagination; the provider documents no pagination request parameters for this operation.

tools.name: List Websets Monitors
