tools.description: Partially update an existing speech engine's connection, ASR, TTS, turn detection, privacy or limits. Omitted fields remain unchanged. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Studio Project
tools.description: Update a Studio project's name, default voices, and optional download metadata. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Update a conversation tag's title and/or description as its owner or a workspace admin. Omit fields to leave them unchanged. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Test Folder
tools.description: Rename an existing agent test folder. Currently only the folder name can be updated. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Tool Override
tools.description: Update configuration overrides for one MCP tool and return its server configuration. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection; omitted settings are not sent and explicit nulls are preserved.

tools.name: Update Transcript Segment
tools.description: Edit a source transcript segment's text, speaker, or timing (Enterprise only). Omitted fields stay unchanged. Bumps the project revision, discards affected translations in every language target, and marks completed targets stale. Audio changes only when a target is regenerated. Requires your own connection.

tools.name: Update Transcript Segments
tools.description: Enterprise only: atomically edit source segments' text, speaker, or timing. Increments the transcript revision, discards affected translations in every target language, and marks completed targets stale. Regenerate a target to change its audio. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Translated Segment
tools.description: Edit a dubbing target segment's translation (Enterprise only, own connection). Omitted translation is unchanged; null clears it for re-translation. Increments the target revision and marks a completed target stale. Audio changes only after regenerating the target; source text and other languages remain untouched.

tools.name: Update Translated Segments
tools.description: Edit 1–500 segment translations for a dubbing language target atomically (Enterprise only). Increments the target revision and marks completed targets stale. Omitted translations stay unchanged; null requests re-translation. Audio changes only after regenerating the target. Requires your own ElevenLabs connection.

tools.name: Update Triage Ticket

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ElevenLabs API key (starts with 'sk_'). Create one at elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys and copy it right away — it's shown only once. tools.name: List team schedule day notes
tools.description: Tool to list all dayNotes from a team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all day notes or search/filter notes for specific dates in a team's schedule.

tools.name: List scheduling groups
tools.description: Tool to list scheduling groups in a team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all scheduling groups for shift management and organization.

tools.name: List service principals
tools.description: Find Microsoft Entra service principals with OData filtering, search, ordering, and property selection.

tools.name: List shifts
tools.description: Tool to list shifts in a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all shifts for a team's schedule.

tools.name: List Graph subscriptions
tools.description: List Microsoft Graph change-notification subscriptions visible to the connected application and user.

tools.name: List swap shifts change requests
tools.description: Tool to list swap shift change requests in a Microsoft Teams schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all swap shift requests for a team's schedule.

tools.name: List team members
tools.description: Tool to list members of a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to retrieve the members of a specific team, for auditing or notifications.

tools.name: List Team Operations
tools.description: Tool to list operations from a team. Use when you need to retrieve all async operations (such as team creation, archiving, channel creation) for a specific team.

tools.name: List teams permission grants
tools.description: Tool to list all resource-specific permission grants for a team with support for filtering, pagination, and sorting. Use when you need to identify which Microsoft Entra apps have access to a team and their corresponding permissions.

tools.name: List team tags
tools.description: List tags configured in a Microsoft Teams team.

tools.name: List Teams templates
tools.description: Tool to list available Microsoft Teams templates. Use when retrieving templates for team creation or customization workflows.

tools.name: List team time off entries
tools.description: Tool to list time off entries from a Microsoft Teams team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve all time off periods for a team.

tools.name: List team schedule time off reasons
tools.description: Tool to get time off reasons from a team's schedule. Use when you need to retrieve the list of available time off reasons for scheduling in Microsoft Teams.

tools.name: List time off requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of time off requests from a Microsoft Teams team's schedule. Use when you need to view all time off requests including their status (pending, approved, declined), dates, and associated users.

tools.name: List user's chat members
tools.description: Tool to list members of a specific chat for a user in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to retrieve the members of a specific user's chat, whether it's a one-on-one chat, group chat, or meeting chat.

tools.name: List user chat messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve messages from a specific chat for a given user. Use when you need to access chat messages through the user context.

tools.name: List user direct reports
tools.description: List users, contacts, and other directory objects who directly report to a specified Microsoft Entra user.

tools.name: List user joined teams
tools.description: Tool to list the Teams that a specified user is a direct member of (joined teams). Use for access/membership audits when enumerating team members is access-restricted.

tools.name: List user license details
tools.description: List Microsoft product licenses and service-plan provisioning states for a selected tenant user.

tools.name: List user directory memberships
tools.description: List a user's direct Microsoft Entra directory memberships with optional selected fields and advanced queries.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: Tool to list all users in the organization. Use when you need to retrieve directory users with filtering, pagination, and field selection.

tools.name: List workbook tables
tools.description: List tables in an Excel workbook stored in a Microsoft Graph drive item.

tools.name: List workbook worksheets
tools.description: List workbook worksheets

tools.name: Mark chat as read for user
tools.description: Tool to mark a chat as read for a specific user in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to update the read status of a chat for a particular user.

tools.name: Mark chat as unread for user
tools.description: Marks a specific chat as unread for a user by setting the last read message timestamp. Use when you need to mark messages after a certain time as unread.

tools.name: Pin message in chat
tools.description: Tool to pin a message in a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to highlight an important message for quick access.

tools.name: Reply to Teams channel message
tools.description: Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by `message_id`, within a specific `channel_id` of a given `team_id` in Microsoft Teams.

tools.name: Provision channel email address
tools.description: Tool to provision an email address for a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to enable email integration for a specific channel.

tools.name: Read worksheet range
tools.description: Read worksheet range

tools.name: Remove channel email address
tools.description: Tool to remove the email address of a channel in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to disable email integration for a specific channel.

tools.name: Remove chat member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to remove a user from a chat conversation.

tools.name: Remove Microsoft 365 group member
tools.description: Remove a directory object's direct membership reference from a Microsoft 365 group without deleting the directory object.

tools.name: Remove team member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to remove a user from a team.

tools.name: Remove team members
tools.description: Tool to remove multiple members from a Microsoft Teams team in bulk. Use when you need to remove one or more users from a team.

tools.name: Search Teams files
tools.description: Search files in Microsoft Teams using KQL syntax. Find files by name, type, content, author, and modification date across all Teams and channels. Supports boolean logic and date ranges. Examples: 'filetype:pdf AND lastmodifiedtime>=2024-10-01', 'contract AND budget', 'filename:report AND author:user@example.com'

tools.name: Search Teams messages
tools.description: Search Microsoft Teams messages using KQL syntax. Supports sender (from:), date filters (sent:), attachments, and boolean logic. Works across all Teams chats and channels the user has access to, including matching self-DM/personal-note messages whose resource chatId is `48:notes`. Examples: 'from:user@example.com AND sent>=2024-10-01', 'punchlist OR termination', 'sent>today-30 AND hasattachment:yes' NOTE: This action requires an organizational Microsoft 365 account (Azure AD/Entra ID). It does NOT work with personal Microsoft accounts (MSA) such as @outlook.com, @hotmail.com, or @live.com. If using a personal Microsoft account, this search will fail.

tools.name: Send Activity Notification to Recipients
tools.description: Tool to send activity notifications to specified recipients in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to send custom notifications to users, team members, or channel members.

tools.name: Send a message to yourself
tools.description: Send a message to your Microsoft Teams self-DM (the chat with yourself), useful for saving a personal note without looking up any chat or user ID.

tools.name: Set My Preferred Presence (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_USER_PREFERRED_PRESENCE instead. Tool to set the preferred availability and activity status for the current authenticated user. Use when you need to update your own presence status in Microsoft Teams. Preferred presence takes effect only when at least one presence session exists.

tools.name: Set Presence
tools.description: Tool to set the presence information for a user's application presence session. Use when you need to update a user's presence state in Microsoft Teams. Valid combinations: Available/Available, Busy/InACall, Busy/InAConferenceCall, Away/Away, or DoNotDisturb/Presenting.

tools.name: Set Presence Automatic Location
tools.description: Tool to set the automatic presence location (office/remote/timeOff) for a specified user. Use when updating work location status in Microsoft Teams via automatic detection.

tools.name: Set Presence Manual Location (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use MICROSOFT_TEAMS_SET_USER_PRESENCE_MANUAL_LOCATION instead. Tool to set the manual presence location (office/remote/timeOff) for the authenticated user. Use when updating work location status in Microsoft Teams.

tools.name: Set User Preferred Presence
tools.description: Tool to set the preferred availability and activity status for a user. Use when you need to update a user's presence status in Microsoft Teams. Preferred presence takes effect only when at least one presence session exists for the user.

tools.name: Set User Presence Manual Location
tools.description: Tool to set the manual presence location (office/remote/timeOff) for a specific user. Use when updating work location status for a user in Microsoft Teams.

tools.name: Share Team Schedule
tools.description: Tool to share a Microsoft Teams schedule for a specified time range. Use when you need to make a team's schedule visible to members.

tools.name: Create a channel
tools.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_CREATE_CHANNEL`) Tool to create a new standard, private, or shared channel within a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to create a new channel for team collaboration.

tools.name: Create Chat
tools.description: Creates a new chat; if a 'oneOnOne' chat with the specified members already exists, its details are returned, while 'group' chats are always newly created. IMPORTANT: The authenticated user MUST be included as one of the members.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: Retrieves Microsoft Teams accessible by the authenticated user, allowing filtering, property selection, and pagination.

tools.name: List channel messages
tools.description: Tool to list messages in a Teams channel when team_id and channel_id are known (no chat_id required). Use this to enumerate channel message history and obtain message_id for follow-on operations like listing replies or getting message details.

tools.name: List team channels
tools.description: Retrieves channels for a specified Microsoft Teams team ID (must be valid and for an existing team), with options to include shared channels, filter results, and select properties.

tools.name: List chat messages (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use ListUserChatMessages instead. Retrieves messages (newest first) from an existing and accessible Microsoft Teams one-on-one chat, group chat, or channel thread, specified by `chat_id`.

tools.name: Send Channel Message
tools.description: Posts a new top-level message to a channel in Microsoft Teams (does NOT reply to an existing message). Despite the file name 'reply_to_channel_chat', this action creates a brand-new message in the channel via POST /teams/{id}/channels/{id}/messages. To reply to an existing message thread, use the dedicated reply action instead.

tools.name: Send message to Teams chat
tools.description: Sends a non-empty message (text or HTML) to a specified, existing Microsoft Teams chat; content must be valid HTML if `content_type` is 'html'.

tools.name: Reply to Teams channel message
tools.description: (DEPRECATED: use `MICROSOFT_TEAMS_POST_MESSAGE_REPLY`) Sends a reply to an existing message, identified by `message_id`, within a specific `channel_id` of a given `team_id` in Microsoft Teams.

tools.name: Unarchive channel
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a channel in a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to restore an archived channel to active state.

tools.name: Unarchive group team channel
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a channel in a Microsoft Teams group's team. Use when you need to restore an archived channel to active state.

tools.name: Unarchive Teams team
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a Microsoft Teams team. Use when you need to restore an archived team to active state.

tools.name: Unhide Chat For User
tools.description: Tool to unhide a chat for a specific user. Use when you need to make a hidden chat visible again in the user's chat list.

tools.name: Unpin chat message
tools.description: Tool to unpin a message from a Microsoft Teams chat. Use when you need to remove a pinned message.

tools.name: Update Call
tools.description: Tool to update the navigation property calls in Microsoft Teams communications. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing call.

tools.name: Update Call Operation
tools.description: Tool to update the navigation property operations in communications. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing call operation.

tools.name: Update Call Participant
tools.description: Tool to update a participant in a Microsoft Teams call. Use when you need to modify participant properties such as lobby status.

tools.name: Update Teams channel
tools.description: Tool to update channel properties in a Microsoft Teams group. Use when you need to modify channel description, display name, or favorite settings.

tools.name: Update Teams channel message
tools.description: Tool to update a message in a channel. Use when you need to modify an existing channel message after confirming channel and message IDs.

tools.name: Update Chat
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of a chat. Use when you need to modify chat settings such as the topic.

tools.name: Update Teams chat message
tools.description: Tool to update a specific message in a chat. Use when you need to correct or modify a sent chat message.

tools.name: Update Content Sharing Session
tools.description: Tool to update a content sharing session in a Microsoft Teams call. Use when you need to modify the properties of an existing content sharing session.

tools.name: Update schedule day note
tools.description: Tool to update an existing day note in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify notes or reminders for a specific date in the team schedule.

tools.name: Update Drive Item
tools.description: Rename, move, or update file-system times for a Microsoft Graph drive item. Descriptions can be changed only for OneDrive Personal items.

tools.name: Update online meeting
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of an existing Microsoft Teams online meeting. Use when you need to modify meeting details such as subject, start time, or end time.

tools.name: Update open shift
tools.description: Tool to update an existing open shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to modify open shift details such as times, theme, notes, or open slot count.

tools.name: Update Planner bucket
tools.description: Update a Planner bucket name or ordering with ETag concurrency.

tools.name: Update Planner task
tools.description: Update selected properties of a Microsoft Planner task using its last known ETag for optimistic concurrency.

tools.name: Update scheduling group
tools.description: Tool to replace/update a scheduling group in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing scheduling group such as display name, active status, code, or member list.

tools.name: Renew Graph subscription
tools.description: Renew a Microsoft Graph subscription or replace its notification URL.

tools.name: Update Teams channel tab
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of a tab in a Microsoft Teams channel. Use when you need to modify tab display name, configuration, or web URL.

tools.name: Update Team
tools.description: Tool to update the properties of a team. Use when you need to modify team settings such as member, messaging, or fun settings.

tools.name: Update team member
tools.description: Tool to update a team member's roles or properties in Microsoft Teams. Use when you need to change a member's role (e.g., promote to owner or demote to member).

tools.name: Update team schedule shift
tools.description: Tool to update an existing shift in a Microsoft Teams team schedule. Use when you need to modify shift details like times, assigned user, or notes.

tools.name: Update time off
tools.description: Tool to replace an existing timeOff entry in a team's schedule. Use when you need to update time off details including dates, reason, or status.

tools.name: Update time off reason
tools.description: Tool to update a time off reason in a team's schedule. Use when you need to modify the display name, icon, active status, or code of an existing time off reason.

tools.name: Upload drive file
tools.description: Upload a file up to 250 MB as a child of a Microsoft drive item. If a file with the same name already exists, this operation replaces its contents.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (email, name) of the connected Microsoft Teams account.

name: Asana
description: Tool to help teams organize, track, and manage their work.

tools.name: Add Followers to Project
tools.description: Tool to add followers to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific project. Followers will receive notifications when tasks are added to the project.

tools.name: Add Followers to Task
tools.description: Tool to add followers to a task in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as followers to a specific task. This will notify them of updates to the task.

tools.name: Add item to portfolio
tools.description: Add a project (or other supported item) to an Asana portfolio using the native addItem endpoint. Use when a workflow needs to attach a newly created project to a portfolio without using ASANA_SUBMIT_PARALLEL_REQUESTS.

tools.name: Add Members to Project
tools.description: Tool to add users to a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to add one or more users as members to a specific project. Members can view and contribute to the project.

tools.name: Add Project to Task
tools.description: Tool to add a project to a task in Asana. Use when you need to associate a task with a project. Optionally position the task within the project using insert_before, insert_after, or section parameters.

tools.name: Add Supporting Relationship to Goal
tools.description: Tool to add a supporting goal relationship to a goal. Use when you want to link a project, task, portfolio, or another goal as a supporting resource to a specific goal in Asana.

tools.name: Add Tag to Task
tools.description: Tool to add an existing tag to a task in Asana. Use when you need to add a tag for prioritization, routing, or automation workflows. Tags cannot be added via Update Task, so this dedicated endpoint is required.

tools.name: Add Task Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to add dependency relationships to an Asana task. Use when you need to mark one or more tasks as prerequisites (dependencies) for another task, ensuring the dependency tasks must be completed first.

tools.name: Add task to section
tools.description: Adds an existing task to a section, optionally positioning it before or after another task in that section; if no position is specified, the task is added to the end.

tools.name: Add User for Team
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a team in Asana. Use this when you need to add a user to a specific team by providing their user GID, email, or "me" for the current user.

tools.name: Add User for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a workspace or organization in Asana. Use this when you need to add a user to a specific workspace by providing their user GID, email, or "me" for the current user.

tools.name: Approve Access Request
tools.description: Tool to approve an access request in Asana. Use when you need to grant access to a resource that requires approval workflow.

tools.name: Create Access Request
tools.description: Tool to create an access request in Asana. Use when you need to request access to a project or portfolio that you don't currently have access to.

tools.name: Create Allocation
tools.description: Creates a new allocation. Use when you need to schedule or assign a specific amount of a user's time per week to a task or project within a defined period.

tools.name: Create a project
tools.description: Creates a new Asana project in the specified workspace. Requires a `workspace` GID, and additionally a `team` GID if the workspace is an organization.

tools.name: Create a tag in a workspace
tools.description: Creates a new tag, with properties like name and color defined in the request body, within a specific Asana workspace (using `workspace_gid`); this tag helps categorize tasks, is confined to the workspace, and is not automatically applied to tasks.

tools.name: Create task in asana with specific details
tools.description: Creates a new Asana task; requires 'workspace', 'parent', or 'projects' for association, and 'followers', 'projects', 'tags' are set only at creation.

tools.name: Create Attachment for Object
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment or link an external resource to a task, project, or project_brief in Asana. Use when you need to attach a file or external URL to any Asana object.

tools.name: Create Attachment for Task
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment to a task. Use when you need to attach a file to a specific task in Asana.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom field in a workspace. Use when you need to define a new field for tracking specific information within Asana tasks.

tools.name: Create Enum Option for Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new enum option for a custom field in Asana. Use this when you need to add a new selectable option to an existing custom field.

tools.name: Create Membership
tools.description: Tool to create a membership by adding a user or team to a project, goal, or portfolio. Use when you need to grant access to an Asana resource.

tools.name: Create Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to create a project brief for a project. Use when you need to add a detailed explanation (what and why) to a project.

tools.name: Create project for team
tools.description: Tool to create a project in a team. Use when you need to create a new project within a specific Asana team.

tools.name: Create project for workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a project in a workspace. Use when you need to create a new project within a specific Asana workspace. Note: The team field is required when creating projects in workspaces.

tools.name: Create Project Status Update
tools.description: Tool to create a new status update on a project. Use when you need to communicate the current status, progress, or any blockers related to a specific project.

tools.name: Create a section in a project
tools.description: Creates a new SECTION (not a task) in a project. Sections are organizational containers within a project used to group and categorize tasks (e.g., 'To Do', 'In Progress', 'Done', 'Backlog'). The new section can be optionally positioned relative to an existing section in the same project. IMPORTANT: This action creates SECTIONS only. Do NOT use this action to create tasks. To create a task, use the ASANA_CREATE_A_TASK action instead. Task-related fields like 'assignee', 'notes', 'due_date', 'description' are NOT supported by this action.

tools.name: Create Status Update for Object
tools.description: Tool to create a status update on a project, portfolio, or goal. Use when you need to communicate progress, blockers, or current state to all followers of an object.

tools.name: Create subtask
tools.description: Creates a new Asana subtask under an existing parent task (`task_gid`); `due_on` and `due_at` are mutually exclusive and cannot be set simultaneously.

tools.name: Create a tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag in an Asana workspace. Use when you need to create a tag for categorizing tasks. Tags help organize and filter tasks across projects but are not automatically applied to any tasks.

tools.name: Create task comment
tools.description: Adds a new text comment (story) to an existing Asana task, appearing in its activity feed.

tools.name: Create Team
tools.description: Tool to create a new team in an Asana workspace. Use when you need to establish a new team for collaboration.

tools.name: Delete Allocation
tools.description: Tool to delete an allocation by its ID. Use this when you need to remove a specific resource allocation in Asana.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Tool to delete an attachment by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an existing attachment from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an existing custom field from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Membership
tools.description: Tool to delete a membership by its GID. Use this when you need to remove a user or team's access to a project, portfolio, goal, or custom field in Asana.

tools.name: Delete a project
tools.description: Delete a project.

tools.name: Delete Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to delete a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to remove a project brief from Asana. Note: This requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid).

tools.name: Delete Project Status
tools.description: Tool to delete a project status by its GID. Use when you need to remove a specific project status update from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a section
tools.description: Tool to delete a section by its GID. Use when you need to permanently remove a section from a project.

tools.name: Delete Status Update
tools.description: Tool to delete a status update by its GID. Use when you need to remove a specific status update from Asana.

tools.name: Delete Story
tools.description: Tool to delete a story by its GID. Use when you need to remove a story from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific tag by its GID. Use when you need to remove an existing tag from Asana.

tools.name: Delete a task
tools.description: Delete a task.

tools.name: Duplicate Project
tools.description: Duplicate a project.

tools.name: Duplicate Task
tools.description: Duplicate a task

tools.name: Get Access Requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve access requests for a target object. Use when you need to get pending access requests for a specific resource like a project or portfolio.

tools.name: Get Allocation
tools.description: Get an allocation by ID. Use when you need to retrieve the details of a specific allocation.

tools.name: Get Allocations
tools.description: Tool to get multiple allocations. Requires either 'parent' (project GID) OR both 'assignee' AND 'workspace' together.

tools.name: Get a project
tools.description: Retrieves a specific Asana project by its `project_gid`, with an option to include additional fields for comprehensive details using `opt_fields`; this action does not return tasks within the project.

tools.name: Get a task
tools.description: Retrieves full details for a specified task GID accessible by the user; use `opt_fields` to customize returned data.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Tool to get a single attachment by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific file attached to a task or project.

tools.name: Get Audit Log Events
tools.description: Tool to get audit log events for a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a log of actions performed within a specific Asana workspace.

tools.name: Get a user task list
tools.description: Retrieves a specific user's task list from Asana by its `user_task_list_gid`, optionally returning extended details like name, owner, and workspace if specified in `opt_fields`.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's full record, including accessible workspaces, often used as an initial call to establish user context for subsequent operations.

tools.name: Get Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to get a single custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve the complete metadata and properties of a specific custom field in Asana.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get all custom fields in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve a list of custom fields associated with a specific workspace.

tools.name: Get Custom Types
tools.description: Tool to get all custom types associated with a project. Use when you need to retrieve custom types that extend Asana objects for categorization purposes.

tools.name: Get Events on a Resource
tools.description: Retrieve events on a resource to monitor changes. Use when you need to track activity or changes related to a specific Asana resource like a task, project, or tag.

tools.name: Get Favorites for User
tools.description: Tool to get a user's favorites within a specified workspace. Returns favorites ordered as they appear in the user's Asana sidebar.

tools.name: Get Goal
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single goal by its GID.

tools.name: Get Goal Relationships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve goal relationships. Use when you need to get the relationships associated with a specific goal in Asana.

tools.name: Get Goals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple goals. Requires exactly one scope parameter (workspace, team, portfolio, or project) to be specified. Can be optionally filtered by time period or archived status.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a job by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to check the status of asynchronous operations like task duplication, project instantiation, or exports.

tools.name: Get Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single membership by its ID. Use this when you need to get details about a specific membership relationship between a user/team and a goal, project, portfolio, or custom field.

tools.name: Get Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve memberships for goals, projects, portfolios, or custom fields. Use this to find out who has access to a specific Asana resource or what resources a specific user/team has access to.

tools.name: Get multiple projects
tools.description: Returns a list of projects filtered by workspace or team (one required), with optional archived status filter, supporting pagination for large datasets.

tools.name: Get multiple tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tasks, allowing filtering by assignee (requires `workspace`), project, section, `completed_since`, and `modified_since`; `workspace` also requires `assignee`.

tools.name: Get multiple users
tools.description: Returns a list of users in an Asana workspace or organization, optionally filtered by workspace or team GID, with support for pagination and specifying optional fields.

tools.name: Get multiple workspaces
tools.description: Retrieves all workspaces accessible by the authenticated user, returning an empty list if the user has no accessible workspaces.

tools.name: Get Portfolio
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single portfolio by its GID. Use this when you need to get detailed information about a specific portfolio.

tools.name: Get Portfolio Items
tools.description: Retrieve items in a portfolio. Use this to get a list of projects or other portfolios contained within a specific portfolio.

tools.name: Get Portfolio Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple portfolio memberships. Use this tool when you need to list memberships for a specific portfolio, a user within a portfolio, or a user across all portfolios in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Portfolios
tools.description: Retrieve multiple portfolios. Use when you need to list portfolios within a specific workspace, optionally filtered by owner.

tools.name: Get Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to get the detailed explanation (what and why) of a project. Note: Requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid). First call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to obtain the project_brief_gid.

tools.name: Get Project Custom Field Settings
tools.description: List the custom-field settings attached to an Asana project.

tools.name: Get Project Membership
tools.description: Tool to get a project membership by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific project membership.

tools.name: Get Project Memberships For Project
tools.description: Tool to get memberships from a specific project. Use when you need to see who has access to a project and their permission levels.

tools.name: Get Projects for Task
tools.description: Tool to get all projects a task is in. Use when you need to retrieve project associations for a specific task.

tools.name: Get Projects for Team
tools.description: Tool to get a list of projects for a specific team in Asana. Use when you need to retrieve project details associated with a team.

tools.name: Get Project Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single project status by its GID. Use when you need to get the details of a specific project status update.

tools.name: Get Project Status Updates
tools.description: Tool to get status updates for a specific project. Use when you need to retrieve the latest or historical status reports associated with an Asana project.

tools.name: Get Multiple Project Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple project templates. Use when you need to list available project templates in a workspace or team.

tools.name: Get Project Templates for Team
tools.description: Tool to get a team's project templates in Asana. Use when you need to retrieve project templates associated with a specific team.

tools.name: Get Reactions on Object
tools.description: Tool to get reactions with a specific emoji base character on an object. Use when you need to retrieve user reactions (emoji responses) on a status update or story.

tools.name: Get Section
tools.description: Retrieve the full record for a single section by its GID. Use this when you need to get details about a specific section within a project.

tools.name: Get sections in a project
tools.description: Returns compact records for all sections (used to group tasks) in a specified project.

tools.name: Get Status Update
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single status update by its GID. Use when you need to get the details of a specific status update.

tools.name: Get Status Updates
tools.description: Retrieve status updates from an object. Use when you need to get the latest or historical status updates for a specific project, portfolio, or goal.

tools.name: Get Stories for Task
tools.description: Tool to get stories (comments, status updates, etc.) for a task. Use when you need to retrieve the history or discussion associated with a specific task.

tools.name: Get Story
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a story. Use when you need to get the complete record for a single story.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Tool to get a single tag by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific tag.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Get multiple tags in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Tags for Task
tools.description: Tool to get all tags associated with a specific task. Use when you need to retrieve tags for categorization, filtering, or understanding task organization.

tools.name: Get Tags For Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get all tags in a specific workspace. Use when you need to retrieve tags for categorizing tasks within a workspace.

tools.name: Get Task Attachments
tools.description: Tool to get the list of attachments for a given task, project, or project_brief. Use when you need to retrieve files attached to a specific Asana object.

tools.name: Get Task Counts For Project
tools.description: Tool to get task count statistics for a project. Use when you need to retrieve the number of tasks, completed tasks, incomplete tasks, and milestone counts for a specific Asana project. Note that all fields are excluded by default - you must specify them in opt_fields to get any data.

tools.name: Get tasks for tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks associated with a specific Asana tag by tag GID. Use when you need to list all tasks that have been tagged with a particular label.

tools.name: Get tasks for user task list
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks from a user task list by user task list GID. Use when you need to list tasks assigned to a specific user's task list.

tools.name: Retrieve tasks for project
tools.description: Retrieves tasks from a specified Asana project, allowing filtering by completion status and selection of optional fields for detailed responses.

tools.name: Get tasks from a section
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks that belong to a specific Asana section (column/header) by section GID. Use when you need to list tasks within a particular section, such as for agenda or carryover workflows. Board view only feature.

tools.name: Get Task Subtasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple task subtasks from a workspace. Use when you need to list or find available task subtasks.

tools.name: Get Task Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple task templates from a workspace. Use when you need to list or find available task templates.

tools.name: Get Team
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific team by its GID. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular team in Asana.

tools.name: Get Team Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a complete team membership record by its GID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific team membership in Asana.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact team membership records. Use when you need to list members of a team, teams a user belongs to, or all team memberships in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships for Team
tools.description: Tool to get memberships from a specific team. Use when you need to retrieve the list of users who are members of a particular team, including their membership details such as admin status and guest status.

tools.name: Get Team Memberships For User
tools.description: Tool to get team memberships for a specific user. Use when you need to retrieve all teams that a user belongs to within a workspace.

tools.name: Get Teams for User
tools.description: Tool to get teams for a specific user in an organization. Returns the team records for all teams in the organization or workspace to which the given user is assigned.

tools.name: Get teams in workspace
tools.description: Returns the compact records for all teams in the workspace visible to the authorized user.

tools.name: Get Time Period
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full record for a single time period by its GID. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific time period, including its start/end dates, display name, and parent period.

tools.name: Get Time Periods
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact or full representations of time periods. Use this when you need to fetch information about specific time periods, such as their start and end dates, display names, and parent periods.

tools.name: Get Time Tracking Entries
tools.description: Tool to get multiple time tracking entries across workspace, tasks, or projects. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking information for filtering by workspace, task, portfolio, user, or date range.

tools.name: Get Time Tracking Entries for Task
tools.description: Tool to get time tracking entries for a task. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking information recorded on a specific task.

tools.name: Get Objects via Typeahead
tools.description: Tool to retrieve objects in a workspace via a typeahead search algorithm. Use when you need to quickly find objects like tasks, projects, users, etc., based on a search string. This is useful for implementing auto-completion features.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get a user by their ID.

tools.name: Get User in Workspace
tools.description: Tool to get a user in a workspace or organization by their GID. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific user within a workspace context.

tools.name: Get Users for Team
tools.description: Get users in a team.

tools.name: Get Users in Workspace
tools.description: Get users in a workspace or organization.

tools.name: Get User Task List
tools.description: Tool to get a single user task list by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve information about a specific user's My Tasks list.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple webhooks in a workspace. Use when you need to list all webhooks for a workspace or filter webhooks by a specific resource.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its GID. Use when you need to get information about a particular Asana workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific workspace membership by its GID. Use when you need to get details about a user's membership in a workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Memberships
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the workspace memberships for a specific workspace. Use when you need to list members of a workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Memberships For User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve workspace memberships for a specific user. Use when you need to list all workspaces a user is a member of.

tools.name: Get Workspace Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the projects associated with a specific workspace. Use when you need to list all projects within a given Asana workspace.

tools.name: Reorder Enum Option for Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to reorder an existing enum option within a custom field by moving it before or after another specified enum option. Use when you need to change the order/position of options in an enum or multi_enum custom field. Note: To create new enum options, use 'Create Enum Option for Custom Field' action instead.

tools.name: Move or Insert Section in Project
tools.description: Tool to move or reorder an existing section within a project by repositioning it before or after another section. Use when you need to change the position/order of sections in a project. Note: This action moves existing sections only. To create new sections, use 'Create Section in Project' action instead.

tools.name: Instantiate Project Template
tools.description: Instantiate (create) a real Asana project from a project template, returning the async job record. Use when you need to create a new project from a template with specific date and role assignments.

tools.name: List Task Dependencies
tools.description: List the prerequisite tasks that must be completed before an Asana task.

tools.name: List Task Dependents
tools.description: List tasks that are blocked by a specified Asana task.

tools.name: Reject access request
tools.description: Tool to reject an access request. Use when you need to deny a user's request for access to a project or resource.

tools.name: Remove Follower From Task
tools.description: Tool to remove one or more followers from a task. Use when you need to update the list of users following a specific task.

tools.name: Remove Followers For Project
tools.description: Tool to remove followers from a project in Asana. Use when you need to remove one or more users as followers from a specific project.

tools.name: Remove Item from Portfolio
tools.description: Tool to remove an item (e.g., a project) from an Asana portfolio. Use to undo/cleanup portfolio membership, support moves between portfolios, or enforce portfolio hygiene.

tools.name: Remove Members from Project
tools.description: Tool to remove users from a project in Asana. Use this tool when you need to remove one or more users as members from a specific project.

tools.name: Remove Project from Task
tools.description: Tool to remove a project from a task in Asana. Use this when you need to disassociate a task from a specific project.

tools.name: Remove Tag from Task
tools.description: Tool to remove an existing tag from a task in Asana. Use this tool when you need to detach a tag from a specific task for cleanup or retagging automation.

tools.name: Remove Task Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to unlink selected prerequisite relationships from an Asana task without deleting any task.

tools.name: Remove User For Team
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a team. Use when you need to revoke team membership for a specific user.

tools.name: Remove User from Workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a workspace or organization. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to a specific workspace.

tools.name: Search Tasks in Workspace
tools.description: Tool to search tasks across a workspace with advanced filters. Use when performing complex queries such as overdue tasks, by project or custom field, for reporting or automation.

tools.name: Set parent for task
tools.description: Tool to set the parent of a task in Asana. Use when you need to make a task a subtask of another task or remove the parent relationship.

tools.name: Submit Parallel Requests (Batch API)
tools.description: Tool to submit multiple Asana API requests in parallel using the Batch API. Use when you need to perform several operations efficiently, such as fetching multiple tasks or creating multiple subtasks at once.

tools.name: Update Allocation
tools.description: Tool to update an existing allocation by its ID. Use this when you need to modify details like the start date, end date, effort, or assignee for an allocation.

tools.name: Update a task
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing Asana task identified by its task_gid.

tools.name: Update Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to update a custom field by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing custom field in Asana.

tools.name: Update Enum Option
tools.description: Tool to update an enum option for a custom field. Use when you need to modify the name, color, or enabled status of an existing enum option.

tools.name: Update a project
tools.description: Update a project.

tools.name: Update Project Brief
tools.description: Tool to update a project brief by its GID. Use when you need to modify the content/description of a project brief. Note: Requires the project_brief_gid (not the project_gid). First call 'Get a project' with opt_fields=['project_brief'] to obtain the project_brief_gid.

tools.name: Update Section
tools.description: Update a section's name or position within a project. Use when you need to rename a section or reorder sections by specifying insert_before or insert_after.

tools.name: Update Story
tools.description: Tool to update a story on a task. Use when you need to modify the text, html_text, or pin status of an existing story. Only comment stories can have text/html_text updated, and only comment and attachment stories can be pinned.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tag by its globally unique identifier. Use when you need to change the name or color of a tag.

tools.name: Update a team
tools.description: Tool to update details of an existing team. Use when you need to change a team's name, description, or organization.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Update a user's custom fields. Note: Asana's API has very limited user update capabilities - most user properties are read-only and managed by users themselves.

tools.name: Update User for Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update a user in a workspace or organization. Use when you need to modify user-specific custom field values for a workspace.

tools.name: Update a webhook
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Asana webhook's filter configuration. Use when you need to modify which events trigger webhook notifications.

triggers.description: Triggers when a comment is added to a task in a project.

Triggers when a tag is added to a task.

Note: Asana's event structure is inverted for tag events — the resource
is the task and the parent is the tag. So parent.gid gives the tag GID.

name: People Data Labs
description: PeopleDataLabs provides B2B data enrichment and identity resolution, empowering organizations to build enriched user profiles and validate customer information

tools.name: Bulk Retrieve Persons
tools.description: Retrieve up to 100 People Data Labs person records by persistent ID.

tools.name: Clean company data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes company information based on a name, website, or profile URL; providing at least one of these inputs is highly recommended for meaningful results.

tools.name: Clean company data (POST)
tools.description: Tool to clean and standardize company data using POST method. Use when you need to standardize company information by providing company name, website, or social profile. Returns standardized company information including name, website, LinkedIn profile, and other company identifiers.

tools.name: Clean location data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes a raw, unformatted location string into a structured representation, provided the input is a recognizable geographical place.

tools.name: Clean location data (POST)
tools.description: Tool to clean and standardize location data using POST method. Use when you need to normalize raw location strings into structured location information including city, region, and country.

tools.name: Clean school data
tools.description: Cleans and standardizes school information; provide at least one of the school's name, website, or profile for optimal results.

tools.name: Clean school data (POST)
tools.description: Tool to clean and standardize school data using POST method. Use when you need to clean school information by providing name, website, or profile.

tools.name: Enrich Bulk Company Data
tools.description: Tool to enrich up to 100 companies in a single request using the Bulk Company Enrichment API. Use when you need to enrich multiple company profiles efficiently. Each request must include at least one company identifier (website, profile, name, ticker, or pdl_id). Results are returned in the same order as the input requests, with individual status codes indicating success (200) or failure (404).

price.description: $0.1 per company matched in the batch

tools.name: Enrich bulk person data
tools.description: Tool to enrich up to 100 person profiles in a single API request using the Bulk Person Enrichment API. Use when you need to enrich multiple people efficiently, as this effectively increases the rate limit by up to 100x compared to individual enrichment calls. Each request in the array can use the same parameters as the single person enrichment endpoint.

price.description: $0.28 per person matched in the batch

tools.name: Enrich Company Data
tools.description: Enriches company data from People Data Labs with details like firmographics and employee counts. CRITICAL: This action REQUIRES at least one company identifier. DO NOT send empty {} requests. You MUST provide at least one of: pdl_id, name, profile, ticker, or website. Valid request examples: - {"name": "Apple Inc."} - enrich by company name - {"website": "google.com"} - enrich by website URL - {"ticker": "MSFT"} - enrich by stock ticker - {"profile": "linkedin.com/company/microsoft"} - enrich by social profile. Each call consumes API credits; use specific identifiers rather than exploratory requests.

tools.name: Enrich IP Data
tools.description: Enriches an IP address with company, location, metadata, and person data from People Data Labs.

tools.name: Enrich job title data
tools.description: Enhances a job title by providing additional contextual information and details.

tools.name: Enrich person data
tools.description: Enriches person data using various identifiers; requires a primary ID (profile, email, phone, email_hash, lid, pdl_id) OR a name (full, or first and last) combined with another demographic detail (e.g., company, school, location).

tools.name: Enrich skill data
tools.description: Retrieves detailed, standardized information for a given skill by querying the People Data Labs Skill Enrichment API; for best results, provide a recognized professional skill or area of expertise.

tools.name: Generate Search Query
tools.description: DEPRECATED: This action is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. Converts natural language queries into structured PDL Elasticsearch queries for people or company searches; generates optimized query structure without executing the search.

tools.name: Autocomplete field suggestions
tools.description: Provides autocompletion suggestions for a specific field (e.g., company, skill, title) based on partial text input.

tools.name: Get autocomplete suggestions (POST)
tools.description: Tool to get autocompletion suggestions using POST method for complex query parameters. Use when building type-ahead interfaces or needing to suggest values for Search API queries. Supports company, location, skill, title, and other fields with configurable result size.

tools.name: Get column details
tools.description: Retrieves predefined enum values for a column name from `enum_mappings.json`; `is_enum` in the response will be false if the column is not found or is not an enum type.

tools.name: Get schema
tools.description: Retrieves the schema, including field names, descriptions, and data types, for 'person' or 'company' entity types.

tools.name: Get subject requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve subject access requests for data privacy compliance. Use when you need to manage or review data subject requests related to person data in your PeopleDataLabs account.

tools.name: Identify person data
tools.description: Retrieves detailed profile information for an individual from People Data Labs (PDL), requiring at least one identifier such as email, phone, or profile URL. If using name alone, it must be paired with at least one additional attribute (company, location, school, etc.) — name-only queries return no match.

tools.name: People Search with Elasticsearch
tools.description: Searches for person profiles in the People Data Labs (PDL) database using an Elasticsearch Domain Specific Language (DSL) query. This action allows for highly targeted searches based on criteria such as job titles, skills, company details, location, experience, and more. Preconditions: - The provided Elasticsearch query (in the `query` field) must be a syntactically correct JSON object representing a valid Elasticsearch query. - The query must utilize fields that are defined in the People Data Labs person schema. - The `dataset` parameter must specify one of the allowed dataset categories.

tools.name: Query person changelog
tools.description: Tool to query the changelog of person records between two consecutive dataset versions. Returns information about updates, additions, deletions, merges, and opt-outs for individuals. Use when you need to track changes to person profiles across PDL dataset versions or monitor specific person IDs for updates.

tools.name: Retrieve person
tools.description: Retrieve one person deterministically by persistent People Data Labs ID.

tools.name: Company Search with Elasticsearch
tools.description: Performs a search for company profiles within People Data Labs using a custom Elasticsearch Domain Specific Language (DSL) query. This action allows for detailed and complex filtering based on various attributes of a company, such as name, industry, employee_count, founded year, location, and more. Results can be paginated using the `size` and `scroll_token` parameters. Preconditions: - The `query` parameter must contain a valid Elasticsearch DSL query string, structured as a JSON object. - This action queries the People Data Labs company search endpoint (`/v5/company/search`) and returns company records.

tools.name: Search Company Records (POST)
tools.description: Tool to search and filter company records from the full Company Dataset using Elasticsearch or SQL queries via POST method. Use when you need to find multiple companies matching specific criteria with complex filtering.

tools.name: Search job postings
tools.description: Search PDL's Job Posting Dataset using one filter mode and cursor pagination. Charged per job returned; failed requests are free.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your secret People Data Labs API key. Sign in at dashboard.peopledatalabs.com and copy it from the API Keys section.

name: Shopify
description: Shopify is an e-commerce platform. This toolkit is GraphQL-first for new Admin API automations while retaining legacy REST compatibility actions for older workflows and numeric-ID interoperability

tools.name: Activate One-Time Charge
tools.description: Activate a one-time application charge in Shopify. Use when you need to finalize billing for an accepted charge. DEPRECATED: This endpoint is deprecated as of API version 2021-01. One-time charges are now immediately activated when approved by a merchant, making this activation step no longer required for newer API versions.

tools.name: Add product to custom collection (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SHOPIFY_ADDS_A_PRODUCT_TO_A_CUSTOM_COLLECTION instead. Adds a product to an existing *custom collection*, optionally specifying its `position` if the collection is manually sorted.

tools.name: Add product to custom collection
tools.description: Add a product to a custom collection by creating a collect resource. Use when you need to link a product to a custom collection. Note: Can only add products to custom collections, not smart collections.

tools.name: Adjust inventory levels
tools.description: Adjust the inventory level of an inventory item at a single location. Use when you need to increase or decrease stock quantities at a specific location.

tools.name: Apply fulfillment hold
tools.description: Applies a fulfillment hold to an open fulfillment order, halting all fulfillment work. Use when you need to pause fulfillment due to payment issues, fraud concerns, address problems, or inventory shortages. The fulfillment order status will change to on_hold, preventing any fulfillment work from proceeding until the hold is released.

tools.name: Approve a comment
tools.description: Approves a pending comment and publishes it to a blog article, making it publicly visible to readers. This action changes the comment's status from 'pending' or 'unapproved' to 'published' and sets the published_at timestamp. Use this when moderating blog comments that require approval before appearing on the storefront. Requires the 'write_content' scope.

tools.name: Bulk create products via GraphQL
tools.description: Creates many products (20-50+) in one asynchronous Shopify bulk mutation job. Uses stagedUploadsCreate for JSONL upload, then bulkOperationRunMutation with productCreate, polling until completion and returning per-row success/errors.

tools.name: Bulk delete customer addresses (Deprecated)
tools.description: Bulk delete multiple customer addresses in a single operation. This action permanently removes several addresses from a customer's address book at once, which is more efficient than deleting addresses one by one. Use this when you need to clean up multiple invalid or outdated addresses for a customer. Requires the 'write_customers' scope and access to protected customer data.

tools.name: Delete metafields in bulk
tools.description: Deletes multiple metafields in bulk using their owner ID, namespace, and key. If a metafield doesn't exist, the mutation still succeeds but returns null for that identifier in the response.

tools.name: Bulk delete metaobjects
tools.description: Asynchronously delete metaobjects and their associated metafields in bulk. Use this action to delete multiple metaobjects by their IDs or delete all metaobjects of a specific type. The operation is asynchronous and returns a job ID for tracking completion status.

tools.name: Run Shopify bulk query operation
tools.description: Run a Shopify GraphQL bulk query operation and return the result file URL and operation metadata. Use when you need to retrieve large datasets (thousands of records) from Shopify without manual pagination, such as bulk fetching products, orders, customers, or inventory. The query must include at least one connection (edges/nodes structure). This action polls the operation status until completion or timeout.

tools.name: Calculate a refund
tools.description: Calculate accurate refund amounts, taxes, and transactions for a Shopify order before creating an actual refund. Use this action to: - Preview refund calculations for line items with accurate tax breakdowns - Determine shipping refund amounts and maximum refundable values - Get suggested transactions that can be used to create the actual refund The response includes transactions with kind='suggested_refund' which must be changed to kind='refund' before creating an actual refund using the create refund endpoint.

tools.name: Cancel App Subscription
tools.description: Cancel an app subscription in Shopify using the appSubscriptionCancel GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to cancel an existing app subscription, optionally with prorated credits.

tools.name: Cancel Shopify bulk operation
tools.description: Cancel a running Shopify bulk operation. Use when you need to stop a long-running bulk query or mutation operation that is no longer needed. Note that there may be a short delay between when cancelation starts and when the operation is actually canceled.

tools.name: Cancel a fulfillment
tools.description: Cancels an existing fulfillment by its ID, reverting all line items to an unfulfilled state. Use this when a fulfillment was created in error or needs to be redone. The cancellation is permanent and cannot be undone - the line items will return to the unfulfilled state and a new fulfillment must be created if needed. Only fulfillments that haven't been shipped or are in certain states can be cancelled.

tools.name: Cancel a Fulfillment Order
tools.description: Cancels a fulfillment order in Shopify and marks it as closed. This creates a replacement fulfillment order with the same line items, allowing reassignment to a different location. Use this for merchant-managed fulfillments. For third-party fulfillment services, use the cancellation request endpoints instead. This endpoint immediately cancels the order without requiring acceptance from a fulfillment service.

tools.name: Cancel an order
tools.description: Cancels a Shopify order and optionally restocks items and sends email notifications. Use when canceling an order that has not yet been paid or fulfilled. Orders cannot be cancelled if payment status is already paid or if the order has existing fulfillments.

tools.name: Close an order
tools.description: Closes an open Shopify order. Use when all line items have been fulfilled or canceled and all financial transactions are complete.

tools.name: Complete a draft order
tools.description: Complete a draft order in Shopify and transition it to an actual order. Use when you need to finalize a draft order, reserve inventory, and create a corresponding order. When completing with payment_pending=true, the payment gateway is set to Manual.

tools.name: Connect inventory item to location
tools.description: Connects an inventory item to a location, establishing where the item can be stocked and fulfilled. This creates an inventory level with an initial available quantity of 0. Use this when you need to enable a product variant to be stocked at a new location. After connecting, use the 'set' or 'adjust' inventory level actions to update quantities.

tools.name: Count articles in blog
tools.description: Retrieves a count of all articles from a blog. Use when you need to know how many articles exist in a specific blog, optionally filtered by creation, publication, or update dates and publication status.

tools.name: Get blogs count
tools.description: Retrieves the total count of all blogs in a Shopify store. Use this action when you need to know how many blogs exist in the store without fetching the full list of blog details. This is useful for pagination calculations, analytics, or checking if any blogs exist before performing other operations. Requires 'read_content' or 'write_content' OAuth scope.

tools.name: Retrieve count of custom collections (Deprecated)
tools.description: Retrieves a count of custom collections with optional filters. Use when you need to know how many custom collections exist in the store, optionally filtered by product, publication status, or date ranges.

tools.name: Get draft orders count
tools.description: Retrieves a count of draft orders from a Shopify store. Use when you need to know how many draft orders exist without fetching full draft order details. Supports filtering by status and date range to count specific subsets of draft orders.

tools.name: Count all the events (Deprecated)
tools.description: Count all events in a Shopify store with comprehensive filtering. Use when you need to determine how many events match specified criteria including date range, resource type, or action verb.

tools.name: Count fulfillments for order
tools.description: Retrieves a count of fulfillments associated with a specific order. Use when you need to determine how many fulfillments exist for an order, optionally filtered by creation or update dates.

tools.name: Retrieves a count of locations (Deprecated)
tools.description: Retrieves a count of locations. Use when you need to determine how many physical or virtual locations are configured in the Shopify store.

tools.name: Count shop metafields
tools.description: Retrieves the shop-level count of metafields. Use resource-specific metafield actions for product, customer, order, collection, page, or article metafields.

tools.name: Count orders (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SHOPIFY_RETRIEVES_AN_ORDER_COUNT instead. Retrieves the count of orders in a Shopify store. Use when you need to know how many orders exist, optionally filtered by status, dates, financial status, fulfillment status, or attribution app. Note: Only the last 60 days' worth of orders are accessible by default unless the app has been granted the read_all_orders scope.

tools.name: Retrieve page count
tools.description: Retrieve the total count of pages in a Shopify store. Use when you need to determine how many pages exist, optionally filtered by creation date, update date, publication date, publication status, or title.

tools.name: Count price rules
tools.description: Retrieves a count of all price rules. Use when you need to determine how many price rules (discount campaigns) are configured in the store.

tools.name: Count product images
tools.description: Retrieves the total count of images for a specific Shopify product. Use when you need to know how many images are associated with a product.

tools.name: Retrieves a count of products
tools.description: Retrieve a count of products in the Shopify store. Use when you need to get the total number of products, optionally filtered by collection, vendor, product type, status, or date ranges.

tools.name: Count product variants
tools.description: Retrieves the total count of variants for a Shopify product. Use when you need to know how many variants exist for a specific product.

tools.name: Count script tags
tools.description: Retrieves a count of all script tags in the shop. Script tags are remote JavaScript files that are loaded into the pages of a shop's storefront or checkout. Use this action to determine the total number of script tags, optionally filtered by a specific source URL. Note: This endpoint is part of the legacy REST Admin API (deprecated). The Shopify GraphQL Admin API should be used for new integrations.

tools.name: Receive a count of all webhooks (Deprecated)
tools.description: Retrieves a count of existing webhook subscriptions. Use when you need to know how many webhooks are configured, optionally filtered by address or topic.

tools.name: Create a metafield
tools.description: Create a metafield for any Shopify resource. Use when you need to attach custom metadata to products, customers, orders, collections, or other supported resources.

tools.name: Create A New Product Image (Deprecated)
tools.description: Create a new product image for a Shopify product. Use when you need to add an image to a product by providing either an image URL or base64-encoded image data. Products can have up to 250 images in PNG, GIF, or JPG formats.

tools.name: Create app subscription
tools.description: Create a recurring or usage-based app subscription for charging Shopify merchants. Use when setting up billing for app features and services. Returns a confirmation URL where the merchant must approve charges before the subscription becomes active.

tools.name: Create Article
tools.description: Create an article for a blog in Shopify. Use when you need to add blog content to a specific blog. The title field is mandatory - requests without titles return a 422 error.

tools.name: Create Comment for Article
tools.description: Create a comment for an article in Shopify. Use when you need to add reader comments to blog articles. Requires 'content' access scope and protected customer data access.

tools.name: Create a new blog
tools.description: Create a new blog in Shopify. Use when you need to add a blog to the store for publishing articles and content. The title field is mandatory.

tools.name: Create Country
tools.description: Create a country with tax configuration for the Shopify store. Use when you need to add a new country to the store's shipping or tax settings. **Important Notes:** - The REST Country API is deprecated as of API version 2024-07 - This action requires merchant approval for the 'write_shipping' scope - The 'tax' field is deprecated as of API version 2020-10 and custom tax values can no longer be created or updated - For new implementations, consider using the GraphQL Admin API's "Countries in shipping zone" endpoint instead

tools.name: Create a custom collection
tools.description: Create a new custom (manually curated) collection in Shopify. Does not support smart collections. Use when you need to manually curate and group products for easier store browsing. Custom collections require a title and support optional fields like description, image, publication settings, and sort order. After creation, use the returned `collection_id` with SHOPIFY_ADD_PRODUCT_TO_COLLECTION to associate products.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a new customer in Shopify. Use to add a customer record to the store with contact details, addresses, and marketing preferences. Requires at least one of: email, phone, or both first_name and last_name. Errors (e.g., duplicate email, invalid fields) are returned in the response body's userErrors array, not as HTTP error codes — always inspect userErrors to detect failures.

tools.name: Generate Customer Account Activation URL
tools.description: Generate a one-time account activation URL for a customer whose account is in 'disabled' state (not yet activated). Use this when you've imported customers and need activation URLs to send in welcome emails. The URL allows customers to set their password and activate their account. Each URL expires after 30 days. Generating a new URL invalidates any previously generated URL for that customer.

tools.name: Create customer address
tools.description: Create a new address for a customer. Use when you need to add an address to an existing customer's address list.

tools.name: Create delegate access token
tools.description: Create a delegate access token with a subset of the parent token's permissions. Use when you need to securely delegate limited access to subsystems or services. Each delegate token inherits only the specified scopes, ensuring minimal required permissions rather than full app access. Note: Delegate tokens cannot create new delegate tokens.

tools.name: Create Discount Code
tools.description: Creates a discount code for an existing price rule. Price rules define the discount logic (e.g., 10% off, buy X get Y), and discount codes are the actual codes (e.g., 'SUMMER10') customers enter at checkout. Important: The price rule must exist before creating a discount code - use a price rule creation action first if needed. Each price rule can have multiple discount codes associated with it. Use this when you need to generate customer-facing discount codes for an established discount promotion.

tools.name: Create Discount Codes Batch
tools.description: Create a discount code creation job for batch processing. Use when you need to asynchronously create up to 100 discount codes for a price rule in a single request.

tools.name: Create a new draft order
tools.description: Create a draft order in Shopify. Use when you need to create orders in draft state using product variant line items or custom line items. Draft orders are useful for creating orders on behalf of customers, generating invoices, or reserving inventory.

tools.name: Create EventBridge webhook subscription
tools.description: Create an AWS EventBridge webhook subscription in Shopify. Use when you need to configure real-time event notifications to AWS EventBridge for events like order creation, product updates, or customer changes. EventBridge webhooks push events to your AWS partner event source immediately when changes occur, eliminating polling. You can filter events and control payload fields to optimize performance.

tools.name: Create Fulfillment
tools.description: Creates a fulfillment for one or many fulfillment orders for a specific order. This completes the shipping process by marking items as fulfilled. IMPORTANT: You must first retrieve fulfillment orders using a "Get fulfillment orders for order" action to obtain the fulfillment_order_id and line item IDs needed for this action. Use when: You need to mark order items as shipped/fulfilled for orders assigned to merchant-managed locations or third-party fulfillment services. Note: As of API version 2024-10, fulfillments can only be created for merchant-managed locations or third-party fulfillment services owned by your app.

tools.name: Create Fulfillment Event
tools.description: Creates a tracking event for a fulfillment to update shipment status. These events appear on the customer's order status page to track delivery progress (e.g., "in_transit", "out_for_delivery", "delivered"). Use this to provide real-time tracking updates from shipping carriers. Requires an existing fulfillment - use after creating a fulfillment for an order.

tools.name: Create Gift Card
tools.description: Create a gift card for a Shopify store. Use when you need to issue a new gift card with a specified value. Requires write_gift_cards access scope. Gift card codes can only be retrieved at creation time.

tools.name: Create Marketing Event Engagements
tools.description: Create engagement data for a marketing event in Shopify. Use when tracking customer interactions like views, clicks, and ad spend on marketing events before customers reach the website.

tools.name: Create Marketing Event
tools.description: Create a marketing event in Shopify to track promotional actions. Use when you need to track marketing campaigns targeting customers across various channels.

tools.name: Create blog metafield
tools.description: Creates a new metafield for a Shopify blog. Metafields store additional custom information (metadata) on blog resources such as sponsor names, SEO keywords, publication dates, or custom attributes not included in standard blog fields.

tools.name: Create One-Time Application Charge
tools.description: Create a new one-time application charge in Shopify. Use when you need to bill merchants for one-time features, upgrades, or services. After creation, the merchant must approve the charge via the confirmation_url before it becomes active.

tools.name: Create an order
