name: Salesforce
description: Salesforce is a leading CRM platform integrating sales, service, marketing, and analytics to build customer relationships and drive business growth

tools.name: Abort query job
tools.description: Abort a Bulk API 2.0 query job in UploadComplete or InProgress state. Requires the job creator or Manage Data Integrations permission. Completed, failed, or already aborted jobs cannot be aborted. Does not delete the job.

tools.name: Create Salesforce Account
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new Salesforce Account using a JSON POST request, requiring 'Name'; specific fields (e.g., custom, DunsNumber) may have org-level prerequisites.

tools.name: Add contact to campaign
tools.description: Adds a contact to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record to track campaign engagement. Fails if the contact is already a member of the campaign; pre-check membership via SOQL before calling.

tools.name: Add lead to campaign
tools.description: Adds a lead to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record, allowing you to track campaign engagement. Both `campaign_id` and `lead_id` must be valid Salesforce IDs of active, existing records — names or emails cannot be substituted, and deleted or inactive records will cause the call to fail. This is a persistent CRM write; confirm the correct lead and campaign before calling.

tools.name: Add product to opportunity
tools.description: Adds a product (line item) to an opportunity. The product must exist in a pricebook entry that's associated with the opportunity's pricebook.

tools.name: Apply lead assignment rules
tools.description: Applies configured lead assignment rules to a specific lead, automatically routing it to the appropriate owner based on your organization's rules. Allow a brief propagation delay before querying updated ownership or field values after rule application.

tools.name: Associate contact to account
tools.description: Associates a contact with an account by updating the contact's AccountId field. Overwrites any existing AccountId on the contact. For broader contact field updates alongside the account association, use SALESFORCE_UPDATE_CONTACT instead.

tools.name: Clone opportunity with products
tools.description: Clones an opportunity and optionally its products (line items). Creates a new opportunity with the same field values and products as the original.

tools.name: Clone record
tools.description: Creates a copy of an existing Salesforce record by reading its data, removing system fields, and creating a new record. Optionally apply field updates to the clone.

tools.name: Clone report
tools.description: Creates a persisted copy of an existing Salesforce report under a new name.

tools.name: Close or abort a job
tools.description: Tool to close or abort a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use when you need to finalize job processing by closing (state: UploadComplete) or cancel a job by aborting (state: Aborted). This is required for every ingest job - closing queues data for processing, while aborting cancels the job and deletes uploaded data.

tools.name: Complete task
tools.description: Marks a task as completed with optional completion notes. This is a convenience action that updates the task status to 'Completed'.

tools.name: Execute Composite Graph (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_POST_COMPOSITE_GRAPH instead. Tool to execute multiple Salesforce REST API requests in a single call using composite graphs. Use when you need to perform a series of related operations that should either all succeed or all fail together. Composite graphs support up to 500 subrequests per graph (compared to 25 for regular composite requests) and allow referencing outputs from previous subrequests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

tools.name: Create account
tools.description: Creates a new account in Salesforce with the specified information. Returns the created Account's ID at `data.response_data.id`.

tools.name: Create analytics notification
tools.description: Create a scheduled report, dashboard or Analytics notification with delivery actions.

tools.name: Create a record
tools.description: Tool to create a Salesforce record using the UI API. Use when you need to create any type of Salesforce record with layout metadata and formatted field values.

tools.name: Create bulk ingest job
tools.description: Create a Bulk API 2.0 ingest job (POST /jobs/ingest). Returns a job in the 'Open' state with an id and contentUrl. This is the first step of a bulk load: create the job here, upload CSV data to it (upload_job_data), then close it (close_or_abort_a_job with state=UploadComplete) to queue processing. Without this action the rest of the ingest-job family has no obtainable job_id.

tools.name: Create bulk query job
tools.description: Create a Bulk API 2.0 query job (POST /jobs/query) for a SOQL query over a large result set. Returns a job with an id; poll get_job_info_query until state is 'JobComplete', then retrieve CSV results with get_job_query_result. Without this action the Bulk query family has no obtainable job_id.

tools.name: Create campaign
tools.description: Creates a new campaign in Salesforce. Only `name` is universally required, but org-level validation rules commonly enforce `type`, `status`, `start_date`, and `end_date` as well — omitting them may cause creation to fail.

tools.name: Create campaign record
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new campaign record in Salesforce; if 'ParentId' is provided, it must be a valid ID of an existing Campaign record, and if 'OwnerId' is provided, it must be a valid ID of an active User.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact in Salesforce with the specified information. Writes to live CRM data — obtain explicit user confirmation before executing. Failures may reflect org-specific validation rules, permission restrictions, or duplicate rules rather than invalid inputs.

tools.name: Create custom field
tools.description: Tool to create a custom field on a Salesforce object using the Tooling API. Use when you need to add a new field (Text, Number, Checkbox, Date, Picklist, Lookup, etc.) to any standard or custom object without deploying metadata packages. The Tooling API provides direct field creation for rapid development and automation tasks.

tools.name: Create custom object
tools.description: Tool to create a custom object in Salesforce using the Metadata API. Use when you need to dynamically create new object types (tables) in Salesforce with custom fields and configurations.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Create a Salesforce folder, optionally beneath an existing parent folder.

tools.name: Create folder shares
tools.description: Append shares to a Salesforce folder without replacing its share list.

tools.name: Create lead
tools.description: Creates a new lead in Salesforce. `LastName` and `Company` are required. Org-level validation rules (e.g., email format, custom required fields) may reject requests beyond these; inspect the error response body for the failing field. The created lead `id` is returned in a response wrapper, not at the top level.

tools.name: Create lead
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new Lead in Salesforce, requiring `LastName` and `Company` unless person accounts are enabled and `Company` is null.

tools.name: Create list view
tools.description: Create a Salesforce UI API list view for a standard or custom object.

tools.name: Create a new contact
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new Contact in Salesforce; 'LastName' is required, an existing 'AccountId' must be used if provided, and any custom fields (ending with '__c') must be predefined.

tools.name: Create note
tools.description: Creates a new note attached to a Salesforce record with the specified title and content. Does not deduplicate — identical calls create duplicate notes. High-volume creation can trigger REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; apply exponential backoff on retries.

tools.name: Create a note record
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new Note record in Salesforce, associated with an existing Salesforce object via `ParentId`, automatically including a `Content-Type: application/json` header.

tools.name: Create opportunity
tools.description: Creates a new opportunity in Salesforce with the specified information.

tools.name: Create opportunity record
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Creates a new Opportunity record in Salesforce; `Name`, `StageName`, and `CloseDate` are mandatory, and ensure any referenced IDs (e.g., `AccountId`, `CampaignId`) are valid and corresponding Salesforce features are enabled if used.

tools.name: Create SObject record
tools.description: Tool to create a new Salesforce SObject record. Use when you need to create any type of standard or custom Salesforce object record by specifying the object type and field values.

tools.name: Create sObject tree
tools.description: Tool to create one or more sObject trees with root records of the specified type. Use when creating nested parent-child record hierarchies in a single atomic operation (e.g., Account with Contacts and Opportunities). Supports up to 200 total records across all trees, up to 5 levels deep, with maximum 5 different object types. All records succeed or all fail together.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Creates a new task in Salesforce to track activities, to-dos, and follow-ups related to contacts, leads, or other records. Ensure who_id, what_id, and owner_id reference existing records before calling; invalid IDs cause silent linkage failures or validation errors.

tools.name: Create Tooling Flow
tools.description: Create a Salesforce Flow version through the Tooling API.

tools.name: Create Tooling API record
tools.description: Create a supported Salesforce Tooling API sObject record.

tools.name: Create validation rule
tools.description: Create an active or inactive Salesforce validation rule through Tooling API.

tools.name: Delete account
tools.description: Permanently deletes an account from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete a lead object by its id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes an existing Lead object from Salesforce using its unique ID.

tools.name: Delete analytics notification
tools.description: Permanently delete one Salesforce analytics notification by ID.

tools.name: Delete campaign
tools.description: Permanently deletes a campaign from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete contact
tools.description: Permanently deletes a contact from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone. Associated records (activities, opportunities) lose the contact reference upon deletion — ensure related data is migrated or acceptable to lose before proceeding. Returns HTTP 204 with empty body on success.

tools.name: Delete dashboard
tools.description: Delete a Salesforce dashboard by moving it to the Recycle Bin.

tools.name: Delete file
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a file from Salesforce. Use when you need to remove a file and its content. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Delete a Salesforce report or dashboard folder by ID.

tools.name: Delete folder share
tools.description: Delete one report or dashboard folder share. Requires manage access to the folder.

tools.name: Delete ingest job
tools.description: Delete a Bulk API 2.0 ingest job and its stored job data and metadata.

tools.name: Delete job query
tools.description: Tool to delete a Salesforce Bulk API v2 query job. Use when you need to permanently remove a job and its associated data. Only the user who created the job can delete it, and the job must be in a completed state.

tools.name: Delete lead
tools.description: Permanently deletes a lead from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete note
tools.description: Permanently deletes a note from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete opportunity
tools.description: Permanently deletes an opportunity from Salesforce. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete report
tools.description: Delete a saved Salesforce report by moving it to the Recycle Bin.

tools.name: Delete sObject record
tools.description: Tool to delete a single Salesforce record by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific record from Salesforce. This operation is idempotent - deleting the same record multiple times returns success. Works with standard and custom objects.

tools.name: Delete multiple records (SObject Collections)
tools.description: Tool to delete up to 200 records in one request with optional rollback. Use when you need to delete multiple records efficiently, reducing API calls.

tools.name: Delete survey translations
tools.description: Delete one or a batch of translated Survey flow fields (REST API 48.0+).

tools.name: Delete Tooling API record
tools.description: Delete one Tooling API metadata record by object name and Salesforce ID.

tools.name: Describe dashboard
tools.description: Get dashboard metadata, components, filters, layout, and running user.

tools.name: Describe list view
tools.description: Retrieve columns, filters, ordering, and generated SOQL for a list view.

tools.name: Describe report type
tools.description: Describe a Salesforce report type's fields, filters and default metadata.

tools.name: Describe Tooling object
tools.description: Describe a Tooling API object's fields, URLs, and child relationships.

tools.name: Discover unit tests
tools.description: Discover one page of Apex and automated flow tests without running them.

tools.name: Download attachment body
tools.description: Download the binary Body field of a legacy Salesforce Attachment record.

tools.name: Execute composite
tools.description: Execute up to 25 dependent Salesforce data API subrequests in one call. Can create, update, or delete records. Inspect every returned httpStatusCode: HTTP 200 on the outer call does not imply all subrequests succeeded. Supports optional rollback and collation; binary subrequests are not supported.

tools.name: Execute composite batch
tools.description: Execute up to 25 independent JSON Salesforce REST subrequests serially. Successful mutations commit immediately and are not rolled back when a later subrequest fails. Subrequests can create, update, or delete data. Multipart binary batch uploads are not supported by this action.

tools.name: Execute global quick action
tools.description: Execute a global (non-object-specific) quick action (POST /quickActions/{actionName}). The 'Get quick actions' action lists the available global quick actions, but only object-scoped quick actions could be executed before — this runs the global ones. Distinct from the sObject-scoped execute (POST /sobjects/{type}/quickActions/{name}).

tools.name: Execute invocable action
tools.description: Invoke any standard or custom invocable action by name (POST /actions/standard/{name} or /actions/custom/{name}). The 'Get standard/custom invocable actions' actions enumerate the available actions (including Flows and Apex invocable methods), but previously only emailSimple and invocableApplyLeadAssignmentRules could actually be run — this executes any of them generically. Returns one result per input.

tools.name: Execute sObject Quick Action
tools.description: Tool to execute a specific quick action on an sObject to create records with pre-configured defaults. Use when you need to leverage Salesforce Quick Actions to streamline record creation with field mappings and default values.

tools.name: Execute SOQL query (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead. Executes the provided SOQL query against Salesforce; the query must begin with 'SELECT'.

tools.name: Execute SOSL search
tools.description: Execute a SOSL search to search across multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to search for text across multiple object types simultaneously.

tools.name: Execute Tooling composite
tools.description: Execute up to 25 mixed GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE Tooling API requests, including at most five queries. The optional all-or-none setting rolls back supported changes when a subrequest fails.

tools.name: Fetch account by ID with query
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use this action to retrieve a Salesforce Account by its unique ID, which must be a valid and existing Salesforce Account ID; you can optionally specify a comma-delimited list of fields to return.

tools.name: Get batch of UI API records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple Salesforce records in a single request with customizable field selection. Use when you need to fetch data for multiple records at once (up to 200 records).

tools.name: Get account
tools.description: Retrieves a specific account by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

tools.name: Get all objects
tools.description: Retrieves Salesforce objects (standard and custom) with detailed metadata. Each object includes a 'custom' field to identify custom objects. Note: the underlying Global Describe (/sobjects) is not paginated — it returns every object in one call — so the page/page_size parameters here are CLIENT-SIDE convenience slicing of that full list, not a server cursor. The full list is fetched on every call, and a page past the end returns an empty slice. Use when you need to discover available objects or their capabilities.

tools.name: Get all fields for an object
tools.description: Retrieves all fields (standard and custom) for a Salesforce object with complete metadata including field types, constraints, picklist values, and relationships.

tools.name: Get all navigation items
tools.description: Gets all navigation items (tabs) that the user has access to. Use when you need to retrieve available navigation tabs for display or navigation purposes.

tools.name: Get analytics notification
tools.description: Retrieve a Salesforce analytics notification or subscription by ID and source.

tools.name: Get Analytics notification limits
tools.description: Get maximum and remaining notification limits for a selected source.

tools.name: Get Apex log body
tools.description: Return the raw text body of one Salesforce Apex debug log.

tools.name: Get API resources by version
tools.description: Tool to discover available REST API resources for a specified Salesforce API version. Use when you need to find available endpoints and their URIs for a specific API version.

tools.name: Get an app
tools.description: Tool to get metadata about a specific Salesforce app by ID. Use when you need to retrieve app configuration details and navigation items for a particular application.

tools.name: Get App Menu
tools.description: Discover App Menu types or retrieve Lightning/mobile menu items or headers.

tools.name: Get appointment candidates
tools.description: Find available Salesforce Scheduler resources and time slots without booking an appointment.

tools.name: Get appointment slots
tools.description: Find available Salesforce Scheduler time slots without booking appointments.

tools.name: Get apps
tools.description: Tool to get metadata for all apps a user has access to. Use when you need to list available Salesforce applications or check app navigation items. Metadata for the selected app includes tabs on the app's navigation bar, while other apps don't include tab details.

tools.name: Get campaign
tools.description: Retrieves a specific campaign by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

tools.name: Get Chatter resources
tools.description: Tool to access Chatter resources directory. Use when you need to discover available Chatter feeds, groups, users, email digest controls, emojis, extensions, or streams.

tools.name: Get child records
tools.description: Tool to get child records for a specified parent record and child relationship name. Use when you need to retrieve related records from a parent-child relationship in Salesforce, such as getting all Contacts for an Account or all Opportunities for an Account. Results are paginated with configurable page size.

tools.name: Get Compact Layouts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve compact layout information for multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to display object data in compact form for Lightning Experience, mobile apps, or custom interfaces.

tools.name: Get composite resources
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available composite resources in Salesforce. Use when you need to discover which composite API endpoints are available for batch operations.

tools.name: Get multiple records by IDs
tools.description: Retrieves multiple records of the same object type by IDs with a request body. Use when you need to retrieve more records than URL length limits allow (up to 2000 records vs ~800 via GET).

tools.name: Get consent preferences
tools.description: Tool to check consent preferences for a SINGLE action (e.g. email, track, fax, phone, solicit, shouldForget) across one or more records (Contact, Lead, User, Person Account, or Individual). Returns a result per identifier; the 'proceed' object is keyed by the requested action, not a fixed set of actions. To query multiple actions at once, use the /consent/multiaction endpoint instead.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Retrieves a specific contact by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

tools.name: Retrieve specific contact by id
tools.description: Retrieves a Salesforce Contact by its unique ID; the ID must correspond to an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get dashboard
tools.description: Gets detailed metadata for a specific dashboard including its components, layout, and filters.

tools.name: Get dashboard components
tools.description: Read details and status for selected dashboard components without refreshing or saving.

tools.name: Get dashboard filter options
tools.description: Validate dashboard filter options against report fields without saving changes.

tools.name: Get dashboard status
tools.description: Read dashboard component refresh status without triggering a refresh.

tools.name: Get data categories
tools.description: List visible Knowledge data category groups or retrieve one category's children.

tools.name: Get deleted records
tools.description: List record IDs and deletion times for one Salesforce object and time window.

tools.name: Get Embedded Service configuration
tools.description: Retrieve an Embedded Service deployment's configuration or response headers.

tools.name: Get file content
tools.description: Returns the binary content of a Salesforce file, including references to external files. Use when you need to download or retrieve the actual file data from Salesforce.

tools.name: Get file information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive metadata and information about a specified file in Salesforce. Use when you need detailed file information including ownership, sharing settings, download URLs, and rendition status.

tools.name: Get file shares
tools.description: Returns information about the objects with which the specified file has been shared. Use when you need to understand who has access to a specific file in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Get a report or dashboard folder's details, ancestors, and sharing URLs.

tools.name: Get folder share
tools.description: Retrieve one explicit access entry for a report or dashboard folder.

tools.name: Get folder shares
tools.description: Lists the explicit access entries for a report or dashboard folder.

tools.name: Get global actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve actions displayed in the Salesforce Global Actions menu with metadata. Use when you need to discover available global actions, quick actions, or custom buttons in the UI.

tools.name: Get ingest job info
tools.description: Retrieve status, processing counts, and metadata for one Bulk API 2.0 ingest job.

tools.name: Get invalid Apex compilation results
tools.description: Read compilation results for invalid Apex classes and triggers (API 68.0+).

tools.name: Get job failed record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve failed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that failed during a bulk operation, including error messages and original data.

tools.name: Get job successful record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve successfully processed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that were successfully created or updated during a bulk operation.

tools.name: Get job unprocessed record results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve unprocessed records from a Salesforce Bulk API 2.0 ingest job. Use when you need to get records that were not processed during a bulk operation, typically due to job abortion or interruption.

tools.name: Get last selected app
tools.description: Retrieves the app the current user last selected or the app the user sees by default. Use when you need to determine which application the user is currently working in or should be using.

tools.name: Get lead
tools.description: Retrieves a specific lead by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

tools.name: Get List View Header Actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve header actions on list views. Use when you need to get available actions, buttons, and quick actions displayed on a specific list view header in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get batch of list view metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for multiple list views in a single batch request. Use when you need to get list view configuration, columns, filters, and sorting for multiple list views at once.

tools.name: Get list view metadata
tools.description: Returns list view metadata by object and list view API name. Use when you need to retrieve complete metadata information for a specific list view, including display columns, filters, sort order, permissions, and user preferences.

tools.name: Get list view records by ID
tools.description: Returns record data for a list view by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve records from a specific Salesforce list view.

tools.name: Get list view records by API name
tools.description: Retrieves paginated record data for a specified list view using the object and list view API names. Use when you need to fetch records that match a specific list view's filters and sorting criteria. Returns the same data that powers Lightning Experience list views.

tools.name: Get list view results
tools.description: Retrieves the results of a list view for a specified sObject. Returns column definitions and record data with a 2,000 record limit per response.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve lookup field suggestions for editing lookup fields with search filtering. Use when searching for records to populate a lookup field, supporting typeahead, recent, and full-text search.

tools.name: Get lookup field suggestions with POST
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field suggestions with POST request. Use when editing lookup fields with dependent lookup filtering or when you need to pass source record context in the request body.

tools.name: Get Metadata Deployment Status
tools.description: Poll a Metadata API deployment request and optionally return detailed results.

tools.name: Get MRU list view metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve MRU list view metadata for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to understand the structure and configuration of the most recently used list view for an object.

tools.name: Get most recently used list view records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve record data for an object's most recently used (MRU) list view. Use when you need to get the records that a user has recently accessed for a specific Salesforce object type.

tools.name: Get named layout
tools.description: Retrieve an object's alternate named layout by its discovered layout name.

tools.name: Get note
tools.description: Retrieves a specific note by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields. Notes with IsPrivate=true require the integration user to have sufficient permissions; inaccessible private notes will not be returned.

tools.name: Retrieve Note with conditions
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves a Salesforce Note object by its ID, optionally specifying which fields to return; the Note ID must exist.

tools.name: Get list views for an object
tools.description: Returns a collection of list views associated with a Salesforce object. Use when you need to discover available list views for an object like Account, Contact, or Opportunity.

tools.name: Get object UI layout
tools.description: Retrieve object-level UI layout metadata without requiring a record ID.

tools.name: Get opportunity
tools.description: Retrieves a specific opportunity by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields.

tools.name: Get organization limits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organization limits with max and remaining allocations. Use when you need to check API usage, storage limits, or other resource consumption in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get photo actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available photo actions for Salesforce pages. Use when you need to get photo management actions for user or group pages. Currently, only group and user pages support photo actions.

tools.name: Get Values for All Picklist Fields
tools.description: Tool to get values for all picklist fields of a record type, including dependent picklists. Use when you need to retrieve available picklist options for a specific object and record type, especially for dependent picklist hierarchies.

tools.name: Get platform event schema
tools.description: Read a platform event schema by event API name or schema ID, without publishing events.

tools.name: Get Process Approvals
tools.description: List Salesforce approval processes grouped by object, or read their headers.

tools.name: Get process rules
tools.description: Read active workflow rules or their headers, globally, by object, or by rule ID.

tools.name: Get job info query
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a Salesforce Bulk API v2 query job. Use when you need to check the status and details of a query job.

tools.name: Get job query result
tools.description: Retrieves results for a completed Bulk API v2 query job in CSV format. Supports pagination for large datasets via maxRecords and locator parameters.

tools.name: Get query result pages
tools.description: List up to five parallel result download links for a completed Bulk API 2.0 query job. Use the same connection API version used to create the job (58.0 or later), otherwise Salesforce returns 409. This lists links, not the CSV result data. Continue with the locator from nextRecordsUrl until done is true.

tools.name: Get quick actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve global and object-specific quick actions from Salesforce. Use when you need to list all available quick actions in the organization.

tools.name: Get record count for objects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve total record counts for specified Salesforce objects. Use when you need to check storage usage or understand data volume for specific sObjects.

tools.name: Get record edit page actions
tools.description: Tool to get available actions on record edit pages. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about actions (standard actions, custom actions, quick actions, productivity actions) displayed on the record edit page for specific records.

tools.name: Get related list actions
tools.description: Tool to get actions on related lists for record detail pages. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about all available actions (standard buttons, quick actions, custom buttons, and productivity actions) that can be performed on records within a specific related list context.

tools.name: Get batch of related list user preferences
tools.description: Tool to get a batch of related list user preferences from Salesforce. Use when retrieving display preferences, column widths, or sort orders for multiple related lists simultaneously.

tools.name: Get related list records with request body
tools.description: Tool to retrieve related list records with request body parameters for filtering and pagination. Use when you need to get records from a related list associated with a parent record with complex query parameters. Returns up to 1,999 records per related list with pagination support.

tools.name: Get relevant items
tools.description: Get the current user's relevant record IDs grouped by Salesforce object.

tools.name: Get report metadata
tools.description: Gets detailed metadata for a specific report including its structure, columns, filters, and groupings. Only fields included in the report layout are returned; use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY when specific fields outside the report layout are required.

tools.name: Get report fields
tools.description: Read a report's available filter fields, optionally intersecting other reports.

tools.name: Get report instance results
tools.description: Gets the results of a report instance created by running a report. Poll `attributes.status` until it equals 'Success' before parsing results. Response data is nested under `factMap` and `reportExtendedMetadata`; an empty `factMap` or zero rows is a valid successful result, not an error.

tools.name: Get rich text image
tools.description: Download an image embedded in a Salesforce record's rich text area field.

tools.name: Get scheduling resources
tools.description: Discover available Salesforce Scheduler REST resources and their URIs.

tools.name: Get search result layouts
tools.description: Retrieves search result layout information for specified sObjects. Use when you need to understand which fields are displayed in search results for objects.

tools.name: Get search scope
tools.description: Get the connected user's default global search scope and object order.

tools.name: Search suggested queries
tools.description: Returns a list of suggested searches based on the user's query string. Use when you want to help users discover relevant search terms before performing a search.

tools.name: Get self-service user password status
tools.description: Read a legacy self-service user's password expiration status or headers.

tools.name: Get sObject basic information
tools.description: Get basic sObject metadata, related resource URLs, and recent records.

tools.name: Get sObject by external ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Salesforce record by matching an external ID field value. Use when you need to find a record using a custom external identifier instead of the Salesforce ID. The field specified must be marked as an External ID in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get multiple sObject records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple records of the same sObject type in a single API call. Use when you need to fetch up to 200 records by their IDs. Returns an array of sObjects with the specified fields.

tools.name: Get sObject compact layouts
tools.description: Retrieve compact layouts and record type assignments for a Salesforce object.

tools.name: Get sObject layout headers
tools.description: Retrieve only HTTP headers for an object's approval or compact layouts.

tools.name: Get sObject layouts
tools.description: Retrieve an object's page layouts and record-type mappings, or HTTP headers.

tools.name: Get sObject list view information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve basic information about a specific list view for an sObject. Use when you need to get list view metadata including its ID, label, developer name, and URLs for accessing results and detailed descriptions.

tools.name: Get list views for sObject
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list views for a specified sObject. Use when you need to discover available filtered views of records for objects like Account, Contact, Lead, or Opportunity.

tools.name: Get PlatformAction SObject metadata
tools.description: Retrieves metadata description of PlatformAction SObject. Use when you need to understand the structure and fields of PlatformAction for querying UI actions.

tools.name: Get sObject Quick Action Default Values by ID
tools.description: Retrieves default field values for a quick action in a specific record context. Use when you need to pre-populate fields when creating related records through quick actions.

tools.name: Get sObject Quick Action Default Values
tools.description: Retrieves default field values for a specific quick action on an sObject. Use when you need to understand what fields will be automatically populated when executing the quick action.

tools.name: Get sObject quick actions
tools.description: List an object's quick actions, including global actions, or retrieve headers only.

tools.name: Get sObject record by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single Salesforce record by ID from any sObject type. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific record.

tools.name: Get records using sObject relationships
tools.description: Retrieves records by traversing sObject relationships using friendly URLs. Use when you need to get related records through a relationship field (e.g., all Contacts for an Account).

tools.name: Get layouts for object with record type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve layout metadata for a specific record type on an object. Use when you need detailed information about page layouts, field positioning, sections, quick actions, related lists, and buttons for a particular record type.

tools.name: Get approval layouts for object
tools.description: Retrieves approval layouts for a specified Salesforce object. Use when you need to understand which fields are displayed in approval pages or to dynamically build approval interfaces.

tools.name: Get updated sObject records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of sObject records that have been updated within a given timeframe. Use when you need to synchronize records or track changes to specific sObject types over a time period.

tools.name: Get support knowledge
tools.description: Retrieves the root of the Support Knowledge REST API. Use when you need to access knowledge articles and data category information.

tools.name: Get directory of supported objects
tools.description: Tool to get a Salesforce org's active theme and directory of supported objects. Use when you need to discover available objects that are supported by the User Interface API, including their CRUD permissions, labels, and theme information.

tools.name: Get support knowledge articles
tools.description: Retrieves user's visible knowledge articles and data categories from Salesforce Knowledge. Use when you need to access published, draft, or archived articles based on user permissions.

tools.name: Get Survey Translations
tools.description: Read translated Survey Flow field values individually or in a batch.

tools.name: Get tabs
tools.description: List all tabs available to the current user, or inspect their HTTP headers.

tools.name: Get theme
tools.description: Tool to get icons and colors for Salesforce UI themes. Use when you need to retrieve theme information for objects in the organization.

tools.name: Get Tooling completions
tools.description: Retrieve available Apex system symbol or Visualforce markup completions.

tools.name: Get Tooling FlexiPage
tools.description: Retrieve one FlexiPage metadata record by its Tooling API ID.

tools.name: Get Tooling API record
tools.description: Retrieve one complete Tooling API metadata record by object name and ID.

tools.name: Get lookup field actions
tools.description: Tool to get lookup field actions for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to retrieve available actions for lookup fields on a specific object type (e.g., Account, Contact).

tools.name: Get MRU List View Actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve header actions available on the MRU (Most Recently Used) list view for a specified Salesforce object. Use when you need to get available actions, buttons, and quick actions for an object's list view.

tools.name: Get related list actions
tools.description: Tool to get available actions on related lists for a record detail page. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about actions (standard actions, custom actions, quick actions, productivity actions) displayed on related lists for a specific parent record.

tools.name: Get Personalized Navigation Items
tools.description: Tool to get personalized navigation items for a specific Salesforce app. Use when you need to retrieve the navigation tabs that a user has access to within an application.

tools.name: Get Account AllAccounts list view metadata
tools.description: Retrieves list view metadata for the Account AllAccounts view using Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to understand the structure, columns, filters, and sorting of the standard AllAccounts list view.

tools.name: Get List View Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get list view metadata from Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to retrieve configuration details for a list view including columns, filters, sorting, and permissions.

tools.name: Get Account SearchResult list view metadata
tools.description: Retrieves list view metadata for the Account __SearchResult view using Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to understand the structure, columns, filters, and sorting of search results for Accounts.

tools.name: Get List Views for Object
tools.description: Tool to get list views for a Salesforce object. Use when you need to retrieve available list views with options to filter by recent usage and search.

tools.name: Get MRU List Info for Account
tools.description: Tool to get Most Recently Used (MRU) list view metadata for Account object. Use when you need to retrieve list view settings, display columns, and preferences. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and no longer updates.

tools.name: Get MRU List Records for Account
tools.description: Tool to get Most Recently Used (MRU) list view records for Account object. Use when you need to retrieve recently accessed Account records. Note: This endpoint is deprecated and no longer updates. It is not part of the Services under your Main Services Agreement with Salesforce and is for evaluation purposes only, not for production use.

tools.name: Get record UI data and metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve layout, field metadata, and record data in a single response. Use when you need comprehensive information including UI layout configuration, object metadata, and actual record values with child relationships.

tools.name: Get related list user preferences
tools.description: Tool to retrieve user preferences for a specific related list on an object. Use when you need to get display settings, column widths, or sort preferences for related lists in Salesforce UI.

tools.name: Get user info
tools.description: Retrieves information about the current user or a specific user in Salesforce.

tools.name: Get custom actions headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for custom invocable actions without response body. Use when you need to check resource availability and metadata before executing full requests or to validate resource state conditionally.

tools.name: Get standard actions headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for standard invocable actions metadata without response body. Use when you need to perform efficient cache validation, check for metadata changes, or reduce bandwidth usage before retrieving full action metadata.

tools.name: Get AppMenu Salesforce1 headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for AppMenu Salesforce1 mobile navigation items without response body. Use when you need to check resource metadata, validate cache (via ETag or Last-Modified), or test endpoint availability without data transfer overhead.

tools.name: Get process rules headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for process rules of an sObject without retrieving the response body. Use when you need to check if process rules exist for an sObject or retrieve metadata like ETag and Last-Modified headers.

tools.name: Get Quick Actions headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for Quick Actions resource without response body. Use when you need to inspect metadata before retrieving full Quick Actions content or to validate resource availability.

tools.name: Get quick action default values headers by ID
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for sObject quick action default values by context ID without response body. Use when you need to check resource availability, verify cache validation headers (ETag, Last-Modified), or optimize API calls by avoiding unnecessary data transfer.

tools.name: Get global publisher layouts headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for all global publisher layouts without response body. Use when implementing cache validation strategies, efficient resource polling, or checking if layouts have been modified without transferring layout data.

tools.name: Get sObject quick action headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for a specific sObject quick action without response body. Use when you need to check ETag or Last-Modified headers before fetching full content or to validate quick action availability.

tools.name: Get User password headers
tools.description: Tool to return HTTP headers for User password resource without response body. Use when you need to check user password metadata and expiration status efficiently without retrieving the full response content.

tools.name: List accounts
tools.description: Lists accounts from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results paginate via nextRecordsUrl with up to ~2000 rows per page. REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED requires exponential backoff; INVALID_FIELD or INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS_OR_READONLY errors indicate profile or field-level restrictions — simplify SELECT/WHERE clauses.

tools.name: List Analytics notifications
tools.description: List Analytics notifications or report/dashboard subscriptions by source.

tools.name: List Analytics templates
tools.description: Tool to list CRM Analytics templates available in the org. Use when you need to discover available templates for creating Analytics apps.

tools.name: List API versions
tools.description: List available Salesforce REST API versions, release labels, and root URLs.

tools.name: List bulk jobs
tools.description: List one page of Salesforce Bulk API ingest or query jobs with optional filters.

tools.name: List campaigns
tools.description: Lists campaigns from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results returned under `response_data.records`; use `Id` (not `Name`) to identify campaigns in downstream operations.

tools.name: List communities
tools.description: List Experience Cloud sites available to the connected Salesforce user.

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: Lists contacts from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are returned under `response_data.records`; check `response_data.done` and `response_data.totalSize` for pagination — use OFFSET or `nextRecordsUrl` until `done=true` to retrieve all records.

tools.name: Get custom invocable actions
tools.description: Retrieves the list of custom actions including Flow actions, Apex actions, and invocable processes. Use when you need to discover available custom invocable actions in your Salesforce organization.

tools.name: List dashboards
tools.description: Lists dashboards with basic metadata including name, ID, and URLs. Note: the Analytics REST API (GET /analytics/dashboards) returns only up to ~200 recently-viewed dashboards, not the org's entire dashboard catalog.

tools.name: List email templates
tools.description: Lists available email templates in Salesforce with filtering and search capabilities.

tools.name: List folder children
tools.description: List one page of a Salesforce folder's immediate child folders.

tools.name: List folders
tools.description: List one page of visible Salesforce folders, optionally filtered by content type.

tools.name: List folder share recipients
tools.description: List eligible folder share recipients without granting any access.

tools.name: List leads
tools.description: Lists leads from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are paginated; follow nextRecordsUrl in the response to retrieve subsequent pages — the first page may silently omit matching records beyond the page limit.

tools.name: List notes
tools.description: Lists notes from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Designed specifically for Note and ContentNote objects.

tools.name: List opportunities
tools.description: Lists opportunities from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Results are paginated up to ~2000 rows per batch; check `done`, `totalSize`, and `nextRecordsUrl` fields to detect and retrieve additional pages, or use a SOQL `LIMIT` clause to cap results. For complex queries rejected by this tool, use `SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY` instead.

tools.name: List pricebook entries
tools.description: Lists pricebook entries from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Use this to map product names to pricebook entry IDs needed for opportunity line items. When using returned IDs with SALESFORCE_ADD_OPPORTUNITY_LINE_ITEM, always filter with WHERE IsActive = true — inactive entries cause REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING or INVALID_CROSS_REFERENCE_KEY errors.

tools.name: List pricebooks
tools.description: Lists pricebooks from Salesforce using SOQL query, allowing flexible filtering, sorting, and field selection. Use this to map pricebook names to IDs.

tools.name: List recent list views
tools.description: List recently used list views for a Salesforce object.

tools.name: List recent records
tools.description: List records recently viewed or referenced by the connected Salesforce user.

tools.name: List report filter operators
tools.description: List available report or dashboard filter operators by field data type.

tools.name: List report runs
tools.description: List asynchronous runs of a Salesforce report, including status and results URLs.

tools.name: List reports
tools.description: Lists reports with basic metadata including name, ID, and URLs. Note: the Analytics REST API (GET /analytics/reports) returns only up to ~200 recently-viewed reports, not the org's entire report catalog.

tools.name: List report types
tools.description: List report types available to the connected Salesforce user.

tools.name: Get standard invocable actions
tools.description: Retrieves the list of standard actions that can be statically invoked. Use when you need to discover available standard invocable actions like posting to Chatter, sending email, or sending custom notifications.

tools.name: List Tooling API objects
tools.description: List available Salesforce Tooling API objects and their metadata.

tools.name: Log call
tools.description: Logs a completed phone call as a task in Salesforce with call-specific details like duration, type, and disposition.

tools.name: Log email activity
tools.description: Creates an EmailMessage record to log email activity in Salesforce, associating it with related records. Requires EmailMessage insert permissions enabled at the org level; some orgs block this entirely.

tools.name: Mass transfer ownership
tools.description: Transfers ownership of multiple records to a new owner in a single operation using Salesforce's composite API for better performance. Operation has no rollback; all provided records are reassigned immediately.

tools.name: Parameterized Search
tools.description: Tool to execute RESTful search using parameters instead of SOSL clause. Use when you need to search across Salesforce objects with simple GET requests (URL parameters) or complex POST requests (JSON body with advanced filtering). POST method supports DataCategories, networks, orderBy constraints, and per-object filtering.

tools.name: Upsert records using external ID
tools.description: Tool to upsert up to 200 records using external ID field matching. Use when you need to create or update multiple records efficiently in a single API call based on an external ID field.

tools.name: Execute Composite Graph
tools.description: Tool to execute multiple related REST API requests in a single transactional call with up to 500 subrequests per graph. Use when you need to perform multiple Salesforce operations atomically where all operations must succeed or fail together. Supports referencing output from one request as input to subsequent requests using @{referenceId.fieldName} syntax.

tools.name: Create records using sObject Collections
tools.description: Tool to create up to 200 records in one request using sObject Collections. Use when you need to create multiple records of potentially different sObject types efficiently in a single API call.

tools.name: Parameterized Search
tools.description: Tool to execute parameterized search across Salesforce objects with advanced filtering. Use when you need to search for records using specific search terms with fine-grained control over which objects to search, which fields to return, and additional filtering criteria.

tools.name: Process Approvals
tools.description: Submit records for approval, or approve/reject pending work items as an assigned approver. Requires a configured approval process. Bulk successes commit independently; inspect each result's success and errors.

tools.name: Execute SOQL Query (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead. Tool to execute SOQL queries against Salesforce. Use when you need to retrieve data from Salesforce objects using SOQL syntax. Returns up to 2000 records per request with pagination support via nextRecordsUrl.

tools.name: Query All (including deleted)
tools.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries including soft-deleted and archived records. Use when you need to query records that have been deleted via merge or delete operations, or when accessing archived Task and Event records.

tools.name: Query contacts by name
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Finds Salesforce Contact records by name using a case-insensitive search.

tools.name: Query more (next page of SOQL results)
tools.description: Retrieve the next page of SOQL results using a query locator (GET /query/{queryLocator}). SOQL queries return at most ~2000 rows per response plus a nextRecordsUrl when more remain; this action follows that locator. Call it repeatedly, passing each response's nextRecordsUrl, until done=true. Without it, run_soql_query / query results beyond the first page are unreachable.

tools.name: Query report
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Executes a Salesforce report synchronously by its `id` and `reportType`, optionally with dynamic ad-hoc adjustments like filters or groupings, and returns its data without modifying the saved report.

tools.name: Refresh dashboard
tools.description: Trigger an asynchronous refresh of a Salesforce dashboard's cached data.

tools.name: Remove account by unique identifier
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Deletes an existing Salesforce Account using its unique ID, returning an empty response on success (HTTP 204).

tools.name: Remove a specific contact by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes a specific Contact from Salesforce using its unique ID, which must correspond to an existing record.

tools.name: Remove campaign object by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes a specific Campaign SObject in Salesforce using its unique ID.

tools.name: Remove from campaign
tools.description: Removes a lead or contact from a campaign by deleting the CampaignMember record. Provide either the member_id (lead/contact ID) or the specific campaign_member_id.

tools.name: Remove note object by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes an existing Salesforce Note object identified by its unique ID.

tools.name: Remove opportunity by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Permanently deletes an existing Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; if the Opportunity does not exist, a 'not found' (404) error occurs.

tools.name: Replace folder shares
tools.description: Replace a folder's entire share list, removing omitted shares. Requires manage access.

tools.name: Reset self-service user password
tools.description: Reset a legacy self-service user's password and email them a reset link.

tools.name: Retrieve account data and error responses
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for the Salesforce Account sObject, detailing its properties, recent records, and related resource URLs.

tools.name: Retrieve campaign data with error handling
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive information and metadata for the Salesforce Campaign sObject, provided it is enabled and accessible in the organization, and features robust error handling.

tools.name: Retrieve contact object metadata
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata (e.g., fields, data types, picklist values) for the Salesforce Contact SObject; this action does not retrieve individual contact records.

tools.name: Retrieve lead by id
tools.description: Retrieves details for a Salesforce Lead by its ID; the specified Lead ID must exist in Salesforce.

tools.name: Retrieve lead data with various responses
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves Lead sObject data from Salesforce, such as recently viewed leads or general Lead object information.

tools.name: Retrieve note object information
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves comprehensive metadata for the Salesforce 'Note' SObject, if it is enabled and accessible, to understand its structure and capabilities.

tools.name: Retrieve opportunities data
tools.description: Retrieves all available Opportunity records, representing potential revenue-generating deals, from Salesforce.

tools.name: Retrieve opportunity by id with optional fields
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves a Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; the Opportunity ID must exist.

tools.name: Retrieve specific campaign object details
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Retrieves details for a specific Salesforce Campaign object by its ID, optionally limiting to specified fields; the Campaign object must exist.

tools.name: Retrieve specific contact by id
tools.description: (DEPRECATED: use `SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT_BY_ID`) Retrieves a Salesforce Contact by its unique ID; the ID must correspond to an existing Contact record in Salesforce.

tools.name: Run report
tools.description: Runs a report synchronously (GET /analytics/reports/{id}?includeDetails=true) and returns the results in one call. This does NOT create an asynchronous report instance — for that, use the async run resource. Results are returned in a nested structure (factMap, reportExtendedMetadata), not a flat record list; an empty factMap/rows is a valid result. Avoid repeated calls when freshness allows.

tools.name: Run report async
tools.description: Run a Salesforce report asynchronously (POST /analytics/reports/{id}/instances). Returns an instance id and status; the report runs in the background. Retrieve results later with get_report_instance using the returned instance id. Use this (instead of the synchronous run_report) for large reports or to avoid blocking. Without this action, get_report_instance had no obtainable instance id.

tools.name: Run report with overrides
tools.description: Run a report synchronously with transient metadata overrides.

tools.name: Run SOQL query
tools.description: Executes a SOQL query against Salesforce data. Returns records matching the query with pagination support.

tools.name: Run tests asynchronously
tools.description: Enqueue explicitly selected Apex or automated flow test classes and methods. Returns a job ID immediately, not test outcomes. Query ApexTestRunResult and ApexTestResult for completion and results; does not select suites or org-wide test levels.

tools.name: Run tests synchronously
tools.description: Run methods from one Apex or automated flow test class synchronously. Select Apex tests by class ID or name; select flow tests by name.

tools.name: Save report
tools.description: Create a saved report, or update selected fields when report_id is provided.

tools.name: Execute SOSL search
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SALESFORCE_EXECUTE_SOSL_SEARCH instead. Executes a SOSL search query across multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to search for text across multiple object types simultaneously.

tools.name: Search accounts
tools.description: Search for Salesforce accounts using criteria like name, industry, type, location, or contact information. Always provide at least one filter parameter; omitting all filters returns a broad, slow listing. Owner/territory filtering is unsupported — use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY for ownership-based filters. Use SALESFORCE_GET_ACCOUNT to fetch complete field data for a specific record. Unsupported filter fields may be silently ignored — verify results reflect intended criteria.

tools.name: Search campaigns
tools.description: Search for Salesforce campaigns using multiple criteria like name, type, status, date range, or active status. Requires access to the Campaign object (Marketing User feature must be enabled in the org). For complex sorting (multi-field ORDER BY), use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY instead.

tools.name: Search contacts
tools.description: Search Salesforce Contact records (not Leads — use SALESFORCE_SEARCH_LEADS for those) using name, email, phone, account, or title. All parameters support partial/fuzzy matching, so results may include unrelated records; post-filter client-side for exact matches. Partial matches and common names can return multiple contacts — always confirm the correct contact by its 18-character Id before passing to write operations like SALESFORCE_LOG_CALL or SALESFORCE_CREATE_TASK. A response with totalSize=0 is a valid 'not found' outcome. Provide at least one search criterion; omitting all returns a broad, slow result set. Returned Ids are 18-character strings and must be used as-is in downstream tools.

tools.name: Search suggested article title matches
tools.description: Search for Salesforce Knowledge articles with titles matching the search query. Returns auto-suggest results for Knowledge articles based on title matches.

tools.name: Search leads
tools.description: Search for Salesforce leads using criteria like name, email, phone, company, title, status, or lead source. At least one search criterion should be provided — omitting all parameters results in a broad, slow listing of arbitrary records. Partial matches on name, email, and company may return multiple candidates; confirm Email or Company field values before using a lead ID in downstream operations.

tools.name: Search notes
tools.description: Search for Salesforce notes using multiple criteria like title, body content, parent record, owner, or creation date. Provide at least one filter criterion — omitting all filters returns a broad, slow, noisy listing.

tools.name: Search opportunities
tools.description: Search for Salesforce opportunities using multiple criteria like name, account, stage, amount, close date, or status. Apply at least one filter to avoid broad result sets. Partial-match searches may return multiple similar records; verify the correct record by Id before downstream use.

tools.name: Search tasks
tools.description: Search for Salesforce tasks using multiple criteria like subject, status, priority, assigned user, related records, or dates. Always provide at least one filter criterion — no filters produces broad, slow results. For complex filtering not supported here, use SALESFORCE_RUN_SOQL_QUERY.

tools.name: Search Tooling API records
tools.description: Search Tooling API metadata records with a SOSL statement.

tools.name: Send email
tools.description: Sends an email through Salesforce with options for recipients, attachments, and activity logging. Can partially succeed — check per-recipient success/failure status rather than treating the call as all-or-nothing. For large recipient lists, use SALESFORCE_SEND_MASS_EMAIL instead.

tools.name: Send email from template
tools.description: Sends an email using a predefined Salesforce email template with merge field support.

tools.name: Send mass email
tools.description: Sends an email to each recipient immediately and irreversibly, using a template or custom subject/body (requires either a valid template_id or both subject and body). Recipients are processed in batches of up to 150 via the emailSimple action. IMPORTANT: this sends one individual email per recipient, so it consumes the org's daily single-email allocation and can hit send/rate limits on large recipient lists — it is not a true bulk/marketing-email mechanism. The response is a `results` array with one entry per recipient; inspect each entry's `success` and `errors`, since individual recipients can fail even when the overall call succeeds.

tools.name: Set self-service user password
tools.description: Replace one legacy self-service user's password with the supplied password.

tools.name: Set user password
tools.description: Set or reset a Salesforce user's password. Provide new_password to set a specific value (silent). Omit new_password to RESET: this is destructive — it invalidates the user's current password and emails them a reset link, and does NOT return a password. This endpoint never returns a generated password.

tools.name: Update sObject record
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields in an existing Salesforce sObject record. Use when you need to modify one or more fields in a record without affecting other fields.

tools.name: Get user password expiration status
tools.description: Tool to check whether a Salesforce user's password has expired. Use when you need to verify password expiration status for a specific user.

tools.name: Start metadata deployment
tools.description: Submit a ZIP package to the Salesforce Metadata API for deployment.

tools.name: Execute Tooling API query
tools.description: Tool to execute SOQL queries against Salesforce Tooling API metadata objects. Use when you need to query metadata components like ApexClass, ApexTrigger, ValidationRule, WorkflowRule, FieldDefinition, or EntityDefinition. The Tooling API exposes objects that use the external object framework and provides granular access to metadata components for development and deployment tasks.

tools.name: Trigger process rules
tools.description: Trigger all active workflow rules for records, regardless of evaluation criteria.

tools.name: Update account
tools.description: Updates an existing account in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update account by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Account object identified by its unique ID; field names are case-sensitive and read-only fields are ignored.

tools.name: Update analytics notification
tools.description: Save changes to an analytics notification's schedule, delivery or subscription settings.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Updates an existing campaign in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update Campaign By ID
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specific fields of an existing Campaign in Salesforce, identified by its unique `id`, which must already exist.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description: Updates an existing contact in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated. Returns HTTP 204 with no body on success; use SALESFORCE_GET_CONTACT to verify applied changes. Org-level validation rules, duplicate rules, or field-level permissions may reject correctly formatted requests with HTTP 400; inspect the error response to identify the constraint.

tools.name: Update contact by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Contact by its ID; at least one field must be provided for modification.

tools.name: Update custom field metadata
tools.description: Update the Metadata representation of one CustomField Tooling record.

tools.name: Update dashboard
tools.description: Saves metadata changes to an existing Salesforce dashboard.

tools.name: Update a favorite
tools.description: Tool to update a favorite's properties in Salesforce UI API. Use when you need to reorder favorites or modify their display properties.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Rename a Salesforce report or dashboard folder by its ID.

tools.name: Update folder share
tools.description: Update the access level of one existing report or dashboard folder share.

tools.name: Update lead
tools.description: Updates an existing lead in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update lead by ID with JSON payload
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Lead in Salesforce via its unique ID (path parameter), returning HTTP 204 on success or error details on failure; request body must contain at least one field to update.

tools.name: Update list view preferences
tools.description: Tool to update user preferences for a Salesforce list view including column widths, text wrapping, and display order. Use when you need to customize how columns appear in a list view.

tools.name: Update note
tools.description: Updates an existing note in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update opportunity
tools.description: Updates an existing opportunity in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated. Returns HTTP 204 with empty body on success; call SALESFORCE_GET_OPPORTUNITY afterward to read updated values. Updates may fail with FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION or REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING — inspect the error message to identify the offending field.

tools.name: Update opportunity by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Opportunity by its ID; the Opportunity must exist, and some fields (like Name, StageName, CloseDate) may have specific Salesforce validation rules if being modified, while read-only fields update indirectly based on other changes.

tools.name: Update a record
tools.description: Tool to update a record's data in Salesforce via UI API. Use when you need to modify field values on an existing record. Salesforce validation rules are enforced. Pass If-Unmodified-Since header to prevent conflicts.

tools.name: Update Related List Preferences
tools.description: Tool to update user preferences for a specific related list on an object in Salesforce. Use when customizing display settings such as column widths, text wrapping, column ordering, and sorting preferences for related lists.

tools.name: Update sObject collection
tools.description: Update up to 200 Salesforce records by ID in one request.

tools.name: Update specific note by id
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use `update_specific_note_by_id` instead. Updates specified fields of an existing Salesforce Note SObject identified by its ID; the Note must already exist.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates an existing task in Salesforce with new information. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update Tooling Flow
tools.description: Delete and replace a draft Flow version with updated Tooling API Metadata. Salesforce assigns the replacement a different ID but does not return that ID.

tools.name: Update Tooling API record
tools.description: Update a supported Salesforce Tooling API record by object name and ID.

tools.name: Upload file to Salesforce Files
tools.description: Upload a file to Salesforce Files home via the Connect REST API. Use when you need to attach files to records or store them in a user's personal library. File size limit: 50 MB per request.

tools.name: Upload job data
tools.description: Tool to upload CSV data to a Salesforce Bulk API v2 ingest job. Use after creating a job and before closing it. Only ONE upload is allowed per job - multiple uploads will fail. After upload, close the job with state 'UploadComplete' to begin processing.

tools.name: Upsert sObject by External ID
tools.description: Tool to upsert records using sObject Rows by External ID. Use when you need to create or update a Salesforce record based on an external ID field value - creates a new record if the external ID doesn't exist, or updates the existing record if it does.

tools.name: Upsert Survey Translations
tools.description: Add or update Survey Flow field translations individually or in a batch.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (email, name, org) of the connected Salesforce account.

triggers.name: Account Created or Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an Account is created or updated in Salesforce.
Uses LastModifiedDate high-watermark to capture both creations and updates.

triggers.name: Contact Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing Salesforce Contact record is modified.
Emits changed fields alongside relevant timestamps.

triggers.name: Record Updated (Generic SObject)
triggers.description:
Triggers when monitored fields change on any Salesforce SObject. You specify the SObject type
and which field values should be returned in the payload. The trigger uses SystemModstamp to
detect changes regardless of which specific field changed.

triggers.name: New Contact Trigger
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Contact is Created in Salesforce.

triggers.name: New Lead Trigger
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Lead is created in Salesforce.

triggers.name: New or Updated Opportunity
triggers.description: Triggers when a Salesforce Opportunity is created or updated.

triggers.name: Task Created or Completed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a Task is created or when its status changes to Completed in Salesforce.
Supports optional filtering by task Status or Subject.

required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret

optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.description: The part of your Salesforce URL before .salesforce.com (e.g. 'acme.my'). Most accounts can keep the default 'login' — your real instance is detected after you sign in.

required.name: suffix.one
required.description: The API version path added to your Salesforce address (e.g. /services/data/v67.0). Most accounts can keep the default; change it only if your org needs another version.

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Consumer Secret from your Salesforce Connected App.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your My Domain subdomain — everything before .salesforce.com (e.g. 'acme.my'); sandboxes look like 'acme--dev.sandbox.my'. Find it in Setup → My Domain.

required.name: suffix.one
required.description: The API version path added to your Salesforce address (e.g. /services/data/v67.0). Most accounts can keep the default; change it only if your org needs another version.

name: Calendly
description: Calendly is an appointment scheduling tool that automates meeting invitations, availability checks, and reminders, helping individuals and teams avoid email back-and-forth

tools.name: Cancel scheduled event
tools.description: Tool to cancel a scheduled Calendly event by creating a cancellation record. Use when you need to permanently cancel an existing, active event. The cancellation will trigger notifications to all invitees.

tools.name: Create event invitee (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE instead. Tool to programmatically schedule Calendly meetings without UI redirects. Use when you need to book a meeting on behalf of an invitee via API. Requires a paid Calendly plan.

tools.name: Create Event Type
tools.description: Tool to create a new one-on-one event type (kind: solo) in Calendly. Use when you need to programmatically create a new event type for scheduling meetings.

tools.name: Create One-Off Event Type
tools.description: Creates a temporary Calendly one-off event type for unique meetings outside regular availability, requiring valid host/co-host URIs, a future date/range for `date_setting`, and a positive `duration`.

tools.name: Create scheduling link
tools.description: Create a single-use scheduling link. Creates a scheduling link that can be used to book an event. The link allows invitees to schedule up to the specified maximum number of events. Once the limit is reached, the link becomes inactive.

tools.name: Create share
tools.description: Creates a customizable, one-time share link for a Calendly event type, allowing specific overrides to its settings (e.g., duration, availability, location) without altering the original event type.

tools.name: Create single use scheduling link
tools.description: Creates a one-time, single-use scheduling link for an active Calendly event type, expiring after one booking.

tools.name: Create webhook subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook subscription for receiving Calendly event notifications. Use when you need to set up automated notifications for events like meeting bookings or cancellations. Organization scope triggers webhooks for all events organization-wide, while user/group scopes limit triggering to specific users or groups.

tools.name: Delete invitee data
tools.description: Permanently removes all invitee data associated with the provided emails from past organization events, for data privacy compliance (requires Enterprise subscription; deletion may take up to one week).

tools.name: Delete invitee no show
tools.description: Deletes an Invitee No-Show record by its `uuid` to reverse an invitee's 'no-show' status; the `uuid` must refer to an existing record.

tools.name: Delete organization membership
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a Calendly organization by membership UUID. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to an organization. Requires admin rights; organization owners cannot be removed.

tools.name: Delete scheduled event data
tools.description: For Enterprise users, initiates deletion of an organization's scheduled event data between a `start_time` and `end_time` (inclusive, where `start_time` must be <= `end_time`); actual data deletion may take up to 7 days to complete.

tools.name: Delete webhook subscription
tools.description: Deletes an existing webhook subscription to stop Calendly sending event notifications to its registered callback URL; this operation is idempotent.

tools.name: Get current user (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use CALENDLY_GET_USER instead. Retrieves detailed information about the currently authenticated Calendly user.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Use to retrieve a specific Calendly scheduled event by its UUID, provided the event exists in the user's Calendly account.

tools.name: Get event invitee
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific invitee of a scheduled event, using their unique UUIDs.

tools.name: Get event type
