tools.description: Invites a user via email to a ClickUp Workspace (Team), optionally granting admin rights or a custom role; requires an Enterprise Plan for the Workspace.

tools.name: Move task to new home list
tools.description: Tool to move a task to a new home List using ClickUp Public API v3. Use when you need to change a task's home list (not just add to additional lists).

tools.name: Remove custom field value
tools.description: Removes an existing value from a Custom Field on a specific task; this does not delete the Custom Field definition or its predefined options.

tools.name: Remove guest from folder
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific ClickUp Folder, optionally unsharing items explicitly shared with them within it; requires an Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from list
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific List, provided the guest currently has access to this List and the Workspace is on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from task
tools.description: Revokes a guest's access to a specific task; only available for Workspaces on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Remove guest from workspace
tools.description: Permanently removes a guest from a specified Workspace, revoking all their access; this destructive operation requires the Workspace to be on the ClickUp Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Remove tag from task
tools.description: Removes a tag from a specified task by disassociating it (does not delete the tag from Workspace), succeeding even if the tag is not on the task.

tools.name: Remove tags from time entries
tools.description: Removes tags from specified time entries in a team, without deleting the tags from the workspace.

tools.name: Remove task from list
tools.description: Removes a task from an extra list (not its home list); the 'Tasks in Multiple Lists' ClickApp must be enabled.

tools.name: Remove user from workspace
tools.description: Deactivates a user from a specified ClickUp Workspace, revoking their access (user can be reactivated later); requires the Workspace to be on an Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Search Docs
tools.description: Tool to search and list Docs metadata in a ClickUp workspace. Use after confirming the workspace ID to quickly locate relevant meeting notes before fetching pages.

tools.name: Set custom field value
tools.description: Sets or updates a Custom Field's value for a task; the new value (with type-dependent structure, e.g., `{"value": "text"}` or `{"value": 123, "value_options": {"currency_type":"USD"}}`) is provided in the JSON request body.

tools.name: Start a time entry
tools.description: Starts a new time entry (timer) in the specified Team (Workspace), optionally associating it with a task, adding a description, setting billable status, or applying tags (tags feature requires Business Plan or higher).

tools.name: Stop a time entry
tools.description: Stops the authenticated user's currently active time entry in the specified Team (Workspace), which requires an existing time entry to be running.

tools.name: Track time
tools.description: Records a time entry for a task using ClickUp's legacy time tracking system; newer endpoints are generally recommended.

tools.name: Update chat channel
tools.description: Tool to update a ClickUp chat channel's properties including name, topic, description, visibility, and location. Use when you need to modify an existing chat channel's settings. The endpoint requires both workspace_id and channel_id.

tools.name: Update chat message
tools.description: Tool to update a ClickUp chat message's content, assignee, or resolved status via the v3 API. Use when you need to edit an existing chat message.

tools.name: Edit checklist
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist's name or position, identified by its `checklist_id`.

tools.name: Edit checklist item
tools.description: Updates an existing checklist item, allowing modification of its name, assignee, resolution status, or parent item for nesting.

tools.name: Update comment
tools.description: Updates an existing task comment's text, assignee (who must be a valid workspace member), or resolution status, requiring a valid existing comment_id.

tools.name: Update folder
tools.description: Updates the name of an existing folder in ClickUp.

tools.name: Update goal
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing ClickUp goal, identified by its `goal_id`.

tools.name: Edit guest on workspace
tools.description: Modifies the details and permissions of an existing guest user within a specific Workspace.

tools.name: Edit key result
tools.description: Updates an existing key result's progress or note in ClickUp, where the key result measures progress towards a goal.

tools.name: Update list
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing ClickUp list, such as its name, content, due date, priority, assignee, or color status, identified by its `list_id`.

tools.name: Update space
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp Space, allowing modification of its name, color, privacy, and feature settings (ClickApps).

tools.name: Edit space tag
tools.description: Updates an existing tag's name and colors in a ClickUp Space; requires current tag name for identification, and new values for tag name, foreground color, and background color, all of which are mandatory for the update.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description: Updates attributes of an existing task; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true, use a single space (" ") for `description` to clear it, and provide at least one modifiable field.

tools.name: Update team
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp User Group (Team) using its `group_id`; note that adding a view-only guest as a paid member may incur charges.

tools.name: Update a time entry
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp time entry. Requires team_id (workspace ID) and timer_id (time entry ID). Optional fields: description, tags, tag_action, start/end times, duration, tid (task ID), billable status. Note: start and end times should be provided together. This is an Advanced Time Tracking feature that may require a Business Plan or higher.

tools.name: Change tag names from time entries
tools.description: Updates the name, background color, and/or foreground color for an existing time entry tag, identified by its current `name` and `team_id`.

tools.name: Edit time tracked
tools.description: Edits a legacy time-tracked interval for a task (identified by `task_id` and `interval_id`) to update its start/end times and duration; `team_id` is required if `custom_task_ids` is true.

tools.name: Edit user on workspace
tools.description: Updates a user's username, admin status, or custom role in a Workspace; requires the Workspace to be on an Enterprise Plan.

tools.name: Update view
tools.description: Updates an existing ClickUp view's settings such as name, type, grouping, or filters; ensure `parent_id` and `parent_type` define a valid hierarchy, and that specified field names (e.g. for sorting, columns) are valid within the ClickUp workspace.

tools.name: Update webhook
tools.description: Updates the endpoint URL, monitored events, and status of an existing webhook, identified by its `webhook_id`.

tools.name: Update workspace ACL
tools.description: Updates privacy and access control list (ACL) permissions for a workspace object or location. Use this to make objects private/public or manage user/team permissions for spaces, folders, lists, tasks, and other ClickUp objects.

triggers.name: Folder Created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Folder is created.

triggers.name: Folder Deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a Folder is deleted.

triggers.name: Folder Updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a Folder is updated (renamed, content edited, etc.).

triggers.name: List Created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new List is created.

triggers.name: List Deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a List is deleted.

triggers.name: List Updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a List is updated (renamed, content edited, etc.).

triggers.name: Space Created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new Space is created in the Workspace.

triggers.name: Space Deleted
triggers.description: Triggers when a Space is deleted.

triggers.name: Space Updated
triggers.description: Triggers when a Space is updated (renamed, settings changed, etc.).

triggers.name: Task Assignee Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an assignee is added to or removed from a task.

`changes[]` carries `AssigneeAddChange` and/or `AssigneeRemoveChange`
entries. A single event may bundle multiple adds and/or removes —
for example when a workflow re-routes a task between two users in
one operation.

triggers.name: Task Comment Posted
triggers.description:
Triggers when a comment is added to a task.

`changes[]` carries one `CommentChange` entry whose `comment` field
is the typed `ClickupComment` object (id, text, user, reactions,
etc.).

triggers.name: Task Comment Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when an existing comment on a task is edited.

`changes[]` carries one `CommentChange` entry whose `comment` field
is the comment in its updated form.

triggers.name: Task Created
triggers.description: Triggers when a new task is created in the configured Workspace.

triggers.name: Task Deleted
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task is deleted.

ClickUp ships no history_items or actor info on deletes — the payload
carries only the task_id and team_id.

triggers.name: Task Due Date Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task's due date is set, changed, or cleared.

`changes[]` carries `DueDateChange` entries only; `before` and
`after` are millisecond-epoch strings or `null`.

triggers.name: Task Priority Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task's priority changes.

`changes[]` carries `PriorityChange` entries only.

triggers.name: Task Status Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task's status changes.

`changes[]` carries `StatusChange` entries only — ClickUp pre-filters
server-side by event type. Lower traffic than subscribing to
`CLICKUP_TASK_UPDATED` and pattern-matching `StatusChange`.

triggers.name: Task Tag Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a tag is added to or removed from a task.

`changes[]` carries `TagAddChange` and/or `TagRemoveChange` entries.
Adds use ClickUp's `field == "tag"`, removes use the undocumented
`field == "tag_removed"`; both are normalised into the typed change
classes.

triggers.name: Task Time Estimate Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task's time estimate is set, changed, or cleared.

`changes[]` carries `TimeEstimateChange` entries only; `before` and
`after` are millisecond strings or `null`.

triggers.name: Task Time Tracked Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a time-tracking interval is created, edited, or deleted on a task.

Fires once per interval-change. Reads ClickUp's top-level `data.description`
for the lifecycle action and `data.interval_id` for the correlation key —
these are unique to time-tracking events and are present even on Deleted
(where `history_items` is empty).

triggers.name: Task Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when a task is updated.

Fires for every kind of update on the task, including comments. If
you only care about a specific property changing, prefer the
dedicated trigger (`CLICKUP_TASK_STATUS_UPDATED`, etc.) — those are
pre-filtered by ClickUp and produce less traffic.

`changes[]` can carry any FieldChange variant (`StatusChange`,
`PriorityChange`, `AssigneeAddChange`, `AssigneeRemoveChange`,
`TagAddChange`, `TagRemoveChange`, `DueDateChange`,
`TimeEstimateChange`, `TimeSpentChange`, `NameChange`,
`ContentChange`, `CommentChange`, `CustomFieldChange`).

name: Brevo
description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one email and SMS marketing platform that provides transactional messaging, marketing automation, contact management, and CRM tools to help businesses communicate and engage with their customers.

tools.name: Add Contacts to List
tools.description: Add existing Brevo contacts to one list using one identifier family.

tools.name: Create a company
tools.description: Creates a new company record in your Brevo CRM. Companies can be used to organize contacts and deals, track business relationships, and manage customer accounts. You can add custom attributes, link existing contacts and deals, and set country codes for international phone numbers. Use this when you need to add a new business or organization to your CRM system.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a Brevo contact, or update a matching contact when explicitly enabled.

tools.name: Create Contact Attribute
tools.description: Create a Brevo contact attribute definition.

tools.name: Create Contact List
tools.description: Creates a new contact list (audience) in Brevo within a specified folder. Contact lists are used to organize and segment contacts for email campaigns, SMS campaigns, and marketing automation workflows. Use this tool when you need to: - Create a new audience segment for a marketing campaign - Organize contacts by specific criteria (e.g., geographic location, interests, purchase history) - Set up a list for newsletter subscribers, event attendees, or customer segments - Prepare a target audience before adding contacts or launching campaigns Note: You must specify a valid folder ID. Use Get Contact Lists to view existing folders and their IDs.

tools.name: Create Deal
tools.description: Create a Brevo CRM deal with optional attributes and associations.

tools.name: Create Email Campaign
tools.description: Create an email campaign as a draft, or schedule it when requested.

tools.name: Create or Update Email Template
tools.description: This tool creates a new email template or updates an existing one in Brevo. If a 'templateId' is provided, it performs an update; otherwise, it creates a new template.

tools.name: Create Sender
tools.description: Create a Brevo email sender identity and return DNS configuration warnings.

tools.name: Create Sender Domain
tools.description: Register a Brevo sender domain and return available DNS authentication records.

tools.name: Create SMS Campaign
tools.description: This tool allows you to create a new SMS campaign in Brevo. You can specify the campaign name, sender, content, recipients (by providing list IDs, exclusion list IDs, or segment IDs), and optionally schedule the campaign for a specific time. You can also enable Unicode characters, add an organization prefix, and include unsubscribe instructions.

tools.name: Delete a company
tools.description: Deletes a company from Brevo using its unique identifier.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Deletes a contact from Brevo by email, contact ID, external ID, phone number, WhatsApp ID, or landline number. Use the identifier_type parameter to specify the type of identifier when using ext_id, phone_id, whatsapp_id, or landline_number_id.

tools.name: Delete Contact List
tools.description: Permanently delete a Brevo contact list without deleting its contacts.

tools.name: Delete Email Campaign
tools.description: Delete an unscheduled campaign and related template, builder, and schedule data.

tools.name: Delete Email Template
tools.description: This tool deletes an inactive email template from Brevo. You need to provide the 'templateId' of the email template you want to delete. Only inactive templates can be deleted.

tools.name: Delete SMS Campaign
tools.description: This tool deletes an existing SMS campaign.

tools.name: Export Email Campaign Recipients
tools.description: Start an asynchronous CSV export of a sent email campaign's recipients.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about the authenticated Brevo account. Returns account details including: - Account holder information (email, first name, last name, company name) - Complete address (street, city, zip code, country) - Plan details with credit information (type, credits remaining, start/end dates) - Relay configuration for transactional emails (enabled status and data) - Marketing Automation status and tracker key (if enabled) No input parameters are required - the action uses the authenticated account's credentials. Use this action to: - Verify account configuration and settings - Check available credits and plan type - Monitor transactional email relay status - Retrieve Marketing Automation tracker information. If credentials are missing or invalid, verify the Brevo connection is active before calling — retries will not resolve credential issues. If blocked by an 'unrecognised IP address' error, add the integration host's IP to the Brevo account allowlist.

tools.name: Get Aggregated Transactional Email Report
tools.description: Return aggregate delivery and engagement totals for transactional emails.

tools.name: Get all contacts
tools.description: This tool retrieves all contacts from your Brevo account with pagination and filtering based on modification/creation dates, list IDs, segment IDs, and contact attributes. For complete retrieval, iterate pages by incrementing `offset` by `limit` on each call until no more records are returned; a single call returns at most `limit` contacts.

tools.name: Get all email templates
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all email templates created in your Brevo account. It corresponds to the GET /v3/smtp/templates endpoint as per the Brevo API documentation, with optional parameters for filtering (templateStatus), pagination (limit, offset), and sorting (asc/desc).

tools.name: Get All Senders
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all senders associated with the Brevo account. Senders are the email addresses or domains that are authorized to send emails through Brevo. This action can be useful for managing and verifying sender identities.

tools.name: Get Company Details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific company from Brevo's CRM. Returns company data including its unique identifier, custom attributes, and lists of linked contact IDs and deal IDs. This is useful for accessing comprehensive company records and understanding company relationships.

tools.name: Get Contact Campaign Stats
tools.description: Retrieve a contact's email campaign statistics for a bounded date range.

tools.name: Get Contact Details
tools.description: This tool retrieves detailed information about a specific contact in Brevo. You can identify the contact using their email address (URL-encoded), their unique contact ID, or their SMS attribute value.

tools.name: Get Contact List
tools.description: Get contact-list metadata and optional campaign statistics by list ID.

tools.name: Get contact lists
tools.description: Retrieves all contact lists from your Brevo account with pagination support. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and folder associations. Use this to discover available lists or obtain list IDs needed for other operations (e.g., SMS campaigns, adding contacts to lists).

tools.name: Get Email Campaign Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full configuration and content for a specific email campaign. Use when you need complete campaign details including HTML content, recipients, statistics, and all configuration settings that may be omitted from list responses.

tools.name: Get Email Template
tools.description: Retrieve one transactional email template by numeric or custom ID.

tools.name: Get Process
tools.description: Retrieve the status and available result details of a Brevo process.

tools.name: Get SMS Campaign Details
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a specific SMS campaign. This action fetches complete information about an SMS campaign including its status, content, sender, scheduling, recipients, and statistics.

tools.name: Get SMS Campaigns
tools.description: Retrieves all SMS campaigns from your Brevo account with optional filtering and pagination. Use this tool to: - List all SMS campaigns with their details (name, status, content, sender, dates) - Filter campaigns by status (sent, draft, queued, suspended, inProcess, archive) - Filter sent campaigns by date range - Control pagination with limit and offset - Sort results by creation date (ascending or descending) Returns campaign overview information including ID, name, status, content, sender, scheduled date (if any), and creation/modification timestamps.

tools.name: Get Transactional Email
tools.description: Retrieve personalized content and event history for one transactional email.

tools.name: Import Contacts
tools.description: Submit a contact import to Brevo and return its background process ID. A 202 response means Brevo accepted the import for asynchronous processing; it does not mean the contacts have finished importing. If notify_url is supplied, Brevo calls it when processing finishes.

tools.name: List All Companies
tools.description: This action retrieves a list of all companies stored in the Brevo CRM. It supports pagination and filtering by name and other attributes.

tools.name: List Contact Attributes
tools.description: List the contact attributes configured in the Brevo account.

tools.name: List Contact Folders
tools.description: List folders that organize contact lists in the connected Brevo account.

tools.name: List Contact Lists in Folder
tools.description: List one bounded page of contact lists belonging to a Brevo folder.

tools.name: List Contact Segments
tools.description: List one page of contact segments configured in the Brevo account.

tools.name: List CRM Notes
tools.description: List one page of Brevo CRM notes, optionally filtered by entity and date.

tools.name: List CRM Pipelines
tools.description: List every Brevo CRM deal pipeline with its stages and stage settings.

tools.name: List Custom Object Records
tools.description: List one page of records for an Enterprise-only Brevo custom object.

tools.name: List Deals
tools.description: List one page of Brevo CRM deals with optional relationship filters.

tools.name: List Email Campaigns
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all email campaigns associated with the user's Brevo account. It allows filtering by campaign type, status, start date, and end date. The response includes the total count of campaigns and an array of campaign objects, each containing details like ID, name, subject, type, status, scheduled date/time, sender information, and optionally, campaign statistics. A response with `count` of 0 and an empty campaigns array is a valid result, not an error.

tools.name: List Organization Users
tools.description: List active and pending users in the connected Brevo organization.

tools.name: List Processes
tools.description: List a bounded page of Brevo background processes for status monitoring.

tools.name: List Sender Domains
tools.description: List sender domains and their authentication and verification status.

tools.name: List Transactional Email Events
tools.description: List one page of transactional email events with Brevo's complete filter set.

tools.name: List Transactional Emails
tools.description: List sent transactional email records using Brevo's supported filters.

tools.name: Remove Contacts from List
tools.description: Remove selected contacts, or every contact, from one Brevo list.

tools.name: Send Email Campaign Now
tools.description: Immediately dispatch an existing draft email campaign to its recipients.

tools.name: Send Email Campaign Test
tools.description: Send a campaign test to explicit recipients or the account test list. Brevo permits at most 50 delivered test emails per day.

tools.name: Send Transactional Email
tools.description: Send or schedule one or many transactional emails through Brevo.

tools.name: Send Transactional Template Test
tools.description: Send a transactional template test to recipients or the account test list. Brevo permits at most 50 delivered test emails per day.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update fields and list memberships for an existing Brevo contact.

tools.name: Update Contact List
tools.description: Rename an existing Brevo contact list, move it to a folder, or both.

tools.name: Update Deal
tools.description: Update a Brevo CRM deal's fields or complete association lists. Supplying either association list replaces every existing association of that type.

tools.name: Update Email Campaign
tools.description: Updates an email campaign in Brevo using its unique identifier.

tools.name: Update Email Campaign Status
tools.description: Apply a documented lifecycle status operation to an email campaign.

tools.name: Upload Campaign Image
tools.description: Upload an image from a public URL to Brevo's campaign image gallery.

name: Stripe
description: Stripe offers online payment infrastructure, fraud prevention, and APIs enabling businesses to accept and manage payments globally

tools.name: Accept quote
tools.description: Tool to accept a quote in Stripe. Use when you need to accept a finalized quote, which will create an invoice, subscription, or subscription schedule based on the quote's configuration.

tools.name: Activate billing alert
tools.description: Reactivates a billing alert, allowing it to trigger again. Use when you need to resume monitoring usage thresholds and receiving notifications for a previously deactivated alert.

tools.name: Add lines to invoice
tools.description: Tool to add multiple line items to a draft Stripe invoice. Use when you need to add additional charges, services, or credits to an existing invoice that is still in draft status.

tools.name: Advance test clock
tools.description: Advance a test clock to a future timestamp. Use for testing time-based billing scenarios. Requires test mode API keys (test_helpers endpoints are only available in test mode). The advancement is asynchronous; monitor the status field to track completion (status changes from 'advancing' to 'ready').

tools.name: Apply customer balance to payment intent
tools.description: Manually reconciles remaining amount for a customer_balance PaymentIntent by applying funds from customer's cash balance. IMPORTANT: This action only works with PaymentIntents that have 'customer_balance' in their payment_method_types. The customer_balance payment method type must be enabled in your Stripe account settings. Use this when you need to apply funds from a customer's cash balance account to complete or partially fund a PaymentIntent.

tools.name: Archive billing alert
tools.description: Tool to archive a billing alert in Stripe, removing it from list views and APIs. Use when you need to permanently archive a billing alert. This action is non-reversible.

tools.name: Attach source to customer
tools.description: Attach a payment source (card token or source object) to a customer for future charges. IMPORTANT: This is a legacy API. For new integrations, use the PaymentMethods API instead (STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD). The source parameter accepts: - Card tokens (tok_xxxx) created client-side via Stripe.js or mobile SDKs - Source objects (src_xxxx) for alternative payment methods NOTE: PaymentMethod objects (pm_xxxx) cannot be used with this endpoint. Use STRIPE_ATTACH_PAYMENT_METHOD for those. In test mode, you can use test tokens like 'tok_visa'. In live mode, tokens must be created client-side for PCI compliance.

tools.name: Attach payment to invoice
tools.description: Attaches a PaymentIntent or Out of Band Payment to an invoice's payments list. When the PaymentIntent status changes to succeeded, the payment is credited to the invoice. Use when you need to associate an existing payment with a specific invoice.

tools.name: Attach payment method to customer
tools.description: Attaches a PaymentMethod to a Customer. Use when you need to save a payment method for future use with a specific customer. The PaymentMethod must be in a detached state before attaching.

tools.name: Attach feature to product
tools.description: Tool to attach a feature to a product. Use when you need to add a feature to a product's capabilities. This creates a product_feature object linking the feature to the product.

tools.name: Cancel payment intent
tools.description: Cancels a PaymentIntent when in cancelable state. Use when a PaymentIntent is no longer needed to prevent further charges. For PaymentIntents with status='requires_capture', the remaining amount_capturable will be automatically refunded.

tools.name: Cancel Quote
tools.description: Tool to cancel a Stripe quote. Use when you need to cancel an existing quote that is in 'draft' or 'open' status. Once canceled, the quote cannot be finalized or accepted by the customer.

tools.name: Cancel setup intent
tools.description: Cancels a SetupIntent that is no longer needed. Use when a SetupIntent is in 'requires_payment_method', 'requires_confirmation', or 'requires_action' state. Note: SetupIntents linked to Checkout Sessions cannot be canceled through this method.

tools.name: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Cancels a customer's active Stripe subscription at the end of the current billing period, with options to invoice immediately for metered usage and prorate charges for unused time.

tools.name: Cancel subscription schedule
tools.description: Cancels a subscription schedule and its associated subscription immediately (if active). Use when you need to stop scheduling of phases while leaving any existing subscription in place. Only succeeds if the schedule status is 'not_started' or 'active'.

tools.name: Cancel Terminal Reader Action
tools.description: Tool to cancel the current reader action. Use when you need to halt any ongoing operation on a Stripe Terminal reader device such as payment collection, setup intent processing, or input collection.

tools.name: Capture Charge
tools.description: Tool to capture payment on an uncaptured charge. Use when a charge was created with capture=false and you're ready to capture the payment.

tools.name: Capture payment intent
tools.description: Captures the funds of an existing uncaptured PaymentIntent. Use when the PaymentIntent status is 'requires_capture'.

tools.name: Close Dispute
tools.description: Tool to close a dispute. Use when you want to dismiss a dispute and acknowledge it as lost, indicating no evidence will be submitted. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Set Terminal Reader Display
tools.description: Initiates input collection on a Terminal Reader to display forms and collect customer information. Use when you need to gather email, phone, text, numeric, signature, or selection inputs from customers on a physical reader.

tools.name: Collect payment method on Terminal Reader
tools.description: Tool to initiate payment method collection on a Stripe Terminal Reader. Use when you need to hand off a PaymentIntent to a physical card reader device to collect payment details. The Reader action executes asynchronously with action.status showing 'in_progress' initially.

tools.name: Confirm payment intent
tools.description: Tool to confirm customer intent to pay with current or provided payment method. Use when ready to finalize a PaymentIntent and initiate the payment attempt. A return_url is required if confirmation needs customer action like 3D Secure authentication.

tools.name: Confirm setup intent
tools.description: Confirms a SetupIntent to complete customer payment method setup. Use when you need to finalize credential collection after creating a SetupIntent.

tools.name: Confirm PaymentIntent on Terminal Reader
tools.description: Tool to confirm a PaymentIntent on a Terminal reader device. Use when you need to finalize a payment transaction on a card reader after the PaymentIntent has been collected on the reader hardware.

tools.name: Create Card Payments Capability
tools.description: Tool to create or update card payments capability for a Stripe Connect account. Use when you need to enable or disable card payment processing for a connected account.

tools.name: Create Account Session
tools.description: Creates an Account Session for a Stripe Connect account, granting access to embedded components. Use when you need to provide temporary, client-side access to a connected account's dashboard features such as account management, onboarding, payments, and payouts. The Account Session expires relatively quickly and cannot be used more than once. We recommend creating a new Account Session each time you need to display an embedded component to your user.

tools.name: Create Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Tool to create an Apple Pay domain registration. Use when registering your domain with Apple Pay to accept Apple Pay payments on your website. Stripe handles the Apple merchant validation process.

tools.name: Create apps secret
tools.description: Tool to create a secret in the Stripe Secret Store. Use when you need to securely persist secrets for use by UI Extensions and app backends.

tools.name: Create Bank Account Token
tools.description: Tool to create a single-use token representing bank account details. Use when you need to securely collect bank account information for ACH payments, direct debits, or adding a bank account to a customer or recipient.

tools.name: Create billing alert
tools.description: Tool to create a billing alert that monitors usage on a billing meter and triggers notifications when a specified threshold is crossed. Use when you need to set up usage-based billing alerts.

tools.name: Create billing credit grant
tools.description: Tool to create a credit grant that allocates billing credits to a customer for use against metered pricing. Use when you need to provide promotional or paid credits to customers.

tools.name: Create billing meter
tools.description: Tool to create a billing meter in Stripe for tracking usage events. Use when you need to set up a new meter to track API calls, storage usage, or other measurable customer actions that form the basis of billing calculations.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event V2
tools.description: Creates a billing meter event using Stripe API v2 for usage-based billing. Use when recording customer usage that will be metered and billed according to configured billing meters.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event Adjustment
tools.description: Creates an adjustment to cancel a billing meter event. Use when you need to correct errors or remove events attached to the wrong customer within 24 hours of Stripe receiving them.

tools.name: Create Billing Meter Event Session
tools.description: Creates authentication session for high-throughput meter event stream. Use when you need to send meter events to Stripe's billing system; tokens are valid for 15 minutes.

tools.name: Create Billing Portal Configuration
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe billing portal configuration. Use when you need to define the functionality and behavior of a customer portal session, including which features customers can access.

tools.name: Create Billing Portal Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe billing portal session. Use when you need to provide customers with a secure URL to manage their subscriptions, payment methods, and invoices.

tools.name: Create charge (deprecated)
tools.description: Tool to create a charge to request payment from a credit or debit card. Use when you need to charge a payment source directly. Note: This method is deprecated; Stripe recommends using the Payment Intents API instead for new integrations.

tools.name: Create Charge Refund
tools.description: Tool to create a refund for a charge in Stripe. Use when you need to refund a previously created charge fully or partially.

tools.name: Create Checkout Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe Checkout Session. Use when you need a secure, hosted URL to collect payments or subscriptions via Stripe Checkout.

tools.name: Create Coupon
tools.description: Creates a new discount coupon in Stripe with percentage or fixed amount discount. Use when creating promotional discounts for customers.

tools.name: Create Credit Note
tools.description: Issues a credit note to adjust a finalized invoice's amount. Use when you need to credit an invoice after finalization, either for refunds, customer balance credits, or out-of-band adjustments.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in Stripe, required for creating charges or subscriptions; an email is highly recommended for customer communications.

tools.name: Create Customer Balance Transaction
tools.description: Tool to create an immutable transaction that updates the customer's credit balance. Use when you need to manually adjust a customer's balance, such as issuing credits or debits.

tools.name: Create customer bank account
tools.description: Tool to create a new bank account attached to a customer object. Use when you need to add a bank account as a payment source for an existing Stripe customer.

tools.name: Create customer card
tools.description: Creates a card or bank account payment source for a Stripe customer. Use when you need to add a new payment method to a customer for future use. Supports both card and bank account creation. Note: To use bank accounts, the customer must be verified and have the `bank_account` capability enabled in their country.

tools.name: Create Customer Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe Customer Session granting client-side access control over a Customer. Use when you need to provide temporary access to customer portal features.

tools.name: Create card or payment source
tools.description: Attaches a payment source to a customer for later reuse. Use when you need to save a card, bank account, or other payment source for future charges.

tools.name: Create customer subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a subscription for an existing customer. Use when creating a new subscription with items and prices for a specific customer.

tools.name: Create Customer Tax ID
tools.description: Creates a new tax ID for a customer, used for tax compliance and invoicing across 100+ supported country-specific tax ID formats. Use when you need to add tax identification to a customer account.

tools.name: Create CVC Update Token
tools.description: Creates a single-use token representing an updated CVC value for card payments. Use when you need to update the CVC for an existing card without collecting the full card details again.

tools.name: Create Feature Entitlement
tools.description: Creates a new feature entitlement in Stripe representing a monetizable ability or functionality. Use when defining features that can be assigned to products and customers.

tools.name: Create Ephemeral Key
tools.description: Tool to create a short-lived ephemeral API key for secure mobile SDK access to specific Stripe resources. Use when integrating with Stripe iOS, Android SDKs, or Stripe.js for Issuing Cards.

tools.name: Create File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to Stripe for business purposes such as dispute evidence, identity verification, or business logos. Use when you need to store files that can be attached to other Stripe objects.

tools.name: Create File Link
tools.description: Tool to create a file link object that generates a shareable URL for accessing uploaded files. Use when you need to provide temporary or permanent access to a Stripe file.

tools.name: Create Financial Connections Session
tools.description: Tool to create a Financial Connections Session to launch the authorization flow for linking financial accounts. Use when you need to collect customer bank account information for payments or data access.

tools.name: Create FX Quote
tools.description: Tool to create an FX quote for currency conversion with optional rate locking. Use when you need to view current exchange rates for currency pairs or extend quoted rates for 5 minutes to 24 hours to reduce FX fluctuation uncertainty.

tools.name: Create an invoice
tools.description: Creates a new draft Stripe invoice for a customer; use to revise an existing invoice, bill for a specific subscription (which must belong to the customer), or apply detailed customizations. Note: Stripe API enforces a maximum value of 99,999,999 (in smallest currency unit) for amount fields including `unit_amount` in invoice items, `application_fee_amount`, and `transfer_data.amount`. Values exceeding this limit will be rejected.

tools.name: Create invoice item
tools.description: Tool to create an invoice item for draft invoices. Use when adding line items to customer invoices before finalization.

tools.name: Create payment intent
tools.description: Creates a Stripe PaymentIntent to initiate and process a customer's payment; using `application_fee_amount` for a connected account requires the `Stripe-Account` header.

tools.name: Create Payment Link
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe Payment Link. Use when you need to generate a hosted checkout page URL that can be shared with customers to collect payments without building custom checkout infrastructure. Supports up to 20 line items per payment link.

tools.name: Create payment method
tools.description: Creates a PaymentMethod object representing a customer's payment instrument (card, bank account, etc.). PaymentMethods can be: - Attached to a Customer for future use - Used directly with PaymentIntents to collect payments - Stored for recurring payments or subscriptions The 'type' parameter determines which payment-specific fields are required: - type='card': requires card object with number, exp_month, exp_year - type='sepa_debit': requires sepa_debit object with iban - type='us_bank_account': requires us_bank_account object with account details - And many other payment method types (acss_debit, au_becs_debit, bacs_debit, boleto, etc.) IMPORTANT: For card payments, collecting card numbers directly via API requires PCI compliance and special account permissions. Consider using Stripe.js, Stripe Elements, or mobile SDKs instead for better security and easier PCI compliance. This action is most useful for non-card payment methods or when you have explicit authorization for raw card data access.

tools.name: Create payment method configuration
tools.description: Creates a payment method configuration to control which payment methods are displayed during checkout. Use when setting up payment options for customers.

tools.name: Create payment method domain
tools.description: Tool to create a payment method domain object to control where payment methods are shown. Use when registering a new web domain with Stripe to enable payment processing capabilities.

tools.name: Create PII Token
tools.description: Tool to create a single-use token representing PII (personally identifiable information). Use when you need to securely tokenize sensitive personal information like ID numbers for compliance or security purposes.

tools.name: Create a plan
tools.description: Tool to create a recurring billing plan with flexible pricing configuration. Use when setting up subscription plans with defined pricing, currency, and billing intervals.

tools.name: Create Preview Invoice
tools.description: Tool to preview an upcoming invoice without creating it. Use when you need to show pending charges, renewal fees, discounts, and prorations before finalizing an invoice.

tools.name: Create a price
tools.description: Creates a new Stripe Price for a product, defining its charges (one-time or recurring) and billing scheme; requires either an existing `product` ID or `product_data`.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Creates a new product in Stripe, encoding the request as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` by flattening nested structures.

tools.name: Create Promotion Code
tools.description: Tool to create a promotion code linked to an underlying coupon. Use when you need to generate customer-redeemable codes with optional restrictions.

tools.name: Create a quote
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe quote modeling prices and services for a customer. Use when you need to generate a formal quote for a customer before finalizing payment.

tools.name: Create Refund
tools.description: Creates a full or partial refund in Stripe, targeting either a specific charge ID or a payment intent ID.

tools.name: Create a Report Run
tools.description: Creates a new report run object and begins executing the report asynchronously. Use when you need to generate Stripe reports such as balance summaries or itemized transaction reports.

tools.name: Create Reversal Tax Transaction
tools.description: Creates a reversal of an existing tax transaction. Use when you need to fully or partially reverse tax calculations, either for full refunds or specific line items.

tools.name: Create Setup Intent
tools.description: Creates a SetupIntent object to collect payment method permissions for future payments. Use when setting up payment methods for subscriptions or saving cards for later use.

tools.name: Create a shipping rate
tools.description: Creates a new shipping rate object that appears on Checkout Sessions for customer display. Use when defining shipping costs for products.

tools.name: Create Source
tools.description: Tool to create a Stripe source object for accepting payment methods. Use when you need to process payments through various payment methods like cards, bank transfers, or redirect-based payment systems.

tools.name: Create subscription
tools.description: Creates a new, highly configurable subscription for an existing Stripe customer, supporting multiple items, trials, discounts, and various billing/payment options.

tools.name: Create subscription item
tools.description: Tool to add a new item to an existing subscription without changing existing items. Use when adding a product or service to a customer's subscription.

tools.name: Create subscription schedule
tools.description: Tool to create a new subscription schedule for managing subscription changes over time. Use when you need to schedule future subscription modifications, phase transitions, or automate subscription lifecycle management.

tools.name: Create Tax Calculation
tools.description: Creates a Tax Calculation to compute taxes for customer purchases. Use when you need to calculate taxes for a transaction before finalizing it, such as displaying tax amounts in a shopping cart.

tools.name: Create Tax ID
tools.description: Creates a new tax ID for an account or customer. Use when you need to add tax identification for compliance and invoicing purposes.

tools.name: Create tax rate
tools.description: Tool to create a new tax rate in Stripe. Use when you need to define a tax rate for invoices, subscriptions, or checkout sessions.

tools.name: Create Tax Registration
tools.description: Creates a new Tax Registration object to enable tax collection in specified jurisdictions. Use when setting up tax collection for a new country, state, or province.

tools.name: Create Tax Transaction from Calculation
tools.description: Tool to create a Tax Transaction from a calculation before 90-day expiration. Use when you need to finalize tax calculations and create a permanent transaction record.

tools.name: Create Terminal Configuration
tools.description: Creates a new Configuration object for Stripe payment terminals with customizable settings. Use when setting up terminal readers with specific device configurations, offline settings, tipping options, or WiFi credentials.

tools.name: Create Terminal Connection Token
tools.description: Creates a short-lived connection token for Stripe Terminal SDK to connect to readers. Use when initializing a Terminal connection with the Stripe Terminal SDK.

tools.name: Create Terminal Location
tools.description: Creates a new Terminal Location for managing Stripe Terminal readers. Use when you need to register a physical location where Terminal readers will be deployed.

tools.name: Create Terminal Onboarding Link
tools.description: Creates an onboarding link for Tap to Pay on iPhone. Use when you need to generate a redirect URL for merchants to complete the Apple Terms and Conditions acceptance flow. The generated link directs merchants through the required onboarding process.

tools.name: Create Terminal Reader
tools.description: Creates and registers a new Terminal Reader to a Stripe account at a specified location. Use this to add physical card reader devices (like Stripe S700, WisePOS E) for accepting in-person payments. The reader must first generate a registration code (enter 0-7-1-3-9 on the device) before registering via this API. For testing purposes, use simulated readers with codes 'simulated-wpe' or 'simulated-s700' in test mode only.

tools.name: Create Test Clock
tools.description: Tool to create a test clock for testing time-based scenarios in Stripe. Use when you need to simulate the passage of time for testing subscriptions, trials, or other time-dependent features.

tools.name: Create Test Confirmation Token (Test Mode Only)
tools.description: Creates a test mode Confirmation Token for server-side payment integration testing. Confirmation Tokens securely transport payment method details collected client-side to your server for confirming PaymentIntents or SetupIntents. This test helper allows you to create these tokens server-side for testing without using Stripe.js. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires TEST MODE API keys (sk_test_...). It will fail with live mode keys. Use this only for integration testing in test mode environments. Provide either 'payment_method' (existing PM ID) or 'payment_method_data' (to create new PM).

tools.name: Create CVC update token
tools.description: Tool to create a single-use CVC update token for card re-collection. Use when you need to collect an updated CVC value for a saved card, typically during payment confirmation with manual confirmation_method on a PaymentIntent.

tools.name: Create Transfer
tools.description: Creates a transfer to move funds between Stripe accounts as part of Connect. Use when you need to move money from your platform's balance to a connected Stripe account, such as paying out to sellers or distributing funds to connected accounts.

tools.name: Create usage record
tools.description: Creates a usage record for a specified subscription item and timestamp. Use when tracking customer usage for metered billing plans to accurately invoice usage-based subscriptions.

tools.name: Deactivate billing alert
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a billing alert, preventing it from triggering. Use when you need to stop a billing alert from monitoring usage thresholds.

tools.name: Deactivate Billing Meter
tools.description: Deactivates a billing meter. Use when you need to stop a meter from accepting new events and prevent it from being attached to prices.

tools.name: Delete Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Tool to delete an Apple Pay domain from a Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a previously registered Apple Pay domain. This operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete apps secret
tools.description: Tool to delete a secret from the Stripe Secret Store by name and scope. Use when you need to permanently remove a secret. Requests from UI extensions can only access account-scoped secrets or secrets scoped to their own user.

tools.name: Delete coupon
tools.description: Tool to delete a coupon from Stripe. Use when you need to remove a coupon code, preventing new redemptions while preserving existing customer discounts.

tools.name: Delete customer (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use STRIPE_DELETE_CUSTOMERS_CUSTOMER instead. Permanently deletes an existing Stripe customer; this irreversible action also cancels their active subscriptions and removes all associated data.

tools.name: Delete customer bank account
tools.description: Deletes a bank account payment source from a customer. This action is irreversible — the bank account cannot be recovered once deleted. Use when you need to remove a bank account from a customer's payment methods.

tools.name: Delete customer discount
tools.description: Removes the currently applied discount on a customer. Use when you need to remove a coupon or promotion code discount from a customer's account.

tools.name: Delete customer
tools.description: Permanently deletes a customer and cancels active subscriptions. Use when you need to remove a customer record from your Stripe account. This operation is irreversible and automatically terminates any active subscriptions.

tools.name: Cancel customer subscription
tools.description: Cancels a customer's subscription immediately. Customer won't be charged again, and subscription status becomes 'canceled'.

tools.name: Delete customer subscription discount
tools.description: Removes currently applied discount from a customer's subscription. Use when you need to remove a discount code or promotion from a specific subscription belonging to a customer.

tools.name: Delete customer tax ID
tools.description: Deletes a customer's tax ID object. Use when you need to remove a specific tax identification from a customer's account.

tools.name: Delete ephemeral key
tools.description: Immediately invalidate an ephemeral key. Use when you need to manually expire a short-lived API key before its automatic expiration time.

tools.name: Delete draft invoice
tools.description: Permanently deletes a draft invoice. This action cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove a draft invoice. Finalized or subscription invoices must be voided instead.

tools.name: Delete invoice item
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice item from Stripe. Use when removing invoice items that are not attached to invoices or attached to draft invoices.

tools.name: Delete plan
tools.description: Tool to delete a plan from Stripe. Use when you need to permanently remove a pricing plan. Prevents new subscribers from being added to the plan, but existing subscribers remain unaffected.

tools.name: Delete product
tools.description: Delete a product. Deleting a product is only possible if it has no prices associated with it. Products with type=good cannot be deleted if they have SKUs.

tools.name: Delete product feature
tools.description: Removes a feature from a product. Use when you need to delete a specific product feature attachment.

tools.name: Delete subscription discount
tools.description: Removes the currently applied discount on a subscription. Use when you need to remove a discount code or promotion from an active subscription. Returns a deleted confirmation flag upon success.

tools.name: Delete subscription item
tools.description: Deletes a subscription item without canceling the subscription. Use when you need to remove a specific item from a customer's subscription while keeping the subscription active.

tools.name: Delete tax ID
tools.description: Deletes an existing tax ID object. Use when you need to permanently remove a tax identification from Stripe.

tools.name: Delete Terminal Configuration
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Terminal Configuration object from your Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a configuration that defines how features should be configured for terminal readers.

tools.name: Delete Terminal Location
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Terminal Location object from your Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a physical location where Terminal readers are no longer deployed. This operation is permanent and irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Terminal Reader
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Terminal Reader object from your Stripe account. Use when you need to remove a reader device that is no longer in use.

tools.name: Delete test clock
tools.description: Permanently deletes a test clock from Stripe's test environment. Use when you need to remove test clocks used for simulating time-based features.

tools.name: Void an invoice
tools.description: Tool to void a finalized Stripe invoice. Use when you need to permanently mark an invoice as void to prevent any further collection attempts. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Cancel subscription
tools.description: Tool to cancel a Stripe subscription immediately. Use when you need to permanently cancel a customer's subscription and prevent future charges.

tools.name: Detach payment from invoice
tools.description: Tool to detach a payment from an invoice. Use when you need to remove a payment from an invoice's list of payments. Only works with paid or canceled PaymentIntents.

tools.name: Detach payment method
tools.description: Detaches a PaymentMethod object from a Customer account. Use when you need to remove a payment method from a customer without deleting it entirely.

tools.name: Disable Event Destination
tools.description: Disables a v2 Event Destination, preventing it from receiving events. Use when you need to stop routing events to a webhook endpoint, Amazon EventBridge, or Azure Event Grid destination. This action is reversible by enabling the destination again.

tools.name: Download File Contents
tools.description: Download authenticated file contents when the file purpose permits it.

tools.name: Download Quote PDF
tools.description: Tool to download the PDF for a finalized quote from Stripe. Use when you need to retrieve the PDF document of a quote that has been finalized.

tools.name: Expire billing credit grant
tools.description: Expires a billing credit grant immediately. Use when you need to terminate a credit grant before its natural expiration date.

tools.name: Expire Checkout Session
tools.description: Tool to expire an active Stripe Checkout Session. Use when you need to prevent customers from completing an open checkout session.

tools.name: Finalize an invoice
tools.description: Finalize a draft invoice so it becomes open/collectable (and immutable where required). Use when you need to transition an invoice from draft to open status for payment collection.

tools.name: Finalize quote
tools.description: Tool to finalize a quote in Stripe. Use when you need to transition a quote from draft status to open status, making it ready to be sent to the customer for acceptance. The quote must have a customer attached before it can be finalized.

tools.name: Find a secret by name and scope
tools.description: Tool to find a secret by name and scope in the Stripe Apps secret store. Use when you need to retrieve a specific secret's details based on its name and scope.

tools.name: Find tax association
tools.description: Tool to find a tax association by PaymentIntent ID. Use when you need to retrieve tax calculation and transaction details linked to a specific payment.

tools.name: Fund Test Mode Cash Balance
tools.description: Tool to fund a test mode cash balance for a customer. Use when you need to simulate incoming bank transfers in test mode. This endpoint creates a test mode bank transfer that funds a customer's cash balance without processing real money.

tools.name: Retrieve Account
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for the authenticated Stripe account. Use when you need to access account capabilities, requirements, settings, or business profile.

tools.name: List Account Capabilities
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all capabilities for a connected Stripe account. Use when you need to check all available capabilities, their statuses, and requirements for an account.

tools.name: Retrieve Account Capability
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific capability for a Stripe account. Use when you need to check the status, requirements, or configuration of a capability such as card payments, transfers, or ACH payments.

tools.name: Retrieve Person from Account
tools.description: Retrieves an existing person associated with a Stripe account. Use when you need to check the details, verification status, or requirements of a specific person on an account.

tools.name: List all persons for an account
tools.description: Retrieves a list of people associated with the account's legal entity. Use when you need to list all persons for an account, with optional filtering by relationship type.

tools.name: Retrieve Account
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a Stripe account. Use when you need to check account properties like current requirements, live charge capability, payout eligibility, business details, or verification status.

tools.name: Retrieve Account Token
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a v2 Account Token by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific account token, including its creation time, expiration, and usage status. Account tokens are single-use tokens which tokenize company/individual/business information.

tools.name: Retrieve active entitlement
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an active entitlement describing customer access to a feature. Use when you need to check specific entitlement details for a customer.

tools.name: Retrieve Apple Pay Domain
tools.description: Retrieves details about a previously registered Apple Pay domain. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific Apple Pay domain that was registered with Stripe.

tools.name: List Balance Transactions (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use STRIPE_LIST_BALANCE_TRANSACTIONS instead. Tool to retrieve a list of balance transactions for your Stripe account. Use when you need to view transaction history affecting your balance. Returns all fund movements including charges, refunds, payouts, and fees with filtering options by date, currency, type, or source.

tools.name: Get balance settings overview
tools.description: Tool to retrieve balance settings for a Stripe account. Use when you need to fetch configuration options for customizing account balances and payout settings for a connected account or the authenticated account.

tools.name: Retrieve Balance Transaction
tools.description: Retrieves the balance transaction with the given ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific balance transaction including amounts, fees, availability dates, and transaction sources.

tools.name: Retrieve Billing Alert
tools.description: Retrieves a billing alert by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific billing alert that notifies when a certain usage threshold on a meter is crossed.

tools.name: Get Billing Credit Balance Summary
tools.description: Retrieves the credit balance summary for a customer in Stripe Billing. This action returns the available and ledger balances for billing credits granted to a customer. You can filter by a specific credit grant, price type (metered), specific prices, or billable items. The balance summary includes one entry per currency used in the credit grants. Use Cases: - Check remaining billing credits for a customer - View credit balances for specific metered prices or products - Monitor available vs. ledger balance for billing credits - Track credit usage across different currencies

tools.name: Retrieve credit balance transaction
tools.description: Retrieves a credit balance transaction by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific credit or debit transaction against a credit grant.

tools.name: List billing credit grants
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of billing credit grants. Use when you need to view credit allocations for customers, track promotional credits, or manage billing credits.

tools.name: Retrieve billing credit grant
tools.description: Retrieves a billing credit grant by its unique identifier. Use when you need to get details about a specific credit grant allocation for a customer.

tools.name: List billing meters
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of billing meters from Stripe. Use when you need to list meters with optional filtering by status and pagination support.

tools.name: Retrieve Billing Meter
tools.description: Retrieves a billing meter by its unique identifier. Use when you need to fetch configuration details and settings for a specific billing meter.

tools.name: List portal configurations
tools.description: Tool to list billing portal configurations. Use when you need to retrieve portal configurations that describe the functionality and settings of the customer portal.

tools.name: Get billing portal configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a billing portal configuration from Stripe. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific portal configuration including branding, features, and settings.

tools.name: Retrieve Charge Dispute
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a dispute for a specified charge. Use when you need to get dispute details associated with a specific charge ID.

tools.name: Get Charge Refund Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the details of an existing refund within a specific charge. Use when you need to get refund information using both the charge ID and refund ID.

tools.name: Get Checkout Session Line Items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve line items for a Checkout Session. Use when you need to view the items, pricing, quantities, and totals for a specific checkout session.

tools.name: Retrieve climate product
