name: Gong
description: Gong is a platform for video meetings, call recording, and team collaboration.

tools.name: Add call media
tools.description: Adds a call media, recorded by a telephony system (PBX) or other media recording facility. Gong accepts call recordings in various audio and video file formats, including WAV, MP3, MP4, MKV and FLAC. If uploading a dual-channel (stereo) file separated by speaker, make sure to specify which channel corresponds to the company team member (rep) in the parties/mediaChannelId parameter of the Add New Call operation. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:create'.

tools.name: Add new call  v2 calls
tools.description: When using this endpoint, either provide a downloadMediaUrl or use the returned callId in a follow-up request to /v2/calls/{id}/media to upload the media file. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:create'.

tools.name: Aggregate activity by period via api
tools.description: Lists the aggregated activity of multiple users within the Gong system for each time period within the defined date range. This endpoint returns multiple records, one for each user. For each user there are items for every time period in the date range, including statistics about the user's activity. Records are returned only for users with activity in the range. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:stats:user-actions'.

tools.name: Aggregate user activity statistics
tools.description: Lists the activity of multiple users within the Gong system during a defined period. Given the period, this endpoint returns multiple records, one for each user, with an applicable activity during the period. Each record includes statistics about the user's activity. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:stats:user-actions'.

tools.name: Assign prospects to flow
tools.description: Use this endpoint to assign a number of prospects to a flow. Prospects can be contacts or leads in your CRM. Generate a list of comma separated CRM Ids of the prospects you want to add to a flow. The flowInstanceOwnerEmail parameter is the email address of the Gong user who set up the flow instance and owns the flow to-dos. You can assign up to 200 prospects to a flow in a single request. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:flows:write'.

tools.name: Retrieve activity scorecards report
tools.description: Retrieve all the answers for the scorecards that were reviewed during a specified date range, for calls that took place during a specified date range, for specific scorecards or for specific reviewed users. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:stats:scorecards'.

tools.name: Create a new gong meeting  v2 meetings
tools.description: When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:meetings:user:create'.

tools.name: Create permission profile  v2 permission profile
tools.description: Create a permission profile in a given workspace.

tools.name: Data privacy for phone number
tools.description: Shows the elements in the Gong system that reference the given phone number. Given a phone number, this endpoint returns details of any leads or contacts with this phone number and their associated calls and email messages. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:data-privacy:read'.

tools.name: Delete a generic CRM integration
tools.description: Deletes an existing generic CRM integration from the Gong platform. This endpoint asynchronously removes a CRM integration and all its associated CRM objects (Accounts, Contacts, Deals, Leads, and Users). Use this when you want to disconnect a previously established integration between Gong and a CRM system. IMPORTANT: This endpoint only works with generic CRM integrations created via the 'register_crm_integration' action. It does NOT delete native integrations (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) that were set up directly through Gong's UI. The deletion is permanent and cannot be undone, so use with caution. This operation will affect data synchronization and may impact existing analytics or reports that rely on the integrated CRM data. Before deletion, you can retrieve existing integration details using the 'get_crm_integration_details' action to verify the integration ID.

tools.name: Delete Meeting
tools.description: Deletes a Gong meeting created via the Meetings API (Beta). Use this to remove a scheduled meeting by providing its unique meeting ID and the organizer's email address. Note: This endpoint is for meetings created through Gong's Meetings API, not for recorded calls accessible via the Calls API. Returns organizer email and request ID upon successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete users from call access list
tools.description: Remove individual user access from calls. The request can only remove access previously given by the /v2/calls/users-access API. If a given user does not have access to the call, they will be unaffected. If a given user does have access to the call, but not through the public API (for example if the call was shared with the user), the user's access will remain unchanged. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:call-user-access:write'.

tools.name: Erase data for email address
tools.description: Erase all data associated with an email address from Gong (GDPR compliance). This endpoint permanently deletes from the Gong system: - All calls where the email address appears (as lead, contact, attendee, or speaker) - All email messages sent to or from the address - All leads or contacts with this email address **IMPORTANT NOTES:** - The deletion is NOT immediate and may take several hours to complete - Has a data integrity protection mechanism to prevent deletion of abnormal number of objects - Delete the data from your CRM and email system BEFORE this operation to prevent re-import - If deletion fails, contact support at help@gong.io - Requires Bearer token scope: 'api:data-privacy:delete' **CAUTION:** This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Erase data for phone number
tools.description: Given a phone number, this endpoint deletes from the Gong system any leads or contacts with a matching phone number or mobile phone number. Email messages sent to or from these leads/contacts are deleted. Calls where the leads/contacts appear are deleted. The deletion is not immediate, and may take several hours to complete. This endpoint contains a data integrity protection mechanism to prevent the deletion of an abnormal number of objects. If the deletion fails please contact support at help@gong.io Delete the data from your CRM and email system before performing this operation so that private data is not re-imported into Gong. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:data-privacy:delete'.

tools.name: Fetch all permission profiles
tools.description: Returns a list of all permission profiles. The listing is in the alphabetical order of the profile names.

tools.name: Get Call By ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch specific call metadata by call ID. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific call using Gong's unique identifier.

tools.name: Get Call Transcript
tools.description: Tool to retrieve call transcripts from Gong. Use when you need to access the text content of calls with speaker information, timestamps, and topic categorization. Requires either a date range or specific call IDs to filter results.

tools.name: Get Crm Integration Details
tools.description: Retrieves details of generic CRM integrations registered with Gong. This endpoint returns generic CRM integrations that were set up using the PUT /v2/crm/integrations endpoint. It does NOT return native integrations (e.g., SALESFORCE, HubSpot) that are configured through Gong's UI. Note: Gong allows only one active CRM integration at a time (either generic or native). If a native integration is active, you cannot register a generic integration until the native one is disconnected. Returns an empty list if no generic CRM integrations exist. Required OAuth scope: 'api:crm:integrations:read'

tools.name: Get crm objects  v2 crm entities
tools.description: Retrieves specific CRM objects by their IDs from Gong's CRM integration. Use this endpoint to fetch detailed information about CRM entities (accounts, contacts, deals, or leads) that have been uploaded to Gong through a registered CRM integration. This is particularly useful during development to verify that CRM objects are uploaded and processed correctly. Prerequisites: - A registered CRM integration (use the register CRM integration endpoint first) - CRM objects must be uploaded to Gong before they can be retrieved - You need the specific CRM IDs of the objects you want to fetch The response includes a crmObjectsMap containing the requested CRM objects with their fields and values as defined in your CRM system.

tools.name: Get Flow Prospects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Gong Engage flows assigned to specified prospects. Use when you need to get flow instance IDs and details for specific CRM prospect IDs. Requires 'api:flows:read' scope.

tools.name: Get Interaction Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve interaction trend statistics for users based on calls with Whisper enabled. Use when analyzing user interaction patterns, measuring engagement metrics, or tracking communication behaviors over a specified date range. Returns metrics like interactivity, question rate, longest monologue, and patience levels.

tools.name: Get permission profile
tools.description: Returns a permission profile.

tools.name: Get CRM Request Status
tools.description: The GetCRMRequestStatus endpoint retrieves the current status of CRM integration requests in the Gong platform. It allows users to check the progress and outcome of operations related to CRM data uploads, synchronization, or other CRM-related processes. This endpoint is particularly useful for monitoring the health and progress of CRM integrations, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring data consistency between Gong and connected CRM systems. It should be used when you need to verify if a CRM integration request has been completed, is still in progress, or has encountered any errors. The endpoint does not modify any data and is intended for status checking only. Note that the specific details returned may vary depending on the type and complexity of the CRM integration request being queried.

tools.name: Get User By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve individual user details by user ID. Use when you need to fetch specific user information including profile data, settings, and organizational details.

tools.name: Get User Settings History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical changes to a user's settings. Use when you need to track capability modifications for a specific user identified by their Gong ID.

tools.name: List all coaching metrics  v2 coaching
tools.description: List all of the coaching metrics of a manager. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:coaching:read'.

tools.name: List all company workspaces  v2 workspaces
tools.description: Returns a list of all workspaces including their details. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:workspaces:read'.

tools.name: List all users  v2 users
tools.description: List all of the company's users. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:users:read'.

tools.name: List Call Outcomes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available call outcomes defined in Gong. Use when you need to list all call outcome configurations including their categories, sentiments, and automation settings.

tools.name: List Flow Folders
tools.description: Tool to list all Gong Engage flow folders with visibility types. Use when you need to retrieve company flow folders, personal folders, and folders shared with a specific user.

tools.name: List Folder Calls
tools.description: Given a folder id, this endpoint retrieves a list of calls in it. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:library:read'.

tools.name: List gong engage flows v2 flows
tools.description: Engage flows have the following visibility types: * Company: visible to everyone in the company, can only be edited by users with edit permissions. * Personal: reps can set up their own flows which are only available to them. * Shared: reps can share a flow with other reps. Those reps can then add leads to the flow. This endpoint returns all company flows, together with personal flows and flows shared with the user specified in the flowOwnerEmail parameter. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, use the 'api:flows:read' scope.

tools.name: List schema fields  v2 crm entity schema
tools.description: Retrieves schema fields for a specific CRM object type within a Generic CRM integration. Returns field metadata including names, data types (STRING, NUMBER, PICKLIST, etc.), labels, reference relationships, and picklist values for ACCOUNT, CONTACT, DEAL, or LEAD objects. IMPORTANT: Only works with Generic CRM integrations created via /v2/crm/integrations API. Does NOT work with native integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Dynamics 365). Required: integrationId (from Generic CRM integration creation), objectType (ACCOUNT/CONTACT/DEAL/LEAD).

tools.name: List Scorecards
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all scorecards within the Gong system. Use when you need to list all scorecard configurations and their associated assessment questions.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Engage tasks assigned to a specific user with filtering options. Use when you need to list tasks by status, action type, and other criteria. Requires 'api:tasks:read' scope.

tools.name: List users by filter  v2 users extensive
tools.description: List multiple Users. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:users:read'.

tools.name: Get user call access
tools.description: Retrieves a list of users who have been granted individual access to specific calls through the API. This endpoint returns only users with explicit API-granted access and doesn't include users who have access through other means (such as being sharing recipients or having access through permission profiles). When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:call-user-access:read'.

tools.name: Post a digital interaction  v2 digital interaction
tools.description: When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:digital-interactions:write'.

tools.name: Post day by day activity stats
tools.description: Retrieve the daily activity of multiple users within the Gong system for a range of dates. This endpoint returns records including statistics about each user's activity, on the daily level. Records are returned only for users with activity in the range. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:stats:user-actions:detailed'.

tools.name: Register Crm Integration
tools.description: Updates an existing CRM integration in the Gong platform. This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a previously set up integration between Gong and your Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system. It's primarily used for changing the integration's name or reassigning the ownership to a different team member. This operation is crucial for maintaining accurate and up-to-date integration configurations, especially when there are changes in your organization's structure or integration strategies. Note that this endpoint only updates the integration metadata and does not affect the actual data synchronization between Gong and your CRM.

tools.name: Report Content Share Event
tools.description: Tool to push content share engagement events to Gong's activity timeline. Use when documenting that a Gong user shared content with external participants such as contracts or proposals.

tools.name: Report Content View Event
tools.description: Tool to log content view engagement events to Gong's activity timeline. Use when tracking external participants viewing shared content like documents or presentations.

tools.name: Report Custom Engagement Event
tools.description: Report custom engagement events to Gong's activity timeline. Use this action to track when external participants (prospects, customers) engage with content such as viewing documents, signing contracts, attending webinars, or downloading materials. The events appear in Gong's activity timeline and help track customer engagement. Required fields: reportingSystem (identifier for your system), eventTimestamp (ISO-8601 format), and actor information (at minimum actor__email and actor__name) to identify who performed the action. Common use cases: Document viewed, contract signed, webinar attended, presentation downloaded, proposal opened. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:engagement-data:write'.

tools.name: Retrieve call data by date range  v2 calls
tools.description: List calls that took place during a specified date range. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:read:basic'.

tools.name: Retrieve data privacy info for email address
tools.description: Retrieves data privacy information for a third-party email address. Shows all elements in the Gong system that reference the given email address, including calls, email messages, meetings, customer data, and engagement events. This endpoint is designed for third-party privacy requests (e.g., customers, prospects, or external contacts) and will reject internal Gong user email addresses. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:data-privacy:read'.

tools.name: Retrieve filtered call details
tools.description: Lists detailed call data for calls that took place during a specified date range, have specified call IDs or hosted by specified users. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:read:extensive'. Moreover, clients requesting media download URLs by the contentSelector.exposedFields.media field should also have the scope 'api:calls:read:media-url'.

tools.name: Retrieve library folders  v2 library folders
tools.description: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of public library folders. We do not allow retrieval of either private or archived folders. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:library:read'.

tools.name: Retrieve logs data by type and time range  v2 logs
tools.description: List log entries that took place during a specified time range. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:logs:read'.

tools.name: Retrieve manual crm call associations
tools.description: Returns a list of all calls that were manually associated or re-associated with CRM account and deal/opportunity since a given time. Actions will be listed in the ascending order of their timing. Notice if a call was associated and later re-associated the API will return both events. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:crm-calls:manual-association:read'.

tools.name: Retrieve tracker details  v2 settings trackers
tools.description: Retrieves details of all keyword trackers in the system or in a given workspace. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the 'api:settings:trackers:read' scope.

tools.name: Retrieve transcripts of calls  v2 calls transcript (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use GONG_GET_CALL_TRANSCRIPT instead. Returns transcripts for calls that took place during the specified date period. If call IDs are specified, only transcripts for calls with those IDs that took place during the time period are returned. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:calls:read:transcript'.

tools.name: Retrieve users from permission profile
tools.description: Returns a list of all users whose access is controlled by the given permission profile. When accessed through a Bearer token authorization method, this endpoint requires the scope 'api:users:read'.

tools.name: Set User Call Access

Operations include: - Creating new dictionaries with configurable matching rules - Listing all available dictionaries - Retrieving dictionary details and configuration - Deleting dictionaries - Adding, retrieving, and removing dictionary entries Note: Dictionaries created here can be used in text analysis by specifying their IDs in the 'entityDictionaries' parameter of TextRazor analysis requests.

tools.description: Create a D1 database with optional placement and replication settings.

tools.name: Create DNS record
tools.description: Tool to create a new DNS record within a specific zone. Requires write privileges and makes live changes to the zone. Use after obtaining the zone ID via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES to programmatically add DNS entries.

tools.name: Create Email Routing Address
tools.description: Register an Email Routing destination; Cloudflare sends it a verification email.

tools.name: Create KV Namespace
tools.description: Create a classic or KV Instant namespace in a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: Create WAF List
tools.description: Create a new empty custom list for use in WAF rules and filters. Lists can contain IP addresses, hostnames, ASNs, or redirects. Once created, use separate actions to add items to the list. Note: List availability depends on plan (Free: 1 list, Pro/Business: 10 lists, Enterprise: 1000 lists). Example: CREATE_LIST(account_id="abc123", kind="ip", name="blocklist", description="Block malicious IPs")

tools.name: Create Pages Deployment
tools.description: Create a Cloudflare Pages deployment from a Git branch or Direct Upload manifest.

tools.name: Create Pages Project
tools.description: Create a Cloudflare Pages project for a production branch.

tools.name: Create Turnstile Widget
tools.description: Create a Turnstile challenge widget for selected domains.

tools.name: Create User API Token
tools.description: Create a user API token carrying supplied grants. Secure the one-time `result.value`; without `not_before` it is active immediately.

tools.name: Create Worker
tools.description: Create a beta Worker resource and configure its observability, previews, subdomain, tags, and tail consumers.

tools.name: Create Worker Deployment
tools.description: Deploy existing Worker versions immediately to live traffic by percentage. `force` can bypass rollback blocks after secret changes.

tools.name: Create Worker Version
tools.description: Upload code, assets, and configuration as a new Worker version without deploying it to production traffic. Bindings and settings are NOT copied from earlier versions. Pass every binding again, or pass {name, type: "inherit"} to carry an existing binding forward.

tools.name: Create Zone
tools.description: Creates a new DNS zone (domain) in Cloudflare. A zone represents a domain and its DNS records. Use this when adding a new domain to manage with Cloudflare. Requires account ID (obtainable via LIST_ACCOUNTS). The zone will be in 'pending' status until nameservers are updated at the domain registrar.

tools.name: Delete Account API Token
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly revoke an account-owned Cloudflare API token. Use only the specifically intended token ID; a revoked token cannot be restored.

tools.name: Delete DNS Record
tools.description: Tool to delete a DNS record within a specific zone. Deletion is immediate and irreversible. Use only after confirming both zone and record IDs. Requires write privileges on the zone. Example: "Delete DNS record 372e6795... from zone 023e105f4ecef..."

tools.name: Delete WAF List
tools.description: Tool to delete a WAF list. Use when you need to remove a list after verifying no filters reference it. Example: DELETE_LIST(account_id="<account_id>", list_id="<list_id>")

tools.name: Delete Pages Deployment
tools.description: Delete a selected non-production Cloudflare Pages deployment.

tools.name: Delete User API Token
tools.description: Permanently revoke one user-owned Cloudflare API token.

tools.name: Delete Worker
tools.description: Permanently delete a beta Worker and its versions and deployments.

tools.name: Delete Worker Script
tools.description: Delete a classic Worker script. Forced deletion may break service bindings and deletes its Durable Object namespaces.

tools.name: Delete Zone
tools.description: Tool to delete a zone. Use after confirming the zone identifier to permanently remove a DNS zone and all its DNS records from your Cloudflare account. Example: DELETE_ZONE(zone_identifier="023e105f4ecef8ad9ca31a8372d0c353")

tools.name: Deploy Worker Script
tools.description: Upload or replace a JavaScript module Worker script and create its latest version.

tools.name: Deploy Worker With Assets
tools.description: Upload static assets, create a Worker version, and deploy all traffic to it. Destructive: the new version replaces the live one for 100% of traffic. Only binding types listed in `keep_bindings` (secrets by default) and bindings passed in `bindings` survive; every other existing binding (KV, D1, R2, vars, services, ...) is dropped. List those types in `keep_bindings` to preserve them. Asset routing (`asset_config`) and compatibility flags are not inherited either and must be passed again on each deploy.

tools.name: Download Worker Script
tools.description: Download the raw source or multipart module bundle for a Worker script.

tools.name: Execute D1 Query
tools.description: Execute SQL against one Cloudflare D1 database. SQL may read, write, or permanently delete database data or schema.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Retrieve one Cloudflare account by its exact account ID.

tools.name: Get Account Build Limits
tools.description: Return whether an account has exhausted its Worker build minutes and when they refresh.

tools.name: Get Account Member
tools.description: Retrieve the identity, roles, policies, and status of an account member.

tools.name: Get Account Token
tools.description: Retrieve metadata and policies for one account-owned API token.

tools.name: Get Bot Management Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a zone's Bot Management configuration (Bot Fight Mode / Super Bot Fight Mode / Enterprise Bot Management). Use after identifying the correct zone_id (e.g., via CLOUDFLARE_LIST_ZONES). This tool is the canonical way to audit bot-related configuration; firewall rules are adjacent controls but not equivalent to Bot Management settings.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieve identity and account-membership details for the current user.

tools.name: Get D1 Database
tools.description: Get details for one D1 database, optionally selecting response fields.

tools.name: Get KV Namespace
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for one Cloudflare Workers KV namespace.

tools.name: Get KV Value
tools.description: Retrieve the stored bytes for a key in a Workers KV namespace.

tools.name: List WAF Lists
tools.description: Tool to fetch all WAF lists (no items) for an account. Results are paginated; iterate using page and per_page parameters until result_info.total_pages is reached to retrieve all lists. Use after confirming account ID.

tools.name: Get MCP Server
tools.description: Retrieve one Access AI Controls MCP server and its synchronization state.

tools.name: Get Pages Deployment
tools.description: Retrieve one Cloudflare Pages deployment and its current build status.

tools.name: Get Pages Deployment Logs
tools.description: Retrieve build log lines for one Cloudflare Pages deployment.

tools.name: Get Pages Project
tools.description: Retrieve one Cloudflare Pages project and its configuration.

tools.name: Get Pages Upload Token
tools.description: Request a short-lived JWT for Cloudflare Pages Direct Upload assets.

tools.name: Get Tunnel Configuration
tools.description: Retrieve the current configuration of a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel.

tools.name: Get User API Token
tools.description: Retrieve metadata and policies for one user-owned API token.

tools.name: Get Worker
tools.description: Retrieve one beta Worker resource by its exact ID or name.

tools.name: Get Worker Preview Deployment
tools.description: Retrieve a specific or latest deployment for a Worker Preview.

tools.name: Get Workers AI Model Schema
tools.description: Retrieve the input and output JSON Schemas for a Workers AI model.

tools.name: Get Worker Script Content
tools.description: Retrieve the deployed content of one Cloudflare Worker script.

tools.name: Get Worker Script Settings
tools.description: Retrieve a Worker script's metadata and runtime configuration.

tools.name: Get Worker Script Subdomain
tools.description: Inspect workers.dev and preview URL availability for a Worker script.

tools.name: Get Worker Script Version
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for one classic Worker script version.

tools.name: Get Worker Service Environment Content
tools.description: Retrieve deployed content for a legacy Worker service environment.

tools.name: Get Workers Subdomain
tools.description: Return the workers.dev subdomain configured for a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: Get Worker Version
tools.description: Retrieve one beta Worker version; optional code modules may add megabytes.

tools.name: Get Workflow
tools.description: Retrieve one Workflow's configuration, metadata, schedules, and counts.

tools.name: Get Workflow Instance
tools.description: Retrieve logs, status, and execution details for one Workflow instance.

tools.name: Get Zone
tools.description: Retrieve one Cloudflare zone and its configuration, status, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Zone Ruleset Phase Entrypoint
tools.description: Retrieve the latest active zone entrypoint ruleset for a Rulesets phase.

tools.name: Get Zone Setting
tools.description: Fetch one setting for a Cloudflare zone by setting name.

tools.name: Inventory Developer Resources
tools.description: Return one page each of KV namespaces, Workflows, and D1 databases.

tools.name: List Account Members
tools.description: Lists all members of a Cloudflare account with their roles, permissions, and status. Returns detailed information about each account member including their user details (name, email, 2FA status), assigned roles with granular permissions, membership status (accepted/pending/rejected), and access policies. Supports filtering by status, sorting by various fields, and pagination for accounts with many members. Use this action when you need to: - View all users with access to a Cloudflare account - Audit account member permissions and roles - Check membership status of invited users - List members with specific roles or statuses Requires the account ID which can be obtained using the List Accounts action. Note: caller's account role may restrict visibility of some members if permissions are insufficient.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: List all Cloudflare accounts you have ownership or verified access to. Retrieves a paginated list of accounts with their details including account ID, name, type, settings, and creation date. An empty or partial result may indicate insufficient API token scope or permissions, not the absence of accounts. When multiple accounts are returned, confirm the intended account_id before performing any write operations to avoid acting on unintended environments. Use this when you need to: - Discover available accounts before performing account-specific operations - Find an account ID for other API calls that require an account identifier - Audit account configurations and settings - Filter accounts by name or paginate through large account lists

tools.name: List Account Subscriptions
tools.description: List billing subscriptions and plan details for one Cloudflare account.

tools.name: List Account Tokens
tools.description: List account-owned API token metadata and policies with pagination.

tools.name: List D1 Databases
tools.description: List one page of D1 databases in an account. Increment `page` until `result_info` shows all matching databases have been retrieved.

tools.name: List DNS records
tools.description: Tool to list and search DNS records in a Cloudflare zone. Use when you need to find existing DNS record IDs for update or delete operations, especially after a "record already exists" error during creation. Returns matching records with their IDs, names, types, content, and other properties.

tools.name: List Email Routing Addresses
tools.description: List Email Routing destination addresses configured for an account.

tools.name: List Firewall Rules
tools.description: Tool to list firewall rules for a specific DNS zone. Use after confirming the zone ID to retrieve and audit current firewall rules. Does not expose Workers routes or other routing constructs.

tools.name: List KV Keys
tools.description: List key names and metadata in a Cloudflare Workers KV namespace.

tools.name: List KV Namespaces
tools.description: List Workers KV namespaces in a Cloudflare account. Sort by namespace `id` or `title` with `order` and `direction`, and paginate with `page` and `per_page`. The response preserves additional namespace fields returned by Cloudflare.

tools.name: List MCP Portals
tools.description: List Cloudflare Access AI Controls MCP portals with pagination and search.

tools.name: List Monitors
tools.description: Tool to list all load-balancer monitors in a Cloudflare account. Use after creating or updating monitors to retrieve a paginated list. Response includes `result_info.total_pages` to determine when all pages have been fetched.

tools.name: List Pages Deployments
tools.description: List production or preview deployments for a Cloudflare Pages project. Use `environment` to filter by deployment type and `page` with `per_page` to traverse results; inspect `result_info.total_pages` to determine whether another page is available.

tools.name: List Pages Project Domains
tools.description: List custom domains attached to a Cloudflare Pages project, including their validation and verification state.

tools.name: List Pages Projects
tools.description: List Pages projects in a Cloudflare account. Use `page` and `per_page` to traverse results and inspect `result_info.total_pages` for additional pages.

tools.name: List Pools
tools.description: Tool to list all load balancer pools in a Cloudflare account. Use after confirming account ID to discover pool IDs. Paginate using `page` and `per_page`; check `result_info.total_pages` in the response to determine if additional pages exist.

tools.name: List Queues
tools.description: List queues owned by a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: List Registrar Registrations
tools.description: List domains registered through Cloudflare Registrar.

tools.name: List Rule List Entries
tools.description: List entries in one Cloudflare account rule list.

tools.name: List Web Analytics Sites
tools.description: List Cloudflare Web Analytics sites for an account. Use `order_by` to sort by hostname or creation time and `page` with `per_page` to traverse results; inspect `result_info.total_pages` to determine whether another page is available.

tools.name: List Tunnels
tools.description: List Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared) tunnels in an account to discover tunnel IDs, names, and statuses. Use when you need to find a tunnel_id before performing tunnel operations like routing, DNS configuration, or debugging.

tools.name: List Turnstile Widgets
tools.description: List Turnstile widgets configured for a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: List User API Tokens
tools.description: List metadata for API tokens created by the connected Cloudflare user without returning token secrets.

tools.name: List Worker Builds
tools.description: List one page of Workers CI builds associated with an immutable Worker tag.

tools.name: List Worker Build Triggers
tools.description: List Workers Builds trigger configurations associated with one Worker tag.

tools.name: List Worker Deployments
tools.description: List deployment history for a classic Worker script.

tools.name: List Worker Routes
tools.description: List Worker route patterns and script assignments for a Cloudflare zone.

tools.name: List Workers
tools.description: List account Workers with optional sorting and page-based pagination.

tools.name: List Workers Build Tokens
tools.description: List Workers Builds authentication token metadata without returning token secrets.

tools.name: List Worker Scripts
tools.description: List uploaded classic Worker scripts, optionally filtering by tag rules.

tools.name: List Worker Script Versions
tools.description: List classic Worker script versions, optionally filtering to deployable versions. The first item is the latest version. Use `page` and `per_page` to paginate unless `deployable` is true, in which case Cloudflare ignores pagination.

tools.name: List Workers Domains
tools.description: List custom domains routed to Workers in a Cloudflare account.

tools.name: List Worker Secrets
tools.description: List the names and types of secrets bound to one Worker script.

tools.name: List Worker Telemetry Values
tools.description: List unique values observed for a Workers telemetry field.

tools.name: List Worker Versions
tools.description: List paginated versions of a Cloudflare Worker. Use `page` and `per_page` to traverse results; version objects are preserved as returned so provider-added fields remain available.

tools.name: List Workflow Instances
tools.description: List Workflow executions with state, UTC date, and cursor filters.

tools.name: List Workflows
tools.description: List and search account Workflows. Use page and per_page to traverse results.

tools.name: List Zones
tools.description: Lists, searches, sorts, and filters zones in the authenticated account. Use `page`/`per_page` to paginate; check `result_info.total_pages` in the response to iterate all pages. Does not return DNS records — extract `zone_id` from results before passing to zone-scoped tools (DNS, firewall, etc.). Only zones delegated to Cloudflare nameservers appear; empty results indicate scope or delegation constraints, not errors.

tools.name: Manage Worker Schedules
tools.description: Get a Worker's Cron Triggers, or replace all triggers when schedules is supplied.

tools.name: Query Analytics SQL
tools.description: Execute a parameterized Cloudflare Analytics SQL SELECT statement.

tools.name: Query GraphQL Analytics
tools.description: Run a read-only query against Cloudflare's GraphQL Analytics API.

tools.name: Query Worker Telemetry
tools.description: Run a saved or ad-hoc Workers Observability telemetry query.

tools.name: Replace Rules List Items
tools.description: Replace every item in a Rules List and wait for the bulk operation outcome.

tools.name: Rerun Zone Activation Check
tools.description: Trigger a fresh activation check for a pending Cloudflare zone. Cloudflare allows one check every five minutes on paid plans and once per hour on free plans.

tools.name: Roll Account Token
tools.description: Irreversibly rotate an Account Owned API token secret. This destructive credential rotation immediately invalidates the current secret and returns its replacement only once. Confirm the token and update dependent integrations.

tools.name: Roll Back Pages Deployment
tools.description: Promote a previous successful Pages deployment back to production.

tools.name: Run Workers AI Model
tools.description: Run a Workers AI model and return non-streaming JSON; streaming is unsupported.

tools.name: Scrape Page Elements
tools.description: Render a URL or supplied HTML and return elements matching CSS selectors.

tools.name: Start Worker Asset Upload Session
tools.description: Register a Worker static-asset manifest and return a one-hour JWT and hash buckets for later asset-upload calls; this action does not upload asset bytes.

tools.name: Update DNS record
tools.description: Tool to update an existing DNS record within a specific zone. Use after confirming both zone and record identifiers; only provided fields are modified. Updates to records used by active tunnels take effect immediately and can disrupt live traffic.

tools.name: Update WAF List
tools.description: Tool to update the description of a WAF list (cannot update items). Use after confirming list metadata.

tools.name: Update Pages Project
tools.description: Rename a Pages project or update its production branch, build configuration, deployment environments, or source repository settings.

tools.name: Update Tunnel Configuration
tools.description: Tool to update a remotely-managed Cloudflare Tunnel's configuration (ingress rules and routing). Use when you need to programmatically configure hostname-to-origin mappings for a tunnel. WARNING: This operation REPLACES the entire configuration - incorrect configuration can break routing and make services unreachable. Best practice: fetch current configuration first (if patching) to preserve existing rules. At least one ingress rule is required, and the last rule should typically be a catch-all (hostname='*' or omitted) with service='http_status:404'.

tools.name: Update Worker Preview Deployment
tools.description: Create a new Preview deployment by merge-patching bindings or annotations on an existing Preview deployment.

tools.name: Update Worker Script Settings
tools.description: Patch Worker configuration and metadata, creating a new version.

tools.name: Update Worker Script Subdomain
tools.description: Enable or disable a Worker script and its previews on workers.dev.

tools.name: Update Zone
tools.description: Tool to update properties of an existing zone; changes apply immediately to the live zone. Confirm zone ID and intended change with the user before calling. Only one field can be modified per call.

tools.name: Update Zone Ruleset Phase Entrypoint
tools.description: Replace a zone phase entrypoint ruleset. WARNING: this is a full replacement, not a patch; omitted body fields may reset existing configuration.

tools.name: Upload Pages Assets
tools.description: Upload static assets and register their hashes for a Pages deployment.

tools.name: Upload Worker Assets
tools.description: Upload one bucket of base64-encoded Worker static assets.

tools.name: Upload Worker Script Version
tools.description: Upload a module-syntax classic Worker version without deploying it. Warning: a new version does not inherit the previous version's bindings. Only binding types in metadata.keep_bindings (secrets by default) are kept; every other binding (KV, D1, R2, services, vars, ...) must be passed in metadata.bindings, for example as {"type": "inherit", "name": "MY_KV"}, or it is missing once this version is deployed.

tools.name: Upsert Worker Secret
tools.description: Add or replace one secret binding, creating a new Worker version.

tools.name: Write KV Value
tools.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 value in a Cloudflare Workers KV namespace.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Global API Key for the Cloudflare account.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Email address associated with the Cloudflare account.

name: Harvest
description: Harvest is a time-tracking and invoicing tool designed for teams and freelancers, helping them log billable hours, manage projects, and streamline payments

tools.name: Create Client
tools.description: Tool to create a new client. Use after gathering client details to register a new client in Harvest.

tools.name: Create Client Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new client contact. Use when you need to add a contact under an existing client. Call after you've retrieved or confirmed the client_id.

tools.name: Create Estimate
tools.description: Tool to create a new estimate. Use after gathering client and line item details.

tools.name: Create Estimate Item Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new estimate item category in Harvest. Use after deciding to categorize line items within an estimate.

tools.name: Create Estimate Message
tools.description: Tool to create a new message for an estimate. Use when you have an estimate ID and want to send a message or run an event (send, accept, decline, re-open) on the estimate.

tools.name: Create Expense
tools.description: Tool to create a new expense entry. Use when recording costs against projects. Ensure either units or total_cost is provided.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice. Use when you have gathered all invoice details and need to bill a client in Harvest.

tools.name: Create Invoice Item Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice item category. Use after you have decided on the category name to register it in Harvest.

tools.name: Create Invoice Message
tools.description: Creates a new message for an invoice in Harvest. Use this to send invoice notifications to clients, create draft messages, or change invoice states (close/reopen). Requires a valid invoice ID. The invoice must be in the appropriate state for the requested event_type.

tools.name: Create Invoice Payment
tools.description: Tool to create a new payment on an invoice. Use when recording a payment against an existing invoice.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a new project in Harvest. A project is a container for tracking time, expenses, and invoices for a specific client engagement. Required: You must provide a valid client_id (use list_clients or create_client first), project name, and billing configuration (is_billable, bill_by, budget_by). Common use cases: - Time & Materials: is_billable=true, bill_by="Tasks", budget_by="project" - Fixed Fee: is_billable=true, bill_by="Project", budget_by="none", is_fixed_fee=true - Internal/Non-billable: is_billable=false, bill_by="none", budget_by="none"

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Creates a new task in Harvest. Tasks are reusable activity types (e.g., "Development", "Design", "Consulting") that can be assigned to projects for time tracking. Use this to define billable or non-billable work categories that your team will track time against.

tools.name: Create Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new time entry. Use when logging hours for a project by specifying start/end times or duration.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Creates a new user in Harvest and sends an invitation email to the specified address. Use this action to add team members to your Harvest account. You can specify their role, permissions, rates, and whether they are employees or contractors. The user will receive an invitation email to activate their account. Required: first_name, last_name, and email. Optional: timezone, access roles, rates, weekly capacity, and business roles.

tools.name: Delete Client
tools.description: Tool to delete a client. Use when you need to remove a client that has no associated projects, invoices, or estimates. Call after confirming the client_id exists and has no dependent resources.

tools.name: Delete Client Contact
tools.description: Permanently deletes a client contact from Harvest. Use when you need to remove a contact that is no longer relevant. Requires Administrator or Manager permissions. The deletion cannot be undone, so verify the contact_id before calling.

tools.name: Delete Estimate
tools.description: Tool to delete an estimate. Use when you need to remove an estimate that is no longer needed. Call after confirming the estimate_id exists and has no dependent resources.

tools.name: Delete Estimate Message
tools.description: Tool to delete an estimate message. Use when you need to remove a message from an estimate. Call after confirming estimate_id and message_id are correct.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Delete an invoice from Harvest. Removes the specified invoice permanently. Requires Administrator or Manager permissions with invoice editing access.

tools.name: Delete Invoice Item Category
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice item category from Harvest. Returns 200 OK on success with no response body. Important: Deletion is only possible if both use_as_service and use_as_expense are false. Categories actively used for billable hours or expenses cannot be deleted. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or unused invoice item category. Requires Admin or Project Manager permissions.

tools.name: Delete Invoice Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a message from an invoice. Use when you need to remove a specific message that is no longer relevant. Call after confirming the invoice_id and message_id.

tools.name: Delete Invoice Payment
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice payment. Use when you need to remove a payment from an invoice after confirming payment details.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project. Use when you need to remove a project and all its associated time entries and expenses; invoices remain intact. Call after confirming the project_id exists.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a task. Use when you need to remove a task that has no associated time entries. Call after confirming the task_id exists and has no dependent time entries.

tools.name: Delete Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a time entry. Use when removing an existing time entry that is deletable (not closed or on archived projects/tasks). Call after confirming the time_entry_id exists.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user. Use when you need to remove a user that has no associated time entries or expenses. Call after confirming the user_id exists and has no dependent time entries or expenses.

tools.name: Get Client
tools.description: Retrieves a specific client by ID from Harvest. Use this to get detailed information about a client including their name, active status, address, currency, and timestamps. Returns complete client details needed for invoicing, reporting, or verifying client information.

tools.name: Get Company Info
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about the company associated with the authenticated Harvest account. This endpoint returns comprehensive company settings including: - Basic information (name, domain, active status) - Time tracking preferences (format, week start day, timer type) - Localization settings (date/time format, currency, separators) - Feature flags (expenses, invoices, estimates, approvals, team scheduling) - Weekly capacity and other operational settings No parameters required. Use this to understand company configuration before performing other operations.

tools.name: Get Estimate
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific estimate by ID. Use after confirming the estimate ID. Example: "Get estimate with ID 123456".

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific invoice by ID. Use when you need the full details of an invoice after selecting or creating it. Example: 'Get invoice with ID 13150378.'

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific Harvest project by ID. Use when you have a project ID and need its details.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific task by ID. Use when you have a task ID and need its detailed information.

tools.name: Get Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single time entry by ID. Use when you have a specific time entry ID and need its full details.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific user by ID. Use after obtaining a valid user ID (for example via List Users). Example: "Get details of user 3230547".

tools.name: List Client Contacts
tools.description: Tool to list client contacts. Use when you need to retrieve contacts with optional filtering and pagination.

tools.name: List Clients
tools.description: Tool to list clients. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of clients from Harvest. Ensure you have a valid access token in metadata before calling.

tools.name: List Estimate Messages
tools.description: Lists all messages associated with a specific estimate in Harvest. Returns messages sorted by creation date (most recent first). Use this tool when you need to: - View communication history for an estimate - Check what messages have been sent to clients regarding an estimate - Track events that occurred on an estimate (send, accept, decline, re-open) - Filter messages by update time to find recent communications Requires a valid estimate_id. Supports pagination via per_page parameter (default 2000, max 2000).

tools.name: List Expense Categories
tools.description: Tool to list expense categories. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of expense categories, optionally filtering by active status or last update timestamp.

tools.name: List Invoice Item Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve invoice item categories. Use when you need to fetch a paginated list of invoice item categories in Harvest.

tools.name: List Invoice Messages
tools.description: Tool to list messages associated with a given invoice. Use when you need to retrieve invoice messages with optional filtering by update time and pagination.

tools.name: List Invoice Payments
tools.description: List all payments recorded for a specific invoice. Returns payment details including amounts, dates, payment gateway information, and who recorded each payment. Supports filtering by updated_since date and pagination. Returns an empty list if the invoice has no payments.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to list invoices. Use when you need to retrieve invoices filtered by client, project, date range, or state. Example: 'List invoices for client 5735776 from 2023-01-01 to 2023-01-31.'

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of projects from Harvest. Ensure a valid access token is present in metadata before calling. Results span multiple pages; check total_pages in the response and increment page to retrieve all projects. Large result sets may be returned as remote files rather than inline JSON; use structure_info to parse the response correctly.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list tasks. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of tasks from Harvest. Ensure you have a valid access token in metadata before calling. Response includes `total_pages` to iterate all pages when task count exceeds `per_page`.

tools.name: List Time Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of time entries. Use when you need to fetch tracked hours with filters or date ranges for reporting or invoicing. Example: "List time entries for project 123 between 2023-01-01 and 2023-01-31".

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to list users. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated list of users from Harvest.

tools.name: Update Client
tools.description: Tool to update an existing client. Use after retrieving client details to modify its properties. Supports partial updates; omit fields to leave them unchanged.

tools.name: Update Client Contact
tools.description: Tool to update a client contact. Use when you have a contact_id and need to modify its details.

tools.name: Update Company Info
tools.description: Updates company time tracking settings in Harvest. This endpoint allows modification of two company settings: 1. wants_timestamp_timers - Controls whether time is tracked via duration or start/end times 2. weekly_capacity - Sets the expected working hours per week (in seconds) Returns the complete updated company object. Requires admin permissions. Note: Other company settings (name, timezone, currency, date/time formats, color scheme, etc.) cannot be modified via the API and must be changed through the Harvest web interface.

tools.name: Update Estimate
tools.description: Tool to update an existing estimate. Use when you need to modify specific fields of an estimate; omit parameters to leave other fields unchanged.

tools.name: Update Estimate Item Category
tools.description: Updates an existing estimate item category's name in Harvest. Estimate item categories are used to organize line items within estimates. Provide the category ID and the new name you want to set.

tools.name: Update Expense
tools.description: Tool to update an existing expense. Use after retrieving an expense to modify project, category, date, cost, or delete a receipt; omit fields to leave unchanged.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Tool to update an existing invoice. Use after retrieving invoice details to modify its fields. Supports partial updates; omit fields to leave unchanged.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing project. Use when you need to modify one or more fields of a project by its ID. Invoke after confirming the project ID and desired changes.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task. Use after retrieving task details to modify its attributes such as name, billing defaults, or status. Supports partial updates; omit fields to leave them unchanged.

tools.name: Update Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing time entry. Use after retrieving the entry to adjust hours, notes, project, or task details. Supports partial updates; omit fields to leave unchanged.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user. Use when you need to modify a user's profile or settings after confirming the user ID.

name: WakaTime
description: WakaTime offers automatic time tracking for developers, integrating with code editors and delivering dashboards on coding activity, project progress, and productivity

tools.name: Get Aggregate Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve aggregate coding statistics across all WakaTime users for a given time range. Use when analyzing global trends in programming languages, editors, operating systems, and categories.

tools.name: Get current user's status bar summary for today
tools.description: Tool to get current user's coding activity today for displaying in IDE status bars. Use when you need a summary of today's coding time broken down by projects, languages, editors, etc.

tools.name: List IDE Plugins
tools.description: Tool to list WakaTime IDE plugins with metadata. Use when you want to discover available IDE integrations and their latest versions.

tools.name: List Goals
tools.description: Tool to list a user's goals with progress series and metadata. Use after authenticating the user with read_goals scope.

tools.name: Get User Insight
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an insight for a user over a time range. Use when analyzing user coding metrics after authentication.

tools.name: List Leaders
tools.description: Tool to list public leaders ranked by coding activity. Use when viewing top coders globally or filtering by language, country code, or hireable status.

tools.name: List Machine Names
tools.description: Tool to list a user's machines including last seen time. Use when needing machine names for a specific user.

tools.name: Get API Meta Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve WakaTime API meta information, including public IP addresses used by WakaTime servers. Use when you need to know WakaTime's infrastructure details for network configuration or security purposes.

tools.name: Generate WakaTime OAuth authorize URL
tools.description: Tool to generate OAuth 2.0 authorization URL. Use when redirecting users to WakaTime to grant access.

tools.name: Get User Details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed profile information for a WakaTime user by user ID or username. Use 'current' as the user parameter to get the authenticated user's details. Returns comprehensive profile data including display name, email, timezone, plan, and privacy settings.

tools.name: Get User's Total Time Since Creation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve total coding time since account creation for a user. Use after authenticating to fetch all-time stats.

tools.name: Get User Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve coding statistics for a user over the default time range. Returns comprehensive metrics including languages, editors, projects, and daily averages. Use when analyzing a user's coding patterns and productivity metrics.

tools.name: Get User Stats by Range
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive coding statistics for a user over a specific time range. Returns breakdowns by language, editor, project, OS, and more, along with daily averages and best day. Use when analyzing productivity patterns or generating coding activity reports for time periods.

tools.name: Get User Summaries
tools.description: Get user's coding activity for a time range as daily summaries. Returns detailed breakdowns by projects, languages, editors, and more for each day. Use when you need to analyze coding patterns, track project time, or generate activity reports over a date range. Requires 'read_summaries' scope.

tools.name: List Program Languages
tools.description: Tool to list all verified program languages supported by WakaTime. Use when you need to discover available programming languages tracked by WakaTime.

tools.name: List User Projects
tools.description: List WakaTime projects for a specified user. Returns project names, IDs, creation dates, and last activity times. Use to discover available projects for any user before querying project-specific stats.

tools.name: List User Agents
tools.description: Tool to list plugins and editors which have sent data for a specified user. Use when needing to discover which development environments and tools a user is actively using.

name: Xero
description: Xero is a cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, providing invoicing, bank reconciliation, bookkeeping, and financial reporting in real time

tools.name: Allocate Overpayment
tools.description: Allocate part of an existing Xero overpayment to an invoice.

tools.name: Bulk Create Bank Transactions
tools.description: Create multiple Xero bank transactions with item-level validation results.

tools.name: Bulk Create Invoices
tools.description: Create multiple Xero invoices or bills. With summarize_errors false (the default), return each success and validation outcome.

tools.name: Create Bank Transaction
tools.description: Create a bank transaction in Xero. Use SPEND for payments out or RECEIVE for money received.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in Xero. Contacts can be customers, suppliers, or both.

tools.name: Create Credit Note
tools.description: Create a new credit note in Xero. Credit notes are used to reduce amounts owed by customers (ACCRECCREDIT) or to suppliers (ACCPAYCREDIT).

tools.name: Create File Association
tools.description: Associate a Xero file with an accounting object.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Create a new invoice in Xero. Supports both sales invoices (ACCREC) and bills (ACCPAY).

tools.name: Create Item
tools.description: Create an inventory item in Xero. Items can be tracked for sales and/or purchases.

tools.name: Create Manual Journal
tools.description: Create one or more manual journals (journal entries) in Xero with journal lines. Manual journals must balance (debits equal credits).

tools.name: Create or Update Account
tools.description: Create a Xero chart-of-account record, or update one by account ID.

tools.name: Create Payment
tools.description: Create a payment in Xero to link an invoice with a bank account transaction.

tools.name: Create Purchase Order
tools.description: Create a purchase order in Xero to order goods/services from suppliers.

tools.name: Create Quote
tools.description: Create a new sales quote in Xero for a customer or prospect. Quotes can be sent to contacts for approval and later converted to invoices. Use this action when you need to create a formal price proposal or quotation for goods or services before issuing an invoice.

tools.name: Create Tracking Option
tools.description: Add an option to an existing Xero tracking category.

tools.name: Delete Item
tools.description: Permanently delete a Xero inventory item by its internal UUID.

tools.name: Download Attachment
tools.description: Download an attachment from a supported Xero accounting entity.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Retrieve a specific account from Xero's chart of accounts by its unique ID. Returns detailed account information including code, name, type (BANK, REVENUE, EXPENSE, etc.), status (ACTIVE/ARCHIVED), tax settings, bank details (for BANK accounts), and classification. Use XERO_LIST_ACCOUNTS to get account IDs if you don't already have one.

tools.name: Get Asset
tools.description: Retrieve a specific asset by ID from Xero. Returns depreciation details and book value.

tools.name: Get Balance Sheet Report
tools.description: Retrieve Balance Sheet report from Xero. Shows assets, liabilities, and equity at a specific date. Liability and credit balances appear as negative numbers in the response. Response structure is Reports → Rows → Sections; account lines are nested inside group sections and summary totals (e.g., 'Total Current Assets') appear in SummaryRows.

tools.name: Get Bank Summary Report
tools.description: Retrieve Xero's account-level Bank Summary for an optional date range.

tools.name: Get Bank Transaction
tools.description: Retrieve a specific spent or received money transaction from Xero by its unique bank transaction ID. Returns full transaction details including line items, contact, bank account, amounts, and reconciliation status. Use this action when you need to fetch the details of a specific bank transaction that was previously created.

tools.name: Get Budget
tools.description: Retrieve a budget from Xero. Budgets track planned vs actual spending by account.

tools.name: Get Connections
tools.description: Tool to list active Xero connections. Use to retrieve all current tenant connections for the authenticated user and resolve the correct tenant_id before making data requests. When multiple tenants are returned, never assume the first connection is correct — always explicitly pass the intended tenant_id to every subsequent call. Using a wrong or stale tenant_id can silently return or modify data for a different organisation.

tools.name: Get Contact Aged Report
tools.description: Retrieve aged payables or receivables rows for one Xero contact.

tools.name: Get Contact History
tools.description: Retrieve activity history records for a Xero contact.

tools.name: Get Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of contacts. Use when you need up-to-date contact information with filtering, paging, or incremental updates.

tools.name: Get Credit Note
tools.description: Retrieve a specific credit note by ID from Xero. Returns full credit note details including line items, allocations, and status. Use this action when you need to fetch detailed information about a single credit note by its UUID identifier.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a specific invoice by ID from Xero. Returns full invoice details including line items and status.

tools.name: Get Item
tools.description: Retrieve a specific item by ID from Xero. Returns item code, name, pricing, and tax details.

tools.name: Get Manual Journal
tools.description: Retrieve a specific manual journal by ID from Xero. Returns full details including journal lines.

tools.name: Get Online Invoice
tools.description: Retrieve the hosted online-invoice URL for an authorised Xero invoice.

tools.name: Get Organisation
tools.description: Retrieve organisation details from Xero. Returns company info, base currency, timezone, financial year settings, SalesTaxBasis, SalesTaxPeriod, etc. Response fields are nested under data.data.Organisations[0]. Use Timezone when computing date ranges to avoid boundary errors.

tools.name: Get Payment
tools.description: Retrieve a specific payment by ID from Xero. Returns full payment details including associated invoice, account, and reconciliation status. Use this action when you need to inspect a particular payment record to verify its status, amount, or linked transactions.

tools.name: Get Profit & Loss Report
tools.description: Retrieve Profit & Loss report from Xero. Shows income, expenses, and net profit for a specified period. Response rows are labeled (e.g., 'Net Profit', SummaryRow); parse by row label, not array index. Aggregates multiple tax codes — not suitable for tax compliance reporting.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieve a specific project by ID from Xero. Returns project details, deadlines, and status.

tools.name: Get Purchase Order
tools.description: Retrieve a specific purchase order by ID from Xero. Returns full details including line items and status.

tools.name: Get Quotes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of quotes. Use when you need to list, filter, or page through sales quotes. Use after obtaining the tenant ID via connections.

tools.name: Get Record History
tools.description: Retrieve history for a Xero bank transaction, invoice, manual journal, or payment.

tools.name: Get Repeating Invoice
tools.description: Retrieve a Xero repeating invoice template by its unique ID.

tools.name: Get Trial Balance Report
tools.description: Retrieve Trial Balance report from Xero. Shows all account balances (debits and credits) at a specific date. Use to verify that total debits equal total credits and to prepare financial statements. Credit balances appear as negative numbers in the response.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: Retrieve chart of accounts from Xero. Returns all accounting codes used for categorizing transactions. Use AccountID (not name or code) as the unique identifier for accounts. Results may be paginated; increment the page parameter until empty results are returned to avoid missing accounts in large organisations.

tools.name: List Advance Payments
tools.description: List filtered Xero overpayments or prepayments.

tools.name: List Assets
tools.description: Retrieve fixed assets from Xero. Assets track depreciation and book value of capital equipment.

tools.name: List Attachments
tools.description: List all attachments for a specific entity in Xero (invoice, contact, etc.).

tools.name: List Bank Transactions
tools.description: Retrieve bank transactions from Xero. Includes SPEND, RECEIVE, and transfer types; unfiltered results include DELETED transactions that skew totals. Dates returned in /Date(milliseconds_since_epoch)/ format. Rate limit: ~60 requests/minute per org; heavy pagination may trigger 429 errors.

tools.name: List Batch Payments
tools.description: List Xero batch payments with documented filtering and ordering controls.

tools.name: List Credit Notes
tools.description: Retrieve list of credit notes from Xero. Credit notes are issued to reduce amounts owed by customers.

tools.name: List Organisation Currencies
tools.description: List currencies enabled for the connected Xero organisation.

tools.name: List File Associations
tools.description: List Xero business objects associated with a specific file.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Retrieve files from Xero Files. Lists documents stored in Xero's file management system.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: Retrieve folders from Xero Files. Lists document folders in Xero's file management system.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Retrieve a list of invoices from Xero. Results include both sales invoices (Type=ACCREC) and bills (Type=ACCPAY) by default; filter by Type in the `where` clause when only one is needed. Supports filtering by status, contact, date range, and pagination.

tools.name: List Items
tools.description: Retrieve items (inventory/products) from Xero. Items can be tracked for sales and/or purchases.

tools.name: List Journals
tools.description: Retrieve journals from Xero. Journals show the accounting entries for all transactions. Omitting filters returns the full historical journal ledger and can produce very large responses — use If-Modified-Since and/or paymentsOnly to narrow scope. No date range filter parameter exists. Results are returned inside a Journals array field.

tools.name: List Manual Journals
tools.description: Retrieve manual journals from Xero. Manual journals are used for period-end adjustments and corrections.

tools.name: List Payments
tools.description: Retrieve list of payments from Xero. Payments link invoices to bank transactions; invoices may have multiple partial/split payment records. Response Date fields use Xero's /Date(milliseconds)/ format requiring custom parsing.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Retrieve projects from Xero. Projects track time and costs for client work.

tools.name: List Project Time Entries
tools.description: List and filter time entries logged against a specific Xero project.

tools.name: List Purchase Orders
tools.description: Retrieve list of purchase orders from Xero. Purchase orders track goods/services ordered from suppliers.

tools.name: List Quotes
tools.description: Retrieve a list of sales quotes from Xero with optional filtering and pagination. Supports filtering by date ranges, contact, status, and quote number. Returns up to 100 quotes per page with full line item details. Use this action when you need to query, list, or search for quotes in a Xero organization.

tools.name: List Tax Rates
tools.description: Retrieve tax rates from Xero. Shows available tax codes and rates for the organization. Use returned tax codes as valid `TaxType` values in other tools — invalid values cause ValidationException errors.

tools.name: List Tracking Categories
tools.description: Retrieve tracking categories from Xero. Tracking categories are used to segment data for reporting (e.g., departments, regions).

tools.name: List Organisation Users
tools.description: List users of the connected Xero organisation.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Tool to update an existing invoice. Use when you need to modify the details of an invoice after it's been created.

tools.name: Update Bank Transaction
tools.description: Update an existing bank transaction in Xero. Use this action when you need to modify details of a previously created bank transaction such as line items, reference, date, or status. Note: Reconciled transactions cannot be updated and will return a validation error.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update an existing contact in Xero. Only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update Credit Note
tools.description: Updates a specific credit note in Xero by its unique identifier. This action allows you to modify credit note details such as status, line items, reference numbers, and other fields after the credit note has been created. Use this action when you need to change the status of a credit note (e.g., from DRAFT to AUTHORISED), update line items, modify reference information, or make other changes to an existing credit note. The credit note must already exist in Xero - use the credit_note_id to specify which credit note to update. Not all fields can be updated depending on the current status of the credit note.

tools.name: Update Item
tools.description: Update an existing Xero inventory item by its ItemID.

tools.name: Update Manual Journal
tools.description: Update an existing manual journal (journal entry) in Xero by its ID. Use this action when you need to modify the narration, date, journal lines, status, or other properties of an existing manual journal. Manual journals must balance (debits equal credits) or the update will fail. Only DRAFT manual journals can have their journal lines updated; POSTED journals can have limited fields updated.

tools.name: Update Purchase Order
tools.description: Updates a specific purchase order in Xero by its unique identifier. Use this action when you need to modify an existing purchase order's details such as line items, delivery information, status, or other fields. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated; fields not included will remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Quote
tools.description: Updates a specific quote in Xero by its QuoteID. Use this action when you need to modify an existing sales quote, such as changing its status, updating line items, contact details, dates, or other quote properties. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated - unprovided fields will remain unchanged.

tools.name: Upload Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file attachment to a Xero entity (invoice, contact, etc.). Supports PDF, images, and documents.

tools.name: Validate Credential
tools.description: Validate Xero API credentials by testing access to connected organisations. Returns success status and a message indicating whether authentication is working. Use this action when you need to verify that Xero API credentials are valid and properly configured before attempting other operations. This is particularly useful for troubleshooting authentication issues or confirming a new connection is operational.

tools.name: List Brands
tools.description: Tool to list all brands in the account. Use after confirming account is authenticated.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a brand-scoped custom field. Use when you need to define and register a new custom field for a specific brand.

tools.name: Edit Custom Field

tools.name: List Behalf Documents

tools.name: Edit Document (Beta)
