tools.name: Update a derived metric
tools.description: Update a derived metric. Uses PUT /api/v2/metrics/derived-metrics/{metric_name}. Supply the documented payload in body; body.data.id must match metric_name. Datadog permission(s): metric_tags_write.

tools.name: Update a downtime
tools.description: Update a downtime. Uses PATCH /api/v2/downtime/{downtime_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): monitors_downtime.

tools.name: Update On-Call escalation policy
tools.description: Updates a Datadog On-Call escalation policy by ID.

tools.name: Update host tags

tools.name: Edit metric metadata
tools.description: Edit metric metadata. Uses PUT /api/v1/metrics/{metric_name}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): metrics_metadata_write.

tools.name: Edit a mobile test
tools.description: Edit a mobile test. Uses PUT /api/v1/synthetics/tests/mobile/{public_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): synthetics_write.

tools.name: Update monitor
tools.description: Updates an existing Datadog monitor with new configuration, thresholds, or notification settings. Only specified fields will be updated.

tools.name: Edit a monitor configuration policy
tools.description: Edit a monitor configuration policy. Uses PATCH /api/v2/monitor/policy/{policy_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): monitor_config_policy_write.

tools.name: Update a monitor notification rule
tools.description: Update a monitor notification rule. Uses PATCH /api/v2/monitor/notification_rule/{rule_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): monitor_config_policy_write.

tools.name: Update a notebook
tools.description: Update a notebook. Uses PUT /api/v1/notebooks/{notebook_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): notebooks_write.

tools.name: Update On-Call notification rule

tools.name: Edit a private location

tools.name: Update a shared dashboard
tools.description: Update a shared dashboard. Uses PUT /api/v1/dashboard/public/{token}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): dashboards_public_share, dashboards_embed_share, dashboards_invite_share.

tools.description: Updates a Datadog On-Call schedule by ID.

tools.name: Update an SLO

tools.name: Update a Synthetics downtime
tools.description: Update a Synthetics downtime. Uses PUT /api/v2/synthetics/downtimes/{downtime_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): synthetics_write, synthetics_default_settings_write.

tools.name: Edit a Network Path test
tools.description: Edit a Network Path test. Uses PUT /api/v2/synthetics/tests/network/{public_id}. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): synthetics_write, synthetics_create_edit_trigger.

tools.name: Update a tag configuration
tools.description: Update a tag configuration. Uses PATCH /api/v2/metrics/{metric_name}/tags. Supply the documented payload in body. Datadog permission(s): metric_tags_write.

name: Echtpost

tools.name: List templates
tools.description: This tool retrieves a list of all available templates in the Echtpost account. Templates serve as the base design for postcards and are essential for creating cards. The action operates independently using only an authentication token and returns detailed template information including id, name, description, preview URL, type, and creation time. This action is crucial for viewing templates before creating cards and obtaining the necessary template IDs for subsequent actions.

required.description: API key for EchtPost. Generate one at www.echtpost.de.

name: 0CodeKit
description: 0CodeKit provides utility APIs for AI, document and image processing, data conversion, validation, generation, storage, and automation workflows.

tools.name: Calculate BMI
tools.description: Calculate body mass index and the provider's related desirable-weight, daily-energy, and nutrient estimates from weight in kilograms and height in centimeters. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Check Weekend
tools.description: Determine whether a date is a weekend and return its weekday name and day number. The verified contract accepts a date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Convert Nation and ISO Code
tools.description: Convert either an English country name to its ISO code or an ISO code to its English country name. Provide exactly one input. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Find Keywords
tools.description: Search text for one or more keywords and report whether each occurs and the zero-based positions of matches. Supports case-sensitive matching and complete-word-only matching. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Get Remaining Credits
tools.description: Return the number of 0CodeKit credits remaining for the connected API key. Use this before credit-metered work to check available quota; credits are billing quota, not an HTTP rate limit.

tools.name: Hash Message
tools.description: Generate a cryptographic digest or HMAC for a text message using a supported algorithm. Supply secret_key only for an HMAC algorithm; this tool hashes data and does not encrypt it. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Parse UTM Parameters
tools.description: Extract standard UTM campaign parameters from a URL. Only parameters present in the URL are returned. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

tools.name: Validate Email
tools.description: Check an email address using 0CodeKit and return whether it is valid plus the provider's corrected-address value. Invalid addresses are normal successful results with valid=false. Each call consumes a 0CodeKit billing credit.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your 0CodeKit API key. After signing in at https://my.0codekit.com/, open the Account tab and copy the API key shown there. It is sent as the raw value of the auth header; keep it secret.

name: 21risk

tools.name: Get Items Per Month
tools.description: Tool to retrieve fact table data for ItemsPerMonth, one row per question per site per month. Use when querying monthly item data with OData parameters ($filter, $top, $skip, $select, maxPageSizeInMb).

tools.name: Get Organizations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organizations from the 21RISK OData API. Use when you need to list, filter, or paginate organizations via OData parameters after authentication is confirmed.

tools.name: Get Properties
tools.description: Tool to fetch a list of properties related to sites, including COPE information and other relevant data. Use when you need property insurance details via OData API after authentication.

tools.name: Get Reports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve audit reports, including draft, published, and scheduled reports. Use when you need a paginated list of reports with optional OData filtering.

tools.name: Get RiskModel Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve risk model categories for grouping questions and compliance checks. Use when you need to filter, select, or paginate risk model categories via OData parameters ($filter, $select, $orderby, $top, $skip, $count).

tools.name: Get Risk Models
tools.description: Tool to retrieve risk models used for audits and compliance. Use when you need to list available risk models with optional OData queries.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated from 21RISK's Account Settings.
