tools.name: Create Data Point
tools.description: Tool to create a custom data point for document extraction. Use when you need to define a new field that should be extracted from documents in a specific extractor. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional. Data points define custom fields for extraction models.

tools.name: Create Data Point Choice
tools.description: Tool to create a custom data point choice. Use when you need to add a new choice option for a specific data point in a collection or organization. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Create Data Source
tools.description: Tool to create a custom mapping data source. Use when you need to set up a new data source for mapping AI-extracted values to your database records.

tools.name: Create Data Source Value
tools.description: Tool to add a new value to a mapping data source. Use when you need to add entries to a data source for mapping or validation purposes. The created value can then be referenced in document extraction and mapping workflows.

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Upload a document to Affinda for parsing and data extraction. Use this action when you need to: - Parse resumes/CVs to extract candidate information - Process invoices to extract line items, amounts, and vendor details - Extract data from any supported document type (PDF, DOCX, images) You can upload either a file directly or provide a publicly accessible URL. The document will be processed by Affinda's AI extraction engine. Prerequisites: - For collection-based uploads: Get collection ID from get_collections action - For workspace-specific uploads: Get workspace ID from get_workspaces action

tools.name: Create Document Type
tools.description: Tool to create a new document type in the specified organization. Use when you need to define a new category of documents for processing. Document types allow you to organize and categorize documents within an organization.

tools.name: Create Extractor
tools.description: Tool to create a new extractor. Use when you need to define a custom document parser with specific fields and extraction rules, typically derived from a base extractor.

tools.name: Create Document from Data
tools.description: Create a document from structured resume or job description data for Search & Match. Use this when you have structured data to create a document programmatically without file uploads. Returns an identifier for subsequent status checks via /documents/{identifier}.

tools.name: Create Index
tools.description: Tool to create a new index for search and match functionality. Use when you need to set up a new index for organizing and searching documents like resumes or job descriptions.

tools.name: Create Invitation
tools.description: Tool to create a new organization invitation. Use when you need to invite a user to join an organization with a specific role.

tools.name: Create Job Description Search
tools.description: Search through parsed job descriptions using custom criteria or resume matching. Use this action when you need to find job postings that match specific requirements such as skills, experience, location, education, or to find jobs matching a candidate's resume. Returns ranked results with detailed match scores.

tools.name: Create Job Description Search Embed URL
tools.description: Tool to create and return a signed URL for the embeddable job description search tool. Use this when you need to generate a URL that can be embedded on a web page to provide job description search functionality. Optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme.

tools.name: Create Mapping
tools.description: Tool to create a custom mapping for a data source. Use when you need to configure specific lookup settings for a MappingDataSource. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Create Organization
tools.description: Tool to create a new organization. Use when you have a unique organization name and want to group resources under it.

tools.name: Create RESTHook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a new RESTHook subscription. Use after confirming your webhook endpoint is ready to receive document event notifications.

tools.name: Create Resume Search
tools.description: Tool to search through parsed resumes using three methods: match to a job description, match to a resume, or custom criteria. Use when you need to find candidates matching specific requirements.

tools.name: Create Resume Search Embed URL
tools.description: Tool to create and return a signed URL for the embeddable resume search tool. Use this when you need to generate a URL that can be embedded on a web page to provide resume search functionality. Optionally pass config_override to customize display settings, field weights, and theme.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Creates a new tag in the specified workspace. Tags can be used to categorize and label documents for organization and filtering. Each tag name must be unique within its workspace. Returns the created tag with its ID and metadata.

tools.name: Create Validation Result
tools.description: Create a validation result for document annotations in Affinda. Use this tool to record validation outcomes after parsing a document. Validation results track whether specific annotations (extracted data fields) pass or fail business rules. Prerequisites: 1. Get a document identifier from Get Documents or Create Document 2. Get annotation IDs from Get Annotations for that document 3. Define a kebab-case rule slug that identifies your validation rule Example use cases: - Recording that an invoice total matches the sum of line items - Marking that a required field is present and valid - Logging validation failures for review workflows

tools.name: Batch Create Validation Results
tools.description: Batch create multiple validation results for document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently record validation outcomes for multiple documents or rules at once, rather than making individual create requests for each validation result. This is particularly useful for bulk validation workflows or when validating multiple rules across many documents. Prerequisites: - Obtain document identifiers from Get Documents or Create Document actions - Get annotation IDs from Get Annotations for those documents - Define kebab-case rule slugs that identify your validation rules Common use cases: - Bulk recording of validation results across multiple documents - Validating multiple business rules on the same document - Automated validation workflows for large document batches

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace. Use when you need to programmatically create a workspace container within an organization.

tools.name: Create Workspace Membership
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a workspace by creating a membership. Use when you need to grant a user access to a specific workspace.

tools.name: Batch Delete Annotations
tools.description: Batch delete multiple document annotations in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently remove multiple annotations at once rather than making individual delete requests for each annotation. Prerequisites: - Obtain annotation IDs using the 'Get Annotations' action with a document filter - Annotations must exist in documents that have been processed by Affinda Common use cases: - Removing incorrect or unwanted annotations in bulk - Cleaning up annotations after document reprocessing - Deleting specific extracted data fields programmatically

tools.name: Delete Collection
tools.description: Permanently delete a collection from Affinda by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Collections first to verify the collection ID before deletion. Note: Documents in the collection may also be affected.

tools.name: Delete Data Point
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a data point by its identifier. Use when you need to remove a data point from the database after confirming the identifier. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Delete Data Source
tools.description: Permanently delete a mapping data source from the database by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove a data source that is no longer needed or was created in error.

tools.name: Delete Data Source Value
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific value from a mapping data source. Use when you need to remove an incorrect or outdated value from a data source mapping.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific document by its ID. Use when you need to remove a document that is incorrect or no longer needed, after confirming the document ID.

tools.name: Delete Document Type
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a document type by its identifier. Use when you need to remove a document type that is no longer needed. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Extractor
tools.description: Permanently delete an extractor from Affinda by its identifier. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Extractors first to verify the extractor ID before deletion. Note: This action is deprecated by the API.

tools.name: Delete Index
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete an index from Affinda by its name. Use when you need to remove an index that is no longer needed. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Invitation
tools.description: Tool to delete an invitation by its identifier. Use when you need to remove or revoke an invitation after confirming the invitation identifier.

tools.name: Delete Mapping
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific mapping by its identifier. Use when you need to remove an unused or incorrect mapping from the database. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Delete Organization
tools.description: Permanently deletes an organization from Affinda. This action is destructive and cannot be undone. All workspaces, collections, and documents associated with the organization will also be deleted. Use the get_organizations action first to confirm the organization identifier before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Resthook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific resthook subscription by ID. Use after confirming the subscription identifier when the webhook is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a tag from Affinda by its ID. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use Get Tags first to verify the tag ID before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Validation Results
tools.description: Delete multiple validation results in a single API call. Use this action to efficiently remove multiple validation results at once rather than making individual delete requests for each validation result. Prerequisites: - Obtain validation result IDs using the 'Get All Validation Results' action Common use cases: - Removing obsolete validation results in bulk - Cleaning up validation results after reprocessing documents - Deleting validation results for specific documents programmatically

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need to remove an unused workspace after confirming the workspace ID.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Membership
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a workspace by membership ID. Use after confirming the workspace membership ID to revoke access.

tools.name: Get All API Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all API users. Use when you need to list API users, optionally filtered by organization.

tools.name: Get All Document Splitters
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all document splitters. Use when you need to retrieve document splitters, optionally filtered by organization.

tools.name: Get All Invitations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all invitations you created or sent to you. Use when you need to list organization invitations with optional filtering by status, role, or organization.

tools.name: Get Organization Memberships
tools.description: Retrieve all organization memberships across the account. Returns paginated results showing which users belong to which organizations. Use to audit organization access or find specific user memberships.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Tool to list all tags. Use after confirming authentication to fetch tags across workspaces.

tools.name: Get All Validation Results
tools.description: Tool to list validation results for documents. Use after processing documents to inspect validation outcomes.

tools.name: Get Workspace Memberships
tools.description: Retrieve all workspace memberships across the account. Returns paginated results showing which users belong to which workspaces. Use to audit workspace access or find specific user memberships.

tools.name: Get Annotations
tools.description: Retrieves all annotations for a specific document. Annotations are extracted data fields (text, dates, numbers, tables, etc.) from parsed documents. Use this after a document has been processed to access the extracted data.

tools.name: Get Collection
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific collection by its ID. Use when you need full metadata about a collection after confirming its identifier.

tools.name: Get Collection Data Field
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data field configuration for a collection associated with a data point. Use when you need to understand the structure and validation rules of a specific field in a collection. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Get Collections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all collections. Use when you need to list collections in your Affinda workspace after authentication.

tools.name: Get Collection Usage
tools.description: Retrieves monthly credits consumption statistics for a specific collection. Returns a list of usage records showing how many credits were consumed each month. Use this to track collection activity, monitor consumption trends, or generate usage reports. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Get Data Point
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific data point by its identifier. Use when you need to inspect a data point's configuration, type, or structure. Data points represent individual fields that can be extracted from documents (e.g., 'name', 'email', 'date'). This endpoint is deprecated but still functional for retrieving data point metadata.

tools.name: Get Data Point Choice
tools.description: Tool to return a specific data point choice by its ID. Use when you need details about a particular data point choice option. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Get Data Source
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific mapping data source by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch mapping data source metadata and schema configuration.

tools.name: Get Data Source Value
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific value from a mapping data source. Use when you need to get details about a particular value in a data source.

tools.name: Get Data Source Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all values from a mapping data source. Use when you need to list or search values in a specific data source after authentication.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Retrieve full details and parsed data for a specific document by its identifier. Use this tool to get comprehensive information about a document including: - Processing status (ready/failed) - Document metadata (file name, page count, language) - Parsed/extracted data results - URLs for PDF, original file, and review page - Collection and workspace information The document identifier can be either a system-generated ID or a custom identifier set during document upload.

tools.name: Get Document Redacted
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the redacted version of a document as a PDF file. Use when you need to get a document with sensitive information removed. The original document is not modified by this operation.

tools.name: Get Documents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all documents. Use when you need to list documents in your Affinda workspace after authentication.

tools.name: Get Document Splitter
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific document splitter by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch metadata about a document splitter configuration.

tools.name: Get Document Type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific document type by its ID. Use when you need to confirm the configuration or metadata of a document type before processing documents.

tools.name: Get Document Type JSON Schema
tools.description: Tool to generate a JSON schema from a document type by its identifier. Use when you need the structured schema definition for a document type to understand its field structure and validation rules.

tools.name: Get Document Type Pydantic Models
tools.description: Tool to generate Pydantic model code from a document type's schema. Use when you need type-safe Python models for parsing documents of a specific type.

tools.name: Get Document Types
tools.description: Retrieve all document types accessible to the authenticated user. Returns a list containing each document type's identifier, name, description, ingest email, and organization. Use this to discover available document types before uploading or processing documents.

tools.name: Get Extractor
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific extractor by its identifier. Use when you need complete metadata about an extractor's configuration, fields, and capabilities.

tools.name: Get Extractors
tools.description: Retrieve all extractors available for an organization. Extractors are document parsing configurations that define what data to extract from documents. This includes both Affinda's built-in extractors (resumes, invoices, etc.) and any custom extractors created for the organization. Use this action to: - List available extractors before creating a collection - Find the identifier of a specific extractor type - Check if custom extractors exist for the organization

tools.name: Get Index Documents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all indexed documents for a specific index. Use when you need to list documents in a search index after creating or accessing an index.

tools.name: Get Invitation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization invitation by its identifier. Use when you need to check invitation status or get invitation metadata.

tools.name: Get Job Description Search Config
tools.description: Tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. Returns display settings, field weights, and maximum results limits.

tools.name: Get Mapping
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific mapping by its identifier. Use when you need to fetch mapping configuration details for a lookup against a MappingDataSource.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization by its ID. Use when you need to fetch an organization's metadata after confirming its identifier.

tools.name: Get Organization Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization membership by its ID. Use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within an organization.

tools.name: Get Organizations
tools.description: Retrieves all organizations accessible to the authenticated user. Returns a list of organizations with details including identifier, name, user role, trial status, and configuration settings. Use the 'identifier' field from the response when calling other organization-related endpoints.

tools.name: Get Resthook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific resthook subscription by its ID. Use after confirming its creation to verify its settings.

tools.name: Get RESTHook Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all RESTHook subscriptions. Use after authenticating to list all webhook subscriptions associated with your account.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific tag by its ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular tag.

tools.name: Get Usage by Workspace
tools.description: Retrieves monthly document processing usage statistics for a specific workspace. Returns a list of usage records showing how many documents were processed each month. Use this to track workspace activity, monitor consumption trends, or generate usage reports.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need full workspace metadata after confirming its identifier.

tools.name: Get Workspace Membership
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific workspace membership by its ID. Use when you need to confirm a user's role and details within a workspace after obtaining the membership identifier.

tools.name: Get Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all workspaces. Use when you need to list workspaces filtered by organization and optional name.

tools.name: List Data Point Choices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available choices for a specific enum data point. Use when you need to discover valid options for dropdown/enum fields in a collection's data schema. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional for accessing data point choice metadata.

tools.name: List Data Points
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all data points. Returns both custom data points and Affinda's off-the-shelf data points. Use when you need to list available data points for extractors.

tools.name: List Data Sources
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all custom mapping data sources. Use when you need to list or search for mapping data sources in your Affinda workspace.

tools.name: List Indexes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all search indexes. Use when you need to view available indexes for searching and matching documents in Affinda.

tools.name: List Mappings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all custom data mappings. Use when you need to list mappings for a specific data source.

tools.name: List Occupation Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of searchable occupation groups. Use when you need to get available occupation categories for job matching or classification.

tools.name: List Resume Search Config
tools.description: Tool to get the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. Use this to retrieve display field settings, search weights, maximum results, and theme customization options for the resume search interface.

tools.name: List Resume Search Job Title Suggestions
tools.description: Tool to get job title suggestions based on provided job title(s). Use when you need to find related job titles for resume search.

tools.name: List Resume Search Skill Suggestions
tools.description: Tool to get skill suggestions based on provided skills. Use when you need to find related skills to expand or refine resume search queries.

tools.name: Remove Tag from Documents
tools.description: Remove a tag from multiple documents in a single batch operation. Use this action to efficiently untag many documents at once rather than making individual remove requests. The operation is idempotent - removing a tag that isn't present on a document will not cause an error.

tools.name: Replace Data Point Choices
tools.description: Tool to completely replace all choices for a data point. Use when you need to bulk update enum options - existing choices are matched by value, new values are created, updated values are modified, and values not in the incoming list are deleted. Note: This is a deprecated endpoint but still functional. Either collection or organization must be specified to scope the replacement.

tools.name: Replace Data Source Values
tools.description: Tool to completely replace all values in a mapping data source. Use when you need to bulk update or refresh an entire data source's value list. Note: For large data sources (>1000 values), new values may take a few minutes to become searchable after the operation completes.

tools.name: Split Document Pages
tools.description: Split a document into multiple documents by dividing its pages. Use when you need to separate a multi-page document into distinct documents based on page groupings. Prerequisites: - Obtain the document identifier from create_document or get_document actions - Use get_document to retrieve page IDs for the pages you want to split Important notes: - Each page can only be assigned to one split - All pages should be accounted for across all splits - One split can optionally use the original document identifier to maintain the root document

tools.name: Update Annotation
tools.description: Tool to update data of a single annotation in Affinda. Use when you need to correct extracted values, verify annotations, or modify annotation metadata after document processing. Prerequisites: - Obtain the annotation ID using the 'Get Annotations' action with a document filter - Annotations must exist in documents that have been processed by Affinda Common use cases: - Correcting OCR or extraction errors in individual fields - Marking annotations as verified after manual review (set isClientVerified=true) - Updating parsed values to fix incorrect data extraction - Modifying annotation coordinates or page references Note: For bulk updates across multiple annotations, use the 'Batch Update Annotations' action instead for better efficiency.

tools.name: Update Collection
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields of a collection. Use when you need to rename or reassign a collection after creation.

tools.name: Update Data Field For Collection
tools.description: Tool to update a data field configuration for a collection's data point. Use when you need to modify field properties such as label, type, mandatory status, or validation settings after the field has been created.

tools.name: Update Data Point
tools.description: Tool to update data of a data point by its identifier. Use when you need to modify a data point's name, description, slug, parent, or mapping data source. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Update Data Point Choice
tools.description: Tool to update data of a data point choice by its ID. Use when you need to modify label, value, description, synonyms, or associated collection/organization for an existing data point choice. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Update Data Source Value
tools.description: Tool to update an existing value in a mapping data source. Use when you need to modify the label or description of an existing data source value. The value identifier itself cannot be changed.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields of a document. Use when you need to rename, reassign, or adjust expiry and storage settings after document creation.

tools.name: Update Document Data
tools.description: Update parsed data for a resume or job description document in Affinda. This endpoint is ONLY applicable for documents that have been processed with 'resume' or 'job-description' extractors. For other document types, use the batch_update_annotations endpoint instead. Use this tool when you need to correct or add parsed fields to an existing resume or job description document after it has been uploaded and processed.

tools.name: Update Document Type
tools.description: Tool to update a document type by its identifier. Use when you need to modify the name or description of an existing document type.

tools.name: Update Extractor
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields of an extractor. Use when you need to modify an extractor's name, category, validation settings, or field groups after creation.

tools.name: Update Index
tools.description: Tool to update the name of an existing search index. Use when you need to rename an index after creation.

tools.name: Update Invitation
tools.description: Tool to update an organization invitation's role. Use when you need to change the role assigned to an invitation before it is accepted.

tools.name: Update Job Description Search Config
tools.description: Tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable job description search tool. Use to configure display fields, field weights, maximum results, and UI customization options.

tools.name: Update Mapping
tools.description: Tool to update a specific mapping's settings. Use when you need to adjust score cutoff or ordering for a lookup against a MappingDataSource.

tools.name: Update Organization
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields of an organization. Use when you need to modify an organization's name, avatar, or webhook and validation settings after creation.

tools.name: Update Organization Membership
tools.description: Tool to update an organization membership's role. Use when you need to change a user's role within an organization.

tools.name: Update RESTHook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to update an existing RESTHook subscription. Use after confirming the subscription identifier to modify its URL, event, or activation status.

tools.name: Update Resume Search Config
tools.description: Tool to update the configuration for the logged in user's embeddable resume search tool. Use this to modify which fields are displayed, their search weights, maximum results limit, distance units, custom actions, and theme settings.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update data of a tag. Use when you need to modify a tag's name or reassign it to a different workspace. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update specific fields of a workspace. Use when you need to modify a workspace's name, visibility, document rejection policy, or other settings. Only provide the fields you want to change; other fields will remain unchanged.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the Affinda API.

required.name: workspace_id
required.description: The identifier of the workspace within which the API operations are performed.

name: Agent Mail
description: AgentMail provides programmable email inboxes, messages, drafts, domains, webhooks, and related infrastructure for AI agents.

tools.name: Batch Get Messages
tools.description: Return metadata for up to 500 messages from one inbox in a single request. Compare count with limit to detect missing or restricted IDs. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Batch Update Message Labels
tools.description: Atomically add or remove the same labels on up to 50 messages in one inbox. Missing or restricted message IDs are omitted from the result. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Complete File Upload
tools.description: Mark a pending Agent Drive file ready after its bytes have been PUT to the presigned URL returned by CREATE_FILE. AgentMail verifies the exact declared size and SHA-256; calling this before a successful upload returns a conflict. Only a key with file_read or the key that created the file can complete it. Agent Drive is a US-production-only Labs feature.

tools.name: Create Agent Armor Feedback
tools.description: Record whether Agent Armor's completed verdict on a message was correct. A message accepts up to 20 feedback records.

tools.name: Create Calendar Event
tools.description: Create a one-off or recurring event on a US-only inbox calendar. client_id makes retries safe; send_invites emails attendees and consumes send limits.

tools.name: Create Draft
tools.description: Create a draft, optionally scheduling its automatic delivery with send_at.

tools.name: Create File
tools.description: Initialize a pending Agent Drive file and return instructions for a direct storage upload. This does not upload bytes: PUT the exact bytes to the credential-sensitive presigned URL with every returned header unchanged and without the AgentMail API key, then call COMPLETE_FILE_UPLOAD. Identical requests are retry-safe. Pending files consume Drive quota immediately and expire after one day if incomplete; call DELETE_FILE when abandoning an upload. Agent Drive is a US-production-only Labs feature.

tools.name: Create Inbox
tools.description: Create a new AgentMail inbox via API. Returns the inbox_id and email address for sending/receiving messages. Use when provisioning new inboxes for agents or workflows.

tools.name: Create Inbox API Key
tools.description: Create an inbox-scoped bearer key and return its one-time secret. Omitting permissions grants all permissions available within the inbox scope.

tools.name: Create Inbox in Pod
tools.description: Create an inbox inside an explicitly selected AgentMail pod, optionally choosing its address, initial status, idempotency ID, and metadata.

tools.name: Create Inbox Polling Webhook
tools.description: Create or resume a polling webhook scoped to one inbox. The inbox comes from the path, so organization selector lists are not accepted. AgentMail's polling guide currently says polling is US-only even though the API reference lists an EU server; follow the guide and do not assume EU support. The response contains a one-time credential-sensitive polling token; store it securely and never log or expose it.

tools.name: Create Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Create a regular webhook scoped to one AgentMail inbox for a non-empty set of event types. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Create Allowlist or Blocklist Entry
tools.description: Add an email address or domain to an organization-wide send, receive, or reply allowlist or blocklist.

tools.name: Create Pod
tools.description: Create an AgentMail pod for grouping inboxes and related resources.

tools.name: Create Polling Webhook
tools.description: Create or resume an organization-level polling webhook for a non-empty set of event types, optionally filtered to at most 10 inboxes and pods combined. Current provider polling support is US-only (api.agentmail.to); do not use this action with an EU connection. The response contains a one-time, credential-sensitive polling token; store it securely and never log or expose it.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create an organization-level webhook for a non-empty set of event types, optionally filtered to at most 10 inboxes and pods combined. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Delete Calendar Event
tools.description: Accept asynchronous deletion of a US-only calendar event or cancel recurring dates. If-Match guards the version and Idempotency-Key makes retries deterministic.

tools.name: Delete Draft
tools.description: Permanently delete one unsent draft from an inbox.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete a pending or ready Agent Drive file and free its path. A previously issued presigned download URL can remain valid until its expiry. Requires file_delete, and only a key with file_read or the key that created the file can delete it. Agent Drive is a US-production-only Labs feature.

tools.name: Delete Inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete one inbox by ID. AgentMail accepts the deletion asynchronously, so acceptance does not guarantee immediate completion.

tools.name: Delete Inbox Polling Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbox-scoped polling webhook by webhook_id or client_id, invalidate its polling token, and free its subscription slot. AgentMail's polling guide currently says polling is US-only even though the API reference lists an EU server; follow the guide and do not assume EU support.

tools.name: Delete Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a regular webhook created for a selected AgentMail inbox and stop future deliveries.

tools.name: Delete Allowlist or Blocklist Entry
tools.description: Remove one email address or domain from an organization-wide send, receive, or reply allowlist or blocklist.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Permanently delete one message from an inbox. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Delete Pod
tools.description: Permanently delete one AgentMail pod by its unique ID.

tools.name: Delete Pod Inbox
tools.description: Permanently delete an inbox through its explicitly selected AgentMail pod, preserving the pod tenant boundary. A 202 response means deletion continues asynchronously; poll GET_POD_INBOX until it returns 404.

tools.name: Delete Polling Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete an organization-level polling webhook by webhook_id or client_id, invalidate its polling token, and free its subscription slot. Current provider polling support is US-only (api.agentmail.to); do not use this action with an EU connection.

tools.name: Delete Thread
tools.description: Permanently delete one AgentMail thread and all of its messages.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete an organization-level webhook and stop future deliveries.

tools.name: Forward Message
tools.description: Immediately forward an existing message to new recipients with optional added content and attachments. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Get Agenda
tools.description: Get one page of non-cancelled calendar dates in a UTC window, expanding recurring events and ordering dates by start time. Calendar is available only in US production.

tools.name: Get API Key
tools.description: Retrieve API-key metadata without exposing bearer secret values.

tools.name: Get Calendar
tools.description: Get an inbox's US-only calendar settings, event count, and ETag. Use primary consistency to read a just-completed write.

tools.name: Get Calendar Event
tools.description: Get the full current form of a US-only calendar event or recurring-event date, including its opaque ETag for conditional mutations.

tools.name: Get Current Identity
tools.description: Return the connected AgentMail identity and its organization, pod, or inbox access boundary without exposing the credential itself.

tools.name: Get Domain
tools.description: Return an AgentMail custom domain, its domain and tracking verification statuses, and all required DNS records.

tools.name: Get Domain Setup Link
tools.description: Build a one-click Domain Connect DNS setup link when supported. The returned signed URL must be delivered privately to the intended domain owner. Retain the sensitive state ephemerally and compare it on redirect; do not log either value.

tools.name: Get Domain Zone File
tools.description: Download the AgentMail-generated DNS zone file for a custom domain as a bounded binary file reference.

tools.name: Get Draft
tools.description: Retrieve the complete contents and scheduling details of one draft.

tools.name: Get Draft Attachment
tools.description: Get a temporary download reference for one draft attachment.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Get Agent Drive file metadata. A ready file can include a credential-sensitive presigned download URL valid for up to one hour; treat it as a secret and never log or expose it. Requires file_read. Agent Drive is a US-production-only Labs feature.

tools.name: Get Inbox
tools.description: Retrieve one AgentMail inbox and its metadata by ID or email address.

tools.name: Get Inbox Polling Webhook
tools.description: Get one inbox-scoped polling webhook by webhook_id or client_id. AgentMail's polling guide currently says polling is US-only even though the API reference lists an EU server; follow the guide and do not assume EU support. The polling token is never returned; create again with the same client_id to issue a new token.

tools.name: Get Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Get one regular webhook created for a selected AgentMail inbox. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Get Inbox Webhook Headers
tools.description: List only the names of custom delivery headers on an inbox-scoped regular webhook. Header values are credential-sensitive, write-only, and never returned.

tools.name: Get Message
tools.description: Retrieve the complete details of a specific email message from an AgentMail inbox. This action returns the full message content including sender, recipients, subject, body (both text and HTML), attachments, labels, and metadata. Use this to read individual messages after discovering them via LIST_MESSAGES or webhooks.

tools.name: Get Message Attachment
tools.description: Get a temporary download reference for one message attachment. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Return the connected AgentMail organization's identifiers, current inbox and domain counts, configured resource limits, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Pod
tools.description: Retrieve one AgentMail pod by its unique ID.

tools.name: Get Pod Inbox
tools.description: Get an AgentMail inbox through an explicitly selected pod, preserving the pod tenant boundary.

tools.name: Get Polling Webhook
tools.description: Get one organization-level polling webhook by webhook_id or client_id. Current provider polling support is US-only (api.agentmail.to); do not use this action with an EU connection. The polling token is never returned; create again with the same client_id to issue a new token.

tools.name: Get Raw Message
tools.description: Get a temporary download reference for one message's raw RFC 5322 source, including its original headers and MIME structure. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Get Thread
tools.description: Retrieve one AgentMail thread and a paginated page of its messages.

tools.name: Get Thread Attachment
tools.description: Get a temporary download reference for an attachment using its thread and attachment IDs. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Get one organization-level webhook configuration by ID. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Get Webhook Headers
tools.description: List only the names of custom delivery headers on an organization-level webhook. Header values are credential-sensitive, write-only, and never returned.

tools.name: List Calendar Event Instances
tools.description: List one page of non-cancelled dates computed for a recurring US-only calendar event in a UTC window, including dates beyond the agenda horizon.

tools.name: List Calendar Events
tools.description: List one US-only calendar page of stored one-off events, recurring series, and edited series dates, including cancelled events, by most recent update.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: List one page of AgentMail custom domains and return the continuation token for the next page.

tools.name: List Drafts
tools.description: List unsent drafts in an AgentMail inbox with filters and pagination.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: List one page of an inbox's Agent Drive files in path order, including pending files. List items intentionally contain no presigned download URL; call GET_FILE for one. Requires file_read. Agent Drive is a US-production-only Labs feature.

tools.name: List Inbox API Keys
tools.description: List API-key metadata scoped to an inbox without exposing secret values.

tools.name: List Inboxes
tools.description: List all inboxes available to the authenticated AgentMail account. Use this to discover valid inbox_id values for message operations.

tools.name: List Inbox Events
tools.description: List label-change events from an AgentMail inbox.

tools.name: List Inbox Polling Webhooks
tools.description: List polling webhooks created through one inbox route. Returns one page and an endpoint- and inbox-bound opaque continuation token. AgentMail's polling guide currently says polling is US-only even though the API reference lists an EU server; follow the guide and do not assume EU support. Polling tokens are never returned.

tools.name: List Inbox Webhooks
tools.description: List one page of regular webhooks created for a selected AgentMail inbox. Responses contain credential-sensitive signature secrets; never log or expose them.

tools.name: List Allowlist or Blocklist Entries
tools.description: List one page of organization-wide send, receive, or reply allowlist or blocklist entries. Supply entry to retrieve one exact email address or domain.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: List messages from an AgentMail inbox. Returns a `messages` array; each message uses `message_id` and `timestamp` fields (not `id`, `date`, or `items`).

tools.name: List Pod Inboxes
tools.description: List one page of inboxes inside an explicitly selected AgentMail pod, or supply query to search addresses and display names. Follow next_page_token until absent, including after an empty search page.

tools.name: List Pods
tools.description: Return one page of AgentMail pods and its continuation token.

tools.name: List Polling Webhooks
tools.description: List organization-level polling webhooks created through the organization route. Returns one page and an endpoint-bound opaque continuation token. Current provider polling support is US-only (api.agentmail.to); do not use this action with an EU connection. Polling tokens are never returned.

tools.name: List Threads
tools.description: List conversation threads in an AgentMail inbox with filters.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List AgentMail webhook configurations.

tools.name: Query Inbox Event Metrics
tools.description: Query timestamped email-event counts for an AgentMail inbox.

tools.name: Query Metrics
tools.description: Query organization-wide email event counts or cumulative resource-usage time series over a bounded time range.

tools.name: Query Rate Metrics
tools.description: Query organization-wide rolling bounce and complaint rates.

tools.name: Release Held Message
tools.description: Release a message that Agent Armor held for review, emit its delivery and security override events, and remove the agent-armor-held label. Only a still-held message with a review verdict can be released.

tools.name: Reply To Message
tools.description: Reply to a selected message while preserving its AgentMail thread.

tools.name: Respond to Calendar Event
tools.description: Accept, decline, or tentatively accept an email invitation on a US-only inbox calendar. By default AgentMail emails the organizer; If-Match guards the response.

tools.name: Send Draft
tools.description: Immediately send and consume a draft, optionally changing message labels.

tools.name: Send Email
tools.description: Send an email using AgentMail API

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Immediately send a new email from an AgentMail inbox with optional HTML, attachments, custom headers, labels, and open tracking. Use a draft instead when the message must be scheduled for later.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Change an inbox calendar's default time zone in US production. Existing events retain their own time zones; optionally guard the update with If-Match.

tools.name: Update Calendar Event
tools.description: Patch a US-only calendar event, one recurring date, or that date and future dates. Explicit null clears only documented nullable fields; If-Match prevents overwrites.

tools.name: Update Draft
tools.description: Edit a draft, reschedule delivery, or cancel a scheduled send with null.

tools.name: Update Inbox
tools.description: Update an inbox's display name, status, or custom metadata.

tools.name: Update Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Update an inbox-scoped regular webhook's enabled state or replace its event types. An empty update is allowed. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Update Inbox Webhook Headers
tools.description: Atomically set, replace, or remove custom delivery headers on an inbox-scoped regular webhook. At least one real header change is required. Header values are credential-sensitive and write-only; never log or expose them.

tools.name: Update Message Labels
tools.description: Add or remove labels from one message in an inbox. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Update Pod Inbox
tools.description: Update the display name, active or paused status, or metadata of an inbox inside an explicitly selected AgentMail pod. Provide at least one field.

tools.name: Update Thread Labels
tools.description: Add or remove custom labels from every message in one thread. Source or target records with spam, blocked, unauthenticated, or trash labels may be hidden or reported not found when the API key lacks the corresponding label visibility permission.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update an organization-level webhook's enabled state, event types, or inbox and pod subscriptions. An empty update is allowed. The response contains a credential-sensitive signature secret; never log or expose it.

tools.name: Update Webhook Headers
tools.description: Atomically set, replace, or remove custom delivery headers on an organization-level webhook. At least one real header change is required. Header values are credential-sensitive and write-only; never log or expose them.

triggers.name: New Email Received
triggers.description: Trigger for new emails in an AgentMail inbox

required.name: region
required.description: Select the AgentMail production region where your account and data reside. Use United States unless your AgentMail account uses EU data residency.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy an API key from the AgentMail Console dashboard at https://console.agentmail.to. Keys begin with am_. Use a key whose organization, pod, inbox, and permission restrictions allow the operations you want Composio to perform. Actions may require inbox_read, inbox_create, inbox_update, inbox_delete, message_read, message_send, message_update, message_delete, agent_armor_release, draft_read, draft_create, draft_update, draft_delete, draft_send, list_entry_read, list_entry_create, list_entry_delete, metrics_read, pod_read, pod_create, pod_update, pod_delete, webhook_read, webhook_create, webhook_update, webhook_delete, domain_read, calendar_read, calendar_update, calendar_event_read, calendar_event_create, calendar_event_update, calendar_event_delete, file_read, file_create, file_update, or file_delete as documented at https://docs.agentmail.to/permissions.

name: Agentql
description: AgentQL is a suite of tools designed to connect AI agents to the web, enabling web interaction and structured data extraction through a specialized query language.

tools.name: Create Remote Browser Session
tools.description: Tool to create a remote browser session. Use when you need to run browser automation on remote infrastructure.

tools.name: Get AgentQL Usage Statistics
tools.description: Retrieves API usage statistics and subscription limits for the AgentQL account. Returns current billing cycle dates, lifetime usage limits, API key usage counts, and total account usage. Useful for monitoring quota consumption and planning usage. No parameters required - uses the authenticated API key from connection settings.

tools.name: Query Data
tools.description: Tool to query structured data as JSON from a web page using an AgentQL query or natural language prompt. Use after defining your query or prompt and a URL or HTML.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your AgentQL API key for authentication.

name: Agenty
description: Agenty is a web scraping and automation platform that enables users to extract data, monitor changes, and automate browser tasks without coding.

tools.name: Add List Rows
tools.description: Tool to add new rows to a list. Use when you need to insert one or more data rows into an existing list. Column names in row objects must match the list's schema.

tools.name: Create Agent
tools.description: Creates a new Agenty agent for web scraping, change detection, crawling, map monitoring, or brand monitoring. Use this tool to set up automated data extraction agents. Requires: - name: A descriptive name for the agent - type: One of 'scraping', 'changedetection', 'crawling', 'mapmonitoring', 'brandmonitoring' - config: Configuration object with url, browser, and collections defining what data to extract The config.collections array contains field definitions with CSS selectors or other extraction methods. Each field specifies what data to extract and how (TEXT content, ATTR for attributes, etc.). Optional: Set start=true to immediately run the agent after creation, or configure a scheduler for recurring runs. Returns the created agent with its unique agent_id for future reference.

tools.name: Get Agent Templates
tools.description: Tool to fetch all public agent templates and sample agents. Use when listing available templates for users to select.

tools.name: Delete Agent by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete a single agent by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an agent after confirming it exists.

tools.name: Fetch all agents
tools.description: Tool to fetch all active agents under an account. Use after authenticating when you need to list agents with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get Agent by ID
tools.description: Retrieves complete details of a specific agent including its configuration, input settings, scheduler, and metadata. Use this tool when you need to: - View full agent configuration and settings - Check agent type and current version - Access scheduler and script configurations - Verify agent status before executing jobs - Retrieve agent metadata for updates or cloning

tools.name: Update Agent by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing agent's configuration, settings, and metadata. Use this tool to modify an agent's properties such as name, type, config, tags, scheduler, scripts, or visibility settings. The API only returns the fields that were updated in the response, not the complete agent object. To get the full updated agent details, use the 'Get Agent by ID' action after updating. Example uses: - "Update agent abc123 to change its name to 'Production Scraper'" - "Enable scheduling for agent xyz789 with a cron expression '0 */6 * * *'" - "Update agent def456 config to scrape a different URL"

tools.name: Create API Key
tools.description: Creates a new API key for programmatic access to the Agenty API. The generated API key can be used to authenticate API requests with different permission levels (Owner, Admin, or Manager). The key is returned in the response and should be securely stored as it provides access to your Agenty account.

tools.name: Delete API key by ID
tools.description: Delete an API key by its unique identifier. Use this tool to permanently revoke access for a specific API key. The key_id can be obtained from the "Get all API keys" or "Create API key" actions. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Download API keys
tools.description: Tool to download all API keys under an account in CSV format. Use when you need a complete list of API keys for export or backup.

tools.name: Get all API keys
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all API keys under an account. Use after authentication when you need to list API keys with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get API key by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific API key by its ID. Use this action when you need to: - Get the full details of an API key including its value, role, and status - Verify the existence and properties of a specific API key - Check if an API key is enabled or disabled The key_id can be obtained from the 'Get all API keys' action or when creating a new API key.

tools.name: Reset API key by ID
tools.description: Resets (regenerates) the secret value of an existing API key. The old secret becomes invalid immediately. Important: This action only confirms the reset was successful but does NOT return the new secret. After resetting, use the 'Get API Key By ID' action to retrieve the new secret value. Use this when you need to: - Rotate API key secrets for security - Invalidate a compromised API key and generate a new secret - Update credentials as part of security maintenance

tools.name: Update API key by ID
tools.description: Updates an existing API key's name and role by its unique identifier. This action allows you to modify the display name and permission level of an API key. Only the name and role fields can be updated; other properties are read-only. After updating, the action automatically fetches and returns the complete updated API key details. Use this when you need to: - Rename an API key for better identification - Change the permission level (Owner, Admin, or Manager) of an API key - Update multiple properties of an API key at once

tools.name: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to capture a full-page or visible screenshot of any webpage URL. Use when you need to capture visual representation of a webpage as an image file. The screenshot is captured using browser automation with default settings.

tools.name: Capture Screenshot with Options
tools.description: Tool to capture webpage screenshots with extensive customization options including full-page capture, image format, quality settings, viewport configuration, and post-processing. Use when you need to take screenshots of web pages with specific requirements for size, format, or rendering behavior.

tools.name: Change API key status by ID
tools.description: Toggles the enabled/disabled status of an API key. This endpoint switches the key between enabled and disabled states - if the key is currently enabled, it will be disabled, and vice versa. Returns a confirmation message upon successful status change. Use this after retrieving the key_id from the list or get API key endpoints.

tools.name: Get all connections
tools.description: Retrieves all connections from your Agenty account. Supports pagination via limit/offset and sorting by field name. Returns an empty list if no connections exist.

tools.name: Convert URL to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert a webpage URL to a PDF document. Use when you need to generate a PDF file from a web page for archival, reporting, or offline viewing purposes.

tools.name: Convert URL to PDF with Options
tools.description: Tool to convert a URL or raw HTML to PDF with customizable options. Use when you need to generate PDFs with specific formatting requirements like custom page sizes, margins, headers/footers, or orientation. Supports both URL-based and HTML content conversion.

tools.name: Copy Agent
tools.description: Tool to copy an existing agent by its ID, creating a duplicate with optionally a new name. Use when you need to duplicate an agent's configuration to create a similar agent without starting from scratch.

tools.name: Create Workflow
tools.description: Creates a new workflow in Agenty to automate actions based on agent events. Use this to set up automated responses like sending emails, triggering webhooks, or notifications when specific agent events occur (e.g., job completed, job failed).

tools.name: Get dashboard reports and usage
tools.description: Tool to fetch account reports like pages used by agent, date, and product. Use when analyzing usage over a date range.

tools.name: Delete List Row by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific row from a list by its unique identifier. Use when you need to permanently remove a single row from a list.

tools.name: Delete List Rows by IDs
tools.description: Tool to delete specific rows from a list by their IDs. Use when you need to remove one or more rows from a list by providing their unique identifiers.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a project. This action cannot be undone, so ensure the project ID is correct before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Schedule
tools.description: Tool to delete a schedule for an agent by its agent ID. Use when you need to remove scheduled automation for a specific agent.

tools.name: Delete Workflow by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete a workflow by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a workflow after confirming it exists.

tools.name: Download Agent Result
tools.description: Tool to download agent results by agent ID in CSV, TSV or JSON format. Use when you need to export or analyze agent execution results as a file.

tools.name: Download List Rows
tools.description: Tool to download list rows as CSV file. Use when you need to export or backup all rows from a specific list.

tools.name: Download users
tools.description: Tool to download users list in CSV format. Use when you need to export or backup the complete list of team members and users.

tools.name: Download workflows
tools.description: Tool to download all workflows in CSV format. Use when you need to export or backup all workflows from your account.

tools.name: Extract Structured Data
tools.description: Tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage including schema.org, RDFa, Microdata, and JSON-LD formats. Use when you need to automatically extract semantic markup from web pages without writing custom scraping rules. The API returns organized structured data in four categories: metatags, microdata, rdfa, and jsonld.

tools.name: Extract Structured Data from URL
tools.description: Tool to auto-extract structured data from a webpage URL. Use when you need to extract schema.org, RDFa, Microdata, or JSON-LD structured data from web pages.

tools.name: Get Agent Result
tools.description: Tool to get the most recent result data for an agent. Use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from an agent's latest execution. Returns result data with pagination support.

tools.name: Get all team members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all team members (users) under an account. Use after authentication when you need to list team members with pagination, sorting, and search filtering.

tools.name: Get URL Redirects
tools.description: Tool to get the complete redirect chain for a URL. Use when you need to trace how a URL redirects, including both server-side (HTTP 3xx redirects) and client-side redirects (JavaScript, meta tags). Returns an ordered list of all redirect steps from the original URL to the final destination.

tools.name: Get Job Result
tools.description: Tool to get the result data from a completed job. Use when you need to retrieve and view the scraped/collected data from a finished job. Returns result data with pagination support.

tools.name: Get list by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific list by its ID. Use this action when you need to: - Get the full details of a list including its name, description, and metadata - Verify the existence of a specific list - Check when a list was created or last updated - Access additional data associated with a list The list_id can be obtained from the 'Get all lists' action or when creating a new list.

tools.name: Get List Row by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch a specific row by its ID from a list. Use when you need to retrieve a single data entry from a list using its unique identifier.

tools.name: Get Page Content
tools.description: Tool to fetch the complete HTML content of any webpage URL. Use this when you need to retrieve the full HTML source code of a page, including content rendered after JavaScript execution. The API navigates to the URL using proxies and captures the page's source content.

tools.name: Get Page Content with Options
tools.description: Tool to fetch HTML content of a webpage with custom options including ad blocking. Use this when you need to retrieve the full HTML source of a webpage, particularly for web scraping or content analysis tasks. The tool supports ad blocking to speed up page loads and reduce unnecessary content.

tools.name: Get Project by ID
tools.description: Retrieves complete details of a specific project by its ID, including name, description, creator information, and timestamps. Use this to get project metadata before adding agents, checking project existence, or verifying project details for updates.

tools.name: Get Redirects with Options
tools.description: Tool to get the complete redirect chain of a URL with custom navigation options. Use when you need to trace URL redirects including both server-side (3xx) and client-side redirects (JavaScript, meta tags). Supports custom timeout and navigation wait conditions to ensure all redirects are captured.

tools.name: Get Agent Schedule
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the schedule configuration for a specific agent. Use when you need to check the current scheduling settings for an agent.

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a user by their ID. Use this to fetch user profile data including email, role, status, and activity timestamps.

tools.name: Get Workflow by ID
tools.description: Retrieves complete details of a specific workflow by its ID. Use this to view workflow configuration including agents, triggers, and actions before updating or deleting.

tools.name: Get agent input by ID
tools.description: Retrieves the input configuration for a specific agent by its ID. Returns the input source type (URL, manual list, saved list reference, or another agent's output) and associated configuration details. Use this to inspect an agent's current input setup before modifying it or starting a job, or to verify what data sources an agent will process.

tools.name: Update Input by Agent ID
tools.description: Updates the input configuration for a specific agent in Agenty. This tool modifies where an agent gets its input data from. You can configure the agent to: - Pull from a URL feed (type='url') - Use a manually specified list of URLs (type='manual') - Reference data from an Agenty list (type='list') - Use output from another agent (type='agent') Use this after creating or identifying an agent to set up its data source before running jobs.

tools.name: Download jobs
tools.description: Tool to download all jobs in CSV format. Use when you need a complete list of jobs for export or analysis.

tools.name: Download job file by ID
tools.description: Tool to download output files by job ID. Use when you need to fetch a specific output file after a job completes.

tools.name: Download Job Result by ID
tools.description: Tool to download the agent output result by job ID. Use when you need to fetch the final output of a completed job in CSV, TSV, or JSON format.

tools.name: Fetch all jobs
tools.description: Tool to fetch all jobs under an account. Use when you need to view and filter the list of jobs with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get Job by ID
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details about a specific job including its status, progress metrics (pages processed/succeeded/failed), timing information (created/started/completed times), resource consumption (page credits), and any error messages. Use this action to check job status, monitor execution progress, or diagnose job failures. Returns complete job metadata needed before downloading results.

tools.name: Get Job Logs by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch logs for a given job by its ID. Use when you need to review or debug job execution logs with pagination support.

tools.name: List job output files
tools.description: Lists all output files generated by a specific job. Returns file names and sizes for available downloads including CSV/JSON/TSV data exports and compressed logs. Use this after a job completes to discover what output files are available before downloading them.

tools.name: Start Agent Job
tools.description: Tool to start a new agent job. Use when you need to trigger execution of an existing agent.

tools.name: Stop Job by ID
tools.description: Tool to stop a running job by job ID. Use when you need to halt an in-progress job before it completes. Confirm the job ID beforehand to avoid unintended stops.

tools.name: Clear List Rows
tools.description: Tool to clear all rows in a list by its ID. Use when you need to wipe out all data in a list before re-populating (e.g., "Clear all rows in list 123").

tools.name: Create List
tools.description: Tool to create a new list. Use after preparing the list name and optional description. Example: "Create a list named 'Contacts' with description 'Potential leads'."

tools.name: Delete List by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific list by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a list after confirming it exists.

tools.name: Download lists
tools.description: Tool to download all lists in CSV format. Use when you need a complete set of lists for export or backup.

tools.name: Get all lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all lists under an account. Use after authentication when you need to list lists with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Fetch List Rows by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch all rows in a specified list. Use when you need to retrieve all data entries from a list with optional pagination and sorting. Example: "Fetch rows from list '61db...' with limit=50".

tools.name: Update List by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a list's name and optionally description by list ID. The name field is always required. Use when you need to modify list metadata after confirming its ID. Example: "Update list 123 with name 'My Updated List' and description 'New description'".

tools.name: Upload CSV file to List
tools.description: Tool to upload a CSV file to an Agenty list for bulk import of data rows. Use this action when you need to: - Import multiple rows of data into an existing list from a CSV file - Bulk update list data - Add structured tabular data to a list Prerequisites: The target list must already exist. Use the 'Create List' action first if needed.

tools.name: Patch Workflow
tools.description: Tool to partially update a workflow by ID. Use when you need to update specific fields of a workflow without replacing the entire workflow object. This action performs a PATCH operation, allowing you to update only the fields you specify (e.g., just the name) without affecting other workflow properties. Currently supports updating the workflow name.

tools.name: Add Agents to Project
tools.description: Add one or more agents to an Agenty project to organize and group related agents together. This action associates agents with a project, allowing better organization and management of your automation workflows. The response includes the complete updated project information with all associated agents. Prerequisites: - Project must exist (use projects_get_all to find valid project IDs) - Agent(s) must exist (use agents_get_all to find valid agent IDs) Example usage: "Add agents ['tx8lubfbun', 'o3xuc2n8es'] to project 7"

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new project in Agenty. Use this to initialize a project with a name and optional description.

tools.name: Get all projects
tools.description: Retrieve all projects in the authenticated user's account. Returns a paginated list of projects with metadata (total count, pagination info). Use this to discover available projects, check project existence, or get project IDs for other operations. Supports sorting by fields like 'name' or 'created_at'.

tools.name: Remove Agent from Project
tools.description: Remove an agent from an Agenty project. Use when you need to disassociate an agent from a project while keeping both the agent and project intact. The agent will no longer be part of the project's organization structure.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage Data
tools.description: Tool to scrape data from any webpage using jQuery/CSS selectors. Use when you need to extract specific data from web pages by defining jQuery selector expressions. Each query field maps a name to a jQuery expression (e.g., "$('h1').text()" extracts the h1 text). The browser will load the page, execute JavaScript, and run your jQuery queries to extract the data.

tools.name: Toggle Agent Schedule
tools.description: Tool to toggle schedule on/off for an agent. Use when you need to enable or disable an agent's scheduled execution without modifying other agent settings.

tools.name: Transfer Agent Ownership
tools.description: Tool to transfer agent ownership to another Agenty account. Use when you need to move an agent to a different user's account by specifying their email address.

tools.name: Update List Row
tools.description: Tool to update a specific row in a list by list ID and row ID. Use when you need to modify existing data in a list row. The row_data must include the '_id' field and any column fields (col1, col2, etc.) you want to update.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update an existing project's name and description in Agenty. Use this to modify project details such as changing the project name or updating its description.

tools.name: Update Agent Schedule
tools.description: Updates the schedule configuration for a specific agent. Use when you need to modify how often an agent runs automatically.

tools.name: Update User by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a user's information by user ID. Use this to modify user properties including email, role, status, name, and subscription settings. Email, role, and status are required fields.

tools.name: Update Workflow
tools.description: Tool to update an existing workflow's configuration by workflow ID. Use this to modify workflow properties including name, agent selection, trigger conditions, and actions to execute. Workflows automate responses to agent events such as job completion, errors, or change detection. Common use cases include sending notifications, triggering webhooks, or updating external systems.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Agenty API key

name: Agile CRM
description: Agile CRM combines contact management, sales pipelines, marketing automation, tasks, campaigns, and customer support in one platform.

tools.name: Create Contact or Company
tools.description: Create a person contact with optional tags and scoring, or a company, with common and tenant custom properties.

tools.name: Create Deal
tools.description: Create a deal, optionally associate contacts, and validate or resolve a case-sensitive milestone from the selected or default pipeline.

tools.name: Delete Contact or Company
tools.description: Permanently delete one person contact or company by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Deal
tools.description: Permanently delete one deal by its numeric Agile CRM ID.

tools.name: Get Contact or Company
tools.description: Get one person contact or company by its numeric Agile CRM ID; return null when the resource does not exist.

tools.name: Get Deal
tools.description: Get one deal by its numeric Agile CRM ID; return null when the deal does not exist.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Return one creation-ordered page of person contacts, with a cursor for the next page when more contacts exist.

tools.name: List Deals
tools.description: Return one creation-ordered page of deals, with a cursor for the next page when more deals exist.

tools.name: Update Contact or Company
tools.description: Add or replace selected properties on one person contact or company without replacing properties that are not included.

tools.name: Update Deal

description: Agility CMS is a headless content management system that allows developers to build and manage digital experiences across various platforms.
