tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a content item by Content ID. Use when you need item fields and metadata from Agility CMS.

tools.name: Get Content List
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of content items by reference name from Agility CMS. Use this action to: - Fetch multiple content items of a specific type (e.g., blog posts, products, authors) - Retrieve content with pagination, filtering, and sorting capabilities - Expand linked content to specified depths Required parameters: instance GUID, API type (fetch/preview), locale code, and lowercase reference name. Tip: Use Get Content Models action first to discover available reference names for your instance.

tools.name: Get Content Models
tools.description: Tool to retrieve content models and page modules. Use when you need schema definitions to dynamically build content structures.

tools.name: Get Logs
tools.description: Retrieve sync items (content change logs) from Agility CMS using the Content Sync API. This tool implements incremental content synchronization: - Use syncToken='0' for initial full sync (retrieves all content) - Use the returned syncToken in subsequent calls to get only new/updated content - Maximum pageSize is 500 items per request - Continue pagination until syncToken='0' is returned (indicating you're up to date) Typical workflow: 1. Call with syncToken='0' to get initial content batch 2. Store the returned syncToken 3. On next sync, pass the stored syncToken to get only changes since last sync 4. Repeat until syncToken='0' (no more updates)

tools.name: Get Page
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a Page, including metadata, content zones, and components. Use after you know the page_id to fetch.

tools.name: Get Page Modules
tools.description: Retrieves page module definitions from Agility CMS. Page modules are UI components that can be added to pages. This action fetches all model definitions and filters to return only page modules (definitions without contentReferenceNames). Use this to understand what page modules are available for building pages. For content type definitions, use Get Content Models instead.

tools.name: Get Sitemap Flat
tools.description: Retrieves the flat sitemap for a specific channel and locale in Agility CMS. Returns a dictionary mapping page paths to sitemap items containing page metadata, SEO info, and routing details. Use this when you need to get all pages and their URLs for implementing page routing, generating sitemaps, or navigating the site structure. Required: instance GUID, API type (fetch/preview), locale code, and channel name.

tools.name: Sync Pages
tools.description: Retrieves all page items from Agility CMS in paged format with sync tokens for incremental updates. Use this to synchronize local page data with the CMS. Start with syncToken=0 for initial sync, then use the returned syncToken in subsequent calls to get only changed pages. Each response includes page metadata, SEO fields, visibility settings, and script configurations.

Every entity provided in `brands` (and `competitors`, when applicable) must include at least one value in `url_groups`. Entities consisting only of `names` are not supported here because citations are matched against URL groups. Prefer using this tool instead of the non '*-entities' tool, since you can more accurately describe brands/competitors with multiple names and/or their websites. Use doc tool first to get the real input schema.

Prefer using this tool instead of the non '*-entities' tool, since you can more accurately describe brands/competitors with multiple names and/or their websites. tools.name: Render-data-table
tools.description: Render an interactive data table widget with sorting, search, and pagination. Accepts column definitions (key and label) and row data. Column types are inferred automatically from the data. IMPORTANT: preserve array values in row data as JSON arrays (e.g. tags: ["tag1", "tag2"]), do not flatten them to comma-separated strings. The source field is optional: set source.tool to the bare tool name without any connector or namespace prefix (e.g. 'site-explorer-all-backlinks' not 'my-connector:site-explorer-all-backlinks'), and source.params to the arguments you passed, to generate an 'Open in Ahrefs' link.

tools.name: Render-scorecard
tools.description: Render a scorecard widget showing key metrics as a card grid. Accepts metric cards with labels, raw numeric values, optional unit, optional change indicators, and optional grouping. IMPORTANT: 'value' is a raw number (e.g. 1234567 not '1,234,567' or '1.2M'); the frontend handles all display formatting. Use 'unit' for symbols: '$' for currency, '%' for percentages, 's' for duration in seconds (rendered as e.g. '11m 27s'). Monetary values are in USD cents (not dollars), make sure to divide them by 100 first such that they are displayed in USD. Omit 'value' or pass null for N/A. Change indicators: change.value is a positive number (the percentage amount, e.g. 12.4 for a 12.4% change); change.direction is 'up' or 'down'. When there are more than 4 cards, use the 'group' field to organize them into logical sections (e.g. 'Organic' and 'Paid'). Always include the source field when the data came from an Ahrefs tool call. Set source.tool to the bare tool name without any connector or namespace prefix (e.g. 'site-explorer-metrics' not 'my-connector:site-explorer-metrics'), and source.params to the arguments you passed, to generate an 'Open in Ahrefs' link.

tools.name: Render-time-series-chart
tools.description: Render an interactive time series line chart. Accepts one or more named data series. Supports multi-series with automatic dual Y-axis when 2 series have different units. Features hover tooltip, vertical crosshair, and toggleable legend. IMPORTANT: series names are shown in the chart legend and must be human-readable labels. Convert snake_case identifiers to Title Case (e.g. 'position_1_to_3' becomes 'Position 1 to 3', 'org_traffic' becomes 'Organic Traffic'). Expand abbreviations where possible (e.g. 'ctr' becomes 'CTR', 'org' becomes 'Organic', 'avg' becomes 'Average'). Never pass an empty string as a series name; use a descriptive label like 'Other' or 'Not Set' instead. The source field is optional: set source.tool to the bare tool name without any connector or namespace prefix (e.g. 'brand-radar-sov-history' not 'my-connector:brand-radar-sov-history'), and source.params to the arguments you passed, to generate an 'Open in Ahrefs' link. Unit labels appear next to values in tooltips: only set unit for currencies ('$') or percentages ('%'). Omit unit for all other metrics. Monetary values are in USD cents (not dollars), make sure to divide them by 100 first such that they are displayed in USD.

name: AI Ark
description: AI Ark provides people and company search, contact enrichment, and recruiting intelligence APIs.

tools.name: Analyze Personality
tools.description: Infer DISC and OCEAN personality assessments plus selling and hiring outreach guidance from one person's LinkedIn profile. This costs 4 AI Ark credits per request and returns sensitive algorithmic inferences, not verified or objective facts.

tools.name: Create or Update List
tools.description: Create or mutate a temporary people/company exclusion list for free. Lists expire after 24 hours, hold at most 10,000 values, and are limited to 50 new lists per day. APPEND merges values; REPLACE irreversibly overwrites the complete prior list. Omitting list_id creates a list, and an unknown list_id can also create new state.

tools.name: Enrich Person with Email
tools.description: Enrich one person by AI Ark person ID or LinkedIn URL with a full profile and provider email-verification metadata. This returns sensitive personal profile and email data and is an enrichment action, not a standalone email verifier. It costs 1 credit only when a valid email is found and 0 credits otherwise.

tools.name: Find Mobile Phone
tools.description: Find candidate mobile phone numbers for one person from a LinkedIn URL or from a company domain plus full name. A found result costs 5 AI Ark credits; a no-result response costs 0 credits. The response contains sensitive personal phone numbers ordered by provider confidence, and AI Ark does not document them as verified.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected AI Ark account's remaining credit balance for free; this is the only action safe to use for credential validation.

tools.name: Get Email Finder Status
tools.description: Make one free status request for an email-finder job and return its state and total/found counts. This action does not poll internally or start another billable lookup; call it again only when another status check is needed.

tools.name: Get People Export Status
tools.description: Make one free status request for a bulk people-export job and return its state, total/found/success/failed counts, and webhook metadata. This action does not poll internally; call it again only when another status snapshot is needed.

tools.name: List Email Finder Results
tools.description: Return one free page of an email-finder job's results without waiting for completion. Entries still in PROCESSING state are preserved alongside completed entries. The response can contain sensitive personal email addresses, lookup inputs, and full provider verification and MX metadata.

tools.name: List Email Finder Submissions
tools.description: Return one free page of the connected AI Ark customer's email-finder submission history, including job states and refund details. The provider automatically scopes results to the authenticated API key; callers control filters, repeated sort criteria, and pagination, and this action makes one request without polling or automatic pagination.

tools.name: List People Export Results
tools.description: Return one free page of a completed bulk people export. The response contains sensitive full person and company profiles and personal emails with provider verification metadata. This action does not poll internally; a still-processing export returns 409, so check GET_PEOPLE_EXPORT_STATUS until its state is DONE before trying again.

tools.name: List People Export Submissions
tools.description: List the authenticated API token's own people-export submission and refund history for free. Results are automatically scoped to the caller's customer account and this action returns one explicitly selected page without polling.

tools.name: Look Up Person by Email
tools.description: Identify and return a sensitive, detailed personal and employment profile from an email address. AI Ark charges 0.5 credits per request, including when no profile is found. This action does not verify the input email and does not return a mobile number.

tools.name: Preview People
tools.description: Return one page of masked people and full company matches for 1 credit per page. The preview contains no email or phone data and its trackId is null, so it cannot start email finding.

tools.name: Resend Email Finder Webhook
tools.description: Irreversibly resend one email-finder completion payload to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook. This free action externally discloses sensitive verified personal emails, may target a different URL from the original submission, and must not be retried after an ambiguous outcome. Success is reported only when AI Ark explicitly confirms delivery.

tools.name: Resend People Export Webhook
tools.description: Irreversibly resend one completed bulk people export to a caller-selected public HTTPS webhook. This free action externally discloses sensitive full profiles and verified personal emails, may target a different URL from the original submission, and must not be retried after an ambiguous outcome. Success is reported only when AI Ark explicitly confirms delivery.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Return one zero-based page of companies using typed company, employee, list, and lookalike filters. Each returned company costs 0.1 AI Ark credits. Lookalike search accepts 1-5 domains or LinkedIn company URLs, page must be 0 or greater, size must be 1-100, and the result set is capped at 10,000 matches.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Return one page of full people and company profiles. This search costs 0.5 credits per returned person and does not return email addresses or phone numbers, but its personal and employment profile data is sensitive. The returned provider trackId (exposed as track_id) can be used once to start email finding and expires 6 hours after this search.

tools.name: Start Email Finder
tools.description: Consume a People Search track ID exactly once, within 6 hours of the search, to start email finding. A required external HTTPS webhook receives sensitive personal email results. This costs 1 credit per valid email found and 0 credits for people without a valid email. Use GET_EMAIL_FINDER_STATUS to monitor the job and LIST_EMAIL_FINDER_RESULTS to retrieve partial or completed results.

tools.name: Start People Export
tools.description: Irreversibly start one paid asynchronous export of up to 10,000 matching people and deliver full personal profiles with real-time verified emails to a required external HTTPS webhook. AI Ark charges 0.5 credits per exported person plus 0.5 credits per valid email found, so the explicit maximum charge is size credits. Do not retry an ambiguous outcome because a duplicate submission can incur another charge and external delivery.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your API key from the official AI Ark API Management Dashboard at https://app.ai-ark.com/settings/api-management/dashboard. The key is sent only in the X-TOKEN request header; keep it secret.

name: AI/ML API
description: AI/ML API provides a suite of AI models and solutions for various tasks, including text generation, image processing, and more.

tools.name: Cancel Run
tools.description: Tool to cancel a run that is currently in progress. Use when you need to stop an assistant run before it completes.

tools.name: Create Assistant
tools.description: Tool to create an AI assistant with configurable model, instructions, and tools. Use when you need to set up a new assistant that can maintain conversation context and use tools like code_interpreter or file_search.

tools.name: Create Message
tools.description: Tool to create a new message in a thread. Use when you need to add a user or assistant message to an existing conversation thread.

tools.name: Create Run
tools.description: Tool to create a run that executes an assistant on a thread. The assistant processes messages in the thread and generates responses based on its instructions and available tools.

tools.name: Create Thread
tools.description: Tool to create a new thread for conversation with an assistant. Threads store messages and maintain context across interactions. Use when starting a new conversation or when you need a fresh context for assistant interactions.

tools.name: Delete Assistant
tools.description: Tool to delete an assistant by ID. Use when you need to remove an assistant that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific message from a thread. Use when you need to remove an unwanted or erroneous message from a conversation thread.

tools.name: Delete Thread
tools.description: Tool to delete a thread by its ID. Use when you need to remove an existing thread from the system.

tools.name: Get Assistant
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific assistant by ID. Use when you need to fetch configuration, model settings, instructions, or available tools for an existing assistant.

tools.name: Get Billing Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current billing balance for the account. Use when you need to check available credits, balance status, or auto-debit configuration.

tools.name: Get Luma Generation
tools.description: Tool to fetch Luma AI video generation results by generation IDs. Use after creating a generation to check its status and retrieve the generated video URL when completed.

tools.name: Get Message
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific message by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a particular message in a thread.

tools.name: Get Response by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a previously generated model response by its unique ID. Use when you need to access details of a specific response, including its output, status, and usage statistics.

tools.name: Get Run
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific run by ID from a thread. Use when you need to check the status, results, or details of a previously created run.

tools.name: Get Run Step
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific run step by its ID within a thread and run. Use when you need detailed information about a particular step's execution status and results.

tools.name: Get Thread
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific thread by ID. Use when you need to fetch thread details, metadata, or available tool resources for an existing conversation thread.

tools.name: List Assistants
tools.description: Tool to list all assistants associated with the account. Use when you need to retrieve available assistants with pagination support.

tools.name: List Batches
tools.description: Tool to get the status or results of a batch processing job. Use when you need to check the progress or retrieve results of a previously submitted batch.

tools.name: List Luma AI Generations
tools.description: Tool to fetch user's Luma AI video generations. Use when you need to retrieve a list of all Luma AI video generation tasks for the authenticated user.

tools.name: List Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of messages from a specific thread. Use when you need to fetch conversation history or message content from an AI assistant thread.

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: Tool to list all available AI models from the AI/ML API. Use when you need to retrieve the complete catalog of 400+ models including chat, image, video, voice, and other model types.

tools.name: List Models With Details
tools.description: Tool to list all available AI/ML models with detailed information including pricing, features, and capabilities. Use when you need to discover available models or get comprehensive model metadata.

tools.name: List Runs
tools.description: Tool to list all runs for a specific thread. Use when you need to retrieve runs with pagination support.

tools.name: List Run Steps
tools.description: Tool to list the steps in a run. Use when you need to retrieve and examine the execution steps of a specific run within a thread.

tools.name: Submit Tool Outputs
tools.description: Tool to submit tool outputs for a run that requires action. Use when a run has status 'requires_action' and needs tool call results to continue execution.

tools.name: Text Chat Completion
tools.description: Tool to generate text completions or chat responses using a specified LLM model. Use after assembling the conversation history to produce the next response.

tools.name: Update Assistant
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing assistant's properties including name, instructions, model, and tools. Use when you need to update an assistant's configuration or behavior after it has been created.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Tool to modify metadata for a specific message in a thread. Use when you need to update message metadata such as tags or custom fields.

tools.name: Update Run
tools.description: Tool to update a run's metadata with key-value pairs. Use when you need to attach or modify additional information for a specific run.

tools.name: Update Thread
tools.description: Tool to update thread metadata and tool resources in the AI/ML API. Use when you need to modify existing thread properties or attach resources.
