tools.description: Tool to retrieve activity log for a specific user on Amara. Use when you need to view a user's recent actions such as video additions, subtitle edits, or comments. Returns a paginated list of activity items with details about what actions the user performed, on which videos, and in which languages.

tools.name: Get User Data
tools.description: Retrieves detailed user profile information from Amara, including username, avatar, biography, languages spoken, and video counts. Use this tool when you need to: - Fetch a user's profile details by their username or user ID - Get information about the authenticated user using 'me' as identifier - Look up user metadata like languages, biography, or avatar - Obtain user resource URIs for further API operations Note: User IDs (with 'id$' prefix) are more reliable than usernames since usernames can be changed by users.

tools.name: Get Video URL
tools.description: Tool to get details for a specific video URL. Use when you need to retrieve metadata about a specific URL entry in Amara's system by video_id and url_id.

tools.name: Get Video URL Details
tools.description: Tool to get details for a specific video URL. Use when you have a public or embeddable video URL and need its Amara metadata (ID, title, duration, thumbnails, etc.).

tools.name: List Activity
tools.description: Tool to list activity across Amara. Use when you need to retrieve activity logs with optional filters by team, video, or activity type.

tools.name: List Available Languages
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all supported languages. Use when you need to know available language options from Amara.

tools.name: List Subtitle Actions
tools.description: Tool to list available actions for subtitles based on current workflow state. Use when you need to determine what operations can be performed on a subtitle (e.g., approve, reject, publish) for a specific video and language.

tools.name: List Subtitle Languages
tools.description: Tool to list all subtitle languages for a video. Use when you have a video ID and need to fetch its available subtitle languages.

tools.name: List Subtitle Notes
tools.description: List notes for subtitles in a specific language. Use this to retrieve all notes/comments added to a subtitle language for collaboration and feedback purposes.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: Tool to list all teams. Use when you need to retrieve your accessible teams with pagination.

tools.name: List Video Activity
tools.description: Tool to list activity for a specific video. Use when you need to fetch the activity log or history of actions performed on a video.

tools.name: List Videos
tools.description: Tool to list all videos. Use when you need to fetch a paginated list of videos with optional filters.

tools.name: List Video URLs
tools.description: Tool to list all URLs associated with a video. Use when you need to retrieve every URL for embedding or processing.

tools.name: Make Video URL Primary
tools.description: Tool to set a video URL as the primary URL. Use when you need to designate one of a video's URLs as primary for embedding and display. Call after listing video URLs to confirm the URL ID.

tools.name: Perform Subtitle Action
tools.description: Tool to perform an action on subtitles such as publish, unpublish, approve, reject, send-back, or endorse. Use when you need to change the workflow state of subtitles for a specific video and language. The available actions depend on the current workflow state and team settings.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Sends a message to a user or team member in Amara. Use this tool to send notifications, updates, or communicate with other users or teams on the platform. You must specify either a recipient user (by username or user ID) or a team (by team slug), but not both.

tools.name: Update Subtitle Language
tools.description: Tool to update a subtitle language for a video. Use after reviewing existing subtitle language settings and needing to adjust completeness flags or soft-limit constraints.

tools.name: Update Video
tools.description: Tool to update an existing video's metadata including title, description, team, and project assignment. Use when you need to modify video information after creation.

tools.name: View Video Details
tools.description: Tool to view details of a specific video by ID. Use when you need complete metadata for a given video.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key for authenticating requests to the Amara API.

name: Amazing Marvin
description: Amazing Marvin is a customizable personal productivity application for managing tasks, projects, planning, habits, time tracking, and rewards.

tools.name: Complete Task
tools.description: Mark one task complete using Amazing Marvin's experimental completion endpoint. Some client-side effects such as stopping time tracking, rewards, Kudos, and worked-on timestamps are not performed, and this toolkit cannot undo the completion.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a project with optional hierarchy, planning, priority, estimate, labels, and notes.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a task with optional scheduling, organization, estimate, and note fields; title autocompletion is enabled by default.

tools.name: Delete Reminders
tools.description: Permanently delete only the specified Amazing Marvin reminders by exact ID. This does not clear reminder metadata on corresponding tasks and does not provide a delete-all mode.

tools.name: Get Current Time Tracking
tools.description: Return the task currently being time-tracked, or tracked=false when no timer is active.

tools.name: List Categories or Labels
tools.description: List categories or labels so their IDs can be used when creating and organizing Amazing Marvin tasks and projects.

tools.name: List Planning Items
tools.description: List open child items, items scheduled for a date, or items due by a date; choose one view per call.

tools.name: List Reminders
tools.description: List all currently scheduled Amazing Marvin reminders.

tools.name: Set Reminders
tools.description: Create or replace one or more mobile push reminders using caller-supplied reminder IDs. The Amazing Marvin mobile app must be installed and logged in; this does not update reminder metadata on corresponding tasks.

tools.name: Set Time Tracking
tools.description: Start or stop time tracking for one task. This changes timer state but does not update the stopped task's stored duration or times; inspect issues in the response for provider-reported problems.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Update one or more low-level fields on an existing Amazing Marvin document and return the complete persisted document. This highly privileged operation can corrupt documents and break the Marvin client when a key or value has an invalid shape; update only known fields with their expected JSON types.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Open Amazing Marvin's API strategy settings at https://app.amazingmarvin.com/pre?api and copy the API_TOKEN value. This token authorizes standard API operations and is sent as X-API-Token.

required.name: generic_token
required.description: Open Amazing Marvin's API strategy settings at https://app.amazingmarvin.com/pre?api and copy the FULL_ACCESS_TOKEN value. This highly privileged token authorizes sensitive operations such as arbitrary document access and is sent as X-Full-Access-Token.

name: Ambee
description: Ambee provides real-time, hyperlocal environmental data through APIs, offering insights into air quality, weather, pollen, and more.

tools.name: Geocode by Place
tools.description: Tool to transform a place name or address into geographic coordinates. Use after confirming the location name to get precise latitude and longitude.

tools.name: Get Air Quality by City
tools.description: Tool to retrieve real-time air quality data for a specific city. Use after obtaining a valid city name when current AQI and pollutant levels are needed.

tools.name: Get Air Quality by Country Code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve real-time air quality data for a specific country using a 3-letter ISO code. Use after acquiring the country code and when you want a national overview of air quality.

tools.name: Get Air Quality by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve real-time air quality data for a specific latitude and longitude. Use when you need hyper-local air quality readings for given coordinates.

tools.name: Get Air Quality by Postal Code
tools.description: Retrieve real-time air quality data for a specific postal code and country. Returns comprehensive air quality metrics including pollutant concentrations (PM2.5, PM10, CO, NO2, O3, SO2), Air Quality Index (AQI) with category (Good/Moderate/Unhealthy), and location details. Data is updated hourly with 500-meter spatial resolution following US EPA standards. Use this when you need hyper-local air quality insights for a specific postal code.

tools.name: Get Air Quality Forecast by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve air quality forecast for a specific latitude and longitude. Use when you need predicted air quality data up to 48 hours in advance based on geographic coordinates.

tools.name: Get Air Quality History by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical air quality data for a specific latitude and longitude. Use when you need past air quality readings for given coordinates within the last 2 days.

tools.name: Retrieve latest natural disasters by continent
tools.description: Tool to retrieve latest natural disaster data for a specific continent. Use when you need up-to-date disaster information by continent code.

tools.name: Get historical natural disasters by date range
tools.description: Tool to retrieve global historical natural disaster data with date range filtering. Use when you need to search disaster events from a specific starting date onwards.

tools.name: Get historical natural disasters by country code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical natural disaster data for a country by ISO country code. Use when you need past disaster information for a specific country within a given date range.

tools.name: Get historical natural disasters by coordinates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical natural disaster data for a specific location by coordinates with date range. Use when you need historical disaster information for a geographic point within the past month.

tools.name: Get latest disasters by country code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve latest natural disaster data for a specific country using ISO country code. Use when you need up-to-date disaster information for a particular country.

tools.name: Get latest natural disasters by coordinates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve latest natural disaster data (earthquakes, floods, droughts, volcanic eruptions) for a specific location using geographic coordinates. Use when you need up-to-date disaster information for a particular latitude and longitude.

tools.name: Get Elevation by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve elevation statistics (min, max, mean) for a specific latitude and longitude. Use when you need geospatial elevation data for a location within North America.

tools.name: Get Elevation by Place
tools.description: Retrieve elevation statistics (minimum, maximum, and mean) for a location by place name. Returns elevation data in meters above sea level. This endpoint has global coverage and is updated every 6 months. Use this when you have a place name (like "San Francisco, USA" or "Tokyo") and need detailed elevation information.

tools.name: Get Fire Risk by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve fire risk forecast and Fire Weather Index (FWI) data for specific geographic coordinates. Use when you need weekly fire risk predictions for a location over the next four weeks based on latitude and longitude.

tools.name: Get ILI Forecast by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve up to 28-day forecast of Influenza-like Illness (ILI) risk using latitude and longitude. Use when you need daily ILI risk levels for a specific location, optionally including pollen and weather details.

tools.name: Get Pollen Forecast by Place
tools.description: Tool to retrieve 48-hour pollen forecast for a specific location by place name. Use when you need hourly pollen count predictions including grass, tree, and weed pollen levels with risk assessments.

tools.name: Get Pollen History by Place
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical pollen data for a specific place name. Use after obtaining a valid place name and time range when historical pollen counts and risk levels are needed.

tools.name: Get Latest Pollen Data by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve latest pollen data for a specific geographic location using latitude and longitude coordinates. Use when you need current pollen concentration levels and risk assessments for grass, tree, and weed pollen at a location.

tools.name: Get Latest Pollen by Place
tools.description: Tool to retrieve latest pollen data for a specific place by name. Use when current pollen count and risk levels are needed for allergy awareness.

tools.name: Get Weather Forecast by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve weather forecast for a specific latitude and longitude (up to 72 hours). Use when you need predicted weather data based on geographic coordinates with customizable time intervals.

tools.name: Get Current Weather by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current weather data for a specific latitude and longitude, including temperature, pressure, humidity, and wind conditions. Use when you need real-time weather information for given coordinates.

tools.name: Get Wildfire Data by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Retrieves real-time wildfire data for a specific geographic location using latitude and longitude coordinates. Returns nearby wildfire incidents including both detected fires (from satellite imagery) and reported fires (from official sources). Each record includes location, detection time, fire category, Fire Radiative Power (FRP), Fire Weather Index (FWI), and confidence level when available. Use this tool when you need to: - Monitor wildfire activity in a specific area - Get real-time fire detection data for coordinates - Check for fire hazards at a particular location - Filter fires by type (detected vs reported) The API returns fires within a radius of the specified coordinates.

tools.name: Get Wildfire Data by Place
tools.description: Retrieves real-time wildfire data for a specific location by place name. Returns wildfire incidents from the last 7 days including both satellite-detected fires and officially reported fires. Each record includes precise location coordinates, detection time, fire intensity metrics (FRP, FWI), fire category, and confidence level. Use this tool when you need to: - Check for active wildfires in a city, state, or country - Monitor fire activity in a specific geographic area - Get recent wildfire detection data without knowing exact coordinates - Filter fires by type (satellite-detected vs officially reported) The API searches within a geographic area around the place name provided. More specific locations (e.g., "San Francisco, CA") return more localized results than broad queries (e.g., "California").

tools.name: Get Wildfire Risk Forecast by Place
tools.description: Tool to retrieve wildfire risk forecast for a specific place. Use when you need weekly wildfire risk predictions for a location over the next four weeks.

tools.name: Reverse Geocode by Latitude and Longitude
tools.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates into human-readable location data (address, place name, postal code). Use when you have latitude and longitude and need to get the corresponding address or location details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique Ambee API key.

name: Ambient Weather
description: Ambient Weather provides personal weather stations and an API for accessing real-time and historical weather data.

tools.name: Get Devices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of user's Ambient Weather devices with their most recent data. Use when you need to list your stations and view their latest readings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Grants access to past and present data for a user's devices. Obtainable from the AmbientWeather.net account page.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: Identifies the developer/application. Required for each application developed. Obtainable from the AmbientWeather.net account page.

name: Ambiguous MCP
description: Operate an Ambiguous workspace through its provider-hosted MCP server, including documents, spreadsheets, tasks, CRM, calendar, mail, chat, and administration. Uses the connected account’s workspace-scoped API key. Some tools send external messages, delete data, change access, or consume the workspace action allowance.

tools.name: Ack mentions activity
tools.description: Acknowledge the Mentions & reactions inbox after it has been displayed. Marks the caller's unread chat mention notifications read and stamps users.mentions_acked_at, so the projector recomputes both chat.mentions and chat.reactions to 0 durably (the sidebar "Mentions & reactions" item un-bolds and stays cleared across re-fetch). Per-channel read cursors are untouched, so channel message unread counts are unaffected; a reaction that arrives after the ack re-bolds the item.

tools.name: Ack thread activity
tools.description: Acknowledge readable Threads inbox activity on entry without advancing personal read cursors or clearing explicit manual unread intent.

tools.name: Add conditional format
tools.description: Add a conditional formatting rule to a spreadsheet. Provide one of booleanRule, gradientRule, iconSetRule, or dataBarRule. The server generates a unique ID for the rule.

tools.name: Add connected element
tools.description: Extend a flow: place a new node beside an existing element and connect them in one call — the server computes the position unless you pass `drop_point`. Use this instead of create_canvas_element + a manual connector when building a flowchart, product map, or swimlane step-by-step. Give `source_element_id` and a `direction` (n/s/e/w); the new node lands one standard gap on that side and is nudged clear of any overlap, and a connector is created pre-attached from the source to it. For a drag-to-empty gesture, supply optional `drop_point: { x, y }` to center the new node at that board-space point instead of automatic placement. Provide `element` for the new node's type (connector/frame/swimlane not allowed here), or omit it to duplicate the source. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: add_connected_element({ id: "<boardId>", source_element_id: "<elId>", direction: "e", element: { type: "shape", shape: "diamond" } }) → { element, connector }.

tools.name: Add deal line item
tools.description: Add a line item to a deal. Either reference an existing product (via product_id) or create a custom line by providing name and unit_price. The deal amount is auto-recalculated.

tools.name: Add forwarding address
tools.description: Add a forwarding address (sends verification email).

tools.name: Add pipeline member
tools.description: Add (or update the role of) a user or team on a CRM pipeline. Provide either user_id or team_id, plus role (admin | member). Admins/owners and pipeline admins can manage members.

tools.name: Add shared drive member
tools.description: Add a member (manager-only).

tools.name: Add sheet column
tools.description: Add a column to a sheet tab.

tools.name: Add sheet rows
tools.description: Append rows to a sheet tab. Each row is an object keyed by column ID. Example: [{"A": "Widget", "B": 9.99}].

tools.name: Add sheet tab
tools.description: Add a new tab to a sheet. Auto-generates the name if not provided.

tools.name: Add slide
tools.description: Add a new slide to an existing presentation. Provide the slide as a JSON object with layout, background, and elements. Each element has a type (text, image, shape, table, video, group), position (x, y), size (w, h), and type-specific properties. IMPORTANT: Create SEPARATE text elements for each visual block (title, each bullet point, each paragraph). Do NOT put multiple lines or bullet points in a single text element — create one element per line with proper positioning. Use bullet character '•' instead of markdown '*' or '-'. Set fontSize and fontWeight per element for visual hierarchy. If the user is currently viewing a presentation, use the presentation ID from the page context.

tools.name: Add task attachment
tools.description: Attach a Drive file to a task. Idempotent — re-attaching the same file returns the existing row. Attaching makes the file readable by everyone who can read the task, so a file you do not own needs the share right on it (403 `file_attach_requires_share` when you can only view it).

tools.name: Add team member
tools.description: Add a user to a team with an optional role (admin or member). Only team admins or workspace admins can add members. Default role is 'member'. Use this when the user asks to add someone to a team or distribution list.

tools.name: Admin integration delete
tools.description: disconnect an integration

tools.name: Admin integrations list
tools.description: list all integrations for workspace

tools.name: Admin integrations slack channels
tools.description: list Slack channels via bot token

tools.name: Admin integration update
tools.description: update integration config

tools.name: Admin invite delete
tools.description: Revoke (cancel) a pending invite. Pending only — an accepted or expired invite is refused `409 invite_not_pending`; its row is history, not a live grant.

tools.name: Admin invite resend
tools.description: Resend invite email + refresh expiry. The email carries a freshly minted link, so every link sent before for this invite stops working. Pending invites only — an accepted or expired invite is refused `409 invite_not_pending`.

tools.name: Admin invites list
tools.description: List pending, accepted, and expired workspace invites, pending first and then newest. Paginated; `pending_total` counts invites awaiting acceptance. Each row also carries `delivery` — what the provider said about the latest send of that invite email, so a bounced invite is distinguishable from an ignored one.

tools.name: Admin mail suppression create
tools.description: manually add a suppression

tools.name: Admin mail suppression delete
tools.description: remove a suppression

tools.name: Admin mail suppressions list
tools.description: list suppressed addresses

tools.name: Admin notification defaults get
tools.description: Read workspace-default email notification prefs. Returns sensible defaults (all enabled) when never configured.

tools.name: Admin notification defaults update
tools.description: Partially update workspace-default email notification prefs. Emits settings.updated audit event.

tools.name: Admin usage export
tools.description: Export usage stats as CSV

tools.name: Admin usage timeseries
tools.description: Daily creation counts (last 14 days, split into "last 7" + "prior 7" windows) for the four hero metrics on the Overview tab. Returns `{users, documents, messages, emails}` each with `{buckets[7], total, previous_total}` so the UI can draw a sparkline + render a 7...

tools.name: Admin user get
tools.description: Get one workspace user's full admin record by id.

tools.name: Admin user reset password
tools.description: Create and email a one-hour password-reset link. On delivery failure, returns `sent: false` with `reset_url`.

tools.name: Admin user suspend
tools.description: Suspend a user account. Suspended accounts return 403 on all API calls.

tools.name: Admin user unsuspend
tools.description: Unsuspend a user account. Restores access to all API calls.

tools.name: Admin workspace logo delete
tools.description: Remove workspace logo (admin only)

tools.name: Analytics annotations list
tools.description: List a project's annotations, oldest date first: each is a date, an optional end date, a short text and its author, drawn on every time-series chart in the project. `from`/`to` keep only annotations overlapping that range.

tools.name: Analytics catalog overrides list
tools.description: List catalog metadata overrides for the workspace.

tools.name: Analytics catalog stats
tools.description: Per-event last_seen_at and 30-day volume for the workspace's tracked events.

tools.name: Analytics cohorts get
tools.description: Read a saved cohort's name, stored criteria and member-count snapshot by ID, without recomputing its audience. Use analytics_cohorts_list to find cohort IDs. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics cohorts list
tools.description: List saved cohort reports in the active workspace, including their definitions and stored member counts. Lists one Analytics project (`project_id`) and requires a role on it.

tools.name: Analytics dashboards get
tools.description: Read a saved analytics dashboard's name, stored query and tile layout by ID. Requires a role on the dashboard's project; unavailable dashboards return not found. Use analytics_dashboards_list to find accessible IDs. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics dashboards list
tools.description: List the saved analytics dashboards of one Analytics project (`project_id`), including their tile layouts. Everyone who can view the project sees every dashboard in it. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics events get
tools.description: Read one Analytics evidence event owned by the caller's source workspace. Foreign and missing IDs return 404.

tools.name: Analytics events list
tools.description: List source-owned Analytics evidence with bounded filters and stable pagination. Measured group IDs never grant access.

tools.name: Analytics funnels get
tools.description: Read a saved funnel report's name and stored conversion query definition by ID, without running the funnel. Use analytics_funnels_list to find report IDs. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics funnels list
tools.description: List saved funnel reports in the active workspace, including their names and conversion query definitions. Lists one Analytics project (`project_id`) and requires a role on it.

tools.name: Analytics insights get
tools.description: Read a saved insights report's name and stored query definition by ID, without executing the query. Use analytics_insights_list to find report IDs. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics insights list
tools.description: List saved insights reports in the active workspace, including their names and query definitions. Lists one Analytics project (`project_id`) and requires a role on it.

tools.name: Analytics metric definitions list
tools.description: List metric definitions visible in the named Analytics project, or its workspace default when omitted. management=true instead reads the workspace-wide admin catalog. Each definition includes its newest stored period.

tools.name: Analytics metrics upsert
tools.description: Upsert external metric rows (ad spend, cloud spend, incident minutes) keyed by metric, grain, period and dimensions. A row replaces the live value only when its observed_at is newer; an older observation is kept in the restatement history and reported as stale. Requires workspace admin rank and the analytics.write scope; the public write key is refused.

tools.name: Analytics metric value
tools.description: Read one number from a saved insight or funnel over a window: the value, the same metric over the window before it, a sparkline and a link to the report. Embedded metrics on canvas, in chips and in sheets read through this. Example: report=insights:<id>&from=today-28d&to=now.

tools.name: Analytics mv metadata
tools.description: Get materialized view name and last refresh time.

tools.name: Analytics projects access request create
tools.description: Ask the project's owners for access at viewer or editor. Must ask higher than the role held (`400 access_role_not_higher`); `409 access_request_open` while one is open; `404` for an unknown project.

tools.name: Analytics projects access request current
tools.description: Return whether the caller has an open access request for the project.

tools.name: Analytics projects access request decide
tools.description: Approve at viewer or editor, or decline, an open access request. Project owners only. Returns 409 once decided.

tools.name: Analytics projects get
tools.description: Read one Analytics project, its view and the caller's role. `404` when the caller holds no role on it.

tools.name: Analytics projects list
tools.description: List the Analytics projects the caller holds a role on, each with its view and the caller's role. Workspace admins hold no implicit role: a private project an admin was not added to is not listed.

tools.name: Analytics projects permissions list
tools.description: List the project's members: users and teams with their roles. The Everyone team row is the workspace tier.

tools.name: Analytics query execute
tools.description: Execute an ad-hoc analytics query (events/insights/funnel/retention/cohort). Returns structured results over the project's view (the workspace default project when project_id is omitted).

tools.name: Analytics restricted marks list
tools.description: List the workspace's restricted event names, trait keys and metric keys. Workspace admin only.

tools.name: Analytics retentions get
tools.description: Read a saved retention report's name and stored query definition by ID, without computing retention. Use analytics_retentions_list to find report IDs. Requires a role on the report's project; `404` otherwise.

tools.name: Analytics retentions list
tools.description: List saved retention reports in the active workspace, including their names and query definitions. Lists one Analytics project (`project_id`) and requires a role on it.

tools.name: Analytics settings get
tools.description: Get the workspace's analytics settings — the timezone calendar windows such as today-7d and day/week/month buckets resolve in.

tools.name: Analytics users aggregates
tools.description: List analytics user profiles from the materialized view (faster at high volume, nightly refresh). Falls back to direct read when MV is unavailable.

tools.name: Analytics users list
tools.description: List analytics user profiles (paginated, searchable). Returns traits, first_seen, last_identified.

tools.name: Analytics user timeline
tools.description: Get a user's event timeline with session grouping (30-min inactivity split). Walks the alias graph (depth 5) to include all prior identities.

tools.name: Analytics write key list
tools.description: List all writeKeys for the workspace (plaintext never returned on list).

tools.name: Append sheet values
tools.description: Append rows of values to a sheet at the first empty row in a range. The server finds the insertion point — no need to read the last row first. Uses OVERWRITE semantics (does not shift existing data).

tools.name: Apply deal template
tools.description: Create a new deal from a saved deal template. The template provides default pipeline, stage, amount, probability, and line items. Use this when starting a deal that matches a known pattern (e.g., 'Standard Enterprise Plan').

tools.name: Apply master to slide
tools.description: Link a master slide to a specific slide by 0-based index. The slide stores a by-reference link, retains its existing elements as child-owned content, and clears prior master-element override markers. Current master elements inherit at render time and future master edits flow through automatically.

tools.name: Apply task template
tools.description: Create a new task by applying a template's defaults. The template pre-fills status, priority, estimate, assignee, description, and labels. Override any field by passing it explicitly. Title is always required.

tools.name: Apply transition to all
tools.description: Apply a slide transition to every slide in the deck. Set transition.type to 'none' to clear transitions on all slides. Prefer duration_s (float seconds, 0.1–10); legacy speed presets map to slow=1.0s, medium=0.5s, fast=0.3s.

tools.name: Archive mail thread
tools.description: Archive every inbox-folder message in a thread

tools.name: Asset get content
tools.description: An image inside a doc, sheet, slide deck, canvas board, wiki page or task description is an asset of that container, not a Drive file: it never appears in Drive, and it is readable exactly when its container is. Returns the image bytes when the caller can read the container — through the document's role, the wiki page's role or the task's access check, collaborators in other workspaces included. Bytes are proxied, never redirected, with `Cache-Control: no-store`; an active type such as SVG is served as a download. Every miss is the same 404.

tools.name: Assign role
tools.description: Assign a role to a user. Requires admin role.

tools.name: Auth whoami
tools.description: Return the current authenticated user's profile (works with both JWT and API-key auth), including active workspace name + ID and agent kind + manager when applicable. needs_workspace_setup: true indicates the account has no workspace yet.

tools.name: Automations enqueue
tools.description: Queue an enabled automation for background execution. Send a JSON object with an optional payload object containing the trigger data. Returns 202 Accepted with run_id, status and status_url; the Location response header points to GET /api/automations/runs/{run_id}. Poll with the same credential until success, failed, filtered, cancelled or depth_exceeded. The durable scheduler resumes queued work. Dry runs use /api/automations/{id}/test instead; _test_mode is rejected on this endpoint.

tools.name: Batch archive emails
tools.description: Archive multiple emails in one atomic call. Moves all specified messages to the archive folder. Use this when the user wants to bulk-archive many emails (e.g., inbox-zero cleanup, archiving all messages from a sender).

tools.name: Batch clear sheet values
tools.description: Clear all cell values in multiple ranges atomically. Sets cells to null without removing rows or columns. Useful for resetting template sheets or clearing data regions.

tools.name: Batch file permissions
tools.description: Batch-fetch permissions for up to 50 files by ID. Returns a map of file_id → permissions array.

tools.name: Batch get contacts
tools.description: Fetch multiple CRM contacts by their IDs in a single request (max 100). Missing or inaccessible IDs are silently omitted from the result.

tools.name: Batch get deals
tools.description: Fetch multiple CRM deals by their IDs in a single request (max 100). Missing or inaccessible IDs are silently omitted from the result.

tools.name: Batch get files
tools.description: Batch-fetch up to 50 files by ID. Powers drive:// embed hydration in Chat/Docs/Wiki/CRM.

tools.name: Batch get sheet values
tools.description: Fetch multiple disjoint ranges from a spreadsheet in a single request. Avoids N sequential round-trips when reading KPIs from different regions.

tools.name: Batch modify emails
tools.description: Batch modify multiple emails in one atomic call. Can star/unstar, mark read/unread, add/remove labels, and change folder — all at once for up to 500 messages. Use this when the user wants to bulk-update many emails (e.g., star all from a sender, mark a batch as read, apply labels to multiple messages).

tools.name: Batch trash emails
tools.description: Trash multiple emails in one atomic call. Moves all specified messages to the trash folder. Use this when the user wants to bulk-trash many emails (e.g., spam cleanup, clearing a project mailbox).

tools.name: Block sender
tools.description: Block a sender (address or domain).

tools.name: Book event resources
tools.description: Book one or more resources (rooms, equipment) for an existing event. Returns a conflict error if a resource is already booked.

tools.name: Browse public channels
tools.description: Browse the workspace's public channels, including the ones the caller has not joined, each with a `joined` flag and member count. `list_channels` returns memberships only, so this is the only way to discover a public channel you are not in and get the id `chat_channel_join` needs. Private channels and DMs are never listed. Use this when the user asks what channels exist, or asks to join a channel by name.

tools.name: Bulk archive tasks
tools.description: Archive up to 100 tasks at once. Only archives tasks the caller created or is assigned to.

tools.name: Bulk copy files
tools.description: Copy multiple files to a folder (max 100). The destination needs editor access (contributor in a shared drive); a folder the caller cannot see answers 404 like one that does not exist, and a visible one they cannot write to answers 403. A copy into a shared-drive folder belongs to that drive.

tools.name: Bulk delete contacts
tools.description: Delete many CRM contacts in a single operation. Returns counts of deleted/skipped/failed items.

tools.name: Bulk delete deals
tools.description: Delete many CRM deals at once by their ids.

tools.name: Bulk delete messages
tools.description: Soft-delete up to 100 messages in a channel. Deletes only the IDs the caller may delete (own messages, or any message when the caller is a channel admin); every other ID returns in `rejected`. Emits one bulk `message.deleted` event, never one per message.

tools.name: Bulk delete tasks
tools.description: Soft-delete multiple tasks at once by ID. Only deletes tasks the current user created. Max 100 task IDs per call. Subtasks cascade. Use `restore_task` to recover individually.

tools.name: Bulk export contacts
tools.description: Export selected contacts as CSV or vCard. CSV includes core fields and custom properties; vCard preserves imported RFC 6350 properties and parameters.

tools.name: Bulk export deals
tools.description: Export selected deals as CSV

tools.name: Bulk move files
tools.description: Move multiple files to a folder (max 100). The destination needs editor access (contributor in a shared drive); a folder the caller cannot see answers 404 like one that does not exist, and a visible one they cannot write to answers 403. Per-file failures come back in `errors`: "File not found" for a file the caller cannot view, "Forbidden" for one they can view but not edit. An item whose sharing is restricted (editors can't share, on it or a folder above it) moves only with its owner.

tools.name: Bulk update contacts
tools.description: Update many CRM contacts in a single operation. Useful for re-assigning ownership, updating lifecycle stage on a list of contacts, or reclassifying industry. Provide an array of contact IDs and the fields to apply to all of them.

tools.name: Bulk update deals
tools.description: Update many CRM deals in a single operation. Useful for moving multiple deals to a new stage, reassigning ownership, or marking a batch of deals as won/lost. Provide an array of deal IDs and the fields to apply.

tools.name: Bulk update tasks
tools.description: Update multiple tasks at once by ID. Only updates tasks the current user has access to (creator or assignee). Max 200 task IDs per call. Omit fields you do not want to change. Pass `null` to clear a nullable field (assignee_id, project_id, due_date, goal_id, task_status_id).

tools.name: Calendar conflicts
tools.description: Detect attendee scheduling conflicts.

tools.name: Calendar event export ics
tools.description: Export single event as .ics.

tools.name: Calendar event meeting notes create
tools.description: Create a meeting-notes doc for an event, or — when `document_id` is given — link that existing doc and grant attendees access.

tools.name: Calendar event meeting notes unlink
tools.description: Unlink meeting-notes doc.

tools.name: Calendar event reminders create
tools.description: Add a reminder to a calendar event.

tools.name: Calendar event reminders list
tools.description: List event reminders.

tools.name: Calendar event reminders set
tools.description: Replace reminder list.

tools.name: Calendar event unbook resources
tools.description: Release every resource booked for a calendar event.

tools.name: Calendar export ics
tools.description: Export entire calendar as .ics.

tools.name: Calendar external auth url
tools.description: Start external provider OAuth.

tools.name: Calendar external calendars enable sync
tools.description: Enable two-way sync.

tools.name: Calendar external calendars list
tools.description: List calendars on connection.

tools.name: Calendar external connection delete
tools.description: Disconnect external account.

tools.name: Calendar external connections list
tools.description: List connected external accounts.

tools.name: Calendar external force sync
tools.description: Schedule every mirror calendar on this connection for an immediate background pull. Poll the connection's `last_sync_at`; completion is any value at or after `requested_at`.

tools.name: Calendar external synced disable
tools.description: Disable sync for one calendar.

tools.name: Calendar import ics url
tools.description: Import an .ics feed by URL. Fetches the URL server-side and imports its events into the calendar.

tools.name: Calendar reminder delete
tools.description: Delete one calendar event reminder by id.

tools.name: Calendar resource delete
tools.description: Delete a bookable calendar resource by id.

tools.name: Calendar resource get
tools.description: Get one bookable calendar resource by id.

tools.name: Calendar resources create
tools.description: Create a bookable resource.

tools.name: Calendar resource update
tools.description: Update a bookable calendar resource's details.

tools.name: Calendars create
tools.description: Create a calendar in the current workspace.

tools.name: Calendars delete
tools.description: Delete a calendar and every event on it.

tools.name: Calendars permissions get
tools.description: Get a single user's permission entry on a calendar, including their role, display name, and email. Useful for checking if a specific user has access without listing all permissions.

tools.name: Calendars update
tools.description: Update calendar fields.

tools.name: Calendar upcoming reminders
tools.description: Reminders due to fire within the next `window_hours` (default 24, max 168), soonest first. Each row carries the event it is about — title, span, status, location and calendar — so the caller renders the row without a second fetch.

tools.name: Cancel scheduled email
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled email

tools.name: Cancel scheduled message
tools.description: Cancel a pending scheduled message so it's never sent. Use this when the user says 'never mind' or changes their plan before the scheduled time.

tools.name: Cancel scheduler booking
tools.description: Cancel a booking as its host. The booked event is cancelled and the booker is always emailed the cancellation, with the optional message.

tools.name: Change coworker manager
tools.description: Reassign the accountable human (manager) for a coworker. Admin-only — the current manager cannot reassign themselves out. Changing manager revokes the coworker's existing API keys and realtime sessions; the new manager must reconnect it. An unchanged manager keeps keys.

tools.name: Chat channel create
tools.description: Create a chat channel in the workspace.

tools.name: Chat channel delete
tools.description: Delete a chat channel and its messages.

tools.name: Chat channel get
tools.description: Get a specific channel by UUID, with members.

tools.name: Chat channel group remove
tools.description: Remove a group from channel (clean up fan-out rows)

tools.name: Chat channel join
tools.description: Self-join a public channel (no body required)

tools.name: Chat channel last messages
tools.description: Batch-fetch the latest message preview for multiple channels in one request. Pass `ids` as a comma-separated list of channel IDs (max 100). Returns one entry per channel the caller can read, each carrying its `channel_id`. Replaces per-channel `GET /messages?limit=1` calls so a DMs/channels list renders previews without an N+1 request fan-out.

tools.name: Chat channel leave
tools.description: Leave a chat channel you belong to.

tools.name: Chat channel member remove
tools.description: Remove a member from a chat channel.

tools.name: Chat channel members add
tools.description: Add member(s) or a group

tools.name: Chat channel notification preference
tools.description: Choose your channel notification preference, not mute/unmute; use set_channel_muted for that. unread_only (default) surfaces unread activity; all_messages also notifies on unmuted messages. mentions_only shows mention badges; nothing hides channel unread/badge indicators and suppresses keyword and subscribed-thread alerts. Direct mention and broadcast notification delivery remains separate. This does not change the mute indicator or expiry. Per-user; other members are unchanged.

tools.name: Chat channel notification prefs
tools.description: Update the caller's per-channel notification preferences (unread_display: count | dot | since_visit).

tools.name: Chat channel update
tools.description: Update a chat channel's name, topic or settings.

tools.name: Chat draft create saved
tools.description: Create a saved (named) draft for the caller.

tools.name: Chat draft delete
tools.description: Delete a draft owned by the caller.

tools.name: Chat drafts list
tools.description: The caller's chat drafts (inflight + saved), newest first.

tools.name: Chat draft update
tools.description: Update a saved draft owned by the caller.

tools.name: Chat emoji image
tools.description: Serve custom emoji image from GCS

tools.name: Chat mentions inbox
tools.description: Messages from other users that @-mention the caller. Powers the Mentions tab.

tools.name: Chat message delete
tools.description: Delete one message from a chat channel.

tools.name: Chat message update
tools.description: Edit message or pin/unpin

tools.name: Chat preferences
tools.description: Workspace-level chat preferences readable by any authenticated member (default_reactions).

tools.name: Chat reactions inbox
tools.description: Messages authored by the caller that carry reactions from other users. Powers the Mentions & Reactions inbox.

tools.name: Chat saved ids list
tools.description: Get saved message IDs for a channel (for UI bookmarked state)

tools.name: Chat sidebar create section
tools.description: Create a custom chat-sidebar section for the caller.

tools.name: Chat sidebar delete section
tools.description: Delete a chat-sidebar section owned by the caller.

tools.name: Chat sidebar list sections
tools.description: The caller's custom chat-sidebar sections, ordered by position.

tools.name: Chat sidebar reorder sections
tools.description: Reorder the caller's chat-sidebar sections.

tools.name: Chat sidebar update section
tools.description: Rename a chat-sidebar section or set its channels.

tools.name: Chat thread activity list
tools.description: List thread-activity inbox for the current user. Powers the sidebar "Threads" inbox entry. Returns readable threads the user participates in or explicitly marked unread, with peer-only unread counts and own-inclusive unread anchors.

tools.name: Chat thread get
tools.description: Get the replies in a chat message's thread.

tools.name: Check availability
tools.description: Check free/busy availability for one or more users in a given time range. Returns busy time slots (not event details) for each user. Use this when the user asks to find a free time, check if someone is available, or schedule a meeting. Call this before create_event to avoid scheduling conflicts.

tools.name: Check resource availability
tools.description: Check if a specific resource (room, equipment) is free in a time range. Call before booking to avoid conflicts.

tools.name: Check workspace slug
tools.description: Check whether a workspace slug is available.

tools.name: Claim document
tools.description: Make an unclaimed document yours. A document, spreadsheet, presentation or board created without an account returns a single-use `claim_key`; call this with it after signing in and the document moves into your active workspace with you as owner, keeping its id and URL. Its link drops to view-only, which you can raise again. A second claim of the same document, or a wrong key, is refused with 409 `claim_rejected`, which does not say which.

tools.name: Clear calendar
tools.description: Delete ALL events from a calendar. Owner-only — use for resetting shared calendars at quarter boundaries or wiping test data. Returns the count of deleted events. This is irreversible.

tools.name: Clear reminder
tools.description: Clear a pending reminder on a saved message. The message stays saved; only the reminder is removed.

tools.name: Clear sheet validation
tools.description: Remove a data validation rule from a spreadsheet by range. The range is matched after normalization (sheet tab defaults to Sheet1 if not specified). Returns 404 if no rule exists for that range.

tools.name: Clear user status
tools.description: Clear the current user's status (emoji + text + expiresAt). Does NOT change DND — use set_user_dnd with until=null to clear DND separately.

tools.name: Code comment update
tools.description: Edit or delete an owned comment; maintainers may delete published comments. Concurrent edits require the last observed body. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code connections list
tools.description: List repositories offered by the workspace GitHub installation. Workspace administrators only.

tools.name: Code pull auto merge
tools.description: Enable or cancel durable Code auto-merge using the PR review policy and GitHub checks. Requires merge authority and the last read version. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull changes since review
tools.description: Compare the caller's last reviewed head with the current head. Historical or truncated source is explicitly reported.

tools.name: Code pull comment
tools.description: Start a discussion or reply to a thread. Inline comments retain their original revision and source excerpt. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull commit
tools.description: Read the diff for one commit in this pull request.

tools.name: Code pull create
tools.description: Create or adopt a GitHub pull request with an accountable Ambiguous author. An omitted base uses the repository's default target branch. Retries use the same idempotency key. autoMerge arms auto-merge on the new pull request in the same call, so it needs no version and cannot race the first check update; it requires merge authority on the repository and is ignored when the key or number returns an existing Code pull request. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull export
tools.description: Export the complete review record with original anchors and attribution as versioned JSON or Markdown.

tools.name: Code pull get
tools.description: Read a native review, its revision, discussion, checks and merge blockers. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull merge
tools.description: Merge the confirmed pull request version into its existing target after fresh revision, authorization, review-policy and GitHub checks. No target branch is accepted. The provider confirms the outcome; uncertain requests remain pending. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull refresh
tools.description: Reconcile with current GitHub state. Never interprets an older webhook as current source truth. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pull review
tools.description: Submit a review for the specified comparison as an authenticated user or agent with repository review permission. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code pulls list
tools.description: Permission-filtered pull request inbox.

tools.name: Code pull update
tools.description: Edit metadata, assign reviewers, follow, close, reopen or mark ready. Requires the last read version. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code repositories list
tools.description: List repositories the caller can read, with their Code role.

tools.name: Code repository compare
tools.description: Compare two repository refs before opening a pull request.

tools.name: Code repository connect
tools.description: Connect a repository from this workspace's existing GitHub installation. Workspace admin only; grants the connector repository ownership.

tools.name: Code repository grant
tools.description: Grant or revoke a workspace user or team. Null role revokes. Repository owner only.

tools.name: Code repository grants
tools.description: Read repository access grants. Repository owner only.

tools.name: Code repository metadata
tools.description: Read the repository labels and milestones available for pull requests.

tools.name: Code repository principals
tools.description: List workspace users and teams available for an explicit repository grant. Repository owner only.

tools.name: Code repository reviewers
tools.description: List currently eligible Ambiguous reviewers, including agents.

tools.name: Code repository update
tools.description: Update the default target branch, review policy or connection. A null target resets to GitHub's default branch. Repository owner only.

tools.name: Code review dismiss
tools.description: Dismiss a blocking review with an auditable reason. Maintainer only. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Code review resolve
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a review without changing its verdict. The PR author or maintainer may resolve another reviewer's feedback. The response carries every file patch, thread and activity entry. Pass `fields` to return only what you need, for example `id,version,blockers,data(autoMerge,mergeIntent,syncError,provider(state,headSha,baseSha,baseRef,mergeable,checks))`.

tools.name: Compute pivot table
tools.description: Compute the result of a persisted pivot table — applies row/column grouping, value aggregation, sort orders, and any matching slicer filters, and returns the rendered cells. The pivot config itself (row/column/value fields, source range) is not modified.

tools.name: Compute wiki rollups
tools.description: Compute and return rollup values for all rows in the database. Each rollup aggregates a property across related rows.

tools.name: Copy sheet to
tools.description: Copy a sheet tab from one spreadsheet to another. Deep-copies columns, rows, formulas, formatting, and merges. Cross-document formulas will show as #REF!. Requires viewer access on source and editor access on destination.

tools.name: Coworkers conversation get
tools.description: Proxy (workspace-isolated): get a single conversation thread.

tools.name: Coworkers conversations list
tools.description: Proxy (workspace-isolated): list conversations for the coworker in the active workspace.

tools.name: Coworkers execution cancel
tools.description: Kill switch: cancel an in-flight execution. Flips an active (PENDING/RUNNING/PAUSED) coworker_executions row to CANCELLED; the coworker's execution loop aborts at its next action-call boundary. Idempotent no-op on an already-terminal execution.

tools.name: Coworkers execution get
tools.description: Get one execution with full trace data — task row, parent/children lineage, conversation, reasoning cycles, and tool-call activities. Powers the Execution Trace debug view.

tools.name: Coworkers executions list
tools.description: Proxy: list coworker execution history (paginated).

tools.name: Coworkers monitored channels add
tools.description: Proxy (workspace-isolated): start monitoring a channel.

tools.name: Coworkers monitored channels list
tools.description: Proxy (workspace-isolated): list channels the coworker is monitoring.

tools.name: Coworkers monitored channels remove
tools.description: Proxy (workspace-isolated): stop monitoring a channel.

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks archive
tools.description: Archive a playbook. Archived playbooks are hidden from lists and cannot be selected during dispatch, but remain linked to historical executions for audit.

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks create
tools.description: Create a playbook and its initial version. `instructions` and `subtasks` seed version 1, which becomes the current version.

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks delete
tools.description: Delete a playbook and its versions. Returns 409 if any coworker_executions still reference the playbook — use the archive endpoint to retire it instead.

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks get
tools.description: Get one playbook with its current version's instructions and subtasks.

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks list
tools.description: List the coworker's playbooks (metadata + current version pointer).

tools.name: Coworkers playbooks update
tools.description: Edit playbook metadata in place (title, objective). Instructions and subtasks are immutable — create a new version instead.

tools.name: Coworkers playbook versions create
tools.description: Append a new version. Auto-increments the version number and marks the new version current. Prior versions stay readable for audit.

tools.name: Coworkers playbook versions get
tools.description: Get one historical version's instructions and subtasks.

tools.name: Coworkers playbook versions list
tools.description: List all versions of a playbook, newest first.

tools.name: Coworkers rotate token
tools.description: Rotate the management token used to talk to the coworker service.

tools.name: Create canvas
tools.description: Create a new (empty) canvas — a Miro-style infinite whiteboard. Use when starting a fresh flowchart, product map, or swimlane flow; returns the canvas envelope with an empty `data.elements`, then add objects with create_canvas_element. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: create_canvas({ title: "Q1 product map" }) → { id: "<boardId>", data: { elements: [] } }.

tools.name: Create canvas element
tools.description: Add one element to a board — a sticky, text, shape, image, codeBlock, frame, swimlane, connector, or metric. Use when placing a new object; to attach a connector so it re-routes when shapes move, set each endpoint to an existing element id with an anchor (n/s/e/w) — free-form points stay fixed and never follow a move, so use them only for unattached lines. Provide `type` and geometry; the server mints the element id and returns it, and every other element on the board is untouched. Fields are flat, never nested under `element`, and `id` is the board. Send only the fields of that type: sticky and text take `content`; shape takes `shape` and `content`; image takes `src`; codeBlock takes `code` and `language`; frame takes `name` and an optional `metricWindow`; metric takes `report` (insights:<id> or funnels:<id>, a saved analytics report), optional `step`, `title` and `window` ({ from, to } like today-28d / now) and renders that report's live value; connector takes `from` and `to` as `{ element, anchor }` or `{ point: { x, y } }`, with `x`,`y`,`w`,`h` all 0. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down — pass `x`,`y` (the element's top-left corner) with `w`,`h`. Example: create_canvas_element({ id: "<boardId>", type: "sticky", x: 100, y: 80, w: 160, h: 120, content: "Idea" }).

tools.name: Create chart
tools.description: Embed a chart on a tab of the sheet. Charts visualize a rectangular data range — pick a chart type (bar / line / pie / scatter), the source range, and an overlay position. Returns the created chart with its server-assigned id.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description: Create a new CRM contact (person or company). Persons can be linked to a company via company_id. IMPORTANT: Before creating a contact, ALWAYS call list_contacts with a search query (q) to check if a contact with the same name or email already exists. If a matching contact is found, use update_contact instead of creating a duplicate. Only create a new contact if no match is found. Use this when the user asks to add a contact, log a lead, or create a company record.

tools.name: Create contact group
tools.description: Create a named contact group for organizing contacts. Groups allow overlapping membership — a contact can be in multiple groups.

tools.name: Create crm property definition
tools.description: Define a typed custom property for contacts or deals. field_type 'relation' (with relation_target contact|company|deal) makes the property a link to another record: values written to custom_properties under this key must be the id of an existing record of the target type.

tools.name: Create crm view
tools.description: Create a saved CRM view: a named filter+sort preset for contacts, companies, or deals. Useful when the user asks to 'save this filter' or 'create a view for high-value deals'.

tools.name: Create data connector
tools.description: Create a new data connector that fetches data into specific cells of a sheet. After creating, call run_data_connector to execute it.

tools.name: Create deal
tools.description: Create a new CRM deal (revenue opportunity). Deals belong to a pipeline and sit in a specific stage. Link to a contact and/or company. Use this when the user asks to create a deal, log an opportunity, or start tracking a sale.

tools.name: Create deal template
tools.description: Create a deal template — a reusable preset for creating deals with standard pipeline/stage/amount and line items. Use when the user has a repeatable sale like 'Standard Enterprise Plan'.

tools.name: Create doc
tools.description: Create a new doc. `content` is Markdown (recommended) or a ProseMirror JSON string. Returns the created document; read, update, share and trash it through the `/api/documents/{id}` operations. For a spreadsheet use `create_sheet`, for a deck `create_presentation`, for a whiteboard `create_canvas`.

tools.name: Create draft email
tools.description: Create a draft email without sending it. The draft is saved in the drafts folder for later review, editing, or sending. Use this when the user wants to compose an email for later, save a draft, or prepare a message without sending it immediately.

tools.name: Create event
tools.description: Create a new calendar event. Requires a title, start time, and end time. Optionally add a description, location, attendees, recurrence, and more. Use this when the user asks to schedule a meeting, add an event, or book time. If the user doesn't specify a calendar, use list_calendars to find their default calendar ID first.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Drive. Returns the created folder with id, name, and path. Use this when the user asks to create, make, or add a new folder for organizing files. Supports nested folders via parent_folder_id.

tools.name: Create form
tools.description: Create a new form for collecting data (surveys, feedback, registrations, quizzes). Returns the created form with id and public slug. Use this when the user asks to create a survey, questionnaire, feedback form, registration form, or any structured data collection. Define fields with types, labels, validation, and optional conditional logic.

tools.name: Create form variant
tools.description: Create a new A/B test variant by duplicating the parent form. Optionally override fields to change question wording, field types, options, or validation. Traffic weight (0–100) controls the percentage of visitors who see this variant versus the control. Use when the user asks to set up an A/B test or add a variant.

tools.name: Create mail label
tools.description: Create a mail label for organizing threads.

tools.name: Create mail rule
tools.description: Create a mail rule that acts on matching messages.

tools.name: Create mail template
tools.description: Create a reusable mail template for composing.

tools.name: Create named range
tools.description: Create a named range or named expression on a spreadsheet. Send either an A1 range or an exact literal Excel expression, such as a structured table reference. External-workbook expressions are preserved verbatim and remain unresolved.

tools.name: Create pipeline
tools.description: Create a new CRM pipeline with ordered stages. Each stage has a name and an optional default probability (0-100). Most workspaces need only one pipeline; create additional ones for distinct sales processes (e.g., 'New Business' vs 'Renewals').

tools.name: Create pivot table
tools.description: Create a pivot table from sheet data. A new sheet tab is automatically created to hold the pivot. Specify the source data range, which columns to group by (rows/columns), and which columns to aggregate (values).

tools.name: Create presentation
tools.description: Create a new presentation deck. Omit `content` for a deck with one blank slide, or pass deck JSON to create it with its slides in place: `{ slides: [{ elements: [{ type: "text", x: 80, y: 60, w: 800, h: 80, text: "Q1 review", fontSize: 44 }] }] }`. A slide is 960 by 540 units with a top-left origin, and elements take the shape `add_slide` accepts. Returns the created `SlideDeck` envelope.

tools.name: Create product
tools.description: Create a product in the workspace catalog. Products are the reusable items that can be attached to deal line items and quote line items. Set is_active=false to retire without deleting.

tools.name: Create project
tools.description: Create a new project to group related tasks. Use this when the user asks to start a new project or create a container for tasks.

tools.name: Create project update
tools.description: Post a status update on a project. Use this when the user wants to report progress, flag a risk, or share a status update on a project. The status field captures the health signal (on_track, at_risk, off_track, paused, completed, cancelled).

tools.name: Create quote
tools.description: Create a CRM quote (proposal) with line items. Auto-computes subtotal, tax, discount, and total. Link to a deal/contact/company via IDs. Status defaults to 'draft' — use send_quote to email it.

tools.name: Create resource comment
tools.description: Create a comment on a document, task, wiki page, mail conversation, pull request, or code review. Replies use parent_id. Documents, wiki pages and Code support anchor; documents, tasks, wiki pages and Code support idempotency_key. Unsupported fields are rejected by the owning module. Mail comments are internal notes and cannot be sent as email.

tools.name: Create role
tools.description: Create a custom role with specific permissions. Requires admin role.

tools.name: Create scheduler link
tools.description: Create a scheduler link (booking page). Returns the public URL slug and availability settings. If auto_create_contact is true, every booking auto-creates a CRM contact + deal.

tools.name: Create scoring rule
tools.description: Create a lead scoring rule. When a contact matches (field + operator + value), the specified points are added to their lead score. Positive points indicate engagement; negative points indicate disqualification signals.

tools.name: Create sequence
tools.description: Create a multi-step CRM sequence (email/wait/task/call/branch steps). Use this when the user asks to build a nurture campaign or outreach cadence.

tools.name: Create shared drive
tools.description: Create a shared drive. Creator becomes a manager.

tools.name: Create sheet
tools.description: Create a new spreadsheet. Returns the full `Sheet` envelope (id, title, owner, visibility, timestamps, and `data` body) so the caller can immediately read or edit cells without a second round-trip. Optional `content` may be a SheetData JSON object or a string that parses as JSON.

tools.name: Create sheet image
tools.description: Create editable floating images with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Image src must reference an image asset owned by this sheet.

tools.name: Create sheet picture group
tools.description: Create editable picture groups with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Every leaf references an image asset owned by this sheet; native group transforms use EMU coordinates.

tools.name: Create sheet shape
tools.description: Create editable floating shapes with editable text, cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry.

tools.name: Create sign document
tools.description: Create a draft signing document.

tools.name: Create sign template
tools.description: Create a reusable signing template from field layout and signer roles.

tools.name: Create slicer
tools.description: Add a slicer to a tab of the sheet. Slicers filter pivot tables and charts that share the same source range by the values selected for a single column. `selectedValues: null` passes everything through; `[]` filters everything out; a non-empty array passes only those values. Returns the created slicer with its server-assigned id.

tools.name: Create slide master
tools.description: Create a new master slide for a deck. If no elements are provided, a default Title + Subtitle layout is used.

tools.name: Create subtask
tools.description: Create a subtask under the given parent task. Equivalent to `POST /api/tasks` with `parent_task_id` pre-filled from the URL parameter.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Create a new task. Auto-subscribes the creator and (if assigned) the assignee. Auto-sets SLA due date when priority is set without an explicit due_date. Auto-logs a CRM activity if linked to a contact.

tools.name: Create team
tools.description: Create a new team in the workspace. The caller becomes the team admin. Teams can serve as email distribution lists (when email_local_part is set) and/or permission targets. Use this when the user asks to create a team, distribution list, or mailing list.

tools.name: Create wiki page
tools.description: Create a new wiki page within a space. Pages use Markdown content and support nested hierarchies via parent_page_id. Use this when the user asks to create a wiki page, add documentation, write a runbook, or add to the knowledge base. Call list_wiki_spaces first to get the space ID.

tools.name: Create wiki page version
tools.description: Create a manual snapshot of the current wiki page state. Useful before a risky edit or when the user wants to mark a 'known good' checkpoint. Optional `label` names the snapshot. Returns the new version's id + metadata.

tools.name: Create wiki space
tools.description: Create a new wiki space (a top-level container for pages). Use this when the user asks to create a new knowledge base area, team wiki, or documentation section. Spaces organize pages by team or domain (e.g., 'Engineering', 'Product', 'Company Handbook').

tools.name: Create wiki synced block
tools.description: Create a synced block — a reusable content fragment that can be embedded in multiple wiki pages and stays in sync everywhere it's used. Returns the new block's id. Use this when the user asks to create a shared snippet, reusable callout, or cross-page content.

tools.name: Create workspace invite
tools.description: Create workspace invites. With no recipient it mints a generic shareable invite link (returned as `invite_url`) and emails nobody; with recipients it creates one invite per address and emails each. Role defaults to `member` and is forced to `member` for any value other than `admin`.

tools.name: Crm contact file attach
tools.description: Attach a Drive file to a contact. The file becomes readable by every workspace member who can read the contact, so a file you do not own needs the share right on it (403 `file_attach_requires_share` when you can only view it).

tools.name: Crm contact file detach
tools.description: Detach a file from a contact

tools.name: Crm contact files list
tools.description: List files attached to a contact

tools.name: Crm contact photo get
tools.description: Serve the photo image stored for a CRM contact.

tools.name: Crm deal activities
tools.description: List activities for deal (owner-scoped)

tools.name: Crm deal file attach
tools.description: Attach a Drive file to a deal. The file becomes readable by everyone who can read the deal, so a file you do not own needs the share right on it (403 `file_attach_requires_share` when you can only view it).

tools.name: Crm deal file detach
tools.description: Detach a file from a deal

tools.name: Crm deal files list
tools.description: List files attached to a deal

tools.name: Crm quote pdf
tools.description: Export quote as PDF (or printable HTML with ?format=html)

tools.name: Cycles add tasks
tools.description: Add tasks to the cycle. Body `{task_ids: [...]}`.

tools.name: Cycles analytics
tools.description: Burndown + summary analytics for the cycle.

tools.name: Cycles complete
tools.description: Complete a cycle. If `auto_rollover` is set, incomplete tasks are moved to the next cycle.

tools.name: Cycles create
tools.description: Create a new cycle. Body fields: name, start_date, end_date, status?, cooldown_days?, auto_rollover?.

tools.name: Cycles delete
tools.description: Delete a cycle. Tasks attached to the cycle are unlinked, not deleted.

tools.name: Cycles get
tools.description: Get one task cycle and its dates by id.

tools.name: Cycles list
tools.description: List cycles in the active workspace. `?status=` filters by status; `?limit=` (1–200) and `?offset=` paginate. `has_more` is set when the underlying query returned a hint of more rows.

tools.name: Cycles remove tasks
tools.description: Remove tasks from the cycle. Body `{task_ids: [...]}`.

tools.name: Cycles update
tools.description: Update cycle fields.

tools.name: Cycles velocity
tools.description: Cross-cycle velocity (last N closed cycles). Default `limit=10`.

tools.name: Decide access request
tools.description: Approve an open access request at a named role, or decline it. Only principals entitled to share the resource may decide. Returns 409 once decided.

tools.name: Decide mail approval
tools.description: Approve and send, request changes, reject, or (as the sender) withdraw one submitted email. The decision names the revision it applies to: exactly one decision per revision succeeds, and a decision on a superseded revision conflicts rather than releasing content the caller has not read. Approving records the human and time against that revision; it authorizes nothing else — not the thread, not a reply, not a later email.

tools.name: Delete activity
tools.description: Delete one logged CRM activity by id.

tools.name: Delete canvas element
tools.description: Delete one element from a board by id. Use when removing an object; connectors attached to it are not auto-deleted, so patch or delete those separately. Every other element is untouched. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down (unchanged by a delete). Example: delete_canvas_element({ id: "<boardId>", elId: "<elId>" }).

tools.name: Delete chart
tools.description: Remove a chart from the sheet. Returns `{ deleted: true }` on success.

tools.name: Delete conditional format
tools.description: Delete a conditional formatting rule from a spreadsheet by its ID. Returns 200 on success, 404 if the rule does not exist.

tools.name: Delete contact
tools.description: Delete a CRM contact (owner-scoped). Permanently removes the contact record. Use with caution — prefer updating lifecycle_stage to 'evangelist' or archiving via merge instead.

tools.name: Delete contact group
tools.description: Delete a contact group. Memberships are removed but contacts themselves are preserved.

tools.name: Delete contact photo
tools.description: Delete a CRM contact's profile photo. Clears the avatar_url and removes the stored image.

tools.name: Delete coworker
tools.description: Delete a coworker (revokes API key + tears down config).

tools.name: Delete crm property definition
tools.description: Delete a custom-property definition. Existing custom_properties values are left in place; they simply stop being typed.

tools.name: Delete crm view
tools.description: Delete a saved CRM view.

tools.name: Delete custom emoji
tools.description: Delete a custom emoji from the workspace. Use this when the user asks to remove or clean up a custom emoji. This does not remove existing reactions or messages that used the emoji — it only stops new usage.

tools.name: Delete data connector
tools.description: Delete a data connector. Does not affect the cells it previously wrote to.

tools.name: Delete deal
tools.description: Delete a CRM deal (owner-scoped). Permanently removes the deal record and its line items. Prefer updating status to 'lost' with a lost_reason for reporting purposes.

tools.name: Delete deal line item
tools.description: Delete a deal line item. By default the deal's total amount is re-synced after deletion.

tools.name: Delete deal template
tools.description: Delete a deal template (does not affect deals previously created from it).

tools.name: Delete document version
