tools.description: Delete a version snapshot of a document. At least one version must always remain — returns an error if attempting to delete the last version. Requires editor permission.

tools.name: Delete email
tools.description: Delete one email message by id.

tools.name: Delete event
tools.description: Delete a calendar event. This is a destructive action — always confirm with the user before calling. If the user is currently viewing an event, use the event ID from the page context. Guests are emailed a cancellation only when `send_updates` asks for it.

tools.name: Delete file
tools.description: Delete a file or folder from Drive. This is a destructive action — always confirm with the user before executing. Deleting a folder also deletes all files inside it. Use this when the user explicitly asks to delete, remove, or trash a file or folder.

tools.name: Delete form
tools.description: Delete a form and all its responses. This is a destructive action — always confirm with the user before executing. Use this when the user explicitly asks to delete or remove a form.

tools.name: Delete form response
tools.description: Delete a single form response. This is destructive — always confirm with the user before executing. Use when the user asks to remove or delete a specific submission.

tools.name: Delete form variant
tools.description: Delete an A/B test variant (and its underlying duplicated form). Destructive — always confirm with the user. Use when the user asks to remove a variant or end an experiment.

tools.name: Delete mail label
tools.description: Delete one mail label from this mailbox.

tools.name: Delete mail rule
tools.description: Delete one mail rule by id.

tools.name: Delete mail template
tools.description: Delete one saved mail template by id.

tools.name: Delete named range
tools.description: Delete a named range from a spreadsheet by name. Names are matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: Delete pipeline
tools.description: Delete a CRM pipeline and all of its stages. Deals in the pipeline must be moved or deleted first.

tools.name: Delete pivot table
tools.description: Remove a pivot table from the sheet. The host tab itself stays — only the pivot row in `pivotTables[]` is removed. Returns `{ deleted: true }` on success.

tools.name: Delete product
tools.description: Delete a product from the workspace catalog. Existing deal/quote line items referencing it are NOT deleted, but their product_id is nulled.

tools.name: Delete project
tools.description: Delete a project by ID. Only project admins or workspace admins can delete. Tasks belonging to the project are not deleted — they become unassigned from the project.

tools.name: Delete quote
tools.description: Delete a CRM quote and its line items.

tools.name: Delete recurring event future
tools.description: Delete this and all future occurrences of a recurring event by adding an UNTIL clause to the master's RRULE, ending the series the day before the given split_date.

tools.name: Delete recurring event single
tools.description: Delete a single occurrence of a recurring event by adding the occurrence date to the master's excluded_dates. The occurrence is suppressed without affecting other instances.

tools.name: Delete resource comment
tools.description: Delete an existing document, task, wiki, mail-thread or Code comment by its comment ID. Existing author, ownership, and parent-resource permissions apply; each module's reply-deletion behavior is preserved.

tools.name: Delete role
tools.description: Delete a custom role. System roles cannot be deleted. Requires admin role.

tools.name: Delete scheduler link
tools.description: Delete a scheduler link. Existing confirmed bookings remain but the public booking page stops accepting new bookings.

tools.name: Delete scoring rule
tools.description: Delete a lead scoring rule.

tools.name: Delete sequence
tools.description: Delete a sequence (and all its enrollments).

tools.name: Delete shared drive
tools.description: Delete a shared drive (destructive, manager-only).

tools.name: Delete sheet columns
tools.description: Delete columns atomically and return the bounded change receipt for undo or redo.

tools.name: Delete sheet image
tools.description: Delete editable floating images with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Image src must reference an image asset owned by this sheet.

tools.name: Delete sheet picture group
tools.description: Delete editable picture groups with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Every leaf references an image asset owned by this sheet; native group transforms use EMU coordinates.

tools.name: Delete sheet rows
tools.description: Delete rows from a sheet tab by 0-based index.

tools.name: Delete sheet shape
tools.description: Delete editable floating shapes with editable text, cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry.

tools.name: Delete slicer
tools.description: Remove a slicer from the sheet. Returns `{ deleted: true }` on success.

tools.name: Delete slide master
tools.description: Delete an unused master slide. Returns 409 with the referencing slide count while the master is in use.

tools.name: Delete team
tools.description: Permanently delete a team from the workspace. Only team admins or workspace admins can delete. All memberships are removed. Child teams are orphaned (parent set to null). Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, or dissolve a team.

tools.name: Delete user
tools.description: Irreversibly delete a member. Requires admin and refuses the last owner. Reassigns CRM contacts to `successor_user_id` (default: acting admin); an ineligible successor aborts before mutation.

tools.name: Delete wiki page
tools.description: Move a wiki page to Trash, together with every page beneath it. Trashed pages leave the tree and search, and can be brought back with `wiki_page_restore`; only `wiki_page_permanent_delete` removes them for good. A page that has child pages answers 409 with `requires_cascade` and `children_count` unless `cascade=true` is passed, so confirm with the user before trashing a sub-tree. Use this when the user asks to delete or remove a wiki page.

tools.name: Delete wiki synced block
tools.description: Soft-delete a synced block. Embedded references will show error chips until restored. Use restore_wiki_synced_block to undo.

tools.name: Detach master from slide
tools.description: Detach a slide from its master. The slide keeps its current rendered elements but no longer inherits from the master.

tools.name: Docs create named range
tools.description: Create a named range (template placeholder) on a document. Named ranges anchor to ProseMirror node positions and are used for template-based document generation. Use replace_named_range_content to fill a named range with content. Name must be alphanumeric + underscore, must not start with a digit (e.g., party_name, companyAddress).

tools.name: Docs delete named range
tools.description: Delete a named range (template placeholder) from a document by name. Names are unique per document.

tools.name: Docs list named ranges
tools.description: List all named ranges (template placeholders) defined on a document. Returns each range's name and its anchored node positions.

tools.name: Documents asset create
tools.description: Add an image to a doc, sheet, slide deck or canvas board as one of its own assets and get back the URL its body should store (`/api/assets/{id}/content`). Send the bytes as `content_base64`, `source_file_id` to copy a Drive file the caller can view, or `source_url` to import a public HTTPS image through the SSRF guard; neither source is referenced afterwards. The type is decided from the bytes and only images are accepted (415 otherwise); SVG uploads are sanitized before storage and refused with 415 when malformed. Stored SVG is sanitized on every read and served inline as image/svg+xml under a restrictive Content-Security-Policy; malformed stored SVG is refused with 404. Drive SVG downloads remain attachments. The bytes count against the container owner's storage (413 past it). The same image added to the same container again returns the asset already held. The asset is never visible in Drive and is readable exactly when the container is.

tools.name: Documents comment delete
tools.description: Delete a comment. Author or document owner only.

tools.name: Documents comment reaction add
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a comment. Idempotent per (user, emoji). Returns the comment's updated reaction aggregate.

tools.name: Documents comment reaction remove
tools.description: Remove the caller's emoji reaction from a comment. Returns the comment's updated reaction aggregate.

tools.name: Documents comment resolve
tools.description: Edit your own comment or resolve a thread. Content edits require commenter access; resolution requires editor access. expected_content rejects stale edits with 409.

tools.name: Documents comments create
tools.description: Add a threaded comment. Commenter permission required. `parent_id` makes it a reply; `anchor` carries CRDT-stable position info.

tools.name: Documents comments list
tools.description: List threaded comments. Response includes per-user `unread_count` (comments by other users since the requester's last `mark-read`, not resolved).

tools.name: Documents comments mark read
tools.description: Advance the requester's last-seen marker so the unread badge clears. Idempotent.

tools.name: Documents comment thread mark read
tools.description: Mark one comment thread read for the requester, clearing its unread badge. Idempotent. `commentId` must be a root comment on this document; a reply id or a comment on another document is refused 404.

tools.name: Documents comment thread mark unread
tools.description: Mark one comment thread unread for the requester so it stays flagged until reopened, even when its only comments are the requester's own. `commentId` must be a root comment on this document; a reply id or foreign-document id is refused 404, and a resolved thread is refused 409 `comment_resolved`.

tools.name: Documents delete
tools.description: Soft-delete a document (move to trash). Owner only.

tools.name: Documents duplicate
tools.description: Make a copy. Title becomes 'Copy of <orig>'. Visibility resets to restricted; labels/pin/star are NOT inherited. Requires viewer access on the source.

tools.name: Documents permanent delete
tools.description: Permanently delete a trashed document. Irreversible.

tools.name: Documents pin
tools.description: Toggle pinned state. Editor permission required (workspace-wide pin, not per-user).

tools.name: Documents restore
tools.description: Restore a trashed document.

tools.name: Documents shared with me
tools.description: Documents shared with the calling account through an explicit permission grant, across every workspace and every identity the account owns. Excludes documents the account owns. Each row names the workspace that shared it and the role the grant carries. `scope=workspace` narrows discovery to resources in the authenticated current workspace without changing access.

tools.name: Documents star
tools.description: Toggle starred state. Viewer permission is sufficient. Body `{starred: bool}` is optional — omit to toggle.

tools.name: Documents thumbnail
tools.description: Content-derived thumbnail for doc/sheet/slide cards. Returns SVG by default or PNG for Accept: image/png; cached privately for 60 seconds.

tools.name: Documents trash list
tools.description: Find all deleted native Docs, Sheets, Slides and Canvas items owned by the caller. Returns their document IDs for documents_restore or documents_permanent_delete; optional type filters doc, sheet, slide or canvas. Uploaded Drive files and folders use list_trashed_files, which can also include materialized native-document shadow rows but is not a complete native-document trash list. An empty Drive-file trash result does not mean this document trash is empty.

tools.name: Documents version get
tools.description: Get a version's metadata + serialized content snapshot.

tools.name: Documents version revert
tools.description: Revert the document to a prior version. Force-snapshots current state first.

tools.name: Documents versions create
tools.description: Create a manual snapshot (forces past the 5-minute throttle).

tools.name: Documents versions list
tools.description: List version snapshots, newest-first, cursor-paginated (default 50 per page). Walk via `next_cursor` until `has_more` is false.

tools.name: Drive file confirm upload
tools.description: Confirm a presigned upload completed successfully. Verifies the blob exists, rechecks its real size and stored bytes, then marks the file as confirmed and emits the upload event. A retryable storage-inspection failure leaves the upload pending and returns 503; a missing object removes the pending row and returns 410. Idempotent — confirming an already-confirmed file returns it unchanged without repeating the upload event.

tools.name: Drive file content
tools.description: A file's bytes. A browser is redirected to a short-lived signed storage URL where signing is available and is otherwise sent the bytes; an MCP tool call always gets the bytes, refused 413 above the MCP result size limit. Pass `?download=true` for `Content-Disposition: attachment`; default is inline. Content retrieval failures can return 503/504 via raw Response because those statuses are outside the typed contract error-code enum.

tools.name: Drive file import
tools.description: Add a file to Drive from JSON, for clients that cannot send multipart: give either an https `url` to fetch (up to 100 MB) or the bytes as `content_base64` (up to 25 MB decoded), plus a `name`. The file goes through the same checks as a browser upload: its type is decided from the bytes, blocked types are refused, and it counts against the caller's storage quota. Links to private network addresses are refused, including through redirects. Returns the stored file.

tools.name: Drive file request create
tools.description: Create a revocable, write-only public file request for a folder. The capability token is returned only in this response.

tools.name: Drive file request remint
tools.description: Replace a live file request's capability token without changing its request identity, limits, upload progress, or expiry. The previous token stops working immediately and the replacement token is returned only in this response.

tools.name: Drive file request revoke
tools.description: Revoke a folder's public file request immediately.

tools.name: Drive file requests list
tools.description: List the caller's file requests for one owned Drive folder.

tools.name: Drive files recent
tools.description: Recently used files for the current user — files they opened in the last 30 days (their own views, including files shared with them that they can still open) OR files they own created in the last 24 hours. Sorted newest first by their own last view, or creation for their own new files.

tools.name: Drive files shared with me
tools.description: Files shared with the current user through a direct, team or external grant, newest share first (`sort=modified` orders by last modified instead). Each row carries `shared_at` and `shared_by`. Excludes files the user owns.

tools.name: Drive files starred
tools.description: Files the current user has starred.

tools.name: Drive files suggested
tools.description: Files the current user is likely to want next, each with the reason it is suggested: they opened it (`opened`), someone shared it with them (`shared`), or someone else added it to a folder they own or an agent they manage created it (`added`). Covers the last 14 days, newest reason first, at most one entry per file and only files the caller can still open. Stars never influence it. Use this for the My Drive home, not for a full history; use `drive_files_recent` for everything the user opened.

tools.name: Drive file tag attach
tools.description: Attach one of your tags to a Drive file, a doc/sheet/slide, or a form, so one tag can group a PDF with the document it belongs to. Owner-only (anyone else gets 404) and idempotent. Pass `resource_type` to name the kind, or omit it to infer it from the id.

tools.name: Drive file tag detach
tools.description: Detach a tag from a Drive file, a doc/sheet/slide, or a form. Owner-only. Pass `?resource_type=` to name the kind, or omit it to infer it from the id.

tools.name: Drive file update
tools.description: Rename, move, or star/unstar a file. Requires edit access — the owner or an editor/owner share. A move also needs editor access on the destination folder (contributor in a shared drive), and an item whose sharing is restricted moves only with its owner (403 `drive_move_requires_owner`).

tools.name: Drive file upload init
tools.description: Initiate a file upload. Reserves a Drive row + storage key and returns a short-lived presigned PUT URL the client uploads the bytes to.

tools.name: Drive folder ancestors
tools.description: Breadcrumb chain (root → leaf) for a folder. Powers breadcrumb hydration on deep-link reloads. Viewer permission is sufficient.

tools.name: Drive publish gallery
tools.description: Publish a folder as an anyone-with-link gallery: stamp link visibility plus the given password/expiry onto the folder and its direct-child non-folder files, skipping legal records (reported as skipped_legal). An omitted password or expires_at keeps the folder's current value, so re-publishing to admit new files keeps the gallery's protection; an explicit null (or empty password) clears it. Owner-only. Materialized, not a cascade — files added after publishing stay restricted until republished.

tools.name: Drive revoke gallery
tools.description: Revoke a folder gallery: restore the folder and its direct-child files to restricted and clear link settings. Owner-only. Legal-record children are left untouched.

tools.name: Drive shared drive folder create
tools.description: Create a folder inside a shared drive. Requires contributor+ on the drive. Pass `parent_folder_id` to nest.

tools.name: Drive tag create
tools.description: Create a new tag in the user's catalog.

tools.name: Drive tag delete
tools.description: Delete a tag (cascades to all file assignments).

tools.name: Drive tag files list
tools.description: List everything you tagged with the given tag: Drive files, docs/sheets/slides and forms you own, newest first. Docs and forms carry `document_type`.

tools.name: Drive tags list
tools.description: Current user's tag catalog. Each tag carries name, color, and sort order.

tools.name: Drive tag update
tools.description: Rename, recolor, or reorder a tag.

tools.name: Duplicate slide
tools.description: Deep-copy a slide within the same deck. The duplicate is inserted immediately after the source slide. All elements (including group children) receive new unique IDs to avoid collisions. Useful for template-based workflows: duplicate a template slide, then update the copy with new content.

tools.name: Duplicate task
tools.description: Clone a task — copies title (appends ' (copy)'), description, priority, project, goal, cycle, estimate, due/start date, recurrence, custom fields, and labels. The clone starts at status 'todo' with a fresh task key.

tools.name: Edit recurring event all
tools.description: Edit all occurrences in a recurring series. Updates the master event.

tools.name: Edit recurring event future
tools.description: Edit this and all future occurrences of a recurring event by splitting the series at the given date. Use this for 'change the meeting time from next week onwards' or 'update our recurring Friday sync starting next month'.

tools.name: Edit recurring event single
tools.description: Edit a single occurrence of a recurring event, creating an exception without affecting other occurrences. Use this when the user says 'move just next Tuesday's meeting to 3pm' or 'cancel only this one occurrence'.

tools.name: Empty trash
tools.description: Permanently delete the trashed files the user holds the owner rung on. Shared-drive files are included only for drives the user manages. Irreversible — confirm with user first. Returns the number of files deleted.

tools.name: Enroll contact in sequence
tools.description: Enroll a contact in a CRM sequence so they begin receiving the automated steps (emails, tasks, calls). Use this when the user asks to start a campaign for a specific contact.

tools.name: Ensure wiki reverse relation
tools.description: Auto-create the reverse relation property on the target database if missing. Idempotent — returns the existing or newly-created reverse property id.

tools.name: Export document
tools.description: Export a document, sheet, or slide to one of its supported standard formats. Sheets support xlsx, csv, tsv, and ods. Returns the file bytes with Content-Type and Content-Disposition attachment headers.

tools.name: Export drive file
tools.description: Export a workspace document (Doc, Sheet, or Slide) to a file format via its Drive ID. Docs support: docx, pdf, html, md. Sheets support: xlsx, csv. Slides support: pptx, pdf, html. Binary Drive files (images, archives, etc.) cannot be exported — use download instead.

tools.name: Export form responses
tools.description: Download all matching form responses as CSV with field labels, display values, blank unanswered cells, and ISO submission timestamps. Streams beyond the response-list page size.

tools.name: Find and replace in deck
tools.description: Find and replace text across all slides in a presentation. Searches every text element and table cell on every slide. Useful for template-based workflows: create a deck from a template with placeholders like {{company_name}}, then replace them programmatically. Plain string matching only (no regex).

tools.name: Formatter set
tools.description: Set a flat map of fields on the node output. Native equivalent of the n8n `Set` node — alias `n8n-nodes-base.set → formatter_set`. Pure passthrough: `parameters.values` is resolved upstream by the dispatcher's `resolveActionParameters` walker, so JSONLogic rules referencing `{var: "<UpstreamNode>.<field>"}` produce the literal value the handler echoes back. Downstream nodes reference the result via `{var: "<NodeName>.values.<key>"}`. Spec line 41: formatters are `formatter_*` operationIds.

tools.name: Get account erasure outcome
tools.description: Read a deleted member's durable erasure outcome and notice-delivery state. Requires admin or owner.

tools.name: Get activity
tools.description: Get a single activity by ID. Useful for reading back a just-created activity via the resource URL in the activity.created event payload.

tools.name: Get billing bonuses
tools.description: Return the workspace's full earned-bonus history, newest-first — perpetual activation bonuses merged with one-time activation grants. Powers the Home Action-bonuses card, which needs the whole history the notification feed cannot show. Any authenticated caller in the workspace.

tools.name: Get billing quota
tools.description: Return the workspace's unified action-meter view: plan, base/earned/topup quota, consumed-this-month, reset_at, member count + cap, trial state, active bonuses, auto-recharge config. Replaces the deprecated /api/billing/usage + /api/billing/ai-usage endpoints. Any authenticated caller in the workspace.

tools.name: Get calendar
tools.description: Get a single calendar by ID. Returns the calendar's name, color, timezone, default status, and owner. Use this when the user asks about a specific calendar's settings or before creating events to verify the timezone.

tools.name: Get calendar colors
tools.description: Get the available color palette for calendars and events. Returns 24 calendar colors and 11 event colors, each with a background and foreground hex value. Use this when the user asks what colors are available, or before setting a calendar or event color.

tools.name: Get canvas
tools.description: Get a full canvas by id, including every element in `data.elements`. Use when you need the complete board; for a large board prefer get_canvas_manifest (ids/types/bounds only) or get_canvas_frame to stay within context budget. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: get_canvas({ id: "<boardId>" }) → the board with all elements.

tools.name: Get canvas elements
tools.description: Batch-fetch specific elements of a board by id — pass `ids` as a comma-separated list (max 500) and only those elements are returned, never the whole board. Use to refresh just the elements that changed (a collaborator's edit named in a `canvas.updated` change-feed frame carries their ids), staying element-scoped rather than reloading the board body. A requested id that is ABSENT from the response means the element was deleted — drop it locally. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: get_canvas_elements({ id: "<boardId>", ids: "el-a,el-b" }) → { elements: [{ id: "el-a", … }] } (el-b was deleted).

tools.name: Get canvas frame
tools.description: Get a frame (or swimlane) element and its children — every element whose `frameId` points at it. Use to read one region of a large board in full detail. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: get_canvas_frame({ id: "<boardId>", frameId: "<frameId>" }) → { frame, elements: [...] }.

tools.name: Get canvas manifest
tools.description: Get a bounded manifest of a board — element ids, types, and bounds only (no style/content). Use this to survey a large board cheaply, then fetch a specific frame or the full board for detail. Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down. Example: get_canvas_manifest({ id: "<boardId>" }) → { element_count, elements: [{ id, type, x, y, w, h }] }.

tools.name: Get channel messages
tools.description: Get recent messages from a chat channel. Returns messages with id, content (Markdown), author info, reactions, thread reply count, and timestamps. Use this when the user asks to read messages, catch up on a channel, or find a specific conversation. If the user is currently viewing a channel, use the channel ID from the page context. Messages are returned in reverse chronological order (newest first).

tools.name: Get channel read receipts
tools.description: Get per-member read positions for a channel — who has read up to which message. Useful for reporting on whether an announcement has been seen by everyone.

tools.name: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single CRM contact by ID, including full details: name, email, phone, title, company, lifecycle stage, custom properties, and timestamps. If the user is currently viewing a contact, use the contact ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get contact score
tools.description: Get a contact's current lead score with a breakdown of which scoring rules matched and how many points each contributed. Use this to explain why a contact is hot/cold.

tools.name: Get cover thumbnail
tools.description: Get the PNG thumbnail bytes for the first slide (cover image) of a presentation. Convenience endpoint — equivalent to get_slide_thumbnail with index 0.

tools.name: Get coworker
tools.description: Get one AI coworker's configuration by id.

tools.name: Get coworker status
tools.description: Get a coworker's runtime status (proxied from coworker service).

tools.name: Get crm analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for accessible deals, optionally scoped to one pipeline: pipeline value by stage, conversion rates, average deal size, sales velocity, and deals breakdown.

tools.name: Get crm metrics
tools.description: Get pipeline metrics summary: total open deals, total deal value, win rate, deals won/lost, and recent activity counts. Useful for high-level pipeline health questions.

tools.name: Get crm reports
tools.description: Get CRM revenue, deals-by-source, pipeline-by-owner, and activity reports for accessible records, optionally scoped to one pipeline. Each report preserves its own timestamp axis.

tools.name: Get current workspace
tools.description: Get the active workspace (name, slug, logo). Accessible to any authenticated user.

tools.name: Get data connector
tools.description: Get a single data connector by ID, including its config and last-run status.

tools.name: Get deal
tools.description: Get a single CRM deal by ID, including full details: title, amount, currency, stage, pipeline, contact, company, owner, probability, close date, custom properties, and timestamps. Pass embed=line_items to include the full line-items array. If the user is currently viewing a deal, use the deal ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get deal template
tools.description: Get a single deal template with its line items and resolved pipeline/stage names.

tools.name: Get detailed user presence
tools.description: Get detailed presence for a set of users — online (≤5min), idle (5–30min), or offline — plus the lastActiveAt timestamp. Capped at 100 user IDs. Fallback/cold-hydrate surface only — the primary presence path is the full-state push over the `presence` /ws/mux channel; poll this on connect or when the socket is down, not on a steady timer.

tools.name: Get docs page layout default
tools.description: Get the caller's default layout for new Docs: `pageless_default: true` (the default) means new Docs start pageless, `false` means they start in pages.

tools.name: Get document
tools.description: Get a single document by ID, including its full content and comments. If the user is currently viewing a document, use the document ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get document footnotes
tools.description: Get the footnotes from a document. Returns an array of footnotes, each with a footnoteId, body content (PM JSON), and the positions of inline references (footnoteRef nodes) in the body text.

tools.name: Get document headers footers
tools.description: Get the default, first-page, and even-page headers and footers from a document as ProseMirror JSON nodes (or null if not set).

tools.name: Get document page style
tools.description: Get the page-level formatting for a document: margins (in PT), page size (letter/A4/legal or custom {width, height} in PT), and orientation (portrait/landscape). Empty object means default formatting.

tools.name: Get drive storage
tools.description: Get Drive storage usage.

tools.name: Get drive storage breakdown
tools.description: Storage breakdown by file type.

tools.name: Get email
tools.description: Get a single email by ID, including full Markdown body, sender, recipients (to/cc/bcc), subject, and timestamps. Use this when the user wants to read an email, see its contents, or reply to a specific message. If the user is currently viewing an email, use the email ID from the page context. Use detail='headers' for envelope fields only (no body), or 'minimal' for id + labels only.

tools.name: Get email attachment url
tools.description: Get an attachment download URL: signed in cloud storage, authenticated API content in local storage.

tools.name: Get email calendar invite
tools.description: Get calendar invite embedded in an email.

tools.name: Get email deliverability
tools.description: Get email deliverability statistics (sent/bounced/complained/opened rates) for the past 30 days. Requires admin role.

tools.name: Get email opens
tools.description: Fetch open events for an email (sender only) Returns the rollup (first/last seen, open count) plus up to the most recent 50 individual open events. 403 if the caller doesn't own the email's mailbox.

tools.name: Get email signature
tools.description: Get the workspace default email signature (Markdown). Requires admin role.

tools.name: Get entity preview
tools.description: Look up a hover-card style preview of any referenced entity (document, task, contact, deal, channel, chat message, user, event, file, wiki page, form, email). Module keys include `docs`, `tasks`, `channels`, `messages`, `users`. Returns rich details — title, status, owner, due date, amount, etc. — without fetching the full record. Use this when an entity is referenced by ID and you need a quick summary.

tools.name: Get event
tools.description: Get a single calendar event by ID, including full details: title, description, location, start/end times, recurrence rule, status, visibility, and attendees with RSVP status. If the user is currently viewing an event, use the event ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get event instances
tools.description: List individual occurrences of a recurring event within a date range. Expands the RRULE server-side and returns instance objects with computed start/end times. Use this to find specific occurrences (e.g., 'what meetings are on next Tuesday?') or to list upcoming instances of a series.

tools.name: Get feedback
tools.description: Read back one submission by its receipt. Answers only the submitter — anyone else, including other members of the submitter's workspace, gets 404. Returns the public projection: a status word (`filed` | `accepted` | `declined` | `shipped`, derived from the task Ambiguous works), the title, the priority, the task key, and timestamps. Nothing else on the task is exposed.

tools.name: Get file info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a file or folder in Drive. Returns id, name, mime_type, size_bytes, storage_key, owner info, parent folder, and timestamps. Use this when the user asks about a specific file's details, size, type, or location. If the user is currently viewing a file in Drive, use the resource ID from page context.

tools.name: Get form
tools.description: Get a form's full details including field schema, settings, publish status, and slug. Use this when the user asks about a form's fields, structure, or configuration. If the user is currently viewing a form, use the resource ID from page context.

tools.name: Get form ab analytics
tools.description: Get A/B test comparison analytics for a form with variants. Returns control + each variant with views, responses, completion rate, and traffic weight. Use when the user asks which variant is winning, for A/B test results, or experiment performance comparison.

tools.name: Get form analytics
tools.description: Get analytics for a form: total views, total responses, completion rate, average completion time, responses-by-day (last 30 days), per-field drop-off funnel, and per-field summaries (option counts for select fields, numeric stats for rating/number fields). Use when the user asks about form performance, response rate, completion rate, or field-level statistics.

tools.name: Get form response
tools.description: Get a single form response by ID. Returns respondent info, submitted data (keyed by field ID), and timestamp. Use when the user asks about a specific submission or wants to review a particular response.

tools.name: Get mail approval
tools.description: Read one submitted email exactly as it will send — From, Reply-To, the complete To/Cc/Bcc set, subject, body with signature applied, attachment manifest, threading and requested schedule. A caller without access gets 404, never 403.

tools.name: Get mail approval attachment url
tools.description: Presigned URL for one frozen attachment, addressed by its position in the manifest. The bytes are the copy taken at submit time, so a later edit of the source Drive file does not change what the reviewer reads. The URL is minted only after the review access check.

tools.name: Get mail rule
tools.description: Get one mail rule's conditions and actions by id.

tools.name: Get mail signature
tools.description: Get the effective email signature.

tools.name: Get mail template
tools.description: Get one saved mail template by id.

tools.name: Get mail thread
tools.description: Get all emails in a thread + muted flag.

tools.name: Get message readers
tools.description: List the users who have read a specific message (i.e. whose read-cursor is at or past this message). Use this to check whether a message (e.g. an important announcement) has been seen by specific people.

tools.name: Get module availability
tools.description: Which productivity modules are enabled for the caller's workspace: module key → boolean. Bootstrap gate for nav + routes.

tools.name: Get my access request
tools.description: Whether you have an open access request for a document, spreadsheet, presentation, canvas, Drive item, form, wiki page, or calendar, task, project, or CRM pipeline.

tools.name: Get notification keywords
tools.description: Get the current user's notification keywords. The user receives a mention-style notification whenever any of these words appears in a message they can read.

tools.name: Get ooo status
tools.description: Check out-of-office status for one or more users. Returns per-user OOO flag and event details when applicable. Call this before scheduling to avoid inviting people who are OOO.

tools.name: Get pipeline
tools.description: Get a single CRM pipeline by ID with its ordered stages and its `visibility` — `workspace` when the pipeline is shared with the whole workspace, `private` when only its members reach its deals. A caller who is not a member receives 404.

tools.name: Get presentation
tools.description: Get a presentation's full data including all slides and their elements. Returns the `SlideDeck` envelope: top-level metadata (id, title, slide_count, owner, visibility, timestamps) plus the structured deck body nested under `data` (see `SlideDeckData`). Read settings/slides/masterSlides as `response.data.slides[…]`, not at the response root. If the user is currently viewing a presentation, use the presentation ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get product
tools.description: Get one CRM product from the catalog by id.

tools.name: Get project
tools.description: Get a single project by ID, including task count, visibility, and metadata.

tools.name: Get quote
tools.description: Get a single CRM quote with its line items and linked deal/contact/company/owner.

tools.name: Get read receipts default
tools.description: Get read-receipts default for new compose.

tools.name: Get resolved presence
tools.description: Cold-hydrate the resolved presence dot for a set of users in the current workspace. Returns user_id → { kind, state } — the same already-resolved dot the projector pushes over the `presence` WebSocket channel. Used on connect and as the WS-down fallback; the client renders the state and computes nothing. Capped at 100 user IDs.

tools.name: Get scheduler link
tools.description: Get a single scheduler link (owner-scoped) with its settings and booking count.

tools.name: Get security settings
tools.description: Get workspace security settings (require_2fa, session_timeout_hours, password_min_length, ip_allowlist). Requires admin role.

tools.name: Get sequence
tools.description: Get a single sequence with its full step list and current enrollment count.

tools.name: Get settings
tools.description: Get all workspace settings. Requires admin role.

tools.name: Get shared drive
tools.description: Get shared drive details.

tools.name: Get sheet
tools.description: Get a spreadsheet's structured data including columns, rows, and formulas. Returns the `Sheet` envelope: top-level metadata (id, title, owner, visibility, timestamps) plus the structured sheet body nested under `data` (see `SheetData`). Read the tab list as `response.data.sheets`; columns and rows are under `response.data.sheets[0]`, not at the response root. If the user is currently viewing a sheet, use the sheet ID from the page context.

tools.name: Get sheet range
tools.description: Get a rectangular range of cell values from a sheet. Useful when you only need a slice of a large sheet (max 10,000 cells). Returns a 2D array of values plus the resolved start/end column letters and row numbers. Use orientation=COLUMNS to get column-major arrays (each inner array is one column). valueRenderOption controls how cells render: STORED (default) returns stored values verbatim — formula cells return the formula string; FORMULA forces formula strings; EVALUATED runs the server-side formula engine and returns computed values (e.g., '=SUM(A1:A3)' becomes 6). Same-sheet refs across tabs (Sheet2!A1) resolve when evaluating; IMPORTRANGE returns #REF! (server cannot recurse cross-document).

tools.name: Get sign audit
tools.description: Get the append-only audit trail for a visible signing document.

tools.name: Get sign document
tools.description: Get a signing document with signers and fields.

tools.name: Get slide thumbnail
tools.description: Get the PNG thumbnail bytes for a specific slide. Sizes: small (200px), medium (800px, default), large (1600px).

tools.name: Get snooze presets
tools.description: Get the user's custom snooze quick-presets. Returns defaults when no custom presets are saved.

tools.name: Get swipe actions
tools.description: Get the caller's own mail-row swipe actions. Returns the defaults (right archive, left trash) when nothing is saved.

tools.name: Get task
tools.description: Get a single task by ID, including full details: title, description, status, priority, assignee, due date, labels, and subtask count.

tools.name: Get team
tools.description: Get details of a single team including its first 10 members. Returns team metadata (name, slug, visibility, join policy, email) and an embedded members list with each member's user_id, display_name, email, role, and added_at. Use this when the user asks about a specific team, its members, or 'who is in team X?'.

tools.name: Get undo send setting
tools.description: Get undo-send duration preference.

tools.name: Get unread counts
tools.description: Get the full unread projection (mail inbox, per-channel chat badges with mute/preference resolved, notifications, total). Used for cold-connect / reconnect hydration; live updates arrive on the mux `unread` channel.

tools.name: Get usage stats
tools.description: Get workspace usage statistics including storage breakdown by user and module, active user count, API call volume, and per-module adoption metrics. Requires admin or owner role. Use this when the user asks about workspace usage, storage consumption, billing metrics, or capacity planning.

tools.name: Get user presence
tools.description: Get online status (true = online within the last 5 minutes) for a set of users in the current workspace. Returns user_id → boolean. Capped at 100 user IDs. Fallback/cold-hydrate surface only — the primary presence path is the full-state push over the `presence` /ws/mux channel; poll this on connect or when the socket is down, not on a steady timer.

tools.name: Get users notification preferences
tools.description: Return the user's notification preferences, merged with defaults so newly-added keys always render.

tools.name: Get user status
tools.description: Get the current user's active chat status (emoji + text) and DND-until timestamp. Use this before setting or clearing the status to know the current state.

tools.name: Get vacation settings
tools.description: Get vacation auto-reply settings.

tools.name: Get wiki database row
tools.description: Get a single database row by id.

tools.name: Get wiki page
tools.description: Get a wiki page's full details including Markdown content, child pages, backlinks (pages that link to this page), and metadata. Use this when the user asks about a page's content, wants to read documentation, or needs to check what links to a specific page. If the user is currently viewing a wiki page, use the resource ID from page context.

tools.name: Get wiki page version
tools.description: Get a wiki page version's full content (title + markdown body). Use this when the user asks what a previous version looked like, wants to compare versions, or needs the content of a specific snapshot.

tools.name: Get wiki space graph
tools.description: Get backlink graph data for a wiki space. Returns nodes (pages) and edges (links between pages). Use this when the user asks to visualize the knowledge graph, see how pages connect, or find highly-linked 'hub' pages.

tools.name: Get wiki synced block
tools.description: Get a synced block by ID. Returns the block's content and metadata. Use this when you need to read the current content of a shared block.

tools.name: Get workspace
tools.description: Get the current workspace details (id, name, slug). Requires admin role.

tools.name: Grant access
tools.description: Share a document, spreadsheet, presentation, canvas, Drive item, form, wiki page, or calendar with exactly one user_id or named team_id (workspace members/teams), or email (anyone; sends an invitation). For all current/future workspace humans and agents use set_visibility(visibility=workspace, workspaceRole), not per-person grants or the Everyone entry. invite_to_workspace=true sends a membership invite (admin-only); message applies only to email. Unsupported roles are rejected; re-sharing cannot lower a live grant.

tools.name: Group slide elements
tools.description: Group existing top-level elements on a slide into a single group. The group's bounding box is computed automatically from the children. Children positions become relative to the group origin. At least 2 element IDs required. A named element may itself be a group — `groupElements` validates only that each id is top-level on the slide, so groups nest.

tools.name: Home digest
tools.description: Workspace-home roll-up: trailing-window task velocity (with prior-window deltas) plus the actor-aggregated team digest, visibility-gated per viewer. The `window` param selects the trailing window (7d default, or 1d for Today). Accessible to any authenticated workspace member.

tools.name: Insert page break
tools.description: Insert a page break into a document at a given position. Forces subsequent content to start on the next page in exported .docx and .pdf files. The page break is inserted as a block node between paragraphs.

tools.name: Insert page number
tools.description: Insert a page number placeholder into a document. The placeholder renders as the current page number in exported .docx and .pdf files. Commonly used inside headers or footers (e.g., 'Page X') but can also appear inline in the body text. The placeholder is inserted as an inline node within a paragraph.

tools.name: Insert section break
tools.description: Insert a section break into a document at a given position. Section breaks divide the document into sections that can have different formatting. A 'next_page' section break forces content to the next page (like a page break but marks a new section). A 'continuous' section break starts a new section on the same page.

tools.name: Invite user
tools.description: Invite a human by email with a member or admin role. Requires admin.

tools.name: Leave resource
tools.description: Remove your own direct grant on a document, spreadsheet, presentation, canvas, Drive item, form, wiki page, or calendar. The owner cannot leave. Returns an undo_token that shared_with_me_undo_leave accepts for ten minutes.

tools.name: List access
tools.description: List named/team grants, workspace/link tiers and pending invitations for a document, spreadsheet, presentation, canvas, Drive item, form, wiki page, or calendar. id names the resource; grant IDs name recipients. To remove broad access but keep explicit collaborators and their roles, use set_visibility(visibility=restricted). The Everyone entry mirrors workspace access, not a named share. Resource kind is inferred from id.

tools.name: List activity
tools.description: List recent workspace activity (last 30 days). Scoped to the current user's workspace. Filterable by resource type, resource ID, and acting user.

tools.name: List address book
tools.description: List the caller's address book: the shared CRM contacts they can see unioned with their own privately captured addresses, deduplicated on email with the shared record winning. Use this to resolve a recipient the user has written to before instead of asking them to retype an address. Private entries are never visible to another member.

tools.name: List archived threads
tools.description: List archived threads (one per thread)

tools.name: List blocked senders
tools.description: List all blocked senders for current user's mailbox

tools.name: List calendar events
tools.description: List events scoped to a single calendar by its id — the RESTful path variant of list_events (`/api/calendars/events?calendar_id=…`). Requires at least viewer access to the calendar.

tools.name: List calendars
tools.description: List the user's calendars. Returns calendar id, name, color, timezone, and whether it's the default. Use this to find the user's default calendar ID before creating events.

tools.name: List channels
tools.description: List the user's chat channels. Returns channels with id, name, type (public/private/dm), description, member count, and creator info. Use this when the user asks to see their channels, find a specific channel by name, or when you need a channel ID to send a message.

tools.name: List charts
tools.description: List every chart across every tab of the sheet. Each entry is annotated with the `tab` name it lives in.

tools.name: List conditional formats
tools.description: List all conditional formatting rules on a spreadsheet. Returns each rule's ID, ranges (A1 notation), and one canonical rule payload.

tools.name: List contact activities
tools.description: List activities (notes, calls, emails, meetings, tasks) on a specific contact's timeline. Useful for summarizing recent interactions with a contact before sending an email or making a call.

tools.name: List contact group members
tools.description: List all contacts that are members of a contact group. Returns the contact id, name, email, and type for each member.

tools.name: List contact groups
tools.description: List all contact groups in the workspace with their member counts. Groups are named collections for organizing contacts (e.g., 'Conference leads 2026').

tools.name: List contacts
tools.description: List CRM contacts. Supports filtering by type, lifecycle stage, owner, and text search. Returns contacts with id, name, email, phone, type, lifecycle_stage, company, and timestamps. Use this when the user asks to see their contacts, find a person, or list companies. Also use this with the 'q' parameter to search for existing contacts BEFORE creating new ones to prevent duplicates.

tools.name: List crm activities
tools.description: List recent CRM activity visible to the current user across contact and deal timelines.

tools.name: List crm property definitions
tools.description: List the workspace's typed custom-property definitions for contacts and deals, including relation properties that link a record to another contact, company, or deal. Optionally filter by entity_type.

tools.name: List crm views
tools.description: List the user's saved CRM views (filter + sort presets for contacts/companies/deals). Views personalize how CRM data is displayed without changing the underlying records.

tools.name: List crm workspace users
tools.description: List all users (humans and agents) in the current workspace who can own CRM records. Use before assigning contacts or deals to a specific owner_id.

tools.name: List custom emojis
tools.description: List all custom emojis uploaded to the current workspace. Returns each emoji with id, name (without colons), image URL, and creator info. Use this to discover what custom emojis are available before referring to them by name.

tools.name: List data connector run history
tools.description: List recent execution history for a data connector. Each row records one manual or scheduled run with its status, duration, row count, and error (if any). Use the `limit` query param to cap the page size (default 20, max 100). Results are ordered by completion time, newest first.

tools.name: List data connectors
tools.description: List data connectors registered on a sheet. Connectors fetch data from external sources (URL, CSV, etc.) into specific cells.

tools.name: List deal line items
tools.description: List all line items for a deal, plus the computed total.

tools.name: List deals
tools.description: List CRM deals. Supports filtering by pipeline, stage, and status. Returns deals with id, title, amount, currency, stage, pipeline, contact, status, and timestamps. Use this when the user asks to see their deals, check the pipeline, or find opportunities.

tools.name: List deal templates
tools.description: List deal templates in the workspace (reusable deal presets: default pipeline, stage, amount, probability, and line items).

tools.name: List documents
tools.description: List the current user's documents. Optionally filter by type. Includes externally owned documents by default; `scope=workspace` limits discovery to the authenticated current workspace.

tools.name: List drafts
tools.description: List the unsent draft emails in this mailbox.

tools.name: List drive folders
tools.description: List only folders (not files) in Drive — useful for folder pickers. Pass root to scope the listing to My Drive, shared drives, or Shared with me.

tools.name: List email attachments
tools.description: List attachments for an email

tools.name: List enrollment events
tools.description: Get the event log for a single sequence enrollment (step-executed, email-opened, email-replied, branch-taken, completed). Useful for auditing why a contact moved to a particular step.

tools.name: List event resources
tools.description: List resources currently booked for an event (rooms, equipment).

tools.name: List events
tools.description: List calendar events across all of the user's calendars. Supports filtering by date range, calendar, and free-text search. Returns events with id, title, start/end times, location, status, and attendees. Use this when the user asks to see their schedule, upcoming meetings, or events for a date. Use the q parameter to search for events by keyword (matches title, description, location, and attendee names).

tools.name: List feedback
tools.description: List the caller's own submissions, newest first, as public projections (see `get_feedback`). Paginated with `limit` (default 50) and `offset`.

tools.name: List files
tools.description: List files and folders in the user's Drive. Returns items with id, name, mime_type, size_bytes, is_folder, parent_folder_id, owner info, and timestamps. Use this when the user asks to see their files, browse a folder, find a specific file, or check what's in Drive. If the user is currently viewing Drive, use context for the current folder. A `parent_id` the caller cannot view answers 404, exactly as an absent folder does; a folder shared from another workspace is browsed through `GET /api/drive/{id}/children` instead.

tools.name: List folder children
tools.description: List the direct children of one folder, named in the path. Use this to browse into a folder — including one shared with you from another workspace, which the `parent_id` form of the list endpoint cannot return. Answers 404 for a folder the caller cannot view, exactly as an absent one does.

tools.name: List form responses
tools.description: List responses submitted to a form. Returns responses with respondent info, submitted data (keyed by field ID), and timestamps. Use this when the user asks to see form results, check submissions, analyze feedback, or export response data.

tools.name: List forms
tools.description: List the user's forms. Returns forms with id, title, slug, is_published, response count, timestamps, and the caller's own star and Drive tags. Pass `starred=true` for only the forms you starred. Use this when the user asks to see their forms, find a specific form, or check form status.

tools.name: List form variants
tools.description: List A/B test variants for a form. Returns each variant's id, name, traffic weight, active status, and variant form ID. Use when the user asks about their A/B tests, variant list, or experiment setup.

tools.name: List forwarding addresses
tools.description: List forwarding addresses + recent log.

tools.name: List identity api keys
tools.description: List the calling user's own API keys. Scoped to `c.var.user.id` — does not return keys belonging to other users in the same workspace. Admins managing other users' keys should use `GET /api/admin/api-keys`.

tools.name: List inbox
tools.description: List the user's received emails (inbox). Returns emails with id, from, subject, preview, read status, and sent timestamp. Use this when the user asks to check their inbox, see recent emails, or find a specific email. Use detail='headers' for bandwidth-efficient scanning (omits body), or 'minimal' for id + labels only. Use label_ids to filter by specific labels (AND semantics — all listed labels must be present).

tools.name: List mail approvals
tools.description: List email submissions awaiting a human decision. Returns the caller's own submissions plus the ones they may decide — as the submitting agent's current manager, or as a workspace admin/owner. A former manager sees nothing.

tools.name: List mail by label
tools.description: List emails with a specific label

tools.name: List mail labels
tools.description: List every mail label in this mailbox.

tools.name: List mail rules
tools.description: List mail rules / filters.

tools.name: List mail templates
tools.description: List the saved mail templates in this mailbox.

tools.name: List muted threads
tools.description: List muted threads (inbox view for muted conversations)

tools.name: List my teams
tools.description: List teams the current user belongs to, with their role (admin or member) in each. Use this when the user asks 'what teams am I in?' or 'my teams' or 'my memberships'.

tools.name: List my workspaces
tools.description: List workspaces the current user belongs to (human users may have multiple). Returns workspace id, name, slug, role, and which one is active.

tools.name: List named ranges
tools.description: List named ranges and named expressions on a spreadsheet. Each entry returns its name and either an A1 range or an exact literal expression. External-workbook expressions remain unresolved.

tools.name: List pinned messages
tools.description: List all pinned messages in a channel. Pinned messages are highlighted by members for ongoing reference (announcements, canonical links, etc.). Returns messages in newest-pin-first order.

tools.name: List pipeline members
tools.description: List the members of a CRM pipeline. Deal visibility is pipeline membership: a deal is visible to admins/owners and to members of its pipeline (directly or via a team). Roles are admin (can manage the pipeline + members) or member.

tools.name: List pipelines
tools.description: List all CRM pipelines with their stages. Each pipeline contains an ordered list of stages with names, sort order, and default probabilities. Use this before creating or moving deals to find valid pipeline_id and stage_id values.

tools.name: List pivot tables
tools.description: List every pivot table across every tab of the sheet. Each entry is annotated with the `tab` name it lives in.

tools.name: List products
tools.description: List products in the workspace catalog. Use this when the user asks about pricing or available SKUs, or before adding a product as a deal line item.

tools.name: List projects
tools.description: List accessible projects in the current workspace, optionally filtering by a case-insensitive name query before pagination. Returns each project with name, icon, color, visibility, and task count. Use this when the user asks to see their projects or find a project by name.

tools.name: List project updates
tools.description: List status updates for a project, newest first. Returns the health timeline with author and timestamp.

tools.name: List protected ranges
tools.description: List all protected ranges on a spreadsheet. Returns each range with its ID, A1 range, description, warningOnly flag, and editorUserIds allowlist.

tools.name: List quotes
tools.description: List CRM quotes/proposals. Filter by status (draft, sent, accepted, rejected, expired), deal, or contact. Useful for finding outstanding quotes or recently-accepted ones.

tools.name: List resource comments
tools.description: Read comments on a document, task, wiki page, mail conversation, pull request, or code review. Resource type is resolved from ID; a mail conversation can use its thread key with mailbox_id. result preserves threading, pagination, unread counts, and entity references supplied by its owning module.

tools.name: List resources
tools.description: List bookable resources (rooms, equipment) in the workspace. Call before booking a room to see what's available.

tools.name: List roles
tools.description: List all roles in the workspace (system roles + custom roles). Requires admin role.

tools.name: List running executions
tools.description: List in-flight executions across every coworker in the active workspace. Joins coworker_executions → coworkers, filtered by status IN ('PENDING','RUNNING'). Powers the 'Coworkers — running now' saved filter on People & Access.

tools.name: List saved messages
tools.description: List all messages the current user has saved (bookmarked) across all channels. Returns messages with saved_at timestamp, channel name, and channel type. Saved messages are private to the current user (unlike pinned messages, which are shared with the channel).

tools.name: List scheduled mail
tools.description: List scheduled (unsent) emails

tools.name: List scheduled messages
tools.description: List all pending scheduled messages for the current user across all channels. Returns each scheduled message with channel name/type and the scheduled_at timestamp. Use this to review what's queued to send later, or before updating/cancelling a scheduled message.

tools.name: List scheduler bookings
tools.description: List all bookings (across all scheduler links) owned by the current user. Useful for summarizing the user's upcoming meetings.

tools.name: List scheduler link bookings
tools.description: List all bookings for a single scheduler link (owner-scoped).

tools.name: List scheduler links
tools.description: List the user's scheduler links (Calendly-style booking pages). Each link has a shareable slug, duration, availability hours, and optionally auto-creates a contact + deal when booked.

tools.name: List scorable fields
tools.description: List the contact fields that can be used in scoring rules (lifecycle_stage, industry, title, website, custom_properties.*, etc.) and the operators each supports.

tools.name: List scoring rules
tools.description: List all lead scoring rules for the workspace.

tools.name: List send as addresses
tools.description: List available send-as addresses for current user

tools.name: List sent mail
tools.description: List the emails sent from this mailbox.

tools.name: List sequence enrollments
tools.description: List all enrollments for a sequence, including each contact's current step, status, and next execute time. Useful for checking progress or finding an enrollment ID to unenroll.

tools.name: List sequences
tools.description: List all CRM email/task sequences (multi-step automated outreach campaigns). Returns sequences with their steps, active status, and current enrollment count.

tools.name: List shared drive files
tools.description: List files in a shared drive.

tools.name: List shared drive members
tools.description: List shared drive members.

tools.name: List shared drives
tools.description: List shared drives user is a member of.

tools.name: List sheet images
tools.description: List editable floating images with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Image src must reference an image asset owned by this sheet.

tools.name: List sheet picture groups
tools.description: List editable picture groups with cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry. Every leaf references an image asset owned by this sheet; native group transforms use EMU coordinates.

tools.name: List sheets
tools.description: List the current user's spreadsheets (owned + shared). Convenience alias for `GET /api/documents?type=sheet`. Returns the lightweight `SheetSummary` shape without the structured `data` body — call `GET /api/sheets/:id` to load a specific sheet's tabs/columns/rows.

tools.name: List sheet shapes
tools.description: List editable floating shapes with editable text, cell anchors and CSS pixel geometry.

tools.name: List sheet validations
tools.description: List all data validation rules on a spreadsheet. Returns each rule's range (A1 notation) and rule definition (type, values, strict, inputMessage).

tools.name: List sign documents
tools.description: List signing documents in the workspace.

tools.name: List sign templates
tools.description: List reusable signing templates.

tools.name: List slicers
tools.description: List every slicer across every tab of the sheet. Slicers are interactive filter widgets that filter pivots / charts on a shared source range. Each entry is annotated with the `tab` name it lives in.

tools.name: List slide masters
tools.description: List the master slide templates registered on a presentation. Child slides link to masters by reference and resolve current master elements at render time, beneath child-owned elements.

tools.name: List snoozed mail
tools.description: List the snoozed emails in this mailbox.

tools.name: List starred mail
tools.description: List the starred emails in this mailbox.

tools.name: List task attachments
tools.description: List Drive files attached to a task.

tools.name: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks in the workspace. Pass assignee_id to filter by assignee (use the caller's user ID for 'my tasks'). Supports filtering by status, priority, project, and free-text query.

tools.name: List task templates
tools.description: List task templates in the workspace. Templates pre-fill fields when creating tasks. Optionally filter by project. Returns name, default fields (priority, status, estimate, assignee, labels), and creator.

tools.name: List teams
tools.description: List workspace teams visible to the current user. Returns public teams and private teams the user is a member of, with member counts. Filterable by `q` (case-insensitive substring match on name + slug). Optional `limit` caps the result count. Use this when the user asks to see teams, distribution lists, or workspace teams.

tools.name: List trashed files
tools.description: Find deleted Drive file rows and folders the caller owns, trashed themselves, or holds the owner rung on (a folder above it is theirs, or they manage its shared drive). Returns paginated file IDs and metadata for restore_file or permanent_delete_file. Can include materialized native-document shadow rows, but does not list every native Docs, Sheets, Slides or Canvas item: use documents_trash_list for the complete native-document trash owned by the caller. An empty result does not mean the whole workspace trash is empty.

tools.name: List users
tools.description: List workspace members and agents with identity, role, status, storage usage, and timestamps. Requires admin or owner.

tools.name: List user statuses
tools.description: List active chat statuses (emoji + text + DND) for users in the workspace. Only returns users who currently have a non-null status or active DND. Useful for 'who's on vacation?', 'is anyone in meetings?', or similar presence queries.

tools.name: List wiki page databases
tools.description: List all inline databases hosted on a wiki page.

tools.name: List wiki page versions
tools.description: List the saved version snapshots for a wiki page (most recent first). Use this when the user asks for revision history, wants to see who edited and when, or needs to find a version to revert to.

tools.name: List wiki space pages
tools.description: List pages in a wiki space with offset/limit pagination. Returns page summaries (id, title, slug, icon, parent_page_id, sort_order). Use this when the user asks to see all pages in a space, or when you need to paginate through a large space.

tools.name: List wiki spaces
tools.description: List all wiki spaces. Returns spaces with id, name, slug, description, icon, owner info, privacy setting, and page count. Use this when the user asks to see wiki spaces, browse the knowledge base, or when you need a space ID to create a page.

tools.name: List wiki synced blocks by page
tools.description: List synced blocks that were originally created on a specific page. Use this when the user asks what shared content a page publishes, or to audit reuse.

tools.name: Log activity
tools.description: Log an activity on a CRM contact or deal timeline. Activities track interactions like calls, emails, meetings, notes, and tasks. Use this when the user asks to log a call, record meeting notes, or add a note to a contact/deal.

tools.name: Mail alias create
tools.description: Add a new alias on a verified workspace domain

tools.name: Mail alias delete
tools.description: Delete a send-from alias address by id.

tools.name: Mail aliases list
tools.description: List all aliases for current user's mailbox

tools.name: Mail alias set default
tools.description: Set alias as default send-as identity

tools.name: Mail blocklist clear
tools.description: Unblock by raw pattern (convenience for "Unblock sender" button)

tools.name: Mail blocklist remove
tools.description: Unblock a sender by their blocklist entry id.

tools.name: Mail bulk modify
tools.description: Apply one bulk action to emails chosen by id or search query.

tools.name: Mail export eml
tools.description: Export a message as RFC 5322 EML, returning retained source octets when available.

tools.name: Mail external auth url
tools.description: Start connected-mailbox (Gmail) OAuth — returns the consent URL.

tools.name: Mail external connection delete
tools.description: Disconnect a connected mailbox.

tools.name: Mail external connections list
tools.description: List connected mailboxes.

tools.name: Mail external connection test
tools.description: Verify a connected mailbox by fetching its Gmail profile.

tools.name: Mail folder counts
tools.description: Per-folder badge counts for sidebar Returns { inbox: unread_count, drafts, scheduled, snoozed } — Gmail-style.

tools.name: Mail label counts
tools.description: Per-label unread counts for sidebar badges. A separate endpoint so the sidebar can refresh counts on read/receive without re-fetching the label definitions themselves. Shape mirrors /folder-counts.

tools.name: Mail message unsubscribe
tools.description: One-click unsubscribe. Triggers the List-Unsubscribe URL (RFC 8058) on the user's behalf. Falls back to telling the client to open a mailto: link if no HTTP URL is present.

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox assignees
tools.description: The people who can hold a thread in this shared mailbox — team grants flattened to their members.

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox create
tools.description: Create a shared mailbox and address it on a workspace domain (admin only)

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox delete
tools.description: Retire a shared mailbox (admin only). Soft: stored mail is retained and the address stays reserved.

tools.name: Mail shared mailboxes list
tools.description: List the shared mailboxes the caller holds, or every one in the workspace with `scope=managed` (admin only)

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox get
tools.description: Get one shared mailbox and its members

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox member add
tools.description: Grant a user or a team access to a shared mailbox (admin only)

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox member remove
tools.description: Revoke a user's or team's access to a shared mailbox (admin only)

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox restore
tools.description: Restore a retired shared mailbox (admin only). Total — delete cascaded nothing.

tools.name: Mail shared mailbox update
tools.description: Rename a shared mailbox's display name; its address is unchanged (admin only)

tools.name: Mail smart compose
tools.description: Suggest a short continuation of an email draft being written. Takes the text typed so far, optionally the subject and the earlier messages of the thread being replied to, and streams the suggested next words.

tools.name: Mail thread mute status
tools.description: Check if a thread is muted

tools.name: Mail trash list
tools.description: List trashed (soft-deleted) emails — the caller's own rows in folder='trash'. Restore one with `untrash_email`; nothing is purged automatically.

tools.name: Mail unread summary
tools.description: Unread mail summary for a cross-module unread view: the total unread count plus the top N (default 5, max 25) unread inbox rows with sender, subject, preview and timestamp, so a unified list can render without pulling the full inbox.

tools.name: Mark all channels read
tools.description: Mark all channels as read for the current user. Advances the read cursor in every channel the user is a member of to the latest message, clearing all unread badges at once. Use this when the user wants to dismiss all chat unreads (e.g. returning from vacation).

tools.name: Mark channel read
tools.description: Mark a channel as read up to a specific message. This clears the unread badge for the current user. Use this after the user has finished catching up on a channel, or programmatically to dismiss unread counts after the assistant reports on recent messages.

tools.name: Mark channel unread
tools.description: Mark a channel as unread starting from a specific message. Moves the calling user's read cursor back to just before that message, so the channel shows an unread badge and the message becomes the unread boundary. Use this when the user wants to revisit a conversation later.

tools.name: Mark email read
tools.description: Update email status (read/unread, starred, snoozed)

tools.name: Mark thread read
tools.description: Mark a thread as fully read up to the latest reply. Use this after the user has finished catching up on a thread, or when you want to programmatically dismiss unread reply counts for a specific thread.

tools.name: Mark thread unread
tools.description: Mark a thread as unread so it reappears in the threads inbox with an unread badge. An optional reply_id marks that reply onward unread. Omit it to mark the whole thread unread. Restore accepts the prior cursor and its expected current cursor; a newer intent returns 409.

tools.name: Merge contacts
tools.description: Merge two CRM contacts that represent the same person/company. The secondary contact is deleted, and its activities and deals are re-linked to the primary. Use this when you discover duplicates (same email or name). The primary contact is the one kept; the secondary is removed.

tools.name: Migrate document source
tools.description: Activate source-preserving editing on an existing document. Only its owner may migrate; the expected content hash prevents stale activation and the command ID makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: Modify contact group members
tools.description: Bulk add or remove contacts from a contact group. Idempotent — adding an already-present contact or removing an absent one is a no-op.

tools.name: Move sheet column
tools.description: Move a column to a new position. Rewrites dependent formulas so they follow the moved column to the same logical data, and re-anchors notes and comment anchors.

tools.name: Move sheet row
tools.description: Move a row to a new zero-based position, carrying its values, formatting, geometry and dependent references.

tools.name: Notifications dismiss
tools.description: Soft-delete (hide from default feed). Preserved for audit / undismiss.

tools.name: Notifications list
tools.description: List notifications for the current user. Supports cursor pagination via `?cursor=`; legacy offset pagination still works. Filters: `resource_types`, `excluded_resource_types`, `event_types`, `unread_only`; visibility toggles: `include_dismissed`, `include_snoozed`.

tools.name: Notifications mark all read
tools.description: Mark every unread notification in the optional resource/event scope as read.

tools.name: Notifications mark read
tools.description: Mark a single notification read. Returns `was_unread` — true only if THIS call flipped it. A consumer that gets `false` skips the work, so two processes on one identity cannot both act on one notification.

tools.name: Notifications mark unread
tools.description: Convenience alias for `PATCH /api/notifications/:id` with `{read:false}`.

tools.name: Notifications mute create
tools.description: Create or refresh your in-app/live notification suppression rule for resourceId, eventType, or both. Matching direct mentions are suppressed there too; email and push delivery are unchanged. This does not change a chat channel's mute setting or notification preference. For ordinary channel mute/unmute use set_channel_muted. At least one selector is required; resourceId also requires resourceType. until=null or omitted means indefinite. A matching rule's expiry is refreshed.

tools.name: Notifications mute delete
tools.description: Remove a mute rule by id. Scoped to the owning user.

tools.name: Notifications mutes list
tools.description: List active mute rules. Pass `?include_expired=true` to also see rules whose `until` has passed (these no longer suppress notifications).

tools.name: Notifications snooze
tools.description: Hide until `{until: ISO8601}`. Pass `{until: null}` to clear snooze.

tools.name: Notifications undismiss
tools.description: Restore a dismissed notification.

tools.name: Patch canvas element
tools.description: Update one element's fields (geometry, style, text, connector endpoints, lock). Use when moving, restyling, relabeling, or re-anchoring a single element. Provide only the fields to change; the element's id and type stay fixed and every other element is untouched (per-element diff — never a full-board replace). Coordinates: board units, top-left origin, +x right / +y down — set `x`,`y` to move the top-left corner. Example: patch_canvas_element({ id: "<boardId>", elId: "<elId>", x: 240, y: 80 }) moves an element right by 140 units.

tools.name: Patch users notification preferences
tools.description: Partial update of notification preferences. Unknown keys → 400. Non-boolean values → 400.

tools.name: Pause coworker
tools.description: Pause coworker (stops scheduled executions).

tools.name: Permanent delete file
tools.description: Permanently delete a trashed file. Needs the owner rung; shared-drive content additionally needs a manager of that drive. A caller who can see the file without that authority gets 403. Irreversible — confirm with user first.

tools.name: Poll close
tools.description: Close a poll to further voting (creator or channel admin).

tools.name: Poll create
tools.description: Create a poll in a channel. Creator must be a channel member.

tools.name: Poll delete
tools.description: Delete a poll (creator or channel admin).

tools.name: Poll get
tools.description: Poll details (question, options, the caller's votes).

tools.name: Poll get by message
tools.description: Poll results for the poll attached to a chat message.

tools.name: Poll results
tools.description: Tallied poll results (respects anonymity).

tools.name: Poll unvote
tools.description: Remove the caller's vote for a poll option.

tools.name: Poll vote
tools.description: Cast a vote for a poll option.

tools.name: Project members add
tools.description: Add a member. Body `{user_id, role?}` — or `{team_id, role?}` for a team share. A project editor may add, capped at its own role: granting a role above it is refused `403`. Notifies the new member.
