name: Anakin
description: Anakin provides web scraping, crawling, search, browser automation, monitoring, and pre-built website actions for AI agents.

tools.name: Create Monitor
tools.description: Create a recurring page or site monitor with optional structured extraction, browser rendering, and change alerts. Active scheduled checks consume credits.

tools.name: Delete Monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a monitor and all of its retained history. Use only for explicit cleanup because this action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Execute Wire Action
tools.description: Start a parameterized asynchronous Wire action by action ID, optionally using an existing target-site credential, and return a job ID. The selected action may read, create, update, submit, or delete target-site data, and its execution consumes the advertised credits.

tools.name: Get Agentic Search
tools.description: Check an agentic research job and return its generated summary and structured data when complete.

tools.name: Get AI Visibility Search
tools.description: Check an AI visibility search and return its synthesis plus each engine's answer, verdict, latency, credit use, or error.

tools.name: Get Crawl
tools.description: Check a crawl job and return page content, progress, timing, and errors.

tools.name: Get Monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor's current configuration, schedule, and state by ID.

tools.name: Get Monitor Snapshot Content
tools.description: Fetch the stored full-page content for a monitor snapshot identified by a detected change.

tools.name: Get Scrape Job
tools.description: Check a single or batch scrape job and return requested content or per-URL results when complete.

tools.name: Get Site Map
tools.description: Check a site-map job and return discovered internal and external links with timing and errors.

tools.name: Get Wire Catalog
tools.description: Get one Wire website catalog with its executable actions, dynamic parameter schemas, authentication modes, and credit costs.

tools.name: Get Wire Job
tools.description: Check a Wire job and return processing guidance, completed structured data or file metadata, credit use, execution time, or failure details.

tools.name: List AI Visibility Sources
tools.description: List the AI engine slugs currently available for AI visibility searches.

tools.name: List Monitor Changes
tools.description: List up to 200 recent detected changes for a monitor, newest first, including snapshot IDs and structured diffs.

tools.name: List Monitors
tools.description: List all monitors owned by the connected account with their schedules, state, and configuration.

tools.name: List Wire Jobs
tools.description: List Wire execution history one page at a time, including job status and summary statistics when available.

tools.name: Resolve Wire Actions
tools.description: Find Wire actions by intent and optional catalog, category, or authentication filters, including required parameters and credit cost.

tools.name: Run Monitor Now
tools.description: Queue an immediate check for an existing monitor; the run may consume credits.

tools.name: Scrape URL
tools.description: Scrape one URL synchronously when possible, optionally using a browser, extraction schema, saved session, or page actions. Browser actions can click, type, or press keys and may modify an authenticated target site. A timed-out call returns a non-terminal job ID for Get Scrape Job. The scrape may consume credits.

tools.name: Search Web
tools.description: Run a synchronous AI-powered web search and return ranked pages with titles, snippets, and dates. The search consumes credits.

tools.name: Set Monitor State
tools.description: Pause or resume a monitor; resuming can optionally set a new expiration time.

tools.name: Start Agentic Search
tools.description: Start a multi-stage web research job from a natural-language prompt and return its job ID for status checks. The research job consumes credits.

tools.name: Start AI Visibility Search
tools.description: Ask selected AI engines a query and return a search ID for collecting per-engine answers and synthesis. Each selected engine may consume credits.

tools.name: Start Batch Scrape
tools.description: Start a parallel scrape of 1-10 URLs and return a job ID for Get Scrape Job. Each URL may consume credits.

tools.name: Start Crawl
tools.description: Start a bounded multi-page crawl and return a job ID for Get Crawl. Crawled pages may consume credits.

tools.name: Start Site Map
tools.description: Start a bounded site link-discovery job and return a job ID for Get Site Map. The job may consume credits.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Anakin API key, which begins with ak-. Sign in at https://anakin.io/dashboard and copy the key from your dashboard. Keep it secret; newly created keys may take 5-10 seconds to become active.

name: Anchor Browser
description: Anchor Browser is a developer platform that enables AI agents to interact with the web through browser automation, transforming complex web interactions into simple API endpoints.

tools.name: Click Mouse
tools.description: Tool to perform a mouse click at specified coordinates within a browser session. Use when you need to interact with page elements by clicking at specific x/y positions. The click is executed in the context of the specified browser session.

tools.name: Copy Selected Text
tools.description: Tool to copy currently selected text in a browser session to the clipboard. Use when you need to extract text that the user or automation has selected in the browser.

tools.name: Create Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a new integration with a third-party service like 1Password. Use when you need to set up an integration for managing credentials or accessing external services. The integration will be available immediately after creation for use in browser sessions and profiles.

tools.name: Create or Update Task Draft
tools.description: Tool to create or update the draft version of a task. Draft versions are used for development and testing before publishing. Use when you need to save task code changes without creating a published version.

tools.name: Create Profile
tools.description: Creates a new browser profile from an active session. A profile stores cookies, local storage, and cache data. The session must be running when this is called; profile data is persisted once the session terminates. Use profiles to maintain persistent browser state across multiple sessions.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task or update an existing task with the same name. Tasks are reusable TypeScript code snippets that execute in browser sessions. Use when you need to define repeatable automation workflows that can be invoked across multiple sessions.

tools.name: Delete Extension
tools.description: Tool to delete a browser extension and remove it from storage. Use after confirming the extension exists.

tools.name: Delete Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing integration and remove its stored credentials. Use after confirming the integration ID exists.

tools.name: Delete Profile
tools.description: Tool to delete a browser profile by ID. Use after confirming the profile exists.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to soft delete a task and all its versions. Use after confirming the task exists.

tools.name: Delete Task Version
tools.description: Tool to soft delete a specific version of a task. The version will no longer be accessible but data is preserved for recovery. Use when you need to remove a specific task version.

tools.name: Deploy Task
tools.description: Tool to deploy a task by creating a new version with auto-incremented version number. Use when you need to publish task changes and make them available for execution.

tools.name: Double Click Mouse
tools.description: Tool to perform a double click at specified coordinates in a browser session. Use when you need to trigger double-click events on UI elements or specific page locations.

tools.name: Drag and Drop
tools.description: Tool to perform a drag and drop operation from start coordinates to end coordinates within a browser session. Use when you need to simulate dragging UI elements or files in automated workflows.

tools.name: End All Sessions
tools.description: Tool to terminate all active browser sessions at once. Use when you need to immediately close every browser session for the authenticated user, such as during cleanup operations or security concerns.

tools.name: End Browser Session
tools.description: Tool to end a specific browser session by ID. Use after confirming the session ID you want to terminate.

tools.name: Get Batch Session Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed status information for a specific batch including progress and errors. Use when you need to check the status of a batch session creation request.

tools.name: Get Browser Session
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific browser session. Use when you need to check the status, configuration, or execution details of a browser session.

tools.name: Get Clipboard Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current content of the clipboard from a browser session. Use when you need to read clipboard data from an active session.

tools.name: Get Latest Task Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest version of a task including the full base64 encoded code content. Use when you need to access the most recent task implementation.

tools.name: Get Profile (v2)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific profile by its name. Use when you need to fetch information about a particular browser profile.

tools.name: Get Session Pages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all pages associated with a specific browser session. Use when you need to list all open tabs or pages in an active or completed session.

tools.name: Get Task Draft
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the draft version of a task, including the full Base64 encoded code content. Use when you need to access the current draft of a task that hasn't been published yet.

tools.name: Get Task Execution Result
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single task execution result by its ID. Use when you need to check the status, output, or error details of a specific task execution.

tools.name: Get Task Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve task metadata without downloading the full task code. Use when you need task information such as status, creation time, or language without the code content.

tools.name: Get Task Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific version of a task, including the full code content. Use when you need to access the complete task code for a particular version (draft, latest, or specific version number).

tools.name: Get Webpage Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve rendered content of a webpage in HTML or Markdown format. Use when you need to fetch a page’s full content, optionally within an existing browser session.

tools.name: List Agent Resources
tools.description: List all agent resources (files) uploaded to a browser session. Returns metadata for each file including name, size, file type, and last modified timestamp. Requires an active running session - use START_BROWSER_SESSION first. Files can be uploaded using UPLOAD_FILE action.

tools.name: List Extensions
tools.description: Retrieves all browser extensions uploaded by the authenticated user. Use this to view available extensions that can be attached to browser sessions for automation tasks.

tools.name: List Integrations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all integrations for the authenticated team. Use when you need to view available integrations that can be used with browser sessions.

tools.name: List Profiles
tools.description: Tool to fetch all stored browser profiles. Use when you need an overview of all profiles available to the authenticated user (e.g., after creating or deleting profiles).

tools.name: List Session Downloads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata of files downloaded during a browser session. Use after confirming the session ID.

tools.name: List Session Recordings
tools.description: Tool to list all recordings for a specific browser session. Use after confirming the session ID.

tools.name: List Sessions
tools.description: Tool to list all browser sessions. Use when you need to retrieve both active and inactive sessions.

tools.name: List Task Executions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve execution history for a specific task with filtering and pagination support. Use when you need to view past execution results, monitor task success rates, or debug failed executions.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all tasks for the authenticated team. Use when you need to view available tasks with their latest version information and metadata.

tools.name: List Task Versions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all versions of a specific task, including draft and published versions. Use when you need to view the version history of a task or select a specific version for deployment or execution.

tools.name: Mouse Move
tools.description: Tool to move the mouse cursor to specified coordinates within a browser session. Use when you need to simulate mouse movement at the OS level.

tools.name: Navigate to URL
tools.description: Tool to navigate a browser session to a specified URL. Use when you need to direct an existing session to a new webpage.

tools.name: Paste Text
tools.description: Tool to paste text at the current cursor position in a browser session. Use when you need to insert text into an active form field or text area.

tools.name: Pause Agent
tools.description: Tool to pause the AI agent for a specific browser session. Use when you need to temporarily halt autonomous agent execution while keeping the session active.

tools.name: Pause Session Recording
tools.description: Tool to pause the video recording for a specific browser session. Use when you need to temporarily stop recording without ending the session.

tools.name: Perform Keyboard Shortcut
tools.description: Tool to perform a keyboard shortcut using specified keys in a browser session. Use when you need to simulate keyboard input like copy (Control+C), paste (Control+V), or any other key combination.

tools.name: Perform Web Task
tools.description: Tool to perform autonomous web tasks using AI agents. Use when you need to automate complex browser interactions like form filling, data extraction, or multi-step workflows.

tools.name: Mouse Down
tools.description: Tool to perform a mouse button down action at specified coordinates within a browser session. Use when you need to simulate pressing and holding a mouse button at a specific screen position.

tools.name: Publish Task Version
tools.description: Tool to publish a specific version of a task. Creates a new version if it doesn't exist, or updates an existing version's metadata. Use when you need to make a specific task version available for execution. Cannot publish to 'draft' versions.

tools.name: Release Mouse Button
tools.description: Tool to release a mouse button at specified coordinates within a browser session. Use when automating mouse interactions that require button release events, such as completing drag operations or simulating natural mouse behavior.

tools.name: Resume Agent
tools.description: Tool to resume the AI agent for a specific browser session. Use when you need to restart agent execution after it has been paused or stopped.

tools.name: Resume Session Recording
tools.description: Tool to resume video recording for a specific browser session. Use when recording was previously paused and needs to be restarted.

tools.name: Run Task
tools.description: Tool to execute a task in a browser session with a specific or latest version. Use when you need to run an existing task with optional session reuse and configuration overrides.

tools.name: Run Task by Name
tools.description: Tool to execute a task by its name, always using the latest version. Use when you need to run a predefined browser automation task by referencing its name.

tools.name: Screenshot Webpage
tools.description: Tool to take a screenshot of a specified webpage within a session. Use when you need a visual PNG snapshot of a live page. Example: "Capture a 1280×720 screenshot of https://example.com".

tools.name: Scroll Session
tools.description: Tool to perform a scroll action at specified coordinates within a browser session. Use when you need to scroll to specific positions or simulate user scrolling behavior. Example: "Scroll down 100 pixels from position (100, 100) in session sess_123".

tools.name: Set Clipboard Content
tools.description: Tool to set the content of the clipboard in a browser session. Use when you need to programmatically copy text to the clipboard for automated workflows.

tools.name: Signal Event
tools.description: Tool to signal a specific event to be received by other processes or sessions. Use when you need real-time coordination across browser sessions after verifying session is active.

tools.name: Start Browser Session
tools.description: Tool to start a new browser session with optional customizations. Use when you need to programmatically allocate an isolated browser instance with recording, proxy, live view, and feature toggles.

tools.name: Take Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to take a screenshot of the current browser session and return it as an image. Use when you need a visual snapshot of an active browser session.

tools.name: Type Text
tools.description: Tool to type specified text with optional delay between keystrokes. Use when you need to input text into a browser session, such as filling forms or entering search queries.

tools.name: Update Profile
tools.description: Updates an existing browser profile with data from an active session. The profile stores cookies, local storage, and cache from the session. Requires an active (running) browser session - the session_id must reference a session that has not been terminated.

tools.name: Update Task Metadata
tools.description: Updates task metadata (name and description). This does not affect the task code or versions. Use when you need to update task information without modifying the implementation.

tools.name: Upload Extension
tools.description: Tool to upload a new browser extension as a ZIP file for use in browser sessions. Use when you need to add custom extensions that can be attached to automation sessions. The ZIP file must contain a valid extension manifest (manifest.json). Extensions are scoped to the authenticated user and can be listed or attached to sessions later.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to a browser session as an agent resource. Use after starting or referencing a session when you need to provide file inputs (single files or ZIP archives) for web forms or AI-driven tasks. Supports direct base64-encoded content or S3 key references from other actions.

tools.name: Upload Files to Session
tools.description: Tool to upload files directly to a browser session for use with web forms and file inputs. Use when you need to provide file inputs to web forms during automated browser sessions.

tools.name: Wait for Event
tools.description: Blocks execution until a specific named event is signaled or the timeout expires. Used for cross-session coordination, MFA handling, and workflow synchronization. The event must first be signaled using the Signal Event action. Returns the data payload that was sent with the signal. Events are user-scoped.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Anchor Browser API key. Find it in your Anchor Browser dashboard.

name: Android Texter
description: Android Texter connects Android phones to an API for sending and receiving SMS and MMS, managing contacts and devices, and automating messaging workflows.

tools.name: Create Quick Reply
tools.description: Create a reusable quick-reply shortcut. The shortcut must be unique within the connected Android Texter account.

tools.name: Delete Quick Reply
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved quick reply by ID.

tools.name: Get Message Status
tools.description: Get the provider's current queued, sent, delivered, or failed status for a message ID returned by Send Message.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: List contacts in the connected Android Texter account, optionally filtering by name or phone text and tag.

tools.name: List Conversation History
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of inbound and outbound message history exchanged with one phone number. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Devices
tools.description: List Android devices linked to the account, including IDs and online state needed to select a sending device.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: List one newest-first page of messages, optionally restricting results to sent or received messages. Pass next_cursor back as cursor with the same direction to continue.

tools.name: List Quick Replies
tools.description: List saved quick-reply shortcuts that can be reused when composing messages.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Immediately queue a real SMS or MMS to one phone number through a linked Android device. This has an external side effect and consumes message quota. A successful queue acknowledgement does not prove that the message was sent or delivered.

tools.name: Send Messages Batch
tools.description: Sequentially queue the same real SMS or MMS for 1-10 recipients. Each queued message is irreversible and consumes quota. Processing stops after the first failed or unknown attempt, and remaining recipients are marked not_attempted.

tools.name: Update Quick Reply
tools.description: Replace an existing quick reply's shortcut, title, and body.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate a user-scoped API key in the Android Texter dashboard at Settings > API Keys (https://androidtexter.com/dashboard/settings/api-keys). Copy the complete key, including its atx_ or at_ prefix. It is sent in the X-API-Key header and should be kept secret.

name: Anonyflow
description: AnonyFlow offers a simple and powerful service for encryption-based data anonymization and community sharing, enabling GDPR, CCPA, and HIPAA data privacy protection compliance.

tools.name: Anonymize Packet
tools.description: Tool to anonymize a JSON data packet with support for partial anonymization. Use when you need to conceal specific fields in structured data. If keys array is empty, the complete data packet will be anonymized.

tools.name: Anonymize Value
tools.description: Tool to anonymize a string or array of string values. Use when you need to conceal sensitive text before storage or transmission. Example: `AnonymizeValue().execute(AnonymizeValueRequest(data=['secret']))` Limitations: Only supports list of strings, not nested structures.

tools.name: Deanonymize Packet
tools.description: Tool to deanonymize a JSON data packet using your private key. Use after receiving an anonymized packet to recover specific fields.

tools.name: Deanonymize Value
tools.description: Tool to deanonymize one or more anonymized string values. Use when you need to recover the original plaintext values after encryption-based anonymization. Example: `DeanonymizeValue().execute(DeanonymizeValueRequest(data=["<anonymized_string>"]))`

tools.name: Test Connection
tools.description: Tool to test the connection to the AnonyFlow API. Use when verifying that the AnonyFlow service is reachable and operational before performing anonymization tasks. Example: `TestConnection().execute(TestConnectionRequest())`

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your AnonyFlow API key, obtainable from your AnonyFlow account under the 'Get API Key' section.

name: Anthropic Administrator
description: The Anthropic Admin API allows programmatic management of organizational resources, including members, workspaces, and API keys.

tools.name: Create Message
tools.description: Create a message completion from Claude. Send a conversation history with user/assistant messages and receive Claude's response. Useful for: chatbots, Q&A systems, text generation, conversational AI, and any task requiring natural language understanding or generation.

tools.name: Get Model
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific model by its ID. Use after confirming the model ID is valid.

tools.name: List models
tools.description: Tool to list available models. Use when you need to see which models are available before selection. Always source model IDs from this tool rather than hard-coding them; stale or outdated model IDs passed to CREATE_MESSAGE will cause a not_found_error.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The Admin API key used for authentication, starting with 'sk-ant-admin...'.

name: AnyAPI
description: AnyAPI provides a marketplace of utility APIs for validation, currency conversion, holidays, document generation, web data, and other common application workflows.

tools.name: Analyze Sentiment
tools.description: Classify the sentiment of English, Spanish, or Portuguese text and return the provider's label, score, language, and tokens.

tools.name: Calculate VAT
tools.description: Calculate the tax-inclusive total and applicable VAT details for a pre-tax amount and country, optionally considering a VAT number and state code.

tools.name: Check Holiday
tools.description: Return holidays AnyAPI reports for a calendar date and country; reported holiday dates can differ from the requested date.

tools.name: Convert Currency
tools.description: Convert a monetary amount between two currency codes using the latest available exchange rate.

tools.name: Create Google Sheet Row
tools.description: Append a row to a Google Sheets tab. Before calling this action, link the Google account that can access the spreadsheet inside AnyAPI.

tools.name: Delete Google Sheet Row
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing row from a Google Sheet tab by its row ID. Before calling this action, link the Google account that can access the spreadsheet inside AnyAPI.

tools.name: Find Phone Numbers
tools.description: Find phone numbers in text and return each number's parsed format, validity, type, and character offsets.

tools.name: Generate Blog OpenGraph Image
tools.description: Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing. Intended to generate a downloadable PNG OpenGraph image for a blog post from its title and author.

tools.name: Generate PDF Invoice
tools.description: Generate and return a downloadable PDF invoice using seller, customer, tax, payment, locale, and up to one line item.

tools.name: Get Google Sheet Document
tools.description: Return a Google Sheets document's title, locale, and sheet-tab titles. Requires the AnyAPI account to have a Google account linked inside AnyAPI.

tools.name: Get Google Sheet Rows
tools.description: Get the JSON payload for one Google Sheets tab as an object or array of row objects. AnyAPI's documentation conflicts: its example shows document metadata instead of rows, so callers must inspect the returned data shape. This requires a Google account to be linked separately inside AnyAPI in addition to the AnyAPI API key.

tools.name: Get VAT Rates
tools.description: Return the latest applicable VAT rate and charge treatment for a country and optional VAT number.

tools.name: List Exchange Rates
tools.description: Return the latest available exchange rates for every supported currency relative to an optional base currency, or AnyAPI's default when omitted.

tools.name: List Holidays
tools.description: List holidays for a country, optionally narrowed by subdivision, language, and year.

tools.name: Lookup IP
tools.description: Look up approximate location, timezone, daylight-saving, and country-flag details for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage
tools.description: Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing. Intended to render and scrape a public HTTP or HTTPS webpage, optionally returning only content matching a CSS selector.

tools.name: Take Website Screenshot
tools.description: Currently unavailable because AnyAPI's Chromium runtime is failing. Intended to capture a public webpage as a downloadable PNG, JPEG, or PDF with optional viewport, quality, and full-page settings.

tools.name: Validate Email
tools.description: Validate an email address and report syntax, typo, disposable-domain, and MX checks.

tools.name: Validate IBAN
tools.description: Validate an IBAN and return its normalized formats plus bank and BIC details.

tools.name: Validate Phone Number
tools.description: Validate and parse one phone number into country, type, international, national, and telephone-URI forms.

tools.name: Validate VAT Number
tools.description: Validate a VAT number and return its normalized identifier plus country and registered-company details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to AnyAPI.io, open the platform dashboard, and create or copy your API key. AnyAPI authenticates requests by sending this secret in the apiKey query parameter, so do not share or log request URLs containing it.

name: AnyDB
description: AnyDB is a flexible collaborative database platform for organizing records, files, sharing, and automated workflows.

tools.name: Copy Record
tools.description: Duplicate an AnyDB record and its child-record subtree, optionally into another database or parent. attachments_mode controls file attachments only.

tools.name: Create Record
tools.description: Create a record in an AnyDB database, optionally attaching it to a parent and setting cell content.

tools.name: Delete Record Permanently
tools.description: Permanently delete one AnyDB record. This operation is irreversible and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Get Record
tools.description: Fetch one AnyDB record by ID, including its metadata and cell content.

tools.name: List Databases
tools.description: List databases in an AnyDB team and return root and recycle-bin IDs used by record workflows.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: Return one page of record summaries from a database, optionally constrained by parent or template.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: List AnyDB teams available to the connected account, including the IDs needed to discover databases.

tools.name: Search Records
tools.description: Search a database for records matching a keyword, with caller-controlled offset and limit.

tools.name: Update Record
tools.description: Update an AnyDB record's name, lock state, parent, user/group assignees, or cell content.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log in at https://app.anydb.com, open the user icon, select the Integration tab, and copy the API key shown there. Keep this value secret.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Enter the email address of the AnyDB user who owns the API key. AnyDB requires this email together with the key on every external integration API request.

name: ApexVerify
description: ApexVerify validates and normalizes email addresses and phone numbers individually or in batches to improve contact-data quality.

tools.name: Delete Batch
tools.description: Permanently delete one ApexVerify batch by its exact UUID. Deletion is irreversible and unavailable while the batch is processing; verify the target batch first and deliberately set confirm_deletion=true.

tools.name: Export Batch Results
tools.description: Export a completed batch as structured JSON for analysis or as a downloadable XLSX workbook. This reads existing results and does not consume verification credits.

tools.name: Get Account Credits
tools.description: Return the connected ApexVerify account's available email and phone verification credit balances. Use this before any credit-consuming verification.

tools.name: Get Batch Details
tools.description: Get an ApexVerify batch's status, metadata, parsed-content counts, estimated verification cost, parameters, and final statistics. Repeat this call to monitor preparation or verification.

tools.name: Launch Batch Verification
tools.description: Launch paid verification for a prepared batch. This consumes the batch's estimated net email or phone credits and can fail when credits are insufficient. First inspect Get Batch Details and Get Account Credits, then deliberately set confirm_credit_spend=true.

tools.name: List Batches
tools.description: List verification batches, optionally restricted by creation time, one offset-controlled page at a time.

tools.name: Normalize Data File
tools.description: Normalize email addresses or phone numbers from a line-delimited TXT file without performing verification or consuming verification credits.

tools.name: Prepare Batch
tools.description: Start or repeat asynchronous parsing, deduplication, format cleanup, and verification-cost calculation for an uploaded batch. This idempotent action does not launch paid verification. Poll Get Batch Details until the batch is ready for verification.

tools.name: Upload Verification Batch
tools.description: Create an ApexVerify verification batch from a line-delimited TXT file. Uploading does not consume verification credits; verification starts only when the batch is launched separately.

tools.name: Verify Email or Phone
tools.description: Verify one email address or phone number in real time. This consumes the corresponding prepaid verification credit; cache hits may receive a partial refund. Check account credits first and deliberately set confirm_credit_usage=true.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign up or log in at https://app.apexverify.com, open API Access, click ADD API KEY, and copy the generated key. Keep this key secret; revoked or invalid keys cannot access the ApexVerify API.

name: API Labz
description: API Labz offers a comprehensive suite of AI-driven APIs and tools designed to streamline workflows, automate tasks, and build innovative applications.

tools.name: Validate IBAN
tools.description: Tool to validate International Bank Account Numbers (IBANs). Use when you need to verify an IBAN's structure before processing transactions.

tools.name: Integrate Deal
tools.description: Tool to integrate a deal into API Labz. Use when you need to push a new or updated deal record into the system after preparing required fields.

tools.name: List Airtable Tables
tools.description: Tool to list all Airtable tables for a given base. Use when you need to retrieve table names before interacting with a table.

tools.name: Trello AI Search Engine
tools.description: AI-powered semantic search tool for Trello cards across boards and lists. Use this when you need to: - Find cards by natural language queries (e.g., "bug reports from last week") - Search across multiple Trello boards or within a specific board/list - Locate cards containing specific keywords, topics, or concepts - Discover relevant cards without knowing exact titles Returns matching cards with IDs, titles, descriptions, and direct URLs for easy access.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key for authenticating requests to API Labz.

name: API Ninjas
description: API Ninjas offers over 120 unique APIs across various categories, enabling developers to build real applications with real data.

tools.name: Analyze Nutrition
tools.description: Tool to extract nutrition information from text query. Use when you need to parse food-related text (e.g., recipes, menus) to calculate corresponding nutrition data.

tools.name: Analyze Text Sentiment
tools.description: Tool to analyze the sentiment of text. Returns a numerical sentiment score from -1 to 1 and a classification (POSITIVE, WEAK_POSITIVE, NEUTRAL, WEAK_NEGATIVE, or NEGATIVE). Use when you need to determine the emotional tone or sentiment of text content.

tools.name: Assess NAICS Risk
tools.description: Assess documented compliance risk indicators for NAICS codes. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: Calculate Airport Distance
tools.description: Calculate great-circle distance, initial bearing, and estimated flight time between two airports. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Calculate Calories Burned
tools.description: Tool to calculate calories burned for an activity based on duration and body weight. Use when you need to estimate energy expenditure for physical activities.

tools.name: Calculate Currency Volatility
tools.description: Calculate realized volatility and percentile context for a currency pair. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Calculate Income Tax
tools.description: Tool to calculate income taxes for US and Canada. Use when you need detailed breakdown of federal, state/provincial, and FICA taxes. Country and region codes must be correct.

tools.name: Calculate Mortgage
tools.description: Tool to calculate mortgage payments and breakdowns. Use when you need to determine monthly/annual payments, including mortgage, property tax, HOA, and insurance components.

tools.name: Calculate Paycheck Withholding
tools.description: Calculate federal, FICA, and optional state paycheck withholding. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Calculate Sales Tax
tools.description: Tool to calculate sales tax for a purchase amount at a US location. Use when you need to determine the sales tax for a purchase based on ZIP code or city/state. Premium features include detailed breakdowns by city, county, and special districts.

tools.name: Check Bank Holiday
tools.description: Check whether banks are closed on a date in a country or subdivision.

tools.name: Check Disposable Email
tools.description: Tool to check whether an email address is from a disposable email provider. Use when validating user emails prior to sending communications.

tools.name: Check Domain Availability
tools.description: Tool to check domain availability and retrieve registration information. Use when you need to verify if a domain is available for registration or get details about an existing domain.

tools.name: Check Holiday
tools.description: Return all documented holiday categories on a date across every country when country is omitted; use Check Is Public Holiday for a country-specific public-holiday boolean or Check Bank Holiday for bank closures.

tools.name: Check If Date Is Public Holiday
tools.description: Tool to check if a specific date is a public holiday in a given country. Use when you need to verify holiday status for scheduling, planning, or calendar-related tasks. Returns holiday name if applicable.

tools.name: Check If Date Is Working Day
tools.description: Tool to check if a date is a working day in a specific country. Returns whether the date is a working day, accounting for weekends and public holidays. Use when you need to determine if a business is likely to be open on a specific date.

tools.name: Check Lottery Ticket
tools.description: Score a supported lottery ticket against a draw. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Check Sales Tax Nexus
tools.description: Evaluate supplied sales and transaction totals against a state's economic-nexus rules. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Check Spelling
tools.description: Tool to check spelling and get corrections for text. Returns the original text, corrected version, and detailed corrections with alternative suggestions.

tools.name: Classify Business NAICS
tools.description: Classify a business description to a NAICS code. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: Compute Text Similarity
tools.description: Tool to compute semantic similarity between two texts. Returns a similarity score from 0 to 1 using NLP embeddings and cosine similarity. Use when comparing text content, detecting duplicates, or measuring semantic relatedness.

tools.name: Convert Airport Code
tools.description: Resolve an IATA, ICAO, GPS, ident, or local airport code to the matching airport record.

tools.name: Convert Currency
tools.description: Convert between currencies using current exchange rates. Returns the converted amount with both source and target currency details. Use this when you need to know how much a specific amount in one currency is worth in another currency.

tools.name: Convert Unit
tools.description: Convert between measurement units across different categories. Returns converted values for all units in the same category. Use this when you need to convert measurements (length, weight, temperature, volume, area, time, speed, etc.) from one unit to another.

tools.name: Detect Faces
tools.description: Detect faces and return their pixel bounding boxes in a JPEG or PNG image.

tools.name: Detect Objects
tools.description: Detect labeled objects and bounding boxes in a JPEG or PNG image.

tools.name: Detect Text Language
tools.description: Tool to detect the language of input text. Returns the ISO language code and full language name. For best accuracy, use text with 10 or more words.

tools.name: Extract Text From Image
tools.description: Extract text blocks and pixel bounding boxes from a JPEG or PNG image.

tools.name: Extract Webpage Content
tools.description: Tool to extract main content and metadata from a webpage. Returns URL, domain, path, page title, description, meta tags, and favicon. Use when you need to retrieve structured information from any web page.

tools.name: Filter Profanity from Text
tools.description: Tool to detect and censor profanity in text. Returns the original text, censored version with profane words replaced by asterisks, and whether profanity was detected.

tools.name: Find Closest Airport
tools.description: Find airports near coordinates, with distance and optional size, runway, and IATA filters. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Find EV Charging Stations
tools.description: Tool to find electric vehicle charging stations near a specified location. Use when you need to locate EV charging infrastructure by geographic coordinates.

tools.name: Forecast Currency Volatility
tools.description: Forecast currency-pair volatility across requested trading-day horizons. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Generate Barcode Image
tools.description: Tool to generate a barcode image for specified text. Use when you need a barcode image (PNG or SVG) of custom data.

tools.name: Generate Lorem Ipsum Text
tools.description: Tool to generate Lorem Ipsum placeholder text. Use when you need dummy text for design mockups, testing, or content placeholders.

tools.name: Generate Secure Password
tools.description: Tool to generate secure random passwords with configurable length and character types. Use when you need to create strong passwords with a chosen length and optional exclusion of numbers or special characters. Uppercase and lowercase exclusions are not supported by the provider.

tools.name: Generate QR Code
tools.description: Tool to generate QR code images for encoding data. Use when you need to create scannable QR codes for URLs, text, or other data. Returns the QR code as a PNG or SVG image file.

tools.name: Generate Random User Profiles
tools.description: Tool to generate fake random user profiles with realistic data. Returns user profiles with names, addresses, contact info, job details, and technical data. Use when you need realistic test data, demo users, or placeholder profiles for development and testing purposes.

tools.name: Generate Sudoku Puzzle
tools.description: Tool to generate a new Sudoku puzzle with a specified difficulty level. Use when you need to create Sudoku puzzles for games or educational purposes. Returns both the puzzle grid (with empty cells) and the complete solution.

tools.name: Generate Text Embeddings
tools.description: Tool to encode text into vector embeddings using NLP models. Use when you need to generate semantic vectors for text comparison, search, or recommendation systems.

tools.name: Generate Text Embeddings Batch
tools.description: Generate embeddings for up to ten texts using a bounded sequence of calls to the provider's singular embeddings endpoint, returning per-item vectors or errors.

tools.name: Generate User Agent String
tools.description: Tool to generate realistic random user agent strings with optional filters for brand, model, OS, and browser. Use when you need authentic-looking user agent strings for web scraping, testing, or browser simulation.

tools.name: Get Account Analytics
tools.description: Return connected-account subscription and API usage analytics while redacting the API key. Requires Professional or Enterprise; account-private and zero-quota.

tools.name: Get Random Life Advice
tools.description: Tool to get a random piece of life advice from the API Ninjas Advice endpoint. Use when you need motivational or thought-provoking advice.

tools.name: Get Aircraft Information
