tools.name: List Failures To Deliver
tools.description: List the latest and historical SEC failures-to-deliver records for a security.

tools.name: List Financial Statement Periods
tools.description: List fiscal years and periods with an available balance sheet, cash-flow statement, or income statement for a company. Requires Premium.

tools.name: List Income Statement Periods
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility tool for income-statement availability. Use API_NINJAS_LIST_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PERIODS with statement_type=income_statement. Requires Premium only. <<DEPRECATED use API_NINJAS_LIST_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_PERIODS>>

tools.name: List Institutional Movers
tools.description: List securities with the largest recent institutional ownership changes. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: List IPO Calendar
tools.description: List documented US IPO calendar records and filing details.

tools.name: List Lottery Games
tools.description: List documented lottery games and their rules.

tools.name: List Lottery Jackpots
tools.description: List current lottery jackpots using optional geography and currency filters. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: List Motorcycle Makes
tools.description: List motorcycle manufacturers accepted by the motorcycle API. Requires Business tier and above, or any annual plan.

tools.name: List Motorcycle Models
tools.description: List motorcycle models for a manufacturer. Requires Business tier and above, or any annual plan.

tools.name: List Quote Authors
tools.description: List quote authors available to the Quotes API with offset pagination. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: List Sales Tax Holidays
tools.description: Return US sales tax holiday periods, eligible categories, price caps, and coverage metadata.

tools.name: List Short Interest Calendar
tools.description: List short-interest settlement and publication dates for a calendar year.

tools.name: List Stock Exchange Holidays
tools.description: List market holidays and closure details for a stock exchange. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: List Stock Exchanges
tools.description: List all stock exchanges and their identity, location, market size, currency, timezone, and session details. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: List Stock News
tools.description: List dated news articles for one or more stock tickers with offset pagination. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: List Stock Splits
tools.description: List forward or reverse stock splits for a ticker or date range.

tools.name: List Stock Tickers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all available stock ticker symbols and company names. Use when you need to browse available stocks or find ticker symbols for specific companies. Returns company tickers and names with pagination support.

tools.name: List Upcoming Earnings
tools.description: List scheduled company earnings announcements by date or ticker. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: List Weather Icons
tools.description: List weather condition codes and their icon metadata. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Lookup BIN
tools.description: Look up issuer, country, and payment-network details for a BIN.

tools.name: Lookup BSB
tools.description: Look up an Australian BSB and return its bank, branch, address, and payment-network details.

tools.name: Lookup Canada Routing Number
tools.description: Look up a Canadian routing number or transit and institution pair to return branch details.

tools.name: Lookup DNS Records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve DNS records for a specified domain. Use when you need DNS record details for troubleshooting or validation.

tools.name: Lookup IBAN
tools.description: Tool to look up and validate an International Bank Account Number (IBAN). Use when you have an IBAN and need to retrieve its components (country, bank code, account number, etc.) and its validity.

tools.name: Lookup India Pin Code
tools.description: Look up Indian postal locations by PIN code, city, district, or state.

tools.name: Lookup IP Address
tools.description: Tool to retrieve geolocation information for an IP address. Returns country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, and timezone data. Use when you need to identify the geographic location or ISP associated with an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

tools.name: Lookup Phone Number
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility tool using the phone-number lookup input and response. Use API_NINJAS_VALIDATE_PHONE_NUMBER. <<DEPRECATED use API_NINJAS_VALIDATE_PHONE_NUMBER>>

tools.name: Lookup Sort Code
tools.description: Look up a UK sort code and return its bank, branch, address, and payment capabilities.

tools.name: Lookup URL
tools.description: Tool to get location information for a URL domain. Returns geolocation data including country, region, city, coordinates, ISP, and timezone. Use when you need to identify the geographic location or hosting provider of a URL.

tools.name: VIN Lookup
tools.description: Tool to decode Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) and retrieve vehicle information. Returns make, model, year, manufacturing country, and VIN components. Use when you need to identify vehicle specifications from a 17-character VIN.

tools.name: Parse User Agent
tools.description: Parse a user-agent string into browser, operating-system, and device details.

tools.name: Scrape Website Content
tools.description: Tool to scrape HTML content from a URL using the API Ninjas Webscraper endpoint. Use when you need to retrieve website content programmatically without dealing with browser automation.

tools.name: Screen Sanctions
tools.description: Screen a person or organization against supported sanctions lists and return candidate matches.

tools.name: Screen Short Interest
tools.description: Screen securities by exchange and short-interest metrics. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: Search Bitcoin Treasuries
tools.description: Deprecated Bitcoin-only treasury search. Use API_NINJAS_SEARCH_CRYPTO_TREASURIES with asset=BITCOIN. <<DEPRECATED use API_NINJAS_SEARCH_CRYPTO_TREASURIES>>

tools.name: Search Branded Foods
tools.description: Find branded food nutrition by barcode, product name, or brand. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Bsbs
tools.description: Search Australian BSB branches by bank, suburb, state, or postcode. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Canada Routing Numbers
tools.description: Search Canadian bank branches by institution, city, province, or postal code. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Crypto Treasuries
tools.description: Search SEC-reported cryptocurrency holdings across supported digital assets.

tools.name: Search Earnings Call Speakers
tools.description: Search earnings-call speakers or retrieve one speaker's profile and appearance history. Requires Business tier and above.

tools.name: Search Earnings Transcripts
tools.description: Find available earnings-call transcript records by company or call date; this does not search transcript text. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search ETFs
tools.description: Search ETFs by fund name, AUM, expense ratio, holdings, or listing country; use Get ETF for an exact ticker. Requires Business tier and above, or any annual plan.

tools.name: Search Institutional Holdings
tools.description: Search institutional holdings by security, manager, or reporting period.

tools.name: Search Institutional Investors
tools.description: Search the institutional-manager directory, filing history, or available quarters. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Motor Carriers
tools.description: Search motor carriers using documented identity and location filters.

tools.name: Search NAICS Codes
tools.description: Search official NAICS text for relevant codes.

tools.name: Search Routing Numbers
tools.description: Search US routing numbers by bank name, location, ZIP code, or SWIFT code. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Sort Codes
tools.description: Search UK bank branches by bank name, city, or postcode. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Search Tickers
tools.description: Search public-company ticker symbols by company name and keyword exclusions. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Solve Sudoku Puzzle
tools.description: Tool to solve a Sudoku puzzle using the API Ninjas Sudoku Solver. Takes a partially filled puzzle grid and returns the complete solution if one exists. Use when you need to solve standard or custom-sized Sudoku puzzles (2x2, 3x3, or 4x4 box dimensions).

tools.name: Suggest Airports
tools.description: Suggest compact airport matches for a name or code query, optionally filtered by country and size. Requires Premium only.

tools.name: Update Counter
tools.description: Increment or set persistent counter state scoped to the connected API key; use value=0 to reset a counter.

tools.name: Validate Email
tools.description: Tool to validate email address format and check deliverability. Returns validity status, domain info, MX records, disposability check, and email role categorization. Use when you need to verify if an email address is valid and deliverable before sending communications.

tools.name: Validate Phone Number Format
tools.description: Validate phone-number formatting and return normalized national, international, and E.164 forms plus country, location, and time-zone information. This endpoint does not return carrier or line-type metadata; use Validate Phone Number for that lookup.

tools.name: Validate Phone Number
tools.description: Validate and normalize a phone number and return country, carrier, line-type, VoIP, mobile-network, and disposable-number metadata.

tools.name: Validate Routing Number
tools.description: Tool to validate and retrieve bank information from a routing number. Use when you need to verify a 9-digit routing number and get associated bank details including name, location, and contact information.

tools.name: Validate VAT Number
tools.description: Validate a VAT number and return its registration and business details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key associated with your API Ninjas account.

name: API-Sports
description: API-Sports provides comprehensive sports data APIs covering over 2,000 competitions with more than 15 years of historical data, offering real-time updates and easy integration for developers.

tools.name: Get AFL Games
tools.description: Tool to retrieve AFL games and matches. Use when filtering games by id, date, league, season, team, or timezone to get upcoming, past, or live matches.

tools.name: Get AFL Game Player Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve player statistics from AFL (Australian Football League) game(s). Use when you need detailed player performance data for specific AFL games by game ID, a list of up to 10 game IDs, or date. Optionally choose a timezone.

tools.name: Get AFL Seasons
tools.description: Tool to get the list of available seasons for AFL. All seasons are 4-digit keys (e.g., 2018 for 2018-2019 season). Use when you need season filters for AFL endpoints.

tools.name: Get AFL Standings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve AFL standings for a league. Use when needing current team rankings, points, and positions for a specific season.

tools.name: Get Baseball Games Head-to-Head
tools.description: Tool to get head-to-head baseball games between two teams. Use when comparing the match history between two specific baseball teams.

tools.name: Get Basketball Bets
tools.description: Tool to get all available basketball bet types. Use when you need to retrieve available betting options for basketball games.

tools.name: Get Basketball Bookmakers
tools.description: Tool to get all available basketball bookmakers. Use when you need to retrieve available bookmakers for basketball odds and betting data.

tools.name: Get Basketball Games
tools.description: Retrieve Basketball games for a league and season, optionally by team.

tools.name: Get Basketball Game Player Statistics
tools.description: Retrieve player-level performance statistics for a Basketball game.

tools.name: Get Basketball Standings
tools.description: Retrieve ranked Basketball teams for a league season.

tools.name: Get basketball statistics
tools.description: Tool to get basketball statistics for a team in a given league and season. Use when you need detailed basketball team statistics including games played, wins, losses, points, and other performance metrics.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Circuits
tools.description: Tool to get the list of available Formula 1 circuits. Use when searching for circuits by id, competition, name, or search term.

tools.name: Get Coaches
tools.description: Tool to fetch coaches and their career history. Use when you need coach info by ID, team filter, or name search.

tools.name: Get Countries
tools.description: Tool to fetch available countries for league queries. Use when filtering by name, code, or search string before retrieving leagues.

tools.name: Get Fighters Records
tools.description: Tool to get fighter career statistics. Use when you need a fighter's complete record including wins, losses, draws, knockouts, and submissions.

tools.name: Get Fixtures
tools.description: Tool to retrieve football fixtures/matches. Use when filtering fixtures by id, date, league, season, team, or date ranges to get upcoming or past matches. Always provide at least one of season, date, team, or league to avoid oversized payloads. Never guess IDs — obtain valid league, season, team, or fixture IDs before calling this tool.

tools.name: Get fixtures events
tools.description: Tool to get events (goals, cards, substitutions, VAR, etc.) from a fixture. Use when you need detailed event data after confirming the fixture ID.

tools.name: Get Head-to-Head Fixtures
tools.description: Tool to get head-to-head fixtures between two teams. Use after determining team IDs to compare their direct match history.

tools.name: Get Fixture Lineups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve starting XI and substitutes for a fixture. Use after confirming fixture ID; optionally filter by team, player, or section (startXI/substitutes). Lineups appear ~20-40 minutes before kickoff for supported competitions.

tools.name: Get fixtures players
tools.description: Tool to get player statistics from a fixture. Use when you need detailed per-player stats for a specific match. Optionally filter by team.

tools.name: Get Fixtures Rounds
tools.description: Tool to get the rounds for a league or cup. Use after confirming league and season to retrieve available round identifiers (optionally with dates) for filtering fixtures.

tools.name: Get fixture statistics
tools.description: Tool to get statistics for a fixture. Use when you need detailed match stats (shots, fouls, possession, cards, passes, etc.), optionally filtered by team, statistic type, or including halftime data.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Competitions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Formula 1 competitions (Grand Prix races). Use when filtering competitions by id, name, country, city, or search term.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Pit Stops
tools.description: Retrieve pit stops for a Formula 1 race, optionally filtered by team or driver.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Races
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Formula 1 race information for a given season. Use when you need to get race schedules, results, or details for a specific Formula 1 competition season.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Starting Grid
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the starting grid for a Formula 1 race. Use when you need to get the qualifying positions and times for drivers before a race starts.

tools.name: Get games events
tools.description: Tool to get events (goals, penalties, etc.) from a game. Use when you need detailed event data after confirming the game ID.

tools.name: Get AFL Games Quarters
tools.description: Tool to retrieve AFL game quarter scores. Use when you need detailed scoring breakdown by quarter for one or multiple AFL games.

tools.name: Get game statistics by teams
tools.description: Tool to get team statistics from a game by ID. Use when you need detailed team stats (assists, blocks, field goals, rebounds, steals, turnovers, etc.) for a specific game or multiple games.

tools.name: Get Injuries
tools.description: Tool to get injured or suspended players. Use when you need a list of sidelined players filtered by league, season, fixture, team, player, date, ids, or timezone.

tools.name: Get Leagues
tools.description: Tool to retrieve leagues and cups. Use when filtering competitions by id, name, country, code, season, team, type, current, search, or last.

tools.name: Get League Seasons
tools.description: Tool to get the list of available seasons for all leagues. Use when you need season filters for other league endpoints.

tools.name: Get MMA Categories
tools.description: Tool to fetch the list of all available MMA categories. Use when you need to get weight class categories (e.g., 'Flyweight', 'Lightweight', 'Heavyweight') for MMA fights.

tools.name: Get MMA Fighters
tools.description: Tool to fetch MMA fighters data. Use when you need to get fighter information by id, team, name, category, or search term.

tools.name: Get MMA Fights
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of MMA fights according to given parameters. Use when filtering fights by id, date, season, fighter, or weight category to get upcoming or past MMA fight details.

tools.name: Get MMA Fight Results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve results from one or several MMA fights. Use when you need outcome details like victory method, round, time, knockout type, or judge scores for specific fights by id(s) or date.

tools.name: Get MMA Fighter Statistics
tools.description: Tool to get fighter statistics from MMA fights. Use when you need detailed strike, takedown, and grappling statistics for fighters in specific fights or on a specific date.

tools.name: Get NBA game statistics
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate NBA statistics for each team that played a game. Use when you need detailed statistics for a specific NBA game such as points, rebounds, assists, field goals, free throws, and other performance metrics.

tools.name: Get NBA Player Statistics
tools.description: Return NBA player box scores. Provide a player, game, or team filter; season cannot be used alone.

tools.name: Get NFL Standings Conferences
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available conferences for the NFL to be used in the standings endpoint. Use when you need to know which conferences are available for a specific NFL league and season before fetching detailed standings data.

tools.name: Get Odds
tools.description: Tool to fetch pre-match odds. Use when you need odds filterable by fixture, league, season, date, timezone, bookmaker, bet, or to navigate pages.

tools.name: Get Odds Bets
tools.description: Tool to get all available pre-match bet types. Use when filtering by bet ID or searching bet names before fetching odds.

tools.name: Get Odds Bookmakers
tools.description: Tool to list all available pre-match bookmakers. Use when you need to discover or filter bookmakers before fetching odds.

tools.name: Get In-Play Odds
tools.description: Tool to fetch in-play odds for fixtures in progress. Use during live matches to get in-play odds.

tools.name: Get Live Odds Bets
tools.description: Tool to fetch all available bet types for in-play odds. Use when you need to retrieve bet IDs or names (optionally filtering by id or search) before fetching live odds.

tools.name: Get Odds Mapping
tools.description: Tool to get the list of available fixture IDs for the odds endpoint. Use when you need to discover which fixtures have odds data available.

tools.name: Get Players
tools.description: Tool to get player statistics. Use when fetching players by id, team, league, season, search, or pagination. Returned player IDs are used as inputs to downstream tools such as fixtures statistics, predictions, and odds.

tools.name: Get Players Profiles
tools.description: Tool to get the list of all available players. Use when you need player profiles optionally filtered by ID, name search, or page.

tools.name: Get Players Seasons
tools.description: Tool to list all available seasons for player statistics. Use when building a player statistics query, optionally filtering by a specific player id.

tools.name: Get Players Squads
tools.description: Tool to get player squads. Use when fetching the current squad of a team (with team ID) or finding which teams a player belongs to (with player ID).

tools.name: Get player statistics
tools.description: Tool to get player statistics for a specific basketball game. Use when you need detailed performance stats like points, rebounds, assists, field goals, three pointers, free throws, etc. Requires at least a game ID to retrieve player statistics.

tools.name: Get Players Teams
tools.description: Tool to get the list of teams and seasons in which a player played during his career. Use after confirming the player ID to retrieve club history.

tools.name: Get Players Top Assists
tools.description: Tool to get the 20 best players (top assists) for a league or cup. Use after confirming league and season.

tools.name: Get Players Top Red Cards
tools.description: Tool to get the 20 players with the most red cards for a league or cup. Use after confirming league and season.

tools.name: Get Players Top Scorers
tools.description: Tool to get the 20 best players (top scorers) for a league or cup. Use after confirming league and season.

tools.name: Get Players Top Yellow Cards
tools.description: Tool to get the 20 players with the most yellow cards for a league or cup. Use after confirming league and season.

tools.name: Get Predictions
tools.description: Tool to get predictions about a fixture. Use when you need calculated predictions for a given fixture ID. Predictions may not be available for all fixtures; empty or null responses indicate no predictions exist, not an error.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Driver Rankings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Formula 1 driver rankings for a season. Use when querying driver standings, championship positions, or filtering by specific driver or team.

tools.name: Get Fastest Laps Rankings
tools.description: Tool to get the ranking of the fastest laps for a Formula 1 race. Use when retrieving fastest lap times, speeds, and rankings by race, team, or driver.

tools.name: Get Race Rankings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve rankings for a specific Formula 1 race. Use when you need to get finishing positions and lap times for drivers in a race.

tools.name: Get Formula 1 Team Rankings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Formula 1 team rankings for a specific season. Use when you need to get championship standings showing teams ordered by points.

tools.name: Get Sidelined
tools.description: Tool to get sidelined information (injuries, suspensions, etc.). Use when you need current sidelined records filtered by player or coach.

tools.name: Get Standings Divisions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available divisions for an NFL competition to be used in the standings endpoint. Use when you need to know which divisions are available for a specific league and season before fetching detailed standings data.

tools.name: Get Standings Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available groups for a league to be used in the standings endpoint. Use when querying standings groups for a specific league and season before fetching detailed standings data.

tools.name: Get Standings Stages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available stages for a league to be used in the standings endpoint. Use when you need to know which stages or groups are available for a specific league and season before fetching standings data.

tools.name: Get API Status
tools.description: Return connected account identity, subscription status, and daily request usage.

tools.name: Get Teams
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available teams. Use when filtering teams by id, name, league, season, country, code, venue, or search before fetching detailed team data. Team IDs are not inferrable from names; use `name` or `search` to look up and confirm the correct `id` before passing it to downstream requests.

tools.name: Get Team Seasons
tools.description: Tool to get the list of seasons available for a team. Use when you need to know which seasons a specific team has data for.

tools.name: Get team statistics
tools.description: Tool to get detailed statistics of a team for a given league and season. Use after confirming league, season, and team ID.

tools.name: Get Timezone
tools.description: Tool to fetch the complete list of available timezones for fixture queries. Use when you need valid timezone identifiers (e.g., 'Europe/London') before calling fixtures endpoints.

tools.name: Get Transfers
tools.description: Tool to get all available transfers for players and teams. Use when you need transfer history filtered by player or team.

tools.name: Get Trophies
tools.description: Tool to get trophies for a player or coach. Use when you need to list honors filtered by player(s) or coach(es).

tools.name: Get Venues
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available venues. Use when filtering venues by id, name, city, country, or search before fetching detailed venue data.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key provided by API-Sports.

name: API.Bible
description: API.Bible allows developers to integrate Scripture content into their applications or websites for non-commercial purposes.

tools.name: Get All Books
tools.description: Retrieve all books for a specific Bible version. Requires a valid Bible version ID (obtainable from Get Supported Versions). Returns a list of books with their IDs, names, and abbreviations in the Bible's native language.

tools.name: Get Audio Bible by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific audio Bible by its ID. Use when you need metadata about an audio Bible version.

tools.name: Get Audio Book
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single audio Book object for a given audio Bible ID and book ID. Use when you need metadata about a specific audio book.

tools.name: Get Audio Chapter
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single audio chapter with mp3 resource URL. Use when you need to fetch audio content for a specific chapter of an audio Bible. The resourceUrl provided in the response is temporary and expires after a certain time (indicated by expiresAt).

tools.name: Get Bible by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Bible version by its ID. Use when you need full metadata after listing versions. Example prompt: 'Get metadata for bibleId de4e12af7f28f599-01'.

tools.name: Get Book
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single Book object for a given Bible version and book ID. Use when you need details about a specific book, optionally including its chapters.

tools.name: Get Chapter
tools.description: Retrieve a complete chapter with all verses from a Bible version. Use when you need to fetch an entire chapter's content including all verses, navigation to adjacent chapters, and copyright information. First use Get Supported Versions to obtain valid Bible IDs.

tools.name: Get Passage
tools.description: Retrieve a Bible passage by ID. A passage can represent a chapter, verse, or range of verses. Use when you need to fetch specific scripture content with configurable display options.

tools.name: Get Section
tools.description: Retrieve detailed content for a Bible section by ID. A section represents a thematic grouping of verses (e.g., 'The Genealogy of Jesus', 'The Sermon on the Mount'). First use Get Sections to obtain section IDs for a specific book, then use this action to fetch the full content with configurable display options.

tools.name: Get Sections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of sections for a specific book in a Bible version. Use after obtaining the Bible and book IDs to view sectional breakdown.

tools.name: Get Supported Bible Versions
tools.description: Retrieve a list of available Bible versions (translations) from API.Bible. Use this tool to: - List all available Bible translations before searching for verses - Find Bible versions by language (e.g., English, Spanish, German) - Search for specific translations by name or abbreviation - Get the Bible version ID needed for other API.Bible operations The returned version IDs can be used with other API.Bible tools to access specific Bible content like books, chapters, verses, and sections.

tools.name: Get Verse
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Bible verse by ID. Use this action when you need to fetch the content of a single verse from a specific Bible version. First use Get Supported Versions to obtain a valid bibleId, then provide the verse ID in format BOOK.CHAPTER.VERSE (e.g., 'JHN.3.16' for John 3:16). Configurable display options allow control over footnotes, titles, and verse numbering.

tools.name: List Audio Bibles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an array of audio Bible objects authorized for the current API Key. Use when you need to discover available audio Bible versions, filter by language, name, or abbreviation.

tools.name: List Audio Books
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all books for a specific audio Bible version. Use when you need to list available audio books for a given audio Bible ID. Returns a list of books with their IDs, names, and abbreviations in the Bible's native language.

tools.name: List Audio Chapters
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of audio chapters for a specific book in an audio Bible version. Use after obtaining the audio Bible ID and book ID to view available audio chapters.

tools.name: List Chapters
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an array of Chapter objects for a given Bible version and book. Use after obtaining the Bible and book IDs to view all chapters available.

tools.name: List Chapter Sections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an array of section objects for a specific chapter in a Bible version. Use after obtaining the Bible and chapter IDs to view sectional breakdown of a chapter.

tools.name: List Verses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an array of verses for a specific chapter in a Bible version. Use after obtaining Bible and chapter IDs to get all verses in that chapter.

tools.name: Search Bible Verses
tools.description: Search for Bible verses containing specified keywords or passage references. This tool searches within a specific Bible version for verses matching your query. For keyword searches, all keywords must be present in a verse to match. You can also search by passage reference (e.g., 'John 3:16-19'). Use API_BIBLE_GET_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS to get valid Bible version IDs.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key for authenticating requests to API.Bible.

name: API2PDF
description: Api2Pdf is a REST API that enables developers to generate PDFs from HTML, URLs, and various document formats using engines like wkhtmltopdf, Headless Chrome, and LibreOffice.

tools.name: Add Header Footer
tools.description: Convert HTML to PDF with customizable headers and footers using Headless Chrome. Use for generating reports, invoices, or documents with consistent page numbering, titles, dates, or branding on every page.

tools.name: Check API Status
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of the API2PDF service. Use when you need to verify if the API is available and responding. This endpoint does not require authentication and returns a simple status indicator.

tools.name: Delete PDF
tools.description: Delete a previously generated PDF from API2PDF storage by its response ID. By default, API2PDF automatically deletes PDFs after 24 hours. Use this tool when you need to immediately remove a PDF for security or cleanup purposes. The response_id parameter is the ResponseId returned from any PDF generation operation (e.g., merge, convert HTML to PDF, etc.).

tools.name: Extract PDF Pages
tools.description: Tool to extract specific pages from a PDF document. Use when you need only certain pages from a larger PDF file. Provide a URL to the source PDF and optionally a page range (0-indexed, end exclusive). Returns a URL to the extracted PDF.

tools.name: LibreOffice PDF to HTML
tools.description: Tool to convert a PDF document to HTML using LibreOffice. Use when you need HTML output of a PDF file (experimental; images may be excluded).

tools.name: LibreOffice Thumbnail
tools.description: Tool to generate a thumbnail image of a document using LibreOffice. Use when you need a quick visual preview of a PDF or Office file's first page.

tools.name: Merge PDFs
tools.description: Merge multiple PDF documents into a single PDF file. Provide a list of publicly accessible PDF URLs, and they will be combined in the order specified. The merged PDF is available via a download URL for 24 hours.

tools.name: Optimize PDF
tools.description: Tool to optimize a PDF document to reduce file size while maintaining quality. Use when you need to minimize storage or bandwidth for an existing PDF.

tools.name: Reorder PDF Pages
tools.description: Reorder pages of a PDF document by specifying a new page sequence. Provide a URL to the source PDF and a list of zero-based page indices in the desired order. For example, to reverse a 3-page PDF, use pages=[2,1,0]. The reordered PDF is available via a download URL for 24 hours.

tools.name: Generate Barcode or QR Code
tools.description: Tool to generate barcodes or QR codes using Zebra Crossing (ZXING). Use when you need a barcode or QR code image from text values.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key obtained from the Api2Pdf portal.

name: Apiflash
description: ApiFlash is a website screenshot API that allows users to capture high-quality screenshots of web pages programmatically.

tools.name: Batch Capture Screenshots
tools.description: Tool to capture screenshots for multiple URLs in a single request. Use when you have a list of pages to snapshot in batch.

tools.name: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to capture a screenshot of a website. Returns a JSON response with URLs to the screenshot (and optionally extracted HTML/text). Supports extensive customization including viewport dimensions, full page capture, quality settings, element selection, geolocation emulation, and more. Use when you need to capture website screenshots for documentation, testing, or monitoring purposes.

tools.name: Capture Website Screenshot (POST)
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of any website. Returns a URL to the generated screenshot image. Supports full-page captures, custom viewport sizes, and multiple image formats (JPEG, PNG, WebP). Use this tool when you need to visually capture web pages for documentation, monitoring, or analysis.

tools.name: Get Quota Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current API quota usage and limits. Use after authentication to monitor usage and reset times.

tools.name: Get Screenshot Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata (file size, MIME type) for a previously captured screenshot. Use this tool when you need to check the size or format of a screenshot without downloading the full image. Requires the screenshot URL from a prior capture action.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: Your unique API access key for authenticating requests. You can find it in your ApiFlash dashboard.

name: Apiframe
description: Apiframe provides one API for generating and managing AI images, videos, music, uploads, assets, jobs, and custom LoRAs.

tools.name: Generate Image
tools.description: Submit a paid image generation job that consumes Apiframe credits based on the selected model and controls. Call List Models for pricing and controls, then Get Job with the returned job_id to retrieve the result.

tools.name: Generate Music
tools.description: Submit a paid music generation job that consumes Apiframe credits, with cost and output count varying by model. Call List Models for pricing and controls, then Get Job with the returned job_id to retrieve the generated tracks.

tools.name: Generate Video
tools.description: Submit a paid video generation job that consumes Apiframe credits based on the selected model and controls. Call List Models for pricing and controls, then Get Job with the returned job_id to retrieve the result.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the authenticated Apiframe user, team plan and credit balance, role, and active API-key metadata.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Get the current status, progress, provider-specific result, cost, and error details for one Apiframe generation job.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: Return one page of generation jobs, optionally filtered by status, model, job ID, or ownership scope.

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: List Apiframe's current image, video, or music models with pricing and the complete live model-specific control metadata needed to construct generation requests.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy an API key from the Apiframe dashboard at https://console.apiframe.ai. Apiframe v2 API keys begin with afk_; keep the full value secret. You can manage or revoke keys from the same dashboard.

name: Apify
description: Apify is a platform for building, deploying, and managing web scraping and automation tools, known as Actors.

tools.name: Build Actor
tools.description: Tool to build an Actor with specified configuration. Use when you need to create a new build of an Actor with a specific version. The build process compiles the Actor's source code into a Docker image.

tools.name: Abort Actor Build
tools.description: Tool to abort an Actor build that is starting or running. Use when you need to cancel a build in progress. Builds in terminal states (FINISHED, FAILED, ABORTING, TIMED-OUT) are not affected.

tools.name: Delete Actor Build
tools.description: Tool to delete an Actor build permanently. Use when you need to remove a specific build by its ID. The default build for an Actor cannot be deleted. Only users with build permissions can delete builds.

tools.name: Get Actor Build
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific Actor build. Use when you need to retrieve complete build details by build ID. Optionally wait for the build to finish using the waitForFinish parameter to avoid polling.

tools.name: Get Actor Build Log
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the log file for a specific Actor build. Use when you need to inspect logs generated during an Actor build process. Only the trailing 5 million characters of the log are stored.

tools.name: Get user builds list
tools.description: Tool to get a paginated list of all builds for a user. Use when you need to retrieve build history across all actors. Supports pagination up to 1000 records.

tools.name: Abort Actor Run
tools.description: Tool to abort a running or starting Actor run. Use when you need to stop an Actor run that is currently in STARTING or RUNNING status. For runs with status FINISHED, FAILED, ABORTING, and TIMED-OUT this call does nothing.

tools.name: Delete Actor Run
tools.description: Tool to delete a finished Actor run. Use when you need to permanently remove a completed run. Only finished runs can be deleted by the initiating user or organization.

tools.name: Get Actor Run
tools.description: Tool to get details about a specific Actor run. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a run including its execution status, resource usage, storage IDs, and metadata.

tools.name: Update Actor Run Status Message
tools.description: Tool to update the status message of an Actor run. Use when you need to set progress information or status updates that will be displayed in the Apify Console UI during Actor execution.

tools.name: Delete Actor Task
tools.description: Tool to delete an Actor task permanently. Use when you need to remove a task by its ID or username~taskName. Confirm before calling.

tools.name: Get Actor Task
tools.description: Tool to get complete details about an Actor task. Use when you need to retrieve task configuration, input settings, or metadata by task ID or username~task-name.

tools.name: Update Actor Task
tools.description: Tool to update Actor task settings using JSON payload. Only specified properties are updated; others remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify task configuration, input, or execution options.

tools.name: Get last actor task run
tools.description: Tool to get the most recent run of a specific Actor task. Use when you need to retrieve the last execution details. You can filter by status to get only successful runs using status='SUCCEEDED'.

tools.name: Run Task Sync (GET)
tools.description: Tool to run a specific task synchronously and return its output. Use when immediate task results are needed with pre-configured settings. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error.

tools.name: Run Task Sync & Get Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to run an actor task synchronously and retrieve its dataset items. Use when immediate access to task run results is needed. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the request times out. For large datasets exceeding the timeout, use `limit`/`offset` pagination to retrieve results in smaller batches or switch to an async run pattern with a separate dataset retrieval call.

tools.name: Run Task Sync with Input Override & Get Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to run an actor task synchronously with input overrides and retrieve its dataset items. Use when you need to override task input configuration and get immediate results. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the request times out.

tools.name: Run Task Sync (POST)
tools.description: Tool to run an Actor task synchronously with input override and return its output. Use when immediate task results are needed with custom input parameters. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error (though the run continues server-side).

tools.name: Update Actor
tools.description: Tool to update Actor settings using JSON payload. Only specified fields will be updated. Use when you need to modify Actor configuration, make an Actor public, or update version settings.

tools.name: Get last actor run
tools.description: Tool to get the most recent run of a specific Actor. Use when you need to retrieve the last execution details of an Actor and optionally filter by status (e.g., status='SUCCEEDED' to get only the last successful run).

tools.name: Run Actor Sync without Input (GET)
tools.description: Tool to run a specific Actor synchronously without input and return its output. Use when immediate Actor results are needed without providing input data; the run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the HTTP request fails with a timeout error.

tools.name: Run Actor Sync & Get Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to run Actor synchronously and get dataset items. Supports both actors that require input and those that don't. Use when immediate access to Actor results is needed. The run must finish within 300 seconds otherwise the request times out.

tools.name: Get list of Actors
tools.description: Tool to get the list of all Actors that the user created or used. Use when you need to enumerate or browse Actors. Add my=1 to get only user-created Actors.

tools.name: Delete Actor Version
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific version of an Actor's source code. Use when you need to remove an Actor version by actor ID and version number. Confirm before calling.

tools.name: Delete Actor Version Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to delete an environment variable from a specific Actor version. Use when removing environment variables from Actor versions.

tools.name: Get Actor Version Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to get environment variable details for a specific Actor version. Use when retrieving environment variable information from an Actor version. Returns name, value (if not secret), and secret status.

tools.name: Update Actor Version Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to update environment variable for a specific Actor version using JSON payload. Only specified fields will be updated. Use when modifying existing environment variables in Actor versions.

tools.name: Get list of Actor version environment variables
tools.description: Tool to get the list of environment variables for a specific Actor version. Use when you need to retrieve environment variable configurations for an Actor version.

tools.name: Create Actor Version Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to create an environment variable for a specific Actor version. Use when adding new environment variables to Actor versions. Requires name and value parameters.

tools.name: Get Actor version
tools.description: Tool to get details about a specific version of an Actor. Use when you need version metadata including source type, build tag, and configuration details.

tools.name: Update Actor Version
tools.description: Tool to update an Actor version's configuration and source code. Use when modifying version properties such as buildTag, sourceType, or environment variables. Only specified properties will be updated.

tools.name: Get list of Actor versions
tools.description: Tool to get the list of versions of a specific Actor. Use when you need to retrieve version metadata including source type, version number, and configuration details.

tools.name: Create Actor Version
tools.description: Tool to create a new version of an Actor. Use when you need to add a new version with specific source code location and configuration. Requires versionNumber and sourceType parameters, plus conditional parameters based on the sourceType.

tools.name: Get list of Actor webhooks
tools.description: Tool to get a list of webhooks for a specific Actor. Use when you need to review or manage webhooks configured for an Actor.

tools.name: Create Actor
tools.description: Tool to create a new Actor with specified configuration. Use when you need to initialize a fresh Actor programmatically before publishing or running it.

tools.name: Create Dataset
tools.description: Tool to create a new dataset. Use when you need to initialize or retrieve a dataset by name.

tools.name: Create Actor Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new Actor task with specified settings. Use when you need to configure or schedule recurring Actor runs programmatically.

tools.name: Create Task Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a webhook for an Actor task. Use when you need external notifications about task run events (e.g., completion or failure) in downstream systems.

tools.name: Delete Dataset
tools.description: Tool to delete a dataset permanently. Use when you need to remove a dataset by its ID or username~dataset-name. Confirm before calling.

tools.name: Get Dataset
tools.description: Tool to retrieve dataset metadata by dataset ID. Use when you need information about a dataset's structure, item counts, or access URLs. This does not return dataset items themselves.

tools.name: Update Dataset
tools.description: Tool to update a dataset's name via JSON payload. Use when you need to rename an existing dataset.

tools.name: Get list of datasets
tools.description: Tool to get list of datasets for a user. Use when you need to enumerate or browse user's datasets. Supports pagination with up to 1000 items per page.

tools.name: Get Dataset Statistics
tools.description: Tool to get dataset field statistics by dataset ID. Use when you need statistical information about dataset fields including min, max, null count, and empty count. Only provides field statistics when dataset schema is configured.

tools.name: Delete Actor
tools.description: Tool to delete an Actor permanently. Use when you need to remove an Actor by its ID or username~actorName. Confirm before calling.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its ID. Use when removing a webhook after confirming the webhook ID.

tools.name: Discover G2 Products
tools.description: Discover G2 software products with fixed Actor BkxudbF8MgHuC8WfI in product-search mode only; this action never requests reviews or reviewer data. Pricing has a $0.01 run-start event plus product events of $0.00345 Free, $0.003 Bronze, $0.00234 Silver, $0.0018 Gold, $0.0012 Platinum, or $0.00084 Diamond. Thus 10,000 monthly products across 100 runs cost about $35.50 to $9.40. In-run compute and storage are included; retained datasets and later reads consume normal platform storage and monthly usage. Each paid call creates a run and default dataset and is limited to 1,000 products; maxTotalChargeUsd caps event exposure. Ratings are preserved with their distinct raw scales. Apify's global API rate limit is 250,000 requests/minute and synchronous waiting ends after 300 seconds.

tools.name: Get Actor Details
tools.description: Tool to get details of a specific Actor. Use when you need actor metadata by ID or username/actorName. Response includes `isDeprecated` and `notice` fields indicating deprecation status, and `pricingInfos` for per-unit cost details — review both before scheduling runs.

tools.name: Get Actor Last Run Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to get dataset items from the last run of an Actor. Use when you need to retrieve output data from the most recent Actor execution, optionally filtered by run status (e.g., status='SUCCEEDED' to get items only from the last successful run).

tools.name: Get all webhooks
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all webhooks created by the user. Use when you need to enumerate webhooks before filtering or maintenance.

tools.name: Get CARFAX Report by VIN
tools.description: Check CARFAX report availability or purchase PDFs with easytools/carfax-report-by-vin. CHECK_ONLY pricing is $0.99/100 VIN checks. AUTO_PURCHASE buys each found, delivered report for $3.50; this is not a free lookup. Runs also cost $0.001 per GB start (minimum one event). Pricing includes Actor compute and in-run storage; retained PDFs, dataset storage, and later reads/writes use normal Apify credits. There is no monthly rental or caller CARFAX credential. One minimum-memory run is about $9.901/1,000 checks or $3,500.001/1,000 delivered reports before post-run storage; 16 monthly users is adoption, not volume. CARFAX terms limit report use and the Actor grants no redistribution right. VINs run sequentially with no published batch maximum or Actor rate limit. Apify's API limit is 250,000 requests/minute; X-RateLimit-Limit gives the resource limit. maxTotalChargeUsd caps spend. Sync wait is 300 seconds, but a timed-out paid run can continue. FAILED_AFTER_CHARGE needs Actor support.

tools.name: Get dataset items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve items from a dataset. Use when you need to fetch data from a specified dataset by pagination or filtering. Only JSON format is fully supported. For datasets larger than 1000 items, issue multiple calls incrementing `offset` by `limit` until the response returns fewer items than `limit`.

tools.name: Get Default Build
tools.description: Tool to get the default build for an Actor. Use after specifying the Actor ID; optionally wait for the build to finish before returning.

tools.name: Get Key-Value Record
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a record from a key-value store. Use when you need to fetch a specific value by key from an Apify Key-Value Store.

tools.name: Get list of builds
tools.description: Tool to get a list of builds for a specific Actor. Use when you need paginated access to an Actor’s build (version) history.

tools.name: Get list of runs
tools.description: Tool to get a list of runs for a specific Actor. Use when you need to paginate through runs and optionally filter by status before processing run data.

tools.name: Get list of task runs
tools.description: Tool to get a list of runs for a specific Actor task. Use when you need to paginate through task runs and optionally filter by status.

tools.name: Get list of tasks
tools.description: Tool to fetch a paginated list of tasks belonging to the authenticated user. Use when you need to browse or sort tasks created by the user.

tools.name: Get list of task webhooks
tools.description: Tool to get a list of webhooks for a specific Actor task. Use when you need to review or paginate webhooks after creating or updating a task.

tools.name: Get log
tools.description: Tool to retrieve logs for a specific Actor run or build. Use after a run completes or fails — a run may report success status yet contain only informational messages, making log inspection the only way to confirm actual outcomes. For long runs, log responses can be very large; prioritize error-level entries and recent timestamps to diagnose issues efficiently.

tools.name: Get OpenAPI Definition
tools.description: Tool to get the OpenAPI definition for a specific Actor build. Use when you need the API schema for code generation or analysis.

tools.name: Get Run Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to get dataset items from a specific Actor run. Use when you need to retrieve the output data from a completed or running Actor run.

tools.name: Get Run Default Dataset
tools.description: Get metadata for an Actor run's default dataset, not its items. This API read and later dataset storage/reads contribute to Apify usage and monthly charging. The default API resource limit is 60 requests per second.

tools.name: Get Run Default Key-Value Store
tools.description: Get metadata for an Actor run's default key-value store, not record values. This API read and later record storage/reads contribute to Apify usage and monthly charging. The default API resource limit is 60 requests per second.

tools.name: Get Run Default Request Queue
tools.description: Get metadata for an Actor run's default request queue, not queued requests. This API read and later queue storage/reads contribute to Apify usage and monthly charging. The default API resource limit is 60 requests per second.

tools.name: Get Run Input
tools.description: Retrieve the exact JSON input supplied to an Actor run.

tools.name: Get Task Input
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the input configuration of a specific task. Use when you need to inspect stored task input before execution or debugging.

tools.name: Get Task Last Run Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to get dataset items from the last run of an Actor task. Use when you need to retrieve data from the most recent task execution. Filter by status (e.g., 'SUCCEEDED') to get items from the last successful run only.

tools.name: Get US Fuel Price Averages
tools.description: Get one national US fuel-price average record from the third-party crawlerbros/fuel-prices-scraper; this is not an official AAA API. Current pricing is a $0.005 Actor-start event per GB plus $0.001-$0.002 per result by tier, and platform usage is additionally paid by the user. The current 4 GB default charged $0.02 at start in the live probe. This paid call creates a run and dataset, consumes monthly credits, and later dataset storage and reads add usage; it may return history even when includeHistory is false. The action fixes national mode and one result; use maxTotalChargeUsd to cap total exposure.

tools.name: Delete Key-Value Store
tools.description: Tool to delete a key-value store permanently. Use when you need to remove a key-value store by its ID. Confirm before calling.

tools.name: Get Key-Value Store
tools.description: Tool to retrieve key-value store metadata by store ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific key-value store including stats and access URLs.

tools.name: Get Key-Value Store Keys
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of keys from a key-value store. Use when you need to list keys in a store with optional filtering and pagination support.

tools.name: Delete Key-Value Store Record
tools.description: Tool to delete a record from a key-value store. Use when you need to remove a specific record by its key from an Apify Key-Value Store.

tools.name: Check Key-Value Store Record Exists
tools.description: Tool to check if a record exists in a key-value store. Use when you need to verify whether a specific key exists in an Apify Key-Value Store without retrieving its content.

tools.name: Get list of key-value stores
tools.description: Tool to get the list of key-value stores owned by the user. Use when you need to enumerate or browse available stores. Supports pagination up to 1000 records per request.

tools.name: Create Key-Value Store
tools.description: Tool to create a new key-value store or retrieve an existing one by name. Use when you need to initialize a store for saving data records or files. If a store with the given name already exists, returns that store instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: List User Actor Runs
tools.description: Tool to get a paginated list of all Actor runs for the authenticated user. Use when you need to browse all runs across all actors, optionally filtered by status or date range.

tools.name: Delete Request Queue
tools.description: Tool to delete a request queue permanently. Use when you need to remove a request queue by its ID.

tools.name: Get Request Queue
tools.description: Tool to retrieve request queue metadata by queue ID. Use when you need information about a specific request queue including its statistics and request counts.

tools.name: Get Request Queue Head
tools.description: Tool to retrieve first requests from the queue for inspection. Use when you need to examine pending requests without locking them.

tools.name: Get Head and Lock Queue Requests
tools.description: Tool to get and lock head requests from the queue. Returns the given number of first requests from the queue and locks them for the given time, preventing other clients from accessing them during the lock period. Use when you need to process requests exclusively without concurrent access by other clients.

tools.name: Update Request Queue
tools.description: Tool to update request queue name using JSON payload. Use when you need to rename an existing request queue.

tools.name: Delete Request from Queue
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific request from a request queue. Use when you need to remove a request by its ID from an Apify request queue.

tools.name: Get Request from Queue
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific request from a request queue by its ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a request in an Apify request queue.

tools.name: Delete Request Lock
tools.description: Tool to delete a request lock from a request queue. Use when you need to unlock a previously locked request. Only the client that locked the request can delete its lock.

tools.name: Prolong Request Lock
tools.description: Tool to prolong request lock in a request queue. Use when you need to extend the lock duration on a previously locked request. Only the client that locked the request can prolong its lock.

tools.name: Update Request in Queue
tools.description: Tool to update a request in a request queue. Use when you need to modify request properties or mark a request as handled by setting handledAt to the current date/time. If handledAt is set, the request will be removed from the head of the queue and unlocked if applicable.

tools.name: Batch Delete Requests from Queue
tools.description: Tool to batch-delete up to 25 requests from a queue. Use when you need to remove multiple requests efficiently. Failed requests due to rate limits should be retried with exponential backoff.

tools.name: Batch Add Requests to Queue
tools.description: Tool to batch-add up to 25 requests to a request queue. Use when you need to add multiple requests efficiently. Failed requests due to rate limits should be retried with exponential backoff.

tools.name: List Request Queue Requests
tools.description: Tool to list requests in a request queue with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve multiple requests from an Apify request queue.

tools.name: Add Request to Queue
tools.description: Tool to add a request to the queue. Use when you need to add a web page URL to a request queue for crawling. If a request with the same uniqueKey was already present in the queue, returns the ID of the existing request.

tools.name: Unlock Queue Requests
tools.description: Tool to unlock requests in a request queue that are currently locked by the client. If the client is within an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked by that specific run plus all requests locked by the same clientKey. If the client is outside of an Actor run, unlocks all requests locked using the same clientKey.

tools.name: Get list of request queues
tools.description: Tool to get list of request queues for a user. Use when you need to enumerate or browse user's request queues. Supports pagination with up to 1000 items per page.

tools.name: Create Request Queue
tools.description: Tool to create a new request queue or retrieve an existing one by name. Use when you need to initialize a queue for storing and managing web scraping requests. If a queue with the given name already exists, returns that queue instead of creating a duplicate. Unnamed queues follow data retention period policies.

tools.name: Resurrect Run
tools.description: Tool to resurrect a finished Actor run. Use when you need to restart a completed or failed run. Deprecated endpoint; may be removed in future.

tools.name: Run Actor Asynchronously
tools.description: Tool to run a specific Actor asynchronously. Use when you need to trigger an Actor run without waiting for completion and retrieve its run details immediately.

tools.name: Run Actor Sync
tools.description: Tool to run a specific Actor synchronously with input and return its output record. Use when immediate Actor results are needed; runs may timeout after 300 seconds. To avoid timeouts, scope inputs to specific URLs rather than broad crawls and request only necessary fields (e.g., text or markdown).

tools.name: Run Actor Sync & Get Dataset Items
tools.description: Tool to run an Actor synchronously and retrieve its dataset items. Use when immediate access to run results is needed.

tools.name: Run Task Asynchronously
tools.description: Tool to run a specific Actor task asynchronously. Use when you need to trigger a task run without waiting for completion and immediately retrieve its run details.

tools.name: Delete Schedule
tools.description: Tool to delete a schedule by its ID. Use when you need to remove a schedule from the Apify system.

tools.name: Get Schedule
tools.description: Tool to get schedule details by ID. Use when you need to retrieve comprehensive information about a schedule including cron expression, timezone, actions, and execution times.

tools.name: Get Schedule Log
tools.description: Tool to get schedule log by ID. Use when you need to retrieve execution history for a schedule, including invocation timestamps and status messages. Returns up to 1000 invocations.

tools.name: Update Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update an existing schedule with new settings. Use when you need to modify schedule properties like cron expression, timezone, enabled status, or actions. Only specified fields are updated; others remain unchanged.

tools.name: Get list of schedules
tools.description: Tool to get list of schedules created by the user. Use when you need to browse or enumerate user's schedules. Supports pagination with up to 1000 items per page.

tools.name: Create Schedule
tools.description: Tool to create a new schedule with specified settings. Use when you need to automate Actor or Actor task execution at specific times using cron expressions.

tools.name: Scrape Amazon Product Details
tools.description: Scrape detailed Amazon product pages by ASIN or URL with delicious_zebu/amazon-product-details-scraper. Pricing is $1.50 per 1,000 unique product results, so 10,000 monthly products cost about $15. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; later dataset retention and reads can consume platform usage. The Actor emits one result per unique input and documents 20 marketplaces, but no run-wide input maximum; use a bounded products list and maxTotalChargeUsd. Apify's global API limit is 250,000 requests/minute, with resource-specific limits reported in X-RateLimit-Limit.

tools.name: Scrape Amazon Reviews
tools.description: Scrape Amazon customer reviews with axesso_data/amazon-reviews-scraper. Pricing is $0.90 per 1,000 dataset items, so 10,000 monthly reviews cost about $9. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; later dataset retention and reads can consume platform usage. Each ASIN is limited to 10 pages; invalid ASINs and filters yielding no reviews produce three charged penalty items, so validate targets and set maxPages and maxTotalChargeUsd. Apify's global API limit is 250,000 requests/minute, with resource-specific limits reported in X-RateLimit-Limit.

tools.name: Scrape Booking Reviews
tools.description: Scrape public Booking.com property reviews with voyager/booking-reviews-scraper. Pricing per 1,000 reviews is $2 Free, $1.90 Bronze, $1.50 Silver, $0.90 Gold, $0.50 Platinum, or $0.30 Diamond, plus a $0.00005/GB start event; 10,000 monthly reviews cost about $20/$19/$15/$9/$5/$3 before negligible start charges. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; retained datasets and later reads can consume platform usage. Reviews can contain copyrighted text and personal context; use only for a legitimate analysis purpose, preserve id and startUrl attribution, and do not bulk republish. Bound maxReviewsPerHotel and maxTotalChargeUsd.

tools.name: Scrape Meta/Facebook Ads
tools.description: Scrape public Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Threads, Messenger, and Audience Network ads with apify/facebook-ads-scraper. Each ad costs exactly $5.80 per 1,000 on Free, $5.00 Bronze, $4.20 Silver, $3.40 Gold, $2.10 Platinum, or $1.00 Diamond; Actor compute and in-run platform usage are included. Optional e-commerce enrichment adds $5.70, $3.20, $2.80, $2.40, $2.00, or $1.50 per 1,000 enriched product URLs respectively, and one ad can contain multiple billable URLs. At current included credits, ad-only monthly ceilings are about 862 Free, 3,800 Starter/Bronze, 47,380 Scale/Silver, and 293,823 Business/Gold before other usage; paid overage can be invoiced. resultsLimit applies per URL and maxTotalChargeUsd bounds charge exposure. Apify's API limit is 250,000 requests/minute, with resource-specific limits in X-RateLimit-Limit; the synchronous wait is 300 seconds and a paid run can continue server-side after timeout.

tools.name: Scrape Facebook Comments
tools.description: Scrape public Facebook post comments with apify/facebook-comments-scraper. Each run has a $0.001 start charge; comments cost $0.0025 Free, $0.002 Bronze, $0.0017 Silver, $0.0014 Gold, $0.0009 Platinum, or $0.0004 Diamond. Nested comments and the separately priced date-filter add-on are disabled. resultsLimit is per run and maxTotalChargeUsd separately caps exposure. Dataset retention and reads can consume normal usage. A synchronous timeout after 300 seconds may leave the paid run active.

tools.name: Scrape Facebook Events
tools.description: Search and scrape public Facebook events with apify/facebook-events-scraper. Plan-discounted pay-per-result pricing ranges from $13.00 to $7.00 per 1,000 events, with Actor compute included. Dataset retention and later reads are not priced on the Actor page and can still affect storage usage. Documented monthly yields are about 2,000 events on free credits, 2,900 on $29 Starter, 23,400 on $199 Scale, and 142,800 on $999 Business. maxEvents applies per query; hidden unauthenticated keywords can return only 10-30 events. maxEvents and maxTotalChargeUsd bound volume and charge exposure. Apify limits its API globally to 250,000 requests/minute and reports resource-specific limits in X-RateLimit-Limit. The synchronous wait is fixed at 300 seconds; a timed-out paid run can continue server-side.

tools.name: Scrape Facebook Group Posts
tools.description: Scrape posts from public Facebook groups with apify/facebook-groups-scraper. This starts a paid run: Free-plan pricing is $2.70 per 1,000 results and Starter pricing is $2.30 per 1,000 (about 12,600 results with the included monthly usage); the headline rate starts at $1.50 per 1,000. The event price includes Actor compute; later dataset storage and reads can consume account usage. Results are capped at 250 per search term and all charges count against monthly Apify usage. Apify limits the API to 250,000 requests per minute globally and reports the current per-resource limit in the X-RateLimit-Limit response header.

tools.name: Search Jobs Across Sites
tools.description: Search public employer-hosted jobs across Greenhouse, Lever, and Ashby with agentx/all-jobs-scraper. Pricing is $0.00350 per result on Free, $0.00315 Bronze, $0.00280 Silver, and $0.00263 Gold or higher, plus a $0.01 Actor-start event per GB (minimum one). A 100-result Free run with one minimum start costs about $0.36. Charges consume monthly credits; in-run compute is event-priced, while retained datasets and later reads consume platform storage usage. Each call creates a paid run and dataset. maxResults is capped at 100 per selected platform and contacts are omitted from this action's typed contract. Source filters can yield fewer results or duplicates. Apify's global API rate limit is 250,000 requests/minute; synchronous waiting ends after 300 seconds and paid POSTs are not safely retryable.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Companies
tools.description: Search for public LinkedIn companies with harvestapi/linkedin-company-search in short mode, without LinkedIn cookies. Current pricing is a $0.001 start plus $0.002 per short company on Free/Bronze and $0.001-$0.0015 on paid tiers; compute is included, while later dataset storage and reads affect usage. This paid call creates a run and dataset and consumes monthly credits. maxItems and takePages bound results; use maxTotalChargeUsd as an additional cap. Full-company, contact, and profile enrichment are intentionally not exposed.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn jobs and return job, application, salary, and company details without requiring LinkedIn credentials. Each job costs $0.001 and each run has a $0.001 start event; all charges count toward monthly Apify usage. Actor compute is included, while later dataset retention and reads affect storage usage. LinkedIn exposes 25 jobs per page and at most 40 pages per query/location combination. Duplicate filters are rejected because each combination can create separately billed work. Apify reports the applicable API resource limit in X-RateLimit-Limit. This paid call creates a run and dataset; use maxTotalChargeUsd to cap spend.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Posts
tools.description: Run harvestapi/linkedin-post-search for public LinkedIn posts. Pricing starts at $1.50 per 1,000 billable records with Actor compute included; requested comments and reactions are standalone charged records as well as nested post fields, and dataset storage/reads consume usage. Charges count toward monthly limits. Apify limits the API to 250,000 requests/minute globally and reports the current per-resource limit in X-RateLimit-Limit.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Profiles
tools.description: Run HarvestAPI's broad LinkedIn people search. Free/Bronze pricing is $0.10 per search page (up to 25 short profiles), plus $0.004 per full profile; paid tiers discount those events. Email-search mode is intentionally omitted because its output contract is not strongly documented. Actor compute is included; later dataset retention and reads affect storage usage, and charges consume monthly credits. LinkedIn normally limits one query to 2,500 profiles and 100 pages, while automatic segmentation supports larger bounded workloads. Creates a paid run and dataset; use maxItems, takePages, or maxTotalChargeUsd to bound exposure.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Name
tools.description: Find LinkedIn profiles by first name, last name, or both; this name-based intent is distinct from fuzzy profile or services search. Search pages cost $0.004 on Free through Silver and $0.003 on Gold+, with full-profile events charged separately. Email-search mode is intentionally omitted because its output contract is not strongly documented. Actor compute is included; later dataset retention and reads affect storage usage, and charges consume monthly credits. Page and query limits are 10 profiles per page, 1,000 profiles per query, and 100 pages. Creates a paid run and dataset; use maxItems, maxPages, or maxTotalChargeUsd to bound spend.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn Profiles by Services
tools.description: Find LinkedIn profiles by services or keywords with HarvestAPI's lower-filter search intent; use broad profile search for extensive employment filters and name search for a known person. Short profiles cost $0.002 each on Free/Bronze and full profiles cost $0.004 or less. Email-search mode is intentionally omitted because its output contract is not strongly documented. Actor compute is included; later dataset retention and reads affect storage usage, and charges consume monthly credits. The page limit is 100, with conflicting provider documentation on page size. Creates a paid run and dataset; use maxItems, takePages, or maxTotalChargeUsd to cap spend.

tools.name: Search Local Fuel Prices
tools.description: Search public crowd-reported local US station fuel prices with the independent johnvc/fuelprices Actor; this is not an official GasBuddy API. Current pricing is $0.001 per station result with no start fee, and in-run compute is included; later dataset storage and reads affect account usage. This paid call creates a run and dataset and consumes monthly credits. Result count is location-dependent and the Actor has no input result limit, so maxTotalChargeUsd is the reliable spend bound. No output-file or contact controls are exposed.

tools.name: Search TikTok Users
tools.description: Discover public TikTok creator profiles by keyword with clockworks/tiktok-user-search-scraper. Current per-profile pricing is $0.006 on Free and $0.0008-$0.005 on paid tiers; Actor compute is included, while later dataset storage and reads affect usage. This paid call creates a run and dataset, consumes monthly credits, and can continue after the synchronous wait. Bound searchQueries and maxProfilesPerQuery and use maxTotalChargeUsd. Followers, contacts, posts, and profile-enrichment expansions are not exposed.

tools.name: Search Tripadvisor Places
tools.description: Search public Tripadvisor hotels, restaurants, and attractions with maxcopell/tripadvisor. Pricing per 1,000 places is $5 Free, $2.90 Bronze, $2.50 Silver, $2 Gold, $1.50 Platinum, or $1.25 Diamond, plus a $0.00005 start event; 10,000 monthly places cost about $50/$29/$25/$20/$15/$12.50 before start charges. Price offers, AI summaries, photos, lead enrichment, and email verification are disabled by construction. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; retained datasets and later reads can consume platform usage. This is a third-party scrape, not Tripadvisor's official API; preserve id and webUrl. Bound maxItemsPerQuery and maxTotalChargeUsd.

tools.name: Search Upwork Jobs
tools.description: Search public Upwork jobs with neatrat/upwork-job-scraper without accepting caller cookies or raw search URLs. Pricing per returned job is $0.0035 Free, $0.0034 Bronze, $0.0033 Silver, and $0.0032 Gold or higher; the Actor also passes platform compute, proxy, and storage usage through to the user. The smallest page is ten jobs, so 10,000 monthly jobs cost about $35 to $32 before platform usage. Each paid call creates an Actor run and dataset; this action caps work at five pages of 10-100 jobs and maxTotalChargeUsd caps event exposure. Retained datasets and later reads consume monthly platform usage. Results are third-party scraped public listings, not an official Upwork API, and client metadata should be handled as personal/commercial data. Apify's global API rate limit is 250,000 requests/minute; synchronous waiting ends after 300 seconds.

tools.name: Search Yandex Market Products
tools.description: Search public Yandex Market listings with zen-studio/yandex-market-scraper-parser. Pricing is $5.99/$4.99/$3.99/$3.49 per 1,000 products on Free/Bronze/Silver/Gold+ tiers, plus a $0.05 Actor-start event; 10,000 monthly products in 100 runs therefore cost about $64.90/$54.90/$44.90/$39.90. Reviews and product enrichment are disabled. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; retained datasets and later reads can consume platform usage. Results are third-party scraped observations, not an official Yandex API; preserve productUrl and scrapedAt. Bound maxItems and maxTotalChargeUsd before each paid run.

tools.name: Search Zillow Properties
tools.description: Discover Zillow listings with fixed Actor X46xKaa20oUA1fRiP. Result pricing per 1,000 is $2.30 Free, $2.00 Bronze, $1.70 Silver, $1.30 Gold, $0.80 Platinum, and $0.40 Diamond. At 10,000 monthly results this is $23/$20/$17/$13/$8/$4, with no Actor rental or start event. Actor compute and in-run storage are included; later dataset reads, writes, and retention consume normal Apify usage. Map markers return about 500 results per URL, plain pagination up to about 820, while recursive zoom has no documented run-wide result limit and can exceed 600,000. No Actor-specific request rate is published. Apify's global API rate limit is 250,000 requests/minute. Always set resultsLimit and maxTotalChargeUsd for bounded cost; synchronous waiting ends after 300 seconds.
