tools.name: Get Record
tools.description: Get one Bika record by ID, with field values keyed by field name or field ID.

tools.name: List Nodes
tools.description: List the nodes in a Bika space so an agent can discover database and automation resource IDs by name, type, and path.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: Return one cursor-controlled page of records from a Bika database, optionally selecting specific fields by name or ID.

tools.name: List Spaces
tools.description: List spaces available to the connected Bika account and return the space IDs needed by database tools.

tools.name: Update Records
tools.description: Update fields on one to ten existing Bika records in one request and return the updated records.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Bika.ai API token from User Settings. In Bika.ai, open your user settings and copy the API token shown there. It is sent as a Bearer token and should be kept secret.

name: Billsby
description: Billsby is a subscription billing platform for managing customers, subscriptions, invoices, products, plans, usage counters, add-ons, and allowances.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a Billsby customer without a subscription or payment card. This does not start recurring billing.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Get billing, contact, payment-status, and account details for one Billsby customer.

tools.name: Get Subscription
tools.description: Get billing schedule, customer, product, plan, pricing, status, and revenue details for one Billsby subscription.

tools.name: Get Subscription Shipping Address
tools.description: Get the shipping address associated with one Billsby subscription.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Return one page of customers for the connected Billsby company, optionally filtered by a partial customer name.

tools.name: List Customer Subscriptions
tools.description: List all subscriptions belonging to one Billsby customer.

tools.name: List Product Plans
tools.description: List the plans and billing cycles configured for one Billsby product.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Return one page of Billsby products, optionally filtered by name or visibility.

tools.name: List Subscriptions
tools.description: Return one page of company subscriptions with optional status, trial, product, plan, and ordering filters.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Replace the editable contact and billing-address details for an existing Billsby customer. Supply the complete desired values, not a partial patch.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Billsby company subdomain. For example, enter widgets if you sign in at widgets.billsby.com. Do not enter the full URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Billsby API key. In the Billsby portal, open Settings > Configuration > API keys and webhooks, then copy the API key. Billsby sends this secret in the ApiKey request header.

name: Bing Webmaster Tools
description: Bing Webmaster Tools helps site owners inspect search performance, manage crawling and indexing, submit URLs and feeds, and configure verified sites in Bing Search.

tools.name: Get Crawl Diagnostics
tools.description: Read crawl issues or daily crawl statistics for a verified site.

tools.name: Get Feeds
tools.description: List a site's submitted sitemaps and feeds, or inspect one feed's child details.

tools.name: Get Inbound Links
tools.description: Read inbound-link counts across a site or link details for one target URL, one provider page at a time.

tools.name: Get Page Performance
tools.description: Read traffic for one owned URL, its search queries, or a paged set of child URLs.

tools.name: Get Query Performance
tools.description: Analyze one Bing search query over time, across ranking pages, or for one query-page pair.

tools.name: Get Search Performance
tools.description: Read site-level Bing search performance as daily totals, top queries, or top pages.

tools.name: Get Submission Quotas
tools.description: Get remaining daily and monthly URL and/or content submission quotas for a verified site.

tools.name: Inspect URL
tools.description: Get Bing index and crawl metadata for one page or directory in a verified site.

tools.name: List Child URLs
tools.description: Return one Bing index-detail page for URLs below a directory or container, with optional crawl and index filters.

tools.name: List Sites
tools.description: List the sites associated with the connected Bing Webmaster Tools user, including verification state and verification codes.

tools.name: Research Keywords
tools.description: Get Bing keyword impressions, historical statistics, or related keyword ideas for a country and language.

tools.name: Submit Feed
tools.description: Submit a sitemap or feed URL for non-recallable Bing processing; do not retry when the submission result is ambiguous.

tools.name: Submit URLs
tools.description: Submit one to 500 owned URLs to Bing, consuming URL-submission quota and starting a non-recallable crawl and indexing request that does not guarantee indexing.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate or copy your user-level API key in Bing Webmaster Tools by opening Settings > API Access > API Key. This key grants access to every site verified by your Bing Webmaster Tools user and is sent as the apikey query parameter. Keep it secret.

name: Bitly
description: Bitly is a link management platform for shortening, customizing, sharing, and measuring links and QR codes.

tools.name: Add Channel Bitlinks
tools.description: Add 1-100 Bitlinks to an existing Bitly channel under a single campaign, without replacing existing channel membership. If needed, the campaign is associated with the channel first. The request is all-or-nothing: if any Bitlink is invalid, nothing is added. Requires a Bitly plan supporting channels; upgrade if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Add Custom Bitlink
tools.description: Add a custom back-half to an existing Bitlink on an available short domain, or set its initial custom redirect. Supply custom_bitlink and bitlink_id in domain/back-half form; their domains must match. Requires access to the domain and Bitlink. Custom-link availability and limits depend on the plan.

tools.name: Add Custom Domain
tools.description: Add a domain you already own to a Bitly organization and queue DNS verification, or set prevalidate=true to check it without adding it. This does not purchase a domain. Requires an organization admin, control of the domain's DNS configuration, and a Bitly plan with custom-domain entitlement and available capacity. Verification is asynchronous and can take up to 24 hours; later read GET /custom_domains for validation_status. An existing domain on this organization is requeued for DNS verification; a domain held by another account cannot be added.

tools.name: Apply Site Template
tools.description: Apply a template's appearance and, where applicable, sample content to an existing Bitly Site. Returns the updated site's settings. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Bulk Update Bitlinks
tools.description: Add or remove tags, or archive/unarchive up to 100 Bitlinks in a Bitly group. Returns the Bitlink IDs that were updated. Availability depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan; a plan upgrade may be required.

tools.name: Bulk Update QR Codes
tools.description: Add or remove tags, or archive/unarchive up to 100 Bitly QR codes in a group. Pages QR codes cannot be updated with this action. Returns the IDs of QR codes that were updated. Availability depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan; a plan upgrade may be required.

tools.name: Clone Site
tools.description: Create a new Bitly Site by cloning the content and appearance of an existing site. Optionally specify the new site's URI. Availability and site limits depend on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Create Bitlink
tools.description: Create a Bitly short link with a title, tags, deep links, expiration, and dynamic routing, or add a keyword override to an existing bitlink_id. Provide exactly one of long_url or bitlink_id. Custom keywords and advanced features depend on your Bitly plan, domain permissions, and monthly limits.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create a Bitly campaign in a group, optionally associating channel GUIDs. Campaign availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan; accounts without campaign entitlement must upgrade.

tools.name: Create Channel
tools.description: Create a Bitly channel in a group, optionally associating campaign bitlinks. Channel availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan; accounts without the required entitlement must upgrade.

tools.name: Create Group Export
tools.description: Build a synchronous CSV export of group link engagements, links, or QR codes. Returns JSON metadata with a base64 CSV data URI. Metrics exports are capped at 200 rows; metadata-only lists at 1000. Check truncated for omitted rows. Availability and metrics history depend on the connected Bitly plan; upgrade if required.

tools.name: Create QR Code
tools.description: Create a QR code in a Bitly group for an existing Bitlink, Link-in-Bio site, or a stand-alone long URL. Optionally customize appearance, GS1 metadata, expiration, tags, and long-URL dynamic routing. Returns QR metadata and ID, not an image. Creation consumes the group's QR quota; customizations and advanced features may require a Bitly plan upgrade.

tools.name: Create Site
tools.description: Create an empty Bitly Site in a group with default appearance settings. Choose a domain and keyword for its URL. Availability and site limits depend on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Create Site Block
tools.description: Create a Bitlink, social, YouTube video, image, digital business card, or text block on a Bitly Site. Supply content matching the selected type; use parent to place it in an existing container. Grid and carousel must be created via the container endpoint instead. Availability and limits depend on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Create Site Container
tools.description: Create a carousel or grid container for a set of content on a Bitly Site. Returns the created site block. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan and site entitlements.

tools.name: Create Site Image
tools.description: Attach a previously uploaded image to a Bitly Site and return its URL and GUID. This endpoint accepts image references, not base64 image data. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan and site entitlements.

tools.name: Create Static QR Code
tools.description: Generate a static QR image for raw content without creating or saving a Bitly QR resource. Returns base64 image bytes, not a hosted URL or data URI. Choose SVG or PNG and basic appearance options; gradients, frame, text, and logo are unsupported. Contact your Bitly Account Manager to enable this feature.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a Bitly webhook for an organization, optionally associated with a group. The destination URL may receive Bitly event data; configure only a trusted endpoint. Webhook availability depends on the connected account's plan; accounts without webhook entitlement must upgrade. Receiver OAuth client secrets cannot be set with this tool.

tools.name: Delete Bitlink
tools.description: Permanently delete an eligible unedited hash Bitlink.

tools.name: Delete QR Code
tools.description: Permanently delete a QR code that has not been redirected and is not for a custom link. Also deletes the associated link, if applicable. Returns the deletion records reported by Bitly. Access depends on the connected account's permissions and plan entitlement.

tools.name: Delete Site
tools.description: Delete an existing Bitly Site by its GUID. Returns no content on success. Access depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan entitlement.

tools.name: Delete Site Block
tools.description: Delete a block of any type from a Bitly Site, rather than deactivate it. Deleting a container block (grid or carousel) also deletes its contained blocks. Does not delete the link tied to the block. Returns no content on success. Access depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan entitlement.

tools.name: Delete Site Redirect
tools.description: Delete a redirect for a Bitly Site by its site ID, custom domain, and keyword (back-half). Returns no content on success. Access depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan entitlement.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete a Bitly webhook by GUID to stop its event deliveries. Returns no content on success. Requires access to the webhook and a Bitly plan supporting webhooks; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Discard Site Draft
tools.description: Discard a Bitly Site's in-progress draft by its site GUID. Returns no content on success. Access depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan entitlement.

tools.name: Expand Link
tools.description: Resolve a Bitlink to its current destination and destination history, when available.

tools.name: Get Account Context
tools.description: Return the authenticated Bitly user together with accessible groups and organizations needed by other tools.

tools.name: Get Aggregate Site Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve aggregate analytics for Bitly Sites: overview, views over time or by city/country/device/referrer, button clicks over time or by city/country/device, top clicked buttons, or digital business card downloads over time. Choose one report per call. Availability depends on the report and plan; detailed traffic breakdowns require a paid analytics entitlement.

tools.name: Get Bitlink
tools.description: Retrieve full Bitlink metadata, including destination, title, tags, archive or deletion state, and associated QR code IDs.

tools.name: Get Bitlink Activity
tools.description: Return paid-plan click or engagement analytics for a Bitlink as a timeline or summary. Requires Bitlink analytics entitlement.

tools.name: Get Bitlink Referrer Analytics
tools.description: Get Bitlink click analytics by AI agent, referrer name, or referrers grouped by domain. Choose exactly one metric per call. Requires access to the Bitlink and the selected analytics entitlement; some metrics require a paid plan.

tools.name: Get Bitlink Traffic Sources
tools.description: Break down paid-plan Bitlink click analytics by country, city, device, referrer, or referring domain. Requires Bitlink analytics entitlement.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly campaign by GUID to inspect its name, description, owning group, creator, timestamps, and resource references. The campaign must be accessible to the authenticated user. Requires a Bitly plan that supports campaigns; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Channel
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly channel by GUID to inspect its name, owning group, creation and modification timestamps, and resource references. The channel must be accessible to the authenticated user. Requires a Bitly plan that supports channels; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Custom Bitlink
tools.description: Retrieve a Custom Bitlink's details, current destination Bitlink, and redirect history. Supply the custom domain/back-half without a protocol. Requires access to the Custom Bitlink and a Bitly plan with the appropriate custom-link entitlement.

tools.name: Get Custom Bitlink Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve time-bucketed clicks across a Custom Bitlink's entire history or click counts grouped by its historical destinations. Select clicks or clicks_by_destination and an analytics window. Requires access to the Custom Bitlink and a Bitly plan with the appropriate analytics entitlement.

tools.name: Get Custom Domain
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly custom domain's verification state, group assignments, redirects, deep-link applications, and SSL configuration. Requires membership in a group assigned to the domain or administrator access to its organization. Only organization administrators can read domains awaiting DNS verification. Account entitlements apply; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Custom Domain DNS
tools.description: Inspect a Bitly custom domain's current DNS records, detected DNS provider, required registrar records, and whether the records match a valid configuration. Use the required A records for a root domain or CNAME record for a subdomain to configure DNS at your registrar. Does not modify DNS. Requires access to the specified organization and domain; account entitlements apply. Upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Domain Agreements
tools.description: Retrieve the registrar agreements a user must accept before Bitly registers a domain. Review their content and pass each accepted agreement_key to POST /domains when purchasing the domain. This read does not accept agreements or purchase a domain. Account entitlements apply; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly group by GUID, including its organization, your role, branded short domains, timestamps, and resource references. The group must be accessible to the authenticated user; account entitlements apply.

tools.name: Get Group Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve one group analytics report: shorten counts, geography/devices/referrers, engagement rankings or timeline, link clicks, QR scans, historical usage, or agentic traffic rollup. Select metric and supply only that endpoint's parameters. Most metrics require unit and units. Analytics availability depends on Bitly plan entitlements; paid features return 402 without an upgrade. Returns provider fields without combining distinct rankings or response shapes.

tools.name: Get Group Preferences
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly group's preferences, including its preferred domain for shortened links. Requires access to the specified group; availability is subject to your Bitly account permissions and plan entitlements.

tools.name: Get Group Tags
tools.description: Retrieve tags currently used in a Bitly group for Bitlinks or QR codes. Returns at most 1000 tags; this endpoint has no documented pagination controls or continuation token. Requires access to the group and is subject to account entitlements; upgrade the connected plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get OAuth App
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly OAuth app by client ID to inspect its name, description, link, PKCE requirement, and first-party status. The authenticated account must have access to the app. Availability is subject to Bitly account permissions and entitlements; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly organization by GUID, including its subscription tier, your role, branded short domains, authentication requirements, timestamps, and resource references. The organization must be accessible to the authenticated user; account entitlements apply.

tools.name: Get Organization Shorten Counts
tools.description: Read an organization's shorten counts over a specified time window, supplying unit and units. Set by_group=true to read counts by group for the current month instead, without time parameters. Returns the provider's metrics envelope. Availability depends on Bitly plan entitlements; a 402 requires a plan upgrade.

tools.name: Get QR Code
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly QR code by ID to inspect its destination, appearance, GS1 metadata, tags, expiration, and dynamic routing. Returns QR metadata, not an image. The connected account must have access to the QR code; feature availability depends on the Bitly plan.

tools.name: Get QR Code Analytics
tools.description: Get a QR Code's scan timeline, total, or country, city, device OS or browser breakdown for a time window. Analytics availability depends on your Bitly plan; detailed reports may require an upgrade.

tools.name: Get QR Code Image
tools.description: Retrieve an existing Bitly QR code's image as a base64 data URI in qr_code_image, suitable for an HTML image src. Choose SVG or PNG; SVG is the default. This does not create a QR code and does not return a hosted image URL. Access and image features depend on the connected account's Bitly plan and QR code permissions.

tools.name: Get Site
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly Site by its GUID, including content, appearance, and publication settings. Set include_blocks to retrieve its draft content blocks as well. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Get Site Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve one Bitly Site analytics report: country, city, device, or referrer views, link performance, a views timeline, or a views summary. Requires the connected account's site analytics entitlement; some reports require a paid plan. Link performance returns one page with provider pagination, not all pages.

tools.name: Get Top Group Engagements
tools.description: Retrieve a group's top Bitlinks and decoupled QR codes ranked together by engagement count over a time window. Returns separate links and qr_codes lists plus sorted_engagements whose IDs preserve the unified ranking. Coupled QR codes are ranked by their Bitlink ID. Returns one bounded result set, not all history pages. Analytics access depends on Bitly plan entitlements.

tools.name: Get Usage and Limits
tools.description: Inspect monthly plan quotas, hourly endpoint budgets, and optional group feature usage before performing quota-consuming work.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieve a Bitly webhook by GUID to inspect its delivery configuration, subscribed event, status, owning organization and group, and lifecycle timestamps. Requires access to the webhook and a Bitly plan supporting webhooks; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List Bitlinks
tools.description: List or search Bitlinks owned by a group, one cursor-controlled page at a time.

tools.name: List Branded Short Domains
tools.description: List verified custom domains the authenticated user can shorten links with, across all their organizations and groups. Any group member can call this endpoint; no organization-admin role is required. Returns domain names only, not setup or verification state; use List Custom Domains for those details. There are no pagination controls. Availability is subject to account entitlements; upgrade the connected plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns for the authenticated Bitly user, optionally filtered by group GUID. This endpoint has no documented pagination controls. Requires a Bitly plan with campaign access; upgrade the connected account if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: List channels available to the authenticated Bitly user, optionally filtered by group GUID and campaign GUID. Use the returned channel GUIDs when working with campaigns. This endpoint has no documented pagination controls. Requires a Bitly plan with channel access; upgrade the connected account if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List Custom Domains
tools.description: List custom domains with verification states, group assignments, HTTPS settings, deep-link applications, and SSL certificate details. Optionally filter by organization GUID; otherwise returns domains for every organization where the authenticated caller is an admin. Organizations where the caller is not an admin are excluded. No pagination controls are documented. Account entitlements apply; upgrade the connected Bitly plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List QR Codes
tools.description: List one page of QR codes in a Bitly group in reverse chronological order, optionally filtering by search text, destination, creation time, creator, tags, QR type, customization, GS1, archive, expiration, or dynamic routing status. Pass pagination.search_after back as search_after with the same filters to continue. Returns metadata, not images. The connected account must have access to the group; feature availability depends on the Bitly plan.

tools.name: List Sites
tools.description: List one page of active Bitly Sites owned by a group, optionally filtered by site URL. Pass pagination.search_after as search_after to request the next page. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: List Site Templates
tools.description: List available Bitly Site templates, optionally by onboarding category. Use a returned template_guid to apply a template to a site. Availability and use of paid templates depend on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: List Sorted Bitlinks
tools.description: Retrieve a group's Bitlinks ranked by clicks for a time window. Preserve the sorted_links order and join its IDs to links metadata by id, not array position. Returns one size-limited result with no documented continuation token. Requires access to the group and the appropriate Bitly analytics entitlement; upgrade the connected plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks available for a Bitly organization by organization GUID. This endpoint has no documented query filters or pagination controls. Requires a Bitly plan with webhook access; upgrade the connected account if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Prevalidate Site YouTube Video
tools.description: Validate a YouTube video ID and construct the content needed for a Bitly Site YouTube video button without creating the button. Requires access to the site and the applicable Bitly Sites plan entitlement.

tools.name: Publish Site
tools.description: Publish a Bitly Site's draft, replacing the production site when changes have been made. Returns the site's publication and content settings. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Redirect QR Code
tools.description: Change the destination URL of a stand-alone Bitly QR code by QR code ID. QR codes already associated with a Bitlink must be updated via the Bitlinks API instead. Returns updated QR metadata, not an image. Redirecting a QR code may require a Bitly plan upgrade.

tools.name: Register Domain
tools.description: Register (purchase) a domain for a Bitly organization and configure its DNS. This creates a domain registration and consumes the organization's plan-included domain allowance; it is not a lookup or dry run. It is not a paid-domain checkout: Bitly rejects domains priced at or above the complimentary limit and requests after the included allowance is exhausted. Requires an organization admin and a plan with available included-domain entitlement. Obtain explicit user approval for registration and the agreements before calling. Select a domain from GET /domains and send agreement_keys from GET /domains/{domain}/agreements. DNS verification can take up to 48 hours; later read GET /custom_domains for validation_status.

tools.name: Search Domains
tools.description: Search domains Bitly can register for an organization. Returns available domain names and the status of the exact name searched for; this does not register or purchase a domain. Returns one set of up to 25 results with no documented pagination. Domain registration depends on organization plan entitlements; upgrade the connected Bitly plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Shorten Link
tools.description: Create an ordinary Bitly short link for a long URL in a specific group.

tools.name: Update Bitlink
tools.description: Update safe metadata or archive state for a Bitlink; this tool does not redirect destinations or configure advanced routing.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Update a Bitly campaign's name, description, associated group, or channels. Supply campaign_guid and the fields to change; omitted fields are not sent. Returns the updated campaign details. Requires campaign access and a Bitly plan that includes campaigns; upgrade the plan if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Update Channel
tools.description: Update an existing Bitly channel by channel_guid, including its name, group, and Bitlink campaign associations. Supply only the fields to change; omitted fields are not sent. Returns updated channel details. Requires channel access and a Bitly plan supporting channels; upgrade if Bitly returns 402.

tools.name: Update Custom Bitlink
tools.description: Move an existing custom keyword (back-half) to a different Bitlink. Supply custom_bitlink and the destination bitlink_id in domain/back-half form; their domains must match. Requires access to the Custom Domain and a Bitly plan with custom-link redirect entitlement. Returns the updated custom redirect, destination Bitlink, and redirect history.

tools.name: Update Custom Domain
tools.description: Change a verified Bitly custom domain's redirects and HTTPS/HSTS settings. Supply custom_domain and only the settings to change; an empty root_redirect or wildcard_redirect clears that redirect. Domains awaiting DNS verification cannot be updated. Requires an organization administrator and a Bitly plan with the appropriate custom-domain entitlement. Returns the updated domain.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Update a Bitly group's name, associated organization, or branded short domains. Supply group_guid and the fields to change; omitted fields are not sent. Returns the updated group details. Requires permission to manage the group; availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Update Group Preferences
tools.description: Update a Bitly group's preferred short domain. Requires access to the group; branded domain availability depends on the account's plan and configured domains.

tools.name: Update QR Code
tools.description: Update an existing Bitly QR code's title, appearance, archive status, expiration, tags, or dynamic routing rules by QR code ID. Returns QR metadata, not an image. Dynamic routing replaces all existing rules; an empty array clears them. Customizations and advanced features may require a Bitly plan upgrade.

tools.name: Update Site
tools.description: Update a Bitly Site's URI, display name, description, or attached QR code. Changing the URI creates a redirect from the previous URI. A QR code can only be attached when the site does not already have one. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Update Site Appearance
tools.description: Update a Bitly Site's theme, layout, fonts, colors, images, header, buttons, and social icon appearance. Availability of appearance options depends on the connected account's Bitly plan. Bitly returns no site data on success.

tools.name: Update Site Block
tools.description: Update an existing Bitly Site block's content, appearance, schedule, active or pinned state, or parent container. Send content fields appropriate to the stored block type; the type is derived from the existing block and cannot be changed. Availability depends on the connected account's Bitly plan.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Update the authenticated Bitly user's display name or default group. Supply the fields to change; omitted fields are not sent. Returns the updated user profile and email details. Availability depends on the connected account's permissions and Bitly plan.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update an existing Bitly webhook's delivery destination, event, activity, organization, group, or OAuth settings. Supply webhook_guid for the path and guid for the required body identifier, plus the fields to change; omitted fields are not sent. Returns updated webhook details. Requires webhook access and a Bitly plan supporting webhooks; upgrade if Bitly returns 402. Receiver OAuth client secrets cannot be changed with this tool.

tools.name: Upgrade QR Code to Bitlink
tools.description: Upgrade a standalone (decoupled) QR code to a coupled QR code by associating it with its underlying Bitly short link. Returns Bitlink metadata, not a QR image. This consumes one encode from the organization's monthly Link limit; if the QR code is already coupled, no encode is consumed. Availability depends on your Bitly plan and remaining monthly Link quota.

tools.name: Verify Webhook
tools.description: Test an existing Bitly webhook's configuration by sending a ping event to its configured webhook URL. This sends an outbound request to the webhook receiver; it is not a read-only configuration check. Returns the webhook configuration and status. Requires access to the webhook and a Bitly plan supporting webhooks; upgrade your plan if Bitly returns 402.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to Bitly, open Settings > Developer settings > API, then generate and paste a generic access token. You can also open https://app.bitly.com/settings/api/ directly. Keep this token secret.

name: Bitquery
description: Bitquery provides historical and real-time indexed data for over 40 blockchains through GraphQL APIs, Websockets, SQL, and cloud providers.

tools.name: Archive Database Query
tools.description: Query the Bitquery Archive Database (V1 API) for historical blockchain data. The Archive Database provides complete historical blockchain data across 40+ blockchains including Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, Solana, and more. Data has a delay of tens of minutes to hours from real-time. For near-real-time data, use the Realtime Database Query instead. The V1 API uses blockchain-specific root types (bitcoin, ethereum, etc.) with fields like blocks, transactions, transfers, and trades. Queries support filtering, pagination with limit/offset, and sorting with orderBy. Example queries: - Bitcoin blocks: { bitcoin { blocks(limit: 5, orderBy: {descending: height}) { height } } } - Ethereum transactions: { ethereum { transactions(limit: 10) { hash value } } }

tools.name: Combined Database Query
tools.description: Query Bitquery's Combined Database (v2 API) for blockchain data across 40+ networks. Use this tool to fetch real-time and historical blockchain data including: - Blocks, transactions, and events - Token transfers and balances - DEX trades and liquidity data - Smart contract interactions - NFT data and metadata Supported networks include: Ethereum (eth), BSC (bsc), Polygon (matic), Solana, Tron, and more. The v2 API uses a different schema than v1 - use EVM(network: eth) instead of ethereum root field.

tools.name: Conditional Metrics Snippet
tools.description: Generate a Bitquery GraphQL metric snippet with conditional logic using the 'if:' attribute. This tool builds metric aggregation snippets (count, sum, avg, min, max) that can be embedded in Bitquery GraphQL queries. The 'if:' filter allows applying conditions directly to metric calculations, enabling conditional aggregation like counting only successful transactions. Output format examples: - count(if: {Block: {GasUsed: {gt: "0"}}}) - sum(of: Block_GasUsed if: {Block: {Time: {after: "2024-01-01"}}}) - myAlias: avg(of: Transaction_Value if: {Transaction: {Success: true}})

tools.name: Database Selection
tools.description: Tool to select the database (archive, realtime, combined) to query at the top level of a GraphQL request. Use after determining whether you need live, historical, or combined blockchain data.

tools.name: Early Access Program Query
tools.description: Execute GraphQL queries against the Bitquery Early Access Program (EAP) Streaming API. This tool queries the EAP endpoint (streaming.bitquery.io/eap) for real-time blockchain data. The EAP provides access to streaming data across various blockchain networks including Solana, EVM chains (Ethereum, Polygon, etc.), and others for evaluation purposes. Key features: - Real-time blockchain data with minimal latency - Supports both queries and subscriptions - Networks: Solana, Ethereum, Polygon (Matic), and other EVM-compatible chains Note: EAP is limited to real-time data only. For historical data, use the Archive Database Query. Existing users can continue using EAP; new users should prefer the V2 endpoint for most use cases. Example queries: - Get latest ETH blocks: { EVM(network: eth) { Blocks(limit: {count: 5}) { Block { Number Time } } } } - Solana DEX trades: subscription { Solana { DEXTrades { Block { Time } Trade { Price } } } }

tools.name: Network Selection
tools.description: Tool to select the blockchain network for GraphQL queries. Use before constructing dataset or metric queries to ensure the correct chain is targeted.

tools.name: Options Query
tools.description: Tool to fetch GraphQL dataset options via schema introspection. Use when you need to discover root-level query fields and their arguments before building queries. Dataset and token availability varies by Bitquery environment; verify available fields here before constructing complex queries that depend on specific datasets.

tools.name: Price Asymmetry Metric
tools.description: Tool to generate GraphQL PriceAsymmetry filter snippet. Use when you need to filter trades based on price asymmetry metric.

tools.name: Realtime Database Query
tools.description: Query the Bitquery Streaming (V2) API for realtime blockchain data. This tool accesses the Bitquery Streaming API at streaming.bitquery.io/graphql which provides real-time blockchain data with minimal latency. Use this for recent data (within minutes). For historical data, use the Archive Database Query. Supported query formats: - V2 EVM queries: { EVM(network: eth) { Blocks(limit: {count: 5}) { Block { Number Time } } } } - V2 Bitcoin queries: { bitcoin(network: bitcoin) { blocks(limit: {count: 5}) { height timestamp { time } } } } Note: Requires an active Bitquery subscription for streaming API access.

tools.name: Select By Metric
tools.description: Tool to generate a GraphQL metric snippet filtering by its value using selectWhere. Use when you need to include only metrics meeting specific value conditions (e.g., only positive sums).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by Bitquery for authenticating API requests.

name: Black Forest Labs
description: Black Forest Labs provides hosted FLUX models for generating and editing images and videos, polling asynchronous results, managing fine-tunes, and checking project credits.

tools.name: Deblur Image
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous deblurring of an authorized image. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting.

tools.name: Edit Video
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous prompt-directed edit of an authorized source video. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted per-second cost without waiting for or downloading the result.

tools.name: Erase Image Object
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous removal of a masked object from an authorized image. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting for or downloading the result.

tools.name: Generate Fine-Tuned Image
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous FLUX fine-tuned image generation using an existing LoRA. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost; it does not wait for or download the result.

tools.name: Generate or Edit FLUX.2 Klein Image
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous FLUX.2 Klein image generation or authorized reference-image edit with the stable 4B or 9B model. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting for or downloading the result.

tools.name: Generate or Edit Image
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous FLUX 3 image generation or authorized reference-image edit. Returns a task ID and exact polling URL without waiting for or downloading the result. Moderation may end the task without media. Result URLs expire quickly; download promptly and preserve the original bytes and C2PA provenance metadata.

price.description: From $0.041 per image (768²) up to $0.607 (~4K²); varies with size.

tools.name: Generate Video
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous FLUX 3 video task from text, authorized keyframes, a source video, or a prior draft cache. Video is charged by duration and resolution. Returns a task ID and exact polling URL without waiting for or downloading outputs. Some connections require a fixed duration and a request price of at most $2.

price.description: Starts at $0.06 per output second for HD drafts; full-render price varies by mode and resolution. Eligible fixed-duration requests have a published price of at most $2.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected BFL project's current credit balance so funds can be checked before a paid generation or editing request.

tools.name: Get Fine-Tune
tools.description: Return details for one BFL fine-tune by ID; an absent or inaccessible fine-tune is reported as not found without distinguishing access denial.

tools.name: Get Generation Result
tools.description: Fetch one status update for an asynchronous BFL task using its exact returned polling URL or task ID. Returns pending, moderation, error, not-found, and ready states without looping, downloading media, or incurring a new generation charge.

tools.name: List Fine-Tunes
tools.description: Return all fine-tunes accessible to the connected BFL project in one unpaginated response.

tools.name: Outpaint Image
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous expansion of an authorized image onto a larger canvas of at most 4,194,304 pixels. Fast mode requires a base64 source; high mode also accepts HTTP(S) URLs. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting for or downloading the result.

tools.name: Upscale Video
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous upscale for the first 20 seconds of an authorized video, with an optional content prompt and 1.5x-3x scale target. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting. BFL charges video upscaling per output megapixel-second.

tools.name: Virtual Try-On
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous virtual try-on using authorized person and garment images. Returns the task ID, exact polling URL, and quoted cost without waiting.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your project-scoped Black Forest Labs API key. In the BFL dashboard at https://dashboard.bfl.ai, select the project you want to use, open API -> Keys, and create or copy a key. The full key is shown only once. It is sent in the 'x-key' request header; keep it secret. Hosted generation requires credits on the selected project.

name: Bland AI
description: Bland AI is a conversational AI platform for building, operating, and evaluating voice agents, calls, messaging, and related communications workflows.

tools.name: Add User to Memory
tools.description: Add a phone-number user and optional initial context to an existing Bland memory. Requires a full-access API key; Bland documents no restricted-key permission for memory membership.

tools.name: Create Agent Version
tools.description: Save a complete agent configuration snapshot on the development timeline or an open branch without deploying it. Autosaves may rewrite the eligible current autosave head in place.

tools.name: Create Pathway Folder
tools.description: Create an empty pathway folder, optionally nested under an existing folder, without running calls or agents.

tools.name: Delete Pathway Folder
tools.description: Delete an empty pathway folder by ID; folders containing pathways or subfolders must be emptied first.

tools.name: Get Account Details
tools.description: Return the connected Bland AI account's status, call count, balance, and refill settings without changing the account.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Retrieve one Bland AI agent by ID, including its development, staging, and production environment version pointers.

tools.name: Get Agent Version
tools.description: Retrieve a specific published agent version by semantic version, including its full configuration snapshot and version metadata.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base
tools.description: Retrieve one Bland AI knowledge base by ID, including its processing status, source details, and file metadata.

tools.name: Get Latest Agent Version
tools.description: Retrieve the newest saved version and full configuration snapshot for an agent's dev timeline or an open branch.

tools.name: Get Pathway
tools.description: Retrieve one Bland AI conversational pathway by ID, including its name, description, nodes, and edges.

tools.name: Get Tool
tools.description: Retrieve one legacy Bland AI custom tool by its TL-prefixed ID.

tools.name: List Calls
tools.description: Search the connected account's existing inbound and outbound call history without placing or modifying calls.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Return organization contacts and their identifiers and memory records one page at a time.

tools.name: List Inbound Numbers
tools.description: List inbound phone numbers configured for the connected Bland AI account, including each number's calling settings.

tools.name: List Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Return one page of the connected Bland AI organization's knowledge bases, including processing status, source details, and file metadata.

tools.name: List Pathway Folders
tools.description: Return all pathway folders and their parent relationships from Bland's US regional pathway service.

tools.name: List Pathways
tools.description: Return all conversational pathways, including their names, descriptions, nodes, and edges.

tools.name: List Pathway Versions
tools.description: List the saved versions of a conversational pathway with their version and revision metadata.

tools.name: List Tools
tools.description: Search and page through the active or draft tools configured for Bland agents.

tools.name: List Voices
tools.description: List every Bland voice available to the connected account with identifiers and synthesis attributes.

tools.name: Release Agent Version
tools.description: Publish a new snapshot, an existing saved version, or the latest saved version to staging, or promote the version currently in staging to production.

tools.name: Rename Pathway Folder
tools.description: Rename an existing pathway folder without moving or changing any pathways inside it.

tools.name: Resolve Contact
tools.description: Find a Bland contact by phone number, email, or external ID, creating one when no match exists. Requires a full-access API key; Bland documents no restricted-key permission for contacts.

tools.name: Synthesize Speech
tools.description: Generate Bland speech audio from text with a selected voice and return a downloadable WAV reference. Successful synthesis is billed per character with a minimum charge per request; restricted API keys need voices:generate.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update a Bland contact's name, email, external ID, or custom metadata. Requires a full-access API key; Bland documents no restricted-key permission for contacts.

tools.name: Update Contact Facts
tools.description: Merge structured facts into a Bland contact memory without deleting existing keys. Requires a full-access API key; Bland documents no restricted-key permission for contact memory.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Bland AI organization API key. In the Bland dashboard, open Settings at https://app.bland.ai/dashboard/settings and copy a full-access key, or a restricted key with voices:generate to use speech synthesis. Keep this organization-wide credential secret.

name: Blazemeter
description: BlazeMeter is a continuous testing platform that enables users to create, run, and analyze performance and functional tests for web and mobile applications.

tools.name: Convert Transactions
tools.description: Tool to convert transaction files to BlazeMeter DSL format for service virtualization. Use when importing API specifications (Swagger, HAR, YAML) to create virtual service transactions.

tools.name: Create API Monitoring Schedule
tools.description: Tool to create a new schedule for running API monitoring tests. Use when you need to automate test runs at defined intervals after determining the correct cron expression and test or collection ID.

tools.name: Create Multi Test
tools.description: Tool to create a new multi-test within a specified project. Use after confirming the project ID. Example: "Create a multi-test named 'load-test' in project 12345."

tools.name: Create Private Location
tools.description: Tool to create a new private location in BlazeMeter. Private locations allow you to run performance tests from your own infrastructure. Use when you need to test internal applications or simulate load from specific geographic regions. Requires valid account and workspace IDs.

tools.name: Create Private Location Agent
tools.description: Creates a new agent (server) within a BlazeMeter private location. Use this when you need to add an agent to handle test execution in your private infrastructure. Save the returned agent ID for subsequent private location setup steps.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new project within a BlazeMeter workspace. Projects are containers for organizing performance tests. Requires a valid workspace_id which can be obtained using the GET_WORKSPACES action. Returns the created project with its unique ID, timestamps, and other metadata.

tools.name: Create Search
tools.description: Execute a search query against BlazeMeter entities using advanced filtering and sorting. Use when you need to find tests, multi-tests, masters, or other entities with complex criteria like name patterns, date ranges, or workspace filters.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Creates a new tag in BlazeMeter for organizing and categorizing resources. Tags can be used in searches and filters to group related assets. Use when you need to create a new tag category with a name and description.

tools.name: Create Test
tools.description: Tool to create a new single test within a specified project. Use when registering a new performance test via API.

tools.name: Create Workspace Asset
tools.description: Tool to create an asset in a workspace for test data management. Use when you need to create data models, test data, or other assets within a BlazeMeter workspace. Assets are used for organizing and managing test data, configurations, and related resources.

tools.name: Create Asset Dependency
tools.description: Tool to create a dependency relationship between two assets in a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when establishing that one asset depends on another asset. The source asset (aId) will depend on the target asset (targetDepId). This is useful for tracking asset relationships in the BlazeMeter Asset Repository.

tools.name: Create Workspace Package
tools.description: Creates a new package within a BlazeMeter workspace. Packages are used for managing and organizing test artifacts and dependencies. Use when you need to create a new package with a specific name, version, and optional dependencies.

tools.name: Create Workspace Transactions
tools.description: Tool to create transactions in a BlazeMeter workspace for service virtualization. Use when you need to define mock API behaviors by specifying request matching criteria and response definitions. Transactions allow you to virtualize services and simulate API responses for testing purposes.

tools.name: Delete API Monitoring Schedule
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific test schedule by its ID. Use when you need to remove a scheduled test by its unique schedule identifier.

tools.name: Delete Private Location Workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove a workspace from a private location. Use when you need to revoke a workspace's access to a specific private location by providing both the harbor ID and workspace ID.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific project by its ID. Use when you need to remove a project from BlazeMeter. If the project contains tests or test reports, use the force parameter to delete it including all contents.

tools.name: Delete Test File
tools.description: Tool to delete a file from a test. Use when you need to remove an uploaded file asset (JMX script, CSV data, or configuration) from a BlazeMeter test.

tools.name: Delete Tests
tools.description: Tool to delete a test by its ID. Use when you need to remove a performance test from BlazeMeter.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Asset Dependency
tools.description: Tool to delete a dependency from a workspace's asset repository by its ID. Use when you need to remove a specific asset dependency.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Asset
tools.description: Tool to delete an asset from a workspace in BlazeMeter's Asset Repository. Use when you need to remove an asset that is no longer needed. This permanently deletes the asset from the workspace.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Assets Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to delete asset dependencies by source/target in a workspace. Use when you need to remove dependency relationships between workspace assets.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Logs
tools.description: Tool to delete master test execution logs from a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to remove logs for specific test masters to free up storage space. The operation is irreversible and removes all logs associated with the specified master IDs.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Managers
tools.description: Tool to remove managers from a workspace. Use when you need to revoke manager access for one or more users by providing the workspace ID and an array of manager IDs.

tools.name: Delete Workspace Package
tools.description: Tool to delete a package from a workspace in the BlazeMeter Asset Repository. Use when you need to remove a package by its workspace and package identifiers.

tools.name: Duplicate Test
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an existing test by its ID. Use when you need to create a copy of a test with all its configuration settings.

tools.name: Export Package
tools.description: Tool to export a package from BlazeMeter Asset Repository as a zip file. Use when you need to download or backup a package's assets and metadata.

tools.name: Export Workspaces Packages
tools.description: Tool to export multiple packages from a workspace as a zip file. Use when you need to download and bundle multiple test packages for backup, transfer, or sharing purposes.

tools.name: Generate Test Data from Data Model
tools.description: Tool to generate test data from a data model in Asset Repository. Use when you need to create synthetic test data based on a predefined data model structure.

tools.name: Generate Workspace Test Data
tools.description: Tool to generate synthetic test data on-the-fly without storing in Asset Repository. Use when you need to quickly generate test data based on a data model schema with generator functions. The data model defines entity schemas with properties, data types, and generator function requirements. Generator functions (like randText, regExp, randInt) create realistic synthetic data. Use the GET_GENERATOR_FUNCTIONS action to discover available generator functions and their parameters.

tools.name: Get Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of accounts associated with the authenticated user. Use after confirming valid authentication.

tools.name: Get API Monitoring Schedule
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific API monitoring schedule by its ID. Use when you need to inspect the configuration or timing of an existing schedule.

tools.name: Get API Monitoring Schedules
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of API monitoring test schedules. Use to enumerate, review, or manage scheduled test runs. IMPORTANT: At least one of testId, collectionId, workspaceId, or projectId must be provided. Use BLAZEMETER_GET_WORKSPACES or BLAZEMETER_GET_PROJECTS to get valid IDs for filtering.

tools.name: Get Generator Functions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available test data generator functions from BlazeMeter Test Data API. Use when you need to discover what generator functions are available for creating synthetic test data. This action returns a comprehensive list of generator functions organized by category (numeric, text, datetime, logical, CSV, etc.), including function signatures, parameters, return types, descriptions, and usage examples.

tools.name: Get Generator Seed Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all available seed lists from BlazeMeter Test Data Management API. Use when you need to view available seed list files that contain sample text such as names of countries, persons, streets, banks, months, weekdays, etc., for test data generation.

tools.name: Get Info Health
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the BlazeMeter service health status. Use when you need to check if the service is operational and healthy.

tools.name: Get Info Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve BlazeMeter service version information. Returns version details including git branch, commit hash, and build number. Use when you need to check the current version of the BlazeMeter service or verify which build is deployed.

tools.name: Get Masters Reports Main Summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve request statistics summary for a master test run. Use when you need high-level performance metrics including response times, throughput, error rates, and percentiles for a completed or running test execution.

tools.name: Get Multi Test
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific multi-test. Use after creating or listing multi-tests when you need full configuration and status. Minimal example: "Get multi-test 12345678 with populated tests."

tools.name: Get Multi Tests
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of multi-tests within a BlazeMeter workspace. Multi-tests allow you to run multiple test configurations together. Use this to list, filter by project, and paginate through available multi-tests. Requires workspaceId (obtain via GET_WORKSPACES).

tools.name: Get Private Locations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of private locations filtered by account or workspace. Use when you need to list available private locations for performance testing.

tools.name: Get Project Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific project by its ID. Use when you need to fetch metadata for a single project including name, description, workspace association, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of projects within a specified workspace. Use when you need to enumerate or page through projects under a given workspace.

tools.name: Get Regions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all available test regions for API monitoring. Use when you need to identify valid region codes for scheduling tests or determining where tests can run.

tools.name: Get Search Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about searchable entities, fields, relationships, and operators in BlazeMeter's search API. Use when you need to understand available search entities, their fields, relationships between entities, or supported query operators.

tools.name: Get Shared Folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of shared folders within a specified workspace. Use when you need to list or enumerate shared folders for organizing tests and assets.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all tags from BlazeMeter Mock Services API. Use when you need to enumerate or page through tags for service virtualization.

tools.name: Get Test Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve complete details of a specific test by its ID. Use when you need full information about a test including configuration, executions, tags, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Tests
tools.description: Retrieve a list of performance tests filtered by workspace or project. Either workspaceId or projectId is required. Use this action to list all tests within a specific workspace or project, with support for pagination and sorting. Example: Get all tests in workspace 2225472: {"workspaceId": 2225472, "limit": 10}

tools.name: Get Tests Files
tools.description: Tool to list all files associated with a test. Use when you need to view the files attached to a specific test, such as JMX scripts, CSV data files, or YAML configurations. The download links in the response are valid for 20 minutes.

tools.name: Get Test Validations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve validation results for a specific test by its ID. Use after uploading or modifying test files to confirm file validation status.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Retrieve the authenticated user's profile information including their default project and preferences. This tool fetches details about the currently authenticated BlazeMeter user, including: - Basic profile info (name, email, timezone) - Account status (enabled, roles) - Activity timestamps (created, last login, last access) - Default project and workspace configuration - User preferences and settings No parameters required - returns information based on the authentication credentials used.

tools.name: Get User Active Sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of active test sessions for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check which performance tests or functional tests are currently running for the user. Returns an empty list if no sessions are active.

tools.name: Get User Invites
tools.description: Tool to retrieve pending invites for the authenticated user. Use when checking for workspace or account invitations.

tools.name: Get User Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all projects belonging to the authenticated user. Use when you need to list projects accessible by the current user across all workspaces.

tools.name: Get Workspace Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific workspace by its ID. Use when you need to fetch workspace configuration, owner details, member count, allowances, available locations, and capabilities.

tools.name: Get Workspace Package
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific package by its ID from a workspace in the BlazeMeter Asset Repository. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a package, including its metadata, version, and optionally its dependencies.

tools.name: Get Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of workspaces for a specified account. Use when you need to list or filter workspaces by account, status, or name.

tools.name: Get Workspace Assets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all data models (assets) in a workspace for Test Data Management. Use when you need to list or search for test data assets within a specific workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Asset By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific asset by ID from the Test Data Management Asset Repository. Use when you need to fetch details of a single asset including metadata, data content, or dependencies.

tools.name: Get Workspace Asset Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data from a specific asset in a workspace's asset repository. Use when you need to fetch the actual content/data of an asset stored in BlazeMeter's Asset Repository.

tools.name: Get Workspace Assets Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all dependencies for a given workspace with optional filtering criteria. Use when you need to understand asset relationships and dependencies within a workspace.

tools.name: Get Workspace Asset Dependency
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific dependency by ID from a workspace's asset repository. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a particular dependency asset.

tools.name: Get Asset Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve dependencies for a specific asset in a workspace from the BlazeMeter Asset Repository. Use when you need to list dependencies of an asset.

tools.name: Get Workspace Data Model By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific data model by ID from a workspace in Test Data Management. Use when you need to fetch the schema and details of a particular data model for test data generation.

tools.name: Get Virtual Service Template by ID
tools.description: Tool to get virtual service template details from a specific workspace. Use when you need to retrieve configuration and metadata for a specific service mock template by its ID.

tools.name: Get Workspace Packages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve packages from a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to list or filter packages within a specific workspace using the Asset Repository API.

tools.name: Get Workspace Package Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve package dependencies for a specific package in a workspace. Use when you need to list dependencies for a package managed in BlazeMeter's artifact repository.

tools.name: Get Workspace Service Mock Templates
tools.description: Tool to list virtual service templates available in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve available service mock templates for service virtualization.

tools.name: Get Workspace Transactions
tools.description: Tool to list transactions for virtual services in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve transactions (request/response pairs) for service virtualization.

tools.name: Get Workspace Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of users within a specified workspace. Use when you need to enumerate users, filter by roles, or check user status in a workspace.

tools.name: Import Workspace Package
tools.description: Import a package from a ZIP file into a BlazeMeter workspace. Use to upload and deploy test packages, with an optional force parameter to overwrite existing packages with the same name.

tools.name: List Generator Card Issuers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available card issuers for test data generation. Use when you need to generate credit card test data and want to know which card issuer types are supported and their valid digit lengths.

tools.name: Publish API Data
tools.description: Publishes test data through the BlazeMeter Test Data Management API. This tool enables API Publishing to initialize test environments by reading, writing, or deleting data before executing tests. Use when preparing stateful test environments with HTTP requests mapped to data entities.

tools.name: Register User
tools.description: Tool to register a new user account in BlazeMeter. Use when creating a new user registration via API. This endpoint creates a new user with the provided credentials and returns the user details upon successful registration.

tools.name: Start Test
tools.description: Tool to start a preconfigured performance load test. Use when you need to execute a test that has already been created and configured. Returns a masterId that can be used to track test status, stop the test, or retrieve results.

tools.name: Stop Master
tools.description: Gracefully stop a running BlazeMeter test execution (master) by its ID. The stop operation signals test sessions to close gracefully and archive test files. Use this to abort a running performance test. To find the master_id, use GET /masters endpoint filtered by testId or workspaceId. Note: This is a graceful stop - for immediate termination, use the terminate endpoint instead.

tools.name: Stop Test
tools.description: Tool to stop all active masters (test executions) for a given test ID. Use when you need to terminate all running sessions associated with a test. For more selective control, use the stop master action with a specific masterId to avoid terminating instances launched by other users.

tools.name: Terminate User Active Sessions
tools.description: Tool to immediately terminate active user sessions in BlazeMeter. Use when you need to forcefully stop running test sessions for the authenticated user. This is an immediate termination action - for graceful shutdown, use the stop endpoint instead.

tools.name: Terminate Workspaces Masters
tools.description: Tool to terminate all running masters in a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to stop all active test executions in a workspace. Set dryRun=true to preview which masters would be terminated without actually stopping them.

tools.name: Update API Monitoring Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update the configuration of an existing API monitoring schedule. Use when you need to enable or disable a schedule after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing BlazeMeter project by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or workspace association of a project. Only the fields you provide will be updated; all other fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Test
tools.description: Tool to update details of a specific test by its ID. Use when you need to modify test configuration or name of an existing test after confirming its ID. Example: "Update the test name to 'LoadTest' for test with ID '12345'."

tools.name: Update Workspace Asset
tools.description: Tool to update an existing asset in a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to modify asset properties such as name, display name, type, metadata, or data content. All fields are optional - provide only the fields you want to update. The asset is identified by workspace_id and asset_id.

tools.name: Update Workspaces Assets Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to update asset dependencies in a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to define or modify the dependency relationships between assets. The provided dependencies list replaces all existing dependencies for the specified asset.

tools.name: Update Workspace Package
tools.description: Tool to update an existing package in a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to modify package properties such as name, display name, version, or dependencies. The package name field is required even when updating other fields.

tools.name: Update Workspace Package Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to update package dependencies for a specific package in a workspace. Use when you need to add, modify, or remove dependencies for a package managed in BlazeMeter's artifact repository.

tools.name: Update Workspace Service Mock Template
tools.description: Tool to update a virtual service template configuration (Service Virtualization). Use when you need to modify settings like name, description, live system configuration, endpoint preferences, or request handling behavior for an existing virtual service template.

tools.name: Update Workspace User
tools.description: Tool to update a user's role and status within a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to change a user's permissions (tester, manager, or viewer) or enable/disable their access. Only ONE role should be assigned per user. Requires valid workspace and user IDs.

tools.name: Upload Test Files
tools.description: Upload a file asset (script, data file, or configuration) to a BlazeMeter test. Use after creating a test via CREATE_TEST to attach JMX scripts, CSV data files, YAML Taurus configs, or other test resources before execution.

tools.name: Upload Workspace Asset Data
tools.description: Tool to upload asset data to a BlazeMeter workspace. Use when you need to upload CSV, JSON, or other data files to workspace assets for test data or configuration.

tools.name: Validate Test
tools.description: Tool to validate a specific test by its ID. Use after creating or updating a test to ensure its configuration is valid.

tools.name: Validate Workspace Asset
tools.description: Tool to validate a data model asset in a workspace for test data management. Use when you need to verify that a data model configuration is correct and passes validation rules before using it in tests.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The Account ID used for authentication.

required.name: username
required.description: The API Key ID used for authentication.

required.name: password
required.description: The API Key Secret used for authentication.

name: Blitz API
description: BlitzAPI provides people, company, and job search plus contact and company enrichment for sales workflows.

tools.name: Enrich Company
tools.description: Retrieve a full company profile from an exact LinkedIn company page URL. A successful match consumes record credits.

tools.name: Enrich Person
tools.description: Retrieve a full professional profile and career history from an exact LinkedIn profile URL. A valid no-match returns found=false and person=null; a successful match consumes 1 record credit.

tools.name: Find Companies Hiring
tools.description: Find distinct companies hiring for matching jobs and return each company's matched-job count. Returns one metered page and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: Find Work Email
tools.description: Retrieve a verified work email for a person identified by LinkedIn profile URL. A successful match consumes record credits.

tools.name: Get API Key Details
tools.description: Validate the connected BlitzAPI key and return its record balance, per-endpoint rate limit, allowed API routes, and active plans.

tools.name: Get Changelog
tools.description: Return recent public BlitzAPI changelog entries newest first, optionally limited by age and count.

tools.name: Get Company Employee Distribution
tools.description: Return a company's employee counts and percentages grouped by country or department; each call consumes record credits.

tools.name: List Company Employees
tools.description: Browse employees at one exact LinkedIn company using location, seniority, department, and connection-count filters. Returns one metered page and an opaque continuation cursor; unlike broad Search People, this action preserves BlitzAPI's one-company page browsing contract.

tools.name: Resolve Domain to LinkedIn Company
tools.description: Resolve a website domain or URL to its primary LinkedIn company page and possible alternatives. A successful match consumes record credits.

tools.name: Resolve LinkedIn Company to Domain
tools.description: Resolve a LinkedIn company page URL to its canonical email domain. A valid lookup with no match returns found=false and email_domain=null; a successful match may consume record credits.

tools.name: Resolve Person
tools.description: Resolve a verified work email or US phone number in E.164 format to a full professional profile. Phone lookup is US-only and requires a paid-plan route entitlement. A valid no-match returns found=false and person=null; a successful match consumes 1 record credit.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Search companies by firmographics, funding, traffic, keywords, and headquarters criteria; returns one metered page and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: Search Company Jobs
tools.description: List live job postings for one exact LinkedIn company, optionally filtered by job attributes; return one metered page with a continuation cursor.

tools.name: Search Jobs
tools.description: Search live job postings by role, description, semantic keywords, recency, location, and company criteria; return one metered page with a continuation cursor.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Search professional profiles across one or more companies using person, role, location, education, and firmographic filters. Returns one metered page and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: Waterfall ICP Search
tools.description: Find and rank decision-makers at one company using an ordered cascade of title and location rules; successful results consume record credits.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to the BlitzAPI Dashboard at https://app.blitz-api.ai and view or manage your API keys. Copy an active key here; it is sent in the x-api-key header. The toolkit's tools are compatible with Startup Trial entitlements. Keep the key secret.

name: Blocknative
description: Blocknative provides real-time mempool monitoring and transaction management tools for public blockchains.

tools.name: Configure Mempool Filters
tools.description: Tool to configure filters and ABI decoding for Ethereum mempool transactions. Use after establishing a Blocknative WebSocket connection to set up event filters and decoding.

tools.name: Get Gas Price Distribution
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current mempool gas price distribution breakdown. Use when analyzing gas price trends or preparing fee strategies.

tools.name: Get Gas Oracles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata on supported gas oracles per chain. Use when you need to dynamically discover all available on-chain gas estimation oracles across networks.

tools.name: Get Gas Prices
tools.description: Tool to fetch gas price estimates for specific inclusion probabilities. Use when you need gas price ranges for the next block or next ~10 seconds.

tools.name: Get Supported Chains
tools.description: Tool to retrieve supported chains metadata. Use when discovering available networks for Blocknative gas services.

tools.name: Get Base Fee Estimates
tools.description: Get real-time gas fee predictions for Ethereum mainnet's next 5 blocks. Returns base fee, blob base fee, and priority fee estimates at multiple confidence levels (99% and 50%). Essential for optimizing transaction costs and timing. Predictions include current block context (block number, time since last block) and estimated fees in gwei.

tools.name: Subscribe Multichain
tools.description: Generate WebSocket connection details to subscribe to real-time blockchain events (transactions or account activity) across multiple chains via Blocknative's Multichain API. Returns the WebSocket URL and subscription message payload needed to establish the connection and start receiving event notifications for a specific transaction hash or account address on any supported blockchain.

tools.name: Subscribe Transaction Hash
tools.description: Tool to subscribe to transaction state change events of an Ethereum transaction hash. Use after establishing a Blocknative WebSocket connection to prepare the subscription message.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Multichain
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from events across multiple chains using the Multichain SDK. Use after stopping monitoring of an address or transaction to clean up resources, e.g., call: blocknative.unsubscribe({ id: '0x..', chainId: '0x1' }).

tools.name: Unsubscribe Transaction Hash
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from transaction state change events for an Ethereum transaction hash. Use after establishing a Blocknative WebSocket connection to prepare the unsubscription message.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Blocknative API key used for authentication.

name: Blooio
description: Blooio provides stable v2 APIs for messaging, chats, contacts, groups, phone numbers, and account analytics.

tools.name: Add Contact Tags
tools.description: Add or reactivate one or more free-form tags on a contact.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a contact from an E.164 phone number or email address, optionally assigning a name.

tools.name: Create Group
