name: CapSolver
description: CapSolver provides APIs for CAPTCHA recognition and token-solving workflows, including task creation, polling, account balance, and solution feedback.

tools.name: Classify AWS WAF Image
tools.description: Classify one AWS WAF challenge image or a nine-image grid and return the immediate geometric or object result. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Classify reCAPTCHA V2 Image
tools.description: Classify a reCAPTCHA v2 challenge image for a documented object category and return the immediate selection result. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Get Balance
tools.description: Return the connected CapSolver account balance and non-secret package metadata. Package access tokens are never returned.

tools.name: Get Task Result
tools.description: Get one asynchronous CapSolver task result, or optionally poll it every three seconds for a bounded time. This action never creates or retries a task.

tools.name: Run Vision Engine
tools.description: Run one documented CapSolver vision module and return its immediate points, distance, angle, rectangles, or text result. This is a paid operation.

tools.name: Solve AWS WAF
tools.description: Create one AWS WAF token task with or without a caller-supplied proxy and optionally poll every three seconds for a bounded time. Returns the task ID when processing continues. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve BotDeflector
tools.description: Create exactly one proxyless BotDeflector task from a target flow token and optionally poll every three seconds for a bounded time. Returns the task ID when processing continues. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve Cloudflare Challenge
tools.description: Create one Cloudflare challenge task through a sticky caller-supplied proxy and optionally poll every three seconds for bounded clearance output. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve Cloudflare Turnstile
tools.description: Create one proxyless Cloudflare Turnstile task and optionally poll every three seconds for a bounded time. Returns the task ID for continuation. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve DataDome
tools.description: Create exactly one DataDome slider task with a caller-supplied proxy and optionally wait a bounded time for its solution cookie. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve GeeTest
tools.description: Create one GeeTest v3 or v4 token task and optionally poll every three seconds for a bounded time. Returns the task ID when processing continues. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve Image To Text
tools.description: Recognize text or number answers from base64-encoded images and return the immediate recognition result. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve MTCaptcha
tools.description: Create one proxyless or caller-proxied MTCaptcha token task and optionally poll every three seconds for a bounded time. Returns the task ID when processing continues. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve reCAPTCHA V2
tools.description: Solve one standard or enterprise reCAPTCHA v2 challenge in task or synchronous mode. Task mode creates exactly one task and may poll for a bounded time; synchronous mode calls getToken exactly once. This is a paid CapSolver operation.

tools.name: Solve reCAPTCHA V3
tools.description: Solve a standard, enterprise, or M1 reCAPTCHA v3 challenge in task or synchronous mode. Task mode creates exactly one task and may poll for a bounded time. Synchronous mode calls getToken exactly once and rejects M1. M1 variants are high-cost and require provider and site-specific enablement.

tools.name: Submit Task Feedback
tools.description: Report whether a previously returned CapSolver token worked, using only the documented minimal task and result fields.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your CapSolver clientKey. Sign in at https://dashboard.capsolver.com and copy the client key shown on the dashboard home page. Keep it secret; CapSolver requires it in the clientKey field of every API request body.

name: Capsule CRM
description: Capsule CRM is a simple yet powerful CRM platform designed to help businesses manage customer relationships, sales pipelines, and tasks efficiently.

tools.name: Add Project Party
tools.description: Tool to add a party (person or organisation) to a project in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to associate an additional contact with a specific project beyond the primary assigned party.

tools.name: Create Capsule CRM Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new task category in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a new category for organizing tasks with a specific name and color.

tools.name: Create Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom field definition for parties, opportunities, or projects in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to extend standard entity fields with custom attributes.

tools.name: Create Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new note entry in Capsule CRM. Note: Only note type entries can be created via API. Emails and tasks can be viewed but not created through this endpoint. Use when you need to add a new note record linked to a party, opportunity, or project.

tools.name: Create Lost Reason
tools.description: Tool to create a new lost reason in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a new reason option for tracking why opportunities were lost. Lost reasons help categorize unsuccessful deals and can be included or excluded from conversion rate calculations.

tools.name: Create Capsule CRM Milestone
tools.description: Tool to create a new milestone in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a new stage to a sales pipeline with defined probability and staleness criteria.

tools.name: Create Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to create a new opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to track a potential sale with a party in the sales pipeline.

tools.name: Add Party to Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to add a party (person or organisation) to an opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to associate an additional party with an existing opportunity.

tools.name: Create Capsule CRM Party
tools.description: Tool to create a Party in Capsule CRM. Use when you have collected a person's or organisation's details and need to add a new record.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project (case) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to create a project associated with a party (person or organisation) to track work or engagements.

tools.name: Create Stage
tools.description: Tool to create a new stage in a board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a new workflow stage to an existing board with a specific display order.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a task with a description and due date, optionally linking it to parties, opportunities, or projects.

tools.name: Create Capsule CRM Title
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom person title in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to add a new title option (e.g., 'Madam', 'Sir', 'Dr') for person records.

tools.name: Create Track
tools.description: Tool to create a new track in Capsule CRM by applying a track definition to a project or opportunity. Use when you need to apply a predefined sequence of tasks to a specific entity.

tools.name: Create Track Definition
tools.description: Tool to create a new track definition in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to define a reusable sequence of tasks for business processes that can be applied to opportunities or projects.

tools.name: Delete Board
tools.description: Tool to delete (archive) a specific board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a board that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Category
tools.description: Tool to delete a category from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a category that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom field definition from an entity type in Capsule CRM. This removes the field value from any parties, opportunities, or projects it was assigned to. Use when you need to permanently remove a custom field definition.

tools.name: Delete Entity Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag from an entity type (parties, opportunities, or kases) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a specific tag from all entities of a given type.

tools.name: Delete Entry
tools.description: Tool to delete an entry (note, email, or task) from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove an entry by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Lost Reason
tools.description: Tool to delete a lost reason from Capsule CRM. The deleted reason remains available for historical reporting but cannot be assigned to new opportunities.

tools.name: Delete Milestone
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific milestone from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a milestone that is no longer needed. Note: Cannot delete a milestone while it is being used on an opportunity.

tools.name: Delete Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to delete an opportunity from Capsule CRM. The opportunity can be restored within 30 days via the web interface. Use when you need to remove an opportunity.

tools.name: Delete Opportunity Party
tools.description: Tool to remove a party (person or organisation) from an opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to disassociate a contact from a specific opportunity.

tools.name: Delete Party
tools.description: Tool to fully delete a specific party (person or organisation) from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to completely remove a party after confirming no active references remain.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project (case) from Capsule CRM. The project can be restored within 30 days via the web interface. Use when you need to remove a project.

tools.name: Delete Project Party
tools.description: Tool to remove a party (person or organisation) from a project in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to disassociate a contact from a specific project.

tools.name: Delete Stage
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific stage from a board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a stage that is no longer needed. Note: Cannot delete a stage while it is being used by open projects.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific task from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a task by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Title
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific title from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a title that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Track
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific track from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a track that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Track Definition
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific track definition from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to remove a track definition that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Get Activity Type
tools.description: Tool to get a specific activity type by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details about a particular activity type including its name, icon, and whether it updates the last contacted date.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific attachment by ID from Capsule CRM. Returns the file content along with metadata (filename, content type). Use when you need to download an attachment that is associated with an entry (note, email, or completed task).

tools.name: Get Board
tools.description: Tool to get a specific board by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular board including its name, description, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Category
tools.description: Tool to get a specific category by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular category including its name and colour.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current authenticated user's details including id, username, name, locale, currency, status, timezone, lastLoginAt, and taskReminder settings. Use when you need to identify the current user or access their preferences and settings.

tools.name: Get Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Tool to get a specific custom field definition by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details about a custom field including its type, options, and configuration.

tools.name: Get Entity Tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific tag by ID for an entity type (parties, opportunities, or kases) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need details about a specific tag associated with an entity type.

tools.name: Get Entry
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific entry by ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a note, email, or task entry.

tools.name: Get Lost Reason
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific lost reason by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need details about a particular lost reason, such as its name or conversion tracking status.

tools.name: Get Milestone
tools.description: Tool to get a specific milestone by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular milestone including its name, description, completion status, and probability.

tools.name: Get Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific opportunity by its ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need detailed information about a single opportunity including value, milestone, and associated parties.

tools.name: Get Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to get a specific pipeline by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular pipeline including its name, description, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific project (case) by its ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need detailed information about a single project.

tools.name: Get Stage
tools.description: Tool to get a specific stage by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details of a particular stage including its name, description, board, and display order.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Tool to get a specific task by ID. Use when you need to retrieve full details of a task including description, due date, status, and associations.

tools.name: Get Track
tools.description: Tool to get a specific track by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a track including its description, date, direction, and optionally its associated tasks.

tools.name: Get Track Definition
tools.description: Tool to get a specific track definition by ID from Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve details of a track definition including its description, capture rule, direction, and associated task definitions.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to get a specific user by ID. Use when you need to retrieve full details of a user including username, email preferences, timezone settings, and optionally their associated party information.

tools.name: List Activity Type Icons
tools.description: Tool to list available activity type icons in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve the set of icons available for categorizing activities or when creating/updating activity types. Returns system and custom icons with their identifiers, display names, and order.

tools.name: List Activity Types
tools.description: Tool to list all activity types on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve available activity types for categorizing activities or understanding what activity classifications are available in the CRM.

tools.name: List Boards
tools.description: Tool to list all boards on the Capsule CRM account. Use when you need to fetch all boards to view their names, descriptions, and metadata.

tools.name: List Board Stages
tools.description: Tool to list stages associated with a board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve all stages for a specific board with optional status filtering.

tools.name: List Categories
tools.description: Tool to list all task categories on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve available categories for tasks or filter tasks by category.

tools.name: List Countries
tools.description: Tool to list all countries on the Capsule CRM account. Returns ISO country codes (alpha2, alpha3, numeric) and country names. Use when you need to reference valid country codes for addresses or other location-based data.

tools.name: List Currencies
tools.description: Tool to list all available currencies on the Capsule account. Returns ISO 4217 currency codes with their symbols and names. Use when you need to display currency options or validate currency codes for opportunities.

tools.name: List Custom Field Definitions
tools.description: Tool to list all custom field definitions for parties, opportunities, or projects (kases). Use when you need to discover what custom fields are available for a specific entity type.

tools.name: List Deleted Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to list opportunities deleted or restricted since a given date. Use when you need to identify recently deleted or restricted opportunities.

tools.name: List deleted parties
tools.description: Tool to retrieve parties deleted since a given date. Use when you need to sync deletions.

tools.name: List Deleted Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects deleted or restricted since a given date. Use when you need to identify recently deleted or restricted projects.

tools.name: List Entity Entries
tools.description: Tool to list entries (notes, emails, tasks) for a specific party, opportunity, or project. Use when you need to retrieve all activity entries associated with an entity.

tools.name: List Entity Tags
tools.description: Tool to list all tag definitions for a specific entity type (parties, opportunities, or kases). Use when you need to retrieve available tags that can be applied to entities.

tools.name: List Entity Tracks
tools.description: Tool to list tracks applied to a specific opportunity or project. Use when you need to retrieve all tracks associated with an entity, optionally including their tasks.

tools.name: List Entries By Date
tools.description: Tool to list notes, emails, and completed party tasks in descending order by entry date. Use when you need the most recent entries first after authenticating.

tools.name: List Goals
tools.description: Tool to list all goals on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve goals with pagination support.

tools.name: List Lost Reasons
tools.description: Tool to list all lost reasons on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve available reasons for marking opportunities as lost.

tools.name: List Milestones
tools.description: Tool to list all milestones on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve available milestones for pipelines or opportunities.

tools.name: List Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to list all opportunities from Capsule CRM with pagination and filtering. Use when you need to retrieve sales opportunities with optional filters for date changes or embed additional data like tags, custom fields, party details, or milestones.

tools.name: List Opportunity Parties
tools.description: Tool to list additional parties associated with an opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve contacts related to a specific opportunity.

tools.name: List Opportunity Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects (cases) associated with a specific opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve all projects linked to an opportunity.

tools.name: List Organisation Employees
tools.description: Tool to list employees linked to a specific organisation (party). Use when you need to retrieve all employees under a given organisation.

tools.name: List Parties
tools.description: Tool to list all parties (contacts) on the account. Use when you need to fetch contacts with optional filters or embed additional related data.

tools.name: List Party Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to list all opportunities associated with a specific party in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to view all sales opportunities for a particular contact or organisation.

tools.name: List Party Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects associated with a specific party in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve all projects linked to a contact or organisation.

tools.name: List Pipeline Milestones
tools.description: Tool to list milestones associated with a specific pipeline in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve all milestones for a pipeline to view their names, completion status, and probability.

tools.name: List Pipelines
tools.description: Tool to list all sales pipelines on the Capsule account. Pipelines contain milestones that track opportunity progress. Use when you need to retrieve available pipelines for opportunity management or to reference pipeline IDs.

tools.name: List Project Parties
tools.description: Tool to list parties associated with a specific project in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to retrieve all contacts linked to a project with optional filters and embedded data.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List projects (cases) from Capsule CRM with pagination and filtering options. Projects (called 'kases' in the API) are used to track work or engagements related to parties. Supports filtering by status, search terms, date modified, and embedding additional data like tags, custom fields, party details, and opportunities.

tools.name: List REST Hooks
tools.description: Tool to list all REST hook subscriptions on the Capsule CRM account. REST hooks are webhook subscriptions that notify your application of events like party/opportunity/project created/updated/deleted. Use when you need to view existing webhook configurations or audit active subscriptions.

tools.name: List Site
tools.description: Tool to retrieve site (account) information for the authenticated Capsule CRM account. Returns the site URL, subdomain, and organization name. Use this when you need to identify which Capsule account is being accessed or retrieve basic account details.

tools.name: List Stages
tools.description: Tool to list all stages on the Capsule CRM account. Use when you need to retrieve stages across all boards with optional status filtering and pagination.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list tasks on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve tasks with filters or embedded related data.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: Tool to list all teams on the Capsule CRM account. Returns team details including id, name, createdAt, and updatedAt timestamps. Optionally embed team membership information using the embed parameter.

tools.name: List Titles
tools.description: Tool to list all custom person titles on the Capsule account. Returns title IDs and text values. Use when you need to retrieve available title options for person records or reference title IDs for other operations.

tools.name: List Track Definitions
tools.description: Tool to list all track definitions on the Capsule account. Use when you need to retrieve track templates that define sequences of tasks for opportunities or projects.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List all users on the Capsule CRM account. Returns user details including id, username, name, locale, currency, status, timezone, lastLoginAt, and taskReminder settings. Optionally embed full party details (addresses, phone numbers, emails) using the embed parameter. Use this for user management, auditing, or when you need to reference user IDs for other operations.

tools.name: Restore Board
tools.description: Tool to restore a deleted board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to recover a previously deleted board. Requires Administrator role.

tools.name: Run Filter Query
tools.description: Tool to run structured filter queries on parties, opportunities or kases. Use when you need to retrieve entities matching specific filter conditions.

tools.name: Search Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to search for opportunities in Capsule CRM by query string. Use when you need to find specific opportunities by searching their names or descriptions.

tools.name: Search Parties
tools.description: Tool to search for parties (contacts/organisations) in Capsule CRM by query string. Use when you need to find specific parties by searching their names, contact info, or tags.

tools.name: Search Projects
tools.description: Tool to search for projects (cases) in Capsule CRM by query string. Use when you need to find specific projects by searching their names or descriptions.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Board
tools.description: Tool to update an existing board in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name or description of a board. Requires Administrator role on the Capsule account.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Category
tools.description: Tool to update an existing category in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name or color of a category.

tools.name: Update Custom Field Definition
tools.description: Tool to update an existing custom field definition in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name or data tag association of a custom field for parties, opportunities, or projects.

tools.name: Update Entity Tag
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tag for an entity type (parties, opportunities, or kases) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name of a tag.

tools.name: Update Entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing entry (note, email, or task) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the content of an entry or manage its attachments.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Lost Reason
tools.description: Tool to update an existing lost reason in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name or conversion tracking setting of a lost reason after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Milestone
tools.description: Tool to update an existing milestone in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or probability of a milestone stage in the sales pipeline.

tools.name: Update Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to update an existing opportunity in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify details such as name, value, milestone, probability, or custom fields after confirming the opportunity ID.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Party
tools.description: Tool to update an existing person or organisation (Party) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify specific fields of a party after confirming its ID. Example: "Update party 11587 to remove phone number 12136 and add a new work email."

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to update an existing pipeline in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name or description of a pipeline.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing project (case) in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify project details such as name, description, status, or custom fields after confirming the project ID.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Stage
tools.description: Tool to update an existing stage in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or display order of a stage within a board. Requires Administrator role on the Capsule account.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify task details, change status to completed, or update due dates.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Track
tools.description: Tool to update an existing track in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the description or trackDateOn of a track instance. Only description and trackDateOn can be modified.

tools.name: Update Capsule CRM Track Definition
tools.description: Tool to update an existing track definition in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify the description or manage task definitions within a track.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user in Capsule CRM. Use when you need to modify user preferences such as task reminders, locale, currency, timezone, or email settings.

tools.name: Upload Attachment
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment to Capsule CRM. Returns a token that can be used to associate the attachment with entries when creating or updating them. Maximum file size is 25MB.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Capsule API token. Click your name (top right) → My Preferences → API Authentication Tokens → Generate new token. Copy it right away — it's only shown in full once.

name: Captions
description: Captions provides the Mirage API for generating videos and speech and adding styled captions to videos.

tools.name: Add Captions
tools.description: Start an asynchronous job that transcribes and renders a selected caption style onto an uploaded or existing completed video. Use CAPTIONS_GET_VIDEO_STATUS to monitor the returned job, then CAPTIONS_DOWNLOAD_VIDEO when it completes. This call consumes paid Mirage credits and cannot be cancelled or deleted once submitted.

tools.name: Download Video
tools.description: Download the MP4 content of a completed video job and return an offloaded file reference. Use CAPTIONS_GET_VIDEO_STATUS first to confirm the job is COMPLETE.

tools.name: Generate Speech
tools.description: Generate WAV speech synchronously from text using a known Mirage voice ID and return an offloaded audio file reference. This call consumes paid Mirage credits and cannot be cancelled or deleted once submitted.

tools.name: Generate Video
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Mirage Video 1 job that animates a portrait image using speech audio. Use the returned job ID with CAPTIONS_GET_VIDEO_STATUS. This call consumes paid Mirage credits and cannot be cancelled or deleted once submitted.

tools.name: Get Caption Template
tools.description: Retrieve one caption style by ID, including its name and preview video URL.

tools.name: Get Video Status
tools.description: Retrieve the current state, progress, and error details for a video generation or captioning job.

tools.name: List Caption Templates
tools.description: Return one page of available caption styles, including names and preview video URLs.

tools.name: List Videos
tools.description: Return one page of video jobs owned by the connected Mirage account, including each job's status and progress.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your API key from the Mirage platform dashboard at https://platform.mirage.app/. Every Mirage API request requires this key in the x-api-key header. Keep it secret.

name: CaptureKit
description: CaptureKit captures webpage screenshots, extracts structured web content, crawls pages, and analyzes websites with AI.

tools.name: Analyze Webpage
tools.description: Analyze a webpage with AI to identify its summary, value proposition, features, categories, use cases, audience, and optional custom fields.

tools.name: Capture Webpage
tools.description: Capture a webpage as an image or PDF and return a downloadable file reference.

tools.name: Extract Webpage Content
tools.description: Extract webpage metadata and links, optionally including rendered HTML, Markdown, sitemap data, or cleaned main content.

tools.name: Fetch Page HTML
tools.description: Fetch a webpage's raw HTML without browser rendering for fast scraping, audits, or monitoring.

tools.name: Get Usage
tools.description: Return the connected workspace's current CaptureKit allowance, usage, API-key status, quotas, and effective rate limits.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your CaptureKit API key. Sign in at https://app.capturekit.dev/, open API Keys in the dashboard, and create or copy a key. CaptureKit shows a newly created key only once. The key is sent in the 'x-api-key' request header; keep it secret.

name: Carbon Voice MCP
description: Carbon Voice MCP connects agents to authorized voice messages, conversations, and collaboration workflows in Carbon Voice.

tools.name: Add attachments to message
tools.description: Add attachments to a message. In order to add attachments to a message, you must provide a message id and the attachments.

tools.name: Create conversation message
tools.description: Sends a message to an existing conversation or any type with a conversation_id. To reply as a thread, included a message_id for "parent_id". You must provide a transcript or attachment.

tools.name: Create direct message
tools.description: Send a Direct Message (DM) to a User or a Group of Users. In order to create a Direct Message, you must provide transcript or link attachments.

tools.name: Create folder
tools.description: Create a new folder.

tools.name: Create voicememo message
tools.description: Create a VoiceMemo Message. In order to create a VoiceMemo Message, you must provide a transcript or link attachments.

tools.name: Delete folder
tools.description: Delete a folder by its ID. Deleting a folder will also delete nested folders and all the messages in referenced folders. (This is a destructive action and cannot be undone, so please be careful.)

tools.name: Get ai action responses
tools.description: Retrieve previously generated AI Action (Prompt) responses by filtering for a specific prompt, message, or conversation ID. Combine filters to narrow results and view all AI-generated responses related to a particular prompt, message, or conversation.

tools.name: Get conversation
tools.description: Get a conversation by its ID.

tools.name: Get conversation users
tools.description: Get users in a conversation.

tools.name: Get current user
tools.description: Get the current user information.

tools.name: Get folder
tools.description: Get a folder by its ID.

tools.name: Get folder with messages
tools.description: Get a folder including its messages by its ID. (Only messages at folder level are returned.)

tools.name: Get message
tools.description: Get a message by its ID.

tools.name: Get recent messages
tools.description: Get most recent messages, including their associated Conversation, Creator, and Labels information. Returns a maximum of 10 messages.

tools.name: Get root folders
tools.description: Lists all root folders for a given workspace, including their names, IDs, and basic structure, but does not provide aggregate counts.(Required to inform message type:voicememo,prerecorded)

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific user by their ID. Returns the full user profile — name, languages, voice settings, workspace memberships and roles, notification preferences, and timestamps. This is richer than `search_user` (which only finds users by phone, email, or name). Use this when you already have a user ID and need their complete information.

tools.name: Get workspaces basic info
tools.description: Get basic information about a workspace.

tools.name: List ai actions
tools.description: List AI Actions (Prompts). Optionally, you can filter by owner type and workspace id. Filtering by owner type, Possible values: "user", "workspace", "system". Do not use unless the user explicitly requests it.

tools.name: List conversations
tools.description: List all conversations. Returns a simplified view of user conversations that have had messages sent or received within the last 6 months. Each result includes id, name, workspace_id, and type (directMessage, customerConversation, namedConversation, or asyncMeeting).

tools.name: List messages
tools.description: List Messages. By default returns latest 20 messages. The maximum allowed range between dates is 183 days (6 months). All presigned URLs returned by this tool are ready to use. Do not parse, modify, or re-encode them—always present or use the URLs exactly as received.If you want to get messages from a specific date range, you can use the "start_date" and "end_date" parameters. If you want to get messages from a specific date, you can use the "date" parameter. If you want to get messages from a specific user, you can use the "user_ids" parameter. If you want to get messages from a specific conversation, you can use the "conversation_id" parameter. If you want to get messages from a specific folder, you can use the "folder_id" parameter. If you want to get messages from a specific workspace, you can use the "workspace_id" parameter. If you want to get messages for a particular language, you can use the "language" parameter.

tools.name: Move folder
tools.description: Move a folder by its ID. Move a Folder into another Folder or into a Workspace.

tools.name: Move message to folder
tools.description: Move a message to a folder by its ID. Move a Message into another Folder or into a Workspace. Only allowed to move messages of type: voicememo,prerecorded.

tools.name: Run ai action
tools.description: Run an AI Action (Prompt) for a message. You can run an AI Action for a message by its ID or a list of message IDs.

tools.name: Run ai action for shared link
tools.description: Run an AI Action (Prompt) for a shared link. You can run an AI Action for a shared link by its ID or a list of shared link IDs. You can also provide the language of the response.

tools.name: Search user
tools.description: Search for a User by their phone number, email address, id or name. (In order to search for a User, you must provide a phone number, email address, id or name.)When searching by name, only users that are part of your contacts will be returned

tools.name: Search users
tools.description: Search multiple Users by their phone numbers, email addresses, ids or names. (In order to search Users, you must provide phone numbers, email addresses, ids or names.)When searching by name, only users that are part of your contacts will be returned

tools.name: Summarize conversation
tools.description: Summarize a conversation.

tools.name: Update folder name
tools.description: Update a folder name by its ID.

optional.description: Client id of the app

optional.description: Client secret of the app

optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

name: Carbone
description: Carbone is a fast and simple report generator that converts JSON data into various document formats such as PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT, and more, using templates.

tools.name: Delete Carbone Template
tools.description: Permanently delete a template from the Carbone server by its 64-character hexadecimal template ID. This action is irreversible. Ensure you have the correct template ID before deleting.

tools.name: Download Template
tools.description: Tool to download a template from Carbone by template ID. Use when you need to retrieve the original template file.

tools.name: Generate Carbone Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a Carbone report from a template and JSON data. Use when you need to render documents in various formats.

tools.name: Get Carbone Server Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current status and health of the Carbone server. Use before generating reports to ensure the service is operational.

tools.name: List Template Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all categories used in templates. Categories function like folders for organizing templates. Use when you need to see available template groupings.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of templates from Carbone storage with filtering, search, and cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to find templates, search by name or ID, or iterate through all deployed templates.

tools.name: List Template Tags
tools.description: Tool to list all tags currently used in templates. Use when you need to discover available tags for categorizing or filtering templates by document type or version.

tools.name: Render Template Direct
tools.description: Tool to generate a document by uploading a base64-encoded template and data in a single API call. Use when you need to render documents without uploading templates separately.

tools.name: Set Carbone API Version
tools.description: Tool to set the Carbone API version to be used for subsequent requests. Use before rendering or managing templates to ensure correct version is applied.

tools.name: Update Template Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update metadata and attributes of an existing Carbone template. Use when you need to modify template name, comment, tags, category, or control version deployment and lifecycle.

tools.name: Upload a template
tools.description: Upload a template file to the Carbone server to obtain a template ID for document generation. Supported template formats: DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, ODT, ODS, ODP, ODG, XHTML, IDML, HTML, or XML. Templates can contain placeholders like {d.fieldname} that will be replaced with data during report generation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Carbone API key used for authentication.

name: CardClan
description: CardClan helps teams personalize and send digital cards, generate card links, and manage card integration workflows.

tools.name: Create Integration Configuration
tools.description: Create a persistent CardClan integration configuration linking a card to its workspace. The connected user's ID is resolved automatically.

tools.name: Generate Personalized Card URL
tools.description: Generate a personalized CardClan viewing URL without sending an email. This may create recipient-specific CardClan state but does not deliver a message.

tools.name: Get Card Details
tools.description: Get a CardClan card's title, merge-tag requirements, and owning workspace details by card ID.

tools.name: Get Integration Configuration
tools.description: Get a CardClan integration configuration by either integration ID or card ID.

tools.name: List Cards
tools.description: List cards in a CardClan workspace, including card IDs needed for details, integration configuration, personalized links, and sending.

tools.name: List Email Accounts
tools.description: List configured CardClan sender accounts that can be selected when sending a card.

tools.name: List Workflow Cards
tools.description: List cards with active CardClan integration workflows and return their integration, card, and workspace IDs.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: List CardClan workspaces accessible to the connected account, including the workspace IDs needed to find cards and create integration configurations.

tools.name: Send Card
tools.description: Immediately personalize and send a CardClan card by email to one or more recipients. This externally side-effecting operation is irreversible; use GENERATE_CARD_URL when delivery is not intended.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your case-sensitive, 36-character CardClan Integration Key. In the CardClan dashboard, open Settings, click Generate Integration Key, and copy the key when it is displayed; CardClan shows it only once. This is not a regular CardClan API key or Zapier key.

name: Cardly
description: Cardly helps businesses create great engagement with customers by getting out of inboxes and into mailboxes.

tools.name: Create Contact List
tools.description: Tool to add a new contact list. Use after defining name and optional custom fields, before populating the list with contacts.

tools.name: Create Invitation
tools.description: Tool to send an invitation to use your organisation portal. Use when you need to grant access to a new user by their email address. If the email already has access, the API will return an appropriate error.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription. Use when you need Cardly to notify your application via HTTP POST for specific events.

tools.name: Delete Invitation
tools.description: Tool to delete an invitation by unique ID, immediately invalidating it for acceptance. Use when you need to revoke a pending invitation using its ID.

tools.name: Delete Invitation by Email
tools.description: Deletes a pending invitation by email address, immediately invalidating it and preventing acceptance. This action is idempotent - deleting a non-existent invitation returns success. Use when you need to revoke access before an invitation is accepted, such as when correcting mistakes or revoking access for security reasons. Note: In test mode, the API returns an empty data object instead of the deleted invitation details.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user by unique ID, immediately revoking their access to your organisation portal. Use when removing user access is required. Cannot remove users with administrator privileges - attempting to delete an admin will fail.

tools.name: Delete User by Email
tools.description: Deletes a user by email address, immediately revoking their access to your organisation portal. This action cannot remove users with administrator privileges. Use when you need to revoke user access, such as when employees leave or access needs to be terminated. The API returns a 404 if no matching user is found.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook. Use after confirming the webhook ID to immediately cease all activity and event subscriptions for that webhook.

tools.name: Echo Request
tools.description: Tool to echo all request parameters, body, and headers for debugging purposes. Use when validating authentication or testing API connectivity without affecting account data.

tools.name: Generate Preview
tools.description: Tool to generate a low-quality, watermarked preview document for a card. Use after confirming artwork and template details to estimate costs and delivery.

tools.name: Get Artwork
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on a specific piece of artwork by its unique ID. Use when you need to fetch detailed artwork data including preview images, media specifications, and metadata. The ID can be obtained from the List Artwork action.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Tool to get details on an existing webhook. Use this to retrieve information about a webhook's configuration, including its target URL, subscribed events, status, and metadata.

tools.name: List Artwork
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the currently available artwork for your organisation. Use when you need to list and paginate artwork items, optionally filtering to only your own artwork.

tools.name: List Contact Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all active contact lists for your organization. Use when you need to list and paginate contact lists with their custom fields and automation rules.

tools.name: List Credit History
tools.description: Retrieves the account's credit transaction history showing all credits and debits. Returns a paginated list of balance changes with timestamps, amounts, and descriptions. Use to audit spending, review signup bonuses, track refunds, or investigate balance changes. Filter by date range using effectiveTime parameters. Supports standard pagination with limit and offset.

tools.name: List Doodles
tools.description: Retrieve your currently available doodles from Cardly. Returns doodle metadata including name and restriction status. Use this to discover available doodle designs before creating cards.

tools.name: List Fonts
tools.description: List available fonts for handwriting and text personalization in Cardly cards. Returns font metadata including name, category, variants, and whether the font supports humanisation. Use this to discover font options before creating cards or generating previews.

tools.name: List Gift Credit History
tools.description: Lists gift credit history records for your organization with pagination and optional time-based filtering. Gift credits are promotional credits that can be applied to orders. This action retrieves a history of gift credit additions, deductions, and balance changes. Returns empty results if no gift credit history exists.

tools.name: List Invitations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve active invitations for your organisation with optional filters. Use when you need to audit invited users and their statuses before sending new invitations or revoking access.

tools.name: List Media
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the currently available media sizes for product artwork. Use when you need to explore or validate media options before creating artwork.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of orders placed by your organization. Returns detailed order information including customer details, costs, items, shipping info, and delivery tracking. Use optional limit and offset parameters to control pagination.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve your currently available templates from Cardly. Use to list and paginate templates for selection in card sends.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all users associated with your account. Use when you need to list and paginate user accounts.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for your organization, including their status, target URLs, subscribed events, and delivery statistics. Use this to audit existing webhooks, monitor their health, or get webhook IDs for updates/deletions.

tools.name: List Writing Styles
tools.description: Tool to list available writing styles. Use when you need to retrieve writing styles available for handwriting personalization.

tools.name: Retrieve Account Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current account and gift credit balances for your organisation. Use after authenticating to verify available credit before placing orders.

tools.name: Retrieve Order
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific order by its ID. Returns complete order data including customer details, items, costs, delivery information, and tracking details. Use this after obtaining an order ID from the List Orders action or from a known order reference.

tools.name: Retrieve User
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific user account by ID. Returns user profile data including name, email, status, and permissions. Use list_users to get available user IDs first.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update a webhook’s settings, including target URL and events. Use after retrieving existing webhook to apply configuration changes.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key provided by Cardly.

name: CarsXE
description: CarsXE provides vehicle data APIs for VIN specifications, recalls, license plate decoding, market values, history, images, recognition, and related automotive lookups.

tools.name: Check Lien and Theft Records
tools.description: Retrieve reportable US lien and theft events for a VIN. A no-data response means CarsXE has no reportable record and is not proof that the vehicle is clear.

price.description: $1.00 per successful lien and theft lookup

tools.name: Decode License Plate
tools.description: Look up vehicle identity from a license plate using CarsXE's current global v2 decoder.

price.description: $0.50 per successful plate decode; $1.00 with Spain require_vin

tools.name: Decode OBD Code
tools.description: Translate an OBD-II diagnostic trouble code into a readable diagnosis.

tools.name: Extract VIN from Image
tools.description: Extract a vehicle identification number from an image supplied as an HTTP(S) URL or raw base64 image data, returning the best match, its bounding box and confidence, and alternative candidates.

price.description: $0.15 per successful VIN extraction from an image

tools.name: Get Vehicle Market Value
tools.description: Estimate wholesale, retail, and trade-in values for a VIN using CarsXE's current v2 valuation, optionally adjusted for state, mileage, and condition.

tools.name: Get Recall Batch
tools.description: Make exactly one read request for a CarsXE recall batch. The default status view returns current progress. The results view is available only when the batch is completed or partial and returns a bounded local page (100 rows by default, at most 1,000) from CarsXE's complete array; use result_offset to continue. CarsXE returns 409 while results are not ready. This tool makes one provider request and never polls internally.

tools.name: Get Vehicle History
tools.description: Retrieve title, brand, junk/salvage, insurance, VIN-change, and historical title records for a VIN.

tools.name: Get Vehicle Images
tools.description: Find up to 10 vehicle photos by make and model, with optional year, trim, angle, image type, size, color, quality, transparency, and license filters.

tools.name: Get Vehicle Recalls
tools.description: Find safety recall campaigns either for one VIN or for a year, make, and model. Supply exactly one lookup method.

tools.name: Get Vehicle Specifications
tools.description: Decode a 17-character VIN into vehicle identity, specifications, equipment, colors, and warranty data. International decoding is used automatically when CarsXE needs it unless explicitly disabled.

tools.name: Get Year Make Model Data
tools.description: Look up detailed vehicle and trim information by year, make, and model without a VIN. Returns bounded trim summaries rather than large feature and color payloads.

price.description: $0.20 per successful year, make, and model lookup

tools.name: Recognize License Plate
tools.description: Analyze a publicly accessible vehicle image and return license-plate candidates, regions, confidence, bounding boxes, and detected vehicle details.

tools.name: Submit Recall Batch
tools.description: Create one asynchronous CarsXE recall-check batch for 1 to 10,000 VIN entries. Charged per unique valid VIN after CarsXE normalizes and deduplicates the list. The action makes one submission request and does not poll or resubmit an ambiguous failure; use the returned batch ID to check progress or retrieve results later.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal or organization CarsXE API key. Copy it from the API key area of the CarsXE developer dashboard and keep it secret. See https://docs.carsxe.com/docs/get-started for setup guidance. This connection covers the standard direct REST API; Enterprise Ownership and alternate x402, RapidAPI, MCP, and EU routing surfaces are not included.

name: Cartesia
description: Cartesia provides real-time text-to-speech, speech-to-text, voice, model training, and managed voice agent APIs.

tools.name: Create Pronunciation Dictionary
tools.description: Create a reusable pronunciation dictionary for text-to-speech generation.

tools.name: Delete Pronunciation Dictionary
tools.description: Permanently delete one pronunciation dictionary by ID.

tools.name: Get Pronunciation Dictionary
tools.description: Return one pronunciation dictionary and its complete text-to-pronunciation mappings.

tools.name: Get Voice
tools.description: Return synthesis-relevant details for one Cartesia voice by ID.

tools.name: List Accents
tools.description: List supported accents, optionally filtered by language, locale, or voice-localization support.

tools.name: List Agent Models
tools.description: List language models available to Cartesia Managed Agents, including provider, latency, and pricing metadata.

tools.name: List Pronunciation Dictionaries
tools.description: Return one page of pronunciation dictionaries available to the connected account.

tools.name: List Voices
tools.description: Search and filter Cartesia voices, returning one page of voice IDs and synthesis-relevant metadata.

tools.name: Synthesize Speech
tools.description: Generate a downloadable audio file from one complete transcript using a selected Cartesia voice; usage is billed by transcript length.

tools.name: Update Pronunciation Dictionary
tools.description: Update a pronunciation dictionary and replace its mappings with the complete supplied item set.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your standard Cartesia API key beginning with sk_car_. Create or copy one from API Keys at https://play.cartesia.ai/keys. Do not use an organization admin key beginning with sk_car_admin_.

name: Cashfree MCP
description: Cashfree Payments MCP lets authorized agents manage payment links, orders, refunds, payment simulation, settlements, reconciliation reports, and related merchant payment workflows.

tools.name: Cancel payment link
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to cancel/deactivate an existing payment link so no further payments can be made.
Cancel a payment link. Only links in ACTIVE status can be cancelled.

tools.name: Create order
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to create a payment order to accept a payment. Requires amount, currency, and customer details.
Create a new payment order. Returns order_id and payment_session_id needed to collect payment.
NEXT: Call get_order(order_id) to verify the order was created and retrieve the payment session.

tools.name: Create payment link
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to create a shareable payment link to collect money from customers.
Create a new payment link with an amount, purpose, and customer details. Returns the link URL.
NEXT: Call fetch_payment_link_details(link_id) to verify the link was created and check its status.

tools.name: Create refund
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to initiate a refund for a payment.
Create a refund against an order. Requires order_id and refund details in the body.
NEXT: Call get_refund(order_id, refund_id) to track the refund status.

tools.name: Download report
tools.description:
USE WHEN: A report has reached DONE status and the user wants the download URL.
Download a completed report.

tools.name: Fetch payment link details
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to check the status or details of an existing payment link.
Fetch all details and status of a payment link by its link_id.

tools.name: Fetch simulation
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to check the result of a simulated payment.
Fetch simulated payment details by simulation_id.

tools.name: Generate recon report
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to generate a settlement reconciliation report.
Generate a settlement reconciliation report asynchronously.
NEXT: Call get_report_status(reportId) to poll until the report is DONE, then download_report(reportId).

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together and be either a
custom range of 31 days or less, or exactly one full financial year — April 1 to
March 31 of any financial year that has already begun (the current one may also be
requested as April 1 to today). There is no limit on how far back the range starts,
but a custom range must not extend into the future. Anything else is rejected with
HTTP 400 — split wider custom periods into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Generate summary report
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to generate a transaction summary, settlement, refund, or ledger report.
Generate a summary/download report asynchronously.
NEXT: Call get_report_status(reportId) to poll until the report is DONE, then download_report(reportId).

DATE RANGE LIMIT: every date pair (startDate/endDate, bbpsStartDate/bbpsEndDate,
subscriptionStartDate/subscriptionEndDate) must be either a custom range of 31 days
or less, or exactly one full financial year — April 1 to March 31 of any financial
year that has already begun (the current one may also be requested as April 1 to
today). There is no limit on how far back a range starts, but a custom range must
not extend into the future. Anything else is rejected with HTTP 400 — split wider
custom periods into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Get instant settlement rates
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks about the charge rate for instant/on-demand settlements.
Get instant/on-demand settlement charge rates.

tools.name: Get merchant free trial credits
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks about free trial credits for on-demand settlements.
Get merchant free trial credits for on-demand settlements.

tools.name: Get next settlement date
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks when the next settlement will happen or about settlement schedule.
Get the merchant's next settlement date and holiday information.

tools.name: Get on demand charges
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to preview charges/fees for an on-demand settlement withdrawal.
Calculate exact charges for a specific on-demand withdrawal amount.

tools.name: Get on demand daily limit
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks about on-demand settlement withdrawal limits.
Get on-demand settlement maximum daily limit.
NEXT: Call get_on_demand_eligible_funds() to see the actual withdrawable amount.

tools.name: Get on demand eligible funds
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to know how much money can be withdrawn via on-demand settlement.
Get eligible funds for on-demand settlement withdrawal.
NEXT: Call get_on_demand_charges(requestedAmount, freeTrialRequest=false) to preview fees before withdrawal.

tools.name: Get on demand settlement activation status
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks if on-demand/instant settlements are available or activated.
Get on-demand settlement activation status.
NEXT: If activated, call get_on_demand_eligible_funds() to check available balance.

tools.name: Get order
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to check the status of an order or retrieve its payment session details.
Fetch order details using the order_id.
NEXT: Call get_payments_for_an_order(order_id) to see all payment attempts against this order.

tools.name: Get order extended
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user needs extended order information including address, cart items, offers, and customer details.
Fetch extended order data using the Cashfree order_id.

tools.name: Get orders for a payment link
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to see all orders created against a specific payment link.
View all order details for a payment link.
NEXT: Call get_order(order_id) or get_payments_for_an_order(order_id) for specific order details.

tools.name: Get payment by id
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to view details of a specific payment attempt on an order.
Get payment details by order_id and cf_payment_id.
NEXT: To refund this payment, call create_refund(order_id, body={refund_amount, refund_id}).

tools.name: Get payment modes
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to filter transactions by payment method but you need the numeric code. Also useful to show what payment methods are available.
Retrieve the merchant's available payment method codes.
NEXT: Use the returned code in search_transactions(paymentCode=<code>) to filter by payment method.

Returns:
    Mapping of payment method display names to numeric codes

tools.name: Get payments for an order
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to see all payment attempts made against a specific order.
View all payment details for an order.
NEXT: Call get_payment_by_id(order_id, cf_payment_id) to view details of a specific payment.

tools.name: Get refund
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to check the status of a specific refund.
Fetch a specific refund by order_id and refund_id.

tools.name: Get report status
tools.description:
USE WHEN: You need to check if a report is ready for download. Poll this after generate_recon_report or generate_summary_report.
Get report status and details (polling endpoint).
NEXT: If status is DONE, call download_report(reportId). If REQUESTED or IN_PROGRESS, poll again.

tools.name: Get settlement recon routes
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to generate a Flowwise Recon report and you need the gateway route names.
Get settlement recon gateway routes.
NEXT: Use route names in generate_recon_report(reportType='flow_wise_recon_report', pg=<route_name>).

Returns:
    Array of gateway route objects

tools.name: Get standard settlement details
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to track where settlement money is in the banking pipeline.
Get real-time transfer timeline for specific settlements.

tools.name: Get tool guide
tools.description:
USE WHEN: You are about to perform a multi-step task and need to know which tools to call and in what order.
CALL THIS FIRST before starting any complex task. Returns the recommended tool chain for a user's intent.

Describe the user's goal in natural language.
Examples:
  - "search for failed transactions in the last 7 days"
  - "generate a settlement reconciliation report"
  - "create a payment order for 500 INR"
  - "check the status of a refund"
  - "verify a PAN number"
NEXT: Follow the returned step-by-step tool chain to complete the task.

tools.name: Get transaction details
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to see the full details of a specific transaction including timeline, settlement, and gateway response.
View the complete lifecycle of a single transaction.

Returns timeline events, order details, customer details, settlement info,
gateway response, and optionally EMI and OCC charge breakdowns.

tools.name: Get unsettled amount
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks about unsettled balance, money held by Cashfree, or pending settlements.
Get the total unsettled amount held by Cashfree.
NEXT: Call get_on_demand_eligible_funds() to check how much can be withdrawn immediately, or search_standard_settlements() for history.

tools.name: Get vendor settlement details
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to track where vendor settlement money is in the banking pipeline.
Get real-time transfer timeline for specific vendor (Easy Split) settlements.

tools.name: List reports
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to see previously generated reports or check if a report exists.
List all previously generated reports for this merchant.
NEXT: Call download_report(reportId) to get the download URL for a completed report.

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together, span 31 days
or less, fall within the last 2 years, and not extend into the future. Wider
requests are rejected with HTTP 400 — split them into 31-day chunks. Unlike the
generate_* tools, there is no financial-year option here.

tools.name: Search on demand settlements
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to search past on-demand/instant withdrawal settlements.
Search on-demand (instant withdrawal) settlements.

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together, span 31 days
or less, fall within the last 2 years, and not extend into the future. Wider
requests are rejected with HTTP 400 — split them into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Search orders
tools.description: Search for orders with filters OR fetch a specific order by ID

tools.name: Search product docs
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user asks about Cashfree Developer Documentation product features, API usage, integration guides, or how something works.
Searches Cashfree Developer Documentation product documentation and returns matching help articles with titles, content, and links.
NEXT: Use the returned content to answer the user's question directly.

tools.name: Search standard settlements
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to search settlement history, check settlement status, or find a specific settlement by UTR.
Search standard (scheduled) settlements with filtering and pagination.
NEXT: Call get_standard_settlement_details(settlementIds=<id>) to track a specific settlement through the banking pipeline.

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together, span 31 days
or less, fall within the last 2 years, and not extend into the future. Wider
requests are rejected with HTTP 400 — split them into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Search transactions
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to find, search, filter, or list payment transactions.
Search for payment transactions matching the given filters. This is the primary discovery endpoint.
NEXT: Call get_transaction_details(txId=<refId>, txTime=<txTime>) to view a specific transaction's full lifecycle.

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together, span 31 days
or less, fall within the last 2 years, and not extend into the future. Wider
requests are rejected with HTTP 400 — split them into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Search vendor settlements
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to search vendor split (Easy Split) settlement payouts.
Search vendor split settlement payouts (Easy Split only).
NEXT: Call get_vendor_settlement_details(settlementIds=<id>) to track vendor payouts.

DATE RANGE LIMIT: startDate and endDate must be supplied together, span 31 days
or less, fall within the last 2 years, and not extend into the future. Wider
requests are rejected with HTTP 400 — split them into 31-day chunks.

tools.name: Simulate payment
tools.description:
USE WHEN: The user wants to test/simulate a payment in sandbox mode.
Simulate a payment for testing. Create an order first using create_order.
NEXT: Call fetch_simulation(simulation_id) to check the simulation result.

optional.name: client_id
optional.description: Client id of the app

optional.name: client_secret
optional.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Castingwords
description: CastingWords offers high-quality, human-powered transcription services with a RESTful API for seamless integration into various workflows.

tools.name: Cancel and Refund Audio File
tools.description: Tool to cancel an ordered audio file and issue a refund if applicable. Use when no transcription work has been done on the file (Pre-Processing, Audio Processing, Error states).

tools.name: Get Prepay Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current prepay balance for the account. Use when you need to check available funds before placing new transcription orders.

tools.name: Get Transcript
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the transcript for a given audiofile in the requested format (txt, doc, rtf, or html). Use after a transcription order has been completed.

tools.name: Get registered webhook URL
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the currently registered webhook URL for account notifications. Use when you need to verify your webhook setup.

tools.name: Order Transcript
tools.description: Create a transcription order for audio/video files at publicly accessible URLs. Returns order ID and audiofile IDs for tracking. Requires prepaid balance for non-test orders. Use test=true to validate URLs without charges.

tools.name: Order Upgrades
tools.description: Tool to order an upgrade for a specific audio file. Use after transcription is complete to add items like timestamps or extra editing. Example: 'Order timestamps for file 12345'.

tools.name: Register Webhook
tools.description: Registers a webhook URL to receive CastingWords event notifications. When events occur (e.g., transcript completion, refund issued, difficult audio), CastingWords will POST to your registered URL with event details. Use CASTINGWORDS_GET_WEBHOOK to verify the current webhook, and CASTINGWORDS_TEST_WEBHOOK to test notifications.

tools.name: List Available SKUs
tools.description: Retrieves all available CastingWords transcription service SKUs with pricing. Use this tool to discover available services (transcription, captions, etc.) and their per-minute prices before placing an order. Returns SKU codes needed for order placement.

tools.name: Test Webhook Call
tools.description: Tool to request a test webhook call for a specific event type. Use after registering a webhook URL to ensure webhook notifications are functioning properly.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key required for authenticating requests to the CastingWords API.

name: Cats
description: An API providing access to a vast collection of cat images, breeds, and facts.

tools.name: Create Favourite
tools.description: Tool to save an image as a favourite to your account. Use when you want to mark a cat image as a favourite for later retrieval or filtering by user ID.

tools.name: Create Vote

tools.name: Delete Favourite

tools.name: Delete Image

tools.name: Delete Vote

tools.name: Get Cat Breed by ID
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific cat breed by its ID. Use when you need comprehensive details about a particular breed including temperament, origin, characteristics, and URLs.

tools.name: Get Favourite by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific favourite by its unique ID. Returns full favourite details including user ID, image ID, creation timestamp, and associated image data. Use when you need to fetch a particular favourite's information or verify favourite existence.

tools.name: Get Cat Image by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific cat image by its unique ID. Returns full image details including URL, dimensions, and breed information if available. Use when you need to fetch a particular image's data or verify image existence.

tools.name: Get Image Analysis
tools.description: Get machine learning analysis results for an uploaded image. Returns labels with confidence scores, bounding boxes for detected objects, and content moderation results from ML vendors. Note: GIF images are not supported for analysis.

tools.name: Get Image Breeds
tools.description: Tool to retrieve breed information associated with a specific cat image. Use when you need to identify which breed(s) are shown in a particular image from The Cat API.

tools.name: Get Cat Breeds
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of cat breeds from The Cat API. Returns comprehensive breed information including name, description, temperament, origin, life span, and weight. Use this to browse available cat breeds or search for specific breed information.

tools.name: Get Vote by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific vote by its unique ID from The Cat API. Returns detailed vote information including the image ID, vote value, timestamp, and optional metadata like sub_id and country code. Use this when you need to fetch details about a specific vote.

tools.name: List Image Categories
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all active image categories from The Cat API. Categories include hats, sunglasses, boxes, sinks, and more. Use category IDs when searching or filtering images by category.

tools.name: List Favourites
tools.description: Tool to get all favourites belonging to your account. Use when you need to retrieve saved cat images, optionally filtered by sub_id. Supports pagination to browse through large collections of favourites.

tools.name: List Uploaded Images
tools.description: Tool to get all images uploaded to your account via /images/upload. Supports pagination and filtering by sub_id or original filename. Use this to retrieve your uploaded images, check if a file already exists, or filter by user identifiers. The API returns images in order of upload date.

tools.name: List Votes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all votes you have created. Returns a paginated list of votes with image IDs, vote values, and metadata. Use this to view voting history, filter by user segment (sub_id), or analyze vote patterns.

tools.name: Search Cat Breeds
tools.description: Search for cat breeds by name. Use the 'q' parameter with part or all of the breed name to find matching breeds. Returns breed details including temperament, origin, and characteristics.

tools.name: Search Cat Images
tools.description: Search for random cat images with optional filters. Filter by breed availability, size, and file type. Returns an array of image objects with URLs and metadata. Use this to find cat images for display, testing, or content generation. The default behavior returns 1 random cat image.
