name: CertSeal
description: CertSeal provides APIs for issuing and managing verifiable digital certificates, recipients, batches, designs, and webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: Create Batch
tools.description: Create a persistent certificate batch from an existing CertSeal design and optional email template. This consumes a batch slot and can fail when the plan batch limit is reached; designs and templates must already exist and are not created by this tool.

tools.name: Create Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Create a persistent webhook subscription for selected certificate events. The response contains a wh_sec_ signing secret exactly once; capture it immediately and store it securely because later reads reveal only its tail. The workspace allows at most 20 subscriptions.

tools.name: Delete Recipient
tools.description: Permanently delete an issued recipient from an active batch. This cannot be undone, does not refund certificate quota, and permanently burns the certificate ID. Use only when permanent removal is intended.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Permanently delete a webhook subscription and stop future deliveries. This cannot be undone; create a new subscription to resume events.

tools.name: Get Batch
tools.description: Get one active or archived certificate batch by ID.

tools.name: Get Certificate
tools.description: Look up an issued certificate using either its human-readable certificate ID or its public-viewer share token, and return its recipient, batch, design, and resolved variables. Provide exactly one lookup value.

tools.name: Get Current Workspace
tools.description: Verify the connected CertSeal API key and return the workspace ID and username it belongs to. Use this to confirm account context before creating or changing resources.

tools.name: Get Recipient
tools.description: Get one issued certificate recipient record by batch ID and recipient ID.

tools.name: Get Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Get one webhook subscription by ID. This does not reveal the signing secret; it returns only the stored secret tail.

tools.name: Issue and Send Certificates
tools.description: Atomically issue certificates for 1-100 recipients and queue email delivery for every created certificate. This irreversible external side effect requires every recipient to have an email address and the active batch to have an email template and configured mail delivery. Each recipient permanently consumes one certificate quota unit.

tools.name: Issue Certificates
tools.description: Atomically issue certificates without sending email for 1-100 recipients in one active batch. Each recipient permanently consumes one certificate quota unit even if later deleted; any invalid row, duplicate certificate ID, or quota failure creates none.

tools.name: List Batches
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of certificate batches in the connected workspace, optionally filtered by archive state.

tools.name: List Designs
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of reusable certificate designs. Designs are read-only through the API and must be authored in the CertSeal web app.

tools.name: List Recipients
tools.description: Return one page of issued certificate recipients in a batch, optionally filtered by email delivery status.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of webhook subscriptions. Stored signing secrets are never returned; secret_tail is only a non-sensitive identifier.

tools.name: Rotate Webhook Signing Secret
tools.description: Immediately invalidate a webhook subscription's current signing secret and replace it. The new wh_sec_ secret is returned exactly once; capture and deploy it immediately or webhook verification will fail.

tools.name: Send Certificate Emails
tools.description: Sequentially queue real certificate emails for 1-25 existing recipients in one active batch. Each queued email is irreversible. Processing stops after the first failed or unknown attempt, and remaining recipients are marked not_attempted.

tools.name: Send Recipient Certificate Email
tools.description: Queue asynchronous certificate email delivery to one recipient. This causes an external email side effect and requires a recipient email, a batch email template, and configured mail delivery; already queued or in-flight recipients and archived batches are rejected.

tools.name: Set Batch Archived State
tools.description: Idempotently archive or unarchive a batch. Archiving freezes recipient create, update, delete, and send operations but preserves existing certificate URLs; unarchiving re-enables those writes. This persistent change is reversible.

tools.name: Test Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Enqueue one synthetic signed event through CertSeal's normal webhook dispatcher. This causes a real external delivery to the subscription URL; it does not only validate the subscription locally.

tools.name: Update Recipient
tools.description: Partially update an issued certificate recipient. Only supplied fields change, while an explicit null clears an optional field; changing certificate_id must remain globally unique. Archived batches reject this mutation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a workspace API key from Settings > API Keys in the CertSeal web app. Copy the csk_live_ value when it is shown because CertSeal displays it only once. REST API access requires a Starter or higher plan.

name: Chameleon
description: Chameleon is a product adoption platform for building in-app experiences, managing customer data, and analyzing user engagement.

tools.name: Count Customer Records
tools.description: Count Chameleon profiles or companies matching structured filters without retrieving the matching records.

tools.name: Get Account Identity
tools.description: Return the Chameleon account ID and admin user ID associated with the connected Account Secret.

tools.name: Get Delivery
tools.description: Retrieve one Chameleon experience delivery by ID without triggering, changing, or cancelling it.

tools.name: Get Experience
tools.description: Retrieve one Chameleon tour, microsurvey, launcher, embed, or tooltip by ID without modifying or publishing it.

tools.name: List Changes
tools.description: List one page of Chameleon change history across the account or for one supported experience.

tools.name: List Deliveries
tools.description: List one page of scheduled Chameleon experience deliveries, optionally filtered by experience or profile, without triggering a new delivery.

tools.name: List Domains or Environments
tools.description: List one page of configured Chameleon domains or environments without changing account routing configuration.

tools.name: List Experience Analytics
tools.description: List one page of tour interactions or microsurvey responses for a specific Chameleon experience.

tools.name: List Experiences
tools.description: List one page of Chameleon tours, microsurveys, launchers, embeds, or tooltips without modifying or publishing them.

tools.name: List Targeting Metadata
tools.description: List one page of Chameleon segments, tags, themes, tracked event names, or profile/company property definitions used to interpret targeting and analytics data.

tools.name: Lookup Customer Record
tools.description: Retrieve one Chameleon profile or company by its Chameleon ID or external identifier. Profiles can also be looked up by email address; provide exactly one identifier.

tools.name: Search Customer Records
tools.description: Search Chameleon profiles or companies with structured filters and return one offset-paginated page of matching records.

tools.name: Track Event
tools.description: Irreversibly record one named event for a Chameleon profile identified by ID or external UID; provide exactly one identifier. The event cannot be deleted, and a new event name also creates a persistent event-name definition that cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Upsert Customer Record
tools.description: Create or update one Chameleon profile or company by external UID and return its Chameleon ID.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate an API Secret in Chameleon at Settings > Tokens (https://app.chameleon.io/settings/tokens). Chameleon only allows the secret to be downloaded once. Use the API Secret, not the public Account Token used by the browser SDK.

name: Charla
description: Charla is a live chat and AI customer-support platform whose public API manages property contacts, conversation exports, and knowledge base articles and categories.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Create a knowledge base article. Charla generates its URL slug from the title and may use it for chatbot training according to the property's AI settings. Defaults to a private draft.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Permanently delete one knowledge base article by ID. This cannot be undone, and deleting an already-missing article fails.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Return one contact in the connected Charla property by UUID.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Return the full content and metadata of one knowledge base article by ID.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Return one page of contacts for the connected Charla property, ordered by most recently modified.

tools.name: List Conversations
tools.description: Export one page of conversations grouped by contact for the connected Charla property, including message history.

tools.name: List Knowledge Base Articles
tools.description: Return one page of knowledge base article summaries for the connected Charla property, newest first.

tools.name: List Knowledge Base Categories
tools.description: Return all knowledge base categories available in the connected Charla property.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Replace every writable field of an existing knowledge base article. Charla regenerates the URL slug from the replacement title and may retrain chatbot content according to the property's AI settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key for the Charla property you want to connect. In Charla, open that property's settings, select the Integration tab, and copy its API key. Each property has a separate key, so connect each property separately.

name: Chartly
description: Chartly renders Chart.js configurations as PNG or SVG images and creates permanent chart URLs for sharing and embedding.

tools.name: Create Permanent Chart
tools.description: Create a permanent Chartly URL from a Chart.js configuration. This creates an undeletable resource because Chartly provides no delete endpoint.

tools.name: Get Permanent Chart
tools.description: Download the PNG or SVG image for an existing permanent Chartly chart ID.

tools.name: Render Chart
tools.description: Render a Chart.js configuration as a PNG or SVG downloadable image without creating a permanent Chartly URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Chartly trial or production API key. For a production key, sign in at https://chartly.dev, open the Dashboard, and create or copy a key from the API keys section. For testing, obtain a trial key from the Chartly homepage. Keep this value secret.

name: ChartMogul
description: ChartMogul is a subscription analytics and revenue data platform for managing customers, billing data, metrics, and sales opportunities.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a customer under a ChartMogul data source using a caller-owned external ID and optional profile or lead details.

tools.name: Delete Customer
tools.description: Request permanent deletion of a customer and all associated ChartMogul data by UUID. ChartMogul accepts this asynchronously, so confirm disappearance with LIST_CUSTOMERS when completion matters.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the connected ChartMogul account's identity, reporting currency, time zone, week start, and optionally selected churn and refund settings.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Return one customer and its identifiers, lifecycle status, revenue values, ownership, location, and attributes by ChartMogul UUID.

tools.name: Get Key Metrics
tools.description: Return all key subscription metrics and current summaries for a date range, optionally grouped by interval and filtered by countries or plans.

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: Return one page of ChartMogul MRR activities for an optional date range, movement type, and date order, with a cursor when more are available.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Return one page of customers filtered by source, identifier, email, status, or billing system.

tools.name: List Plans
tools.description: Return one page of subscription plans, optionally filtered by source, external ID, or billing system.

tools.name: List Sources
tools.description: Return the account's billing data sources, optionally filtered by name or system and with selected source settings included.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Update selected profile, ownership, location, timing, website, or lead-status fields on an existing ChartMogul customer. Omitted fields remain unchanged; tags and custom attributes are not replaced.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a separate integration key in ChartMogul under Profile > View Profile > API Keys: click Add API Key, give it a name, select the Read & Write access level, create it, then reveal and copy the key. Staff, Admin, or Owner roles can create a Read & Write key; keep it secret.

name: Chaser
description: Chaser is an accounts receivable automation software that helps businesses automate invoice reminders and get paid faster.

tools.name: Create Contact Person
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact person for a customer in Chaser. Requires customer_id and external_id. Use when adding additional contacts to an existing customer account.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice record in the organization. Use after ensuring the customer exists in Chaser.

tools.name: Create Overpayment
tools.description: Creates a new overpayment record in Chaser for tracking customer overpayments. Overpayments represent amounts paid by customers in excess of invoice amounts and can be used to offset future invoices. The customer must exist in Chaser before creating an overpayment (use POST /customers first if needed). Valid statuses: DRAFT, SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, PAID, VOIDED, DELETED.

tools.name: Delete Contact Person
tools.description: Tool to delete a contact person from a customer record in Chaser. Use this when you need to remove a specific contact person associated with a customer. Requires both the customer identifier and the contact person identifier.

tools.name: Get Contact Person by ID
tools.description: Tool to get a specific contact person by ID for a customer. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a contact person associated with a customer in Chaser.

tools.name: Get Credit Note by ID
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific credit note by its ID. Accepts both internal Chaser IDs and external credit note IDs (with 'ext_' prefix). Use when you need to fetch complete details of a single credit note.

tools.name: Get Credit Notes
tools.description: Retrieves a list of credit notes from Chaser. Supports filtering by customer, status, and date range. Returns all credit notes if no filters are specified.

tools.name: Get Current Organisation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the current organisation associated with the API credentials. Use when you need the organisation ID, currency, timezone, or legal details for the authenticated account.

tools.name: Get Customer by ID
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific customer by their Chaser customer ID. Use this after obtaining the customer_id from listing customers or creating a customer. The customer_id is the internal Chaser identifier (e.g., 'cust_abc123'), not the external_id from your source system.

tools.name: Get Customers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all customers associated with the organization. Use when you need to display or process complete customer contact and status information.

tools.name: Get Invoice by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific invoice by its ID. Use when you need to view invoice details, payment status, or associated customer information.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the connected organizations. Use when you need organization IDs, currency, timezone, or legal details before other operations.

tools.name: Get Overpayment
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific overpayment by its ID. Use when you need to fetch overpayment details, check remaining credit, or verify overpayment status. Both internal ID (e.g., op_XXX) and external ID with 'ext_' prefix are supported.

tools.name: Get Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of the Chaser API. Use when you need to verify if the API is operational before making other requests.

tools.name: List Contact Persons
tools.description: Tool to retrieve contact persons for a specific customer. Returns a paginated list of contact persons with their details. Use when you need to get contact information for a customer's representatives.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve invoices with pagination and filtering. Use when you need to fetch invoice records from Chaser with support for various filter criteria including status, amounts, dates, and customer information.

tools.name: List Overpayments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve overpayments from Chaser with pagination and filtering. Use when you need to list overpayments, check remaining credits, or filter by customer, amount, currency, or date.

tools.name: Create Credit Note
tools.description: Creates a new credit note record in Chaser for tracking customer credits. Credit notes represent amounts owed to customers and are used to reduce outstanding invoices. The customer must exist in Chaser before creating a credit note (use POST /customers first). Note: ACTIVE is not a valid status for creating credit notes via API. Valid statuses: SUBMITTED, AUTHORISED, PAID, VOIDED, DELETED.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer record in Chaser. Use after obtaining Basic Auth credentials.

tools.name: Update Credit Note
tools.description: Update an existing credit note in Chaser. All fields are optional. Use this to modify credit note details such as amount, status, or customer association.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Tool to update an existing customer's information using their unique Chaser customer ID. Use after confirming the customer's ID (the 'id' field, not 'externalID'). Example: "Update contactEmailAddress for customer ID cust_abc123."

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Update an existing invoice in Chaser by its internal ID. Use this to modify invoice status, amounts, dates, payments, or customer associations. Requires the internal Chaser invoice ID (e.g., 'inv_abc123') from invoice creation or retrieval responses.

tools.name: Update Contact Person
tools.description: Tool to update a contact person for a customer in Chaser. Use when you need to modify contact person details such as name, email, or phone numbers.

tools.name: Update Overpayment
tools.description: Tool to update an overpayment record in Chaser. Use when modifying overpayment details such as remaining credit, status, or other fields. All fields except overpayment_id are optional.

tools.name: Upload Invoice PDF
tools.description: Upload a PDF file to an existing invoice in Chaser. Use this to attach invoice documentation. The file must be a valid PDF document and is sent as multipart/form-data.

tools.name: Bulk Upsert Customers
tools.description: Tool to bulk upsert up to 100 customers in a single operation. Customers are matched by external_id (or id) for updates. Use when you need to create or update multiple customers efficiently.

tools.name: Bulk Upsert Contact Persons
tools.description: Tool to bulk insert or update contact persons for a customer. Use when you need to create or update multiple contact persons in a single request (up to 100). Matching is done by external_id - existing contacts with the same external_id will be updated, new ones will be inserted.

tools.name: Bulk Upsert Credit Notes
tools.description: Tool to bulk upsert up to 100 credit notes in a single request. Matches by credit_note_id (or id). Use when you need to create or update multiple credit notes efficiently in Chaser.

tools.name: Bulk Upsert Invoices
tools.description: Tool to bulk upsert up to 100 invoices in a single request. Invoices are matched by invoice_id for updates or created if not found. Use when you need to create or update multiple invoices efficiently.

tools.name: Bulk Upsert Overpayments
tools.description: Tool to bulk upsert up to 100 overpayments in Chaser, matching by overpayment_id. Use when you need to create or update multiple overpayment records in a single operation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by Chaser for authentication.

required.name: generic_secret
required.description: The API secret provided by Chaser for authentication.

name: Chatbotkit
description: ChatBotKit is a platform that enables developers to build and manage AI-powered chatbots, offering comprehensive APIs and SDKs for seamless integration into applications.

tools.name: Attach Dataset File
tools.description: Tool to attach a file to a dataset as a source. Use when you need to link a specific file to a dataset to provide knowledge content.

tools.name: Authenticate Secret
tools.description: Tool to authenticate a secret by its ID. Use when you need to generate an authentication URL for a specific secret.

tools.name: Clone Blueprint
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing blueprint. Use when you need to create a duplicate of a blueprint with all its associated resources.

tools.name: Clone Bot
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing bot. Use when you need to create a duplicate copy of a bot with all its settings and configurations.

tools.name: Clone Platform Example
tools.description: Tool to clone a platform example. Use when you need to create instances of all resources defined in a platform example template.

tools.name: Clone Widget Integration
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing widget integration. Use when you need to duplicate a widget integration while preserving its tested configurations.

tools.name: Complete Conversation
tools.description: Send a message to a ChatBotKit conversation and receive the bot's AI-generated reply. This is the primary action for interacting with a chatbot. It sends user text to an existing conversation and returns the bot's response along with token usage statistics. Prerequisites: - A valid conversation_id (obtain from list_conversations or create_conversation action) - The conversation should have a bot assigned for meaningful responses Returns the AI's reply text, message ID, token usage, and completion reason.

tools.name: Create Blueprint
tools.description: Tool to create a new blueprint in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to create a reusable template or configuration blueprint.

tools.name: Create Blueprint (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new blueprint template via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to create a reusable bot configuration template via the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Create Bot
tools.description: Tool to create a new AI bot with configurable settings. Use when you need to create a new chatbot with specific name, personality, model, and connected resources like datasets or skillsets.

tools.name: Create Bot (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new bot using GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to create a bot with specified name, description, and other configuration via the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Create Bot Session
tools.description: Creates a new bot session with an associated conversation and authentication token. Use this when you need to start a new chat session with a bot, optionally with pre-populated messages.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact. Use when you need to track users interacting with bots. Contacts can have associated memories, secrets, and conversations.

tools.name: Create Conversation
tools.description: Tool to create a new conversation. Use when you need to start a new chat session with a bot. Conversations store message history between users and bots. You can either reference an existing bot by ID or configure a new bot inline.

tools.name: Create conversation message
tools.description: Tool to create a new message in an existing conversation. Use this to add user messages, bot messages, or other message types to a conversation.

tools.name: Create conversation message batch
tools.description: Tool to create multiple messages in a conversation in a single batch operation. Use this when you need to add multiple messages at once, which is more efficient than creating them individually.

tools.name: Create Conversation Session
tools.description: Tool to create a new conversation session with an authentication token. Use when you need to generate a temporary access token for a conversation.

tools.name: Create Dataset (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new dataset using GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to create a dataset to store knowledge and information for bots.

tools.name: Create Dataset Record
tools.description: Tool to create a new record in a dataset. Use when you need to add text data to an existing dataset for knowledge retrieval by bots.

tools.name: Create Discord Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Discord integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Discord by providing Discord Application ID, Bot Token, and Public Key.

tools.name: Create Email Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a new email integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Email integrations enable your bot to receive and respond to emails, making it accessible through email communication channels. Use when you need to connect a bot to handle email-based conversations.

tools.name: Create Extract Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a new Extract integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Extract integrations enable your chatbot to automatically pull and extract structured data from conversations based on a predefined JSON schema. Use when you need to capture specific information from user interactions and optionally send it to a webhook endpoint.

tools.name: Create File
tools.description: Tool to create a new file resource in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to create a file that can be attached to datasets for processing and indexing. Note: This creates the file record; use the upload action to add actual file content.

tools.name: Create Instagram Integration
tools.description: Tool to create an Instagram integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Instagram by providing an Instagram access token.

tools.name: Create Support Integration
tools.description: Creates a new support integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Support integrations enable your chatbot to handle customer support inquiries and optionally forward conversation summaries to a specified email address. Use this when you need to connect a bot to your customer support workflow.

tools.name: Create MCP Server Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a new MCP Server integration for ChatBotKit. Use when you need to set up an MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server integration to extend bot capabilities with custom server-side functionality.

tools.name: Create Memory
tools.description: Tool to create a new memory entry. Use when you need to store information for later retrieval, such as user preferences, conversation context, or important facts associated with a bot or contact.

tools.name: Create Messenger Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Facebook Messenger integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Facebook Messenger by providing a Facebook Page Access Token.

tools.name: Create Notion Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Notion integration for a ChatBotKit dataset. Use when you need to connect a dataset to Notion for syncing content between Notion pages and ChatBotKit.

tools.name: Create Rating
tools.description: Tool to create a rating in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to submit a numeric rating value for tracking purposes.

tools.name: Create Secret
tools.description: Tool to create a new secret in ChatBotKit. Secrets store credentials that bots use to access external services via skillset abilities. Use when you need to securely store API keys, tokens, or other authentication credentials.

tools.name: Create Secret (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to create a new secret via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to securely store credentials, API keys, or authentication tokens via the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Create Sitemap Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a sitemap integration for a ChatBotKit dataset. Sitemap integrations automatically crawl and index website content from a sitemap.xml file, keeping your dataset synchronized with your website content. Use when you need to import or sync website content into a dataset for bot knowledge.

tools.name: Create Skillset
tools.description: Tool to create a new skillset. Use when you need to group multiple skills into a single reusable unit.

tools.name: Create Slack Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Slack integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Slack by providing signing secret and bot token from Slack Developer Portal.

tools.name: Create Space
tools.description: Tool to create a new space in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to create a workspace or organizational container for related resources.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new background task that can be triggered to perform automated operations. Use when you need to set up scheduled or on-demand tasks with configurable bot and contact associations.

tools.name: Create Telegram Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Telegram integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Telegram by providing a Telegram bot token from BotFather.

tools.name: Create Trigger Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Trigger integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to set up automated triggers that can process events and execute bot actions on a schedule or based on specific conditions.

tools.name: Create Twilio Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Twilio integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to connect a bot to Twilio for SMS or messaging capabilities. All parameters are optional.

tools.name: Create WhatsApp Integration
tools.description: Creates a new WhatsApp integration for a ChatBotKit bot. WhatsApp integrations enable your chatbot to communicate with users through WhatsApp messaging. Use this when you need to connect a bot to WhatsApp Business API for customer engagement.

tools.name: Create Widget Integration
tools.description: Tool to create a Widget integration for a ChatBotKit bot. Use when you need to create a web widget that can be embedded on websites to enable conversations with a bot.

tools.name: Create Widget Integration Session
tools.description: Creates a new widget integration session for interactive chat. Use this when you need to initialize a widget chat session with optional contact information, initial messages, and custom session duration.

tools.name: Delete Blueprint
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a blueprint from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a blueprint and optionally its associated resources.

tools.name: Delete Blueprint (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a blueprint template via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to remove a blueprint from the platform using the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Delete Bot
tools.description: Tool to delete a bot. Use when you need to permanently remove a bot from the system.

tools.name: Delete Bot (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to delete a bot via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to permanently remove a bot from the system using the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a contact from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a contact from the system.

tools.name: Delete Conversation
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a conversation from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a conversation and all its associated messages.

tools.name: Delete Conversation Message
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a message from a conversation in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a specific message from a conversation.

tools.name: Delete Dataset
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a dataset from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a dataset and all its associated data.

tools.name: Delete Dataset (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to delete a dataset via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to permanently remove a dataset and all its associated records using the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Delete Dataset Record
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a record from a dataset. Use when you need to remove a specific record from a ChatBotKit dataset.

tools.name: Delete Discord Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete a Discord integration. Use when you need to permanently remove a Discord integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Email Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete an Email integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove an Email integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Extract Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete an Extract integration. Use when you need to permanently remove an Extract integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a file from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a file from the system.

tools.name: Delete Instagram Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete an Instagram integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove an Instagram integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Integration (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to delete an integration via GraphQL mutation. Use when you need to permanently remove an integration from the system using the GraphQL API.

tools.name: Delete MCP Server Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete an MCP Server integration. Use when you need to permanently remove an MCP Server integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Memory
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a memory from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a memory from the system.

tools.name: Delete Messenger Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Messenger integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a Messenger integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Notion Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Notion integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a Notion integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Partner User
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a partner user account. Use when you need to clean up test or inactive accounts.

tools.name: Delete Rating
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a rating from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a rating from the system.

tools.name: Delete Secret
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a secret from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a secret from the system.

tools.name: Delete Sitemap Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Sitemap integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a Sitemap integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Skillset
tools.description: Tool to delete a skillset. Use when you need to permanently remove a skillset from the system.

tools.name: Delete Skillset Ability
tools.description: Tool to delete an ability from a skillset. Use when you need to remove a specific ability from a skillset.

tools.name: Delete Slack Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete a Slack integration. Use when you need to permanently remove a Slack integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Space
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a space from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a space from the system.

tools.name: Delete Support Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete a Support integration. Use when you need to permanently remove a Support integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a task from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a task from the system.

tools.name: Delete Telegram Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Telegram integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a Telegram integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Trigger Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Trigger integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a Trigger integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Twilio Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete a Twilio integration. Use when you need to permanently remove a Twilio integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete WhatsApp Integration
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a WhatsApp integration from ChatBotKit. Use when you need to remove a WhatsApp integration from the system.

tools.name: Delete Widget Integration
tools.description: Tool to delete a Widget integration. Use when you need to permanently remove a Widget integration from the system.

tools.name: Detach Dataset File
tools.description: Tool to detach a file from a dataset. Use when you need to remove a file's association with a dataset, optionally deleting its records.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download a file by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve a file's content from ChatBotKit.

tools.name: Downvote Bot
tools.description: Tool to downvote a bot in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to register negative feedback on a bot's performance or quality.

tools.name: Downvote Conversation
tools.description: Tool to downvote a conversation in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to register negative feedback on a conversation's quality or outcome.

tools.name: Downvote Conversation Message
tools.description: Tool to downvote a conversation message in ChatBotKit. Use when you need to register negative feedback on a message's quality or appropriateness.

tools.name: Ensure Contact
tools.description: Tool to ensure a contact exists or create a new one. Use when you need to create or retrieve a contact by fingerprint, ensuring idempotent contact management.

tools.name: Execute GraphQL Query
tools.description: Tool to execute a GraphQL query or mutation against the ChatBotKit API. Use when you need to run custom GraphQL queries to retrieve or modify data in flexible ways not covered by other actions.

tools.name: Export Contacts
tools.description: Tool to export contacts with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve or export contact information from ChatBotKit.

tools.name: Export Conversations
tools.description: Tool to export conversations with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve and export conversation data in bulk for analysis, backup, or migration purposes.

tools.name: Export Dataset Records

tools.description: Mark a Checkvist checklist for deletion. This destructive operation affects the checklist and all data it contains.

name: Circleback MCP
description: Circleback MCP lets agents search authorized meetings, transcripts, action items, calendar events, emails, people, companies, and support documentation.

tools.name: Findcompanies
tools.description:
Find companies matching the given search terms.
      Searches match company names and company domains.
      The data returned will be an array of objects with each company's domain and name when available.

tools.name: Findprofiles
tools.description:
Find profiles matching the given names.
      The data returned will be an array of objects representing each of the matching profiles.

tools.name: Gettranscriptsformeetings
tools.description:
Get the full transcripts for given meeting IDs.
       Use string IDs like Vd6Pz_kWqLm3xY-c8RhTn.
       The data returned will be an array of objects, each representing a full transcript for a meeting.
       Each transcript object will contain the meetingId, meetingName, and an array of transcript segments.
       Each segment is formatted with timestamps like: {startTimestamp: 123.45, endTimestamp: 128.00, speaker: 'John Doe', words: 'This is a test.'}
       This should be used to get detailed transcript information for one or many meetings at once.

tools.name: Listtags
tools.description: List all tags available in the user's workspace. Returns an array of tag objects with their IDs and names. Use this to discover available tags before filtering meetings, transcripts, or action items by tag.

tools.name: Readmeetings
tools.description:
Given up to 50 meeting IDs, fetch detailed information for each meeting.
      Use string IDs like Vd6Pz_kWqLm3xY-c8RhTn.
      The data returned will be an array of objects, with each containing the meeting ID, name, notes, attendees, action items, AI-generated insights, creator, tags, status, duration, and creation date.

tools.name: Searchactionitems
tools.description:
Find action items that match a given search term or filter. Returns action items with their title, description, status, assignee, and related meeting details.
       By default, only action items assigned to the user are returned. To find action items assigned to someone else, use FindProfiles to resolve their name to a profile ID and pass it as assigneeProfileId.
       Action items can be filtered by search terms, status (PENDING or DONE), tags, and meeting date range (startDate/endDate).
       Only 25 action items are returned per page, so this function may need to be called multiple times if there are more than that many results.
      If 25 action items are returned, call this function again with the next pageIndex to ensure you get all results.

tools.name: Searchcalendarevents
tools.description:
Get calendar events from the user's connected calendars.
       When searching for calendar events, the tool will extract relevant excerpts based on the intent instead of returning the entire data.
       Each calendar event excerpt includes comprehensive details: event title, date (in the user's timezone), organizer email, attendees (with names, emails, and status), calendar description (if present), meeting platform (Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, etc.), meeting platform link, whether it's a recurring event, Circleback join status, and any associated meeting data from the Circleback (meeting ID, status, tag IDs, user notes).
       You can filter events by providing a date range using startDate and endDate parameters.
       This is useful for finding upcoming meetings, scheduled calls, or calendar events that the user has.
       Note: This should be primarily used for searching calendar events happening in the future. Past calendar events have a meeting record if they were captured with Circleback. The only reason to use this to search past calendar events is if searching for the meeting with SearchMeetings yielded no relevant results.
      Only 50 calendar events are returned per page, so this function may need to be called multiple times if there are more than that many results.
      If 50 events are returned, call this function again with the next pageIndex to ensure you get all results.

tools.name: Searchemails
tools.description:
Search the user's connected email accounts for email threads matching a query. This should be used when the user asks questions about their emails or needs to find specific email conversations.
       This function queries across all connected email services and retrieves up to 20 matching email threads per service per page.
       The data returned will be an array of objects, with each containing the email thread ID, subject line, and relevant excerpts.
       Each email thread object includes metadata such as the sender email, received date, and the fromEmailAddress of the connected account the thread belongs to (if available).
       Only 20 email threads are returned per page, so this function may need to be called multiple times if there are more than that many results.

tools.name: Searchmeetings
tools.description:
Find meetings that match a given search term or filter.

      Searches can be done by direct match on the meeting name or notes.
      Search term is a direct match ignoring case, prefer to search for a single word or phrase if provided.
      Searches can also be performed for tags or related profiles (attendees of the meetings).
      When searching for a meeting, the tool will find the appropriate meeting and extract the relevant source excerpt based on the intent instead of returning the entire data.
      NOTE: A search term is not explicitly required, for example if you want to find all meetings with a specific tag in a date range, only include those and don't pass a searchTerm.
      To restrict the search further, you can provide a start and end date. This will significantly improve performance.
      The data returned will be an an array of objects, with each containing meeting data.
      Only 20 meetings are returned per page, so this function may need to be called multiple times if there are more than that many results.
      If 20 meetings are returned, call this function again with the next pageIndex to ensure you get all results.
      IMPORTANT: The pageIndex is only valid for the exact same search parameters (aside from pageIndex).
      For example, if you provide a start / end date to fetch page 0, then you must provide the EXACT SAME start / end dates to fetch page 1.

tools.name: Searchsupportarticles
tools.description: Search for support articles about Circleback to find relevant documentation and help content.

tools.name: Searchtranscripts
tools.description:
Search meeting transcripts to find transcript chunks that match a given search term.

       If the user's question requires searching for multiple distinct search terms, you should call this function multiple times.
       The data returned will be an an array of objects, with each containing the meeting ID, name, creator user ID, when it was created, the chunk matching the search term, and the start and end timestamps of the matching chunk.
       Search results can be further filtered by including tags, profiles (attendees), or domains.
       This function is useful to find relevant meetings where a search term was mentioned. We can find more details about those meetings using the ReadMeetings tool.

name: CircleCI
description: CircleCI is a continuous integration and delivery platform that automates build, test, and deployment pipelines for software development.

tools.name: Create Context
tools.description: Tool to create a new context in CircleCI. Contexts are used to secure and share environment variables across projects. Use this when you need to set up a new environment configuration for your CircleCI workflows.

tools.name: Create Context (GraphQL)

tools.name: Create Context Restriction
tools.description: Tool to create a context restriction in CircleCI. Use when you need to limit context access based on project, expression rules, or group membership.

tools.name: Create Organization Orb Allowlist
tools.description: Tool to create a new URL Orb allow-list entry for an organization. Use when you need to allow URL-based orb references from specific URL prefixes in CircleCI pipelines for an organization.

tools.name: Create Organization Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project within a CircleCI organization. Use when you need to programmatically set up a new project for CI/CD automation.

tools.name: Create Organization Group
tools.description: Tool to create a group in an organization. Use when you need to organize users within a CircleCI organization by creating logical groups.

tools.name: Create Project Environment Variable

tools.name: Delete Context (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to delete a CircleCI context by its UUID using GraphQL API. Use when you need to permanently remove a context from your CircleCI organization. This action is irreversible and will delete all environment variables associated with the context.

tools.name: Delete Context Restriction
tools.description: Tool to delete a context restriction by its ID. Use when you need to remove a specific restriction from a CircleCI context.

tools.name: Delete Namespace and Related Orbs
tools.description: Tool to delete a CircleCI registry namespace and all its associated orbs. Use when you need to permanently remove a namespace from the registry. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Namespace Alias
tools.description: Tool to remove a namespace alias by name in CircleCI. Use when you need to delete an existing namespace alias that is no longer needed. The mutation returns a boolean indicating success and any errors that occurred during deletion.

tools.name: Delete Organization Orb Allowlist Entry
tools.description: Tool to remove an entry from the organization's URL orb allow-list. Use when you need to revoke access to a previously allowed orb URL.

tools.name: Delete Organization Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a group from a CircleCI organization. Use when you need to remove a group permanently from the organization.

tools.name: Delete Project

tools.name: Delete Project Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to delete an environment variable from a CircleCI project. Use when you need to remove an existing environment variable by name.

tools.name: Get Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a context by its unique ID. Use when you need details about a specific CircleCI context.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need details about the signed-in user's profile, permissions, and account settings.

tools.name: Get Flaky Tests
tools.description: Tool to get flaky tests for a project. Use when you need to identify tests that passed and failed in the same commit. Branch-agnostic insights help improve test reliability.

tools.description: Retrieves artifacts (output files like test results, logs, build binaries, reports) produced by a CircleCI job. Use this when you need to access files generated during a job's execution, such as test reports, coverage data, compiled binaries, or deployment artifacts. Returns download URLs for each artifact. Note: Jobs may produce zero artifacts if none were explicitly stored using 'store_artifacts' in the config.

tools.name: Get Job Details

tools.name: Get Orb Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific CircleCI orb version via GraphQL. Use when you need orb source code, version history, usage statistics, or metadata for a specific orb version.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organization details from CircleCI using GraphQL query. Use when you need organization information by ID or by name and VCS type.

tools.name: Get Organization Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a group in an organization. Use when you need to get details about a specific group within a CircleCI organization.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Config
tools.description: Tool to fetch pipeline configuration by ID. Use when you need the source or compiled YAML of a specific pipeline.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Definition
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a pipeline definition by project and definition ID. Use when you need details about a specific pipeline definition's configuration, sources, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a CircleCI project by its slug. Use when you need project details such as organization info, project ID, or VCS configuration.

tools.name: Get Test Metadata
tools.description: Tool to fetch test metadata for a specific job. Use when you need detailed test results, run times, and failure messages after a job completes.

tools.name: Get Usage Export Job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a usage export job by organization ID and job ID. Use when you need to check the status or download URLs of a usage export job.

tools.name: Get User Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a CircleCI user by their unique ID. Use when you need user profile details after obtaining the user ID.

tools.name: Get Workflow Summary
