tools.description: Render one Clio bill as HTML, cap the response at 2 MB, and offload it as a file instead of returning active HTML inline. This does not change or send the bill. Requires Billing read permission.

tools.name: Save Activity
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_ACTIVITY when activity_id is omitted and UPDATE_ACTIVITY when it is provided. Preserves the combined Clio time-or-expense create/update behavior. Requires Activities write permission.

tools.name: Save Calendar
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_CALENDAR when calendar_id is omitted and UPDATE_CALENDAR when it is provided. Preserves custom-calendar creation and ETag-safe updates. Requires Calendars write permission.

tools.name: Save Calendar Entry
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_CALENDAR_ENTRY when calendar_entry_id is omitted and UPDATE_CALENDAR_ENTRY when it is provided. Contact attendees are unsupported because Clio always emails them, so updates fail closed when any already exist. Recurring updates require occurrence or series scope; future-series updates are unsupported. Calendar notifications are disabled. Requires Clio's Calendars write permission.

tools.name: Save Contact
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_CONTACT when contact_id is omitted and UPDATE_CONTACT when it is provided. Person writes intentionally use first_name/last_name because live Clio rejects the OpenAPI-documented name field for Person. Nested records can be irreversibly deleted.

tools.name: Save Matter
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_MATTER when matter_id is omitted and UPDATE_MATTER when it is provided. Preserves combined matter create/update behavior. Requires Clio's Matters write permission.

tools.name: Save Task
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility action. Use CREATE_TASK when task_id is omitted and UPDATE_TASK when it is provided. Assignee notifications are disabled on creation and reassignment; completion notifications are disabled and verified before a complete status transition. Requires Clio's Tasks write permission.

tools.name: Search Activities
tools.description: Search and filter Clio activities, including multiple activity IDs, one page at a time. Use Get Activity for one known ID and full billing details. Requires Activities read permission in the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Search Calendar Entries
tools.description: Search Clio calendar entries by time window, text, calendar, matter, or ID, one page at a time. Requires read access to the Calendars permission in the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Search Contacts
tools.description: Search and filter Clio contacts, including multiple contact IDs, one page at a time. Use Get Contact for one known ID and full contact details. Requires Contacts read permission in the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Search Matters
tools.description: Search and filter Clio matters, including multiple matter IDs, one page at a time. Use Get Matter for one known ID and full lifecycle, staffing, and billing details. Requires Matters read permission in the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Search Tasks
tools.description: Search and filter Clio tasks, including multiple task IDs, one page at a time. Use Get Task for one known ID and full task details. Requires Tasks read permission in the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Start Document From Template
tools.description: Start Clio's asynchronous create-document-from-template generation and return the automation ID, current state, and any documents already present. This action does not wait for completion because Clio documents no polling SLA. Check GET /document_automations/{id}.json using Platform Equivalent via proxy, or a future show action, before treating the document as generated. Requires Clio Documents write access and access to the Matter and template.

tools.name: Transition Bill State
tools.description: Irreversibly transition a bill to paid, void, or deleted only after exact identity, ETag, expected current state, available transition, and explicit confirmation checks. Uses Clio's official PATCH bill operation and requires Billing write permission.

tools.name: Update Activity
tools.description: Update at least one field on an existing Clio time or expense activity, optionally using its ETag as a concurrency precondition. Posted or billed activities may be immutable. Requires Clio's Activities write permission.

tools.name: Update Bill
tools.description: Update ordinary bill presentation, financial, tax, discount, or interest fields using the required current ETag. Lifecycle state is deliberately excluded; use Transition Bill State for a confirmed state change. Requires Billing write permission.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Update at least one of an existing Clio calendar's name, color, source, or visibility after reading its current ETag. Requires the Calendars write permission selected on the Clio developer application.

tools.name: Update Calendar Entry
tools.description: Update at least one field on a Clio calendar entry without sending calendar notifications. Existing contact attendees cause the update to fail closed because Clio always emails them. Recurring updates require occurrence or series scope; future-series updates are unsupported. Requires Clio's Calendars write permission.

tools.name: Update Communication
tools.description: Update a recorded Clio communication using its current ETag, including explicitly confirmed irreversible deletion of external properties. Notification subscribers are intentionally unsupported. Requires Communications write permission.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update at least one field on a Clio person or company, including adding or updating nested email and phone records. Setting destroy=true with a nested record ID irreversibly deletes that record. Requires Clio's Contacts write permission.

tools.name: Update Document Metadata
tools.description: Update only Clio document metadata with an If-Match ETag. It cannot restore a trashed document, initialize or finalize uploads, create versions, or mutate external properties. HTTP 412 is surfaced without retry. Requires Documents write permission.

tools.name: Update Folder
tools.description: Rename, move, recategorize, or restore a Clio folder, and add, change, or explicitly and irreversibly delete external properties, using its current ETag. Requires Documents write permission.

tools.name: Update Matter
tools.description: Update at least one field on an existing Clio matter, optionally using its ETag for concurrency safety. Requires Clio's Matters write permission.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Update a Clio note using its current ETag. Notification subscribers are intentionally unsupported. Requires Notes write permission.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Update at least one field on an existing Clio task. Assignee notifications are disabled on reassignment. Completion notifications are disabled and verified before a complete status transition. Requires Clio's Tasks write permission.

tools.name: Void Bill
tools.description: Irreversibly void an Unpaid bill after exact ID, number, ETag, state, and confirmation checks. Clio only accepts bills without recorded payments. Draft and Pending Approval bills must use Delete Bill. Uses Clio's official DELETE bill operation and requires Billing write permission.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

optional.name: region
optional.description: Your Clio Manage regional host: app.clio.com (US), eu.app.clio.com (EU), ca.app.clio.com (Canada), or au.app.clio.com (Australia).

name: Clockify
description: Clockify is a free time tracking software that allows individuals and teams to track work hours across projects.

tools.name: Add User to Group
tools.description: Tool to add a user to a user group in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to add a specific user to an existing group.

tools.name: Create Client
tools.description: Tool to add a new client to a workspace. Use when you need to create a client in a specific workspace.

tools.name: Create New Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to create a project with name, color, billable status, visibility, and optional client association.

tools.name: Create Shared Report
tools.description: Tool to create a shared report in Clockify. Use when generating shareable summary, detailed, or weekly reports with custom date ranges and grouping options.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a named tag in a Clockify workspace.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to add a new task to a project in Clockify. Use when you need to create a task with optional time estimates, assignees, and billable status.

tools.name: Create Templates On Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create templates on a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to create one or more templates with associated projects and tasks for reusable project structures.

tools.name: Create Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when logging time with start/end timestamps, project/task/tag associations, and billable status.

tools.name: Create User Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new user group in a workspace. Use when you need to add a group to organize users within a specific workspace.

tools.name: Create User Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a time entry for another user in a Clockify workspace. Use when adding time logs on behalf of team members with admin/manager permissions.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook in a workspace. Use when you want to subscribe to workspace events by registering a callback URL.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Clockify. Use when you need to set up a new workspace for time tracking and project management.

tools.name: Delete Client
tools.description: Permanently deletes a client from a Clockify workspace. Returns the deleted client's data. Warning: This action is irreversible. Ensure the client has no associated projects or time entries.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project from a workspace. Use when you need to permanently remove a project. Warning: This action is irreversible and may affect associated time entries and tasks.

tools.name: Delete Shared Report
tools.description: Tool to delete a shared report from a workspace by ID. Use when you need to remove a shared report that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag from a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing tag by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a task from a project in Clockify. Use when removing tasks that are no longer needed or were created by mistake.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a template from a Clockify workspace. Returns the deleted template's data including entries, projects, and tasks.

tools.name: Delete Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a time entry from a workspace by ID. Use for cleanup workflows such as removing bad imports, duplicates, or cancelled entries.

tools.name: Delete User Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a user group from a workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing user group by its ID.

tools.name: Delete User Time Entries
tools.description: Tool to delete multiple time entries for a user in a workspace. Use for bulk cleanup such as removing test data, correcting erroneous imports, or batch deleting cancelled work periods.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook from a workspace. Use when you need to remove an existing webhook by its ID.

tools.name: Duplicate Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an existing time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when creating a copy of a time entry with the same attributes (project, task, tags, description, billable status).

tools.name: Filter Workspace Users
tools.description: Tool to filter users in a workspace by advanced criteria. Use when you need a paginated, sortable list of workspace users matching multiple filters.

tools.name: Find User's Team Managers
tools.description: Retrieves the list of team managers assigned to a specific user in a Clockify workspace. Team managers are users who have supervisory responsibilities over other users. Use this after obtaining valid workspace and user IDs from other actions.

tools.name: Generate Detailed Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a detailed time entry report with filtering and pagination. Use when you need comprehensive time tracking data with project, client, user, and tag breakdowns for reporting or analysis.

tools.name: Generate Expense Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a detailed expense report for a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to retrieve and analyze expense data within a specific date range for reporting, invoicing, or financial analysis.

tools.name: Generate New Webhook Token
tools.description: Tool to generate a new webhook token. Use after confirming workspace and webhook IDs.

tools.name: Generate Summary Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a summary report for time entries in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need aggregated time tracking data grouped by projects, users, clients, or other criteria for high-level analysis and reporting.

tools.name: Generate Weekly Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a weekly time entry report for a workspace with grouped data. Use when you need detailed weekly breakdowns of time entries organized by user, project, task, or other dimensions.

tools.name: Get All Addon Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks for an addon in a workspace. Use after confirming workspace and addon IDs.

tools.name: Get All My Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to list all workspaces the user belongs to. Use when you need an overview of accessible workspaces after authentication. Verify the correct workspace ID from the returned list before using it in subsequent operations — wrong workspace IDs misroute all entries. Each workspace object may include settings such as forceTasks; when enabled, time entry creation requires a valid taskId or returns HTTP 400 (code 501).

tools.name: Get All Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve defined webhooks after confirming the workspace ID.

tools.name: Get Client By ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific client in a Clockify workspace. Returns client details including name, contact information (email, address), billing currency, and archived status. Use 'Get All My Workspaces' to obtain workspace_id and 'Get Clients' to obtain client_id before calling this action.

tools.name: Get Clients
tools.description: Tool to list clients in a workspace. Use after obtaining a workspace ID.

tools.name: Get Created Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve created entities within a workspace (Experimental). Use when you need to track incremental changes or newly created time entries, projects, clients, or other entity types.

tools.name: Get Currently Logged In User Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve info about the authenticated user. Use when verifying credentials and needing current user context after authentication.

tools.name: Get Deleted Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about entities deleted within a date range (Experimental API). Use when you need to track incremental changes or identify deleted records for synchronization purposes.

tools.name: Get Holidays
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all holidays for a workspace. Use when you need to list or filter workspace holidays after confirming the workspace ID.

tools.name: Get Holidays In Period
tools.description: Tool to retrieve holidays in a specific period. Use when you need holidays assigned to a user between two dates after confirming the workspace ID.

tools.name: Get In Progress Time Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all currently running time entries in a workspace. Use when you need to check which timers are active or see who is currently tracking time.

tools.name: Get member's profile
tools.description: Tool to get a member's profile in a workspace. Use when you need detailed profile info after identifying the workspace and user.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific project by ID. Use when you need to get project details such as name, billable status, budget estimates, rates, and memberships.

tools.name: Get Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects in a workspace with filtering and pagination. Use after obtaining a workspace ID.

tools.name: Get Shared Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a shared report by ID from Clockify. Returns report data including totals, charts, groupings, and filter configuration. Use when you need to access and analyze shared report data. Note: This endpoint uses the Reports API domain (reports.api.clockify.me).

tools.name: Get Shared Reports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all shared reports in a workspace. Use when you need to view reports that have been shared within the workspace.

tools.name: Get Tag By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific tag by ID in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to get tag details including name, workspace ID, and archived status.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Tool to find and list tags in a workspace. Use when you need to view all tags or filter tags by name or archived status.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific task in a Clockify project. Returns task details including name, assignees, estimates, billable status, and rates. Use this to inspect or verify task information within a project.

tools.name: Get Tasks
tools.description: Tool to find all tasks on a specific project in a workspace. Use when you need to list, search, or filter tasks for project management.

tools.name: Get Template By ID On Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific template by ID from a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to fetch template details including projects and tasks, optionally hydrated or cleansed. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in the API but remains functional.

tools.name: Get Templates On Workspace
tools.description: Tool to list all templates in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve available templates for creating projects or time entries.

tools.name: Get Time Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical time entries for a user in a workspace with filters. Use when you need to audit, summarize, or analyze time logs for reporting or invoicing.

tools.name: Get Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific time entry by ID from a workspace. Use when you need to inspect details of a particular time entry for auditing, reporting, or further processing.

tools.name: Get Updated Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve entities that have been updated in a workspace (Experimental). Use when tracking incremental changes to time entries, expenses, custom fields, or other entity types for synchronization or audit purposes.

tools.name: Get User Groups
tools.description: Tool to find all user groups in a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve all groups that organize users within a specific workspace.

tools.name: Get Webhook By ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific webhook in a Clockify workspace. Returns the webhook's name, URL, event type, trigger source configuration, auth token, and enabled status. Use this to inspect or verify webhook settings.

tools.name: Get Webhook Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve webhook logs for a specific webhook. Use when you need to inspect webhook delivery history, debug failed webhook calls, or monitor webhook activity.

tools.name: Get Workspace Info
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Clockify workspace. Use this tool to get workspace configuration, settings, memberships, and features. Requires a workspace ID which can be obtained from 'Get All My Workspaces' action. Returns workspace details including: - Name and ID - Cost rates and hourly rates - Subscription type and enabled features - Membership information - Workspace settings (time tracking mode, permissions, etc.)

tools.name: List Assignments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all scheduling assignments in a workspace. Use when you need to view team member assignments to projects within a specific date range.

tools.name: Remove User From Group
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a group in Clockify. Returns the updated user group details after removal.

tools.name: Stop User Timer
tools.description: Tool to stop a currently running timer for a user in a workspace. Use when ending an active time tracking session by providing the end timestamp.

tools.name: Update Client
tools.description: Tool to update an existing client in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to modify client details such as name, email, address, or archived status.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing project in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying project details like name, color, billable status, or client associations.

tools.name: Update Project Memberships
tools.description: Tool to update project memberships in Clockify. Use when you need to add users to a project or modify their rates.

tools.name: Update Project User Hourly Rate
tools.description: Tool to update a project user's billable rate. Use when you need to set or change the hourly rate for a specific user on a project.

tools.name: Update Shared Report
tools.description: Tool to update an existing shared report in Clockify. Use when modifying report name, visibility, date settings, or filter configuration.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update a tag in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to rename a tag or archive/unarchive it.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task on a project in Clockify. Use when modifying task details like name, assignees, status, estimates, or billing settings.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Tool to update a template in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to modify a template's name. Note: This endpoint is deprecated in API v1.

tools.name: Update Time Entries
tools.description: Tool to bulk update multiple time entries in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying multiple time logs simultaneously with start/end times, descriptions, billable status, or project/task associations.

tools.name: Update Time Entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing time entry in a Clockify workspace. Use when modifying time logs including start/end times, description, billable status, or project/task associations.

tools.name: Update User Group
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user group in a workspace. Use when you need to modify the name of a user group.

tools.name: Update User Hourly Rate
tools.description: Tool to update a user's hourly rate in a Clockify workspace. Use when you need to set or change the billable hourly rate for a specific user.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update a webhook in a workspace. Use when you need to modify an existing webhook's configuration such as its name, URL, event type, or trigger sources.

tools.name: Update Workspace Hourly Rate
tools.description: Tool to update the workspace billable hourly rate. Use when you need to set or modify the default hourly billing rate for a workspace.

name: Cloro
description: Cloro provides structured data from Google Search and leading AI assistants, with synchronous extraction and asynchronous task APIs.

tools.name: Extract AI Answer
tools.description: Synchronously extract a Gemini or Perplexity answer for a prompt and country. Synchronous calls add 2 credits compared with async tasks. Use Submit Async Task for ChatGPT or Copilot, which can exceed the synchronous execution deadline.

price.description: $0.08 per 100 API credits; 6 credits per synchronous Gemini answer, plus 2 for US state targeting

tools.name: Extract ChatGPT Response
tools.description: Synchronously extract a geo-targeted ChatGPT response with sources and optional rich data. Use Submit Async Task when the caller should not wait for completion.

price.description: $0.08 per 100 API credits; 7 credits per synchronous response, plus 2 once for paid include flags and 2 for US state targeting

tools.name: Extract Copilot Response
tools.description: Synchronously extract a Microsoft Copilot response with sources and available shopping or map modules. Use Submit Async Task when the caller should not wait for completion.

price.description: $0.08 per 100 API credits; 7 credits per synchronous response, plus 2 for US state targeting

tools.name: Extract Google AI Mode Answer
tools.description: Extract a structured Google AI Mode answer with sources and optional rich modules for a prompt and country.

price.description: $0.08 per 100 API credits; 6 credits per synchronous response

tools.name: Extract Grok Response
tools.description: Extract Grok's answer, web sources, and search queries for a prompt and country, with optional HTML, markdown, and raw response data.

tools.name: Get Async Queue Status
tools.description: Read organization-wide queued and processing counts, priority distribution, and current async concurrency without modifying the queue.

tools.name: Get Async Task
tools.description: Get a queued Cloro task by ID, or wait with bounded polling until it reaches COMPLETED or FAILED. FAILED is returned as a valid terminal record with its provider response details intact.

tools.name: Get Credits
tools.description: Read the organization's current completed-charge credit balance and billing cycle. Queued async work is not reserved, and even after a task reports a completed charge, the balance may take about 25 seconds to reflect it.

tools.name: List Supported Countries
tools.description: Return Cloro's current supported country codes, optionally filtered by provider model. This reports geographic support only and does not confirm that a provider monitor is operational.

tools.name: List US States
tools.description: Return the US state and DC codes accepted for state-level targeting. State targeting applies only to ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, and Perplexity and adds 2 credits.

tools.name: Resolve Google Redirect
tools.description: Resolve one redirectLink from a Cloro Google Search, Google News, or AI Mode response to its destination URL.

tools.name: Search Google
tools.description: Extract structured Google web or Google News results from a query and country, or web results from a complete Google Search URL. Costs at least 5 credits; extra result pages cost 2 credits each.

price.description: $0.08 per 100 API credits; 5 credits for the first synchronous page, plus 2 per extra page and 2 once for AI Overview options

tools.name: Submit Async Task
tools.description: Queue one non-cancelable Cloro monitor task and return its task ID and estimated credit charge without waiting. An accepted task continues after this call and is charged on completion. Use Get Async Task to retrieve it.

tools.name: Submit Async Task Batch
tools.description: Queue 1-500 independently validated, non-cancelable Cloro monitor tasks. Each accepted task continues after this call and is charged on completion. Inspect summary, partial_success, and every indexed result because one response can contain both accepted and rejected items.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your API key from the Cloro dashboard at https://dashboard.cloro.dev. Cloro uses this key directly as the Bearer token for API requests; keep it secret.

name: Close MCP
description: Close MCP gives agents scoped access to CRM leads, contacts, opportunities, activities, communications, and organization workflows.

tools.name: Activity search
tools.description:
Search for activities. Results are returned ordered by date descending.

Examples:
- To list activities on a lead, use the lead_ids filter.
- To list conversations, filter for calls and meetings.

tools.name: Aggregation
tools.description:
Perform an aggregation to answer questions like:

- How many emails were sent this week?
- Calls by user this week (Who made the most?)

You MUST first fetch the list of available fields using the
`get_fields` tool.

tools.name: Apply voice agent update
tools.description:
Apply a previously proposed voice agent update.

This tool persists the server-stored proposal identified by proposal_id.
It does not rerun the feedback processor, and it fails if the proposal has
expired or the voice agent changed after the proposal was created.

tools.name: Close product knowledge search
tools.description:
Search Close product documentation and knowledge base for relevant information.

Use this tool when users ask about:
- How to use specific Close features
- Close API documentation and integration
- Workflow automation and best practices
- Product capabilities and limitations
- Setup and configuration guidance

Example queries:
- "How do I set up automated lead assignment?"
- "What are Close's API rate limits?"
- "How to create custom fields in Close?"
- "Best practices for email templates in Close"

tools.name: Create address
tools.description: Add a new address to an existing lead (company).

tools.name: Create call task
tools.description:
Schedule a call task on a lead, assigned to either a user or a
voice agent (Chloe).

A call task represents a scheduled outbound call that will be made
to the specified contact at the given time. The task can be assigned
to a specific user or dispatched to a voice agent.

tools.name: Create comment
tools.description:
Add a comment to a commentable object (note, call, opportunity, task,
custom object, etc.).

If the object already has a comment thread, the new comment is appended
to it. Otherwise a new thread is started for the object. Use this tool
for both starting a conversation and replying to an existing one — the
object_id alone determines which.

Comments support @-mentions of users and groups. The body is HTML.

tools.name: Create contact
tools.description:
Create a new contact for a lead.

A contact represents a person associated with a lead (company).

tools.name: Create custom activity instance
tools.description:
Create a new custom activity instance on a lead.

A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type,
holding the custom field values defined by that type. Use the
find_custom_activities tool to look up the available custom activity
types.

If in an interactive session, ask the user for the relevant field values
(including custom fields) before creating, even if they are not required.

tools.name: Create custom object instance
tools.description:
Create a new custom object instance on a lead.

A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached
to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type. Use
the find_custom_object_types tool to look up the available custom object
types.

If in an interactive session, ask the user for the relevant field values
(including custom fields) before creating, even if they are not required.

tools.name: Create draft email
tools.description:
Create a draft email on a lead.

The email is saved as an unsent draft for the user to review, edit, and
send from Close; it is never sent automatically. Provide the body as
Close rich text (HTML) via body_html; the sender's saved email signature
is appended automatically. To create a reply in an existing thread,
provide the ID of the email being replied to via in_reply_to_id.

tools.name: Create email template
tools.description:
Create a new email template.

Handling of attachments and unsubscribe links via this tool is currently unsupported.

Email template body should be HTML formatted.

Use template tags as placeholders, for example:
{{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name.
{{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the email.
{{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).
{{ contact.first_name }} {{ contact.last_name }} to refer to the recipient.

tools.name: Create lead
tools.description:
Create a new lead (company).

After creating a lead, you should usually add an address or contact
(including phone or email) to the lead.

tools.name: Create lead status
tools.description: Create a new lead status.

tools.name: Create note
tools.description:
Create a new note on a lead.

A note is a text-based activity attached to a lead. At least one
of note (plaintext) or note_html (rich text) must be provided.

tools.name: Create opportunity
tools.description:
Create a new opportunity.

Requires a lead ID and status ID. Other fields are optional.
The value should be specified in cents (e.g., $100.00 = 10000).

tools.name: Create opportunity status tool

tools.name: Create pipeline

tools.name: Create sms template

Create a new SMS template.

Handling of attachments via this tool is currently unsupported.

Use template tags as placeholders, for example:
{{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name.
{{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the message.
{{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).

Create a new task for a lead.

ONLY call this if the user specifically instructed you to delete the contact.

This action cannot be undone.

A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached

ONLY call this if the user specifically instructed you to delete the

tools.name: Delete note

Permanently delete an existing note.

ONLY call this if the user specifically instructed you to delete

tools.name: Delete sms template

Permanently delete an SMS template.

tools.name: Get ai credit usage
tools.description:
AI credit usage for the billing account, broken down by feature.

Reports total credits used and a per-feature breakdown. Credits
are the billing unit for AI features. Usage covers the whole
billing account, not a single organization. Omit `start`/`end`
for the current billing period; the result's `start`/`end` report
the window actually measured.
Explicit ranges must be timezone-aware and span at most 366 days.
Older ranges may return empty or partial data — zero usage for an
old range does not mean no activity. On a rate-limited error,
retry after `retry_after` seconds.

tools.name: Get billing summary
tools.description:
Billing summary for the organization's billing account.

Reports the subscription plan, billing status with the trial end
date, seat counts, and AI usage availability, tier, and credit
allowance for the current billing cycle. Whether the account is on
trial is `status`, not anything under `ai_usage`. Use
`get_ai_credit_usage` for the credits actually used.

tools.name: Get fields
tools.description: Use this tool ONLY to get a list of fields for the aggregation tool.

tools.name: Get voice agent overview report
tools.description:
Cross-agent rollup for the Voice Agents list page.

Returns one row per **active** agent — agents with completed calls
in `date_range` **or** queued upcoming calls. Cumulative funnel
counts (`answered`, `engaged`, `objective_met`) plus `total_calls`.
`upcoming_calls` is the agent's queued (not yet completed) calls and
is **not** bound by `date_range` — open tasks are open regardless of
when scheduled (so an agent with only upcoming calls still appears).
Use this to compare agents;
for one agent's outcomes, sentiment, or time saved use
`get_voice_agent_performance_report`. For an inventory of all
configured voice agents regardless of activity, use
`find_agent_configs`.

The Voice Agents list (Agents tab) shows all-time stats, so leave
`date_range` at its default (`all_time`) unless the user asks for a
specific window. (The Upcoming and Recent tabs are call lists, not
this rollup — search Calls for those.)

Rows are sorted server-side per the `sort` field (default
`most_calls`); pass a different mode rather than re-sorting in
your reply. Set `reverse=True` to invert (e.g. `sort=most_calls,
reverse=True` for least active first) — necessary to surface the
bottom of the ordering, since `rows` are capped before they reach
you. `truncated` and `total_agent_count` flag in-scope active
agents; `dormant_agent_count` reports in-scope agents with
**neither** completed calls in the date range **nor** queued
upcoming calls (not included in `rows`).

tools.name: Get voice agent performance report
tools.description:
Performance metrics for one voice agent.

Returns the numbers shown on the Performance tab of a Voice Agent
detail page. Passing multiple `agent_config_ids` pools metrics
into a single aggregate (not a per-agent breakdown — for that,
use `get_voice_agent_overview_report`). For per-call drill-down,
search Calls filtered by `agent_config_id`.

When the user is on a Voice Agent page, pull `date_range` from
`page_context.date_range` so the numbers match the UI.

Percentages: `*_pct` is over `total_calls`;
`engaged_over_answered_pct` and `objective_met_over_answered_pct`
are over `answered` (tier-to-tier conversion). For any other
denominator, compute from `*_count`.

`funnel_previous_period_deltas` is null when the date range has
no defined previous period (e.g. `all_time`).

tools.name: Get voice agents
tools.description:
Return detailed configuration for one or more voice agents.

Includes each agent's objective, user instructions, and which skills are
enabled. Use this as the follow-up to `find_voice_agents` once one or
more agent IDs have been selected.

tools.name: Lead search
tools.description:
Perform a simple lead search and return the initial set of results.

Use this to retrieve all leads, most recent leads, search leads by
keyword, or filter by lead status and smart view. For more complex
searches use the `search` tool instead.

Leads will be returned by last updated first.

tools.name: List membership requests
tools.description:
List pending requests to join the current organization.

Each entry includes the requesting user's name and email, the
request id, and when the request was created.

tools.name: List roles
tools.description:
List the roles that can be assigned in the organization.

Covers Close's built-in roles plus any custom roles the org defines.
Use this to resolve a role name to its id, or to see which roles
grant organization management access.

tools.name: Org info
tools.description: Return general information about the organization and the user.

tools.name: Org users
tools.description: Return active users (memberships) which are part of the current org.

tools.name: Paginate search
tools.description:
Paginate a search to retrieve more results.

Provide exactly one of:
- `search_id`: a `share_*` id from a previous search or shared entry, or
- `smart_view_id`: a `save_*` Smart View (saved search) id the user is
  viewing.

tools.name: Propose voice agent update
tools.description:
Propose a voice agent configuration update from natural-language feedback.

This tool does not apply changes to the voice agent. It returns a short
behavioral summary and proposal ID when the requested edit is clear. If the
feedback is ambiguous, it returns clarification questions instead of making
a proposal. Use apply_voice_agent_update with the proposal ID only after
the user approves the proposal.

tools.name: Schedule voice agent call
tools.description:
Schedule a voice agent to call a lead's contact.

Creates a call task assigned to the voice agent. The voice agent will
place the call automatically at the scheduled time, or as soon as the
queue picks it up when no time is given.

Use `find_voice_agents` first to discover which voice agents are
available in this organization.

tools.name: Search
tools.description:
Perform a natural language search for leads or contacts.

If a more specific search tool (like lead_search or activity_search)
satisfies the request, use that tool instead.

You can reference related objects like activities (such as calls, emails,
meetings, notes, custom activities, etc.), opportunities, tasks as long as
they are part of a lead query.

Example queries:

- leads not contacted in the past week
- leads assigned to me with uncompleted tasks
- leads with an active opportunity over $500
- contacts with CTO title

Each returned result will contain a title label, preview text, object ID,
and URL.

The initial set of results, total count of all results, and a URL to open
the results in Close is returned. To retrieve more results, use the
returned cursor and call the paginate_search tool using the cursor and
search ID returned in this response.

tools.name: Update call task
tools.description:
Update a call task.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. Reassigning to a user or
voice agent (agent_config_id) affects only this task. Completing a call
task also completes every sibling task sharing its deduplication key.

tools.name: Update contact
tools.description:
Update an existing contact.

You can update a contact's name, title, email addresses, phone numbers, and URLs.
Only fields that are provided will be updated.

tools.name: Update custom activity instance
tools.description:
Update an existing custom activity instance.

A custom activity instance is an activity of a custom activity type,
holding the custom field values defined by that type.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. For custom fields, only
the custom fields included are modified; pass null to clear one. Pass
'clear' for contact_id to detach the contact.

tools.name: Update custom object instance
tools.description:
Update an existing custom object instance.

A custom object instance is a record of a custom object type, attached
to a lead and holding the custom field values defined by that type.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. For custom fields, only
the custom fields included are modified; pass null to clear one.

tools.name: Update draft email
tools.description:
Update an existing draft email.

Only draft emails can be updated; sent or scheduled emails are rejected.
Only fields that are provided are changed. When the body is replaced the
sender's saved email signature is appended again. This never sends the
email.

tools.name: Update email template
tools.description:
Update an existing email template.

Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated.

Handling of attachments and unsubscribe links via this tool is currently unsupported.

Email template body should be HTML formatted.

Use template tags as placeholders, for example:
{{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name.
{{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the email.
{{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).
{{ contact.first_name }} {{ contact.last_name }} to refer to the recipient.

tools.name: Update lead
tools.description:
Update an existing lead (company).

Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated.

tools.name: Update lead smart view
tools.description:
Update a lead smart view (saved search).

Only fields that are provided and not None will be updated.

tools.name: Update lead status
tools.description: Update the label of an existing lead status.

tools.name: Update note
tools.description:
Update an existing note.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. Note content is
provided as rich text (HTML) via note_html; the plaintext note is
automatically derived.

tools.name: Update opportunity
tools.description:
Update an existing opportunity.

Only fields that are provided will be updated.
The value should be specified in cents (e.g., $100.00 = 10000).

tools.name: Update opportunity status tool
tools.description: Update the label of an existing opportunity status.

tools.name: Update pipeline
tools.description:
Update an existing opportunity pipeline.

Only fields that are provided will be updated.

tools.name: Update sms template
tools.description:
Update an existing SMS template.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. Fields that are not provided will remain unchanged.

Handling of attachments via this tool is currently unsupported.

Use template tags as placeholders, for example:
{{ organization.name }} to refer to the sender's organization name.
{{ user.first_name }} {{ user.last_name }} {{ user.email }} {{ user.phone }} to refer to the user sending the message.
{{ lead.display_name }} to refer to the lead name (recipient's name/company).
{{ contact.first_name }} {{ contact.last_name }} to refer to the recipient.

tools.name: Update task
tools.description:
Update an existing task.

Only fields that are provided will be updated. Pass 'clear' for
contact_id or due_date to clear those values.

name: Cloud 66
description: Deploy and manage applications, stacks, servers, databases, networking, and users across cloud providers with Cloud 66.

tools.name: Add User Device
tools.description: Register a human user's mobile device token with Cloud 66. This changes the user's UI notification destination. Cloud 66 currently supports iOS devices; Android is documented but not currently available.

tools.name: Cancel Deployment
tools.description: Cancel an existing Cloud 66 deployment. This irreversibly stops the deployment operation but does not delete its deployment history.

tools.name: Clear Stack Caches
tools.description: Clear all application caches for a Cloud 66 stack and return the accepted asynchronous job by default. Cache removal cannot be undone.

tools.name: Commit Application Variant
tools.description: Finalize a rollout application variant and make it the active production version. This immediately changes which application version serves production traffic and cannot be undone by this action.

tools.name: Create Backup Task
tools.description: Create a scheduled backup task for a Cloud 66 stack. Cloud 66 only acknowledges that the task was queued; this action does not wait for or claim backup completion.

tools.name: Create Cluster
tools.description: Call Cloud 66's documented cluster-creation route with no parameters. Cloud 66 currently documents this operation as unavailable and returning HTTP 501 Not Implemented; this action reports that condition as an error, not success.

tools.name: Create Container Session
tools.description: Start an interactive Cloud 66 container session. A successful result confirms only that the asynchronous action was accepted; it does not confirm that the session is ready.

tools.name: Create Database
tools.description: Create a database in a Cloud 66 server group, optionally grant database users access, and by default wait for asynchronous completion.

tools.name: Create Database User
tools.description: Create a database user in a Cloud 66 server group. By default, wait for the asynchronous action to finish and return only after Cloud 66 reports successful completion.

tools.name: Create Elastic Address
tools.description: Create an elastic address failover group between distinct primary and secondary Cloud 66 stacks.

tools.name: Create Firewall Rule
tools.description: Add a firewall rule to a Cloud 66 stack using a numeric protocol code and at least one destination field. Returns the accepted asynchronous action; the action ID is not the created firewall-rule ID.

tools.name: Create Gateway
tools.description: Create a gateway for a Cloud 66 account using bastion-server connection metadata without accepting private-key content. Cloud 66 confirms success without returning the new gateway ID; call CLOUD_66_LIST_GATEWAYS afterward.

tools.name: Create SSL Certificate
tools.description: Submit a Let's Encrypt SSL-certificate creation request for a Cloud 66 stack. Manual certificate and private-key uploads are excluded. A successful result confirms request acceptance only, not completed certificate provisioning.

tools.name: Create Stack
tools.description: Create and build a Docker stack. A non-terminal result confirms acceptance only because Cloud 66 does not return a documented stack UID that can safely route action-status polling.

tools.name: Delete All Tags
tools.description: Permanently delete all tags from one Cloud 66 server or load balancer. This removes the entity's entire tag set, not one selected tag, and cannot be undone; verify the entity type and ID first.

tools.name: Delete Application Variant
tools.description: Permanently delete a preview application variant from a Cloud 66 stack. This operation only applies to preview variants and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Database
tools.description: Permanently delete a Cloud 66 database and all of its data. This cannot be undone. By default, wait for the asynchronous action to finish and fail unless Cloud 66 confirms successful completion.

tools.name: Delete Database User
tools.description: Permanently remove a database user from every associated database. This cannot be undone. By default, wait for Cloud 66's asynchronous deletion to finish and fail if the terminal action reports failure.

tools.name: Delete Elastic Address
tools.description: Permanently delete a Cloud 66 elastic address (failover group). This cannot be undone. The failover group must be detached from all stacks before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Environment Variable
tools.description: Permanently delete an environment variable from a Cloud 66 stack by its key/name. This irreversible operation cannot recover the deleted value; verify the stack UID and key before calling it.

tools.name: Delete Gateway
tools.description: Permanently delete a gateway from a Cloud 66 account. This irreversible operation cannot be undone; verify both the account ID and gateway ID first.

tools.name: Delete SSL Certificate
tools.description: Permanently delete an SSL certificate from a Cloud 66 stack. Verify the stack and certificate identifiers before this irreversible operation. A successful result confirms request acceptance only, not completed removal.

tools.name: Disable Database Replication
tools.description: Disable replication to a Cloud 66 slave database server and return the accepted irreversible asynchronous job by default.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information for a specific Cloud 66 account.

tools.name: Get API Status
tools.description: Call Cloud 66's unauthenticated basic ping endpoint and return its acknowledgement. A successful response confirms only that this endpoint answered; it does not validate the connected OAuth account or guarantee broader API availability.

tools.name: Get Backup
tools.description: Get information about a single Cloud 66 backup.

tools.name: Get Backup File
tools.description: Get the public download URL for a Cloud 66 backup file.

tools.name: Get Cloud
tools.description: Get regions and server sizes for one cloud provider available to the connected Cloud 66 account.

tools.name: Get Cloud Reference
tools.description: Return Cloud 66 cloud-provider reference data needed to select valid cloud, region, and server-size values. Use cloud and filter to limit the response.

tools.name: Get Cluster
tools.description: Return status, health, capacity, and node details for a Kubernetes cluster.

tools.name: Get Container
tools.description: Get runtime information for a specific container in a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Container Session
tools.description: Get a specific Cloud 66 container session by session ID, or the most recent session for a service. Requires SSH key download permission on the stack.

tools.name: Get Current Identity
tools.description: Verify the Cloud 66 connection and return the authenticated user and current account identity.

tools.name: Get Deployment
tools.description: Get information about a single deployment in a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Environment Variable
tools.description: Get one environment variable's name and metadata from a Cloud 66 stack by numeric ID. Current and historical values are never returned.

tools.name: Get Firewall Rule
tools.description: Get information about a specific firewall rule in a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Nginx Module Reference
tools.description: Return the Nginx modules supported by Cloud 66 stack configuration.

tools.name: Get Process
tools.description: Gets one page of information about a specific process in a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: Get Server
tools.description: Get information about a single server in a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Server Setting
tools.description: Get information about a single setting for a server in a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get SSL Certificate
tools.description: Get one SSL certificate from a Cloud 66 stack by certificate identifier.

tools.name: Get Stack
tools.description: Retrieve detailed configuration, deployment status, and health for a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Stack Action
tools.description: Return the current state and result of one asynchronous Cloud 66 stack action.

tools.name: Get Stack Alert
tools.description: Return the configuration for a named alert on a Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: Get Stack Setting
tools.description: Get a single setting for a Cloud 66 stack by its setting identifier.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get detailed information about a Cloud 66 user by user ID.

tools.name: Import Backup
tools.description: Queue an external backup import for a Cloud 66 stack. Cloud 66 only acknowledges that the import was queued; this action does not wait for or claim import completion.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: Lists accounts that the current authenticated user can access. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items.

tools.name: List Application Variants
tools.description: Returns all active, rollout, and preview application variants for a specified Cloud 66 stack.

tools.name: List Backup Files
tools.description: Get backup files for a Cloud 66 stack backup. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items.

tools.name: List Backups
tools.description: Gets backups for a Cloud 66 stack. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items.

tools.name: List Clouds
tools.description: Get cloud providers available to the connected Cloud 66 account, with their regions and server sizes. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items.

tools.name: List Clusters
tools.description: Return one documented page of Kubernetes clusters accessible to the user. Each call returns one page, currently up to 100 clusters. This documented route returned an HTML 404 in prior probing, so availability may depend on the account or provider deployment.

tools.name: List Containers
tools.description: Gets containers for a Cloud 66 stack, optionally filtered by server. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items.

tools.name: List Databases
tools.description: Returns one page of databases associated with a Cloud 66 server group; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Database Users
tools.description: Gets one page of database-user names and metadata for a Cloud 66 server group. Passwords and password hashes are never requested or returned. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Deployments
tools.description: Gets one page of deployments for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List DNS Providers
tools.description: Gets one page of DNS providers configured for SSL certificate management; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Elastic Addresses
tools.description: Return Cloud 66's documented elastic-address failover groups. This documented route returned an HTML 404 in prior probing without a scope or paid-tier signal, so its availability is unresolved.

tools.name: List Environment Variables
tools.description: Get one page of environment-variable names and metadata for a Cloud 66 stack. Current and historical values are never returned. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Firewall Rules
tools.description: Gets one page of firewall rules for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Gateways
tools.description: Gets one page of gateway metadata for a Cloud 66 account. Private-key content is never returned. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Image Repositories
tools.description: Gets one page of image repositories for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: Gets one page of jobs configured on a Cloud 66 stack, including each job's command and run_on server-target context. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Notifications
tools.description: Return one documented page of Cloud 66 notification records. Each call returns one page, normally up to 30 items. This documented route returned an HTML 404 in prior probing, so availability may depend on the account or provider deployment.

tools.name: List Processes
tools.description: Gets one page of processes for a Cloud 66 stack, optionally filtered by server; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Server Groups
tools.description: Gets one page of server groups for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Servers
tools.description: Gets one page of servers for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Server Settings
tools.description: Returns one page of settings for a server, including optional IDs, timestamps, and warnings when Cloud 66 provides them; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Services
tools.description: Gets one page of services for a Cloud 66 stack; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List SSL Certificates
tools.description: Gets one page of SSL certificate metadata for a Cloud 66 stack. Certificate and private-key material is never returned. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Stack Actions
tools.description: Retrieve one page of asynchronous actions performed for a Cloud 66 stack, optionally filtered by caller reference; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Stack Alerts
tools.description: Returns the alert configurations and notification channels for a specified stack.

tools.name: List Stacks
tools.description: Retrieves stack objects accessible to the current user. Each call returns one page, currently up to 100 stacks.

tools.name: List Stack Settings
tools.description: Returns one page of settings for a Cloud 66 stack, including their values and read-only status; Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: Gets one page of tags for a Cloud 66 server or load balancer, identified by entity type and ID. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Gets one page of users in the connected Cloud 66 account, including account roles and access-profile details when available. Cloud 66 normally returns up to 30 items per page.

tools.name: Patch SSL Certificate
tools.description: Update a Let's Encrypt SSL certificate using Cloud 66's PATCH method. Manual certificate and private-key uploads are excluded. Cloud 66 does not distinguish PATCH from PUT semantics. Success confirms request acceptance only.

tools.name: Pause Stack Workload
tools.description: Pause a Cloud 66 service or process workload. Services require service_name, server_uid, or both; processes require process_name, server_uid, or both. By setting all_workloads=true without either selector, the action broadly pauses every workload of the selected type across the stack. Pausing workloads is disruptive; the accepted asynchronous job is returned by default.

tools.name: Promote Database Replica
tools.description: Promote a Cloud 66 slave database server to a standalone master and return the accepted irreversible asynchronous job by default.

tools.name: Put SSL Certificate
tools.description: Update a Let's Encrypt SSL certificate using Cloud 66's PUT method. Manual certificate and private-key uploads are excluded. Cloud 66 does not distinguish PUT from PATCH semantics. Success confirms request acceptance only.

tools.name: Reboot Cluster Servers
tools.description: Queue an irreversible reboot of selected Kubernetes cluster servers. A non-terminal result confirms acceptance only because Cloud 66 does not return a documented stack UID that can safely route action-status polling.

tools.name: Reboot Server
tools.description: Initiate an irreversible reboot of one Cloud 66 server. A successful result confirms acceptance only; this endpoint does not confirm that the server finished rebooting.

tools.name: Reboot Stack Servers
tools.description: Reboot all servers or one server group in a Cloud 66 stack using a parallel or serial strategy, and by default wait for documented asynchronous completion.

tools.name: Redeploy Stack
tools.description: Redeploy a Cloud 66 stack. This changes its running deployment and returns the accepted asynchronous action by default because deployments commonly outlast the tool execution window.

tools.name: Replace Tags
tools.description: Replace all tags on one Cloud 66 server or load balancer with the supplied non-empty tag set.

tools.name: Restart Stack
tools.description: Restart every component of a Cloud 66 stack and return the accepted asynchronous job by default. The restart is disruptive.

tools.name: Restart Stack Workload
tools.description: Restart a Cloud 66 container, service, or process workload. Containers require container_id. Services require service_name, server_uid, or both; processes require process_name, server_uid, or both. Set all_workloads=true without either selector to restart every workload of the selected type across the stack. Restarts are disruptive and irreversible once initiated; the accepted asynchronous job is returned by default.

tools.name: Resume Stack Workload
tools.description: Resume a Cloud 66 service or process workload. Services require service_name, server_uid, or both; processes require process_name, server_uid, or both. By setting all_workloads=true without either selector, the action broadly resumes every workload of the selected type across the stack. Resuming workloads is disruptive; the accepted asynchronous job is returned by default.

tools.name: Resync Database Replica
tools.description: Re-synchronize a PostgreSQL or MySQL Cloud 66 slave database server with its master and return the accepted asynchronous job by default. The replica's current data may be replaced.

tools.name: Scale Process
tools.description: Trigger the provider-configured scaling operation for a process on a Cloud 66 stack and, by default, poll until Cloud 66 confirms success. This tool cannot set a desired process count; scaling behavior comes from the process's existing Cloud 66 configuration.

tools.name: Set Stack Maintenance Mode
tools.description: Enable or disable maintenance mode for a Cloud 66 stack. By default this returns the accepted asynchronous job because Cloud 66 can take 70-120 seconds to mark it complete.

tools.name: Stop Container
tools.description: Stop a container in a Cloud 66 stack. This changes the container's running state and can interrupt workloads.

tools.name: Update Application Group Alerts
tools.description: Apply alert configurations to every stack in a Cloud 66 application group and report successes, non-applicable alerts, and failures.

tools.name: Update Application Variant Percentage
tools.description: Change the percentage of production traffic sent to a canary rollout application variant. This action applies only to canary deployments.

tools.name: Update Elastic Address
tools.description: Update an elastic address's primary or secondary stack assignment, or switch which stack currently receives traffic. Provide at least one of primary_stack_uid, secondary_stack_uid, or current_stack.

tools.name: Update Gateway
tools.description: Update a Cloud 66 gateway's bastion-server metadata without accepting or returning private-key content. Provide at least one of name, username, address, ttl, or private_ip.

tools.name: Update Server Setting
tools.description: Update one server setting in a Cloud 66 stack and, by default, poll the asynchronous action until Cloud 66 confirms success.

tools.name: Update Stack Alerts
tools.description: Update one or more Cloud 66 stack alert configurations. Only specified alerts are changed; other stack alert settings remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Stack Setting
tools.description: Update one Cloud 66 stack setting and, by default, poll the asynchronous action until Cloud 66 confirms success.

tools.name: Update Tags
tools.description: Incrementally add or delete tags on one Cloud 66 server or load balancer. Deleting a tag that is not present is ignored; Cloud 66 performs deletions before additions.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Update a Cloud 66 user's access profile. This changes account permissions and stack roles for a human user; verify the target user and intended access before calling. Cloud 66 ignores user fields outside access_profile.

name: Cloudcart
description: CloudCart is an e-commerce platform that enables businesses to create and manage online stores efficiently.

tools.name: Add Category Properties
tools.description: Tool to add properties to a category relationship. Use when you need to associate one or more properties with a category for filtering or organization purposes.

tools.name: Add to Cart
tools.description: Tool to add an item to the cart. Use after confirming a product selection with desired quantity.

tools.name: Clear Cart
tools.description: Tool to remove all items from the specified cart. Use when you need to empty the cart before adding new items or starting over.

tools.name: Create Blog Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new blog category in CloudCart. Use when you need to organize blog posts into categories. Requires a category name and optionally accepts an image URL for visual representation.

tools.name: Create Blog Post
tools.description: Tool to create a new blog post in CloudCart. Use when you need to publish blog content to your store. Requires post title, content, blog ID, and author ID.

tools.name: Create Blog Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new blog tag in CloudCart. Use when you need to add tags for organizing blog content. Tags help categorize and filter blog posts for better content discovery.

tools.name: Create Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new category. Use when you need to add organizational structure to your product catalog.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer in CloudCart. Use when you need to register a new customer profile. Provide validated customer details (first name, last name, email, and password). Returns the created customer with their unique ID and timestamps.

tools.name: Create Customer Billing Address
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer billing address. Use when you need to add a billing address for an existing customer. Requires customer ID and address details (name, country, city, street).

tools.name: Create Customer Groups
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer group in CloudCart. Use when you need to organize customers into categories or segments for targeted marketing, pricing, or permissions. The group name must be unique.

tools.name: Create Customer Shipping Address
tools.description: Tool to create a customer shipping address in CloudCart. Use when you need to add a new delivery address for an existing customer. Requires customer ID and complete address details (name, phone, country, city, street, postal code).

tools.name: Create Customer Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new customer tag in CloudCart. Use when you need to add tags for organizing and categorizing customers. Tags can be used for filtering, grouping, or marketing purposes.

tools.name: Create Discount
tools.description: Tool to create a new discount in CloudCart. Use when you need to add promotional discounts, sales, or special offers. Supports various discount types (fixed, percent, flat, shipping) and flexible targeting (all products, specific products, categories, or customers).

tools.name: Create Discount Code
tools.description: Create a new discount code in CloudCart. Use when you need to add promotional discount codes to the store. The value represents the discount percentage multiplied by 100 (e.g., 1500 = 15% off).

tools.name: Create Image
tools.description: Tool to create a new image for a product. Use when you need to add an image to an existing product by providing the image URL and product ID.

tools.name: Create Linked Products
tools.description: Tool to create linked product relationships in CloudCart. Use when you need to associate related products together, such as complementary items or product bundles. Supports bidirectional linking where linked products reference each other.

tools.name: Create Order
tools.description: Tool to create a new order. Use after assembling customer ID, cart items, and optional addresses/payment info.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Creates a new product in CloudCart catalog. Requires product name, price, and at least one category ID. Supports optional fields like SKU, description (HTML allowed), quantity, weight, barcode, status, tags, and images. Use this when you need to add a new product to the store inventory.

tools.name: Create Products Property Options
tools.description: Tool to add property options to a product relationship. Use when you need to associate one or more property options with a product for configuration or customization purposes.

tools.name: Create Product to Discount
tools.description: Tool to create a product to discount relationship in CloudCart. Use when you need to associate a product variant with a discount and optionally set a discounted price.

tools.name: Create Property
tools.description: Tool to create a new property in CloudCart. Properties are attributes that can be assigned to products (e.g., color, size, material). Use when you need to define new product characteristics or attributes for your catalog.

tools.name: Create Property Option
tools.description: Tool to create a new property option. Use when you need to add a new option value to a product property (e.g., adding "Red" to a "Color" property or "Large" to a "Size" property).

tools.name: Create Redirect
tools.description: Create a new URL redirect in CloudCart. Supports five redirect types: 'manual' for custom paths, 'external' for external URLs, and 'product', 'category', or 'vendor' to link to specific store items. Use when you need to redirect old URLs to new locations or specific store resources.

tools.name: Create Subscriber
tools.description: Tool to create a new subscriber in CloudCart. Use when you need to add a subscriber to the mailing list. Provide the subscriber's first name, last name, and two-letter country code.

tools.name: Create Subscriber Channel
tools.description: Tool to create a new subscriber channel in CloudCart. Use when you need to add a communication channel (email or phone) for a subscriber. Provide the subscriber ID, channel type, contact identifier, and consent flags.

tools.name: Create Subscriber Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new subscriber-tag association in CloudCart. Use when you need to associate a tag with a subscriber for organizing, categorizing, or filtering subscribers.

tools.name: Create Variant
tools.description: Tool to create a new product variant for a given product. Use when you need to add a variant with specific SKU, price, and options.

tools.name: Create Variant Option

Use cases: - Audit historical rule configurations - Compare rule changes between versions - Rollback analysis (view what rules looked like before a change) - Debug issues by examining past ruleset states Prerequisites: - Requires a valid account_id or zone_id (use List Zones to get zone IDs) - Requires knowing the ruleset phase (e.g., 'http_request_firewall_custom') - Requires knowing the version number to fetch

tools.name: Update Cloudflare Zone
tools.description: Tool to edit a Cloudflare zone. Use when you need to update a single zone property at a time. Ensure only one of paused, type, or vanity_name_servers is provided per call.

tools.name: Upload File to S3
tools.description: Tool to upload arbitrary file content to temporary storage. Use when you need to stage files for actions requiring FileUploadable.

name: Cloudflare Browser Rendering
description: Cloudflare Browser Rendering enables developers to programmatically control and interact with headless browser instances running on Cloudflare’s global network, facilitating tasks such as automating browser interactions, capturing screenshots, generating PDFs, and extracting data from web pages.

tools.name: Capture Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to capture a webpage screenshot. Use when you need a visual snapshot of a URL or HTML with optional viewport and clipping. Always validate screenshot content — the tool returns a successful result even when the captured page is a 404 or error page, with no error signal raised.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: List all Cloudflare accounts accessible to the authenticated API token. Returns account IDs, names, types, and settings. Use this to retrieve a valid account_id required by other browser-rendering actions like capture_screenshot, scrape_html_elements, and take_webpage_snapshot.

tools.name: Scrape HTML Elements
tools.description: Tool to scrape HTML elements for text, HTML, attributes, and box metrics. Use when you need detailed data of matched selectors after rendering a page.

tools.name: Take Webpage Snapshot
tools.description: Capture both rendered HTML content and a screenshot of a webpage in a single request. Returns the full DOM content as a string and a Base64-encoded screenshot image. Useful when you need both visual representation and page content for analysis.
