name: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary is a cloud-based media management platform for uploading, storing, transforming, and delivering images and videos via CDN.

tools.name: Activate Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to manually activate a Cloudinary live stream. Use when you need to start a live stream that is in an inactive state.

tools.name: Create Asset Relations by Asset ID
tools.description: Tool to add related assets by asset ID. Use when you need to create relationships between assets in Cloudinary. Can relate up to 10 assets at once to a source asset.

tools.name: Create Asset Relations by Public ID
tools.description: Tool to create relations between assets by public ID. Use when you need to link related assets together (e.g., linking subtitles to videos, or associating images with each other). Each request can relate up to 10 assets to the primary asset.

tools.name: Create Folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new asset folder. Use when you need to organize assets into nested directories. Use after confirming the folder path does not already exist.

tools.name: Create Image from Text
tools.description: Tool to create an image from text using Cloudinary's text generation API. Use when you need to generate custom text images with specific styling options. The generated image can be customized with font, color, alignment, and other visual properties.

tools.name: Create Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to create a new live stream in Cloudinary. Use when you need to set up a new live streaming session. The created stream will provide connection details (URI and stream key) for pushing live content.

tools.name: Create Live Stream Output
tools.description: Tool to create a new live stream output configuration. Use when you need to add an output destination to an existing live stream, such as simulcasting to YouTube, Facebook, or creating an archive.

tools.name: Create Metadata Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new metadata field definition. Use when extending your metadata schema with new fields.

tools.name: Create Metadata Rule
tools.description: Tool to create a new conditional metadata rule. Use when you need to automatically populate metadata fields based on conditions. The rule applies a value to a target metadata field when a condition on another metadata field is met.

tools.name: Create Multi-Resource Animation
tools.description: Tool to create an animated image, video, or PDF from a set of images. Use when you need to combine multiple images into an animated format. Provide either a tag (to combine all images with that tag) or a list of URLs.

tools.name: Create Slideshow
tools.description: Tool to create an auto-generated video slideshow from existing Cloudinary assets. Use when you need to compile multiple images or videos into a single video with transitions. The slideshow is created asynchronously; check status field or use notification_url for completion updates.

tools.name: Create Streaming Profile
tools.description: Tool to create a new adaptive streaming profile in your Cloudinary account. Use when you need to define custom video quality settings for adaptive bitrate streaming. The profile will contain multiple representations at different resolutions and bitrates.

tools.name: Create Transformation
tools.description: Tool to create a new named transformation by assigning a custom name to a set of transformation parameters. Use when you need to save and reuse a transformation configuration with a memorable name.

tools.name: Create Trigger
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook trigger for a specified event type. Use after configuring your webhook endpoint and choosing the event type. Example: "Create a trigger for uploads to https://example.com/hooks/cloudinary"

tools.name: Create Upload Mapping
tools.description: Tool to create a new upload mapping folder and URL template. Use when you need to dynamically map external URL prefixes to a Cloudinary asset folder before uploading files.

tools.name: Create Upload Preset
tools.description: Tool to create a new upload preset. Use when defining centralized upload options (tags, formats, transformations, etc.) before asset uploads.

tools.name: Delete Asset Relations by Asset ID
tools.description: Tool to delete asset relations by asset ID. Use when you need to unrelate a specific asset from other assets.

tools.name: Delete Asset Relations by Public ID
tools.description: Tool to delete asset relations by public ID. Use when you need to unrelate assets from a specific asset.

tools.name: Delete Derived Resources
tools.description: Tool to delete derived assets. Use when you need to remove specific derived assets by their IDs. Example: "Delete derived assets with IDs [id1, id2]".

tools.name: Delete Metadata Field Datasource Entries
tools.description: Tool to delete datasource entries for a specified metadata field. Use when you need to soft-delete (inactivate) specific entries in a field's datasource. Example prompt: "Delete entries ['color1','color2'] from metadata field 'color_id'"

tools.name: Delete Folder
tools.description: Tool to delete an empty asset folder. Use when the folder is confirmed empty and you need to remove it.

tools.name: Delete Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to delete a live stream from Cloudinary. Use when you need to permanently remove a live stream that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Live Stream Output
tools.description: Tool to delete a live stream output from Cloudinary. Use when you need to remove a specific output configuration from a live stream.

tools.name: Delete Metadata Field
tools.description: Tool to delete a metadata field by external ID. Use when you need to remove a metadata field that is no longer required.

tools.name: Delete Metadata Rule
tools.description: Tool to delete a conditional metadata rule by its ID. Use when you need to remove a metadata rule that is no longer required.

tools.name: Delete Resources by Asset ID
tools.description: Tool to delete resources by asset IDs. Use when you need to permanently remove specific resources by their immutable asset IDs; irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Resources by Public ID
tools.description: Tool to delete Cloudinary resources by public ID, prefix, or all resources. Use when you need to permanently remove specific assets by their public IDs, or bulk delete by prefix pattern. Deletion is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Resources by Tags
tools.description: Tool to delete Cloudinary assets by tag. Use when you need to remove all assets associated with a given tag.

tools.name: Delete Streaming Profile
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom streaming profile or revert a built-in profile to original settings. Use when you need to remove a custom profile that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Transformation (v2)
tools.description: Tool to delete a named transformation from your Cloudinary account. Use when you need to remove a transformation that is no longer required.

tools.name: Delete Trigger
tools.description: Tool to delete a trigger (webhook notification). Use when you need to remove a trigger by its ID after confirming the correct ID.

tools.name: Delete Upload Mapping
tools.description: Tool to delete a folder upload mapping. Use when you need to remove an existing upload mapping configuration.

tools.name: Delete Upload Preset
tools.description: Tool to delete an upload preset from the account. Use when you need to remove an upload preset that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Destroy Asset
tools.description: Tool to permanently destroy a Cloudinary asset/resource by public ID. Use when you need to permanently delete a specific asset. This operation is irreversible and removes the asset from Cloudinary storage.

tools.name: Destroy Asset by ID
tools.description: Tool to delete an asset by its immutable asset ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a specific asset using its asset ID; operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Explicit Resource Update
tools.description: Tool to update an existing asset and/or eagerly generate derived transformations using Cloudinary's Explicit API. Use when you need to pre-generate transformations, update metadata, move assets to new folders, or modify tags on already-uploaded resources.

tools.name: Explode Multi-Page Resource
tools.description: Tool to create derived images from multi-page files (PDF, PSD, TIFF, animated GIF) by exploding them into separate images. Use when you need to extract individual pages or frames from a multi-page resource. The operation is asynchronous and returns a batch_id for tracking.

tools.name: Generate Archive
tools.description: Tool to create an archive (ZIP or TGZ file) containing a set of assets from your Cloudinary environment. Use when you need to download multiple assets as a single archive file. Supports filtering by tags, public IDs, or prefixes. The archive is created asynchronously if async=true; use notification_url to receive completion notifications.

tools.name: Generate Sprite
tools.description: Tool to generate sprites by merging multiple images into a single large image. Use when you need to combine multiple images for efficient web delivery. Note: This API was deprecated in 2025 and may not be available in all Cloudinary accounts.

tools.name: Get Adaptive Streaming Profiles
tools.description: Tool to list adaptive streaming profiles. Use when retrieving built-in and custom adaptive streaming profiles for delivering video via HLS or DASH.

tools.name: Get Analysis Task Status
tools.description: Tool to get the status of an analysis task. Use when you need to check the progress or completion status of a previously submitted analysis task.

tools.name: Get product environment config details
tools.description: Tool to get product environment config details. Use when you need to fetch or verify environment configuration such as folder_mode. Config values like folder_mode constrain uploads, folder creation, and preset creation — check this config before those operations to avoid mode conflicts.

tools.name: Get Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to get details of a single live stream by ID. Use when you need to retrieve configuration, status, and metadata of an existing live stream.

tools.name: Get Live Stream Output
tools.description: Tool to get details of a single live stream output. Use when you need information about a specific output configuration for a live stream.

tools.name: Get Live Stream Outputs
tools.description: Tool to get a list of live stream outputs. Use when you need to retrieve all outputs configured for a specific live stream in Cloudinary.

tools.name: Get Live Streams
tools.description: Tool to get a list of live streams from Cloudinary. Use when you need to retrieve all configured live streams for your account.

tools.name: Get Metadata Field By ID
tools.description: Tool to get a single metadata field definition by external ID. Use after creating or updating a metadata field to fetch its full definition. Example: "Get metadata field definition for external ID 'color_id'."

tools.name: Get Resource by Asset ID
tools.description: Get Resource by Asset ID

tools.name: Get Resource by Public ID
tools.description: Tool to get details of a single resource by public ID. All three of resource_type, type, and public_id must exactly match the stored asset's values; a mismatch in any one causes lookup failure even if the asset exists under a different combination. Returns full asset, derived, and related info.

tools.name: Get Resources by Asset Folder
tools.description: Tool to list assets stored directly in a specified folder. Use when you need to view assets in a specific folder without including subfolder contents.

tools.name: Get Resources by Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve assets with a specified contextual metadata key/value. Use when filtering resources by context metadata. Empty `resources` array indicates no matches, not an error. Enable `context`, `metadata`, `tags`, or `moderations` only when needed; use `fields` to limit payload size.

tools.name: Get Resources in Moderation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve assets in a moderation queue by status. Use after moderation to process pending or reviewed assets.

tools.name: Get Root Folders
tools.description: Tool to list all root folders in the product environment. Use when you need to retrieve top-level asset folders.

tools.name: Get Streaming Profile Details
tools.description: Tool to get details of a single streaming profile by name. Use when you need to inspect an existing profile's configuration before making changes. Example: "Get details of streaming profile 'hd'."

tools.name: Get Resource Tags
tools.description: Tool to list all tags used for a specified resource type. Use when you need to retrieve or page through the tags assigned to your assets.

tools.name: Get Transformation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific transformation. Use when you need to get information about a named transformation or transformation string, including its parameters, derived resources, and usage status.

tools.name: Get Transformations
tools.description: Tool to list all transformations (named and unnamed). Use when you need to retrieve transformation definitions or paginate through transformation records.

tools.name: List Webhook Triggers
tools.description: Tool to list all webhook triggers for event types in your environment. Use when you need to retrieve or filter existing triggers by type.

tools.name: Get Upload Mapping Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single upload mapping by folder. Use when you need the URL prefix template associated with a specific mapping folder.

tools.name: Get Upload Mappings
tools.description: Tool to list all upload mappings. Use when you need to retrieve and paginate through upload mapping configurations. For details of a specific mapping, use CLOUDINARY_GET_UPLOAD_MAPPING_DETAILS.

tools.name: Get Upload Preset
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single upload preset by name. Use when you need to inspect an existing preset's configuration.

tools.name: Get Usage
tools.description: Tool to get product environment usage details. Use when you need to monitor your Cloudinary account storage, bandwidth, requests, and other usage limits. Exceeding these limits can silently block uploads and other operations; check usage when operations fail unexpectedly to rule out cap exhaustion.

tools.name: Get Video Views
tools.description: Tool to get video analytics views from Cloudinary. Use when you need to retrieve video viewing statistics including watch time, viewer location, and device information.

tools.name: Idle Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to manually idle a Cloudinary live stream. Use when you need to put an active live stream into idle state without stopping it completely.

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Tool to list image assets from Cloudinary. Use when you need to retrieve a list of image resources, with optional filtering by prefix, tags, or public IDs. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: List Metadata Fields
tools.description: Tool to list all structured metadata fields defined in your Cloudinary product environment. Use to retrieve metadata schema definitions, optionally filtered by external IDs.

tools.name: List Metadata Rules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all conditional metadata rules defined in your Cloudinary account. Use when you need to list or audit metadata rules that automatically apply values to assets based on conditions.

tools.name: List Raw Files
tools.description: Tool to list raw assets from Cloudinary. Use when you need to retrieve raw files with optional filtering by prefix, tags, or public IDs.

tools.name: List Resources by Asset IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple resources by their asset IDs. Use when you need to fetch details for multiple specific assets (up to 100) by their immutable asset IDs.

tools.name: List Resources by External IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve resources by their external IDs. Use when you need to fetch multiple resources using external identifiers assigned during upload.

tools.name: List Resources by Tag
tools.description: Tool to list resources (assets) with a specified tag. Use when you need to retrieve assets filtered by tag value.

tools.name: List Resources by Type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve resources (assets) by resource type and storage type. Use when you need to list all assets of a specific type (image, video, raw) and storage method (upload, private, etc.).

tools.name: List Resource Types
tools.description: Tool to list all available resource types in your Cloudinary product environment. Use when you need to discover which resource types are available.

tools.name: List Upload Presets
tools.description: Tool to list all upload presets configured in the account. Use when you need to retrieve and paginate through upload preset configurations. For creating a new upload preset, use CLOUDINARY_CREATE_UPLOAD_PRESET.

tools.name: List Video Assets
tools.description: Tool to list video assets from Cloudinary. Use when you need to retrieve video assets with optional filtering by prefix, public IDs, tags, or timestamps.

tools.name: Manage Context Metadata
tools.description: Tool to add or remove contextual metadata on Cloudinary assets. Use when you need to manage custom context key-value pairs on existing assets.

tools.name: Order Metadata Field Datasource
tools.description: Tool to update ordering of a metadata field datasource. Use when you need to reorder enum or set values for a metadata field datasource before updating assets.

tools.name: Ping Cloudinary Servers
tools.description: Tool to ping Cloudinary servers. Use when testing API reachability and authentication.

tools.name: Publish Resources
tools.description: Tool to publish Cloudinary assets by public IDs, prefix, or tag. Use when you need to make authenticated or private assets publicly accessible.

tools.name: Rename or Move Resource Public ID
tools.description: Tool to rename an asset's public ID using Cloudinary's rename endpoint. Use when reorganizing resources by changing public_id without re-uploading. Note: renaming changes URLs; optionally invalidate CDN caches.

tools.name: Reorder Metadata Field
tools.description: Tool to change the position of a specific metadata field. Use when you need to reorder a single metadata field to a specific position in the list.

tools.name: Reorder Metadata Fields
tools.description: Tool to reorder all metadata fields in the product environment. Use when you need to change the display order of metadata fields based on label, creation date, or external ID.

tools.name: Restore Metadata Field Datasource Entries
tools.description: Tool to restore previously deleted datasource entries for a metadata field. Use after deleting entries to reactivate soft-deleted datasource entries.

tools.name: Restore Deleted Resources
tools.description: Tool to restore deleted Cloudinary resources by public IDs. Use when you need to recover previously deleted assets that have backups available. Only works if backups were enabled when the resources were deleted.

tools.name: Restore Resources by Asset IDs
tools.description: Tool to restore backed up assets by asset IDs. Use when you need to restore previously backed up resources from their immutable asset IDs. The API processes each asset ID independently; some may succeed while others fail.

tools.name: Search Assets
tools.description: Tool to search and filter assets using powerful query expressions. Use when you need to find specific assets by resource type, tags, metadata, or other attributes with sorting and pagination support.

tools.name: Search Datasource in Metadata Field
tools.description: Tool to search datasource values in a metadata field. Use when looking for specific values in enum or set metadata fields.

tools.name: Search Folders
tools.description: Tool to search asset folders with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to locate specific folders by name, path, or creation date.

tools.name: Search All Metadata Field Datasources
tools.description: Tool to search across all metadata field datasources. Use when you need to find values across multiple metadata fields without knowing the specific field ID.

tools.name: Visual Search Assets
tools.description: Tool to find images in your asset library based on visual similarity or content. Use when searching for visually similar images using an image URL, an existing asset, or a text description.

tools.name: Show Folder
tools.description: Tool to list sub-folders within a specified folder. Use when you need to explore folder hierarchy or list nested folders.

tools.name: Update Asset Metadata
tools.description: Tool to populate or update metadata field values on one or more Cloudinary assets. Use when you need to set structured metadata on existing assets using their public IDs.

tools.name: Update Folder
tools.description: Tool to rename or move an existing asset folder. Use when you need to change the folder's name or location.

tools.name: Update Live Stream
tools.description: Tool to update a live stream's configuration in Cloudinary. Use when you need to modify the name, idle timeout, or maximum runtime of an existing live stream.

tools.name: Update Live Stream Output
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing live stream output configuration. Use when you need to update the name, URI, stream key, or other settings of a live stream output. Note: Default HLS and archive outputs cannot be updated; only custom simulcast outputs can be modified.

tools.name: Update Metadata Field
tools.description: Tool to update a metadata field definition by external ID. Use when modifying an existing schema field (e.g., changing label or validation) without redefining all properties.

tools.name: Update Metadata Field Datasource
tools.description: Tool to update the datasource (allowed values) for a metadata field. Use when replacing or modifying the predefined list of values for enum or set type metadata fields.

tools.name: Update Metadata Rule
tools.description: Tool to update an existing conditional metadata rule. Use when you need to modify the name, condition, result, state, or position of a metadata rule.

tools.name: Update Resource by Asset ID
tools.description: Tool to update asset properties by asset ID in Cloudinary. Use when you need to modify tags, metadata, display name, or other asset properties using the immutable asset ID.

tools.name: Update Resource by Public ID
tools.description: Tool to update asset properties by public ID in Cloudinary. Use when you need to modify tags, metadata, display name, or other asset properties without re-uploading.

tools.name: Update Resource Tags
tools.description: Tool to add, remove, replace, or remove all tags for one or more Cloudinary assets. Use when you need to manage tags on existing assets without re-uploading them. Constraint: Maximum 1000 total operations (public_ids * tags <= 1000).

tools.name: Update Streaming Profile
tools.description: Tool to modify an existing adaptive streaming profile's configuration. Use when you need to update video quality settings for an existing profile. The updated profile will contain the new representations and display name specified in the request.

tools.name: Update Transformation (v2)
tools.description: Tool to update the definition of an existing named transformation. Use when you need to modify transformation parameters or strict mode settings for a transformation.

tools.name: Update Trigger
tools.description: Tool to update the callback URL of an existing webhook trigger. Use when you need to change the notification endpoint for a trigger by its ID.

tools.name: Update Upload Mapping
tools.description: Tool to update an existing upload mapping by changing its remote URL template. Use when you need to modify the URL prefix for an existing folder mapping.

tools.name: Update Upload Preset
tools.description: Tool to update an existing upload preset's configuration settings. Use when modifying preset options like tags, transformations, or analysis features.

tools.name: Upload Asset
tools.description: Tool to upload media assets (images, videos, raw files) to Cloudinary. Use when you need to upload files from local storage or remote URLs. Supports both synchronous and asynchronous uploads with various transformation and analysis options.

tools.name: Upload File Chunk
tools.description: Tool to upload a single chunk of a large file to Cloudinary. Use when implementing chunked upload for large files. All chunks of the same file must use the same x_unique_upload_id. The final chunk triggers processing and returns the complete upload response.

tools.name: Upload File (Auto Detect)
tools.description: Tool to upload files with automatic resource type detection. Use when uploading images, videos, or raw files without specifying the type. Cloudinary automatically detects whether the file is an image, video, or raw file based on its content.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Cloudinary cloud name. Found on the Programmable Media page of your Cloudinary console.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Cloudinary API secret. Found on the Programmable Media page of your Cloudinary console.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your Cloudinary API key. Found on the Programmable Media page of your Cloudinary console.

name: Cloudlayer
description: cloudlayer.io is a document and asset generation service that enables users to dynamically create PDFs and images through a REST-based API, SDKs, or no-code integrations.

tools.name: Add Storage
tools.description: Add a user-owned S3-compatible storage configuration for storing generated assets. This action allows Enterprise plan users to configure their own S3-compatible storage (AWS S3, DigitalOcean Spaces, Wasabi, MinIO, etc.) instead of using the built-in cloud storage included with Cloudlayer accounts. Note: User storage is only available on Enterprise plans. Standard plans will receive an 'allowed: false' response indicating the feature requires a plan upgrade.

tools.name: Convert HTML to Image (V2)
tools.description: Convert HTML content to an image (PNG, JPG, or WebP) using the v2 API endpoint. Renders the provided HTML string using a headless browser and returns job details with the generated image asset. Supports various rendering options including viewport configuration, transparency, auto-scroll, and custom wait conditions.

tools.name: Convert HTML to PDF (v2)
tools.description: Tool to convert HTML content to PDF using CloudLayer v2 API. Use when you need to generate a PDF from raw HTML with advanced options like custom paper size, margins, headers/footers, and viewport settings. The HTML is automatically Base64 encoded before sending to the API.

tools.name: Convert URL to PDF (Simple)
tools.description: Tool to convert a URL to PDF using GET request. Use when you need quick PDF conversion with minimal parameters and immediate result.

tools.name: Delete Storage Configuration
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific user storage configuration. Use when you need to remove an external bucket configuration by its ID after confirming the ID is correct.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Cloudlayer account usage, credits, and document counts. Use when monitoring account limits and subscription status.

tools.name: Get Asset
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific asset by its ID. Use when you need to fetch metadata or download URL of an existing asset after its generation.

tools.name: Get Job By ID
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific Cloudlayer job by its ID. Use this to check the status of an async job, get the asset download URL after completion, or view job parameters. Returns 401 if the job ID doesn't exist or doesn't belong to your account.

tools.name: Get API Status
tools.description: Tool to test API reachability. Use when checking if the Cloudlayer API is available.

tools.name: Get Storage Configuration by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific storage configuration by its ID. Use when you need to inspect or validate details of a user storage configuration.

tools.name: List Assets
tools.description: List assets in your CloudLayer account with cursor-based pagination. Returns PDFs and images generated via HTML/URL conversion jobs. Use this to find asset IDs for further operations like downloading or deleting assets.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: List jobs in your CloudLayer account with cursor-based pagination. Use when you need to view your recent jobs and their statuses.

tools.name: List Storage Configurations
tools.description: Retrieves all user storage configurations (S3-compatible buckets) for the authenticated Cloudlayer account. Use this to view configured external storage destinations where generated documents can be saved. Note: User Storage is an Enterprise plan feature. Non-Enterprise accounts will receive an empty list.

tools.name: Template to PDF
tools.description: Generate a PDF document from an HTML/Nunjucks template with dynamic data. Provide either: - A `templateId` for predefined templates from CloudLayer's template library, OR - A base64-encoded `template` string containing custom HTML/Nunjucks markup. The `data` parameter populates template variables (e.g., {{name}}, {{items}}) with your JSON data. By default, jobs run asynchronously and return a job ID to poll for completion via get_job_by_id.

tools.name: Convert URL to Image
tools.description: Converts a webpage URL to an image (PNG, JPG, or WebP). Supports custom viewport settings, wait conditions, transparency, auto-scroll, and thumbnail preview generation. The API is asynchronous - use the returned job ID to poll for results.

tools.name: Convert URL to PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert a URL to PDF with full parameter support. Use when you need advanced control over paper size, margins, headers/footers, or webhook callbacks.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your cloudlayer.io API Key, which can be obtained from the API Keys section in your account settings.

name: CloudPDF
description: CloudPDF provides APIs for creating, uploading, managing, and securely sharing PDF documents and webhooks.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a CloudPDF webhook subscription for selected document, collection, tracker, lead, or file-processing events.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Permanently delete one known CloudPDF document by UUID. This destructive operation is irreversible, and CloudPDF provides no recovery endpoint.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete one CloudPDF webhook subscription by its decimal ID.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the connected CloudPDF organization's plan, allowances, and current upload, view, and storage usage.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Retrieve one CloudPDF document by ID, including metadata, default permissions, and current file processing status.

tools.name: Get Document File
tools.description: Retrieve one known CloudPDF file version and its processing status. This returns file metadata, not the PDF bytes.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieve one CloudPDF webhook subscription by its ID.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Return all webhook subscriptions configured for the connected CloudPDF organization.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Update selected metadata or default-permission fields on a known CloudPDF document without requiring unchanged values to be resent.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update selected fields of a CloudPDF webhook subscription without requiring unchanged values to be resent.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to the CloudPDF Dashboard, open Settings -> API Keys, and copy the credential labeled Simple API Key. Do not enter the Cloud Name or API Secret used for signed JWT authentication. The key is sent raw in X-Authorization without a Bearer prefix and must be kept secret.

name: Cloudpress
description: Cloudpress enables exporting content from Google Docs and Notion to various Content Management Systems.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve authenticated account information. Use after authentication to get current account details.

tools.name: List Collections
tools.description: Tool to list all collections in the user's Cloudpress account. Use when you need to browse or manage collection metadata. Supports pagination via pageNo and pageSize.

tools.name: List Connections
tools.description: Tool to list all connections with pagination. Use when you need to retrieve Cloudpress connections page by page with optional filters like kind, type, or sourceReference.

tools.name: List Document Exports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of document exports. Use after initiating export jobs to fetch export history.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of webhooks. Use when you need an overview of all configured webhooks.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal access token for authenticating with the Cloudpress API.

name: Cloudsmith
description: Cloudsmith is a cloud-native artifact management platform for securely managing, distributing, and governing software packages across teams and repositories.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Return the identity authenticated by the connected Cloudsmith API key. Fails if Cloudsmith reports authenticated=false, even when the HTTP response is 200.

tools.name: Get Package
tools.description: Get metadata, status, checksums, licensing, and security state for one package in a Cloudsmith repository.

tools.name: Get Quota
tools.description: Return current storage and bandwidth usage and allowances for a Cloudsmith namespace without inferring a billing plan name.

tools.name: Get Rate Limits
tools.description: Return Cloudsmith's current per-resource request limits, remaining counts, intervals, and throttling state for the authenticated principal.

tools.name: Get Repository
tools.description: Get configuration, visibility, usage, and capability details for one Cloudsmith repository without returning repository signing keys or certificates.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: List Cloudsmith organizations associated with the authenticated principal so an agent can discover namespace slugs for later calls.

tools.name: List Repository Vulnerabilities
tools.description: List vulnerability scan summaries for packages in a Cloudsmith repository.

tools.name: Search Audit Log
tools.description: Search paginated audit events for a Cloudsmith namespace by event, actor, or timestamp text.

tools.name: Search Packages
tools.description: Search packages in a Cloudsmith repository by name, filename, version, distribution, architecture, format, or status.

tools.name: Search Repositories
tools.description: Search and list repositories within a Cloudsmith namespace, returning identifiers and summary state without repository signing keys.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or select a service account in your Cloudsmith workspace settings, then copy the API key shown when the service account is created or its key is rotated. Grant the service account only the workspace and repository privileges required for your automation.

name: Clover
description: Manage Clover merchant, inventory, customer, employee, order, payment, cash, notification, app, and print data through the regional Platform REST API.

tools.name: Apply Modification To Line Item
tools.description: Applies a modifier to an order line item and snapshots the modifier's current name and price as a modification record.

tools.name: Apply Order Service Charge
tools.description: Applies a configured merchant service charge or creates an ad-hoc order-fee line item on an order. Choose `mode` explicitly so Clover receives the matching body and route.

tools.name: Checkout Atomic Order
tools.description: Calculates and previews an order cart, including totals, taxes, discounts, and service charges, without persisting an order.

tools.name: Create Address For Customer
tools.description: Adds a postal address to an existing customer record; it does not create the customer.

tools.name: Create App Billing Metered Event
tools.description: Records metered app usage and bills the merchant at the configured price; `count` defaults to 1. This is irreversible, so verify an uncertain result before retrying to avoid billing twice.

tools.name: Create Atomic Order
tools.description: Creates an order with line items, modifiers, discounts, and service charges while Clover calculates inventory-based totals and taxes. Maximum 3,000 line items.

tools.name: Create Attribute
tools.description: Creates an inventory variant attribute within an item group, optionally with its initial options.

tools.name: Create Authorization On Payment
tools.description: Create an authorization for a payment. This has financial consequences and is not safely retryable without first checking whether Clover created the authorization.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Creates a customer record for the connected merchant with the supplied identity and contact details.

tools.name: Create Customer Card
tools.description: Creates a vaulted credit or debit card record for a customer. `first6` and `last4` are required.

tools.name: Create Discount
tools.description: Creates a merchant inventory discount with a fixed amount or percentage for later application.

tools.name: Create Discount On Line Item
tools.description: Applies a named fixed-amount or percentage discount to one order line item.

tools.name: Create Discount On Order
tools.description: Applies a named fixed-amount or percentage discount to an order subtotal, not a specific line item.

tools.name: Create Email Address For Customer
tools.description: Adds an email address to an existing customer record; it does not create the customer.

tools.name: Create Employee
tools.description: Creates a merchant employee profile with a required name and optional login, contact, and role details.

tools.name: Create Inventory Item
tools.description: Creates an inventory item. Clover ignores `available=false` during creation and creates the item as available; call Update Inventory Item afterward to make it unavailable.

tools.name: Create Item Category
tools.description: Creates an inventory category used to organize items in Clover Register.

tools.name: Create Item Category Associations
tools.description: Creates one or more associations between inventory items and categories or subcategories. Every tuple requires both `category.id` and `item.id`.

tools.name: Create Item Group
tools.description: Creates an item group for related inventory variants and their attributes.

tools.name: Create Item Modifier Group Associations
tools.description: Creates an association between an inventory item and a modifier group so the group's modifiers can be applied to that item. Provide both `modifierGroup.id` and `item.id`.

tools.name: Create Item Option Associations
tools.description: Creates one or more associations between Clover options and inventory items. Every tuple requires both `option.id` and `item.id`.

tools.name: Create Item Stock
tools.description: Creates the stock quantity and optional low-stock alert threshold for one inventory item.

tools.name: Create Item Tax Rate Associations
tools.description: Creates one or more associations between inventory items and tax rates. Every tuple requires both `item.id` and `taxRate.id`.

tools.name: Create Merchant Opening Hours
tools.description: Creates merchant opening hours. Supply all seven weekday arrays and use an empty array for every closed day; for example, `{'sunday': [], 'monday': [{'start': 900, 'end': 1700}], 'tuesday': [], 'wednesday': [], 'thursday': [], 'friday': [], 'saturday': []}`.

tools.name: Create Modifier
tools.description: Creates a named modifier with a price adjustment inside a specific modifier group.

tools.name: Create Modifier Group
tools.description: Creates a new modifier group. After you create a modifier group, you can associate modifiers with the group.

tools.name: Create Multiple Inventory Items
tools.description: Creates multiple inventory items in one request; use Update Inventory Items to patch existing items instead.

tools.name: Create Notification For App
tools.description: Send a message to devices that have the connected Clover app installed and are listening for notifications. Delivery is irreversible and cannot be recalled; verify an uncertain result before retrying to avoid duplicate delivery.

tools.name: Create Notification For Device
tools.description: Push a message to a device that has the connected Clover app installed and is listening for notifications. Delivery is irreversible and cannot be recalled; verify an uncertain result before retrying to avoid duplicate delivery.

tools.name: Create Option
tools.description: Creates a named option within an inventory attribute, such as `Small` for a `Size` attribute.

tools.name: Create Order Line Item
tools.description: Creates one line item for a standard or Multiple Service Charges order; provide `price` or `item.id`. Orders allow 2,500 line items with Multiple Service Charges and 3,000 otherwise.

tools.name: Create Order Line Items Bulk
tools.description: Creates up to 100 priced line items for either a standard or Multiple Service Charges order. The order limit is 2,500 line items with Multiple Service Charges and 3,000 otherwise.

tools.name: Create Order Type Category Associations
tools.description: Creates associations that limit an order type to specific merchant categories. Every tuple requires both resource IDs.

tools.name: Create Order Type For Merchant
tools.description: Creates a custom order type for the merchant, such as dine-in, delivery, or takeout.

tools.name: Create Payment Record On Order
tools.description: Records an externally processed payment on an order for bookkeeping; it does not process a Clover credit or debit payment. Requires a positive amount and merchant tender ID.

tools.name: Create Phone Number For Customer
tools.description: Adds a phone number to an existing customer record; it does not create the customer.

tools.name: Create Role
tools.description: Creates a merchant employee role based on a Clover system role.

tools.name: Create Shift For Employee
tools.description: Creates a time-clock shift for one employee, including clock-in/out times, cash tips, or override details.

tools.name: Create Subcategory
tools.description: Creates a subcategory within a parent inventory category; it inherits the parent's color when one is set.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Creates an inventory tag for reporting, with optional item and printer associations.

tools.name: Create Tag Item Associations
tools.description: Creates one or more associations between Clover tags and inventory items. Every tuple requires both `tag.id` and `item.id`.

tools.name: Create Tax Rate
tools.description: Creates a merchant tax rate as a percentage or flat amount, optionally making it the default or associating items.

tools.name: Create Tender
tools.description: Creates a merchant-level custom tender and returns its generated identifier.

tools.name: Delete All Line Items In Order
tools.description: Deletes every line item from an order. This is destructive; verify the order before calling.

tools.name: Delete App Billing Metered Event
tools.description: Deletes an unbilled app metered event. Billed events cannot be deleted; verify the event before calling.

tools.name: Delete Attribute
tools.description: Deletes an inventory variant attribute. This is destructive; verify the attribute identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Authorization
tools.description: Permanently delete a payment authorization. Only target an authorization the caller intends to remove; repeat only after confirming whether the first request succeeded.

tools.name: Delete Categories
tools.description: Permanently deletes the categories identified by a comma-separated list of category IDs. Get IDs from List Categories and target only categories you intend to delete.

tools.name: Delete Customer
tools.description: Deletes a customer from the connected merchant. This is destructive; verify the customer identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Customer Address
tools.description: Deletes one address from a customer. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Customer Card
tools.description: Deletes one vaulted card record from a customer. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Customer Email Address
tools.description: Deletes one email address from a customer. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Customer Phone Number
tools.description: Deletes one phone number from a customer. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Employee
tools.description: Deletes an employee from the connected merchant. This is destructive; verify the employee identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Inventory Discount
tools.description: Deletes a merchant inventory discount. This is destructive; verify the discount identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Inventory Item
tools.description: Deletes an inventory item. This is destructive; verify the item identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Item Category
tools.description: Deletes an inventory category. This is destructive; verify the category identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Item Group
tools.description: Deletes an inventory item group. This is destructive; verify the group identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Item Stock
tools.description: Deletes the stock record for an inventory item. This is destructive; verify the item identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Line Item Discount
tools.description: Removes a discount from an order line item. This changes order pricing; verify all identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Merchant Opening Hours
tools.description: Deletes one merchant opening-hours interval. This is destructive; verify the interval identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Modifier
tools.description: Deletes one modifier from a modifier group. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Modifier Group
tools.description: Deletes a modifier group and every modifier in it. This is destructive; verify the group identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Modifier Groups
tools.description: Permanently deletes the modifier groups identified by a comma-separated list of IDs, including every modifier in those groups. Get IDs from List Modifier Groups.

tools.name: Delete Multiple Inventory Items
tools.description: Permanently deletes the inventory items identified by a comma-separated list of item IDs. Get IDs from List Inventory Items and target only intended items.

tools.name: Delete Option
tools.description: Deletes an option from an inventory attribute. This is destructive; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Order
tools.description: Deletes an order. This is destructive; verify the order identifier and current state before calling.

tools.name: Delete Order Discount
tools.description: Removes a discount from an order. This changes order pricing; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Order Line Item
tools.description: Deletes a line item from an order. This is destructive and changes the order; verify both identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Delete Order Type
tools.description: Deletes a merchant order type. This is destructive; verify the order-type identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Role
tools.description: Deletes a merchant employee role. This is destructive; verify the role identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Shift
tools.description: Deletes one employee shift. Clover requires `account_id` to identify an employee permitted to edit shifts.

tools.name: Delete Subcategory
tools.description: Deletes a subcategory and reassigns its items to the parent category. This is destructive; verify the subcategory identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Deletes an inventory tag. This is destructive; verify the tag identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Tags
tools.description: Permanently deletes the tags identified by a comma-separated list of tag IDs. Get IDs from List Tags and target only intended tags.

tools.name: Delete Tax Rate
tools.description: Deletes a merchant tax rate. This is destructive; verify the tax-rate identifier before calling.

tools.name: Delete Tender
tools.description: Deletes a merchant tender. This is destructive; verify the tender identifier before calling.

tools.name: Exchange Order Line Item
tools.description: Creates a replacement line item under the client-supplied `line_item_id` and exchanges `old_line_item_id` for it. Provide `price` or `item.id`; Clover's required matching body ID is supplied automatically.

tools.name: Export Customers Csv
tools.description: Exports customers as CSV. Use `filter` to export only matching customers and `expand` to include selected related address, contact, card, or metadata fields.

tools.name: Export Shifts CSV
tools.description: Exports merchant shifts as CSV for a required effective clock-in time window.

tools.name: Get App Billing Metered Event
tools.description: Returns one metered billing event recorded for a merchant's app subscription.

tools.name: Get Attribute
tools.description: Returns one inventory variant attribute with the item-group and option references present in Clover's response.

tools.name: Get Authorization
tools.description: Retrieve one Clover payment authorization by identifier.

tools.name: Get Category
tools.description: Returns one inventory category, including its Register sort order and optional item expansion.

tools.name: Get Configured Service Charge
tools.description: Returns one service charge configured for the merchant, identified by `service_charge_id`.

tools.name: Get Credit Refund
tools.description: Retrieve one Clover credit refund, including its credit, order, device, employee, and transaction details.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Returns one customer profile, with addresses, email addresses, phone numbers, cards, or metadata when expanded.

tools.name: Get Default Service Charge
tools.description: Returns the merchant's default configured service charge.

tools.name: Get Device Provisioned To Merchant
tools.description: Returns one Clover device provisioned to the connected merchant.

tools.name: Get Discount
tools.description: Returns one merchant inventory discount, including its fixed amount or percentage.

tools.name: Get Employee
tools.description: Returns one merchant employee profile, with assigned roles or related shifts, payments, and orders when expanded.

tools.name: Get Inventory Item
tools.description: Returns one inventory item with pricing, availability, SKU, and requested related resources.

tools.name: Get Item Group
tools.description: Returns one inventory item group and its related variants or attributes when expanded.

tools.name: Get Item Stock
tools.description: Returns the current stock quantity and alert threshold for one inventory item.

tools.name: Get Item Subcategory Associations
tools.description: Returns an inventory item and, with `expand=categories.items`, its category and subcategory associations; subcategories have a `parentCategory`.

tools.name: Get Legacy Sync Token
tools.description: Retrieves a provider-deprecated table sync token only for a downstream legacy Clover sync consumer that explicitly requires it. Normal list and filter tools do not produce this token. Clover documents the route, but the sandbox route is known to return 404 in some environments.

tools.name: Get Merchant
tools.description: Returns the connected merchant's business profile and requested related resources.

tools.name: Get Merchant Address
tools.description: Returns the connected merchant's business address.

tools.name: Get Merchant App Billing Information
tools.description: Returns a merchant's app-billing status, including the current subscription tier and trial status.

tools.name: Get Merchant Opening Hours
tools.description: Returns one merchant opening-hours interval by identifier.

tools.name: Get Merchant Payment Gateway Configuration
tools.description: Returns the connected merchant's payment-gateway configuration and supported capabilities.

tools.name: Get Merchant Properties
tools.description: Returns the connected merchant's operational properties and feature settings.

tools.name: Get Modifier
tools.description: Returns one modifier from a specific modifier group, including its name and price adjustment.

tools.name: Get Modifier Group
tools.description: Returns one modifier group and its configuration, with related modifiers or items when expanded.

tools.name: Get Option For Attribute
tools.description: Returns one option from a specific inventory attribute, including its item references.

tools.name: Get Order
tools.description: Returns one order with totals, state, and any related resources requested through `expand`.

tools.name: Get Order Line Item
tools.description: Returns one line item from any order, including age-restriction or Multiple Service Charges fields when Clover provides them.

tools.name: Get Order Type
tools.description: Returns one merchant order type, including taxability and category-filter settings.

tools.name: Get Payment
tools.description: Retrieve one Clover payment, including amount, tax, tip, and result status.

tools.name: Get Print Event
tools.description: Get a print event for the connected Clover merchant by event ID. Successfully printed events are discarded by Clover and cannot be replayed.

tools.name: Get Refund
tools.description: Retrieve one Clover refund, including associated payment, tax, tip, and transaction details.

tools.name: Get Role
tools.description: Returns one merchant employee role and its base system role.

tools.name: Get Service Charge Applied To Order
tools.description: Returns one service-charge line item already applied to an order.

tools.name: Get Shift
tools.description: Retrieves one shift by ID. Set `employee_id` to use Clover's dedicated employee shift operation; omit it to use the merchant shift collection.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Returns one inventory tag and its item or printer associations when expanded.

tools.name: Get Tax Exemption Rule
tools.description: Returns one tax exemption rule that links order types and items to excluded tax rates.

tools.name: Get Tax Rate
tools.description: Returns one merchant tax rate, including its rate, type, and default status.

tools.name: Get Tender
tools.description: Returns one merchant tender and its payment-handling settings.

tools.name: Get Tip Suggestion
tools.description: Returns one merchant tip suggestion, including its percentage or flat amount.

tools.name: Get Voided Line Item Totals
tools.description: Returns deleted line-item and order totals for a required caller-supplied deletedTime window.

tools.name: List App Billing Metered Events
tools.description: Lists billing events recorded for one app metered-event type, such as `reservation`. Requires an OAuth-generated token.

tools.name: List Attributes
tools.description: Lists inventory variant attributes, such as size or color. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Authorizations
tools.description: List payment authorizations for the connected merchant. Authorizations permit a future charge up to the authorized amount.

tools.name: List Cash Events
tools.description: List cash events for the merchant, one device, or one employee. Select `context` and provide `context_id` for device or employee requests.

tools.name: List Categories
tools.description: Lists inventory categories in Register sort order, optionally with associated items. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Categories Of Item
tools.description: Retrieves all categories of an item. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Category Subcategories
tools.description: Returns a category with its subcategories expanded by default; use `subCategories.items` only when nested item details are also needed.

tools.name: List Configured Service Charges
tools.description: Lists service charges configured for the merchant; use the applied-service-charge tools for charges already attached to an order.

tools.name: List Credit Refunds
tools.description: List credit refunds for the connected merchant, including associated tax and transaction details.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Lists customer records for the connected merchant, optionally filtered or expanded with related contact data.

tools.name: List Devices Provisioned To Merchant
tools.description: Lists Clover devices provisioned to the connected merchant, optionally filtered by documented device fields.

tools.name: List Discounts
tools.description: Lists the merchant's inventory discounts. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request successive offsets until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Discounts For Order
tools.description: Lists discounts currently applied at the order level; line-item discounts are returned by the line-item tools.

tools.name: List Employee Orders
tools.description: Lists one employee's orders through Clover's exact `/employees/{empId}/orders` route, which requires `Read employees`, while preserving a caller-supplied custom `filter`. Use List Orders instead for the merchant `/orders` route and its `Read orders` permission.

tools.name: List Employees
tools.description: List employees for the connected Clover merchant, optionally filtered or expanded.

tools.name: List Inventory Items
tools.description: Lists inventory items for the connected merchant. Returns one caller-selected offset page; increase offset by the page size until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Inventory Without Revenue Class
tools.description: Lists inventory items that have no revenue-class tag. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Item Groups
tools.description: Lists item groups used to organize related inventory variants and attributes. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Items By Tax Rate
tools.description: Lists inventory items associated with the specified tax rate.

tools.name: List Items For Tag
tools.description: Lists inventory items associated with one tag.

tools.name: List Items In Category
tools.description: Retrieves all items in a category. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Items In Modifier Group
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all items in a single modifier group. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Item Stocks
tools.description: Lists stock quantities and alert thresholds for the merchant's inventory items.

tools.name: List Item Tags
tools.description: Lists inventory tags associated with one item.

tools.name: List Merchant Opening Hours
tools.description: Lists the connected merchant's opening-hours intervals.

tools.name: List Modifier Groups
tools.description: Lists modifier groups that organize selectable item modifiers. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Modifiers
tools.description: Retrieves all modifiers from all modifier groups. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Modifiers In Modifier Group
tools.description: Retrieves a list of modifiers in a single modifier group. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Options
tools.description: Lists options across all inventory variant attributes. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Options For Attribute
tools.description: Retrieves all available variants or options associated with an attribute. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Order Line Items
tools.description: Lists line items from any order, including age-restriction or Multiple Service Charges fields when Clover provides them.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Lists orders through Clover's merchant `/orders` route, which requires `Read orders`, with filtering, expansion, and offset pagination. Set `employee_id` for an employee-filtered merchant-route view; use List Employee Orders for the exact employee route, its `Read employees` permission, and preservation of a custom `filter`.

tools.name: List Order Types
tools.description: Lists merchant-defined order types and their system-type or category settings. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Payments
tools.description: List payments for the merchant, one order, or one employee. Select `context` and provide `context_id` for order or employee requests.

tools.name: List Refunds
tools.description: List merchant refunds, including taxes and tips. Clover returns at most 90 days and automatically narrows wider time filters to the most recent 90 days.

tools.name: List Roles
tools.description: Retrieves all system and employee roles for a merchant's business. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Service Charges Applied To Order
tools.description: Lists service-charge line items already applied to an order; use configured-service-charge tools for merchant templates.

tools.name: List Shifts
tools.description: List shifts for the connected merchant or, when `employee_id` is provided, for one employee. Filters, expansions, and offset pagination apply to either route.

tools.name: List System Order Types
tools.description: Lists Clover's system order-type categories used to classify merchant-defined order types, such as takeout.

tools.name: List Tag Item Associations
tools.description: Lists every association between the merchant's inventory tags and items.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: Lists the merchant's inventory tags. Tags label items for reporting and can route tagged items to associated printers. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request successive offsets until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Tax Exemption Rules
tools.description: Lists tax exemption rules that link order types and items to tax rates excluded from those items.

tools.name: List Tax Rates
tools.description: Lists percentage and flat-amount tax rates. Returns one offset page; continue until `elements` is empty.

tools.name: List Tenders
tools.description: Retrieves all tenders for a merchant. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: List Tip Suggestions
tools.description: Retrieves all tip suggestions for a merchant, for example: flat tip or percentage. Returns one caller-selected offset page; request another offset until elements is empty.

tools.name: Record Voided Line Items
tools.description: Records voided line items on an order for reporting, including their quantities and reasons.

tools.name: Remove Item Category Associations
tools.description: Permanently removes specific item-category associations or all associations on one supplied side. Review one-sided tuples carefully because they can remove many links.

tools.name: Remove Item Modifier Group Associations
tools.description: Permanently removes a specific item-modifier-group association or all associations on one supplied side. Review one-sided bodies carefully because they can remove many links.

tools.name: Remove Item Option Associations
tools.description: Permanently removes specific option-item associations or all associations on one supplied side. Review one-sided tuples carefully because they can remove many links.

tools.name: Remove Item Tax Rate Associations
tools.description: Permanently removes specific item-tax-rate associations or all associations on one supplied side. Review one-sided tuples carefully because they can remove many links.

tools.name: Remove Modification From Line Item
tools.description: Removes an applied modifier snapshot from an order line item. This is destructive; verify all identifiers before calling.

tools.name: Remove Order Service Charge
tools.description: Permanently removes a configured service charge or order-fee line item from an order. Verify `mode`, `order_id`, and `service_charge_id` before calling; the removal is destructive.

tools.name: Remove Tag Item Associations
tools.description: Permanently removes specific tag-item associations or all associations on one supplied side. Review one-sided tuples carefully because they can remove many links.

tools.name: Submit Print Request
tools.description: Queues content for the merchant's default order printer. Printing is an external side effect; verify an uncertain result before retrying.

tools.name: Update Address For Customer
tools.description: Updates one postal address on an existing customer record.

tools.name: Update Attribute
tools.description: Updates an inventory variant attribute, including its name, item group, or option references.

tools.name: Update Authorization
tools.description: Update a payment authorization. This can alter a future charge permission; verify the current authorization and do not blindly retry an uncertain result.

tools.name: Update Category
tools.description: Updates an inventory category's name, Register sort order, color, or item associations.

tools.name: Update Category Sort Orders
tools.description: Updates Register menu sort positions for up to 1,000 inventory categories in one request.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Updates one customer's identity, contact, marketing, or metadata fields using the supplied values.

tools.name: Update Customer Card
tools.description: Updates a customer's vaulted credit or debit card record. `first6` and `last4` are required.

tools.name: Update Discount
tools.description: Updates a merchant inventory discount's name, fixed amount, percentage, or approval reference.

tools.name: Update Email Address For Customer
tools.description: Updates one email address on an existing customer record.

tools.name: Update Employee
tools.description: Updates one employee's name, login, contact, or role details using the supplied fields.

tools.name: Update Inventory Item
tools.description: Updates one inventory item's supplied fields. Unlike creation, this action accepts `available=false` and makes the item unavailable.

tools.name: Update Inventory Items
tools.description: Patches multiple existing inventory items in one request without replacing omitted fields; use Create Multiple Inventory Items for new records.

tools.name: Update Item Group
tools.description: Updates an inventory item group's name, member items, or variant attributes.

tools.name: Update Item Stock
tools.description: Updates the stock quantity or low-stock alert threshold for one inventory item.

tools.name: Update Merchant
tools.description: Updates the connected merchant's business profile using the supplied fields.

name: Clueso MCP
description: Create and edit Clueso product videos, documentation articles, clips, voiceovers, captions, animations, and exports through Clueso's hosted MCP server.

tools.name: Add article media
tools.description:
Add a screenshot or GIF to the article. Returns a screenshot_id to place in the article via update_article using `<SCREENSHOT screenshot_id>`.

- kind="image": one of `timestamp` (capture a frame from the project's base video), `mcp_upload_id` (an uploaded image: `mup_…` from upload_file, or a Clueso upload_id) or `source_url` (an image URL, e.g. one generate_media returned).
- kind="gif": pass `timestamp` (start) and `duration` (seconds). Captures a short GIF clip from the base video. Requires the project to have a video clip.

tools.name: Add audio
tools.description:
Add a music track or sound effect that plays as a project-level audio layer over all clips. Does NOT consume a clip slot. Use this for background music or a soundtrack that should play under the existing timeline. (For inserting an audio file as its own sequential clip with auto-transcription, use add_clips(kind='video') with an audio mime_type instead.)

- type="music": requires src. `src` is the `src` from a find(type='music') result (pass with its name and duration as source_duration), or an upload: an mcp_upload_id (`mup_`) from upload_file or a Clueso upload_id, whose name and duration are filled in for you. For a Freesound result the `src` is an opaque handle; pass it through unchanged and Clueso downloads + hosts the original server-side (do not try to fetch it yourself). Anything not from find has its duration probed. Optional: guide_start_time, guide_end_time, music_start_time, music_end_time (trim the source track), volume, loop, fade_in, fade_out. A user's own upload is also saved to the project's media panel (saved_to_media_panel).
- type="sfx": pass the `src`, `name`, and `source_duration` from a find(type='sfx') result (or an upload as `src`), plus guide_start_time (Freesound `src` is an opaque handle, resolved server-side just like music). Optional: volume. (Legacy: a fixed-library `sfx_key` like 'whoosh' still works instead of src.)

Concurrency: whole-project mutation (conflict domain: the entire project) — serialize; do not run in parallel with ANY other mutation on the same project_id (including element/voiceover edits). Size your clips BEFORE calling add_audio, or pass guide_end_time explicitly — the default ('end of project') is captured at call time and will NOT auto-extend if clips are added or resized afterwards.

tools.name: Add clips
tools.description:
Create new clips on a project. One tool, four sources:

- kind="blank": empty slide clips you'll populate with add_elements / generate_media. Pass `clips: [{title?, duration?}, ...]`. Note: create_project already creates clip 0; calling with N blank entries gives N+1 clips total.
- kind="pptx": extract slides from an uploaded .ppt/.pptx. Pass `mcp_upload_id` (from upload_file), optional `slide_indices`. Each slide becomes a slide_clip with native text/image/shape elements pre-populated.
- kind="video": cut clips from an uploaded video/audio. Pass `mcp_upload_id` and optionally `mime_type` (default video/mp4), `title`, `voiceover_text`, `cuts: [{start_seconds, end_seconds, heading?}]`, `auto_elements`. Without `cuts` the whole upload becomes one clip. Pipeline (download → transcribe → insert) runs in the background; subsequent calls on the same upload hit a 24h cache and return synchronously. (To overlay a video ONTO an existing clip — picture-in-picture, b-roll, background loop — rather than insert it as its own clip, use add_elements(element_type='video') instead.)
  - Re-cut clips already on the timeline: pass `source_start_clip_id`, `source_end_clip_id` (a run of video clips from one recording, inclusive) and `cuts` instead of an upload. The run is replaced in place by one clip per cut; cut seconds are on the run's own clock (0 = start of the first clip). Recording cut out between the clips counts back in, so a cut across it restores that footage (`restored_gap_seconds`).
- kind="template": one clip from a clip template (find(type='clip_templates')). Pass `template_id` and `text_overrides` (strings for the template's text elements in document order; a missing or empty one keeps the placeholder — fill them with the user's words). `after_clip_id` is REQUIRED: ask the user where it goes, never guess. Insert only; a template whose aspect ratio differs from the project is refused (`aspect_mismatch` — pick another). The clip inherits the project's voice.

All variants accept `after_clip_id` to control insertion position; appends at end if omitted (except kind="template").

Concurrency: whole-project mutation (conflict domain: the entire project) — serialize. Do not run it in parallel with ANY other mutation on the same project_id, including element/voiceover edits; run them one at a time. (Mutations to different projects run in parallel freely.)

tools.name: Add comment
tools.description:
Post a review comment on a project, attributed to "Clueso AI".

Use this to leave feedback, suggestions, or notes — either at the project level (no clip_id) or pinned to a specific clip with an optional timestamp inside that clip.

Pass `parent_comment_id` to REPLY to an existing comment rather than open a new thread. Read what is already there with `get_comments` first: answering a reviewer in their own thread is what makes the note resolvable, where a fresh top-level comment just adds noise.

tools.name: Add elements
tools.description:
Add many elements across one or more clips in a single tool call. Replaces the per-element tool — always batch.

SEND LESS. Most batches repeat themselves — the same clip_index, element_type, font_setting, alignment or gradientSetting on every item. Hoist those into `defaults` and send them once; each item then carries only what differs, and overrides any key it sets (type_data merges one level). On a 20-30 element batch this typically cuts the call by a quarter to a half. `returning` shapes the response the way `select` shapes a get_clip read.

  defaults: { clip_index: 2, element_type: 'text', type_data: { font_setting: { font: 'Inter', weight: '600' }, alignment: 'center' } }
  elements: [ { name: 'headline', x: 960, y: 400, type_data: { text: 'Hello', fontSize: 120 } }, ... ]

Use after calling get_element_schema to confirm the type_data shape per element_type. Items within one call are applied in order; returns one result entry per input item so partial success is fine.

Native is the default; compute boxes and eased keyframes in run_script (layout.row/grid/split, anim.stagger, native.box/text/tween — worked example: get_design_guide({topic: "stdlib", query: "native-elements"})). An `animation` item with `code` lands as a draft you refine in place with edit_animation(element_id, project_id).

Across a cut: an item `{continue_from: <element_id or group id>, clip_index?, start_time?, end_time?, type_data?: {animation_setting: {exit}}}` carries that element, group or animation into the next clip (or clip_index) as it was at its end, so consecutive scenes in one world don't reset; end_time and an exit let it leave on time. It returns the new element_ids and end_state: the transform the copy starts with, as applied (positionX, positionY, width, height, rotation and held values such as opacity or scale; for a group {group, elements: {<id>: state}}), so a keyframe that starts from it continues without a jump.

Reuse instead of rebuilding: an item may pass `component_id` INSTEAD of element_type/type_data to insert a saved component from this workspace exactly as stored — no generation, instant — returning every new element_id plus its parameter_schema; set its content afterwards with update_elements(type_data.parameter_values). Find them with find(type='element_components'). Use `base_component_id` (with element_type='animation' and a prompt) only when you want a NEW variant rather than that component.

Z-order: list position IS z-index — later renders on top — and a new element goes on top by default. Pass `insert_at: 'back'` to put it behind what's already there, or `insert_at: {before: id}` / `{after: id}` to land next to a specific element — that also puts the new element in THAT node's group, which is the only way to place inside one. `reorder_elements` rewrites the whole order in one call, grouped clips included.

`group` + `insert_at: {before|after}` together: what the reference is relative to decides what gets positioned. Point at a node INSIDE the group and the ELEMENT takes that slot among its new siblings. Point at one OUTSIDE it and the GROUP takes that slot, with the element inside — which is how you put a backdrop pattern of N elements at a chosen depth as one hideable unit: hoist both into `defaults` and the first item seats the group, the rest just join it. The one refusal left is naming a reference outside a group that already exists somewhere else, since moving an established group is not what adding one element to it should do; seat the group where you want it in the call that CREATES it, because there is no reposition afterwards. `front`/`back` with a `group` follow the same principle: they address the GROUP only while the element is alone in it — the call that creates it — and once the group has other members they address the ELEMENT within the group's interior, so they will not move an established group either.

Grouping (`group: "<name>"`) never changes coordinates but does affect z-order: a group's members render contiguously at the group's slot, and a NEW group takes the slot of its first member, so grouping scattered elements pulls them together at the lowest member's slot.

Concurrency: within ONE call every element lands in a single save. Across calls the conflict domain is the CLIP's element list, not the individual element, so you can fan this tool out across parallel subagents targeting DIFFERENT clips. Two concurrent add_elements calls on the SAME clip are NOT safe: every add claims that clip's element list, so the later call is REJECTED ('changed since this edit was based on') and nothing it sent is written — batch all of a clip's elements into ONE call instead. A rejection is not last-write-wins: re-read and re-apply. Do NOT run it concurrently with a whole-clip or whole-project mutation on the same guide (update_clips on that clip, add_clips/remove_clip/split_clip/duplicate_clip, add_audio, update_project) — those rewrite a larger scope and would clobber the element.

Element-type quirks (handled per-item):
  • zoom      → x/y/width/height are ignored; use centerX/centerY in type_data
  • image     → provide x/y/width/height (the clip is located by clip_index; the clip_id input is accepted but unused)
  • animation → x/y/width/height default to the full canvas if omitted (the clip is located by clip_index)
  • avatar    → an AI presenter; type_data.avatarId from find(type='avatars'). Omit x/y for the default bottom-right position (both 0 also means default) and width/height for the default size; width sets the size and height follows the look. The result's `avatar` says whether export will render it and what it costs — read get_element_schema('avatar') before the first one.
For everything else, x/y/width/height are required.
