tools.description: Cancel an active Creem subscription immediately, at the end of its current billing period, or according to the store default. This is a destructive financial operation; confirm the subscription and timing before calling.

tools.name: Close Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: permanently close a credit account in the connected production store. This irreversible action cannot be undone; confirm the account ID before calling.

tools.name: Create Checkout
tools.description: Create a live checkout session in the connected Creem production store for a one-time payment or subscription. The returned checkout_url can accept a real customer payment. custom_price overrides the product's per-unit price for this checkout and must be reviewed carefully before calling.

tools.name: Create Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: create a credit account for a customer in the connected production store, optionally with an initial balance. This is a live financial mutation. Verify the customer ID and initial balance before calling because a successful request creates the account and seeds its balance.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a customer record in the connected Creem production store. This is a live production mutation: a successful call permanently adds a customer.

tools.name: Create Customer Portal Link
tools.description: Generate a sensitive customer portal link for managing billing, subscriptions, and payment methods in the connected Creem production store. Share the returned URL only with the intended customer.

tools.name: Create Discount
tools.description: Create a promotional discount for products in the connected Creem production store. This is a live financial mutation that can reduce customer prices. Confirm the product IDs, fixed amount and currency, or percentage before calling.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Create a product in the connected Creem production store for a one-time payment, free purchase, or subscription. This is a live financial mutation: a successful call creates a purchasable product. Use idempotency_key for safe retries.

tools.name: Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: add credits to a customer credit account in the connected production store and return the resulting ledger transaction. This is an irreversible live financial mutation. Confirm the account, amount, and reference before calling, and reuse the same idempotency key for retries of the same intended credit.

tools.name: Deactivate License
tools.description: Deactivate one device instance for a Creem license key and free its activation slot. This removes that instance's entitlement and access; confirm both the license key and instance ID before calling.

tools.name: Debit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: irreversibly deduct credits from a customer credit account in the connected production store and create a live ledger transaction. Confirm the account, amount, and reference before calling. For retries, reuse the same idempotency key so an uncertain prior attempt cannot become a duplicate debit.

tools.name: Delete Discount
tools.description: Permanently delete a Creem discount code and prevent any further use. This destructive financial operation cannot be undone; confirm the discount ID before calling.

tools.name: Freeze Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: freeze a credit account in the connected production store, preventing new transactions against its live credit balance. This changes financial account state; confirm the account ID before calling.

tools.name: Get Affiliate
tools.description: Retrieve a single affiliate by ID, including referral link, click and conversion counts, and lifetime commission.

tools.name: Get Checkout
tools.description: Retrieve a Creem checkout session by ID, including its status, product, customer, payment relationships, issued licenses, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: retrieve a customer credits account by its unique identifier, including its owner, unit label, status, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Credit Account Balance
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: retrieve a credit account's current projected balance or its balance at an optional historical timestamp.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Retrieve one Creem customer by exactly one lookup field: customer_id or email. Returns the customer's profile and metadata.

tools.name: Get Discount
tools.description: Retrieve Creem discount details by exactly one lookup field: discount_id or discount_code. Returns usage limits, expiration, and discount amount.

tools.name: Get Product
tools.description: Retrieve a single Creem product by its unique identifier.

tools.name: Get Store Metrics
tools.description: Retrieve Creem store counts, revenue, and monthly recurring revenue in integer cents, optionally filtered and grouped by a date range.

tools.name: Get Subscription
tools.description: Retrieve a Creem subscription by ID, including its status, billing cycle, customer, product, items, payment history, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Transaction
tools.description: Retrieve a single Creem transaction by ID, including payment amounts, status, tax details, and associated resource IDs.

tools.name: List Affiliate Commissions
tools.description: Retrieve one page of an affiliate's commissions, optionally filtered by pending, approved, or paid settlement status.

tools.name: List Affiliates
tools.description: Retrieve one page of joined Creem affiliates with referral links, click and conversion counts, and lifetime commission. Invited affiliates who have not joined a program are not included.

tools.name: List Credit Account Entries
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: retrieve one page of a credit account's credit and debit history, with forward or backward ID-based pagination.

tools.name: List Credit Accounts
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: list customer credit accounts for the authenticated store, excluding system accounts. Returns one page at a time. The response and cursor contract may change while this API remains experimental.

tools.name: List Customer Licenses
tools.description: Retrieve one page of license keys for a specific Creem customer. Returns pagination totals and an opaque cursor when another page is available.

tools.name: List Customer Orders
tools.description: Retrieve one page of orders for a specific customer, including monetary details, statuses, related resource IDs, and pagination totals.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Retrieve one page of customers, including customer details and pagination totals. Use next_cursor to continue through additional pages.

tools.name: List Discounts
tools.description: Search and retrieve one page of Creem discounts, optionally filtered by product, status, type, or creation date.

tools.name: List License Instances
tools.description: Retrieve one page of activated instances for a Creem license. Use an instance ID from the response when deactivating a specific instance.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Search and retrieve one page of Creem products, optionally filtered by lifecycle status. Returns an opaque cursor when another page is available.

tools.name: List Subscriptions
tools.description: Retrieve one page of Creem subscriptions across the store or for one customer, including product, customer, billing, transaction, and pagination details.

tools.name: List Transactions
tools.description: Search and retrieve one page of Creem payment transactions, optionally filtered by customer, order, or product.

tools.name: Pause Subscription
tools.description: Pause a Creem production subscription immediately or after its current billing period, stopping live billing while retaining it for later resumption. Confirm the subscription and timing before calling.

tools.name: Refund Payment
tools.description: Issue an irreversible full refund of a payment's entire remaining refundable amount using its transaction ID. Partial refunds are not supported. Confirm the transaction before calling. A `pending` or `requiresAction` response is non-terminal and means provider processing continues asynchronously.

tools.name: Resume Subscription
tools.description: Resume a paused or scheduled-cancel Creem production subscription. This changes live subscription billing; confirm the subscription before calling.

tools.name: Reverse Credit Transaction
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: reverse a previous credit or debit in the connected production store by creating a new compensating transaction; the original transaction remains in the ledger. This is an irreversible live financial mutation. Confirm the account and transaction IDs before calling. The request does not accept an idempotency key, so verify the account ledger before retrying after a timeout, rate limit, or server error.

tools.name: Screen Prompt
tools.description: Evaluate a text prompt against Creem content policies before generation. Warning: this endpoint is experimental and its request, response, or behavior may change without stability guarantees.

tools.name: Unfreeze Credit Account
tools.description: Experimental Creem API: unfreeze a frozen credit account in the connected production store, allowing live credit and debit transactions again. Confirm the account ID before calling. Closed accounts and accounts that are not frozen cannot be unfrozen.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Update the name or metadata of an existing customer in the connected Creem production store. Only supplied fields change; provide at least one change.

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Update at least one field on a product in the connected Creem production store. Only supplied fields change; pricing, currency, billing, and tax changes affect future purchases, and changing the price creates a new default price.

tools.name: Update Subscription
tools.description: Update items, units, seats, or add-ons on a Creem production subscription. This changes live recurring billing; proration-charge-immediately can charge the customer immediately.

tools.name: Upgrade Subscription
tools.description: Upgrade a subscription to a different product or plan in Creem production. This changes live billing and may charge the customer: the default update behavior applies proration and can charge it immediately.

tools.name: Validate License
tools.description: Verify that a Creem license key is valid and active for a specific instance, including its activation status and expiration.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your production Creem API key. In the Creem dashboard, switch to production mode, open Developers at https://creem.io/dashboard/developers, and copy the API key. Test-mode keys do not work with this production toolkit.

name: CrewAI
description: Run deployed CrewAI automations and manage CrewAI AMP SaaS control-plane resources.

tools.name: Get Deployment Logs
tools.description: Return deployment lifecycle logs for a CrewAI deployment UUID to diagnose build or runtime deployment failures.

tools.name: Get Deployment Status
tools.description: Return the current AMP deployment status for one crew UUID from the SaaS control plane.

tools.name: Get Execution Status
tools.description: Return the current state, progress, result, or error for a deployed-crew execution started with a kickoff ID.

tools.name: Get Required Inputs
tools.description: Return the input names required by the connected deployed CrewAI automation before starting an execution.

tools.name: List Crew Deployments
tools.description: List CrewAI crew deployments visible to the selected SaaS organization and return their identifiers for status, logs, or redeployment.

tools.name: Redeploy Crew
tools.description: Trigger a new deployment of an existing CrewAI automation by UUID; this irreversibly changes the live deployment and may replace its runtime URL or token.

tools.name: Resume Crew Execution
tools.description: Approve or retry a human-in-the-loop task and resume its paused CrewAI execution. Resuming may continue externally effectful work.

tools.name: Start Crew Execution
tools.description: Start one execution of the connected deployed CrewAI automation and return its kickoff ID for status checks. The automation may perform irreversible external actions.

required.name: generic_token
required.description: The organization-level Bearer Token shown with the deployed automation URL on the automation Status tab. Enter only the token, without the Bearer prefix; CrewAI actions add that prefix.

required.name: generic_secret
required.description: Your bare CrewAI Personal Access Token from Settings > Account > Personal Access Token. Enter only the token, without the Bearer prefix; CrewAI actions add that prefix. This credential is used only with https://app.crewai.com.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The unique URL for your deployed CrewAI automation, shown on its Status tab, for example https://your-crew-name.crewai.com. Enter the origin without a trailing slash.

optional.name: generic_id_2
optional.description: Optional CrewAI organization UUID used as X-Crewai-Organization-Id for control-plane requests. Find available organization IDs through the CrewAI CLI account or organization selection flow. Leave blank to use the token default.

name: Crisp
description: Crisp is a customer messaging platform for managing conversations, contacts, operators, helpdesk content, campaigns, and workspace settings.

tools.name: Assign Conversation
tools.description: Assign a conversation to one operator or explicitly remove its current operator assignment.

tools.name: Get Conversation
tools.description: Get one conversation's status, assignment, inbox, visitor metadata, unread counts, and latest-message summary.

tools.name: Get People Profile
tools.description: Get one customer profile by its Crisp people ID or exact email address.

tools.name: List Conversation Messages
tools.description: Return a batch of messages from a conversation, optionally before, after, or around one millisecond timestamp.

tools.name: List Conversations
tools.description: List or search workspace conversations with support-focused filters, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Inboxes
tools.description: List configured Crisp inboxes and their operator/team membership, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Operators
tools.description: List workspace operators and pending members with their IDs, roles, and current availability.

tools.name: List People Profiles
tools.description: List or search customer profiles by text, creation date, and sort order, one page at a time.

tools.name: Move Conversation to Inbox
tools.description: Move a conversation to a specific Crisp inbox, or remove its inbox categorization when inbox_id is null.

tools.name: Send Conversation Message
tools.description: Send a visitor-visible text reply to an existing Crisp conversation immediately; this external communication is irreversible.

tools.name: Update Conversation Meta
tools.description: Update support-relevant visitor details, subject, segments, or custom data on a conversation without replacing unspecified fields. Provide at least one field to update.

tools.name: Update Conversation State
tools.description: Set a conversation to pending, unresolved, or resolved.

required.name: prefix.one
required.description: The Website ID for the workspace bound to this token. Find it in Crisp Dashboard > Settings > Workspace Settings > Setup instructions, then copy the Website ID shown for your workspace.

required.name: token_identifier
required.description: The identifier from Crisp Dashboard > Settings > Workspace Settings > Advanced configuration > API Token. Generate a Website Token there and copy the identifier when Crisp displays it; keep it secret.

required.name: token_key
required.description: The key paired with your Website Token in Crisp Dashboard > Settings > Workspace Settings > Advanced configuration > API Token. Copy it when Crisp displays it; it cannot be recovered later and must remain secret.

name: Cronfree Time Scheduler
description: Cronfree Time Scheduler creates and removes recurring webhook schedules using weekday, month, day, hour, minute, and timezone selectors.

tools.name: Create Recurring Webhook Schedule
tools.description: Create a Cronfree schedule that repeatedly POSTs to a webhook URL at times selected by weekday, month, month-day, hour, minute, and IANA timezone.

tools.name: Remove Recurring Webhook Schedule
tools.description: Remove the Cronfree recurring schedule associated with a webhook URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign up or sign in at https://cronfree.com/ using the emailed magic link, then copy the License Key shown in your Cronfree dashboard. Cronfree requires this secret as the license_key field in every JSON request body.

name: Cronly
description: Cronly monitors cron jobs, SSL certificates, servers, and crontab backups and reports operational alerts.

tools.name: Create Certificate Monitor
tools.description: Create an SSL/TLS certificate-expiry monitor for a hostname and port.

tools.name: Create Monitor
tools.description: Create a cron-job heartbeat monitor and return its ID and sensitive pulse token.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a project for organizing Cronly monitors and certificate checks.

tools.name: Delete Certificate Monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete an SSL/TLS certificate monitor by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a cron-job monitor by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently delete a Cronly project by numeric ID.

tools.name: Get Company
tools.description: Return safe organization, timezone, and subscription-summary fields for the connected Cronly account without exposing billing or integration secrets.

tools.name: Get Resource
tools.description: Get one monitor, project, certificate, user, server, or backup by its resource identity.

tools.name: List Resources
tools.description: List notifications, monitors, projects, certificates, users, servers, or backups. Notifications return one page with a continuation cursor; other resource types return their complete arrays.

tools.name: Pulse Monitor
tools.description: Record a successful heartbeat for a monitor using its sensitive pulse token. This changes monitor run state even though Cronly exposes it as GET.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A Cronly API token created by a Developer or Admin user in the Cronly application. Cronly's public documentation does not specify the exact navigation path for managing API keys. Copy the token and keep it secret.

name: Crowdin
description: Crowdin is a localization management platform that streamlines the translation process, offering tools for collaboration, content centralization, and workflow automation.

tools.name: Add Branch
tools.description: Tool to create a new branch in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to isolate translations for a new feature or release.

tools.name: Add Directory
tools.description: Tool to create a new directory in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to organize files into directories before uploading.

tools.name: Add File
tools.description: Tool to add a new file to a Crowdin project. Use after uploading the file to storage to place it under the specified project, branch, or directory.

tools.name: Add Glossary Term
tools.description: Tool to add a new term to a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to create terminology entries for consistent translations across projects.

tools.name: Add Label
tools.description: Tool to create a new label in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to tag resources with a custom identifier, such as 'Sprint-5'.

tools.name: Create Crowdin Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in Crowdin. Use before uploading source files to initialize translation workflows.

tools.name: Add Project File Format Settings
tools.description: Tool to add file format settings to a Crowdin project. Use when configuring how specific file formats should be processed during import/export. Allows customization of segmentation, export paths, and format-specific options.

tools.name: Add Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook in a Crowdin project. Use after confirming the project ID and desired event triggers.

tools.name: Assign Label to Strings
tools.description: Assign a label to one or more source strings in a Crowdin project. Labels help organize and categorize strings for easier filtering and management. The label and strings must exist in the same project. Returns the updated string details with their assigned label IDs.

tools.name: Build Project Directory Translation
tools.description: Tool to build translations for a specific directory in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to export translations for a directory. Returns build details after successfully initiating the build process.

tools.name: Build Project File Translation
tools.description: Tool to build a project file translation in Crowdin. Use when you need to generate a translated version of a specific file for a target language. Returns a download URL for the translated file. May return 304 (Not Modified) if the file hasn't changed and If-None-Match header is provided.

tools.name: Build Project Translation
tools.description: Tool to build project translation in Crowdin, generating downloadable translation files. Use to create translation builds before downloading. This is an asynchronous operation - use CROWDIN_CHECK_PROJECT_BUILD_STATUS to monitor progress.

tools.name: Cancel Project Translation Build
tools.description: Tool to cancel a project translation build in Crowdin. Use when you need to stop an ongoing or queued translation build.

tools.name: Check Bundle Export Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a bundle export operation in Crowdin. Use when you need to monitor the progress of a bundle export initiated earlier. Returns the current export status, completion percentage, and download URL when the export finishes successfully.

tools.name: Check Glossary Export Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a glossary export operation. Use after initiating a glossary export to monitor progress and retrieve download URL.

tools.name: Check Glossary Import Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a glossary import operation. Use after initiating a glossary import to monitor progress and verify completion.

tools.name: Check GraphQL Rate Limit
tools.description: Tool to check GraphQL API rate limit status for Crowdin. Use to monitor remaining API quota and avoid rate limit errors. Returns maximum allowed points per hour, current call cost, remaining points in the window, and reset timestamp. The Crowdin GraphQL API enforces a 5000 points per hour rate limit using a normalized point scale.

tools.name: Check Project Report Status
tools.description: Tool to check report generation status in a Crowdin project. Use when monitoring asynchronous report generation operations. Poll this endpoint until status is 'finished' or 'failed'.

tools.name: Check Project Build Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a project translation build in Crowdin. Use when you need to monitor the progress of a translation build operation. Returns build details including status (created, inProgress, finished, failed, canceled), progress percentage, and timestamps.

tools.name: Check TM Export Status
tools.description: Tool to check Translation Memory export status in Crowdin. Use when you need to monitor the progress of an asynchronous TM export operation.

tools.name: Check TM Import Status
tools.description: Tool to check Translation Memory import status in Crowdin. Use when you need to monitor the progress of an asynchronous TM import operation.

tools.name: Check AI Report Status
tools.description: Tool to check the generation status of an AI report for a Crowdin user. Use this to poll for completion status after generating an AI report. Returns current status, progress percentage, and timestamps.

tools.name: Clone AI Prompt
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing AI prompt in Crowdin. Use when you need to duplicate an AI prompt with a new name or configuration.

tools.name: Create Glossary
tools.description: Tool to create a new glossary in Crowdin. Use when you need to establish terminology standards for translation projects.

tools.name: Import Glossary
tools.description: Tool to import glossary terms from a file into a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to bulk import glossary terms from TBX, CSV, or XLS/XLSX files. This is an asynchronous operation - use Check Glossary Import Status action to monitor completion.

tools.name: Create Custom Language
tools.description: Tool to create a custom language in Crowdin. Use when standard languages don't meet needs and you require a custom language with specific codes and plural rules.

tools.name: Create MT Translations
tools.description: Tool to translate strings using Crowdin's Machine Translation engine. Use when you need to quickly translate text strings programmatically.

tools.name: Create Project Comment
tools.description: Tool to add a comment or issue to a string or file (asset) in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to provide feedback, ask questions, or report issues on specific translation strings or asset files. Either stringId or fileId must be provided.

tools.name: Add Project Member
tools.description: Tool to add members to a Crowdin project. Use when you need to grant project access to users by their IDs, usernames, or email addresses. Supports assigning roles and permissions.

tools.name: Add Bundle
tools.description: Tool to add a new bundle to a Crowdin project. Bundles allow exporting sets of strings or files in specified formats regardless of original file format.

tools.name: Add Distribution
tools.description: Tool to create a new distribution in a Crowdin project. Use to package translated files or bundles for distribution.

tools.name: Create Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to create a report settings template in Crowdin. Use when setting up cost estimation and translation pricing templates for projects.

tools.name: Create Project Strings Exporter Settings
tools.description: Tool to add project strings exporter settings in Crowdin. Use when configuring how strings should be exported from a project in specific formats (Android XML, macOS Strings, or XLIFF).

tools.name: Create Project Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to assign translation or proofreading work to team members.

tools.name: Create String
tools.description: Tool to add a new source string to a Crowdin project. Use when you need to create translatable content programmatically or add strings that are not part of uploaded files.

tools.name: Create TM Import
tools.description: Tool to import a Translation Memory file into Crowdin. Use when you need to import TM data from TMX, CSV, or XLS/XLSX files. This is an asynchronous operation - use Check TM Import Status action to monitor progress.

tools.name: Add Translation Memory
tools.description: Tool to create a new Translation Memory (TM) in Crowdin. Use when you need to establish a centralized repository of translations for reuse across projects.

tools.name: Create TM Segments
tools.description: Tool to create translation memory segments in Crowdin. Use when you need to add new translation pairs to a translation memory for future reuse.

tools.name: Create TM Segment Records
tools.description: Tool to create translation memory segment records in Crowdin. Use when you need to add additional language translations to an existing TM segment.

tools.name: Create Translation
tools.description: Add a translation for one source string and target language.

tools.name: Create Translation Alignment
tools.description: Tool to create translation alignment for a project. Use when aligning translations between source and target languages.

tools.name: Create AI Prompt
tools.description: Tool to create a new AI prompt in Crowdin. Use when you need to configure AI-assisted translation, translation assistance, or quality assurance checks with specific context and settings.

tools.name: Add AI Snippet
tools.description: Tool to create an AI snippet in Crowdin. Use when you need to add a custom placeholder for AI prompts that will be used across translations.

tools.name: Create User Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to create a user report settings template in Crowdin. Use when setting up cost estimation and translation pricing templates for specific users.

tools.name: Delete Branch
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific branch from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove an obsolete branch after it's fully merged.

tools.name: Delete Directory
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific directory from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove an obsolete directory and its contents.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific file from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or incorrect file from the project.

tools.name: Delete Glossary
tools.description: Tool to delete a glossary from Crowdin. Use when you need to permanently remove a glossary that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Glossary Concept
tools.description: Tool to delete a concept from a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect concepts from your glossary.

tools.name: Delete Glossary Term
tools.description: Tool to delete a term from a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect terminology entries. This operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Glossary Terms
tools.description: Tool to clear terms from a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to remove all terms or specific terms based on language, concept, or term ID. Without optional filters, this action deletes all terms in the glossary.

tools.name: Delete Label
tools.description: Tool to delete the label identified by the specified label ID in a project. Use when you need to remove outdated or incorrect labels. Ensure no resources reference the label before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Custom Language
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom language from Crowdin. Use when you need to remove a custom language that is no longer needed. Note: Only custom languages can be deleted, not standard built-in languages.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a Crowdin project by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a project after confirming no further usage. Ensure all resources are no longer needed before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Project Comment Attachment
tools.description: Tool to delete an attachment from a string or asset comment in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove a file attachment from a comment. This operation is permanent.

tools.name: Delete Project Member
tools.description: Tool to delete a member from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove a user's access to a specific project.

tools.name: Delete Bundle
tools.description: Tool to delete a bundle from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove a bundle that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Distribution
tools.description: Tool to delete a distribution from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to permanently remove a distribution.

tools.name: Delete Project File Format Settings
tools.description: Tool to delete file format settings from a Crowdin project. Use when removing obsolete or incorrect file format configurations. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a report settings template from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to permanently remove a report settings template that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to delete a screenshot from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect screenshots.

tools.name: Delete Project Strings Exporter Settings
tools.description: Tool to delete project strings exporter settings in Crowdin. Use when you need to remove strings exporter settings that are no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Task Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a task settings template from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to permanently remove a task settings template that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Project Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific task from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or completed task after it's no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Project Task Comment
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific comment from a project task. Use when you need to remove outdated or incorrect comments from tasks.

tools.name: Delete Storage
tools.description: Tool to delete a storage from Crowdin. Use when you need to remove a storage that is no longer needed or was uploaded incorrectly.

tools.name: Delete String
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific source string from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to remove obsolete or incorrect strings that are no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Translation Memory
tools.description: Tool to delete a Translation Memory (TM) from Crowdin. Use when you need to permanently remove a TM that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete TM Segment
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific translation memory segment from Crowdin. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or incorrect translation segment from a TM.

tools.name: Clear TM Segments
tools.description: Tool to clear all segments from a Translation Memory in Crowdin. Use when you need to remove all translation segments from a TM while keeping the TM itself.

tools.name: Delete TM Segment Record
tools.description: Tool to delete a translation memory segment record in Crowdin. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or incorrect translation from a TM segment.

tools.name: Delete Translation
tools.description: Permanently remove one translation from a Crowdin project.

tools.name: Delete User AI Prompt
tools.description: Tool to delete an AI prompt for a specific user. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or unwanted AI prompt. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete User AI Provider
tools.description: Tool to delete an AI provider for a specific user. Use when you need to remove an AI provider association from a user account. Returns 204 status code on successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete AI Snippet
tools.description: Tool to delete an AI snippet from Crowdin. Use when you need to remove obsolete or no longer needed AI snippets from a user's settings.

tools.name: Delete User Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a user report settings template from Crowdin. Use when you need to permanently remove a report settings template that is no longer needed for a specific user.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a webhook from a Crowdin project. This action cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove obsolete, misconfigured, or no longer needed webhooks. Requires both the project ID and webhook ID which can be obtained from list webhooks.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download a file from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve the download URL for a specific file. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Download Glossary Export
tools.description: Tool to download an exported glossary from Crowdin. Use when you have a completed glossary export and need to obtain the download URL. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Download Bundle Export
tools.description: Tool to download an exported bundle from Crowdin. Use when you have a completed bundle export and need to obtain the download URL. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Download Project Report
tools.description: Tool to download a generated project report from Crowdin. Use after checking report status and confirming it is 'finished'. Returns a temporary download URL for the report file.

tools.name: Download Project Translation Build
tools.description: Tool to download a built project translation from Crowdin. Use when you have a completed translation build and need to obtain the download URL. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Download TM Export
tools.description: Tool to download an exported Translation Memory from Crowdin. Use when you have a completed TM export and need to obtain the download URL. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Download AI Report
tools.description: Tool to download an AI report from Crowdin. Use when you have a completed AI report and need to obtain the download URL. Returns a temporary URL that expires after the specified time.

tools.name: Edit File
tools.description: Tool to update file details in a project. Use after confirming valid project and file IDs.

tools.name: Edit Label
tools.description: Tool to edit a label's title in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to rename an existing label. Labels are used to organize and categorize strings in your project. Example: Rename label 42 to 'Release-1.1'.

tools.name: Edit Project
tools.description: Tool to update project details using JSON-Patch. Use after confirming project settings to modify metadata like name, description, visibility, or languages.

tools.name: Edit String
tools.description: Edit a source string in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify string text, context, visibility, max length, labels, or identifier. Note: Only works with file formats that support online editing (CSV, RESX, JSON, Android XML, iOS strings, PROPERTIES, XLIFF).

tools.name: Execute GraphQL Query
tools.description: Tool to execute GraphQL queries against the Crowdin GraphQL API. Use when you need to query complex nested data structures or perform advanced filtering. The GraphQL endpoint supports queries for projects, files, strings, translations, and more. All connection queries must include pagination parameters (first or last) with values between 1-10,000. The API enforces a 5,000-point-per-hour rate limit based on query complexity.

tools.name: Export Glossary
tools.description: Tool to initiate a glossary export operation in Crowdin. Use when you need to export glossary terms to TBX, CSV, or XLSX format. After initiating, use Check Glossary Export Status to monitor progress and get download URL.

tools.name: Export Bundle
tools.description: Tool to initiate an asynchronous export operation for a bundle in Crowdin. Use when you need to export a bundle of translated files. Returns an export identifier that can be used with Check Bundle Export Status action to monitor progress and download the bundle once completed.

tools.name: Export Project Translations
tools.description: Tool to export project translations from Crowdin. Returns a download URL for the exported translation file. Use when you need to download translations for a specific target language.

tools.name: Export Project Task Strings
tools.description: Tool to export strings from a project task in XLIFF format. Use when you need to download task strings for translation or review. Returns a temporary download URL that expires after a specified time.

tools.name: Export Translation Memory
tools.description: Tool to export Translation Memory (TM) from Crowdin. Use when you need to export TM data in TMX, CSV, or XLSX format. This is an asynchronous operation - use Check TM Export Status action to monitor progress and retrieve the download URL.

tools.name: Generate Project Report
tools.description: Tool to generate organization reports in Crowdin projects. Creates asynchronous report generation jobs for cost estimation, top members, translation costs, and other analytics. Use Check Project Report to monitor generation status.

tools.name: Generate AI Prompt Fine-Tuning Dataset
tools.description: Tool to generate an AI prompt fine-tuning dataset from project or TM data. Use when you need to create training or validation datasets for fine-tuning AI models. This is an asynchronous operation - check status using the returned identifier.

tools.name: Get Branch
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific branch in a Crowdin project by its ID. Use when you need to inspect branch settings or verify branch existence.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific file in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect file properties, metadata, or settings before processing.

tools.name: Get Glossary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific glossary by its ID. Use when you need to fetch glossary details including terms count, languages, and associated projects.

tools.name: Get Glossary Concept
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific concept from a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to view concept details including definition, subject, notes, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Glossary Term
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific term from a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to inspect term details including translations, definitions, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Label
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the label identified by the specified label ID in a project. Use after confirming the project context to fetch label details.

tools.name: Get Language
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific language. Use when you have a language identifier and need locale codes and plural rules before configuring translations.

tools.name: Get Member Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a project member. Use when you need to inspect details for a specific user within a project after obtaining their member ID.

tools.name: Get MT
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Machine Translation engine. Use when you need to inspect MT engine configuration and settings.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect project settings before making updates.

tools.name: Get Project AI Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve AI settings for a specific Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect project-level AI configuration.

tools.name: Get Branch Progress
tools.description: Tool to retrieve branch translation progress for all languages in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to monitor translation status for a specific branch.

tools.name: Get Bundle
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific bundle from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect bundle configuration.

tools.name: Get String/Asset Comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific string or asset comment by its ID in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect comment details, check issue status, or view comment metadata.

tools.name: Get Directory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific directory in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect directory details or verify directory existence.

tools.name: Get Directory Progress
tools.description: Tool to get translation progress for all languages in a specific directory of a Crowdin project. Use when you need to check translation and approval progress by language for a directory. Returns detailed progress information including word counts, phrase counts, and progress percentages for each target language.

tools.name: Get Distribution
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific distribution in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect distribution settings or metadata.

tools.name: Get Project File Format Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve file format settings for a specific project. Use when you need to inspect configuration options for how files are processed in Crowdin translations.

tools.name: Get File Progress
tools.description: Tool to retrieve file translation progress for all languages in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to monitor translation status before exporting.

tools.name: Get File Revision
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific file revision in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect revision changes before restoring.

tools.name: Get Project Progress
tools.description: Tool to retrieve project translation progress for all languages in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to monitor overall project translation status.

tools.name: Get Language Progress
tools.description: Tool to retrieve translation progress for a specific language across all files in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to monitor translation status for a particular language.

tools.name: Get QA Checks Revalidation Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status of a QA checks revalidation job. Use when you need to check the progress of a previously started revalidation.

tools.name: Get Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific report settings template from Crowdin. Use when you need to inspect existing template configuration for cost estimation and translation pricing.

tools.name: Get Project Strings Exporter Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve project strings exporter settings by ID. Use when you need to inspect exporter configuration before making updates.

tools.name: Get Task Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific task settings template from a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect template configuration before creating tasks.

tools.name: Get Project Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific task in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect task status, progress, or configuration.

tools.name: Get Project Task Comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific task comment by its ID in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to inspect task comment details, check issue status, or view comment metadata.

tools.name: Get Storage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific file uploaded to Crowdin storage. Use when you need to verify storage file information before using it in other operations.

tools.name: Get String
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific source string in a Crowdin project. Returns the string's text content, metadata (type, context, maxLength), translation status flags (isHidden, isDuplicate, hasPlurals, isIcu), associated labels, timestamps, and editor URL. Use this to inspect individual strings before editing or to verify string properties.

tools.name: Get Translation Memory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific Translation Memory by its ID. Use when you need to fetch TM details including segment count, languages, and associated projects.

tools.name: Get Authenticated User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to get the profile details of the user making the API request.

tools.name: Get AI Prompt
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific AI prompt from Crowdin. Use when you need to inspect existing AI prompt configuration, settings, or enabled project associations.

tools.name: Get AI Prompt Fine-Tuning Dataset Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the generation status of an AI prompt fine-tuning dataset. Use this to check the progress and completion status of a dataset generation job initiated by Generate AI Prompt Fine-Tuning Dataset.

tools.name: Get User AI Provider
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an AI provider for a specific user. Use when you need to fetch configuration details of a specific AI provider instance.

tools.name: Get User AI Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve AI settings for a Crowdin user. Use when you need to inspect current AI configuration and preferences for a specific user.

tools.name: Get AI Snippet
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an AI snippet from Crowdin. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific custom placeholder for AI prompts.

tools.name: Get User Report Archive
tools.description: Tool to get a specific report archive for a Crowdin user. Use when retrieving details of a previously generated report archive by its ID.

tools.name: Get User Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user report settings template in Crowdin. Use when you need to view cost estimation and translation pricing template details for a specific user.

tools.name: Get User Security Log
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific security log entry for a user. Returns information about security events such as logins, password changes, email changes, including event type, location, IP address, device, and timestamp. Use when you need to audit or investigate specific user security activities.

tools.name: Get Viewer
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the authenticated user via GraphQL. Use when you need to get the current user's ID and username.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific webhook in a Crowdin project. Returns webhook configuration including name, URL, events that trigger it, HTTP method, headers, payload template, and status. Use this to verify webhook setup or check if a webhook is active before relying on it. Requires both project_id and webhook_id. Returns 404 if either doesn't exist.

tools.name: List Application Installations
tools.description: List all application installations in Crowdin with pagination and filtering support. Use this action to retrieve installed applications, filter by installer user, or paginate through large lists using limit and offset.

tools.name: List Branches
tools.description: List all branches in a Crowdin project. Returns branch details including name, title, priority, and export patterns. Use to view project branch structure, pagination support via limit/offset. Filter by name if needed.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Tool to list files in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve a list of project files with optional filters by directory, group, or branch before processing.

tools.name: List Glossaries
tools.description: Tool to list all glossaries available to the authenticated user. Use when you need to view available glossaries or retrieve glossary IDs for other glossary operations.

tools.name: List Glossaries Concepts
tools.description: Tool to list concepts in a Crowdin glossary with pagination and sorting support. Concepts group related terms across multiple languages. Use when you need to view all concepts in a glossary or get concept IDs for other operations.

tools.name: List Glossary Terms
tools.description: Tool to list all terms in a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to view terminology entries, their translations, definitions, and metadata. Supports filtering by language, user, concept, and advanced CroQL queries. Includes pagination support via limit/offset parameters.

tools.name: List Project File Strings (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to list source strings within files in Crowdin projects using GraphQL API. Returns strings with support for PlainSourceString, ICUSourceString, PluralSourceString, and AssetSourceString types. Use when you need to retrieve strings from multiple projects and files with cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: Lists all labels in a Crowdin project with pagination support. Labels are used to categorize and organize source strings for easier management. Use this tool to view available labels before assigning them to strings or to retrieve label IDs for other label operations.

tools.name: List Languages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of supported languages. Use when you need to fetch all languages Crowdin supports before starting localization.

tools.name: List MTs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of Machine Translation engines. Use when you need to view all configured MT engines and their settings.

tools.name: List Project Members
tools.description: Tool to list members in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve project member list for management tasks after confirming the project ID.

tools.name: List Projects (v2)
tools.description: List all Crowdin projects accessible to the authenticated user with advanced filtering and sorting options. Use to retrieve projects with customizable sort order, filter by user/type/manager access, and paginate results.

tools.name: List Projects Approvals
tools.description: Tool to list translation approvals in a Crowdin project with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve approved translations, optionally filtered by file, string, language, labels, or translation ID.

tools.name: List Bundles
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of bundles in a Crowdin project. Use this to view all bundles with their configurations including formats, source patterns, and export settings.

tools.name: List Bundle Files
tools.description: Tool to list files in a specific Crowdin project bundle. Use when you need to retrieve the list of files included in a bundle before exporting or processing.

tools.name: List Project Comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of comments on strings or assets in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view all comments, filter by string/file, or search for specific comment types or issues.

tools.name: List Project Dictionaries
tools.description: Tool to list all dictionaries in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view available dictionaries for translation quality and consistency checks.

tools.name: List Directories
tools.description: List all directories in a Crowdin project. Returns directory details including name, path, priority, and export patterns. Use to view project directory structure with pagination support via limit/offset. Filter by branchId or parentDirectoryId if needed.

tools.name: List Distributions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of distributions for a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view existing distribution configurations before releasing or managing them.

tools.name: List Project File Format Settings
tools.description: Tool to list all file format settings for a Crowdin project. Use to retrieve configuration options for how different file types are processed in translations. Supports pagination via limit/offset parameters.

tools.name: List Asset References
tools.description: Tool to list asset references for a specific file in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view file references with pagination support.

tools.name: List File Revisions
tools.description: Tool to list all revisions for a specific file in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view file change history or select a revision to restore.

tools.name: List Projects Issues
tools.description: Tool to list reported issues in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve issues that have been reported by project members or translators. Supports filtering by issue type and resolution status.

tools.name: List Language Translations
tools.description: Tool to list language translations for a specific project and language. Use when you need to retrieve translations for a target language with optional filtering by strings, labels, files, branches, or directories.

tools.name: List Projects QA Checks
tools.description: Tool to list QA check issues in a Crowdin project with pagination and filtering support. Use this to identify translation quality issues that need attention before finalizing translations. Supports filtering by category type, validation level, and target languages.

tools.name: List Report Settings Templates
tools.description: Tool to list report settings templates for a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve available cost estimation and translation pricing templates for a project.

tools.name: List Screenshots
tools.description: Tool to list screenshots in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve all screenshots or filter them by strings or labels. Returns screenshot details including id, name, URL, dimensions, and associated tags/labels with pagination support.

tools.name: List Project Strings
tools.description: Lists all source strings in a Crowdin project with filtering and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve project strings, optionally filtered by file, branch, directory, labels, or text content. Supports both simple filters and advanced CroQL queries.

tools.name: List Project Strings Exporter Settings
tools.description: Tool to list project strings exporter settings in Crowdin. Use when you need to retrieve all configured export format settings for a project.

tools.name: List Task Settings Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of task settings templates for a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view available templates before creating tasks or to get template IDs for task operations.

tools.name: List Project Builds
tools.description: Tool to list translation builds for a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve all builds or check recent build history. Returns build details including status, progress, timestamps, and configuration for each build.

tools.name: List Translation Votes
tools.description: Tool to list translation votes in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve voting information for translations, optionally filtered by string, language, translation, file, or labels.

tools.name: List Project Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of webhooks configured in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to view all webhooks, check webhook configurations, or find specific webhook IDs.

tools.name: List Project Task Comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all comments on a specific project task. Use when you need to view feedback, issues, or discussions related to a task.

tools.name: List Storages
tools.description: Tool to list files uploaded to Crowdin storage with pagination. Use when you need to retrieve a list of previously uploaded storage files.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list tasks in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to retrieve translation or proofreading tasks with optional filters by status or assignee.

tools.name: List Translation Memories
tools.description: Tool to list all Translation Memories available to the authenticated user. Use when you need to view available TMs, retrieve TM IDs for other operations, or filter TMs by user or ordering criteria.

tools.name: List TM Segments
tools.description: Tool to list Translation Memory segments in Crowdin. Use when you need to view all translation segments stored in a specific TM, with support for filtering via CroQL and pagination.

tools.name: List User AI Prompts
tools.description: Tool to list AI prompts for a specific user in Crowdin. Use when you need to retrieve all available AI prompts, optionally filtered by project or action type.

tools.name: List AI Prompt Fine-Tuning Jobs
tools.description: Tool to list AI prompt fine-tuning jobs for a specific user. Use when you need to view all fine-tuning jobs, check their status, or filter by job status.

tools.name: List User AI Providers
tools.description: Tool to list all AI providers configured for a specific user. Use when you need to retrieve all AI provider configurations for a user. Returns paginated list of AI providers with details including type, credentials, and enabled status.

tools.name: List User AI Provider Models
tools.description: Tool to list AI provider models configured for a specific user. Use when you need to retrieve all AI models across all providers configured for a user.

tools.name: List Supported AI Provider Models
tools.description: Tool to list supported AI provider models for a user. Use when you need to retrieve available AI models and their configurations.

tools.name: List AI Snippets
tools.description: Tool to list AI snippets for a specific user in Crowdin. Use when you need to retrieve all custom placeholders configured for AI prompts in translations.

tools.name: List User Report Archives
tools.description: Tool to list report archives for a Crowdin user. Use when retrieving historical report data for a specific user, with optional filtering by scope, task, report name, or date range.

tools.name: List User Report Settings Templates
tools.description: Tool to list user report settings templates in Crowdin. Use when retrieving cost estimation and translation pricing templates for a specific user.

tools.name: List User Security Logs
tools.description: Tool to list security log entries for a specific user. Returns user activity events such as logins, password changes, email changes, MFA changes, session management, and SSO connections. Use when you need to audit user security activities, investigate suspicious behavior, or track authentication events. Supports filtering by event type, date range, and IP address.

tools.name: List User Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of tasks assigned to a specific user. Use when you need to see all tasks for a particular user including translation and proofreading assignments.

tools.name: List User Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks assigned to the authenticated user across all projects. Use when you need to view tasks assigned to the current user.

tools.name: List Viewer Projects Files
tools.description: Tool to list files within projects using GraphQL viewer query. Returns file names, types, and total count for files in projects accessible to the authenticated user. Supports pagination with cursors for both projects and files.

tools.name: List Translations By Language
tools.description: Tool to retrieve translation information for strings in specific target languages. Returns translations for PlainStringTranslation, ICUStringTranslation, PluralStringTranslation, and AssetStringTranslation types. Supports pagination across projects, files, strings, and translations.

tools.name: List Viewer Projects (GraphQL)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve projects via Crowdin GraphQL API using viewer.projects query. Use when you need cursor-based pagination or advanced filtering/sorting capabilities.

tools.name: List Viewer Projects Translations
tools.description: Tool to list translations for projects in a specific language using GraphQL viewer query. Returns translations with support for different types: PlainStringTranslation, ICUStringTranslation, PluralStringTranslation, and AssetStringTranslation. Supports pagination with cursors for both projects and translations.

tools.name: Notify Project Members
tools.description: Tool to send notifications to Crowdin project members. Use when you need to alert specific users or all members with a role about project updates or events.

tools.name: Query GraphQL Node
tools.description: Tool to query Crowdin GraphQL Project nodes by their global ID. Use when you need to retrieve Project details using a base64-encoded node identifier (format: base64("Project:numericId")). Note: Currently only Project nodes are supported by Crowdin's GraphQL API. File, Branch, Directory, and String nodes cause internal server errors.

tools.name: Release Distribution
tools.description: Tool to release a distribution in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to publish the latest version of a distribution to make translated files available for download.

tools.name: Reset Project File Format Settings Custom Segmentations
tools.description: Tool to reset custom segmentations for file format settings in a Crowdin project. Use when reverting custom segmentation rules to defaults.

tools.name: Revalidate QA Checks
tools.description: Tool to revalidate QA checks for a Crowdin project. Use when you need to manually trigger QA check validation for specific languages or categories. Returns a job identifier for tracking the async revalidation process.

tools.name: Search Glossaries Concordance
tools.description: Tool to search for glossary terms using concordance search in Crowdin. Use when you need to find matching glossary entries for a specific expression across source and target languages.

tools.name: Search TM Concordance
tools.description: Tool to search for translations in Translation Memory (TM) using concordance search. Use when you need to find existing translations for specific expressions or phrases across all translation memories in a project.

tools.name: Send Notification
tools.description: Tool to send a notification message to the authenticated Crowdin user. Use when you need to alert the user about important events or updates.

tools.name: Update Glossaries
tools.description: Tool to update glossary details using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify glossary metadata like name or primary language.

tools.name: Update Glossary Concept
tools.description: Tool to update a concept in a Crowdin glossary. Use when you need to modify concept details including subject, definition, notes, translatable status, or language-specific information.

tools.name: Update Glossary Term
tools.description: Tool to update an existing glossary term in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify term properties like text, description, status, or grammatical attributes for consistent terminology management.

tools.name: Update Custom Language
tools.description: Tool to update a custom language in Crowdin using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing custom language like name, text direction, or plural categories.

tools.name: Edit String/Asset Comment
tools.description: Tool to edit a string or asset comment in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify comment text or update issue status for issue-type comments.

tools.name: Update Branch
tools.description: Tool to update branch details using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify branch metadata like name, title, export pattern, or priority.

tools.name: Update Bundle
tools.description: Tool to update bundle properties in a Crowdin project using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify bundle settings like name, format, source patterns, or export configuration.

tools.name: Update Projects Comments
tools.description: Tool to perform batch operations on project comments using JSON-Patch. Use when you need to update multiple comments, change issue statuses, or modify comment text in a single request. Supports add, replace, and remove operations.

tools.name: Update Project Dictionaries
tools.description: Tool to edit a dictionary in a Crowdin project using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to add or remove words from project dictionaries for translation quality and consistency checks.

tools.name: Update Directory
tools.description: Tool to update directory details in a Crowdin project using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify directory name, title, export pattern, or priority.

tools.name: Edit Distribution
tools.description: Tool to update distribution settings using JSON-Patch operations. Use to modify name, export mode, or file/bundle IDs.

tools.name: Update Project File Format Settings
tools.description: Tool to edit file format settings in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use when modifying existing format configurations like export patterns or segmentation rules.

tools.name: Update or Restore File
tools.description: Tool to update or restore a file in a Crowdin project. Use when you need to replace file content with a new version from storage (provide storageId) or restore a file to a previous revision (provide revisionId).

tools.name: Update Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to update a report settings template using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify template name, currency, unit, mode, or configuration settings for cost estimation and translation pricing.

tools.name: Edit Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to edit a screenshot in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify screenshot name or label assignments. Operations are applied atomically - all succeed or all fail.

tools.name: Edit Screenshot Tag
tools.description: Tool to edit a screenshot tag in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to update tag position or change the associated string ID. Tags link strings to specific areas on screenshots to provide visual context for translators.

tools.name: Update Projects Strings
tools.description: Tool to perform batch operations on strings in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch. Use to update multiple string fields, create new strings, or delete strings in a single request. Supports replace (update field values), add (create new strings), and remove (delete strings) operations.

tools.name: Update Project Strings Exporter Settings
tools.description: Tool to edit project strings exporter settings in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when modifying existing exporter configurations (e.g., changing format, updating export patterns, toggling placeholder conversion). Apply targeted updates to specific settings without replacing the entire configuration.

tools.name: Update Task Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to update a task settings template in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify template name or configuration settings.

tools.name: Update Project Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update webhook configuration in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify webhook properties like name, URL, event triggers, or active status.

tools.name: Update Project Task
tools.description: Tool to update a project task in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify task details like title, description, status, deadline, or assignees.

tools.name: Edit Project Task Comment
tools.description: Tool to edit a task comment in a Crowdin project using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify comment text or update issue status for issue-type comments.

tools.name: Update Translation Memory
tools.description: Tool to update a Translation Memory (TM) in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify TM name or language settings. Supports RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations (replace, test) on paths /name and /languageId.

tools.name: Update TM Segments
tools.description: Tool to edit a translation memory segment in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to update translation text or metadata for existing TM segment records.

tools.name: Update TM Segment Record
tools.description: Tool to edit a translation memory segment record in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to update the text of an existing translation in a TM segment. Note: This action is deprecated - prefer using newer TM management actions if available.

tools.name: Update Authenticated User
tools.description: Tool to update the authenticated user's profile using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify username, full name, timezone, or avatar. Applies one or more field updates in a single request.

tools.name: Update AI Prompt
tools.description: Tool to update an AI prompt in Crowdin using JSON-Patch operations. Use when you need to modify AI prompt configuration, name, enabled status, or project associations after the prompt has been created.

tools.name: Update User AI Provider
tools.description: Tool to edit an AI Provider for a specific user using JSON Patch operations. Use to update provider name, enable/disable status, or modify configuration settings. Operations follow RFC 6902 JSON Patch standard.

tools.name: Edit User AI Settings
tools.description: Tool to update AI settings for a Crowdin user using JSON Patch operations. Use to modify AI prompt IDs or shortcuts configuration. Supports updating pre-translation prompts, assist action prompts, editor suggestions, and custom AI shortcuts.

tools.name: Update AI Snippet
tools.description: Tool to update an existing AI snippet in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify snippet properties like description, placeholder, or value for AI prompts.

tools.name: Update User Report Settings Template
tools.description: Tool to update a user report settings template in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when modifying template name, currency, unit, or configuration for cost estimation and translation pricing.

tools.name: Update Organization Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update organization webhook configuration in Crowdin using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify organization-level webhook properties like name, URL, or event triggers.

tools.name: Upload Storage
tools.description: Upload a file to Crowdin storage to get a storage ID for subsequent operations. Storage is a temporary container for files at Crowdin. Use this action before: - Adding new source files to a project (Add File action) - Updating existing source files (Update File action) - Uploading Translation Memory (TM) or Glossary files Returns a storage ID that can be used in follow-up API calls.

tools.name: Validate QA Checks
tools.description: Tool to validate translation text by QA checks in a Crowdin project. Use to check if translations meet quality requirements before submitting.

required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The personal access token generated in Crowdin for API authentication.

name: CrowTerminal
description: AI-powered command line assistant with memory and automation capabilities for developers

tools.name: Analyze Agent Engagement
tools.description: Tool to analyze engagement correlation for every field in your agent's markdown. Use when you need to understand which agent configuration fields drive engagement and get specific recommendations for improvement. Returns similarity to best/worst performing versions and field-by-field analysis.

tools.name: Compare Agent Markdown
tools.description: Tool to compare your agent's markdown directly with all stored versions. Returns field differences showing which values differ across versions, lists missing fields not present in your current data, and provides version counts. Use when you need to understand how your current agent configuration compares to historical versions.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to register a new webhook for receiving real-time event notifications from CrowTerminal. Use when you need to set up asynchronous notifications for events like skill updates, data ingestion, or validation blocks.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing webhook registration. Use when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or should be replaced.

tools.name: Get BYOK Platform Intelligence
tools.description: Tool to get algorithm insights for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube without client-specific context. Use when you need platform intelligence data for BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) analysis workflows. This endpoint provides raw contextual algorithm data without triggering LLM inference charges.

tools.name: Get Client Memory Changelog
tools.description: Retrieve human-readable change history for a client's memory. Provides a narrative view of how the client's skill data has evolved over time.

tools.name: Get Client Memory Pattern
tools.description: Tool to track a specific field over time for trend analysis. Use when you need to understand how a particular metric evolved across versions or time periods.

tools.name: Get Components Status
tools.description: Tool to get detailed status of each CrowTerminal service component. Returns current health status, latency, and summary statistics for all monitored components (database, cache, APIs, webhooks). Use when checking system health or diagnosing service issues.

tools.name: Get Data Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve valid data types for ingestion across platforms. Returns available data types for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube that can be used for data ingestion operations.

tools.name: Get Recent Incidents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of recent incidents from CrowTerminal with duration and affected components. Use when you need to check system status, monitor service health, or investigate recent outages or degradations.

tools.name: Get Platform Intelligence
tools.description: Tool to retrieve algorithm insights for TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube. Returns platform-wide intelligence about content algorithm behavior and optimization strategies. Use when you need current platform algorithm trends and recommendations.

tools.name: Get Sandbox Client
tools.description: Tool to get mock client data for testing in the sandbox environment. Use when you need to test client-related functionality without affecting real data. No authentication required for sandbox endpoints.

tools.name: Get Sandbox Memory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve mock memory/skill data for testing purposes. Use when you need to test memory retrieval without affecting real data or requiring authentication. Part of the sandbox testing environment.

tools.name: Get Service Status
tools.description: Retrieve CrowTerminal service status including overall health, component metrics, and uptime data. Use when you need to check the operational status of CrowTerminal services or monitor system health. No authentication required.

tools.name: Get Status History
tools.description: Tool to get 7-day uptime data points ready for visualization and charting. Use when you need historical uptime metrics for monitoring dashboards or status displays.

tools.name: Get Uptime Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical uptime data for CrowTerminal agents. Use when you need to check system reliability, view uptime percentages for 24h/7d periods, or review recent service incidents.

tools.name: Bulk Ingest Analytics Data
tools.description: Tool to bulk ingest up to 50 analytics data points at once to CrowTerminal. Use when you need to efficiently push large amounts of platform analytics data for content creators across social media platforms. Ideal for batch uploads of retention, engagement, views, and other metrics.

tools.name: Ingest Analytics Data
tools.description: Tool to ingest platform analytics data from TikTok Studio, Instagram Insights, or YouTube Analytics. Use when you need to push retention curves, demographics, traffic sources, or other engagement metrics for analysis. Supports both video-specific and channel-level data ingestion.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all registered webhooks for the authenticated agent. Use when you need to view all webhook subscriptions and their configurations.

tools.name: Ping CrowTerminal Service
