required.description: The API token used to authenticate requests to the Doppler API.

name: Dotsimple
description: DotSimple is a comprehensive social media management tool that enables users to plan, create, and publish content across multiple platforms, leveraging AI for content generation and providing analytics for performance optimization.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a new tag in DotSimple workspace for categorizing and organizing social media content. Tags are used to label and filter posts, drafts, and media files in DotSimple. Each tag has a unique name and color for easy visual identification in the dashboard. Use this tool when you need to: - Create a new category for content organization - Set up tags before scheduling posts - Organize content by topics, campaigns, or priorities Example: Create a tag named "news" with sky blue color "#38bdf8" for news-related posts. Note: Requires workspace_id in authentication configuration. Get your workspace_id from the DotSimple dashboard URL: https://app.dotsimple.io/app/YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID/

tools.name: Delete Media Files
tools.description: Deletes one or more media files (images/videos) from your DotSimple workspace. Use this tool when you need to remove media files that are no longer needed. You must provide the media file IDs as strings. Use the list_media_files tool first to get the IDs of files you want to delete. Returns a success indicator when deletion completes.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Delete a tag by its UUID from your DotSimple workspace. Use this tool when you need to remove a specific tag. Ensure the UUID is correct before invoking. The tag will be permanently deleted from your workspace. Note: Requires workspace_id in authentication configuration. Get your workspace_id from the DotSimple dashboard URL: https://app.dotsimple.io/app/YOUR-WORKSPACE-ID/

tools.name: Get Media File
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific media file. Use when you have the mediaFileId and need its metadata.

tools.name: Get Tag by UUID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific tag by UUID. Use when you need full tag information after obtaining its identifier.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: List all connected social media accounts in the DotSimple workspace. Returns details about each connected account including ID, name, type (e.g., Google, Microsoft), connection status, and credentials. Use this to discover available accounts before posting or scheduling content to social platforms. Note: Requires workspace_id to be configured in auth settings or provided as a parameter.

tools.name: List Autoresponders
tools.description: List all autoresponders in the DotSimple workspace with optional pagination. Returns details about each autoresponder including ID, name, and status. Use this to browse through your autoresponder setup and check their current state. Note: Requires workspace_id to be configured in auth settings or provided as a parameter.

tools.name: List Media Files
tools.description: List all media files in a DotSimple workspace with optional pagination. This tool retrieves media files from a specific workspace. The workspace_id is required and can be found in the DotSimple dashboard URL. Use when you need to: - Browse all uploaded media files - Retrieve media file metadata (name, type, URL, thumbnail) - Paginate through media library

tools.name: List Posts
tools.description: List all posts in a DotSimple workspace with optional pagination. This tool retrieves posts from a specific workspace. The workspace_id is required and can be found in your DotSimple dashboard URL (e.g., https://app.dotsimple.io/app/YOUR-WORKSPACE-UUID/...). Use this when you need to: - View all posts in a workspace - Paginate through large sets of posts - Check post status (published/draft) - Access post metadata (author, timestamps, content) Pagination is supported via optional page and page_size parameters.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: List all account-level email marketing reports from the DotSimple workspace. Returns paginated report entries with aggregated metrics for each date, including emails sent, delivered, opens, clicks, unsubscribes, bounces, and complaints. Use this to fetch account-level performance metrics chronologically after authentication. Note: Requires workspace_id to be configured in auth settings or provided as a parameter.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List all tags available in a DotSimple workspace for content organization and categorization. Tags in DotSimple are used to label and categorize social media posts, drafts, and media files. Each tag has a unique name and hex color for visual identification. Use this tool when you need to: - View all available tags in the workspace - Get tag IDs for assigning to posts - Retrieve tag colors and metadata - Check existing tags before creating new ones **Required:** workspace_id (UUID format) - obtain from DotSimple dashboard URL or connection config

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The access token generated for API authentication.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your DotSimple workspace UUID. For example, UUID from https://app.dotsimple.io/app/{UUID}/

name: Dovetail
description: Dovetail is an Australian software company that provides tools for transcription analysis, coding interpretation of interviews, survey responses, and feedback, enabling users to create summarized insights from their research analysis.

tools.name: Create Channel
tools.description: Creates a new channel in Dovetail to organize and collect feedback data. Channels are containers for specific types of customer feedback such as app reviews, NPS responses, churn reasons, product reviews, or support tickets. Use this to set up a new data collection source before importing feedback data.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in Dovetail. Use when you need to register a contact before logging interactions.

tools.name: Create Data
tools.description: Tool to create a data item in a Dovetail project with text content, title, and/or structured fields. Use when you need to capture and store research data, interview notes, or other content in a project.

tools.name: Create Data Point
tools.description: Tool to create a data point within a channel. Use after capturing new content to record and classify it in Dovetail.

tools.name: Create Doc
tools.description: Tool to create a doc in a Dovetail project with text content, title and/or custom fields. Use when you need to document research findings, store notes, or create structured content within a project. The doc content is stored but not returned in the response.

tools.name: Create Insight
tools.description: Creates a new insight in Dovetail to store synthesized research findings, observations, or conclusions. Use this tool when you need to document and save key findings from user research, interviews, or data analysis. Insights can optionally be linked to a project for better organization. Returns the created insight's ID, title, creation timestamp, and other metadata. Note: The body content is stored but not included in the response.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note in a Dovetail project with text content, title and/or custom fields. Use when you need to document research notes, store interview findings, or create structured content within a project. The note content is stored but not returned in the response.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in your Dovetail workspace. Use when you need to create a project to organize research data.

tools.name: Create Topic
tools.description: Tool to create a new topic in a Dovetail channel. Requires channel_id, title, and description. Use to organize feedback within channels by creating themed discussion topics.

tools.name: Delete Channel
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing channel. Use when you need to remove a channel and move it to the project's trash (restorable for 30 days). Confirm the channel ID before calling.

tools.name: Delete Data
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing data item. Use when you have confirmed the data ID and want to move it to trash (restorable for 30 days). Example: "Delete data with ID 1tFfvvAmYPCLUqb9zO8dgN."

tools.name: Delete Doc
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing doc. Use when you need to remove a doc and move it to the project's trash (restorable for 30 days).

tools.name: Delete Insight
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing insight. Use when you have confirmed the insight ID and want to move it to trash (restorable for 30 days).

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing note. Use when you have confirmed the note ID and want to move it to trash (restorable for 30 days).

tools.name: Delete Topic
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing topic. Use when you have confirmed the topic ID and want to move it to trash (restorable for 30 days). Example: "Delete topic with ID 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000."

tools.name: Export Data
tools.description: Tool to export data in HTML or Markdown format. Use when you need to retrieve a formatted version of data items from Dovetail.

tools.name: Export Doc
tools.description: Tool to export a doc in HTML or Markdown format. Use when you need to retrieve the full content of a doc from Dovetail in a specific format.

tools.name: Export Insight
tools.description: Tool to export an insight in HTML or Markdown format. Use when you need to retrieve the full content of an insight for documentation, reporting, or sharing purposes. The exported content includes the insight's title and body in the specified format.

tools.name: Export Note
tools.description: Tool to export a note from Dovetail in HTML or Markdown format. Use when you need to retrieve the full content of a note in a specific export format.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific contact. Use when you have confirmed the contact ID and need full contact metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific data item by ID. Use when you have confirmed the data ID and need full metadata including custom fields, files, and project information from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Doc
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific doc by ID. Use when you have confirmed the doc ID and need full doc metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific file by its ID. Use when you need file metadata, download URL, or processing status from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Folder
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific folder. Use when you have confirmed the folder ID and need full folder metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Insight
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific insight by ID. Use when you need full insight metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Note
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific note. Use when you have confirmed the note ID and need full note metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific project. Use when you have confirmed the project ID and need full project metadata from Dovetail.

tools.name: Get Token Info
tools.description: Retrieves information about the current API token, including its unique identifier and the associated workspace subdomain. Use this to verify which workspace the token belongs to.

tools.name: Import Data File
tools.description: Tool to import a public URL of a file as new data in Dovetail. Use when you need to add external files to a project.

tools.name: Import Doc File
tools.description: Tool to import a public file URL as a new doc in Dovetail. Use when you need to create a doc from an external file source. The file must be publicly accessible at the provided URL.

tools.name: Import Insight from File
tools.description: Tool to import a file from a public URL as a new insight in Dovetail. Use when you need to create an insight from an external file source such as PDFs, images, or documents. The file must be publicly accessible for Dovetail to fetch and import it. After import, the insight can be analyzed, tagged, and connected to projects.

tools.name: Import Note File
tools.description: Tool to import a file from a public URL as a new note in Dovetail. Use when you need to create a note by importing content from an accessible file URL (PDF, video, audio, etc.).

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of contacts from a Dovetail workspace. Returns contact IDs, names, creation timestamps, and custom fields. Use cursor-based pagination (limit + start_cursor) to navigate large contact lists efficiently.

tools.name: List Data
tools.description: Tool to list data items in Dovetail. Use when you need to retrieve, filter, sort, or paginate through your workspace data. Supports filtering by created_at (date range), project_id, and title. Results can be sorted by created_at or title. Uses cursor-based pagination with configurable page size.

tools.name: List Docs
tools.description: Tool to list docs in a Dovetail workspace with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve docs, optionally filtered by project, title, content, or creation date.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: Tool to get a list of folders associated with a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve folder hierarchy, search for folders by title, or navigate the folder structure with pagination support.

tools.name: List Highlights
tools.description: List highlights from your Dovetail workspace with optional filtering and pagination. Use this action to retrieve highlights that have been created across your notes and projects. Supports filtering by project or note, and cursor-based pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: List Insights
tools.description: Tool to get a list of insights associated with a workspace. Use when you need to retrieve insights with optional filtering by project, publication status, or title, and support for cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: List notes in Dovetail workspace with optional pagination and sorting. Use this tool to retrieve notes from your Dovetail workspace. Supports pagination for large result sets and sorting options. Returns note metadata including IDs, titles, timestamps, and associated project information.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Tool to list all projects in Dovetail. Use after authenticating with a valid workspace token when you need to retrieve the full project list.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List all tags in the authenticated Dovetail workspace. Returns tag details including title, color, highlight count, and timestamps. Supports pagination for workspaces with many tags.

tools.name: List User Docs
tools.description: Tool to get a list of docs associated with a user in Dovetail. Use when you need to retrieve documents for a specific user or the authenticated user (use 'me' as user_id).

tools.name: List User Insights
tools.description: List personal insights for a user in Dovetail. Returns a paginated list of insights including their IDs, titles, creation dates, and published status. Use DOVETAIL_GET_TOKEN_INFO to obtain a valid user_id.

tools.name: Magic Search
tools.description: Tool to perform a magic search across workspace data. Use when you need to retrieve relevant highlights, notes, insights, channels, themes, or tags by query.

tools.name: Update Channel
tools.description: Tool to update an existing channel's title or context. Use after confirming the channel ID and fields to change.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Tool to update an existing contact in Dovetail. Use when you need to modify a contact's name, email, or custom fields.

tools.name: Update Data
tools.description: Tool to update a data item in Dovetail. Use when you need to modify the title or fields of an existing data item.

tools.name: Update Doc
tools.description: Tool to update a doc in Dovetail. Use when you need to modify a doc's title or custom fields.

tools.name: Update Insight
tools.description: Updates an existing insight in Dovetail, allowing you to modify the title and custom fields. Use when you need to revise insight information, correct titles, or update custom field values.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Tool to update an existing note in Dovetail. Use when you need to modify a note's title, content, or custom fields. Example: "Update note 8IFq5LEC6hV1Vgsu0jPNJ with new title 'Q1 Review'".

tools.name: Update Topic
tools.description: Tool to update an existing topic. Use after confirming the topic ID and fields to change. Example: "Update topic with id 123... to have title 'New'".

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the Dovetail API.

name: Dpd2
description: DPD is a digital product delivery platform for selling ebooks, software, music, and other digital goods.

tools.name: Get Storefront
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific DPD storefront by its ID. Returns storefront configuration including name, URL, contact details, currency, type, and subdomain. Use this after obtaining a storefront ID from DPD2_LIST_STOREFRONTS or when you need to fetch current metadata for a known storefront.

tools.name: List DPD Customers (Filtered)
tools.description: Tool to list customers in your DPD account with advanced filtering. Use when you need to find customers by email, name, product purchases, newsletter subscription status, or creation date range.

tools.name: List DPD Purchases
tools.description: Tool to list all purchases made through your DPD account. Use when you need to retrieve purchase records with optional date filters and pagination for reporting or analysis.

tools.name: List Storefronts
tools.description: Tool to list all storefronts in your DPD account. Use after authenticating to fetch storefront details before managing products or purchases.

tools.name: List Subscribers
tools.description: Tool to list subscribers for a given storefront. Use when you need a paginated and filtered list of subscribers after storefront setup.

tools.name: DPD: Ping API
tools.description: Tool to ping the API to check its status. Use when verifying API connectivity before further operations.

tools.name: Verify DPD IPN Notification
tools.description: Tool to verify a POST from the URL integration (IPN/webhook). POST all parameters that were POSTed to your site to confirm authenticity. Use after receiving an IPN notification to validate it came from DPD.

tools.name: Verify Subscriber
tools.description: Tool to verify a subscriber's subscription status. Use when you need to check if a subscriber is active and receiving service. Either username (email) or subscriber ID must be provided.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API password available on your profile

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your DPD account username

name: Draftable
description: Draftable provides an enterprise-grade document comparison API that allows developers to compare popular document types such as PDFs, Word, and PowerPoint files.

tools.name: List Comparisons
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of document comparisons. Use when you need to browse comparisons across pages.

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: Your Draftable API authentication token.

name: Dreamstudio
description: DreamStudio is Stability AI's user interface for generative AI, allowing users to create and edit generated images.

tools.name: Generate Image from Image
tools.description: Tool to generate a new image from an initial image and text prompts. Use after you have a reference image and want to transform it via text guidance.

tools.name: Generate Image from Text
tools.description: Generate images from text prompts using Stability AI's text-to-image models. Use when you need to create images from textual descriptions without a reference image. Supports multiple prompts with weights, configurable dimensions, and various generation parameters.

tools.name: List Engines
tools.description: List all available DreamStudio/Stability AI engines accessible with your API key. This action retrieves all AI models (engines) you can use for image generation and other tasks. Common engines include Stable Diffusion XL and various Stable Diffusion versions. Use this action to: - Discover which engines are available to your account - Get engine IDs needed for image generation requests - Check engine types and capabilities No parameters required - simply call to get the complete list of accessible engines. Using an unsupported engine_id in generation requests will cause failures; engines also vary in supported image sizes (typically capped near 1024x1024) and quality for specific tasks.

tools.name: User Account
tools.description: Retrieves authenticated user's account information from Stability AI. Returns user ID, email, organization memberships, and profile picture. No parameters required - uses authenticated session.

tools.name: DreamStudio User Balance
tools.description: Retrieves the user's current credit balance from their DreamStudio account. Use this tool to check how many credits are available before generating images or to monitor remaining credits after API operations. Credits are consumed when generating images through the Stability AI API. For large or high-resolution batch generation, verify sufficient balance first — insufficient credits will cause failures mid-run.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Stability API key used for authentication.

name: Dribbble
description: Dribbble is a design community and publishing platform for managing shots, projects, and attachments. Automated mutations must be specifically requested by the user.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a project for the connected Dribbble user.

tools.name: Create Shot
tools.description: Upload an image to create a public Dribbble shot asynchronously. The connected user must be a player or team and eligible to upload shots. Returns the shot location without polling or claiming processing is complete.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently delete a project belonging to the connected Dribbble user. Returns deletion confirmation and the provider's project fields when supplied.

tools.name: Delete Shot
tools.description: Permanently delete a shot owned by the connected Dribbble user. This action is irreversible and returns the deleted shot ID as confirmation.

tools.name: Delete Shot Attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete an attachment from a shot owned by the connected Dribbble user. This action is irreversible and returns both IDs as confirmation.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Return the connected Dribbble user's profile, account capabilities, teams, and shot-upload eligibility.

tools.name: Get My Shot
tools.description: Return one shot owned by the connected user, including its media, tags, projects, and attachments. Choose HTML or plain-text description representation.

tools.name: List My Projects
tools.description: Return one page of projects belonging to the connected Dribbble user, with a safe cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List My Shots
tools.description: Return one page of shots owned by the connected Dribbble user, with a safe cursor and selectable HTML or plain-text description representation.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update the name or description of a project belonging to the connected user.

tools.name: Update Shot
tools.description: Update an owned Dribbble shot's metadata and choose the HTML or plain-text description representation returned in the response.

tools.name: Upload Shot Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file attachment to an owned Dribbble shot asynchronously. This requires a Pro user, team, or team membership. A successful response only confirms acceptance; retrieve the shot later to discover the attachment ID.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Dripcel
description: Dripcel is a platform for automated SMS and Email marketing, campaign compliance, and data-driven lead generation.

tools.name: Create Contacts in Bulk
tools.description: Tool to upload a list of new contacts to Dripcel in bulk. Only creates new contacts (does not update existing ones). Use when you need to add multiple contacts to your Dripcel account at once. Maximum 100,000 contacts per request.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Tool to delete a contact by their cell number. Use when you need to remove a contact from Dripcel after confirming the MSISDN.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag by its ID. Use when you need to remove a tag from Dripcel. Warning: This will also remove the tag from all contacts and campaigns that have it.

tools.name: Get current credit balance
tools.description: Retrieves the current credit balance for your Dripcel organization account. This action requires no input parameters and returns the available credit balance as a numeric value. Use this to check your account balance before performing credit-consuming operations like sending SMS messages. The balance is returned in your account's default currency (not explicitly specified in the response).

tools.name: Get Dripcel Campaigns
tools.description: Retrieves a list of campaigns from Dripcel. Supports optional pagination (page, pageSize) and filtering by campaign status. Returns campaign details including ID, name, status, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get contact by cell number
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single contact by their cell number (MSISDN). Use when you need to view details of a specific contact including their name, email, tags, and other metadata.

tools.name: Get Deliveries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SMS/email delivery records from Dripcel. Returns a list of message deliveries filtered by recipient phone number (cell) or send operation ID (customerId). Useful for tracking message delivery status, checking delivery history for a specific contact, or auditing a particular send operation.

tools.name: Get email templates
tools.description: Retrieves all email templates from your Dripcel account. Returns a list of templates with their IDs, names, subjects, and content. Use this action when you need to: - View all available email templates in your account - Get template IDs for use in email sending operations - Check template content before selecting one for a campaign - List templates to verify template creation or updates Note: According to API documentation, this endpoint returns all templates without documented support for pagination or filtering.

tools.name: Get sales
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all sales. Use when you need comprehensive sales data for reporting or analytics.

tools.name: List all tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tags in your Dripcel organization. Use when you need to view available tags, get tag IDs for adding to contacts, or verify tag existence before operations.

tools.name: Opt out contact from campaigns
tools.description: Tool to opt out a contact from multiple campaigns at once. Use when you need to remove a contact from campaign messaging. More robust than single campaign opt-out, allowing batch operations or opting out from all campaigns at once.

tools.name: Check SMS Compliance
tools.description: Check if phone numbers are allowed to receive SMS messages based on opt-out status and campaign targeting rules. Returns whether each number can be sent to, helping ensure compliance before sending messages. Costs 0.14 credits per phone number checked.

tools.name: Search replies based on filters
tools.description: Search for SMS/message replies with flexible filtering by ID, campaign, phone number, reply type, message content, or date range. Returns matching replies with metadata. All filters are optional and can be combined for precise queries.

tools.name: Add tags to a contact
tools.description: Add one or more tags to a contact identified by phone number. Use this tool to organize contacts by assigning tags for segmentation and targeting. Tags must exist in the system before being added - use GET /tags to retrieve valid tag IDs. Provide either tag_ids (recommended) or tag names. Set create_missing_contact=true to automatically create the contact if they don't exist in your Dripcel account. Response includes matchedCount (contacts found) and modifiedCount (contacts updated).

tools.name: Search send logs
tools.description: Search for SMS send logs with flexible filtering by ID, phone number, campaign, delivery, message content (regex), or date range. Supports MongoDB-style queries with projection and pagination. All filters are optional and can be combined.

tools.name: Send Bulk Email
tools.description: Tool to send bulk emails to multiple recipients using a template. Use when you need to send the same email content to many contacts at once.

tools.name: Send SMS
tools.description: Tool to send a single SMS to a contact. Use when you need to deliver a targeted message immediately or schedule it for later.

tools.name: Upsert Contacts
tools.description: Tool to upload contacts in bulk, creating new contacts or updating existing ones. Limit: 20,000 contacts per request. Use when you need to import or sync a list of contacts to Dripcel. Invalid contacts will be reported but won't block the operation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key for your Dripcel organization.

name: Dromo
description: Dromo is an intuitive spreadsheet importer that integrates seamlessly with your product, enabling users to match columns, correct errors, perform complex validations, transform values, and upload perfectly formatted data.

tools.name: Create Headless Import
tools.description: Tool to create a headless import in Dromo. Returns a signed upload URL for file uploads. Use this before uploading files to obtain the temporary upload URL.

tools.name: Create Import Schema
tools.description: Tool to create a new import schema in Dromo. Define fields, validation rules, and settings for data imports. Use this when setting up a new data import workflow or template.

tools.name: Delete Import Schema
tools.description: Tool to delete an import schema in Dromo. Use when you need to remove a schema definition that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Get Import Schema
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an import schema by ID from Dromo. Returns the complete schema definition including fields, validation rules, settings, and webhook configurations. Use this to inspect schema structure, validate field requirements, or retrieve configuration details before creating imports.

tools.name: List Import Schemas
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all import schemas configured for your Dromo organization. Use this to discover available schemas, their field definitions, validation rules, and settings before creating imports.

tools.name: List Uploads
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all file uploads stored by Dromo for your organization. Returns upload metadata including status, row counts, errors, user information, and file details. Use this to monitor import progress, track upload history, or retrieve upload IDs for further processing.

tools.name: Update Import Schema
tools.description: Tool to update an existing import schema in Dromo. Modifies the schema definition including fields, validation rules, and settings. Use when you need to change field configurations, add/remove validators, or update import settings for an existing schema.

tools.name: Upload File To Headless Import
tools.description: Upload a file to Dromo's headless import system using a presigned S3 URL. This action performs the actual file upload step in Dromo's headless import workflow: 1. First, create a headless import via POST to /headless/imports/ to get an upload URL 2. Then, use this action to upload the file to that URL 3. Dromo automatically processes the file once the upload completes The upload URL is valid for 30 minutes. This action performs an HTTP PUT request with the file content to the provided presigned S3 URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Dromo backend API key, used for authenticating API requests.

name: Drop to CDN
description: Upload files and publish HTML pages to public CDN URLs, then list, inspect, and delete hosted files.

tools.name: Permanently Delete File
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly delete a file or hosted page owned by the connected account. This cannot restore monthly upload quota already consumed.

tools.name: Get Account Usage
tools.description: Return the connected account's plan and current upload/storage usage context for deciding whether an upload is appropriate.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Get metadata and the public CDN URL for one file or hosted page owned by the connected account.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of files and hosted pages owned by the connected account, with a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: Publish Page
tools.description: Publish HTML as a publicly hosted page and return its CDN URL. Each successful publish consumes monthly upload quota.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Upload a file and return its public CDN URL and expiration metadata. Each successful upload consumes monthly upload quota even if the file is later deleted.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your Drop to CDN API key in Dashboard -> Settings -> API keys at https://droptocdn.com/dashboard/settings. Keys start with dtc_. Enter only the key; the Bearer prefix is added automatically.

name: Dropcontact
description: Dropcontact is a B2B email finder and data enrichment service that provides verified professional email addresses and enriches contact information.

tools.name: Create Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription for receiving automatic notifications when enrichment results are ready. Use this instead of polling GET /v1/enrich/all to receive push notifications when contact enrichment processing completes. Currently only supports 'enrich_api_result' event type.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook subscription. Use when you need to remove a configured webhook and stop receiving notifications. Alternatively, you can pause a subscription by setting it to inactive using the update endpoint.

tools.name: Initiate Contact Enrichment
tools.description: Initiates asynchronous batch enrichment for up to 250 contacts with email finding, validation, and company information. Returns a request_id that must be used with the 'Retrieve Enrichment Results' action to fetch the enriched data. Each contact needs at least one of: email, OR (first_name + last_name + company), OR (full_name + company), OR LinkedIn URL. The enrichment typically completes within 30-60 seconds depending on batch size.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to list webhook subscriptions. Use when you need to inspect your configured webhooks.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions V2
tools.description: Tool to list all webhook subscriptions configured for the account. Returns webhook URLs, event types, and subscription details. Use when you need to inspect your configured webhooks.

tools.name: Retrieve Enrichment Results
tools.description: Retrieves enriched contact data by request ID after submitting contacts for enrichment. Use this tool to fetch the results of a contact enrichment request created with the 'Batch Enrich Contacts' action. The enrichment process may take 30-60 seconds. If the request is still processing, the response will indicate 'success=false' with a reason message. Once complete, you'll receive enriched data including emails with qualification status, LinkedIn profiles, company information, phone numbers, and location details. Note: You can retrieve partial results even if all contacts haven't been processed yet.

tools.name: Update Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Tool to update an existing webhook subscription. Use when you need to modify the callback URL, rate limiting settings, or active status. The event_type field cannot be changed after creation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal access token for authenticating API requests.

name: Dropleads
description: Dropleads provides contact and company search, enrichment, email discovery, email verification, and mobile-number discovery APIs for sales workflows.

tools.name: Count Companies
tools.description: Count companies matching optional filters for free without returning company records or consuming credits. The response contains only aggregate count status, and the contract is documentation-derived and not live-verified.

tools.name: Count People
tools.description: Count people matching optional filters without returning personal records or consuming credits. The contract is documentation-derived and not live-verified.

tools.name: Enrich Companies
tools.description: Enrich up to 50 companies by domain and/or name. Each found company is documented to consume 0.1 credit; not-found inputs are documented as free. Results can contain sensitive company profile, financial, technology, location, and nullable phone data. This contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Enrich People without Email Verification
tools.description: Enrich 1-10 people and return sensitive unmasked personal records without verifying returned emails. Dropleads documents a charge of 0.2 credits per returned lead. Only submit personal data you are authorized to process. This contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Enrich People with Verified Email
tools.description: Enrich 1-10 people and retrieve sensitive, unmasked personal records whose emails satisfy the requested verification policy. Dropleads documents a charge of 0.2 credits per verified match. Only submit people whose data you are authorized to process. The contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Estimate lead export cost
tools.description: Get a free estimate only of credits required to save or export leads and whether the account can afford it. This performs no export execution and does not save any leads. Documentation-derived and not live-verified.

tools.name: Find Mobile Number
tools.description: Discover the sensitive personal mobile number associated with one LinkedIn profile URL. This finds a number but does not verify it. A successful lookup consumes 3 credits; whether unsuccessful lookups are charged is undocumented. The contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Find Work Email
tools.description: Find and verify one person's sensitive work email from their name and company. A successful lookup is documented to consume 1 credit, while a not_found result is documented as free. This contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return sensitive account subscription and pay-as-you-go credit balances and the configured credit rate. No charge is documented for this read-only lookup. The contract is documentation-derived and has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Return exactly one requested page of companies matching optional filters. Every returned company consumes 0.1 credit, up to 5 credits at limit 50. Results may contain sensitive nullable company phone data. The contract is documentation-derived and not live-verified.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Return exactly one requested page of masked people matching optional filters without consuming credits. Results do not reveal email addresses or phone numbers. The contract is documentation-derived and not live-verified.

tools.name: Verify Email
tools.description: Check one sensitive personal or business email address for valid, invalid, catch-all, or unknown deliverability. Only submit an address you are authorized to process. Dropleads documents a 0.1-credit charge for valid or invalid results; catch-all and unknown results are documented as free. This contract has not been live-verified.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log in to Dropleads, open Settings > API Keys, select Create API Key, and copy the key when it is shown. Dropleads shows Data Enrichment API keys only once, so store it securely.

name: Dub
description: Short link management platform with analytics and API for creating, managing, and tracking branded short links

tools.name: Bulk Delete Links
tools.description: Tool to delete multiple short links in bulk from Dub. Use when you need to remove multiple links at once. Maximum of 100 link IDs per request. Non-existing IDs are silently ignored.

tools.name: Bulk Update Links
tools.description: Tool to update multiple short links in bulk. Use when you need to apply the same updates to multiple links at once by specifying link IDs or external IDs.

tools.name: Create Domain
tools.description: Tool to add a domain to a Dub workspace. Use when you need to create a new domain for shortening links. The domain must be verified before it can be used for link shortening.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag in Dub. Use when you need to organize links by creating custom tags. Tags help categorize and filter links for better organization.

tools.name: Delete Domain
tools.description: Tool to delete a domain from your Dub workspace. Use when you need to permanently remove a domain. The domain must exist and be owned by your workspace.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag from Dub. Use when you need to remove a tag that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Get Link Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific short link from Dub. Use when you need to get comprehensive information about a link including its configuration, targeting settings, and performance metrics.

tools.name: Get Links
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of links for the authenticated workspace. Use when you need to list links with optional filtering by domain, tags, folder, search terms, or user. Supports pagination and sorting for efficient retrieval of large link collections.

tools.name: Get Links Count
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the count of links in workspace with optional filters. Use when you need to get the total number of links matching specific criteria such as domain, tags, folder, or search terms.

tools.name: Retrieve List of Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of tags from Dub. Use when you need to fetch all tags or search for specific tags by name or IDs. Supports pagination and sorting by name or creation date.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific workspace. Use when you need to get workspace details including plan, usage limits, domains, users, and configuration settings.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of domains for the authenticated workspace. Use when you need to view all domains, search for specific domains, or filter domains by archived status. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: Track Deep Link Open Event
tools.description: Tool to track a deep link open event in Dub. Use when you need to record when a user opens your app via a deep link. Supports both direct tracking via deepLink parameter or probabilistic tracking via dubDomain parameter.

tools.name: Update Domain
tools.description: Tool to update a domain configuration in Dub. Use when you need to modify domain settings like redirect URLs, placeholder text, archive status, or deep linking configurations.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tag by ID. Use when you need to change the name or color of a tag.

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update workspace settings in Dub. Use when you need to modify workspace name, slug, logo, or conversion tracking settings.

tools.name: Upsert a Link
tools.description: Tool to create or update a short link in Dub. Use when you need to create a new short link or update an existing one. If the link already exists (matching domain and key), it will be updated; otherwise, a new link will be created.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Dub API key (workspace key starting with "dub_" or legacy personal key starting with "user_"). Get it from https://app.dub.co/settings/tokens

name: Dungeon Fighter Online
description: Dungeon Fighter Online (DFO) is an arcade-style, side-scrolling action game with RPG elements, offering players a dynamic combat experience.

tools.name: Character Base Information
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive base information for a Dungeon & Fighter Online character, including level, job details, fame, adventure/account info, and guild membership. Prerequisites: - Use GET_SERVER_LIST to obtain valid server IDs (e.g., "cain", "siroco") - Use CHARACTER_SEARCH to find character IDs by searching character names Returns character details including level, job/class information, fame points, adventure (account) name, and guild affiliation if applicable.

tools.name: Character Search
tools.description: Search for Dungeon Fighter Online characters by name on a specific server. Returns a list of characters matching the search criteria, including their ID, level, job information, and fame points. Use the Get Server List action first to obtain valid server IDs. Supports both exact matching and partial substring searches.

tools.name: Get Character Skill Buff Avatar
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a character's buff skill and equipped avatars that enhance it. Returns comprehensive data including: - Buff skill details (name, ID, level, description, stat values) - Avatar equipment in buff slots (jacket, pants, etc.) - Avatar properties (rarity, clone info, option abilities) - Emblems attached to each avatar piece Use this to analyze a character's buff skill configuration, avatar setup for skill enhancement, and emblem attachments. Requires valid serverId (from GET_SERVER_LIST) and characterId (from CHARACTER_SEARCH).

tools.name: Get Character Skill Buff Status
tools.description: Tool to fetch character's skill buff status information. Use when you need to know active buff statuses for a specific character.

tools.name: Character Status Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve status information of a specific character. Use after obtaining serverId and characterId to fetch current stats.

tools.name: Character Timeline
tools.description: Retrieves the activity timeline for a specific character in Dungeon Fighter Online. Returns a chronological list of timeline events (e.g., equipment changes, level ups, achievements) for the character. Use this tool after obtaining a valid serverId from server list and characterId from character search. Returns an empty timeline if no events are available for the character.

tools.name: Get Character Avatar Equipment
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about a character's equipped avatar items in Dungeon Fighter Online. Returns character details and avatar equipment across all slots (hair, face, hat, neck, jacket, pants, belt, shoes, skin, weapon) including item details, rarities, clone avatars, option abilities, and attached emblems.

tools.name: Get Character Buff Skill Creature
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a character's buff skill creature equipment. Returns comprehensive data including: - Character information (name, level, job, guild) - Buff skill details (skill name, ID, level, description, stat values) - Creature equipped for the buff skill (item name, ID, rarity) Use this to analyze a character's buff skill creature configuration. Requires valid serverId (from GET_SERVER_LIST) and characterId (from CHARACTER_SEARCH). Note: Buff skill value information is provided based on the latest in-game login and can differ or be unavailable depending on character login circumstances.

tools.name: Get Character Creature
tools.description: Tool to retrieve equipped creature information for a Dungeon & Fighter Online character. Use after obtaining serverId and characterId to fetch creature details.

tools.name: Get Character Equipment
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive equipment information for a Dungeon & Fighter Online character. Returns detailed data including: - Character base information (level, job, fame, adventure, guild) - All equipped items across 13 equipment slots - Item details (name, type, rarity, level requirements) - Enhancement information (reinforcement, amplification, refinement, enchantments) - Set item bonuses and fusion stone options - Upgrade, tuning, and exalted equipment details Prerequisites: - Use GET_SERVER_LIST to obtain valid server IDs - Use CHARACTER_SEARCH to find character IDs by name

tools.name: Get Character Equipped Insignia
tools.description: Retrieves character equipped insignia (flag) information from Dungeon Fighter Online. Returns character details and equipped insignia/flag items including reinforcement skills.

tools.name: Get Character Skill Buff Equipment
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a character's skill buff equipment, including the buff skill details and equipment items that enhance the buff. This action returns: - Character information (name, level, job, guild) - Buff skill information (skill name, level, description) - Equipment items that provide buff bonuses (weapon, armor, accessories, title) Prerequisites: - Valid server ID (use Get Server List action) - Valid character ID (use Character Search action) Note: Buff data is based on the character's latest in-game login.

tools.name: Get Character Skill Style
tools.description: Tool to retrieve character skill style information. Use when you need to know a character's active skills, passive skills, skill evolutions, and skill enhancements. Note: Skill enhancements through items and equipment are excluded from this response.

tools.name: Get Item Hashtags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all available item hashtags for searching items. Use when needing to know which hashtag categories are available for item searches.

tools.name: Get Item Information
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific item in Dungeon & Fighter Online. Equipment stats are shown based on Superior 100% grade values. Titles are shown based on average Ordinary grade values.

tools.name: Get Item Shop Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve item shop sell information for specific equipment. Use when needing to find which NPCs sell a particular item and at what price. Only supports Lv.95 Epic and Lv.100+ Unique/Legendary/Epic equipment.

tools.name: Get Jobs List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all available character classes (jobs) in Dungeon Fighter Online. Use when needing to know which job classes are available in the game.

tools.name: Get Job Skills
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the complete list of skills available for a specific character class and advancement. Use when you need to know what skills are available for a particular job and job growth combination.

tools.name: Get Multiple Items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for multiple items at once. Use when needing to fetch item details for up to 15 items in a single request. Duplicate item IDs will be processed only once.

tools.name: Get Multiple Skills Information
tools.description: Retrieves information for multiple skills of a character class at once. Up to 10 skills can be queried per request, with duplicate skill IDs automatically removed. Use this action when you need to fetch details for several skills simultaneously rather than making individual requests. The response includes skill names, levels, descriptions, and option values for each requested skill. Note: If invalid skill IDs are provided, they may be omitted from the response rather than causing an error.

tools.name: Get Server List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available game servers. Use when needing to know which servers are available.

tools.name: Get Skill Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific skill of a character class. Use when you need to know skill stats, level requirements, MP costs, cooldowns, or level-by-level progression details.

tools.name: Search Characters By Fame
tools.description: Tool to search characters by fame ranking. Only returns characters level 110 or above that have logged in within 90 days. Use when you need to find high-ranking characters based on fame points.

tools.name: Search Items
tools.description: Search for Dungeon Fighter Online items by name or hashtag. Only returns items currently obtainable in-game. Supports filtering by level range and rarity. Item images available at https://img-api.dfoneople.com/df/items/{itemId}.

tools.name: Search Set Items
tools.description: Search for Dungeon Fighter Online set items by name. Returns a list of set items matching the search criteria, including their unique identifiers. Supports exact match, prefix match, and full text search modes. Use URL encoding for non-ASCII characters (automatically handled).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key issued upon application registration.

name: Dynamic Mockups
description: Dynamic Mockups provides APIs for generating product mockups, rendering templates, managing catalogs and collections, and creating AI-powered image and motion assets.

tools.name: Create MockAnything Mockup
tools.description: Create and optionally wait for a MockAnything mockup from exactly one prompt, public image URL, or uploaded image. WARNING: this persists a mockup, may find-or-create named collections, and consumes model-dependent credits on SUCCESS; the connected account's tier and balance are unknown. Polling is bounded and may return completed=false with a task_id for later status checks.

tools.name: Get Generation Options
tools.description: Return current MockAnything styles and aspect-ratio support plus MotionMockups models, durations, aspect ratios, estimated times, and live credit prices. Call this before choosing generation settings because model availability and costs change.

tools.name: Get MockAnything Product
tools.description: Get one POD product's supported sizes, colors, and decoration locations before using its UUID in MockAnything generation.

tools.name: Get MockAnything Status
tools.description: Check one MockAnything task once, typically after Create MockAnything Mockup stops waiting. WARNING: a well-formed unknown UUID may return PENDING indefinitely, so PENDING does not prove the task exists and this tool never loops.

tools.name: Get Motion Mockup Status
tools.description: Check a submitted MotionMockups video job once and return its queue state or completed MP4 metadata. The tool does not poll automatically because jobs commonly take 2-15 minutes.

tools.name: List Catalogs and Collections
tools.description: Return the connected account's catalogs and collections, including the UUIDs used to filter mockups and target creation or bulk workflows. This is read-only and does not consume render credits.

tools.name: List Mockups
tools.description: Find renderable mockup templates and return their mockup, smart-object, text-layer, and print-area-preset UUIDs. Filters are optional; name matching semantics are not guaranteed because they could not be verified on the empty connected account.

tools.name: Render Mockups
tools.description: Render one or more explicitly selected mockup templates from public artwork URLs, colors, Beta text layers, and shared export settings. One item uses POST /renders and multiple items use POST /renders/batch. WARNING: every successful output consumes a credit, Free-plan API renders may be watermarked, and output URLs last about 24 hours. Account tier, credit balance, and batch limits are unknown.

tools.name: Search MockAnything Products
tools.description: Fuzzy-search POD products that can ground MockAnything generation. The provider may return up to 50 broad matches and exposes no pagination, so use a specific brand, style code, or product phrase.

tools.name: Submit Motion Mockup
tools.description: WARNING: Submit image-to-video generation and return a request ID for later status checks. This creates a long-running job and reserves or consumes model-, duration-, and audio-dependent credits; current live-discovered prices range from 40 to 585 credits, while the connected account's tier and balance are unknown. Call Get Generation Options first. The submit endpoint is limited to 10 requests per minute.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Dynamic Mockups REST API key. Create or copy it from the API Dashboard at https://app.dynamicmockups.com/dashboard-api. Keep this account-bound key secret.

name: Dynapictures
description: Generate Hundreds of Personalized Images in Minutes. DynaPictures is a cloud-based solution for dynamic image generation. Connect your preferred data source like Google Sheets to create personalized images and display your client names, coupons, or virtually anything else.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace for organizing templates, images, and media library assets. Use when you need to establish a new workspace within a Dynapictures account.

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Tool to delete a workspace and all associated content (templates, media, generated images). Use when permanently removing a workspace. Warning: Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to get all image templates that are ready and have the 'Sync to Zapier' checkbox enabled. Use when you need to retrieve available templates for image generation.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to get all workspaces associated with the API key. Use when you need to retrieve workspaces the authenticated user is a member of.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from webhook notifications by providing the same parameters used during subscription. Use when you need to stop receiving notifications for a specific webhook.

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update an existing workspace's details by workspace ID. Use when you need to modify a workspace's name or properties.

tools.name: Upload Media Asset
tools.description: Tool to upload an image and create a media asset object. Use when you need to upload an image to Dynapictures workspace for later use in image generation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Navigate to your DynaPictures account and sign in. Click on your profile in the top-right, then "Account" to retrieve your API token.

name: Dynatrace
description: Dynatrace provides observability, analytics, automation, settings, documents, and telemetry APIs for monitored environments.

tools.name: Acquire Lock
tools.description: Acquire or extend the current user's lock on a document. A user can lock at most five documents, and a lock can last at most 15 minutes.

tools.name: Add Direct Share Recipients
tools.description: Add users or groups to an accessible Dynatrace direct share.

tools.name: Add Settings Object Accessor Permissions
tools.description: Grant read or write permissions on a settings object to one accessor.

tools.name: Autocomplete Grail Query
tools.description: Return structured Dynatrace Grail DQL completion suggestions at an optional cursor position. The connected OAuth client and user need at least one supported storage read permission, plus storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the DQL query.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Document
tools.description: Move up to 100 documents to trash in one request and return the outcome for each document. Trashed documents are inaccessible until restored.

tools.name: Cancel Execution
tools.description: Request cancellation of an active workflow execution. Acceptance does not wait for the execution to reach CANCELLED.

tools.name: Cancel Grail Query
tools.description: Cancel a Grail query identified by its request token. The connected OAuth client and user need at least one supported storage read permission, plus storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the original query.

tools.name: Cancel Task Execution
tools.description: Request cancellation of an active task execution. Acceptance does not wait for the task or workflow to reach a terminal state.

tools.name: Claim Environment Share
tools.description: Claim another user's environment share and gain its granted access to the shared document. This access cannot be relinquished by the claimer.

tools.name: Close Problem
tools.description: Close an open Dynatrace problem and add the supplied closing comment. Closure is an irreversible state change; an already closed problem is left unchanged.

tools.name: Create Business Calendar
tools.description: Create a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Create Direct Share
tools.description: Create a read or read-write direct share for a Dynatrace document.

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Create a Dynatrace document from metadata and up to 50 MB of binary content.

tools.name: Create Environment Share
tools.description: Create an environment-wide share link for a document owned by or reshareable by the connected user.

tools.name: Create Problem Comment
tools.description: Add a new visible comment to an existing Dynatrace problem. The operation mutates the problem's comment history.

tools.name: Create Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Create a Dynatrace scheduling rule from the official SDK rule contract.

tools.name: Create Workflow
tools.description: Create a Dynatrace workflow from its task and trigger definition.

tools.name: Delete Business Calendar
tools.description: Delete a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Delete Direct Share
tools.description: Delete a direct share without deleting its Dynatrace document.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Move a document to the trash. The caller must own the document and provide its current optimistic-locking version.

tools.name: Delete Environment Share
tools.description: Delete an environment share and revoke the document access granted through that share from all claimers.

tools.name: Delete Metric
tools.description: Irreversibly trigger deletion of one metric ingested through Metrics v2. Dynatrace rejects metrics written within the last two hours and does not delete the metric's data from Grail storage.

tools.name: Delete Metrics
tools.description: Irreversibly trigger bulk deletion of Metrics v2-ingested metrics selected by metric_selector and age. Wildcards can select many or all custom metrics. This does not delete metric data from Grail storage.

tools.name: Delete Problem Comment
tools.description: Permanently delete one identified comment from an identified Dynatrace problem. This action cannot restore the deleted comment.

tools.name: Delete Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Permanently delete one scheduling rule by UUID.

tools.name: Delete Settings Object
tools.description: Delete a Dynatrace settings object using optimistic locking.

tools.name: Delete Settings Object Accessor Permissions
tools.description: Remove every permission a user, group, or all-users accessor has on a settings object.

tools.name: Delete Snapshot
tools.description: Irrevocably delete a snapshot without changing the document's current state. Only the document owner can delete it. Deletion does not consume Dynatrace's snapshot creation quota of 5 snapshots per document within 60 seconds.

tools.name: Delete Trashed Document
tools.description: Irreversibly destroy a trashed Dynatrace document owned by the connected user. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Trashed Workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete a workflow that is already in trash.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Handler
tools.description: Delete a webhook handler using an installed Dynatrace app as its context.

tools.name: Download Document Content
tools.description: Download the binary content of the latest document version or a specific snapshot, preserving the provider's filename and MIME type.

tools.name: Duplicate Business Calendar
tools.description: Create a copy of a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Duplicate Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Duplicate a Dynatrace scheduling rule, optionally assigning a new title.

tools.name: Duplicate Workflow
tools.description: Create a new workflow by copying an existing Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: Execute Grail Query
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Grail DQL query and return either its result or a request token for polling. The connected OAuth client and user need at least one supported storage read permission, plus storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the DQL query.

tools.name: Export Workflow
tools.description: Export a workflow as the provider's JSON WorkflowExport definition.

tools.name: Export Workflow History Record as JSON
tools.description: Export one historical workflow version as a transferable JSON workflow definition, including its tasks and configuration. Use Inspect Workflow History Record instead for read-only inspection of saved runtime metadata.

tools.name: Export Workflow Template
tools.description: Export the current workflow, or a historical version when version is supplied, as the provider's reusable YAML template envelope.

tools.name: Generate Schema Default Value
tools.description: Generate the default settings value for a Dynatrace schema and optional scope.

tools.name: Get Action Execution
tools.description: Return one Dynatrace Automation action execution.

tools.name: Get Action Execution Log
tools.description: Return the plain-text log for a Dynatrace Automation action execution.

tools.name: Get Action Sample Result
tools.description: Return the sample result for a Dynatrace Automation action. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Get Business Calendar
tools.description: Return one Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Get Business Calendar History Record
tools.description: Return one historical version of a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Get Direct Share
tools.description: Return an accessible Dynatrace direct share by its ID.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Retrieve a document's metadata and binary content, optionally from a snapshot.

tools.name: Get Document Metadata
tools.description: Return metadata for the latest version or a specific snapshot of a document.

tools.name: Get Entity
tools.description: Return one monitored entity by its Dynatrace entity identifier.

tools.name: Get Entity Type
tools.description: Return the schema and relationship metadata for one Dynatrace entity type.

tools.name: Get Environment Share
tools.description: Retrieve an accessible Dynatrace environment share by its ID.

tools.name: Get Event
tools.description: Return one Dynatrace event by its event ID; the connected environment must expose the Events v2 REST endpoint.

tools.name: Get Event Property
tools.description: Return details of one event property supported by the Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: Get Event Type
tools.description: Return details of one event type supported by the Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: Get Execution
tools.description: Return a workflow execution and its current asynchronous state.

tools.name: Get Execution Log
tools.description: Return the plain-text log for one workflow execution.

tools.name: Get Holiday Calendar
tools.description: Return a country's holidays, optionally bounded by an inclusive date range.

tools.name: Get Metric Descriptor
tools.description: Return the descriptor of one metric by its metric key.

tools.name: Get Problem
tools.description: Return details of one Dynatrace problem by its problem ID.

tools.name: Get Problem Comment
tools.description: Return one identified comment from a Dynatrace problem.

tools.name: Get Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Return one scheduling rule by UUID.

tools.name: Get Scheduling Rule History Record
tools.description: Return one historical version of a Dynatrace scheduling rule.

tools.name: Get Schema Definition
tools.description: Retrieve the complete definition of a Dynatrace settings schema.

tools.name: Get Settings
tools.description: Return Dynatrace Automation system settings and execution limits. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Get Settings Object
tools.description: Return a Dynatrace settings object by ID; secret properties remain irreversibly masked outside trusted app functions.

tools.name: Get Settings Object Accessor Permissions
tools.description: Return a user, group, or all-users accessor's permissions on one Dynatrace settings object.

tools.name: Get Settings Object Permissions
tools.description: Return every accessor and permission configured on a settings object.

tools.name: Get Snapshot Metadata
tools.description: Return metadata about a specific snapshot, not the snapshotted document content. This read does not create snapshots; Dynatrace limits snapshot creation by other operations to 5 snapshots per document within 60 seconds. Requires write access to the document.

tools.name: Get Task Execution
tools.description: Return one task execution, including its asynchronous state and result.

tools.name: Get Task Execution Input
tools.description: Return the merged JSON inputs from all action executions belonging to a task execution.

tools.name: Get Task Execution Log
tools.description: Return the raw standard-output log for a task execution; the log can be large.

tools.name: Get Task Execution Result
tools.description: Return the merged JSON results from all action executions belonging to a task execution.

tools.name: Get Transitions
tools.description: Return workflow task transitions keyed by transition name for an execution.

tools.name: Get User Permissions
tools.description: Return the connected user's effective Dynatrace Automation permissions. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Get User Settings
tools.description: Return Dynatrace Automation settings for the connected user. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Get Version
tools.description: Diagnostic endpoint that returns the Dynatrace Automation service version; it does not inspect or change user resources.

tools.name: Get Webhook Handler
tools.description: Return one webhook handler for an installed Dynatrace app context.

tools.name: Get Workflow
tools.description: Return a workflow by UUID.

tools.name: Inspect Workflow History Record
tools.description: Retrieve one saved workflow history version for inspection, including its runtime and modification metadata. Use Export Workflow History Record instead when the JSON definition will be transferred or reused.

tools.name: Get Workflow Task
tools.description: Return one task definition from a Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: Ingest Event
tools.description: Ingest one event into the connected Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: Ingest Metric Data Points
tools.description: Ingest newline-separated Dynatrace metric line protocol as raw text. Return the documented accepted/invalid line report even when line validation produces HTTP 400; rejected lines are not ingested, so always inspect linesInvalid and error.

tools.name: Inspect Lock
tools.description: Inspect a document lock, including its owner and document version.

tools.name: Inspect Trashed Document
tools.description: Return metadata and deletion audit information for a trashed Dynatrace document owned by the connected user.

tools.name: List All Event Logs
tools.description: Return all structured event log entries for a workflow execution.

tools.name: List Automation Service Users
tools.description: Return service users available as Dynatrace workflow actors. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: List Business Calendar History Records
tools.description: Return the change history for a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: List Business Calendars
tools.description: Return one page of Dynatrace Automation business calendars.

tools.name: List Direct Share Recipients
tools.description: Return one page of users and groups assigned to a direct share.

tools.name: List Direct Shares
tools.description: Return one page of direct shares accessible to the connected user.

tools.name: List Documents
tools.description: Return one page of documents accessible to the connected user.

tools.name: List Effective Settings Values
tools.description: Return one page of effective values, including schema defaults.

tools.name: List Entities
tools.description: Return one page of monitored entities matching an entity selector.

tools.name: List Entity Types
tools.description: Return one page of entity types from the connected Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: List Environment Share Claimers
tools.description: Return one page of users who claimed an accessible environment share.

tools.name: List Environment Shares
tools.description: Return one page of environment shares accessible to the connected user.

tools.name: List Event Properties
tools.description: Return one page of event properties supported by the Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: List Events
tools.description: Return one page of events; the connected environment must expose the Environment API v2 endpoint.

tools.name: List Event Types
tools.description: Return one page of event types supported by the Dynatrace environment.

tools.name: List Execution Actions
tools.description: Return action identifiers assigned to tasks in a workflow execution.

tools.name: List Executions
tools.description: Return one filtered page of workflow executions and the offset for the next page.

tools.name: List Holiday Calendar Countries
tools.description: Return countries that can be used to retrieve a holiday calendar.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: Return one alphabetically sorted page of labels accessible to the connected user, optionally filtered by substring and document type.

tools.name: List Metric Descriptors
tools.description: Return one page of metric descriptors; the connected environment must expose the Environment API v2 endpoint.

tools.name: List Problem Comments
tools.description: Return one page of comments attached to a Dynatrace problem.

tools.name: List Problems
tools.description: Return one filtered page of Dynatrace problems and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Schedule Timezones
tools.description: Return timezone names accepted by Dynatrace schedules.

tools.name: List Scheduling Rule History Records
tools.description: Return the version history records for a Dynatrace scheduling rule.

tools.name: List Scheduling Rules
tools.description: Return one page of scheduling rules matching optional search and ordering criteria.

tools.name: List Schema Definitions
tools.description: List all settings schemas available to the connected Dynatrace user.

tools.name: List Settings History
tools.description: Return one page of revision history for Dynatrace settings objects.

tools.name: List Settings Objects
tools.description: Return one page of persisted settings objects for one schema and scope.

tools.name: List Snapshots
tools.description: Return one page of a document's snapshots in descending version order. This read does not create snapshots; Dynatrace limits snapshot creation by other operations to 5 snapshots per document within 60 seconds. Requires write access to the document.

tools.name: List Task Executions
tools.description: Return the task executions keyed by task name for a workflow execution.

tools.name: List Trashed Documents
tools.description: Return one page of documents owned by the connected user that currently reside in Dynatrace trash. Trashed documents are permanently deleted after 30 days.

tools.name: List Trashed Workflows
tools.description: Return one page of workflows that have been moved to trash.

tools.name: List Webhook Handlers
tools.description: Return webhook handlers for an installed Dynatrace app context.

tools.name: List Workflow Actions
tools.description: Return action identifiers assigned to tasks in a workflow.

tools.name: List Workflow History Records
tools.description: Return the version history records for a Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: List Workflows
tools.description: Return one page of workflows matching optional filters.

tools.name: List Workflow Tasks
tools.description: Return the workflow's task map keyed by task name, preserving each task definition.

tools.name: Parse Grail Query
tools.description: Parse a Dynatrace Grail DQL query into its recursive syntax tree without executing it. The connected OAuth client and user need at least one supported storage read permission, plus storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the DQL query.

tools.name: Patch Business Calendar
tools.description: Modify selected fields on a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Patch Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Partially update one scheduling rule.

tools.name: Patch Workflow
tools.description: Patch selected fields on an existing Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: Pause Execution
tools.description: Pause an active workflow execution.

tools.name: Permanently Delete Workflow
tools.description: Permanently delete an active workflow without moving it to trash.

tools.name: Poll Grail Query
tools.description: Return the current state and available result for an asynchronous Grail DQL request token. The connected OAuth client and user need at least one supported storage read permission, plus storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the original query.

tools.name: Preview Filter
tools.description: Preview the DQL filter generated from a Dynatrace event trigger configuration. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Preview Schedule
