tools.description: Validate a schedule and return its next execution timestamps.

tools.name: Preview Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Validate a scheduling rule and return its upcoming execution times. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Query Metric Data Points
tools.description: Return metric data points; the connected environment must expose the Environment API v2 endpoint.

tools.name: Release Lock
tools.description: Release the current user's lock on a document.

tools.name: Remove Direct Share Recipients
tools.description: Remove users or groups from an accessible Dynatrace direct share.

tools.name: Reorder Settings Objects
tools.description: Reorder objects in an ordered multi-object Dynatrace settings schema.

tools.name: Reset Workflow Throttles
tools.description: Clear the current throttle state for a Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: Resolve Effective Permissions
tools.description: Resolve the connected user's effective settings permissions.

tools.name: Restore Business Calendar History Record
tools.description: Restore a historical version of a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Restore Scheduling Rule History Record
tools.description: Restore a Dynatrace scheduling rule to a historical version.

tools.name: Restore Snapshot
tools.description: Reset a document to a selected snapshot without changing ownership or sharing. Dynatrace first creates a safety snapshot when the current state has no snapshot; snapshot creation is limited to 5 per document within 60 seconds. If more than 50 snapshots exist, Dynatrace automatically deletes the oldest.

tools.name: Restore Trashed Document
tools.description: Restore a Dynatrace document owned by the connected user from trash. Users who had access before deletion regain access.

tools.name: Restore Trashed Workflow
tools.description: Restore a trashed workflow to the active workflow list. By default, the workflow is deployed and its triggers are reactivated; set isDeployed=false to restore it as draft-only.

tools.name: Restore Workflow History Record
tools.description: Restore a workflow to a selected historical version and deploy that restored version.

tools.name: Resume Execution
tools.description: Resume a paused workflow execution.

tools.name: Run Workflow
tools.description: Create an execution for a Dynatrace workflow, with optional idempotency qualifier and monitoring.

tools.name: Set Document Favorite
tools.description: Set whether an accessible Dynatrace document is a personal favorite for the connected user. Setting the document to its current state is a no-op.

tools.name: Set Document Visibility
tools.description: Set a Dynatrace document's environment-wide visibility to public or private. The document owner or certain administrators can perform this operation; setting the document to its current visibility is a no-op.

tools.name: Summarize Settings Value
tools.description: Generate display and search summaries for a Dynatrace multi-object settings value.

tools.name: Transfer Document Owner
tools.description: Transfer a document to a new owner. Only the current owner can perform this operation, and the previous owner loses access after the transfer.

tools.name: Transfer Settings Object Ownership
tools.description: Transfer a Dynatrace settings object to a user, group, or all users. Only the owner or a main administrator can transfer ownership.

tools.name: Trash Workflow
tools.description: Move a workflow to trash so it can be restored later.

tools.name: Update Authorizations
tools.description: Refresh Dynatrace Automation authorization assignments. This provider endpoint is deprecated; Dynatrace does not name a replacement.

tools.name: Update Business Calendar
tools.description: Replace fields on a Dynatrace Automation business calendar.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Update document metadata and/or binary content using optimistic locking, optionally creating a snapshot before the change.

tools.name: Update Document Content
tools.description: Completely replace a document's binary content using optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Document Metadata
tools.description: Call Dynatrace's deprecated, provider-specific metadata endpoint to update only a document's name or type using optimistic locking. Prefer Update Document for ordinary document updates; this action is retained for full endpoint coverage.

tools.name: Update Problem Comment
tools.description: Replace the content of one identified comment on an identified Dynatrace problem. This mutates the existing comment rather than adding a new one.

tools.name: Update Scheduling Rule
tools.description: Replace the mutable fields of one scheduling rule.

tools.name: Update Settings Object
tools.description: Update an existing Dynatrace settings object using optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Settings Object Accessor Permissions
tools.description: Replace a user, group, or all-users accessor's permissions on a Dynatrace settings object.

tools.name: Update Workflow
tools.description: Replace fields on an existing Dynatrace workflow.

tools.name: Upsert Custom Device
tools.description: Create a custom device or update the device with the supplied customDeviceId.

tools.name: Upsert Settings Object
tools.description: Create a settings object or update the object matching its external ID.

tools.name: Upsert Webhook Handler
tools.description: Create or replace a webhook handler using an installed Dynatrace app as its context.

tools.name: Validate Settings Container
tools.description: Validate a settings container with a Dynatrace schema custom validator.

tools.name: Validate Settings Object Delete
tools.description: Validate deleting a settings object without applying the deletion.

tools.name: Validate Settings Object Update
tools.description: Validate a settings object update without applying it.

tools.name: Validate Settings Object Upsert
tools.description: Validate creating or updating a settings object without applying it.

tools.name: Validate Settings Property
tools.description: Validate one typed property value with a Dynatrace schema custom validator.

tools.name: Verify Grail Query
tools.description: Validate a DQL query without executing it and return semantic notifications. Invalid DQL can be a successful HTTP response with valid set to false. This endpoint requires at least one supported storage read permission; the connected OAuth client and user also need storage:<table>:read for every dataset referenced by the DQL query.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The ID at the start of your Dynatrace SaaS environment URL. For https://abc12345.apps.dynatrace.com or https://abc12345.live.dynatrace.com, enter abc12345. You can also paste either full environment URL and use the suggested extracted ID.

name: Dynosend
description: Dynosend is an email marketing platform for managing audiences and contacts, operating campaigns, sending transactional messages, and tracking customer events.

tools.name: Add Email To Blacklist
tools.description: Permanently add an email address to the Dynosend blacklist. This cannot be undone through the Dynosend API because Dynosend exposes no removal operation.

tools.name: Add Tags To Contact
tools.description: Append one or more tags to a contact without replacing its existing tags.

tools.name: Check Blacklist
tools.description: Check whether an email address is on the connected Dynosend account's blacklist and return its timestamp and reason when available.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a contact in an audience, optionally assigning tags and audience-defined custom fields. Can bypass double opt-in when explicitly requested.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Permanently delete one contact from an audience for GDPR/CCPA erasure. This destructive operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Find Duplicate Contacts
tools.description: Find contacts that use the same email address across all audiences in the connected Dynosend account.

tools.name: Get Audience
tools.description: Get one audience's configuration, custom-field definitions, contact information, and subscription statistics by audience UID.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign's configuration and delivery, open, click, spam, bounce, and unsubscribe insights.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Get one contact in an audience by contact UID or email address.

tools.name: List Audiences
tools.description: List audiences available to the connected Dynosend account, including the UID needed by audience and contact tools.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns in the connected Dynosend account, including status and the campaign UID used by campaign tools.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Return one page of contacts in a Dynosend audience, including contact UIDs, subscription status, tags, and audience-defined custom-field values.

tools.name: Record Contact Event
tools.description: Record an application event for a contact in an audience. Dynosend stores the event persistently for automations and segmentation, and its API does not provide an operation to delete recorded events.

tools.name: Send Transactional Message
tools.description: Send a configured Dynosend transactional message. This immediately sends email and may create the recipient as a new Dynosend contact if the address is unknown.

tools.name: Set Campaign Delivery State
tools.description: Pause a sending campaign or resume a paused campaign by setting its delivery state to paused or sending. Resuming can send queued emails to campaign recipients; this does not start a ready campaign.

tools.name: Set Contact Subscription Status
tools.description: Set a contact's subscription status to subscribed or unsubscribed in an audience.

tools.name: Start Campaign
tools.description: Start a ready broadcast campaign. This immediately sends email to all campaign recipients and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update a contact's email, replace its complete tag set, or set audience-defined custom fields.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log in to your Dynosend dashboard and copy the authentication key shown with your account's API details. This token grants access to the Dynosend v2 API, so keep it secret.

name: E2B
description: Open-source Code Interpreting for AI Apps. Run sandboxed code execution environments with support for multiple programming languages.

tools.name: Connect to Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to connect to an existing E2B sandbox and retrieve its details. Use when you need to reconnect to a sandbox from different environments or resume a paused sandbox. The TTL is extended upon connection.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new E2B template with specified configuration. Use when you need to define a new sandbox template that can be used to spawn sandbox environments.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to register a new webhook to receive sandbox lifecycle events for the team. Use when you need to set up notifications for sandbox lifecycle events such as creation, updates, or termination.

tools.name: Delete Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to terminate and permanently delete a running E2B sandbox instance. Use when you need to kill a sandbox that is no longer needed. Once terminated, the sandbox cannot be resumed.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Permanently delete an E2B template that is no longer needed. The template cannot be deleted while running or paused sandboxes use it.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unregister a webhook and stop receiving lifecycle events. Use when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or to clean up webhook registrations.

tools.name: Check API Health
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of the E2B API. Use when you need to verify that the API service is operational and accessible.

tools.name: Get Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific sandbox by its ID. Use when you need to check sandbox status, metadata, or configuration details.

tools.name: Get Sandbox Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve logs from a specific E2B sandbox instance. Use when you need to debug or monitor sandbox execution by viewing its console output and system logs.

tools.name: Get Sandbox Lifecycle Events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest lifecycle events for a particular sandbox instance. Use when you need to track state changes including creation, pausing, resuming, updates, and termination of a sandbox.

tools.name: Get Sandbox Metrics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve timestamped CPU, memory, and disk usage metrics for a sandbox. Use when you need to monitor resource usage of a running sandbox. Metrics are collected every 5 seconds; returns empty array if no metrics available yet.

tools.name: Get Team Metrics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve timestamped CPU, memory, and disk usage metrics for a team. Use when you need to monitor aggregated resource usage across all sandboxes belonging to a team.

tools.name: Get Team Maximum Metrics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the maximum value for a specific team metric in a given interval. Use when you need to check team limits or peak usage, such as maximum concurrent sandboxes allowed or highest resource usage.

tools.name: Get Template Build Status
tools.description: Tool to get the status of a template build. Use when you need to check the build status of a template that was started asynchronously. Useful in polling loops to monitor template builds in progress.

tools.name: Get Template Files
tools.description: Tool to get an upload link for a tar file containing build layer files. Use when you need to retrieve or download template build layer files by their hash.

tools.name: Get Webhook Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current webhook configuration for a specific webhook. Use when you need to inspect webhook settings, verify configuration, or check webhook status.

tools.name: List All Sandboxes
tools.description: Tool to list all running and paused sandboxes associated with your team. Use when you need to view active sandboxes, monitor sandbox state, or retrieve sandbox identifiers for further operations. Supports pagination and filtering by state or metadata.

tools.name: List Sandboxes Metrics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve timestamped CPU, memory, and disk usage metrics for multiple sandboxes. Use when you need to monitor resource usage across multiple sandboxes simultaneously. Metrics are collected every 5 seconds; returns empty array if no metrics available yet.

tools.name: List Team Sandbox Lifecycle Events
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest lifecycle events across all sandboxes associated with the team. Use when you need to monitor sandbox activity, track lifecycle changes, or audit sandbox operations.

tools.name: List All Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all available E2B templates for your team. Use when you need to view available templates, retrieve template identifiers, or audit template configurations.

tools.name: List All Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all registered webhooks for your team. Use when you need to view all webhook configurations, audit webhook settings, or manage multiple webhooks.

tools.name: Pause Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to pause a running E2B sandbox preserving its filesystem and memory state. Use when you need to temporarily suspend a sandbox while maintaining its state for later resumption. Takes approximately 4 seconds per 1 GiB of RAM to pause. Paused sandboxes can be stored for up to 30 days.

tools.name: Create Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to create a new E2B sandbox from a template. Use when you need to launch a fresh sandbox environment for code execution, testing, or development purposes.

tools.name: Set Sandbox Timeout
tools.description: Tool to set the timeout for an E2B sandbox. Use when you need to extend or reduce the sandbox lifetime. The timeout is measured from the current time, and calling this multiple times overwrites the previous TTL.

tools.name: Refresh Sandbox
tools.description: Tool to refresh an E2B sandbox and extend its time to live. Use when you need to keep a sandbox alive longer and prevent it from timing out.

tools.name: Start Template Build
tools.description: Tool to start a build for an E2B template. Use when you need to initiate the build process for a template with specific configuration. The build runs asynchronously and returns immediately with a 202 Accepted status.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Tool to update an E2B template configuration. Use when you need to modify template settings such as changing visibility (public/private status).

tools.name: Update Webhook Configuration
tools.description: Tool to update an existing webhook configuration including URL, enabled status, and subscribed events. Use when you need to modify webhook settings, change the destination URL, enable/disable a webhook, or update event subscriptions.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and get your API Key from "Keys" on the left navigation menu at https://e2b.dev/docs/api-key

name: Eagle doc
description: AI-Powered, Fast, Reliable and Accurate Invoice OCR and Receipt OCR API for Seamless Integration

tools.name: Process Any Document with OCR
tools.description: Tool to process any document type with OCR and automatic classification. Supports bank statements, resumes, passports, delivery sheets, and more. Use when you need to extract structured data from various document types.

tools.name: Submit Batch Any Document OCR Task
tools.description: Tool to submit batch OCR processing tasks for various document types including bank statements, resumes, passports, delivery sheets, and more. Use when you need to asynchronously process documents with custom configurations. The task is processed asynchronously; use the Results Check API with the returned task ID to monitor status and retrieve results.

tools.name: Delete Batch Processing Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a submitted batch processing task from the queue. Use when you need to cancel or remove a previously submitted batch OCR task before processing completes.

tools.name: Eagle Doc Invoice OCR from Base64
tools.description: Tool to extract invoice data from base64 encoded images using Eagle Doc OCR API. Use when you need to process invoice images that are already base64 encoded. Supports optional parameters for privacy control, coordinate extraction, and full text extraction.

tools.name: Get Management Quota
tools.description: Tool to get contractual quota allowance and current usage counters for all workloads. Use when you need to check remaining capacity for dashboards or billing workflows.

tools.name: Receipt OCR V3
tools.description: Tool to process receipt images into structured JSON with 40+ fields including merchant info, line items, taxes, and payments. Use when extracting detailed data from receipt images or PDFs.

tools.name: Get Receipt Quota V2 (Deprecated)
tools.description: Tool to get quota information for receipt processing API v2 (deprecated). Use when you need to check available quota and usage for receipt OCR processing. Note: Multi-page receipts count each page as one request.

tools.name: Get Current Month Usage
tools.description: Tool to get current month's usage statistics including quota, pages processed, over-usage, and costs. Use when you need to check API usage and billing information for the current billing period.

tools.name: Get Monthly Usage History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve historical monthly usage data with pricing context for reconciliation and forecasting. Use when you need to analyze page processing trends or calculate costs.

tools.name: Get Usage Request Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve chronological list of recent API calls with page counts and timestamps. Use for troubleshooting and auditing consumption patterns.

required.name: full
required.description: Eagle Doc server URL. Frankfurt server: https://de.eagle-doc.com. For custom server locations, contact Eagle Doc.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API Key is sent to your email when you sign up to Eagle Doc

name: Easy Email Verification
description: Verify individual email addresses or lists and manage asynchronous bulk email verification jobs.

tools.name: Download Bulk Results
tools.description: Download the processed text or CSV result file for a completed bulk verification job.

tools.name: Get Bulk Job Status
tools.description: Get the status, progress, and verification totals for one asynchronous bulk verification job.

tools.name: List Bulk Jobs
tools.description: List all bulk verification jobs associated with the connected API key, including their current status and verification counts when available.

tools.name: Upload Bulk Email File
tools.description: Upload a text or CSV file containing one email address per line and start an asynchronous bulk verification job. Processing consumes one verification credit per address.

tools.name: Verify Emails
tools.description: Verify between 1 and 50 email addresses synchronously and return deliverability details for each address. Each address consumes one verification credit.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in at https://dashboard.easyemailverification.com/, open Developer -> API Settings, enter an API name, and create an API key. Copy the generated key and keep it secret.

name: eBay
description: Access eBay public marketplace, taxonomy, notification, and developer APIs with application OAuth.

tools.name: Browse: Check Compatibility
tools.description: Check whether an eBay Motors part is compatible with a supplied car, truck, or motorcycle definition without changing the item.

tools.name: Browse: Get Item
tools.description: Retrieve complete details for one eBay listing or variation by either its RESTful item ID or legacy listing ItemID using an application access token.

tools.name: Browse: Get Items
tools.description: Retrieve details for up to 20 eBay items or 10 item groups in one request. This limited-release operation requires selected-partner access.

tools.name: Browse: Get Items By Item Group
tools.description: Retrieve every purchasable item variation and shared description in an eBay Browse item group.

tools.name: Browse: Search
tools.description: Search eBay item summaries by keyword, category, product identifier, charity, compatibility, aspects, and Browse field filters, returning one page plus an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: Browse: Search By Image
tools.description: Search eBay item summaries using a bare Base64-encoded image, optionally refine the matches, and return one page plus an opaque continuation cursor. To continue, pass the cursor and repeat the same image; search selectors are restored from the cursor.

tools.name: Deal: Get Deal Items
tools.description: Retrieve one page of eBay deal items by category, commissionable status, delivery country, and marketplace. This Limited Release operation requires eBay Buy Deal approval.

tools.name: Deal: Get Event
tools.description: Retrieve the details of one eBay deal event by event ID, including its coupons, dates, terms, and images. This limited-release operation requires eBay approval for the buy.deal scope.

tools.name: Deal: Get Event Items
tools.description: Return one page of eBay Deal event items for an event, with optional category and delivery-country filters plus an opaque continuation cursor. This Limited Release operation requires eBay partner approval.

tools.name: Deal: Get Events
tools.description: Return one page of eBay deal events for a marketplace, including coupons, event terms, images, and an opaque continuation cursor. This limited-release operation requires eBay approval for the buy.deal scope.

tools.name: Feed: Get Item Feed
tools.description: Download one byte range of an eBay Item feed gzip file for a top-level category. The restricted Buy Feed API grant and eBay partner approval are required.

tools.name: Feed: Get Item Group Feed
tools.description: Download an eBay Item Group feed gzip file, or an optional byte range, for a top-level category. The restricted Buy Feed API grant and eBay partner approval are required.

tools.name: Feed: Get Item Priority Feed
tools.description: Download one byte range of an eBay Item Priority delta feed gzip file for a top-level category and date. Consume the daily Item and Item Group feeds before this feed. The restricted Buy Feed API grant and eBay partner approval are required.

tools.name: Feed: Get Item Snapshot Feed
tools.description: Download one byte range of an hourly eBay Item Snapshot feed gzip file for a top-level category and UTC hour. The restricted Buy Feed API grant and eBay partner approval are required.

tools.name: Marketing: Get Merchandised Products
tools.description: Return eBay products selected by category and the BEST_SELLING metric, including catalog IDs, prices, images, reviews, and rating details. This limited-release operation requires eBay Buy Marketing approval.

tools.name: Charity: Get Charity Org
tools.description: Retrieve full details for one eBay-supported charitable organization by its charity organization ID.

tools.name: Charity: Get Charity Orgs
tools.description: Search supported eBay charitable organizations by keywords or registration IDs, returning one page of complete organization details and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: Notification: Get Public Key
tools.description: Retrieve the eBay public key identified by a push notification signature for validating that notification's payload. Cache returned keys temporarily instead of requesting one for every notification.

tools.name: Notification: Get Topic
tools.description: Retrieve one eBay notification topic by ID, including its subscription scope requirements and supported payload configurations.

tools.name: Notification: Get Topics
tools.description: Return one page of eBay notification topics, including subscription scope requirements, supported payload configurations, and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Fetch Item Aspects
tools.description: Download the complete gzipped JSON item-aspect dataset for every leaf category in an eBay category tree. The compressed file can exceed 100 MB and this bulk operation has a substantially lower daily quota than other Taxonomy operations.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Category Suggestions
tools.description: Find ranked eBay leaf-category suggestions for free-form item keywords, including each category's ancestor path to the category-tree root.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Category Tree
tools.description: Retrieve eBay's complete category tree when root_category_id is omitted, or retrieve the subtree rooted at root_category_id when it is provided. Both modes include recursively nested descendants.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Compatibility Properties
tools.description: Retrieve the localized vehicle properties that define compatibility for an eBay parts category, such as Make, Model, Year, Engine, and Trim.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Compatibility Property Values
tools.description: Retrieve the applicable values of one vehicle compatibility property for an eBay parts category, optionally narrowed by other property-value pairs.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Default Category Tree ID
tools.description: Retrieve the identifier and version of the default eBay category tree for a marketplace. Use the returned identifier with other Taxonomy operations.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Expired Categories
tools.description: Retrieve mappings from expired eBay leaf categories to the active leaf categories that replaced them. Only mapped category consolidations and splits are returned; expired categories without an active replacement are omitted.

tools.name: Taxonomy: Get Item Aspects for Category
tools.description: Retrieve complete eBay aspect metadata for a leaf category, including valid values, value dependencies, listing requirements, variation support, and format constraints.

tools.name: Translation: Translate
tools.description: Translate one eBay listing title or description from a supported source language to a supported target language without changing a listing.

tools.name: Analytics: Get Rate Limits
tools.description: Return application-level eBay API quota usage, remaining calls, and reset windows, optionally filtered by API context and name.

tools.name: Shopping API Unavailable
tools.description: Compatibility-only action for retired eBay Shopping API calls. It always fails locally because eBay decommissioned Shopping; use Browse for items and Taxonomy for categories and aspects.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Your eBay App ID (Client ID)

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Your eBay Cert ID (Client Secret)

name: Ecologi
description: Ecologi is the platform for collective climate action. Purchase trees and carbon offsets programmatically through their Impact API.

tools.name: Get User Carbon Offset
tools.description: Tool to get the total tonnes of CO2e emissions a user has avoided (carbon offset). Data refreshes every 10 minutes. No authentication required.

tools.name: Get User Carbon Removal
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the total tonnes of CO₂e a user has permanently removed from the atmosphere. Data refreshes every 10 minutes. Use when checking carbon offset impact for a specific Ecologi user or business.

tools.name: Get User Habitat Restoration
tools.description: Tool to get the total area of habitat and ecosystem a user has restored. Data refreshes every 10 minutes. No authentication required.

tools.name: Get User Impact
tools.description: Tool to get a combination of all impact types a user has funded: trees, carbon avoidance, carbon removal, and habitat restoration, in a single request. Data refreshes every 10 minutes and no authentication is required.

tools.name: Get User Trees
tools.description: Tool to get the total number of trees a user has funded on Ecologi. Use when you need to retrieve tree statistics for a specific user. Data refreshes every 10 minutes.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Navigate to your Ecologi account → "Account" → "Impact API" to generate an API key

name: Eden AI
description: Eden AI provides one API for accessing and orchestrating AI models across multiple providers for text, image, audio, document, and multimodal workloads.

tools.name: Count Anthropic Tokens
tools.description: Count input tokens for an Anthropic-format message request before generation, including system content and tool definitions.

tools.name: Create Anthropic Message
tools.description: Generate a non-streaming Anthropic-compatible message with content blocks, stop reason, token usage, provider metadata, and Eden AI cost. Each call runs a paid model and consumes Eden AI credits.

tools.name: Create Chat Completion
tools.description: Generate a non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat completion with a current Eden AI model and return its choices, token usage, provider, and cost. Each call runs a paid model and consumes Eden AI credits.

tools.name: Create Embeddings
tools.description: Create embeddings for one text or a batch of texts and return vectors with model, usage, provider, and cost metadata. Each call runs a paid model and consumes Eden AI credits.

tools.name: Create Response
tools.description: Create or continue a synchronous OpenAI Responses-compatible text response, stored by default for later retrieval, and return its ID, structured output, text, usage, provider, and cost.

tools.name: Discover AI Capabilities
tools.description: Find current Eden AI models or inspect Universal AI feature schemas, providers, pricing, and regions before an execution call.

tools.name: Get Cost Overview
tools.description: Return current account credits and, when a date range is supplied, aggregated consumption filtered by provider or subfeature.

tools.name: Get Response
tools.description: Retrieve a previously stored Responses API object by ID, including its status, text output, structured output, usage, and canonical model.

tools.name: Moderate Text
tools.description: Classify one text or a batch of texts for safety categories and return flags, category scores, applied input types, provider, and cost. Each call runs a paid model and consumes Eden AI credits.

tools.name: Run Universal AI
tools.description: Run one synchronous Eden AI Universal AI feature using a current model and feature-specific input. Call DISCOVER_CAPABILITIES first for the exact model ID and runtime input schema. Returns normalized output, provider, and cost, with the raw provider response only when requested. Each call runs a paid model and consumes Eden AI credits.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your production Eden AI API token. Create or copy an api_token from the Eden AI dashboard at Settings > API Keys (https://app.edenai.run/settings/api-keys). Do not use a sandbox_api_token, which returns simulated results instead of making provider calls.

name: Edworking
description: Edworking is a collaborative workspace for managing projects, tasks, files, messages, notifications, and time tracking.

tools.name: Add Time Entry
tools.description: Record a duration against a task at a specified start time.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a named task in an Edworking project.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Permanently delete one Edworking task. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Get one task with its project, state, assignees, and time entries.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: List folders in an Edworking project, optionally restricted to children of a parent folder.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: List Edworking's message/activity records for one project from a zero-based offset. Live provider responses may contain only activity records and do not reliably expose text accepted by SEND_MESSAGE.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List the Edworking projects available to the connected account, returning IDs needed by project-scoped tools.

tools.name: List Project States
tools.description: List the workflow states configured for an Edworking project for inspection.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: List tasks, optionally within one Edworking project, with concise status and tracking information.

tools.name: Remove Time Entry
tools.description: Permanently remove one tracked-time entry by ID. This destructive action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Irreversibly send a text message to an Edworking project. Edworking provides no verified message deletion operation, and project message listing may not return the sent text; use the returned message ID as confirmation.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Update an existing task's name within its Edworking project.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal Edworking API token. In Edworking, open your avatar, go to Preferences, select My Account (or Admin in the older interface), find API Token, and choose Copy Token.

name: Egnyte
description: Egnyte is a cloud-based content collaboration platform that enables secure file sharing, storage, and governance for businesses.

tools.name: Create Permissions Audit Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a permissions audit report for specified date range and filters. Use when you need to create an audit report for permissions changes and retrieve a report ID for async retrieval.

tools.name: Create user audit report
tools.description: Tool to create a user audit report in Egnyte. Use when you need to generate an audit report of user-related actions within a specific date range. The report is generated asynchronously - use the returned job ID to poll for completion.

tools.name: Create Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to create a bookmark on a folder using either path or folder_id. Use when you need to add a folder to user bookmarks for quick access.

tools.name: Create Comment
tools.description: Tool to create a new comment/note on a file in Egnyte. Use when you need to add comments, notes, or feedback to a specific file.

tools.name: Create File Audit Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a file activity audit report for specified date range and filters. Use when you need to track file operations like downloads, uploads, moves, deletes within a date range. Returns a job ID for async retrieval - poll the job status to check when report is ready.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group with display name and members. Use when you need to add a new group to the Egnyte domain. SCIM-compliant.

tools.name: Create Shared Link
tools.description: Tool to create a shared link for a file or folder with accessibility and expiration settings. Use when you need to share content with specific users, set password protection, configure expiration dates, or enable upload capabilities for recipients.

tools.name: Create Login Audit Report
tools.description: Tool to generate a login audit report for specified date range and filters. Use when you need to create an audit report for login activity and retrieve a report ID for async retrieval.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in the Egnyte domain. Use when you need to add a new user account with specified authentication type and user type. SCIM-compliant endpoint.

tools.name: Delete Audit Report
tools.description: Tool to delete an audit report from Egnyte. Use when you need to remove a specific audit report by its type and ID.

tools.name: Delete Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to delete a bookmark from the user's bookmarks. Use when you need to remove a specific bookmark by its ID.

tools.name: Delete File By ID
tools.description: Delete a file using persistent file ID. Can specify entry_id to delete specific version. Use when you need to delete a file by its persistent identifier (Group ID) rather than path.

tools.name: Delete file or folder
tools.description: Tool to delete a file or folder at the specified path. Items are moved to trash, not permanently deleted. Use when you need to remove a file or folder from the Egnyte file system.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a group from the Egnyte domain. Use when you need to permanently remove a group. SCIM-compliant.

tools.name: Delete Shared Link
tools.description: Tool to delete a shared link by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a link. Once deleted, the link cannot be reactivated.

tools.name: Delete Metadata Key
tools.description: Tool to delete a metadata key from a namespace. Use force_delete=true to remove keys that are currently in use.

tools.name: Delete Metadata Namespace
tools.description: Tool to delete a metadata namespace. Use force_delete=true to remove namespaces that are currently in use. Returns 403 error if the namespace is in use and force_delete is false.

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a note/comment in Egnyte by its UUID. Use when you need to remove a comment from a file or folder.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user from the Egnyte domain using the SCIM-compliant endpoint. Use when you need to permanently remove a user from the system. This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download file content from a specified path in Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve the contents of a file stored in the Egnyte file system. Supports downloading specific versions via entry_id and partial content via Range header.

tools.name: Download File By ID
tools.description: Tool to download file content using persistent file ID from Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve file content by its unique group_id. Optionally specify entry_id to download a specific version of the file.

tools.name: Get Audit Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an audit report by type and ID. Audit reports are generated asynchronously - first create a report using POST /pubapi/v1/audit/{type}, then use this action to retrieve the completed report data. Returns audit events in JSON format.

tools.name: Get audit job status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of an audit report generation job. Use when you need to poll the status of a previously created audit report to determine if it's ready for download.

tools.name: Get Audit Stream
tools.description: Tool to stream audit events starting from a specific date. Returns up to 5,000 events for at most 30-minute spans. Use when you need to retrieve audit logs for the last 7 days. For pagination, use the nextCursor value from the response in subsequent requests.

tools.name: Get Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific bookmark by its ID. Use when you need to get the path, folder_id, or creation date of a bookmarked folder.

tools.name: Get Events Cursor
tools.description: Tool to get the latest event cursor position for starting event polling. Use this to obtain the current cursor before beginning to poll for events.

tools.name: Get Events V2
tools.description: Tool to poll for events (v2) including permission_change event type in addition to file_system and note types. Use when you need to retrieve events after a specific cursor ID. Returns a 204 status if no events exist after the provided cursor.

tools.name: Get File Metadata by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve file metadata using persistent file ID (group_id) instead of path. Use when you need to access file details regardless of the file's current location or name changes.

tools.name: Get file or folder metadata
tools.description: Tool to get file or folder metadata from Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve properties like name, path, size, last modified date, type, and other metadata. For folders, optionally list contents with pagination and sorting.

tools.name: Get File Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom metadata values for a file or file version within a specific namespace. Use when you need to fetch custom properties associated with a file.

tools.name: Get Folder By ID
tools.description: Tool to get folder metadata using a persistent folder ID instead of a path. Use when you have a folder_id and need to retrieve current folder details including name, path, contents, and permissions.

tools.name: Get Folder Statistics
tools.description: Tool to get statistics for a folder by ID including file counts, folder counts, and size information. Use when you need to retrieve storage and content metrics for a specific folder.

tools.name: Get Group Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific group including members and attributes. Use when you need to fetch group information by group ID. SCIM-compliant.

tools.name: Get Link Details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a shared link by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve details like path, type, accessibility settings, expiration date, and recipients for a specific shared link.

tools.name: Get Link Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve domain link settings including default expiration and allowed link types. Use when you need to check the organization's policies for link creation and expiration.

tools.name: Get Folder Permissions
tools.description: Tool to get effective permissions for a folder including users and groups with their permission levels. Use when you need to check who has access to a specific folder and their permission levels (Owner, Full, Editor, Viewer, None).

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a single user by ID. Use when you need to fetch specific user information using their user ID. SCIM-compliant endpoint.

tools.name: Get User Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve details about the user associated with the OAuth token.

tools.name: List Bookmarks
tools.description: Tool to list all bookmarked folders for the authenticated user with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve user bookmarks or check which folders are bookmarked.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: Tool to list all comments/notes on a file in Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve comments or discussion threads associated with a specific file.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: Tool to list all custom groups in the Egnyte domain. Use when retrieving groups for user management or access control. Does not return default Egnyte groups, only custom-created groups.

tools.name: List Insights Files
tools.description: Tool to list recently accessed files for the authenticated user. Returns up to 10 files with metadata including size, last_modified, and last_accessed timestamps.

tools.name: List Links V2
tools.description: Tool to list all shared links using the v2 API with extended response fields. Use when you need detailed link information including accessibility, protection, recipients, creation date, expiry settings, and last accessed timestamp. Note: Non-admin users will only see links they created.

tools.name: List Metadata Namespaces
tools.description: Tool to list all custom metadata keys in a namespace. Use when you need to inspect metadata key definitions for a specific namespace in Egnyte.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all users or a filtered subset from the Egnyte domain. Use when you need to list users with optional pagination and filtering via SCIM-compliant parameters.

tools.name: List workflows
tools.description: Tool to list all workflows in Egnyte. Use when you need to retrieve the list of workflows configured in the Egnyte account.

tools.name: List Workflow Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list all workflow tasks. Returns an array of tasks with total count. Use when you need to retrieve all workflow tasks in the Egnyte system.

tools.name: Lock File
tools.description: Tool to lock a file to prevent edits by other users. Use when you need to acquire an exclusive lock on a file to prevent concurrent modifications.

tools.name: Replace Group (PUT)
tools.description: Tool to fully replace a group's attributes including display name and members. Use when you need to completely overwrite all group properties. This uses PUT method and replaces all attributes.

tools.name: Advanced Search with Metadata Filters
tools.description: Tool to perform advanced search with custom metadata filtering in Egnyte using v2 API. Use when you need to search files and folders with metadata filters or namespace constraints. Results scoped to user permissions.

tools.name: Set File Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to set custom metadata values for a file or file version within a specific namespace. Use when you need to add or update custom properties on a file. Keys must already exist in the namespace.

tools.name: Set Folder Metadata Values
tools.description: Tool to set custom metadata values for a folder within a namespace. Use when you need to assign or update custom properties on a folder in Egnyte.

tools.name: Set Folder Permissions
tools.description: Tool to set folder permissions for users or groups. Permission levels: Owner, Full, Editor, Viewer, None. Use when you need to grant or revoke access to a folder for specific users or groups.

tools.name: Stream Audit Events
tools.description: Tool to stream audit events with filtering by audit types (FILE_AUDIT, LOGIN_AUDIT, PERMISSION_AUDIT). Use when you need to retrieve audit events for a specific date range or continue streaming from a previous cursor. Returns up to 5,000 events per request.

tools.name: Update Folder Options
tools.description: Tool to update folder options including description and other settings. Use when you need to modify folder metadata such as adding or updating the folder description.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Tool to update specific attributes of a group including display name and members. Use when you need to modify group properties or membership. SCIM-compliant endpoint for incremental updates.

tools.name: Update Metadata Key
tools.description: Tool to update key definitions including display name, help text, data values for enums, and priority. Use when you need to modify metadata key properties within a namespace.

tools.name: Update Metadata Namespace
tools.description: Tool to update key definitions of a metadata namespace. Use when you need to change the display name or adjust field priorities. At least one of displayName or priorities must be provided.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update specific attributes of a user in the Egnyte domain using the SCIM-compliant endpoint. Use when you need to modify user information such as name, email, active status, or other user properties. Only the attributes provided in the request will be updated.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload or update a file at the specified path in Egnyte. Use when you need to create a new file or replace an existing file. For files larger than 100MB, consider using chunked upload instead.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Egnyte domain/subdomain (e.g., "mycompany" for mycompany.egnyte.com)

name: Elai
description: Elai is an AI video generation platform for creating, personalizing, translating, and rendering presenter-led videos from text, templates, and uploaded media.

tools.name: Copy Video
tools.description: Create a draft copy of an existing video or template; the new draft counts against Elai's creation quota.

tools.name: Create Story Video
tools.description: Create a Story video from text, HTML, or a web-page URL and generate its visual slides so it is ready for rendering. The video counts against Elai's creation quota; a failed slide-generation step automatically deletes the draft.

tools.name: Delete Video
tools.description: Permanently delete one Elai video or template. This cannot be undone, requires the exact known ID, and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Estimate Speech Duration
tools.description: Estimate how many seconds narration text will take with a selected Elai voice before modifying or rendering a video.

tools.name: Get Video
tools.description: Get a video's status, render URL, metadata, and optionally its full slide configuration.

tools.name: List Avatars
tools.description: Find available avatars and variants as compact records, optionally limited to Realtime-compatible avatars.

tools.name: List Videos
tools.description: List videos and templates as compact summaries, with filters and a continuation cursor for additional pages.

tools.name: Render Video
tools.description: Start asynchronous rendering of a prepared video, consuming paid rendering minutes. Requires confirm_paid_render=true. Use Get Video afterward to check status and obtain the final URL; this action does not poll automatically.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Elai API Token. The primary workspace admin can generate or copy it from API Settings at https://app.elai.io/api. Keep this token secret; regenerating or revoking it invalidates existing connections.

name: Elastic Email
description: Elastic Email provides transactional email delivery, email marketing, contact and campaign management, reporting, verification, and account administration APIs.

tools.name: Add Contact List Members
tools.description: Add selected existing contacts to a named Elastic Email contact list.

tools.name: Add Contacts
tools.description: Add up to 1000 Elastic Email contacts and optionally assign them to existing lists.

tools.name: Add Suppressions
tools.description: Add up to 1000 email addresses to Elastic Email's bounce, complaint, or unsubscribe suppression records.

tools.name: Adjust Subaccount Credits
tools.description: Add or remove email credits from a managed Elastic Email subaccount. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan. The signed adjustment is not idempotent; a retry can apply the adjustment twice.

tools.name: Check Domain Restriction
tools.description: Check whether Elastic Email restricts a domain or identifies it as a free-provider domain.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create a campaign. An active or scheduled campaign may initiate email delivery, and sent messages cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Create Contact List
tools.description: Create a contact list, optionally with initial email members.

tools.name: Create Domain
tools.description: Create a sending or tracking domain in the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: Create Inbound Route
tools.description: Create a new inbound email route.

tools.name: Create Segment
tools.description: Create a dynamic contact segment from a name and SQL-like rule.

tools.name: Create Subaccount
tools.description: Create a managed subaccount with optional initial email settings. An activation email can be sent; when activation email delivery is disabled, the subaccount is activated immediately. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Create a new email template with its name, content, and scope.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription for selected email events.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Delete one campaign by exact name. This does not cancel email already in progress.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Delete one contact by exact email address.

tools.name: Delete Contact List
tools.description: Delete one contact list by exact name. Contacts that belonged to the list are removed from it but are not deleted.

tools.name: Delete Contacts
tools.description: Permanently delete 1-10 contacts by exact email address. This destructive action sends one targeted deletion per address and reports partial failures; it does not use rule-based bulk deletion.

tools.name: Delete Domain
tools.description: Delete one configured domain from the connected Elastic Email account.

tools.name: Delete Email Verification
tools.description: Delete one saved email verification result by exact email address.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete one stored file by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Inbound Route
tools.description: Permanently delete one inbound email route by its public ID.

tools.name: Delete Segment
tools.description: Delete one Elastic Email dynamic contact segment by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Suppression
tools.description: Remove one email address from Elastic Email suppression records. This can allow sending to resume, so use only with documented recipient consent.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Delete one Elastic Email template by its exact name.

tools.name: Delete Verification File
tools.description: Delete one uploaded verification file job by its VerificationID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Delete one webhook subscription by its public WebhookID.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Download a stored Elastic Email file by its exact name.

tools.name: Download Verification File Results
tools.description: Download the ZIP result archive for a completed verification file job.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email campaign by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email contact by email address.

tools.name: Get Contact Export Status
tools.description: Get the current status of an asynchronous contact export job.

tools.name: Get Contact List
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email contact list by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Credential Metadata
tools.description: Get one Elastic Email API-key or SMTP credential's audit metadata without returning its secret token.

tools.name: Get Domain
tools.description: Return detailed DNS and certificate state for one Elastic Email domain.

tools.name: Get Email Job Status
tools.description: Return delivery status and optional recipient-level details for an Elastic Email transaction.

tools.name: Get Email Preview
tools.description: Return the rendered preview, attachment metadata, and delivery status for an Elastic Email message ID.

tools.name: Get Email Verification
tools.description: Return the saved Elastic Email verification result for one email address.

tools.name: Get Event Export Status
tools.description: Get the current status of an asynchronous global or channel event export. Use export_scope='global' when Start Event Export had no channel, and export_scope='channel' when it targeted a channel.

tools.name: Get File Info
tools.description: Return metadata for a stored Elastic Email file without downloading it.

tools.name: Get Inbound Route
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email inbound route by its public ID.

tools.name: Get Segment
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email dynamic contact segment by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Account Statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate Elastic Email delivery statistics for a time interval.

tools.name: Get Statistics Breakdown
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email campaign or channel delivery summary by exact name.

tools.name: Get Subaccount
tools.description: Return one managed Elastic Email subaccount by its login email. Requires an Elastic Email PRO plan.

tools.name: Get Suppression
tools.description: Return suppression details for one Elastic Email address.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email template by its exact name.

tools.name: Get Verification File Results
tools.description: Return one page of detailed results and metadata for a verification file.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Return one Elastic Email webhook subscription by its public ID.

tools.name: Import Contacts
tools.description: Start an asynchronous contact import using exactly one source: an uploaded CSV file or a provider-accessible CSV URL.

tools.name: Import Suppressions

name: Emailable
description: Emailable provides an email verification API that allows developers to integrate real-time email validation into their applications, ensuring the accuracy and deliverability of email addresses.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account information including owner email and available credits. Use when you need to confirm account status before sending email verifications.

tools.name: Get Batch Status
tools.description: Tool to get the status and results of a batch verification job. Use after submitting a batch to check its progress.

tools.name: Build OAuth Authorization URL
tools.description: Build an OAuth 2.0 authorization URL for the Emailable authorization code flow. Returns a URL to redirect users to for authorization. Upon successful authorization, users are redirected to your redirect_uri with an authorization code (valid for 10 minutes) that can be exchanged for access tokens.

tools.name: Verify Batch Emails
tools.description: Submit a batch of email addresses for asynchronous verification. Returns a batch ID immediately. Use this for bulk email validation (2 to 50,000 emails). For single emails, use EMAILABLE_VERIFY_EMAIL instead. The batch is processed asynchronously - use EMAILABLE_GET_BATCH_STATUS with the returned batch ID to check progress and retrieve verification results.

tools.name: Verify Email
tools.description: Tool to verify a single email address and return detailed results. Use when you need to check email deliverability and risk.

name: Emaillistverify
description: EmailListVerify is a service that provides email verification and validation to ensure email lists are clean and deliverable.

tools.name: Check Blacklists
tools.description: Tool to check an IP address (IPv4/IPv6) or domain against multiple DNS-based blacklists (DNSBLs) for spam or malicious activity. Use when you need to verify the reputation of an IP or domain. Rate limit: 10 requests/second.

tools.name: Check Disposable Domain
tools.description: Tool to verify if an email domain is associated with temporary/disposable email addresses. Includes DNS record verification. Use when you need to validate if a domain is disposable before accepting email registrations.

tools.name: Delete Maillist

tools.description: Tool to search for a contact's business email address by name and company domain. Returns possible emails with confidence levels (high/medium/low/unknown). Rate limit: 5 requests/second. Credits: 5 (with name) or 10 (domain only).

tools.name: Get Credits

tools.name: Get Email Job Status
tools.description: Tool to get the status of an asynchronous email verification job. Use when you need to check if a verification job has completed and retrieve its results. Rate limit: 100 requests per second.

tools.name: Get Maillist Progress
tools.description: Tool to retrieve real-time progress updates for an uploaded email list verification. Shows status, completion percentage, and credit usage. Rate limit: 100 requests/second.

tools.name: Upload Email List
tools.description: Tool to upload an email list file for bulk verification. Accepts .csv, .txt, or .xlsx files (max 100MB, 1M rows). Returns an ID to query verification progress. Rate limit: 5 requests/second.

tools.name: Verify Single Email
tools.description: Tool to verify email deliverability status of a single email address. Returns a plain text status representing deliverability. Rate limit: 10 requests/second. Credits required: 1.

tools.name: Verify Single Email Detailed
tools.description: Tool to verify email deliverability with detailed metadata including MX server info, ESP, first/last name estimation, gender, and role detection. Use when you need comprehensive email validation beyond basic deliverability. Rate limit: 10 requests/second, requires 1 credit per verification.

required.name: generic_api_key
