tools.name: Add People to Tracker List
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Add people to a person tracker list. Identify people by LinkedIn URL, user ID, or slug. At least one identifier is required per person. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Search Blue Collar Job Listings
tools.description: Billable operation: Search blue collar and trade job postings. Ideal for finding service, manufacturing, trades, and other non-desk positions. Currently US-only. Supports search by company, job title/keyword, and location. Supports pagination via nextPageToken. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Resolve Company to Blue Collar Job Board Identifier
tools.description: Billable operation: Resolve a company to the identifier used for searching their blue collar job listings on boards such as Indeed. Provide a company name, a website domain or URL, or both for best results. Use the returned slug in the companySlug field of the blue collar jobs search endpoint. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Get Booking.com Property Details
tools.description: Billable operation: Retrieves full details for a single Booking.com property, including amenities, photos, scores, and house rules. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Search Booking.com Properties
tools.description: Billable operation: Searches Booking.com stays for a destination and returns matching properties with rates, ratings, and availability. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Build Audience from Search Parameters
tools.description: Billable asynchronous trigger: Triggers the audience building process. This runs a company and prospect search based on the configured search parameters and saves results to the database. The build runs asynchronously - use the get-audience-status endpoint to poll for completion. Status transitions: DRAFT BUILDING NORMAL (success) or FAILED (error). Check progress or retrieve results with FIBER_GET_AUDIENCE_STATUS. Confirm the expected credit charge immediately before starting work; do not retry merely because results are not yet ready.

tools.name: Bulk Company Logos
tools.description: Billable operation: Get logo URLs for a list of companies. Max 10,000 companies can be looked up at a time. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Bulk Enrich Companies
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: enrich 1-50 known companies in one request. Fiber charges 2 credits per company lookup and reports the actual charge in chargeInfo. Use FIBER_ENRICH_COMPANY for one company and company search for discovery. Responses may include workforce and personnel-derived aggregates. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose, request only necessary data, and apply appropriate retention controls.

tools.name: Bulk Enrich People
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: enrich 1-50 known people in one request. Fiber charges 2 credits per lookup, plus 2 additional credits per lookup when live_fetch is true. Use FIBER_ENRICH_PERSON for one person and contact reveal actions only when email or phone discovery is the goal. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose and subject, minimize the personal data requested, and apply appropriate retention controls.

tools.name: Bulk Profile Pics
tools.description: Billable operation: Get profile pics for a list of profiles. Max 10,000 profiles can be looked up at a time. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Cancel Batch Contact Reveal
tools.description: Irreversibly stop pending work in an existing batch contact-reveal task. Obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before calling. Fiber refunds eligible profiles the task has not reached; already processed or delivered profiles remain charged and their results are not removed. The response's cancelledCount, creditsRefunded, and chargeInfo are authoritative.

tools.name: Check Google Maps Search Progress
tools.description: Read-only asynchronous status check: Check readiness and progress for a Google Maps search started by FIBER_START_GOOGLE_MAPS_SEARCH. This action returns status only; use FIBER_POLL_GOOGLE_MAPS_RESULTS to retrieve paginated result rows. No polling charge is documented; it does not start another job or modify Fiber state.

tools.name: Live Fetch LinkedIn Company
tools.description: Billable operation: Returns an enriched company with details for a given LinkedIn company identifier. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Company Logo
tools.description: Billable operation: Get the logo for a single company. Accepts a LinkedIn company URL, slug, numeric organization ID, or domain the format is auto-detected. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Fetch LinkedIn Company Posts
tools.description: Billable operation: Fetches recent posts from a LinkedIn company page. Returns a paginated feed of company posts. Each page contains up to 50 posts. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Company/School/Investor Typeahead
tools.description: Billable operation: Search for companies, schools/universities, and investors by name. Supports partial inputs, which can enable typeaheads in your UI. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Count Company Search Results
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: count companies matching Fiber's structured filters without returning company records. Use FIBER_SEARCH_COMPANIES when records are needed. Fiber charges 1 credit per request and reports the actual charge in chargeInfo. Use only for an authorized purpose, minimize and retain filters appropriately, call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS first, and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call.

tools.name: Count Job Postings
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: count Fiber job postings matching structured filters without returning postings. Use FIBER_SEARCH_JOB_POSTINGS when posting records are needed. Fiber charges 1 credit per request and reports the actual charge in chargeInfo. Hiring filters may disclose strategic interests; use only for an authorized purpose, minimize and retain filters appropriately, call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS first, and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call.

tools.name: Count People and Companies
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: count companies and people together, with people scoped to companies matching the company filters. Use FIBER_SEARCH_PEOPLE_AND_COMPANIES when records are needed. Fiber charges 1 company-count credit and 1 profile-count credit and reports the actual charge in chargeInfo. Use only for an authorized purpose, minimize and retain filters appropriately, call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS first, and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call.

tools.name: Count People Search Results
tools.description: Billable and privacy-sensitive: count people matching Fiber's structured filters without returning profiles. Use FIBER_SEARCH_PEOPLE when profile records are needed. Search criteria may encode sensitive employment or demographic targeting. Fiber charges 1 credit per request and reports the actual charge in chargeInfo. Use only for an authorized purpose, minimize and retain filters appropriately, call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS first, and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call.

tools.name: Create a New Audience
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Creates a new audience in DRAFT status. After creation, use the update-search-params endpoint to set filters, then use the build endpoint to populate the audience with companies and prospects. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state.

tools.name: Create Company Exclusion List
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Create a company exclusion list. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state.

tools.name: Create Company Exclusion List from Audience
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: This endpoint creates a new company exclusion list by extracting all companies from a specified audience. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state.

tools.name: Create Job Change List

tools.name: Create Prospect Exclusion List

tools.name: Create Saved Search

Given search params, it automatically re-runs it periodically and tells you which new people and/or companies fit your parameters over time (and also who drops out or returns). You are charged for each new prospect or company we find, depending on your desired type. You can also manually run the saved search if you don't want to wait for the next auto-run. Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Create Company Tracker List
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Create a new company tracker list. By default you add companies manually and we periodically check them for changes matching your tracking rules. Provide `companySearchParams` to instead create a DYNAMIC list that auto-populates with companies matching a query and refreshes over time. Credits are charged per entity per refresh cycle; lists containing premium rules (marked `isPremium` in GET /tracker/rules) bill at a minimum per-entity rate (see your plan's pricing for exact rates). Creating the list itself is free. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Create Person Tracker List
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Create a new person tracker list. By default you add people manually and we periodically check them for changes matching your tracking rules. Provide `prospectSearchParams` to instead create a DYNAMIC list that auto-populates with people matching a query and refreshes over time. Credits are charged per entity per refresh cycle; lists containing premium rules (marked `isPremium` in GET /tracker/rules) bill at a minimum per-entity rate (see your plan's pricing for exact rates). Creating the list itself is free. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Delete a Job Changes List

Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Delete Profiles from a Job Change List
tools.description: Destructive or state-removing change: Remove profiles from a job changes tracking list. Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Delete Prospect Exclusion List
tools.description: Destructive or state-removing change: Delete a prospect exclusion list. Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling.

tools.name: Archive Company Tracker List

Signal history is preserved for audit purposes. Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling. Signal history is preserved for audit purposes. Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Endpoint
tools.description: Destructive or state-removing change: Delete a webhook endpoint. All future event deliveries to its URL stop immediately. Deleting webhooks is free. Obtain explicit confirmation and verify all target identifiers immediately before calling.

tools.name: Poll Domain Lookup

tools.name: Download Your Past API Requests

tools.name: Enrich Company

tools.name: Export Audience Prospects to CSV

tools.name: Get Flight Booking Options

tools.name: List Accelerators

tools.name: List API Keys

tools.name: Fetch LinkedIn Profile Reactions

Use the `nextPageToken` field from the response to retrieve subsequent pages of top-level comments (their nested replies come along automatically). Confirm the documented credit cost immediately before calling.

tools.name: Search Reddit Posts

tools.name: List Subreddit Posts

tools.name: Search Within a Subreddit

tools.name: Reschedule Company Tracker List Refresh

Future refreshes continue at the list's regular interval, counted from the rescheduled run. Changing the list's refresh interval later resets the schedule from that moment. To refresh a list immediately, use the refresh endpoint instead. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Reschedule Person Tracker List Refresh
tools.description: Free persistent-state operation: Move this list's next scheduled refresh to a chosen date (UTC) later (for example to skip a cycle or align with a billing period) or earlier, as long as the date is tomorrow or later. The refresh runs on the chosen date and checks all tracked people in the list, with credits charged per entity as usual. Future refreshes continue at the list's regular interval, counted from the rescheduled run. Changing the list's refresh interval later resets the schedule from that moment. To refresh a list immediately, use the refresh endpoint instead. Confirm the intended target before changing Fiber state. Handle returned or submitted personal data only for an authorized purpose and minimize retention.

tools.name: Resolve Companies

tools.name: Reveal Contact Details

Request only necessary channels; the documented cost ranges from 2 to 5 credits and actual cost is reported in chargeInfo. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose and subject, and retain only necessary personal data.

tools.name: Reveal Contact Details Instant
tools.description: Billable and highly privacy-sensitive: return contact data already on file for one known person, with no live lookup or request-time re-verification. This is the fastest and lowest-coverage tier; each delivered email or phone channel costs 1 credit and chargeInfo is authoritative. Use Lite or Normal when fresh lookup or validation is required. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose and subject, minimize requested channels, treat unknown validation status cautiously, and retain only necessary personal data.

tools.name: Reveal Contact Details Lite
tools.description: Billable and highly privacy-sensitive: run Fiber's cheapest live contact lookup for one known person, accepting lower coverage than Normal. Lite costs 1 credit per delivered email channel and 2 per delivered phone channel; chargeInfo is authoritative. Use Instant for on-file-only speed, Normal for balanced coverage, or Turbo for lower latency. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose and subject, minimize requested channels, and retain only necessary personal data.

tools.name: Reveal Contact Details Turbo
tools.description: Billable and highly privacy-sensitive: run Fiber's fastest synchronous live contact lookup for one known person when latency matters more than cost. Turbo costs 3 credits for one email type, 5 for phones or both email types, and 7 for all channels; partial results bill only delivered data and chargeInfo is authoritative. Use Normal or Lite for lower cost, or Exhaustive after synchronous tiers miss. Call FIBER_GET_ORG_CREDITS and obtain explicit user confirmation immediately before every call. Use only for an authorized purpose and subject, minimize requested channels, and retain only necessary personal data.

tools.name: Reveal Identity-Checked Phone
