name: Finerworks
description: FinerWorks is an online platform specializing in fine art and photo printing services, offering artists and photographers the ability to order prints and manage their inventory.

tools.name: Add Images

tools.name: Add or Update Gallery Collection
tools.description: Tool to add or update personal gallery collections in GeoGalleries.com. Use when creating new collections or modifying existing ones. Omit id or set to 0 for new collections; provide existing id to update.

tools.name: Delete Images
tools.description: Tool to delete a list of image files from FinerWorks based on their unique GUIDs. Note: If an image is assigned to the inventory library, this will also remove any virtual inventory products assigned to those images. Use when you need to permanently remove images from a library.

tools.name: Delete Pending Orders
tools.description: Tool to remove orders from temporary storage that were saved as pending. Use when you need to delete pending orders by their identifiers.

tools.name: Delete Virtual Inventory
tools.description: Tool to delete virtual inventory products by SKU. Use when removing products from virtual inventory. Note that deleted items will lose any sync connection with 3rd party platforms.

tools.name: Disconnect Virtual Inventory
tools.description: Tool to disconnect ALL virtual inventory items from a 3rd party platform. Use when you need to remove platform data (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy) from all virtual inventory items.

tools.name: Fetch Order Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve order production status and tracking details from FinerWorks. Use when you need to check the current status of orders including shipment tracking information.

tools.name: Get Company Info
tools.description: Tool to get essential information about FinerWorks including site identifier, company address, and operating hours. Use when you need to retrieve FinerWorks' contact information or business location details.

tools.name: Get Frame Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed specifications for a specific frame by ID. Returns dimensions, pricing, material info, size constraints, and URLs for visual references. Use when you need complete frame specifications for order processing or product catalog display.

tools.name: Get Prices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve pricing information for FinerWorks products. Use when you need to get price quotes for specific product SKUs and quantities.

tools.name: Get Shipping Options IDs
tools.description: Tool to list all available shipping option IDs from FinerWorks. Use this to retrieve IDs for various shipping methods that can be used for cross-reference purposes when configuring orders. Sites should periodically check and update this data in case new shipping methods are added or deleted.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's FinerWorks account profile including billing/business addresses, account credits, shipping preferences, connected platforms, and gallery settings. Use this to get user details like account_key, email, credits balance, or to verify authentication.

tools.name: List File Selection
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of currently selected files by their master guid. Use when you need to see which file GUIDs are grouped under a specific selection key.

tools.name: List Frame Collections
tools.description: Retrieve available frame collections and categories from FinerWorks. Use this to discover frame options for print orders. Pass a collection ID to get detailed frame specifications within that collection, or filter by product code to see only compatible frames. Returns all collections if no filters specified.

tools.name: List Galleries
tools.description: Tool to list galleries setup in GeoGalleries.com for the user's account. Use when you need to retrieve available galleries, filter by personal galleries, or get specific galleries by their IDs.

tools.name: List Gallery Themes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available themes for GeoGalleries. Use when you need to discover valid theme options for gallery customization or when filtering galleries by theme.

tools.name: List Glazing
tools.description: Retrieve available glazing and glass options from FinerWorks. Use this to discover glazing choices (UV protection glass, acrylic, etc.) for framed prints. Call without parameters to list all glazing options, or pass a specific ID to filter results.

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of image files uploaded to your FinerWorks account. Use this to browse your image inventory, search by filters, or get specific images by GUID. Supports pagination, sorting, date filtering, and gallery filtering.

tools.name: List Mats
tools.description: Retrieve available matting options from FinerWorks for framing products. Mats include specifications like dimensions, colors, thickness, and pricing. Use this to discover valid mat IDs and specifications before configuring framed prints.

tools.name: List Media Types
tools.description: Retrieve available print media types from FinerWorks. Media types represent printing substrates (e.g., canvas, paper, vinyl) and include associated product type and style information. Call without parameters to list all media types, or pass specific IDs to filter results.

tools.name: List Order Status Definitions

tools.name: List Product Types
tools.description: Retrieve FinerWorks product types (print categories like Canvas Prints, Metal Prints, Posters, etc.). Use this to discover available printing options and their media IDs before placing orders. Returns all product types if no IDs specified, or filtered results for specific IDs.

tools.name: List Shipping Options Multiple
tools.description: Retrieve shipping options and rates for multiple orders in a batch request. Use this tool to get available shipping methods, rates, and estimated delivery times before submitting orders. Returns all available shipping options for each order with pricing breakdown including shipping rate, taxes, and total cost. The returned shipping_code values (e.g., 'FL', 'GD', '2A') should be used when submitting the actual order via submit_orders. Supports both US domestic and international shipping destinations.

tools.name: List Style Types
tools.description: Retrieves available print style types from FinerWorks. Style types define how prints are formatted (e.g., border sizes, canvas wraps, panel depths). Use this to discover valid style_type_id values needed when creating print orders or configuring products. Each style type includes sizing constraints, framing options, and border/bleed specifications.

tools.name: List Virtual Inventory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's virtual inventory products from their FinerWorks account. Use when you need to list products with valid product codes, search by SKU or product code, or filter by creation date. Returns paginated results with product details including pricing, images, and stock information.

tools.name: Save Pending Orders

tools.name: Update Images

Note: if the image is assigned to the inventory library, this will also remove any virtual inventory products assigned to those images.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update various features of a user's account profile. Use when you need to modify billing/business info, logos, or payment profile after retrieving current account.

tools.name: Update Virtual Inventory
tools.description: Tool to update virtual inventory items within a user's account. Use when you need to modify product details like pricing, stock quantities, descriptions, or third-party integrations for existing inventory items.

tools.description: Tool to update an invoice item in Fingertip. Use when you need to modify the title, price, or description of an existing invoice item.

tools.name: Update Page
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Fingertip page with new data. Use when you need to modify page properties like name, description, slug, position, or media configurations. Only fields included in the request will be updated.

tools.name: Update Page Theme
tools.description: Tool to update the theme configuration for a specific page. Use when you need to modify theme settings such as making it a reusable component, linking it to a parent component theme, or updating theme content.

tools.name: Update Fingertip Quote
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Fingertip store quote. Use when you need to modify quote items, pricing, discounts, or metadata like memo and footer. Requires the quote ID and at least one quote item.

tools.name: Update Fingertip Site
tools.description: Updates an existing Fingertip site with provided partial data. Use when modifying site properties like name, description, status, or configuration. Only include fields you want to change - all fields are optional except siteId.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Fingertip webhook subscription. Use when you need to modify the endpoint URL or change the event triggers for a webhook. Only fields included in the request will be updated.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Fingertip API key, obtainable from https://fingertip.com/api-keys. Keep it secure and do not share it publicly.

name: Finlight
description: Search Finlight's financial news, retrieve articles by link, and list source metadata through its complete v2 REST API surface.

tools.name: Get Article by Link
tools.description: Retrieve one Finlight-indexed article by its original URL. Optional full content and company entities are plan-gated and may be silently absent even when the request succeeds.

tools.name: List Sources
tools.description: List all news source domains visible to the connected Finlight account, including default-source status, origin country, and supported languages.

tools.name: Search Articles
tools.description: Search Finlight's indexed financial news using text, market, source, geography, category, language, and date filters. Returns one page at a time. Availability, recency, content, and entity enrichment depend on the connected plan and may be silently omitted.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Finlight API key. Sign in at https://app.finlight.me, open the API Keys section of the dashboard, and copy an active key. Finlight sends this secret in the X-API-KEY header for REST requests.

name: Finmei
description: Finmei is an invoicing tool designed to simplify billing processes, allowing users to create and manage invoices and track expenses efficiently.

tools.name: Create Expense
tools.description: Tool to create a new expense with file upload (receipt or invoice). Use when you need to record an expense with supporting documentation. Requires multipart/form-data submission with file, date, total, currency, and seller information.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Creates a new invoice in Finmei with buyer information and line items. Use this when you need to generate an invoice for a customer. You can specify: - Buyer details (person or company) - Products/services with quantities and prices - Invoice type (regular, VAT, preliminary, credit) - Currency, dates, and custom notes Example: "Create an invoice for Tech Solutions Inc with 3 months of support services at $99.99/month"

tools.name: Delete Customer
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific customer by their ID. Use after confirming the correct customer_id to remove the record.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice. Use when you need to remove an existing invoice by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Payment
tools.description: Delete a payment record by its unique identifier. This action permanently removes the payment from the system. Returns success even if the payment doesn't exist (idempotent operation). Use this when you need to remove incorrect, duplicate, or obsolete payment records.

tools.name: Delete Product
tools.description: Deletes a product from the Finmei catalog by its unique identifier. This operation is idempotent - calling it multiple times with the same product_id will return success. The tool attempts multiple endpoint patterns to maximize compatibility across different Finmei API deployments. Use this when you need to: - Permanently remove a product from the catalog - Clean up discontinued or obsolete products - Remove test or duplicate product entries Note: If all API endpoints return 404, the action will succeed with a message explaining that the product doesn't exist or the API doesn't support deletion. This follows idempotent DELETE semantics.

tools.name: Download Expense File
tools.description: Tool to download the file associated with an expense. Returns the expense document file (PDF or image). Use when you need to retrieve the actual file content for an expense.

tools.name: Download Invoice PDF
tools.description: Tool to download an invoice as a PDF file. Use when you need to retrieve the PDF version of an invoice.

tools.name: Get Expense by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single expense by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific expense including date, total, currency, and seller information.

tools.name: Get Invoice by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single invoice by its ID. Use when you need full invoice details including buyer, seller, items, amounts, and payment options.

tools.name: Get Payment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific payment by its ID. Use after creating a payment or when you need to confirm payment details.

tools.name: Get Product by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a product by its ID. Use when you need detailed information about a single product.

tools.name: Get Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve main information about the business to which the API token is assigned. Use when needing business ID, title, type, address, VAT code, company name, or company code.

tools.name: List Currencies
tools.description: Tool to list all currencies supported by Finmei. Use when you need to retrieve available currency codes before creating transactions.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Tool to list all customers with optional filters and pagination. Use when needing to browse or search customer records.

tools.name: List Expenses
tools.description: Tool to list all expenses for the business. Use when you need a paginated list of expenses with metadata.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to list invoices. Use when you need a paginated list of invoices with basic details.

tools.name: List Payments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of payments. Use when you need to view past payment records with optional filters and pagination.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of products with optional filters and pagination. Use when you need to browse or filter the product catalog.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Tool to update an existing customer's details. Use after confirming the customer ID to modify their information.

tools.name: Update Expense
tools.description: Tool to update an existing expense's fields including date, total, currency, and seller. Use when you need to modify expense details. To update the invoice/bill file, use the Update Expense File endpoint instead.

tools.name: Update Expense File
tools.description: Updates the file attachment of an existing expense in Finmei. Use this action when you need to attach or replace a receipt/invoice file for an expense. This endpoint is specifically for updating the file only - use the Update Expense action for updating other expense fields like amount, date, or description. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data content type and typically should be a PDF or image file of the bill/receipt.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Tool to update an existing invoice in Finmei. Use when you need to modify invoice details such as buyer information, products, dates, or currency.

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Updates an existing product in the Finmei product catalog. Use this action when you need to modify product details such as name, description, price, or currency. You must provide the product ID and at least one field to update. The action returns the complete updated product details. Prerequisites: - The product must already exist in the system (obtain product_id from List Products action) - At least one update field (name, description, price, or currency) must be provided Note: This action will fail if the product doesn't exist or if the Finmei API instance doesn't support product management endpoints.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the Finmei API.

name: Finmo
description: Finmo provides payment collection, payouts, wallets, foreign exchange, virtual accounts, and transaction management for businesses.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a real production Finmo customer profile containing personal or company identity data. This stores PII, mutates production, and may start identity-verification or other compliance workflows, but does not itself move money. Confirm that the customer has authorized this processing and supply the organization-specific documented fields. Use a unique idempotency_key and reuse it only for an identical retry.

tools.name: Create Payin
tools.description: Create a real production payin that can collect money from a customer and credit a customer or merchant wallet. This has real financial effects. First call FINMO_LIST_PAYIN_METHODS and FINMO_GET_PAYIN_METHOD_REQUIREMENTS, then supply exactly the selected method's required parameters. Reuse the same idempotency_key only for an identical retry within 8 days. A 499 or 504 may mean Finmo already processed the payment: do not blindly retry; check the payin or transaction state with the same merchant reference, or contact Finmo.

tools.name: Create Payout
tools.description: Send real production funds from a Finmo wallet to a beneficiary. This reserves and can irreversibly transfer money. First call FINMO_LIST_PAYOUT_METHODS and FINMO_GET_PAYOUT_METHOD_REQUIREMENTS, verify the beneficiary and available wallet balance, and obtain approval for the exact destination and amount. Use a unique idempotency_key and reuse it only for an identical retry within 8 days. Supply either stored tokens or the documented inline sender and beneficiary data. Cross-currency payouts require a matching Finmo fx_rate_id. A 499 or 504 may mean Finmo already processed the payout: never retry blindly; check payout or transaction state using the merchant reference, or contact Finmo.

tools.name: Create Payout Beneficiary
tools.description: Create a real payout beneficiary in the connected Finmo production account. This does not move money, but Finmo stores the supplied sensitive bank, proxy, identity, and contact data and the record can enable later payouts. First call FINMO_LIST_PAYOUT_METHODS and FINMO_GET_PAYOUT_METHOD_REQUIREMENTS, then provide only the selected method's required destination and identity fields. A newly created beneficiary may take 24 hours to activate. Reuse idempotency_key only for an identical retry.

tools.name: Create Refund
tools.description: Issue a real production full refund for a completed Finmo payin. This moves real money, debits or holds funds in the payin wallet, may incur fees, and may be irreversible. Before calling, verify the payin is refundable and that the full refund is intended. Use a unique idempotency_key and reuse it only for an identical retry within 8 days.

tools.name: Get Payin Method Requirements
tools.description: Return the dynamic required fields, validation regexes, limits, instructions, and capabilities for one Finmo payin method. Call this immediately before constructing a payin request.

tools.name: Get Payment
tools.description: Get one payin, payout, or refund by its Finmo reference ID. Use this after an ambiguous timeout before retrying a money-moving request with the same idempotency key.

tools.name: Get Payout Method Requirements
tools.description: Return the dynamic payout, beneficiary, and sender field requirements for one Finmo payout method. Use it before creating a beneficiary or moving money.

tools.name: Get Wallet
tools.description: Get one wallet and its currency accounts, including actual and available balances. Reading balances is sensitive but does not move funds.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: List one page of individual or company customer profiles and wallet-readiness state. Returns a continuation cursor when more customers are available.

tools.name: List Payin Methods
tools.description: List one page of enabled ways to collect money for a country and currency, with a continuation cursor when more results exist. Use FINMO_GET_PAYIN_METHOD_REQUIREMENTS before creating a payin because required fields vary by method.

tools.name: List Payins
tools.description: List inbound payment attempts with status, method, customer, wallet, and time filters. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Payout Beneficiaries
tools.description: List one page of stored payout beneficiaries and their destination details. Returns a continuation cursor when more beneficiaries are available; use payout method discovery to assess rail suitability.

tools.name: List Payout Methods
tools.description: List one page of enabled payout rails for a sender and beneficiary country/currency pair. Results may use wildcard sender values. Inspect the returned beneficiary requirements, then call FINMO_GET_PAYOUT_METHOD_REQUIREMENTS for current beneficiary and sender fields before creating a payout or beneficiary. Returns a continuation cursor when more methods are available.

tools.name: List Payouts
tools.description: List one page of outbound payments with status, payout method, and time filters. Returns a continuation cursor when more payouts are available.

tools.name: List Refunds
tools.description: List one page of refunds with status, originating payin, amount, and time filters. Returns a continuation cursor when more refunds are available.

tools.name: List Transactions
tools.description: List organization-level financial transactions for reconciliation, filtered by customer, event type, settlement, reconciliation, or time. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Wallets
tools.description: List one page of Finmo wallets available to the connected organization or a customer. Returns a continuation cursor when more wallets are available. Summaries exclude balances; use FINMO_GET_WALLET for wallet accounts and balances.

tools.name: Transfer Wallet Funds
tools.description: Move real production funds immediately between two Finmo wallets. This money-moving operation may be irreversible. Before calling, use FINMO_GET_WALLET on both wallets to verify the exact destination, active currency accounts, and sufficient source available balance for the amount and currency. Use a unique idempotency_key and reuse it only for an identical retry within 8 days. After an ambiguous failure, check transfer and transaction state before retrying.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your production Access API key, used as the HTTP Basic username. In the Finmo Dashboard, open Settings > Developer Settings > API Keys and copy the Access API key from a production key pair with the permissions your workflows require. Production and sandbox share an API URL, so ensure this key belongs to the production environment.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your production Secret API key, used as the HTTP Basic password. Copy it when generating the production key pair in Finmo Dashboard > Settings > Developer Settings > API Keys; Finmo shows this secret only once. Store it securely and use a pair with write or admin permissions for write workflows.

name: Finnhub
description: Finnhub provides real-time market data, company fundamentals, financial news, economic data, and securities reference information.

tools.name: Get Company Financial Metrics
tools.description: Get Finnhub's current key ratios and annual or quarterly metric series for one company.

tools.name: Get Company Profile
tools.description: Look up a company profile by exactly one ticker, ISIN, or CUSIP.

tools.name: Get Market Status
tools.description: Check whether an exchange is open now and identify its current session, timezone, or holiday.

tools.name: Get Quote
tools.description: Get the latest price snapshot for one Finnhub symbol. Unknown symbols fail explicitly instead of returning a misleading zero quote.

tools.name: Get Quotes
tools.description: Get price snapshots for 1-10 Finnhub symbols in one tool call. This uses one Finnhub API request per symbol and reports unrecognized symbols per result.

price.description: $0.02 per Finnhub API request; 1-10 requests ($0.02-$0.2) per tool call

tools.name: Get Reported Financials
tools.description: Retrieve as-reported balance-sheet, cash-flow, and income-statement data for a company or filing. A ticker, CIK, or accession number is required; large statement details are available only when requested.

tools.name: List Calendar Events
tools.description: List earnings releases or IPO events in an ordered date range. Use an earnings ticker or a narrow date window because Finnhub does not paginate or server-limit these calendars.

tools.name: List Earnings Results
tools.description: List a company's recent actual versus estimated earnings and surprise values.

tools.name: List SEC Filings
tools.description: List SEC filing metadata; a ticker, CIK, or accession number is required, optionally filtered by form and an ordered date range.

tools.name: Search News
tools.description: Get broad market news by category or company-specific news for an ordered date range. Use narrow company date ranges because Finnhub does not paginate or server-limit company news.

tools.name: Search Symbols
tools.description: Find tradable symbols by ticker, company name, ISIN, or CUSIP, optionally restricted to an exchange.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Finnhub API key. Sign in at https://finnhub.io/dashboard and copy the API key shown on the Dashboard. Keep this value secret.

name: Finviz
description: Finviz provides market screening and research data through its official API for ELITE subscribers.

tools.name: Get Options Chain
tools.description: Return the options chain for one ticker, optionally restricted to an expiration date or strike price. Results use the export's dynamic columns and preserve all CSV values as strings. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: Get Portfolio
tools.description: Return an existing Finviz portfolio using a configured portfolio URL or portfolio ID. Explicit fields override values parsed from portfolio_url. The response preserves CSV values as strings and includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: Get Stock History
tools.description: Return OHLCV price history for one ticker at a selected bar timeframe and history range. Finviz does not support every timeframe and range combination. CSV values, including prices and volume, are preserved as strings. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Calendar
tools.description: Return economic events, company earnings, or company dividends for an inclusive date range. Select the calendar with calendar_type. Results preserve dynamic CSV columns and string values and include a bounded record prefix plus the matching row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Market Groups
tools.description: Return aggregate Finviz market groups for a selected grouping and data view. Results use the export's dynamic columns and preserve all CSV values as strings. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Insider Transactions
tools.description: Return recent market-wide or ticker-specific insider transactions, filtered to all transactions, purchases, or sales. Results preserve numeric-looking values and SEC links exactly as strings. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Investor Holdings
tools.description: Return a bounded prefix of one manager's or fund's complete unpaginated holdings export and report its full row count. Select the resource with investor_type and pass its Investor ID or combined slug. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Investors
tools.description: Return the institutional-manager or fund directory, optionally narrowed by name. Records preserve Investor ID for FINVIZ_LIST_INVESTOR_HOLDINGS. max_records returns a bounded prefix, and Finviz may cap the export itself, so the result is not guaranteed to be an exhaustive directory. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List Latest Filings
tools.description: Return the latest SEC filings for one ticker, optionally filtered by filing category and ordered by filing date, report date, or form. Results preserve all CSV cells, including filing and document links, exactly as strings. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: List News
tools.description: Return market, stock, ETF, or crypto news from Finviz. Stock and ETF feeds can optionally be restricted to one ticker; market and crypto feeds are market-wide. Results use the export's dynamic CSV header and preserve every cell as a string. The response includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

tools.name: Screen Stocks
tools.description: Return stocks from a configured Finviz screener URL or explicit screener controls. Explicit fields override values parsed from screener_url. Unknown filter codes may be silently ignored. The response preserves CSV values as strings and includes a bounded record prefix and the full export row count. A truncated response has no continuation page. Requests are paced only within one worker; external callers and multi-worker runners must serialize Finviz requests.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API key from User -> Settings -> API in Finviz. API access requires an active ELITE subscription. Copy the key shown on that page and keep it secret.

name: Firebase
description: Firebase Authentication client tools for project discovery, user sign-in and sign-up flows, out-of-band codes, and Secure Token refresh using a Firebase Web API Key.

tools.name: Discover Sign-In Methods
tools.description: Look up sign-in methods previously used by a Firebase account email. Firebase anti-enumeration settings can suppress results, so empty lists or an absent registered value do not prove that the account does not exist.

tools.name: Get Auth Project Config
tools.description: Get the public Firebase Authentication configuration associated with the connected Web API key, including the project ID and authorized domains. This does not authenticate a user or grant backend access.

tools.name: Refresh ID Token
tools.description: Exchange a Firebase refresh token for a fresh Firebase ID token and rotated refresh token using Google's Secure Token service.

tools.name: Sign In With Custom Token
tools.description: Exchange a trusted server-minted Firebase custom token for a Firebase ID token and refresh token. The exchange may create the Firebase user on their first sign-in.

tools.name: Sign In With Email Link
tools.description: Complete Firebase email-link sign-in using an email address and the one-time OOB code from a previously delivered sign-in link. This may create the Firebase user on first sign-in; it does not send email.

tools.name: Sign In With Identity Provider
tools.description: Sign in with one configured external identity provider using provider-specific OAuth or OIDC credential parameters. This sign-in-only tool may create the Firebase user on first sign-in and rejects Firebase idToken account-linking semantics.

tools.name: Sign In With Password
tools.description: Sign in an existing Firebase Authentication user with email and password and return fresh ID and refresh tokens. Requires the Email/Password provider to be enabled.

tools.name: Verify Password Reset Code
tools.description: Validate a Firebase password-reset OOB code and identify the associated email and request type without changing the password.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The Web API Key for your Firebase project. In the Firebase console, open Project settings > General, scroll to Your apps, select a Web app, choose Config, and copy the apiKey value. You can also manage project keys in Google Cloud console > APIs & Services > Credentials. Use a key whose API restrictions allow Identity Toolkit API and Token Service API.

name: Fireberry
description: Fireberry is a CRM platform that offers integrations with various tools and applications to streamline business processes.

tools.name: Create a Competitor
tools.description: Tool to create a new competitor in Fireberry. Use when you need to track competitive companies, including their products, SWOT analysis, revenue, and contact information.

tools.name: Create a Fireberry contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add a new person to the system with contact information, billing address, and related account details.

tools.name: Create an Activity Log
tools.description: Create a new Activity Log record in Fireberry. Use when you need to log activities such as phone calls, meetings, or other interactions with contacts and accounts.

tools.name: Create a date field
tools.description: Tool to create a new date field in a Fireberry object/table. Use when you need to add custom date fields to CRM objects like accounts, contacts, or other entities for tracking dates such as contract dates, anniversaries, or custom date attributes.

tools.name: Create a Fireberry lookup field
tools.description: Tool to create a lookup field in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add a lookup field that relates records from one object type to another.

tools.name: Create a new Fireberry account
tools.description: Tool to create a new account in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add a new company or organization to the system with detailed information including contact details, billing address, and business metadata.

tools.name: Create an Article
tools.description: Tool to create a new article in Fireberry. Use when you need to add knowledge base articles, documentation, or help content to the system. The article requires a name (title) and subject (category). You can optionally provide the article body, description, owner, state, status, and view count.

tools.name: Create a Fireberry asset
tools.description: Creates a new asset (account product) in Fireberry. Use this to associate products or services with customer accounts, tracking details like quantity, price, installation dates, and status.

tools.name: Create an Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to create a new opportunity in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add a new sales opportunity to track potential deals with estimated values, close dates, and associated accounts.

tools.name: Create an Order Item
tools.description: Tool to create a new order item in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add line items or products to an existing order with details like quantity, price, and description.

tools.name: Create a note
tools.description: Create a new note record in Fireberry. Use when you need to add notes to records such as accounts, contacts, or other objects. Supports HTML formatting and reply threads.

tools.name: Create a phone call
tools.description: Creates a new phone call record in Fireberry's call log. Use this to log incoming, outgoing, or internal phone calls with details like duration, status, and participants.

tools.name: Create a Fireberry product
tools.description: Tool to create a new product in Fireberry. Use when you need to add a new product to the system with details like catalog number, name, vendor information, and status.

tools.name: Create a Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to add a new project to track work, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.

tools.name: Create a Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to create to-do items, action items, or work assignments with tracking information.

tools.name: Create a Ticket
tools.description: Tool to create a new ticket (case) in Fireberry CRM. Use when you need to log customer issues, support requests, or service cases with detailed tracking information.

tools.name: Create a URL field
tools.description: Tool to create a new URL field in a Fireberry object/table. Use when you need to add custom URL fields to CRM objects like accounts, contacts, or other entities for storing website links, company URLs, or other web addresses.

tools.name: Create a Campaign
tools.description: Tool to create a new campaign in Fireberry. Use when you need to add a new marketing or sales campaign to track campaign activities, budgets, and outcomes.

tools.name: Create a CRM Order
tools.description: Tool to create a new CRM Order in Fireberry. Use when you need to create an order with line items linked to an account.

tools.name: Upload file to Fireberry record
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to a specific record in Fireberry. Use when you need to attach documents, images, or other files to existing records such as accounts, contacts, or custom objects.

tools.name: Create a Fireberry meeting
tools.description: Tool to create a new meeting (activity) in Fireberry. Use when you need to schedule a meeting in the CRM system. The created meeting will be returned with its system-generated ID and all default values populated.

tools.name: Create a new Fireberry record
tools.description: Creates a new record in a specified Fireberry table/module. Use this tool when you need to add new records to Fireberry (e.g., create a new account, contact, or deal). The created record will be returned with its system-generated ID and all default values populated. Common use cases: - Create new accounts/companies in the CRM - Add new contacts to the system - Insert leads, opportunities, or custom records Note: Field names are case-sensitive and must match Fireberry's system field names.

tools.name: Delete an Account
tools.description: Tool to delete an account from Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove an account record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a Competitor
tools.description: Tool to delete a competitor in Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a competitor record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a contract
tools.description: Tool to delete a contract in Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a contract record from the system.

tools.name: Delete an Activity Log
tools.description: Delete an activity log by its GUID. Use when you need to remove a specific activity log record from Fireberry. The activity log ID must be a valid GUID obtained from querying activity logs.

tools.name: Delete a custom field
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom field from a Fireberry object/table. Use when you need to permanently remove a custom field from CRM objects like accounts, contacts, or other entities.

tools.name: Delete an Article
tools.description: Tool to delete an article from Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove an article record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a Fireberry asset
tools.description: Delete an asset from Fireberry by its unique identifier. Use this tool when you need to remove an asset record from the Fireberry system. The asset is permanently deleted and cannot be recovered once this operation completes successfully.

tools.name: Delete an Opportunity
tools.description: Tool to delete an opportunity in Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove an opportunity record from the system.

tools.name: Delete an Order Item
tools.description: Tool to delete an order item in Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove an order item (line item/product) from an order.

tools.name: Delete a Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a note from Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to remove a specific note record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a Phone Call
tools.description: Tool to delete a phone call record from Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to remove a specific phone call entry from the system.

tools.name: Delete a project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project from Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a project record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a task
tools.description: Tool to delete a task in Fireberry by its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a task record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a ticket
tools.description: Tool to delete a ticket (case) from Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a ticket record from the system.

tools.name: Delete a Business Unit
tools.description: Tool to delete a Business Unit in Fireberry using its GUID. Use when you need to remove a Business Unit from the system permanently. Note: This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete a Fireberry campaign

This action provides direct access to Fireberry's query API endpoint with support for complex filter expressions, field selection, and result ordering. Ideal for searching specific records, building reports, or retrieving filtered datasets.

tools.name: Update a Fireberry Competitor

The competitor is identified by its unique GUID, and you can update any combination of available fields. Common use cases: - Update competitor contact information (address, website) - Modify SWOT analysis (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats) - Update competitor metrics (revenue, number of employees) - Change competitor product information
