required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal Fireberry API token. In Fireberry, click your profile picture → Profile → Account Security → API Access Token, then copy it.

name: Fireworks AI
description: Fireworks AI provides APIs for serverless model inference, fine-tuning, deployments, datasets, evaluations, and account management.

tools.name: Create Chat Completion
tools.description: Generate one non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat completion from role-based messages using a caller-supplied Fireworks model or deployment ID.

tools.name: Create Embeddings
tools.description: Create embedding vectors for one or more caller-provided inputs using a caller-supplied Fireworks embedding model.

tools.name: Generate Model Response
tools.description: Generate one non-streaming Responses API result, optionally continuing a stored response or using function, MCP, or SSE tools; storage is off by default.

tools.name: Get Deployment
tools.description: Return configuration and serving status for one Fireworks deployment without scaling or modifying it.

tools.name: Get Model
tools.description: Return metadata and status for one model resource in a Fireworks account; this does not test whether the model can serve inference.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: Return one page of Fireworks accounts accessible to the API key so an agent can obtain account IDs for model and deployment discovery.

tools.name: List Deployments
tools.description: Return one page of deployment resources in a Fireworks account for deployment ID discovery and serving-capacity and status inspection.

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: Return one page of model resources in a Fireworks account for model-ID discovery and status inspection; availability for inference is not guaranteed.

tools.name: Rerank Documents
tools.description: Rank a provided document list by relevance to a query using an optional caller-supplied Fireworks reranker model.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy a Fireworks API key at https://app.fireworks.ai/settings/users/api-keys. The key inherits your user or service account's Fireworks RBAC permissions and is sent as an Authorization bearer credential.

name: Firmable
description: Firmable's Partner API enriches company and people records, searches for people within companies, and returns supported search-filter metadata.

tools.name: Enrich Company
tools.description: Look up one enriched company using at least one Firmable, LinkedIn, domain, ABN, or website identifier. This call may consume Firmable credits; Firmable does not publish a per-call cost. Successful enrichment and identifier precedence were not live-verified to avoid consuming credits.

tools.name: Enrich Person
tools.description: Look up one enriched person using a Firmable, LinkedIn, work-email, or personal-email identifier. This request may consume Firmable credits and can return personal contact data; use it only for an authorized purpose. Prefer one strong identifier because precedence between multiple identifiers is not documented or live-verified.

tools.name: List Filter Options
tools.description: Return Firmable's current search filter codes and supported markets, optionally selecting filters or paging one location or industry filter. Firmable explicitly documents this read-only endpoint as not charged.

tools.name: Search People in Company
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of people at a Firmable company, optionally filtered by position, country, seniority code, or department code. Each call may consume Firmable credits and can return personal data; use it only for an authorized purpose. Firmable does not publish a per-call cost.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Firmable Partner API key beginning with fbl_. In Firmable, go to Manage Account > Integrations > API and select Generate API Key. API access requires an eligible plan and Admin or Integration role permission.

name: Firmao
description: Firmao is a business information platform offering data and insights on companies, industries, and markets, providing tools for company research, industry analysis, and market intelligence.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Creates a new sales or purchase invoice in Firmao CRM. This action generates an invoice transaction with line items, customer information, pricing details, and payment terms. It can auto-create customers if needed and supports automatic invoice numbering.

tools.name: Delete Company Setting
tools.description: Deletes a company setting by its unique identifier. Returns success status and details about the deletion attempt. Use this when you need to permanently remove a specific company setting configuration.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Soft-deletes a contact in Firmao CRM by marking it as deleted (sets deleted=true). This action sends a PUT request to mark the contact as deleted without permanently removing it from the system. The contact can potentially be restored later through the Firmao interface. Returns a changelog documenting the deletion operation. Use this when you need to remove a contact from active use in Firmao CRM.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Soft-deletes a Firmao invoice by marking it as deleted. This action sends a PUT request to mark the invoice's 'deleted' field as true. The invoice record remains in the system but is marked as deleted. Returns a changelog documenting the deletion operation. If the API returns unexpected response formats, the action normalizes them to the expected schema.

tools.name: Delete Offer
tools.description: Soft-delete an offer in Firmao by marking it as deleted. The offer record is not permanently removed but is marked with deleted=true, making it inactive in the system. Use this action when you need to remove an offer without permanently destroying the record. The action returns a changelog documenting the deletion operation.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific invoice by its ID. Returns comprehensive invoice data including customer details, line items, payment status, pricing information, and metadata. Use this when you need complete invoice details for a known invoice ID.

tools.name: Get Offer
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific offer from Firmao CRM by its unique ID. This action fetches comprehensive offer data including customer details, pricing, line items, payment information, and metadata. Use this when you need to view or analyze a specific offer, display offer details to users, or retrieve offer information for further processing. The configured Firmao organization is taken from the connected account.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific task by its unique ID. Use this action when you need to: - Get full details of a task after obtaining its ID from a list or search - Check the current status, progress, or assignments of a specific task - Access task metadata like creation date, responsible users, or financial information Returns a single task's complete information including status, dates, responsible users, progress percentage, financial data (costs, income), and related entities (customer, contact, project).

tools.name: List Company Settings
tools.description: Lists all company settings from Firmao. Company settings are key-value configuration pairs that store custom configurations for companies. Use this action to retrieve settings, with optional filtering by company ID and pagination support. Returns an empty list if no settings exist or the endpoint is not available in the current Firmao deployment.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to list invoices. Use when retrieving a list of invoices with optional pagination and filtering.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of tasks from Firmao. Returns task details including status, priority, dates, responsible users, tags, and financial data. Supports sorting, filtering by various fields, and configurable detail levels (MINIMAL, MEDIUM, FULL).

tools.name: Update Contact in Firmao
tools.description: Updates an existing contact in Firmao CRM by its ID. Use this tool to modify contact information such as name, email, phone, position, or customer association. Only include the fields you want to change - omitted fields will remain unchanged. Returns a changelog of the modifications made. Prerequisites: - The contact ID must exist in your Firmao organization - If updating the customer field, the customer ID must already exist

tools.name: Update Offer
tools.description: Updates an existing offer/quote in Firmao by ID. Modifies specified fields while preserving unspecified ones. Returns a changelog detailing what changed. Supports partial updates - only provide fields you want to change.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task. Use when you need to modify one or more fields of a task after confirming its current details.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The unique identifier for your Firmao organization, used to construct the API endpoint URL.

required.name: suffix.one
required.description: The domain extension from your Firmao account URL, such as 'net' or 'pl'.

required.name: basic_encoded
required.description: Base64-encoded value of your Firmao API login and password (username:password), used for Basic Authentication.

name: Fish Audio
description: Fish Audio provides speech synthesis, transcription, voice cloning, and conversational voice-agent APIs.

tools.name: Configure Agent
tools.description: Partially update an agent's draft prompt, voice, and core conversation behavior without publishing it.

tools.name: Create Agent
tools.description: Create a private Fish Audio agent, optionally with an initial prompt, voice, and core conversation settings. The new agent remains a draft until separately published.

tools.name: Delete Agent
tools.description: Permanently delete a Fish Audio agent by ID; use only when deletion is explicitly intended.

tools.name: Design Voice
tools.description: Generate original voice previews synchronously from a voice description, without cloning or saving a voice model.

tools.name: Get Account Balance
tools.description: Return the connected Fish Audio account's package allowance and API credit so an agent can distinguish free quota from paid credit.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Return an agent's workspace metadata together with its current draft conversation configuration.

tools.name: Get Voice Model
tools.description: Get a Fish Audio voice model by ID and inspect whether it is trained and suitable for synthesis.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: Search agents in the connected Fish Audio workspace, including draft or archived agents when requested.

tools.name: List Agent Sessions
tools.description: List conversation sessions for the workspace or a specific agent, filtered by lifecycle status, caller, or creation time.

tools.name: List Voice Models
tools.description: Search public or workspace-owned Fish Audio voice models. Before synthesis, select an item whose type is tts; svc model IDs are not compatible with TTS.

tools.name: Synthesize Speech
tools.description: Generate downloadable speech synchronously using a selected Fish Audio model and voice IDs. With your own Fish Audio key it defaults to free S2.1; otherwise it defaults to paid S2.1 Pro and allows only paid models and public licensed voices.

price.description: $0.015 per 1,000 bytes of text; non-English characters use more bytes

tools.name: Transcribe Audio
tools.description: Transcribe a previously uploaded audio file synchronously with Fish Audio. First upload through Composio files.upload in the SDK or the file-upload API; pass the returned file object, not a raw URL. Audio must be at most 64 MiB (a stricter platform limit may apply). Returns text, duration, optional segment timestamps and detected language. Long recordings may take several minutes.

price.description: $0.36 per audio hour, rounded up to the next second per successful request

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your Fish Audio API key from the API Keys dashboard at https://fish.audio/app/api-keys/. The key grants access to resources in your Fish Audio team, so keep it secret.

name: Fixer
description: Fixer is a currency data API providing real-time and historical exchange rates for 170 world currencies.

tools.name: Get Historical Rates
tools.description: Tool to get historical exchange rate data for a specific date. Use when you need past currency rates for all or selected currencies.

tools.name: Get Latest Exchange Rates
tools.description: Tool to get real-time exchange rate data for all available or specified currencies. Use when you need current forex rates before performing currency conversions.

tools.name: Get Supported Symbols
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all supported currency symbols and their full names. Use when you need to display or validate available currencies before performing conversions.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: Your unique API key for authenticating requests to the Fixer API.

name: Fixer.io
description: Fixer.io is a simple and lightweight API for current and historical foreign exchange rates and currency conversion.

tools.name: Convert Currency
tools.description: Tool to convert an amount from one currency to another. Use when you need current or historical exchange rates. Specify `date` for historical rates.

tools.name: Get Currency Fluctuations
tools.description: Tool to fetch exchange rate fluctuations between two dates. Use when you need day-to-day currency rate changes.

tools.name: Get Historical Rates
tools.description: Fetch historical exchange rates for a specific date. Returns end-of-day (EOD) exchange rates for any date back to January 1, 1999. Use this when you need past currency conversion rates or historical financial data.

tools.name: Get Supported Symbols
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all available currency symbols and their corresponding names. Use when you need to fetch and display supported currency codes.

tools.name: Get Time Series
tools.description: Retrieves daily foreign exchange rates for a date range. Returns a time series of exchange rates for each day between start_date and end_date (inclusive, max 365 days). The rates show how much of each currency equals one unit of the base currency.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: The API key provided by Fixer.io to authenticate API requests.

name: Flatfile
description: Flatfile is a data exchange platform for collecting, validating, transforming, and managing structured data across collaborative workflows.

tools.name: Delete Records
tools.description: Permanently delete one to 100 explicitly identified records from one Flatfile sheet. This action never performs an unfiltered delete. Flatfile hooks are disabled, so these deletions do not trigger hook-driven workflows.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Get detailed status, outcome, result, and diagnostic information for one Flatfile asynchronous job.

tools.name: Get Sheet
tools.description: Get one sheet's field configuration and record counts before reading or writing records.

tools.name: Get Space
tools.description: Get safe metadata for one Flatfile space without exposing transient access credentials or token-bearing guest links.

tools.name: Insert Records
tools.description: Insert one or more rows into a Flatfile sheet using simple field-key to value objects. Returns Flatfile's success receipt and commit ID, not created record IDs. Use List Records separately when later work requires IDs; only attribute matches that are unambiguous for caller-controlled unique values. Hooks are disabled for this mutation.

tools.name: List Environments
tools.description: List Flatfile environments visible to the connected environment secret key and return the IDs needed to find spaces.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Discover import or export files and their processing status, optionally within a Flatfile space.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: Find asynchronous Flatfile jobs by environment, space, workbook, file, or parent job and inspect progress at a glance.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: Read one page of records from a Flatfile sheet, optionally filtering by validity, field, record ID, search value, or FFQL expression.

tools.name: List Spaces
tools.description: Find Flatfile spaces by environment, text, namespace, archive state, or template status.

tools.name: List Workbooks
tools.description: List workbooks, optionally within a space, with their nested sheets so an agent can continue to sheet and record tasks.

tools.name: Update Records
tools.description: Update one or more existing Flatfile records by ID using simple field-key to value objects. Flatfile hooks are disabled, so these updates do not trigger hook-driven workflows.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your environment's server-side secret key beginning with sk_. In the Flatfile dashboard, open the environment you want to connect, go to Developer settings, then API Keys and Secrets, and copy the Secret key. Do not use a publishable key, personal access token, or temporary access token.

name: Fleetio
description: Fleetio is a fleet management platform for managing vehicles, equipment, maintenance, inspections, fuel, parts, purchasing, and operational workflows.

tools.name: Archive Contact
tools.description: Archive one Fleetio contact by ID. This reversible action is preferred over permanent deletion.

tools.name: Archive Vehicle
tools.description: Archive one Fleetio vehicle by ID. This is reversible with Restore Vehicle and is preferred over permanent deletion.

tools.name: Change Issue State
tools.description: Close, resolve, or reopen one Fleetio issue using the dedicated lifecycle endpoint for that transition. Closing and resolving require a note; reopening does not accept one.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a Fleetio contact with a required first name and optional common business identity fields.

tools.name: Create Fuel Entry
tools.description: Create a Fleetio fuel entry and its required meter reading for a vehicle. Supply volume in the vehicle's configured unit.

tools.name: Create Issue
tools.description: Report a Fleetio issue for a vehicle or equipment asset with required timing and summary plus optional priority, assignment, and labels.

tools.name: Create Meter Entry
tools.description: Record a primary or secondary Fleetio meter reading for a vehicle. Inspect the vehicle's existing meter history first because Fleetio requires values to increase in chronological order and checks readings on both sides of the timestamp.

tools.name: Create Vehicle
tools.description: Create a Fleetio vehicle with its required name, primary meter unit, status, and type, plus optional common identity and assignment fields.

tools.name: Delete Fuel Entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one Fleetio fuel entry and its associated meter entry by exact fuel-entry ID. Both deletions are irreversible and can affect meter history, so use this only for a verified erroneous or disposable entry.

tools.name: Delete Issue
tools.description: Permanently delete one Fleetio issue by exact ID. This action is irreversible: use it only for a known disposable or erroneous issue after verifying the ID. Prefer issue state transitions for normal lifecycle handling.

tools.name: Delete Meter Entry
tools.description: Permanently delete one Fleetio meter entry by exact ID. This action is irreversible: use it only for a known erroneous or disposable reading after verifying the ID.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Retrieve one Fleetio contact by ID for assignment, issue, or maintenance workflows. Returns purposeful business and employment details while omitting residential, license, user-access, and account-membership data.

tools.name: Get Issue
tools.description: Retrieve full details for one Fleetio issue by ID.

tools.name: Get Service Entry
tools.description: Retrieve one Fleetio service entry by ID, including its status, maintenance tasks, issues, meter data, and costs.

tools.name: Get Vehicle
tools.description: Retrieve full current details for one Fleetio vehicle by ID.

tools.name: Get Work Order
tools.description: Retrieve full details for one Fleetio work order by ID.

tools.name: List Account Context
tools.description: Return Fleetio account identity, plan, state, and permission or feature context for the connected API key. Credential-like account tokens are always removed.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Find Fleetio contacts using bounded cursor pagination and common identity or employment filters.

tools.name: List Fuel Entries
tools.description: Find Fleetio fuel entries by vehicle, vendor, external ID, or date range using bounded cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Issues
tools.description: Find Fleetio issues by vehicle, state, issue number, assigned contact, due date, or reported date.

tools.name: List Meter Entries
tools.description: Find Fleetio primary or secondary meter readings by vehicle, meterable asset, category, or date range, ordered for chronology checks.

tools.name: List Reference Data
tools.description: List one Fleetio reference collection used by vehicle, issue, work-order, service, fuel, vendor, grouping, and inspection workflows.

tools.name: List Service Entries
tools.description: List Fleetio service entries by reference, status, or completion-date range, with sorting and cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Service Reminders
tools.description: Find due, overdue, snoozed, or upcoming Fleetio service reminders by vehicle or service task.

tools.name: List Vehicles
tools.description: Find active Fleetio vehicles by name, VIN, license plate, group, status, or type, with cursor pagination and configurable sorting.

tools.name: List Work Orders
tools.description: Find Fleetio work orders by vehicle, vendor, contact, number, status, or purchase order reference.

tools.name: Restore Contact
tools.description: Restore one archived Fleetio contact by ID.

tools.name: Restore Vehicle
tools.description: Restore one archived Fleetio vehicle by ID.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update selected business identity, communication, employment, or group fields on one Fleetio contact; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Fuel Entry
tools.description: Correct selected timestamp, volume, meter, vendor, fuel type, price, flag, or reference fields on one Fleetio fuel entry; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Issue
tools.description: Update issue content, priority, due date, or assignments without changing the issue lifecycle state; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Meter Entry
tools.description: Correct the timestamp, value, or void state of one Fleetio meter entry, or change its meter type from primary to secondary. This tool cannot change a secondary entry back to primary. Omitted fields remain unchanged; Fleetio returns no resource body after accepting the correction.

tools.name: Update Vehicle
tools.description: Update selected identity, classification, or assignment fields on one Fleetio vehicle; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Work Order
tools.description: Update selected status, scheduling, assignment, reference, description, or issue fields on an existing Fleetio work order; omitted fields remain unchanged.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Fleetio user API key. In Fleetio, open Settings > Manage API Keys (https://secure.fleetio.com/api_keys), then copy the API key for the dedicated user whose role grants the permissions this connection needs.

required.name: generic_token
required.description: The Fleetio account token paired with your API key. In Fleetio, open Settings > Manage API Keys (https://secure.fleetio.com/api_keys) and copy the Account Token for the account this connection should access.

name: Flexisign
description: FlexiSign is a privacy and security-focused e-signature tool that simplifies how you sign, send, and manage documents.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all available document templates. Use when you need to retrieve and display templates from your FlexiSign account after connecting.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your FlexiSign API key used for authentication.

name: Float
description: Float is a resource management and project planning platform for scheduling teams, managing project capacity, tracking time, and reporting on utilization.

tools.name: Create Allocation
tools.description: Schedule work on a Float project for one or more people, or leave it unassigned, with optional phase, status, notes, and recurrence. Supplying a project-task name may create that project-task definition when none matches.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a Float project with core scheduling and classification fields. This tool intentionally excludes rates, currencies, budgets, and project-team replacement operations.

tools.name: Get People Capacity Report
tools.description: Return person-level capacity, scheduled, unscheduled, time-off, billable, and non-billable totals for a required date range.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieve one Float project by ID, optionally including its phases, project tasks, team, expenses, or currency details.

tools.name: Get Project Utilization Report
tools.description: Return project-level scheduled, logged, billable, non-billable, budget, and utilization totals for a required date range, optionally for one project.

tools.name: List Allocations
tools.description: Find scheduled allocations in Float by project, person, client, phase, project task, date range, billing state, status, or recurrence.

tools.name: List People
tools.description: Find active people on the Float schedule by default, or filter for archived or all people, employee type, department, tags, and related account details.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Find Float projects by code, client, lifecycle state, billing state, status, or tags, optionally including planning details such as phases, tasks, team, and currency.

tools.name: Update Allocation
tools.description: Reschedule or revise selected fields of a Float allocation. Sends only fields explicitly supplied by the caller and preserves Float task IDs in the result. Supplying a project-task name may create that project-task definition when none matches.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update selected core identity, schedule, lifecycle, and tag fields on a Float project. This tool does not expose financial configuration or project-team replacement and removal operations.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Float API key. The Float Account Owner can copy or regenerate it in Company settings > Integrations > Float API. Treat it like a password because it grants account-owner access and remains valid until regenerated or the account is no longer in good standing.

required.name: user_agent
required.description: An identifying application name and contact email required by Float, in the format "Application Name (contact@example.com)". Use an email address where Float can contact the integration owner if there are API issues.

name: Flotiq
description: Flotiq is an API-first headless content management system for defining content types, managing and publishing content, searching data, and handling media.

tools.name: Batch Upsert Content Objects
tools.description: Create or update up to 100 objects of one Flotiq content type in a batch, returning success and error counts plus per-object validation errors. The batch is atomic: if any object fails validation, Flotiq persists none and the tool raises a validation error with the provider's counters and details.

tools.name: Create Content Object
tools.description: Create one object that conforms to a Flotiq content type definition.

tools.name: Delete Content Object
tools.description: Soft-delete one Flotiq content object. Flotiq retains deleted objects for 60 days, but restoration requires Flotiq support.

tools.name: Get Content Object
tools.description: Get one object by content type and ID, optionally expanding its relationships.

tools.name: Get Content Type
tools.description: Get one content type definition, including its field schema and metadata configuration.

tools.name: List Content Objects
tools.description: List and filter objects from one Flotiq content type while preserving its dynamic fields.

tools.name: List Content Types
tools.description: List the content type definitions visible to the connected Flotiq account, including internal types.

tools.name: Search Content
tools.description: Full-text search across content objects visible to the API key, optionally restricted to content types, with configurable matching, ordering, relationship expansion, and pagination.

tools.name: Set Content Publication
tools.description: Publish a Draft & Public content object or return it to draft; this changes what public consumers can see.

tools.name: Update Content Object
tools.description: Partially update selected fields of one existing Flotiq content object.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.displayName: Application Read and Write API Key
required.description: In the Flotiq Dashboard, open the API Keys page and copy the Application Read and Write API key. This account-wide key permits reads and writes across your Flotiq content, schemas, publishing, media, search, and GraphQL data. Keep it secret.

name: Flowiseai
description: FlowiseAI is an open-source generative AI development platform for building AI Agents and LLM workflows.

tools.name: Clone Chatflow
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing chatflow. Use when you need to duplicate a chatflow by its ID.

tools.name: Create Chatflow
tools.description: Creates a new chatflow in FlowiseAI. Chatflows are visual workflows that define AI agent behavior using nodes and edges. Use this to programmatically create single-agent (CHATFLOW) or multi-agent (MULTIAGENT) flows. Only 'name' is required; type defaults to 'CHATFLOW' and flowData defaults to an empty flow structure.

tools.name: Create Document Store
tools.description: Creates a new document store in FlowiseAI. Document stores are used to manage embeddings and vector data for AI applications. Use this to programmatically create storage for documents that will be embedded and searched.

tools.name: Create Lead
tools.description: Tool to create a new lead in a chatflow. Use when you need to capture lead information from a chat session for follow-up or CRM integration.

tools.name: Create Tool
tools.description: Tool to create a new FlowiseAI tool. Use when you need to create a custom tool with specific name, description, and color. Optionally provide icon URL, JSON schema, or JavaScript function code.

tools.name: Create Variable
tools.description: Creates a new variable in FlowiseAI. Variables are used to store configuration values, API keys, and other data that can be referenced across chatflows. Use this to programmatically create string or number variables with optional values.

tools.name: Delete Chatflow
tools.description: Tool to delete a chatflow by its ID. Use after confirming the chatflow ID is correct.

tools.name: Delete Chat Messages
tools.description: Tool to delete chat messages for a specific chatflow. Use when you need to remove messages based on optional filters. Use after confirming the chatflow ID.

tools.name: Delete Document Store
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific document store by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a document store. This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Tool By ID
tools.description: Permanently deletes a FlowiseAI tool by its unique ID. This action is destructive and cannot be undone. Use FLOWISEAI_LIST_ALL_TOOLS first to verify the correct tool ID before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Variable
tools.description: Tool to delete a variable by its unique ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a variable from FlowiseAI.

tools.name: Edit Document Store File Chunk
tools.description: Tool to update a specific chunk in a FlowiseAI document store. Use when you need to modify the content or metadata of an existing chunk. At least one of pageContent or metadata must be provided.

tools.name: Get All Chatflows
tools.description: Retrieves all chatflows from the authenticated FlowiseAI account. Use this to list available chatflows, get their IDs for subsequent operations (like update, delete, export), or check chatflow deployment status. Returns an empty list if no chatflows exist.

tools.name: Get All Chat Message Feedback
tools.description: Tool to list all chat message feedbacks for a chatflow. Use when you need to view feedback given on messages in a specific chatflow.

tools.name: Get All Leads for Chatflow
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all leads for a specific chatflow. Use when you need to see lead information collected from a chatflow's interactions.

tools.name: Get All Upsert History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all upsert history records for a specific chatflow. Use when you need to view the history of upsert operations.

tools.name: Get All Variables
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all variables. Use when you need to list all variables available in the FlowiseAI workspace. Returns an empty list if no variables exist.

tools.name: Get Document Store By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a document store by its ID. Use when you have a document store ID and need its full details including configuration and status.

tools.name: Get Document Store File Chunks
tools.description: Tool to get chunks from a specific document loader. Use when you need to retrieve chunked content from a document in a FlowiseAI document store.

tools.name: Get Single Chatflow
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a chatflow by its ID. Use when you have a chatflow ID and need its full details.

tools.name: Get Tool By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific FlowiseAI tool by its ID. Use when you need detailed metadata of a tool before interacting with it.

tools.name: List All Tools
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all tools. Use when you need to list every tool available after authentication.

tools.name: List Assistants
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all assistants. Use when you need to list every assistant available in the authenticated FlowiseAI account.

tools.name: List Chat Messages
tools.description: Tool to list chat messages of a chatflow. Use after selecting a chatflow when you need to view its messages.

tools.name: Ping Server
tools.description: Tool to ping the FlowiseAI server to verify it is running and accessible. Use this to perform a health check before executing other operations or to diagnose connectivity issues.

tools.name: Update Chatflow Details
tools.description: Tool to update details of an existing chatflow. Use when you have confirmed the chatflow ID and want to modify its fields.

tools.name: Update Document Store
tools.description: Tool to update a specific document store. Use when you need to modify properties of an existing document store.

tools.name: Update Tool By ID
tools.description: Updates a FlowiseAI tool's properties by its ID. Use this to modify tool name, description, color, icon, JSON schema, or JavaScript function code. Requires the tool's UUID from LIST_ALL_TOOLS or GET_TOOL_BY_ID. At least one field must be provided for update.

tools.name: Update Variable
tools.description: Tool to update a variable by its ID. Use when you need to modify a variable's name, value, or type.

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL of your hosted FlowiseAI instance, e.g., 'https://flowise-test.com'.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the FlowiseAI API.

name: Fluxguard
description: Fluxguard is an AI-powered website change detection and monitoring tool that helps businesses track, analyze, and respond to critical changes in web-based data.

tools.name: Add FluxGuard Page
tools.description: Tool to add a new page for monitoring in FluxGuard. This action can: 1. Create a new site with a page (when siteId/sessionId are not provided) 2. Add a page to an existing site (when siteId/sessionId are provided) When creating a new site, you can optionally assign it to categories and provide a nickname. Use this when you need to start monitoring a URL for changes.

tools.name: Create FluxGuard Site Category
tools.description: Creates a new site category in FluxGuard for organizing monitored websites. Site categories help you group and manage your monitored sites logically (e.g., by environment like 'Production' or 'Staging', by purpose like 'Marketing' or 'E-commerce', or by client/team). Use this action to create categories before adding sites, making it easier to filter and organize your monitoring dashboard. The returned category ID can be used when adding sites to assign them to this category.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Creates a webhook endpoint registration in FluxGuard to receive real-time notifications when changes are detected on monitored pages. When changes occur, FluxGuard will POST JSON data to your specified URL containing change details, diff information, and file references. Use this when you need to integrate FluxGuard change detection into your own systems, automation workflows, or alerting infrastructure. Note: Only one webhook can be active per account. Creating a new webhook will replace any existing webhook configuration.

tools.name: Delete Fluxguard Page
tools.description: Permanently deletes a monitored page from FluxGuard along with all its captured snapshots and version history. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. Use this when you need to remove a page that is no longer needed for monitoring. The operation is idempotent - deleting an already-deleted page will succeed without error. To obtain the required IDs (site_id, session_id, page_id), first use FLUXGUARD_ADD_PAGE to create a page or FLUXGUARD_GET_SITES to list existing sites and their pages.

tools.name: Delete Fluxguard Site
tools.description: Permanently deletes a monitored site and all associated data including sessions, pages, and captured versions. This operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent site returns success. Use when you need to remove a site from FluxGuard monitoring.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently removes a webhook from your FluxGuard account by its ID. After deletion, the webhook will no longer receive notifications about monitored page changes. This operation is idempotent - deleting a non-existent webhook will succeed without error. Use this tool when you need to remove a webhook configuration that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Get All FluxGuard Categories
tools.description: Retrieves all categories defined in your FluxGuard account. Use this tool when you need to: - List all available categories for organizing sites or pages - Get category IDs for use in other operations - Check what categories exist before creating new ones This is a read-only operation that returns both site and page categories. No parameters are required - simply call this action to get all categories.

tools.name: Get FluxGuard Page Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive data for a monitored page in FluxGuard. This action fetches detailed information about a specific page including its URL, monitoring status, capture history, and metadata. Use this when you need to verify a page exists, check its monitoring status, or retrieve page configuration details. The page must be identified by its site_id, session_id, and page_id, which are typically obtained from FLUXGUARD_ADD_PAGE when creating a page or from FLUXGUARD_GET_SITES when listing existing sites and their pages.

tools.name: Get Sample Webhook Payload
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a sample webhook payload. Use when you need to inspect the structure of webhook notifications.

tools.name: Get Current FluxGuard Account
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated FluxGuard account's information as a user profile. Returns details about the current organization's account including ID, status, creation date, and last update timestamp. This provides account information in a user-friendly format for the authenticated API key's organization.

tools.name: Get FluxGuard Webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all configured webhooks for the FluxGuard account. Use this action to list all webhook endpoints that are configured to receive FluxGuard change notifications. Each webhook includes its URL, secret for signature verification, API version, and associated site categories. No parameters required - returns all webhooks for the authenticated account.

tools.name: Initiate FluxGuard Crawl
tools.description: Tool to initiate a crawl for a session identified by siteId and sessionId. Use when you need to start monitoring a site for changes after adding pages with FLUXGUARD_ADD_PAGE.

tools.name: Fluxguard Webhook Notification
tools.description: Simulate Fluxguard webhook notification by sending change detection data to your webhook endpoint. Use this tool to test your webhook receiver implementation by sending it a properly formatted Fluxguard webhook payload with optional HMAC signature authentication. This helps verify your endpoint can receive and process Fluxguard change notifications correctly. Note: This does NOT retrieve data from Fluxguard or trigger actual monitoring - it only sends test notifications to your webhook URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Fluxguard API key used for authentication.

name: Fly
description: Fly.io transforms containers into micro-VMs that run on hardware in 30+ regions on six continents.

tools.name: Add WireGuard Peer
tools.description: Tool to add a WireGuard peer connection to a Fly.io organization for private network access. Use when setting up VPN access or private networking between your infrastructure and Fly.io.

tools.name: Check App Name Availability
tools.description: Tool to validate an app name for Fly.io app creation. Use when you need to check if a proposed app name is available before attempting to create a new app. Returns availability status via GraphQL query.

tools.name: Check Jobs
tools.description: Execute GraphQL queries against the Fly.io checkJobs endpoint. Retrieves check jobs with their schedules, URLs, and configuration. Supports pagination via first/last/after/before parameters. Returns both data and errors for flexible error handling.

tools.name: Check User Only Token
tools.description: Check whether the authentication token only allows user access. Returns false if the token allows organization access, true if it only allows user access.

tools.name: Create Health Check Job
tools.description: Tool to create a health check job for monitoring application endpoints in Fly.io. Use when you need to set up automated health monitoring for a URL from multiple geographic locations.

tools.name: Create Check Job Run
tools.description: Triggers a run of an existing health check job on Fly.io. Use when you need to manually trigger a health check for monitoring or testing purposes.

tools.name: Create Delegated WireGuard Token
tools.description: Tool to create a delegated WireGuard token for peer management in a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to generate a token for managing WireGuard peers with delegated access.

tools.name: Create Third-Party Configuration
tools.description: Tool to create a third-party service configuration for discharging macaroon caveats. Use when you need to configure external authorization services for Fly.io token validation.

tools.name: Delete Delegated WireGuard Token
tools.description: Tool to delete a delegated WireGuard token from a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to revoke or remove an existing WireGuard token that was previously created. Either token or name must be provided to identify which token to delete.

tools.name: Delete Organization
tools.description: Tool to delete a Fly.io organization and all its associated resources using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to permanently remove an organization. This operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Remote Builder
tools.description: Tool to delete a remote builder configuration for a Fly.io organization. Use when you need to remove the remote builder setup from an organization.

tools.name: Delete Third Party Configuration
tools.description: Tool to delete a third-party service configuration from Fly.io. Use when you need to remove an existing third-party service integration or configuration that was previously created.

tools.name: Detach Postgres Cluster
tools.description: Tool to detach a Postgres cluster from a Fly.io application, revoking access credentials. Use when you need to remove database connectivity from an application.

tools.name: Establish SSH Key
tools.description: Tool to establish an SSH key for a Fly.io organization. Use when setting up SSH access for secure connections to Fly.io infrastructure.

tools.name: Fetch Nodes by IDs
tools.description: Fetches a list of node objects from Fly.io given a list of IDs using the GraphQL nodes query. Use when you need to retrieve multiple objects by their IDs in a single request. Supports all Node interface types including Organization, App, Machine, Volume, and more.

tools.name: Get Add-On
tools.description: Tool to find a Fly.io add-on by ID, name, or provider. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific add-on. Returns add-on information including status, organization, region, and access URLs.

tools.name: Get Add-On Provider
tools.description: Tool to query information about a specific Fly.io add-on provider (extension) by name. Returns provider details including provisioning settings, terms of service, and configuration options.

tools.name: Get app details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific Fly.io application. Use when you need to get app details including certificates and configuration.

tools.name: Get Certificate
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a certificate by its ID from Fly.io. Use when you need to get details about a specific certificate including hostname, creation date, and configuration status.

tools.name: Get Current Token Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about the current authentication token. Use when you need to retrieve details about the token being used for API authentication, including organizations, apps, and whether the token is from a user or machine.

tools.name: Get Latest Image Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest available tag details for a given image repository from Fly.io's registry. Use when you need to get digest, registry, repository, tag, and version information for a container image.

tools.name: Get Latest Image Tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest available image tag for a Fly.io Docker repository. Use when you need to find the most recent version of a Fly.io image.

tools.name: Get Machine
tools.description: Tool to get a single machine by ID from Fly.io. Use when you need to retrieve details about a specific machine instance.

tools.name: Get Nearest Region
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the nearest Fly.io region to the requesting client based on network location. Use when you need to determine which Fly.io region has the lowest latency from the current location.

tools.name: Get Node by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch an object by its globally unique ID using Fly.io's GraphQL node query. Returns a Node interface object with id and __typename fields. Use when you need to retrieve any Fly.io object by its ID.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Tool to find a Fly.io organization by slug using the GraphQL API. Use when you need to retrieve organization details including ID, name and slug.

tools.name: Get Personal Organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user's personal organization details from Fly.io. Use when you need to check credit balance, saved payment methods, certificates, or WireGuard peer information.

tools.name: Get Placements
tools.description: Tool to get placement recommendations for Machines in Fly.io regions. Use when you need to determine optimal regions for deploying machines based on resource requirements, volume constraints, and organizational limits.

tools.name: Get Platform Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Fly.io platform information including available regions, VM sizes, and flyctl version. Use when you need infrastructure-level details about the Fly.io platform.

tools.name: Get Products and Pricing
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Fly.io product and price information via GraphQL. Use when you need to fetch product catalog, pricing tiers, or billing information.

tools.name: Get Regions
tools.description: Tool to get the list of available Fly.io regions with optional filtering. Use when you need to discover which regions are available for deploying machines, or to filter regions by specific resource requirements like CPU, memory, or GPU.

tools.name: Get Viewer Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated user's account information from Fly.io. Use when you need to get the current user's profile details, including avatar, email, creation date, and feature flags.

tools.name: Issue Certificate
tools.description: Tool to issue an SSH certificate for accessing Fly.io infrastructure. Returns an SSH certificate in OpenSSH format. Use when you need to authenticate SSH access to Fly.io machines or apps.

tools.name: List Add-On Plans
tools.description: Tool to list available add-on service plans from Fly.io. Use when you need to discover pricing, features, and resource limits for Fly.io add-on services. Supports cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: List Add-Ons
tools.description: Tool to list add-ons associated with an organization in Fly.io. Use when you need to retrieve add-ons for apps in an organization. Supports querying personal organization or specific organizations by slug. Returns comprehensive add-on details including status, creation date, and configuration.

tools.name: List Apps
