name: Forcemanager
description: ForceManager is a mobile-first CRM designed to enhance sales team productivity by providing real-time insights and streamlined management of customer interactions.

tools.name: Delete Activity
tools.description: Delete an existing activity by ID. Tries multiple base hosts and path variants to maximize compatibility across environments and gateways.

tools.name: Delete Company
tools.description: Tool to delete a company by its ForceManager ID. Use when you need to remove an existing company from the system.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Permanently deletes a contact from ForceManager by its unique ID. This action removes the specified contact and all associated data. The operation is irreversible. The action automatically tries multiple API endpoint combinations to ensure compatibility across different ForceManager deployments and configurations. Returns the HTTP status code and any response message from the API. A successful deletion typically returns a 200 status code.

tools.name: Delete Sales Order
tools.description: Delete a sales order by ID using ForceManager REST API. Tries multiple base hosts and path variants to maximize compatibility across environments. Accepts successful HTTP status codes (< 300) even when the response is non-JSON, capturing response text.

tools.name: Delete Sales Order Line
tools.description: Delete a sales order line by ID. Attempts deletion across multiple ForceManager API hosts and path variations to ensure compatibility. Returns detailed information about the deletion result, including any messages or status codes from the API. Use this when you need to remove a specific sales order line item from the system.

tools.name: Delete Master Data Value
tools.description: Delete a master-data value (Z_ table) by ID using ForceManager REST API. Tries multiple base hosts and path variants to maximize compatibility across environments. Accepts successful HTTP status codes (< 300) even when the response is HTML instead of JSON, capturing the response text as a message. Also retries sending authentication headers as query parameters on HTTP 401 as some gateways expect them in query string.

tools.name: Delete View
tools.description: Delete a saved view (custom filter) by its ID. Views in ForceManager are saved filter configurations that users create to quickly access filtered lists of entities (accounts, activities, opportunities, etc.). This action permanently removes a view that the authenticated user has permission to delete. **Use Cases:** - Remove outdated or unused custom filters - Clean up views after organizational changes - Programmatically manage view lifecycle **Requirements:** - Valid view ID that exists in the system - Appropriate permissions to delete the view - The view must be owned by or shared with the authenticated user **Note:** This action tries multiple ForceManager API endpoints to maximize compatibility across different deployment environments and API versions.

tools.name: Get Activity
tools.description: Retrieves a single activity by its ID from ForceManager CRM. Use this tool when you need to: - Fetch details of a specific activity by its ID - Check if an activity exists - Retrieve activity data including comments, dates, linked contacts/accounts, and location info The action attempts multiple ForceManager API endpoints to ensure compatibility across different API versions and deployment configurations. Returns found=False if the activity does not exist or cannot be retrieved. Authentication is handled automatically via headers from the connected account.

tools.name: Get Company
tools.description: Retrieve a single company by its ID from ForceManager. Returns company details when found, or an empty entity with found=False when the company doesn't exist or the API returns non-JSON content. The action automatically tries multiple ForceManager API endpoints for maximum compatibility. Use this to fetch company information including name, address, contact details, and custom fields. Check the 'found' field to determine if the company exists.

tools.name: Get Internal ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ForceManager internal IDs mapping for a given externalId and entity type. This action calls the documented endpoint /api/internalid with required authentication headers and optional pagination/version headers. It tries multiple base hosts to avoid HTML app shell responses and gracefully handles non-JSON responses and error codes by returning empty results instead of failing the execution.

tools.name: Get Product
tools.description: Retrieve a single product by its ID from ForceManager/Sage Sales Management. This action tries multiple known ForceManager API endpoints in sequence until one succeeds. If a product is not found or the API returns non-JSON content, it returns found=False with an empty entity dict. This graceful handling allows agents to check for product existence without encountering errors. Use this when you need to fetch product details such as name, price, cost, category, or custom fields by product ID.

tools.name: Get Sales Order Line
tools.description: Retrieves a single sales order line by ID from ForceManager. A sales order line represents a product item within a sales order, including quantity, pricing, and discount information. Use this when you need to fetch details about a specific line item in a sales order, such as product information, quantities, prices, or applied discounts.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Retrieves a single ForceManager user by their ID, returning comprehensive user information including name, email, phone, active status, permission level, manager, branches, and more. Returns the complete user object if found, or an empty entity with found=False if the user doesn't exist, was deleted, or the API returns an error. Automatically tries multiple ForceManager API endpoints and versions to ensure compatibility. Use this when you need to: fetch user profile details, verify user existence, check user permissions/status, or retrieve user contact information.

tools.name: Get View
tools.description: Tool to get a single view by ID. Returns a list with zero or one view object.

tools.name: List Views
tools.description: Tool to list saved view filters. Use when you need to retrieve saved views for a specific entity (e.g., list views for entity 'account').

tools.name: Update Activity
tools.description: Tool to update an existing activity by ID. Use when you need to change fields such as comment, date/time, linked entities, or geocode.

tools.name: Update Company
tools.description: Update Company

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Updates an existing product by ID in ForceManager. Use this tool to modify product details such as name, price, cost, description, availability status, category, family, discount limits, and custom fields. The product must already exist - this action does not create new products. At least one field besides 'id' must be provided to update.

tools.name: Update Sales Order
tools.description: Update Sales Order

tools.name: Update Sales Order Line
tools.description: Tool to update sales order line by ID. Use when modifying details of an existing sales order line. Retries with query auth on 401 for proxy-pro host.

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The SHA1 hash signature generated by concatenating the Unix timestamp, public key, and private key. Used for X-FM-Signature header.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The public key provided by ForceManager for API authentication. Typically set as the X-FM-PublicKey header.

required.name: generic_secret
required.description: The private key provided by ForceManager for API authentication. Used to generate the signature. This key should never be transmitted in plain text.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The current Unix timestamp in UTC. Used for X-FM-UnixTimestamp header in ForceManager authentication.

name: Formbricks
description: Formbricks is an open-source platform for building and managing surveys, enabling organizations to collect and analyze user feedback effectively.

tools.name: Check Health
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of the Formbricks API. Use when you need to verify that the API is operational and responding to requests.

tools.name: Create Action Class
tools.description: Tool to create a new action class. Use when defining custom action logic in your environment.

tools.name: Create Attribute Class
tools.description: Creates a new attribute class (custom contact attribute) in Formbricks. Attribute classes define the schema for contact attributes used for segmentation and personalization. Each attribute must have a unique key within the environment. Common examples include 'plan', 'tier', 'company', or custom business-specific attributes. Use this when you need to define new contact attribute types before tracking user data.

tools.name: Create Client User
tools.description: Tool to create or identify a user within a specified environment. If the user already exists, this will identify them and potentially update user attributes. If they don't exist, it will create a new user. Use when you need to register or update users in the client API for survey targeting.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Creates a new contact in a Formbricks environment. A contact represents a person or entity tracked in Formbricks for survey responses and interactions. The email serves as the unique identifier within an environment - if a contact with the same email already exists, this will update the existing contact. Use this action when you need to: - Register a new contact for survey distribution - Add contact information before sending surveys - Create or update contact records with custom attributes Prerequisites: - An environment ID (use GET_ME to retrieve available environments) - All attribute keys must exist in the environment (email is always available) - Write permissions on the API key

tools.name: Create Display
tools.description: Create a display record to track when a survey is shown to users. Displays are used to measure survey view counts and can optionally be linked to a specific user. Use this after obtaining valid survey and environment IDs to register that a survey was displayed.

tools.name: Create Survey Response
tools.description: Tool to create a response for a survey. Use after collecting all survey answers.

tools.name: Create Survey
tools.description: Tool to create a new survey. Use after defining survey details and questions.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook. Use when you need to register an external endpoint to receive form response events.

tools.name: Delete Attribute Class
tools.description: Tool to delete an attribute class. Use when you need to remove an attribute class by its ID after confirming it's no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Person
tools.description: Tool to delete a person. Use when you need to remove a person's record from Formbricks after confirming the ID.

tools.name: Delete Survey Response
tools.description: Tool to delete a survey response by its ID. Use when you need to remove an existing response after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Delete Survey
tools.description: Deletes a survey from Formbricks by its unique identifier. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a survey. The deletion cannot be undone. Before deletion, ensure you have the correct survey ID - you can list surveys first to verify. Returns the deleted survey's data including its ID, name, type, status, and timestamps.

tools.name: Delete Team
tools.description: Tool to delete an organization team by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a team from an organization. Requires write permissions on the organization. Returns the deleted team's details including ID, name, timestamps, and organization ID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook by ID. Use when you need to remove an existing webhook from Formbricks. Use after confirming the webhook ID.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Retrieves environment information for the authenticated API key. Returns details about the environment (development or production) including the associated project and setup completion status. This is useful for understanding which environment and project you're working with.

tools.name: Get All Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts within the organization. Use when you need a complete list of contacts.

tools.name: Get Attribute Class
tools.description: Tool to get a specific attribute class by ID. Use when you need to retrieve details of a specific attribute class for inspection or validation.

tools.name: Get Client Contacts State
tools.description: Tool to get the current state of a contact including surveys and segment information. Use when you need to retrieve tracking data for a specific user, including their segment memberships, survey displays, and response history. This endpoint uses the v2 client API.

tools.name: Get Contact Attribute Key
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific contact attribute key by ID (v2 API). Use when you need to inspect the properties of a contact attribute key such as its type, uniqueness requirement, or associated environment.

tools.name: Get Contact by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific contact by its ID. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a single contact.

tools.name: Get Me
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current authenticated organization's and environment details. Use when you need to fetch organization and environment information for the current API key.

tools.name: Get Person by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a person by their internal ID in Formbricks. Use when you need detailed information about a specific person, including all their custom attributes. The person ID can be obtained from the Get All Persons endpoint.

tools.name: Get Responses
tools.description: Retrieve survey responses with flexible filtering, sorting, and pagination. Use this tool to: - List all responses across surveys or filter by specific surveyId - Filter responses by contactId to see submissions from a specific contact - Apply date range filters (startDate/endDate) with filterDateField - Sort by creation or update time (sortBy: createdAt/updatedAt) - Paginate through large result sets (limit: 1-250, skip for offset) Returns detailed response data including answers, completion status, timestamps, contact attributes, time-to-complete metrics, and pagination metadata.

tools.name: Get Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available roles in the system. Use when you need system roles for access control.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific webhook. Use when you need to inspect a webhook's configuration by ID.

tools.name: List Action Classes
tools.description: List all action classes in your Formbricks environment. Action classes define trackable user interactions (like clicks, page views, form submissions) that can trigger surveys or be used in targeting logic. Use this to discover what actions are available for survey triggers and audience segmentation.

tools.name: List Attribute Classes
tools.description: Tool to list all attribute classes. Use when you need to retrieve existing attribute classes for segmentation or management.

tools.name: List Client Environment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve environment state for Formbricks SDKs. Use when you need to fetch the complete environment configuration including surveys, action classes, and project settings. Note: This endpoint uses server-side caching with a 5-minute TTL, so changes may take up to 5 minutes to reflect.

tools.name: List Contact Attribute Keys
tools.description: Tool to retrieve contact attribute keys from Formbricks. Use when you need to list all available contact attributes for segmentation, filtering, or contact management. Supports pagination, sorting, and date filtering.

tools.name: List Health
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of critical application dependencies including database and cache. Use when you need to verify that Formbricks services are operational.

tools.name: List Management Contact Attributes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contact attributes in the environment. Use when you need to view custom data stored for contacts across the organization.

tools.name: List Management Me
tools.description: Tool to retrieve authenticated user's environment and project information. Use when you need to get details about the environment associated with the current API key, including project details and setup status.

tools.name: List Management People
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all people (legacy term for contacts) in the environment. Use when you need a complete list of people with their attributes.

tools.name: List Organizations Project Teams
tools.description: Tool to list all project-team assignments for an organization (v2 API only). Use when you need to retrieve which teams are assigned to which projects, along with their permission levels. Supports filtering by team, project, date range, and pagination.

tools.name: List Organization Teams
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all teams in an organization (v2 API). Use when you need to list teams within a specific organization, with support for pagination, sorting, and date-based filtering. Returns team details including ID, name, timestamps, and organization ID.

tools.name: List Surveys
tools.description: List all surveys in the environment. Use this tool to: - Retrieve all surveys with complete configuration details - Access survey questions, endings, triggers, and styling - View survey status and metadata (created/updated timestamps, creator) - Get display settings, targeting, and language configurations Returns complete survey objects including questions, endings, welcome cards, triggers, display options, styling, and all other configuration settings.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List all webhooks configured for the current environment. Returns webhooks with pagination support and optional filtering by survey IDs, date ranges, and sorting. Use this action to retrieve webhook configurations, check which surveys have webhooks enabled, or audit webhook settings.

tools.name: Update Contact Attributes
tools.description: Tool to update a contact's attributes in Formbricks. Use when you need to keep contact information in sync with your app or set custom attributes.

tools.name: Update Survey Response
tools.description: Tool to update an existing survey response. Use after identifying the response to modify.

tools.name: Update Survey
tools.description: Updates an existing Formbricks survey with new properties. Only include fields you want to modify - all fields except 'id' are optional. Common use cases: - Change survey status (e.g., from 'draft' to 'inProgress' to make it live) - Update survey name or closed message - Modify display settings (delay, frequency, percentage) - Add/update questions, welcome cards, or ending screens - Configure triggers and targeting Requires: Valid survey ID (get from List Surveys or Create Survey actions)

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update an existing webhook. Use when you need to apply modifications to a webhook's configuration.

tools.name: Upload Bulk Contacts
tools.description: Upload multiple contacts to a Formbricks environment in bulk (up to 250 per request). Each contact must include an 'email' attribute with a valid email address. Additional attributes like firstName, lastName, or custom fields can be included. The API returns status 200 for full success or 207 for partial success with details about skipped contacts. Use this tool when you need to efficiently import multiple contacts at once instead of creating them individually.

tools.name: Upload Private File
tools.description: Tool to obtain S3 presigned upload data for a private survey file. Use after confirming environmentId and surveyId.

tools.name: Upload Public File
tools.description: Retrieves S3 presigned upload URLs and form fields for uploading a public file to Formbricks storage. Returns signed URL and presigned fields needed to upload files directly to S3. Maximum file size: 5MB. Uploaded files are publicly accessible. Requires write permissions on the specified environment.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Formbricks API key.

name: Formcrafts
description: Formcrafts is an online form builder for collecting responses, managing forms, and accessing uploaded files across an organization.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Download an uploaded Formcrafts file by file ID and return an offloaded file reference.

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Get a Formcrafts form's metadata, response count, fields, and pages by form ID.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Return one page of files uploaded to the connected Formcrafts organization. Use before and after for exclusive created_at windows; inspect has_more because Formcrafts provides no continuation token.

tools.name: List Form Responses
tools.description: Return one page of live responses for a Formcrafts form, including visitor metadata, workflow results, and typed field values. Use before and after for exclusive created_at windows; inspect has_more because Formcrafts provides no continuation token.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: Return one page of forms from the connected Formcrafts organization. Use before and after for exclusive created_at windows; inspect has_more because Formcrafts provides no continuation token.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Return one page of workspaces from the connected Formcrafts organization. Use before and after for exclusive created_at windows; inspect has_more because Formcrafts provides no continuation token.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create an API key in Formcrafts under Organization > Settings > API Keys, then enter it here. Formcrafts displays the key only once after creation, so store it securely.

name: Formdesk
description: Formdesk is an online form builder that allows users to create and manage professional online forms with flexible features and integrations.

tools.name: Validate Formdesk Authentication
tools.description: Validates the Formdesk API bearer token and returns authentication details. This action confirms that your connected Formdesk account credentials are valid by making a test API call to the /forms endpoint. It returns the bearer token information that can be used for subsequent authenticated requests. **Important**: This does NOT perform username/password login. Formdesk uses API keys (bearer tokens) for authentication, which are obtained from your Formdesk account's User Management section. The username/password parameters are placeholders for API compatibility and are not used. **Use this action to**: - Verify that your Formdesk API credentials are valid - Retrieve the bearer token from your connected account - Confirm API connectivity before performing other operations **How it works**: 1. Uses the bearer token from your connected account metadata 2. Validates the token by calling the Formdesk /forms endpoint 3. Returns token details if validation succeeds

tools.name: Create Formdesk Entry
tools.description: Submit a new entry (result) to a Formdesk form. This action creates a new form submission with the provided field values. Before using this action: 1. Use FORMDESK_GET_FORM_LIST to find the form ID 2. Use FORMDESK_GET_FORM_FIELDS to understand which fields the form expects 3. Prepare field values that match the form's schema The action returns the ID of the newly created entry, which can be used with FORMDESK_GET_ENTRY_DETAILS to retrieve the full entry data.

tools.name: Create Field
tools.description: Creates a new field in a Formdesk form. Use this action to add fields like text inputs, email fields, textareas, checkboxes, date pickers, etc. to an existing form. You must have the form ID from FORMDESK_GET_FORM_LIST or FORMDESK_GET_FORM_DETAILS before creating fields. The field definition should specify at minimum the field name, type, and label. Additional properties like 'required', 'placeholder', 'description', and 'default' can be included.

tools.name: Create Visitor
tools.description: Tool to add a new visitor to a specific Formdesk form. Use when you need to register a visitor's metadata before submitting entries.

tools.name: Delete Formdesk Entry
tools.description: Deletes a specific entry (form submission/result) from a Formdesk form. This action is idempotent - it will succeed even if the entry doesn't exist (404), making it safe to call multiple times. Use this when you need to remove a form submission permanently. The entry can be obtained from GET_FORM_ENTRIES or GET_ENTRY_DETAILS actions.

tools.name: Delete Field in Formdesk
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific field in a Formdesk form. Use after confirming formId and fieldId.

tools.name: Delete Form in Formdesk
tools.description: Delete a specific form from Formdesk. This action permanently removes a form from the Formdesk account. Use with caution as this operation is destructive and cannot be undone. If the form ID does not exist, the action returns success=False with an appropriate message rather than raising an error. Returns success=True if the form was deleted, or success=False if the form was not found.

tools.name: Delete Visitor in Formdesk
tools.description: Deletes a specific visitor from a Formdesk form. This action is idempotent - it will succeed even if the visitor doesn't exist (404), making it safe to call multiple times. Use this to remove a visitor from a form's visitor list. Obtain valid form_id from GET_FORM_LIST and visitor_id from GET_FORM_VISITORS actions.

tools.name: Get Field Details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details about a specific field in a Formdesk form. Returns structured information including field ID, name, type (e.g., text, email, number), label, validation rules, and whether the field is required. Use this after obtaining formId from Get Form List and fieldId from Get Form Fields to inspect specific field properties, validation rules, or configuration.

tools.name: Get Form Details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details about a specific Formdesk form by its ID. Returns form metadata including name, description, active status, timestamps, public URL, and configuration settings. Use this when you need to inspect form properties or verify form existence before performing other operations.

tools.name: Get Form Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all fields of a specific form. Use after obtaining the formId to inspect its field definitions.

tools.name: Get Form List
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all forms in the Formdesk account. This action returns basic information about each form including its ID and name. Use the form ID with other actions (like Get Form Details, Get Form Fields, Get Form Entries) to access more detailed information about a specific form. No parameters are required - this action lists all forms accessible with the current authentication credentials.

tools.name: Get Form Visitors
tools.description: Retrieves all visitors registered to access a specific Formdesk form. Visitors are users who have been granted access to view or complete a form. This action returns visitor details including their credentials, permissions, and registration information. Use this when you need to list all visitors for a form or check visitor access rights. Note: First use 'Get Form List' to obtain valid form IDs if you don't have one.

tools.name: Get Visitor Details
tools.description: Retrieve complete details of a specific visitor in a Formdesk form. A visitor represents a unique person or entity who can submit entries to a form. Visitors have attributes (name, email, custom fields) and can be associated with multiple form entries. Use this action to get full visitor information including all custom attributes defined in your form. Prerequisites: You must have both the form_id and visitor_id. Obtain these from: - form_id: Use 'Get Form List' action - visitor_id: Use 'Get Form Visitors' or 'Create Visitor' actions

tools.name: KVK Handelsregister Lookup
tools.description: Tool to lookup company details from the Dutch KVK Handelsregister. Use when auto-filling company address fields.

tools.name: Manage Visitor Entries
tools.description: Retrieve form entries (submissions) from a Formdesk form. This action fetches submission data from a form's results database. You can: - List all entries in a form - Filter entries by visitor ID - Retrieve a specific entry by its ID Use cases: - View all form submissions - Track entries submitted by specific visitors - Retrieve detailed information about a specific submission Note: The form must exist and be accessible with your API credentials.

tools.name: Create Multi-Page Form
tools.description: Tool to create a multi-page Formdesk form. Use when you need forms split into multiple pages for better user experience.

tools.name: Update Field
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing field in a Formdesk form. This action modifies field configuration such as labels, types, validation rules, required status, placeholder text, help text, and default values. Only the properties specified in the request are updated; other properties remain unchanged (partial update). Use this when you need to: - Change a field's display label or help text - Modify field validation requirements - Update placeholder or default values - Change field type or options for select/radio fields - Toggle required/optional status Note: Requires valid form_id and field_id from existing Formdesk resources.

tools.name: Update Form
tools.description: Updates properties of an existing form in Formdesk. Use this action to: - Rename a form - Activate or deactivate a form (control whether it accepts responses) - Update other form metadata At least one of 'name' or 'isActive' must be provided. Only specified fields will be updated; other properties will remain unchanged. Use GET_FORM_LIST to retrieve valid form IDs first.

tools.name: Update Visitor
tools.description: Update an existing visitor's attributes in a Formdesk form. A visitor represents a unique person or entity who can submit entries to a form. This action modifies visitor attributes such as name, email, or custom fields. Only the attributes you specify will be updated; other attributes remain unchanged. Prerequisites: You must have both the form_id and visitor_id. Obtain these from: - form_id: Use 'Get Form List' action - visitor_id: Use 'Get Form Visitors', 'Create Visitor', or 'Get Visitor Details' actions Use Cases: - Update visitor contact information (email, phone, address) - Correct visitor name or other profile details - Modify custom visitor attributes defined in your form - Keep visitor records synchronized with external systems

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your unique Formdesk account name (also called 'folder of forms'). Found in your account settings or as the first part of the URL path when accessing forms.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key for your Formdesk account. Can be found or created within User Management in your Formdesk account.

name: Formilla
description: Create or update customer contacts through Formilla's Secure Token REST API for live chat and marketing automation workflows.

tools.name: Upsert Contact
tools.description: Create a Formilla contact or overwrite supplied fields on an existing contact matched by user ID first, then email. Returns no contact data, ID, or create-versus-update result.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log in to Formilla as the Account Owner, open Settings > Security, enable REST API Enabled, and copy the generated Secure Token. If needed, use Create New Token on that page; generating a replacement invalidates the token used by existing integrations. This is not the JavaScript Secure Key or the Zapier API key.

name: Frame.io V4
description: Frame.io V4 provides collaborative media review, project, asset, comment, sharing, metadata, and workspace management through Adobe IMS user authorization.

tools.name: Copy Version Stack

tools.name: Create Comment Attachment

tools.name: Create Folder
tools.description: Create a named child folder under an existing Frame.io folder and return its new ID.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Create an account group that can later receive shared resource access; this changes the account's access-management structure and may require the user-groups plan feature.

tools.name: Create Local Upload
tools.description: Create a Frame.io file record and obtain presigned URLs for uploading local file bytes.

tools.name: Create Metadata Field
tools.description: Create an account-level Frame.io metadata field definition with type-specific configuration.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a Frame.io project in a specific workspace.

tools.name: Create Remote Upload
tools.description: Start an asynchronous Frame.io upload from a source URL and return its file and status links.

tools.name: Create Share
tools.description: Create an externally accessible Frame.io review share for selected project assets.

tools.name: Create Version Stack
tools.description: Combine two to ten existing files in one folder into a new ordered Frame.io version stack.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Register a Frame.io workspace webhook for selected events and return its one-time validation secret.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Create a Frame.io workspace in an account.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Permanently delete a Frame.io comment by ID.

tools.name: Delete Comment Attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete one attachment from a Frame.io comment.

tools.name: Delete Custom Action
tools.description: Delete a Frame.io custom action by ID.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete a Frame.io file by ID.

tools.name: Delete Folder
tools.description: Delete a Frame.io folder by ID; use only when the folder and its contents are no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Metadata Field
tools.description: Delete a mutable account-level Frame.io custom metadata field definition.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Delete a Frame.io project by ID.

tools.name: Delete Share

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete a Frame.io webhook registration by ID.

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Delete a Frame.io workspace from its account by ID.

tools.name: Get Collection
tools.description: Return current details for one Frame.io collection by ID.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Return one Frame.io comment by ID, optionally including its owner or replies.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Return the Frame.io user connected through OAuth, including the user ID needed to interpret access and ownership.

tools.name: Get Custom Action
tools.description: Return current details for one Frame.io custom action by ID.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Return one Frame.io file by ID, optionally including creator, project, metadata, or media links.

tools.name: Get File Upload Status
tools.description: Return the current completion or failure status of a Frame.io file upload.

tools.name: Get Folder
tools.description: Return one folder's current details by ID, optionally including creator, project, or metadata data.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Get an account group's details without changing access; this endpoint may require the user-groups plan feature.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Return current details for one Frame.io project by ID.

tools.name: Get Share

tools.name: Get Version Stack
tools.description: Retrieve a Frame.io version stack and optionally include related data or media links without changing it.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Return current details for one Frame.io workspace by ID.

tools.name: Import File

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: List Frame.io accounts available to the connected user and return account IDs for downstream discovery.

tools.name: List Account Users
tools.description: List users and their roles in an account, optionally including deactivated users, without changing permissions.

tools.name: List Audit Logs
tools.description: List account audit events using Frame.io's experimental audit API, optionally expanding the acting user.

tools.name: List Collections
tools.description: List saved collections in a project, including default review-oriented collections and their root folder IDs.

tools.name: List Comments
tools.description: List one page of comments on a file, with optional owners, replies, and a next_cursor.

tools.name: List Custom Actions
tools.description: List one page of custom actions configured in a Frame.io workspace. Use next_cursor to retrieve subsequent pages.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: List one page of files in a folder, with optional media links and a next_cursor.

tools.name: List Folder Children
tools.description: List files, folders, and version stacks directly inside a folder, with optional type filtering and media-link expansion.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: List only the folders directly inside a Frame.io folder, one cursor-controlled page at a time.

tools.name: List Folder User Roles

name: FraudLabs Pro
description: FraudLabs Pro is an online payment fraud detection service that helps merchants minimize chargebacks and maximize revenue by detecting fraud across various payment methods.

tools.name: Create FraudLabs Pro Reseller Sub-Account
tools.description: Creates a new FraudLabs Pro user account under a reseller account. Requires a Reseller API key (not a regular API key). Use this action to provision new sub-accounts for customers when operating as a FraudLabs Pro reseller. Returns account credentials (username and password) upon successful creation. Prerequisites: - Must have a FraudLabs Pro Reseller account (apply at https://www.fraudlabspro.com/reseller/program) - Requires valid Reseller API key (different from standard FraudLabs Pro API key) - All required fields must contain valid data matching FraudLabs Pro validation rules Important: - Phone numbers should contain only digits (no +, -, spaces, or parentheses) - Country must be valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., US, GB, CA) - Industry must be a valid ID from 1-14

tools.name: FLP Feedback Order
tools.description: Submit fraud screening feedback to improve FraudLabs Pro's machine learning model. Use this after reviewing a screened order to mark it as approved, rejected, or blacklisted. This feedback trains the algorithm to better detect fraud patterns in future transactions.

tools.name: FraudLabs Pro Screen Order
tools.description: Tool to screen orders for fraud. Use when you need to assess transaction risk before fulfillment.

tools.name: Get FraudLabs Pro Order Result (v2)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an existing transaction from FraudLabs Pro fraud detection system using the v2 API. This API is only available for paid plans.

tools.name: Get SMS Verification Result
tools.description: Verify an OTP (one-time password) received via SMS. Returns 'Y' if the OTP is valid, 'N' if invalid or expired. Must be called after using Send SMS Verification to obtain a transaction ID.

tools.name: Send SMS OTP Verification
tools.description: Sends an SMS message containing a one-time password (OTP) to verify a user's phone number. The API generates a random 6-digit OTP, replaces the <otp> placeholder in your message template, and sends the SMS to the recipient. Returns a transaction ID that you must use with the Get SMS Verification Result action to verify the OTP the user enters. Testing: Use phone number '+11' for sandbox testing (no credits deducted). For verification testing with sandbox number, use OTP '123456'.

tools.name: Subscribe Reseller Plan
tools.description: Tool to subscribe a reseller account to a specific plan. Use after obtaining a reseller API key and selecting a plan. Example: Subscribe user "john_doe" to the MICRO plan.

tools.name: Test Order Status Changed Webhook Delivery
tools.description: Tool to send a test webhook payload to the provided callback URL for FraudLabs Pro order status change notifications. This helps validate your endpoint behavior. Important: FraudLabs Pro webhook registration must be configured manually via dashboard.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: Your FraudLabs Pro API license key.

name: Freeagent
description: Cloud-based accounting software for freelancers and small businesses

tools.name: Cashflow summary for a date range
tools.description: Tool to retrieve cashflow summary for a given date range from FreeAgent. Use when you need to analyze cash inflow and outflow over a specific period. Provides net cashflow balance, incoming and outgoing totals, and monthly breakdowns.

tools.name: Get Company Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve company details from FreeAgent. Use when you need information about the company's registration, accounting periods, or settings.

tools.name: Create a Journal Set
tools.description: Tool to create a journal set in FreeAgent. Use when you need to create manual journal entries for accounting corrections or adjustments. All journal entries must balance to zero (total debits equal total credits).

tools.name: Create Sales Tax Period
tools.description: Tool to create a sales tax period in FreeAgent. Use when you need to establish a new sales tax period with specific rates and settings for tax reporting.

tools.name: Create Task Under Project
tools.description: Tool to create a task under a specific project in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new task to an existing project for tracking billable or non-billable work.

tools.name: Create A Timeslip
tools.description: Tool to create a new timeslip in FreeAgent. Use when you need to log time worked on a project task by a specific user on a given date.

tools.name: Create a User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new team member with specific role and permissions. Requires 'Tax, Accounting & Users' permission level.

tools.name: Create Bank Account
tools.description: Tool to create a bank account in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new bank account, PayPal account, or credit card account to track financial transactions.

tools.name: Create Bill with Attachment
tools.description: Tool to create a bill with optional attachment in FreeAgent. Use when you need to record a supplier bill with line items and optionally attach supporting documentation.

tools.name: Create Category
tools.description: Tool to create a custom category in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new category for classifying income or costs. Note that tax_reporting_name is required for cost_of_sales, admin_expenses, current_assets, and liabilities. The allowable_for_tax field is required for cost_of_sales and admin_expenses.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new client, supplier, or business contact with their details.

tools.name: Create Credit Note
tools.description: Tool to create a credit note in FreeAgent. Use when you need to issue a credit note to a contact for refunds or adjustments. The credit note is created with 'Draft' status.

tools.name: Create Credit Note Reconciliation
tools.description: Tool to create a credit note reconciliation in FreeAgent. Use when you need to reconcile a credit note against an invoice, offsetting the invoice amount with the credit note.

tools.name: Create Estimate
tools.description: Tool to create a new estimate in FreeAgent. Use when you need to create an estimate, quote, or proposal for a client. Requires contact, reference, date, type, status, and at least one estimate item with position, item_type, quantity, price, and description.

tools.name: Create Estimate Item
tools.description: Tool to create an estimate item in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a line item to an existing estimate with details like position, type, quantity, price, and optional description.

tools.name: Duplicate Estimate
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an existing estimate in FreeAgent. Use when you need to create a copy of an estimate. The duplicated estimate will always have status=Draft, the next reference in the sequence, and dated_on set to today.

tools.name: Send Estimate Email
tools.description: Tool to email an estimate in FreeAgent. Use when you need to send an estimate to a contact via email with customizable subject, body, and attachments. You can use an existing email template (use_template=true) or provide manual email fields.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Tool to create an invoice in FreeAgent. Use when you need to generate a new invoice for a contact. The invoice will be created in 'Draft' status and can be modified or sent later.

tools.name: Create Invoice Item
tools.description: Tool to create an invoice item in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a line item to an existing invoice with details like type, quantity, price, and description.

tools.name: Duplicate Invoice
tools.description: Tool to duplicate an existing invoice in FreeAgent. Use when you need to create a new invoice based on an existing one. The duplicated invoice is always created with status 'Draft', today's date, and the next reference number in sequence.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note for a contact or project in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add documentation, reminders, or context to contacts or projects.

tools.name: Create Price List Item
tools.description: Tool to create a price list item in FreeAgent. Use when you need to add a new item to the price list with code, description, pricing, and tax information.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a project in FreeAgent. Use when you need to set up a new project for tracking time, expenses, and billing against a specific client or internal initiative.

tools.name: Delete Bank Transaction Explanation
tools.description: Tool to delete a bank transaction explanation in FreeAgent. Use when you need to remove an explanation from a bank transaction.

tools.name: Delete Estimates Default Additional Text
tools.description: Tool to delete default additional text for estimates in FreeAgent. Use when you need to remove the default additional text that appears on estimates.

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a note by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a note from FreeAgent.

tools.name: Get Invoice Timeline
tools.description: Tool to retrieve invoice timeline showing chronological record of invoice-related events. Use when you need to track invoice payment history and related activities.

tools.name: Get Mileage Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve mileage settings including engine type/size options and reimbursement rates. Use when you need to determine valid engine configurations or current mileage rates for expense claims.

tools.name: Get Opening Balances
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the Opening Balances journal set for a company. Use when you need to access initial account balances including journal entries, bank accounts, and stock items.

tools.name: Get Personal Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated user's personal profile from FreeAgent. Use when you need information about the current user's details, role, or permissions.

tools.name: Get the Opening Balances
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the opening balances from the trial balance summary. Use when you need to get the initial balance amounts for all account categories at the start of the accounting period.

tools.name: Get the P&L summary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the Profit and Loss summary for a specified period from FreeAgent. Use when you need financial performance overview including income, expenses, and retained profit.

tools.name: Get Trial Balance Summary
tools.description: Tool to get the trial balance summary from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve the trial balance report data for accounting purposes.

tools.name: Get Balance Sheet
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the balance sheet for a FreeAgent account. Use when you need to get financial position data including assets, liabilities, and equity. Returns balance sheet data for the specified date or current date if not specified.

tools.name: Get Opening Balances
tools.description: Tool to retrieve opening balances for the balance sheet from FreeAgent. Use when you need to get the initial financial position values including capital assets, current assets, liabilities, and equity.

tools.name: List Accounting Transactions
tools.description: Tool to list all accounting transactions from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve transaction history for accounting purposes. Filter by date range or nominal code to narrow results.

tools.name: List All CIS Bands
tools.description: Tool to list all CIS (Construction Industry Scheme) bands for a company. Use when you need to retrieve the available CIS bands configured for a UK company enrolled in CIS for Subcontractors. The bands include gross, standard, and higher rate bands with their respective deduction rates and nominal codes.

tools.name: List All Expenses
tools.description: Tool to list all expenses from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve expense records, optionally filtered by view type (recent/recurring), date range, project, or last update timestamp.

tools.name: List All Price List Items
tools.description: Tool to list all price list items from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve all price list items with optional sorting by creation date, code, or update date.

tools.name: List All Properties
tools.description: Tool to list all properties in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve property records for UK unincorporated landlord companies. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: List All Recurring Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of recurring invoices from FreeAgent. Use when you need to query recurring invoices by status or contact. Supports filtering by draft, active, or inactive status and can include nested invoice line items.

tools.name: List All Sales Tax Periods
tools.description: Tool to list all sales tax periods for a company in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve sales tax configuration history including rates, registration status, and effective dates. Available for US and Universal companies only.

tools.name: List All Stock Items
tools.description: Tool to list all stock items from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve stock items with optional sorting by creation date, description, or update date.

tools.name: List All Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list all tasks in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve tasks with optional filtering by status, project, or update date, and sorting options.

tools.name: List All Timeslips
tools.description: Tool to list all timeslips from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking records with optional filtering by date range, user, project, task, billing status, or last update timestamp.

tools.name: List All Users
tools.description: Tool to list users in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve users with optional filtering by type (all, staff, advisors). Requires 'Tax, Accounting & Users' permission scope.

tools.name: List Bank Accounts
tools.description: Tool to list bank accounts in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve all bank accounts or filter by account type (standard, credit card, or PayPal).

tools.name: List Bank Feeds
tools.description: Tool to list all bank feeds for a company. Use when you need to retrieve the list of bank feeds and their current status.

tools.name: List Bank Transactions
tools.description: Tool to list all bank transactions under a certain bank account in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve transaction history, reconcile accounts, or find specific transactions for a bank account.

tools.name: List Bills
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of bills from FreeAgent. Use when you need to view bills with optional filters by status, date range, contact, or project.

tools.name: List Business Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available business categories from FreeAgent. Use when you need to get the complete list of industry classifications for company categorization.

tools.name: List Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all categories for the current FreeAgent company. Categories are used to classify income or costs for estimate items, invoice items, expenses, bills, and bank transaction explanations. Returns four category sets: admin expenses, cost of sales, income, and general. Use sub_accounts parameter to include sub-accounts instead of top-level accounts.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Tool to list contacts in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve contacts with optional filtering by type, sort order, or update date.

tools.name: List Credit Note Reconciliations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all credit note reconciliations from FreeAgent. Use when you need to list credit notes that have been reconciled against invoices. Optionally filter by update timestamp or date range.

tools.name: List Credit Notes
tools.description: Tool to list credit notes from FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve credit notes with optional filtering by contact, project, status, or date range. Requires 'Estimates and Invoices' permission.

tools.name: List EC MOSS Sales Tax Rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve EC VAT MOSS sales tax rates for a specific EU country and date. Use when you need to determine the applicable VAT rates for cross-border digital services within the EU.

tools.name: List Estimates
tools.description: Tool to list estimates in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve estimates with optional filtering by status, date range, contact, project, or invoice. Set nested_estimate_items to true to include estimate items in the response.

tools.name: Get Default Estimates Additional Text
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the default additional text for estimates. Use when you need to get the default text that appears on all estimate documents.

tools.name: List Final Accounts Reports
tools.description: Tool to list final accounts reports for a company in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve all final accounts reports with their filing status and period dates.

tools.name: List Hire Purchases
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all hire purchases for the authorized FreeAgent account. Use when you need to view existing hire purchase agreements. Requires 'Bills' access level and is only available for UK companies.

tools.name: Get Default Additional Text
tools.description: Tool to get the default additional text shown on all invoices. Use when you need to retrieve the default invoice text.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of notes for a contact or project. Use when you need to view all notes associated with a specific contact or project.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve projects with optional filtering by status and sorting. Requires 'Contacts and Projects' permission scope.

tools.name: List VAT Returns
tools.description: Tool to list VAT returns for a company in FreeAgent. Use when you need to retrieve VAT return records, their filing status, and payment information.

tools.name: Show Tax Timeline
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the company's tax timeline showing upcoming tax events and deadlines. Use when you need to view VAT returns, corporation tax payments, Companies House filings, and other tax-related events with their due dates and amounts.

tools.name: Update Bank Transaction Explanation
tools.description: Tool to update a bank transaction explanation in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify an existing explanation's details such as description, category, amounts, or tax information.

tools.name: Update Estimates Default Additional Text
tools.description: Tool to update the default additional text for estimates in FreeAgent. Use when you need to set or change the standard text that appears on all estimates.

tools.name: Convert Estimate to Invoice
tools.description: Tool to convert an estimate to an invoice in FreeAgent. Use when an estimate has been approved and needs to be converted into a billable invoice. The estimate's status will transition to 'Invoiced' and a new invoice will be created automatically.

tools.name: Update Expense
tools.description: Tool to update an existing expense in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify expense details such as description, amount, date, category, or tax information. Only the fields you provide will be updated; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Invoices Default Additional Text
tools.description: Tool to update the default additional text shown on all invoices. Use when you need to set or change the default invoice text that appears at the bottom of all invoices.

tools.name: Convert Invoice to Credit Note
tools.description: Tool to convert a draft negative invoice to a credit note in FreeAgent. Use when you need to transform a draft invoice with a negative value into a credit note. The invoice must be in draft status and have a negative value before conversion.

tools.name: Update a Journal Set
tools.description: Tool to update a journal set in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify journal entries, change description, date, or tag. Can add new entries, modify existing ones, or remove entries using _destroy flag.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Tool to update an existing note in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify the text content of a note attached to a contact or project.

tools.name: Update Price List Item
tools.description: Tool to update a price list item in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify existing price list item fields like description, price, code, quantity, or tax settings.

tools.name: Update Personal Profile
tools.description: Tool to update the authenticated user's personal profile in FreeAgent. Use when you need to modify user details such as name, email, role, or tax information.

tools.name: Upload a Bank Statement
tools.description: Tool to upload a bank statement to FreeAgent. Use when you need to import multiple bank transactions at once for a specific bank account.

name: Freshsales
description: Personalize engagement, shorten your sales cycle, and grow your business with Freshsales

tools.name: Add Marketing List Contacts
tools.description: Add contacts to a Freshsales marketing list. The same official operation also copies contacts that already belong to another list.

tools.name: Bulk Assign Contact Owner
tools.description: Replace the owner of up to 100 Freshsales contacts using explicit contact and owner IDs. Freshsales is known to return a false-success 200 for this endpoint, so this action reads every contact after the write and fails unless every owner_id matches.

tools.name: Bulk Assign CPQ Record Owners
tools.description: Queue one owner assignment for selected CPQ products or documents; acknowledgment does not prove completion. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled. Observed product bulk paths support OAuth; OAuth behavior for document and template paths remains unverified. https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Bulk Delete CPQ Records
tools.description: Queue soft deletion of selected CPQ products or documents so they remain restorable; acknowledgment does not prove completion. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled. Observed product bulk paths support OAuth; OAuth behavior for document and template paths remains unverified. https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Bulk Restore CPQ Records
tools.description: Queue restoration of selected soft-deleted CPQ products or documents using the PUT methods in Freshsales' official cURL examples; acknowledgment does not prove completion. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled. Observed product bulk paths support OAuth; OAuth behavior for document and template paths remains unverified. https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Bulk Update CPQ Records
tools.description: Queue one shared-field update for selected CPQ products or documents. Product pricing and document product-line mutations are not supported by these bulk endpoints; acknowledgment does not prove completion. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled. Observed product bulk paths support OAuth; OAuth behavior for document and template paths remains unverified. https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Clone Contact
tools.description: Create a new Freshsales contact by cloning an existing contact and applying field overrides.

tools.name: Clone Custom Module Record
tools.description: Create a new Freshsales custom-module record by cloning an existing record and applying field overrides.

tools.name: Clone Deal
tools.description: Clone a Freshsales deal, optionally overriding fields on the new deal.

tools.name: Clone Sales Account
tools.description: Clone a Freshsales sales account, optionally overriding fields on the new account.

tools.name: Create Appointment
tools.description: Create a Freshsales appointment, optionally linked to a CRM record or attendees, and return its ID and related records.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a Freshsales contact identified by email addresses, mobile number, Twitter username, or external ID and return its ID and contact fields. Tenant contact-field settings can impose additional requirements; inspect List Contact Fields first.

tools.name: Create CPQ Document
tools.description: Create a Freshsales quote or other CPQ document and return its confirmed ID. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Create a persistent custom field on one explicit Freshsales entity form. This mutates tenant schema, may make future record writes require the field, and cannot be undone through any documented custom-field delete endpoint. Requires confirm_irreversible_schema_change=true.

tools.name: Create Custom Module
tools.description: Create a tenant-wide Freshsales custom-module definition and return its ID and internal entity name. This changes the tenant's CRM schema, immediately creates five saved filters, and consumes one of the documented maximum of 10 custom modules per account.

tools.name: Create Custom Module Record
tools.description: Create one record in a named Freshsales custom module and return its record ID and fields.

tools.name: Create Deal
tools.description: Create a Freshsales deal associated with exactly one existing or new sales account.

tools.name: Create Document Link
tools.description: Attach a web document URL to one explicit Freshsales CRM record.

tools.name: Create Marketing List
tools.description: Create an empty Freshsales marketing list.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Create a Freshsales note on one lead, contact, sales account, or deal.

tools.name: Create CPQ Product
tools.description: Create a Freshsales CPQ product and return the provider-confirmed product ID. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. Product create, get, update, delete, and restore paths support OAuth. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Create Sales Account
tools.description: Create a Freshsales sales account with standard, parent-account, or tenant-defined fields.

tools.name: Create Sales Activity
tools.description: Create a Freshsales sales activity with all provider-mandatory time, owner, type, and CRM-target fields.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a Freshsales task with every provider-mandatory assignment, due-date, and CRM-target field.

tools.name: Delete Appointment
tools.description: Delete one Freshsales appointment by ID.

tools.name: Delete Contacts
tools.description: Delete one or more Freshsales contacts through ordinary deletion rather than permanent forget. Provide contact_id for one contact or contact_ids for a bulk request. This toolkit does not expose a restore operation.

tools.name: Delete CPQ Document
tools.description: Soft-delete one Freshsales CPQ document so it can be restored. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Delete Custom Module
tools.description: Delete a Freshsales custom-module definition and change the tenant's CRM schema. Remove all records from the custom module before calling this action.

tools.name: Delete Custom Module Records
tools.description: Delete one or more records from a named Freshsales custom module through ordinary deletion. Provide record_id for one record or record_ids for a bulk request. This action never permanently forgets records or their data.

tools.name: Delete Deals
tools.description: Ordinarily delete one deal or bulk-delete multiple deals. This operation is separate from permanent forget.

tools.name: Permanently Delete Note
tools.description: Permanently delete one Freshsales note. Freshsales documents no restore operation; the response contains provider-confirmed deletion fields.

tools.name: Delete CPQ Product
tools.description: Soft-delete one Freshsales CPQ product so it can be restored. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. Product create, get, update, delete, and restore paths support OAuth. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Delete Sales Accounts
tools.description: Ordinarily delete one account or bulk-delete multiple accounts. This is not permanent forget; associated contacts and deals are deleted only when explicitly requested.

tools.name: Delete Sales Activity
tools.description: Delete one Freshsales sales activity after confirming the provider success code.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Delete one Freshsales task and return provider-confirmed deletion fields.

tools.name: Permanently Forget Contact
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly erase one Freshsales contact and associated data. This is not ordinary deletion, cannot be undone by this toolkit, and requires confirm_permanent_erasure=true.

tools.name: Permanently Forget CPQ Document
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly delete one CPQ document and all associated data. This cannot be restored and requires confirm_permanent_erasure=true. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Permanently Forget Custom Module Record
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly erase one Freshsales custom-module record and associated data. This is not ordinary deletion, cannot be undone by this toolkit, and requires confirm_permanent_erasure=true.

tools.name: Permanently Forget Deal
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently erase one Freshsales deal and associated data. This cannot be restored and requires confirm_permanent_erasure=true.

tools.name: Permanently Forget Sales Account
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently erase one Freshsales sales account and associated data. This cannot be restored and requires confirm_permanent_erasure=true.

tools.name: Get Appointment
tools.description: Return one Freshsales appointment and its related attendees, users, conferences, and notes.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Return one Freshsales contact by ID, optionally including related resources.

tools.name: Get CPQ Document
tools.description: Get one Freshsales CPQ document, optionally including product line items. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Get Custom Module
tools.description: Return one Freshsales custom-module definition by ID, including the entity name required by custom-module record tools.

tools.name: Get Custom Module Record
tools.description: Return one record by ID from a named Freshsales custom module.

tools.name: Get Deal
tools.description: Get one Freshsales deal by ID, optionally with related resources.

tools.name: Get Bulk Upsert Job Status
tools.description: Get bounded, single-request progress and failure details for one Freshsales bulk-upsert job; this does not poll.

tools.name: Get CPQ Product
tools.description: Get one Freshsales CPQ product, optionally including pricing. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. Product create, get, update, delete, and restore paths support OAuth. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Get Sales Account
tools.description: Get one Freshsales sales account by ID, optionally with related resources.

tools.name: Get Sales Activity
tools.description: Get one Freshsales sales activity by ID.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Get one Freshsales task by ID, optionally with collaborators and its CRM target.

tools.name: List Appointments
tools.description: Return one page selected by Freshsales's required appointment filter. Open is documented for upcoming appointments; complete is a separate provider-named filter whose semantics are not further defined. Return the next page number only when Freshsales meta.total proves another page exists. Pages default to 25 appointments (maximum 100); larger pages increase response size and token cost.

tools.name: List Configuration Options
tools.description: List one Freshsales configuration option family for IDs needed by CRM operations. Covers all 21 official selectors without exposing arbitrary paths; each selector returns its complete provider-bounded option set and does not expose pagination.

tools.name: List Contact Activities
tools.description: Return activity history for one Freshsales contact. The limit input is a provider result-size hint, not a guaranteed maximum. Inspect meta.has_next and meta.has_previous to determine whether the response is incomplete; this action does not expose an unproven continuation input.

tools.name: List Contact Document Associations
tools.description: List the file and web-link associations attached to one Freshsales contact, including referenced links, users, and provider totals. This returns metadata only, not file bytes, and exposes no continuation because Freshsales documents none for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Contact Fields
tools.description: List Freshsales contact field definitions, internal names, types, choices, and tenant form metadata for use in contact create and update calls. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Contacts by View
tools.description: Return one explicitly numbered page from a saved Freshsales contact view, including shaped page totals and the next page number when available.

tools.name: List Contact Views
tools.description: List saved Freshsales contact views and their IDs for use with contact listing tools. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List CPQ Document Related Products
tools.description: List the typed product records associated with one Freshsales CPQ document. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: List Custom Module Records
tools.description: Return one saved-view page of records from a named Freshsales custom module and a page cursor when more records are available.

tools.name: List Custom Module Views
tools.description: List saved views for a Freshsales custom module and return the view IDs needed to list its records. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Deal Fields
tools.description: List standard and tenant-defined Freshsales deal field definitions. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Deals by View
tools.description: Return one numbered page from a saved Freshsales deal view.

tools.name: List Deal Views
tools.description: List saved Freshsales deal views and their IDs. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Entity Forms
tools.description: List Freshsales forms for a standard or custom entity so callers can obtain an explicit form ID before creating a custom field. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Marketing List Contacts
tools.description: Return one documented page of contacts in a Freshsales marketing list. Freshsales can reject this endpoint when the account plan lacks the feature.

tools.name: List Marketing Lists
tools.description: Return one documented page of Freshsales marketing lists.

tools.name: List Sales Account Fields
tools.description: List standard and tenant-defined Freshsales sales-account field definitions. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Sales Accounts by View
tools.description: Return one numbered page from a saved Freshsales sales-account view.

tools.name: List Sales Account Views
tools.description: List saved Freshsales sales-account views and their IDs. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Sales Activities
tools.description: Return one bounded Freshsales sales-activity page (25 records by default, 100 maximum) and an explicit next page number.

tools.name: List Sales Activity Fields
tools.description: List standard and tenant-defined Freshsales sales-activity field definitions. Freshsales documents no pagination or continuation parameter for this endpoint.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Return one Freshsales task page for exactly one documented status/due-date filter. Freshsales uses a fixed 25-record page size; pass next_page back as page to continue.

tools.name: Log Phone Call for Existing Record
tools.description: Create an irreversible manual call log for one existing Freshsales lead, contact, or sales account and optionally create a note. Freshsales documents no call-log delete operation; explicit confirmation is required.

tools.name: Log Phone Call for New Record
tools.description: Create a new Freshsales contact and an irreversible manual call log associated with it, optionally with a note. Contact-field requirements vary by tenant; provide emails when the tenant requires them, but email is not universally required. Neither effect has a documented call-log rollback; explicit confirmation is required.

tools.name: Lookup Records by Exact Field
tools.description: Look up exact matches across one or more Freshsales lead, contact, sales-account, or deal types using one compatible standard or custom field. Freshsales returns a provider-bounded result set and exposes no pagination parameters.

tools.name: Move Marketing List Contacts
tools.description: Move selected contacts or every contact from one Freshsales marketing list to a different destination list.

tools.name: Remove Marketing List Contacts
tools.description: Remove selected contacts or every contact from one Freshsales marketing list. This changes list membership, not the contact records.

tools.name: Restore CPQ Document
tools.description: Restore one soft-deleted Freshsales CPQ document. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Restore CPQ Product
tools.description: Restore one soft-deleted Freshsales CPQ product. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. Product create, get, update, delete, and restore paths support OAuth. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Search Contacts by Exact Filters
tools.description: Find exact-match Freshsales contacts with explicit field/operator/value rules.

tools.name: Search Records
tools.description: Fuzzy-search Freshsales users, standard CRM records, and custom-module records in one bounded request.

tools.name: Start Bulk Contact Upsert
tools.description: Start an asynchronous upsert of up to 100 Freshsales contacts. Returns only the provider's job acknowledgment and status URL; this tool does not wait for or verify completion.

tools.name: Start Bulk Deal Upsert
tools.description: Start an asynchronous upsert of up to 100 deals. Returns acceptance and a status URL but does not verify completion.

tools.name: Start Bulk Sales Account Upsert
tools.description: Start an asynchronous upsert of up to 100 sales accounts. Returns acceptance and a status URL but does not verify completion.

tools.name: Update Appointment
tools.description: Update selected fields or attendees on an existing Freshsales appointment and return the updated appointment and related records.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update selected fields on an existing Freshsales contact and return the updated contact.

tools.name: Update Contact Team Memberships
tools.description: Add, update, or remove Freshsales contact-team memberships using explicit contact, user, and designation IDs. Removing a membership changes that user's access to the contact; verify all tenant IDs before calling.

tools.name: Update CPQ Document
tools.description: Update document fields or replace its complete product list through the one official PUT contract. Freshworks documents quantity as optional, though some tenants require a positive quantity for every supplied line; products=[] removes all lines. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. OAuth behavior for CPQ document and template paths remains unverified. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#documents

tools.name: Update Custom Module
tools.description: Update selected display, icon, navigation, or description settings on an existing Freshsales custom-module definition. The internal entity name remains stable when display names change.

tools.name: Update Custom Module Record
