tools.description: Update selected fields on one record in a named Freshsales custom module and return the updated record.

tools.name: Update Deal
tools.description: Update a Freshsales deal, its contact associations, or replace all deal products. Supplying an empty products list removes every line item.

tools.name: Update Deal Team Memberships
tools.description: Add, update, or remove team memberships for one Freshsales deal.

tools.name: Update Marketing List
tools.description: Rename an existing Freshsales marketing list.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Replace the text and target association of an existing Freshsales note.

tools.name: Update CPQ Product
tools.description: Update product fields or add, overwrite, and delete product prices through the one official PUT contract. Requires Freshsales CPQ to be licensed and enabled for the connected account. Product create, get, update, delete, and restore paths support OAuth. Official contract: https://developer.freshsales.io/api/#products

tools.name: Update Sales Account
tools.description: Update standard or tenant-defined fields on a Freshsales sales account.

tools.name: Update Sales Account Team Memberships
tools.description: Add, update, or remove team memberships for one Freshsales sales account. Requires an API-key connection; Freshworks does not authorize this operation through its available OAuth scopes.

tools.name: Update Sales Activity
tools.description: Update selected fields on one existing Freshsales sales activity.

tools.name: Update or Mark Task Done
tools.description: Update a Freshsales task through the single documented PUT path; set status=1 to mark it completed or status=0 to reopen it.

tools.name: Upload and Attach Document
tools.description: Upload a required file as multipart/form-data and attach it to one explicit Freshsales CRM record.

tools.name: Upsert Contact
tools.description: Create or update one Freshsales contact matched by a unique identifier and return the resulting contact.

tools.name: Upsert Deal
tools.description: Create or update a deal by one unique standard or tenant-defined field.

tools.name: Upsert Sales Account
tools.description: Create or update a sales account by one unique standard or tenant-defined field.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Freshsales bundle alias, such as "acme" from acme.myfreshworks.com. You may also paste the complete myfreshworks.com CRM API URL.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Freshsales bundle alias, such as "acme" from acme.myfreshworks.com. You may also paste the complete myfreshworks.com CRM API URL.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Freshsales API key. Find it in Profile Settings > API Settings.

name: Freshservice
description: Freshservice is a cloud-based IT service management (ITSM) solution with incident management, asset management, and IT service automation capabilities

tools.name: Bulk Update Tickets
tools.description: Tool to bulk update multiple Freshservice tickets by sequential update calls. Use when you need to update fields across many tickets in absence of a native bulk API.

tools.name: Create Service Request
tools.description: Create a service request for a catalog item in Freshservice using the v2 API. The catalog item display_id can be found in Admin > Service Catalog by clicking on an item and checking the URL (e.g., /service_catalog/items/1 means display_id=1).

tools.name: Create Ticket
tools.description: Tool to create a new ticket. Use when you need to log an incident or service request.

tools.name: Delete Release
tools.description: Tool to delete a release from Freshservice. Use when you need to permanently remove a release from the system. This action is irreversible — the release cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Delete Solution Article
tools.description: Tool to delete a solution article from the knowledge base by its ID. This action is irreversible — the article cannot be recovered once deleted. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a solution article from Freshservice.

tools.name: Delete Solution Category
tools.description: Tool to delete a solution category in Freshservice. Use this action when you need to remove a solution category that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible — the category cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Get Problem Form Fields by Workspace
tools.description: Tool to list problem form fields. Use when you need to retrieve the form fields available for problems in a specific workspace.

tools.name: List Release Form Fields
tools.description: Tool to list release form fields metadata. Use when you need to fetch release field definitions before building or validating release forms.

tools.name: Get Freshservice Ticket
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific ticket by ID. Use when you need to get full details of a ticket including its status, priority, requester, and other attributes.

tools.name: List Freshservice Locations
tools.description: Tool to list all locations in Freshservice. Use when you need to retrieve paginated location data.

tools.name: List Service Catalog Items
tools.description: Tool to list all service catalog items in Freshservice. Use when you need to discover available catalog items and their display_ids before creating service requests.

tools.name: List Freshservice Tickets
tools.description: Tool to list all tickets in Freshservice with optional filtering and pagination. Use when you need to retrieve ticket IDs or search for tickets. By default only tickets created within the past 30 days are returned; use updated_since for older tickets.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Freshservice account subdomain, derived from your Freshservice account URL. For example, if your Freshservice account URL is 'https://your-company.freshservice.com', then the subdomain is 'your-company'.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Freshservice API Key. You can find this in your Profile Settings page, below the change password section.

name: FullEnrich
description: FullEnrich is a B2B email and phone waterfall enrichment platform that aggregates contact information from over 15 premium vendors to find the emails and phone numbers of leads.

tools.name: Create Contact Data List
tools.description: Tool to create a list of contact data entries. Use when preparing the 'datas' payload for bulk enrichment; validates each contact's composition and returns a JSON-ready list.

tools.name: Get current credit balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current workspace credit balance. Use after authenticating your API key.

tools.name: Get Bulk Enrichment Result
tools.description: Tool to retrieve results of a bulk enrichment by enrichment ID. Use after submitting a bulk enrichment job to check its status and get enriched data.

tools.name: Get Reverse Email Result
tools.description: Tool to retrieve results from a reverse email lookup operation using reverse email ID. Use after submitting a reverse email lookup to check its status and get contact data.

tools.name: Lookup Company
tools.description: Look up the best matching company. Provide at least one domain or professional network URL or ID. Returns at most one company.

tools.name: Lookup People
tools.description: Look up the best matching person. Provide a person professional network URL or ID, or a full name combined with at least one company identifier. Returns at most one person.

tools.name: Reverse Email Lookup
tools.description: Tool to perform bulk reverse email lookup to retrieve full person and company profile from work or personal email addresses. Use when you have email addresses and need to enrich them with complete contact information. Results are processed asynchronously; use the returned enrichment_id to retrieve actual data.

tools.name: Search Company
tools.description: Tool to search for companies based on filters including name, domain, industry, type, headquarters location, headcount, and founded year. Multiple filters within the same field are combined with OR logic. Use when you need to find companies matching specific criteria.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Tool to search for people based on filters including company, location, skills, position titles, and seniority levels. Multiple filters within the same field are combined with OR logic. Use when you need to find people matching specific professional criteria.

tools.name: Start Bulk Enrichment
tools.description: Tool to start a bulk enrichment job. Use when you have up to 100 contacts prepared and need batch enrichment. Use after confirming contact data.

tools.name: Verify API Key
tools.description: Tool to check if your API key is valid and return the associated workspace ID. Use when you need to verify API key validity before performing other operations.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your FullEnrich API key, obtainable from your API Dashboard.

name: FullStory
description: FullStory provides digital experience analytics APIs for managing users, events, sessions, exports, recording settings, privacy rules, and related organization data.

tools.name: Cancel Operation
tools.description: Irreversibly request cancellation of a cancelable in-progress FullStory operation, currently intended for segment exports. Confirm the operation before calling because a successful cancellation request cannot be undone.

tools.name: Create Annotation
tools.description: Add a persistent annotation to the FullStory timeline for a point or time range. Warning: FullStory provides no matching delete endpoint, so a successful call cannot be cleaned up through this API.

tools.name: Create Element Block
tools.description: Create a beta FullStory element recording or masking rule. Requires an Admin API key. Privacy-critical: an incorrect selector, UNMASK action, or live scope can expose sensitive data, while EXCLUDE or MASK can suppress useful recording. Review every field and prefer preview scope before calling.

tools.name: Create Extraction Rule
tools.description: Create and immediately activate one FullStory beta extraction rule using the provider's nested rule, source, and mapping contract. Extraction can capture sensitive element, URL, header, or body values and can materially increase collected data volume. Archiving later only stops future capture; it does not erase data already collected. Review selectors, network filters, mapping targets, property scope, and privacy policy before calling. The beta contract may change without notice. Requires an Architect or Admin API key.

tools.name: Delete Element Block
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom FullStory privacy element-block rule. This is irreversible: removing a block or mask can expose sensitive content in future recordings. Confirm the exact custom rule first; built-in rules cannot be deleted. This API is in beta and may change without notice.

tools.name: Delete User Data
tools.description: Permanently delete a FullStory user and their associated data by FullStory-generated ID. This is an irreversible privacy mutation; confirm the target before calling.

tools.name: Get FullStory Account
tools.description: Validate the connected API key and return its FullStory organization, identity, and API-key role. Do not use the role to infer paid product entitlements.

tools.name: Get Element Block
tools.description: Get one FullStory privacy element-block rule by ID, including its exact selector source, recording or masking operation, platforms, and editability. Warning: this exposes privacy-sensitive recording configuration. This API is in beta; functionality and documentation are subject to breaking change without notification.

tools.name: Get Extraction Rule
tools.description: Get one FullStory beta extraction rule by ID, including its archive state and complete nested source and mappings.

tools.name: Get Import Status
tools.description: Get status and success/error counts for an asynchronous FullStory event or user import job.

tools.name: Get Operation
tools.description: Get detailed status, progress, operation-specific results, and failure details for one asynchronous FullStory operation.

tools.name: Get Organization Quotas
tools.description: Return current FullStory session and server-event quota usage, limits, and quota periods.

tools.name: Get Recording Settings
tools.description: Get one current FullStory recording-settings category. Privacy settings may contain sensitive configuration and large built-in rule sets; the complete provider response is preserved.

tools.name: Get Segment
tools.description: Get metadata and the FullStory app URL for one segment.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Retrieve one user by FullStory-generated user ID, including profile fields and a FullStory app link.

tools.name: Import Events
tools.description: Start an asynchronous import of 1 to 50,000 server events. This permanently adds analytics data; use an idempotency key when retrying.

tools.name: Import Users
tools.description: Start an asynchronous upsert import of 1 to 50,000 users. This mutates personal profile data.

tools.name: List Datasets
tools.description: List beta datasets readable by the connected FullStory organization.

tools.name: List Element Blocks
tools.description: Return one page of custom and built-in FullStory privacy element-block rules. These rules determine what FullStory records or masks.

tools.name: List Extraction Rules
tools.description: List all FullStory beta extraction rules matching one required scope and optional filters, together with current active-rule usage and limits.

tools.name: List Import Records
tools.description: Return one page of successful or failed records from a FullStory event or user import job, including failure details when requested.

tools.name: List Operations
tools.description: Return one page of asynchronous FullStory operations, optionally filtered by state or type.

tools.name: List Recording Settings History
tools.description: Return one page of historical FullStory recording settings for blocking, domain, geo, privacy, features, or targeting. Privacy history requires an Architect-level API key; the other categories require Standard or higher.

tools.name: List Segments
tools.description: Return one page of FullStory segments, optionally filtered by creator.

tools.name: List Sessions
tools.description: Find recent FullStory session replay links by application UID, email, or exact session UID. Provide at least one selector; session_uid cannot be combined with uid or email. This is a filtered single-page lookup, not an unfiltered or paginated list; a no-match 404 returns an empty sessions list.

tools.name: Search Users
tools.description: Find FullStory users by UID, email, display name, or identification state. Provide at least one of uid, email, display_name, or is_identified. A no-match 404 is returned as an empty result page.

tools.name: Set Extraction Rule Archived
tools.description: Archive a FullStory beta extraction rule to stop future capture, or unarchive it to resume capture. Warning: this changes collection behavior immediately. Archiving does not erase data already collected, and data not captured while the rule is archived cannot be recovered by unarchiving. Confirm the rule ID and intended state before calling. Requires an Architect or Admin API key.

tools.name: Update Element Block
tools.description: Fully replace an editable beta FullStory element recording or masking rule. Requires an Admin API key. This is an irreversible privacy configuration update, not a patch: read the existing rule first and provide every required replacement field. An incorrect selector, UNMASK action, or live scope can expose sensitive data, while EXCLUDE or MASK can suppress desired recording.

tools.name: Update Extraction Rule
tools.description: Partially update a FullStory beta extraction rule using last-write-wins semantics. Provide at least one of name, description, source, or mappings. Omitted fields remain unchanged; read the current rule first. Warning: changing a rule's source or mappings changes what FullStory captures and may affect privacy, downstream analytics, and data volume.

tools.name: Upsert User
tools.description: Create or update one FullStory user. Supplying fullstory_user_id updates that record; otherwise uid identifies an upsert. This mutates personal profile data.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create an Admin-level API key in Fullstory under Settings > Integrations > API Keys, then enter the token shown at creation time. Fullstory displays the token only once. This key grants the full Standard, Architect, and Admin server API hierarchy, including privacy element block rule administration.

name: FuseAI
description: FuseAI is an AI-powered sales platform for prospecting, enrichment, campaigns, signal agents, research, and revenue analytics.

tools.name: Activate Agent
tools.description: Activate a draft FuseAI signal agent and begin monitoring. WARNING: this irreversible operation creates the results list, starts provider work, and deducts workspace credits; a paused or previously started agent cannot be resumed with this endpoint.

tools.name: Add List Members
tools.description: Add up to 5,000 existing contacts to a Fuse prospect list by contact ID. Contacts already in the list are skipped, making repeated calls idempotent.

tools.name: Approve Campaign
tools.description: Approve a draft or stopped FuseAI campaign and start its sending scheduler. WARNING: this may immediately begin externally visible email or LinkedIn outreach; messages already sent cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Approve Scheduled Sends
tools.description: Approve selected FuseAI queued sends that are waiting for review. WARNING: each approved row becomes scheduled and its externally visible message may be sent at the scheduled time; sent messages cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Autocomplete Agent Field
tools.description: Resolve free text to canonical region, industry, title, or school values accepted by Fuse agent configuration filters.

tools.name: Autocomplete Company Search Field
tools.description: Suggest canonical company names, domains, investor domains, or fully qualified headquarters city values for Fuse company-search filters.

tools.name: Autocomplete Prospect Search Field
tools.description: Suggest canonical values for a free-text prospect-search field without consuming search credits. Region suggestions also identify their countries.

tools.name: Cancel Research Run
tools.description: WARNING: Request asynchronous cancellation of an in-flight FuseAI research run, then poll Get Research Run until it reports cancelled. Provider actions already completed are not refunded; only reserved credits are released. Completed, failed, or already-cancelled runs cannot be cancelled.

tools.name: Commit Import
tools.description: Commit a parsed spreadsheet import into an existing contact list or a destination list created or reused by name. Provide exactly one of list_id or list_name. This creates persistent contacts asynchronously; optional enrichment consumes non-refundable credits.

tools.name: Copy Prospect List Rows
tools.description: Copy up to 10,000 filtered rows from one contact list into an existing or create-or-reused destination contact list. Provide exactly one of list_id or list_name. The operation starts asynchronously; poll the returned destination list until completionStatus is complete.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create a FuseAI draft campaign from one or more prospect lists. This call does not send messages; approval is a separate operation.

tools.name: Create Campaign Step
tools.description: Add one email, LinkedIn, InMail, dialer, or task step at an unused position in a FuseAI campaign sequence. This creates the draft step but does not approve or activate the campaign.

tools.name: Create Campaign Template
tools.description: Save an owned FuseAI campaign's current steps and schedule settings as a reusable template. Later campaign edits do not update this snapshot.

tools.name: Create Companies Watcher Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that watches companies from one or more existing lists for job postings, LinkedIn posts, press mentions, or funding milestones. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Company Department Headcount Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies whose selected department has a specified employee count. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Company Headcount Growth Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies within a specified year-over-year headcount growth range. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create First Department Hire Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies making their first hire in a specified department. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create First International Hire Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies making their first hire outside their home country. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Folder
tools.description: Create a folder for contact lists, company lists, campaigns, or agents. Folder names must be unique within the selected kind.

tools.name: Create Funding Announcements Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that monitors funding announcements by round type and company filters. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Headcount Growth Over Baseline Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies whose headcount grew by a specified percentage over a historical baseline. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Job Changes Watcher Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that watches people in one or more existing lists for company or title changes. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Job Keyword Match Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies posting jobs matching title or description terms in one region. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Hub
tools.description: Create a FuseAI knowledge hub from one or more websites and optional text notes. The asynchronous crawl starts immediately; use the returned hub ID to check whether processing completes.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Hub Page
tools.description: Add a user-authored Markdown page to a completed FuseAI knowledge hub. FuseAI indexes the page before returning, and later hub rebuilds preserve it.

tools.name: Create Large Import Upload Target
tools.description: Create a short-lived external PUT target for a CSV, XLS, or XLSX import file over 10 MiB and up to 50 MiB. This action only returns upload instructions: it does not upload bytes, parse the file, preview it, or commit contacts. After the caller performs the external PUT, use Preview Import with import_id.

tools.name: Create LinkedIn Post Engagement Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that collects people who liked or commented on up to 50 specific LinkedIn posts. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin scraping.

tools.name: Create LinkedIn Profile Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that collects reactors or commenters from recent posts by up to 50 LinkedIn profiles. The draft can configure a one-time scrape or, with enable_recurring, recurring scrapes that optionally stop at recurring_expires_at. Creation is unbilled and does not start scraping; use Activate Agent to start the configured operation.

tools.name: Create LinkedIn Topic Discovery Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds authors, and optionally reactors, of LinkedIn posts matching specified topics and filters. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create List Column
tools.description: Create a plain custom column on a Fuse prospect list. Use the returned column ID to write cell values; use a smart column instead for AI-computed values.

tools.name: Create People Watcher Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that watches people from one or more existing contact lists for LinkedIn profile or post updates. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Person Discovery Via Filters Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that discovers people matching explicit filters. At least one filter must be non-empty. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin discovery.

tools.name: Create Person Starting New Job Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that watches one industry for people starting new jobs. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Prospect List
tools.description: Create an empty contact or company prospect list owned by the connected FuseAI user. The name must be unique within the workspace.

tools.name: Create Regional Job Discovery Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that finds companies posting jobs in one region, optionally filtered by industry, company size, and headquarters country. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Saved Search
tools.description: Store a reusable people or company search under a display name. The returned filters can be sent to the matching search operation, and the selected search type is immutable.

tools.name: Create Smart Column
tools.description: Create an AI-powered column on a FuseAI prospect list and start its first asynchronous, credit-consuming research run over the selected rows.

tools.name: Create Two Country Workforce Agent
tools.description: Create an unbilled draft of FuseAI's provider-defined signal agent for companies with an employee distribution across two countries. FuseAI does not specify or let the caller choose the country pair; regions filters the company's headquarters, not employee locations. Use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Create Web Monitor Agent
tools.description: Create a FuseAI agent that repeatedly searches the web for matching people or companies. This saves an unbilled draft; use Activate Agent to begin monitoring.

tools.name: Decline Scheduled Sends
tools.description: Permanently stop selected queued FuseAI sends. Eligible sends move from approval_required or scheduled to stopped, and each affected contact's remaining campaign sequence is halted rather than advanced.

tools.name: Delete Agent
tools.description: Permanently delete a FuseAI agent and tear down its provider subscriptions. The agent's results list and previously delivered rows are retained.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Stop and delete a campaign. Sending halts immediately and the campaign disappears from campaign reads, while delivered sends and contact state remain.

tools.name: Delete Campaign Step
tools.description: Permanently remove one sequence step from a FuseAI campaign. Remaining steps are renumbered, but queued sends already created for the removed step are not deleted.

tools.name: Delete Campaign Template
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved FuseAI campaign template. Campaigns already created from the template are unaffected because they keep independent copies of its steps.

tools.name: Delete Folder
tools.description: Permanently delete a folder without deleting the lists, campaigns, or agents it contained. The contained resources move back to the root.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Hub
tools.description: Soft-delete a FuseAI knowledge hub so it no longer appears in reads or grounds campaigns. The default hub cannot be deleted; make another hub the default first.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Hub Attachment
tools.description: Delete a document attached to a FuseAI knowledge-hub note. This removes the entire note, including its text, not only the document. To preserve the text, save it first and re-add the note after deleting the attachment.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Hub Page
tools.description: Permanently remove a page from a FuseAI knowledge hub and its knowledge store. Generated pages can reappear after a hub update or refresh if their sources still exist; user-authored pages cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete Learned Fact
tools.description: Retire a learned fact so it stops contributing to the team's knowledge hubs after the next daily learning run. The fact's audit trail is retained.

tools.name: Delete List Column
tools.description: Permanently delete a custom or smart column from a prospect list, including all values stored in that column.

tools.name: Delete Prospect List
tools.description: Delete a prospect list and its custom columns. Contacts remain in the workspace and in every other list they belong to.

tools.name: Delete Saved Search
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved people or company search. Lists, campaigns, and contacts created from the search are unaffected.

tools.name: Derive Company List
tools.description: Create a company list from the companies represented by a contact list. The operation starts asynchronously; poll the returned list ID until its completionStatus is complete.

tools.name: Duplicate Agent
tools.description: Copy an owned FuseAI agent of any status into a new, unbilled draft. Inspect isReconstructed and lossyFields before activating a copy of an older agent.

tools.name: Duplicate Campaign
tools.description: Copy an owned FuseAI campaign into a fresh draft with the same sequence steps, schedule settings, and source lists. The copy has no enrolled contacts, analytics, or queued sends and sends nothing until approved.

tools.name: Enrich List
tools.description: Start an asynchronous, credit-consuming enrichment of a Fuse contact list. Discover emails or phones, revalidate existing emails, or resolve uploaded contact demographics; poll the list rows or metrics for completion.

tools.name: Export Campaign Leads
tools.description: Export every enrolled lead in an owned FuseAI campaign as an inline CSV document. This operation does not support filtering or pagination.

tools.name: Export List
tools.description: Start an asynchronous CSV export of an entire FuseAI prospect list. Returns a job ID for polling; this operation does not consume credits.

tools.name: Generate Campaign Step Preview
tools.description: Render one campaign step for a sample contact, resolving variables and spintax without saving content or sending a message. Previewing an AI-authored step can invoke FuseAI generation and consume provider compute or resources even though this action does not mutate campaign state.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Return one signal agent's stored configuration, lifecycle status, and source-list metadata. This does not return results delivered by the agent.

tools.name: Get Agent Analytics
tools.description: Return team signal-agent performance for a rolling 7-, 30-, or 90-day window, including totals, type and status breakdowns, and prospects over time.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Return one campaign's lifecycle and initialization state. Use this to poll an AI-generated campaign until initialization completes before adding steps or approving it.

tools.name: Get Campaign Analytics
tools.description: Return account-wide email and LinkedIn campaign totals and time series over a rolling 7-, 30-, or 90-day window, plus top LinkedIn campaigns. Use the campaign stats action instead for one campaign's detailed metrics.

tools.name: Get Campaign Stats
tools.description: Return one campaign's email send, open, click, and reply totals, plus percentage changes for the current UTC calendar month versus the previous month.

tools.name: Get Company Filter Options
tools.description: Return the complete accepted vocabularies for enum-backed company-search filters, including industries, tags, NAICS codes, countries, and accelerators.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected user's available credit balance for checking whether billable Fuse operations can run.

tools.name: Get Credit Usage
tools.description: Return the workspace credit-spend ledger for a date range and optional team members. This action reads data even though Fuse exposes it through POST.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Return the connected user's ID, email address, and display name. This can also verify that the connected Fuse API key is valid.

tools.name: Get Dialer Analytics
tools.description: Return campaign and team power-dialer call totals and time series for a rolling 7-, 30-, or 90-day window.

tools.name: Get Enrichment Analytics
tools.description: Return enrichment totals and zero-filled time series for enriched emails, enriched phones, saved contacts, and searched prospects over a rolling window.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Poll a Fuse asynchronous job, including a list export job returned by EXPORT_LIST, and return its status, operation type, row count, failure reason, or short-lived download URL.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Hub
tools.description: Return one knowledge hub's full detail, including websites, notes, build status, and default status. Poll this action while the hub is processing.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Hub Attachment
tools.description: Return a knowledge-hub note attachment's filename, MIME type, byte size, and presigned download URL. The URL remains valid for one hour.

tools.name: Get Prospect Filter Options
tools.description: Return the complete accepted prospect-search vocabulary, each field's required value shape, and the role-to-sub-role mapping. Use each vocabulary entry's value, not its label, when constructing a prospect search.

tools.name: Get Prospect List
tools.description: Return one prospect list's metadata, processing status, row count, enrichment metrics, and optionally its column definitions.

tools.name: Get Prospect List Filter Values
tools.description: Return the distinct company names or web domains stored in a prospect list for use in row filters and exclusion sets.

tools.name: Get Research Run
tools.description: Return one research run's current state, credit usage, markdown report, and resulting prospect list. Poll until status is completed, failed, or cancelled.

tools.name: Get Saved Search
tools.description: Return one saved people or company search by ID, including filters that can be sent to the matching search operation.

tools.name: Get Smart Column
tools.description: Return a smart column's definition, provider restriction, rerun cost, and current run state.

tools.name: Get Smart Column Cell Provenance
tools.description: Return the reasoning, research steps, source URLs, and computation metadata behind one smart-column cell.

tools.name: Get Smart Column Job Status
tools.description: Poll a smart-column run and return its progress, terminal state, row counts, credit usage, and lifecycle timestamps.

tools.name: Get Website Intent Analytics
tools.description: Return website intent metrics, a zero-filled visitor time series, and the top visiting companies and identified people over a rolling 7-, 30-, or 90-day window. Website tracking must already be configured.

tools.name: Get Website Tracking
tools.description: Return the account's website-tracking configuration, including tracked domains and pages, the installation script, and monthly credit usage.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: Return one page of the connected user's agents across every kind, including their lifecycle state, results-list references, and delivered-result counts.

tools.name: List Agent Types
tools.description: Return all available agent types across signal, watcher, and scrape categories, with their creation slugs and display names.

tools.name: List Campaign Leads
tools.description: Return one page of a campaign's enrolled leads with sequence progress, engagement state, recorded outcomes, and first-contact details.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Return one page of the connected user's campaigns with headline delivery and engagement analytics, optionally filtered by name, type, status, or folder.

tools.name: List Campaign Steps
tools.description: Return a campaign's ordered sequence steps, including each step's channel, content mode, delay, manual subject and body, and AI topic and title configuration. Subject and body may be null for AI-written steps; use GENERATE_CAMPAIGN_STEP_PREVIEW to render AI copy. Use the returned step IDs when updating or previewing campaign-step content.

tools.name: List Campaign Templates
tools.description: Return up to the 100 most recent campaign templates visible to the workspace, including saved schedules and full step sequences. Use a returned template ID as templateId when creating a campaign. Fuse provides no way to request later pages; inspect pagination.total to detect omitted older templates.

tools.name: List Campaign Variables
tools.description: List the custom and smart-column personalization variables available to a campaign. Paste a returned token verbatim into a campaign step's subject or body; built-in tokens are always available and are not returned.

tools.name: List Contact Activities
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of a contact's email, LinkedIn, call, CRM, and scheduled campaign activity timeline.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: Return every folder of one requested kind owned by the connected user. Use contactList or companyList for prospect-list folders, campaign for campaign folders, or agent for agent folders.

tools.name: List Integrations
tools.description: Return the CRM integrations connected by the team. Use this before pushing a prospect list to a CRM to confirm that the target provider is connected.

tools.name: List Knowledge Hub Pages
tools.description: Return the knowledge pages used to ground campaign generation for a knowledge hub, including each page's full Markdown content and origin.

tools.name: List Knowledge Hubs
tools.description: Return all knowledge hubs owned by the connected user, including each hub's build status and whether it is the default for AI campaign grounding.

tools.name: List Learned Facts
tools.description: Return active anonymized facts learned from the team's emails, LinkedIn messages, calls, and meeting transcripts. Results cover every teammate and knowledge hub and are sorted by category, then newest first.

tools.name: List List Columns
tools.description: Return a prospect list's custom and smart column definitions. Column IDs identify entries in row column-values and are required by column update and delete operations.

tools.name: List Prospect List Rows
tools.description: Return one page of contacts or companies from a prospect list, including resource IDs, enrichment fields, list memberships, and custom column values.

tools.name: List Prospect Lists
tools.description: Return one page of the connected user's prospect lists, optionally filtered by list kind, folder, or a case-insensitive name substring. System-generated lists are excluded.

tools.name: List Research Providers
tools.description: Return the Deep Research providers available to the connected user, with their capabilities, credential readiness, and run availability.

tools.name: List Research Run Events
tools.description: Return one page of a research run's durable progress log in ascending event sequence order, including its current lifecycle status.

tools.name: List Research Runs
tools.description: List up to 50 research runs that are currently in flight for the connected account, newest first. Finished runs are not returned.

tools.name: List Saved Searches
tools.description: Return the connected user's saved people and company searches. Each result includes filters that can be sent back to the matching search endpoint.

tools.name: List Scheduled Sends
tools.description: Return one page from a campaign's send queue for a required status, optionally restricted to one delivery channel.

tools.name: List Sending Accounts
tools.description: List connected email mailboxes or LinkedIn seats available for campaign sending, including connection status and channel-specific account details.

tools.name: List Team Members
tools.description: Return up to 100 active members of the connected user's team, including their Fuse user IDs, email addresses, and display names.

tools.name: List Website Visitors
tools.description: Return one page of the connected team's all-time deanonymized website visitor feed, grouped by identified people or visiting companies.

tools.name: List Writing Styles
tools.description: Return the account's writing styles accepted by AI campaigns. Use a returned ID as writingStyleId when creating an AI campaign.

tools.name: Pause Agent
tools.description: WARNING: Permanently pause a running or expired FuseAI agent. Provider subscriptions and recurring schedules stop, no further results are delivered or billed, and already-delivered rows remain. This cannot be undone: Fuse provides no resume operation and activation accepts drafts only; duplicate and activate a copy to restore equivalent monitoring.

tools.name: Preview Import
tools.description: Parse and preview a CSV, XLS, or XLSX import without writing contacts to a destination list. Provide exactly one direct file up to 10 MiB or the import ID of a completed large-file external upload. Review the detected headers, sample rows, and suggested mapping, then use Commit Import explicitly to create persistent contacts.

tools.name: Push List To CRM
tools.description: Start an asynchronous push to a connected CRM. Fuse exposes no job or status endpoint for this work, so the action cannot poll for completion. Omitting contact_ids pushes every contact in the list without overwriting existing CRM records; providing contact_ids pushes exactly those IDs without intersecting them with the list and may overwrite fields on existing CRM records. This action provides no rollback for changes already made in the CRM.

tools.name: Refresh Knowledge Hub Website
tools.description: Start an external re-crawl of one website already attached to a FuseAI knowledge hub and regenerate the knowledge pages derived from that website. This mutates the hub asynchronously and immediately changes its status to processing. The crawl does not revisit previously discovered subpages or regenerate their existing text; if subpage discovery is enabled, it can add newly discovered subpages. Refresh an existing subpage by passing that subpage's own URL, then poll the hub until its status is complete.

tools.name: Regenerate Campaign Step Topics
tools.description: Rebuild the topic plan and titles across all AI-generated steps in a FuseAI campaign so the sequence follows one narrative. Manual steps and already queued sends are not changed. This action mutates existing campaign content.

tools.name: Regenerate Knowledge Hub Page
tools.description: Regenerate a generated FuseAI knowledge-hub page from its cached website and note sources, discarding manual edits, re-indexing the new content, and resetting its origin to generated. FuseAI completes regeneration before responding: the returned content is final and there is no background job to poll. User-authored pages and pages whose sources were removed cannot be regenerated.

tools.name: Remove List Members
tools.description: Remove up to 5,000 contacts from a prospect list by contact ID. The operation is idempotent: IDs that are not members are ignored, and contacts remain in the workspace and in every other list.

tools.name: Rename Folder
tools.description: Rename a contact-list, company-list, campaign, or agent folder. Campaign and agent folders require their folder kind to route the request correctly.

tools.name: Rerun Smart Column
tools.description: Start an asynchronous rerun of a smart column for all covered rows or only rows that have not been computed. Both modes cancel any active run before starting a replacement, and each row computed by the replacement consumes credits.

tools.name: Resolve Contact By LinkedIn URL
tools.description: Resolve an existing workspace contact ID from a LinkedIn profile URL. This read-only action does not create or modify a contact.

tools.name: Save Company Search To List
tools.description: Run a company search and asynchronously save up to 10,000 matches into a created, reused, or existing company list. The job consumes two credits per company saved and may be partially billed if it stops early.

tools.name: Save Prospect Search To List
tools.description: Run a people search and asynchronously save up to 10,000 matches into a created, reused, or existing contact list. This runs a new metered search and can optionally spend additional per-row credits on email or phone enrichment, then attach the list to a campaign. An attachment failure does not roll back the already-started save job.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Return one metered page of companies matching literal filters, a saved company search, or a natural-language query. Continuation cursors retain the complete original request body context.

tools.name: Search Prospects
tools.description: Return one metered page of people matching literal filters, a saved people search, or a natural-language query. Continuation cursors retain the exact original body filters and search inputs.

tools.name: Set Default Knowledge Hub
tools.description: Make one of the connected FuseAI user's knowledge hubs the default used when a campaign does not specify a knowledge hub.

tools.name: Skip Scheduled Send
tools.description: WARNING: Irreversibly skip one queued campaign send. This cannot be undone and advances the contact's sequence to its next step; the next step's wait is measured from the skipped send's scheduled time. Use Decline Scheduled Send instead when the contact's sequence should stop.

tools.name: Start Research Run
tools.description: Start an autonomous FuseAI Deep Research run and return immediately with its ID. WARNING: this starts external provider work and consumes FuseAI credits per provider action, up to the selected effort cap. Supply an idempotency_key and reuse it for identical retries to avoid duplicate work and charges.

tools.name: Stop Campaign
tools.description: Stop an owned FuseAI campaign. Sending halts immediately and open task mirrors are cleared, but per-contact state is preserved so Approve Campaign can resume the same campaign later. A draft campaign may also be parked in the stopped state.

tools.name: Update Agent
tools.description: Update one or more type-specific config fields on a FuseAI draft agent. Only agents in initializing status are editable; duplicate an active, paused, expired, failed, or completed agent before changing it. The patch does not activate the agent or consume credits.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Update one or more settings on a FuseAI campaign, including its schedule, source and exclusion lists, enrollment rules, tracking, delegates, and call-to-action link. Only explicitly supplied settings are changed.

tools.name: Update Campaign Step
tools.description: Update the content, AI topic, or delay of one FuseAI campaign sequence step. For manual-step content, subject and body must be updated together.

tools.name: Update Column Values
tools.description: Write up to 500 values into one custom column on a Fuse prospect list, keyed by contact row ID. Values must match the column's configured type.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Promote an existing email address, phone number, or both to be a contact's primary values. The values must already belong to the contact.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Hub
tools.description: Rename a FuseAI knowledge hub or merge websites and notes into it. The asynchronous rebuild starts immediately; poll the hub until its status is complete to read the merged content. This operation never removes sources.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Hub Page
tools.description: Replace the title, Markdown content, or both for a page in a completed FuseAI knowledge hub. FuseAI re-indexes the page before returning.

tools.name: Update Learned Fact
tools.description: Correct the claim text or category of an active FuseAI learned fact. Claim changes must remain anonymized and appear in knowledge-hub pages after the next daily learning run.

tools.name: Update Prospect List
tools.description: Rename a Fuse prospect list or move it into an existing or newly named folder. Only explicitly supplied fields are changed.

tools.name: Update Saved Search
tools.description: Rename a saved people or company search, replace all of its filters, or do both. The search type cannot be changed, and filter replacement is not a merge.

tools.name: Update Scheduled Send
tools.description: Replace the copy or send time of a queued FuseAI campaign send before it goes out. Fuse creates a new queued row, so use the returned new ID for any later edit.

tools.name: Update Smart Column
tools.description: Rename a FuseAI smart column, change its research prompt, or change a Deep Research provider restriction. Prompt changes may consume credits by starting an immediate recomputation.

tools.name: Update Website Tracking
tools.description: Replace FuseAI's tracked domains and page labels, change the monthly visitor deanonymization credit cap, or do both. Provide at least one of domains, tracked_pages, or monthly_credit_limit; tracked_pages requires domains in the same request. Domain and page arrays are full replacements; read the current configuration first to preserve existing values.

tools.name: Upload Knowledge Hub Attachment
tools.description: Attach a document to one note in a completed FuseAI knowledge hub. Only the current hub owner can upload an attachment. The file is stored for download but is not indexed as knowledge; add learnable content to the note text. Each note accepts only one attachment, and an ambiguous failure should be checked before retrying to avoid a duplicate conflict.

tools.name: Upload List Contacts
tools.description: Create up to 500 raw contacts and add them to a contact prospect list without enrichment or deduplication. Retrying the same request creates duplicate rows.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create an API key in the Fuse app under Settings > API Cockpit, then copy the complete af_ key when it is shown. Fuse displays the full key only once, at creation.

name: FuseAI MCP
description: FuseAI MCP lets authorized agents search prospects, manage lists and campaigns, work with email and LinkedIn inboxes, monitor signals, inspect analytics and website intent, manage integrations and settings, and run external or deep research.

tools.name: Agents
tools.description: The Agents / Signals feature: create, list, activate, and pause signal monitors — recurring lead/intent watchers (e.g. companies hiring SDRs, funding announcements, people engaging with a LinkedIn post, job postings). Hand off the user's full request here for anything about signal monitors or 'agents'.

tools.name: Analytics
tools.description: Read-only performance dashboards & metrics: campaign metrics and trends (email / LinkedIn / dialer, with up-or-down deltas), dialer call analytics, prospecting/enrichment volumes, and team performance. Use for 'how is X performing / trending / up or down' questions. NOT the raw call log (that is power_dialer), and NOT for building or editing campaigns (that is campaigns).

tools.name: Ask fuse brain
tools.description: Ask the Fuse Brain — living relationship files for ENGAGED contacts/companies, built from the team's real emails, LinkedIn messages, calls and meetings. Best tool for questions about existing relationships: history, needs, objections, commitments, deal state ('what does Dana care about?', 'which contacts mentioned budget?', 'where did the Acme deal stall?', 'who is waiting on us?'). Answers cite the contacts/companies used. Not for cold prospects: no file exists until a contact engages.

tools.name: Automations
tools.description: Create and manage AUTOMATIONS — scheduled or event-triggered multi-step rules (website/news monitors with Slack digests, follow-up drafts, auto-enrolment into campaigns, CRM saves, AI steps, and rules that listen to or act in the user's connected apps: Google Calendar, Google Sheets, Notion, Typeform, Zendesk, Airtable, Asana, Linear, ...). Route here for anything recurring — 'daily', 'every time', 'whenever', 'monitor' — or any if-this-then-that request ('automate X when Y', 'when a Typeform response arrives...', 'before each calendar meeting...'), for connecting an app an automation needs, for 'I connected <app>, continue', and for inspecting, editing, pausing, resuming, deleting, or asking about the runs of an existing automation / rule. Pass the user's full request (verbatim) as `request`.

tools.name: Campaigns
tools.description: Outreach campaigns and their email/LinkedIn/dialer SEQUENCES, end to end: list/create/update/duplicate/delete campaigns; build, generate, edit, reorder, test and preview sequence steps; ATTACH LISTS to a campaign (this is how you set up reaching a list of people, including system lists like All Website Visitors — attaching to an ALREADY-ACTIVE campaign enrolls its contacts in the background, while a draft campaign enrolls at launch); manage leads (pause/resume, activity); templates; and per-campaign performance metrics + trends. NEW campaigns built here stay DRAFTS until the user asks to launch; an existing active campaign keeps running. (For cross-feature dashboards — dialer/prospecting/team analytics — use analytics instead.)

tools.name: Deep research start
tools.description: Starts an asynchronous Fuse Deep Research run: over several minutes it researches the request across the web in the background and produces a markdown report, plus — when the request is to find people or companies — a new Fuse prospect list. Runs bill credits. ONLY call this when the user EXPLICITLY asks for "deep research", or confirms they want Deep Research after you offered it. For a general research/find-X request that does not say deep, do NOT call this — use the quick `research` tool, or ask the user whether they want quick research (immediate answer) or Deep Research (background, 5-20 minutes, report + prospect list) and wait for their choice. Returns immediately with a runId; it can NEVER wait for or preview results in the same call. After starting, call deep_research_status with the runId to check progress (suggest the user checks back in a few minutes). Pass the user's full request as `query`, an optional short `listName` when a list is expected, and `effort` if specified.

tools.name: Deep research status
tools.description: Checks a Fuse Deep Research run started with deep_research_start. Returns the run status (queued/planning/running/generating_csv/uploading/completed/failed/cancelled) and, once completed, the full markdown research report plus the id of any produced prospect list. Use it whenever the user asks whether their research is done or wants the results.

tools.name: Inbox
tools.description: Use for anything in the user's inbox / messaging: reading, sending, flagging (read/archive/spam/delete), and tagging emails; AI-drafting email or LinkedIn replies; approving/declining/skipping pending auto-replies; and LinkedIn messaging (chats, messages, connections, invitations). Pass a clear, self-contained natural-language request.

tools.name: Integrations
tools.description: CRM & integrations: connection status, CRM Fields/sync settings, owner mapping, pulling/pushing contacts & companies to the connected CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce/Zoho/Pipedrive/Attio), custom contact properties, and Slack notifications. Pass the full task as `request`.

tools.name: Power dialer
tools.description: Power Dialer — call history (READ-ONLY). Use for questions about the user's recent calls / call history. Cannot place or manage live calls.

tools.name: Prospect lists
tools.description: Manage the user's prospect lists: list lists (including the system/auto lists — All Website Visitors, All Saved Contacts, All <CRM> Leads, All Enriched Contacts), view/search a list's rows, create/append/clean lists, smart columns, and resolve a list's real id. This is where you FIND the listId of a cohort (e.g. the people who visited the website) so a campaign can target it. NOT for finding brand-new prospects on the internet or the prospect database (that is prospect_search).

tools.name: Prospect search
tools.description: Find people and companies, generate prospect/company search filters from a natural-language description, enrich contacts, and save prospects to lists. Use for anything in the Prospect Search area.

tools.name: Research
tools.description: EXTERNAL / internet research and web tasks: search & scrape the web (Firecrawl), Google Maps & Google Jobs lookups, building a prospect list from the web (EXA websets), internal knowledge-hub semantic search, and FuseAI how-to / navigation help. NOT for searching FuseAI's own prospect database — that's prospect_search. Examples: 'find recent funding news about Acme Corp', 'build me a list of AI infra startups in SF from the internet'.

tools.name: Settings
tools.description: Account & workspace settings: company profile (name/website), enrichment preferences, team members & invitations, Knowledge Hub profiles, writing styles, ICPs (Ideal Customer Profiles), campaign visibility, a thin lifecycle view of existing Rules Engine automations (list/pause/resume/delete only — it does NOT create or edit automations), Deep Research provider keys (BYOK), and MANAGING the connected sending accounts — email accounts (settings/sharing/disconnect/SMTP connect/warmup start-pause), LinkedIn accounts, dialer phone numbers, and purchased sending domains & mailboxes. Also the door for API keys and billing/subscription questions (it can READ the current credit balance; everything else billing it explains is app-only). NOT for CRM connection/sync/owner-mapping. Pass the full settings task as `request`.

tools.name: Smart actions
tools.description: The Smart Actions feed — the home list of suggested next actions per contact, aggregated from website visits, signal-monitor matches, campaign replies, and ICP matches. Use it to answer 'what should I do next', to act on website-visitor or signal items one contact at a time (inspect -> enrich -> send), and to triage/execute the feed. Examples: 'what should I do next?', 'send the top suggested action', 'work through my website-visitor actions'.

tools.name: Website intent
tools.description: Use for Website Intent READ-ONLY reports + tracking config: who (companies/people/industries) is visiting the website, visitor analytics/trends, and the tracking setup (allowed domains, tag script, de-anonymization credits). NOT for acting on visitors — to turn website visitors into a list, reach them, or add them to a campaign, use prospect_lists (the 'All Website Visitors' list) + campaigns. Examples: 'which companies visited my site this month?', 'show my visitor trend', 'is my tracking tag live on acme.io?'.

optional.name: client_id
optional.description: Client id of the app

optional.name: client_secret
optional.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: FuseDesk
description: FuseDesk is a customer support platform for managing cases, email conversations, contacts, departments, representatives, chats, and webhooks.

tools.name: Add Case Note
tools.description: Add an internal note or call record to a case and optionally change its status.

tools.name: Bulk Merge Cases
tools.description: Irreversibly merge multiple FuseDesk cases. This cannot be undone; call only after the user explicitly requests a merge and verifies every case ID.

tools.name: Bulk Update Cases
tools.description: Apply an assignment, department, status, tag, CRM automation, CRM tag, or snooze operation to multiple FuseDesk cases.

tools.name: Change Case Tag
tools.description: Apply or remove one existing case tag from one FuseDesk case.

tools.name: Close Chat
tools.description: Irreversibly close a FuseDesk chat and end the live conversation. This cannot be undone. Supplying rep_id, department_id, or case_status may also create and assign a new support case from the chat.

tools.name: Create Case
tools.description: Open a support case for a customer in a FuseDesk department.

tools.name: Create Case Tag
tools.description: Create a reusable FuseDesk case tag.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a FuseDesk contact. FuseDesk also links the new contact to a matching contact in the connected CRM, or creates that CRM contact when no match exists.

tools.name: Get Case
tools.description: Get one FuseDesk support case and its complete history by case ID.

tools.name: Get Chat
tools.description: Get one FuseDesk chat and its complete message history by chat UUID.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Get a FuseDesk contact by UUID, including current data from its linked CRM contact.

tools.name: Get Department
tools.description: Get a FuseDesk department's assignment, template, staleness, feedback, phone, and archive settings by department ID.

tools.name: Get Email
tools.description: Get one FuseDesk email by its numeric ID, including its complete body.

tools.name: Get Rep
tools.description: Get a FuseDesk rep's detailed profile, permissions, and signatures.

tools.name: List Case Tags
tools.description: List available FuseDesk case tags and their case counts.

tools.name: List Chats
tools.description: List active FuseDesk chats across connected chat platforms, including assignment links, recent-message context, and lifecycle state.

tools.name: List Departments
tools.description: List active, archived, or all FuseDesk departments using the current v2 representation.

tools.name: List Reps
tools.description: List active and disabled FuseDesk reps for assignment and ownership decisions.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List configured FuseDesk webhook subscriptions.

tools.name: Reply To Case
tools.description: Send an external email reply on a FuseDesk case using supplied content or an existing reply template. This immediately emails the resolved recipients.

tools.name: Search Cases
tools.description: Search support cases by customer, assignment, status, text, and lifecycle dates, returning one controllable page.

tools.name: Search Contacts
tools.description: Search FuseDesk and linked CRM contacts by required text. The connected API key must include FuseDesk's View Contacts permission.

tools.name: Search Emails
tools.description: Search all or only unassigned FuseDesk emails, returning one controllable page with optionally truncated bodies.

tools.name: Snooze Case
tools.description: Snooze a case until an absolute date/time or FuseDesk relative-time expression.

tools.name: Update Case
tools.description: Change a case's content, customer link, assignment, department, or status. Provide at least one field to update.

tools.name: Update Chat
tools.description: Rename, transfer, relink, or mark a live FuseDesk chat seen or unseen. Provide at least one field to update.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update a FuseDesk contact. Warning: FuseDesk also updates the linked CRM contact, so confirm that both records should change before calling this tool. Provide at least one contact field or non-empty billing address to update.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your FuseDesk application name from your account URL. For example, enter "acme" if you sign in at https://acme.fusedesk.com.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A scoped API key for this FuseDesk app. In FuseDesk, open Settings > API Keys, create a key with only the permissions needed for the tools you intend to use, and copy the key shown there.

name: FutureAGI
description: FutureAGI provides evaluation, observability, simulation, dataset, and annotation APIs for building and improving AI systems.

tools.name: List Agent Definitions
tools.description: List one page of agent definitions in the connected FutureAGI organization, optionally filtering by type, name, assistant ID, or agent ID. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Annotation Labels
tools.description: List one page of FutureAGI annotation labels by type, name, project, or dataset, optionally including usage counts. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Annotation Queues
tools.description: List one page of FutureAGI annotation queues by status or name, optionally including item counts. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Custom Eval Configs
tools.description: List custom evaluation configurations, optionally restricted to a FutureAGI project or evaluation task.

tools.name: List Datasets
tools.description: List one page of datasets in the connected FutureAGI organization, optionally searching by name. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Eval Tasks
tools.description: List one page of FutureAGI evaluation tasks, optionally filtering by project ID or task name. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Personas
tools.description: List one page of built-in and workspace personas for FutureAGI simulations, with type, simulation-mode, and text filters. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Run Tests
tools.description: List one page of configured FutureAGI run tests without executing them, optionally filtering by name, source type, or prompt template. Returns next_cursor to continue.

tools.name: List Scenarios
tools.description: List one page of FutureAGI simulation scenarios, optionally filtering by agent definition, agent type, or search text. Returns next_cursor to continue.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your FutureAGI API key. In the FutureAGI dashboard, open Settings > API Keys and copy the FI_API_KEY value. API key management is available to organization owners.

required.name: generic_secret
required.description: Your FutureAGI secret key paired with FI_API_KEY. In the FutureAGI dashboard, open Settings > API Keys and copy the FI_SECRET_KEY value. Keep this value secret.

name: Gagelist
description: GageList is a user-friendly calibration management platform that simplifies the integration process with intuitive interfaces and straightforward APIs, enabling seamless connection with existing tools and workflows.

tools.name: Add Calibration Record
tools.description: Creates a new calibration record in GageList to document equipment calibration results. Use this tool to record calibration activities including test results, dates, technician info, and equipment condition. Can optionally link to an existing gage record via EquipmentRefId, or create a standalone calibration record. Supports detailed test data, attachments, and custom fields.

tools.name: Add Gage Record
tools.description: Tool to add a new gage record. Use after gathering all required gage attributes to create a record.

tools.name: Add Manufacturer
tools.description: Creates a new manufacturer record in the GageList calibration management system. A manufacturer represents the company that produces gages and measurement instruments. Use this action when you need to add a new manufacturer to the system for tracking and managing calibration records for their equipment. Returns the unique identifier of the newly created manufacturer record.

tools.name: Authenticate with Gagelist
tools.description: Tool to obtain a Gagelist API access token. Use when you need to authenticate with Gagelist using client credentials. Returns OAuth2 tokens for subsequent requests.

tools.name: Delete Calibration Record
tools.description: Deletes a calibration record by its ID. This is a destructive operation that permanently removes the record. Verify the record exists before deletion.

tools.name: Delete Gage Record
tools.description: Deletes a gage record by its ID. The record must exist in the system to be deleted successfully. This operation is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Manufacturer
tools.description: Tool to delete a manufacturer by its ID. Use after confirming the manufacturer exists.

tools.name: Generate Calibration Certificate
tools.description: Tool to generate a PDF certificate from a calibration record. Use after ensuring record ID and authentication.

tools.name: Get Account Settings
tools.description: Tool to get account settings. Use after successful authentication to retrieve user-specific settings.

tools.name: Get account status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account status. Use after authenticating with Gagelist.

tools.name: Get all calibration records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of calibration records. Use after obtaining a valid access token.

tools.name: Get All Gage Records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of gage records. Use after confirming the access token.

tools.name: Get All Manufacturers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all manufacturers. Use after obtaining a valid access token. Returns manufacturer details including ID, name, contact information, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an attachment by its ID. Use when you need to download file attachments from the system.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom field definitions. Use when you need to list all custom fields configured for both gage and calibration items after authentication.

tools.name: Get Single Calibration Record
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single calibration record. Use when you need a specific record's detailed data. Ensure a valid Bearer token is set.

tools.name: Get Single Gage Record
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details of a single gage/gauge record from GageList by its unique ID. Returns complete gage information including: serial number, control number, manufacturer details, calibration dates and intervals, measurement specifications (range, tolerance, unit of measure), location, responsible user, test templates, and attached files. Use this after obtaining a valid gage ID from GAGELIST_GET_ALL_GAGE_RECORDS or GAGELIST_ADD_GAGE_RECORD. Example: GetSingleGageRecord(id=123)

tools.name: Update Account Settings
tools.description: Tool to update account settings. Use after retrieving current settings to apply user preference changes.

tools.name: Update Custom Field Values
tools.description: Tool to update custom field values. Use when you need to set or modify custom field values for a gage or calibration record after authentication.

tools.name: Update Manufacturer
tools.description: Tool to update a manufacturer by its ID. Use after confirming the manufacturer exists.

tools.name: Upload Attachment To Gage Record
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment to a gage record. Use when adding files to an existing gage record.

required.name: client_id
required.description: The client ID provided by GageList for API authentication.

required.name: client_secret
required.description: The client secret provided by GageList for API authentication.

name: Gamma
description: Gamma helps create beautiful, interactive content and presentations using AI. This integration enables programmatic generation via Gamma’s API.

tools.name: Create from Template
tools.description: Tool to create new Gamma content based on an existing template. Use when you need to generate content with a predefined structure/layout by providing custom instructions and prompt. The API creates content asynchronously. This action polls the generation status and returns the gammaUrl when complete, or a generationId if the 2-minute timeout is reached.

tools.name: Edit Gamma
tools.description: Apply an edit and poll up to 120 seconds for completion.

tools.name: Export Gamma
tools.description: Export an existing Gamma and poll up to 120 seconds for its download URL.

tools.name: Generate a Gamma
tools.description: Generate a Gamma presentation, document, webpage, or social media content using AI. Documentation: https://developers.gamma.app/docs/generate-api-parameters-explained The API creates content asynchronously. Poll the returned generationId to check status.

tools.name: Get Gamma
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for one Gamma by file ID or document ID.

tools.name: Get Gamma File URLs
tools.description: Retrieve generation status and file URLs. Poll this endpoint every ~5 seconds until status is 'completed'. Docs: https://developers.gamma.app/reference/get-generation-status

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of folders in your Gamma workspace. Use when you need folder IDs to organize generated content or to search for specific folders by name.

tools.name: List Themes
tools.description: Fetch the list of themes available in your workspace. Returns both standard (global) and custom (workspace-specific) themes in a paginated format. Use this to discover available theme IDs and names for use with the Generate API. Filter by name using the query parameter.

tools.name: Search Gammas
tools.description: Search accessible Gamma documents by text, creator, or update time.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Gamma API key used for authenticating requests. Find it in your Gamma account settings.

name: Gan.AI
description: Gan.AI provides advanced APIs for text-to-speech, voice cloning, and video personalization, enabling developers to integrate natural and expressive speech synthesis into their applications.

tools.name: Get Avatar Video Inference Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed status and metadata for a specific avatar video inference. Use when you have an inference_id and need to check its processing status and access video URLs.

tools.name: Get Photo Avatar Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific photo avatar by ID. Use when you need to check photo avatar processing status and access its metadata and image URL.

tools.name: Get photo avatar inference details
tools.description: Tool to fetch photo avatar inference details. Use after obtaining a valid inference ID to retrieve detailed information.

tools.name: List avatar video inferences
tools.description: Tool to list avatar video inferences. Use when you need to retrieve generated avatar videos with optional filtering by avatar ID, title, status, or date range.

tools.name: List photo avatar inferences
tools.description: Tool to list photo avatar inferences. Use when you need to retrieve inference videos with optional filtering by avatar, title, status, or date range.

tools.name: List Photo Avatars
tools.description: Tool to list avatars. Use when you need a paginated collection of avatars with filters. Example: "List the first 10 published avatars created after 2023-01-01".

tools.name: Login
tools.description: Tool to authenticate a user and retrieve access and refresh tokens. Use when you need to login before calling other GAN.AI API actions.

tools.name: GAN AI Text-to-Speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech using GAN.AI's Text-to-Speech API. This tool synthesizes speech from text using a specified voice. The voice_id must be obtained from the GAN.AI Get Voices endpoint or from your GAN.AI dashboard. Returns audio in WAV format.

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: The API key generated from Gan.AI's platform, used to authenticate API requests.

name: Gatherup
description: GatherUp is a customer feedback and online review management platform that helps businesses collect, manage, and leverage customer feedback to improve their online reputation.

tools.name: Delete GatherUp Business
tools.description: Permanently deletes a business location from GatherUp. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. **When to use**: Remove business locations that are no longer needed or were created in error. **Important**: Verify the businessId before deletion. Check errorCode in response: 0=success, non-zero=error.

tools.name: Find GatherUp Agency Client ID
tools.description: Find the client ID for a specific business in GatherUp agency accounts. This tool retrieves the numeric client identifier associated with a business location. Use this when you need to look up the client ID for agency-level operations or business management.

tools.name: Get GatherUp Business
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific GatherUp business location. Returns comprehensive business data including: name, contact details (phone, address), timezone, business type, subscription package, communication settings, engagement metrics (NPS score, feedback counts), and marketing assets (logos, banners, feedback URLs). Prerequisites: - Use GATHERUP_SEARCH_BUSINESS if you need to find a businessId by customField/extraField

tools.name: Get GatherUp Business Types
tools.description: Retrieves the list of available business categories from GatherUp (e.g., Restaurant, Hotel, Dental Office). Use this to: - Get valid business type IDs for creating new businesses - Discover available business categories in GatherUp - Filter business types by search term (optional)

tools.name: Get GatherUp Customer
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific customer from GatherUp by their customer ID. Use this action to get customer details including name, email, phone, rating, feedback status, and other customer-related information. Common use cases: - Retrieve customer contact information before sending feedback requests - Check customer's current rating and feedback status - Verify customer subscription status (unsubscribed flag) - Get customer creation date and associated business details Error codes: 0=success, 2=invalid clientId, 3=server error, 44=customer not found Endpoint: POST https://app.gatherup.com/api/customer/get

tools.name: Get Widget HTML
tools.description: Retrieve pre-formatted widget or badge HTML code with schema.org structure and SEO-friendly content. Returns ready-to-embed HTML code that displays customer reviews or badges on your website. The HTML includes structured data markup for better search engine visibility. Prerequisites: - Use GATHERUP_SEARCH_BUSINESS if you need to find a businessId

tools.name: Search GatherUp Business by Custom Identifier
tools.description: Search for a GatherUp business location by custom identifier and retrieve its business ID. This tool locates business locations using user-defined identifiers (customField or extraField) that you've assigned in GatherUp. Returns the businessId on success (errorCode=0), or an error code with message on failure.
