Common error codes: 2=Invalid clientId, 25=Business not found, 26=Invalid search type Endpoint: POST /api/business/search

tools.name: Send GatherUp Customer Feedback
tools.description: Send a feedback request to a customer to collect their rating and review. Use this when you want to automatically request feedback after a customer interaction or transaction. Ensure the customer exists in your GatherUp account and hasn't unsubscribed from feedback requests.

tools.name: Set GatherUp User Password
tools.description: Sets a new password for an existing user in GatherUp. Use this action to update user credentials securely. **Prerequisites**: - Valid userId (user must exist in your GatherUp account) - Password must meet security requirements: minimum 12 characters, at least one uppercase letter and one number **When to use**: Update user passwords for security purposes or user account management. Check errorCode in response: 0=success, non-zero=error. See errorMessage for details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Bearer token for authenticating API requests to GatherUp.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Client ID for GatherUp API requests, found under Account Owner > Client Details.

name: Geekflare
description: Geekflare provides APIs for web scraping, search, website testing, DNS and network diagnostics, and security scans.

tools.name: Capture Website Screenshot
tools.description: Capture a webpage or selected element as PNG, JPEG, or WebP with viewport and rendering controls. This is credit-heavy at 5 credits per successful run; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on and additional credits.

tools.name: Check Broken Links
tools.description: Scan one webpage for links that return errors. Costs 2 credits; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Check DNSSEC
tools.description: Check whether DNSSEC is enabled and validating for a domain, including DNSKEY and RRSIG records. Observed Free cost is 1 credit.

tools.name: Check Mixed Content
tools.description: Scan an HTTPS page for insecure HTTP images, scripts, stylesheets, and other mixed content. Observed Free cost is 2 credits; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Check Site Status
tools.description: Check whether a website is reachable and return the target site's HTTP status. Costs 1 credit; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Convert URL to PDF
tools.description: Render a webpage into a downloadable PDF with paper, orientation, margin, and scale controls. This is credit-heavy at 5 credits per successful run; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on and additional credits.

tools.name: Look Up DNS Records
tools.description: Retrieve A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, CAA, NS, SOA, SRV, and TXT records for a domain. Costs 1 credit per successful run.

tools.name: Measure Page Load Time
tools.description: Measure browser page-load time from Geekflare's default location for 1 credit. Optionally compare additional countries, but setting target_countries is credit-heavy and costs 8 credits total for the run. proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Ping Host
tools.description: Send ICMP pings to a domain or IP address and return latency, packet-loss, and round-trip statistics. Costs 2 credits per successful run.

tools.name: Run Lighthouse Audit
tools.description: Run a Google Lighthouse audit for performance, SEO, accessibility, and best practices. This credit-heavy endpoint costs 10 credits per successful run; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on and additional credits.

tools.name: Run MTR Network Diagnostic
tools.description: Run MTR to report packet loss and latency at each network hop between Geekflare and a target. Observed Free cost is 2 credits; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Scan Open Ports
tools.description: Scan a domain or IP address for open TCP ports using a common-port set, custom ranges, or Geekflare's default top 100 ports. Costs 2 credits per successful run.

tools.name: Scan TLS Configuration
tools.description: Inspect a domain's TLS protocols, cipher suites, and certificate details. Costs 1 credit per successful run.

tools.name: Scrape Page Metadata
tools.description: Extract meta tags, Open Graph fields, Twitter Card fields, canonical URLs, and images from a webpage. Base cost is 2 credits per successful run; proxy_country opts into the paid Premium Proxy add-on and additional credits.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage
tools.description: Fetch webpage content as HTML, Markdown, JSON, or text, with optional browser rendering, selector extraction, and AI analysis. Base cost is 1 credit; ai_prompt adds 6 credits, and proxy modes use the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

tools.name: Search the Internet
tools.description: Search web pages, news, or images with domain, category, location, and time filters. A base search costs 2 credits. Scraping result URLs and synthesizing a grounded answer are opt-in, credit-heavy enhancements and default off.

tools.name: Trace URL Redirects
tools.description: Trace every redirect hop, status code, and final destination for a URL. Costs 1 credit; proxy_country uses the paid Premium Proxy add-on.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Geekflare API key. Sign in at https://dash.geekflare.com/ and copy the API key generated for your account or workspace. Geekflare currently provides one active key per account, so keep it secret.

name: Gelato
description: Gelato is a print-on-demand platform for creating and managing orders, browsing printable products and prices, checking stock, and finding shipment methods.

tools.name: Cancel Order
tools.description: Cancel a regular Gelato order before production advances too far. DESTRUCTIVE: cancellation is an irreversible lifecycle change and may fail with conflict once the order is printed or shipped. Confirm the target order and do not retry blindly.

tools.name: Check Stock Availability
tools.description: Check current regional stock status for 1 to 250 Gelato product UIDs. Availability is volatile; call near quote or order time and do not treat an earlier result as a reservation.

tools.name: Create Draft Order
tools.description: Create a Gelato draft for review or later submission without entering production. Use a unique order_reference_id; delete the draft when it is no longer needed.

tools.name: Create Order
tools.description: Create a production order that can immediately enter fulfillment and charge the connected account. IRREVERSIBLE: call only after explicit purchase authorization, use a unique order_reference_id, and never retry an ambiguous result.

tools.name: Delete Draft Order
tools.description: Permanently delete a Gelato draft. DESTRUCTIVE: only use for a confirmed draft, preferably one created by the same workflow; this cannot delete a regular production order and success was not live-exercised.

tools.name: Get Catalogs
tools.description: List available Gelato product catalogs, or provide catalog_uid to retrieve one catalog's full product-attribute definitions and allowed values. Use detail mode before constructing attribute filters.

tools.name: Get Order
tools.description: Retrieve the full current state, financial status, fulfillment status, shipment tracking, items, and totals of one Gelato order by its Gelato order ID.

tools.name: Get Product
tools.description: Retrieve one Gelato product's attributes, dimensions, weight, supported countries, printability, stockability, content areas, and valid page counts by product UID.

tools.name: Get Product Prices
tools.description: Return Gelato's quantity price tiers for one product, optionally localized by destination country, currency, and multipage page count. These catalog prices do not replace Quote Order for actual shipment options and final order cost.

tools.name: Quote Order
tools.description: Quote product and shipping costs and delivery estimates for a destination before creating an order. This does not place or charge an order, but submitted print-file URLs are sent to Gelato for quote validation.

tools.name: Search Orders
tools.description: Search Gelato orders with status, reference, date, country, currency, channel, type, store, or free-text filters and return one offset-controlled page.

tools.name: Search Products
tools.description: Search printable products in a Gelato catalog by catalog attribute values and return one offset-controlled page. Facet hit maps are omitted by default because they are extremely large; request them only when needed for filter discovery.

tools.name: Submit Draft Order
tools.description: Convert an existing draft into a regular production order. CRITICAL: this is an irreversible, potentially payable transition that can start production. If items are supplied, every omitted existing item is removed; include ID-only entries for items that must remain unchanged. Never retry blindly.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate an API key in the Gelato Dashboard API Portal under Developer > API Keys. Copy it when it is created because Gelato shows a new key only once, and keep it secret. You must be an admin or have permission to manage API keys.

name: Gemini
description: Comprehensive Gemini integration supporting Veo 3 video generation, Gemini Flash text generation (Nano Banana), chat completions, and multimodal AI capabilities via the Google Gemini API.

tools.name: Count Tokens (Gemini)
tools.description: Counts the number of tokens in text using Gemini tokenization. Useful for estimating costs, checking input limits, and optimizing prompts before making API calls.

tools.name: Embed Content (Gemini)
tools.description: Generates text embeddings using Gemini embedding models. Converts text into numerical vectors for semantic search, similarity comparison, clustering, and classification tasks.

tools.name: Generate Content (Gemini)
tools.description: Generates text content or speech audio from prompts using Gemini models. Supports text generation models (Gemini Flash, Pro) and text-to-speech models with configurable parameters. Generated text is nested at results[i].response.data.text. Output may be wrapped in markdown fences (e.g., ```html...```) or preceded by explanatory prose; strip these before file writing or rendering.

tools.name: Generate Image (Nano Banana)
tools.description: Generates one downloadable raster image from a text prompt. Defaults to Nano Banana 2 Lite (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image), one 1K square image. Some connections allow only these defaults with a 1-1000 character prompt; others accept the schema's model choices and options. A successful call returns data.image; no generated image is an error. Image generation is synchronous, but a transport timeout can leave the provider outcome unknown. Do not automatically retry an ambiguous submission: another generation can incur another charge.

price.description: $0.033 per 1K image, plus $0.25/1M input and $1.5/1M output tokens.

tools.name: Generate Videos (Veo)
tools.description: Submits one Veo video generation request and returns operation_name for tracking. Uses Veo 3.1 Lite at 720p with an explicit integer duration of 4/6/8 seconds, a 1-1000 character text prompt and aspect ratio 16:9 or 9:16; longer videos cost more. Pass the returned handle unchanged to GEMINI_GET_VIDEOS_OPERATION for status or GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO to retrieve the MP4. Submission success means Google accepted the job, not that a video file is already available. The price is charged, nonrefundably, once Google accepts the job; status and result reads are free. A timeout can leave acceptance unknown: do not automatically resubmit.

tools.name: Get Videos Operation (Veo)
tools.description: Checks an existing Veo operation without waiting for media download. response and video_urls may be hidden, even when generation succeeds; read status and next_action. succeeded means retrieve the same operation using GEMINI_WAIT_FOR_VIDEO. pending or unknown means continue polling the same handle, without submitting another paid generation. filtered or failed is a terminal rejection; any resubmission is a separate charged request. Poll at 10–30 second intervals and allow up to 15 minutes for generation.

tools.name: List Models (Gemini API)
tools.description: Lists available Gemini and Veo models with their capabilities and limits. Useful for discovering supported models and their features before making generation requests.

tools.name: Wait and Download Video (Veo)
tools.description: Polls an existing Veo operation and downloads its MP4 when ready. Each call polls for a bounded time (about 20 seconds on some connections). pending=true with success=null means this call did not retrieve a terminal result; the job may still be running or may already have completed after a poll timeout. Reuse the exact returned operation_name with this action or GEMINI_GET_VIDEOS_OPERATION; do not resubmit a paid generation to continue. success=true includes video_file, while success=false indicates terminal safety filtering. Provider errors fail the call. A new generation is a separate request and can incur another charge.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Google AI Studio API key. Create one at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

name: Gender API
description: Gender API determines the gender of a first name, email address, or username.

tools.name: Get Country of Origin
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a name's likely countries of origin. Use after confirming the name identifier.

tools.name: Get Country of Origin (v1)
tools.description: Tool to get the country of origin for a given first name using v1 API. Returns the most likely country where the name is most common.

tools.name: Get Gender API Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account statistics from Gender-API, including remaining credits and usage details. Use when you need to check your credit balance before performing further gender lookups.

tools.name: Query Gender by Email Address
tools.description: Determine likely gender from an email address by extracting and analyzing the name portion. Returns male/female/unknown with a confidence score. Optionally filter by country for improved accuracy. Check result_found to know if a determination was made; probability indicates confidence level.

tools.name: Query Gender by Multiple Email Addresses
tools.description: Determine likely gender for multiple email addresses in a single batch request. Returns male/female/unknown with confidence scores for each email. Use for efficient bulk processing. Each result includes result_found flag and optional probability score.

tools.name: Gender From First Name
tools.description: Tool to determine the gender of a first name. Use when you need to identify gender based on a given name.

tools.name: Query Gender by Full Name
tools.description: Tool to determine gender by splitting a full name. Use when you have an exact full name string and want to infer gender. Slightly less reliable for rare or ambiguous names.

tools.name: Query Gender by Multiple First Names
tools.description: Tool to determine gender for multiple first names in a single batch request. Use when you need to query gender for several names efficiently to save API credits and reduce latency.

tools.name: Query Gender by Full Name (Multiple)
tools.description: Tool to batch query gender for multiple full names in a single request. Use when you need to determine gender for multiple names efficiently. Each name can optionally include country, locale, or IP for more accurate regional inference.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique API key for authenticating requests to the Gender API.

name: GenderAPI.io
description: GenderAPI.io provides an API to determine the gender associated with a given name, email address, or username.

tools.name: Gender API Get Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account usage statistics from GenderAPI.io. Use when you need to check remaining API credits and expiry.

tools.name: Query Gender by First Name
tools.description: Tool to determine gender by querying first name. Use when you need to infer likely gender for a given name with optional localization hints.

tools.name: Get Gender from Username
tools.description: Tool to determine gender from a username or nickname. Use when you have an alias or handle and want to infer gender from that identifier.

tools.name: List Gender API Error Codes
tools.description: Tool to list all possible error codes returned by Gender API. Use when debugging or validating API responses.

tools.name: Query gender by email address
tools.description: Tool to determine gender from an email address. Use when you need to infer gender for personalization after obtaining proper consent.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API key for authentication with GenderAPI.io

name: Genderize
description: Genderize is an API that predicts the gender of a person based on their first name, providing statistical probabilities for male or female classifications.

tools.name: Predict Gender
tools.description: Tool to predict gender from a given first name. Use when you need a quick gender estimation possibly localized by country code.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key obtained from Genderize.io for authentication.

name: Geoapify
description: Geoapify offers a suite of APIs for integrating maps, geocoding, routing, and other location-based services into applications.

tools.name: Address Autocomplete
tools.description: Tool to fetch address suggestions based on partial input. Use when you need to get predictive suggestions from incomplete address text.

tools.name: Batch Requests
tools.description: Create or retrieve asynchronous batch processing jobs for geocoding, reverse geocoding, routing, or isoline APIs. Use cases: - Batch geocode up to 1000 addresses at once (forward geocoding) - Batch reverse geocode multiple coordinates - Process multiple routing or isoline requests in one batch Workflow: 1. Create a job by providing 'api' and 'inputs' (returns job ID and status 'pending') 2. Poll the job by providing 'id' until status changes from 'pending' to complete (results available)

tools.name: Get Boundaries Containing Location
tools.description: Retrieve all administrative boundaries that contain a given location. Returns hierarchical boundaries (suburb, city, county, state, country) as GeoJSON features. Use this to find what administrative areas a coordinate belongs to, get boundary polygons for mapping, or identify postal codes and political districts for a location.

tools.name: Create Batch Forward Geocode Job
tools.description: Tool to create a batch forward geocoding job for up to 1000 addresses. Use when you need to geocode multiple addresses asynchronously. Returns a job ID for retrieving results once processing is complete.

tools.name: Create Batch Reverse Geocode Job
tools.description: Tool to create a batch reverse geocoding job that converts multiple lat/lon coordinates into addresses asynchronously. Use when you need to reverse geocode multiple coordinates (up to 1000) in one request. Returns a job ID for retrieving results.

tools.name: Forward Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to convert an address into geographic coordinates. Use when you need latitude and longitude from an address.

tools.name: Geometry Operation
tools.description: Tool to perform geometric operations on stored polygon geometries. Use when combining or intersecting multiple stored geometries.

tools.name: Get Batch Forward Geocode Results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve batch forward geocoding job results using the job ID. Use when you need to fetch geocoded addresses from a previously submitted batch job. Results available in JSON or CSV format. Job must be complete (status 200) to get results.

tools.name: Get Batch Reverse Geocode Results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve batch reverse geocoding job results. Use when you have a batch job ID from creating a batch reverse geocoding job and want to fetch the completed results.

tools.name: Get Child Boundaries (Consists Of)
tools.description: Get boundaries that a specified location consists of. Returns child administrative divisions (states for country, districts for city). Useful for drilling down into sub-regions.

tools.name: Get Map Style JSON
tools.description: Tool to retrieve vector map style JSON for MapLibre GL and Mapbox GL. Returns a Mapbox-compatible style specification for rendering vector tiles.

tools.name: Generate Static Map Image
tools.description: Tool to generate static map images with customizable style, size, center, zoom, markers, and geometries. Use when you need a map image for display or printing.

tools.name: IP Geolocation
tools.description: Lookup geographic location information for an IP address. Returns city-level location data including country, region, city, coordinates, and additional metadata like currency and language. If no IP is provided, returns location for the caller's IP address.

tools.name: Generate isoline (isochrone/isodistance)
tools.description: Tool to generate isochrone or isodistance isolines. Use when visualizing reachable areas from a point; use `id` to poll ongoing calculations.

tools.name: List Postcodes
tools.description: Tool to list postcodes within a specified area or boundary. Use when you need to retrieve multiple postcodes in a geographic region using filters like circle, rectangle, or place ID.

tools.name: Map Matching
tools.description: Snap GPS traces to the road network for accurate route reconstruction. Use this tool to: - Correct GPS drift and inaccuracies in recorded tracks - Align vehicle/cycling/walking traces to actual roads - Get road names and properties along the matched route - Calculate accurate distance and travel time from GPS data

tools.name: Fetch Geoapify Map Tiles
tools.description: Tool to fetch raster map tiles or style JSON from Geoapify. Use when rendering custom maps with specific styles.

tools.name: Create Marker Icon
tools.description: Generate custom map marker icons as PNG images. Creates customizable marker icons for use in mapping applications (Leaflet, MapLibre GL, Google Maps, etc.). Supports multiple styles (material, circle, plain), custom colors, icons from Material Design and Font Awesome libraries, or custom text/numbers. Example use cases: - Create a red location pin with a star icon - Generate numbered markers (1, 2, 3...) for route waypoints - Create custom-colored markers matching your brand

tools.name: Place Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific place. Use when you have a place ID or coordinates and need comprehensive metadata.

tools.name: Places Search
tools.description: Search for points of interest (POIs) like restaurants, hotels, attractions, hospitals, etc. within a geographic area. Use this tool when you need to find places by category near a location. You must provide either a 'filter' (to search within a bounded area) or 'bias' (to rank results by proximity to a point). Common use cases: - Find restaurants near a location: categories=['catering.restaurant'], bias='proximity:lon,lat' - Search for hotels in a city area: categories=['accommodation.hotel'], filter='circle:lon,lat,5000' - Find wheelchair-accessible attractions: categories=['tourism.attraction'], conditions=['wheelchair']

Solves Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP) including: Travelling Salesman (TSP), Capacitated VRP, VRP with Time Windows, and Pickup-Delivery problems. Required: Either 'jobs' (one-way tasks) or 'shipments' (pickup-delivery pairs). Coordinates: Use [longitude, latitude] format (not lat/lon).

name: Getform
description: Getform is a modern form backend platform that enables developers to handle web forms and submissions without setting up a server or writing backend code.

tools.name: Get Form Submission
tools.description: Retrieve a specific form submission by its ID from Getform. Use this tool when you have both a form_id and submission_id and need to fetch the details of that single submission. The response includes all form field values submitted by the user, plus metadata like submission date and any uploaded files. Note: The Getform API does not have a dedicated single-submission endpoint, so this action fetches all submissions and filters by ID. For forms with many submissions, consider using get_submissions with pagination if you need to process multiple records. tools.description: Enable or update the account-wide callback URL and event subscriptions. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update campaign
tools.description: Update a GetResponse campaign (contact list) and its confirmation or profile settings.

tools.name: Update campaign blocklist
tools.description: Add, delete, or replace blocklist masks for a campaign (contact list).

tools.name: Update cart
tools.description: Update a cart and its selected variants. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update category
tools.description: Update a category's supplied fields. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update contact details
tools.description: Update contact details; supplied tags and custom fields replace existing values, and changing campaign moves the contact and its history. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update a custom event
tools.description: Update a custom event definition and its attributes.

tools.name: Update a custom field
tools.description: Update a custom field definition's visibility and assigned values.

tools.name: Update meta field
tools.description: Update a meta field's supplied fields. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update order
tools.description: Update the supplied fields of an ecommerce order. Provide at least one mutable body field; additional_flags alone does not update the order.

tools.name: Update a predefined field
tools.description: Update the value of an existing GetResponse predefined field.

tools.name: Update product
tools.description: Update a product and its nested ecommerce data. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update product variant
tools.description: Update a product variant and its nested ecommerce data. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update RSS newsletter
tools.description: Update an RSS newsletter's content, status, delivery, or audience settings. Setting status to 'enabled' can send messages according to its delivery schedule. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update search contacts
tools.description: Replace a saved contact search's name and condition sections.

tools.name: Update shop
tools.description: Update a shop's supplied fields. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update a suppression list by ID
tools.description: Replace a suppression list's masks and optionally rename it. The complete masks list is required; pass an empty list to remove all masks.

tools.name: Update tax
tools.description: Update a tax's supplied fields. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update transactional email template
tools.description: Update the subject or content of a transactional email template. Provide at least one mutable field.

tools.name: Update a workflow
tools.description: Set a workflow to active, inactive, or incomplete (draft).

tools.name: Upload image
tools.description: Upload an image file to GetResponse Multimedia.

tools.name: Upsert the custom fields of a contact
tools.description: Add or update a contact's custom fields without removing other assigned custom fields.

tools.name: Upsert the tags of a contact
tools.description: Add tags to a contact without unassigning the contact's existing tags.

tools.name: Upsert product meta fields
tools.description: Assign meta fields to a product without removing existing assignments.

tools.name: Upsert product categories
tools.description: Assign categories to a product and optionally set its default category without removing existing assignments.

tools.name: Upsert custom fields by search contacts
tools.description: Submit an asynchronous request to add or update custom fields for contacts matching a saved contact search. A successful response confirms acceptance, not completion.
