tools.name: Compare Repository Refs
tools.description: Compare two branches, tags, or commit SHAs in a GitLab project.

tools.name: Create Commit
tools.description: Creates a new commit with multiple file operations in a GitLab project. This action supports batch operations including creating, updating, deleting, moving files, and changing file permissions in a single atomic commit. Use this action when you need to perform multiple file changes at once or when you need to commit changes to a GitLab repository programmatically. Note: Commits over 20 MB are rate-limited to 3 requests per 30 seconds, and commits over 300 MB are rejected.

tools.name: Create Commit Comment
tools.description: Posts a comment to a specific commit in a GitLab project repository. Use this action when you need to provide feedback, review notes, or discussion on a particular commit. Line-specific comments require both path and line parameters; if invalid, the comment is placed at the commit level.

tools.name: Create Deployment
tools.description: Create a deployment for a project's environment and deployed commit. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#create-a-deployment.

tools.name: Create Environment
tools.description: Create an environment in a project, optionally associating Kubernetes resources. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#create-an-environment.

tools.name: Create Repository File
tools.description: Creates a new file in a GitLab repository at the specified path with the given content. Use this action when you need to add a new file to a repository branch with a commit message.

tools.name: Create GitLab Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group in GitLab. Use when you need to establish a new group for projects or collaboration.

tools.name: Create Group Variable
tools.description: Create a group-level CI/CD variable. Requires the Owner role for the group.

tools.name: Create Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Create a group wiki page with a title and content in a supported markup format. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#create-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Create Issue Discussion
tools.description: Create an issue discussion thread that can receive replies. Backdating with created_at requires administrator or project/group owner rights.

tools.name: Create Issue Link
tools.description: Create a two-way relationship between two issues. The caller must be allowed to update both issues. Supports related issues, blocking, and blocked-by relationships.

tools.name: Create Issue Note
tools.description: Creates a new note (comment) on a project issue in GitLab. Use this action when you need to add a comment, provide feedback, or document information on an existing issue.

tools.name: Create Label
tools.description: Creates a new label for a GitLab project with specified name, color, and optional attributes. Use this action when you need to create a new label for organizing issues and merge requests within a project. Labels help categorize and filter project items, making project management more efficient.

tools.name: Create Merge Request
tools.description: Creates a new merge request in a GitLab project to propose changes from a source branch into a target branch. Use this action when you need to create a merge request for code review, feature integration, or bug fixes. This action requires both the source and target branches to exist in the project.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Dependency
tools.description: Make a merge request depend on another merge request being merged first. Specify a global blocking MR ID or its project-local IID. For a blocking IID in another project, also provide blocking_project_id.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Create a replyable merge request discussion on the overview or a diff position. For added lines supply new_line only; for removed lines supply old_line only; for unchanged lines supply both. Use line_range for multiline comments.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Creates and saves an unpublished merge request draft note that is visible only to its author. Use this action when the requested outcome is a saved draft for later publication; it does not publish a comment.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Note
tools.description: Create a merge request comment, not a line-specific diff discussion. Emoji-only content can create and return an emoji reaction instead of a note. Quick actions in the body can also change the merge request.

tools.name: Create Merge Request Pipeline
tools.description: Create a detached or, when enabled, merged results merge request pipeline. This does not run a regular branch/tag pipeline. Configure .gitlab-ci.yml for merge request jobs (for example, only: [merge_requests]).

tools.name: Create Milestone
tools.description: Creates a new milestone in a GitLab project. Milestones track progress towards a goal with a start date, due date, and associated issues. Use this action when you need to establish a new project milestone for organizing work, tracking release schedules, or planning sprints.

tools.name: Create Personal Snippet
tools.description: Create a personal snippet containing one or more files. Requires permission to create snippets. Prefer files over deprecated single-file fields. Limited to 300 requests per hour per user, shared with project snippet creation and the createSnippet GraphQL mutation. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#create-a-snippet.

tools.name: Create Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to create a new pipeline for a specific branch or tag in a GitLab project. Use when you need to manually trigger a CI/CD pipeline run, optionally passing variables or inputs. For merge request pipelines, use the dedicated merge requests endpoint instead.

tools.name: Create Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Create a recurring pipeline schedule for a project's branch or tag. Set active to false to create an initially deactivated schedule. Optional pipeline inputs require GitLab 17.11 or later (generally available in 18.1).

tools.name: Create Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Create a variable on an existing project pipeline schedule. Use env_var for an environment variable or file for a file-type variable.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in GitLab. Implements POST /projects endpoint.

tools.name: Create Project Issue
tools.description: Tool to create a new issue in a GitLab project. Use when you need to report a bug, request a feature, or track a task within a specific project.

tools.name: Create Project Snippet
tools.description: Create a project snippet containing one or more files. Requires permission to create snippets and the files array. Deprecated single-file attributes are optional legacy fields. Creation is limited to 300 requests per hour per user, shared with personal snippet creation and the createSnippet GraphQL mutation. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_snippets/#create-a-snippet.

tools.name: Create Project Variable
tools.description: Create a project-level CI/CD variable. An existing key requires a different environment_scope; the same key and environment scope cannot be created twice.

tools.name: Create Project Wiki Page
tools.description: Create a project wiki page with a title and content in a supported markup format. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#create-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Create Release
tools.description: Create a project release, optionally creating its tag and adding asset links. Requires at least Developer access. Supply ref when the tag does not exist. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#create-a-release.

tools.name: Create Release Asset Link
tools.description: Create an asset link for an existing project release. Link names and URLs must each be unique within the release. Supported URL protocols are HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP. Optionally set a direct download path. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/links/#create-a-release-link.

tools.name: Create Repository Branch
tools.description: Tool to create a new branch in a project. Use when you need to create a new branch from an existing branch or a specific commit in a GitLab project.

tools.name: Create Repository Tag
tools.description: Create a repository tag pointing to a commit, branch, or existing tag. Supply a message for an annotated tag. Creation is subject to the project's shared tag-creation rate limit and can return HTTP 429.

tools.name: Create Project Webhook
tools.description: Creates a new webhook (project hook) for a GitLab project to receive real-time event notifications. Use this action when you need to set up automated integrations that respond to GitLab events like pushes, merge requests, issues, or CI/CD pipeline activities. Configure which events trigger the webhook by enabling the appropriate event flags. The webhook will send POST requests to your specified URL whenever the configured events occur.

tools.name: Delete Deployment
tools.description: Delete a deployment that is not running or the last deployment for its environment. The deployment must satisfy both prerequisites before deletion. GitLab rejects running deployments and deployments currently deployed to an environment. Returns an empty-response success indicator or GitLab's confirmation message. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#delete-a-deployment.

tools.name: Delete Environment
tools.description: Delete an environment from a project. The environment must be stopped first. Returns success for GitLab's empty 204 response. GitLab returns 403 if the environment is not stopped and 404 if it does not exist. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#delete-an-environment.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Deletes a GitLab group by its ID or URL-encoded path. Use this action when you need to remove a group entirely. This action is irreversible — the group cannot be recovered once permanently removed. On GitLab.com, groups are retained for 30 days before permanent deletion unless permanently_remove=true is specified. You must have Owner permissions on the group to delete it.

tools.name: Delete Group Variable
tools.description: Delete a group-level CI/CD variable. Requires the Owner role for the group. When multiple variables share the key, use filter.environment_scope to select the variable to delete (Premium and Ultimate only). See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_level_variables/#delete-a-group-variable.

tools.name: Delete Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Delete a specified group wiki page. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#delete-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Delete Issue
tools.description: Delete an issue from a project permanently. Planner or Owner roles can delete any issue; other project members can delete issues they authored (GitLab 18.10+).

tools.name: Delete Issue Discussion Note
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing note from an issue discussion. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#delete-an-issue-thread-note.

tools.name: Delete Issue Link
tools.description: Delete an issue link, removing the two-way relationship without deleting either issue. Returns the deleted relationship's source issue, target issue, and link type. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issue_links/#delete-an-issue-link.

tools.name: Delete Issue Note
tools.description: Deletes a note (comment) from an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to remove a specific comment from an issue. This action is irreversible — the note cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Delete Job Artifacts
tools.description: Permanently delete a job's archived files, metadata, and report artifacts. Artifacts cannot be recovered. The job log is not deleted. Requires the Maintainer or Owner role for the project. Returns success for HTTP 204. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/job_artifacts/#delete-job-artifacts.

tools.name: Delete Label
tools.description: Deletes a label from a GitLab project by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to remove a label from a project permanently. This action is irreversible — the label cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Delete Merge Request
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a merge request from a GitLab project. Use when you need to remove a merge request entirely, though closing is typically preferred to preserve the discussion history and audit trail. This action is irreversible — the merge request and its associated data cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Delete Merge Request Dependency
tools.description: Delete a merge request dependency without deleting either merge request. Requires permission to update the merge request and read the blocking merge request. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#delete-a-merge-request-dependency.

tools.name: Delete Merge Request Discussion Note
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing note from a merge request discussion. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#delete-a-merge-request-thread-note.

tools.name: Delete Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Deletes one caller-owned unpublished merge request draft note. This operation is irreversible and does not delete published comments.

tools.name: Delete Merge Request Note
tools.description: Delete an existing note (comment) from a merge request. This permanently removes the specified note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#delete-a-merge-request-note.

tools.name: Delete Milestone
tools.description: Deletes a project milestone by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a milestone from a project. This action is irreversible — the milestone cannot be recovered once deleted. Requires at minimum the Planner role for the project.

tools.name: Delete Personal Snippet
tools.description: Delete an existing personal snippet. Returns success for GitLab's 204 No Content response and raises an error if the snippet is not found (404).

tools.name: Delete Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to delete a CI/CD pipeline by its ID within a specified project. This action expires all pipeline caches and deletes all immediately related objects such as builds, logs, artifacts, and triggers. This action is irreversible — the pipeline cannot be recovered once deleted. Use when you need to permanently remove a pipeline and all its associated data.

tools.name: Delete Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Delete a project's pipeline schedule, preventing future scheduled runs. Returns the deleted schedule, or success for an empty response. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#delete-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Delete Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Delete a variable from a project's pipeline schedule and return the deleted variable. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#delete-a-variable-for-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a GitLab project by its ID. Use when you need to remove a project, either by marking it for later deletion or deleting it immediately.

tools.name: Delete Project Snippet
tools.description: Delete a specified project snippet. Returns success for GitLab's 204 No Content response and raises an error if the snippet is not found (404).

tools.name: Delete Project Variable
tools.description: Delete a project's CI/CD variable by key. When multiple variables share the key, use filter.environment_scope to select the variable to delete. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/#delete-a-variable.

tools.name: Delete Project Wiki Page
tools.description: Delete a specified project wiki page. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#delete-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Delete Release
tools.description: Delete a project release and return its release body, without deleting its tag. Requires at least the Developer role for the project. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#delete-a-release.

tools.name: Delete Release Asset Link
tools.description: Delete a specified asset link from a release and return the deleted link. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/links/#delete-a-release-link.

tools.name: Delete Repository Branch
tools.description: Tool to delete a branch from a GitLab project repository. Use when you need to remove a branch that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible — the branch cannot be recovered once deleted. Cannot delete default or protected branches.

tools.name: Delete Repository File
tools.description: Deletes a file from a GitLab repository by creating a new commit. Use this action when you need to remove a file from a project's repository on a specific branch. This action is irreversible — the file will be removed from the specified branch, though it remains in the git history and can be recovered from previous commits.

tools.name: Delete Repository Tag
tools.description: Delete the specified repository tag from a project.

tools.name: Delete Review Apps
tools.description: Schedule deletion of stopped environments in the review app folder. Defaults to a safe dry run. With dry_run=false, actual deletion takes place one week after execution. By default only environments 30 days or older are selected. Returns scheduled and unprocessable environment entries. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#delete-multiple-stopped-review-apps.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Deletes a project webhook/hook permanently from a GitLab project, removing the integration and stopping all event notifications. Use this action when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed or to clean up unused integrations. This action is irreversible — the webhook cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Download Job Artifacts
tools.description: Download a job's artifacts archive or a specific report by job ID.

tools.name: Download Job Artifacts By Ref
tools.description: Download a named job's artifacts archive from the latest successful pipeline for a branch or tag. Requires a completed successful pipeline with artifacts. Optionally search recent successful pipelines. Parent pipeline artifacts take precedence over child artifacts.

tools.name: Download Project Avatar
tools.description: Tool to download a project's avatar image. Use when you need the raw avatar bytes after confirming the project exists.

tools.name: Download Repository Archive
tools.description: Download a repository archive, optionally limited to a ref and subpath. GitLab.com limits this endpoint to five requests per minute.

tools.name: Erase Job
tools.description: Tool to erase the content of a specified job within a project. Use when you need to remove job artifacts and logs.

tools.name: Fork Project
tools.description: Forks a GitLab project to a specified namespace or the current user's namespace. Creates an independent copy of the project that maintains a relationship with the source. Use this action when you need to create a personal or team copy of a project for development, experimentation, or contribution workflows.

tools.name: Generate Release Evidence
tools.description: Collect evidence for an existing release. Returns success, not a release object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#collect-release-evidence.

tools.name: Get Commit Diff
tools.description: Retrieve a page of file diffs for a commit, branch, or tag in a project. Configured diff limits can stop pagination before all changed files are returned.

tools.name: Get Commit References
tools.description: Tool to get all references (branches or tags) a commit is pushed to. Use when you need to find out which branches or tags a specific commit belongs to in a GitLab project.

tools.name: Get Commit Sequence
tools.description: Tool to get the sequence number of a commit in a project by following parent links from the given commit. Use when you need to determine the order of a commit in the project's history.

tools.name: Get Commit Signature
tools.description: Retrieve a commit's GPG, SSH, or X.509 signature. Unsigned commits return HTTP 404.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Retrieves information about the currently authenticated user. Use this action when you need to get details about the user who owns the authentication token, such as their profile information, permissions, and settings.

tools.name: Get Deployment
tools.description: Retrieve one project deployment, including its job and available approval summary. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#retrieve-a-deployment.

tools.name: Get Environment
tools.description: Retrieve a project environment, including its last deployment and cluster agent. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#retrieve-an-environment.

tools.name: Get Repository File
tools.description: Retrieves a single file from a GitLab repository at a specific ref (branch, tag, or commit). Returns the file content as base64-encoded data along with metadata like size, encoding, and commit information. Use this action when you need to fetch the contents or details of a specific file from a GitLab project repository.

tools.name: Get File Blame
tools.description: Return commit attribution and lines for a GitLab repository file.

tools.name: Get Group Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific group by its ID. Use when you need to get details of a GitLab group.

tools.name: Get Group Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific group member. Use when you need to fetch membership information for a user in a group after you know both group ID and user ID.

tools.name: Get Group Member All
tools.description: Retrieve one group member, including inherited and invited memberships. Use when the group and user IDs are known and direct membership alone is not sufficient. Visibility of invited private-group members depends on caller access.

tools.name: Get Groups
tools.description: Get Groups

tools.name: Get Group Variable
tools.description: Retrieve a group CI/CD variable by key. Requires the group's Owner role. Use filter to select an environment scope when variables share a key. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_level_variables/#retrieve-details-of-a-group-variable.

tools.name: Get Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Retrieve a group wiki page, optionally as HTML or at a version SHA. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#retrieve-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Get Issue
tools.description: Retrieves a single issue from a GitLab project by its internal ID (iid). Returns comprehensive issue details including description, state, labels, assignees, time tracking, and task status. Use this action when you need to inspect a specific issue's current state, check its metadata, or retrieve detailed information before performing updates or analysis. Requires knowing both the project ID/path and the issue's internal ID.

tools.name: Get Issue By ID
tools.description: Retrieve an issue by its global ID. Administrator access is required. This does not accept a project-local IID. For a project ID/path and issue IID, use Get Issue instead. Returns issue details and preserves tier-specific fields.

tools.name: Get Issue Discussion
tools.description: Retrieve one issue discussion and its notes without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#retrieve-an-issue-discussion-item.

tools.name: Get Issue Link
tools.description: Retrieve one issue relationship by project, issue IID, and issue link ID. Returns the source issue, target issue, and relationship type. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/issue_links/#retrieve-an-issue-link.

tools.name: Get Issue Note
tools.description: Retrieves a single comment (note) from a GitLab issue by its ID. Use this action when you need to fetch the details of a specific note on an issue, including its content, author information, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Job Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single job by its ID within a specified project. Use this when you need to fetch specific information about a particular CI/CD job.

tools.name: Get Job Trace
tools.description: Retrieves the trace (log output) for a specific CI/CD job within a project. Use this action when you need to view the execution logs of a job to debug failures, check output, or monitor job progress. The trace contains the complete console output from the job execution.

tools.name: Get Project Label
tools.description: Retrieves a single project label by its ID or title. Use this action when you need to fetch details about a specific label within a GitLab project, such as its color, description, or associated issue/MR counts.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Approvals
tools.description: Retrieves aggregate approval status for a GitLab merge request on any GitLab tier. Returns every approving user, even when an approval does not satisfy a specific approval rule. Use Get Merge Request Approval State instead when Premium or Ultimate rule-level satisfaction is needed.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Approval State
tools.description: Retrieves rule-level approval satisfaction for a GitLab merge request. This endpoint requires GitLab Premium or Ultimate and shows which users count toward each rule, not every user who approved. Use Get Merge Request Approvals for all-tier aggregate status and the complete approving-user list.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Diff Version
tools.description: Retrieve a specific merge request diff version with its commits and file diffs. GitLab diff limits may exclude file contents. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#retrieve-a-merge-request-diff-version.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Retrieve one merge request discussion and its notes without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#retrieve-a-merge-request-discussion-item.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Retrieve an unpublished merge request draft note, visible only to its author. Does not publish or change the note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#retrieve-a-draft-note.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Note
tools.description: Retrieve one existing merge request note by its ID without modifying it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#retrieve-a-merge-request-note.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Notes
tools.description: Tool to fetch comments on a merge request. Use when you need to retrieve all notes for a specific merge request.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Raw Diffs
tools.description: Get raw diffs of files changed in a merge request. GitLab diff limits may truncate results.

tools.name: Get Milestone
tools.description: Retrieves a single milestone by its ID for a specific project. Returns detailed information including title, description, dates, and state. Use when you need to fetch complete details about a specific milestone.

tools.name: Get Personal Snippet
tools.description: Retrieve a personal snippet's metadata, not its raw file content. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#retrieve-a-snippet.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Retrieve a project's pipeline schedule, including its last pipeline and owner. Variables and inputs are only returned to Maintainers, Owners, or the schedule owner. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#retrieve-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Get Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Retrieve a variable by key from a project's pipeline schedule. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#retrieve-a-variable-for-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Tool to get a single project by ID or URL-encoded path.

tools.name: Get Project Languages
tools.description: Tool to list programming languages used in a project with percentages. Use when you need the project language breakdown.

tools.name: Get Project Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member. Use after confirming project and user IDs to fetch membership information for a project member.

tools.name: Get Project Member All
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific project member (including inherited and invited members). Use when you need the effective membership info (including invitations and inheritance).

tools.name: Get Project Merge Request
tools.description: Tool to fetch full details for a single merge request when the MR IID is known. Use when you need to retrieve canonical metadata, description, state, branches, authors, and approval-related fields for a specific merge request.

tools.name: Get Merge Request Commits
tools.description: Tool to get commits of a merge request. Use when you need to retrieve all commits associated with a specific merge request.

tools.name: Get Project Merge Requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of merge requests for a specific project. Use when you need to get all merge requests associated with a project, with options to filter by state, labels, milestones, and other attributes.

tools.name: Get Project Release
tools.description: Retrieve the complete release resource associated with a project tag.

tools.name: Get Projects
tools.description: Tool to list all projects accessible to the authenticated user. Supports filtering. Private or group projects may be silently omitted if the token lacks sufficient scopes or group membership.

tools.name: List Merge Request Diff Versions
tools.description: Tool to list all diff versions of a merge request. Use when you need to inspect changes across different diff versions after creating or updating a merge request.

tools.name: Get Project Snippet
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for a specified project snippet, not its raw file content. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_snippets/#retrieve-a-snippet.

tools.name: Get Project Variable
tools.description: Retrieve a project's CI/CD variable by key, optionally selecting its environment scope. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/#retrieve-a-single-variable.

tools.name: Get Project Wiki Page
tools.description: Retrieve a project wiki page, optionally as HTML or at a version SHA. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#retrieve-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Get Raw File
tools.description: Retrieves the raw contents of a file from a GitLab repository without Base64 encoding. Use this action when you need to read the actual file content directly from a repository. Unlike the standard file retrieval endpoint, this returns unencoded file content.

tools.name: Get Raw Personal Snippet
tools.description: Get a personal snippet's raw contents as text.

tools.name: Get Raw Project Snippet
tools.description: Retrieve a project snippet's raw content as plain text.

tools.name: Get Raw Repository Blob
tools.description: Retrieves raw Git blob bytes by object SHA as a lossless Base64 string.

tools.name: Get Release Asset Link
tools.description: Retrieve a specified asset link from a project's release by tag and link ID.

tools.name: Get Repository Blob
tools.description: Retrieve Base64-encoded Git blob content and metadata by object SHA.

tools.name: Get Repository Blobs Batch
tools.description: Retrieve up to 20 files with Base64-encoded content in one request. Requires authentication and GitLab's experimental feature flag (404 if disabled); not production-ready. Each blob is truncated to its first 1 MB, with size reporting its full size. Missing files are omitted. The default rate limit is 5 requests per minute per user and project.

tools.name: Get Repository Branch
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific branch in a project. Use when you need to get details for a single branch.

tools.name: Get Repository Branches
tools.description: Retrieves a list of repository branches for a project. Use this when you need to get all branches or search for specific branches within a GitLab project.

tools.name: Get Repository Tag
tools.description: Retrieve one repository tag by name, including its commit and associated release.

tools.name: Get Single Commit
tools.description: Tool to get a specific commit identified by the commit hash or name of a branch or tag. Use this when you need to retrieve detailed information about a single commit in a GitLab project repository.

tools.name: Get Single Pipeline
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a single pipeline by its ID within a specified project. Use when you need to get information about a specific CI/CD pipeline.

tools.name: Get Tag Signature
tools.description: Retrieve a repository tag's X.509 signature. Unsigned tags return HTTP 404.

tools.name: Get Issue Time Stats
tools.description: Retrieves time tracking statistics for a specific issue in a project. Returns both machine-readable values (in seconds) and human-readable formatted durations. Use this action when you need to check time estimates, logged time, or track progress on an issue's time budget.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific user by their ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a single GitLab user.

tools.name: Get User Preferences
tools.description: Tool to get the current user's preferences. Use when you need to retrieve the user's diff display and CI identity JWT settings after authentication.

tools.name: Get Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of users from GitLab. Use this when you need to find user information, search for specific users, or filter users based on various criteria like activity status or creation date.

tools.name: Get Any User's Status by ID
tools.description: Tool to get a user's status by ID. Use when you need to retrieve a GitLab user's current status message, emoji, and availability after identifying their user ID.

tools.name: Get User Status
tools.description: Tool to get the current user's status. Use when displaying or verifying the authenticated user's GitLab status after login.

tools.name: Get User Support PIN
tools.description: Tool to get details of the current user's Support PIN. Use when you need to retrieve the active support PIN and its expiration for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project webhook by its ID. Use this action when you need to inspect a webhook's configuration, including its URL, enabled event triggers, SSL verification settings, and authentication details. This is useful for verifying webhook configurations or before updating webhook settings.

tools.name: Import project members
tools.description: Tool to import members from one project to another. Use when migrating members between projects.

tools.name: Keep Job Artifacts
tools.description: Prevent a job's artifacts from being automatically deleted at expiration. Returns the job details. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/job_artifacts/#keep-job-artifacts.

tools.name: Lint Project CI Configuration
tools.description: Validate the CI/CD configuration stored in a GitLab project.

tools.name: List All Group Members
tools.description: Tool to list all members of a group including direct, inherited, and invited members. Use when you need a comprehensive membership list beyond direct members.

tools.name: List All Project Members
tools.description: Tool to list all members of a project (direct, inherited, invited). Use when you need the effective membership list including inherited and invited members.

tools.name: List Billable Group Members
tools.description: Tool to list billable members of a top-level group (including its subgroups and projects). Use when generating billing reports; requires Owner role on the group.

tools.name: List Blocked Merge Requests
tools.description: List one page of merge requests blocked by the specified merge request. Returns dependency relationships with blocking and blocked merge request details. Follow next_page to retrieve additional results.

tools.name: List Commit Comments
tools.description: Retrieves all comments associated with a specific commit in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to view discussions or feedback left on a particular commit, including both general comments and inline code review comments.

tools.name: List Commit Merge Requests
tools.description: List one page of merge requests associated with a commit. Returns the merge request that originally introduced the commit. Optionally filter by state and follow next_page for more results.

tools.name: List Commit Statuses
tools.description: List one page of commit statuses, optionally filtered and sorted. By default GitLab returns only the latest statuses. Set all to true to include all statuses and follow next_page to retrieve additional pages.

tools.name: List Deployment Merge Requests
tools.description: List one page of merge requests shipped with a deployment. Not all deployments can be associated with merge requests. Supports the Merge Requests API filters; follow next_page to retrieve subsequent pages. https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#list-all-merge-requests-associated-with-a-deployment

tools.name: List Environments
tools.description: List one page of project environments, filtered by exact name, search, or state.

tools.name: List Group Issues
tools.description: List one page of group issues with filters. Follow next_page to retrieve more results.

tools.name: List Group Members
tools.description: Tool to list direct members of a group. Use when you need to retrieve or filter a group's direct membership.

tools.name: List Group Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects within a GitLab group by group ID or full path. Use when discovering projects under a namespace or subgroup.

tools.name: List Group Releases
tools.description: List one page of releases for projects in a group. Use simple for limited release fields and sort for ascending or descending order. Follow next_page for additional pages. The group endpoint has no order_by parameter. Current GitLab documentation lists Free, Premium, and Ultimate availability, with no Premium-only limitation stated.

tools.name: List Group Variables
tools.description: List one page of a group's CI/CD variables, including available values. Requires the Owner role for the group. Use page and per_page to paginate; next_page indicates whether more results exist.

tools.name: List Group Wiki Pages
tools.description: List one page of a group's wiki pages, optionally including content. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. Use page and per_page to paginate, following next_page for further results.

tools.name: List Issue Closing Merge Requests
tools.description: List one page of merge requests that close an issue when merged. Private projects and confidential issues require authorized credentials.

tools.name: List Issue Discussions
tools.description: List one page of an issue's discussions, including threaded and individual notes.

tools.name: List Issue Links
tools.description: List linked issues ordered by relationship creation time, oldest first. Results are filtered by the caller's authorization to view the linked issues.

tools.name: List Issue Notes
tools.description: Retrieves all notes (comments and activity) for a specific project issue in GitLab. Use this action when you need to view the discussion history, comments, or activity log on an issue to understand the context or follow up on conversations. Results are paginated and can be filtered by activity type or sorted by creation/update time.

tools.name: List Issue Participants
tools.description: List one page of users participating in an issue. Follow next_page for more results. Private projects and confidential issues require credentials with access to the issue.

tools.name: List Issue Related Merge Requests
tools.description: List one page of merge requests related to an issue. Follow next_page for more results. Private projects and confidential issues require credentials with access to the issue.

tools.name: List Issues
tools.description: List one page of issues accessible to the authenticated user across projects. Defaults to issues created by the current user, not every accessible issue. Use filters to narrow results and next_page to continue pagination. GitLab.com may reject scope=all; use a group or project issues action in that case.

tools.name: List Job Artifact Files
tools.description: Browse one page of a job's artifact archive without downloading it. Optionally browse a subdirectory or list recursively. Nested directories are represented by entry paths, not nested children. Requires artifact metadata; GitLab returns 404 if the job, artifacts, metadata, or requested path is missing. CI/CD job token authentication is not exposed by this action.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: Lists all labels for a project with optional filtering by name, archived status, and ancestor inclusion. Use this action when you need to retrieve available labels for a project to categorize issues or merge requests, or to check which labels exist before assigning them.

tools.name: List Merge Request Closed Issues
tools.description: List one page of issues that would close when a merge request is merged. These are not necessarily already closed. External trackers may return only an issue key and title. Follow next_page for additional results.

tools.name: List Merge Request Dependencies
tools.description: List dependencies that must be resolved before a merge request can merge. Follow next_page for additional results. Blocking merge request details are omitted by GitLab when the caller lacks access to that merge request.

tools.name: List Merge Request Diffs
tools.description: List the files changed by a GitLab merge request, including patch content.

tools.name: List Merge Request Discussions
tools.description: Lists grouped discussion threads and their notes for a merge request.

tools.name: List Merge Request Draft Notes
tools.description: Lists the connected author's unpublished draft notes for a merge request.

tools.name: List Merge Request Participants
tools.description: List one page of participants for a merge request. Follow next_page to retrieve additional results.

tools.name: List Merge Request Pipelines
tools.description: List one page of pipelines for a merge request. Follow next_page to retrieve additional results.

tools.name: List Merge Request Related Issues
tools.description: List one page of issues referenced by a merge request's title, description, commit messages, comments, and discussions. Supports GitLab and external issue trackers. Follow next_page for additional results.

tools.name: List Merge Request Reviewers
tools.description: List a page of merge request reviewers with their review states. Follow next_page to retrieve additional results.

tools.name: List Merge Requests
tools.description: Retrieves a list of merge requests from across all accessible projects based on scope and filters. Use this action when you need to query merge requests at the instance or user level (not scoped to a specific project), such as finding all merge requests created by a user, assigned to a user, or awaiting review. By default returns merge requests created by the authenticated user; use scope=all to retrieve all accessible merge requests.

tools.name: List Project Milestones
tools.description: Lists all milestones for a specific project with optional filtering by state, title, or search terms. Use this action when you need to view project milestones, check milestone progress, or find a specific milestone by title or IID before creating or updating issues.

tools.name: List Package Files
tools.description: List the files belonging to a package in a GitLab project.

tools.name: List Pending Group Members
tools.description: Tool to list pending members of a group and its subgroups and projects. Use when you need to review users awaiting approval or invited without an account. Call after confirming the top-level group ID.

tools.name: List Personal Snippets
tools.description: List one page of the current user's snippets, optionally filtered by creation time. Follow next_page with page and per_page to retrieve further results. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#list-all-snippets-for-current-user.

tools.name: List Pipeline Jobs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of jobs for a specified pipeline within a project. Use this when you need to inspect the status or details of jobs associated with a particular CI/CD pipeline.

tools.name: List Pipeline Schedule Pipelines
tools.description: List one page of pipelines triggered by a project's pipeline schedule. Optionally filter by scope, status, or creation/update time and choose sort order. Follow next_page to retrieve additional results.

tools.name: List Pipeline Schedules
tools.description: List one page of pipeline schedules for a project, optionally filtered by activity. Follow next_page for additional results. Inputs are visible only to Maintainers, Owners, or the schedule owner.

tools.name: List Pipeline Variables
tools.description: Retrieve variables associated with a project pipeline. GitLab returns 404 if the pipeline variables file is missing from storage.

tools.name: List Project Deployments
tools.description: List and filter deployments in a GitLab project.

tools.name: List Project Groups
tools.description: Tool to list ancestor groups of a project. Use when you need to retrieve all groups a project belongs to or is shared with.

tools.name: List Project Invited Groups
tools.description: Tool to list groups invited to a project. Use when auditing which groups have access to a project.

tools.name: List Project Issues
tools.description: Tool to list issues for a project with filtering options (state, labels, search, assignee, author, etc.). Use when you need to browse, filter, or triage project issues to confirm IIDs or decide what to update/close.

tools.name: List Project Jobs
tools.description: List one page of a project's CI/CD jobs, newest first, optionally filtered by status.

tools.name: List Project Members
tools.description: List one page of direct project members viewable by the authenticated user. Does not include inherited members or memberships through invited groups. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/#list-all-direct-members-of-a-project.

tools.name: List Project Packages
tools.description: List and filter packages in a GitLab project's package registry.

tools.name: List Project Pipelines
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of pipelines for a specified project. Use when you need to get information about CI/CD pipelines, such as their status, source, or creation/update times.

tools.name: List Project Releases
tools.description: List one page of project releases, sorted by released_at descending by default. Optionally sort by creation time or include rendered descriptions. Follow next_page to retrieve additional releases.

tools.name: List Project Shareable Groups
tools.description: Tool to list groups that can be shared with a project. Use before sharing a project to fetch eligible groups.

tools.name: List Project Snippets
tools.description: List one page of snippets for a project. Use page and per_page to paginate, following next_page for further results.

tools.name: List Project Repository Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of repository tags for a specified project. Use when you need to get all tags associated with a project in GitLab.

tools.name: List Project Transfer Locations
tools.description: Tool to list namespaces available for project transfer. Use when you need to determine which groups a project can be transferred into.

tools.name: List project users
tools.description: Tool to list users of a project. Use after you have a project ID and want to retrieve its users.

tools.name: List Project Variables
tools.description: List one page of a project's CI/CD variables, including available values. Use page and per_page to paginate; next_page indicates whether more results exist.

tools.name: List Project Wiki Pages
tools.description: List one page of a project's wiki pages, optionally including content. Use page and per_page to paginate, following next_page for further results.

tools.name: List Release Asset Links
tools.description: List asset links from a project release identified by its tag. Returns link IDs, names, URLs, and link types, not downloaded asset content.

tools.name: List Repository Commits
tools.description: Tool to get a list of repository commits in a project. Use when you need to retrieve commit history for a specific project, branch, or time range.

tools.name: List Repository Tree
tools.description: List files and directories in a GitLab project's repository tree.

tools.name: List User Events
tools.description: List contribution events for a GitLab user.

tools.name: List User Projects
tools.description: Tool to list projects owned by a specific user. Use after obtaining target user identity to fetch owned projects.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks configured for a GitLab project. Returns webhook configurations including URLs, event triggers, and SSL settings. Use when you need to view existing webhooks for a project, audit webhook configurations, or check which events are being monitored. Webhook secret tokens are redacted from the response.

tools.name: Merge Merge Request
tools.description: Merge a GitLab merge request immediately or enable auto-merge when checks pass. A successful merge is irreversible, and should_remove_source_branch can also delete the source branch.

tools.name: Move Issue
tools.description: Moves an issue from one project to another in GitLab. The issue receives a new IID and project_id in the destination project. Use this action when you need to relocate an issue to a different project, such as when reorganizing work or transferring issues between team projects. If equivalent labels or milestones exist in the destination project, they are automatically assigned to the moved issue.

tools.name: Play Job
tools.description: Triggers execution of a manual job in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to start or run a job that requires manual intervention or has a manual status.

tools.name: Play Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Run a project's pipeline schedule immediately without affecting its next scheduled run. Returns GitLab's confirmation message, not a pipeline object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#run-a-pipeline-schedule-immediately.

tools.name: Create Support PIN
tools.description: Tool to create a support PIN for your authenticated user. Use when GitLab Support requests a PIN to verify your identity.

tools.name: Protect Branch
tools.description: Protects a repository branch in a GitLab project by setting access controls for push, merge, and unprotect operations. Use this action when you need to enforce branch protection rules to prevent unauthorized modifications or deletions of important branches like main, master, or release branches. Protected branches can restrict who can push, merge, force push, and remove protection.

tools.name: Publish All Merge Request Draft Notes
tools.description: Publish all pending draft notes belonging to the authenticated user on a merge request. Optionally add a summary note and set the review state without recording a formal approval. GitLab may normalize note bodies when publishing. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#publish-all-pending-draft-notes.

tools.name: Publish Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Publish one pending draft note as a comment on a merge request. Before publication, draft notes are visible only to their author. GitLab may normalize the note body when publishing. Returns success, not a note object. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#publish-a-draft-note.

tools.name: Update User Preferences
tools.description: Tool to update the current user's preferences. Use when adjusting default diff viewing and CI identity settings.

tools.name: Rebase Merge Request
tools.description: Enqueue rebasing a merge request's source branch against its target branch. HTTP 202 means queued, not completed. Poll the retrieve merge request endpoint with include_rebase_in_progress=true to check rebase_in_progress and merge_error. Requires permission to push to the source branch, including force push when protected. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_requests/#rebase-a-merge-request.

tools.name: Remove Group Member
tools.description: Remove a user explicitly assigned a role in a group. This does not remove users who only belong directly to a project in the group. By default, direct memberships in subgroups and projects are also removed. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#remove-a-group-member.

tools.name: Remove Project Member
tools.description: Remove a direct member of a project, not an inherited membership. Optionally skip subresource membership removal or unassign project issuables. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/#remove-a-direct-member-of-a-project.

tools.name: Reorder Issue
tools.description: Reorder a project issue for manually sorted issue lists. Position references use global issue IDs, not project-local IIDs. Supply at least one reference. Each name identifies the neighbor that should be before or after the reordered issue, not a move-command direction.

tools.name: Reply Issue Discussion
tools.description: Add a note to an issue thread, or turn a single comment into a thread. System notes cannot receive replies (GitLab returns HTTP 400). See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#add-a-note-to-an-issue-thread.

tools.name: Reply Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Add a note to a merge request thread, or turn a single comment into a thread. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#add-note-to-a-merge-request-thread.

tools.name: Reset Merge Request Approvals
tools.description: Reset all approvals for a specified merge request. Available only to bot users with a valid project or group token. Human users receive 401 Unauthorized, even with an otherwise valid personal access token. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/merge_request_approvals/#reset-approvals-for-a-merge-request.

tools.name: Reset Spent Time
tools.description: Resets the total spent time for a specified GitLab issue to 0 seconds. This action is irreversible — all previously recorded time entries will be cleared and cannot be recovered. Use this action when you need to clear all time tracking entries for an issue and start time tracking from scratch.

tools.name: Reset Time Estimate
tools.description: Resets the estimated time for a specified issue to 0 seconds. Use this action when you need to clear a previously set time estimate on an issue while preserving the total time spent.

tools.name: Restore Project
tools.description: Restore a project marked for deletion before it is permanently deleted.

tools.name: Retry Job
tools.description: Retry a single CI/CD job, optionally supplying job input values. Returns the retried job. Trigger jobs require GitLab 17.0 or later. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/jobs/#retry-a-job.

tools.name: Retry Pipeline
tools.description: Retries failed or canceled jobs in a pipeline. Use this action when you need to re-run a pipeline that has failed or was canceled. Note that if there are no failed or canceled jobs in the pipeline, calling this action has no effect.

tools.name: Revert Commit
tools.description: Revert a commit on a target branch, creating a new commit. Set dry_run=true to check applicability without writing. Conflicting or already-reverted changes can fail.

tools.name: Search Project
tools.description: Search resources and repository content within one GitLab project.

tools.name: Set Time Estimate
tools.description: Sets the estimated time to complete an issue in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to set or update the time estimate for tracking project work. The estimate is specified in human-readable format like '3h30m' for 3 hours and 30 minutes.

tools.name: Set User Status
tools.description: Tool to set the current user's status. Use when you need to update availability or convey current mood on GitLab.

tools.name: Share Project With Group
tools.description: Tool to share a project with a group. Use when you need to grant a group specific access level to a project.

tools.name: Star Project
tools.description: Stars a project in GitLab, marking it as a favorite for the authenticated user. This adds the project to your starred projects list and increments its star count. Use this action when you want to bookmark or show support for a project. The operation is idempotent - starring an already-starred project succeeds without error.

tools.name: Start Housekeeping Task
tools.description: Tool to start the housekeeping task for a project. Use when you need to trigger manual maintenance or pruning on a repository.

tools.name: Stop Environment
tools.description: Stop a running environment, optionally skipping its on_stop actions. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#stop-an-environment.

tools.name: Stop Stale Environments
tools.description: Request stopping all environments last modified or deployed to before a date. Protected environments are excluded. Confirmation means the stop was requested, not that all environments have finished stopping. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#stop-stale-environments.

tools.name: Take Pipeline Schedule Ownership
tools.description: Take ownership of a project's pipeline schedule as the authenticated user. Returns the updated schedule and owner. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-ownership-of-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Unapprove Merge Request
tools.description: Removes the approval from the currently authenticated user for a specified merge request. Use this action when you need to revoke your previously given approval on a merge request. The action requires the merge request to have been previously approved by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Unarchive Project
tools.description: Unarchive a GitLab project to restore active use. Requires administrator access or the Owner role on the project. Idempotent: unarchiving an already unarchived project does not change it.

tools.name: Unprotect Branch
tools.description: Tool to remove protection from a branch in a GitLab project. Use this action when you need to unprotect a branch, allowing unrestricted push and merge access. This action is irreversible in the sense that protection rules must be manually reapplied if needed later.

tools.name: Unstar Project
tools.description: Unstar a previously starred GitLab project to remove it from your favorites list. Use this action when you need to remove a project from your starred projects. This action removes the star that was previously added by the authenticated user.

tools.name: Update Deployment
tools.description: Update the status of a project's deployment. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/deployments/#update-a-deployment.

tools.name: Update Environment
tools.description: Update an environment's settings, without renaming it. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/environments/#update-an-existing-environment. Omit a setting to leave it unchanged; explicit null removes supported associations.

tools.name: Update GitLab Group
tools.description: Updates an existing GitLab group's settings and properties. Use this action when you need to modify group configuration such as name, path, visibility, permissions, or feature settings. Administrators can update additional settings like shared runners limits and IP restrictions.

tools.name: Update Group Member
tools.description: Update a group member's access level, expiration, or custom role. Promotions may be queued for administrator approval rather than applied immediately. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#update-a-group-member.

tools.name: Update Group Member State
tools.description: Change a user's group membership state to awaiting or active. The change applies to all subgroups and projects and can allow access when a user is over the free user limit. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/members/#change-group-membership-state-for-a-user.

tools.name: Update Group Variable
tools.description: Update a group CI/CD variable. Requires the Owner role for the group. Use filter.environment_scope to select the existing scope and environment_scope to set the new scope. Verify the selected scope exists with the retrieve endpoint first: GitLab falls back to another scope with the same key if it does not exist. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_level_variables/#update-a-group-variable.

tools.name: Update Group Wiki Page
tools.description: Update a group wiki page's content, title, and optional markup format. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. Provide content or title (or both). Changing the title can change the page slug. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#update-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Update Issue Discussion Note
tools.description: Update the content of an existing issue discussion note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#update-an-issue-thread-note.

tools.name: Update Issue Note
tools.description: Updates an existing note (comment) on a GitLab issue. Use this action when you need to edit the content of a previously created comment on an issue. This is useful for correcting typos, adding additional information, or updating outdated information in issue discussions.

tools.name: Update Label
tools.description: Updates an existing label in a GitLab project by modifying its name, color, description, priority, or archived status. At least one of new_name or color must be provided to perform the update. Use this action when you need to rename a label, change its appearance, update its description, adjust its priority, or archive/unarchive it.

tools.name: Update Merge Request
tools.description: Updates an existing merge request in a GitLab project (title, description, assignees, reviewers, labels, state, etc.). Use this action when you need to modify merge request details, manage assignees/reviewers, update labels, close/reopen merge requests, or configure merge settings like squash or auto-removal of source branch. This action is idempotent and can be called multiple times with the same parameters.

tools.name: Resolve or Reopen Merge Request Discussion
tools.description: Resolve or reopen a resolvable merge request discussion thread.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Discussion Note
tools.description: Update the content of a merge request thread note, or resolve/reopen it. Set exactly one of body or resolved. An empty resolved value is a no-op. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/#update-a-merge-request-thread-note.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Draft Note
tools.description: Update the content or diff position of a merge request draft note. Draft notes are unpublished and visible only to their author. Omitted position is kept unchanged. This does not publish the note. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/draft_notes/#update-a-draft-note.

tools.name: Update Merge Request Note
tools.description: Update an existing merge request note's content and optional confidential flag. This edits a published note, not an unpublished draft note or a diff discussion. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/notes/#update-a-merge-request-note.

tools.name: Update Milestone
tools.description: Updates an existing milestone in a GitLab project, allowing you to modify the title, description, dates, or state. Use this action when you need to change milestone details, adjust deadlines, or close/reopen a milestone.

tools.name: Update Personal Snippet
tools.description: Update an existing personal snippet's metadata or files. Requires permission to change the snippet. For multi-file snippets, supply files with an action on each entry; prefer files over deprecated content and file_name. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/snippets/#update-snippet.

tools.name: Update Pipeline Schedule
tools.description: Update a project's pipeline schedule, which is automatically rescheduled. Only supplied fields are updated. Inputs accept strings, arrays, numbers, or booleans; remove an existing input with its name and destroy=true. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Update Pipeline Schedule Variable
tools.description: Update an existing variable for a project's pipeline schedule. Supply value, variable_type, or both; omitted fields are not sent. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/pipeline_schedules/#update-a-variable-for-a-pipeline-schedule.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update an existing GitLab project's settings, visibility, features, and CI/CD configuration. Requires Maintainer or Owner; some settings require Owner, administrator access, a paid tier, or a newer GitLab version. Only supplied settings are changed. Topics replace existing topics. Avatar accepts an image URL to upload. To clear an array, send an empty array in a separate call without avatar.

tools.name: Update Project Issue
tools.description: Tool to update an existing issue in a GitLab project (title, description, labels, assignees, state, etc.). Use when you need to modify issue details, close/reopen issues, or manage labels and assignments.

tools.name: Update Project Member
tools.description: Update a project member's access level, expiration, or custom role. Promotions may be queued for administrator approval rather than applied immediately. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_members/#update-a-member-of-a-project.

tools.name: Update Project Snippet
tools.description: Update a project snippet's metadata or files. Requires permission to change existing snippets. Multi-file snippet updates must use files, with an action on every entry. Prefer files over deprecated content and file_name. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_snippets/#update-a-snippet.

tools.name: Update Project Variable
tools.description: Update a project's CI/CD variable by key with a required new value. Use filter.environment_scope to select an existing variable when keys repeat; environment_scope sets the variable's new scope instead. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_level_variables/#update-a-variable.

tools.name: Update Project Wiki Page
tools.description: Update a project wiki page's content, title, and optional markup format. Provide content or title (or both). Changing the title can change the page slug. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#update-a-wiki-page.

tools.name: Update Release
tools.description: Update a project release's name, description, milestones, or release date. Requires Developer access. Omitted fields remain unchanged; pass an empty milestones array to remove all milestone associations. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/#update-a-release.

tools.name: Update Release Asset Link
tools.description: Update an existing asset link for a project release. Supply at least one of name or url; optionally change the direct asset path or link type. Supported URL protocols are HTTP, HTTPS, and FTP. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/releases/links/#update-a-release-link.

tools.name: Update Repository File
tools.description: Updates an existing file in a GitLab repository. Commits the changes to the specified branch with the provided commit message. Use this action when you need to modify file contents, change file permissions, or update files in a specific branch. Note that if concurrent modifications occur (detected via last_commit_id), the update will fail.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Updates an existing project webhook configuration including URL, event triggers, SSL verification, and authentication token. Use this action when you need to modify a webhook's endpoint, change which events trigger notifications, update security settings, or rotate the authentication token. This operation is idempotent and overwrites the specified settings.

tools.name: Upload Group Wiki Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file to the uploads folder in a group's wiki repository. Requires a GitLab Premium or Ultimate group. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/group_wikis/#upload-an-attachment-to-the-wiki-repository.

tools.name: Upload Project Wiki Attachment
tools.description: Upload a file to the uploads folder in a project's wiki repository. See https://docs.gitlab.com/api/wikis/#upload-an-attachment-to-the-wiki-repository.

tools.name: Validate CI Configuration
tools.description: Validate supplied GitLab CI/CD YAML without creating a pipeline.

tools.name: Validate Credential
tools.description: Validates the authentication credentials by retrieving the currently authenticated user's information. Use this action when you need to verify that the API token or credentials are valid and active. Returns the authenticated user's profile details if credentials are valid.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: full
required.description: Your Gitlab server base URL with /api/v4 appended.

required.name: authorizationUrl
required.description: Your Gitlab server base URL.

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: full
required.description: Integrator-configured GitLab API base URL, including /api/v4. Set this when creating the auth config: https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for GitLab.com, or your trusted self-managed instance URL followed by /api/v4. Connecting users supply only their access token.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a personal access token in GitLab under Edit profile > Access > Personal access tokens, or a project/group access token under its Settings > Access tokens. Administrator-created impersonation tokens are also supported. Select api for read/write access, or read_api for read-only API operations; read_user grants user-profile reads and read_repository/write_repository apply only to their documented repository surfaces. Access is also limited by token role and resource membership. Supply the token value only, without PRIVATE-TOKEN or a Bearer prefix. Browser-session cookies and CI job tokens are not supported by this connection method.

name: Givebutter
description: Givebutter is a fundraising platform that offers a free, open, and public API for developers to manage campaigns, track donations, and engage with supporters.

tools.name: Add Contact Tags
tools.description: Tool to add tags to a contact by contact ID. Use when you need to categorize or label contacts with specific tags.

tools.name: Add Household Contact
tools.description: Tool to add a contact to a household. Use when you have both a household ID and contact ID to associate them together.

tools.name: Archive Contact
tools.description: Tool to archive a contact by their ID. Use after ensuring the contact has no associated data (e.g., no transactions or communications). Example: "Archive contact abc123".

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Tool to create a new campaign. Use when you have title, description, goal, and type ready, after confirming your Givebutter account is authenticated.

tools.name: Create Campaign Ticket
tools.description: Tool to create a campaign ticket for events or fundraisers. Use when you need to add ticket options to a campaign with pricing and inventory details.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact in Givebutter. Use when you need to add a new contact with first name, last name, and optionally email, phone, and other details.

tools.name: Create Contact Activity
tools.description: Tool to create a contact activity (e.g., note). Use when you need to log an activity for a contact. Requires contact ID and activity details.

tools.name: Create Discount Code
tools.description: Tool to create a discount code for a campaign. Use when you need to provide promotional pricing or discounts for campaign items.

tools.name: Create Fund
tools.description: Tool to create a new fund. Use when you need to create a fund with a name and optional code.

tools.name: Create Household
tools.description: Tool to create a new household in Givebutter. Use when you need to group related contacts under a single household entity.

tools.name: Create Transaction
tools.description: Tool to create a new transaction for a campaign. Use when you need to record a donation or payment, typically for offline transactions like cash or check payments.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription. Use when you need to receive real-time notifications programmatically after confirming your endpoint can validate Givebutter's signing secret.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Tool to delete a campaign by its ID. Use after confirming the campaign has no funds raised. Example: "Delete campaign abc123".

tools.name: Delete Contact Activity
tools.description: Tool to delete a contact activity by contact ID and activity ID. Use when you need to remove a specific activity from a contact's record.

tools.name: Delete Discount Code
tools.description: Tool to delete a discount code from a campaign. Use when you need to remove a discount code after confirming it exists.

tools.name: Delete Fund
tools.description: Tool to delete a fund by its ID. Use when you need to remove a fund after confirming it exists. Example: "Delete fund fund_abc123".

tools.name: Delete Household
tools.description: Tool to delete a household by its ID. Use after confirming the household exists and has no associated data. Example: "Delete household 1007067".

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its ID. Use when you need to remove an obsolete webhook after confirming no further events are needed. Example: "Delete webhook abc123".

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific campaign by its ID or code. Use when you need to fetch campaign information, check status, or get fundraising progress.

tools.name: Get Campaign Ticket
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific campaign ticket by campaign ID and ticket ID. Use when you need details about a specific ticket item within a campaign.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific contact by ID. Use after confirming the contact ID is valid.

tools.name: Get Contact Activity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific contact activity by contact ID and activity ID. Use when you need detailed information about a particular activity for a contact.

tools.name: Get Discount Code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific discount code for a campaign. Use when you need to view discount code information.

tools.name: Get Fund
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific fund by its ID. Use after confirming the fund ID is valid.

tools.name: Get Household
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific household by its ID. Use when you need information about a household including its contacts.

tools.name: Get Members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of members for a given campaign. Use when you need to list or process campaign members.

tools.name: Get Payouts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of payouts associated with your account. Use when you need to list withdrawal transactions after authentication.

tools.name: Get Plans
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of plans associated with your account. Use after authentication to fetch recurring donation plans. Returns only plans scoped to the authenticated account; cross-account retrieval is not supported. An empty array is a valid response indicating no recurring plans exist. If paginated, iterate all pages to retrieve the full plan set.

tools.name: Get Teams
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of teams for a specific campaign. Use after creating or updating a campaign when you need to list fundraising teams. Example: "Get teams for campaign camp123".

tools.name: Get Tickets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of tickets. Use when you need to list all tickets for your account after authentication.

tools.name: Get Transactions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of transactions associated with your account. Use when you need to list all donations and payments, optionally filtered by scope.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific webhook by its ID. Use when you need details about a single webhook subscription.

tools.name: Get Webhook Activity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific webhook activity by its ID. Use when you need detailed information about a single webhook delivery event.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks configured for your account. Use after obtaining valid authentication.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of campaigns for the authenticated account. Use when you need to list all campaigns.

tools.name: List Campaign Tickets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all campaign tickets for a specific campaign. Use when you need to list tickets available for a campaign.

tools.name: List Contact Activities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all activities for a specific contact. Use when you need to view the activity history of a contact, optionally filtered by activity type.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of contacts from your Givebutter account. Use when you need to list all contacts with optional filtering by type, date ranges, contribution amounts, tags, or sorting preferences.

tools.name: List Discount Codes
tools.description: Tool to list all discount codes for a campaign. Use when you need to retrieve all active and inactive discount codes associated with a specific campaign.

tools.name: List Funds
tools.description: Tool to list all funds in your Givebutter account. Returns paginated results with up to 20 funds per page. Use when you need to retrieve multiple funds or browse all available funds.

tools.name: List Household Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contacts associated with a household. Use when you need to list contacts for a specific household ID.

tools.name: List Households
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all households in your account. Use when you need to view or manage household groups and their associated contacts.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of messages. Use when you need to list messages sent through your Givebutter account. Returns paginated results; use the page parameter to navigate through pages.

tools.name: List Pledges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all pledges. Use when you need to list pledges with optional pagination support.

tools.name: List Webhook Activities
tools.description: Tool to list all webhook activities for a specific webhook. Use when you need to retrieve activity logs for a webhook subscription.

tools.name: Remove Contact Tags
tools.description: Tool to remove tags from a contact in Givebutter. Use when you need to disassociate specific tags from a contact record. Requires the contact ID and a list of tag names to remove.

tools.name: Restore Contact
