tools.name: Delete Place Action Link
tools.description: Permanently delete a public Google Business Profile place-action link. Warning: Destructive: customers may lose the linked action immediately.

tools.name: Delete Review Reply
tools.description: Permanently remove the merchant's public reply from a Google Business Profile review. Warning: Destructive and public-facing: the existing merchant reply is permanently removed; confirm the exact review before calling.

tools.name: Find Chains
tools.description: Search Google Business Profile chains by display name, or return one chain by its exact chain resource name. Provide exactly one of chain_resource_name or chain_name.

tools.name: Generate Verification Token
tools.description: Generate a Google Business Profile instant verification token for an unverified listing identified by its final location ID. The connected caller must own or manage the listing. A returned token is sensitive: use it only for the intended location and never log, disclose, or reuse it.

tools.name: Get Accounts
tools.description: List one page of Business Profile accounts accessible to the connected Google user, or return one exact account when account_name is supplied.

tools.name: Get Categories
tools.description: Search one page of localized Google Business Profile categories, or fetch up to 100 exact stable category resource names in one batch.

tools.name: Get Daily Metrics
tools.description: Return one or more daily Google Business Profile performance metrics over an inclusive date range, normalized into one list of metric time series. This Performance v1 action replaces the discontinued v4 location insights report for metrics that Google migrated.

tools.name: Get Follower Metadata
tools.description: Return the total follower count for a verified Google Business Profile location connected to Google Maps.

tools.name: Get Food Menus
tools.description: Return food menus for an eligible Google Business Profile location, optionally restricted to top-level fields by a read mask.

tools.name: Get Google-Updated Location
tools.description: Return Google's consumer-facing version of a Business Profile location and field masks describing differences and pending merchant changes.

tools.name: Get Local Posts
tools.description: List one page of local posts for a Google Business Profile location, or return one exact post when post_name is supplied.

tools.name: Get Location
tools.description: Return selected merchant-managed fields for one Business Profile location. Use read_mask=serviceItems to read services through the supported Business Information v1 replacement for the deprecated v4 service-list read.

tools.name: Get Location Attributes
tools.description: Return either merchant-set or Google-displayed attributes for one Google Business Profile location, preserving attribute identifiers and typed values.

tools.name: Get Lodging
tools.description: Return merchant-set hotel lodging data or Google's displayed lodging data and the fields Google changed.

tools.name: Get Media
tools.description: List one page of merchant or customer-contributed media for a Google Business Profile location, or return one exact media item.

tools.name: Get Notification Setting
tools.description: Return an account's Google Pub/Sub topic and enabled Business Profile notification types.

tools.name: Get Place Action Links
tools.description: List one page of a Google Business Profile location's place-action links, or return one exact link when link_name is supplied.

tools.name: Get Reviews
tools.description: Return one exact Google Business Profile review, one page for a verified location, or one account-batch page across up to 50 verified locations.

tools.name: Get Voice of Merchant State
tools.description: Return whether a Google Business Profile location has merchant control and the next required verification, ownership, review, or policy action.

tools.name: Invite Admin
tools.description: Invite a user or location group to administer a Google Business Profile account or location. Location groups can be invited only to locations. This changes who can manage the business and may send an invitation; confirm the parent resource, recipient, and role before calling.

tools.name: List Admins
tools.description: Return administrators and their roles for a Google Business Profile account or location.

tools.name: List Attribute Metadata
tools.description: Return one page of valid Google Business Profile attribute definitions for a location or a category and region, including value constraints.

tools.name: List Invitations
tools.description: Return pending account invitations, optionally filtered by target type.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: Return one page of Google Business Profile locations in an account, with the fields selected by read_mask and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List Place Action Type Metadata
tools.description: Return one page of place-action types, such as appointment or food-ordering links, available for a Google Business Profile location or region.

tools.name: List Search Keyword Impressions
tools.description: Return one page of monthly search keyword impression counts for a Google Business Profile location and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List Verification Options
tools.description: List the verification methods currently eligible for one Google Business Profile location in a requested language. This is a non-mutating discovery step to run before starting verification.

tools.name: List Verifications
tools.description: Return one page of verification attempts and states for a Google Business Profile location, plus a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: Search Google Locations
tools.description: Find an existing Google Maps location by free-form query or structured location data before creating or claiming a Business Profile. Provide exactly one of query or location. Google policy restricts this search to merchants with an existing business relationship with the caller and solely to creating or claiming their locations; never use it for lead generation. This is the supported Business Information v1 successor to the deprecated v4 findMatches operation.

tools.name: Start Verification
tools.description: Start Google Business Profile verification with a method currently eligible for the location. Warning: this is a consequential, policy-gated external side effect that may send mail, email, an SMS, or a phone call. Call it only on the business owner's direct request, using an option Google returned from List Verification Options.

tools.name: Transfer Location
tools.description: Transfer a Google Business Profile location to another account administered by the connected user. High-consequence ownership move: confirm both resource names before calling; this can disrupt management access and is not automatically reversible.

tools.name: Update Account
tools.description: Rename a non-personal Business Profile account; validate_only checks the request without applying it.

tools.name: Update Admin
tools.description: Change a Google Business Profile account or location administrator's role. This alters their access to the business; confirm the administrator and replacement role before calling.

tools.name: Update Food Menus
tools.description: Replace or update food-menu data for an eligible Google Business Profile location. Warning: menu content is customer-facing; omitting update_mask performs a full update that may clear omitted fields, and repeated menu elements cannot be updated individually.

tools.name: Update Local Post
tools.description: Update selected fields on an existing Google Business Profile local post. Warning: changes affect already-published customer-facing content; verify the post, text, links, dates, and offer terms before calling.

tools.name: Update Location
tools.description: Update selected merchant-managed fields on a Google Business Profile location. Public listing changes can immediately affect Search and Maps; use validate_only before consequential edits. Use update_mask=serviceItems to replace services through the supported Business Information v1 replacement for the deprecated v4 service-list update.

tools.name: Update Location Attributes
tools.description: Set or clear selected merchant-managed attributes on a Google Business Profile location. Warning: every ID in attribute_mask that is omitted from attributes is deleted; inspect attribute metadata and current values first.

tools.name: Update Lodging
tools.description: Update selected lodging, amenity, policy, accessibility, service, or sustainability fields for a Google Business Profile hotel location. Warning: these values can become public hotel details; verify the field mask and payload.

tools.name: Update Media
tools.description: Update the category association of merchant-owned Google Business Profile media. Warning: changing this metadata can immediately alter how public media is categorized or displayed; COVER and PROFILE cannot be assigned.

tools.name: Update Notification Setting
tools.description: Set or clear an account's Pub/Sub topic and replace its enabled Google Business Profile notification types. Warning: notification_types is a complete replacement, and clearing either setting can stop event delivery.

tools.name: Update Place Action Link
tools.description: Update a Google Business Profile place-action link's URL, action type, or preferred status. Warning: changes may immediately alter the customer-facing action links shown for the location.

tools.name: Update Review Reply
tools.description: Create or replace a merchant reply to a Google Business Profile review. Only call this after obtaining explicit end-client authorization from the represented business. Google moderates the reply; inspect review_reply_state to determine whether it is pending, rejected, or approved for public display.

tools.name: Upload Location Media
tools.description: Upload a photo file and publish it on a Google Business Profile location in one operation. This creates customer-facing media on Search and Maps; confirm the exact location, image, and association before calling. Final publish errors or malformed responses can be ambiguous: publication may have succeeded, so list the location's media before retrying to avoid duplicates. If byte upload succeeds but publishing fails, temporary uploaded bytes can remain until Google expires them because Google provides no cleanup API.

name: Google Chat
description: Google Chat API integration for messaging and collaboration in Google Workspace

tools.name: Complete Space Import
tools.description: Completes the import process for an import-mode Google Chat space and makes it visible to users. Use this action at the end of a data migration into Google Workspace, after all messages and memberships have been imported into a space that was created with `importMode: true`. Requires user authentication with domain-wide delegation (service-account flow) and the `chat.import` OAuth scope. Cannot be called with regular user OAuth.

tools.name: Create Custom Emoji
tools.description: Creates a custom emoji in Google Chat for use within an organization. Use this action when you need to add a custom emoji that can be used by members of your Google Workspace organization. The emoji will be available in Google Chat after creation. Note: Custom emojis are only available for Google Workspace accounts and require the administrator to enable custom emojis for the organization. This is a Developer Preview feature.

tools.name: Create Space Member
tools.description: Creates a membership for a user, Chat app, or Google Group in a space. When creating a membership, if the member has auto-accept turned off, they're invited and must accept the invitation before joining. Use this action when you need to add a new member to a Google Chat space. This can be used to invite individual users, add Chat apps, or add Google Groups to a space. If the member requires acceptance, they will receive an invitation. Note: `parent` must be the resource name of a space that already exists - this action does not create one. To start a new direct message with a user, use GOOGLE_CHAT_SET_UP_SPACE instead, which creates the DM space and adds the member in one call. Note: App authentication cannot add users external to the Workspace organization, add Google Groups, or add Chat apps to a space.

tools.name: Create Message
tools.description: Creates a message in a Google Chat space. With user authentication, only text messages are supported. Maximum message size is 32,000 bytes. Use this action when you need to send a message to a Google Chat space or channel. Reply to an existing thread using thread_name, including threads started by people or other apps. Use thread_key for threads created by the calling Chat app; it only joins an existing thread when message_reply_option is set. With thread_name, replies default to REPLY_MESSAGE_OR_FAIL unless message_reply_option is provided. Messages can mention users using '@username' syntax. Note: `parent` must be the resource name of a space that already exists - this action does not create one. To send a first-time direct message to a user, call GOOGLE_CHAT_SET_UP_SPACE first to get-or-create the DM space, then pass its returned name as `parent` here. Note: With user auth, only plain text messages are supported. Card-based messages require bot authentication.

tools.name: Create Reaction
tools.description: Creates an emoji reaction on a Google Chat message. Use this action when you need to add an emoji reaction (like 👍, ❤️, or 🎉) to an existing message in a Google Chat space. Either emoji_unicode or emoji_custom_id is required, but not both. This action is useful for acknowledging messages, voting on ideas, expressing emotions in response to messages, or building interactive message features in Google Chat bots.

tools.name: Create section
tools.description: Creates a custom section in Google Chat for organizing conversations in the navigation panel. Use when you need to create a new custom section to organize spaces and direct messages in the user's Chat sidebar.

tools.name: Create Space
tools.description: Creates a named space in Google Chat. The calling user is automatically added as a member and space manager. For a group chat or direct message, use GOOGLE_CHAT_SET_UP_SPACE instead. Use this action when you need to create a discoverable named space for team collaboration or project discussions. For group conversations without a named space, use GOOGLE_CHAT_SET_UP_SPACE. Note: If you receive the error ALREADY_EXISTS when creating a space, try a different displayName. The displayName must be unique within the organization.

tools.name: Delete Custom Emoji
tools.description: Deletes a custom emoji from Google Chat. By default, users can only delete custom emojis they created. Emoji managers assigned by the administrator can delete any custom emoji in the organization. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a custom emoji that is no longer needed. This action is irreversible — once deleted, the custom emoji cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete Member from Space
tools.description: Removes a user, Google Group, or app from a space. This action is irreversible — once removed, the member cannot be recovered and will need to be re-added to the space. Use when you need to remove a specific member from a Google Chat space. Note: Deleted members will lose access to the space immediately and will need to be re-invited if they need access again.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Deletes a message from a Google Chat space. Use this action when you need to remove a message that is no longer needed, was posted in error, or is outdated. App authentication can only delete messages created by the calling Chat app. User authentication with proper permissions can delete any message in a space they manage. This action is irreversible — once deleted, the message cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete Reaction
tools.description: Deletes a reaction to a message. Use when you need to remove a reaction that was previously added to a message. Users can only delete their own reactions. This action is irreversible — once the reaction is deleted, it cannot be recovered.

tools.name: Delete section
tools.description: Deletes a custom section from Google Chat by its ID. This action is irreversible — once a section is deleted, it cannot be recovered. If the section contains items (such as spaces), they are moved to Google Chat's default sections and are not deleted. Use when you need to remove a custom section that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete space
tools.description: Deletes a named space from Google Chat. Always performs a cascading delete, which means that the space's child resources like messages and memberships are also deleted. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a Google Chat space and all associated data. This action is irreversible — the space and all its messages and memberships cannot be recovered once deleted.

tools.name: Download Media
tools.description: Downloads the bytes of a Google Chat message attachment via the media API. Use this after `get_attachment` to fetch the actual file content for an attachment. The `resource_name` parameter is the `attachmentDataRef.resourceName` returned by `get_attachment`. Returns the downloaded file. The download endpoint adds `?alt=media` automatically, which is required by Google to return raw bytes rather than the JSON Media resource.

tools.name: Find Direct Message
tools.description: Returns the existing direct message space with the specified user. Use this action when you need to find an existing DM space with a particular user, such as when checking if a DM already exists before creating one or when you need the space resource name for subsequent operations. If no direct message space exists with the specified user, this action returns a NOT_FOUND (404) error. Note: This only finds existing DM spaces - it does not create a new one. To start a new DM (or safely get-or-create one), use the GOOGLE_CHAT_SET_UP_SPACE action instead.

tools.name: Find Group Chats
tools.description: Finds all group chat spaces that contain exactly the calling user and the specified users. This action uses the Google Chat Developer Preview API to search for GROUP_CHAT spaces whose human memberships contain exactly the calling user and the specified users. Use this action when you need to find existing group chats that include specific participants.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Gets the metadata of a Google Chat message attachment. Returns the attachment's content type, filename, source, and references that can be used to download the file via the media API. To fetch the binary bytes of the attachment, pass the returned `attachmentDataRef.resourceName` to the `download_media` action. Requires Chat app authentication (the `chat.bot` scope) — this endpoint is not callable with regular user OAuth.

tools.name: Get Custom Emoji
tools.description: Returns details about a custom emoji in Google Chat. Custom emojis are only available for Google Workspace accounts, and the administrator must turn custom emojis on for the organization. Use this action when you need to retrieve information about a specific custom emoji, such as its name, unique identifier, or temporary image URL. This is useful for displaying emoji details or verifying emoji existence before performing other operations. Note: The `payload` field is only populated when creating or updating custom emojis and is not returned when getting emoji details.

tools.name: Get Chat Space Member
tools.description: Returns details about a membership in a space. Use this action when you need to retrieve information about a specific member's relationship with a Google Chat space, including their role, state, and user details.

tools.name: Get Message
tools.description: Returns details about a specific message in a Google Chat space. Use this action when you need to retrieve the full content, sender information, thread details, and other metadata for a particular message. Requires user authentication with an appropriate Google Chat OAuth scope.

tools.name: Get Space
tools.description: Returns details about a specific Google Chat space including configuration, membership count, and access settings. Use this action when you need to retrieve information about a specific space in Google Chat, such as getting the space's display name, description, membership count, threading state, or access settings. Note: Some response fields are only populated based on the OAuth scopes used. The accessSettings, predefinedPermissionSettings, and permissionSettings fields are only populated when using the chat.app.spaces scope. Requires user authentication with one of the following OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.admin.spaces - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.admin.spaces.readonly - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.app.spaces - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.bot - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces.readonly

tools.name: Get Space Event
tools.description: Returns an event from a Google Chat space. The event payload contains the most recent version of the resource that changed. Use this action when you need to retrieve details about a specific space event, such as a new message, membership change, reaction, or space update. If the resource was modified after the event occurred, the server returns the updated resource in the event payload. Note: The `permissionSettings` field is not returned in the Space object of the Space event.

tools.name: Get Space Notification Setting
tools.description: Gets the notification settings for a user in a specific space. Use when you need to retrieve the caller's space notification setting, including whether notifications are muted and what type of notifications are enabled. Requires user authentication with the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.spacesettings` OAuth scope.

tools.name: Get space read state
tools.description: Returns details about a user's read state within a space. Use this action when you need to identify which messages in a space have been read or unread by the user.

tools.name: Get thread read state
tools.description: Returns details about a user's read state within a thread. Use this action when you need to identify which messages in a specific thread have been read or unread by the user.

tools.name: List custom emojis
tools.description: Lists custom emojis visible to the authenticated user in Google Chat. Use this action when you need to retrieve all custom emojis available in Google Chat for the authenticated user. This is useful for displaying available emojis, filtering by creator, or enumerating organization-specific custom emojis. Supports pagination via pageSize and pageToken parameters. By default, returns up to 25 emojis.

tools.name: List Space Members
tools.description: Lists memberships in a space. Returns a list of all members including users, bots, and Google Groups. Use when you need to retrieve all members of a Google Chat space, such as to get a list of participants, check who has access, or find specific members by role or type. Supports pagination when there are many members in a space. Use the nextPageToken from a response to fetch subsequent pages.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Lists non-system messages from one Google Chat space that the authenticated user is a member of, including messages from blocked members and spaces. Returns the matching message records and a next-page token. Use this action for message history filtered by creation time or one thread. It does not search message text or filter by sender; use GOOGLE_CHAT_SEARCH_MESSAGES for keywords, senders, mentions, attachments, or searches across spaces. Requires user authentication with one of the following OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.messages - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.messages.readonly - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.import

tools.name: List reactions on a message
tools.description: Lists all reactions on a specific message in a Google Chat space. Use when you need to retrieve all emoji reactions (likes, thumbs up, hearts, etc.) that users have added to a message. This action is read-only and does not modify any data. The results can be filtered by emoji type or user using the filter parameter.

tools.name: List Section Items
tools.description: Lists all items (such as spaces) within a specified section of a user's Google Chat. Use when you need to retrieve all items grouped under a section in Google Chat, or when implementing pagination to fetch all items across multiple pages. Sections can be system sections like 'default-spaces' or custom sections created by the user. Requires user authentication with the `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.sections.readonly` (read-only) or `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.sections` (full access) OAuth scope.

tools.name: List Sections
tools.description: Lists all sections available to the authenticated user in Google Chat. Use this action when you need to retrieve all sections for organizing conversations in the navigation panel. Sections include custom sections created by the user and system sections like default direct messages, default spaces, and default apps. Requires user authentication with one of the following OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.sections - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.sections.readonly

tools.name: List Space Events
tools.description: Lists events from a Google Chat space. Use when you need to retrieve historical events such as new messages, membership changes, or reactions from a specific Google Chat space. The filter parameter is required and must specify event type filters. Note: This action requires specifying event type filters in the filter parameter. Supported event types include message events (created, updated, deleted), membership events (created, updated, deleted), and reaction events.

tools.name: List Spaces
tools.description: Lists spaces the authenticated user is a member of in Google Chat. Use this action when you need to retrieve all spaces that the user belongs to, such as displaying available spaces or finding a specific space. Note: Group chats and direct messages (DMs) are not listed until the first message is sent. Requires user authentication with one of the following OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces.readonly - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.bot

tools.name: Move Section Item
tools.description: Moves a space from one section to another in Google Chat. Use when organizing spaces into different sections, such as moving a space from the default-spaces section to a custom user-created section. The action updates the section membership of the specified space item.

tools.name: Position Section in Sidebar
tools.description: Changes the sort order of a section in the Google Chat sidebar. Use when you need to reorder sections in the sidebar. Either sortOrder (absolute position) or relativePosition (START/END) must be provided to specify the new position.

tools.name: Replace Message (Full)
tools.description: Replaces an existing message in a Google Chat space using full replacement. Use this action when you need to completely replace a message's content, including text, cards, and other properties. Unlike patch which modifies specific fields, this action replaces the entire message. Note: Google recommends using the patch method for partial updates. This PUT method does a full replacement of the specified fields. App authentication can only replace messages created by the calling Chat app. User authentication with appropriate permissions can replace any message in spaces they manage.

tools.name: Search Messages
tools.description: Searches for messages across Google Chat spaces the caller has access to. Use this action to find messages by keyword, sender, space, attachment presence, or mentions, instead of paging through ListMessages for a single space. Excludes private messages, Chat app messages, messages from blocked users, and messages in muted spaces. Requires user authentication with one of the following core OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.messages - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.messages.readonly Some filters and FULL-view metadata require the additional scopes documented on their request fields. Display-name enrichment is best-effort and optional.

tools.name: Search Spaces
tools.description: Searches for spaces across a Google Workspace organization using administrator privileges. Use this action to find spaces in your Workspace org by filtering on create time, customer, display name, external user allowed, last active time, history state, or space type. Requires the caller to be a Google Workspace administrator and to pass `use_admin_access=true`. Requires one of the chat.admin.spaces / chat.admin.spaces.readonly scopes (or the equivalent user-mode chat.spaces / chat.spaces.readonly scopes).

tools.name: Setup Space
tools.description: Creates a Google Chat named space, group chat, human DM, or calling-app DM and can add initial members. The caller is added automatically. Named spaces require displayName. Group chats require at least two memberships. Human DMs require exactly one HUMAN membership. For a calling-app DM, set singleUserBotDm to true and omit memberships. An existing human DM is returned. Google groups can only join named spaces. This is the only action that creates DIRECT_MESSAGE or GROUP_CHAT spaces; CREATE_SPACE, CREATE_MESSAGE, and CREATE_MEMBER require an existing space. Requires user authentication with one of the following OAuth scopes: - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces - https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.spaces.create

tools.name: Update Member
tools.description: Updates a membership in a Google Chat space, such as changing a member's role between member and manager. Use this action when you need to modify a user's role or permissions within a Google Chat space.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Updates a message in a Google Chat space, modifying its text, cards, or other properties. Use this action when you need to edit an existing message's content or properties. Supports partial updates via the updateMask parameter. App authentication can only update messages created by the calling Chat app. User authentication with appropriate permissions can update any message in spaces they manage.

tools.name: Update section
tools.description: Updates a section's display name in Google Chat. This action uses patch semantics for partial updates. Use when you need to rename an existing custom section in Google Chat. Only sections of type 'CUSTOM_SECTION' can be updated. System sections (like 'default-direct-messages', 'default-spaces', 'default-apps') cannot have their display names modified. Requires user authentication with the 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/chat.users.sections' scope.

tools.name: Update Space
tools.description: Updates a Google Chat space's configuration including display name, description, guidelines, history settings, access settings, and permission settings. Use this action when you need to modify the settings of an existing Google Chat space that you have admin or manager permissions for.

tools.name: Update Space Notification Setting
tools.description: Updates the notification settings for a user in a space. Use when you need to modify how a user receives notifications in a specific space, such as muting a noisy channel or changing the notification level to only important messages. Requires user authentication with the chat.users.spacesettings scope.

tools.name: Update Space Read State
tools.description: Updates a user's read state within a space, used to mark messages as read or unread. Use this action when you need to programmatically mark a Google Chat space as read or update the user's read position in a space. Note: To mark a space as unread, set lastReadTime to a value earlier than the latest message timestamp. To mark as read, set it to any value later than the latest message.

tools.name: Upload Media Attachment
tools.description: Uploads a file as an attachment to a Google Chat space using the multipart media upload endpoint. Use this when sending a file to a Chat space. The returned `attachmentUploadToken` can then be passed into `create_message` (under `attachments[].attachmentDataRef.attachmentUploadToken`) to include the file in a message. The upload uses Google's `multipart` upload protocol: a metadata part (JSON with `filename`) plus the binary file part, sent to `/upload/v1/{parent}/attachments:upload?uploadType=multipart`. Maximum file size is 200 MB. Requires user authentication. One of: `chat.import`, `chat.messages`, `chat.messages.create`.

name: Google Classroom
description: Google Classroom is a free web service developed by Google for schools that aims to simplify creating, distributing, and grading assignments

tools.name: Create Course Alias
tools.description: Tool to create an alias for a course. Use when you need to add an alternative identifier to a course after confirming the course ID.

tools.name: Delete Course Alias
tools.description: Tool to delete an alias of a course. Use when you need to remove an alias from a course after confirming the course ID and alias name.

tools.name: List Course Aliases
tools.description: Tool to list aliases for a course. Use when you need to retrieve all aliases associated with a specific course.

tools.name: Create Announcement
tools.description: Tool to create an announcement in a course. Use after confirming the course ID is valid.

tools.name: Delete Announcement
tools.description: Tool to delete an announcement. Use after confirming the announcement ID.

tools.name: Get Announcement
tools.description: Tool to get an announcement. Use when you need to fetch an announcement by course and announcement ID.

tools.name: Get Add-on Context for Announcement
tools.description: Tool to get metadata for Classroom add-ons in the context of a specific announcement post. Use when validating query parameters and user permissions for add-ons loading in an iframe. Returns the current user's role (student or teacher) with exactly one context field populated.

tools.name: List Announcements
tools.description: Tool to list announcements in a course. Use after you have the course ID to page through announcements.

tools.name: Modify Announcement Assignees
tools.description: Tool to modify assignee mode and options of an announcement. Use when you need to change who can view an announcement, either making it visible to all students or to specific students only.

tools.name: Patch Announcement
tools.description: Tool to update fields of an announcement. Use when you need to modify specific details of an existing announcement after confirming which fields to update.

tools.name: Delete Add-on Attachment
tools.description: Tool to delete an add-on attachment from a course announcement. Requires the add-on to have been the original creator of the attachment.

tools.name: Get Add-on Attachment

tools.name: Modify CourseWork Assignees

tools.name: Patch Course Work

tools.name: List Course Work Rubrics

tools.name: Get Course

tools.name: Get Grading Period Settings

tools.name: List Courses

tools.name: Patch Course
tools.description: Tool to update one or more fields of a Classroom course. Use after retrieving course details and confirming fields to update.

tools.name: List Post Add-on Attachments
tools.description: Tool to list all add-on attachments created under a post. Use when you need to retrieve attachments added by an add-on. Requires the add-on to have active attachments on the post or permission to create new attachments.

tools.name: Get Add-on Context for Post
tools.description: Tool to get metadata for Classroom add-ons in the context of a specific post. Use when validating query parameters and user permissions for add-ons loading in an iframe. Returns the current user's role (student or teacher) with exactly one context field populated.

tools.name: Delete Course Student

tools.name: Get Course Student

tools.name: List Student Guardians

tools.name: List Course Students

tools.name: Delete Course Teacher

tools.name: Get Teacher

tools.name: List Course Teachers

tools.name: Create Course Topic

tools.name: Delete CourseWork

tools.name: Get Coursework Material

tools.name: List CourseWorkMaterials

tools.name: List Student Submissions

name: Google Cloud Vision
description: Google Cloud Vision API enables developers to integrate vision detection features into applications, including image labeling, face and landmark detection, optical character recognition (OCR), and explicit content tagging.

tools.name: Annotate Files with Vision API
tools.description: Tool to perform image detection and annotation for batch files in Google Cloud Vision. Supports PDF, TIFF, and GIF files. Extracts up to 5 frames (GIF) or pages (PDF/TIFF) from each file and performs detection for each image. Use when you need to analyze documents or multi-page images with features like text detection, label detection, face detection, or other Vision API capabilities.

tools.name: Async Batch Annotate Files
tools.description: Tool to run asynchronous image detection and annotation for a list of generic files (PDF, TIFF, GIF). Use when processing multi-page documents that may contain multiple images per page. Results are written to Google Cloud Storage and progress can be tracked via the returned operation name using VisionGetOperation.

tools.name: Annotate Images
tools.description: Run image detection and annotation for a batch of images using Google Cloud Vision API. Performs various types of image analysis including face detection, landmark detection, logo detection, label detection, text detection (OCR), safe search detection, image properties, crop hints, web detection, product search, and object localization. Supports up to 16 images in a single batch request. Each image can have multiple feature types analyzed simultaneously.

tools.name: Annotate Images Async Batch
tools.description: Tool to run asynchronous image detection and annotation for a batch of images. Use when processing multiple images or large images that require longer processing time. Results are written to Google Cloud Storage as JSON files.

tools.name: Annotate Location Images
tools.description: Tool to run image detection and annotation for a batch of images scoped to a specific project and location. Performs various types of image analysis including label detection, face detection, landmark detection, logo detection, OCR text detection, safe search detection, image properties, crop hints, web detection, product search, and object localization. Supports processing up to 16 images per request with regional endpoint routing (us, asia, eu). Use this when you need to analyze images with location-specific processing for content extraction, text recognition, object detection, face identification, or landmark/logo recognition.

tools.name: Create Vision Product
tools.description: Creates a new Product resource in Google Cloud Vision Product Search. A Product represents a physical item that can be visually searched using reference images. After creating a product, you can add reference images to it and include it in product sets for visual search capabilities. Prerequisites: - Vision API must be enabled in your Google Cloud project - Product Search must be enabled - Valid project ID and location (us-west1, us-east1, europe-west1, or asia-east1) Use this action to: - Register a new product for visual search - Set up product metadata (display name, description, category, labels) - Obtain a product resource name for adding reference images

tools.name: Create Product Set
tools.description: Creates a new ProductSet resource in Google Cloud Vision Product Search. A ProductSet is a container for grouping related products together for visual search. After creating a product set, you can add products to it using the AddProductToProductSet action. Prerequisites: - Vision API must be enabled in your Google Cloud project - Product Search must be enabled - Valid project ID and location (us-west1, us-east1, europe-west1, or asia-east1) Use this action to: - Create a new product set container - Organize products into logical groups - Obtain a product set resource name for adding products

tools.name: Create ReferenceImage
tools.description: Tool to create a ReferenceImage under a product. Use when adding a new image to a product for detection.

tools.name: Delete Product
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Product and its associated reference images from Google Cloud Vision API. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone. The product metadata and all images are deleted immediately, though search queries against ProductSets may temporarily return cached results until caches refresh. Use this tool when you need to remove a product that is no longer needed. Ensure you have the correct product resource name before deletion.

tools.name: Get Product
tools.description: Tool to get information associated with a Product. Use when you have the product resource name and need its details.

tools.name: Get Product Set
tools.description: Tool to get a ProductSet. Use when you need metadata details of an existing ProductSet by its full resource name. Use after obtaining the resource name.

tools.name: Import Product Sets
tools.description: Asynchronously imports product sets and reference images from a CSV file stored in Google Cloud Storage. This bulk import operation creates ProductSets, Products, and ReferenceImages from a properly formatted CSV file. Returns a long-running Operation that can be polled for completion status. The import automatically creates new ProductSets and Products if they don't exist based on the IDs in the CSV. Use this when you need to: - Bulk import multiple products and images at once - Create product catalogs from existing CSV data - Set up initial product search datasets Note: Requires OAuth authentication with cloud-platform or cloud-vision scope, and read access to the GCS bucket.

tools.name: List Vision AI IndexEndpoints
tools.description: Lists IndexEndpoints in Vertex AI Vision for a given project and location. IndexEndpoints are deployed instances of image indexes used for visual search and retrieval in Vision AI's media warehouse. Use this tool to discover existing endpoints before querying them or to manage deployed indexes. IMPORTANT: Requires OAuth2 authentication (API keys are NOT supported). Needs 'visionai.indexEndpoints.list' IAM permission.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: Tool to list available Vision AI service locations for a project. Use when you need to discover supported regions before making region-specific API calls.

tools.name: List Vision API Operations
tools.description: Tool to list operations that match the specified filter. Use when you need to retrieve all operations under a specific project and location.

tools.name: Purge Products
tools.description: Tool to asynchronously delete products in a ProductSet or orphan products. Use when you need to clean up products at scale; ensure `force` is true to execute.

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Tool to update a Product's mutable fields: displayName, description, and productLabels. Use after confirming the product resource name.

tools.name: Update Product Set
tools.description: Tool to update a ProductSet resource. Use when you need to modify the displayName of an existing ProductSet.

tools.name: Add Product to ProductSet
tools.description: Add a Product to a ProductSet in Google Cloud Vision Product Search. This action associates a Product with a ProductSet, enabling the product to be included in product search queries against that set. Both resources must exist in the same Google Cloud project and location before calling this action. Key characteristics: - Idempotent: If the Product is already in the ProductSet, no change is made and no error occurs - Constraint: One Product can be added to at most 100 ProductSets - The Product and ProductSet must be in the same project and location - Valid locations: us-west1, us-east1, europe-west1, asia-east1 Use this after creating both a Product and a ProductSet to establish their association. Returns an empty response on success.

tools.name: Cancel Vision Operation
tools.description: Starts asynchronous cancellation of a long-running Vision API operation. Returns an empty response on successful cancellation request. Note that the server makes a best effort to cancel the operation, but success is not guaranteed. Use the Get Operation action to check if cancellation succeeded or if the operation completed despite the cancellation attempt. The server may return UNIMPLEMENTED if the operation does not support cancellation.

tools.name: Delete Vision API Operation
tools.description: Tool to delete a long-running Vision API operation. Use after confirming the operation name.

tools.name: Delete Product Set
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a ProductSet. Use after confirming the ProductSet's resource name.

tools.name: Delete Reference Image
tools.description: Permanently removes a reference image from a product in Google Cloud Vision Product Search. This action deletes the reference image association from the specified product. The image will be marked for deletion and removed during the next indexing operation. Note that the actual image file in Google Cloud Storage is not deleted. Use this when you need to: - Remove outdated or incorrect product reference images - Clean up test images from products - Update product imagery by removing old references Prerequisites: - The product must exist - The reference image must have been previously created under the product - You need the full resource path of the reference image (use List Reference Images if unknown)

tools.name: Get Vision API Operation
tools.description: Retrieves the latest state of a long-running Vision API operation. Use this to poll the status of asynchronous operations like importProductSets or purgeProducts. The operation name is returned when you start an async operation.

tools.name: Get Reference Image
tools.description: Tool to get information associated with a ReferenceImage. Use when you have the full resource name and need its metadata.

tools.name: List Products in ProductSet
tools.description: Tool to list Products in a specified ProductSet. Use when you need to retrieve Products associated with a ProductSet after confirming it exists, with optional pagination.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List Google Cloud projects accessible to the authenticated user via Cloud Resource Manager API. This action queries the Cloud Resource Manager API (not Vision API directly) to enumerate projects. It requires OAuth 2.0 authentication - API key auth is insufficient. Use this when you need to discover available project IDs before making Vision API calls that require project identifiers. Note: Returns projects you have 'resourcemanager.projects.get' permission on.

tools.name: List Reference Images
tools.description: Tool to list reference images for a product. Use when you need to retrieve stored reference images under a specified product resource name, with optional pagination.

tools.name: Remove Product from ProductSet
tools.description: Removes a Product from a specified ProductSet in Google Cloud Vision API. This operation unlinks a product from a product set but does not delete either resource. Both the product and product set must exist in the same Google Cloud project and location. The product must have been previously added to the product set for this operation to succeed. Use this when you need to reorganize products across product sets or remove a product from a set without deleting the product itself.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: The API key used to authenticate requests to the Google Cloud Vision API.

name: Google Data Studio
description: Google Data Studio is Google's business intelligence platform for creating dashboards and reports; its Asset API searches organizational assets and manages their sharing permissions.

tools.name: Add Members to Asset Role
tools.description: Ensure one or more members belong to a mutable asset role and verify each requested membership after the write.

tools.name: Get Asset Permissions
tools.description: Get every populated permission role and the current concurrency etag for one Google Data Studio asset.

tools.name: Replace Asset Permissions
tools.description: Replace all four mutable permission-role memberships for a Google Data Studio asset, preserving owners and rejecting stale etags. Every mutable role is required; pass an empty list to clear that role.

tools.name: Revoke Asset Member Permissions
tools.description: Remove one or more members from every removable role on a Google Data Studio asset and verify whether each was removed or already absent.

tools.name: Search Assets
tools.description: Search accessible Google Data Studio reports or data sources and return one page of asset metadata.

tools.name: Get Review

tools.name: Get Shipping Settings

tools.name: Get Terms Agreement State

tools.name: Get Terms Agreement State For Application

tools.name: List Quota Groups
tools.description: List one page of daily usage, daily limits, and per-minute limits for the method quota groups of a Merchant Center account. Quotas are shared by all methods listed in each group.

tools.name: List Quota Limits
tools.description: List one page of limits of a selected type that apply to a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: List Regions
tools.description: Lists one page of regions in a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: List Reviews
tools.description: Return one page of merchant or product reviews for a Merchant Center account. Merchant reviews use Reviews v1alpha; product reviews use Reviews v1.

tools.name: List Subaccounts
tools.description: List one page of subaccounts managed by an advanced Merchant Center account. This endpoint uses the advanced account's quota and is preferred over the general account list when enumerating subaccounts.

tools.name: Manage Loyalty Customer
tools.description: Insert or update a customer's Google Merchant loyalty tier, or remove the association by setting the tier to NON_MEMBER. Submit customer identifiers only after the customer has consented to Google storing and using their loyalty data. An empty response is a successful privacy-preserving or removal result and should not be retried.

tools.name: Propose Account Service
tools.description: Propose an account service for a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: Record LFP Sale
tools.description: Insert a Local Feed Partnership sale for a target Merchant Center merchant. The connected account must be allowlisted as an LFP provider.

tools.name: Render Account Issues
tools.description: Render a Merchant Center account's current issues, localized impact details, and available resolution actions for an interactive third-party UI. Call this during each business interaction instead of caching results, and sanitize the returned pre-rendered HTML before embedding it.

tools.name: Render Product Issues
tools.description: Render a Merchant Center product's current issues, localized impact details, and available resolution actions for an interactive third-party UI. Call this during each business interaction instead of caching results, and sanitize the returned pre-rendered HTML before embedding it.

tools.name: Request Inventory Verification
tools.description: Request inventory verification for a given merchant in a given country.

tools.name: Respond to Account Service
tools.description: Approve or reject a proposed Merchant Center account service. The decision changes the service relationship and cannot be undone by this action.

tools.name: Search Reports
tools.description: Run a Merchant Reports Query Language statement and return one page of query-selected report rows.

tools.name: Set Homepage Claim
tools.description: Claim or unclaim a Merchant Center account homepage. The connected user must have admin access. Overwrite is available only for claiming.

tools.name: Set Program State
tools.description: Enable or disable participation in one Merchant Center program by its canonical resource name.

tools.name: Trigger Issue Action
tools.description: Execute a business-requested Google Merchant issue-remediation action using a fresh context and form returned by RENDER_ACCOUNT_ISSUES for the same account with BUILT_IN_USER_INPUT_ACTIONS. Submit every dynamically required field. This changes provider state and cannot be undone by this action. The OAuth cloud project must be allowlisted through Google's Shopping API Support Form.

tools.name: Undelete Conversion Source
tools.description: Re-enable an archived Merchant Center Destination conversion source. Only Merchant Center Destination sources archived within their recovery period can be undeleted; deleted Google Analytics Link sources must be recreated.

tools.name: Update Account
tools.description: Update a standalone, advanced, or sub-account in Merchant Center. The caller must have administrator access to the account.

tools.name: Update Account Relationship
tools.description: Update an account relationship. Executing this action requires Merchant Center admin access.

tools.name: Update Account User
tools.description: Update a user's access rights in a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: Update Autofeed Settings
tools.description: Updates the autofeed settings of a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: Update Automatic Improvements
tools.description: Updates the automatic improvements of a Merchant Center account.

tools.name: Update Business Identity
tools.description: Updates the business identity of a Merchant Center account. The caller must have administrator access to the account.

tools.name: Update Business Info
tools.description: Updates the business info of a Merchant Center account. Executing this action requires administrator access to the account.

tools.name: Update Checkout Settings
tools.description: Updates CheckoutSettings for the given merchant.

tools.name: Update Conversion Source
tools.description: Updates information for an existing Merchant Center Destination conversion source.

tools.name: Update Data Source
tools.description: Updates an existing Merchant Center data source. Fields included in the update mask but omitted from the body are deleted.

tools.name: Update Email Preferences
tools.description: Update email preferences for the authenticated Merchant Center account user. Advanced-account users must identify the advanced account rather than a sub-account.

tools.name: Update Homepage
tools.description: Update a store's Merchant Center homepage. The connected user must have administrator access to the account.

tools.name: Update Notification Subscription
tools.description: Updates an existing notification subscription for a merchant.

tools.name: Update Omnichannel Setting
tools.description: Update the omnichannel setting for a given merchant in a given country.

tools.name: Update Product Input
tools.description: Updates an existing product input in Merchant Center through an API data source. Masked attributes omitted from the body are deleted.

tools.name: Update Region
tools.description: Updates a region definition in your Merchant Center account. The connected user must have administrator access to the account.

tools.name: Update UCP Settings
tools.description: Patches UCP settings for a Merchant Center account and starts asynchronous validation of the public UCP profile.

tools.name: Upsert LFP Inventory
tools.description: Insert or fully replace a local inventory record for a target merchant as an allowlisted Local Feeds Partnership provider. The record expires automatically after 30 days.

tools.name: Upsert LFP Store
tools.description: Insert a Local Feed Partnership store for a target merchant, replacing the existing store when the same store code already exists. The connected account must be allowlisted as an LFP partner.

tools.name: Upsert Order Tracking Signal
tools.description: Submit one delivered order's tracking signal to Google Merchant, or update the existing signal by submitting newer data with the same order ID.

tools.name: Upsert Product Input
tools.description: Uploads a product input through an API data source, replacing an existing input with the same language, offer ID, and data source. Processing can take several minutes.

tools.name: Upsert Product Inventory
tools.description: Insert or fully replace one local store inventory record or regional inventory record for a processed Merchant Center product. Changes can take up to 30 minutes to appear in products.

tools.name: Upsert Promotion
tools.description: Insert a promotion into a Merchant Center account, replacing the existing promotion when its country, language, channels, and promotion ID match. The account must have the Promotions program enabled.

tools.name: Upsert Review
tools.description: Insert or replace one Merchant Center merchant review or product review through its matching review data source. Merchant reviews use the current indexed v1alpha API; product reviews use the available stable v1 API.

tools.name: Upsert Shipping Settings
tools.description: Replace a business's shipping settings. Requires admin access to the target Merchant Center account.

tools.name: Verify Current User
tools.description: Update the connected Merchant Center user from pending to verified for an account.

name: Google Search Console
description: Google Search Console provides tools to monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot your site's presence in Google Search results.

tools.name: Add Site
tools.description: Adds a site to the set of the user's sites in Google Search Console. This action registers a new property (site) in Google Search Console for the authenticated user. After adding the site, you will need to verify ownership through one of the available verification methods. The site URL must be properly formatted as either a URL-prefix property (with protocol) or a domain property (with sc-domain prefix).

tools.name: Delete Site
tools.description: Removes a site from the user's Google Search Console sites. This action permanently removes a site property from the authenticated user's Search Console account. The site URL must be URL-encoded. Use this when you need to unregister a site from tracking in Search Console.

tools.name: Get Site
tools.description: Retrieves information about a specific Search Console site. Use when you need to get site details including permission level for a specific property.

tools.name: Get Sitemap
tools.description: Retrieves sitemap metadata (submitted/indexed counts, errors, warnings, last-submission timestamps) for a specific sitemap in Search Console. Returns metadata only, not raw XML content. Note: numeric fields like `errors`, `warnings`, `submitted`, and `indexed` may be returned as strings; cast to int before comparisons. Values such as `contents.indexed` can lag several days after submission.

tools.name: Inspect URL
tools.description: Inspects a URL for indexing issues and status in Google Search Console. Results may reflect cached data lagging real changes by several days. High-volume use can trigger 429 quota errors; limit to priority URLs.

tools.name: List Sitemaps
tools.description: Lists all sitemaps for a site in Google Search Console. Response fields `errors`, `warnings`, `contents.submitted`, and `contents.indexed` may be returned as strings; cast to integers before numeric operations. Evaluate these fields alongside `isPending` for sitemap health.

tools.name: List Sites
tools.description: Lists all verified sites (properties) owned by the authenticated user in Google Search Console. Response contains a siteEntry array — always iterate it, never assume a single object. Each entry includes permissionLevel, which varies per site; do not assume owner-level access for all returned properties. When calling downstream tools, use the site_url value exactly as returned, including protocol, subdomain, sc-domain: prefix, and trailing slash — any deviation causes empty results or permission errors. Empty siteEntry may indicate missing OAuth scopes or no verified properties. Newly added properties may not appear immediately due to propagation delay.

tools.name: Search Analytics Query
tools.description: Queries Google Search Console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, CTR, and position metrics. Only returns URLs with at least one impression; missing rows do not confirm non-indexing. Position is an impression-weighted average rank.

tools.name: Submit Sitemap
tools.description: Submits a sitemap to Google Search Console for indexing. This action registers or resubmits a sitemap for a verified property in Google Search Console. The sitemap file must be accessible at the specified URL and properly formatted as XML. Supported sitemap types include standard sitemaps, sitemap index files, RSS feeds, and Atom feeds. The authenticated user must have site owner or full user permissions for the property. After submission, Google will crawl and process the sitemap according to its standard indexing schedule.

name: Google Slides
description: Google Slides is a cloud-based presentation editor with real-time collaboration, template gallery, and integration with other Google Workspace apps

tools.name: Create Google Slides Presentation
tools.description: Tool to create a blank Google Slides presentation. Use when you need to initialize a new presentation with a specific title, locale, or page size.

tools.name: Create Slides from Markdown
tools.description: Creates a new Google Slides presentation from Markdown text. Automatically splits content into slides using '---' separators and applies appropriate templates based on content structure.

tools.name: Get Page Thumbnail v2
tools.description: Tool to generate a thumbnail of the latest version of a specified page. Use when you need a preview image URL for a slide page. This request counts as an expensive read request for quota purposes.

tools.name: Update Presentation (Batch/Markdown)
tools.description: Update Google Slides presentations using markdown content or raw API text. Supports professional themes, auto-formatting, and multiple slide types (title, bullet, table, quote, image, two-column).

tools.name: Copy Google Slides from Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new Google Slides presentation by duplicating an existing template deck via Drive file copy. Use when you need to preserve themes, masters, and layouts exactly as they appear in the template. After copying, use GOOGLESLIDES_PRESENTATIONS_BATCH_UPDATE to replace placeholder text or images.

tools.name: Get Presentation
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest version of a presentation. Use after obtaining the presentation ID.

tools.name: Get Presentation Page
tools.description: Tool to get the latest version of a specific page in a presentation. Use when you need to inspect slide, layout, master, or notes page details.

tools.name: Get Page Thumbnail (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use GOOGLESLIDES_GET_PAGE_THUMBNAIL2 instead. Tool to generate and return a thumbnail image URL for a specific page. Use when you need a quick preview of a slide page after loading it.

triggers.name: New Slide Added
triggers.description: Fires when a new slide is added to a Google Slides presentation.
