tools.description: Tool to retrieve all benefits supported by Gusto. Use when you need to discover available benefit types, their tax considerations, or determine which benefits can be created for companies.

tools.name: List Benefits Requirements
tools.description: Tool to retrieve field requirements for a specific benefit type. Use when you need to understand what fields are required, editable, or have specific constraints for enrolling employees in benefits.

tools.name: List Company Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the custom fields configured for a company. Use when you need to know the schema of custom fields at the company level.

tools.name: List Companies Time Off Requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all time off requests for a company in Gusto. Use when you need to view pending, approved, denied, or cancelled time off requests submitted by employees.

tools.name: List Company Bank Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all bank accounts for a specific company. Currently, Gusto only supports a single default bank account per company. Use when you need to view company banking details for payroll processing.

tools.name: List Company Benefits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all benefits offered by a company. Use when you need to list available company benefits, check benefit statuses, or see employee enrollment information. Company benefits represent the benefits that a company offers to employees and can be filtered by active status or benefit type.

tools.name: List Company Benefits Contribution Exclusions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contributions for a given company benefit and whether they are excluded or not. Use when you need to check which contribution types are excluded from a specific benefit. Currently only works for 401-k and Roth 401-k benefit types.

tools.name: List Company Benefits Employee Benefits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all employee benefits for a specific company benefit. Use when you need to see which employees are enrolled in a particular company benefit and their enrollment details. Returns employee-specific benefit information including contribution amounts, deduction percentages, and coverage details.

tools.name: List Company Forms
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all company's forms. Use when you need to retrieve all forms associated with a specific company, including tax forms and other company documents.

tools.name: List Contractor Documents
tools.description: Tool to get all documents for a specific contractor in Gusto. Use when you need to retrieve contractor documents including tax forms, agreements, and other signed or unsigned documents with their details and status.

tools.name: List Contractor Forms
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all contractor's forms. Use when you need to retrieve all forms associated with a specific contractor, including tax forms and other contractor documents.

tools.name: List contractor onboarding status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a contractor's onboarding status from Gusto. Use when you need to check contractor onboarding progress and view completion status of required onboarding steps.

tools.name: List Contractor Payment Details
tools.description: Tool to get payment details for contractors in a company, including their payment methods and bank account details for direct deposit. Use when you need to retrieve contractor payment information such as bank routing numbers, account details, or payment split configurations.

tools.name: List Contractor Payment Method
tools.description: Tool to fetch a contractor's payment method configuration. Use when you need to retrieve how contractor payments are split across bank accounts or if they are paid by check.

tools.name: List Contractors
tools.description: Tool to get all contractors for a company including individuals and businesses. Use when you need to retrieve contractor information, filter by onboarding or termination status, or search for specific contractors by name.

tools.name: List Employee Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the custom fields configured for an employee. Use when you need to get the custom field values for a specific employee.

tools.name: List Employee Forms
tools.description: Tool to get a list of all employee's forms. Use when you need to retrieve all forms associated with a specific employee, including tax forms and other employee documents.

tools.name: List Employee Home Addresses
tools.description: Tool to get an employee's home addresses. The home address is used to determine certain tax information and supports effective dating and courtesy withholding. Use when you need to retrieve address information for tax purposes or employee records.

tools.name: List employee onboarding status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an employee's onboarding status from Gusto. Use when you need to check the onboarding progress and completion status of required steps for a specific employee.

tools.name: List Employees
tools.description: Tool to get all employees for a given company including onboarding, active, and terminated employees. Use when you need to retrieve employee information for a specific company.

tools.name: List Employee Work Addresses
tools.description: Tool to get all work addresses for a specific employee. Use when you need to retrieve address information for all work locations associated with an employee, including historical and active addresses.

tools.name: List Employment History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve employment history for a given employee, including terminations and rehires. Use when you need to view the complete work history for a specific employee.

tools.name: List Child Support Agencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve child support agency data including FIPS codes, payment requirements, and required attributes for each state. Use when you need to lookup agency-specific requirements before creating a child support garnishment.

tools.name: List Information Requests
tools.description: Tool to fetch all information requests for a company in Gusto. Use when you need to retrieve pending, under review, or approved information requests that may be blocking payroll.

tools.name: List job compensations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all compensations for a specific job in Gusto. Use when you need information on how much is paid out for a job. Jobs may have many compensations, but only one that is active. By default returns only the current compensation.

tools.name: List migration readiness
tools.description: Tool to check if a Gusto company is ready to be migrated to embedded payroll. Returns blockers and warnings for migration. Use this before attempting to migrate a company.

tools.name: List Minimum Wages
tools.description: Tool to get minimum wages for a specific location. Use when you need to retrieve minimum wage information for a location, optionally filtered by effective date.

tools.name: List Notifications
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all notifications relevant for a company. Returns notifications that can be filtered by status (open, expired, resolved). Use when you need to check pending actions, critical alerts, or payroll blockers for a company.

tools.name: List Paid Holidays
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a company's paid holidays from Gusto. Use when you need to preview the paid holidays for a company based on their holiday pay policy.

tools.name: List Employee Payment Details
tools.description: Tool to fetch payment details for employees in a company including payment methods and bank account details. Use when you need to retrieve employee payment information such as bank routing numbers, account details, or payment split configurations.

tools.name: List Pay Periods
tools.description: Tool to retrieve pay periods for a company. Pay periods are the foundation of payroll and are used for compensation, time & attendance, taxes, and expense reports. Use when you need to get pay period information for submitting payroll data.

tools.name: List Payroll Blockers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all payroll blockers for a company. Returns reasons that prevent the company from running payrolls, or an empty list if no blockers exist. Use when you need to check if a company can run payroll or identify issues that need to be resolved before payroll processing.

tools.name: List Payroll Reversals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all approved payroll reversals for a company. Use when you need to view reversals that have been applied to previous payroll runs.

tools.name: List pay schedules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all pay schedules for a company. Use when you need to get information about when employees work and when they should be paid for a specific company.

tools.name: List pay schedules assignments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current pay schedule assignment for a company, including pay schedules and employee/department mappings. Use when you need to understand how pay schedules are assigned to employees and departments in a company.

tools.name: List pay schedules preview
tools.description: Tool to preview pay schedule dates with specified parameters for the next 18 months. Use when you need to see upcoming pay dates, pay periods, and bank holidays for a proposed pay schedule configuration before creating it.

tools.name: List Pay Stubs
tools.description: Tool to get an employee's pay stubs including payment details and amounts. Use when you need to retrieve pay stub information for a specific employee.

tools.name: List Recovery Cases
tools.description: Tool to fetch all recovery cases for a company. Use when you need to retrieve recovery case information including status, outstanding amounts, and associated payroll or contractor payment details. Recovery cases track failed ACH transactions that require recovery.

tools.name: List Signatories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all company signatories. Use when you need to get signatory information for signing company forms and documents. Currently only a single signatory per company is supported.

tools.name: List Tax Requirements
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tax requirement states for a company. Use when you need to check which states have tax requirements and whether the company has completed setup for each state during onboarding.

tools.name: List Time Off Activities
tools.description: Tool to get employee time off activities for a specific time off type. Use when you need to view an employee's time off balance changes, accruals, and usage history.

tools.name: List Time Off Policies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all time off policies for a company. Use when you need to list available time off policies, check policy configurations, or see which employees are assigned to each policy.

tools.name: List Time Tracking Time Sheets
tools.description: Tool to fetch all company's time sheets representing time worked by employees or contractors. Use when you need to retrieve time tracking data including regular, overtime, and double overtime hours for a given time range.

tools.name: List unprocessed termination pay periods
tools.description: Tool to retrieve unprocessed termination pay periods for a company. Use when you need to view dismissal payrolls for past and future terminated employees.

tools.name: List Wire In Requests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Wire In Requests for a company. Use when you need to view wire transfer requests, track payment statuses, or manage incoming wire transfers for payroll and contractor payments.

tools.name: List YTD Benefit Amounts From Different Company
tools.description: Tool to retrieve year-to-date benefit amounts contributed at a different company for an employee. Returns benefit amounts for the requested tax year (defaults to current year if not specified). This endpoint only supports retrieving outside contributions for 401(k) benefits.

tools.name: Remove Employees from Holiday Pay Policy
tools.description: Tool to remove employees from a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to exclude specific employees from the holiday pay policy scope.

tools.name: Remove People From Department
tools.description: Tool to remove employees and contractors from a department in Gusto. Use when you need to unassign people from a department.

tools.name: Remove Employees from Time Off Policy
tools.description: Tool to remove employees from a time off policy in Gusto. Use when you need to exclude specific employees from a vacation or sick leave policy scope.

tools.name: Retrieve Terms of Service Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user acceptance status of Gusto Embedded Payroll's Terms of Service. Use when you need to check if a specific user has accepted the latest terms of service for a company.

tools.name: Update Company
tools.description: Tool to update a company in Gusto. Use when you need to change company settings, particularly the contractor_only flag to enable W-2 employee support.

tools.name: Update Company Benefit Contribution Exclusions
tools.description: Tool to update contribution exclusions for a company benefit in Gusto. Use when you need to specify which contribution types should be excluded from a specific benefit. Currently only works for 401-k and Roth 401-k benefit types.

tools.name: Update Company Benefit
tools.description: Tool to update an existing company benefit in Gusto. Use when you need to modify benefit details such as description, active status, or other attributes. Note that company benefits can be deactivated only when no employees are enrolled.

tools.name: Update Contractor Address
tools.description: Tool to create or update a contractor's address in Gusto. Use when you need to set or modify the home address information for an existing contractor. Requires the contractor's UUID and the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Contractor Payment Method
tools.description: Tool to update a contractor's payment method in Gusto. Use when you need to change how a contractor receives payments (Check or Direct Deposit). For Direct Deposit, you'll need to configure bank account splits separately.

tools.name: Update Department
tools.description: Tool to update a department in Gusto. Use when you need to modify department details like the title. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Earning Type
tools.description: Tool to update an earning type in Gusto. Use when you need to modify the name of a custom earning type for a company.

tools.name: Update Employee
tools.description: Tool to update an employee in Gusto. Use when you need to modify employee information such as name, email, SSN, or shareholder status. Requires the current version field for idempotency.

tools.name: Update Employee Bank Account
tools.description: Tool to update an employee bank account in Gusto. Use when you need to modify existing employee bank account details.

tools.name: Update Employee Benefit
tools.description: Tool to update an individual employee benefit by its UUID in Gusto. Use when you need to modify benefit details like deduction amounts, company contributions, coverage, or dates for a specific employee's benefit enrollment. Requires the benefit UUID and version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Employee Benefits
tools.description: Tool to bulk update or create employee benefits for a company benefit in Gusto. Use when you need to enroll employees in a benefit plan or modify existing enrollments.

tools.name: Update Employee Onboarding Status
tools.description: Tool to update the onboarding status of an employee in Gusto. Use when you need to change an employee's progress through the onboarding process. Note that invalid status transitions will return a 422 error.

tools.name: Update Employee Payment Method
tools.description: Tool to update an employee's payment method in Gusto. Use when you need to change how an employee receives payments (Check or Direct Deposit). For Direct Deposit, you must also specify split_by and splits to configure bank account distribution.

tools.name: Update Employee Rehire
tools.description: Tool to update an employee rehire in Gusto. Use when you need to modify the details of a pending rehire for a terminated employee.

tools.name: Update Employee Termination
tools.description: Tool to update an existing employee termination in Gusto. Use when you need to modify the effective date or payroll settings for a scheduled termination. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Federal Tax Details
tools.description: Tool to update federal tax details for a company in Gusto. Use when you need to update attributes relevant for federal taxes such as EIN, filing form, legal name, tax payer type, or S-Corporation election.

tools.name: Update Employee Federal Taxes
tools.description: Tool to update federal tax information for an employee in Gusto. Use when you need to update W-4 form data including filing status, withholdings, and allowances. The response structure varies based on whether pre-2020 or 2020+ W-4 data is being updated.

tools.name: Update Garnishment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing garnishment in Gusto. Use when you need to modify garnishment details such as amount, description, or child support information. Requires the garnishment UUID and the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Historical Employee
tools.description: Tool to update a historical employee in Gusto. Historical employees are employees that were previously dismissed from the company in the current year. Use when you need to update information for a terminated employee.

tools.name: Update Holiday Pay Policy
tools.description: Tool to update a company's holiday pay policy in Gusto. Use when you need to configure which federal holidays are included in the company's holiday pay policy.

tools.name: Update Home Address
tools.description: Tool to update an employee's home address in Gusto. Use when you need to change an employee's residential address details.

tools.name: Update Company Industry Selection
tools.description: Tool to update the industry classification for a company by providing a NAICS code. Use when you need to set or change a company's industry classification in Gusto's payroll system.

tools.name: Update Jobs
tools.description: Tool to update a job in Gusto. Use when you need to modify job details such as title, hire date, workers' compensation settings, or shareholder status. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update location
tools.description: Tool to update an existing location in Gusto. Use when you need to modify address details, phone number, or filing/mailing address status for a location. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Onboarding Documents Config
tools.description: Tool to update an employee's onboarding documents configuration in Gusto. Use when you need to indicate whether to include Form I-9 during employee onboarding.

tools.name: Update pay schedule
tools.description: Tool to update a pay schedule in Gusto. Use when you need to modify pay schedule settings such as custom name, anchor dates, frequency, or auto-payroll configuration.

tools.name: Update recurring reimbursement
tools.description: Tool to update an existing recurring reimbursement in Gusto. Use when you need to modify the amount or description of a recurring reimbursement. Requires the current version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Salary Estimate
tools.description: Tool to update a salary estimate for an S-Corp owner in Gusto. Use when you need to modify occupation details, location, or business revenue for salary calculations. Cannot update if the estimate has already been finalized.

tools.name: Update Section 603 High Earner Status
tools.description: Tool to update an employee's Section 603 high earner status for a specific year. Use when you need to set or modify whether an employee is classified as a high earner under Section 603 of the SECURE 2.0 Act, which affects their retirement contribution tax treatment.

tools.name: Update State Taxes
tools.description: Tool to update state tax attributes for an employee in Gusto. Use when you need to update state-specific tax information such as withholding exemptions or additional withholding amounts. Answers must be supplied in effective-dated format with valid_from='2010-01-01' and valid_up_to=null.

tools.name: Update State Tax Requirements
tools.description: Tool to update state tax requirements for a company in Gusto. Use when you need to update state-specific tax settings such as tax rates, unemployment insurance rates, or other state tax compliance requirements.

tools.name: Update time off policy balance
tools.description: Tool to update time off hours balances for employees under a time off policy. Use when you need to set or adjust employee vacation or sick leave balances for a specific policy. Requires the time_off_policies:write scope.

tools.name: Update Time Off Policy
tools.description: Tool to update a time off policy in Gusto. Use when you need to modify vacation or sick leave policy settings such as accrual rates, limits, carryover rules, or termination payout configuration. Requires the policy version for optimistic locking.

tools.name: Update Time Tracking Time Sheet
tools.description: Tool to update a time tracking time sheet in Gusto. Use when you need to modify shift times, time zone, or hours worked with their pay classifications for an employee's time sheet.

tools.name: Update Work Address
tools.description: Tool to update an employee work address in Gusto. Use when you need to change an employee's work location or effective date. Requires the version field for optimistic locking.

required.description: Client id of the app

required.description: Client secret of the app

name: Habitica
description: Habitica is an open-source task management application that gamifies productivity by turning tasks into role-playing game elements.

tools.name: Add Task to Challenge
tools.description: Tool to add a new task to a specified challenge. Use when you need to programmatically create a challenge task after the challenge is set up and you have its ID.

tools.name: Add Push Device
tools.description: Tool to register a push notification device for the authenticated user. Use when you need to enable push notifications for mobile devices or UnifiedPush clients.

tools.name: Add Tag to Task
tools.description: Tool to add a tag to a task. Use when you need to categorize or label a task with an existing tag.

tools.name: Clone Challenge
tools.description: Tool to clone an existing challenge. Use when you need to duplicate a challenge to a different group with a new name.

tools.name: Create Challenge
tools.description: Tool to create a new challenge. Use when you need to start a challenge in a specific group with title, summary, and optional tasks.

tools.name: Create Habitica Party
tools.description: Create a new Habitica party for collaborative gameplay. Use this tool to create a party where users can: - Participate in quests together - Chat with party members - Share achievements and progress **Important Notes:** - A user can only be in one party at a time. If already in a party, they must leave first. - Guilds are no longer supported by Habitica (removed August 2023). Only 'party' type works. - The authenticated user automatically becomes the party leader.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag. Use after determining the desired tag name.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a new task in Habitica. Supports four task types: - 'habit': Recurring positive/negative actions (use up/down to enable +/- buttons) - 'daily': Scheduled tasks that repeat on a schedule (configure with frequency, repeat, startDate) - 'todo': One-time tasks with optional due date (use date field) - 'reward': Custom rewards that cost gold (set value for the gold cost) Required fields: text (task title), type (habit/daily/todo/reward). Optional: notes, priority (0.1=Trivial, 1=Easy, 1.5=Medium, 2=Hard), tags, checklist.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook for taskActivity events. Use when you need real-time notifications of task creation, updates, deletion, or scoring.

tools.name: Delete Habitica Challenge
tools.description: Permanently delete a Habitica challenge. Only the challenge leader (creator) or an admin can delete a challenge. This action is irreversible - once deleted, the challenge and all associated tasks are permanently removed. Use HABITICA_GET_USER_CHALLENGES to find challenge IDs you own.

tools.name: Leave or Delete Habitica Group
tools.description: Leave or delete a Habitica group (party or guild). This tool allows you to: 1. Leave a party: Pass 'party' as groupId or the party's UUID to leave your current party. 2. Leave a guild: Pass the guild's UUID to leave the guild. 3. Delete a guild: If you are the leader and there are no other members, passing the guild's UUID will delete it (DELETE endpoint is tried if leave fails). Note: The Habitica API endpoint used is POST /groups/:groupId/leave. Only if that fails (e.g., you're the leader trying to delete an empty guild), the DELETE /groups/:groupId endpoint is attempted.

tools.name: Delete Group Chat Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a chat message from a Habitica group (party, guild, or Tavern). Use when you need to remove a specific chat message. Note that only the message author or group moderators can delete messages.

tools.name: Delete Habitica Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag for the authenticated user. Use when you need to remove an obsolete tag after confirming it’s no longer applied to any tasks.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a user's task (habit, daily, todo, or reward) by its ID. The task cannot be recovered after deletion. Use get_tasks to list tasks and their IDs first.

tools.name: Delete Task Checklist Item
tools.description: Tool to delete a checklist item from a task. Use when you need to remove a specific checklist item from a todo or daily task.

tools.name: Delete User Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a message from the authenticated user's inbox by its ID. Use when you need to remove a specific message from the user's Habitica inbox.

tools.name: Delete User Push Device
tools.description: Tool to remove a push device registration from the authenticated user's account. Use when you need to unregister a device that should no longer receive push notifications.

tools.name: Equip Item
tools.description: Tool to equip or unequip gear, pets, mounts, or costume items in Habitica. Use when you need to change the user's equipped items. Equipping an already-equipped item will unequip it.

tools.name: Export Challenge to CSV
tools.description: Tool to export a Habitica challenge to CSV format. Use when you need to download challenge data as a CSV file. The CSV contains all challenge tasks and participant information.

tools.name: Get Challenge
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific challenge. Use when you have the challenge ID and need its full data.

tools.name: Get Group Challenges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve challenges available in a specific group (guild, party, or tavern).

tools.name: Get Task by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a task by its unique ID. Works for any Habitica task type (habit, daily, todo, reward) whether it belongs to a challenge or is a personal user task. Returns full task details including type-specific properties like completion status, streaks, and scheduling information.

tools.name: Get Challenge Tasks
tools.description: Tool to get all tasks for a specified challenge. Use when you have a challenge ID and need to list its defined tasks, including challenge metadata per task.

tools.name: Get Content
tools.description: Retrieves all Habitica game content definitions in a single request. Returns ~9MB of static game data including achievements, quests, gear, pets, mounts, eggs, hatching potions, food, backgrounds, spells, and more. Use cases: - Loading full game content to cache for local lookups - Getting all available items, quests, or equipment for reference - Building item pickers or content browsers Note: For specific content types, prefer get_content_by_type to reduce payload size. This endpoint requires no authentication but returns localized English text by default.

tools.name: Get Content By Type
tools.description: Retrieves Habitica game content data filtered by a specific category type. Use this tool to fetch game definitions like quest details, equipment stats, pet/mount info, backgrounds, spells, or other static game content. Useful when you need specific category data without fetching all content at once.

tools.name: Get Export History CSV
tools.description: Tool to export user tasks history in CSV format. Returns CSV data with task completions and updates over time.

tools.name: Get Export Inbox HTML
tools.description: Tool to export inbox data in HTML format from Habitica. Use when you need to retrieve the user's private messages and inbox content as an HTML document.

tools.name: Export User Data JSON
tools.description: Exports the authenticated user's complete data in JSON format. Use when you need a full backup or comprehensive snapshot of all user data. Returns the raw internal data structure with all fields and nested objects.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a Habitica group (guild or party). Use 'party' as groupId to get the user's current party, or provide a specific group UUID obtained from HABITICA_GET_GROUPS.

tools.name: Get Group Members
tools.description: Retrieve members of a Habitica group (guild or party). Supports pagination via lastId parameter and optional search filtering. Use 'party' as groupId to get members of the current user's party.

tools.name: Get Habitica Groups
tools.description: Retrieves Habitica groups based on type. Use 'guilds' to get all guilds the authenticated user belongs to, 'party' to get the user's current party, or 'tavern' to get the global Tavern (the main public chat).

tools.name: Get Habitica Tavern Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the Habitica Tavern (habitrpg) group details. The Tavern is the main public group where all Habitica users can chat and participate in community discussions.

tools.name: Get Party Chat Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve party chat messages from Habitica. Use when you need to fetch recent chat messages from the authenticated user's party.

tools.name: Get Model Paths
tools.description: Retrieves all available field paths and their data types for a specified Habitica model. Use this to discover the structure and available fields for user, group, challenge, tag, or task models. Helpful for understanding what fields can be queried or updated.

tools.name: Get News
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the latest Bailey announcement from Habitica. Use when you need to check current news, events, or updates posted by Bailey.

tools.name: Get Party
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's party details from Habitica. Returns information about the user's current party including: - Party name, description, and member count - Party leader information - Current quest status and progress - Recent chat messages - Leader-only permissions Note: Returns an error if the user is not currently in a party. No parameters required - automatically fetches the party for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Get Shops Market Gear
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the available gear for purchase in the market shop. Use when you need to check what equipment is available for each character class. Returns gear organized by class: healer, wizard, rogue, and warrior.

tools.name: Get Time Travelers Shop
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available items in the Time Travelers shop. Use when you need to see what quests, backgrounds, pets, or mounts can be purchased with hourglasses.

tools.name: Get Habitica API Status
tools.description: Tool to check Habitica API server status. Use when you need to verify if the Habitica service is operational before making other API calls.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Retrieve all tags for the authenticated Habitica user. Tags are labels that can be attached to tasks for organization. Returns both user-created tags and challenge-related tags. Use this to get tag IDs for filtering tasks or assigning tags to new tasks.

tools.name: Get Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tasks for the authenticated user. Use when you need the user's current tasks list after authenticating.

tools.name: Get User Challenges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve challenges the authenticated user participates in. Use when you need a paginated list of user challenges.

tools.name: Get User Profile
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's complete Habitica profile. Returns comprehensive user data including: - Stats: HP, MP, level, experience, gold, and character class - Inventory: gear, pets, mounts, eggs, potions, and quest items - Achievements: unlocked achievements and completed quests - Party: current party membership and quest progress - Preferences: language, timezone, notification settings - Tasks: order of habits, dailies, todos, and rewards - Tags: user-created tags for task organization This is a read-only endpoint that requires no parameters. The user is identified automatically via the API credentials.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all webhooks configured for the authenticated Habitica user. Returns a list of webhooks including their URLs, types, enabled status, and task activity options. Use this to check existing webhook configurations, monitor webhook health via failure counts, or get webhook IDs for updates/deletions.

tools.name: Get World State
tools.description: Retrieves the current state of the Habitica game world including active events, world boss status, and seasonal NPC visual themes. Use when checking for active world events, monitoring world boss progress, or determining current seasonal themes.

tools.name: Invite To Group
tools.description: Tool to invite users to a specific group. Use when you need to send invitations by user UUID, email, or username.

tools.name: Invite To Quest
tools.description: Tool to invite party members to a quest. Use when you want to start a quest with a specific quest key in a group. The user must own the quest scroll to invite others.

tools.name: Join Challenge
tools.description: Tool to join a challenge. Use after confirming the challenge ID to participate in a specific challenge.

tools.name: Leave Challenge
tools.description: Tool to leave a Habitica challenge. Use when you need to remove yourself from a specific challenge and decide whether to keep or remove its tasks.

tools.name: Local Login
tools.description: Tool to authenticate a user via local credentials. Use when needing an API token for subsequent Habitica requests.

tools.name: Local User Registration
tools.description: Tool to register a new Habitica user via email and password. Use when creating a fresh account before authentication.

tools.name: Mark Group Chat Seen
tools.description: Tool to mark all chat messages as read/seen for a specific group. Use when you need to clear unread message notifications in a group chat. Requires a valid group ID ('party' for user's party, 'habitrpg' for Tavern).

tools.name: Mark Notification Seen
tools.description: Tool to mark a single notification as seen in Habitica. Use this when you need to mark one specific notification as read after the user has viewed it.

tools.name: Mark Notifications Seen
tools.description: Marks specific notifications as read/seen in Habitica. Use this after getting notifications to clear unread notification badges. Requires valid notification IDs from the Get Notifications action. Returns updated notification state.

tools.name: Move Pinned Item
tools.description: Tool to move a pinned item in the rewards column to a new position. Use when you need to reorder pinned items after sorting them.

tools.name: Move Task To Position
tools.description: Move a Habitica task to a new position in the task list. Use this when you need to reorder tasks by moving a specific task to the top (position=0), bottom (position=-1), or any specific position. The response returns the updated task order for the task type (habit, daily, todo, or reward) that the moved task belongs to.

tools.name: Dismiss Bailey Announcement
tools.description: Tool to dismiss the latest Bailey announcement in Habitica, allowing it to be read later. Use this when the user wants to clear the current news notification without reading it. The announcement will reappear later.

tools.name: Reset User Account
tools.description: Resets the authenticated user's account to starting state. This permanently deletes all tasks, resets character to level 1, and clears progress while retaining some items and achievements. Use with caution as this action is irreversible.

tools.name: Read Card
tools.description: Tool to mark a card as read in Habitica. Use when a user receives a special card (birthday, greeting, nye, thankyou, or valentine) and wants to acknowledge it. Updates user.flags.cardReceived and returns updated user.items.special.

tools.name: Remove Party Member
tools.description: Removes a member from the authenticated user's party. Requirements: - You must be the party leader to remove members - You cannot remove yourself (use Leave Party instead) - The member must be currently in your party Use Get Party Members first to obtain member IDs. This action is typically used to remove inactive members or those who no longer wish to participate.

tools.name: Score Task
tools.description: Score a Habitica task to mark it as completed or incomplete. Use this tool to: - Mark a todo as complete ('up') or incomplete ('down') - Check off a daily task ('up') or uncheck it ('down') - Record a positive habit action ('up') or negative habit action ('down') - Redeem a reward (use 'up' direction for rewards) Returns updated user stats including health, mana, experience, gold, and level. Scoring tasks can trigger drops (food, eggs, potions) and quest progress.

tools.name: Social Auth
tools.description: Tool to authenticate a user via a social provider. Use after obtaining an OAuth token or code from Facebook, Google, GitHub, or Apple.

tools.name: Subscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to enable (subscribe) an existing webhook by ID for the authenticated user. This aligns with Habitica's documented API by updating the webhook resource to ensure it is enabled. Usage: obtain the webhook ID (e.g., via Get Webhooks or after creating a webhook) and call this action to set enabled=true.

tools.name: Unlink All Challenge Tasks
tools.description: Tool to unlink all tasks from a Habitica challenge. Use when you need to disconnect all tasks associated with a challenge and decide whether to keep or remove them.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Tool to update a Habitica group (party or guild) by modifying its properties. Use when you need to change the name, description, or summary of an existing group. Only the group leader can update group properties.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tag's name. Use when you need to rename a tag after identifying its ID.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Update an existing task in Habitica. Use this to modify task properties like title, notes, priority, or other attributes. Only include fields you want to update - all body parameters are optional.

tools.name: Update Task Checklist Item
tools.description: Tool to update a checklist item in a task. Use when you need to modify the text of a specific checklist item in a todo or daily task.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's profile, preferences, flags, and other settings in Habitica. Use dot notation for nested fields (e.g., profile.name, preferences.language). Note: Some paths are protected and cannot be modified (e.g., stats.class will be rejected).

tools.name: Validate Coupon Code
tools.description: Validate a Habitica coupon code to check if it is valid and active. Use this tool to verify coupon codes before attempting to apply them to a user account. Returns information about the coupon's validity and type (e.g., subscription, gems).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token associated with the user, used for API authentication.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The unique identifier for the user, used for API authentication.

name: HackMD
description: HackMD is a collaborative Markdown workspace for creating, organizing, and sharing personal and team notes.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Create a Markdown note in the personal workspace or a specified team workspace. The team branch is documented but was not live-tested because the test account belongs to no teams.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the HackMD profile for the connected token and the teams visible to it. Use the returned team paths with tools that accept team_path.

tools.name: Get Note
tools.description: Get a note by ID, including its Markdown content. The personal note route can also retrieve an accessible team note, so no team selector is needed.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: List all folders in the personal workspace, or in one team workspace when team_path is supplied. Use a folder ID as parent_folder_id when creating a note. The team route is documented but was not live-tested.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: List all notes in the personal workspace, or in one team workspace when team_path is supplied. HackMD returns the complete collection without pagination; the team route is documented but was not live-tested.

tools.name: List Trash
tools.description: List soft-deleted notes in the personal workspace. Team trash is intentionally excluded because it requires team-admin permission and could not be live-tested.

tools.name: Move Note to Trash
tools.description: Soft-delete a note by moving it to trash in the personal workspace or an explicitly selected team workspace. This is not permanent deletion. Personal notes can be restored with HACKMD_RESTORE_NOTES; team deletion is documented but was not live-verified, and no team restore endpoint is mapped.

tools.name: Restore Notes
tools.description: Restore one or more personal notes from HackMD trash. Returns a per-note success or failure outcome so a partial HTTP 207 result is never reported as an unconditional success.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your personal API token from HackMD under My account > Settings > API (https://hackmd.io/settings#api). The same token authorizes personal resources and team resources available to your HackMD account.

name: HaloPSA
description: Create, inspect, list, and delete HaloPSA tickets, with customer, site, user, agent, asset, and ticket-routing lookups.

tools.name: Create Ticket
tools.description: Create one HaloPSA ticket from a summary and optional details and routing IDs; sends the provider-required one-item array body.

tools.name: Delete Agent
tools.description: Request deletion of one HaloPSA agent by numeric ID. Use only for an agent that is confirmed safe to remove; this action does not create or verify a disposable replacement.

tools.name: Delete Appointment
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA appointment by numeric ID. HaloPSA also deletes its linked Exchange event unless ignore_exchange_delete is true.

tools.name: Delete Asset
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA asset by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA attachment by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Client Contract
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA client contract by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Customer
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA customer by numeric ID. Success is reported only after HaloPSA returns the endpoint's documented HTTP 200 status.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA invoice by numeric ID. Set bypass_accounts_sync to true to delete it in HaloPSA without synchronizing the deletion to the connected accounts system.

tools.name: Delete Item
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA inventory or service item by numeric ID. Use only for an item that is confirmed safe to remove.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA knowledge-base article by numeric ID. Use only for an article that is confirmed safe to remove.

tools.name: Delete Opportunity
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA sales opportunity by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA project by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Quotation
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA quotation by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Report
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA report definition by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Site
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA customer site by numeric ID.

tools.name: Delete Status
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA ticket-status configuration record by numeric ID. Use only for a status that is confirmed safe to remove.

tools.name: Delete Supplier
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA supplier by numeric ID. Use only for a supplier that is confirmed safe to remove.

tools.name: Delete Team
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA team by numeric ID. This changes tenant-level team configuration.

tools.name: Delete Ticket
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA ticket by numeric ID, optionally recording a reason. The ticket is removed from active ticket results.

tools.name: Delete Ticket Action
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA ticket action by numeric action ID and its parent ticket ID. HaloPSA may reject deletion for protected action types; the provider's reason is returned.

tools.name: Delete Ticket Type
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA ticket-type configuration record by numeric ID. This does not create or verify a disposable replacement.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Delete one HaloPSA end user by numeric ID.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA agent by numeric ID. Optional flags can request expanded configuration, signature, holiday-allowance, cache, or client-context data; the response preserves additional provider fields.

tools.name: Get Appointment
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA appointment by numeric ID, optionally with extra detail objects.

tools.name: Get Asset
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA asset by numeric ID, optionally including activity, allowed statuses, details, diagram data, and hierarchy data.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Download one HaloPSA attachment by numeric ID.

tools.name: Get Client Contract
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA client contract by numeric ID, with optional expanded billing, asset, user, schedule, and period details.

tools.name: Get Current Agent
tools.description: Return a compact identity for the HaloPSA agent authorized by the current connection, without claims or access-control records.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA customer by numeric ID, with optional expanded, activity, ticket-type, period, and pre-pay data.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA invoice by numeric ID, optionally with extra detail objects.

tools.name: Get Item
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA inventory or service item by numeric ID, optionally with expanded details and tenant-specific accounting data; additional provider fields are preserved.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA knowledge-base article by numeric ID, optionally with expanded details and language or organisation context.

tools.name: Get Opportunity
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA sales opportunity by numeric ID, optionally with extra provider detail objects.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA project by numeric ID, optionally with expanded details.

tools.name: Get Quotation
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA quotation by numeric ID, optionally with expanded details or portal-view context.

tools.name: Get Report
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA report definition by numeric ID. Optionally include definition details or load report data with the documented report context.

tools.name: Get Site
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA customer site by numeric ID, with optional customer, permission, activity, detail, setup, and ticket-type context.

tools.name: Get Status
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA ticket-status configuration record by numeric ID, optionally including its detailed configuration.

tools.name: Get Supplier
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA supplier by numeric ID, optionally including expanded details; additional provider fields are preserved.

tools.name: Get Team
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA team by numeric ID, optionally including agent details and expanded team objects.

tools.name: Get Ticket
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA ticket by numeric ID, with core assignment and classification fields and optional expanded details and most recent action.

tools.name: Get Ticket Action
tools.description: Get one HaloPSA ticket action by numeric action ID, optionally providing its ticket ID and requesting expanded details.

tools.name: Get Ticket Type
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA ticket type by numeric ID. Optional flags select the documented configuration, detail, knowledge-base, team-restriction, survey, new-ticket, and ticket-context representations.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Return one HaloPSA end user by numeric ID, with optional customer, site, ticket-type, opportunity, supplier, activity, billing, asset, and detail context.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: Return compact HaloPSA agent records for assignment lookup, optionally filtered by name, email address, telephone number, or team ID.

tools.name: List Appointments
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA appointments, optionally filtered by customer, ticket, date range, or search text.

tools.name: List Assets
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA assets, optionally filtered by customer, site, user, asset type, search text, and active state.

tools.name: List Attachments
tools.description: List HaloPSA attachment metadata, optionally for one ticket.

tools.name: List Client Contracts
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA client contracts, optionally filtered by customer, site, search text, and active state.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA customers, optionally filtered by name and active state.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA invoices, optionally filtered by date, customer, site, ticket, user, or search text.

tools.name: List Items
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA inventory and service items with the provider's documented status, asset, supplier, accounting, stock, search, and ordering filters.

tools.name: List Knowledge Base Articles
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA knowledge-base articles using the provider's documented status, access, relationship, language, search, and ordering filters.

tools.name: List Opportunities
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA sales opportunities, optionally filtered by customer, assignment, status, date range, or search text.

tools.name: List Priorities
tools.description: Return HaloPSA policy-priority mappings used to classify tickets, optionally filtered by SLA policy ID.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA projects. HaloPSA represents projects as ticket-like records in a tickets array.

tools.name: List Quotations
tools.description: Return HaloPSA quotations with customer, state, approval, processing, text, attachment, ordering, and page filters.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA report definitions with the provider's documented access, chart, customer, publication, ordering, group, search, and type filters.

tools.name: List Sites
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA customer sites, optionally filtered by customer, name, and active state.

tools.name: List Statuses
tools.description: Return HaloPSA ticket statuses, optionally constrained to a ticket type or a specific ticket's valid context.

tools.name: List Suppliers
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA suppliers with the provider's documented status, integration, ordering, search, and top-level filters.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: Return HaloPSA teams available for ticket assignment, optionally limited to the current agent's teams or a department.

tools.name: List Ticket Actions
tools.description: List HaloPSA ticket actions, optionally filtering by occurrence date range and whether attachment details are included. Set ticket_id to retrieve actions for a ticket; HaloPSA can return an empty list when it is omitted.

tools.name: List Tickets
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA tickets, optionally filtered by customer, site, user, status, assigned agent, or text search.

tools.name: List Ticket Types
tools.description: Return ticket types available for ticket classification, optionally limited to types that agents can create for a customer.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Return one page of HaloPSA end users, optionally filtered by customer, site, name, and active state.

tools.name: Upsert Agent
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA agent profiles, team memberships, account enablement, administrator access, working hours, licensing, costs, notifications, and approval settings in one array request.

tools.name: Upsert Appointment
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA appointments in one array request. Each item with id updates that appointment and each item without id creates one. HaloPSA does not document a universally sufficient minimal create payload.

tools.name: Upsert Asset
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA assets. Each item with an id updates that asset; each item without an id creates a new asset.

tools.name: Upsert Client Contract
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA client contracts. Each item with an id updates that contract; each item without an id creates a contract. Creates require client_id, ref, start_date, end_date, and billingperiod.

tools.name: Upsert Customer
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA customers in the endpoint's array body. Each item with id updates that customer; each item without id creates one.

tools.name: Upsert Invoice
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA invoice records and their typed line items. This action does not capture payment, post or email invoices, create credit notes, or trigger accounting-system synchronization.

tools.name: Upsert Item
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA inventory and service items in one array request. Each item with id updates that record and each item without id creates one; mixed batches are supported and can alter inventory and accounting state.

tools.name: Upsert Knowledge Base Article
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA knowledge-base articles through POST /KBArticle. Each item with id updates that article; each item without id creates one. HaloPSA documents no universally sufficient create payload.

tools.name: Upsert Opportunity
tools.description: Upsert HaloPSA sales opportunities: each resource item with id updates that record, while each item with id omitted creates a record. HaloPSA does not document a universally sufficient minimal create payload.

tools.name: Upsert Project
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA project records, typed milestones, and tags. This action does not close projects, publish articles, send notifications, override record locks, or invoke provider-import and validation workflows.

tools.name: Upsert Quotation
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA quotation records and typed quotation lines. This action does not send quotations, start signing or approval, create sales orders, or invoke external commerce integrations.

tools.name: Upsert Report
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA report definitions in one array request. Each item with id updates that report and each item without id creates one; this mutates report definitions and may expose saved SQL or report output.

tools.name: Upsert Site
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA customer sites. Each item with an id updates that site; each item without an id creates a site. HaloPSA does not document a universally sufficient minimal create payload.

tools.name: Upsert Status
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA ticket statuses in one array request. Set an item's id to update that exact status, or omit id to create one.

tools.name: Upsert Supplier
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA suppliers through POST /Supplier. Each item with id updates that supplier; each item without id creates one. HaloPSA does not document a universally sufficient minimal create payload.

tools.name: Upsert Team
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA teams in one array request. Set an item's id to update that exact team, or omit id to create one.

tools.name: Upsert Ticket Action
tools.description: Create or update ticket notes and work-log actions, optionally recording time or applying a ticket status, without sending email. Each resource with action_id updates that action; each resource without action_id creates one.

tools.name: Upsert Ticket Type
tools.description: Create or update HaloPSA ticket types in one array request. Set an item's id to update that exact ticket type, or omit id to create one.

tools.name: Upsert User
tools.description: Create or update one or more HaloPSA end-user records without sending welcome email. Each item with an id updates that user; each item without an id creates one.

name: Handwrite.io
description: Handwrite.io creates and tracks physical handwritten card orders using selectable handwriting and stationery styles.

tools.name: Get Order
tools.description: Get a Handwrite order by ID, including its current status, test or live environment, addresses, and proof images when available.

tools.name: List Handwriting Styles
tools.description: List the handwriting styles available to the connected Handwrite account, including the style ID required when sending cards and a preview URL.

tools.name: List Stationery
tools.description: List public stationery and custom stationery available to the connected Handwrite account, including the card ID required when sending cards and a preview URL.

tools.name: Send Handwritten Cards
tools.description: Create handwritten-card orders for one or more recipients. With a test API key, this creates persistent non-production records and sends no physical cards; with a live API key, it creates billable physical cards for every recipient. Do not call with a live key unless the user intends and authorizes billable physical mailing. The current API has no cancel or delete endpoint.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy a test or live API key from the Handwrite developer dashboard at https://app.handwrite.io/integrations/api. Test keys do not count against usage; live keys can create billable card orders. Enter the complete key exactly as shown.

name: Handwrytten
description: Automate your handwritten correspondence. Send real notes with your message written in pen by robots.

tools.name: Add Recipient
tools.description: Tool to add a recipient address to the user's addressbook in Handwrytten. Use when you need to store a new recipient for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: Calculate Order Taxes
tools.description: Tool to calculate taxes for Handwrytten basket orders. Use without any parameters for basket orders, or optionally provide order details to calculate taxes for a specific order (experimental).

tools.name: Check Authentication
tools.description: Tool to verify API key authentication validity for Handwrytten. Use when you need to test if the API credentials are valid and properly configured.

tools.name: Clear Basket
tools.description: Tool to clear all items from the shopping basket. Use when you need to empty the basket and remove all pending items before starting a new order or canceling the current selection.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new template for the current user. Use when you need to save a new message template for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: Create User Address
tools.description: Tool to create a new user address in Handwrytten. Use when adding a new return address to a user's profile for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: Delete Custom Image
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom image/logo from Handwrytten. Use when you need to remove a previously uploaded custom image or logo from your account.

tools.name: Delete Recipient Address
tools.description: Tool to delete one or more recipient addresses from user's profile. Use when you need to remove saved recipient addresses. Provide either address_id for single deletion or address_ids for bulk deletion.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a user's template by its ID. Use when you need to remove a saved template from the user's account.

tools.name: Get Basket (New Method)
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user's basket using the new method. Use when you need to fetch the current state of the shopping basket with all items, billing information, and totals.

tools.name: Get Basket Count
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the count of items currently in the basket. Use when you need to check how many items are in the shopping basket before proceeding with checkout or additional operations.

tools.name: Get Basket Item
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a basket item by its ID from Handwrytten. Use when you need to get details of a specific basket item.

tools.name: Get Card Details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a specific card in the Handwrytten catalog. Use when you need comprehensive details about a card including pricing, dimensions, images, and customization options.

tools.name: Get List of Addresses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all addresses associated with the user's account. Use when you need to view or select from saved addresses for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: Get Random Cards
tools.description: Tool to retrieve random cards from Handwrytten. Use when you need to get a random selection of greeting cards from the Handwrytten catalog.

tools.name: Get Template Details
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a card text template in the Handwrytten catalog. Use when you need to view the template message content and details.

tools.name: Get Current User Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to fetch user profile details, account information, or verify authentication status.

tools.name: Get User Address
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated user's address and billing information. Use when you need to access user profile address details.

tools.name: List Basket Orders Grouped
tools.description: Tool to list all basket orders grouped by basket. Use when you need to retrieve all items currently in the user's basket or review pending orders.

tools.name: List Past Baskets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of user's past baskets. Use when you need to view historical basket information including orders, recipients, and totals.

tools.name: List Cards
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available Handwrytten cards with optional filtering and pagination. Use when browsing card catalog or searching for specific card types.

tools.name: List Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available card categories from Handwrytten. Use when you need to display category options or filter cards by category.

tools.name: List Countries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of countries available in Handwrytten. Use when you need to get available countries for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: List Credit Cards
tools.description: Tool to list all credit cards associated with the Handwrytten account. Use when you need to retrieve stored payment methods and billing information.

tools.name: List Fonts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available handwriting fonts. Use when you need to display font options or select a font for a handwritten message.

tools.name: List Fonts for Customizer
tools.description: Tool to list fonts available for use with the card customizer. Use when you need to retrieve available font options for customizing handwritten cards.

tools.name: List Gift Cards
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available gift cards with their denominations and pricing. Use when you need to see what gift card options are available for purchase through the Handwrytten API.

tools.name: List Custom User Images
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of custom user images uploaded to Handwrytten. Use when you need to browse or manage custom cover images or logos.

tools.name: List Inserts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of available inserts from Handwrytten. Use when you need to view all inserts that can be included with handwritten cards.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of user's past orders from Handwrytten. Use when you need to view order history or check the status of previously placed orders.

tools.name: List Orders Grouped
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the user's order history grouped by basket. Use when you need to view or analyze past orders.

tools.name: List Past Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of user's past orders from Handwrytten API. Use when you need to view order history or check the status of previously placed orders.

tools.name: List Recipients
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of recipient addresses that the user has previously saved. Use when you need to view or select from saved recipient addresses for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: List Signatures
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available signatures for use in card orders. Use when you need to display signature options or select a signature for a handwritten message.

tools.name: List States
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of states/provinces available in Handwrytten. Use when you need to get available states for addressing handwritten cards.

tools.name: List Template Categories
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available template categories from Handwrytten. Use when you need to display template category options or filter templates by category.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of card text templates from Handwrytten. Use when you need to display available templates or filter templates by category.

tools.name: Logout User
tools.description: Tool to logout user from Handwrytten application. Use when you need to terminate the current user session and invalidate the authentication token.

tools.name: Place Order in Basket
tools.description: Tool to add an order to the basket in Handwrytten. Use when you need to create a new handwritten card order with specified recipients, card design, message, and delivery details. The order can be placed immediately or scheduled for future delivery.

tools.name: Register User
tools.description: Tool to register a new Handwrytten user account. Use when creating a new user with email and password. Sends activation email to user; user status is not_active until email is confirmed.

tools.name: Request Password Reset
tools.description: Tool to request a password reset email for a Handwrytten account. Use when a user needs to reset their password and requires an email with reset instructions. The API will send an email with a password reset link if the provided email exists in the system, but will return success regardless to prevent email enumeration attacks.

tools.name: Set Default Address
tools.description: Tool to set a default return address for the user in Handwrytten. Use when you need to designate a specific address as the default return address for sending handwritten cards.

tools.name: Set Test Mode
tools.description: Tool to set test mode for the current Handwrytten user. Use when you need to enable or disable test mode for testing purposes. When enabled, cards will not be sent and money will be returned to the credit card.

tools.name: Update Basket Item
tools.description: Tool to update an existing basket item in Handwrytten. Use when you need to modify card details, recipient addresses, messages, or other basket item properties.

tools.name: Update Billing Information
tools.description: Tool to update user billing information (country, zip, address) for tax calculations in Handwrytten. Use when updating billing address details for accurate tax computation.

tools.name: Update Recipient
tools.description: Tool to update a recipient address in the user's addressbook in Handwrytten. Use when you need to modify an existing recipient's address details.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user template in Handwrytten. Use when you need to modify a template's name or message content.

tools.name: Upload Custom Logo
tools.description: Tool to upload a custom image (logo or cover) to Handwrytten for use with custom cards. Use when you need to add a custom logo or cover image that can be referenced in future card creation requests.

name: Happy Scribe
description: Happy Scribe offers automatic and professional transcription services, converting audio and video files into text with high accuracy.

tools.name: Create Subtitle
tools.description: Create subtitles for a video file using Happy Scribe's automatic transcription service. Submits a video URL to be processed for subtitle generation. The video must be publicly accessible during ingestion. Returns a subtitle job with an editor URL for reviewing and editing the generated subtitles. Processing states progress from 'initial' -> 'ingesting' -> 'automatic_done' (or 'failed'). Use the GET transcription endpoint to check processing status.

tools.name: Create Translation Task
tools.description: Creates an AI-powered translation task to translate an existing transcription into another language. Use this after a transcription is complete (state='automatic_done') to translate it. The task runs asynchronously - use Retrieve Translation Task to check progress and get results. Note: Not all language pairs are supported (e.g., German to English may fail).

tools.name: Delete Transcription
tools.description: Tool to delete a transcription job. Use when you have a transcription ID and want to remove it, optionally permanently. Use after confirming the transcription ID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Deletes a webhook by its ID. This action is idempotent: if the webhook does not exist or was already deleted, it returns success. Use Get Webhooks to retrieve available webhook IDs.

tools.name: Get Account Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details about your account, including subscription status and usage statistics. Use after authenticating your API key to monitor plan and usage.

tools.name: Get Supported Languages
tools.description: Retrieve the list of supported language codes for Happy Scribe transcription services. Returns BCP-47 language codes and indicates which languages have human transcription service available. This is a static reference based on Happy Scribe's official documentation, as there is no dedicated languages API endpoint.

tools.name: Get API Rate Limit
tools.description: Get Happy Scribe API rate limit information. Returns the documented rate limit for the Happy Scribe API: - Default limit: 200 requests per hour - Applies only to the transcription creation endpoint - When rate limited, API returns HTTP 429 with 'retry_in_seconds' in the body Note: Happy Scribe does not expose rate limit headers, so this tool provides documented defaults. If you encounter a 429 response during transcription creation, wait for the 'retry_in_seconds' value before retrying. For higher limits, contact sales@happyscribe.co with subject "Happy Scribe for Business".

tools.name: Get Signed Upload URL
tools.description: Tool to get a signed URL for uploading a file to Happy Scribe's S3 storage. Use before creating a transcription or order to obtain a secure upload URL for your media file.

tools.name: Confirm Order
tools.description: Tool to confirm a pending order. Use after creating an order with confirm=false when you're ready to submit it for processing.

tools.name: Create Translation Order
tools.description: Tool to create a translation order from an existing transcription. Use when you have a completed transcription and want translations into one or more languages. By default, the order remains incomplete unless confirm=true.

tools.name: Export Transcription
tools.description: Creates an export job to download transcription content in various formats. Use this action after a transcription job completes (state='automatic_done'). First obtain transcription IDs using the List Transcriptions action. The export job runs asynchronously - poll the Retrieve Export action with the returned export ID to check when the download URL becomes available (state='ready'). Supported formats: - Documents: txt, docx, pdf (support timestamps, speakers, comments, highlights) - Subtitles: srt, vtt, stl (standard caption formats) - Video editing: avid, premiere, fcp (professional editing software) - Other: html, json, maxqda

tools.name: Get API Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current API version and check for updates. If Happy Scribe does not expose a dedicated /version endpoint, this tool attempts to infer the version from HTTP response headers or from the base_url path (e.g., /api/v1).

tools.name: Get Error Codes
tools.description: Returns a list of HTTP error codes used by the Happy Scribe API along with their descriptions. Use this tool to understand what different error responses mean when calling other Happy Scribe API endpoints. This returns static reference data matching the official Happy Scribe API documentation.

tools.name: Get Supported Formats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve supported file formats. Use when you need to know available input and output formats before creating a transcription or subtitle. If a dedicated '/formats' endpoint is unavailable, this action probes known endpoints to verify connectivity and returns a curated list based on official documentation.

tools.name: Get Transcription Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details and status of a specific transcription job. Use after creating or listing transcription jobs to inspect a particular job's metadata.

tools.name: Get Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve webhooks configured for your account. Note: Happy Scribe's public API does not have a dedicated webhooks listing endpoint. Webhooks are specified via webhook_url when creating orders. This action attempts common endpoints and returns an empty list if unavailable.

tools.name: Retrieve Export
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific export. Use when you need to check export status and get download link.

tools.name: Retrieve Translation Task
tools.description: Retrieves the status and details of a translation task by its ID. Use this after creating a translation task with HAPPY_SCRIBE_CREATE_TRANSLATION_TASK to check progress (state: initial, working, failed, done) and obtain the translated transcription ID when complete. Note: This endpoint is deprecated; consider using HAPPY_SCRIBE_RETRIEVE_ORDER for new integrations.

tools.name: List Transcriptions
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transcription jobs for a Happy Scribe organization. Returns transcription metadata including ID, name, processing state, language, and duration. Supports filtering by folder and tags, with pagination for large result sets. Note: This returns metadata only; use the Export Transcription action to get actual transcript content.

tools.name: Retrieve Order
tools.description: Retrieve details of a Happy Scribe order by its ID. Returns order state, pricing, operations, and inputs. Use this to check order status, verify pricing details, or get information about translation/transcription operations. The order ID is obtained from create order responses (e.g., Create Translation Order).

tools.name: List Projects

tools.name: List Services

name: Hashnode
description: Hashnode is a blogging platform tailored for developers, offering tools to create, manage, and publish content seamlessly.

tools.name: Hashnode Accept Publication Invite
tools.description: Tool to accept a publication invitation. Use when you have a valid invite token and want to join the publication.

tools.name: Hashnode Add Comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Hashnode post. Requires a valid post ID (obtainable via HASHNODE_FETCH_STORIES_FEED or HASHNODE_FETCH_POSTS) and markdown content. For replying to existing comments, use the HASHNODE_ADD_REPLY action instead.

tools.name: Hashnode Add Content Block
tools.description: Tool to add a content block to a Hashnode documentation project. Use when you need to add embeddable content (such as code snippets, widgets, or other custom content) to a documentation project.

tools.name: Hashnode Add Custom MDX Component
tools.description: Tool to add a custom MDX component to a Hashnode documentation project. Use when you need to register a new reusable React component that can be used in MDX content. Requires a project ID, component identifier, and the JavaScript/React code defining the component.

tools.name: Hashnode: Add Documentation Project Custom Domain
tools.description: Tool to add a custom domain to a Hashnode documentation project. Use when setting up custom domain mapping for documentation sites. Requires projectId, domain name, and wwwDomain boolean flag.

tools.name: Hashnode Add Reply
tools.description: Tool to add a reply to an existing comment. Use after confirming comment ID and reply content.

tools.name: Hashnode: Check Custom Domain Availability
tools.description: Tool to check if a custom domain is available for your Hashnode publication. Use when verifying domain mapping before setup.

tools.name: Hashnode: Check Subdomain Availability
tools.description: Tool to check if a subdomain is available for a Hashnode publication. Use when verifying subdomain availability before creating a publication.

tools.name: Create Documentation API Reference
tools.description: Tool to create a documentation API reference from an OpenAPI specification URL in a Hashnode project. Use when you need to import and generate API documentation from a Swagger/OpenAPI spec. Requires projectId and the URL of the API specification.

tools.name: Create Documentation Link
