name: Highergov
description: HigherGov is a market intelligence platform providing comprehensive data on U.S. federal, state, and local government contracts and grants.

tools.name: Get Agencies
tools.description: Retrieves government agency information from the HigherGov database with pagination support. Use this tool to: - List all federal agencies with details like name, abbreviation, type, and hierarchy - Search for a specific agency by its unique agency_key identifier - Navigate through paginated results of agencies (28,000+ agencies available) The response includes agency hierarchy levels (level_1 through level_7) showing parent-child relationships between agencies, along with pagination metadata for browsing through results.

tools.name: Get Contracts
tools.description: Retrieve federal government contract data from HigherGov. Returns paginated list of contracts with details including awardees, agencies, amounts, dates, NAICS/PSC codes, and performance information. Supports filtering by date, search criteria, award ID, awardee, agency, industry codes, and more. Data updates daily by 2am for two days prior.

tools.name: Get Contract Vehicles
tools.description: Retrieve federal multi-award contract vehicles from HigherGov. Contract vehicles are pre-established contracting mechanisms that streamline procurement. Use this to list available vehicles with optional filtering by vehicle key and sorting by award date. Supports pagination with up to 100 records per page. Updated ad hoc as new awards are made.

tools.name: Get Documents
tools.description: Retrieve document metadata and download URLs for files associated with government opportunities, contracts, and grants from HigherGov. **When to use:** After calling Get Opportunities, Get Contracts, or Get Grants, use this tool to fetch the actual documents (RFPs, amendments, attachments, etc.) associated with those records. **How to use:** 1. First call Get Opportunities, Get Contracts, or Get Grants 2. Extract the 'document_path' field from the response 3. Parse the 'related_key' parameter from that document_path URL 4. Pass that related_key to this tool to retrieve the documents **Important notes:** - Download URLs expire after 60 minutes; retrieve new URLs by calling this endpoint again - Some opportunities/contracts/grants may have no associated documents (returns empty results) - Results are paginated; use page and page_size parameters for large document sets

tools.name: Get Grant History
tools.description: Tool to fetch historical data on grants from the HigherGov API. REQUIRED: At least one filter parameter (award_id or last_modified_date) must be provided. Use cases: - Retrieve history for a specific grant by award_id - Retrieve grants modified since a specific date using last_modified_date - Paginate through results using page and page_size parameters

tools.name: Get Grant Opportunities
tools.description: Retrieve government grant and contract opportunities from HigherGov. Returns Federal contracts, SLED (State/Local) opportunities, grants, and SBIR opportunities with comprehensive details including agency info, dates, contacts, and award estimates. Use this when you need to: - Find government opportunities by date (posted_date or captured_date recommended) - Search for opportunities with specific keywords - Filter opportunities by agency, status, or other criteria - Get detailed opportunity information including contact details and documents REQUIRED: Must provide at least one filter (posted_date, captured_date, search_id, source_id, agency_key, opp_key, or version_key). For best results, use posted_date or captured_date with optional keyword filtering.

tools.name: Get Grant Programs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on grant programs. Use when you need to list available grant programs with pagination.

tools.name: Get NAICS Codes
tools.description: Retrieve NAICS (North American Industry Classification System) codes with detailed descriptions. Returns a paginated list of NAICS codes that can be filtered by code prefix and sorted. Useful for finding industry classifications, understanding NAICS hierarchies, and identifying relevant codes for business categorization.

tools.name: Get Opportunity History
tools.description: Retrieve historical opportunity data from HigherGov with pagination support. This tool requires at least one identifying filter (captured_date, opp_key, version_key, search_id, posted_date, source_id, or agency_key). Most commonly used with captured_date to get all opportunities from a specific date, optionally filtered by source_type ('sam' or 'sled'). Returns paginated results with comprehensive opportunity details including title, description, agency, dates, contact information, and links to documents.

tools.name: Get People
tools.description: Retrieves contact information for federal and state/local government personnel from HigherGov. Returns detailed contact records including names, titles, emails, phone numbers, and affiliated agencies. Data is updated in real-time. Use this to find government contacts, especially when you have an email address or need to browse through personnel listings. Common use cases: - Find contact details for a specific government employee by email - Browse government personnel with pagination - Get the most recently updated contacts using ordering

tools.name: Get Product and Service Codes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on Product and Service Codes. Use when fetching PSC entries with optional pagination and filtering by code.

tools.name: Get Pursuits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve user-specific pursuits. Use when you need to fetch a user's pursuits with optional filtering by status and pagination.

tools.name: Get SBIR Opportunities
tools.description: Retrieve SBIR (Small Business Innovation Research) opportunities from HigherGov. SBIR is a U.S. government program that provides funding to small businesses for research and development with commercialization potential. This action retrieves SBIR opportunities from federal agencies. By default, retrieves opportunities captured since 2024-01-01. Use filters to narrow results by specific dates, agencies, or opportunity identifiers. Supports pagination for large result sets. Key use cases: - Find recent SBIR opportunities for a specific federal agency - Track SBIR opportunities by capture/posting dates - Retrieve details for specific SBIR opportunities by ID - Monitor new SBIR opportunities added to the system Note: At least one filter parameter (captured_date, posted_date, search_id, source_id, agency_key, opp_key, or version_key) is required by the API. The action provides captured_date with a sensible default.

tools.name: Get SLED Contract Opportunities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve state and local (SLED) contract opportunities. Uses the general Opportunity endpoint with optional filters.

tools.name: Get Subcontract Awards
tools.description: Retrieves federal subcontract award data from HigherGov. Returns paginated subcontract records with details about subcontract recipients, amounts, prime contracts, and awarding agencies. **Important**: At least one filter parameter (last_modified_date or search_id) is required by the API. Use this when you need to: - Find subcontracts modified on a specific date - List subcontracts from a saved HigherGov search - Access detailed subcontract award information including recipient details and prime contract relationships Data is updated weekly. Use the last_modified_date field to track updates.

tools.name: Get Subgrant Awards
tools.description: Retrieves federal subgrant award data from HigherGov. Returns paginated subgrant records with details about subgrant recipients, funding amounts, associated prime grants, and program information. **Important**: At least one filter parameter (last_modified_date or search_id) is required by the API. Use this when you need to: - Find subgrant awards modified on a specific date - List subgrant awards from a saved HigherGov search - Access detailed subgrant award information including recipient details and prime grant relationships Data is updated regularly. Use the last_modified_date field to track updates.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by HigherGov for authenticating API requests.

name: HighLevel Agency
description: Manage agency-level HighLevel company data, users, custom menus, snapshots, and installations without location-level access.

tools.name: Create Custom Menu
tools.description: Create an agency-only custom menu link that is never shown in sub-accounts.

tools.name: Create Snapshot Share Link
tools.description: Create an externally usable share link for a snapshot belonging to a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID. Location-restricted links are not supported. HighLevel exposes no API to revoke a created snapshot share link.

tools.name: Delete Custom Menu
tools.description: Permanently delete one agency custom menu link by its ID. A newly created menu may take a few seconds to become deletable; retry after a short delay if HighLevel initially reports that its ID does not exist.

tools.name: Delete Agency User
tools.description: Queue permanent deletion of an agency user by ID. A successful response confirms that HighLevel queued the request, not that deletion has completed. HighLevel does not allow the agency owner to be deleted.

tools.name: Find Agency Users by Email
tools.description: Return one page of agency users matching an exact batch of email addresses, including deleted users when requested, for a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID.

tools.name: Get Company
tools.description: Return a HighLevel agency's company profile and plan summary using its agency/company ID, never a location ID.

tools.name: Get Custom Menu
tools.description: Return one agency custom menu link by its ID.

tools.name: Get Installer Details
tools.description: Return agency, installer, and Marketplace plan details for this OAuth installation using the Marketplace OAuth App ID stored in the auth config.

tools.name: Get Last Snapshot Push
tools.description: Return the latest push status and asset progress for an agency snapshot at one target HighLevel sub-account. location_id selects the sub-account for reporting and is not a Location OAuth credential; the connection remains Agency OAuth.

tools.name: Get Agency User
tools.description: Return one agency user's profile, role, permissions, and scopes by user ID.

tools.name: List Custom Menus
tools.description: Return one page of agency-visible custom menu links, optionally filtered by title text.

tools.name: List Snapshot Pushes
tools.description: Return one page of sub-account push statuses for an agency snapshot within an ISO 8601 date range. Continue manually by passing a returned record ID as last_doc. The company_id is a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID.

tools.name: List Snapshots
tools.description: Return all owned and imported snapshots for a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID.

tools.name: Search Agency Users
tools.description: Return one page of agency users matching name, email, phone, role, IDs, or sync filters for a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID.

tools.name: Update Custom Menu
tools.description: Update selected fields of an agency custom menu while preserving omitted fields and keeping all sub-account visibility disabled.

tools.name: Update Agency User Profile
tools.description: Update an agency user's name, phone, profile photo, or language without changing company, location access, permissions, scopes, email, or password. HighLevel does not allow the agency owner's profile to be modified. The company_id is a HighLevel agency/company ID, never a location ID.

required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

required.name: app_id
required.description: Open HighLevel Marketplace, select the OAuth app used by this auth config, and copy the App ID from the app's details page.

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: HighLevel Location
description: HighLevel provides Location-scoped CRM, marketing, conversations, calendars, payments, and business automation APIs.

tools.name: Add custom audience member
tools.description: Add a member to a Facebook custom audience Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Batch update audience members
tools.description: Queue an asynchronous job to add, remove, or replace Facebook custom-audience members via CSV or smart lists. HighLevel does not validate the audience or smart-list IDs before returning `success:true`, so that response means only that the job was accepted, not that members changed. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Create conversation form
tools.description: Create a new Facebook conversation lead form. HighLevel exposes no delete counterpart for conversation forms. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Create page lead form
tools.description: Create a new lead form on a Facebook page. is_draft=true always creates a new local draft; draft_form_id does not update an existing draft, and drafts cannot be deleted through this toolkit. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete ad
tools.description: Permanently delete a Facebook ad. Unlike campaign and ad-set deletion, this is a hard delete and a repeated delete returns not found. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete ad set
tools.description: Archive a Facebook ad set and remove its ads. This is a soft delete: the ad set may remain readable with publishingStatus=ARCHIVED. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete campaign
tools.description: Archive a Facebook campaign and its ad sets. This is a soft delete: Get campaign continues to return the campaign with publishingStatus=ARCHIVED, and repeated deletes may still return success=true. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete custom audience
tools.description: Delete a Facebook custom audience by ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete Facebook integration
tools.description: Remove the Facebook ad integration from a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete page connection
tools.description: Remove a Facebook page connection from a location. HighLevel does not validate page_id before returning success=true, so success confirms request acceptance, not that the page existed or was disconnected. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Duplicate ad
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Facebook ad Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Duplicate ad set
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Facebook ad set Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Duplicate campaign
tools.description: Duplicate an existing Facebook campaign Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Get campaign with linked entities
tools.description: Retrieve a Facebook campaign with its linked adsets and ads Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Facebook Campaign Publishing Progress
tools.description: Return the current Meta publishing step counts and completion state for a Facebook campaign. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission `adPublishing.readonly`; a minimal PIT without it was denied while a broad PIT passed.

tools.name: Get conversation forms
tools.description: Retrieve Facebook conversation lead forms for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get custom audience by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Facebook custom audience by its ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get custom audiences
tools.description: Retrieve Facebook custom audiences for a location. HighLevel returns an empty details list for an unknown ad account ID, so an empty result does not validate that account. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get entities
tools.description: List Facebook campaigns, ad sets, or ads that exist on Meta. Local HighLevel drafts are not returned. type=INTEGRATION requires selected_ad_account_id. An empty result is returned as data=[] rather than an error. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Instagram accounts for page
tools.description: Retrieve Instagram accounts linked to a specific Facebook page Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get lead form by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific published or draft Facebook lead form by ID. Draft IDs require is_draft=true. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get page lead forms
tools.description: Retrieve lead forms for a Facebook page. Draft IDs are returned with a draft_ prefix; pass that ID and is_draft=true to Get lead form by ID. HighLevel may return drafts even when is_draft=false. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Facebook pages
tools.description: Retrieve Facebook pages associated with the connected account Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get conversion pixels
tools.description: Retrieve Facebook conversion pixels for a location. Facebook-channel results are returned under `items`; Instagram-channel results are returned under `details`. HighLevel may return the full pixel list when page_id does not match a known page, so an unfiltered result does not confirm that page exists. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Pause ad
tools.description: Pause a published Facebook ad. Draft or otherwise unpublished ads cannot be paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Pause ad set
tools.description: Pause a published Facebook ad set. Draft or otherwise unpublished ad sets cannot be paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Pause campaign
tools.description: Pause a published Facebook campaign. Draft or otherwise unpublished campaigns cannot be paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Publish campaign
tools.description: Publish a Facebook campaign and push it live to Facebook Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Remove custom audience member
tools.description: Remove a member from a Facebook custom audience Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Resume ad
tools.description: Resume a paused Facebook ad. The ad must already be published and paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Resume ad set
tools.description: Resume a paused Facebook ad set. The ad set must already be published and paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Resume campaign
tools.description: Resume a paused Facebook campaign. The campaign must already be published and paused. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Set default page
tools.description: Set the default Facebook page for a location. HighLevel does not validate page_id before returning success=true and an unknown ID can unset the real default, so verify the integration after this call. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Update custom audience
tools.description: Update name or description of a Facebook custom audience Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert ad
tools.description: Create or update a Facebook ad. Creating requires a non-empty name. Each media item type must be lowercase image or video. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert adset
tools.description: Create or update a Facebook ad set. Creating requires a non-empty name. Publishing every ad set requires name, pageId, audience, and budget with budgetType and amount. audience.placements must be an object keyed by platform, for example {facebook: [feed], instagram: [stream]}, not a string array. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert campaign
tools.description: Create or update a Facebook campaign. Creating requires a non-empty name and an objective; updates may identify the campaign by id. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert conversion pixel
tools.description: Create or update a Facebook conversion pixel. Omitting conversion_pixel_id or supplying an unknown ID creates a real Meta pixel/dataset; this is not a local draft. INSTAGRAM_DM pixels cannot be updated, and an empty name is ignored by HighLevel. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Create offline user list job
tools.description: Create a job to upload users to an existing Google Customer Match list. Verify user_list_id and smart_list_ids before calling: HighLevel can return success=true even when either identifier does not exist, and this action cannot verify downstream ingestion. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete conversion
tools.description: Soft-delete a Google Ads conversion action by ID. Google retains the resource with status REMOVED, so GET_CONVERSION_BY_ID may still return it after deletion. HighLevel may report an unknown ID as an opaque 500 rather than not-found. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Delete segment
tools.description: Delete a Google Ads audience segment by ID. HighLevel may report an unknown ID as an opaque 500 rather than not-found. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Get assets
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads creative assets for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get audience by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Google Ads combined audience by ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get audiences
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads combined audiences for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Google Campaign by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Google Ads campaign by ID, including its ad groups and ad content. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get conversion by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Google Ads conversion action by ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get conversion goals
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads conversion goals for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get conversions
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads conversion actions for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get entities
tools.description: Retrieve Google-side campaigns, ad groups, or ads through the current AD_MANAGER path. HighLevel draft campaigns are not returned; retain the ID returned by UPSERT_CAMPAIGN and use GET_CAMPAIGN_BY_ID to read a draft. ADGROUP requires campaign_id, while AD requires ad_group_id or campaign_id. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get keyword ideas
tools.description: Retrieve keyword suggestions for Google Ads campaigns Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get segment by ID
tools.description: Retrieve a specific Google Ads audience segment by ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get segments
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads audience segments for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get target interests
tools.description: Retrieve affinity and in-market audience options for Google Ads targeting. IN_MARKET with SEARCH or DISPLAY exceeds the platform response-size limit (413); use another supported channel when possible. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Publish ad
tools.description: Publish a Google ad and push it live Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert assets
tools.description: Create or update Google Ads creative assets. Include resourceName to update an existing CALL or SITELINK asset. On SITELINK updates, resend description1 and description2 because HighLevel clears either omitted description. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert audience
tools.description: Create or update a Google Ads combined audience. dimensions is required; a minimal live-proven value is {"genders":["FEMALE"]}. HighLevel exposes no delete endpoint for these audiences. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert Google campaign
tools.description: Create or update a full Google Ads campaign structure. HighLevel exposes no campaign delete endpoint; archive a draft by updating it with publishing_status=ARCHIVED. GET_ENTITY only lists Google-side entities and will not find HighLevel drafts, so retain the returned HighLevel id for GET_CAMPAIGN_BY_ID. HighLevel currently does not persist maximum_cpc or advanced_options. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert conversion
tools.description: Create or update a Google Ads conversion action. On create, Google may replace GOOGLE_ADS_LAST_CLICK with GOOGLE_SEARCH_ATTRIBUTION_DATA_DRIVEN; read the action back before relying on the attribution model. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert segment
tools.description: Create or update a Google Ads audience segment Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Create lead form
tools.description: Create a new LinkedIn lead gen form for an ad account Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Get ad campaign group
tools.description: Retrieve a LinkedIn ad campaign group by ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get campaign group reporting
tools.description: Retrieve reporting metrics for a specific LinkedIn campaign group Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get lead forms
tools.description: Retrieve LinkedIn lead gen forms for an ad account Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Publish ad campaign group
tools.description: Publish a LinkedIn ad campaign group and push it live Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Update ad status
tools.description: Pause or resume a LinkedIn ad, campaign, or ad group Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Upsert ad campaign group
tools.description: Create or update a LinkedIn ad campaign group with campaigns and ads Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.write`.

tools.name: Get Affiliate
tools.description: Retrieve a single affiliate by id for a location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `affiliate-manager.readonly`.

tools.name: List Affiliates
tools.description: Retrieve the list of affiliates for a location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `affiliate-manager.readonly`.

tools.name: List Commissions
tools.description: Retrieve the list of commissions for a location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `affiliate-manager.readonly`.

tools.name: List Payouts
tools.description: Retrieve the list of payouts for a location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `affiliate-manager.readonly`.

tools.name: Create Agent
tools.description: Create an Agent Studio agent with an initial staging version. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Delete Agent
tools.description: Permanently delete an Agent Studio agent and all of its versions. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Execute Agent
tools.description: Execute an active Agent Studio agent and return its complete non-streaming response. Execution may invoke the agent's configured actions and cause external side effects. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Get one active Agent Studio agent and all of its non-deleted versions. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.readonly`.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: List active Agent Studio agents for the connected Location, one page at a time. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.readonly`.

tools.name: Promote to Production
tools.description: Irreversibly promote an Agent Studio draft version to production. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Update Agent Metadata
tools.description: Update an Agent Studio agent's name, description, or status. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Update Agent
tools.description: Update a specific Agent Studio version. HighLevel's PATCH currently replaces nodes, edges, and variables with empty shells; set graphs at create time and update only version_name, description, or global_config here. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `agent-studio.write`.

tools.name: Create association
tools.description: Create a user-defined association between supported HighLevel object types. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.write`.

tools.name: Create relation
tools.description: Create a relation between two records in the association definition's canonical first-object then second-object order; reversing the records is invalid. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations/relation.write`.

tools.name: Delete association
tools.description: Permanently delete a user-defined association. HighLevel refuses deletion while relations remain; first list them with GET_RELATIONS_BY_RECORD_ID and remove each with DELETE_RELATION. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.write`.

tools.name: Delete relation
tools.description: Permanently delete one relation between associated records. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations/relation.write`.

tools.name: List associations
tools.description: Return a page of association definitions for the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.readonly`.

tools.name: Get association by ID
tools.description: Get a system- or user-defined association by its ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.readonly`.

tools.name: Get associations by object key
tools.description: Get association definitions for a contact, opportunity, or custom-object key. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.readonly`.

tools.name: Get association by key name
tools.description: Get a standard or user-defined association definition by its key name. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.readonly`.

tools.name: Get relations by record ID
tools.description: Return a page of relations for a record, optionally filtered by association IDs. Results can include HighLevel system-defined opportunity/contact relations as well as user-defined relations. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations/relation.readonly`.

tools.name: Update association
tools.description: Update the first- and second-object labels of an association definition. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `associations.write`.

tools.name: Check blog URL slug
tools.description: Check whether a URL slug is already used by a blog post in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/check-slug.readonly`.

tools.name: Create blog post
tools.description: Create a blog post in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/post.write`.

tools.name: List blog authors
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of blog authors for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/author.readonly`.

tools.name: List blog categories
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of blog categories for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/category.readonly`.

tools.name: List blog posts
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of posts for a blog in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/posts.readonly`.

tools.name: List blogs
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of blogs for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/list.readonly`.

tools.name: Update blog post
tools.description: Update an existing blog post in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `blogs/post-update.write`.

tools.name: Create a new brand board
tools.description: Create a brand board with logos, colors, and fonts in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `brand-boards/design-kit.write`.

tools.name: Create Brand Voice
tools.description: Create a brand voice in the connected location. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.write`.

tools.name: Delete a Brand Board
tools.description: Delete a brand board from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `brand-boards/design-kit.write`.

tools.name: Delete Brand Voice
tools.description: Delete a brand voice after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.write`.

tools.name: Get Brand Board
tools.description: Retrieve one brand board by ID from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `brand-boards/design-kit.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Brand Boards
tools.description: Return one page of brand boards for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `brand-boards/design-kit.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Brand Voice
tools.description: Get a brand voice from the connected location. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.readonly`.

tools.name: List Brand Voices
tools.description: Return one page of brand voices for the connected location. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.readonly`.

tools.name: Set Default Brand Voice
tools.description: Set the location's default brand voice, replacing the previous default, after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.write`.

tools.name: Update a Brand Board
tools.description: Update an existing brand board in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `brand-boards/design-kit.write`.

tools.name: Update Brand Voice
tools.description: Update a brand voice after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `brand-boards/voices.write`.

tools.name: Create Business
tools.description: Create a business in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `businesses.write`.

tools.name: Delete Business
tools.description: Permanently delete a business by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `businesses.write`.

tools.name: Get Business
tools.description: Retrieve one business by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `businesses.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Businesses by Location
tools.description: Return one offset-paginated page of businesses for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `businesses.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Business

This may irreversibly deduct verification charges from the connected location or company wallet, and verification must be configured for that location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `lc-email.readonly`.

tools.name: Create Email Campaign
tools.description: Create an email campaign draft without scheduling or sending it. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.write`.

tools.name: Create an email template
tools.description: Create a new email template in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.write`.

tools.name: Create a template folder
tools.description: Create an email-template folder in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.write`.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Delete an email campaign. For a scheduled campaign, the first call cancels its schedule; call again only if the campaign should then be permanently deleted. Verify the campaign ID before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with `emails/campaigns.write`.

tools.name: Delete a template
tools.description: Permanently delete one email template from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.write`.

tools.name: Get Bulk Action Campaign by ID
tools.description: Get one bulk-action campaign from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Campaign Statistics
tools.description: Get statistics for an email, workflow, or bulk-action campaign. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/stats.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Email Campaign by ID
tools.description: Get one email campaign from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Email Template by ID
tools.description: Get one email template from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Workflow Campaign by ID
tools.description: Get one workflow campaign from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: Import an email template
tools.description: Import an email template from a supported provider URL into the connected location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.write`.

tools.name: List Bulk Action Campaigns
tools.description: Return one page of bulk-action campaigns for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: List Email Campaigns
tools.description: Return one page of email campaigns for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: List templates
tools.description: Return one page of email templates and folders for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.readonly`.

tools.name: List Workflow Campaigns
tools.description: Return one page of workflow campaigns for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.readonly`.

tools.name: Schedule Campaign
tools.description: Start or schedule a draft or paused email campaign after validating recipients and schedule configuration. A cancelled campaign cannot be rescheduled; create a new draft. This can irreversibly send email to external recipients. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.write`.

tools.name: Update Email Campaign
tools.description: Update selected fields of an email campaign draft; this action never schedules or sends it. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/campaigns.write`.

tools.name: Update an email template
tools.description: Update selected fields of an email template in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `emails/templates.write`.

tools.name: Get File by Slug
tools.description: Get metadata and a short-lived signed download URL for a HighLevel file share slug. The documented response is JSON; this action does not follow the uncredentialed asset URL or forward provider credentials to its dynamic origin. Location PITs must have `files.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Forms
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of forms for the connected HighLevel location. Pass `next_cursor` back as `skip` to retrieve the next page. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `forms.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Forms Submissions
tools.description: Return one page of form submissions for the connected HighLevel location. Pass `next_cursor` back as `page` to retrieve the next page. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `forms.readonly`.

tools.name: Upload Files to Custom Fields
tools.description: Upload one or more files to file-upload custom fields on a contact in the connected HighLevel location. Each file may be up to 50 MB. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `forms.write`.

tools.name: Create Redirect
tools.description: Create a URL redirect for the connected HighLevel Location. The source domain must already be connected to the location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/redirect.write`.

tools.name: Delete Redirect By ID
tools.description: Permanently delete a URL redirect from the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/redirect.write`.

tools.name: Fetch Redirects List
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of URL redirects for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/redirect.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch List of Funnels
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of funnels for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/funnel.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch List of Funnel Pages
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of pages belonging to a HighLevel funnel. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/page.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Count of Funnel Pages
tools.description: Count pages belonging to a HighLevel funnel, optionally filtered by name. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/pagecount.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Redirect By ID
tools.description: Update the destination and action of an existing HighLevel URL redirect. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `funnels/redirect.write`.

tools.name: Get Ad Account
tools.description: Return one ad account or the selected account details for one ad platform. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Ad Campaign Reporting
tools.description: Return reporting metrics for one Facebook or Google ad campaign. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Ad Platform Integration
tools.description: Return the Location's integration state for one ad platform. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Ad Platform User
tools.description: Return the current user from one connected ad platform. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Ad Reporting
tools.description: Return aggregate reporting metrics for one connected ad platform. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Manage Auto payment for an schedule invoice
tools.description: API to manage auto payment for a schedule. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may charge the contact's configured payment method. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Cancel an scheduled invoice
tools.description: API to cancel a scheduled invoice by schedule id. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. This destructive change may be irreversible; confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Create Estimate Template
tools.description: Create a new estimate template. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: API to create an invoice. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Create Invoice from Estimate
tools.description: Create a new invoice from an existing estimate. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Create Invoice Schedule
tools.description: API to create an invoice Schedule. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Create template
tools.description: Create an invoice template. HighLevel stores internal=true as false and drops items[].type. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/template.write`.

tools.name: Create New Estimate
tools.description: Create a new estimate. send_estimate_details.estimateName overwrites name; sent_to and user_id are not stored until the estimate is sent. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Delete Estimate
tools.description: Delete an existing estimate. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This destructive change may be irreversible; confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Delete Estimate Template
tools.description: Delete an existing estimate template. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This destructive change may be irreversible; confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Delete invoice
tools.description: Permanently delete a draft invoice by ID. HighLevel rejects deletion after the invoice leaves `draft`. Confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Delete schedule
tools.description: API to delete an schedule by schedule id. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. This destructive change may be irreversible; confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Delete template
tools.description: Permanently delete an invoice template by ID. Confirm the target template before calling because this destructive change may be irreversible. Location PITs must be provisioned with `invoices/template.write`.

tools.name: Generate Estimate Number
tools.description: Get the next estimate number for the given location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.readonly`.

tools.name: Generate Invoice Number
tools.description: Get the next invoice number for the given location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.readonly`.

tools.name: Get invoice
tools.description: Get an invoice by ID. HighLevel returns not found for voided invoices even though LIST_INVOICES can still return them with `status=void`. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.readonly`.

tools.name: Get an schedule
tools.description: API to get an schedule by schedule id. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Invoice Settings
tools.description: Get the invoice settings for the given location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.readonly`.

tools.name: Get an template
tools.description: API to get an template by template id. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/template.readonly`.

tools.name: List Estimates
tools.description: Get a paginated list of estimates. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.readonly`.

tools.name: List Estimate Templates
tools.description: Get a list of estimate templates or a specific template by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.readonly`.

tools.name: List invoices
tools.description: API to get list of invoices. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.readonly`.

tools.name: List schedules
tools.description: API to get list of schedules. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.readonly`.

tools.name: List templates
tools.description: API to get list of templates. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/template.readonly`.

tools.name: Preview Estimate Template
tools.description: Get a preview of an estimate template. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.readonly`.

tools.name: Record a manual payment for an invoice
tools.description: Record a manual payment against an invoice. Omit amount to record the full remaining balance; payment-plan invoices accept only scheduled step amounts. This irreversibly changes the invoice's financial balance; verify the invoice, amount, method, and payment schedule before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Schedule an schedule invoice
tools.description: API to schedule an schedule invoice to start sending to the customer. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This may create, change, or cancel future billing activity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Send Estimate
tools.description: API to send estimate by estimate id. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This sends a customer-facing payment or billing communication. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Send invoice
tools.description: API to send invoice by invoice id. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. This sends a customer-facing payment or billing communication. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Create & Send
tools.description: Create or update a text-to-pay invoice. HighLevel ignores `title` and `terms_notes`, as well as attachments, tips_configuration, late_fees_configuration, payment_schedule, invoice_number_prefix, and sent_to for this operation. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record and sends a customer-facing billing communication. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Update scheduled recurring invoice
tools.description: Replace the contents of an invoice schedule that is already in `scheduled` state; call SCHEDULE_INVOICE_SCHEDULE first for a draft. The request is a full replacement, so include every existing invoice, schedule, and auto-payment setting that must be preserved; omitting tipsConfiguration, paymentMethods, or automaticTaxesEnabled clears it. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings because this changes future billing activity and may charge the contact. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Update Estimate
tools.description: Update an existing estimate. Omitted terms_notes, payment_schedule_config, automatic_taxes_enabled, and live_mode are cleared. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Update estimate last visited at
tools.description: Update an estimate's last-visited timestamp by estimate ID. The estimate must already be in the sent state. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Update Estimate Template
tools.description: Update an existing estimate template. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/estimate.write`.

tools.name: Update invoice
tools.description: Update an invoice by invoice ID. Omitting payment_schedule clears the stored payment schedule. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Update Invoice Last Visited At
tools.description: Mark an invoice as last visited in the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Update Invoice Late Fees Configuration
tools.description: Replace late-fee settings on an invoice in the connected Location. Confirm the amount, type, frequency, grace period, and cap before changing this financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Update schedule
tools.description: Replace an invoice schedule by schedule ID. The request is a full replacement, so include every existing invoice and schedule setting that must be preserved; omitting tipsConfiguration, paymentMethods, or automaticTaxesEnabled clears it. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record and future billing activity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/schedule.write`.

tools.name: Update template
tools.description: Update an invoice template by ID. HighLevel nulls attachments, tipsConfiguration, paymentMethods, and automaticTaxesEnabled on every update, even when they are sent. Review currency, amounts, taxes, discounts, fees, and payment settings before calling because this changes a financial record. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices/template.write`.

tools.name: Update Template Late Fees Configuration
tools.description: Replace an invoice template's late-fee configuration in the connected Location. Confirm the fee amount, type, frequency, grace period, and cap before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Update Template Payment Methods Configuration
tools.description: Replace payment-method settings on an invoice template in the connected Location. Confirm the intended bank-debit behavior before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Void invoice
tools.description: Void a non-draft invoice by ID without deleting its record. Draft invoices cannot be voided, and any paid amount must be refunded before voiding. Confirm the intended accounting outcome because this financial change is irreversible. Location PITs must be provisioned with `invoices.write`.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Base FAQ
tools.description: Create an FAQ after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Base
tools.description: Create a knowledge base after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Base FAQ
tools.description: Idempotently delete an FAQ after explicit confirmation; deleting an already-deleted FAQ is treated as successful. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Delete Knowledge Base
tools.description: Delete a knowledge base after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Delete Trained Knowledge Base URLs
tools.description: Idempotently delete trained pages after explicit confirmation; repeated deletion may still report a positive deletedCount. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Discover Website for Knowledge Base
tools.description: Start website discovery after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: List Knowledge Base Crawler URLs
tools.description: Return one page of crawled website URLs. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base Crawler Status
tools.description: Get crawler operation status. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Knowledge Base
tools.description: Get a knowledge base by ID. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.readonly`.

tools.name: List Knowledge Bases
tools.description: Return one page of knowledge bases for the connected location. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.readonly`.

tools.name: List Knowledge Base FAQs
tools.description: Return one page of FAQs. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.readonly`.

tools.name: Train Discovered Knowledge Base URLs
tools.description: Queue discovered pages for training after explicit confirmation. A successful response confirms queue acceptance, not that the URL IDs existed or training completed; poll crawler status to verify progress. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Base FAQ
tools.description: Update an FAQ after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Base
tools.description: Update a knowledge base after explicit confirmation. Location PITs require `knowledge-bases.write`.

tools.name: Create Link
tools.description: Create a trigger link in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.write`.

tools.name: Delete Link
tools.description: Permanently delete a trigger link by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.write`.

tools.name: Get Link by ID
tools.description: Get a single trigger link by ID from the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Links
tools.description: Get all trigger links in the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.readonly`.

tools.name: Search Trigger Links
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of trigger links matching a search query. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Link
tools.description: Update a trigger link's name and redirect destination. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `links.write`.

tools.name: List Ad Accounts
tools.description: List ad accounts available through one connected ad platform. Facebook supports type, fetch_all, and cursor-based next; type=AD_MANAGER filters to the account used by HighLevel Ad Manager. limit is not exposed because HighLevel ignores it. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: List Ad Reports
tools.description: List published reporting entities for one connected ad platform. Facebook drafts are not returned; use Get campaign with linked entities for a HighLevel draft. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Create a custom field in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customFields.write`.

tools.name: Create Custom Value
tools.description: Create a custom value in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customValues.write`.

tools.name: Create Recurring Task
tools.description: Create Recurring Task Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `recurring-tasks.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Create Tag

tools.name: Delete Custom Value

tools.name: Delete Recurring Task

tools.name: Get Conversation Channel

tools.name: Get Custom Field

tools.name: Get Custom Fields

tools.name: Get Custom Value
tools.description: Get one custom value from the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customValues.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Custom Values
tools.description: List custom values owned by the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customValues.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Sub-Account (Formerly Location)
tools.description: Get the Location bound to the connected HighLevel account. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: List tags owned by the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/tags.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Recurring Task By Id
tools.description: Get Recurring Task By Id Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `recurring-tasks.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Tag by ID
tools.description: Get one tag from the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/tags.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Timezones
tools.description: Fetch the available timezones for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations.readonly`.

tools.name: Task Search Filter
tools.description: Return one offset-based page of tasks from the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/tasks.readonly`.
