tools.description: Update a custom field in the connected HighLevel Location. HighLevel fully replaces placeholder, accepted_format, and text_box_list_options, so resend those values when they must be preserved. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customFields.write`.

tools.name: Update Custom Value
tools.description: Update a custom value in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customValues.write`.

tools.name: Update Recurring Task
tools.description: Update Recurring Task Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `recurring-tasks.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Rename a tag in the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/tags.write`.

tools.name: Upload File to Custom Fields
tools.description: Upload a file to a custom field for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `locations/customFields.write`.

tools.name: Check Wallet Funds
tools.description: Check whether the connected HighLevel sub-account has sufficient wallet funds to be charged.

tools.name: Create Wallet Charge
tools.description: Create a real wallet charge for the connected HighLevel Location. The Location and its parent Company are resolved from the OAuth connection, and explicit confirmation is required.

tools.name: Delete Wallet Charge
tools.description: Delete a wallet charge. This is a destructive billing operation with real wallet consequences and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Get Marketplace Installer Details
tools.description: Get company, Location, user, and installation details associated with the current HighLevel OAuth token for an app.

tools.name: Get Marketplace Rebilling Config
tools.description: Get the subscription and usage rebilling plans for an app in the connected HighLevel Location. HighLevel marks this endpoint deprecated.

tools.name: Get Wallet Charge
tools.description: Get the details of one HighLevel wallet charge by charge ID.

tools.name: List Wallet Charges
tools.description: Return one page of wallet charges visible to the connected HighLevel Location, with optional billing and date filters.

tools.name: Uninstall Marketplace Application
tools.description: Uninstall an application from the connected HighLevel Location. This removes the application's access and stops its functionality, so explicit confirmation is required.

tools.name: Bulk Delete / Trash Files or Folders
tools.description: Delete or trash multiple files and folders in the connected Location. Explicit confirmation is required; verify every target ID and the requested state first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Bulk Update Files / Folders
tools.description: Rename multiple files or folders in the connected Location's media storage. Review every target ID and name before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Create Media Folder
tools.description: Create a folder in the connected Location's media storage. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Delete File or Folder
tools.description: Delete a file or folder from the connected HighLevel location's media storage. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Get List of Files / Folders
tools.description: Fetch files and folders from the connected HighLevel location's media storage. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.readonly`.

tools.name: Update File / Folder
tools.description: Rename one file or folder in the connected Location's media storage. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Upload File into Media Storage
tools.description: Upload a file or import a hosted file into HighLevel media storage. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `medias.write`.

tools.name: Create Object Record
tools.description: Create a business or custom object record with schema-defined fields. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/record.write`.

tools.name: Delete Object Record
tools.description: Permanently delete a business or custom object record by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/record.write`.

tools.name: List Location Objects
tools.description: List standard and custom object schemas for the connected HighLevel location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/schema.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Object Schema by Key
tools.description: Retrieve an object schema by key or ID, optionally including its fields. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/schema.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Object Record
tools.description: Retrieve a business or custom object record by ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/record.readonly`.

tools.name: Search Object Records
tools.description: Return one page of business or custom object records matching a search expression. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/record.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Object Schema
tools.description: Update a custom object's labels, description, and searchable fields, or update searchable fields for a standard object. Custom object keys must include the `custom_objects.` prefix. `searchable_properties` replaces the complete searchable-field list. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/schema.write`.

tools.name: Update Object Record
tools.description: Update a standard or custom object record with schema-defined fields. Custom object schema keys include the `custom_objects.` prefix. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `objects/record.write`.

tools.name: Add Followers
tools.description: Add up to 10 user IDs as followers of an opportunity and return the resulting follower list. HighLevel may report an unknown user as `followersAdded:[[]]`; verify the resulting `followers` list when user IDs are not known-valid. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Create Opportunity
tools.description: Create an opportunity. HighLevel rejects a duplicate opportunity for the same contact in the same pipeline. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Create Pipeline
tools.description: Create a pipeline with at least one stage in the connected HighLevel location. Pipeline and stage names must be unique. Explicit confirmation is required. Location PITs must have `pipelines.create`.

tools.name: Delete Opportunity
tools.description: Delete Opportunity. This destructive change may be irreversible; confirm the target ID and intended outcome first. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Delete Pipeline
tools.description: Permanently delete a pipeline and every opportunity in all its stages. This is irreversible and requires explicit confirmation. Location PITs must have `pipelines.write`.

tools.name: Get lost reason
tools.description: Get lost reason. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Opportunity
tools.description: Get Opportunity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Pipeline
tools.description: Retrieve one pipeline, including its stages and configuration. Location PITs must have `pipelines.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Pipelines
tools.description: Get Pipelines. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.readonly`.

tools.name: Remove Followers
tools.description: Allows removal of one or all followers from an opportunity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Search Opportunities
tools.description: Search opportunities based on combinations of advanced filters. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.readonly`.

tools.name: Search Opportunity
tools.description: Search Opportunity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Opportunity
tools.description: Update Opportunity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Update Opportunity Status
tools.description: Update Opportunity Status. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Update Pipeline
tools.description: Update a pipeline. The stage list is a full replacement and removing stages migrates their opportunities, so explicit confirmation is required. Location PITs must have `pipelines.write`.

tools.name: Upsert Opportunity
tools.description: Upsert Opportunity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `opportunities.write`.

tools.name: Create Coupon
tools.description: Create a promotional coupon. applyToFuturePaymentsConfig is ignored unless applyToFuturePayments is true. Review discount type and value, eligible products, dates, usage limits, and future subscription effects before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.write`.

tools.name: Create Custom Payment Integration
tools.description: Create a custom payment-provider association for the connected Location. Review all external URLs and subscription support before creating financial infrastructure. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

tools.name: Create White-label Integration Provider
tools.description: Create a Location payment-provider integration backed by Authorize.net or NMI. Review the provider, public URLs, and Location before creating financial infrastructure. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/integration.write`.

tools.name: Create Order Fulfillment
tools.description: Create fulfillment history for an order. Confirm order, item quantities, tracking data, and whether a customer notification should be sent before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.write`.

tools.name: Update Custom Provider Capabilities
tools.description: Set whether the connected Location's custom payment provider supports subscription schedules. Confirm downstream recurring-billing behavior before disabling support. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

tools.name: Delete Coupon
tools.description: Permanently delete a coupon. This cannot be undone; confirm the exact coupon ID and that no active promotion should continue before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.write`.

tools.name: Delete Custom Payment Integration
tools.description: Permanently delete the connected Location's custom payment-provider association. If no provider is configured, HighLevel may return no error detail and the action reports that explicit empty state. This can stop payment processing; confirm the Location and migration or shutdown plan before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

tools.name: Disconnect Custom Payment Provider Config
tools.description: Disconnect a custom provider's live or test payment configuration. Disconnecting live mode can stop charges and subscriptions; confirm the Location, mode, and operational impact before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.write`.

tools.name: Fetch Custom Payment Provider Config
tools.description: Fetch the custom payment-provider configuration for the connected Location. A traceId-only response means no custom provider is configured. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/custom-provider.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Coupon
tools.description: Retrieve coupon details by ID for the connected Location. The endpoint requires `code`, but HighLevel currently ignores it when selecting the coupon. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Order by ID
tools.description: Retrieve one order by ID from the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Subscription by ID
tools.description: Retrieve one payment subscription by ID from the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/subscriptions.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Transaction by ID
tools.description: Retrieve one payment transaction by ID from the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/transactions.readonly`.

tools.name: List Coupons
tools.description: Return one offset page of coupons for the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.readonly`.

tools.name: List White-label Integration Providers
tools.description: Return one offset page of white-label payment integration providers for the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/integration.readonly`.

tools.name: List Order Fulfillment
tools.description: List fulfillment history for one order in the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.readonly`.

tools.name: List Order Notes
tools.description: List notes for one payment order in the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.readonly`.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Return one offset page of orders for the connected Location. altType is fixed to the live-required value `location`. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.readonly`.

tools.name: List Subscriptions
tools.description: Return one offset page of subscriptions for the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/subscriptions.readonly`.

tools.name: List Transactions
tools.description: Return one offset page of payment transactions for the connected Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/transactions.readonly`.

tools.name: Record Order Payment
tools.description: Record a real manual payment against an order. This changes financial balances and may mark the order paid; confirm the order ID, amount, currency, payment method, and partial-payment intent before calling. Do not use this action to test connectivity. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/orders.collectPayment`.

tools.name: Update Coupon
tools.description: Replace an existing coupon's promotional terms. applyToFuturePaymentsConfig is ignored unless applyToFuturePayments is true. Confirm the coupon ID, discount, dates, limits, eligible products, and future subscription effects before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `payments/coupons.write`.

tools.name: List Active Numbers
tools.description: List one page of active numbers and phone-account state for the connected HighLevel location. Pass `next_cursor` back as `page` for the next page. This action depends on external phone-system state. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `phonenumbers.read`.

tools.name: List Number Pools
tools.description: List number pools for the connected HighLevel location. This action requires the location's external phone-system state to be configured. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `numberpools.read`.

tools.name: List Available Phone Numbers
tools.description: Search external phone-provider inventory for numbers purchasable by the connected HighLevel location. This does not purchase or reserve a number. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `phonenumbers.read`.

tools.name: Purchase Number for Location
tools.description: Purchase a phone number for the connected HighLevel location from external provider inventory. This can incur an immediate charge. Explicit confirmation is required, and this toolkit surface has no action for releasing the number. HighLevel rejects purchases when the location is not KYC verified, including when skip_location_kyc is true. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `phonenumbers.write`.

tools.name: Bulk Edit Products and Prices
tools.description: Edit fields on up to 30 products and nested prices in one request. Confirm every product ID and changed field before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission `products.write`.

tools.name: Bulk Update Products
tools.description: Bulk-update product prices, availability, collections, or currency, or permanently delete products when type is `bulk-delete-products`. Collection updates add products to collections and never remove existing collection assignments. Confirm the operation type and product IDs before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Bulk Update Product Reviews
tools.description: Update one or multiple product reviews: status, reply, etc. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Create Price for a Product
tools.description: The "Create Price for a Product" API allows adding a new price associated with a specific product to the system. Use this endpoint to create a price with the specified details for a particular product. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.write`.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: The "Create Product" API allows adding a new product to the system. Use this endpoint to create a product with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Create Product Collection
tools.description: Create a new Product Collection for a specific location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/collection.write`.

tools.name: Delete Price by ID for a Product
tools.description: The "Delete Price by ID for a Product" API allows deleting a specific price associated with a particular product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to remove a price from the system. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.write`.

tools.name: Delete Product by ID
tools.description: The "Delete Product by ID" API allows deleting a specific product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to remove a product from the system. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Delete Product Collection
tools.description: Delete specific product collection with Id :collectionId Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/collection.write`.

tools.name: Delete Product Review
tools.description: Delete specific product review Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: List Inventory
tools.description: The "List Inventory API allows the user to retrieve a paginated list of inventory items. Use this endpoint to fetch details for multiple items in the inventory based on the provided query parameters. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Price by ID for a Product
tools.description: The "Get Price by ID for a Product" API allows retrieving information for a specific price associated with a particular product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single price based on the provided price ID and product ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Product by ID
tools.description: The "Get Product by ID" API allows to retrieve information for a specific product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to fetch details for a single product based on the provided product ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Product Collections
tools.description: Fetch product collections for the connected HighLevel Location. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/collection.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Details about individual product collection
tools.description: Get Details about individual product collection Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/collection.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Product Reviews
tools.description: API to fetch the Product Reviews Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Product Store Stats
tools.description: API to fetch the total number of products, included in the store, and excluded from the store and other stats Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch Review Count as per status
tools.description: API to fetch the Review Count as per status Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.readonly`.

tools.name: List Prices for a Product
tools.description: The "List Prices for a Product" API allows retrieving a paginated list of prices associated with a specific product. Customize your results by filtering prices or paginate through the list using the provided query parameters. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.readonly`.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: The "List Products" API allows to retrieve a paginated list of products. Customize your results by filtering products based on name or paginate through the list using the provided query parameters. This endpoint provides a straightforward way to explore and retrieve product information. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.readonly`.

tools.name: Update Product Display Priorities
tools.description: Set product display priorities for a store in the connected Location. Confirm the complete intended ordering before calling. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Update Inventory
tools.description: The Update Inventory API allows the user to bulk update the inventory for multiple items. Use this endpoint to update the available quantity and out-of-stock purchase settings for multiple items in the inventory. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.write`.

tools.name: Update Price by ID for a Product
tools.description: Replace a product price by ID. This is a full replacement: resend every field to retain, including SKU, description, recurring schedule, trial period, total cycles, setup fee, compare-at price, shipping options, inventory settings, and digital-delivery settings. Omitted optional fields are cleared. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/prices.write`.

tools.name: Update Product by ID
tools.description: Update a product by ID. HighLevel ignores product_type and clears taxInclusive when tax_inclusive is omitted. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Update Product Collection
tools.description: Update a specific product collection with Id :collectionId Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products/collection.write`.

tools.name: Update Product Review
tools.description: Update status, reply, etc of a particular review Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: Update Product Store Inclusion
tools.description: API to update the status of products in a particular store Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `products.write`.

tools.name: List Proposal Documents
tools.description: Return one page of proposal and contract documents for the connected HighLevel location. Availability may depend on an account entitlement that has not been verified. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `documents_contracts/list.readonly`.

tools.name: List Proposal Templates
tools.description: Return one page of proposal and contract templates for the connected HighLevel location. Availability may depend on an account entitlement that has not been verified. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `documents_contracts_template/list.readonly`.

tools.name: Send Proposal Document
tools.description: Irreversibly send an existing proposal or contract to external recipients for the connected HighLevel location. Review the document, recipients, sender, and delivery medium before calling. Availability may depend on an unverified account entitlement. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `documents_contracts/sendLink.write`.

tools.name: Create or Send Proposal from Template
tools.description: Create a proposal or contract from a template for a contact in the connected HighLevel location. Setting `send_document=true` or omitting it sends externally and is irreversible; pass `false` to create a draft. Availability may depend on an unverified account entitlement. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `documents_contracts_template/sendLink.write`.

tools.name: Search Ad Targeting
tools.description: Search targeting options on Facebook Ads, Google Ads, or LinkedIn Ads. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `adPublishing.readonly`.

tools.name: Connect Account (Step 3 of 3)
tools.description: Attach an account returned by SOCIAL_PLANNER_GET_OAUTH_ACCOUNTS (step 2 of the OAuth flow). Copy its provider identifiers unchanged: Instagram requires page_id; LinkedIn requires type and urn; YouTube, Threads, and Pinterest require type='profile'; Google Business Profile requires both location and account. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/oauth.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Social Planner Posts
tools.description: Idempotently soft-delete up to 50 Social Planner posts from HighLevel. Repeating a deletion may report the same count again, and `SOCIAL_PLANNER_GET_POSTS` does not list these records with its `deleted` filter. Confirm all post IDs before calling. The proven six-scope OAuth union is sufficient, but HighLevel does not map this endpoint to one individually necessary scope; no Social Planner-specific PIT permission was enforced by the minimal-PIT probe.

tools.name: Clone a queue item
tools.description: Duplicates an existing queue item at a specified order position. Requires an active edit session. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Create a comment or reply
tools.description: Create a top-level post comment (`isParentThread: true`, `parentId` = post ID) or reply (`isParentThread: false`, `parentId` = comment ID). Attachments work only on Facebook; mentions work on Facebook, LinkedIn, and Community; `notifyAllGroupMembers` broadcasts only in Community and is ignored elsewhere. Content limits are Facebook 8000, Instagram 2200, LinkedIn 3000, Community 8000, TikTok 150, Bluesky 300, YouTube 10000, and Threads 500 characters. Location PITs must be provisioned with `socialplanner/comments.write`. Explicit confirmation is required.

tools.name: Like a comment
tools.description: Like a comment by its **Highlevel** comment ID (the `_id` returned by the list-comments endpoint — not the native platform ID). Works for any comment level — top-level comments, replies, and replies-to-replies. **Supported platforms:** Facebook, LinkedIn, Community, TikTok, Bluesky. Instagram is not supported (passing `instagram` returns 400). Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/comments.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Create post
tools.description: Create a draft or publish/schedule content on connected external social networks. An immediate `published` request can succeed without returning a post ID; recover the created record with `SOCIAL_PLANNER_GET_POSTS` using a narrow `from_date`/`to_date` window around creation. Non-draft requests require explicit confirmation because they may make content public or notify followers. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/post.write`.

tools.name: Create a new category queue
tools.description: Creates a queue in draft status for a category. Published posts are auto-added. Use update endpoint to activate. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Create a new item in the queue
tools.description: Adds a new post item to a queue. Use sessionId for edit session or directToQueue for immediate addition. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Delete Account
tools.description: Delete account and account from group Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/account.write`.

tools.name: Delete CSV
tools.description: Delete a CSV import and all its associated posts Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/csv.write`.

tools.name: Delete CSV Post
tools.description: Delete a specific post from a CSV import Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/csv.write`.

tools.name: Delete an active post and schedule the next one
tools.description: Deletes a post that is currently scheduled and automatically triggers the scheduling of the next available post in the queue. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Unlike a comment
tools.description: Remove a like from a comment by its **Highlevel** comment ID (the `_id` returned by the list-comments endpoint — not the native platform ID). Works for any comment level — top-level comments, replies, and replies-to-replies. **Supported platforms:** Facebook, LinkedIn, Community, TikTok, Bluesky. Instagram is not supported (passing `instagram` returns 400). Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/comments.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Delete Post
tools.description: Soft-delete one Social Planner post from HighLevel idempotently through the bulk-delete operation. Repeating the deletion may still report `deletedCount: 1`, and `SOCIAL_PLANNER_GET_POSTS` does not list these records with its `deleted` filter. This does not guarantee removal from an external social network. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/post.write`.

tools.name: Delete an item from a queue
tools.description: Deletes an item from a specific category queue. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Discard edit session changes
tools.description: Cancels the edit session and deletes all staged changes without affecting the live queue. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Edit post
tools.description: Edit an existing Social Planner post and optionally republish or reschedule it on its connected external networks. This PUT replaces stored post fields: GET the post first and resend values such as category, schedule date, and media that must be preserved. Non-draft changes require explicit confirmation because they may update public content or notify followers. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/post.write`.

tools.name: Get all categories with their queue status
tools.description: Returns categories with status: "available" (no queue), "in_queue" (active/paused queue), or "draft" (queue in draft). Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Get scheduled posts calendar view
tools.description: Returns scheduled posts from active queues within a date range. Supports filtering by categories and accounts. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch calendar view for an edit session
tools.description: Retrieves a calendar preview of scheduled posts based on draft items within an edit session. This shows how posts would be scheduled if changes were saved. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch a category queue by ID
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a single category queue by its unique ID. The response includes a count of posts within the queue that have errors. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch items from a queue
tools.description: Returns paginated queue items. Pass sessionId to get draft items from an edit session instead of live items. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch category queues for a location
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all category queues for a given location, excluding any that have been marked as deleted. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Fetch slot information for queue items
tools.description: Returns paginated slot information (scheduledDateTime, isSkipped) for queue items. Pass sessionId to get slots for draft items, or omit for live items. Call this after mutations to refresh slot data. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Accounts
tools.description: Get list of accounts and groups Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/account.readonly`.

tools.name: Get categories by id
tools.description: Retrieve a specific category by its ID Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: Get categories by location id
tools.description: Retrieve all categories for a specific location with optional search and pagination Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.readonly`.

tools.name: List comments for a post or thread
tools.description: Paginated list of comments scoped to a post (`parentId` = postId) or a comment thread (`parentId` = commentId). Use `skip`/`limit` for pagination, `sortBy` for ordering, `originIds` to filter by connected account, and `search` for keyword search. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/comments.readonly`.

tools.name: Get CSV Post
tools.description: Get details of a specific CSV import including its posts Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/csv.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Available Accounts (Step 2 of 3)
tools.description: Step 2 of the Social Planner OAuth flow: after Start OAuth returns an account ID, list the Facebook pages, Instagram professional accounts, Google Business Profile locations, LinkedIn organizations, TikTok accounts, YouTube channels, Pinterest accounts, Threads profiles, or Bluesky profiles available to attach. Pass the selected result to the attach-account action. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/oauth.readonly`.

tools.name: Get post
tools.description: Get post Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/post.readonly`.

tools.name: Get posts
tools.description: Get Social Planner posts. Use a narrow `from_date`/`to_date` window to recover an immediately published post when `SOCIAL_PLANNER_CREATE_POST` succeeds without returning a post ID. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/post.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Social Media Statistics
tools.description: Retrieve analytics data for multiple social media accounts. Supports custom date ranges for both the current period and a comparison period. If no date ranges are provided, defaults to the last 7 days (excluding today) with comparison to the previous 7 days. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/statistics.readonly`.

tools.name: Get tags by ids
tools.description: Retrieve specific tags by their IDs Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/tag.readonly`.

tools.name: Get tags by location id
tools.description: Retrieve all tags for a specific location with optional search and pagination Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/tag.readonly`.

tools.name: Get Upload Status
tools.description: Get the status of all CSV imports for a location Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/csv.readonly`.

tools.name: Reset an item in a queue
tools.description: Reset a staged queue item to its original state. For a live item with no original staged version, HighLevel deletes the item instead of restoring it. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Save edit session changes
tools.description: Applies all staged changes to the live queue and closes the edit session. Location PITs must be provisioned with the HighLevel permission: `socialplanner/category.write`. Explicit confirmation is required before this mutation is sent.

tools.name: Set Accounts

Retrieves a list of connected social media accounts and groups for a location. Returns account information including account IDs, platform types, and group associations. Use this tool when users want to get social media accounts, list connected accounts, find available accounts, or retrieve account information. Ideal for account selection, account management, and social media account discovery.

Capabilities: get_get-account

Examples:
- Use this tool to get accounts
- Endpoint: /social-media-posting/{authorized location}/accounts

Source: default | Team: social-media-posting

tools.name: Social-media-posting get-post
tools.description:
Retrieves detailed information for a specific social media post by post ID. Returns complete post details including content, media, status, schedule information, platform accounts, tags, categories, and post metadata. Use this tool when users want to get post details, view social media post, see post information, retrieve post data, or look up post by ID. Ideal for post detail viewing, post information retrieval, and post data lookup.

Capabilities: get_get-post

Examples:
- Use this tool to get post
- Endpoint: /social-media-posting/{authorized location}/posts/{id}

Source: default | Team: social-media-posting

tools.name: Social-media-posting get-posts
tools.description:
Retrieves social media posts with advanced filtering and pagination. Supports filtering by post type (recent, all, scheduled, draft, failed, in_review, published, in_progress, deleted), account IDs, date range, and post type (post, story, reel). Returns post list with content, media, status, schedule information, and post metadata. Use this tool when users want to get social media posts, list posts, find posts by status, search posts, filter posts by account, or view scheduled posts. Ideal for post management, content review, post scheduling, and social media content browsing.

Capabilities: get_get-posts

Examples:
- Use this tool to get posts
- Endpoint: /social-media-posting/{authorized location}/posts/list

Source: default | Team: social-media-posting

tools.name: Social-media-posting get-social-media-statistics
tools.description:
Retrieve analytics data for multiple social media accounts. Provides metrics for the last 7 days with comparison to the previous 7 days. Supports filtering by platforms and specific connected accounts.

Capabilities: get_get-social-media-statistics

Examples:
- Use this tool to get social media statistics
- Endpoint: /social-media-posting/statistics

Source: default | Team: social-media-posting

name: Hireflix
description: Hireflix is a one-way video interview platform for managing positions, candidate interviews, templates, themes, and hiring workflows.

tools.name: Create Candidate Interview
tools.description: Create a candidate interview in a Hireflix position without sending candidate notifications. This still creates a candidate and interview record.

tools.name: Create Position
tools.description: Create a one-way interview position with one or more video-answer questions. Positions are private by default; setting public=true makes the position publicly discoverable. Empty notification arrays request no custom configurations, but Hireflix may apply account defaults. Use Create Candidate Interview to add a candidate without sending; Invite Candidate sends configured notifications.

tools.name: Permanently Delete Position
tools.description: Permanently delete a Hireflix position and its associated workflow state. This destructive operation cannot be undone. Use only a position ID that the caller explicitly intends to remove.

tools.name: Get Account Overview
tools.description: Return the connected Hireflix user, company, subscription status, permissions, and current usage counters without exposing credentials.

tools.name: Get Interview
tools.description: Return one accessible Hireflix interview with candidate, progress, answers, scores, comments, metadata, and sharing state.

tools.name: Get Position
tools.description: Return one Hireflix position's configuration and interview-step details by position ID; use List Position Interviews for candidates.

tools.name: Invite Candidate
tools.description: Invite a candidate to a Hireflix position and immediately send any configured candidate notifications. Notification delivery cannot be undone; use Create Candidate Interview to create the record without sending.

tools.name: List Notification Templates
tools.description: List Hireflix notification templates for one channel without returning Draft.js message bodies.

tools.name: List Position Interviews
tools.description: Return one cursor-controlled page of interviews for a Hireflix position, with optional candidate and stage filters.

tools.name: List Positions
tools.description: Return all positions visible to the connected Hireflix account, including archive state and tags.

tools.name: List Themes
tools.description: Return the company's available position branding themes and their core visual settings.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Return configured Hireflix webhook destinations, activation state, and subscribed events without exposing signing secrets.

tools.name: Set Interview Decision
tools.description: Move a Hireflix interview to the shortlisted or discarded hiring stage.

tools.name: Set Position Archived
tools.description: Archive a Hireflix position to stop new submissions, or unarchive it to accept submissions again.

tools.name: Share Interview
tools.description: Create an immediately active public, unauthenticated link exposing a Hireflix interview and its answers for duration_days (default 75). This toolkit cannot revoke the link before expiry, so treat sharing as irreversible.

tools.name: Update Interview Review
tools.description: Set or clear exactly one review field for a Hireflix interview: the connected user's score or comment. Pass null to clear the selected field; use a separate call for the other field.

tools.name: Update Position
tools.description: Patch a Hireflix position's core settings. Omitted fields are preserved. Null clears theme or restores automatic transcription language; use [] to clear tags. Supplied tag and question arrays replace existing values rather than merging.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity of the user associated with the connected API key.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate or copy an integration API key from Hireflix Admin > My Account > API Keys at https://admin.hireflix.com/en/my-account/api-keys. Keep this key secret; it grants access to your company's administration API.

name: HitPay
description: HitPay provides payment processing, commerce, invoicing, recurring billing, payout, and business-management APIs for merchants.

tools.name: Get Account Status
tools.description: Check the connected HitPay business's verification, bank-account, and payment-provider readiness.

tools.name: Get Balances
tools.description: Return available, pending, deposit, and reserve balances by currency and wallet provider.

tools.name: Get Location
tools.description: Retrieve one HitPay business location by ID.

tools.name: Get Payment Request
tools.description: Retrieve the current status and details of one HitPay payment request.

tools.name: List Charges
tools.description: Search completed and attempted charges by status, date, amount, payment request, customer, or location. Returns one page and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: List customer records stored by the connected HitPay business. Returns one provider-selected page because continuation input has not been verified.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Find invoices by customer email, status, or merchant reference. Returns one provider page; continuation is unavailable because HitPay's cursor input has not been verified.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: List business locations, optionally filtering by name keywords or an exact location ID. Returns one page and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List Orders
tools.description: Search HitPay commerce orders by version, status, date, or keywords. Returns one provider page because continuation input is not verified.

tools.name: List Payment Requests
tools.description: Search hosted payment requests and inspect their current payment status.

tools.name: List Product Categories
tools.description: Browse or search active and nested HitPay product categories.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Search the HitPay product catalog using product, inventory, location, and sales-channel filters.

tools.name: List Recurring Billings
tools.description: Find recurring billing records by customer, reference, plan, or status.

tools.name: List Staff

tools.name: List Subscription Plans
tools.description: List recurring-payment plans configured for the connected HitPay business.

required.name: full

name: Hive
description: Hive is a project management and team collaboration platform for managing actions, projects, workflows, resources, and workspace metadata.

tools.name: Create Action
tools.description: Create a Hive action (task) in a workspace, optionally inside a project and assigned to users.

tools.name: Create Label
tools.description: Create a color-coded label in a Hive workspace.

tools.name: Delete Action
tools.description: Soft-delete one Hive action by ID. Hive preserves soft-delete semantics; this tool does not permanently erase the action. Deleting an action that is already gone succeeds rather than failing.

tools.name: Delete Label
tools.description: Delete one label from a Hive workspace. Deleting a label that is already gone succeeds rather than failing.

tools.name: Get Action
tools.description: Get the current details of one Hive action by ID.

tools.name: List Actions
tools.description: List Hive actions in a workspace, optionally narrowed by project, status, dates, hierarchy, or archive state.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: List labels configured in a Hive workspace and return label IDs usable in action search.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List projects in a Hive workspace, with optional archive and parent-project filters.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: List Hive workspaces accessible to the connected API key and return IDs needed by workspace-scoped tools.

tools.name: Search Actions
tools.description: Search action titles in a Hive workspace and return one offset-based result page.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Hive API key for the core REST API. In Hive, open your profile or My Settings, select API Info, and generate or copy the API key. Keep this value secret.

name: Hjarni
description: Hjarni is a personal knowledge management platform for organizing, searching, linking, and maintaining notes, containers, and tags.

tools.name: Create Container
tools.description: Create a root or nested Hjarni container for organizing notes.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Create a Markdown note in the inbox or a container. Tags named in tag_names are applied as part of creation. Free accounts are limited to 25 notes, so check account status if quota pressure is possible.

tools.name: Create Notes
tools.description: Create 1-25 Markdown notes in order and return one result per input. This batch is non-atomic: successful notes remain created if another item fails.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a Hjarni tag for organizing notes.

tools.name: Get Account Status
tools.description: Return the connected Hjarni identity, token scope, plan, teams, and current resource usage and quotas. Use this before creating many notes or attachments; Free accounts allow 25 notes, 5 attachments, and 20 MB of attachment storage.

tools.name: Get Note
tools.description: Get one Hjarni note by ID with its Markdown body, tags, container, attachments, links, and optimistic-lock version.

tools.name: List Containers
tools.description: List Hjarni containers as active roots, archived roots, or all active containers in a flat view. Use next_cursor to page through results.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: List and filter personal Hjarni notes, including active, inbox, archived, or favorited notes. Use next_cursor to page through results; use query for simple personal-note filtering.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List all Hjarni tags and their note counts. Use next_cursor to page through results.

tools.name: List Trashed Notes
tools.description: List recoverable trashed Hjarni notes with their deletion and scheduled purge times. Use next_cursor to page through results.

tools.name: Rename Tag
tools.description: Rename an existing Hjarni tag without changing its note associations.

tools.name: Restore Note
tools.description: Restore a note from Trash before its scheduled purge and return the active note.

tools.name: Move Note to Trash
tools.description: Move a note to recoverable Trash. This is not immediate permanent deletion: Hjarni retains the note for about 30 days, and RESTORE_NOTE can recover it before purge.

tools.name: Update Container
tools.description: Update a Hjarni container's name, description, parent, position, or container-specific AI instructions.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Update note metadata, placement, tags, or body. body replaces the entire Markdown body; append_body safely appends text. Provide expected_lock_version from GET_NOTE to prevent overwriting concurrent edits.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a personal integration token in Hjarni under Settings > Connections. Use a full-account token rather than restricting it to a folder so all REST API operations can access the resources allowed by your account. Keep this token secret.

name: HLR Lookup
description: HLR Lookup provides phone-number validation, network and portability intelligence, account balance checks, and asynchronous bulk HLR processing.

tools.name: Check Phone Status
tools.description: Run full HLR lookups for 1-80 phone numbers. This processes sensitive phone data and spends credits; optional status features can increase the cost.

tools.name: Create Batch
tools.description: Create an empty persistent HLR_V2 batch. Creation has no documented charge and handles no phone data; later uploads persist sensitive phone data, and processing can spend credits.

tools.name: Delete Batch
tools.description: Permanently delete one HLR batch and its results. This action is irreversible: never invoke it without explicit authorization, and download all needed results before deletion. It does not select a batch automatically.

tools.name: Download Batch Results
tools.description: Download a completed batch's full, unpaginated CSV or JSON result export, including source phone values and sensitive HLR intelligence, as a file reference. Select the required format explicitly.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected HLR Lookup account's remaining credit balance. This zero-credit read is the approved authentication check and does not process a phone number.

tools.name: Get Batch
tools.description: Return metadata and current progress for one HLR batch. Use it to follow an asynchronous batch until status is COMPLETE.

tools.name: List Batches
tools.description: List the connected account's HLR batches with their metadata and progress. The response reports provider offset and limit values, but the API documents no pagination inputs.

tools.name: Run MNP Lookup
tools.description: Look up network and mobile-number-portability data for 1-80 phone numbers. This processes sensitive phone data and spends credits; requesting the optional ported date is the only MNP feature that can add a surcharge.

tools.name: Pause Batch
tools.description: Pause processing one HLR batch. This action returns when the command is accepted and does not poll for a status change.

tools.name: Schedule Batch
tools.description: Schedule processing of one uploaded HLR batch at a UTC time. Scheduled processing of sensitive phone data can irreversibly spend credits, so never invoke this action automatically. This action does not poll for processing or completion.

tools.name: Start or Resume Batch
tools.description: Start or resume processing one uploaded HLR batch. Processing sensitive phone data can irreversibly spend credits, so never invoke this action automatically. This action returns when the command is accepted and does not poll for completion.

tools.name: Upload Batch CSV
tools.description: Upload a CSV file of sensitive phone data into an empty HLR batch. The provider permits one source upload; repeating it on a populated batch is documented to fail.

tools.name: Upload Batch Phone Numbers
tools.description: Upload 1-100,000 sensitive phone numbers into an empty HLR batch as a compact JSON array. The UTF-8 body must not exceed 2 MiB, and a populated batch cannot be uploaded again.

tools.name: Validate Phone Numbers
tools.description: Validate formatting and original-network information for 1-80 phone numbers without a live HLR lookup. It costs zero credits but still processes sensitive phone data.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API v2 key from the HLR Lookup portal. Sign in at https://portal.hlrlookup.com, open Account settings, then APIv2, and copy the key paired with your API secret.

required.name: generic_token
required.description: Your API v2 secret from the HLR Lookup portal. Sign in at https://portal.hlrlookup.com, open Account settings, then APIv2, and copy the secret paired with your API key.
