name: Jev
description: Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One API for discovering available models and evaluating structured state with Noul, Choice, and Score questions.

tools.name: Evaluate State
tools.description: Evaluate one shared state against one or more named Noul, Choice, or Score questions in parallel; each call performs usage-priced inference.

price.description: $0.042 per 1 million input tokens; output tokens free

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: List the Jev model names and aliases available to the connected account for use in evaluations.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your TypeSafe API key. Create or copy it from the TypeSafe console at https://console.typesafe.ai/keys, then keep it secret. Your account must have Jev early-access API access.

name: Jibble
description: Manage Jibble organizations, people, schedules, projects, time tracking, attendance, time off, reports, and approvals.

tools.name: Archive Member
tools.description: Dangerously deactivate a member by setting their status to Removed while retaining their data. The member will lose access to Jibble.

tools.name: Archive Screenshot
tools.description: Archive one time-tracking screenshot so it is no longer active. The screenshot ID must come from Jibble's screenshot records.

tools.name: Archive Time Entry
tools.description: Archive one time entry by setting its status to Archived so it is no longer active in time-tracking records.

tools.name: Assign Member Position
tools.description: Assign one existing position to a member.

tools.name: Assign Member To Project
tools.description: Assign one existing member to an existing project.

tools.name: Change Member Role
tools.description: Dangerously replace a member's authorization role. This administrative change can grant privileged organization access or remove existing access; confirm both the member and replacement role before calling.

tools.name: Change Pay Period Status
tools.description: Dangerously change a pay period to Approved, Reopened, or Rejected. This approval decision locks or unlocks its time records as Jibble defines; confirm the pay period and intended status before calling.

tools.name: Change Time Off Request Status
tools.description: Change a time-off request to Approved, Cancelled, Rejected, or Pending. This approves, cancels, rejects, or returns the request to pending review; confirm the request and intended status before calling.

tools.name: Clear Project Client
tools.description: Remove the client assignment from one project. This action can only clear the assignment; it cannot assign or replace a client.

tools.name: Clock In
tools.description: Clock a Jibble member in with required device context and optional activity, project, location, coordinates, and automatic clock-out context.

tools.name: Clock Out
tools.description: Clock a Jibble member out by creating an Out time entry with required client device context.

tools.name: Create Activity
tools.description: Create a time-tracking activity.

tools.name: Create Client
tools.description: Create an organization client. Jibble may require an upgraded plan.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Create an organization group with a caller-supplied ID and name.

tools.name: Create Holiday
tools.description: Add a named holiday date to an organization calendar.

tools.name: Create Kiosk
tools.description: Create an attendance kiosk for a location and selected members using a sensitive master PIN. The PIN is sent to Jibble but never returned.

tools.name: Create Location
tools.description: Create a work location with an address, geofence, and coordinates.

tools.name: Create Member
tools.description: Create a member and optionally send an invitation email to that member.

tools.name: Create Position
tools.description: Create an organization position with a name.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a project with optional client and location assignments.

tools.name: Create Schedule
tools.description: Create a fixed or flexible work schedule with per-day working times and optional paid or unpaid breaks.

tools.name: Create Time Off Request
tools.description: Create either a full-day or hourly time-off request for a Jibble member under a specific time-off policy.

tools.name: Delete Async Export
tools.description: Delete a generic asynchronous OData export from the Jibble service where it was started, freeing an active export slot. This does not delete XLSX attendance reports.

tools.name: Delete Holiday
tools.description: Permanently delete one holiday from an organization calendar. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Location
tools.description: Permanently delete an organization location. This destructive action cannot be undone; archive the location instead when permanent deletion is not required.

tools.name: Delete Member Permanently
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly delete a member and all of their retained data. This cannot be undone; use Archive Member instead when permanent deletion is not required.

tools.name: Get Async Export
tools.description: Poll a generic asynchronous OData export on the Jibble service where it was started. Returns either job-state metadata or the completed exported payload without changing provider field casing. This does not download XLSX attendance reports.

tools.name: Get Current Attendance Totals
tools.description: Get real-time counts of members clocked in, clocked out, or on a break for a documented attendance scope and optional member filters.

tools.name: Get Kiosk
tools.description: Get one attendance kiosk by ID with optional location expansion.

tools.name: Get Latest Time Entry
tools.description: Get a member's latest time entry, returning no entry when the member has not recorded one.

tools.name: Get Organizations
tools.description: Return organizations available to the connected Jibble API credentials, including IDs and settings.

tools.name: Get Pay Period Approval
tools.description: Get one pay-period approval with daily breakdowns and totals.

tools.name: Get Recent Activities
tools.description: Get a bounded number of activities recently used by one Jibble member.

tools.name: Get Recent Projects
tools.description: Get a bounded number of projects recently used by one member.

tools.name: Get Timesheet Daily Summary
tools.description: Get per-member daily attendance summaries and total tracked duration for a date range, optionally limited to selected member IDs.

tools.name: Get Tracked Time Report
tools.description: Get tracked-time report data grouped by a primary and optional secondary dimension, with filters for people and organization entities.

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: List organization activities with optional OData filtering and field selection.

tools.name: List Approval Configurations
tools.description: List pay-period definitions used to configure timesheet approvals.

tools.name: List Async Exports
tools.description: List generic OData asynchronous exports from a selected Jibble service. This does not list or download XLSX attendance reports started by Start Attendance Report Export.

tools.name: List Calendars
tools.description: List holiday calendars available in the organization.

tools.name: List Clients
tools.description: List clients configured in the organization.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: List groups visible to the connected organization credentials.

tools.name: List Holidays
tools.description: List calendar holidays with OData filtering, field selection, total counts, and opaque cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Hour Entries
tools.description: List raw hour entries with OData filtering, expansion, field selection, ordering, and cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Leave Balances
tools.description: List member leave balances for a requested date, with optional OData person or policy filtering and ordering.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: List organization locations with optional OData filtering and field selection.

tools.name: List Members
tools.description: List organization members with optional OData filtering, field selection, relationship expansion, ordering, and group IDs.

tools.name: List Member Time Status
tools.description: List members' current active state and recent time-entry activity or project fields using Jibble's documented time-tracking projections.

tools.name: List Pay Period Approvals
tools.description: List member pay-period approval summaries with OData filtering, total counts, and opaque cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Positions
tools.description: List positions configured in the organization.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List organization projects and optionally expand client and location details.

tools.name: List Roles
tools.description: List authorization roles that can be assigned to Jibble members.

tools.name: List Schedules
tools.description: List organization work schedules with optional people and group expansion.

tools.name: List Screenshots
tools.description: List time-tracking screenshots with optional OData filtering, ordering, field selection, and person expansion.

tools.name: List Time Entries
tools.description: List raw time entries with OData filtering, expansion, field selection, stable ordering, total counts, and opaque cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Time Off Policies
tools.description: List organization time-off policies with an optional OData status filter.

tools.name: List Time Off Requests
tools.description: List time-off requests with OData date or status filtering, person or policy expansion, ordering, total counts, and opaque cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Timesheets
tools.description: List member timesheets for a date and Day, Week, or Month period, with member search, OData filtering and expansion, and cursor pagination.

tools.name: Start Attendance Report Export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous XLSX attendance-report export for a date range and selected report sections. Returns the ID from Jibble's export metadata; Jibble documents this ID as the identifier used to download the generated file, but this toolkit does not expose that download operation.

tools.name: Update Activity
tools.description: Rename an existing time-tracking activity.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Rename an existing organization group.

tools.name: Update Location
tools.description: Update a location's name, address, status, geofence, or coordinates.

tools.name: Update Member
tools.description: Update a member's profile, group, or schedule without archiving the member. Jibble does not support direct member-location assignment on People; configure locations through schedule or project location assignments instead.

tools.name: Update Organization Settings
tools.description: Dangerously change organization-wide country or time-tracking settings for one organization. These changes affect the entire organization.

tools.name: Update Position
tools.description: Rename an existing organization position.

tools.name: Update Schedule
tools.description: Rename a schedule or replace its break type and break assignments.

tools.name: Update Time Entry
tools.description: Update a time entry's activity or note without archiving it.

tools.name: Update Time Off Request
tools.description: Update the dates or note of an existing time-off request without changing its approval status.

required.name: client_id
required.description: The Client ID shown after creating an API key in Jibble under Organization Settings > API Keys (also labeled API Credentials) > Create New Secret.

required.name: client_secret
required.description: The Client Secret shown with the Client ID after creating an API key in Jibble under Organization Settings > API Keys > Create New Secret. Copy it when Jibble displays it and keep it secret.

name: Jigsawstack
description: JigsawStack provides a suite of custom small AI models integrated into scalable infrastructure, enabling developers to build AI-powered applications efficiently.

tools.name: Check Image for NSFW Content
tools.description: Tool to detect NSFW content in images. Use when you need to quickly detect nudity, violence, hentai, porn and other NSFW content in images.

tools.name: Check Profanity
tools.description: Tool to check text for profanity and inappropriate language. Use when you need to validate user-generated content, filter inappropriate language, or sanitize text input.

tools.name: Check Spam
tools.description: Tool to perform spam check analysis on text. Use when you need to detect spam content and get a spam confidence score.

tools.name: Check Spelling
tools.description: Tool to check and correct spelling errors in text. Use when you need to validate text for spelling mistakes and get correction suggestions.

tools.name: Classify Content
tools.description: Tool to classify text and image datasets using custom labels. Use when you need to categorize content into predefined labels.

tools.name: Convert HTML to Image or PDF
tools.description: Tool to convert HTML to images (PNG/JPEG/WEBP) or PDF, or capture website screenshots. Use when you need to generate visual representations of HTML content or web pages.

tools.name: Create Embedding V2
tools.description: Tool to generate enhanced vector embeddings with speaker fingerprint support using the v2 model. Use when you need to create embeddings from text, images, audio, or PDF files.

tools.name: Create Prediction
tools.description: Tool to forecast time series data using AI-powered prediction. Use when you need to predict future values based on historical data patterns.

tools.name: Create Prompt
tools.description: Tool to create a new prompt in the Prompt Engine for reusable LLM interactions. Use when you need to store and manage prompt templates with variable inputs.

tools.name: Create Voice Clone
tools.description: Tool to create a cloned voice for text-to-speech synthesis. Use when you need to clone a voice from an audio sample for later use in TTS operations.

tools.name: Detect Objects in Image
tools.description: Tool to recognize and identify objects within an image using computer vision AI. Use when you need to detect and locate objects in images.

tools.name: Extract Data with Vision OCR
tools.description: Tool to recognize, describe and retrieve data within images with great accuracy using Vision OCR. Use when you need to extract text, data fields, or descriptions from images or PDFs.

tools.name: Get Search Suggestions
tools.description: Tool to get real-time search suggestions for a given query. Use when you need to provide autocomplete suggestions or related search queries.

tools.name: Get Sentiment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve sentiment analysis via GET request. Use when you need to classify text into positive, negative, or neutral sentiment using a GET endpoint.

tools.name: Generate Image from Prompt
tools.description: Tool to generate images from text prompts. Use when you need visual content created from a prompt.

tools.name: List Prompts
tools.description: Tool to list all prompts stored in the Prompt Engine. Use when you need to retrieve or view stored prompts.

tools.name: Run Prompt By ID
tools.description: Tool to execute a stored prompt using its prompt engine ID. Use when you need to run a pre-configured prompt template with dynamic input values.

tools.name: Scrape Website
tools.description: Tool to scrape any website and extract structured data using AI-powered element prompts or CSS selectors. Use when you need to extract specific information from web pages without writing custom scraping code. Supports both URL-based scraping and direct HTML content parsing.

tools.name: Sentiment Analysis
tools.description: Tool to analyze text sentiment. Use when you need to classify text into positive, negative, or neutral sentiment.

tools.name: Summarize Text
tools.description: Tool to generate concise, intelligent summaries of text or documents with AI. Use when you need to condense long content into bullet points or paragraphs.

tools.name: Text to Speech
tools.description: Tool to convert text to natural-sounding speech. Use when you need to generate an audio file from text input.

tools.name: Translate Text
tools.description: Tool to translate text from one language to another. Use when you need to convert text between different languages with automatic language detection support.

tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Tool to perform AI-powered web search with AI overview and geo-aware results. Use when you need concise search results enriched with AI summary and location context.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your JigsawStack API key for authentication

name: Jinko
description: Jinko provides flight and hotel discovery, trip management, ancillaries, and hosted travel checkout APIs.

tools.name: Add Trip Item
tools.description: Add one flight or hotel offer to an existing trip. Returns the successful mutation snapshot and a best-effort canonical trip read; if that read fails, the warning confirms the mutation succeeded and must not be retried blindly.

tools.name: Create Hosted Checkout
tools.description: Quote a complete trip and create a hosted checkout URL for a person to review and pay. This tool neither opens checkout nor submits payment nor creates a booking; create a fresh checkout if the quote expires.

tools.name: Create Trip
tools.description: Create a new trip containing one flight or hotel offer. Returns the successful mutation snapshot and a best-effort canonical trip read; if that read fails, the warning confirms the mutation succeeded and must not be retried blindly.

tools.name: Find Destinations
tools.description: Discover destinations reachable from one or more origins using cached fare data, with optional dates, budget, cabin, and passenger constraints. Increase offset to request another page; returned_count describes only this page.

tools.name: Get Hotel Details
tools.description: Get descriptive property, policy, facility, image, and room metadata for one hotel. Rooms are descriptive and unpriced; use Search Hotels for current rates and bookable hotel offer IDs.

tools.name: Get Trip
tools.description: Read the canonical current state of a trip, including items, travelers, contact, quote and fulfillment state, totals, and booking references. Use this instead of relying on a prior mutation response.

tools.name: List Trip Ancillaries
tools.description: Create or reuse a price quote and list purchasable baggage, seat, meal, and other ancillary offers for a trip without creating checkout. Creating the quote can update the trip's quote state and consume Jinko account credit; completed quotes are reused while valid. If Jinko is still pricing, this tool polls until ready or times out; it never returns a hosted checkout URL.

tools.name: Remove Trip Item
tools.description: Remove one flight or hotel item from an existing trip. This is destructive. Returns the successful mutation snapshot and a best-effort canonical trip read; if that read fails, do not retry blindly and reconcile with Get Trip.

tools.name: Replace Trip Travelers and Contact
tools.description: Replace an existing trip's complete traveler list and optionally its booking contact. Travelers cannot be empty. Returns the successful mutation snapshot and a best-effort canonical read; a read warning must not trigger a blind retry.

tools.name: Search Flight Calendar
tools.description: Search cached priced itineraries for known origins and destinations across exact or flexible dates. This does not live-price fares; pass an itinerary's offer token to Search Flights before adding a fare to a trip.

tools.name: Search Flights
tools.description: Get live flight offers either by searching a route or by re-pricing one cached discovery offer. Provide exactly one of search or offer_token; re-pricing can return multiple alternatives and exact_match_found may be false.

tools.name: Search Hotels
tools.description: Search live hotel availability and priced room rates for dates, occupancy, and one location selector. Pass next_cursor by itself to continue the same search using Jinko's exact next offset.

tools.name: Select Ancillaries
tools.description: Replace the ancillary selections for one trip item using offer IDs from List Trip Ancillaries. This updates the quoted trip price but does not create checkout or submit payment.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a production API key in the Jinko dashboard at Developers > API Keys (https://dashboard.gojinko.com/developers/keys). Copy the full key when it is shown; it begins with jnk_ or jnk_t_, is environment-specific, and must be kept secret. Sandbox keys do not work with this production connector.

name: Job Search
description: Search approved job-listing sources through fixed RapidAPI Runtime provider hosts. Availability depends on the connected RapidAPI application's subscriptions and plan entitlements.

tools.name: Count Active ATS Jobs
tools.description: Count active ATS jobs matching company, role, location, date, salary, and enrichment filters without returning job records.

tools.name: Count Active Job Board Jobs
tools.description: Count active LinkedIn, Wellfound, and Y Combinator jobs matching company, role, location, date, salary, and enrichment filters.

tools.name: List Active ATS Jobs
tools.description: List active ATS jobs with company, role, location, date, salary, and enrichment filters plus offset or cursor pagination.

tools.name: List Active Job Board Jobs
tools.description: List active LinkedIn, Wellfound, and Y Combinator jobs with company, role, location, date, salary, and enrichment filters plus pagination.

tools.name: Count Daily International Jobs
tools.description: Count international job postings matching documented date, company, role, salary, and geography filters.

tools.name: List Distinct International Job Values
tools.description: List distinct values and counts for a searchable international-job field.

tools.name: Search Daily International Jobs
tools.description: Search international job postings with documented date, company, role, salary, geography, and pagination filters.

tools.name: Get International Job Statistics
tools.description: Get coverage and frequency statistics for a searchable international-job field.

tools.name: Estimate Glassdoor Salary
tools.description: Estimate Glassdoor salary for a title, location, and experience range.

tools.name: Get Glassdoor Company Overview
tools.description: Get an employer overview and ratings by Glassdoor company ID.

tools.name: Get Glassdoor Company Salaries
tools.description: Get salary data for a job title at one Glassdoor company.

tools.name: List Glassdoor Company Interviews
tools.description: List interview experiences for a Glassdoor company by job function, job title, location type, offer outcome, sort order, regional domain, and page.

tools.name: List Glassdoor Company Jobs
tools.description: List jobs posted by a Glassdoor company with location and function filters.

tools.name: List Glassdoor Company Reviews
tools.description: List and filter employee reviews for a Glassdoor company.

tools.name: List Glassdoor Company Salaries
tools.description: List paginated salary records for a Glassdoor company, optionally by title and location.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Autocomplete Companies
tools.description: Returns company-name suggestions and identifiers for a partial name. Use the result to select a company before calling company-specific actions.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Search Companies
tools.description: Returns paginated company matches for a name query. Use the returned company identifiers with company profile, review, interview, job, and benefit actions.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Search Conversations
tools.description: Returns paginated Glassdoor conversation matches for a text query, ordered by relevance or recency. Use a returned ID to fetch one conversation's details.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Company Base Info
tools.description: Returns core identity and profile information for a company ID. Use this for basic company data rather than the broader company overview actions.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Company Interview Details
tools.description: Returns one interview report identified by an interview ID. Use the company interviews action first when the interview ID is not known.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Company Job Details
tools.description: Returns the detailed company-job listing identified by a listing ID and the query string supplied by a company jobs result.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Company Overview
tools.description: Returns a company overview for a profile ID and company ID. Use this for a company summary; use the detailed overview action for the expanded profile.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Conversation Details
tools.description: Returns one Glassdoor conversation and its detailed content by conversation ID. Use conversation search first when the ID is not known.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Detailed Company Overview
tools.description: Returns the expanded company overview for a company ID. Use this when the standard overview or base information does not provide enough profile detail.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Job Details
tools.description: Returns the detailed job listing identified by a listing ID and the query string supplied by a general job-search result.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Salary Details
tools.description: Returns the provider's salary-detail payload, distinct from a salary report selected by ID. Supply salary_id returned by Search Salaries.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Get Salary Report
tools.description: Returns one salary report for a provider salary ID. Use salary search to find salary records before requesting an individual report.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Autocomplete Jobs
tools.description: Returns job-title suggestions for a partial query. Use a suggestion to refine the query sent to job search.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Search Jobs
tools.description: Searches job listings across companies and returns filtered, sortable, cursor-paginated results. Use company jobs instead to restrict results to one company.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Awards
tools.description: Lists awards associated with a company. Use this for recognition and award history rather than general company profile data.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Benefits
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of employee-reported benefits for a company. Use this to inspect benefits rather than reviews or general profile data.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Interviews
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of interview reports for a company, with optional sorting. Use an interview ID from the result to fetch one detailed report.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Jobs
tools.description: Lists job openings for one company, with title, location, date, function, sort, and cursor filters. Use the general job search for cross-company results.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Locations
tools.description: Lists locations associated with a company ID. Use this for a company's offices and operating locations, not to resolve a job-search location.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Photos
tools.description: Returns the provider's company photo collection. Supply company_id from Search Companies.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Company Reviews
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of employee reviews for a company, with optional sorting. Use this for workplace feedback rather than company profile data.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: List Salary Filters
tools.description: Returns the provider's available salary-search filter metadata. The provider's public parameter schema is unavailable, so this action exposes no inputs.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Resolve Job Location
tools.description: Resolves a location name to Glassdoor job-location matches and identifiers. Use a returned identifier as the location filter in job search.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Resolve Salary Location
tools.description: Returns the provider's salary-location resolution payload for use with salary search. Supply a location query such as New York.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Autocomplete Salaries
tools.description: Returns salary-title suggestions for a partial query. Use a suggestion to refine the query sent to salary search.

tools.name: Glassdoor Real-Time: Search Salaries
tools.description: Searches salary records by job title and returns paginated compensation results, with experience, function, location, and sort filters.

tools.name: Search Glassdoor Companies
tools.description: Search Glassdoor employers by name or company ID.

tools.name: Search Glassdoor Jobs
tools.description: Search Glassdoor jobs by query, location and location type, easy-apply or remote status, posting age, minimum company rating, regional domain, and cursor.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Entry-Level Jobs
tools.description: Lists entry-level and junior roles, graduate programs, trainee positions, and jobs that do not require prior experience.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Four-Day Work Week Jobs
tools.description: Lists positions offering a four-day work week or compressed schedule.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Freelance Jobs
tools.description: Lists freelance, contractor, consulting, and other independent-work opportunities.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List High-Paying Jobs
tools.description: Lists high-compensation positions listed as paying at least $100,000.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Internships
tools.description: Lists internships, co-op positions, trainee programs, apprenticeships, and student opportunities.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs
tools.description: Lists aggregated job postings from sources including LinkedIn, Indeed, Jooble, ZipRecruiter, and Glassdoor.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Benefits
tools.description: Lists positions filtered by benefits and perks, including roles advertising health insurance, retirement plans, or stock options.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Company
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by company. Supply company, for example Google.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Company Size
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by company size for startup through enterprise employers.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Distance
tools.description: Lists job postings filtered by distance.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Experience
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by experience level, covering career stages from entry level through executive roles.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Industry
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by industry specific for sectors such as healthcare, finance, and technology.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Job Type
tools.description: Lists job postings filtered by job type.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Language
tools.description: Lists job postings filtered by language.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Minimum Salary
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by minimum salary.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Salary
tools.description: Lists job postings filtered by salary.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Sites
tools.description: Lists aggregated job postings filtered by site.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs by Technology Stack
tools.description: Lists jobs filtered by technology stack for technologies and programming languages such as React, Python, or AWS.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Jobs with Relocation
tools.description: Lists positions offering relocation packages or assistance.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Recent Jobs
tools.description: Lists recent job postings aggregated from multiple sources.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Remote Jobs
tools.description: Lists remote and work-from-home job postings across industries and roles.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Startup Jobs
tools.description: Lists opportunities at startups, early-stage companies, and venture-backed firms, including listings from startup-focused platforms.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Trending Jobs
tools.description: Lists trending and highly viewed job openings from the past week.

tools.name: Google Jobs: List Visa Sponsorship Jobs
tools.description: Lists positions offering employer-sponsored work authorization such as H-1B sponsorship or work permits.

tools.name: Google Jobs: Search by Exact Job Title
tools.description: Searches filtered by exact job title. Supply title, for example Software Engineer.

tools.name: Search Indeed US jobs
tools.description: Search the Indeed Jobs API US feed by keyword and city or state, with offset pagination.

tools.name: Get Bing job
tools.description: Gets full details for a Bing job by its search-result ID.

tools.name: Search Bing jobs
tools.description: Searches Bing job listings by keywords and location, with posting-age, employment-type, remote-only, and pagination filters.

tools.name: Get Indeed job
tools.description: Gets full details for an Indeed job by its search-result ID.

tools.name: Search Indeed jobs
tools.description: Searches Indeed job listings with documented country, distance, sorting, and pagination filters.

tools.name: Get LinkedIn job
tools.description: Gets full details for a LinkedIn job by its numeric search-result ID.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn organizations
tools.description: Finds LinkedIn organization IDs that can be passed to the LinkedIn jobs search action.

tools.name: Search LinkedIn jobs
tools.description: Searches LinkedIn job listings by keywords, organization, and location, with posting-age, employment-type, experience, workplace, and pagination filters.

tools.name: Get job salary ranges
tools.description: Compares reported salary ranges for a job title in a selected country.

tools.name: List salary job titles
tools.description: Finds canonical job-title matches for a query and country before a salary-range lookup.

tools.name: Get Xing job
tools.description: Gets full details for a Xing job by its search-result ID.

tools.name: Search Xing jobs
tools.description: Searches Xing job listings by keywords and location, with posting-age, employment-type, career-level, workplace, salary, and pagination filters.

tools.name: Ping Jobs Search API
tools.description: Diagnostic endpoint that confirms provider reachability only. It returns no jobs and should not be used for normal job searches.

tools.name: Search jobs
tools.description: Searches Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, and Google by keywords, location, posting age, job type, and remote status; returns JSON results.

tools.name: Search jobs for Excel
tools.description: Searches Indeed, LinkedIn, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, and Google and returns the matching jobs as a downloadable Excel workbook.

tools.name: Get JSearch Company Job Salary
tools.description: Get salary data for a job title at a specified company.

tools.name: Get JSearch Estimated Salary
tools.description: Get estimated salary for a title, location, and experience range.

tools.name: Get JSearch Job Details
tools.description: Get full details for one JSearch job ID.

tools.name: Search JSearch Jobs
tools.description: Search public job sites through JSearch by country, language, posting age, remote status, employment type, job requirements, radius, excluded publishers, projected fields, and cursor.

tools.name: Count Active LinkedIn Jobs
tools.description: Counts active LinkedIn jobs matching role, company, location, date, seniority, work arrangement, experience, salary, or visa-sponsorship filters.

tools.name: List Active LinkedIn Jobs
tools.description: Searches active LinkedIn jobs by role, company, location, date, seniority, work arrangement, experience, salary availability, visa sponsorship, and other filters; supports pagination and optional descriptions.

tools.name: List Expired LinkedIn Job IDs
tools.description: Lists IDs for LinkedIn jobs that expired within the selected one-hour, one-day, one-month, or six-month window.

tools.name: List remote jobs
tools.description: Searches remote jobs by title, country, and employment type, with cursor pagination and optional company details or total count.

tools.name: Get ZipRecruiter Estimated Salary
tools.description: Get ZipRecruiter's annual pay distribution for a title nationally or in one state or province.

tools.name: Get ZipRecruiter Job Details
tools.description: Get full details for up to 20 ZipRecruiter job IDs; unresolved IDs are omitted.

tools.name: Search ZipRecruiter Jobs
tools.description: Search United States or Canadian ZipRecruiter postings by location, posting age, employment type, experience, remote status, salary range, radius, ZipApply eligibility, company, and projected fields, with optional detail enrichment.

price.description: $0.250 per 100 pages, +$0.250 per 100 jobs when details are included.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The application key from RapidAPI Console. It is sent only as X-RapidAPI-Key to the fixed provider host selected by each Job Search action.

name: Jobber
description: Jobber is a field service management platform for managing clients, jobs, scheduling, quotes, invoices, and payments.

tools.name: Create Client
tools.description: Create an individual or company client in Jobber with optional primary email and phone contact details. Provide at least one of first_name, last_name, or company_name. Jobber provides no client deletion path, so this leaves a persistent record.

tools.name: Create Custom Field Configuration
tools.description: Create one Jobber TEXT, LINK, AREA, TRUE_FALSE, NUMERIC, or DROPDOWN custom-field definition through a fixed type-specific mutation. WARNING: this persistent administrative write requires Jobber Connect+ (Connect or higher) and the Custom Field Configurations write permission. Creation is persistent, and Jobber provides apps no supported cleanup or deletion path for a custom field they configure.

tools.name: Create Job
tools.description: Create a basic one-off Jobber job for an existing property with an explicit invoicing strategy. Jobber provides no job deletion path, so this leaves a persistent record.

tools.name: Create Note
tools.description: Create a note on exactly one Jobber client, job, quote, invoice, or request. The resource type selects a fixed provider mutation, and unsupported cross-resource link options are rejected. Created notes persist, and this toolkit has no general delete-note action across all five resource types. Attachments are not supported.

tools.name: Create Quote
tools.description: Create a persistent draft quote for an existing Jobber client and property with one or more explicit line items. Setting a line item's save_to_products_and_services flag to true also creates a persistent copy in Jobber's products and services catalog. Jobber exposes no quote deletion root, so this action leaves a persistent business record.

tools.name: Disconnect App
tools.description: Permanently disconnect this connected account from the Jobber app, immediately revoking its access and refresh tokens. This cannot be undone; future Jobber calls require reconnecting through OAuth.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Return the connected Jobber account's identity and basic company details.

tools.name: Get Client
tools.description: Return one client, its basic properties, and up to 10 normalized notes by opaque Jobber client ID. Note IDs can be passed to Update Note.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Return one invoice's receivables summary, client, salesperson, and up to 10 normalized notes by opaque Jobber invoice ID.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Return one job's status, schedule, totals, client, property, and up to 10 normalized notes by opaque Jobber job ID. Note IDs can be passed to Update Note.

tools.name: Get Product Or Service
tools.description: Return one catalog product, service, or labour item by opaque Jobber catalog ID. A supplied unknown catalog ID fails with Jobber's GraphQL error because this root is non-null.

tools.name: Get Property
tools.description: Return one service property and its owning client by opaque Jobber property ID.

tools.name: Get Quote
tools.description: Return one quote's financial summary, client, property, salesperson, and up to 10 notes by opaque Jobber quote ID.

tools.name: Get Request
tools.description: Return one work request and up to 10 normalized notes by opaque Jobber request ID. Note IDs can be passed to Update Note.

tools.name: Get Time Sheet Entry
tools.description: Return one time sheet entry by opaque Jobber ID.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Return a Jobber user by ID, or the current authorized user when user_id is omitted.

tools.name: List Clients
tools.description: Search and filter clients in the connected Jobber account, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Custom Field Configurations
tools.description: List custom-field definitions by target, value type, or creating app, with type-specific defaults and one cursor page. This read was verified on Core; Jobber documents custom-field configuration features as Connect or higher.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Search and filter invoices by client, status, or due date, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: Search and filter jobs by status, type, schedule, or assignee, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: List one cursor page of notes for a Jobber client, job, quote, invoice, or request. An initial call requires resource_type and resource_id. Each opaque LIST_NOTES continuation retains the original resource type, resource ID, and limit, so pass only its cursor for later pages. A raw notes_next_cursor from the matching bounded GET tool requires resource_type and resource_id.

tools.name: List Products And Services
tools.description: Return one cursor-paginated page of catalog products, services, and labour items.

tools.name: List Properties
tools.description: Search properties or list those belonging to a client, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Quotes
tools.description: Search and filter quotes by client, status, salesperson, or creation time, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Requests
tools.description: Search and filter work requests by client, property, status, assignee, or timestamp, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Scheduled Items
tools.description: List visits, tasks, events, assessments, and reminders for a required date-time range, optionally including unassigned or unscheduled items, one cursor-paginated page at a time.

tools.name: List Time Sheet Entries
tools.description: Filter time sheet entries by user, approval, payable state, active timer, or timestamps, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Search Jobber users by name or activation status and return each user's account status and role details in one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: List Visits
tools.description: Filter scheduled or unscheduled visits by status, time, assignee, or billing state, returning one cursor-paginated page.

tools.name: Update Client
tools.description: Update a Jobber client's identity, communication preferences, or tags, or add primary email or phone details. Provide at least one update field in addition to client_id; added contact records do not replace existing records.

tools.name: Update Custom Field Configuration
tools.description: Rename or update the type-specific default of an existing Jobber custom field. Requires Jobber Connect or higher and the app's Custom Field Configurations permission. field_type is needed only for type-specific updates and must match the existing field; this action cannot change appliesTo, readOnly, transferable, or the field's value type.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Update an existing Jobber invoice's customer-facing text, issue or due terms, discount, salesperson, or payment options. This is a financial write: discounts can change the invoice total, due terms can change when payment is owed, and payment switches can change how the client may pay.

tools.name: Update Job
tools.description: Update an existing Jobber job's basic details, timeframe, salesperson, or review-request preference. Provide at least one update field.

tools.name: Update Note
tools.description: Update a note discovered on a Jobber client, job, quote, invoice, or request. Dispatches only to the fixed mutation for resource_type and requires at least one supported update field. Link compatibility: CLIENT supports invoices/jobs/quotes/requests; JOB supports invoices; QUOTE supports invoices/jobs; REQUEST supports invoices/jobs/quotes; INVOICE supports no link flags.

tools.name: Update Product Or Service
tools.description: Update an existing Jobber catalog item's pricing, visibility, scheduling, classification, or self-serve quantity settings. Financial fields affect the item as follows: default_unit_cost changes the default customer price, internal_unit_cost changes the internal cost used to track profitability, markup changes the markup percentage, and taxable controls whether the item is subject to tax. Provide at least one update field in addition to product_or_service_id.

tools.name: Update Quote
tools.description: Update an existing Jobber quote's customer-facing text, quote number, pricing modifiers, salesperson, or payment options. Provide at least one update field in addition to quote_id.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: JobNimbus
description: JobNimbus is a CRM and project management software designed for contractors, helping streamline scheduling, estimates, invoicing, and job tracking.

tools.name: Create Location
tools.description: Tool to create a new location in JobNimbus. Use after gathering address and contact details.

tools.name: Get Account Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account-wide settings (workflows, types, sources). Use after authenticating to load or refresh workflow and source mappings.

tools.name: Get Activity by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a specific JobNimbus activity by its unique jnid. Activities in JobNimbus represent logged events such as task modifications, contact updates, job creation, and other system actions. Each activity contains details about what changed, who made the change, and when it occurred. Use this action when you need detailed information about a specific activity, such as viewing the full history of changes or understanding who performed an action.

tools.name: Get Contact by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a contact by ID. Use after obtaining the contact’s jnid to fetch full details.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Tool to list all contacts. Use when you need to fetch multiple contacts, e.g., for reporting or synchronization.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Tool to update an existing contact. Use when you have a contact's JNID and need to modify its fields. Call after fetching or creating a contact.

tools.name: Create File Attachment Type
tools.description: Creates a new file attachment type in JobNimbus. File types are custom categories used to organize and classify document attachments (e.g., contracts, warranties, photos, permits). You must create a file type before you can upload files with that category.

tools.name: Create Material Order
tools.description: Creates a new material order in JobNimbus. A material order tracks materials needed for a job and can be submitted to suppliers. Material orders must be linked to a contact or job record and include at least one line item referencing an existing product from your Products & Services catalog. Prerequisites: - At least one contact or job record must exist (use JOBNIMBUS_CONTACT_LIST to find contacts) - Products must exist in your catalog (use JOBNIMBUS_LIST_PRODUCTS to find product IDs) Note: Custom line items are not supported - all items must reference existing products by their jnid.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task. Use when scheduling or tracking tasks linked to contacts or jobs.

tools.name: Create Workflow Status
tools.description: Tool to create a new status in an existing workflow. Use after confirming the workflow ID to add specialized status entries like 'Lead' or 'Inspection'.

tools.name: Get File Attachment Content by ID
tools.description: Retrieves the raw content of a specific file attachment from JobNimbus by its unique ID. This action downloads the actual file content (binary data for PDFs, images, etc.) but does NOT return file metadata like filename, content type, or size. If you need metadata, use the files list endpoint instead. Common use case: Download a file attachment after obtaining its jnid from a list files query or from a related record (contact, job, etc.).

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all activities. Use after authentication to fetch a paginated list of activities.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to list all invoices (v2). Use when you need to fetch multiple invoice records.

tools.name: List Material Orders
tools.description: Tool to list all material orders (v2). Use after authentication to fetch multiple material order records.

tools.name: List Payments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve payments list with optional filters. Use after auth.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Tool to list all products. Use after authentication to fetch full product catalog.

tools.name: List Work Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all work orders (v2). Use after authentication when you need a paginated list of work orders.

tools.name: Get Product by ID
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific JobNimbus product using its jnid. Use this action when you need to get full details about a product, including pricing, cost, unit of measurement, and tax settings. Obtain the jnid first using the List Products action.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Tool to list all tasks. Use when you need an overview of tasks for planning or review.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Update an existing JobNimbus task by its jnid. Allows updating task details like title, description, dates, priority, and task type. Use List Tasks action to find task jnids. Note: To update task type, both record_type and record_type_name must be provided together.

tools.name: Get Units of Measure
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of supported units of measure. Use after authenticating when you need to present or validate measurement units.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated in JobNimbus for authenticating API requests.

name: JoggAI
description: JoggAI provides APIs for creating AI avatar, product, lip-sync, template, and translated videos and managing their supporting media assets.

tools.name: Animate Photo Avatar
tools.description: Create a reusable animated avatar from a photo-avatar image. WARNING: this generation creates persistent media and costs at least 2 JoggAI credits; the 2.0-Pro model costs 3 credits. Call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a motion ID for GET_PHOTO_AVATAR.

tools.name: Animate Product Avatar
tools.description: Add motion and a voice to a selected JoggAI product-avatar image generation. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits and creates persistent media; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a motion ID for GET_PRODUCT_AVATAR.

tools.name: Create Asset Upload URL
tools.description: Create a signed URL for uploading an asset to JoggAI. This does not upload the file bytes; PUT them to sign_url separately, then use asset_url in a generation request, including as a template image or video variable's url.

tools.name: Create Lip Sync Video
tools.description: Start an asynchronous lip-sync video from publicly reachable video and audio URLs. WARNING: this request consumes JoggAI credits; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a task ID for GET_LIP_SYNC_VIDEO.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Create product information from exactly one source: a product page URL, or manually supplied product details. WARNING: this creates a persistent JoggAI product, and API v2 provides no read or delete product endpoint. Retain this tool's returned product ID and details because the side effect cannot be read back or automatically reversed.

tools.name: Create Product Video
tools.description: Start a product video using a saved product and nested video, avatar, voice, audio, and script settings. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits and creates persistent media; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns an ID for GET_PRODUCT_VIDEO.

tools.name: Create Product Video Previews
tools.description: Generate product-video previews for one or more visual styles. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI preview credits and creates persistent previews; API v2 provides no preview delete endpoint. Call GET_ACCOUNT first to check credits, then use LIST_PRODUCT_PREVIEWS to retrieve status and preview IDs.

tools.name: Create Talking Avatar Video
tools.description: Start a talking-avatar video using an avatar and either a text script or hosted audio. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits and creates persistent media; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a video ID for GET_TALKING_AVATAR_VIDEO.

tools.name: Create Template Video
tools.description: Start rendering a JoggAI v2 template with typed text, script, image, or video variables and optional avatar, voice, captions, and music settings. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits and creates persistent media; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a video ID for GET_TEMPLATE_VIDEO.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a JoggAI webhook endpoint with a callback URL, delivery status, and event subscriptions. Returns a one-time sensitive signing secret; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently delete one JoggAI webhook endpoint. WARNING: this operation is irreversible; confirm the endpoint ID before calling it.

tools.name: Generate AI Scripts
tools.description: Start asynchronous AI script generation from a saved product or inline product details. WARNING: this request may consume JoggAI credits; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a task ID, not completed scripts.

tools.name: Generate Photo Avatar Image
tools.description: Start AI photo-avatar image generation using JoggAI's exact demographic, style, model, and aspect-ratio modes. WARNING: this call consumes credits and creates persistent media; documented pricing is 0.05 credit per single image or 0.2 credit for a batch of four. Call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a photo ID for GET_PHOTO_AVATAR_IMAGE.

tools.name: Generate Product Avatar Images
tools.description: Start asynchronous generation of one to four product-avatar images from a public product image and an existing avatar, reference image, or description. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits for persistent media, and requesting more images may consume more credits. Call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a batch ID for GET_PRODUCT_AVATAR_IMAGE_TASK.

tools.name: Get Account and Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected JoggAI user and remaining credit balance. Use this before a credit-consuming generation request; JoggAI does not expose a plan name.

tools.name: Get AI Script Task
tools.description: Check an AI script generation task and return generated scripts when completed.

tools.name: Get Lip Sync Video
tools.description: Check a lip-sync task and return its output URLs and duration when successful.

tools.name: Get Photo Avatar
tools.description: Check photo-avatar motion generation and return the reusable avatar details when complete.

tools.name: Get Photo Avatar Image
tools.description: Check photo-avatar image generation and return the generated image URLs and keys when ready.

tools.name: Get Product Avatar
tools.description: Check product-avatar motion generation and return the reusable avatar when complete.

tools.name: Get Product Avatar Image Task
tools.description: Check a product-avatar image generation batch and return its status summary and generated image candidates.

tools.name: Get Product Video
tools.description: Check one product video and return its generated media when available.

tools.name: Get Talking Avatar Video
tools.description: Check a talking-avatar video and return its media URLs when completed.

tools.name: Get Template Video
tools.description: Check a template-rendered video and return its output details when complete.

tools.name: Get Video Translation
tools.description: Check a video translation and return translated media when complete.

tools.name: List Avatars
tools.description: List public, instant, photo, or product avatars available for JoggAI video generation. Filters vary by avatar kind; returned IDs can be used in generation tools. This toolkit can create photo and product avatars; JoggAI API v2 only permits listing pre-existing instant avatars.

tools.name: List Creation Assets
tools.description: Browse one music, template, visual-style, or voice catalog used to create JoggAI media. Returns one page for music/voice and complete template/style catalogs.

tools.name: List Product Previews
tools.description: List generated JoggAI product-video previews and their statuses one page at a time. Preserve the returned preview identifier for selective rendering.

tools.name: List Product Videos
tools.description: List product videos with status and sort filters, one bounded page at a time.

tools.name: List Translation Languages
tools.description: Return currently supported lowercase target-language identifiers for JoggAI video translation.

tools.name: List Webhook Events
tools.description: Return event identifiers that can be subscribed to by a JoggAI webhook.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List webhook endpoints registered on the connected JoggAI account. Signing secrets are never returned by this tool.

tools.name: Render Product Video Preview
tools.description: Render one selected product preview into a final video. WARNING: this consumes JoggAI render credits and creates persistent media.

tools.name: Translate Video
tools.description: Start asynchronous video translation with optional audio-only translation, dubbing, lip sync, subtitles, and dynamic duration. WARNING: this call consumes JoggAI credits and creates persistent translated media; call GET_ACCOUNT first to check the remaining balance. Returns a translation task ID for GET_VIDEO_TRANSLATION.

tools.name: Update Product
tools.description: Update an existing JoggAI product's descriptive fields. Supplying media replaces the complete media list; pass an empty list to remove all media. JoggAI API v2 has no product read endpoint, so retain the product details in your own workflow state.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Fully replace an existing JoggAI webhook's callback URL, delivery status, and event subscriptions.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in at https://app.jogg.ai, click your avatar, select "API" from the menu, and copy your API key. Keep this key secret; JoggAI uses it to authenticate all API v2 requests.

name: Jotform
description: Jotform is an online form builder that allows users to create and manage forms for various purposes, including data collection, surveys, and more.

tools.name: Clone Form
tools.description: Tool to clone a single form in Jotform. Creates a complete copy of the form with all its questions and settings. Use when you need to duplicate an existing form.

tools.name: Create Form
tools.description: Create one original Jotform form from supplied form definitions.

tools.name: Create Form Question
tools.description: Add one configured question to a Jotform form.

tools.name: Create Form Questions
tools.description: Add multiple questions to a Jotform form in one request.

tools.name: Create Form Webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint to receive submissions from a form.

tools.name: Create Label
tools.description: Tool to create a new label for organizing forms in Jotform. Use when you need to categorize or group forms with a named label.

tools.name: Delete Form Question
tools.description: Delete one question from a Jotform form by its question ID.

tools.name: Delete Label
tools.description: Tool to delete a label along with all its sublabels. Use when you need to remove a label from the account.

tools.name: Delete Submission
tools.description: Delete one Jotform submission permanently by its submission ID.

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Retrieve one Jotform form by ID and return its persisted details.

tools.name: Get Form Properties
tools.description: Return the complete property collection for a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: Get Form Question
tools.description: Return one identified question from a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: Get Label
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a label by its ID, including name and color. Use when you need to fetch information about a specific label.

tools.name: Get Label Resources
tools.description: Tool to get a list of assets (forms) in a label and their associated information. Use when you need to retrieve forms organized under a specific label.

tools.name: Get Submission
tools.description: Retrieve one Jotform submission, including its dynamic answers, by ID.

tools.name: Get System Plan
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific system plan. Use when you need to check limits and pricing of a plan.

tools.name: Get User Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of the authenticated user, including account and usage info. Use after confirming valid API key.

tools.name: Get User Folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of labels (folders replacement) for the authenticated user. Uses the GET /user/labels endpoint per Jotform's migration from folders to labels.

tools.name: Get User Forms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of forms created by the authenticated user. Use after setting up API key authentication.

tools.name: Get User History
tools.description: Tool to fetch user activity history records. Use when auditing or filtering user actions by type or date.

tools.name: Get User Reports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of report URLs for all forms in the account. Includes Excel, CSV, printable charts, and embeddable HTML tables.

tools.name: Get User Settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the settings of the authenticated user. Use after confirming a valid API key.

tools.name: Get User Setting By Key
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific user setting by key. Use when you need a single setting value like email, timezone, language, or website.

tools.name: Get User Submissions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all submissions for all forms on the account. The answers dictionary contains submission data with question IDs as keys. Use when you need to access submission data across multiple forms.

tools.name: Get User Usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve monthly usage statistics for the authenticated user. Use to check form submissions, payment forms, SSL submissions, and storage used.

tools.name: List Form Files
tools.description: Return uploaded-file records for a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: List Form Questions
tools.description: Return all questions and their configuration for a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: List Form Submissions
tools.description: Return one page of submissions belonging to a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: List Form Webhooks
tools.description: Return webhook subscriptions configured for a specific Jotform form.

tools.name: Remove Resources from Label
tools.description: Tool to remove specified resources (forms) from a label by their IDs and types. Use when you need to unassign forms from a specific label.

tools.name: Update Form Properties
tools.description: Update multiple properties of a Jotform form from a JSON object.

tools.name: Update Form Question
tools.description: Update selected properties of one question in a Jotform form.

tools.name: Update Label
tools.description: Tool to update an existing label with new name or color settings. Use when you need to modify label properties.

tools.name: Update User Settings
tools.description: Tool to update user's settings like time zone, language, email, and website. Use when you need to modify user account settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated from your Jotform account.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The API domain to use, based on your account type. Options are 'api.jotform.com', 'eu-api.jotform.com', or 'hipaa-api.jotform.com'.

name: Jotform Sign
description: Access the supported Jotform forms, submissions, files, and webhooks API used around Jotform Sign workflows. Dedicated Sign document creation, sending, signer management, and completed-document download are not available through Jotform's public API.

tools.name: Create Submission
tools.description: Create an ordinary Jotform submission from simple question-ID answers. This does not send, prefill, or sign a Jotform Sign document. WARNING: every successful call permanently consumes one monthly submission unit; deleting the submission does not restore that quota.

tools.name: Delete Form Webhook
tools.description: Delete one general Jotform form webhook registration by its object-key webhook ID and return the registrations that remain.

tools.name: Delete Submission
tools.description: Delete one ordinary Jotform submission by ID. The deletion removes API readability but does not restore the monthly submission quota consumed when the submission was created.

tools.name: Get Form Schema
tools.description: Inspect a form's metadata, properties, and question definitions so an agent can understand its fields. Provider values are returned without claiming the form is a Jotform Sign asset.

tools.name: Get Submission
tools.description: Return one ordinary Jotform submission by ID with its question-ID-keyed answers and workflow status when present. This does not download a signed document.

tools.name: List Form Files
tools.description: List uploaded-file metadata associated with a Jotform form. This does not convert a submission to PDF or download a completed signed document.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: Return one page of forms visible to the connected Jotform account for ID discovery; results may include soft-deleted forms and are not classified as Jotform Sign assets.

tools.name: List Form Webhooks
tools.description: List webhook registrations for one Jotform form as webhook IDs and callback URLs. These are general form webhooks, not a dedicated Jotform Sign event API.

tools.name: List Submissions
tools.description: Return one page of ordinary Jotform submissions across the account or for one form, including answer maps and workflow status when present. This does not represent Sign Inbox or signer status.

tools.name: Register Form Webhook
tools.description: Register an HTTPS callback URL to receive general Jotform form-submission notifications; this does not configure or guarantee a dedicated Jotform Sign event stream.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy a Full Access API key from Jotform My Account > API at https://www.jotform.com/myaccount/api. Full Access is required for tools that add, edit, or delete forms, submissions, files, and webhooks. Keep this key secret. This connection uses the Standard / US API host only.

name: Judge.me
description: Judge.me helps online stores collect, manage, and display product and shop reviews.

tools.name: Bulk Create Webhooks
tools.description: Create multiple webhook subscriptions in one request.

tools.name: Bulk Update Review Visibility
tools.description: Sequentially publish, hide, archive, or unarchive 1-25 reviews. Each update uses a separate request, and the response reports a per-item outcome so one rejected update does not hide partial completion.

tools.name: Count Reviews
tools.description: Count management review records, optionally filtered by reviewer, product, and star rating. Use the storefront aggregate count action for widget-facing all-review or shop-review totals.

tools.name: Count Storefront Reviews
tools.description: Return the storefront aggregate review count for either all product and shop-level reviews or only shop-level reviews.

tools.name: Create Checkout Comment
tools.description: Persist a customer's comment for a product through Judge.me's documented Checkout Comments operation. Requires the shop's Checkout Comments app entitlement.

tools.name: Create Private Review Reply

name: JumpCloud
description: JumpCloud is a cloud-based directory platform that provides secure identity, access, and device management solutions for organizations.

tools.name: Create System
tools.description: Validates credentials and provides guidance for enrolling systems in JumpCloud. Important: JumpCloud does not support creating systems via REST API. Systems must be enrolled by installing the JumpCloud Agent on each device. This action performs a credential validation check and returns detailed instructions for agent-based system enrollment, including documentation links and Connect key guidance. Use this action when you need to: - Understand how to enroll new systems in JumpCloud - Validate API credentials before system management operations - Get documentation links for the JumpCloud Agent installation process

tools.name: Delete Role
tools.description: Deletes a specific custom role from JumpCloud by its ID. This action permanently removes a custom role. Built-in system roles (Administrator, Read Only, Manager, etc.) cannot be deleted. Before deleting a role, ensure it is not currently assigned to any administrators. The operation is idempotent - attempting to delete a non-existent role returns success (404 treated as successful deletion).

tools.description: Retrieve Xiaohongshu Pugongying follower history for a creator over the selected 30- or 90-day period. Use it to track total followers or new-follower growth over time.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Follower Summary
tools.description: Retrieve the Xiaohongshu Pugongying follower summary for a known creator. Use it to review the account's aggregate audience status before deeper demographic or trend analysis.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Note Performance Metrics
tools.description: Retrieve Xiaohongshu Pugongying aggregate note performance metrics for a creator with business, note-type, date-range, and advertisement filters. Use it to compare content performance across selected scopes.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Data Summary
tools.description: Retrieve the Xiaohongshu Pugongying data summary for a creator's daily or cooperation notes. Use it to compare aggregate creator performance between business modes.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Creator Profile
tools.description: Retrieve a Xiaohongshu Pugongying creator profile and cooperation quote information for a known user ID. Use it to review a creator before campaign outreach or pricing comparison.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Note Details
tools.description: Retrieves Xiaohongshu Pugongying details and view counts for a known note ID; engagement metrics may be unavailable for some notes. Use it during creator or campaign research.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Creator Note List
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated Xiaohongshu Pugongying creator note list with advertisement, sort-order, note-type, and third-platform filters. Use it to browse selected content from a known creator.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Content Square Notes
tools.description: Search Xiaohongshu Pugongying Content Square notes by keyword or browse all notes, with business-category, ranking, time-window, and page controls. Use it to discover high-performing campaign content.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) Creator Search
tools.description: Search Xiaohongshu Pugongying creators with keyword, audience, location, content, pricing, performance, cooperation, live, and similarity filters. Use it to build a campaign creator shortlist.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) Approximate-Time Note Search
tools.description: Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes by keyword with pagination, sort, note-type, and approximate publish-time filters. Use provider V4 when accurate time filtering matters. This is provider V2 and accepts keyword, page, sort, note_type, note_time.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) Precise-Filter Note Search
tools.description: Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes through the more accurate mobile-app search flow with pagination, sorting, note-type, and time filters. Use it when precise filtered discovery matters. This is provider V4 and accepts keyword, page, sort_type, note_type, time_filter.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) Keyword Suggestions
tools.description: Returns Xiaohongshu (RedNote) search keyword suggestions for a submitted seed term. Use it to expand query sets, refine content-research searches, and plan SEO or programmatic SEO keyword coverage.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) User Search
tools.description: Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) users by keyword with page-based pagination. Use it to support creator discovery, account research, and finding profiles related to a topic, name, or brand term.

tools.name: Xiaohongshu (RedNote) Share Link Resolution
tools.description: Resolve a supported Xiaohongshu (RedNote) short share link and return its public redirect URL. Use it to expand shared links before subsequent Xiaohongshu content lookup or processing.

tools.name: YOUKU User Profile
tools.description: Retrieves a Youku user profile identified by UID. Use it to look up a known account for creator research, profile review, or related video discovery.

tools.name: YOUKU Video Details
tools.description: Retrieves details for a Youku video identified by video ID. Use it to look up a known video for content review, cataloging, or subsequent video analysis.

tools.name: YOUKU Video Search
tools.description: Searches Youku videos by keyword with page-based pagination. Use it to discover videos related to a topic, title, creator, or other search term.

tools.name: YouTube Channel Shorts
tools.description: Retrieve public Shorts from a YouTube channel ID with optional continuation-token pagination. Use it to browse a channel's short-form videos and continue through additional result pages.

tools.name: YouTube Channel Videos
tools.description: Retrieve public videos from a YouTube channel, with optional cursor-based pagination. Use it to browse a channel's uploads and continue through additional result pages.

tools.name: YouTube Video Captions
tools.description: Retrieve available caption tracks for a YouTube video or request captions in SRT, XML, JSON3, or plain-text format. Use it to support transcription, accessibility, localization, or text analysis.

tools.name: YouTube Video Comment List
tools.description: Retrieve first-level comments for a YouTube video with sorting, locale options, and cursor pagination. Use it to review audience discussion or continue through additional comment pages.

tools.name: YouTube Video Details
tools.description: Retrieve public details for a YouTube video identified by video ID. Use it to inspect a known video before further content or comment analysis.

tools.name: YouTube Video Comment Replies
tools.description: Retrieve replies associated with a YouTube comment continuation cursor, with optional locale settings. Use it to follow threaded discussion beyond first-level comments.

tools.name: YouTube General Search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos by keyword with optional language, upload-date, duration, and sort filters, or continue with a pagination token. Use it to discover public videos or browse additional result pages.

tools.name: Zhihu Answer Comments
tools.description: Retrieve comments for a Zhihu answer with hottest or latest sorting and offset pagination. Use it to review discussion around a known answer and continue through additional comment pages.

tools.name: Zhihu Answer List
tools.description: Retrieve answers for a Zhihu question with sorting and pagination controls. Use it to browse responses to a known question and continue through additional answer pages.

tools.name: Zhihu Column Article Details
tools.description: Retrieve details for a Zhihu column article identified by article ID. Use it to inspect a known article for reading, review, or archiving.

tools.name: Zhihu Column Article List
tools.description: Retrieve articles from a Zhihu column with offset pagination. Use it to browse a known column's publication history and select articles for detail lookup.

tools.name: Zhihu Comment Replies
tools.description: Retrieve replies to a Zhihu comment with hottest or latest sorting and offset pagination. Use it to follow discussion under a known comment and continue through additional reply pages.

tools.name: Zhihu User Articles
tools.description: Retrieve articles published by a Zhihu user with offset pagination and publish-time or upvote sorting. Use it to browse a creator's articles in the selected order.

tools.name: Zhihu Collections Followed by User
tools.description: Retrieve Zhihu collections followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the collections associated with a known account's follow activity.

tools.name: Zhihu Columns Followed by User
tools.description: Retrieve Zhihu columns followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the columns associated with a known account's follow activity.

tools.name: Zhihu User Followees
tools.description: Retrieve accounts followed by a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to explore the outgoing connections of a known account.

tools.name: Zhihu User Followers
tools.description: Retrieve accounts that follow a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to explore the audience connections of a known account.

tools.name: Zhihu Topics Followed by User
tools.description: Retrieve Zhihu topics followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the topics associated with a known account's follow activity.

tools.name: Zhihu User Included Articles
tools.description: Retrieve the included-article records exposed for a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse that account's included-article list.

tools.name: Zhihu User Info
