name: Klazify
description: The most accurate Content Classification API. Categorize websites into 385+ topic categories with confidence scores, extract logos, social media links, company information, and technology stack data.

tools.name: Categorize URL
tools.description: Tool to retrieve IAB and Klazify category classifications for a specified domain or URL with confidence scores. Use when you need to categorize websites into 620+ IAB V3 categories using machine learning, or obtain detailed domain information including company data and social media links.

tools.name: Get Company Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive company information for a specified domain including business data, location, employee count, revenue, funding, and industry classifications. Use when you need detailed company profile information from a domain URL.

tools.name: Get Domain Expiration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve domain registration and expiration information for a specified domain. Use when you need to check domain age, registration date, expiration date, or days until expiration.

tools.name: Get Domain Logo
tools.description: Tool to obtain the logo URL associated with a given domain. Use when you need to retrieve a company's logo from their website URL.

tools.name: Get Similar Companies
tools.description: Tool to identify companies similar to the specified domain by analyzing category and target market. Use when you need to find competitors or similar businesses to a given domain.

tools.name: Get Social Media Links
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of social media links for a given domain. Use when you need to extract social media profile URLs across multiple platforms (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, Medium, GitHub, Pinterest).

tools.name: Get Tech Stack
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the technological stack utilized by a website including frameworks, platforms, and services. Use when you need to identify what technologies a domain uses for competitive analysis, lead generation, or market research.

tools.name: Real Time Categorization
tools.description: Tool to perform real-time website categorization with immediate AI-powered analysis and classification. Use when you need instant domain categorization into 621+ IAB V3 categories with confidence scores, along with company data, social media profiles, and technology stack information.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Klazify API key. Sign in to your Klazify dashboard at https://www.klazify.com/ to copy your personal API access key.

optional.name: user_agent
optional.description: User-Agent string for API requests (required by Klazify)

name: Knack
description: No-code database and business application platform for building custom web apps without coding.

tools.name: Create object record
tools.description: Tool to create a new record in a specific Knack object. Use when you need to add new data to a Knack database object. Requires object-based API key authentication.

tools.name: Create View Record
tools.description: Tool to create a new record through a form view in Knack. Use when you need to add a record to a Knack object using a form view interface. Only fields that exist in the form will be used, and any record rules configured on the form will be triggered.

tools.name: Delete Object Record
tools.description: Tool to delete a single record from a specific Knack object by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a record from an object. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Requires API key authentication (X-Knack-Application-Id and X-Knack-REST-API-KEY headers).

tools.name: Delete View Record
tools.description: Tool to delete a record through a view that contains a delete link. Works with tables, lists, searches, calendars, and details views. This operation is permanent and cannot be undone. Use only after confirming the correct scene_key, view_key, and record_id.

tools.name: Get Object Record
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single record by its ID from a specific Knack object. Returns the complete record with all field values in both formatted and raw formats. Use this for object-based access which requires API key authentication.

tools.name: List Object Records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple records from a specific Knack object (table). Returns up to 1000 records per page with pagination support. Use this for object-based access which requires API key authentication and provides full access to all fields and records. Supports filtering by field values and sorting by field keys.

tools.name: List View Records
tools.description: Tool to retrieve multiple records from a specific Knack view (tables, lists, searches, calendars). Use when you need to fetch data from a view with pagination support. Returns only fields included in the view configuration.

tools.name: Update object record
tools.description: Tool to update an existing record in a specific Knack object. Use when you need to modify field values in an existing record. Only fields provided in the request will be updated; all other fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to a Knack application. This is step 1 of a two-step process - after uploading, use the returned file ID when creating or updating a record with a file field.

tools.name: Upload Image
tools.description: Tool to upload an image to a Knack application. This is the first step in a two-step process - after uploading, use the returned file ID when creating or updating a record with an image field. Use when you need to attach images to Knack records.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Knack REST API Key. Find it in Settings > API & Code > API in the Knack Builder. This should only be used for server-side code.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your Knack Application ID. Find it in Settings > API & Code > API in the Knack Builder.

name: Ko-fi
description: Ko-fi is a platform that enables creators to receive support from their audience through donations, memberships, and sales.

tools.name: Receive Ko-fi payment webhook
tools.description: Receives and validates Ko-fi payment webhook events. Use this to process real-time notifications for donations, subscriptions, commissions, and shop orders from Ko-fi. The webhook includes payment details, supporter information, and transaction metadata. Returns validated payment data to confirm receipt (Ko-fi expects 200 OK to prevent retries).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Ko-fi API key, used to authenticate API requests.

name: KoboToolbox
description: KoboToolbox is a data collection platform for building forms, managing survey projects, collecting submissions, and exporting humanitarian and research data.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a draft survey project, optionally by cloning an existing KoboToolbox asset.

tools.name: Delete Export
tools.description: Delete one asynchronous export job from a KoboToolbox project.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently delete one KoboToolbox project by UID.

tools.name: Deploy Project
tools.description: Deploy a draft KoboToolbox survey or redeploy its latest form version so it can accept and expose submissions.

tools.name: Export Submissions
tools.description: Create an asynchronous KoboToolbox submission export and wait for it to complete, returning the export UID and result URL.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieve a KoboToolbox project with its form content, settings, resource URLs, and deployment state.

tools.name: Get Submission
tools.description: Retrieve one submission by integer ID, root UUID, or submission UUID from a KoboToolbox project.

tools.name: List Assets
tools.description: Find projects and other visible assets in the connected KoboToolbox account, returning one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Submissions
tools.description: Read one page of submissions for a deployed KoboToolbox project, with optional field selection, filtering, and sorting.

required.name: full
required.description: The origin of the KoboToolbox KPI server where your account and projects are hosted, without a trailing slash. Use https://kf.kobotoolbox.org for Global, https://eu.kobotoolbox.org for the European Union, or your organization's private KPI server origin. Do not enter a KoboCAT/OpenRosa server URL such as kc.kobotoolbox.org.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your personal API key for the selected KPI server. In KoboToolbox, open Account Settings, choose Security, and copy the API key. You can also retrieve it from /token/?format=json while signed in to that server. Regenerating the key revokes the previous one; keep it secret.

name: Kommunicate
description: Kommunicate is a customer support platform for managing conversations, users, messages, and agent assignments across human and AI support workflows.

tools.name: Change Conversation Assignee
tools.description: Assign one Kommunicate conversation to a human agent, changing live routing. By default, this sends a user-visible notification that cannot be undone; it can also remove all AI agents when take_over_from_bot=true.

tools.name: Change Conversation Status
tools.description: Change one Kommunicate conversation to open, closed, or spam. By default, this also sends a user-visible notification message, which cannot be undone; set send_notification=false to suppress it.

tools.name: Create Conversation
tools.description: Create a persistent Kommunicate conversation with the specified members. This can create missing users, add account-default bots or assignees, and cannot be undone through this toolkit; provider business errors are treated as failures even when returned with HTTP 2xx.

tools.name: Get User Details
tools.description: Return details for one or more specified Kommunicate user IDs. Requires a non-empty user list and fails on provider business errors even when the HTTP response is successful.

tools.name: Send Message

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific content item by its identifier. Use after confirming the environment ID and item identifier.

tools.name: Get Language
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific language by its ID. Supports Management API directly and Delivery API via normalization.

tools.name: Get Language Variant
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific language variant of a content item. Use after confirming the item and language identifiers when needing localized content.

tools.name: Get Content Type Element

tools.name: List Languages

tools.name: Get User Settings

tools.name: List Shortened URLs

name: La Growth Machine

tools.name: Add RB2B Visitor to Audience
tools.description: Tool to add RB2B website visitor to a LaGrowthMachine audience via native webhook. Use when you need to push identified website visitors from RB2B into a specific audience for outreach campaigns.

tools.name: Create Audience from LinkedIn URL
tools.description: Tool to import leads into La Growth Machine audiences from LinkedIn URLs. Accepts LinkedIn Regular search URLs, Sales Navigator search URLs, or LinkedIn post URLs. Requires specifying the identity to impersonate and the audience name to populate.

tools.name: Create Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create an inbox webhook for real-time notifications. Use when you need to receive notifications about LinkedIn and Email messages sent or received by leads in La Growth Machine campaigns.

tools.name: Create or Update Lead
tools.description: Tool to create or update a lead in LaGrowthMachine. Requires audience plus at least one identifier: proEmail, persoEmail, linkedinUrl, twitter, or firstname+lastname with companyUrl/companyName. Use leadId to update an existing lead.

tools.name: Delete Inbox Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing inbox webhook by its ID. Use when you need to stop receiving inbox events at the webhook URL.

tools.name: Get Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all campaigns from LaGrowthMachine with pagination support. Use when you need to list campaigns, with optional skip and limit parameters for pagination (max 25 per page).

tools.name: List Audiences
tools.description: Tool to list all audiences in your LaGrowthMachine account. Use when you need to retrieve audience details including ID, name, description, size, type, and source URL.

tools.name: List Identities
tools.description: Tool to list all connected identities in your LaGrowthMachine account. Use when you need to retrieve identity IDs for sending LinkedIn or Email messages through other APIs.

tools.name: List Inbox Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all inbox webhooks currently configured in your workspace. Use when you need to retrieve webhook IDs, names, and target URLs for webhook management or audit purposes.

tools.name: List Members
tools.description: Tool to list all members (users) associated with your workspace. Use when you need to retrieve member information, especially memberId which is required for action-based endpoints like sending LinkedIn or Email messages.

tools.name: Register Vector Visitor Webhook
tools.description: Tool to register Vector website visitors to a La Growth Machine audience. Use when receiving visitor events from Vector integration to automatically add identified contacts to the specified audience.

tools.name: Remove Lead From Audiences
tools.description: Tool to remove a lead from one or more specified audiences in La Growth Machine. Use when you need to unsubscribe or remove a lead from audience lists.

tools.name: Search Lead
tools.description: Tool to search for a lead using various criteria. Use when you need to find a lead by email, LinkedIn URL, lead ID, or name combination. At least one of these must be provided: email, linkedinUrl, leadId, or firstname+lastname+(companyName or companyUrl).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Copy your API Key from your LaGrowthMachine Settings > Integrations & API page (https://app.lagrowthmachine.com/settings/api)

name: Labs64 NetLicensing
description: Labs64 NetLicensing is a license management software designed to help software vendors and developers efficiently manage their software licenses and distribution.

tools.name: List Licenses
tools.description: Tool to list all licenses. Use when you need to retrieve license records with optional filtering and pagination.

tools.name: List Products
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all products. Use after authenticating with NetLicensing.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the NetLicensing API.

name: LabsMobile
description: LabsMobile provides APIs for sending SMS messages and retrieving account balances and country pricing.

tools.name: Get Balance
tools.description: Return the connected LabsMobile account's available SMS credits.

tools.name: Get SMS Prices
tools.description: Return current SMS credit prices for selected ISO country codes, or for all countries when no codes are supplied.

tools.name: Send SMS
tools.description: Submit one or more real SMS messages for immediate processing, which may consume credits and trigger a configured delivery callback. A successful result confirms acceptance, not recipient delivery.

tools.name: Simulate SMS
tools.description: Validate one or more SMS submissions without delivery or credit use. The simulation creates an entry in LabsMobile history.

required.name: username

required.name: password
required.description: Generate and copy an API token from WebSMS > Account > API Settings at https://websms.labsmobile.com/SY0204/api. LabsMobile uses this token as the HTTP Basic password; do not enter your account login password.

name: Lakera Guard
description: Lakera Guard screens AI application interactions for security and safety risks and provides Enterprise APIs for managing guardrail policies and projects.

tools.name: Create Policy
tools.description: Create an Enterprise Lakera policy with built-in detectors and/or custom guardrails. Lakera may omit the new policy ID; if omitted, later retrieval, replacement, and deletion require external policy lookup.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create an Enterprise Lakera project, optionally assigning a policy, metadata, and detect-or-flag action. Omit policy_id to use the default policy. Lakera does not return the generated project ID, so later retrieval, updates, and deletion require external project lookup.

tools.name: Delete Policy
tools.description: Permanently delete an Enterprise Lakera policy by ID. The provider rejects deletion while any project is assigned to the policy.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently and irreversibly delete an Enterprise Lakera project by ID. Historical requests lose their association with the project's metadata and assigned policy.

tools.name: Evaluate Detectors
tools.description: Evaluate content and return one confidence result per configured detector without producing an aggregate flagging decision or Guard screening log. Use for analysis and tuning, not runtime allow/block decisions.

tools.name: Get Policy
tools.description: Retrieve an Enterprise Lakera policy by ID, including its detector configuration, custom guardrails, version, and assigned projects.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieve an Enterprise Lakera project by ID, including its assigned policy, metadata, and detect-or-flag action.

tools.name: Screen Content
tools.description: Screen the latest LLM or agent interaction with Lakera Guard and return the policy decision. Use this for runtime allow/block decisions; earlier messages provide context, but only the latest interaction is screened.

tools.name: Update Policy
tools.description: Replace an Enterprise Lakera policy's complete configuration and create a new policy version. Omitted detectors or custom guardrails are removed, so retrieve the policy first when preserving existing settings.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update an Enterprise Lakera project by ID. Name is required by the official request schema; retrieve the project first when preserving its current name or other optional settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create an API key in the Lakera AI Guardrails Dashboard at Account > API Access (https://platform.lakera.ai/account/api-keys), then copy it when it is shown. Lakera displays a newly created key only once. Enterprise Platform policy and project operations also require an Enterprise SaaS account with the appropriate administrative access.

name: Landbot
description: Landbot is a no-code chatbot builder that enables businesses to create conversational experiences for customer engagement, lead generation, and support across various messaging channels.

tools.name: Delete Bot
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific bot from your account. Use when you need to remove an unused or test bot after confirming the bot ID.

tools.name: Get Brand
tools.description: Tool to retrieve your brand data including contact information and settings. Use when you need to access brand profile details, configuration, or contact information.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of agents in your Landbot account. Use after authenticating your account to enumerate all agents and their details.

tools.name: List Bots
tools.description: Tool to list all bots in your Landbot account. Use after authenticating to discover your configured bots.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: Tool to list all channels integrated with your account. Use after authenticating your account to enumerate available messaging channels and metadata.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: Tool to list customers who have interacted with your bot. Use when you need to retrieve customer records with optional filters (channel_id, opt_in, search) and pagination.

tools.name: List WhatsApp Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all WhatsApp message templates available for the account. Use after obtaining your WhatsApp channel ID to fetch template IDs and parameter counts.

tools.name: Replace Agent
tools.description: Tool to replace all data for a specific agent (full update). Use when you need to update agent information like name or password.

tools.name: Replace Brand
tools.description: Tool to replace or update brand data with a full update (PUT operation). Use when you need to change company branding information in your Landbot account.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Tool to send a plain text outbound message to a Landbot customer. Use when you need to reply to or continue a support chat with a known customer_id.

tools.name: Set Agent Status
tools.description: Tool to change your agent status to online, offline, or busy. Use when you need to update your availability status in Landbot.

tools.name: Update Agent
tools.description: Tool to update an agent's information in your Landbot account. Use when you need to modify agent details such as name, email, or password. This performs a partial update.

tools.name: Update Brand
tools.description: Tool to partially update your brand data in Landbot. Use when you need to modify brand information such as name, phone, address, city, zipcode, or country.

required.name: generic_api_key

name: Langbase
description: Langbase is a serverless AI developer platform that enables developers to build, collaborate, and deploy AI agents and applications with composable AI infrastructure.

tools.name: Append Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to add new messages to an existing conversation thread. Use when continuing a chat session or adding context to a thread.

tools.name: Check API Health
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of the Langbase API service. Use when you need to verify API availability.

tools.name: Split Content into Chunks
tools.description: Tool to split content into smaller chunks. Use when processing large text segments to fit downstream limits.

tools.name: Create Thread
tools.description: Tool to create a new conversation thread. Use when starting a fresh chat session or grouping messages into a distinct thread.

tools.name: Delete Thread
tools.description: Tool to delete a thread that is no longer needed to manage conversation history. Use when you need to permanently remove a thread by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Thread Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific message from a conversation thread. Use when you need to remove a message from a thread by its ID.

tools.name: List Documents in Memory
tools.description: Tool to list documents in a specific memory. Use when you need to fetch document metadata (and optionally vectors) from a memory after confirming its name. Supports pagination via limit and startAfter parameters.

tools.name: Get Pipe Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific pipe by owner and name. Use when you need to fetch configuration and settings of a particular pipe.

tools.name: Get Thread Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific conversation thread. Use when you need the full thread details by its ID after confirming its existence.

tools.name: List Available Models
tools.description: Tool to get available AI models supported by Langbase. Use to discover text and image generation models from various providers.

tools.name: List Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to list all messages in a conversation thread. Use after obtaining the thread ID to fetch its messages.

tools.name: List Execution Traces
tools.description: Tool to get execution traces for debugging and monitoring pipe runs. Use when you need to retrieve trace logs for a specific primitive.

tools.name: Create Memory
tools.description: Tool to create a new memory. Use when storing a new memory record in Langbase after confirming memory details.

tools.name: Delete Memory
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific memory. Use when you need to permanently remove a stored memory by its name.

tools.name: List Memories
tools.description: Tool to list all memory objects. Use when you need to fetch stored memories for context retrieval.

tools.name: Create a new pipe
tools.description: Tool to create a new pipe. Use after configuring pipe parameters. Returns an array of pipe objects, each including API key and URL.

tools.name: List all pipes
tools.description: Tool to list all pipes. Use after authentication to retrieve the complete list of pipes. Returns an array of pipe objects; callers must handle list iteration.

tools.name: Update an existing pipe
tools.description: Tool to update an existing pipe's configuration on Langbase. Use when modifying model settings, parameters, prompts, tools, or memory. The pipe must already exist.

tools.name: Update Thread Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update an existing thread's metadata. Use when you need to modify metadata fields for managing and organizing conversation threads.

tools.name: Update Thread Message
tools.description: Tool to update an existing message in a conversation thread. Use when you need to modify the content or metadata of a specific message.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Langbase API key for authenticating API requests.

tools.name: Create Score
tools.description: Attach an evaluation score to exactly one Langfuse trace, session, or dataset run, optionally narrowing a trace score to an observation.

tools.name: Get Annotation Queue
tools.description: Retrieve one Langfuse annotation queue by its ID.

tools.name: Get Prompt
tools.description: Retrieve a Langfuse text or chat prompt by name, deployment label, or exact version, with optional dependency resolution.

tools.name: List Annotation Queues
tools.description: List annotation queues configured for human evaluation in the connected Langfuse project.

tools.name: List Dataset Items
tools.description: List dataset items, optionally scoped to a dataset, source trace or observation, or historical dataset version.

tools.description: List run items for a specific Langfuse dataset and run name.

tools.description: List datasets available to the connected Langfuse project.

tools.description: List Langfuse experiments active in a required time range, optionally including metadata and directly attached scores.

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: List Langfuse-managed and project-custom model pricing definitions used for usage and cost calculation.

tools.name: List Observations
tools.description: Search Langfuse observations such as generations, spans, events, agents, and tool calls, selecting only the field groups needed.

tools.name: List Scores

tools.name: Query Metrics
tools.description: Run an aggregate Langfuse metrics query over observations or numeric, boolean, or categorical scores.

tools.name: Upsert LLM Connection
tools.description: Create or update a Langfuse LLM provider connection by provider name.

name: Laposta
description: Dutch newsletter app (email marketing) that makes it exceptionally easy to send professional newsletters.

tools.name: Get All Campaigns
tools.description: Retrieve all email campaigns from your Laposta account. Use this tool to list all campaigns with their configuration, delivery status, and analytics settings. Returns campaign details including sender information, subject lines, recipient lists, delivery timestamps, and tracking settings. No parameters required - retrieves all campaigns associated with your account.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a custom field for a mailing list to define subscriber attributes. Use when you need to add custom fields like text, numeric, date, or select fields to a list. For select fields (select_single or select_multiple), you must provide the options parameter.

tools.name: Delete Field
tools.description: Tool to permanently remove a custom field from a mailing list. Use when you need to delete a field that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Get Field Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific field details by field_id. Use when you need to fetch complete information about a custom field including its configuration, data type, and available options.

tools.name: Get All Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all fields for a specific list in Laposta. Use when you need to see all field definitions, metadata, and settings for a list.

tools.name: Update Field
tools.description: Tool to modify field configuration in a Laposta list. Use when you need to update field properties such as name, datatype, required status, or display settings. WARNING: Modifying datatype removes all data from that field.

tools.name: Get Segment Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific segment details by segment_id. Use when you need to fetch complete information about a segment including its name, definition criteria, and timestamps.

tools.name: Clear All Members From List
tools.description: Tool to clear all active members from a list. Use when you need to remove all active member relationships while preserving the list itself. The operation is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.description: Tool to create a new mailing list in Laposta to manage email subscribers. Use when you need to create a new list with zero members.

tools.name: Delete List
tools.description: Permanently deletes a mailing list from Laposta. This action is irreversible - the list and all its configuration (including notification settings and metadata) will be permanently removed. Members are not deleted, only the list itself. Use this when a mailing list is no longer needed. Returns the deleted list object with state set to 'deleted'.

tools.name: Get List Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific list details by list_id. Use when you need to fetch complete information about a mailing list including its metadata, state, notification settings, and member statistics.

tools.name: Get All Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all mailing lists from your Laposta account. Use when you need to view all lists including both active and deleted ones.

tools.name: Update Mailing List
tools.description: Tool to modify list properties such as name, remarks, or notification emails. Use when you need to update an existing mailing list's configuration.

tools.name: Create Member
tools.description: Tool to add a new subscriber relationship to a list with custom fields and tracking info. Use when you need to create a new member in a list or update an existing member if upsert is enabled.

tools.name: Delete Member
tools.description: Tool to permanently remove a member from a list. Use when you need to delete a member by their ID or email address.

tools.name: Get Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific member details by member_id or email. Use when you need to get comprehensive information about a member from a list, including their status, registration details, and custom field values.

tools.name: Get All Members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all members from a specified Laposta mailing list. Use when you need to list or view all contacts in a list. Optionally filter by member state (active, unsubscribed, or cleaned).

tools.name: Update Member
tools.description: Tool to modify member data, status, or custom fields in a Laposta list. Use when updating existing member information or managing subscription state. Supports partial updates (only modified fields need to be included).

tools.name: Get All Campaign Reports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve performance metrics for all campaigns. Use when you need campaign statistics including opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, and unsubscribes.

tools.name: Get All Segments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all segments from a mailing list. Use when you need to list or browse segments within a specific list.

tools.description: Tool to register a new webhook for list events in Laposta. Use when you need to receive real-time notifications for subscriber events like subscriptions, modifications, or deactivations.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to permanently remove a webhook. Use when you need to delete a webhook from a list. Pending webhook requests are completed before deletion.

tools.name: Get Webhook Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve specific webhook details by webhook_id. Use when you need to inspect webhook configuration including event type, URL, and status.

tools.name: Get All Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks for a specific list. Use when you need to view all webhooks configured for a particular list.

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to modify webhook configuration including URL, event type, or blocked status. Use when you need to update an existing webhook's settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Laposta API key. Navigate to Toegang & Abonnement > Koppelingen > API sleutels in your Laposta account to retrieve it.

name: Layerre
description: Layerre automates the creation of image and PDF variants from reusable Canva-based design templates.

tools.name: Analyze Canva Design
tools.description: Extract colors, fonts, and images from a public Canva share URL without creating a documented template resource. Layerre does not document whether this operation consumes metered render capacity.

tools.name: Create Layer
tools.description: Create a text or image layer on a template and return the new layer.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Import a public Canva share URL as a Layerre template. This consumes one render credit; Free and Starter plans import one page, Plus up to 25, and Pro up to 200.

tools.name: Create Variant
tools.description: Synchronously render one template variant and return its signed output URL. Each successful render consumes one render credit.

tools.name: Create Variants in Bulk
tools.description: Synchronously render multiple variants with one shared output format. Each successful item consumes one render credit. combine_pdf is PDF-only and requires a Layerre Plus or Pro plan.

tools.name: Delete Layer
tools.description: Soft-delete one layer from a Layerre template and confirm the request succeeded.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Soft-delete one Layerre template and confirm the request succeeded.

tools.name: Delete Variant
tools.description: Soft-delete one generated Layerre variant and confirm the request succeeded.

tools.name: Get Layer
tools.description: Return one template layer, refreshing its signed image URL when needed.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Return one template with its layers and refreshed signed image URLs.

tools.name: Get Variant
tools.description: Return one generated variant with a refreshed signed output URL.

tools.name: List Templates

tools.name: List Template Variants
tools.description: Return one page of a template's generated variants with refreshed signed URLs and an opaque cursor for the next page.

tools.description: Update a layer and return the refreshed layer. Provide at least one of name, layer_type, x, y, position, page_number, or properties.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Update a template and return the refreshed template. Provide at least one of name, width, height, background_color, page_backgrounds, or layers.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate an API key from the Layerre dashboard at https://layerre.com/app/api-keys. Layerre API keys begin with "lyr_"; copy the complete value and keep it secret.

tools.name: Post Event Data
tools.description: Tool to send event data for tracking user activities via POST request. Use when tracking events by sending data in the request body with application/x-www-form-urlencoded format.

tools.name: Get Lead Detail
tools.description: Tool to fetch detailed information about a lead based on filters. Use when you need comprehensive lead data for a specific lead ID. The default view type is B2B. Note: On initial pageview, there may be a few seconds overhead before data is populated; consider implementing a 3-second delay after lead creation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Navigate to Integrations → data → API Key in your LeadBoxer dashboard

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Copy your Dataset ID from the LeadBoxer dashboard

name: Leadfeeder
description: Leadfeeder identifies companies visiting your website and converts them into high-value leads.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the details of a specific account by ID. Use when you need to get information about a particular Leadfeeder account.

tools.name: Get Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of accounts the user has access to. Use when you need to discover all available Leadfeeder accounts after authentication.

tools.name: Get All Visits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all visits for a specific lead. Use when you need detailed visit history for a lead, optionally filtered by date range.

tools.name: Get Company Info by IP
tools.description: Tool to retrieve company information based on an IP address. Use when you need to enrich an IP and obtain its company profile. Returns 404 if no match is found.

tools.name: Get Custom Feeds
tools.description: Retrieve all custom feeds configured for a Leadfeeder account. Custom feeds are saved filter configurations that help organize and segment company visits. Returns an empty list for accounts without premium features (402), non-existent accounts (404), or accounts with no custom feeds. Use LEADFEEDER_GET_ACCOUNTS first to obtain valid account IDs.

tools.name: Get Tracking Script
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the website tracking script for a given account. Use when you need to obtain the JavaScript tracking code to be inserted on webpages for visitor tracking.

required.name: bearer_token
required.description: Your unique API token for authenticating requests to the Leadfeeder API.

required.name: user_agent
required.description: The name of your application, to be included in the 'User-Agent' header of API requests.

name: LeadIQ
description: The Smart B2B Prospecting Platform. Query professional information about people and companies, find leads, and enrich contact data.

tools.name: Abandon Import Batch
tools.description: Abandon a contact tracking import batch that is no longer needed. Use when you need to cancel or stop an ongoing import batch operation.

tools.name: Get Account Details
tools.description: Retrieve current user's account information including plans, billing cycles, and credit usage. Use to check available API credits, billing status, and data visibility settings before making data queries.

tools.name: Get Contact Tracking Balance
tools.description: Tool to check the remaining balance of contact tracking credits available for the account. Use when you need to verify how many contact tracking credits are left.

tools.name: Get Usage Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve API usage statistics and credit consumption for the current LeadIQ account. Use when you need to check credit usage, remaining capacity, or billing information.

tools.name: Search Company
tools.description: Tool to search for companies by name, domain, LinkedIn URL, or other identifying information. Use when you need to find companies matching specific criteria. Returns detailed company information including employee count, industry, location, and social profiles.

tools.name: Search Grouped Advanced
tools.description: Tool to search for people by job title, seniority, role, company size, and location with results grouped by company. Returns companies with matching people nested under each company for account-based prospecting. Use when you need to find contacts at companies matching specific criteria.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Search for individual contacts by name, company (past and present), LinkedIn profile, email, or phone number. Use when you need to find people based on identifying information. Returns comprehensive contact data including work/personal emails, phones, employment history, education, and social profiles.

tools.name: Flat Advanced Search
tools.description: Tool to search for people using advanced filters by job title, seniority, role, company size, location, and more. Returns a flat list of individual contacts unorganized by company.

tools.name: Submit Person Feedback
tools.description: Tool to submit data correction feedback for person contact information to improve LeadIQ data accuracy. Use when you need to report contact info status, invalid reasons, or update profile details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: To get your API Key, sign in and go to Settings > System Settings > API Keys (https://account.leadiq.com/app/settings/api-keys). Use the Secret Base64 API key.

name: LeadMagic
description: LeadMagic provides people, company, jobs, advertising, and enrichment data for sales and recruiting workflows.

tools.name: Add Emails To Suppression List
tools.description: Add a non-empty plaintext email list to one owned suppression list; LeadMagic stores only normalized SHA-256 hashes. Use the exact list_id captured in the same create lifecycle and only addresses intentionally owned by that workflow.

tools.name: Create Credit Budget
tools.description: Create a persistent credit budget that caps spend for one LeadMagic scope. Record the returned id so the owned budget can be updated or deleted later.

tools.name: Create Email Suppression List
tools.description: Create an owned suppression list from a unique list_id and non-empty plaintext email list. LeadMagic hashes emails server-side. Capture the returned list_id, use only that exact ID for subsequent reads or mutations, and always delete the owned list at the end of the lifecycle.

tools.name: Create Job Search Export V3
tools.description: Synchronously export up to 5,000 matching jobs. At least one search filter is required. The price grows with the number of jobs returned; limit defaults to 1.

tools.name: Delete Credit Budget
tools.description: Permanently delete one credit budget. This is an irreversible teardown action: use only the exact budget ID captured from Create Credit Budget in the same owned lifecycle, and never delete a budget discovered by listing workspace data.

tools.name: Delete Email Suppression List
tools.description: Permanently delete an entire suppression list and its stored hashes. This is an irreversible teardown action: use only the exact list_id captured from Create Email Suppression List in the same owned lifecycle, never a pre-existing list.

tools.name: Detect Job Change
tools.description: Check whether a person has changed jobs relative to an expected company. A resolved check costs 3 credits; PROFILE_NOT_FOUND is free.

tools.name: Download Bulk Job Results CSV
tools.description: Download all result rows for an owned bulk job as a CSV file. Use only a jobId captured from the same submission chain. The streamed download is offloaded and fails if it exceeds the documented 50 MiB bulk source-size bound.

tools.name: Enrich Company V1
tools.description: Call POST /v1/companies/company-search to enrich one company from its domain, name, or business profile identifier. A found company costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Enrich Company V3 Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/enrich alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each call is charged.

tools.name: Find Company Competitors V1
tools.description: Find competitors from a company domain, profile, or name. A found competitor list costs 5 credits.

tools.name: Find Company Employees V1
tools.description: Find up to 10 employees at one company, returning names, titles, locations, and professional profile URLs. Each returned employee costs up to 1 credit.

tools.name: Find Jobs V1
tools.description: Call POST /v1/jobs/jobs-finder to find jobs with the LeadMagic V1 filters. Each returned job costs 1 credit; an empty result is free. per_page is capped at 50.

tools.name: Find Lookalike Companies V3
tools.description: Find similar companies from a seed domain, name, or description. A non-empty result costs 5 credits; an empty result is free.

tools.name: Find Mobile Phone
tools.description: Find one person's mobile phone number from a professional profile URL or known email. A found mobile number costs 5 credits; no result is free. Exactly one person is processed per call.

tools.name: Find Personal Email
tools.description: Find one person's personal email addresses from a professional profile URL or identifier. A found email costs 2 credits. Personal email addresses are sensitive personal data; use this tool only for a lawful, authorized purpose.

tools.name: Find Person By Role V1
tools.description: Find one person by job title at a specified company. A found match costs 2 credits. The response can contain personal identity and professional profile data.

tools.name: Find Work Email
tools.description: Find one person's work email from their name and company domain or name. A found valid email costs 1 credit; no result is free. Exactly one person is processed per call.

tools.name: Find Work Email From B2B Profile
tools.description: Find one person's work email from a professional profile URL or slug. A found email costs up to 5 credits.

tools.name: Get Account Overview
tools.description: Return the connected workspace's available credits, API-key permission summary, current rate limits, and today's usage. This read is free.

tools.name: Get Analytics All Time Summary
tools.description: Get documented lifetime account request, credit, product, success, and latency statistics, optionally restricted to a date range. This free analytics route was not individually live-probed during the build.

tools.name: Get Analytics Credit History
tools.description: Get LeadMagic credit consumption history with a daily breakdown.

tools.name: Get Analytics Daily Metrics
tools.description: Get documented daily request, credit, latency, and error metrics for the last 1 to 90 days. This free analytics route was not individually live-probed during the build.

tools.name: Get Analytics Day Breakdown
tools.description: Get the documented per-product request and credit breakdown for one date. This free analytics route was not individually live-probed during the build.

tools.name: Get Analytics Products
tools.description: Get per-product LeadMagic usage with request, credit, and success metrics.

tools.name: Get Analytics Usage
tools.description: Get daily LeadMagic usage with request, credit, and chargeable-rate totals.

tools.name: Get B2B Ad Details V1
tools.description: Get full details for a specific B2B ad from its library URL, detail path, or numeric ID. A found detail lookup costs 2 credits.

tools.name: Get B2B Profile From Email
tools.description: Find one person's professional profile from a supplied work or personal email. A found complete profile costs 10 credits. Email addresses and matched profile data are personal data; submit and use them only for a lawful, authorized purpose.

tools.name: Get B2B Profile From Profile URL
tools.description: Retrieve one person's professional profile, including employment, education, certifications, and honors, from a profile URL or slug. A found profile costs 1 credit. Returned profile data is personal data; use it only for a lawful, authorized purpose.

tools.name: Get Batch
tools.description: Read status, progress, cost, and metadata for a mixed-product batch by its exact batch identifier. A missing synthetic identifier safely returns not found and does not change anything and is free.

tools.name: Get Batch Campaign Metrics
tools.description: Read aggregate usage and success metrics for a batch campaign. A syntactically valid missing identifier can be used for a safe, non-mutating not-found check.

tools.name: Get Batch Client Metrics
tools.description: Read aggregate batch usage and success metrics for one client UUID. An all-zero missing UUID is safe for a non-mutating not-found check.

tools.name: Get Bulk Capabilities
tools.description: Return the current bulk submission limits and supported operational features in a stable agent-facing shape. Service-internal host and deployment metadata are intentionally omitted.

tools.name: Get Bulk Job
tools.description: Read status, progress, timestamps, and finalized credit usage for one bulk job. Pass a jobId captured from the same owned submission workflow; do not inspect an unrelated workspace job.

tools.name: Get Bulk Job Progress
tools.description: Return LeadMagic's compact progress snapshot for frequent polling of one bulk job owned by the connected workspace. This read does not start, stop, or restart processing.

tools.name: Get Company Funding V1
tools.description: Call POST /v1/companies/company-funding to get complete funding history and related company intelligence by domain or name. A found funding result costs 4 credits.

tools.name: Get Company Funding V3 Company Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/company-funding alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each call is charged.

tools.name: Get Company Funding V3 Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/funding alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each call is charged.

tools.name: Get Company Technographics V1
tools.description: Get a company's technology stack from its domain. A found stack costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance V1
tools.description: Check the connected LeadMagic workspace's current credit balance for free.

tools.name: Get Credit Budget Status
tools.description: Read current limits, remaining credits, and exceeded state for every LeadMagic credit budget. This does not reserve or consume credits.

tools.name: Get Credit Service Health V1 Docs Only
tools.description: Validate the connected LeadMagic API key and check credit-service authentication status. Its response schema is undocumented.

tools.name: Get Email Suppression List
tools.description: Return one offset-controlled page of details and irreversible SHA-256 email hashes for one owned suppression list. Use only the exact list_id captured in the same create lifecycle, never auto-fetch pages, and continue only with the returned next_offset. Hashes cannot be converted back to plaintext emails.

tools.name: Get Job Board Stats V3
tools.description: Return the free job search dataset statistics through LeadMagic's exact job-board integration alias route.

tools.name: Get Job Search Catalogs
tools.description: Return the free filter catalogs used by job search, including countries, regions, job types, industries, company types, and seniority values. This helper is free.

tools.name: Get Job Search Dataset Stats V3
tools.description: Return free public coverage, freshness, and capability statistics for the LeadMagic Jobs Search index.

tools.name: Get Search Stats
tools.description: Return free cached coverage, capabilities, and top dimensions for selected LeadMagic search products. Requested product sections may be absent when unavailable. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Batch Clients
tools.description: List existing organization-scoped client records used to segment batch work. This read does not create or modify clients.

tools.name: List Batch Client Webhooks
tools.description: List delivery webhooks configured for one batch client. This read does not create, change, or invoke webhooks.

tools.name: List Batches
tools.description: List one bounded page of mixed-product batches for the connected organization. Continue only with the returned next_offset; this tool never auto-fetches additional pages.

tools.name: List Bulk Job Errors
tools.description: Return one offset-controlled page of failed rows and error details for a bulk job owned by the connected workspace. This is read-only and never retries or restarts failed rows.

tools.name: List Bulk Job Events
tools.description: Return the append-only event log, newest first, for one bulk job owned by the connected workspace. Reading events does not alter the job lifecycle.

tools.name: List Bulk Job Results
tools.description: Return one bounded offset page of row-level JSON results for an owned bulk job. Use only a jobId captured from the same submission chain and pass next_offset back explicitly to continue; this tool never auto-fetches all rows.

tools.name: List Bulk Jobs
tools.description: Return one bounded offset page of bulk jobs owned by the connected account, newest first. Use next_offset to continue; this action never auto-fetches pages.

tools.name: List Credit Budgets
tools.description: List all persistent credit budgets configured for the connected LeadMagic workspace, including identifiers needed for owned-budget lifecycle operations.

tools.name: List Email Suppression Lists
tools.description: Read all suppression-list summaries for the connected workspace. This tool is for discovery only: never pass an ID from this result to a mutation or deletion; lifecycle writes must use the exact ID captured from a list created by that workflow.

tools.name: List External Batch Providers
tools.description: List organization-level external enrichment provider configurations. LeadMagic redacts stored credentials from this read.

tools.name: List Job Company Types V1
tools.description: List the company type IDs accepted by the legacy V1 Jobs Finder API. Returns reference data only.

tools.name: List Job Countries V1
tools.description: List the free country codes accepted by the legacy V1 Jobs Finder API. Use V3 catalogs or locations for V3 job search.

tools.name: List Job Industries V1
tools.description: List the industry IDs accepted by the legacy V1 Jobs Finder API. Returns reference data only.

tools.name: List Job Occupation Taxonomy V3
tools.description: Autocomplete LeadMagic's broad-to-specific occupation taxonomy and return canonical IDs, labels, levels, and paths. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Regions V1
tools.description: List the free region IDs accepted by the legacy V1 Jobs Finder API. Use the exact returned IDs with V1 job searches.

tools.name: List Job Search Company Suggestions V3
tools.description: Autocomplete companies or resolve an exact domain into canonical company IDs and card data for Job Search filters. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Search Location Suggestions V3
tools.description: Autocomplete countries, regions, states, and cities into canonical IDs for exact Job Search geo filters. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Search Role Suggestions V3
tools.description: Autocomplete role names into canonical occupation taxonomy IDs for Job Search filters. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Search Tag Suggestions V3
tools.description: Autocomplete normalized job tags with tag-type and occupation taxonomy metadata for Job Search filters. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Search Title Suggestions V3
tools.description: Autocomplete searchable job title phrases with occupation taxonomy metadata for Job Search filters. This helper is free.

tools.name: List Job Types V1
tools.description: List the job type IDs accepted by the legacy V1 Jobs Finder API. Returns reference data only.

tools.name: Lookup Company Domain V3 Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/domain-lookup alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each call is charged.

tools.name: Lookup Company V3 Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/lookup alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each call is charged.

tools.name: Pause Bulk Job
tools.description: Pause a queued or running LeadMagic bulk job. This mutates processing state but is reversible with Resume Bulk Job. Use only a job ID owned by the connected workspace and intentionally selected for this lifecycle workflow.

tools.name: Preview Mixed Batch Cost
tools.description: Estimate the maximum credit cost and budget impact of an exact mixed-product batch payload. This is a free dry run: it does not submit work, reserve credits, or consume credits.

tools.name: Refresh Credit Cache V1 Docs Only
tools.description: Force LeadMagic to refresh the connected workspace's credit cache from its database. This medium-confidence docs-only POST updates cached account state; its response schema is undocumented.

tools.name: Remove Emails From Suppression List
tools.description: Irreversibly remove specific email suppressions from one owned list, allowing those addresses to be processed again. Use only the exact list_id captured in the same create lifecycle and the exact lifecycle-owned plaintext addresses previously added; never alter a pre-existing list.

tools.name: Resolve Job Search Filters V3
tools.description: Resolve friendly job-search companies, tags, occupation taxonomy, locations, and titles into canonical values. This helper returns no jobs and is free.

tools.name: Restart Bulk Job
tools.description: Destructively restart a LeadMagic bulk job in full, for failed rows only, or from a zero-based row or shard. This irreversible lifecycle operation can repeat work and add to the price. Use only an intentionally selected job owned by the connected workspace; inspect its status and errors first.

tools.name: Resume Bulk Job
tools.description: Resume a paused LeadMagic bulk job. This mutates processing state and may continue the job's existing charged work. Use only a job ID owned by the connected workspace and intentionally paused in this workflow.

tools.name: Review Bulk Job
tools.description: Resume or irreversibly cancel an owned bulk job. Use only a jobId captured from the same submission chain, choose a state-valid transition, and never mutate a pre-existing job discovered by listing workspace jobs.

tools.name: Search B2B Ads V1
tools.description: Search for B2B ads by company domain or name. Costs 1 credit per search plus 1 credit per returned ad. Set limit to cap the per-ad portion.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Call the canonical POST /v3/companies/search route to search or look up companies by domain, name, website, professional profile URL, or company filters and return one cursor-controlled page. Each search costs 1 credit, whatever the page size. The page limit is capped at 50.

tools.name: Search Companies V1 Legacy Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct legacy compatibility route POST /v1/companies/search. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each search costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Search Companies V3 Company Hyphenated Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/companies/company-search alias. Prefer SEARCH_COMPANIES for new integrations. Returns one cursor-controlled page. Each search costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Search Google Ads V1
tools.description: Search for Google ads run by a company. Each returned ad costs 1 credit; no results is free. The limit defaults to 1 to keep the price low.

tools.name: Search Jobs
tools.description: Call the canonical POST /v3/jobs/search route to search by title, company, location, taxonomy, tags, salary, seniority, date, and work arrangement, returning one cursor-controlled page. Each returned job costs 1 credit; zero-result pages are free. The page limit is capped at 5.

tools.name: Search Jobs V1 Legacy Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct legacy compatibility route POST /v1/jobs/search; prefer POST /v3/jobs/search for new integrations. Returns one cursor page. Each search costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Search Jobs V2 Legacy Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct legacy compatibility route POST /v2/jobs/search; prefer POST /v3/jobs/search for new integrations. Returns one cursor page. Each search costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Search Jobs V3 Hyphenated OpenAPI Alias
tools.description: Search the distinct documented POST /v3/jobs-search alias and return one cursor-controlled page. Each returned job costs 1 credit; the page limit is capped at 5.

tools.name: Search Jobs V3 Singular Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented compatibility route POST /v3/job-search; prefer POST /v3/jobs/search for new integrations. Returns one cursor page. Each search costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Search Meta Ads V1
tools.description: Search for Meta ads by company domain or name. Each returned ad costs 1 credit; no results is free. The limit defaults to 1 to keep the price low.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Call the canonical POST /v3/people/search route to search by company, title, role, free text, and contact availability, returning one cursor-controlled page without raw email or mobile details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V1 Legacy Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct legacy compatibility route POST /v1/people/search; prefer the canonical V3 route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V2 Legacy Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct legacy compatibility route POST /v2/people/search; prefer the canonical V3 route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 By Title Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct compatibility route POST /v3/people/by-title; prefer the canonical route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Company Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/people/company-search alias. Prefer SEARCH_PEOPLE for new integrations. Returns one cursor page without raw contacts. Charged per returned person; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Contacts By Title Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct compatibility route POST /v3/people/contacts-by-title; prefer the canonical route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Employees Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct compatibility route POST /v3/people/employees; prefer the canonical route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Full Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/people/full-search alias. Prefer SEARCH_PEOPLE for new integrations. Despite its route name, raw contacts stay disabled. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Icp Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented compatibility route POST /v3/people/icp-search; prefer POST /v3/people/search for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Lookalike Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct compatibility route POST /v3/people/lookalike; prefer the canonical route for new integrations. Returns one base-only cursor page and never requests raw contact details. Each returned person costs 1 credit; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Mixed Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/people/mixed-search alias. Prefer SEARCH_PEOPLE for new integrations. Returns one cursor page without raw contacts. Charged per returned person; zero results are free.

tools.name: Search People V3 Singular Docs Alias
tools.description: Call the distinct documented POST /v3/person/search alias. Prefer SEARCH_PEOPLE for new integrations. Returns one cursor page of base person data without raw contacts. Charged per returned person; zero results are free.

tools.name: Submit Bulk Job
tools.description: Create one asynchronous bulk enrichment job from exactly one input mode. Every processed row is charged. Retain the returned jobId and use only that owned ID for follow-up reads or lifecycle changes.

tools.name: Submit Bulk Local Leads Job
tools.description: Create a long-running local-leads bulk job. Every keyword-city combination becomes work and may be charged. Retain the returned jobId and use only that owned ID for follow-up reads or lifecycle changes.

tools.name: Submit Mixed Product Batch
tools.description: Create one asynchronous mixed-product enrichment batch. Every item is charged: preview the exact payload first, keep the item count bounded, and supply an idempotency_key before submitting.

tools.name: Update Batch Metadata
tools.description: Update metadata or client association for an owned batch during its mutable window. Use only a product and batch_id captured from the same submitted batch; never mutate a batch discovered by listing workspace data.

tools.name: Update Bulk Job Priority
tools.description: Change the priority of a queued or running LeadMagic bulk job owned by the connected workspace. This mutates scheduling but does not restart the job or change which rows it processes.

tools.name: Update Credit Budget
tools.description: Update one or more controls on a credit budget created and owned by the caller. Use only an id captured from that owned budget lifecycle; never modify a budget discovered incidentally in workspace listings.

tools.name: Validate Bulk Submission
tools.description: Validate exactly one bulk input mode and its options without persisting or processing a job. This is a contract check, not a submission.

tools.name: Validate Email
tools.description: Check one email address for deliverability and return mail-server and company context. A definitive valid or invalid result costs 0.25 credits; an unknown result is free. Exactly one email is validated per call.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your workspace API key from the LeadMagic app. Open Settings -> API Keys at https://app.leadmagic.io/settings/api, then copy a key for the workspace you want this connection to access. Keep it secret.

name: Leadoku
description: Leadoku is a platform designed to streamline lead management and sales processes.

tools.name: Get New Connections
tools.description: Retrieves a list of new connections from Growth-X (formerly Leadoku). The 'tsField' for this action is 'connection_date' (mapped from 'creation_date' in the API response).

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by Leadoku for authenticating API requests.

name: Leadsforge
description: Leadsforge provides lead search, company discovery, and contact enrichment APIs for sales prospecting workflows.

tools.name: Count Leads
tools.description: Count people matching Leadsforge person and company filters without returning lead records. Charge behavior is undocumented; do not assume this action is free. Authenticated behavior has not been live-verified.

tools.name: Find Mobile Phone
tools.description: Find one person's mobile phone number synchronously using a Leadsforge person ID, LinkedIn URL, or name plus a company signal. The result contains sensitive personal contact data and is discovery, not phone verification. A successful hit costs 10 credits; a miss is documented free. Retries may repeat a charged lookup because provider deduplication is undocumented.

tools.name: Find Work Email
tools.description: Find one person's work email synchronously from a Leadsforge person ID, LinkedIn URL, or full name plus a company signal. The result contains sensitive personal data. Leadsforge documents a cost of 1 credit when an email is found and no charge on a miss. This performs discovery, not email verification. Retry charging or deduplication is undocumented, so avoid automatic retries.

tools.name: Get Balance
tools.description: Return available and reserved credits plus current enrichment and company-discovery prices. Use this non-mutating read as a safe credential check. Leadsforge does not document a per-call charge for this endpoint, but that does not establish that it is free.

tools.name: Get Company Follower Filter Values
tools.description: Return supported countries, departments, seniority levels, or states accepted by START_COMPANY_FOLLOWER_SEARCH. These static reads are not documented as charged. Select one filter family per call.

tools.name: Get Company Follower Job
tools.description: Get one company-follower job's status, progress, company context, credit accounting, result path, and webhook metadata. This reads one snapshot and does not poll; call it again later while status is in_progress, then use List Company Follower Results. This read is not documented as charged, but is not represented as free.

tools.name: Get Enrichment Job
tools.description: Get the current status, progress, credit accounting, result URL, and webhook metadata for one asynchronous enrichment job. This reads one snapshot and does not poll; call it again later while the job remains in progress, then use List Enrichment Results when it completes.

tools.name: Get Lookalike Filter Values
tools.description: Return controlled departments, employee ranges, locations, or seniorities accepted by Leadsforge company lookalike preview and search.

tools.name: Get Maps Categories
tools.description: Return Leadsforge's curated Google Maps business categories recommended for Start Maps Business Search. The start action also accepts free-text categories. This read is not documented as charged, but is not represented as free.

tools.name: Get Maps Owner Job
tools.description: Get one snapshot of a Maps owner-enrichment job's lifecycle status, business progress, owner count, credit accounting, acceptance outcomes, result and status URLs, and webhook metadata. This does not poll. Keep checking while status is in_progress, then use List Maps Owner Results. A completed job can still contain an error when contact backfill stopped early because credits ran out. Status reads are not documented as charged, but are not represented as free.

tools.name: Get Maps Search Job

name: Legal Data Hunter MCP
description: Legal Data Hunter MCP gives agents structured access to legal-data discovery workflows such as supported-country and source exploration.

tools.name: Discover countries
tools.description:
List all available countries with their document counts and source counts.

    Returns LDH jurisdiction codes — mostly ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, plus
    aggregate/supranational codes such as EU, UN, CoE, INTL, and OECD — with the
    number of case law / legislation / doctrine sources and total document
    counts. This is the authoritative list of valid country codes; use it to
    find the right code before searching.

tools.name: Discover sources
tools.description:
List all data sources available for a specific country.

    Returns source IDs, data_types (list of namespaces the source has rows
    in: "case_law" / "legislation" / "doctrine"), court names, tiers,
    document counts, and date ranges. Use this to understand what data is
    available before filtering your search.

    Most sources have a single-element `data_types`. A source whose
    `data_types` list has multiple entries (e.g. ["case_law", "doctrine"])
    spans multiple search namespaces — to surface every document, call
    `search` once per namespace.

    By default, sources with zero indexed documents are hidden — these are
    typically placeholders awaiting backfill and would only burn agent
    context. Pass include_empty=True to see them (useful for catalog
    debugging).

    Args:
        country_code: LDH jurisdiction code — mostly ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, plus
            aggregate/supranational codes such as EU, UN, CoE, INTL, and OECD.
            Call discover_countries for the full list. E.g. "FR", "DE", "EU".
        include_empty: If True, include sources with document_count == 0.

tools.name: Get document
tools.description:
Retrieve a legal document by its source and source_id.

    Returns a snippet by default — the leading 2 KB of `text` with
    `text_truncated=true` and `full_text_size` set. Pass
    `include_full_text=True` to inline the full document body. Use
    source and source_id values from search or resolve_reference results.

    Args:
        source: Source identifier, e.g. "FR/Judilibre", "DE/BVerfG".
        source_id: Document identifier within the source.
        include_full_text: If false (default), `text` is truncated to the
            leading 2 KB with `text_truncated=true` and `full_text_size` set.
            Set true to return the full document text inline.

tools.name: Get filters
tools.description:
Get available filter values for a specific data source.

    Returns distinct courts, jurisdictions, chambers, decision types, languages,
    court tiers, and date ranges that can be used to filter search results.

    Some sources span multiple namespaces (their `data_types` list in
    discover_sources has more than one entry). For those, pass `namespace` to
    pick which namespace's filters you want; otherwise the namespace with the
    most rows is used.

    Args:
        source: Source identifier, e.g. "FR/Judilibre", "AT/RIS".
        namespace: Optional — "case_law", "legislation", or "doctrine". Required
            mental model for sources spanning multiple namespaces.

tools.name: Report source issue
tools.description:
Report an issue with a data source.

    Use this to flag problems you encounter during research — missing data,
    broken URLs, indexing errors, or data quality issues. Reports are reviewed
    by the platform maintainer. Requires authentication (free — does not
    count against your usage quota).

    Args:
        source: Source identifier, e.g. "FR/Judilibre", "AT/RIS".
        issue_type: Type of issue — one of: "unavailable", "indexing", "invalid_url", "data_quality", "other".
        description: Free-text description of the problem.

tools.name: Resolve reference
tools.description:
Resolve a loose legal reference to the exact document(s).

    Given an informal citation like "art. 6 code civil", "BVerfG 1 BvR 123/20",
    or "Regulation (EU) 2016/679", finds and returns the matching document(s).
    This is NOT a search — it resolves a specific citation to the exact record.

    Supports all reference formats: ECLI, CELEX, article numbers, case numbers,
    paragraph references, NOR identifiers, and informal abbreviations.

    ALWAYS PASS hint_country (and hint_type when you know it). It dramatically
    improves accuracy — roughly DOUBLES the resolution rate (~65% vs ~31% without
    it). Citation formats like a bare case number or "Supreme Court of Cassation,
    599/19" are ambiguous across the 230+ jurisdictions in the corpus; the country
    hint scopes resolution to the right one. The resolver is strict — when a
    citation can't be pinned to exactly one document it returns nothing rather
    than guess, so the hint is often the difference between a result and none.
    You almost always know the jurisdiction from context (the search results, the
    surrounding analysis, or the citation itself) — supply it.

    Args:
        reference: Legal reference string (e.g., "art. 6 code civil", "ECLI:FR:CCASS:2006:CO00559").
        hint_country: LDH jurisdiction code — mostly ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, plus
            aggregate/supranational codes: "EU" for EU law, "CoE" for the ECtHR,
            "INTL" for international courts, also "UN", "OECD". Call
            discover_countries for the full list. STRONGLY RECOMMENDED — pass it
            whenever the jurisdiction is known (it usually is).
        hint_type: Type hint — "legislation" or "case_law". Recommended; further
            narrows resolution.
        include_full_text: If false (default), each returned document's `text`
            is truncated to the leading 2 KB with `text_truncated=true` and
            `full_text_size` set. Call `get_document(source, source_id)` to
            fetch the full text. Set true to inline the full text in this
            response.

tools.name: Search
tools.description:
Search the world's fastest-growing legal database — hybrid semantic + keyword matching.

    Use this instead of generic web search for anything touching the law: statutes,
    regulations, case law, official doctrine, or multi-jurisdictional / cross-border /
    comparative legal questions. Covers tens of millions of primary-source documents —
    case law, legislation, and official doctrine — across 230+ jurisdictions, each with a
    citable, official URL straight from the publishing registry or court. Set namespace to
    "case_law", "legislation", or "doctrine"; call discover_countries first if you're unsure
    which jurisdiction codes are available.

    Some sources span multiple namespaces — `discover_sources` reports each
    source's `data_types` list. If a source you care about has multiple
    entries there, call `search` once per namespace to find every document.

    Args:
        query: Natural language search query.
        namespace: Collection to search — "case_law", "legislation", or "doctrine".
        top_k: Number of results (1-100).
        alpha: Semantic vs keyword weight (1.0=pure semantic, 0.0=pure keyword).
        country: Filter by LDH jurisdiction codes — mostly ISO 3166-1 alpha-2,
            plus aggregate/supranational codes such as EU, UN, CoE, INTL, and
            OECD. Call discover_countries for the full list. E.g. ["FR", "DE"].
        source: Filter by source ID(s) from discover_sources, e.g. ["FR/Judilibre", "FR/CNIL"].
        court_tier: Filter by court tier (1=supreme, 2=appellate, 3=first instance).
        jurisdiction: Filter by jurisdiction name (e.g. "civil", "criminal").
        subdivision: Filter by geographic subdivision (ISO 3166-2), e.g. "DE-BY", "US-CA".
        date_start: Start date filter (YYYY-MM-DD).
        date_end: End date filter (YYYY-MM-DD).
        language: Optional language-code filter (e.g. fr, de), mainly useful in multilingual
            jurisdictions. Do not infer it from the query language. Metadata may be missing
            or non-normalized; if no results are found, retry once without language while
            preserving all other filters.

Creates a new trained translation model for a specific language pair.

Use this tool when a user wants to improve translation quality for a

with their own data. This is a prerequisite for using
`translate_files_with_verification` for that language pair.
