tools.name: Get credit balance information
tools.description:
Retrieves all available credit balances for the authenticated user.

Instant credits refresh every month. You get a certain amount to use every month.
Every month the credits refresh.

Verified credits don't expire. Once they are purchased you will always have them.

Use this tool to check the current balance for both instant and verified
translation credits.

Returns:
    dict[str, int]: A dictionary representing the credits with the following keys:
        - instant_translation(int): The number of instant translation credits
        - verified_translation(int): The number of verified translation credits

tools.description: Lists and filters jobs or models.

tools.name: Translate files with verification
tools.description:
Create a verified translation job that will be assigned to professional LILT
linguists for translation and review.

IMPORTANT TWO-STEP WORKFLOW:

STEP 1 - Get Quote (user_confirmed=False, default):
- Call this tool WITHOUT user_confirmed or with user_confirmed=False
- Returns a quote showing credits needed, current balance, and detailed breakdown
- NO job is created, NO credits are deducted
- Show the user the quote and ask for explicit confirmation

STEP 2 - Create Job (user_confirmed=True):
- Only after user explicitly confirms, call this tool again with user_confirmed=True
- Creates the job and deducts credits
- Returns the created job details

Credit Handling:
- If insufficient_credits=True: Inform user they don't have enough credits and
  suggest purchasing more at https://mcp.lilt.com/home
- If credits are sufficient but low (10 or fewer): Warn user about low balance
  and suggest purchasing more credits
- If credits are sufficient: Show quote details (credits needed, current balance,
  balance after) and ASK FOR EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION before proceeding to step 2

If the tool throws a ValueError related to no trained models existing for a
language pair, then tell this to the user and ask if they would like to
create a trained model.

tools.name: Translate text
tools.description:
Translates text using LILT's instant translate API.

Use this tool when you need to translate text from one language to another
using LILT's neural translation models.

IMPORTANT: Check the 'insufficient_credits' field in the response. If True,
inform the user they don't have enough credits and suggest purchasing more
instant translation credits at https://mcp.lilt.com/home.

If the user has sufficient credits but their balance is running low (5,000
credits or fewer), inform them about the remaining balance and suggest
purchasing more credits to avoid interruptions.

In the response object, if the "used_trained_model" is false, then tell the
user that the translation was done with a LILT base model. If the user
wants to improve the translation quality or match their brand voice they
should create a trained model. Ask the user if they would like to create a
trained model.

tools.name: Upload file
tools.description:
Upload a file to LILT for translation.

This tool handles file uploads. For non-plain-text file formats like PDF,
DOCX, RTF, etc., it assumes the client has extracted the text content.
To indicate that only the text is being used, the tool appends a `.txt`
extension to the original filename (e.g., `report.docx` becomes
`report.docx.txt`).

IMPORTANT: You must inform the user of this behavior. When a user uploads a
file like a PDF or DOCX, confirm by saying: "I am uploading the extracted
text from your file [original_filename] for translation."

tools.name: Create attachment
tools.description:
Deprecated fallback for tiny files only. Accepts base64 file content, verifies SHA-256 checksum, and uploads it through the MCP worker.
Prefer `prepare_attachment_upload` plus direct PUT plus `create_attachment_from_upload`.

CRITICAL: Do not print base64Content and then copy it into this tool call.
Opaque base64 copied through model-visible text is easy to corrupt.

Generate base64Content mechanically from the source bytes and pass it through a programmatic argument construction path whenever available. Before calling this tool, verify the values are consistent:

Unix-like shells:
file="/path/to/file"
base64Content=$(base64 < "$file" | tr -d '\n\r')
sha256=$(shasum -a 256 "$file" | awk '{print $1}')
decodedSha256=$(printf '%s' "$base64Content" | base64 -d | shasum -a 256 | awk '{print $1}')
size=$(wc -c < "$file" | tr -d ' ') # optional; stat can also get file byte size
decodedSize=$(printf '%s' "$base64Content" | base64 -d | wc -c | tr -d ' ')

PowerShell:
$file = 'C:\path\to\file'
$bytes = [IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($file)
$base64Content = [Convert]::ToBase64String($bytes)
$sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -Path $file).Hash.ToLower()
$size = $bytes.Length # optional
$decoded = [Convert]::FromBase64String($base64Content)
$decodedStream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new($decoded)
$decodedSha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -InputStream $decodedStream).Hash.ToLower()
$decodedSize = $decoded.Length

decodedSha256 must equal sha256. If you pass size, decodedSize must equal size.
Pass `sha256`. Passing `size` is optional, but recommended for clearer mismatch errors.

tools.name: Prepare attachment upload
tools.description:
Prepare a direct Linear file upload for an existing issue.

Workflow:
1. Call this tool with issue, filename, contentType, and size.
2. Upload raw bytes with PUT to uploadRequest.url outside MCP.
3. All headers in uploadRequest.headers are part of the signed request, so send them verbatim.
4. After PUT succeeds, call create_attachment_from_upload with assetUrl to link it to the issue.

Do not base64-encode or transform the file. Use curl --data-binary @path or fetch(url, { method: 'PUT', body: blob }).
Omitting or modifying any signed header, including casing, will return HTTP 403.
The signed URL must be used within 60 seconds or it will expire.

Upload sequencing:
Prepare, PUT, and finalize one file before calling this tool for another file.
Do not batch multiple prepare_attachment_upload calls before starting the PUTs because earlier signed URLs can expire while later files are prepared.

Example:
curl -X PUT --data-binary @file.png \
  -H "content-type: image/png" \
  -H "x-goog-content-length-range: N,N" \
  -H "cache-control: public, max-age=31536000" \
  -H 'Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="file.png"' \
  "<uploadRequest.url>"

tools.name: Save comment
tools.description: Create or update a comment on a Linear issue, project, initiative, document, project milestone, or project/initiative status update. If `id` is provided, updates the existing comment; otherwise creates a new one. To start a new thread, pass `body` and exactly one of `issueId`, `projectId`, `initiativeId`, `documentId`, `milestoneId`, or `statusUpdateId` — comments on issues/projects/initiatives become top-level discussion threads; comments on documents/milestones become description comments. A status update holds a single thread, so a comment on an update that already has one is added to it as a reply. To reply to an existing thread, pass `parentId` and `body`; the reply inherits the parent's thread type, so no entity reference is needed. Parent reference fields are ignored when `id` or `parentId` is provided (`statusUpdateType` is rejected instead).

tools.name: Save document

When creating, `title` is required and exactly one parent (`project`, `issue`, `initiative`, `cycle`, or `team`) must be specified. On update, passing a parent reparents the document. To change parts of the content without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `content`.

tools.name: Save initiative
tools.description: Create or update a Linear initiative. If `id` is provided, updates the existing initiative; otherwise creates a new one. When creating, `name` is required. To change parts of the description without resending all of it, pass `patch` instead of `description`.

tools.name: Save initiative label

tools.name: Save issue

When creating, `team` is required, and `title` is required unless `template` is set. Note: use `assignee` (not `assigneeId`) to set the assignee — it accepts a user ID, name, email, or "me".

tools.name: Save issue label

tools.name: Save milestone

tools.name: Create or Update Link
tools.description: Tool to create a new shortened link or update an existing one in Linkly. Use when you need to generate a trackable short URL with custom parameters, UTM tracking, retargeting pixels, or Open Graph metadata. To create a new link, provide url and workspace_id. To update an existing link, provide id and the fields you want to change.

tools.name: Delete Link
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific link by ID from a workspace. Use when you need to permanently remove a link. This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Links
tools.description: Tool to delete one or more links by their IDs. This action is permanent and cannot be undone. Use when you need to remove links from a workspace.

tools.name: Export Links
tools.description: Tool to export all links in a workspace as JSON or CSV. Use when you need to retrieve all links for backup, analysis, or migration purposes.

tools.name: Get Click Counters by Dimension
tools.description: Tool to retrieve click analytics grouped by a specific dimension (counter). Returns aggregated counts for each unique value of the selected dimension. Use when you need to analyze click patterns by country, platform, browser, referrer, ISP, link, or URL parameters.

tools.name: Get Click Analytics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve click analytics for a workspace. Filter by link, date range, country, and more. Returns time-series data suitable for charting.

tools.name: Get Link Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific link by its ID. Use when you need to fetch link configuration, UTM parameters, or click statistics.

tools.name: Get Link By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a specific link by ID. Use when you need to fetch information about a shortened link, including its destination URL, click statistics, and configuration settings.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom domains configured for a workspace. Use when you need to see available domains for creating short links.

tools.name: List Links
tools.description: Tool to get a paginated list of all links in a workspace. Supports search, sorting, and pagination. Returns link details including click statistics. Use when you need to retrieve or search through links.

tools.name: List Link Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhook subscriptions for a specific link. Use when you need to see what webhooks are configured for a link.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all workspaces the authenticated user has access to. Use this to discover available workspace IDs for other API calls.

tools.name: List workspace webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhook subscriptions for a specific workspace. Use when you need to retrieve or view the configured webhooks for a workspace.

tools.name: Subscribe webhook to link
tools.description: Tool to subscribe a webhook URL to receive notifications when a specific link is clicked. Use when you need to track click events for a shortened link.

tools.name: Subscribe Webhook to Workspace
tools.description: Tool to subscribe a webhook URL to receive click notifications from a Linkly workspace. Use when you need to set up real-time notifications for link clicks. The webhook will receive POST requests containing click data including country, platform, browser, and other analytics information whenever any link in the workspace is clicked.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook from Link
tools.description: Tool to remove a webhook subscription from a link. Use when you need to stop receiving webhook events for a specific link.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook From Workspace
tools.description: Tool to remove a webhook subscription from a workspace. Use when you need to unsubscribe a webhook URL from receiving events for a specific workspace.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and get your API Key from Settings > API Keys at https://app.linklyhq.com/app/user/api

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Get your Workspace ID from Settings > API Keys at https://app.linklyhq.com/app/user/api

name: LinkTwin
description: LinkTwin is a link management platform for creating shortened deep links, tracking analytics, and managing domains, pixels, QR codes, and collections.

tools.name: Create Link
tools.description: Create a shortened deep link with optional access limits, targeting, query parameters, and pixel or collection assignments. Free accounts can shorten only LinkTwin-approved destination domains and apps; arbitrary destination websites require a paid plan.

tools.name: Delete Link
tools.description: Permanently delete one shortened link by numeric ID. This destructive action removes the link and its redirect and cannot be undone; use it only when the caller explicitly intends permanent deletion.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Return the connected LinkTwin account's plan, usage, timezone, and feature limits. Use this before creating or updating links when plan availability is uncertain.

tools.name: Get Link
tools.description: Return one shortened link's destination, targeting rules, assignments, access controls, and summary click analytics.

tools.name: Get Link Analytics
tools.description: Return detailed clicks, unique clicks, time series, and geography, referrer, browser, device, language, and city breakdowns for one link. Free accounts retain only 14 days of analytics.

tools.name: List Collections
tools.description: Return one page of link collections available for organizing or assigning shortened links.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: Return standard LinkTwin short domains and branded domains available to the connected account. Branded domains are disabled on Free accounts.

tools.name: List Links
tools.description: Return one filtered page of shortened links owned by the connected account, including destination URLs, click totals, and assignments.

tools.name: List Pixels
tools.description: Return one page of tracking pixels available for assignment to shortened links.

tools.name: Update Link
tools.description: Partially update a shortened link's destination, access limits, targeting, query parameters, or assignments. Only explicitly supplied fields are changed; replacement arrays overwrite the complete existing value. Changing the destination URL requires a paid LinkTwin plan.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your LinkTwin API key from Settings -> Developer API Key at https://linktw.in/user/settings. LinkTwin generates it automatically after registration and allows you to regenerate it; keep it secret because it grants access to your account API.

name: Linq
description: Send and manage iMessage, RCS, and SMS conversations, attachments, phone numbers, payments, and webhooks through the Linq Partner API.

tools.name: Add Chat Participant
tools.description: Add an external participant to an existing group chat. The participant-visible change is queued asynchronously.

tools.name: Add Poll Options
tools.description: Irreversibly add recipient-visible options to an existing iMessage poll. Poll options cannot be edited or removed after they are added.

tools.name: Block Handle
tools.description: Block a handle account-wide from inbound and direct outbound messaging. Pair controlled test blocks with UNBLOCK_HANDLE cleanup.

tools.name: Cancel Payment
tools.description: Irreversibly cancel a financial payment and close its virtual card. Confirm the payment identifier and authorization before calling because the canceled payment cannot be resumed.

tools.name: Cancel Payment Request
tools.description: Irreversibly cancel an unpaid payment request and its underlying payment intent. The checkout can no longer be completed after cancellation; paid, canceled, or expired requests cannot be canceled. Confirm the request ID and intent first.

tools.name: Check Messaging Capability
tools.description: Check whether a recipient can receive iMessage or RCS without sending a message. Linq permits only one capability check per 10 seconds; cache successful answers briefly (minutes, not days) instead of checking before every send.

tools.name: Connect Payment Handle
tools.description: Start the financial-consent ceremony for a customer phone number or email so an agent can later pay on that customer's behalf. This consent-sensitive, irreversible action may contact the customer and send an OTP; call it only with the customer's explicit consent.

tools.name: Create Chat
tools.description: Create or reuse a chat on an explicit sending line and send an irreversible recipient-visible initial message. First-message text and parts cannot contain links.

tools.name: Create Payment
tools.description: Create or advance a real financial payment on a connected customer's behalf, potentially minting a single-use virtual card. This is consent-sensitive and financially consequential; obtain explicit customer authorization, verify the amount and merchant, and use an Idempotency-Key for retries.

tools.name: Create Payment Request
tools.description: Create a customer-facing checkout that can collect a one-time charge or start an auto-renewing subscription. This creates financial state but does not itself send the checkout URL to a recipient. Confirm the amount, currency, mode, rail, and intended payer before calling; use idempotency_key for retries.

tools.name: Create Poll
tools.description: Irreversibly send a recipient-visible iMessage poll to an existing chat. A poll cannot be the chat's first message, and its options are add-only and immutable.

tools.name: Create Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription for selected Linq events at a controlled HTTPS callback. The response includes a one-time signing secret that must be stored securely.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Permanently delete a Linq attachment and its stored bytes.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Irreversibly delete a message record from Linq. This does not unsend the message or remove it from recipients' devices, and its idempotency key cannot be reused to resend it.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Permanently delete a Linq webhook subscription and stop its future event deliveries.

tools.name: Edit Message
tools.description: Irreversibly change recipient-visible text in one part of a message sent within the last 15 minutes. Linq permits at most five edits per message. A response with no message fields means Linq accepted an edit for a deleted message.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Return metadata and current status for a Linq attachment referenced by a message. This metadata-only action does not download the file.

tools.name: Get Available Number
tools.description: Select an available Linq sending number, optionally for recipients or a line type. Treat the returned vCard URL as sensitive and ephemeral.

tools.name: Get Chat
tools.description: Return one chat by ID, including participants, service, state, and health information.

tools.name: Get Chat Location
tools.description: Return precise locations currently shared by contacts in a chat. Treat coordinates and addresses as sensitive and minimize retention.

tools.name: Get Experience
tools.description: Return one Linq experience and preserve its dynamic action field definitions. Discovery does not prove that required provider setup is complete.

tools.name: Get Message
tools.description: Return one Linq message by ID with its content parts, sender, actual and preferred transport, delivery state, reply target, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Payment
tools.description: Read a payment's financial state, amount, customer handle, merchant details, and any customer-action URL. Treat returned identifiers and hosted URLs as sensitive financial metadata.

tools.name: Get Payment Credentials
tools.description: Return the complete, highly sensitive short-lived handoff used to reveal a ready payment's virtual card directly from the provider. The response includes provider, user_token, card_ref, and fetch_url when supplied. Use it only for the immediate authorized checkout; never log, persist, or disclose the handoff or the resulting PAN/CVC.

tools.name: Get Payment Handle Connection
tools.description: Read the financial-consent connection status for a customer phone number or email. Query only a customer handle whose owner consented to this lookup; the response may include a transient connect_id for a pending ceremony.

tools.name: Get Payment Provider
tools.description: Read the organization's onboarding status for a payment provider. This is a read-only financial setup check; a 404 is an execution failure and must not be interpreted as a normal disabled status.

tools.name: Get Payment Request
tools.description: Return one payment request's amount, lifecycle status, checkout details, and provider join keys. This is read-only financial metadata; treat checkout URLs and customer or provider IDs as sensitive.

tools.name: Get Poll
tools.description: Return an iMessage poll's current options, voters, and distinct voter count.

tools.name: Get Reputation Audit
tools.description: Return a Linq line reputation audit created with explicit approval. Audits are retained for no more than 24 hours.

tools.name: Get Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Return one Linq webhook subscription by ID, including its callback URL, event and phone filters, active state, and configured routing-header names.

tools.name: Leave Chat
tools.description: Leave an iMessage group chat. This is irreversible and prevents further interaction through the sending line.

tools.name: List Blocked Handles
tools.description: Return phone numbers, email addresses, short codes, and sender IDs currently blocked account-wide from inbound and direct outbound messaging.

tools.name: List Chats
tools.description: Return one page of chats, optionally filtered by sending line or participant, with a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List Contact Cards
tools.description: Return Linq account contact-card identity data, optionally for one E.164 sending line.

tools.name: List Experiences
tools.description: Discover Linq experiences and their dynamic action fields. Availability in this response does not prove payment-provider onboarding is complete.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Return one page of messages from a chat, including content, sender, transport, delivery state, direction, reply target, and timestamps, plus a cursor for older messages.

tools.name: List Message Thread
tools.description: Return one page containing the origin message and threaded replies, starting from any message in the thread. A message with no thread returns by itself.

tools.name: List Payment Requests
tools.description: Return one newest-first page of payment requests for reconciliation, optionally filtered by lifecycle status. This is read-only financial metadata; checkout URLs and customer or provider IDs in results are sensitive.

tools.name: List Phone Numbers
tools.description: Return the connected Linq account's sending lines with line type, forwarding configuration, and reputation status.

tools.name: List Webhook Events
tools.description: Return the webhook event types currently available for subscription on the connected Linq account.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions
tools.description: Return the connected Linq account's webhook subscriptions, including event and phone-number filters, target URLs, active state, and routing-header names.

tools.name: Mark Chat As Read
tools.description: Mark every message in a chat as read and send an irreversible read receipt.

tools.name: Remove Chat Background
tools.description: Reset a chat's recipient-visible transcript background to the default.

tools.name: Remove Chat Participant
tools.description: Remove an external participant from a group chat. This irreversibly changes recipient-visible conversation membership.

tools.name: Request Attachment Upload
tools.description: Reserve persistent attachment storage and return a 15-minute presigned upload URL. This action does not upload file bytes; PUT the raw bytes separately to the returned opaque URL using the exact required_headers.

tools.name: Request Chat Location
tools.description: Prompt a contact in a one-to-one iMessage chat to consent to sharing their precise location. This is recipient-visible and rate-limited per chat.

tools.name: Revoke Payment Handle Connection
tools.description: Irreversibly revoke this partner's financial-consent grant for a customer phone number or email. This prevents future payments through the grant but does not delete the customer's provider wallet; revoke only with explicit authorization.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Send one irreversible, externally visible message to phone numbers or emails. Linq reuses a matching chat or creates one and automatically selects the sending line.

tools.name: Send Message to Chat
tools.description: Send one follow-up or threaded reply to an existing Linq chat using its established sending line. This creates an irreversible recipient-visible message.

tools.name: Send Voice Memo to Chat
tools.description: Irreversibly send recipient-visible audio as a native iMessage voice memo bubble to every participant in an existing Linq chat.

tools.name: Set Chat Background
tools.description: Set a recipient-visible color, animated, or photo transcript background. Linq processes the change asynchronously.

tools.name: Set Up Contact Card
tools.description: Create or replace a Linq contact card for a sending line. This changes public account identity and may activate contact-card sharing.

tools.name: Share Contact Card With Chat
tools.description: Share the connected sending line's active contact card with a chat. This irreversibly discloses account identity to recipients.

tools.name: Start Payment Provider Onboarding
tools.description: Create a hosted payment-provider onboarding session for the organization. This starts an external Stripe/Agentcard authorization flow and returns a sensitive hosted URL that an authorized administrator must open; do not use it to complete production onboarding without explicit administrative consent.

tools.name: Start Reputation Audit
tools.description: Start a potentially metered or limited reputation audit for a Linq sending line. The resulting audit persists for 24 hours.

tools.name: Start Typing Indicator
tools.description: Show a best-effort recipient-visible typing indicator for about 85-90 seconds. Primarily effective for active iMessage chats.

tools.name: Stop Chat Location Sharing
tools.description: Stop a specific contact's inbound location share. This consent-sensitive operation ends that contact's share across chats.

tools.name: Stop Typing Indicator
tools.description: Immediately clear the connected line's recipient-visible typing indicator for a chat.

tools.name: Toggle Poll Vote
tools.description: Irreversibly send a recipient-visible update that adds or removes the connected line's vote on one option of an iMessage poll.

tools.name: Unblock Handle
tools.description: Remove an account-wide messaging block. This changes messaging behavior; for testing, unblock only a handle blocked by the same test.

tools.name: Update Chat
tools.description: Update a group chat's display name or icon. The participant-visible change is processed asynchronously.

tools.name: Update Contact Card
tools.description: Update the public contact-card identity for one Linq sending line.

tools.name: Update iMessage App Card
tools.description: Irreversibly send a recipient-visible in-place update to an iMessage app card. The update creates a new message version; use its returned message ID for the next serialized update.

tools.name: Update Message Reaction
tools.description: Irreversibly mutate recipient-visible reaction state by adding or removing a tapback, or by adding an iMessage sticker. Stickers cannot be removed.

tools.name: Update Phone Number
tools.description: Change a Linq sending line's production forwarding configuration. Capture the current value before changing it when rollback is required.

tools.name: Update Sticker Placement
tools.description: Irreversibly send a recipient-visible update that moves, resizes, or rotates an existing iMessage sticker on a message.

tools.name: Update Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Update a Linq webhook subscription's callback, filters, active state, or routing-header names. Callback and routing changes can redirect future account events.

tools.name: Verify Payment Handle
tools.description: Submit a customer's single-use OTP to complete the financial-consent ceremony and authorize future payments on the customer's behalf. This irreversible, consent-sensitive action consumes the code and records consent; use only a code the customer explicitly provided for this connection.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate a Partner API V3 bearer token in the Linq dashboard at https://dashboard.linqapp.com/api-tooling by opening API > Overview and clicking "Generate new token". This token authorizes the iMessage, RCS, and SMS Partner API; do not enter a WhatsApp or Apple Messages for Business key.

name: Listclean
description: Listclean is an email verification service that helps users validate and clean their email lists to improve deliverability and maintain sender reputation.

tools.name: Create Bulk Verification List
tools.description: Tool to create a CSV file with provided email addresses for bulk verification. Use when you need to generate a file for bulk upload through LISTCLEAN_UPLOAD_LIST.

tools.name: Delete List
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a single list from the account. Use when you need to remove a list that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Download List Results as CSV
tools.description: Tool to download list results as a CSV file. Use when you need to retrieve verification results filtered by email type (clean, dirty, or unknown).

tools.name: Download List Results as JSON
tools.description: Tool to download list results as JSON. Downloads emails filtered by type (clean, dirty, or unknown) in JSON format. Use after list verification is complete to retrieve filtered results.

tools.name: Get Account Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated account's profile. Use after obtaining a valid auth token to fetch user account data.

tools.name: Get Remaining Credits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve remaining verification credits. Use when you need to check your available account credits before performing more email verifications.

tools.name: Get List Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific list. Returns analytics with clean/dirty breakdown, cost details, and processing status.

tools.name: Get Upload Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status of a specific upload. Returns upload status (inprocess, success, error), progress percentage, and chunk details. Use after initiating an upload to track its completion.

tools.name: Get Verification Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve logs for all single email verifications. Returns history of email verifications with status, remarks, credits deducted, and timestamps.

tools.name: List All Verification Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all email verification lists. Returns all processed lists with complete analytics including clean/dirty counts, summary statistics, and cost information.

tools.name: List CSV Uploads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of CSV uploads. Use when you need to check upload IDs, status, and progress for all CSV file uploads in your account.

tools.name: Start Upload
tools.description: Tool to start a CSV upload process for bulk email verification. Initializes chunked file upload and returns an upload_id for subsequent chunk uploads. Use when you need to upload large CSV files containing email addresses.

tools.name: Update Account Profile
tools.description: Tool to update account profile details. Use when you need to modify user profile information such as name, address, contact details, company information, or billing details.

tools.name: Upload Chunk
tools.description: Tool to upload a chunk of a CSV file. Use when sending base64-encoded content with sequence number as part of chunked upload process, optionally with MD5 checksum for integrity verification.

tools.name: Verify Batch of Emails
tools.description: Tool to verify a batch of email addresses (max 3000 emails). Use when you need to verify multiple emails at once and get a list_id for tracking the batch verification request.

tools.name: Verify Email Address
tools.description: Tool to verify an email's validity. Use when you need to ensure an address is deliverable and non-disposable, after collecting a user's email.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Listclean API key used for authentication.

name: LiveChat
description: Manage LiveChat agents, groups, bots, webhooks, properties, and customer conversations through server-side OAuth.

tools.name: Accept Greeting
tools.description: Accept an incoming LiveChat greeting for an existing customer and mark that greeting as seen in the customer's live session. This changes greeting state.

tools.name: Approve Agent
tools.description: Approve a licensed LiveChat agent so they can use the application. This non-public operation requires the private subscription.lc:rw grant and changes the agent's approval state; do not retry it automatically.

tools.name: Cancel Greeting
tools.description: Cancel an incoming LiveChat invitation for an existing customer. This changes the greeting state in the customer's live session.

tools.name: Check Product Limits for Plan
tools.description: Read which current organization resources exceed a selected LiveChat plan's limits. This action requires the private subscription.lc:rw grant, which cannot be configured for ordinary public OAuth clients.

tools.name: Create Agent
tools.description: Create a normal-role licensed LiveChat user who must await approval. This safe baseline may consume a paid seat and send an irreversible account or approval email. Do not retry after an uncertain outcome. Use Create Privileged Agent only for approval bypass or an elevated role.

tools.name: Create Auto Access
tools.description: Add an ordered LiveChat auto-access rule. The rule immediately changes which groups customers matching its conditions can access.

tools.name: Create Bot
tools.description: Create a LiveChat bot and return its write-once secret. Treat the secret as a credential and never log or replay it. The bot does not receive chats until its routing status is set; clean up only through a controlled lifecycle.

tools.name: Create Bot Template
tools.description: Create a bot template for an application client ID and return its write-once secret. Treat the secret as a credential. This affects only the template and future installations; it does not create bots on existing installations.

tools.name: Create Bot Template Across Installations
tools.description: Create a LiveChat bot template and also create a bot from it on every license where the app is already installed. This is a cross-license bulk creation and returns a sensitive write-once template secret.

tools.name: Create Canned Response
tools.description: Create a group-owned LiveChat canned response. LiveChat sanitizes its text, and is_private controls whether other users can see it.

tools.name: Create Greeting
tools.description: Create a LiveChat greeting with trigger rules and optional rich content. An active greeting can immediately appear to matching visitors; use active=false while safely preparing it.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Create a LiveChat routing group with its initial language and agent-priority map.

tools.name: Create Privileged Agent
tools.description: Create a licensed LiveChat agent while explicitly bypassing approval and/or assigning an elevated administrator or viceowner role. This may consume a paid seat, send an irreversible account or approval email, and uses stronger or private grants than Create Agent. Do not retry after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a LiveChat tag and optionally assign it to groups. Tag-name duplicate matching is case insensitive.

tools.name: Deactivate Chat
tools.description: Deactivate a LiveChat chat by closing its currently open thread. This takes effect immediately and prevents further messages to that thread. Use only for an explicitly selected chat; do not repeat after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Delete Agent
tools.description: Permanently delete a licensed LiveChat agent. This irreversible operation removes the user from the license; verify the exact agent ID and do not retry automatically.

tools.name: Delete Auto Access
tools.description: Permanently delete an auto-access rule. This immediately changes customer access routing and should only target a confirmed rule ID.

tools.name: Delete Bot
tools.description: Permanently delete a LiveChat bot. This irreversible operation can remove a bot from live routing; use an explicit verified bot ID and do not retry automatically.

tools.name: Delete Bot Template
tools.description: Permanently delete only a bot template. Bots already installed from the template on existing licenses are not deleted.

tools.name: Delete Bot Template And Installed Bots
tools.description: Permanently delete a LiveChat bot template and every bot installed from it across all licenses. This cross-license bulk deletion can disrupt live routing and must not be retried automatically.

tools.name: Delete Canned Response
tools.description: Permanently delete one canned response by ID, removing it from agent use. Use only a confirmed disposable or intentionally retired response.

tools.name: Delete Chat Properties
tools.description: Permanently delete selected registered property values from a live customer chat. Property data may contain PII; this action does not retry.

tools.name: Delete Event
tools.description: Delete one event from a specified LiveChat chat and thread. This is an irreversible customer-visible action: Customer Chat API responses hide the event, while Agent Chat can retain it as deleted or visible to elevated roles. Use only captured IDs from a disposable lifecycle and do not repeat after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Delete Event Properties
tools.description: Permanently delete selected registered property values from a live customer-chat event. Property data may contain PII; this action does not retry.

tools.name: Delete Greeting
tools.description: Permanently delete a greeting, immediately stopping it from appearing to new matching visitors. Use only a confirmed disposable or retired greeting ID.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Permanently delete one LiveChat group by ID.

tools.name: Delete Group Properties
tools.description: Delete selected custom property values from one LiveChat group without unregistering their definitions.

tools.name: Delete License Properties
tools.description: Delete selected license-level custom property values without unregistering their definitions.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Permanently delete the exact case-sensitive LiveChat tag, removing it from workflows that rely on that tag. Use a confirmed disposable or retired name.

tools.name: Delete Thread Properties
tools.description: Permanently delete selected registered property values from a live customer-chat thread. Property data may contain PII; this action does not retry.

tools.name: Disable License Webhooks
tools.description: Disable all webhooks across the connected LiveChat license. Warning: this causes a license-wide webhook outage that persists through application reinstall.

tools.name: Enable License Webhooks
tools.description: Enable webhooks across the connected LiveChat license after they were explicitly disabled. Warning: this changes license-wide integration state and should not be treated as a guaranteed safe rollback without owner approval.

tools.name: Evaluate Goals
tools.description: Trigger LiveChat goal evaluation for an offline customer. Achieved goals can record conversions and trigger configured integrations from the supplied session fields, group, and page URL.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Return one LiveChat agent by ID, including any explicitly requested optional fields.

tools.name: Get Bot
tools.description: Return one LiveChat bot by ID with explicitly requested optional fields.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Return the customer profile for an explicit existing LiveChat entity through the server-side customer authorization bridge.

tools.name: Get Customer Chat
tools.description: Return one existing customer's LiveChat chat and either its latest thread or a specified thread.

tools.name: Get Customer Configuration
tools.description: Return versioned forms, buttons, integrations, and readable properties for a LiveChat customer group.

tools.name: Get Customer Form
tools.description: Return the enabled pre-chat or post-chat form for one LiveChat group.

tools.name: Get Customer Localization
tools.description: Return versioned customer-facing localization phrases for a LiveChat group and language through LiveChat's public Customer Chat endpoint.

tools.name: Get Dynamic Customer Configuration
tools.description: Return current customer-facing widget availability and the version identifiers needed for detailed configuration and localization reads.

tools.name: Get Greeting
tools.description: Get one LiveChat greeting, including its rules and rich-message structure.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Return one LiveChat group by ID, including any explicitly requested optional fields.

tools.name: Get License Webhooks State
tools.description: Return whether webhook delivery is enabled for the connected LiveChat license.

tools.name: Get Predicted Agent
tools.description: Return whether a new chat for an existing customer is predicted to queue and the agent predicted to receive it, when available.

tools.name: Get Product Source
tools.description: Return the source parameters supplied when the Text product was activated.

tools.name: Get URL Preview
tools.description: Return LiveChat-hosted preview image URLs for a public webpage without changing chat state.

tools.name: Issue Bot Token
tools.description: Issue a sensitive, non-revocable bot bearer token valid for 24 hours. The request secret and returned token must never be logged, stored in fixtures, or replayed; this action performs one request with no automatic loop.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: List LiveChat agents, optionally filtering by group membership or suspension state.

tools.name: List All Bots
tools.description: List every bot in the LiveChat license, including bots not owned by the connected app. This is a privileged license-wide inventory read.

tools.name: List All Private Canned Responses
tools.description: Return one page including every private canned response across the requested LiveChat groups. This privileged read exposes private records beyond those normally accessible to the caller and never fetches later pages automatically.

tools.name: List Auto Accesses
tools.description: List all LiveChat auto-access rules in their evaluation order.

tools.name: List Bots
tools.description: List only bots owned by the connected LiveChat app. Use List All Bots for the privileged license-wide inventory.

tools.name: List Bot Templates
tools.description: List bot templates owned by a specified OAuth application client ID.

tools.name: List Canned Responses
tools.description: Return one page of canned responses accessible to the caller and a next_page_id for explicit continuation. This action never reads every private response or fetches subsequent pages automatically.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: List summaries of communication channels used by the connected Text product.

tools.name: List Customer Bans
tools.description: List all active customer bans. Results can contain sensitive IP addresses and customer identifiers and should not be persisted unnecessarily.

tools.name: List Customer Chats
tools.description: List one existing customer's chat summaries through LiveChat's server-side customer authorization bridge, returning one page at a time.

tools.name: List Customer Chat Threads
tools.description: List threads from one existing customer's chat through LiveChat's server-side customer authorization bridge, returning one page at a time.

tools.name: List Customer Group Properties
tools.description: Read the custom property values a customer may access for one LiveChat group. Property values may contain customer data. Warning: live probes of this documented public endpoint currently return HTTP 405 or unsupported action; call it only to check whether provider support has been restored.

tools.name: List Customer Group Statuses
tools.description: Return chat availability statuses for selected LiveChat groups or all groups visible to an existing customer.

tools.name: List Customer License Properties
tools.description: Read the license property values visible to a LiveChat customer. Property values may contain customer data. Warning: live probes of this documented public endpoint currently return HTTP 405 or unsupported action; call it only to check whether provider support has been restored.

tools.name: List Greetings
tools.description: List a bounded page of LiveChat greetings, optionally filtered by group. Use the returned native next_page_id in a later call when present.

tools.name: List Group Properties
tools.description: Read group-level property values for selected LiveChat groups or a property namespace.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: List all LiveChat groups, optionally requesting additional fields for each group.

tools.name: List License Properties
tools.description: Read license-level property values, optionally narrowed to a namespace and property-name prefix.

tools.name: List Property Definitions
tools.description: List private and public LiveChat property definitions owned by a specified OAuth application client ID.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List LiveChat tags, optionally filtering by nested group IDs.

tools.name: List Webhook Names
tools.description: List webhook actions supported by LiveChat Configuration API version 3.6, including their accepted filters and additional payload data.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List webhooks registered for a specified OAuth application client ID.

tools.name: Mark Events as Seen
tools.description: Advance an existing customer's seen state in a LiveChat chat through an RFC 3339 timestamp. This emits a read-receipt state change for the chat.

tools.name: Publish Property
tools.description: Publish a private property for access by tokens belonging to any Client ID. Warning: publication is irreversible; a published property cannot be unpublished or unregistered.

tools.name: Reactivate Email
tools.description: Reactivate a bounced external email address for one LiveChat agent. Warning: this changes external email delivery state and may resume messages to that address.

tools.name: Register Property
tools.description: Register one private custom property definition for a LiveChat OAuth application.

tools.name: Register Webhook
tools.description: Register one LiveChat webhook endpoint for an OAuth application and action.

tools.name: Request Agent Unsuspension
tools.description: Request unsuspension for the connected suspended agent. LiveChat sends external emails to the license owners and vice owners; do not retry this notification operation automatically.

tools.name: Request Email Verification
tools.description: Send a verification email to an existing LiveChat customer. After confirmation, LiveChat sends the verified email to the supplied HTTPS callback exactly once and expects HTTP 200; failed callbacks are not retried.

tools.name: Request Welcome Message
tools.description: Request an asynchronous welcome message for an existing logged-in customer. This creates greeting session state, emits incoming_welcome_message later, and can affect AI or agent routing; the response reports the predicted route.

tools.name: Reset Bot Secret
tools.description: Irreversibly rotate a bot secret and return the sensitive replacement. The old credential stops working; update dependents immediately and never log, persist, replay, or automatically retry this operation.

tools.name: Reset Bot Template And Installed Bot Secrets
tools.description: Irreversibly rotate a LiveChat bot template secret and set the replacement on every installed bot based on it across all licenses. This bulk credential rotation invalidates prior secrets; never log, replay, or automatically retry it.

tools.name: Reset Bot Template Secret
tools.description: Irreversibly rotate only a bot template secret and return the sensitive replacement. Existing installed bot secrets are unchanged; never log, replay, or automatically retry this action.

tools.name: Resume Chat
tools.description: Resume an archived LiveChat chat for an existing customer entity. This is non-idempotent: a successful call creates a new thread and can create initial events, change access or continuous mode, and mark events seen. Do not repeat a call after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Send Event
tools.description: Send one event into a real LiveChat chat for an existing customer. This is non-idempotent: a successful call creates and delivers the event and marks chat events seen for the customer. Do not repeat after an uncertain outcome, because duplicate messages or interactions can be delivered.

tools.name: Send File Event
tools.description: Upload one non-executable file of at most 10,000,000 bytes and irreversibly deliver it as a file event in an existing LiveChat chat. Delivery also marks chat events seen for the customer. If delivery fails after upload, the temporary uploaded file can remain without an event; do not retry after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Send Greeting Button Clicked
tools.description: Record that an existing customer clicked a specific button in an incoming LiveChat greeting. This writes interaction state for the live session.

tools.name: Send Rich Message Postback
tools.description: Send a button postback for an existing rich-message event. This is non-idempotent and changes the live interaction state; for an active thread it can emit an incoming-rich-message-postback notification. Do not repeat a call after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Send Sneak Peek
tools.description: Send transient typed content into a real LiveChat chat before the customer submits it as a message. Agents may see the supplied text immediately. This is non-idempotent interaction activity; do not repeat after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Set Customer Session Fields
tools.description: Replace an existing LiveChat customer's ordered session fields. This mutates customer session/profile data and the values may contain PII.

tools.name: Start Chat
tools.description: Start a new LiveChat chat for an existing customer entity. This is non-idempotent: every successful call can create a real chat, thread, and initial events, and it also marks existing chat events seen for the customer. Do not repeat a call after an uncertain outcome.

tools.name: Suspend Agent
tools.description: Suspend a licensed LiveChat agent. This non-public operation requires the private sessions--all:rw grant and can interrupt active sessions and live chat routing; do not retry it automatically.

tools.name: Unban Customer
tools.description: Lift a customer ban by IP address or customer ID. Warning: this restores the customer's access to the connected LiveChat license.

tools.name: Unregister Property
tools.description: Permanently remove one custom property definition owned by an OAuth application.

tools.name: Unregister Webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove one webhook registration owned by a LiveChat OAuth application.

tools.name: Unsuspend Agent
tools.description: Unsuspend a licensed LiveChat agent. This non-public operation requires the private subscription.lc:rw grant and restores the agent's ability to participate in live routing; do not retry it automatically.

tools.name: Update Agent
tools.description: Update a licensed LiveChat agent. Role, group, login-status, chat-capacity, notification, and schedule changes can immediately alter permissions or live routing; verify the target and intended fields before calling.

tools.name: Update Auto Access
tools.description: Update or reorder an auto-access rule. Changes immediately affect customer access routing, so use a confirmed disposable or intended rule ID.

tools.name: Update Bot
tools.description: Update a LiveChat bot. Group, priority, schedule, and chat-capacity changes can immediately alter live routing; verify the bot and intended fields before calling.

tools.name: Update Bot Template
tools.description: Fully replace a LiveChat bot template for future installations. Existing installed bots are not changed. Omitted optional replacement fields are reset or cleared to provider defaults.

tools.name: Update Canned Response
tools.description: Update an existing canned response while preserving omitted fields. Changing its group or privacy setting changes who can access it.

tools.name: Update Chat Properties
tools.description: Set registered custom property values on a live customer chat. This mutates chat state and values may contain PII.

tools.name: Update Company Details
tools.description: Update license-level company details. Warning: this is an organization-wide change, and enrich=true may populate currently empty fields from the company domain.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Partially update an existing LiveChat customer profile. This writes PII and may change omnichannel identity matching; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Event Properties
tools.description: Set registered custom property values on a live customer-chat event. This mutates event state and values may contain PII.

tools.name: Update Greeting
tools.description: Update a greeting while preserving omitted fields. Rule, content, or active changes affect matching visitors immediately; deactivate before structural editing when appropriate.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Update the name, language, or complete agent-priority map of an existing LiveChat group.

tools.name: Update Group Properties
tools.description: Set one or more custom property values on a LiveChat group.

tools.name: Update Installed Bots From Template
tools.description: Fully replace a LiveChat bot template and propagate the replacement to every bot installed from it across all licenses. Omitted optional replacement fields are reset or cleared to provider defaults. This bulk cross-license update can immediately change live bot routing behavior.

tools.name: Update License Properties
tools.description: Set one or more license-level custom property values grouped by namespace.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Update a LiveChat tag identified by its exact case-sensitive name. When provided, group_ids replaces the tag's group assignment.

tools.name: Update Thread Properties
tools.description: Set registered custom property values on a live customer-chat thread. This mutates thread state and values may contain PII.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Upload one non-executable file of at most 10,000,000 bytes for later use in a Customer Chat event. This creates a temporary provider-hosted file URL that expires after 24 hours unless used in send_event. Do not repeat after an uncertain outcome because each successful call uploads another file.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Livesession
description: LiveSession is a session replay and user behavior analytics tool that helps you understand how users interact with your website.

tools.name: List Live Sessions
tools.description: Tool to list live sessions. Use when you need paginated session data filtered by criteria after authentication.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The Personal Access Token (PAT) used for authenticating API requests to LiveSession.

name: LLM API
description: LLM API provides a unified inference API for text, embeddings, images, audio, video, files, and batch workloads across multiple AI providers.

tools.name: Cancel Batch
tools.description: Request best-effort cancellation of an in-progress batch. Return the provider's actual batch state without implying cancellation took effect; work may still finish and incur charges before the request is applied.

tools.name: Count Anthropic Message Tokens
tools.description: Count input tokens for an Anthropic-compatible message request without generating a model response.

tools.name: Create Anthropic Message
tools.description: Generate one complete, non-streaming Anthropic-compatible message with flexible content blocks, system prompts, and tool use with your own connection. Instant supports the Claude models listed in its pricing, with plain-text messages and a plain-text system prompt; tools, content blocks and other models are rejected before provider execution.

tools.name: Create Chat Completion
tools.description: Generate a complete, non-streaming OpenAI-compatible chat response. Instant supports only the models listed in its pricing, with plain-text messages: no tools, multimodal content, web search, or reasoning-effort overrides. Unsupported Instant requests are rejected before provider execution. With your own connection, use models and capabilities supported by your provider project.

tools.name: Create Embeddings
tools.description: Create vector embeddings for one text or a batch of texts with a selected embedding model. Requires your own connection; this action is unavailable through Instant.

tools.name: Create Response
tools.description: Generate one complete, non-streaming OpenAI Responses-compatible result from text or structured input, preserving reasoning and tool items. Requires your own connection; this action is unavailable through Instant.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete a caller-owned or explicitly authorized project file. This destructive operation cannot be undone; a missing file fails with not found rather than reporting a successful deletion.

tools.name: Discover Models
tools.description: Return one model's full live capabilities by ID, or browse a compact, bounded view of the live model catalog using local capability filters.

tools.name: Get Account and Credits
tools.description: Return the connected user, project, organization, purchased and bonus credit balances, funding mode, and balance gating in one account-status read.

tools.name: List or Get Batches
tools.description: Return one asynchronous batch and its latest lifecycle, token, and cost status by ID, or one provider-default page of project batches when no batch ID is supplied. List mode supports provider cursor pagination.

tools.name: List or Get Files
tools.description: Return metadata for one project file by ID, or one provider-default page of project file metadata when no file ID is supplied. List mode supports purpose filtering and provider cursor pagination.

tools.name: Submit Batch
tools.description: Create an asynchronous batch from an existing purpose=batch file ID, or upload a JSONL input file with purpose=batch and create the batch in one call.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a project API key in the LLM API dashboard at https://app.llmapi.ai/dashboard/api-keys and copy it when it is shown. Keys are displayed in full only once. Do not use an organization Public API key, which belongs to a separate reporting API.

name: LLMWhisperer
description: LLMWhisperer is a technology that presents data from complex documents to LLMs in a way that they can best understand.

tools.name: Convert Document to Text (v2)
tools.description: Tool to convert PDF/scanned documents to text format for LLM consumption. Supports file upload or URL processing with multiple modes (native_text, low_cost, high_quality, form, table). Use when you need to extract text from documents for LLM processing. Returns whisper_hash for status checking and text retrieval.

tools.name: Get Highlights Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get line metadata for highlighting extracted text in the original document. Returns bounding box coordinates (x, y, width, height) and page number for each line. Use when you need to create text overlays on document images or highlight specific lines in the source document.

tools.name: Register Webhook
tools.description: Tool to register a new webhook endpoint for LLMWhisperer async notifications. Use when you need to set up a callback URL to receive processing results. The webhook URL is validated during registration to ensure it's reachable.

tools.name: Get Usage Information
tools.description: Tool to check usage metrics of your LLMWhisperer account. Use when you need to monitor API consumption, verify quotas, or check remaining page limits.

tools.name: Get Usage Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve usage statistics for your LLMWhisperer account based on a specific tag. Use when you need to check consumption metrics for a given tag and optional date range. Returns usage data for the preceding 30 days when date parameters are omitted.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a registered webhook from LLMWhisperer system. Use when you need to remove a webhook that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Get Webhook Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve registered webhook details for LLMWhisperer. Use when you need to get the configuration of a specific webhook including its URL and authentication token.

tools.name: Update Webhook Configuration
tools.description: Tool to update an existing webhook configuration for document conversion callbacks. Use when you need to modify the callback URL, authentication token, or webhook identifier. The system validates the webhook by sending a test payload and requires a 200 status response.

tools.name: Check Whisper Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a text extraction process in LLMWhisperer. Use when the conversion is done in async mode to poll for completion status.

tools.name: Get Whisper Detail
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive details about ongoing or completed text extraction process. Use when you need to monitor the status and progress metrics of a text extraction job.

tools.name: Retrieve Whisper Text
tools.description: Tool to retrieve extracted text from asynchronous whisper processing. Use when the conversion process was initiated in async mode and you need to retrieve the results using the whisper_hash identifier. Note that retrieval is single-use for security - once retrieved, the same whisper_hash cannot be used again.

required.name: region
required.description: Select your API region (US Central or EU West)

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and copy your API key directly from your Profile page at https://llmwhisperer.unstract.com/profile

name: Lob
description: Direct Mail Automation and Address Verification APIs

tools.name: Create Domain
tools.description: Tool to add a new custom domain for creating custom links. Use when you need to register a domain for short link customization.

tools.name: Create Link
tools.description: Tool to create a shortened URL from a long URL using Lob's link shortening service. Use when you need to shorten a long URL either by using a custom domain or Lob's own short domain.

tools.name: Delete Domain
tools.description: Tool to delete a registered domain. Use only after confirming all associated links with the domain are deleted.

tools.name: Delete Link
tools.description: Tool to delete a shortened link. Use when you need to remove a previously created short link from the system.

tools.name: Delete Upload
tools.description: Tool to delete an existing upload by its unique identifier. Use when you need to permanently remove an upload and its associated data.

tools.name: Get Domain
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details for a single domain from Lob. Use when you need to get configuration status, redirect links, or other metadata for a specific domain.

tools.name: Get Link
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single shortened link. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific link by its ID.

tools.name: List Domains
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all created domains. Use when you need to view or manage custom domains configured for URL shortening. Supports pagination and filtering by configuration status.

tools.name: List Shortened Links
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of shortened links. The list is sorted by creation date, with the most recently created appearing first. Use when you need to view all links or filter by campaign or domain.

tools.name: List QR Code Analytics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of your QR codes and their analytics data. The QR codes are returned sorted by scan date, with the most recently scanned QR codes appearing first.

tools.name: List Uploads
tools.description: Tool to list uploads from Lob. Use when you need to retrieve all uploads or filter uploads by campaign ID.

tools.name: Update Link
tools.description: Tool to update any properties of a shortened link. Use when you need to modify the redirect URL, title, or metadata of an existing Lob shortened link. Requires the link_id and at least the redirect_link to update.

tools.name: Validate Identity
tools.description: Tool to validate whether a given name is associated with an address. Use when you need to verify identity information by checking if a recipient name matches address records.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Lob secret API key. Find this in your account settings at https://dashboard.lob.com/settings/api-keys. Use test_ prefix for testing or live_ prefix for production.

name: Lodgify
description: Lodgify is an all-in-one vacation rental software that enables property owners and managers to create bookable websites, synchronize property data across multiple channels, and manage guest reservations and communications from a single platform.

tools.name: Create Call Me Back Request
tools.description: Tool to create a Call Me Back request in Lodgify. Use when scheduling a callback appointment with a guest for property inquiries or booking assistance.

tools.name: Create Enquiry
tools.description: Tool to create a new general enquiry with guest and reservation details. Use when a potential guest wants to make an enquiry about a property or availability.

tools.name: Decline Enquiry
tools.description: Tool to decline an enquiry, changing its status to Declined. Use when you need to reject or decline an enquiry from a potential guest.

tools.name: Delete Enquiry
tools.description: Tool to delete an enquiry by moving it to the trash. Use when you need to remove an enquiry from active listings without permanently deleting it.

tools.name: Delete Reservations
tools.description: Tool to delete multiple bookings or enquiries in a single batch operation. Use when you need to remove several reservations at once instead of deleting them individually.

tools.name: Get Countries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available countries. Use when you need to populate country selectors with supported ISO codes and names.

tools.name: Get Country by Code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific country by its ISO code. Use when you need to validate a country code or get the full country name for a given code.

tools.name: Get Currency By Code
tools.description: Tool to retrieve currency details by its code. Use when you need to get information about a specific currency including its exchange rate, decimal places, and symbol.

tools.name: Get Deleted Properties
tools.description: Retrieves IDs of properties that have been deleted from the Lodgify account. Use this action to: - Get a list of all deleted property IDs - Filter deleted properties by deletion date using the deletedSince parameter - Sync local property databases by identifying which properties no longer exist Returns an array of integer property IDs. Use deletedSince to only retrieve properties deleted after a specific datetime.

tools.name: Get External Bookings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve external bookings for a specific booking ID. Use when you need to get external booking details associated with a main booking record.

tools.name: Get Messaging Thread
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a messaging thread. Use when you need to access thread information including messages, guest details, and thread status. The threadGuid parameter can be obtained from: - Reservation responses (thread_uid field) - Webhook events (guest_message_received) - Other Lodgify API endpoints that return thread identifiers

tools.name: Get Property Availability
tools.description: Retrieves availability information for a specific property within a date range. This action queries the Lodgify API to get detailed availability data including: - Property ID, room type ID, and user ID - Availability periods with start and end dates - Number of units available during each period - Booking information and channel calendars - Closed period details if applicable The propertyId is required. Date range defaults to today through 30 days if not specified. Returns empty details array if no availability data exists for the property.

tools.name: Get Room Type Availability
tools.description: Retrieves availability calendar data for a specific room type within a property for a given date range. This action queries the Lodgify API to get detailed availability information for a specific room type, including availability periods, booking status, and rates. Use when you need to check availability for a specific room type within a property, rather than for the entire property.

tools.name: Get Unread Count
tools.description: Retrieves the total count of unread bookings and enquiries. Use this to check how many new reservations or enquiries require attention.

tools.name: Get V1 Availability
tools.description: Retrieves availability information for all properties and room types for a given date range. Use when you need to check availability across all properties in the account. Returns empty array if no availability data exists for the specified period.

tools.name: List Channel Connections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all channel connections. Use when you need to display or synchronize channel connections across properties.

tools.name: List Channel Mappings
tools.description: Tool to list channel mappings. Use when you need to retrieve all channel mappings, optionally filtered by property, channel code, or external ID. Supports pagination.

tools.name: List Channel Reservations
tools.description: Tool to list channel reservations. Use when you need to retrieve reservations across channels filtered by property, channel, or date range. Results are paginated; use `limit` and `offset` together across multiple requests to retrieve all reservations, as a single request may not return the full result set.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all available distribution channels in the Lodgify account. Channels are booking platforms (e.g., Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Expedia) that can be connected to properties for synchronized availability and reservations. Use this action to: - Get a list of all available channels that can be connected - View channel details including ID, name, description, and active status - Check which channels are currently active in the account Returns an empty list if no channels are available or configured.

tools.name: List Currencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available currency codes. Use when you need to display currency options or validate currency codes for pricing and reservations.

tools.name: List Properties
tools.description: Retrieves all properties from the Lodgify account with optional pagination. Use this action to: - Get a list of all properties in the account - Iterate through properties using pagination - Check which properties exist before performing operations on specific properties Returns property IDs, names, and address details including coordinates. Paginate through all pages until results are exhausted — stopping early silently omits remaining properties. No server-side filtering by region or location; filter client-side using returned name or address fields.

tools.name: List Reservations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of bookings and enquiries from the inbox. Use when you need to fetch reservations with optional filtering by status, property, date range, or trash status.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all webhooks configured in the Lodgify account. Use this action to: - Get all webhook configurations - View webhook details including ID, event type, and target URL - Check which webhooks are currently set up for receiving notifications Returns an empty list if no webhooks are configured.

tools.name: Mark Reservations Not Replied
tools.description: Tool to batch mark bookings and enquiries as not replied. Use when you need to mark multiple reservations (bookings or enquiries) as not replied in a single operation.

tools.name: Mark Reservations Replied
tools.description: Tool to batch mark bookings or enquiries as replied. Use when you need to mark multiple reservations as replied in a single operation.

tools.name: Recover Enquiry
tools.description: Tool to restore an enquiry that was previously moved to the trash. Use when you need to recover a deleted enquiry by its ID.

tools.name: Reopen Enquiry
tools.description: Tool to reopen an enquiry, changing its status to Open. Use when you need to reactivate a previously closed or cancelled enquiry.

tools.name: Set Availability
tools.description: Updates the number of available units for a specific room type within a date range. Use this action to set availability for booking periods. The period_start and period_end dates define the range during which the specified number of units will be available.

tools.name: Subscribe to Webhook
tools.description: Subscribes to a Lodgify webhook by providing a target URL and event type. Use this action to: - Register a callback URL to receive real-time notifications from Lodgify - Listen for specific events like new bookings, rate changes, or availability updates - Set up integrations that respond to changes in the Lodgify system The target_url must be unique. Returns a webhook ID for later unsubscription and a secret for signature verification.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from a Lodgify webhook. Use when you need to remove a webhook subscription by providing the webhook ID that was returned during subscription.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key obtained from Lodgify's Public API settings.

name: Logo.dev
description: Logo.dev provides a high-quality logo API and company brand database, enabling developers to retrieve official high-resolution logos from any domain without scraping or manual effort.

tools.name: Describe Domain
tools.description: Return domain enrichment: name, description, colors, social links, and logo. Use Brand Profile instead for an asset-rich profile with brandmarks and banners. Describe requires a paid Logo.dev plan, and quotas and rate limits vary by plan. On HTTP 429, honor Retry-After when supplied or use exponential backoff.

tools.name: Get Brand Profile
tools.description: Return an asset-rich profile with logos, brandmarks, banners, and colors. The profile also includes available descriptions and social profiles. Use Describe Domain for the paid domain-enrichment summary. Access, quotas, and rate limits depend on the Logo.dev plan. When rate limited, honor Retry-After when supplied or retry with exponential backoff.

tools.name: Get Logo by Cryptocurrency
tools.description: Retrieve a logo by cryptocurrency symbol with optional rendering controls. Image quotas and rate limits depend on the connected Logo.dev plan. If the provider rate-limits a request, honor Retry-After when present and retry with exponential backoff.

tools.name: Get Logo by ISIN
tools.description: Retrieve a downloadable logo image for an ISIN. Rendering-option availability, request quotas, and rate limits depend on the Logo.dev plan.

tools.name: Get Logo by Name
tools.description: Retrieve Logo.dev's top logo search match for a brand name. Name matching can be ambiguous, so verify the image before downstream use. Image quotas and rate limits depend on the Logo.dev plan. When rate limited, honor Retry-After when supplied or retry with exponential backoff.

tools.name: Get Logo by Ticker
tools.description: Retrieve a downloadable logo image for a stock ticker. Logo availability, request quotas, and rate limits are plan-dependent. On a 429 response, honor the provider's Retry-After value or use exponential backoff before retrying.

tools.name: Get Logo Image
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the logo image for a domain. Use when you need the raw image bytes (PNG or SVG) of a specific domain's logo. Use after validating the domain string.

tools.name: Search Brand
tools.description: Search for existing brands by name and return their image URLs. Managed calls accept query and a limit up to 10. Verify the domain before using a result.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Logo.dev secret API key (starts with 'sk_'). Required for all REST API endpoints. Find it in your Logo.dev dashboard.

optional.name: generic_token
optional.description: The separate publishable key (starts with pk_) for img.logo.dev.

name: Lokalise
description: Lokalise is a translation and localization management platform for managing multilingual content, projects, contributors, files, keys, translations, and localization workflows.

tools.name: Create Keys
tools.description: Create 1 to 500 keys in a Lokalise project or branch. Requires a personal read/write API token and the project's Manage keys admin right. Branch targets also require a compatible Software project with Branching enabled. The response retains per-item errors so partial batch failures remain visible.

tools.name: Delete Keys
