name: MailUp
description: MailUp is an email and SMS marketing platform for managing lists, recipients, campaigns, and engagement statistics.

tools.name: Add Image
tools.description: Decode and store supplied base64 image data in either MailUp's shared console library or one list, returning the resulting full paths. This creates persistent provider content, requires image/list access, and counts toward the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: Add Message Attachment
tools.description: Upload base64-encoded bytes into a specific attachment slot on one MailUp email message.

tools.name: Associate Personalization Endpoint With List
tools.description: Associate an existing MailUp personalization endpoint with one list. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Import SMS Recipients To Group
tools.description: Asynchronously add or update an SMS recipient batch in a MailUp group and return the import ID. clear_missing_or_empty_fields=true permanently clears stored recipient fields omitted or empty in each row. remove_from_prev_groups=true removes each recipient from every previous group before adding this group. Requires SMS entitlement; limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Import SMS Recipients To List
tools.description: Asynchronously add or update an SMS recipient batch in a MailUp list and return the import ID. clear_missing_or_empty_fields=true permanently clears stored recipient fields omitted or empty in each row. Requires SMS entitlement; limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Import One SMS Recipient To Group
tools.description: Add or update one SMS recipient in a MailUp group and return the recipient ID. clear_missing_or_empty_fields=true permanently clears stored recipient fields omitted or empty in this request. remove_from_prev_groups=true removes the recipient from every previous group before adding this group. Requires SMS entitlement; observe the 5 calls per second limit.

tools.name: Import One SMS Recipient To List
tools.description: Add or update one SMS recipient in a MailUp list and return the recipient ID. clear_missing_or_empty_fields=true permanently clears stored recipient fields omitted or empty in this request. Requires SMS entitlement; observe the 5 calls per second limit.

tools.name: Batch Unsubscribe Recipients From List
tools.description: Remove multiple recipients' memberships from one MailUp list without deleting their global recipient records. This non-atomic action processes 1-20 unique recipient IDs sequentially at less than 5 requests per second. It stops after the first failed or unknown removal, reports any partial completion, and marks remaining recipients not_attempted; successful earlier removals are not rolled back.

tools.name: Confirm SMS Numeric Sender
tools.description: Confirm a MailUp numeric SMS sender using the code previously delivered by the sender-confirmation flow. Confirmation and SMS entitlement may be required before sending; observe MailUp's limit of 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Copy Email Message
tools.description: Create a copy of one MailUp email message, optionally replacing its subject or internal notes; this does not send it.

tools.name: Count Message Sending Recipients
tools.description: Return MailUp's count of recipients to whom one email message was sent. This is the SendingRecipients statistic, distinct from the recipient-detail list; message-recipient data is retained for the console retention period, up to 12 months, after which related recipient statistics can be zero or empty.

tools.name: Count Subscribers
tools.description: Return the subscribed-recipient count for a MailUp list or, when group_id is supplied, for one group in that list.

tools.name: Create Audience Group
tools.description: Create a recipient group in one MailUp list and return the complete group record.

tools.name: Create Content Source
tools.description: Create a named content-provider source in MailUp.

tools.name: Create Email Message
tools.description: Create a draft email campaign message in one MailUp list without sending it.

tools.name: Create Email Message from Template
tools.description: Create a new draft email message in a MailUp list from an existing template without sending it.

tools.name: Create List
tools.description: Create a MailUp mailing list without adding recipients or sending messages. The request must supply at least one settings source: id_settings or use_default_settings. Availability and accepted settings depend on the connected user's console permissions; MailUp limits standard REST traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Create Personalization Endpoint
tools.description: Create a MailUp endpoint used to obtain external personalization data. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Create SMS Message
tools.description: Create a MailUp SMS draft without sending or consuming delivery credits. The account needs SMS entitlement; observe MailUp's limit of 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Create SMTP+ Account
tools.description: Create an SMTP+ user account for a MailUp list and return its generated credentials. Supply at least one non-empty trusted domain or confirmed trusted sender, and choose priority_code from GET_SMTP_PLUS_PRIORITY_CODES. This feature-gated operation requires SMTP+ to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a named tag in one MailUp list for organizing email messages.

tools.name: Delete Audience Group
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp group. This does not delete its recipients from the parent list.

tools.name: Delete Audience Recipient From List
tools.description: Delete one recipient record from one MailUp list only; other list memberships are unaffected.

tools.name: Delete Audience Recipient Globally
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp recipient from every list in the account. This high-impact operation can remove all list memberships and returns a result for each affected list.

tools.name: Delete Content Source
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp content-provider source.

tools.name: Delete Email Message
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp email message from a list. This does not cancel an already queued sending.

tools.name: Delete Image
tools.description: Permanently delete the image at an exact full MailUp path from provider storage. This destructive operation has no list-specific route, requires image access, and counts toward the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: Delete List
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp list and its list-scoped configuration. This destructive operation requires console permission, cannot be undone, and is subject to MailUp's 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: Delete Message Attachment
tools.description: Permanently remove the attachment in one slot from a MailUp email message and return the remaining attachments.

tools.name: Delete Personalization Endpoint
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp personalization endpoint. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Delete Email Sending Task
tools.description: Delete an existing MailUp email sending task record; this does not recall email already delivered. MailUp permits at most 1 combined stop or delete call per 30 seconds. A process-local guard coordinates both actions in this worker only; MailUp remains authoritative across workers and other clients. Never retry automatically after a rejection or ambiguous result.

tools.name: Delete SMS Message
tools.description: Permanently delete one MailUp SMS draft without sending it. Requires SMS service entitlement; observe MailUp's limit of 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Delete Source Content
tools.description: Permanently delete one keyed content item from a MailUp content-provider source.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Permanently delete one tag from a MailUp list; messages using it may lose that classification.

tools.name: Disable Trusted Sender
tools.description: Disable a trusted sender registration by ID so it is no longer active for sending. The action verifies the sender address because MailUp may return one ID for multiple registrations, then supplies MailUp's required request GUID internally. This feature-gated operation requires Trusted Senders to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Disassociate Personalization Endpoint From List
tools.description: Remove one MailUp personalization endpoint association from a list. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Empty Audience Group
tools.description: Remove every recipient membership from one MailUp group. This high-impact operation leaves the group and parent-list recipients intact.

tools.name: Set Email Message Dynamic Fields
tools.description: Enable or disable dynamic recipient-field substitution on one MailUp email message and return its complete current details.

tools.name: Set SMS Message Dynamic Fields
tools.description: Explicitly enable or disable dynamic recipient-field substitution for one MailUp SMS draft. Requires SMS entitlement; limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Set Tracking for Every List
tools.description: Explicitly enable or disable email tracking for one recipient across every MailUp list. The enable boolean is the desired final state.

tools.name: Set Tracking for List
tools.description: Explicitly enable or disable email tracking for one recipient on one MailUp list. The enable boolean is the desired final state.

tools.name: Find Recipients
tools.description: Find MailUp recipients by email address, mobile number, or both; this endpoint cannot list recipients without a lookup value.

tools.name: Get Account Details
tools.description: Return the connected MailUp account identity, plan, trial status, expiry, and available credits; use this before credit-dependent sending.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Return the authenticated MailUp account identity, console version, trial flag, and optional expiry/URL. This is account metadata, not credits or plan details, and is subject to the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: List Archived Email Messages
tools.description: Return one page of archived email messages from a specific MailUp list.

tools.name: Get Deferred Dispatch Date
tools.description: Get the first useful MailUp date for scheduling a sending task.

tools.name: Get Earliest Deferred SMS Dispatch Date
tools.description: Return MailUp's earliest useful scheduling date for one SMS sending task. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Deferred SMS Sendings
tools.description: Return SMS sending tasks scheduled for deferred dispatch. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Email Message
tools.description: Return the content, subject, tracking settings, tags, dynamic fields, and attachments for one MailUp email message.

tools.name: List Email Send History for List
tools.description: Return one page of send-history records across all email messages in one MailUp list.

tools.name: Get Email Template Details
tools.description: Return metadata and content for one email template in a MailUp list.

tools.name: List Email Templates
tools.description: Return one page of email templates defined in a specific MailUp list.

tools.name: List Immediate SMS Sendings
tools.description: Return SMS sending tasks scheduled for immediate dispatch. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Import Details
tools.description: Return the complete MailUp import configuration and nested valid/invalid row totals for one import ID. Access follows the connected user's list permissions and standard REST traffic is limited to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Import Sending
tools.description: Return the sending and message IDs for confirmation requests generated by one MailUp import. Data exists only when that import generated confirmation messages; standard REST traffic is limited to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Import Status
tools.description: Return completion and recipient outcome counts for an asynchronous MailUp import ID.

tools.name: List Last Sent SMS Messages
tools.description: Return the most recently sent SMS messages and their account-billing costs for one list. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get List
tools.description: Return configuration and sender details for one MailUp mailing list by ID.

tools.name: Get MailUp Login URL
tools.description: Create an ephemeral URL that logs a user into the MailUp platform. This is a feature-gated SSO operation: MailUp must enable SSO for the connected platform account before this action can succeed.

tools.name: List Current User Email Messages
tools.description: Return one page of cloned and original email messages across lists for the current MailUp user.

tools.name: List Message Attachments
tools.description: Return all attachment slots currently configured on one MailUp email message.

tools.name: Get Message Statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate recipient, view, click, bounce, and unsubscription counts for one MailUp email message using five read-only statistics calls. Counts can be zero after MailUp's message-recipient retention period expires.

tools.name: Get Message Statistics Pages
tools.description: Return MailUp's precompiled public statistics-page URLs for one message: overall, click trend, opens, link tracking, readers, and sent reports, plus the console login URL. These human-facing pages expose less detail than the statistics API; the console URL can also reveal the account host. Legacy click/open filter pages are no longer available and are not returned by the current XSD.

tools.name: List Non-Temporary SMS Errors
tools.description: Return undelivered SMS error totals grouped by originator address. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Pending SMS Recipients By List
tools.description: Return recipients whose SMS subscription is pending in one MailUp list. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Personalization Endpoint
tools.description: Retrieve one MailUp personalization endpoint including its configured details. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Published Email Messages
tools.description: Return one page of email messages currently visible online for a specific MailUp list.

tools.name: Get Recipient
tools.description: Return contact details, dynamic fields, and list membership states for one MailUp recipient ID.

tools.name: Get Recipient Statistics
tools.description: Return aggregate delivery, view, click, bounce, and unsubscription counts for one MailUp recipient using five rate-limited, read-only statistics calls. Counts can be zero after MailUp's message-recipient retention period expires.

tools.name: Request SMS Numeric Sender Confirmation Code
tools.description: Request the authentication code for a MailUp numeric SMS sender and return whether MailUp accepted the request. This mutates sender-verification state and may cause MailUp to issue a code; never retry automatically after any status or transport failure because the first request may have succeeded. The SMS channel and sender verification must be enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get SMS Message Details
tools.description: Return the complete XSD-defined content and settings for one MailUp SMS message. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List SMS Messages By List
tools.description: Return SMS campaign message summaries from one MailUp list. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List SMS Message Send History
tools.description: Return sending attempts and recipient counts for one SMS message. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get SMS Message Sending Report
tools.description: Return aggregate duration, cost, recipient-message, and billable SMS-part totals for one SMS message. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List SMS Message Sending Report Details
tools.description: Return per-recipient delivery statuses and errors for one SMS message. A DeliveryId filter returns at most one detail. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get SMS Numeric Sender Status
tools.description: Return the verification status code and description for one numeric MailUp SMS sender. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List SMS Recipients By Group
tools.description: Return recipients in one MailUp group using the SMS channel projection. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get SMTP+ Priority Codes
tools.description: List the SMTP+ priority codes available in MailUp. This feature-gated operation requires SMTP+ to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Subscribed SMS Recipients By List
tools.description: Return recipients subscribed to the SMS channel in one MailUp list. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Enabled Tags
tools.description: Return one page of enabled tags configured for a specific MailUp list.

tools.name: List Temporary SMS Errors
tools.description: Return temporary undelivered SMS error totals grouped by originator address. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Get Tracking Status for Every List
tools.description: Get one recipient's email tracking status across every MailUp list.

tools.name: Get Tracking Status for List
tools.description: Get one recipient's email tracking status for a specific MailUp list.

tools.name: Get Trusted Sender
tools.description: Get one trusted sender registration by ID. This feature-gated operation requires Trusted Senders to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Trusted Senders
tools.description: Return one page of trusted sender registrations. This feature-gated operation requires Trusted Senders to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Unscheduled SMS Sendings
tools.description: Return SMS sending tasks that still need a dispatch schedule. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Unsubscribed SMS Recipients By List
tools.description: Return recipients unsubscribed from the SMS channel in one MailUp list. This is a read-only Console API operation: it does not send SMS or consume SMS credits. The connected MailUp account and relevant list must have the SMS channel enabled. MailUp limits Console API traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Import Audience Recipient To Group
tools.description: Synchronously create or update one email recipient and add them to a MailUp group, returning the recipient ID. For a new recipient, the group's owning list becomes the owning list and they receive a Subscribed subscription status by default. confirm_email=true sends a confirmation email automatically and leaves a new recipient Pending; a Pending recipient receives another confirmation email and an Unsubscribed recipient moves to Pending. Never retry an ambiguous result because doing so can send duplicate confirmation email.

tools.name: Import Audience Recipient To List
tools.description: Synchronously create or update one email recipient in a MailUp list and return the recipient ID. The target list becomes the recipient's owning list; a new recipient receives a Subscribed subscription status by default. confirm_email=true sends a confirmation email automatically and leaves a new recipient Pending; a Pending recipient receives another confirmation email and an Unsubscribed recipient moves to Pending. Never retry an ambiguous result because doing so can send duplicate confirmation email.

tools.name: Import Recipients
tools.description: Queue an asynchronous import that adds or updates a non-empty recipient batch in one MailUp list or group. MailUp permits only one account import at a time; use the returned import ID with MAIL_UP_GET_IMPORT_STATUS until it completes. New recipients receive a Subscribed subscription status in the destination list or the group's owning list by default; confirm_email=true instead leaves them Pending and generates confirmation emails for the confirmation-request queue. import_type='asOptout' makes every supplied recipient Optout except recipients already Pending, so it can unsubscribe existing recipients. clear_missing_or_empty_fields can erase stored data and group remove_from_prev_groups can remove memberships. Never retry an ambiguous result because these effects may already have occurred.

tools.name: List Audience Email Opt-Ins By List
tools.description: Return one page of subscribed and unsubscribed email recipients for a MailUp list with complete opt-in and opt-out details.

tools.name: List Audience Email Opt-Ins By Recipient
tools.description: Return one page of a MailUp recipient's email subscription status and opt-in/opt-out history across lists.

tools.name: List Audience SMS Opt-Ins By List
tools.description: Return one page of subscribed and unsubscribed SMS recipients for a MailUp list with complete opt-in and opt-out details.

tools.name: List Audience SMS Opt-Ins By Recipient
tools.description: Return one page of a MailUp recipient's SMS subscription status and opt-in/opt-out history across lists.

tools.name: List Content Sources
tools.description: Return one page of MailUp content-provider sources.

tools.name: List Country Codes
tools.description: Return MailUp's complete unpaged country-code reference for list sender settings. Availability follows console access and the call is subject to the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: List Dynamic Fields
tools.description: Return one page of recipient dynamic-field definitions and IDs. Supports provider filter/order expressions and an opaque cursor; access follows console permissions and standard REST traffic is limited to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Email Messages
tools.description: Return one page of email campaign messages in a MailUp list, including message IDs used by message editing, sending, and statistics tools.

tools.name: List Email Send History
tools.description: Return one page of completed send-history records for a specific MailUp email message.

tools.name: List Email Sendings
tools.description: Return one page of MailUp email sending tasks for one queue state: pending scheduling, immediate, or deferred.

tools.name: List Group Recipients
tools.description: Return one page of recipients currently associated with a MailUp group.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: Return one page of recipient groups in a MailUp list, including group IDs used by group-scoped tools.

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Return all full image paths from either the console-wide shared library or one MailUp list. The provider does not paginate these arrays; list access follows console permissions and calls count toward the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: List Imports
tools.description: Return one page of MailUp recipient imports with status codes and row counts. Supports provider filter/order expressions and an opaque cursor; standard REST traffic is limited to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: List Import Status Codes
tools.description: Return MailUp's complete reference table for interpreting import status_code values. This unpaged metadata call is subject to the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: List List Recipients
tools.description: Return one page of recipients in a MailUp list for one subscription state: subscribed, pending, or unsubscribed.

tools.name: List Lists
tools.description: Return one page of mailing lists available to the connected MailUp user, including the list IDs required by list-scoped tools.

tools.name: List List Scopes
tools.description: Return MailUp's complete unpaged list-purpose reference table for scope_code settings. These are provider list-purpose codes, not OAuth scopes; the call is subject to the 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: List Message Events
tools.description: Return one page of recipient-level delivery, view, click, bounce, or unsubscription statistics for a sent MailUp email message. View and click rows are recipient rollups with Count, not individual event timestamps. Delivery details are retained for at most 12 months. If a message ID was reused, results aggregate every campaign sent with that ID.

tools.name: List Message URL Click Details
tools.description: Return one page of clicked links for a MailUp message with each link's total and per-recipient click counts. Full click details are retained for the console data-retention period. Reusing one message across campaigns merges its statistics; clone messages when campaign statistics must stay separate.

tools.name: List Message URL Clicks
tools.description: Return one page of links with at least one click for a MailUp message, with the click total for each URL or MailUp special-link label. Full click details are retained for the console data-retention period. Reusing one message across campaigns merges its statistics; clone messages when campaign statistics must stay separate.

tools.name: List Personalization Endpoints
tools.description: Return one page of MailUp personalization endpoints. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Personalization Endpoints By List
tools.description: Retrieve all personalization endpoints associated with one MailUp list. This operation requires Personalization to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: List Recipient Activity
tools.description: Return one page of sent-email delivery, view, click, bounce, or unsubscription statistics for one MailUp recipient. View and click rows are message-level rollups with Count, not individual event timestamps. Delivery details are retained for at most 12 months; reused message IDs aggregate campaigns.

tools.name: List Recipient Bounce Details
tools.description: Return one page of messages that bounced for a MailUp recipient, including message subject, notes, and bounce classification when available. Statistics are limited by the account's configured data-retention period.

tools.name: List Recipient Click Details
tools.description: Return one page of messages in which a MailUp recipient clicked, including each message's total and per-URL click counts. URL values can be normal URLs or MailUp special-link labels. Full click details are retained for the console data-retention period.

tools.name: List Recipient Groups
tools.description: Return one page of groups to which a recipient belongs within one MailUp list.

tools.name: List Source Contents
tools.description: Return one page of content items from one MailUp content-provider source.

tools.name: List Time Zones
tools.description: Return MailUp's complete unpaged time-zone reference for list settings. Availability follows Console access and the call is subject to MailUp's 5-calls-per-second standard REST limit.

tools.name: Register Trusted Sender
tools.description: Register an email address as a trusted sender and begin MailUp's authorization process; registration does not itself guarantee authorization. This feature-gated operation requires Trusted Senders to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Reset SMTP+ Account
tools.description: Reset an existing SMTP+ user account and return a replacement password. The old password stops working; treat the returned password as a secret and store it securely without logging or exposing it. Never retry automatically after an ambiguous result. This feature-gated operation requires SMTP+ to be enabled by MailUp for the connected platform account.

tools.name: Schedule Deferred Email Dispatch
tools.description: Queue an existing MailUp email campaign for deferred dispatch at the supplied UTC date in exact yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ssZ format. Dispatch may consume email credits. Never retry automatically after a rejection or ambiguous result; check the sending state before deciding whether to call again. This action is email-only; use SCHEDULE_DEFERRED_SMS_DISPATCH for SMS.

tools.name: Schedule Deferred SMS Dispatch
tools.description: Explicitly schedule an existing MailUp SMS sending for a supplied future Date. The dispatch can consume SMS credits when it runs and repeating the request may change or duplicate scheduling; never retry an ambiguous result. Requires SMS entitlement and the 5 calls per second limit applies.

tools.name: Schedule Immediate Email Dispatch
tools.description: Irreversibly move an existing inactive MailUp email sending task into the immediate sending queue, where delivery can begin. Never automatically retry after an ambiguous timeout or transport failure; inspect the immediate and pending sending queues first. Use SCHEDULE_IMMEDIATE_SMS_DISPATCH for SMS.

tools.name: Schedule Immediate SMS Dispatch
tools.description: Explicitly queue an existing MailUp SMS sending for immediate dispatch. This requires SMS entitlement and credits, may incur charges, and can duplicate a dispatch if repeated; never retry an ambiguous result. Limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Send Email Message to Recipient
tools.description: Irreversibly enqueue, defer, or snapshot an existing MailUp email message for one recipient email address. An omitted or `now` datetime starts queued delivery; a UTC datetime creates an immutable schedule; `undefined` creates an inactive recipient snapshot. This can consume credits and produce duplicate email if repeated. Never retry after an ambiguous timeout, connection loss, or unknown outcome; inspect the sending queues first.

tools.name: Send Email Message to Group
tools.description: Irreversibly enqueue, defer, or snapshot an existing MailUp email message for recipients in one group. An omitted or `now` datetime starts queued delivery; a UTC datetime creates an immutable schedule; `undefined` creates an inactive recipient snapshot. This can consume credits and deliver duplicate email if repeated. Never automatically retry after an ambiguous timeout or transport failure; inspect the sending queues first.

tools.name: Send Email Message to List
tools.description: Irreversibly enqueue, defer, or snapshot an existing MailUp email message for recipients in one list, optionally including or excluding groups. An omitted or `now` datetime starts queued delivery; a UTC datetime creates an immutable schedule; `undefined` creates an inactive recipient snapshot. This can consume credits and deliver duplicate email if repeated; never automatically retry after an ambiguous timeout or transport failure; inspect the sending queues first.

tools.name: Send SMS Message To Recipient
tools.description: Irreversibly send an existing MailUp SMS message directly to one Prefix/Number. This requires SMS entitlement, a confirmed sender, and credits; it may incur a charge and duplicate delivery if repeated. Never retry an ambiguous result and limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Send SMS Message To Group
tools.description: Irreversibly send or schedule an existing SMS message to recipients in one MailUp group. MailUp uses the SMS sender configured on the group's list, regardless of the message's Sender field. This requires SMS entitlement and credits, may incur charges, and may duplicate delivery if repeated; never retry an ambiguous result. Limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Send SMS Message To List
tools.description: Irreversibly send or schedule an existing SMS message to recipients in one MailUp list. MailUp uses the SMS sender configured on the list, regardless of the message's Sender field. This requires SMS entitlement and credits, may incur charges, and may duplicate delivery if repeated; never retry an ambiguous result. Limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Stop Email Sending Task
tools.description: Stop an existing MailUp email sending task and prevent its remaining queued email deliveries. MailUp permits at most 1 combined stop or delete call per 30 seconds. A process-local guard coordinates both actions in this worker only; MailUp remains authoritative across workers and other clients. Never retry automatically after a rejection or ambiguous result.

tools.name: Subscribe Audience Recipient To Group
tools.description: Add an existing MailUp recipient to one group. With confirm_subscription=true, also subscribe the recipient to the group's owning list; with confirm_subscription=false, assign the recipient to the group without changing the list subscription.

tools.name: Subscribe Recipient To List
tools.description: Extend an already-subscribed email recipient's membership to one additional MailUp list. This cannot reactivate an email recipient who is unsubscribed.

tools.name: Subscribe SMS Recipient To Group
tools.description: Add an existing SMS recipient to one MailUp group. With confirm_subscription=true, also subscribe the recipient to the group's owning list; with confirm_subscription=false, assign the recipient to the group without changing the list subscription. The account must have SMS service entitlement; observe MailUp's limit of 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Subscribe SMS Recipient To List
tools.description: Subscribe an existing recipient to the SMS channel of one MailUp list. The account must have SMS entitlement; observe the 5 calls per second limit.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Audience Recipient From Group
tools.description: Remove one recipient from a MailUp group without unsubscribing that recipient from the parent list.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Audience Recipient From Lists
tools.description: Unsubscribe one recipient from every explicitly supplied MailUp list ID in one request. This high-impact bulk subscription change does not delete the recipient record and reports both successful and failed list IDs.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Recipient From List
tools.description: Unsubscribe an existing email recipient from one MailUp list and remove the recipient from every group owned by that list, without deleting the global recipient record or changing the SMS channel.

tools.name: Unsubscribe SMS Recipient From List
tools.description: Remove one recipient's SMS subscription from one MailUp list without deleting the recipient. Requires SMS entitlement; observe the 5 calls per second limit.

tools.name: Unsubscribe SMS Recipient From Lists
tools.description: Remove one recipient's SMS subscriptions from an explicit set of MailUp lists and report per-list results. Requires SMS entitlement; limit traffic to 5 calls per second.

tools.name: Update Audience Group
tools.description: Update explicitly supplied fields of a MailUp group; omitted body fields are not sent.

tools.name: Update Audience Recipient Detail
tools.description: Update explicitly supplied contact and dynamic-field details for a MailUp address-book recipient; omitted fields are not sent.

tools.name: Update Content Source
tools.description: Update supplied settings of one MailUp content-provider source.

tools.name: Update Email Message
tools.description: Update an existing MailUp email message's subject and content while preserving omitted settings; this changes the draft and does not send it.

tools.name: Update List

name: Malwarebytes MCP
description: Verify links, emails, phone numbers, and domains against Malwarebytes threat intelligence.

tools.name: Reputation-check email
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check if an email address is associated with phishing, scams, or malicious activity.

Checks the email domain against threat intelligence database. Returns one of:
- malicious: Confirmed phishing or malicious email domain
- suspicious: Potentially dangerous email domain
- safe: Verified legitimate email domain
- unknown: No threat intelligence available

Cross-tool workflow:
- If the email contains URLs, consider scanning them with reputation-check_link.
- If the email contains phone numbers, consider scanning them with reputation-check_phone.
- For unknown or suspicious verdicts, consider using reputation-whois to check domain
  registration details (age, registrar, abuse contact).

Do not use this for email validation, mailbox verification, or general email lookup services.

tools.name: Reputation-check link
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check if a link or URL is safe, suspicious, or malicious.

Provides reputation verdict based on threat intelligence database. Returns one of:
- malicious: Confirmed harmful link
- suspicious: Potentially dangerous link
- safe: Verified safe link
- unknown: No threat intelligence available

Cross-tool workflow:
- For unknown or suspicious verdicts, consider using reputation-whois to check domain
  registration details (age, registrar, abuse contact).
- If the URL redirects to a different domain, consider scanning the destination URL separately.
- If the URL came from an email or text message, consider checking the sender with
  reputation-check_email or reputation-check_phone.

Do not use this for general web searches, content fetching, or webpage analysis.

tools.name: Reputation-check phone
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check if a phone number is associated with scams or suspicious activity.

Provides reputation verdict and additional phone information. Returns one of:
- malicious: Confirmed scam or spam phone number
- suspicious: Potentially dangerous number
- safe: Verified legitimate number
- unknown: No threat intelligence available

Also provides optional details like carrier, location, and phone type when available.

Cross-tool workflow:
- If the caller provided links, consider scanning them with reputation-check_link.
- If the caller provided email addresses, consider scanning them with reputation-check_email.

Do not use this for phone number lookups, caller ID services, or general phone directory searches.

tools.name: Reputation-report
tools.description:
Use this when a user wants to report a suspicious link, email address, or phone number.

Submits the indicator to the threat intelligence system for analysis.
Only use when explicitly requested by the user.

Do not use this to automatically report every checked item.

tools.name: Reputation-scan all
tools.description:
Use this when you need to check multiple links, emails, or phone numbers at once.

Scans all indicators concurrently and returns a unified result. Each indicator needs:
- type: 'url', 'email', or 'phone'
- value: the URL, email address, or phone number (E.164 format for phones)

Returns a summary with counts per verdict and individual results for each indicator.
Prefer this over individual scan tools when 3 or more indicators are present.
Maximum 10 indicators per request.

Cross-tool workflow:
- For unknown URL or email verdicts, consider using reputation-whois on the associated
  domains for additional registration context and abuse contact information.

tools.name: Reputation-whois
tools.description:
Use this when you need to look up domain registration information to verify legitimacy or identify suspicious patterns.

Provides WHOIS/RDAP data including registrar, registration dates, name servers, and abuse contacts.
Particularly useful for identifying newly registered domains (common in phishing and scams).
Returns the registrar's abuse contact email when available, which can be used for filing
complaints about fraudulent domains.

Cross-tool workflow:
- Consider using reputation-check_link to check the domain's threat reputation alongside
  WHOIS registration data.

Do not use this for general domain availability checks or bulk domain searches.

name: Mapbox
description: Mapbox is a platform that provides mapping, navigation, and location data services for developers to integrate into their applications.

tools.name: Batch Geocode V6
tools.description: Tool to perform batch geocoding with up to 1000 queries in a single request. Use when you need to geocode multiple locations efficiently (forward, reverse, or structured). Supports mixing query types in the same batch.

tools.name: Forward Geocode V5
tools.description: Tool to search for places by name or address using Mapbox Geocoding v5 API (forward geocoding). Use when you need to convert place names or addresses to geographic coordinates using the v5 endpoint.

tools.name: Batch Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to perform batch forward or reverse geocoding for multiple locations. Use when you need consistent geocoding of up to 50 queries in one call.

tools.name: Forward Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to convert free-form or structured address into geographic coordinates and place features. Use when you need forward geocoding from text or address components.

tools.name: Permanent Forward Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to perform permanent forward geocoding. Use when you need enterprise-grade permanent geocoding after confirming account privileges.

tools.name: Permanent Reverse Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to perform permanent reverse geocoding. Use after obtaining coordinates to get cacheable place data. Example: lon=-73.989, lat=40.733

tools.name: Reverse Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to reverse geocode coordinates into place names. Use after obtaining coordinates.

tools.name: Get Access Token
tools.description: Tool to extract and validate Mapbox access token from connection metadata. Use when you need a valid token for downstream actions.

tools.name: Get Isochrone
tools.description: Tool to calculate areas reachable within a specified amount of time or distance from a location. Use when you need to visualize travel time or distance zones for routing analysis.

tools.name: Get Map Matching
tools.description: Tool to snap fuzzy GPS traces to roads on the road network. Use when you need to clean up inaccurate location traces for display or analysis.

tools.name: Get Optimization V1
tools.description: Tool to calculate optimal driving routes and trips that visit a set of waypoints. Use when you need to find the best order to visit multiple locations with optimized routing.

tools.name: Get Sprite
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a sprite image or its JSON document from a Mapbox style. Use when you need sprite assets for rendering map icons. Sprites are collections of small icons used in map styles. The JSON format returns metadata about icon positions and dimensions within the sprite sheet, while the PNG format returns the actual image. Sprite sheets optimize performance by combining multiple icons into a single image.

tools.name: Get Static Image
tools.description: Request a static map image from a Mapbox Studio style. Returns a PNG or JPEG image of the specified map area with customizable parameters including location, zoom level, camera angle, and optional overlays like markers or GeoJSON features. Use when you need to generate static map images for embedding in documents, emails, or web pages without interactive map functionality.

tools.name: Get Static Tiles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve raster tiles from a Mapbox Studio style. Use when you need map tiles for specific coordinates and zoom levels. Returns PNG or JPG raster tiles that can be assembled to create map visualizations. Tiles follow the XYZ tiling scheme where the world is divided into a grid at each zoom level. Supports retina/high-DPI displays via the @2x suffix.

tools.name: Get Token Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a Mapbox access token and validate its status. Use when you need to check token validity or retrieve token metadata.

tools.name: Get Vector Tiles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve vector tiles from Mapbox-hosted vector tilesets. Use when you need tile data for mapping applications at specific zoom levels and coordinates.

tools.name: Map Matching (POST)
tools.description: Tool to snap GPS coordinates to the road network using POST method for longer coordinate lists. Use when you have GPS traces to match to roads (2-100 coordinates).

tools.name: Query Tile Features
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data about specific features from vector tilesets based on a location. Use when you need to query tileset features at a geographic point, such as finding buildings, roads, or points of interest near coordinates.

tools.name: Request Style Embed HTML
tools.description: Retrieve embeddable HTML for a Mapbox style that can be embedded in an iframe. Returns a complete HTML document with Mapbox GL JS code that renders an interactive map with the specified style. Useful for quickly embedding Mapbox maps into web pages without custom JavaScript code.

tools.name: Retrieve Directions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve directions between waypoints. Use when you need navigation routes with optional turn-by-turn instructions after confirming origin and destination.

tools.name: Retrieve Font Glyph Ranges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve font glyph ranges as PBF tiles. Use when you have confirmed the font name, codepoint range, and valid token.

tools.name: Retrieve Marker
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a standalone marker image without any background map. Returns a PNG image file of the specified marker type. Use when you need to obtain marker icons for display or reference purposes.

tools.name: Retrieve Matrix
tools.description: Retrieve a travel time and distance matrix between multiple locations. Use this tool when you need to calculate travel times and/or distances between many origin-destination pairs efficiently (e.g., comparing routes from multiple starting points to multiple destinations, finding the nearest location from a set, or optimizing multi-stop routing). Returns matrices showing durations (in seconds) and distances (in meters) between all coordinate pairs.

tools.name: Retrieve Searchbox Place Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full details for a specific place by its Mapbox ID. Use when you have a mapbox_id from a search suggestion and need complete place information.

tools.name: Retrieve Style
tools.description: Retrieves the complete Mapbox style specification as JSON, including all layers, sources, sprites, and configuration. A Mapbox style defines how a map is rendered, including data sources, layer styling, fonts, and sprites. This action returns the full style specification conforming to the Mapbox Style Specification, which can be used with Mapbox GL JS, mobile SDKs, or for analyzing map configurations. Use this action when you need to: - Inspect or analyze a map style's configuration - Retrieve style definitions for programmatic rendering - Examine layers, sources, and styling rules - Get complete style specifications for custom map implementations

tools.name: Retrieve Style WMTS
tools.description: Retrieve a WMTS (Web Map Tile Service) capabilities document for a Mapbox style. This action returns an OGC-compliant WMTS XML document that describes how to access map tiles for the specified style. The document includes tile matrix sets, supported coordinate systems (EPSG:3857), and tile URL templates. Use this when integrating Mapbox styles with desktop GIS applications (ArcGIS, QGIS, CARTO, Tableau) or any WMTS-compliant mapping client. The WMTS endpoint works with both Mapbox's official styles (e.g., streets-v12, satellite-v9) and custom styles created in Mapbox Studio.

tools.name: Retrieve Tileset Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for a Mapbox tileset. Use when you need TileJSON details including bounds, zooms, and layer info.

tools.name: Reverse Geocoding V6
tools.description: Tool to convert geographic coordinates to place names using Geocoding v6 API. Use when you need to perform reverse geocoding from latitude/longitude coordinates.

tools.name: Search Box Reverse Geocoding
tools.description: Tool to convert coordinates to places using the Search Box API (reverse geocoding). Use when you need to find place names, addresses, or points of interest for given coordinates.

tools.name: Search Box Forward
tools.description: Tool to search for places by name or address using the Search Box API. Use when you need to find locations, addresses, or points of interest based on a text query.

tools.name: Search by Category
tools.description: Tool to search for places by category (e.g., restaurants, hotels, coffee shops). Use when you need to find POIs in a specific category, optionally filtered by location, bounding box, or proximity.

tools.name: Search Box Suggest
tools.description: Tool to get autocomplete suggestions for a partial search query. Use when you need address or place suggestions as users type, before retrieving full details.

required.description: Your Mapbox access token used to authenticate API requests.

tools.description: Get detailed status, progress, cost, errors, source configuration, and result-layer metadata for one current v2 processing. Poll no more often than every 30-60 seconds while it is running.

tools.name: Get Storage Overview
tools.description: Return custom-imagery storage limits and usage together with the account's mosaics, so an agent can select existing uploaded imagery without separate discovery calls.

tools.name: List Processings
tools.description: List current v2 processings. Omit project_id for the connected account's personal list, or provide project_id to include processings in a specific visible personal, shared, or team project.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the connected account, including personal and shared or team projects and the IDs needed to scope processing operations.

tools.name: Search Imagery Catalog
tools.description: Search external imagery providers linked to the connected account for scenes or mosaics intersecting a GeoJSON AOI. Available inventory depends on account and provider entitlements; route access does not imply commercial imagery access.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate and save the encoded API token from your Mapflow account API settings at https://app.mapflow.ai/account/api. Enter the generated value exactly as shown; Mapflow already encodes the email and API-token credential, so do not decode it or add the "Basic" prefix.

name: Mapulus
description: Mapulus is a platform that enables users to create, manage, and analyze interactive maps, integrating with various applications to automate tasks and leverage location insights.

tools.name: Find Location by External ID
tools.description: Find locations by their external identifier. Returns a list of locations that match the provided external_id. External IDs are unique identifiers used for integrating Mapulus with external systems (CRM, databases, etc.). Returns an empty list if no matching locations are found.

tools.name: Get Map Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a map. Use when you have a map_id and need full map metadata.

tools.name: List Maps
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all maps accessible to the authenticated user. Supports filtering by name/tag and sorting by various fields. Returns map metadata including IDs, titles, and timestamps. Use this to discover available maps before fetching detailed information or locations.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated from your Mapulus account, used for authenticating API requests.

name: MarcoPolo MCP
description: MarcoPolo MCP lets agents securely query, correlate, analyze, and act on authorized data across databases, warehouses, cloud storage, and SaaS applications.

tools.name: Connection setup
tools.description:
Create a browser setup URL for a credentialed connection.

Use a canonical `type` when known; otherwise pass `intent_text`.
For hosted demo data with no credentials, use `install_demo_connection`.

tools.name: Connections list
tools.description:
List visible Marcopolo connections ready in the execution workspace.

Returned names are valid `connection_name` values for `data_query`.
Capabilities and workspace paths describe supported workspace commands.

tools.name: Data query
tools.description:
Run a bounded governed query against a visible connection.

Use this tool in generated code that re-queries live data at view or
load time: Remote Artifacts, external web apps, scheduled scripts, and
any other programmatic interface that fetches fresh data on each run.
Do NOT use it for agent-side analytics or one-off snapshot
visualizations — use the `workspace_shell` tool with the connection
query CLI instead.

Pass the full workspace-relative `query_file` path including the
connection prefix, e.g. `connections/<name>/queries/<file>`. Paths
resolve from `/workspace`, not from any current directory. Author new
query files through `workspace_shell` before calling this tool so query
text is durable and reusable.

Returns `rows` as a parsed list of record dicts and `row_count` as the
total — no JSON parsing needed. Results are capped by `max_rows`
(1–5000).

tools.name: Install demo connection
tools.description:
Install hosted demo data with no user credentials.

Pass a demo id or natural-language request. Use `connection_setup` for
real user-owned connections.

tools.name: Workspace shell
tools.description:
Run a shell command in the persistent /workspace runtime.

Use for all agent-side work: query authoring, analytics, DuckDB joins,
workspace files, scripts, git, diagnostics, and cron. The `connection`
and `cron` CLIs exist only inside this runtime and must be invoked
through this tool.

tools.name: Get Dividends

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get End-of-Day Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve end-of-day (EOD) stock data for one or multiple ticker symbols. Returns OHLCV data (open, high, low, close, volume) along with adjusted prices, dividends, and split factors. Use when you need historical daily stock prices or market data analysis.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Exchange Info

tools.name: Get Exchange Intraday Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve intraday stock data for symbols on a specific stock exchange (by MIC) at a chosen interval. Use when you need intraday prices scoped to a particular exchange.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Exchange Intraday Data for Date

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Exchange Intraday Latest

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Intraday Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve intraday (real-time and historical) stock data for one or multiple ticker symbols at a chosen interval (1min/5min/10min/15min/30min/1hour). Use when you need live prices or to build an intraday (e.g. 1D) chart.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Intraday Data for Date
tools.description: Tool to retrieve intraday stock data for one or multiple ticker symbols on a specific date. Use when you need the intraday series for a particular trading day.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Stock Splits

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Real-Time Stock Price
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the real-time (last known) stock price for a ticker symbol. Use when you need an up-to-the-minute price quote, for example to display a live price in a stock widget.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Ticker EOD Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve end-of-day stock price data for a specific ticker symbol. Use when you need historical daily price information including open, high, low, close, volume, and adjusted values.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Ticker EOD Latest

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Ticker Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about stock tickers including exchange, sector, and industry data. Use when you need comprehensive company information for a ticker symbol.

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

tools.name: Get Ticker Intraday Data

price.description: $0.009 per 10 stock requests. Each stock counts as one request.

description: Markup AI provides content agents, brand terminology, personas, brand voice profiles, and style configuration for evaluating and improving content.

tools.name: Get Agent
tools.description: Get one agent's metadata and complete runtime input and output JSON Schemas before executing it.

tools.name: Get Analysis Profile
tools.description: Get one persona, brand voice profile, style target, or style guide by ID, including detailed configuration needed to understand its effect on analysis. Style details can contain a large hierarchy of goals, groups, and guidelines.

tools.name: Get Workflow
tools.description: Get the current status and result of an asynchronous agent workflow by ID.

tools.name: List Agent Categories
tools.description: Return all agent categories available to the connected organization for discovery and agent-list filtering.

tools.name: List Agents
tools.description: Discover Markup AI agents available to the connected organization, optionally filtered by category. Returns compact summaries for choosing an agent; use GET_AGENT for its full runtime schemas.

tools.name: List Analysis Profiles
tools.description: List selectable persona, brand voice, style guide, style target, or content profile resources used to configure agent runs.

tools.name: List Terminology Resources
tools.description: List terminology term sets or domains with filters and cursor-controlled pagination.

tools.name: List Workflows
tools.description: List one cursor-controlled page of agent execution workflows, optionally filtering that page by status, stable agent name, or creation time.

tools.name: Run Agent
tools.description: Run one selected Markup AI agent against document text, synchronously or asynchronously. Discover the agent and inspect its schema first; execution may consume organization quota. The persona agent requires persona_id at runtime even when its advertised input schema marks only text as required.

tools.name: Search Terminology
tools.description: Find organization terminology rules relevant to supplied text, optionally limited to selected domains.

name: Mathpix
description: Mathpix extracts text, mathematics, tables, and other structured content from images and documents and converts results into editable formats.

tools.name: Convert Mathpix Markdown
tools.description: Submit Mathpix Markdown, wait for one requested format to finish, then return the conversion ID and downloadable output file. The remote conversion remains if waiting fails or times out.

tools.name: Create App Token
tools.description: Mint a short-lived client OCR credential, optionally with a live ink strokes session. Requires explicit acknowledgement because the response exposes the new secret exactly once to the caller.

tools.name: Delete Conversion
tools.description: Permanently delete one Mathpix Markdown conversion's hosted output data after explicit confirmation. The response preserves the status immediately before deletion; Mathpix may continue to report that status after the output data has been deleted.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Permanently delete one Mathpix document source and its hosted outputs after explicit confirmation. The response reports the status immediately before deletion, not a deleted status marker, and cached downloads may remain reachable for up to 10 minutes.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete one terminal Files API file and its Mathpix-hosted results. This does not remove customer-owned destination objects, reverse billing, or delete a file that is still processing.

tools.name: Finalize File Job
tools.description: Permanently close one Files API job to new file additions and arm its completion webhook. Already accepted files may continue processing. Requires explicit confirmation; repeating the same finalization is provider-idempotent.

tools.name: Get App Token
tools.description: Get expiry and ownership metadata for a specific short-lived Mathpix app token. The secret token is used only in the request path and is omitted from the returned object and provider-error diagnostics.

tools.name: Get Conversion Result
tools.description: Wait for an existing Mathpix Markdown conversion and requested format to finish, then return its status and downloadable output file without creating a conversion.

tools.name: Get Document Result
tools.description: Wait for an existing Mathpix document job and requested format to finish, then return its status and downloadable output file without creating a new job.

tools.name: Get File Job
tools.description: Get aggregate status, file and page counters, and timestamps for one Files API job. A completed job can still contain errored files; inspect files_errored and has_file_errors.

tools.name: Get File Result
tools.description: Wait for an existing Files API file and selected format to finish, then return its status and downloadable output without creating a file.

tools.name: Get Job File by Custom ID
tools.description: Get the complete Files API processing status for one job member using the exact caller-defined custom ID assigned at submission.

tools.name: Get OCR Usage
tools.description: Return one page of aggregated Mathpix OCR usage for a date range, optionally grouped by usage type, request configuration, or application.

tools.name: Get Storage Onboarding Identities
tools.description: Get the Mathpix AWS, Azure, and GCP identities needed to grant cloud-storage access. Requires explicit acknowledgement because the first call may lazily create the account's immutable external ID.

tools.name: List Conversions
tools.description: List one page of retained Mathpix Markdown conversion records, optionally filtered by date, and return IDs usable by conversion result or deletion tools.

tools.name: List Data Sources
tools.description: List cloud-storage data sources registered with Mathpix, returning only allowlisted non-secret metadata.

tools.name: List Documents
tools.description: List retained document OCR jobs for the connected account, optionally filtered by date or document ID, and return one page.

tools.name: List File Job Files
tools.description: List one cursor-paginated page of files in a Mathpix Files API job, optionally filtered by terminal status.

tools.name: List File Jobs
tools.description: List one cursor-paginated page of Files API jobs newest first, optionally bounded by inclusive UTC dates.

tools.name: OCR Document
tools.description: Submit a PDF, office document, or ebook URL, wait for OCR and the requested conversion to finish, then return its Mathpix job ID and downloadable output file. Mathpix retains the remote job after success; call Delete Document when the hosted source and outputs are no longer needed.

tools.name: OCR Image
tools.description: Extract text, math, tables, diagrams, or chemistry from one image URL or base64 data URI and return the requested OCR representations. Mathpix may retain the submitted image and result, and provides no image deletion endpoint.

tools.name: Process Equation (Deprecated)
tools.description: Compatibility-only access to Mathpix's deprecated equation-image OCR endpoint. Use MATHPIX_OCR_IMAGE for all new image OCR work. This paid operation may retain the submitted image and result in Mathpix history.

tools.name: Process File URI
tools.description: Submit one public or registered-cloud document URI to the paid Files API, wait for OCR and one requested output, and return the retained file ID and downloadable result. Supply an idempotency key for safely retryable standalone submissions. External storage writes or callback delivery require explicit authorization.

tools.name: Process Image Batch
tools.description: Submit a paid asynchronous batch of 1-100 named public image URLs, wait until every key has a semantically successful OCR result, and return the retained batch ID and results. Explicit confirmation is required because Mathpix provides no batch deletion route and may deliver an external callback.

tools.name: Recognize Strokes
tools.description: Recognize handwritten math or text from aligned x/y digital-ink stroke arrays and return OCR representations. This paid call may retain the result.

tools.name: Revoke App Token
tools.description: Irreversibly revoke one short-lived app token immediately. Existing clients using the credential will stop authenticating. Requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Search OCR Results
tools.description: Search retained image and stroke OCR history by date, identifiers, content, tags, or detected content and return one page of results.

tools.name: Submit File Job
tools.description: Submit 1 to 200,000 remote documents as one paid asynchronous Mathpix Files job. This creates retained processing state and may read or write external storage or deliver callbacks. Acceptance defers per-file validation, so use job status and member listing tools to determine actual outcomes.

tools.name: Upload and Process File
tools.description: Upload one local document to the paid Mathpix Files API, wait until OCR and one requested output are ready, then return the retained Mathpix file ID and a downloadable result. The operation can consume page quota and does not delete the remote file; use Delete File when it is no longer needed. External storage writes or callback delivery require explicit authorization.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Mathpix server-side API key. Sign in to the Mathpix Console at https://console.mathpix.com/, open the OCR API organization's API keys page, and copy the app_key value. Keep this credential secret.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your Mathpix application ID. Sign in to the Mathpix Console at https://console.mathpix.com/, open the OCR API organization's API keys page, and copy the app_id value.

tools.name: Get Model Event Webhook Callbacks

tools.name: List Room Classifications

tools.name: Update Model State

name: Maxio
description: Subscription billing and revenue management platform (formerly Chargify)

tools.name: Allocate Component
tools.description: Creates an allocation for a component on a subscription. Use when you need to allocate quantities of a metered, quantity-based, or on/off component to a subscription. This action is commonly used to: - Add a new component to a subscription (initial allocation) - Upgrade or downgrade the quantity of an existing component - Reactivate a previously cancelled component - Record usage for metered components Note: For metered components, allocating a quantity records usage. For on/off components, use quantity=1 to turn it on or quantity=0 to turn it off.

tools.name: Apply Coupons to Subscription
tools.description: Applies one or more coupons to a subscription. Use when you need to apply promotional discounts or coupon codes to an existing subscription. The coupon must be valid and not expired for the operation to succeed.

tools.name: Archive Component
tools.description: Archives a component to prevent new allocations. Use this action when you need to stop allowing new component allocations while keeping existing allocations active. This action is irreversible — once archived, the component cannot be used for new subscriptions, but existing subscriptions with the component will continue to work.

tools.name: Archive Component Price Point
tools.description: Archives a component price point, making it inactive. Use when you need to deactivate a price point that is no longer needed but should not be permanently deleted. Archived price points are no longer available for new subscriptions but remain accessible for historical reference. This action is irreversible — once archived, a price point cannot be directly unarchived to its original state (use the unarchive action instead).

tools.name: Archive Coupon
tools.description: Archives a coupon to prevent new uses. Use this action when you need to deactivate a coupon while preserving its redemption history. This action is irreversible — once archived, the coupon cannot be used for new subscriptions, but existing redemptions remain valid.

tools.name: Archive Offer
tools.description: Archives an offer to prevent new subscriptions from using it. Use this action when you need to deactivate an offer while preserving existing subscriptions. This action is irreversible — once archived, the offer cannot be used for new subscriptions, but existing subscriptions using this offer will continue to function normally.

tools.name: Archive Product
tools.description: Archives a product to prevent new subscriptions from being created. Use this action when you need to stop accepting new subscriptions for a product while keeping existing subscriptions active. This action is irreversible - once archived, the product cannot be unarchived.

tools.name: Archive product price point
tools.description: Archives a product price point by its ID. Use when you need to deactivate and archive a price point that is no longer needed. Archived price points cannot be used for new subscriptions but existing subscriptions will continue to use them. This action is irreversible once completed.

tools.name: Cancel Delayed Cancellation
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled cancellation on a subscription. Use when a user wants to undo a previously scheduled cancellation before it takes effect. This action is reversible only before the scheduled cancellation time passes.

tools.name: Clone Component Price Point
tools.description: Clones an existing component price point to create a new one. Use this action when you need to duplicate a price point with all its pricing configuration, optionally providing a new name for the cloned version. The cloned price point will inherit all pricing settings from the source price point including the pricing scheme, prices, and currency configuration.

tools.name: Bulk Create Product Price Points
tools.description: Creates multiple product price points in a single API call. Use when you need to set up several pricing options for a product at once, such as creating tiered pricing plans (e.g., Basic, Standard, Premium) with different prices, intervals, and trial periods. This is more efficient than creating price points individually. The price_points array accepts price point objects with fields like name, price_in_cents, interval_unit, interval_length, trial configuration, and initial fees.

tools.name: Create Component
tools.description: Creates a new component within a product family in Chargify. Use when you need to add billing components like metered usage, quantity-based pricing, on/off toggles, prepaid usage, or event-based components to a product family. Supports five component types: metered_components (usage-based with unit pricing), quantity_based_components (per-unit pricing), on_off_components (binary add-ons), prepaid_usage_components (credit-based), and event_based_components (event-triggered billing).

tools.name: Create Component Price Point
tools.description: Creates a price point for a component in Maxio Advanced Billing. Use this action when you need to define a new pricing configuration (such as per-unit, tiered, volume, or stair-step pricing) for a component. This action is irreversible — once created, a price point cannot be deleted via API; it can only be archived.

tools.name: Create Coupon Subcodes
tools.description: Creates multiple subcodes for an existing coupon in Maxio Advanced Billing. Use when you need to add additional coupon codes for tracking, segmentation, or allowing multiple uses of a coupon. Subcodes are tied to the parent coupon and inherit the coupon's discount rules. Note: Subcodes must be unique across the entire site - they cannot duplicate codes used by other coupons.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in Maxio/Chargify with the required fields: first_name, last_name, and email. Use this action when you need to add a new customer to your billing system. Optional fields like organization, reference, phone, and address can be included to provide additional customer information.

tools.name: Create Webhook Endpoint
tools.description: Creates a new webhook endpoint in Maxio Advanced Billing. Use when you need to register a new webhook endpoint to receive event notifications.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Creates a one-time invoice for a subscription with custom line items. Use when you need to bill a customer for a one-time charge or custom amount that is not part of their regular subscription. The invoice can include multiple line items with titles, descriptions, quantities, and prices.

tools.name: Create Metadata
tools.description: Creates metadata values for a resource in Maxio/Chargify Advanced Billing. Use this action when you need to attach custom key-value metadata to customers, subscriptions, or sites to store additional information. Note: If metadata with the same name already exists for the resource, this action will update the existing value.

tools.name: Create Metafields
tools.description: Creates metafield definitions for a resource type. Use this action when you need to define custom fields that can be attached to resources like customers, subscriptions, or products. After creating a metafield definition, you can set values for that field on individual resources. The resource_type determines which entity type the metafield applies to. Valid values are: customers, subscriptions, products, or product_families. Use this action when setting up custom data structures for your billing data.

tools.name: Create or Update Coupon Currency Prices
tools.description: Tool to create or update currency prices for a coupon in Maxio. Use when you need to set or modify the pricing of a coupon across different currencies. This action is idempotent - calling it will replace all existing currency prices for the coupon with the new values provided.

tools.name: Create Payment Profile
tools.description: Creates a new payment profile for a customer in Maxio (Chargify). Use when you need to add a new credit card or payment method to a customer's account. The payment profile stores card details securely and returns a vault token for future use.

tools.name: Create Prepaid Usage Component
tools.description: Creates a prepaid usage component for pre-purchased units. Use when you need to create a component that allows customers to prepay for usage-based charges such as SMS credits, API calls, or storage units. The component supports various pricing schemes (per_unit, volume, tiered, stairstep) and optional overage pricing for charges when usage exceeds prepaid amounts. Note: This action creates the component within a product family. Ensure the product_family_id is valid and corresponds to an existing product family in your Chargify/Maxio account.

tools.name: Create Prepayment
tools.description: Creates a prepayment for a subscription. Prepayments allow customers to add funds to their account in advance, which are then applied to future invoices. Use this action when a customer wants to prepay for services, make an advance payment, or add funds to their account balance.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Tool to create a new product within a product family in Maxio. Use when you need to add a new subscription product to an existing product family for billing purposes. This action is useful for setting up subscription billing products with various pricing configurations including trial periods, initial charges, and billing intervals.

tools.name: Create Product Family
tools.description: Creates a new product family in Maxio/Chargify. Product families are top-level containers used to organize products and related components. Use this action when you need to create a new product category or family grouping to organize your subscription products.
