name: Mermaid Chart MCP
description: Validates Mermaid syntax, renders diagrams as high-quality SVG, and displays them in an interactive UI for preview, zoom, and real-time iteration.

tools.name: Validate and render mermaid diagram
tools.description:
Use this tool to output a Mermaid diagram:
- The tool will validate the diagram syntax and render it to a UI widget.
- The widget will contain the diagram code, a "Copy Code" button, and a rendered diagram.
- If the diagram is invalid, the widget will give user a link to repair the diagram in Mermaid.

name: Meshy
description: Meshy provides generative 3D, image, motion, animation, model-processing, and Creative Lab APIs.

tools.name: Cancel Creative Lab Task
tools.description: Cancel a Creative Lab task only while it is PENDING or IN_PROGRESS. Terminal task history is retained. Canceling a PENDING task refunds its credits; canceling an IN_PROGRESS task does not refund credits.

tools.name: Create Animation Task
tools.description: Start a 3-credit task that applies either a selected library animation or a succeeded Text to Motion clip to a completed rigging task and return the animation task ID.

tools.name: Create Auto Split Task
tools.description: Split a succeeded untextured Meshy 6 or Meshy 7 model into separately printable parts and return the task ID. An accepted task costs 10 credits; failed tasks are refunded, as is a task deleted while still pending.

tools.name: Create Collapsible Fidget Task
tools.description: Start an entitled 6-credit task that generates a collapsible fidget directly from an image and return the task ID.

tools.name: Create Convert Task
tools.description: Start a 1-credit task that converts a model into one or more requested formats; returns the task ID.

tools.name: Create Creative Lab Build
tools.description: Start a 3D build from a succeeded matching Creative Lab prototype. Lamp builds cost 6 credits, keycap builds cost 50, and all other builds cost 30. The call returns a build task ID.

tools.name: Create Creative Lab Prototype
tools.description: Start an entitled image-to-prototype task for a fixed Creative Lab product. Lamp prototypes cost 30 credits, keycap prototypes cost 12, and all other prototypes cost 6. The task ID can be passed to the matching build operation.

tools.name: Create Image to 3D Task
tools.description: Start a 3D generation task from one to four views of one object or a prior task's input images. One image uses single-image generation and two to four use multi-image generation. Meshy-6/7 cost 20 credits without texture, 30 with texture, or 35 with 8K texture; single-image Meshy T2 costs 5, 15, or 20 respectively; other models cost 5 without or 15 with texture. Ultra on Meshy-7 adds 5 credits. Returns task_id and the exact task_type discriminator for GET_TASK, LIST_TASKS, or DELETE_TASK.

tools.name: Create Image to Image Task
tools.description: Start a credit-consuming task that edits or restyles one to five reference images from a text instruction. The task costs 3 to 12 credits depending on the model and returns a task ID for status checks.

tools.name: Create Multi-Color Print Task
tools.description: Start a 10-credit task that converts a GLB or FBX model from a prior Meshy task or direct URL into a limited-color 3MF for 3D printing, and return the task ID. When both sources are provided, input_task_id takes precedence.

tools.name: Create Print Analysis Task
tools.description: Start a free task that analyzes a GLB, GLTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL model from a prior Meshy task or direct URL for printability defects and return the task ID. When both sources are provided, input_task_id takes precedence.

tools.name: Create Print Repair Task
tools.description: Start a 10-credit task that repairs a GLB, GLTF, OBJ, FBX, or STL model from a prior Meshy task or direct URL for 3D printing and return the task ID. When both sources are provided, input_task_id takes precedence. The repaired asset retains the input format.

tools.name: Create Remesh Task
tools.description: Start a 5-credit task that remeshes a model to the requested topology and polygon count, optionally resizes it, and exports the remeshed result in the requested formats. Use CREATE_CONVERT_TASK for format conversion without remeshing. Returns the remesh task ID.

tools.name: Create Resize Task
tools.description: Start a 1-credit task that scales a model by height, longest side, or automatic sizing and return the task ID.

tools.name: Create Retexture Task
tools.description: Start a credit-consuming task that applies one text, image, or multiview style source to an existing 3D model. The task costs 10 credits at 2k or 4k resolution and 15 credits at 8k, and returns a task ID for status checks.

tools.name: Create Rigging Task
tools.description: Start a 5-credit task that rigs a GLB character with a biped or quadruped skeleton and return the task ID. Models above 300,000 faces must be remeshed first.

tools.name: Create Text to 3D Task
tools.description: Start a new Text to 3D preview or fused geometry-and-texture task and return its task ID. Preview costs 20 credits for Meshy 6/7, 5 credits for Meshy T2 or other models, and Ultra adds 5 credits; fused generation costs 30 credits for Meshy 6/7 or 15 for Meshy T2 and other models. Use REFINE_TEXT_TO_3D_TASK to texture a succeeded preview.

tools.name: Create Text to Image Task
tools.description: Start a credit-consuming 2D image generation task from a text prompt. The task costs 3 to 9 credits depending on the model and returns a task ID for status checks.

tools.name: Create Text to Motion Task
tools.description: Start an entitled motion-generation task from a text prompt and return its task ID. Prime mode costs 10 credits and the completed task produces FBX; swift mode costs 3 credits and the completed task produces BVH.

tools.name: Create UV Unwrap Task
tools.description: Start a 5-credit task that generates UV coordinates for a GLB model and return the task ID. High-poly models may need to be remeshed first.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Permanently delete a GA or Text-to-Motion task and its retained outputs. Creative Lab tasks cannot be deleted with this action; use CANCEL_CREATIVE_LAB_TASK for an active Creative Lab task.

tools.name: Get Credit Balance
tools.description: Return the connected Meshy account's available credit balance before starting paid generation tasks.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Retrieve current status, errors, and available outputs for one task from a selected Meshy task family. This read does not consume credits.

tools.name: List Animation Library
tools.description: Search or filter Meshy's unpaginated animation catalog and return action IDs for use when creating animation tasks.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Return one page of tasks for one selected Meshy task family, with an opaque cursor for safe continuation. This read does not consume credits.

tools.name: List Usage Records
tools.description: Return one page of terminal API-task usage and consumed credits for the connected Meshy team. This endpoint is available only to Studio and Enterprise team API keys. Pass next_cursor alone to continue the same filtered export; split exports into windows of at most one year.

tools.name: Refine Text to 3D Task
tools.description: Apply texture to a succeeded Text to 3D preview and return the new refine task ID. Refinement costs 10 credits at 2k or 4k texture resolution and 15 credits at 8k.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create an API key at https://www.meshy.ai/settings/api by selecting Create API Key and naming it. Copy the msy_ value when it is shown because Meshy does not display it again. API access requires a paid Meshy plan; some endpoints also require additional account entitlements. Enter only the key, without the Bearer prefix.

name: Metabase
description: Metabase is an open-source business intelligence tool that lets you ask questions about your data and visualize answers as charts, graphs, and dashboards.

tools.name: Create Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to create a new bookmark for a Metabase item (card, dashboard, collection, or dataset). Use when the user wants to bookmark a specific item for quick access.

tools.name: Run Card Pivot Query
tools.description: Tool to run a pivot table query on a Metabase card (question). Use when you need to execute the query associated with a specific card and get results formatted for pivot table visualization. The response includes data rows, column metadata, query status, and execution timing.

tools.name: Run Card Query
tools.description: Tool to run the query associated with a Card and return its results. Use when you need to execute a card's query with optional parameters and cache control.

tools.name: Copy Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Metabase dashboard. Use when you need to duplicate a dashboard with optional customization of name, description, and collection placement. Supports both shallow copy (references same cards) and deep copy (duplicates all cards).

tools.name: Run Dashboard Pivot DashCard Query
tools.description: Tool to run a pivot table query for a specific DashCard. Use when you need to execute a pivot table query on a dashboard card with optional parameter filters.

tools.name: Save Dashboard to Collection
tools.description: Tool to save a denormalized dashboard description into a collection. Use when you need to create a new dashboard directly in a specific collection with full configuration including cards, tabs, and parameters.

tools.name: Discard Database Field Values
tools.description: Tool to discard all saved field values for a specific database. Use when you need to clear cached field value data for all fields in a database. Requires superuser privileges.

tools.name: Dismiss Database Sync Spinner
tools.description: Tool to manually set the initial sync status of a Database and corresponding tables to complete. Use when you need to dismiss the synchronization spinner for a database after initial setup.

tools.name: Trigger Database Field Values Rescan
tools.description: Tool to trigger a manual scan of field values for a Database. Use when you need to refresh field values for filter dropdowns after data changes. Requires superuser permissions.

tools.name: Trigger Database Schema Sync
tools.description: Tool to trigger a manual update of the schema metadata for a Database. Use when you need to refresh the database schema metadata in Metabase after structural changes.

tools.name: Search Dataset Parameter Values
tools.description: Tool to search for parameter values in datasets when editing cards or dashboards. Use when you need to provide autocomplete functionality for parameters. Expects a query string and returns matching values.

tools.name: Create Field Dimension
tools.description: Tool to set the dimension for a field at the specified ID in Metabase. Use when you need to configure field remapping or display values for better data presentation.

tools.name: Discard Field Values
tools.description: Tool to discard the FieldValues belonging to a Metabase field. Use when you need to clear cached field values. Only applies to fields that have FieldValues. If the Field's Database is set up to automatically sync FieldValues, they will be recreated during the next sync.

tools.name: Update Field Values
tools.description: Tool to update field values and human-readable values for a Field whose semantic type is category/city/state/country or whose base type is type/Boolean. Use when you need to set or update the distinct values for a field along with optional human-readable remappings.

tools.name: Unpersist Card
tools.description: Tool to unpersist a Metabase card/model. Deletes the persisted table backing the model and all queries after this will use the card's query rather than the saved version. Use when you need to remove persistence from a model.

tools.name: Disable Database Model Persistence
tools.description: Tool to disable model persistence for a Metabase database. Use when you need to turn off caching of model results. Returns success whether persistence was already disabled or not (idempotent operation).

tools.name: Discard Table Field Values
tools.description: Tool to discard the FieldValues belonging to the Fields in a Metabase Table. Use when you need to clear cached field values for all fields in a table. Only applies to fields that have FieldValues. If this Table's Database is set up to automatically sync FieldValues, they will be recreated during the next sync.

tools.name: Rescan Table Field Values
tools.description: Tool to manually trigger an update for FieldValues for Fields belonging to a specific Table. Use when you need to refresh field value caches after table data changes. Only applies to Fields that are eligible for FieldValues.

tools.name: Sync Table Schema
tools.description: Tool to trigger a manual update of the schema metadata for a specific Table. Use when you need to refresh table schema information after database changes. This synchronizes columns, data types, and other metadata from the underlying database.

tools.name: Delete Action
tools.description: Tool to delete a Metabase action by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove an action from the system.

tools.name: Delete API Cache
tools.description: Tool to delete/clear cached data in Metabase for specific entities. Use when you need to invalidate cache for a database, dashboard, question, or clear all cache (root).

tools.name: Delete Timeline
tools.description: Tool to delete a timeline by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a timeline. Returns success status on completion.

tools.name: Delete Bookmark
tools.description: Tool to delete a bookmark by model and ID. Use when you need to remove a bookmark assigned to the user making the request. The operation returns HTTP 204 No Content on successful deletion.

tools.name: Delete Card
tools.description: Tool to hard delete a Metabase card. Use when you need to permanently remove a card from the system. For soft deletion, use PUT /api/card/:id instead.

tools.name: Delete Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to hard delete a Metabase dashboard by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a dashboard. This will also remove any questions/models/segments/metrics that use this database. For soft delete, use the update dashboard action instead.

tools.name: Delete User Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to delete all Alert and DashboardSubscription subscriptions for a User. Use when you need to remove all subscriptions for a specific user and archive alerts/dashboards they created. This is an enterprise feature requiring admin privileges or current user access.

tools.name: Delete Field Dimension
tools.description: Tool to remove the dimension associated with a field at the specified ID. Use when you need to disassociate a dimension from a field in Metabase.

tools.name: Delete Glossary Entry
tools.description: Tool to delete a glossary entry from Metabase. Use when you need to permanently remove a glossary entry by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Model Index
tools.description: Tool to delete a ModelIndex by ID from Metabase. Use when you need to remove a model index from the system.

tools.name: Delete Timeline Event
tools.description: Tool to delete a Metabase timeline event. Use when you need to permanently remove a timeline event from the system.

tools.name: Delete User Key-Value Pair
tools.description: Tool to delete a user key-value pair by namespace and key. Use when you need to remove a specific key-value entry from a user's namespace.

tools.name: Get Action
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Metabase action by ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific action including its configuration, parameters, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Action Execute Parameters
tools.description: Tool to fetch values for filling in action execution parameters. Use when you need to get parameter values for executing an action by providing PK parameters and values to select.

tools.name: Get all Metabase actions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all actions available in the Metabase instance. Actions are entities that let you build custom forms and business logic with parameterized SQL that writes back to your database. Returns an array of action objects including query, http, and implicit action types.

tools.name: Get Popular Items
tools.description: Tool to get the list of 5 popular items on the Metabase instance. Use when you need to discover frequently accessed dashboards or cards. Returns both dashboards and cards with their metadata including name, description, parent collection, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Recent Activity Views
tools.description: Tool to retrieve recently viewed items in Metabase. Use when you need to get a list of cards, dashboards, collections, tables, or documents that the authenticated user has recently accessed. Returns metadata including timestamps and permissions for each viewed item.

tools.name: Get All Alerts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all alerts in Metabase. Use when you need to get a list of all configured alerts with their settings and notification channels.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboard Candidates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve automagic dashboard candidates for a specific database. Use when you need to discover interesting tables and schemas for automatic dashboard generation. Returns an array of schema candidates with their tables, ordered by interestingness score.

tools.name: Get User Bookmarks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all bookmarks for the authenticated user. Use when you need to fetch bookmarked cards, dashboards, or collections.

tools.name: Get API Card
tools.description: Tool to list all cards (questions) available to the authenticated user in Metabase. Use when you need to retrieve all saved questions, queries, or visualizations.

tools.name: Search Card Parameter Values
tools.description: Tool to search for values of a specific parameter in a Metabase card. Use when you need to provide autocomplete/search functionality for card parameters (template tags). The card must have parameters defined with dimension/field filter type.

tools.name: Get Card by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific card (question) by its ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a card including its query, visualization settings, and metadata.

tools.name: Get all collections
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all collections that the current user has read permissions for. Returns collections with can_write property indicating write permissions. Use when you need to list available collections or check collection permissions.

tools.name: Get Collection by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a Metabase collection by its ID. Use when you need to get collection metadata, permissions, and hierarchy information. Accepts either a numeric collection ID or the string 'root' for the root collection.

tools.name: Get Collection Items
tools.description: Tool to retrieve items from a specific Metabase collection. Use when you need to list cards (questions), dashboards, nested collections, or pulses within a collection. Supports filtering by item type and archived status.

tools.name: Get Root Collection
tools.description: Tool to fetch the Root Collection and its top-level objects. Use when you need to list items at the root level that the current user can access. Shows objects with no collection_id for users with Root Collection permissions, or objects with effective location of / for others.

tools.name: Get Collection Tree
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the collection tree structure from Metabase. Use when you need to view the hierarchical organization of collections. Official collections are returned first in the response. Supports filtering by archived status, user ownership, depth, and specific collection ID.

tools.name: Get All Databases
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use METABASE_LIST_DATABASES instead for a concise, LLM-friendly response. Retrieves all Database instances configured in Metabase with full detail including connection info.

tools.name: Get Database Autocomplete Suggestions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve autocomplete suggestions for table and field names in a database. Use when you need to find tables or columns that match a specific prefix for query building in the SQL editor.

tools.name: Get Database Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve complete metadata for a specific database including all tables and fields. Use when you need detailed information about database structure, table schemas, and field properties.

tools.name: Get Virtual Database Datasets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all datasets from a Metabase virtual database. Use when you need to list available dataset collections for a virtual database (commonly the Saved Questions virtual database with ID -1337).

tools.name: Get User Audit Info
tools.description: Tool to get audit info for the current authenticated user. Returns audit collection info if the user has permissions to access the audit collection, otherwise returns empty map. Requires enterprise audit-app feature.

tools.name: Get Billing API Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the billing API version information for the Metabase Enterprise Edition instance. Use when you need to check the billing API version.

tools.name: Get Resource Dependents
tools.description: Tool to get dependents of a resource in Metabase's dependency graph. Use when you need to find which resources depend on a specific resource (e.g., which dashboards use a particular card). This is an Enterprise Edition feature that helps track dependencies between different Metabase objects.

tools.name: Get Embedding Hub Checklist
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the embedding hub checklist status for Metabase Enterprise Edition. Use when you need to check the progress of embedding setup steps.

tools.name: Get Current Remote Sync Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current remote sync task status in Metabase. Use when you need to check if a remote sync operation is currently running. Returns HTTP 204 when no task is active, or task details when a sync is in progress.

tools.name: Get Stale Data By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve stale data information by ID from Metabase Enterprise Edition. Use when you need to fetch details about stale resources.

tools.name: Get Uploaded Tables
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all uploaded tables in Metabase Enterprise Edition. Use when you need to list all tables that were created from CSV or file uploads.

tools.name: Get Field Related Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve related entities for a Metabase field. Use when you need to get the parent table, related segments, metrics, and other fields from the same table for a specific field ID.

tools.name: Search Field Values
tools.description: Tool to search for field values in Metabase that start with a given string. Use when you need autocomplete or type-ahead functionality for field values. Returns paired values from both the primary field and search field where the search field value starts with the provided string.

tools.name: Get Field Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve distinct values for a Metabase field. Use when you need to get all distinct values of a field that has has_field_values set to 'list', including any human-readable remapped values. Returns empty response for Saved Questions virtual database fields.

tools.name: Get API Glossary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all glossary items from Metabase. Use when you need to list all glossary terms and their definitions available in the Metabase instance.

tools.name: Get Current User Login History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve login history for the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to audit or review login activity.

tools.name: Get Model Index Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve indexed field values for a specific Metabase model. Use when you need to get searchable text values that have been indexed for a model. Metabase indexes text/string fields from models to make them searchable.

tools.name: Get Model Index Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific model index by its ID. Use when you need to get information about model indexing status, schedule, or configuration.

tools.name: Get all native query snippets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all native query snippets available in the Metabase instance. Native query snippets are reusable SQL fragments that can be included in native queries. Returns an array of snippet objects with their content and metadata.

tools.name: Get Native Query Snippet by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific native query snippet by its ID. Use when you need to get details about a saved SQL snippet including its content, metadata, and template tags.

tools.name: Get Notifications
tools.description: Tool to retrieve notifications from Metabase with optional filtering. Use when you need to list notifications by creator, card, recipient, or include inactive ones. Returns an array of notification objects with their payloads, handlers, and creator information.

tools.name: Get Public Card by UUID
tools.description: Tool to fetch a publicly-accessible card by its public UUID and return card information including query definition, visualization settings, and parameters. Use when you need to retrieve card details that have been shared publicly. Does not require authentication when accessing via public UUID.

tools.name: Get Public oEmbed Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get oEmbed metadata for public Metabase resources. Use when you need to generate embeddable content for public dashboards or questions following the oEmbed protocol.

tools.name: Get Public Pivot Card Query
tools.description: Tool to fetch a publicly-accessible pivot card and return query results including data rows, column metadata, and query status. Use when you need to retrieve pivot table data for cards that have been shared publicly via a public UUID. Does not require authentication when accessing via public UUID.

tools.name: Get All Pulses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all pulses (scheduled reports/subscriptions) in Metabase. Use when you need to get a list of configured pulses with their settings and delivery channels.

tools.name: Get Pulse Form Input Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve configuration information for creating or updating Pulses (scheduled email reports). Returns available notification channels and user choices. Use when setting up or modifying pulse subscriptions.

tools.name: Get Pulse by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific pulse (subscription) by its ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a pulse including its channels, cards, schedule, and recipients.

tools.name: Get Pulse Preview Card
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the HTML preview of a Metabase card formatted for pulse emails. Use when you need to get the rendered HTML representation of a card for email delivery.

tools.name: Get Pulse Preview Card Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve preview information for a Metabase card formatted for pulse emails. Use when you need both the HTML rendering and metadata about a card for pulse delivery. Returns a JSON object with the card ID, type, and HTML content.

tools.name: Get Revision by ID and Entity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific revision by ID and entity type. Use when you need to get details about a particular revision of a Metabase entity (card, dashboard, document, or segment).

tools.name: Get Entity Revision History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the revision history for a Metabase entity (dashboard, card, metric, or segment). Use when you need to see the complete change history, who made changes, and what was modified. Returns an array of revision objects ordered from most recent to oldest.

tools.name: Search Metabase objects
tools.description: Tool to search Cards, Dashboards, Collections, Tables, Databases, and Pulses for a substring. Use when you need to find Metabase objects by name or search across multiple object types.

tools.name: Get Search Weights
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current search weight configuration for the Metabase instance. Use when you need to understand how search results are ranked based on factors like recency, bookmarks, view count, and other scoring factors.

tools.name: Get All Segments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all segments from Metabase. Use when you need to list all available segments or filter definitions for tables.

tools.name: Validate Password Reset Token
tools.description: Tool to validate a password reset token in Metabase. Use when you need to check if a password reset token is still valid and can be used to reset a user's password.

tools.name: Get Session Properties
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all global session properties and their values that are public. Use when you need to access configuration settings visible to the current user.

tools.name: Get Card Table Foreign Keys
tools.description: Tool to retrieve foreign key relationships for a card-based virtual table. Use when you need to get FK information for a saved question (card). Note that virtual tables typically return an empty array as they don't have traditional database foreign key relationships.

tools.name: Get Card Virtual Table Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata for a virtual table created from a card (saved question). Use when you need comprehensive information about a card's virtual table including database details, fields with their types and properties, field foreign keys, segments, and metrics.

tools.name: Get All Timelines
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all timelines in Metabase. Use when you need to get a list of all timelines with their settings, events, and associated metadata.

tools.name: Get Collection Timelines
tools.description: Tool to retrieve timelines associated with a specific Metabase collection. Use when you need to get all timelines and their events for a collection. Returns an empty array if the collection has no timelines.

tools.name: Get Root Collection Timelines
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all timelines associated with the root collection. Use when you need to get timelines where items have no collection_id. The root collection is a virtual collection for items without a specific collection assignment.

tools.name: Get Timeline Event
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a timeline event by ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific timeline event including its name, description, timestamp, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Timeline by ID
tools.description: Tool to fetch a timeline by its ID from Metabase. Use when you need to retrieve timeline details including optional events. Add include='events' to get unarchived events, and archived=true to return all events.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to get the current user's profile, permissions, and account details.

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific user by their ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a user including their profile, permissions, and status.

tools.name: Get User Key-Value by Namespace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user key-value pairs for a specified namespace. Use when you need to fetch user-specific settings or preferences stored within a namespace. Returns HTTP 204 (No Content) when the namespace exists but contains no data.

tools.name: Get User Recipients
tools.description: Tool to retrieve users for recipient selection. Returns only active users with permissions-based filtering applied. Use when you need to get a list of users that can be selected as recipients for notifications, alerts, or subscriptions.

tools.name: Generate Random Security Token
tools.description: Tool to generate a cryptographically secure random token for Metabase. Use when you need to generate a secure token for embedding-secret-key or other security purposes.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an automagic dashboard for a specified entity with its ID. Use when you need to get auto-generated analytics and visualizations for tables, databases, cards, segments, or adhoc queries.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboard Cell Analysis
tools.description: Tool to return an automagic dashboard analyzing a specific cell in an entity's data. Use when you need to generate automated insights and visualizations for a cell query within a table, database, or other Metabase entity. The cell-query must be a base64-encoded JSON object in MBQL format.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboards Compare
tools.description: Tool to return an automagic comparison dashboard for entity with id compared with comparison-entity with comparison-entity-id-or-query. Use when you need to generate a visual comparison dashboard between two entities (tables, segments, or adhoc queries).

tools.name: Get automagic dashboard by rule
tools.description: Tool to return an automagic dashboard for a specific entity using a dashboard template with rule prefix. Use when you need to generate an auto-generated analytical dashboard for a table, segment, or adhoc query with specific visualization patterns.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboard Cell Rule Analysis
tools.description: Tool to fetch an automagic dashboard analyzing a specific cell using a template rule. Use when you need to generate automated insights and visualizations for a cell query with a specific dashboard template (e.g., correlations analysis, overview). Returns a dashboard with cards analyzing the specified cell using the given template from the prefix directory.

tools.name: Get Automagic Dashboard Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all metadata for an automagic dashboard for the specified entity type and ID. Use when you need databases, tables, fields, segments, metrics, cards, dashboards, or snippets metadata. Returns comprehensive metadata used to build automagic dashboards that automatically analyze data patterns.

tools.name: Get Card Dashboards
tools.description: Tool to get a list of dashboards that a specific card appears in. Use when you need to find which dashboards contain a particular card. Returns an array of dashboard objects with id and name for each dashboard.

tools.name: Get Card Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get comprehensive query metadata for a Metabase card (saved question). Use when you need detailed information about the database structure, tables, fields, segments, and metrics associated with a card. This endpoint consolidates metadata that would otherwise require multiple API calls to /api/field/:id, /api/database/:id, and /api/table/:id/query_metadata.

tools.name: Get Card Series
tools.description: Tool to fetch a list of cards compatible as series with a specified card. Only cards with display types 'bar', 'scalar', 'line', or 'area' are compatible with series functionality. Use when you need to find cards that can be combined into multi-series visualizations. Returns 400 error for incompatible card types like 'smartscalar'.

tools.name: Get Automagic Comparison Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an automagic comparison dashboard comparing a cell in one entity with another entity. Use when you need to generate comparative analytics and visualizations between two tables, segments, or adhoc queries based on a specific cell query.

tools.name: Get Dashboard by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a dashboard by its ID from Metabase. Use when you need to fetch dashboard details including name, description, cards, parameters, and metadata.

tools.name: Search Dashboard Parameter Values
tools.description: Tool to fetch possible values of a dashboard parameter that contain the search query. Use when you need to search or filter parameter values for a specific dashboard parameter. The parameter must be linked to a text field (not DateTime or other non-text types).

tools.name: Get Dashboard Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get all of the required query metadata for the cards on a dashboard. Use when you need to understand what databases, tables, fields, snippets, and cards are used by a specific dashboard.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Related Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve related entities for a Metabase dashboard. Use when you need to find questions/cards that are related to a specific dashboard.

tools.name: Get Database By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single database by ID from Metabase. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific database, optionally including its tables and fields.

tools.name: Get Database Card Autocomplete Suggestions
tools.description: Tool to return a list of Card autocomplete suggestions for a given query in a given Database. Use when the user needs to search for cards (questions or models) in a specific database, typically for autocomplete functionality.

tools.name: Get Database Datasets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tables (models and metrics) from a virtual database schema in Metabase. Use when you need to discover available datasets in the Saved Questions virtual database. The virtual database ID -1337 represents the Saved Questions database where models and metrics are stored.

tools.name: Get Database Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all field metadata from a Metabase database. Use when you need to explore available fields across all tables in a database. Returns field names, types, display names, and table associations for building queries or understanding database structure.

tools.name: Get Database Healthcheck
tools.description: Tool to check if a Metabase database can currently connect. Use when you need to verify database connectivity status. Returns the connection health status for the specified database ID.

tools.name: Get Database Schemas
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all schemas with tables for a specific database in Metabase. Use when you need to discover available database schemas. Returns only schemas that contain tables, excluding empty schemas.

tools.name: Get Database Settings Available
tools.description: Tool to get all database-local settings and their availability for a given database. Use when you need to check which settings are available or enabled for a specific database. Returns a map of setting names to their availability status (enabled/disabled).

tools.name: Get Database Syncable Schemas
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all syncable schemas for a specific database in Metabase. Use when you need to discover schemas available for syncing or CSV uploads. Returns all schemas that can be synced, unlike the regular schemas endpoint which excludes empty schemas.

tools.name: Get Field Remapping
tools.description: Tool to fetch remapped field values for a specific field in Metabase. Use when you need to retrieve human-readable display values that correspond to field values. Returns an array of value pairs where each pair contains the original field value and its remapped display text.

tools.name: Get Field Summary
tools.description: Tool to get summary statistics for a Metabase field by its ID. Use when you need count and distinct count information for a specific field. Returns count (total values) and distincts (distinct unique values) for the specified field.

tools.name: Get Most Recently Viewed Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the most recently viewed dashboard for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check what dashboard the user last accessed.

tools.name: Get Dashboard HTML Preview
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an HTML preview rendering of a dashboard. Use when you need to get the HTML representation of a dashboard for rendering or pulse notifications.

tools.name: Get Table By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve basic table information by ID from Metabase. Use when you need table details including name, schema, entity type, and associated database information. For comprehensive table metadata with fields and query information, use the query_metadata endpoint instead.

tools.name: Get Table Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data from a specific table in Metabase. Use when you need to fetch the actual data rows and column metadata for a table. Returns table data including rows, column metadata, and optional statistics.

tools.name: Get Table Foreign Keys
tools.description: Tool to get all foreign keys whose destination is a field that belongs to a specific table. Use when you need to retrieve foreign key relationships for a table.

tools.name: Get Table Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get metadata about a Table useful for running queries. Returns DB, fields, field FKs, and field values. Deprecated: Use METABASE_GET_TABLE_SCHEMA instead — it provides a more concise, LLM-friendly output with FK resolution and supports lookup by table name.

tools.name: Get Table Schema
tools.description: Gets column names, types, and foreign key relationships for a Metabase table. Use this before writing queries to know exact column names and types. Accepts either a table_id directly, or database_id + table_name to look up the table. Discovery chain: METABASE_LIST_DATABASES → METABASE_LIST_TABLES → METABASE_GET_TABLE_SCHEMA → METABASE_POST_API_DATASET.

tools.name: Get User Key-Value Setting
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user-specific key-value pair from Metabase storage. Use when you need to fetch user preferences, settings, or stored values organized by namespace and key. Returns the stored value if it exists, or None for unset keys (HTTP 204 response).

tools.name: List Databases
tools.description: Lists all databases configured in Metabase with essential info: ID, name, and engine. Use this first to discover available database IDs before running queries or listing tables.

tools.name: List Tables
tools.description: Lists all tables in a Metabase database with their IDs, names, and schemas. Use this after METABASE_LIST_DATABASES to discover available tables before querying. For detailed column information, use METABASE_GET_TABLE_SCHEMA next.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Parameter Remapping
tools.description: Tool to get parameter remapping for a dashboard parameter value. Use when you need to retrieve remapped values or human-readable representations for a specific parameter value in a Metabase dashboard.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Parameter Values
tools.description: Tool to fetch available values for a specific dashboard parameter. Use when you need to get the list of possible values that can be used to filter a dashboard parameter.

tools.name: Create Dashboard Subscription
tools.description: Tool to create a dashboard subscription using Metabot tools. Use when you need to set up automated delivery of a dashboard to an email address on a scheduled basis.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve dashboard details for a Metabase metabot conversation. Use when you need to get information about a specific dashboard including its name, description, type, and verification status within a conversation context.

tools.name: Get Document Details via Metabot
tools.description: Tool to retrieve document details using Metabase metabot tools. Use when you need to fetch specific document information by document ID within a conversation context.

tools.name: Record Recent Activity
tools.description: Tool to record recent activity for a Metabase item. Use when tracking user interactions with cards, dashboards, tables, or other Metabase objects. This helps maintain the user's recent activity history for quick access to frequently used items.

tools.name: Create Card
tools.description: Tool to create a new Metabase card (question or model). Use when you need to create a new query, report, or visualization in Metabase.

tools.name: Execute Card Query (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use METABASE_METABASE_CREATE_CARD_QUERY1 instead. Tool to execute a query for a saved Metabase card/question and retrieve results. Use when you need to run a saved question and get the data rows, columns, and metadata. Optionally accepts parameters for filtering results using template tag variables.

tools.name: Bulk Move Cards to Collection
tools.description: Tool to bulk move multiple Metabase cards into a target collection or remove them from collections. Use when you need to organize multiple cards by moving them to a specific collection, or pass null as collection_id to remove cards from all collections.

tools.name: Copy Card
tools.description: Tool to create a copy of an existing Metabase card (question) by its ID. Use when you need to duplicate a card with all its query, visualization, and configuration settings.

tools.name: Get Card Dashboard Associations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve dashboard associations for given card IDs. Returns an array with card_id and associated dashboards for each card. Use when you need to find which dashboards contain specific cards.

tools.name: Bulk Move Cards
tools.description: Tool to bulk move cards to a collection or remove them from collections. Use when you need to organize multiple cards by moving them to a specific collection or removing them from all collections.

tools.name: Create Collection
tools.description: Tool to create a new Metabase collection for organizing content. Use when you need to create a collection with name and color. Collections are used to organize dashboards, questions, and models in Metabase.

tools.name: Create Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to create a new Metabase dashboard. Use when you need to create a new dashboard for organizing and displaying visualizations and reports.

tools.name: Execute Dataset Query
tools.description: Tool to execute a query against a Metabase database and retrieve results. Use when you need to run native SQL or MBQL queries. Supports both raw SQL queries (type='native') and structured MBQL queries (type='query').

tools.name: Convert Query to Native SQL
tools.description: Tool to convert a Metabase query to native SQL format. Use when you need to get the formatted native SQL representation of a query.

tools.name: Remap Dataset Parameter Value
tools.description: Tool to remap dataset parameter values in Metabase. Use when you need to transform or map parameter values for dataset queries. Returns an array of remapped values based on the parameter configuration.

tools.name: Get Dataset Parameter Values
tools.description: Tool to fetch parameter values for dataset fields in Metabase. Use when you need to retrieve possible values for a parameter based on specific field IDs. Returns a list of value pairs and indicates if more values exist.

tools.name: Execute Pivot Table Query
tools.description: Tool to execute a pivot table query and retrieve results. Use when you need to run an MBQL query with aggregation and breakout fields to generate pivot table data.

tools.name: Get Dataset Query Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve query metadata for a dataset query including databases, tables, fields, and snippets. Use when you need metadata about what's available for constructing or analyzing a query.

tools.name: Check Snippet Dependencies
tools.description: Tool to check dependencies for a native query snippet in Metabase Enterprise Edition. Use when you need to verify which cards or transforms depend on a specific snippet before modifying or deleting it.

tools.name: Filter Records
tools.description: Tool to filter records from a Metabase data source using metabot tools. Use when you need to apply filters to a table, query, or report to narrow down the data set. Returns an MBQL query object with the applied filters.

tools.name: Generate Insights
tools.description: Tool to generate insights for a table using Metabot tools. Use when you need to automatically generate analytical insights or dashboard for a specific table.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the current authenticated user in a Metabase metabot conversation. Use when you need to get details about the user making queries within a conversation context.

tools.name: Get Query Details
tools.description: Tool to get query details using Metabot tools API. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a query including its structure, ID, and result columns. Returns either structured output with query metadata or plain text output.

tools.name: Get Snippet Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SQL snippet details via Metabase metabot tools. Use when you need to get the full details of a specific snippet including its ID, name, content, and description within a metabot conversation context.

tools.name: Get Metabot Snippets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SQL snippets for a Metabase metabot conversation. Use when you need to get available snippets that can be used in SQL queries within a conversation context.

tools.name: Get Table Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive table details via Metabase metabot tools. Use when you need to get complete information about a specific table including its fields, metrics, and related tables within a metabot conversation context.

tools.name: Query Datasource via Metabot
tools.description: Tool to query a Metabase datasource using Metabot tools. Use when you need to execute queries against tables or models within a conversation context. Requires either a table_id or model_id in the arguments.

tools.name: Metabot Search
tools.description: Tool to search Metabase entities using the metabot search API. Use when you need to search for tables, models, questions, dashboards, metrics, databases, or transforms within a metabot conversation context.

tools.name: Search Metabase Items (Metabot V2)
tools.description: Tool to search Metabase items using the Metabot search v2 endpoint. Use when you need to find dashboards, questions, tables, models, metrics, or other Metabase entities using keyword or semantic search. Supports filtering by entity type, database, and dates.

tools.name: Cancel Current Remote Sync Task
tools.description: Tool to cancel the current active Remote Sync task in Metabase Enterprise Edition. Use when you need to stop an ongoing remote sync operation. Returns 'No active task to cancel' when there is no active task running.

tools.name: Translate Entity IDs
tools.description: Tool to translate Metabase entity IDs (21-character strings) to their numeric IDs. Use when you need to convert entity ID strings to numeric IDs for API operations.

tools.name: Rescan Field Values
tools.description: Tool to manually trigger an update for the FieldValues for a specific field. Use when you need to refresh the cached values for a field that is eligible for FieldValues. Only works with fields that have has_field_values set to 'list'.

tools.name: Create Glossary Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new glossary entry in Metabase. Use when you need to add a new term and its definition to the glossary.

tools.name: Create Model Index
tools.description: Tool to create a new model index in Metabase. Use when you need to enable search functionality on a model by indexing specific fields.

tools.name: Create native query snippet
tools.description: Tool to create a new native query snippet in Metabase. Native query snippets are reusable SQL fragments that can be included in native queries. Use when you need to create a new SQL snippet for reuse across multiple queries.

tools.name: Create Notification
tools.description: Tool to create a new notification in Metabase. Use when you need to create notifications for cards or other resources.

tools.name: Send Notification
tools.description: Tool to trigger sending an unsaved notification in Metabase. Use when you need to send a one-time notification for a card with custom handlers and templates. Returns success status when notification is sent (HTTP 204).

tools.name: Submit Product Feedback
tools.description: Tool to submit product feedback to Metabase. Use when you need to send feedback about the product from various sources.

tools.name: Create Pulse
tools.description: Tool to create a new pulse (scheduled report/subscription) in Metabase. Use when you need to set up automated delivery of card or dashboard results via email or Slack.

tools.name: Revert Entity to Previous Revision
tools.description: Tool to revert a Metabase entity (card, dashboard, document, or segment) to a previous revision. Use when you need to undo changes and restore an entity to an earlier state.

tools.name: Send Password Reset Email
tools.description: Tool to send a password reset email when user has forgotten their password. Use when you need to initiate a password reset for a user. Returns 204 status code on success regardless of whether the email exists (security measure).

tools.name: Check Password Complexity
tools.description: Tool to check if a password meets Metabase's configured password complexity rules. Use when you need to validate a password against current complexity requirements. The endpoint was previously at /api/util/password_check but was moved to /api/session/password-check.

tools.name: Submit Bug Report to Slack
tools.description: Tool to submit a bug report to Slack via Metabase's bug reporting endpoint. Use when you need to send diagnostic information about a bug to the configured Slack channel. Requires Slack integration with 'metabase-bugs' channel to be properly configured.

tools.name: Create Timeline
tools.description: Tool to create a new timeline in Metabase. Use when you need to create a timeline for organizing events.

tools.name: Execute Dashboard Card Query
tools.description: Tool to execute a query for a specific card within a dashcard on a dashboard. Use when you need to retrieve query results for dashboard visualizations. Returns data rows, column metadata, and execution statistics.

tools.name: Update Action by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Metabase action by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name, description, query, or settings of an action. Returns the updated action object with the new updated_at timestamp.

tools.name: Update Bookmark Ordering
tools.description: Tool to update the order of bookmarks for the authenticated user. Use when you need to reorder bookmarked cards, dashboards, or collections.

tools.name: Update Card by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a specific card (question) by its ID. Use when you need to modify card properties like name, description, visualization settings, or query definition.

tools.name: Update Collection by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Metabase collection by its ID. Use when you need to modify collection properties like name, description, color, archive status, or move it to a different parent. All parameters except id are optional - only include the fields you want to update.

tools.name: Update Dashboard Cards
tools.description: Tool to update dashboard cards and tabs. DEPRECATED: This endpoint is marked for removal in v48 - use PUT /api/dashboard/:id instead to update dashcards along with other dashboard data. Use when you need to update card positions, sizes, or tab ordering on a dashboard.

tools.name: Update Database Configuration
tools.description: Tool to update a database configuration in Metabase. Use when you need to modify database settings such as name, description, connection details, or sync preferences. Requires superuser permissions.

tools.name: Update Field Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update a Metabase field by its ID. Use when you need to modify field metadata such as description, display_name, semantic_type, or visibility_type. Only fields included in the request will be updated; others remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Glossary Entry by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing glossary entry in Metabase by its ID. Use when you need to modify the term name or definition of an existing glossary entry.

tools.name: Update Native Query Snippet by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing native query snippet by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or SQL content of a saved snippet. At least one field (name, description, or content) should be provided to update.

tools.name: Update Pulse by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing pulse (scheduled report/subscription) by ID. Use when you need to modify pulse settings like name, cards, channels, or skip_if_empty behavior.

tools.name: Update Search Weights
tools.description: Tool to update search weights configuration in Metabase. Use when you need to customize how search results are ranked by adjusting scorer weights. Returns the current search weights configuration after update.

tools.name: Update Table Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update a Metabase table by its ID. Use when you need to modify table metadata such as display_name, description, visibility_type, caveats, or points_of_interest. Only fields included in the request will be updated; others remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Table Field Display Order
tools.description: Tool to update the display order of fields in a Metabase table. Use when you need to reorder how fields appear in a table's schema or query results.

tools.name: Update Timeline Event by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing timeline event by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name, description, timestamp, or other properties of a timeline event. Returns the updated event object.

tools.name: Update Timeline by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing timeline by its ID. Use when you need to modify the name, description, icon, or other properties of a timeline. Returns the updated timeline object.

tools.name: Update User by ID
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Metabase user by their ID. Use when you need to modify user information such as email, name, group memberships, or superuser status. All update fields are optional; only provided fields will be updated.

tools.name: Update Dashboard
tools.description: Tool to update a Metabase dashboard by ID. Use when you need to modify dashboard properties like name, description, parameters, cards, or tabs. The request body accepts the same structure as the response from GET /api/dashboard/:id. When setting archived to true, the dashboard is moved to Trash; when false, you may provide a collection_id.

tools.name: Update Dashboard Cards (Deprecated)
tools.description: Tool to bulk update dashboard cards and tabs. DEPRECATED - use PUT /api/dashboard/:id instead for new implementations. Use when you need to create, update, or delete multiple dashboard cards at once. Cards with negative IDs are created, existing IDs are updated, and omitted cards are deleted.

required.name: full
required.description: The web address where you open Metabase, e.g. https://metabase.yourcompany.com — copy it from your browser address bar, with no trailing slash or extra path.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: An API key created by a Metabase admin: go to Admin settings → Authentication → API Keys → Create API Key, then copy it right away — it's shown only once.

name: Metaphor
description: Metaphor is a neural search engine that enables developers to perform contextually relevant searches by understanding how people describe and share content online.

tools.name: Get document contents by IDs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve parsed HTML/text contents and metadata for documents by their IDs." Use when you need to fetch the full text and metadata of multiple documents at once.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Metaphor API key, obtainable from your Metaphor account settings.

name: Mezmo
description: Mezmo provides a comprehensive platform for log management and telemetry data processing, enabling organizations to collect, analyze, and manage their log data efficiently.

tools.name: Create Category
tools.description: Tool to create a new category for views, boards, or screens in Mezmo. Use when organizing Mezmo resources into categories.

tools.name: Create Ingestion Exclusion Rule
tools.description: Tool to create an exclusion rule for log ingestion to control costs. Use this when you need to prevent specific logs from being ingested or stored based on query patterns. Exclusion rules help reduce ingestion costs by filtering out debug logs, test environment logs, or other non-essential log data.

tools.name: Create API Key
tools.description: Tool to create a new API key (ingestion or service key) in Mezmo. The API auto-generates a unique name for the key. Use when you need to provision a new key for log ingestion or API access.

tools.name: Create Member Invitation
tools.description: Tool to invite a new member to the Mezmo organization with a specified role. Use this to send invitations to team members and optionally assign them to specific groups.

tools.name: Create Preset Alert
tools.description: Tool to create a new preset alert in Mezmo with specified name and notification channels. Use this to configure alerts that can be triggered based on log conditions. Supports email, PagerDuty, and webhook notification channels.

tools.name: Create View
tools.description: Tool to create a new Mezmo view with filtering and alert configuration. Use when you need to set up custom log views with specific filters (query, hosts, apps, levels, tags) and optional alert channels (email, PagerDuty, webhook). At least one filter parameter must be provided in addition to the view name.

tools.name: Delete Category
tools.description: Tool to delete a category by its type and ID. Use when you need to remove a view, board, or screen category from Mezmo configuration.

tools.name: Delete Ingestion Exclusion
tools.description: Tool to remove an ingestion exclusion rule by its ID. Use when you need to delete a specific exclusion rule from Mezmo's ingestion configuration.

tools.name: Delete API Key
tools.description: Tool to delete an API key by its unique identifier. Use when you need to remove an ingestion key from Mezmo to revoke access.

tools.name: Delete Organization Member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from the organization by their email address. Use when you need to revoke a user's access to the organization.

tools.name: Delete Pipeline Alert
tools.description: Tool to delete an alert for a specific component within a pipeline. Use after confirming pipeline ID, component kind, component ID, and alert ID.

tools.name: Delete Preset Alert
tools.description: Tool to delete a preset alert by its ID. Use after confirming the preset alert ID exists.

tools.name: Delete View
tools.description: Tool to delete a view by its ID. Use when you need to remove a specific view from Mezmo.

tools.name: Get Preset Alert
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific preset alert by its ID. Use when you need to view the configuration of an existing alert.

tools.name: Get Category
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a category configuration by its type and ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific Mezmo category (view, board, or screen).

tools.name: Get Index Rate Alert Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current index rate alert settings for the Mezmo account. Use this to check if index rate alerting is enabled and view configured thresholds and notification channels.

tools.name: Get Ingestion Exclusion Rule
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an ingestion exclusion rule by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details of a specific exclusion rule.

tools.name: Get Ingestion Status
tools.description: Tool to get the current ingestion status for the Mezmo account. Use when you need to check whether log ingestion is currently active or paused.

tools.name: Get API Key
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an API key configuration by its ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific Mezmo API key.

tools.name: Get Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve member information by their ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific member in your Mezmo account.

tools.name: Get Stream Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current event streaming configuration for the Mezmo account. Use when you need to check if streaming is enabled and get streaming settings. Returns error details if streaming is unavailable on the account/plan.

tools.name: Get View Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific view by its ID. Use when you need to fetch view configuration including name, query, filters, and other attributes.

tools.name: Ingest Logs to Mezmo
tools.description: Ingest log lines into Mezmo Log Analysis. Use this tool to send structured log data from hosts, applications, or services to Mezmo for centralized logging, analysis, and alerting. Logs are sent to the Mezmo ingestion endpoint and will appear in the Mezmo dashboard.

tools.name: List Preset Alerts
tools.description: Tool to list all preset alerts configured for the Mezmo account. Use when you need to retrieve notification rules that trigger based on log patterns. Returns preset alert configurations including their channels (email, PagerDuty, webhook).

tools.name: List API Keys
tools.description: Tool to list all API keys and ingestion keys configured for the account. Use when you need to retrieve all keys for viewing or management purposes.

tools.name: List Members
tools.description: Tool to list all team members in the Mezmo account configuration. Use when you need to retrieve information about all members in the organization.

tools.name: List Telemetry Pipelines
tools.description: Tool to list all telemetry pipelines configured for the account. Use when you need to view or retrieve information about existing pipelines that manage the flow and transformation of telemetry data.

tools.name: List Views
tools.description: Tool to list all views configured for the account. Views are saved search queries and filters for quick access to specific log data.

tools.name: Resume Log Ingestion
tools.description: Tool to resume log ingestion for the account after it has been stopped. Use when you need to re-enable log collection after a pause.

tools.name: Update Category
tools.description: Tool to update a category name by its type and ID. Use when you need to rename an existing category in Mezmo.

tools.name: Update Index Rate Alert Configuration
tools.description: Tool to configure index rate alerting settings including thresholds and notification channels. Use this when you need to set up or modify alerts for unusual log ingestion rates based on absolute line counts or statistical deviations.

tools.name: Update Ingestion Exclusion Rule
tools.description: Tool to update an existing exclusion rule by its ID. Use when you need to modify the query, active status, indexonly behavior, or title of an existing exclusion rule. At least one field (query, active, indexonly, or title) must be provided for update.

tools.name: Update API Key
tools.description: Tool to update an API key name by its ID. Use when you need to rename an existing Mezmo API key.

tools.name: Update Member Role and Groups
tools.description: Tool to update a member's role and group assignments by their email address. Use when you need to change a member's permissions or group memberships.

tools.name: Update Preset Alert
tools.description: Tool to update an existing preset alert by ID. Allows modifying the alert's name and notification channels. Use when you need to change alert configuration after creation. Requires full resource representation with both name and channels.

tools.name: Update Mezmo View
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Mezmo view by its ID. Use when you need to modify a view's name or search query.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Mezmo Access Token used for all API requests except ingest. Obtain it from your Mezmo account settings.

name: Microsoft Advertising
description: Manage Microsoft Advertising accounts, campaigns, ad groups, and asynchronous reports through the documented v13 REST APIs.

tools.name: Activate Ad Groups
tools.description: Activate up to 1,000 ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign. WARNING: Activation can immediately make eligible ads deliver and incur spend when the parent campaign, bids, targeting, and ads permit delivery. Verify the selected IDs and campaign configuration before calling. Inspect partial_errors because Microsoft can accept the request while rejecting individual activations.

tools.name: Activate Campaigns
tools.description: Activate 1 to 100 Microsoft Advertising campaigns. This can immediately make configured ads eligible for delivery and cause the account to incur ad spend. Inspect partial_errors because Microsoft can accept the request while rejecting individual campaign activations.

tools.name: Create Search Ad Groups
tools.description: Create up to 1,000 Search ad groups under a Microsoft Advertising campaign. Ad groups default to Paused. HTTP success can include failed items, represented by null ad_group_ids and indexed partial_errors.

tools.name: Create Search Campaigns
tools.description: Create up to 100 Search campaigns with unshared budgets in a Microsoft Advertising account. Campaigns default to Paused. HTTP success can include failed items, represented by null campaign_ids and indexed partial_errors.

tools.name: Delete Ad Groups
tools.description: Permanently delete 1 to 1,000 ad groups from a Microsoft Advertising campaign. This destructive operation cannot be undone. A successful HTTP response can still contain item-level failures in partial_errors.

tools.name: Delete Campaigns
tools.description: Permanently delete 1 to 100 campaigns from a Microsoft Advertising account. This destructive operation cannot be undone. A successful HTTP response can still contain item-level failures, which are preserved in partial_errors.

tools.name: Generate Account Performance Report
tools.description: Submit an account-performance report without polling, or check an existing report_request_id once. A submission returns Pending promptly; wait 2 to 15 minutes before checking that ID again until Success. Does not download the ZIP.

tools.name: Get Current Advertising User
tools.description: Return the connected Microsoft Advertising user and their customer/account roles; optionally look up another accessible user by ID.

tools.name: List Advertiser Accounts
tools.description: Return advertiser accounts accessible under a customer, including lifecycle and pause state needed before campaign work.

tools.name: List Ad Groups
tools.description: Return ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign. Omit ad_group_ids to use the campaign-wide route, or supply up to 1,000 IDs to use Microsoft's ID-filtered route. ID-filtered responses preserve nullable ad-group slots and partial_errors instead of treating HTTP 200 as complete success.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Return campaigns in a Microsoft Advertising account. Omit campaign_ids to use the account-wide route, or supply up to 100 IDs to use Microsoft's ID-filtered route. ID-filtered responses preserve nullable campaign slots and matching partial_errors instead of treating HTTP 200 as complete success.

tools.name: List Accessible Customers
tools.description: Return Microsoft Advertising customers accessible to the connected user, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive name prefix.

tools.name: Update Ad Groups
tools.description: Partially update up to 1,000 ad groups in a Microsoft Advertising campaign. Only supplied fields are sent, so omitted settings remain unchanged. This action is financially consequential: increasing a CPC bid or expanding network reach can increase spend on an active ad group. Inspect partial_errors because Microsoft can accept the request while rejecting individual ad-group patches.

tools.name: Update Campaigns
tools.description: Partially update up to 100 campaigns in a Microsoft Advertising account. Only supplied fields are sent, so omitted settings remain unchanged. This action is financially consequential: increasing a budget can increase spend on an active campaign. It can pause campaigns but cannot activate them; use ACTIVATE_CAMPAIGNS for activation. Inspect partial_errors because Microsoft can accept the request while rejecting individual campaign patches.

name: Microsoft Bookings
description: Microsoft Bookings provides shared business scheduling through Microsoft Graph, including booking businesses, appointments, customers, services, staff, and currencies.

tools.name: Cancel Appointment
tools.description: Irreversibly cancel an appointment and ask Microsoft Bookings to send the supplied cancellation message to its customers and staff. A successful result confirms that Graph accepted the cancellation, not message delivery.

tools.name: Create Appointment
tools.description: Create an appointment for a service at explicit start and end times, optionally assigning staff and customer details. Microsoft Bookings may send customers a confirmation email; opt_out_of_customer_email requests suppression but does not guarantee non-delivery.

tools.name: Create Booking Business
tools.description: Create a shared booking business with the supplied display name. The business starts unpublished and can then be configured with the update tool.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a saved customer in one booking business with structured contact details.

tools.name: Create Custom Question
tools.description: Create a text or single-choice intake question for one booking business.

tools.name: Create Service
tools.description: Create a bookable service with a name and default duration, optionally configuring location, price, staff, reminders, questions, and scheduling rules.

tools.name: Create Staff Member
tools.description: Add a staff member to one booking business with a role, email, time zone, and optional working schedule.

tools.name: Delete Appointment
tools.description: Permanently delete an appointment without invoking Microsoft Bookings' cancellation-message action. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Booking Business
tools.description: Permanently delete one shared booking business and all of its Microsoft Bookings data. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Customer
tools.description: Permanently delete one saved customer from a Microsoft Bookings business. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Custom Question
tools.description: Permanently delete one custom intake question from a booking business. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Service
tools.description: Permanently delete one service from a Microsoft Bookings business. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Staff Member
tools.description: Permanently remove one staff member from a Microsoft Bookings business. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get Appointment
tools.description: Get one booking appointment, including its service, customers, assigned staff, attendee counts, and UTC start and end times.

tools.name: Get Booking Business
tools.description: Get the complete configuration and publication state of one shared booking business.

tools.name: Get Booking Currency
tools.description: Get one Microsoft Bookings currency by its ISO currency code.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Get one saved customer and their contact details from a booking business.

tools.name: Get Custom Question
tools.description: Get one custom intake question, including its answer type and available choices.

tools.name: Get Service
tools.description: Get one service and its duration, pricing, staff, questions, reminders, location, and scheduling configuration.

tools.name: Get Staff Member
tools.description: Get one booking staff member's identity, role, membership state, time zone, working hours, and calendar settings.

tools.name: List Appointments
tools.description: List one Microsoft Graph page of appointments for a booking business. Omit start and end to list the appointments collection, or provide both to list appointments occurring in that inclusive calendar-view range.

tools.name: List Booking Businesses
tools.description: List shared booking businesses visible to the connected work or school account. Microsoft Graph returns up to 500 results and does not paginate this endpoint. Results contain only each business ID and display name; use search_query to narrow results or Get Booking Business for full details.

tools.name: List Booking Currencies
tools.description: Return one Microsoft Graph page of the Microsoft Bookings currency catalog with ISO currency IDs and localized symbols. The documented OData controls are passed through, but Graph may accept and ignore them.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: List saved customers for one booking business, one Microsoft Graph page at a time.

tools.name: List Custom Questions
tools.description: List custom intake questions defined for one booking business, one Microsoft Graph page at a time.

tools.name: List Services
tools.description: List services offered by one booking business, including duration, pricing, staff, and scheduling defaults, one Microsoft Graph page at a time.

tools.name: List Staff Members
tools.description: List staff members configured for one booking business, including roles and working hours, one Microsoft Graph page at a time.

tools.name: Publish Booking Business
tools.description: Publish a booking business's external scheduling page so customers can access it. After publishing, call Get Booking Business to retrieve the resulting public URL.

tools.name: Unpublish Booking Business
tools.description: Take a booking business's external scheduling page offline and clear its public URL without deleting the business.

tools.name: Update Appointment
tools.description: Update an existing appointment's schedule, attendees, service, staff, location, notifications, or pricing without cancelling it.

tools.name: Update Booking Business
tools.description: Update supported contact details, hours, currency, business type, address, or scheduling rules without publishing or unpublishing the business.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Update a saved customer's name, email, phone numbers, or postal addresses in one booking business.

tools.name: Update Custom Question
tools.description: Update the text, answer type, or choices of one custom intake question.

tools.name: Update Service
tools.description: Update a service's name, duration, location, pricing, staff, reminders, questions, visibility, or scheduling rules.

tools.name: Update Staff Member
tools.description: Update a booking staff member's identity, role, time zone, working schedule, calendar behavior, or email notifications.
