tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Mixmax contacts (people you've emailed using Mixmax). Use when you need to list, search, or analyze contacts with optional analytics data. Note: Endpoint is deprecated but remains functional. Does not return contacts shared via contact groups unless search parameter is provided.

tools.name: List Rule Actions
tools.description: Tool to list all actions for a given Mixmax rule. Actions represent the "Then" part of the rules UI - what happens when a rule is triggered. Use when you need to view all actions configured for a specific rule.

tools.name: List Sequence Folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all sequence folders from Mixmax. Use when you need to view or enumerate available sequence folders for organizing sequences.

tools.name: List Sequences
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of sequences from Mixmax. Use when you need to view sequences (email campaigns) that you have access to. Supports limiting results and expanding nested fields like stages and userId.

tools.name: List Snippets
tools.description: Tool to list templates or snippets that you have access to (including those shared with you). Use when you need to retrieve available snippets in your Mixmax account.

tools.name: Update Rule by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a rule by its unique ID in Mixmax. Use when you need to modify an existing rule's name, trigger, or filter. At least one field should be provided to update.

tools.name: Update Rule Action
tools.description: Tool to update an action within a Mixmax rule. Use when you need to modify action properties like webhook URL or action type.

tools.name: Update Snippet by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a snippet by its unique ID in Mixmax. Use when you need to modify an existing snippet's name, title, content, or inline status. At least one field should be provided to update.

tools.name: Query Contacts
tools.description: Tool to search for matching contacts across multiple sources including Mixmax, Google Directory, and Salesforce (contacts, leads, accounts, and opportunities). Use when you need to find contacts by name, email, or other search criteria.

tools.name: Remove Contact from Group
tools.description: Tool to remove a contact from a contact group. Use when you need to disassociate a contact from a specific group after confirming both the group ID and contact ID.

tools.name: Remove Team Member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from a Mixmax team. Use when you need to revoke a user's team membership. Can only be called by the admin or a user trying to leave a team.

tools.name: Search Sequences
tools.description: Tool to search sequence recipients by email and sequenceId from Mixmax. Use when you need to find sequences and recipients based on specific criteria. Returns both sequences and recipients matching the search parameters.

tools.name: Send Message Draft
tools.description: Tool to send a message draft by its unique ID. Use when you need to send an existing draft message that was created via POST /v1/messages. Messages are sent within 3 seconds after calling this action.

tools.name: Send Snippet as Email
tools.description: Tool to send a snippet as an email to specified recipients. Use when you need to send a saved snippet/template to one or more email addresses.

tools.name: Send Test Message
tools.description: Tool to send a test Mixmax message to the authenticated user, resolving any variables. Use when you need to test message templates or verify that the Mixmax API integration is working correctly.

tools.name: Update Appointment Link Calendar Name
tools.description: Tool to update your custom "Mixmax Calendar" vanity URL name. Use when you need to change the calendar name that appears in your personalized calendar link (e.g., https://cal.mixmax.com/<your-name>). This setting is available in the Calendar settings from the Mixmax dashboard.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Tool to update a specific contact by ID. Use when you need to modify contact details such as name, email, or custom metadata fields.

tools.name: Update Contact Group
tools.description: Tool to update a contact group by ID. Use when you need to modify a contact group's name, sharing settings, or team associations. Note: This endpoint is deprecated but still functional.

tools.name: Update Contact Note
tools.description: Tool to update a note on a contact by its ID. Only the creator of the note can edit it. The contact note will show "(edited)" in the UI after update.

tools.name: Update insights report
tools.description: Tool to update an existing insights report in Mixmax. Use when you need to modify a report's title, type, or query. All fields are optional - only provide the fields you want to update.

tools.name: Update Message by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a message by its unique ID. Use when you need to modify message content, recipients, or tracking settings for an existing message.

tools.name: Update Sequence Folder by ID
tools.description: Tool to update a sequence folder by its unique ID in Mixmax. Use when you need to modify an existing sequence folder's name or other properties.

tools.name: Update Snippet Tag
tools.description: Tool to update a snippet tag (folder) by its unique ID. Use when you need to modify a snippet tag's name, sharing settings, or inline status.

tools.name: Update Team
tools.description: Tool to update a team's information by ID. Use when you need to modify a team's name or other properties. Only admins can perform this operation.

tools.name: Update Current User Preferences
tools.description: Tool to update preferences for the currently authenticated user. Use when you need to modify user-specific settings like tracking preferences, UI features, hotkeys, or calendar settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Mixmax API token. Create one at Settings > Integrations > API (https://app.mixmax.com/dashboard/settings/personal/integrations). Note: API access is restricted to Mixmax annual plans (Growth+ or Enterprise tier).

name: Mobbin MCP
description: Mobbin is a UI/UX design inspiration platform with 600,000+ app screens, user flows, and design patterns from over 1,100 apps. Search and browse mobile and web design references for inspiration.

tools.name: Search flows
tools.description: Search Mobbin for multi-step user flows (e.g. onboarding, checkout) using natural language. Returns evenly-spaced preview images inline along with metadata for each flow, including per-screen previews. Examine the returned images to understand each flow's actual content — do not describe screens based solely on metadata. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

tools.name: Search screens
tools.description: Search Mobbin for UI screens using natural language. Returns matching screens with inline images and metadata. Examine the returned images to understand each screen's actual content — do not describe or summarize screens based solely on metadata. Each screen has a `mobbin_url` — the canonical Mobbin link for that screen. When you present results to the user, ALWAYS cite each screen you mention as a markdown link to its `mobbin_url` so the user can open it on Mobbin. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

tools.name: Search sections
tools.description: Search Mobbin for website sections (e.g. About, Pricing, Footer) using natural language. Returns section images inline along with metadata. Examine the returned images to understand each section's actual content — do not describe or summarize sections based solely on metadata. On hosts that support MCP Apps, also renders an interactive gallery of the results.

optional.name: client_id
optional.description: Client id of the app

optional.name: client_secret
optional.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Moco
description: MOCO is a business management software offering project management, time tracking, and invoicing solutions.

tools.name: Activate Offer Customer Approval
tools.description: Tool to activate customer approval on an offer to generate the offer_document_url. Use when you need to create a shareable PDF link for customer approval.

tools.name: List Activities
tools.description: Retrieves a list of activities (time entries) from MOCO. Activities are time tracking records that log hours worked on projects and tasks. Use this tool to: - Get all time entries within a date range - Find activities by user, project, task, or company - Filter by billing status (billable/non-billable, billed/unbilled) - Search for activities by description, tag, or external reference - Sort results by any field (date, hours, etc.) Returns paginated results with detailed information about each activity including the associated project, task, customer, and user.

tools.name: Get Activity
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single activity by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific activity after confirming the activity ID.

tools.name: Update Activity
tools.description: Tool to update an existing activity. Use when you need to adjust details of a recorded time entry after confirming the activity exists.

tools.name: Assign Offer
tools.description: Tool to assign an offer to a project, company, or deal. Use when you need to link an existing offer with a project (creating project from offer), associate it with a company, or link it to a deal.

tools.name: Assign Purchase to Project
tools.description: Tool to assign a purchase item to a project by creating or linking to an expense. Use when you need to associate a purchase line item with a specific project for billing and budget tracking.

tools.name: List comments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of comments. Use after confirming the resource type and ID.

tools.name: Create Company
tools.description: Creates a new company in MOCO (customer, supplier, or organization). Required fields: - name: Company name - type: Must be 'customer', 'supplier', or 'organization' - currency: Required only for 'customer' type (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CHF') Common optional fields: website, email, phone, address, tags, user_id, country_code

tools.name: Delete a company
tools.description: Tool to delete a company. Use when you need to remove a company from MOCO after confirming no active dependencies.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of contacts. Use when you need to list contacts optionally filtered by tags, term, or phone after confirming criteria.

tools.name: Create Account Catalog Service
tools.description: Tool to create a catalog service including its items. Use when you need to create a catalog service with pricing items. Note: Items cannot be updated through this endpoint - use separate item-specific endpoints for modifications.

tools.name: Create Catalog Service Item
tools.description: Tool to create a new item within a catalog service in MOCO. Use when you need to add items like consulting services, products, or other billable items to a service catalog.

tools.name: Create Account Custom Property
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom property in MOCO. Use when you need to define a new custom field for entities like Deals, Projects, or Customers. Custom properties can be of various types (String, Textarea, Link, Boolean, Select, MultiSelect, Date) and can be configured to appear on documents or trigger notifications.

tools.name: Create Activities Bulk
tools.description: Tool to bulk create multiple activities (time entries) at once in MOCO. Activities are time tracking records that log hours worked on projects and tasks. Use this tool to: - Create multiple time entries in a single API call for efficiency - Import time logs from external systems in bulk - Backfill historical time tracking data - Log multiple activities for the same or different projects/tasks at once More efficient than calling activity create endpoint multiple times. All activities must have valid date, project_id, and task_id. Returns all created activities with their generated IDs.

tools.name: Create Activity
tools.description: Tool to create a new activity (time tracking entry) in MOCO. Use when you need to record time spent on a project task. Activities are created for the user that the API key belongs to.

tools.name: Create Comment
tools.description: Tool to create a new comment on a MOCO resource. Use when you need to add a comment to a project, deal, contact, or other supported entity.

tools.name: Create Comments Bulk
tools.description: Tool to create multiple comments in bulk for MOCO objects. Use when you need to add the same comment to multiple objects of the same type efficiently.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact person in MOCO. Use when you need to add a new contact with their personal and professional information. Requires lastname and gender; optionally accepts contact details, company association, and tags.

tools.name: Create Deal
tools.description: Tool to create a new deal in MOCO. Use when you need to add a deal with specified parameters.

tools.name: Create Deal Category
tools.description: Creates a new deal category in MOCO with a name and probability percentage. Deal categories represent stages in a sales pipeline (e.g., "Contact", "Negotiation", "Closed Won") and include probability percentages (0-100) indicating the likelihood of winning at each stage. Use this action to add new stages to your sales pipeline.

tools.name: Create Employment
tools.description: Create a new employment (weekly work model) for a user in MOCO. Define work hours distribution across weekdays using 'am' and 'pm' arrays.

tools.name: Create Expense Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new expense template in MOCO. Use when you need to set up reusable expense items with predefined pricing and cost information.

tools.name: Create Holiday
tools.description: Create a new holiday entry for a user in MOCO. Use this to allocate annual leave days, vacation allowances, or other holiday entitlements for specific users and years.

tools.name: Add Invoice Attachment
tools.description: Tool to add a PDF attachment to an existing invoice. Use when you need to attach supporting documents or files to an invoice record.

tools.name: Create Invoice Bookkeeping Export
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice bookkeeping export. Use when you need to export invoice data for accounting purposes.

tools.name: Create Invoice Payment
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice payment. Use when recording a payment received for an invoice.

tools.name: Create Invoice Reminder
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice reminder for an existing invoice. Use when you need to send a payment reminder to a customer for an overdue invoice.

tools.name: Create Invoice Payments Bulk
tools.description: Tool to create multiple invoice payments in bulk. Use when you need to record multiple payments at once across different invoices.

tools.name: Create Offer
tools.description: Tool to create a new offer/proposal. Use after gathering complete offer data (company, dates, items, etc.).

tools.name: Create Offer Attachment
tools.description: Tool to upload an attachment to an offer. Use when you need to attach a document to an existing offer after obtaining the offer ID and file content.

tools.name: Create Project Contract
tools.description: Tool to create a new contract (assign staff) for a project in MOCO. Use when you need to assign a staff member to a project with specific billing parameters.

tools.name: Create Project Expense
tools.description: Tool to create an additional service entry (expense) on a project. Use when you need to log project expenses like hosting costs, external services, or materials.

tools.name: Create Project Expenses Bulk
tools.description: Tool to create multiple project expense entries in bulk. Use when you need to add several additional services or expense items to a project at once.

tools.name: Create Project Payment Schedule
tools.description: Tool to create a payment schedule entry for a project. Use when you need to add a scheduled payment milestone to an existing project.

tools.name: Create Recurring Expense on Project
tools.description: Tool to create a recurring additional services entry on a project in MOCO. Use when you need to set up periodic billing for services like hosting, maintenance, or support contracts.

tools.name: Trigger Recurring Expense
tools.description: Tool to manually trigger the creation of an expense entry for an active recurring expense ahead of its automatic schedule. Use when you need to create the next expense entry immediately rather than waiting for the scheduled recurrence date.

tools.name: Create Project Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task (service) for a project in MOCO. Use when you need to add a billable or non-billable task to an existing project.

tools.name: Create Purchase Bookkeeping Export
tools.description: Tool to create a new purchase bookkeeping export. Use when you need to export purchases for bookkeeping or DATEV submission.

tools.name: Create Purchase Payment
tools.description: Tool to create a new purchase payment. Use when you need to record a payment made for a purchase or create a standalone payment entry with a description.

tools.name: Create Purchase Payments Bulk
tools.description: Tool to create multiple purchase payments in bulk. Use when you need to record multiple payments at once for efficiency.

tools.name: Create Receipt
tools.description: Tool to create a new receipt. Use when you need to record an expense receipt after gathering date, title, currency, and items.

tools.name: Create Schedule
tools.description: Tool to create a planning entry (absence/schedule). Use when you need to record absences such as holidays, sick days, or other time off. If user_id is not supplied, the entry is created for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Tool to create a new tag in MOCO. Use when you need to create a reusable label for categorizing entities like projects, deals, companies, etc.

tools.name: Create Task Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new task template in MOCO. Use when you need to define a reusable task template for projects.

tools.name: Create Unit
tools.description: Tool to create a new unit/team in MOCO. Use when you need to provision a new organizational unit.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new staff member/user in MOCO. Use when you need to add a new employee or team member to the system. Requires firstname, lastname, email, and unit_id (team assignment). Optionally set password, role permissions, language preference, contact details, and whether to send a welcome email.

tools.name: Create Users Presences
tools.description: Tool to create a presence entry (work time tracking) in MOCO. Use when you need to record work hours or home office days. The presence is created for the user that the API key belongs to.

tools.name: Toggle User Presence
tools.description: Tool to toggle user presence (clock in/out) in MOCO. First call creates a new presence starting from current time, second call closes the previous open presence. Use when implementing a clock system or time tracking system.

tools.name: Create Work Time Adjustment
tools.description: Tool to create a new work time adjustment in MOCO. Use when you need to add or subtract hours from a user's work time balance (e.g., overtime compensation, vacation corrections).

tools.name: Deactivate Offer Customer Approval
tools.description: Tool to deactivate a customer approval on an offer to prevent access and signing. Use when you need to revoke customer approval access for an offer.

tools.name: List Deal Categories
tools.description: Retrieves all deal categories configured in MOCO with their IDs, names, probabilities, and timestamps. Deal categories represent stages in a sales pipeline (e.g., "Contact", "Create quote", "Negotiation") and include probability percentages (0-100) indicating the likelihood of winning at each stage. Use this action to: - Get available category IDs for creating or updating deals - Understand the sales pipeline stages configured in the system - View probability percentages associated with each stage No parameters required - returns all categories in the system.

tools.name: Delete Deal
tools.description: Tool to delete a deal. Use when you have identified an obsolete or unwanted deal and confirmed its deletion. Example: "Delete the deal with id 123."

tools.name: Get Deal
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific deal/lead by its ID from MOCO. Returns complete deal data including status, monetary value, associated company/person, category, and timestamps. Use this when you need to get full details about a specific deal that you already have the ID for.

tools.name: List Deals
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all deals (leads). Use when you need an overview of deals filtered by status, tags, date range, or associated company.

tools.name: Update Deal
tools.description: Tool to update an existing deal. Use when you need to modify one or more fields of a deal after retrieving its details.

tools.name: Delete Catalog Service
tools.description: Tool to delete a catalog service. Use when you need to remove a catalog service from MOCO after confirming it is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Account Custom Property
tools.description: Tool to delete a custom property in MOCO. Use when you need to permanently remove a custom field definition from an entity type.

tools.name: Delete Expense Template
tools.description: Tool to delete an expense template. Use when you need to remove an expense template from MOCO after confirming it is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Catalog Service Item
tools.description: Tool to delete an item from a catalog service. Use when you need to remove a specific item from a catalog service by providing both the service ID and item ID.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Tool to delete a manually created comment. Use when you need to remove a comment that was created by a user (not system-generated).

tools.name: Delete Contact Person
tools.description: Tool to delete a contact person in MOCO. Use when you need to remove a contact person from the system after confirming they are no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Deal Category
tools.description: Tool to delete a deal category. Use when you need to remove an unused or obsolete deal category from MOCO. Note: deletion will fail with 403 Forbidden if the category is still in use by any deals.

tools.name: Delete Invoice
tools.description: Tool to delete a single invoice. Use when you need to remove an invoice from MOCO. Note: 'reason' is mandatory for non-draft invoices but optional for draft invoices.

tools.name: Delete Invoice Payment
tools.description: Tool to delete an invoice payment. Use when you need to remove an invoice payment record from MOCO.

tools.name: Delete Offers Attachments
tools.description: Tool to remove an attachment from an offer. Use when you need to delete a specific attachment by its ID from a given offer.

tools.name: Delete Presence
tools.description: Tool to delete a presence entry. Use when you need to remove a specific presence record from the system. Example: "Delete the presence entry with id 22018495."

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Tool to delete a project. Use when you need to permanently remove a project from MOCO. Deletion is only possible if the project has no associated activities, invoices, offers, or expenses.

tools.name: Delete Project Staff Assignment
tools.description: Tool to delete a staff assignment (contract) from a project. Use when removing a staff member from a project. Note: deletion is only possible if no hours have been tracked by this person.

tools.name: Delete Project Expense
tools.description: Tool to delete an additional services entry on a project. Use when you need to remove an expense that has not yet been billed. Deletion is only possible for unbilled expenses.

tools.name: Delete Project Payment Schedule
tools.description: Tool to delete a payment schedule from a project. Use when you need to remove a scheduled payment milestone from an existing project.

tools.name: Delete Project Recurring Expense
tools.description: Tool to delete a recurring expense from a project. Use when you need to remove a periodic billing entry for services like hosting or maintenance contracts.

tools.name: Delete Project Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific task from a project. Deletion is only possible if no hours were tracked on the task. Use when you need to remove a single task that has no time entries.

tools.name: Delete All Project Tasks
tools.description: Tool to bulk delete all deletable tasks on a project. Tasks with tracked hours cannot be deleted and will be automatically skipped without causing errors. Use when you need to clear all removable tasks from a project.

tools.name: Delete Purchase
tools.description: Tool to delete a purchase. Use when you need to remove a purchase record that is in 'pending' status and has no registered payments.

tools.name: Delete Purchase Payment
tools.description: Tool to delete a purchase payment. Use when you need to remove a payment record from a purchase.

tools.name: Delete Schedule
tools.description: Tool to delete a schedule entry (absence). Use when you need to remove a scheduled absence such as holidays, sick days, or other time off entries that are no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag in MOCO. Use when you need to remove a tag and optionally merge it with another tag.

tools.name: Delete Taggings
tools.description: Tool to selectively remove tags from an entity. Use when you need to remove specific tags from a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user from MOCO. Use when you need to permanently remove a user account that has no billed hours. Users with billed hours cannot be deleted and must be archived instead by updating them with active=false.

tools.name: Delete Employment
tools.description: Tool to delete an employment (weekly work model) for a user. Use when you need to remove an employment record after confirming it is no longer needed.

tools.name: Disable Project Share
tools.description: Tool to deactivate project report sharing. Use when you need to disable public access to a project's report by removing the sharing URL.

tools.name: Mark Project Expenses as Billed
tools.description: Tool to mark project expense entries as already billed. Use when you need to disregard specific expenses from billing because they were courtesy services or handled outside the normal billing process.

tools.name: Get Catalog Service Item
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific item within a catalog service in MOCO. Use when you need to get details about a specific catalog service item by its ID.

tools.name: Get Account Fixed Costs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all fixed costs from the account. Use when you need to view recurring monthly costs like rent, subscriptions, or other fixed expenses. Fixed costs show historical and planned monthly cost data organized by year and month.

tools.name: Get Cashflow Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the cashflow report from MOCO. Use when you need to view cash inflows and outflows over a specific period. This report provides a chronological view of all financial transactions including invoices created, payments received, expenses, and other cashflow events. Each entry shows the amount, date, associated company, user, and transaction type. Useful for financial analysis, cash position tracking, and understanding the timing of revenue and expenses.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single comment by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific comment after confirming the comment ID.

tools.name: Get Company
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single company by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to get complete details about a specific company including contact information, billing settings, and associated projects.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific contact person by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to get full details about a specific contact that you already have the ID for.

tools.name: Get Custom Property
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single custom property by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific custom property after obtaining its ID.

tools.name: Get Deal Category
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single deal category by ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific deal category in the MOCO sales pipeline.

tools.name: Get Employment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single employment (weekly work model) by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific employment after confirming the employment ID.

tools.name: Get Holiday
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single holiday entry by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific holiday allocation after confirming the holiday ID.

tools.name: Get Internal Hourly Rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all internal hourly rates from the account. Use when you need to view staff costs, budget planning, or analyze team rates over time. Returns user IDs, names, and their hourly rates organized by year.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single invoice by ID with full details including items, payments, and reminders. Use when you have an invoice ID and need complete invoice information.

tools.name: Get Invoice Bookkeeping Export
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single invoice bookkeeping export by ID. Use when you need to get details about a specific bookkeeping export that you already have the ID for.

tools.name: Get Invoice Payment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single invoice payment by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific payment record after confirming the payment ID.

tools.name: Get Invoice Reminder
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single invoice reminder by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific invoice reminder after confirming the reminder ID.

tools.name: Get Invoice Reminders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all invoice reminders. Use when you need to view reminders, optionally filtered by invoice ID or date range.

tools.name: Get Invoice Bookkeeping Exports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all invoice bookkeeping exports. Use when you need to view existing invoice bookkeeping exports for accounting purposes.

tools.name: Get Invoice Expenses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all expenses that were invoiced in a particular invoice. Use when you need to see which expense items are associated with a specific invoice.

tools.name: Get Locked Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all locked invoices. Use when you need to access invoices that have been finalized and locked for editing, optionally filtered by status, date range, or identifier.

tools.name: Get Invoice Payments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all invoice payments. Use when you need to view payment records, optionally filtered by invoice or date range.

tools.name: Get Invoice Timesheet
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a time sheet for a particular invoice, i.e. all activities that were invoiced. Use when you need to see the detailed list of activities billed in a specific invoice.

tools.name: Get Offer Customer Approval
tools.description: Tool to retrieve customer approval status and URL for an offer. Use when you need to check if customer approval is activated and get approval URLs for an offer.

tools.name: Get Offer PDF
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single offer document as PDF. Use when you need to download an offer in PDF format for sharing or archiving.

tools.name: Get Presence
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single presence entry by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific work time tracking record after confirming the presence ID.

tools.name: Get Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current authenticated user's profile. Use when you need to get information about the API key owner or impersonated user.

tools.name: Get Project Contract
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single staff assignment (contract) on a project. Use when you need details about a specific person's assignment to a project, including their billable status, budget, and hourly rate.

tools.name: Get Single Project Expense
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single additional service (expense) for a project. Use when you need detailed information about a specific project expense entry.

tools.name: Get Project Payment Schedules By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all payment schedules for a specific project by its ID. Use when you need to view scheduled payment milestones for a particular project, optionally filtered by date range or checked status.

tools.name: Get Project Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a project report with budget, hours, costs, and business indicators. Use when you need financial and time tracking metrics for a specific project after confirming the project ID.

tools.name: Get Project Expenses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all additional services (expenses) for a project. Use when you need to view project costs, track billable expenses, or analyze project spending.

tools.name: Get Projects Payment Schedules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all payment schedules for fixed price projects. Use when you need an overview of payment schedules, optionally filtered by date range, project, or company.

tools.name: Get Project Payment Schedule
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single payment schedule entry for a project by its ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific payment schedule milestone.

tools.name: Get Project Recurring Expenses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all recurring expenses for a specific project. Use when you need to view periodic billing items like hosting, maintenance contracts, or support services associated with a project.

tools.name: Get Project Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single task on a project by project ID and task ID. Use when you need detailed information about a specific task within a project, including billing rates, budget allocation, and revenue categorization.

tools.name: Get Purchase
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single purchase by ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific purchase including items, payments, and supplier details.

tools.name: Get Purchase Bookkeeping Export
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single purchase bookkeeping export by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific bookkeeping export after confirming the export ID.

tools.name: Get Purchase Payment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single purchase payment by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific purchase payment after confirming the payment ID.

tools.name: Get Purchase Bookkeeping Exports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all purchase bookkeeping exports. Use when you need to view existing purchase bookkeeping exports for accounting purposes.

tools.name: Get Purchase Budgets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve purchase budgets for a given fiscal year. Use when you need to check budget allocations, spending status, or remaining funds for purchases.

tools.name: Get Purchase Payments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all purchase payments. Use when you need an overview of payments made for purchases, optionally filtered by purchase ID or date range.

tools.name: Get Receipt
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single receipt by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to fetch complete details for a specific receipt including items, VAT information, project association, and refund status.

tools.name: Get Receipts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of receipts (expense receipts) from MOCO. Receipts are records of expenses that can be allocated to projects and submitted for refund requests. Use this tool to: - Get all receipts within a date range - Find receipts by user, project, or purchase category - Filter by refund request submission status - Search for receipts by refund request ID Returns a list with detailed information about each receipt including the associated project, items with VAT details, refund request status, and user information.

tools.name: Get All Recurring Expenses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all recurring additional services entries across all projects in MOCO. Use when you need to view all periodic billing items like hosting, maintenance contracts, or support services globally across the account.

tools.name: Get Report Absences
tools.description: Tool to retrieve absence report showing employee absences by type and date range. Returns vacation days (total, used, planned) and sick days per user for the specified period.

tools.name: Get Finance Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the finance report from MOCO. Use when you need financial data including income and expenses with associated companies and users. Returns an array of financial records that can be filtered by date range (from/to) or text search term. Each record includes transaction details, amounts in account currency, and associated company/user information.

tools.name: Get Utilization Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the utilization report from MOCO. The utilization report shows how employees spend their time, breaking down billable versus unbillable hours for each user across a date range. Use this tool to: - Analyze team utilization and productivity over a period - Calculate billable vs. unbillable time ratios for employees - Identify under-utilized or over-worked team members - Generate reports for resource planning and capacity management - Track how much time is being charged to clients versus internal work Both from_date and to_date parameters are required to define the reporting period.

tools.name: Get Schedule
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single planning entry (schedule) by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific schedule entry.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single tag by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific tag after confirming the tag ID.

tools.name: Get Taggings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of tags associated with an entity. Use when you need to fetch tags for a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of tags from MOCO. Tags are reusable labels for categorizing entities like projects, deals, companies, contacts, invoices, offers, purchases, and users. Use this tool to: - Get all available tags across all entity types - Filter tags by specific entity context (e.g., only Project tags) - Find tags for tagging/categorizing records

tools.name: Get Task Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single task template by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific task template after confirming the template ID.

tools.name: Get Unit
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single unit/team by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific team/organizational unit including its name and assigned staff members.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information for a specific user/staff member by ID. Returns complete user profile including contact info, status, role, unit, tags, and custom properties. Use when you need details about a specific team member after obtaining their ID (e.g., from MOCO_USERS_LIST).

tools.name: Get User Performance Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's performance report comparing tracked hours vs target hours. Returns annual summary and monthly breakdown showing variations between actual tracked hours and expected target hours. Use when you need to analyze work performance, track hour completion, or identify under/over-worked periods.

tools.name: Get VAT Code Purchase
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single VAT code for purchases by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific VAT code purchase configuration, including tax rate, reverse charge settings, and intra-EU status.

tools.name: Get VAT Code Purchases
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of purchase VAT codes. Use when you need to fetch available VAT codes for purchases, check tax rates, or filter by reverse charge or intra-EU status.

tools.name: Get VAT Code Sale
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single VAT code for sales by ID from MOCO. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific VAT code sales configuration, including tax rate, reverse charge settings, intra-EU status, and tax exemption notices.

tools.name: Get VAT Code Sales
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of sale VAT codes from MOCO. Use when you need VAT/tax code information for sales transactions, including tax rates, active status, and exemption notices.

tools.name: Get Work Time Adjustment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single work time adjustment by ID. Use when you need to fetch details for a specific work time adjustment after confirming the adjustment ID.

tools.name: Create Invoice
tools.description: Tool to create a new invoice. Use after gathering complete invoice data (customer, dates, items, etc.).

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all invoices. Use when you need an overview of invoices, optionally filtered by status, date range, or client.

tools.name: List All Project Expenses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all project expenses across all projects. Use when you need to analyze expenses company-wide, generate expense reports, or track spending across multiple projects.

tools.name: List Assigned Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all projects assigned to the authenticated user. Use when you need to see which projects the current user is assigned to, optionally filtered by active status.

tools.name: List Catalog Services
tools.description: List all catalog services (Leistungskatalog) from the account. Returns an array of services with nested items including pricing, quantities, and revenue categories. Use when you need to retrieve predefined service templates or catalog offerings.

tools.name: List Companies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all companies (customers and suppliers). Use when you need to list companies optionally filtered by type, search term, or archived status.

tools.name: List Custom Properties
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom properties from MOCO. Use when you need to get the list of available custom fields configured for different entity types (e.g., Projects, Deals, Companies).

tools.name: List Employments
tools.description: Retrieve all user employments from MOCO. Employments define weekly work models (target hours and work patterns) for users. Use to get employment schedules, check user availability, or filter by date range to find active employments during specific periods.

tools.name: List Expense Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all expense templates from MOCO. Use when you need to view available expense templates for creating project expenses or generating invoices.

tools.name: List Holidays
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user holidays/vacation entries from MOCO. Use when you need to list holiday allocations, check vacation entitlements, or filter holidays by year or user.

tools.name: List Hourly Rates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all hourly rates from MOCO. Use when you need to get default rates, task-specific rates, or user-specific rates. Can optionally filter by company to get customer-specific rates.

tools.name: List Invoice Attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attachments for an invoice. Use when you need to see files attached to a specific invoice.

tools.name: List Offer Attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attachments for a specific offer. Use when you need to view or list all files attached to an offer.

tools.name: List Presences
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user presences (attendance entries) from MOCO. Use when you need to get work attendance records, track office vs home office days, or filter presence entries by date range or user.

tools.name: List Project Contracts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all contracts (assigned staff) for a project. Use when you need to see which staff members are assigned to a specific project and their billing details.

tools.name: List Project Groups
tools.description: Retrieve all project groups from MOCO. Use when you need to view grouped projects, analyze project portfolios by company or user, or get aggregated budget information across multiple projects.

tools.name: List Project Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all tasks (services) for a project by project ID. Use when you need to see all available tasks within a project for activity tracking, budgeting, or billing purposes.

tools.name: List Purchase Categories
tools.description: Retrieves all purchase categories configured in MOCO with their IDs, names, account codes, and status. Purchase categories are used to classify expenses and purchases in the system (e.g., "Travel expenses", "Office supplies"). Each category includes an associated credit account code for bookkeeping. Use this action to: - Get available category IDs for creating or categorizing purchases - View all expense categories configured in the system - Check which categories are active or inactive

tools.name: List Purchase Drafts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all purchase drafts (German: Ausgaben – Entwürfe). Use when you need to view all draft purchases that have been created but not yet finalized.

tools.name: List Purchases
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all purchases (supplier invoices). Use when you need an overview of expenses, optionally filtered by status, date range, or supplier.

tools.name: List Schedules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all absences (schedules) from MOCO. Schedules track employee time off including holidays, sick days, and other absences. Use when you need to view team availability, check planned absences, or track vacation days.

tools.name: List Task Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all task templates from MOCO. Use when you need to get available task templates for creating project tasks or understanding task categories.

tools.name: List Units
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all units/teams in MOCO. Use when you need to list organizational units/teams or find unit IDs for assignments.

tools.name: List User Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user permission roles in MOCO. Returns role IDs, names, and permission settings for various modules. Use when you need to check available roles for user assignment or review permission configurations.

tools.name: List Work Time Adjustments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user work time adjustments from MOCO. Use when you need to view hours added or subtracted from users' work time balances (e.g., overtime compensation, vacation corrections).

tools.name: Get Offer
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single offer by ID. Use when you have an offer ID and need detailed offer information. Use after confirming the offer ID.

tools.name: List Offers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all offers. Use when you need an overview of offers filtered by status, date range, or identifiers.

tools.name: Patch Taggings
tools.description: Tool to partially update taggings by adding new tags to an entity without removing existing tags. Use when you need to append tags to a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User while preserving existing tags.

tools.name: List Planning Entries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all planning entries. Use when you need an overview of planned hours filtered by period, user, or project.

tools.name: Create Planning Entry
tools.description: Tool to create a new planning entry. Use when you need to allocate working hours to a project or deal.

tools.name: Get Planning Entry
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single planning entry by ID. Use when you need detailed information for a specific planning entry after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new project in MOCO. Use when you need to provision a project with validated parameters.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a specific project by its ID. Returns complete project information including budget, billing details, dates, assigned tasks, team members, and customer information. Use this action when you need detailed information about a specific project after obtaining its ID (e.g., from MOCO_PROJECTS_LIST).

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all projects. Use when you need an overview of projects optionally filtered by company, leader, date range, or tags after confirming criteria.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing project. Use when you need to modify project details after confirming the project ID.

tools.name: Create Purchase
tools.description: Tool to create a new purchase. Use when you need to log an expense record after gathering date, items, and payment info.

tools.name: Send Invoice by Email
tools.description: Tool to send an invoice by email. Use when you need to email an invoice to a customer with custom subject and message.

tools.name: Send Invoice Reminder Email
tools.description: Tool to send an invoice reminder by email. Use when you need to email a payment reminder to a customer for an overdue invoice.

tools.name: Send Offer Email
tools.description: Tool to send an offer by email to specified recipients. Use when you need to email an offer to clients or contacts with custom subject and message.

tools.name: Share Project
tools.description: Tool to activate project report sharing and get a shareable URL. Use when you need to enable public access to a project's report.

tools.name: Start Activity Timer
tools.description: Tool to start or continue a timer on an activity. Use when you need to track time on a specific activity in real-time. The activity must be from the current day, and only one timer can be running at a time per user.

tools.name: Stop Activity Timer
tools.description: Tool to stop a timer running on an activity. Use when you need to end time tracking for a currently running activity timer.

tools.name: Unassign Project from Project Group
tools.description: Tool to unassign a project from its project group. Use when you need to remove a project's association with its current project group.

tools.name: Update Account Catalog Service
tools.description: Tool to update a catalog service. Use when you need to modify the title of an existing catalog service entry. Note: Items cannot be updated via this endpoint; use separate item endpoints.

tools.name: Update Catalog Service Item
tools.description: Tool to update an existing item within a catalog service in MOCO. Use when you need to modify details of a catalog service item such as title, quantity, or pricing.

tools.name: Update Account Custom Properties
tools.description: Tool to update a custom property in MOCO. Use when you need to modify name, placeholder, print settings, or notification options for an existing custom property. Note: kind and entity fields cannot be changed.

tools.name: Update Expense Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing expense template in MOCO. Use when you need to modify pricing, description, or other details of a reusable expense item.

tools.name: Update Account Internal Hourly Rates
tools.description: Tool to update internal hourly rates for one or more users for a specific year. Use when you need to set or modify staff cost rates for budgeting and financial planning purposes.

tools.name: Update Comment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing comment on a MOCO resource. Use when you need to modify the text or attachment of a manually created comment.

tools.name: Update Company
tools.description: Tool to update an existing company. Use when you need to modify one or more fields of a company after retrieving its details.

tools.name: Update Contact Person
tools.description: Tool to update an existing contact person in MOCO. Use when you need to modify one or more fields of a contact after retrieving its details.

tools.name: Update Deal Category
tools.description: Tool to update an existing deal category in MOCO. Use when you need to modify the name or probability of a deal category.

tools.name: Update Holiday
tools.description: Tool to update an existing holiday entry in MOCO. Use this to modify annual leave days, vacation allowances, or other holiday entitlements for specific users and years.

tools.name: Update Invoice Status
tools.description: Tool to update an invoice status. Use when you need to change the status of an existing invoice. Only works for actual invoices, not invoice drafts.

tools.name: Update Offer Status
tools.description: Tool to update the status of an offer. Use when you need to change an offer's status (e.g., from created to sent, or sent to accepted).

tools.name: Update Planning Entry
tools.description: Tool to update an existing planning entry. Use when you need to modify hours, dates, or other details of a planning allocation after confirming the entry exists.

tools.name: Update Presence
tools.description: Tool to update a presence entry (work time tracking) in MOCO. Use when you need to modify existing work hours, dates, or home office status for a specific presence record.

tools.name: Archive Project
tools.description: Tool to archive a project in MOCO. Use when you need to archive a project without deleting it.

tools.name: Update Project Contract
tools.description: Tool to update a staff assignment to a project. Use when you need to modify budget, hourly rate, or active/billable status of an existing assignment.

tools.name: Update Project Expense
tools.description: Tool to update an additional services entry (expense) on a project. Use when you need to modify existing project expenses like hosting costs or external services. Updates are only possible for expenses that have not yet been billed.

tools.name: Update Project Payment Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update a payment schedule entry for a project. Use when you need to modify an existing scheduled payment milestone for a project.

tools.name: Update Project Recurring Expense
tools.description: Tool to update a recurring additional services entry on a project. Use when you need to modify details of an existing recurring expense after confirming both the project ID and recurring expense ID. Note: start_date and period cannot be modified after creation.

tools.name: Update Project Task
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task on a project in MOCO. Use when you need to modify task details such as budget, hourly rate, billability, or description after the task has been created.

tools.name: Unarchive Project
tools.description: Tool to reactivate an archived project. Use when you need to restore a previously archived project to active status.

tools.name: Update Purchase
tools.description: Tool to update an existing purchase. Use when you need to modify purchase details after confirming the purchase ID.

tools.name: Update Purchase Document
tools.description: Tool to update or store a purchase document. Use when you need to attach a document file to an existing purchase or replace an existing document. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data format.

tools.name: Update Purchase Status
tools.description: Tool to update the status of a purchase. Use when you need to change a purchase status between pending and archived.

tools.name: Update Receipt
tools.description: Tool to update an existing receipt. Use when you need to modify receipt details such as title, currency, or line items after confirming the receipt exists.

tools.name: Update Schedule
tools.description: Tool to update a planning entry (absence/schedule). Use when you need to modify existing absences such as holidays, sick days, or other time off.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Tool to update an existing tag in MOCO. Use when you need to change a tag's name or color.

tools.name: Update Taggings
tools.description: Tool to replace all tags associated with an entity. Use when you need to set the complete tag list for a Company, Contact, Project, Deal, Purchase, Invoice, Offer, or User. This operation replaces all existing tags with the provided list.

tools.name: Update Task Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing task template in MOCO. Use when you need to modify the properties of an existing task template.

tools.name: Update Unit
tools.description: Tool to update an existing unit/team. Use when you need to modify unit details after confirming the unit ID.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing staff member/user in MOCO. Use when you need to modify user information such as contact details, role, status, or team assignment. Note that a related employment must be terminated separately through the employment endpoint.

tools.name: Update User Employment
tools.description: Tool to update a user employment record. Use when you need to modify work hours patterns, employment dates, or user assignment for an existing employment.

tools.name: Update Work Time Adjustment
tools.description: Tool to update an existing work time adjustment in MOCO. Use when you need to modify details of a previously created work time adjustment (e.g., changing hours, description, or date).

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List all users in MOCO with optional filters. Returns user IDs, names, contact info, tags, and status. Useful for getting user/staff IDs for assignments, finding team members by tags, or checking user availability.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The subdomain of your MOCO account, used to construct the base URL for API requests.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the MOCO API.

name: Modelry
description: Modelry is a 3D visualization platform for eCommerce that creates custom 3D product models, AR experiences, and digital asset management.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Create a new workspace or return an existing one with the same name. Workspaces are used to organize products and embeds in Modelry. If workspace creation is not supported by the API, this tool will return an existing workspace matching the requested name.

tools.name: Delete Modelry Embed
tools.description: Tool to delete an embed. Tries multiple common endpoint patterns and treats 404 as idempotent success after exhausting candidates (embed already deleted or not found).

tools.name: Delete Modelry Product
tools.description: Permanently deletes a product from Modelry by its ID. Use this action to remove a product that is no longer needed. This operation is idempotent - deleting an already-deleted product will succeed without error. Prerequisites: - Obtain the product ID using MODELRY_LIST_PRODUCTS first - Ensure you have delete permissions for the product WARNING: This action is destructive and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Product Repository
tools.description: Permanently delete a product repository from Modelry. This action is idempotent - deleting a non-existent repository returns success. Use the list product repositories action first to get valid repository IDs.

tools.name: Delete Modelry Workspace
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Modelry workspace. This action is idempotent - deleting a non-existent workspace will return success. Use the list workspaces action first to get valid workspace IDs. WARNING: This is a destructive action that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Get Embed
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific Modelry embed (3D viewer or AR experience for eCommerce). Use MODELRY_LIST_EMBEDS first to obtain valid embed IDs. Returns embed metadata including status, workspace, and configuration details.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Retrieves details for a specific Modelry workspace by its ID or name. The workspace ID can be obtained from the List Workspaces action. This action fetches all workspaces and returns the matching one.

tools.name: List Embeds
tools.description: List embeds in Modelry. Embeds are 3D viewer/AR embed codes for products. Use to retrieve embed IDs for downstream actions (e.g., MODELRY_GET_EMBED, MODELRY_DELETE_EMBED). Returns empty list if no embeds exist. Supports pagination and optional workspace filtering.

tools.name: List Modeling Requests
tools.description: List all 3D modeling requests in a workspace. Requires workspace_id to scope the request. Returns modeling requests with their status and metadata.

tools.name: List Product Repositories
tools.description: Tool to list all product repositories in a workspace. Use after confirming the workspace ID.

tools.name: List Modelry Products
tools.description: List all products in Modelry. Returns paginated product data including IDs, names, and metadata. Use this to retrieve product IDs needed for other product-related actions like delete or get details. Optionally scope to a specific workspace using workspace_id parameter.

tools.name: List Modelry Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to list all workspaces in Modelry. Use when you need to retrieve available workspaces after authenticating.

tools.name: Order Modeling Service
tools.description: Tool to place an order for 3D modeling services. Use when workspace and product IDs are known and modeling specifications are ready.

tools.name: Track Modeling Progress
tools.description: Tool to track the progress of a 3D modeling request. Use after initiating a modeling job to poll current status and completion percentage.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the Modelry API.

name: Modem
description: Modem turns customer conversations into structured topics, people, and company insights for analysis and workflow automation.

tools.name: Add People to Company
tools.description: Associate one or more existing people with an existing company. People already associated with the company are reported as skipped. This changes company membership, and the approved API surface has no inverse removal operation.

tools.name: Create Companies
tools.description: Create one to 50 companies in one batch. Each item succeeds or fails independently; use a one-item array to create one company.

tools.name: Create People
tools.description: Create one to 50 people in one batch. Each item succeeds or fails independently; use a one-item array to create one person.

tools.name: Get Channel
tools.description: Get one channel's source details, connection state, context, timestamps, and message count by UUID.

tools.name: Get Company
tools.description: Get one company's core details, connection values, domain, logo, and VIP status by decimal ID.

tools.name: Get Company Activity
tools.description: Get one company's message count, weekly activity series, and source-level message breakdown.

tools.name: Get Company History
tools.description: Get up to 50 company audit records plus merge history. The API reports the total audit count but exposes no cursor or page parameter, so this tool cannot retrieve records beyond the requested limit.

tools.name: Get Company Identities
tools.description: Get external platform identities linked to one company by Modem's identify operation.

tools.name: Get Current Organization
tools.description: Return the organization selected by the connected API key. Use this as an authentication smoke test and to confirm the active tenant; it returns no member, credential, or plan details.

tools.name: Get Person

tools.name: Get Person History
tools.description: Get up to 50 person audit records plus merge history. The API reports the total audit count but exposes no cursor or page parameter, so this tool cannot retrieve records beyond the requested limit.

tools.name: Get Person Identities

tools.name: Get Person Source Stats

tools.name: Get Topic
tools.description: Get one topic's complete details, including its summary, classification, lifecycle, priority, keywords, time range, archive state, and event count.

tools.name: Get Topic Groups
tools.description: Get every message group assigned to one topic in ascending or descending group-time order. Modem does not paginate or limit this endpoint, so topics with many deeply nested messages can return a large response.

tools.name: Get Topic History
tools.description: Get up to 50 topic audit records plus action and merge history. The API reports the total audit count but exposes no cursor or page parameter, so this tool cannot retrieve audit records beyond the requested limit.

tools.name: Get Topic People
tools.description: Get every unique person who participated in one topic, including source identities, company, profile, VIP state, and contribution count.

tools.name: Identify External Records
tools.description: Upsert links from external platform records to Modem people and companies in batches of 50. Modem matches platform identities before natural keys, can create records only from the documented creation fields, links resolved memberships, and reports probable duplicate conflicts without merging them.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: List organization channels with connection state and message counts, optionally filtered by source, name, or channel IDs.

tools.name: List Companies
tools.description: List companies with person and message aggregates, optionally searching and sorting the result. Returns one page and an opaque continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: List message groups for exactly one company or one person, returning compact message content and topic context one page at a time.

tools.name: List People

tools.name: List and Search Topics
tools.description: List or search topics by keywords or semantic meaning with organization, participant, source, status, date, and classification filters, one page at a time. Semantic search takes precedence when both search modes are supplied.

tools.name: Merge Companies Irreversibly
tools.description: Irreversibly merge one or more source companies into one surviving target. All domains, person associations, and Slack workspaces move to the target, and source records cannot be restored by this API. Requires explicit confirm_irreversible=true. Supply an Idempotency-Key when retrying the same merge to avoid applying it twice.

tools.name: Merge People Irreversibly
tools.description: Irreversibly merge one or more source people into one surviving target. All identities, emails, and company associations move to the target, and source records cannot be restored by this API. Requires explicit confirm_irreversible=true. Supply an Idempotency-Key when retrying the same merge to avoid applying it twice.

tools.name: Merge Topics Irreversibly
tools.description: Irreversibly merge 1 to 50 source topics into one surviving target. Modem archives and marks every source as merged, then copies their group and event associations to the target; this API cannot undo the merge. Requires explicit confirm_irreversible=true. Supply an Idempotency-Key when retrying an identical merge to avoid applying it twice.

tools.name: Update Companies
tools.description: Update one to 50 companies in one batch. Omitted fields remain unchanged, explicit null values clear nullable fields, and each item reports success independently.

tools.name: Update People
tools.description: Update one to 50 people in one batch. Omitted fields remain unchanged, explicit null values clear nullable fields, and each item reports success independently.

tools.name: Update Topic
tools.description: Update one topic's priority, lifecycle, issue type, complete keyword list, or archive state. Omitted fields remain unchanged; issue_type=null clears the classification.

tools.name: Update Topics
tools.description: Set priority or archive state for one to 100 topics at once. Provide at least one change, use archived=false to unarchive, and provide an archive reason only with archived=true.

name: MoltSets
description: MoltSets provides people and company search, profile enrichment, email and mobile discovery, advertising identity resolution, and account usage data.

tools.name: Enrich LinkedIn Profile
tools.description: Resolve a LinkedIn profile URL into a sparse full person and company profile, optionally including experience. A found result is billable against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens, misses do not, and every call counts as a request. Results can contain sensitive personal contact data and identity hashes; personal-email or SHA-256 fields may be omitted by plan restrictions while the lookup still succeeds. A status of not_found is a successful lookup miss.

tools.name: Find Best Email by LinkedIn
tools.description: Find the best validated email for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100, preferring business email and falling back to sensitive personal email. Each item counts against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens and misses do not. HTTP 200 may represent not_found or a partial batch, so retry only items omitted from a partial response.

tools.name: Find Best US Personal Email by LinkedIn
tools.description: Find the highest-confidence validated sensitive personal email for one US LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100. Use this instead of the standard US personal-email selector when provider-ranked highest-confidence selection is required. This billable endpoint is capability-gated: first call GET_ACCOUNT and require personal_email_available=true, otherwise MoltSets returns 403 plan_restricted. Each item counts against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens and misses do not. Non-US profiles return HTTP 200 not_found. HTTP 200 may also contain a partial batch, so retry only omitted items.

tools.name: Find Business Email by LinkedIn
tools.description: Find a validated corporate email, without personal-email fallback, for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100. Each item counts against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens and misses do not. risk_score describes deliverability, not identity confidence. HTTP 200 may represent not_found or a partial batch, so retry only items omitted from a partial response.

tools.name: Find Business Email by Name
tools.description: Find a validated business email and matched LinkedIn URL from a person's name and company/domain. This is billed against Search Fair Use only when an email is found; every call still counts as a request. risk_score describes deliverability, not identity confidence, and a miss is HTTP 200 status=not_found.

tools.name: Find Business Profile by Name
tools.description: Find a sparse full person and company profile from a person's name and company or domain, optionally including experience. A matched result is billable against Search Fair Use and every call counts as a request. Results can contain sensitive personal contact data and identity hashes; personal-email or SHA-256 fields may be omitted by plan restrictions while the lookup still succeeds. A status of not_found is a successful lookup miss.

tools.name: Find Company by IP
tools.description: Resolve a B2B visitor IPv4 address to associated company domains and provider percentages. A found result is billable against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens, misses do not, and every call counts as a request. Consumer ISP addresses commonly return HTTP 200 status=not_found. Percentages are preserved as provider strings rather than interpreted as numeric confidence values.

tools.name: Find Email Hashes by LinkedIn
tools.description: Retrieve sensitive ad-audience match keys for one LinkedIn profile URL or slug: at most one business and one personal email hash in both SHA256 and MD5 formats. This endpoint does not return multiple hashes or accept batches. It costs one token when data is found; an HTTP 200 not_found costs no tokens but still counts as one Enrichment Fair Use request. The endpoint is unavailable on the $397/month and $997/month plans, which return 403 plan_restricted; retrying or adding tokens does not remove that plan restriction.

tools.name: Find LinkedIn by Email
tools.description: Resolve one email address to the highest-confidence LinkedIn profile URL available from MoltSets. A found record consumes Enrichment Fair Use tokens; a miss consumes no tokens but every call counts as a request. A miss returns HTTP 200 with status=not_found. This lookup does not verify the email address.

tools.name: Find LinkedIn Profile
tools.description: Find matching person or company LinkedIn profiles from a person's name and company/domain. Set count_only=true for a non-fetching match count that consumes no records or tokens but still counts as a Search Fair Use request. Full results consume records and tokens only when found; not-found calls also count as requests. A miss is HTTP 200 status=not_found with an empty result list.

tools.name: Find Mobile Advertising ID by Email
tools.description: Resolve one email address to at most one highly sensitive Mobile Advertising ID (MAID), such as an Android AAID or Apple IDFA, for advertising audience matching and cross-device targeting. This Enrichment lookup is billable when found; misses cost no tokens but still count against the Fair Use request limit. The endpoint is unavailable on the $397 and $997 monthly plans: those plans receive 403 plan_restricted, and retrying or adding tokens does not remove the restriction. A miss returns HTTP 200 with status=not_found and empty or null results. Handle the returned advertising identifier as highly sensitive identity data and use it only with appropriate authorization and privacy controls.

tools.name: Find Mobile Phone by LinkedIn
tools.description: Find sensitive carrier-verified mobile data for one LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100. This requires a paid base plan and a separately billed phone-token subscription; first use GET_ACCOUNT to check phone_token_balance, phone_token_allowance, and phone_plan. Each returned number costs one phone token, while misses cost no phone token; insufficient balance can return 402 or an HTTP 200 partial batch, so retain completed results and retry only dropped items. Results are mobiles only, not landlines or VoIP, but they are not screened against Do Not Call registries. last_validated_at means active and in service on that date, not consent or permission to contact; the caller remains responsible for applicable calling, messaging, privacy, and DNC compliance.

tools.name: Find Personal Email Hash by Business Email
tools.description: Convert one business email into one sensitive SHA-256-hashed personal-email match key for customer-match and paid-advertising audiences. Hashing does not make this identity data non-sensitive. The endpoint does not accept aliases or batches and never returns multiple hashes. A found result consumes Enrichment tokens; a miss costs no tokens but still counts against the Fair Use request limit and returns HTTP 200 with status=not_found. This endpoint is unavailable on the $397/month and $997/month plans: those plans receive 403 plan_restricted, which retrying or adding tokens does not clear.

tools.name: Find US Personal Email by LinkedIn
tools.description: Find a validated sensitive personal email for one US LinkedIn profile or a batch of up to 100. Use this standard selector when provider-ranked highest-confidence selection is not required; use FIND_BEST_US_PERSONAL_EMAIL_BY_LINKEDIN when it is. This billable endpoint is capability-gated: first call GET_ACCOUNT and continue only when personal_email_available is true; otherwise MoltSets returns 403 plan_restricted. Each profile counts against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens and misses do not. A non-US profile is an HTTP 200 not_found. HTTP 200 may also contain a partial batch, so retain completed results and retry only omitted items.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Safely read the connected MoltSets account, plan capabilities, token and phone-token balances, and live Fair Use headroom before paid or plan-restricted discovery. This read is free, consumes no tokens, is excluded from enrichment and search Fair Use, and can also verify the API key.

tools.name: Get Billing
tools.description: Get billing-sensitive plan and subscription dates, token balance, unlimited status, and per-tool token costs. This read-only request is free and excluded from enrichment and search Fair Use; use it to estimate provider token cost before billable discovery calls.

tools.name: Get Usage
tools.description: Get daily and aggregate API calls, tokens, found-data, no-data, and failed counts for today, week, month, or the billing cycle. This read is free and excluded from enrichment and search Fair Use; it exposes account usage but performs no mutation.

tools.name: Reverse Lookup Email
tools.description: Resolve one email or a batch of up to 100 into a sensitive sparse person and business profile, including company firmographics, LinkedIn URLs, confirmed work email, and personal emails on file. Each address counts against Enrichment Fair Use; found records consume tokens and misses do not. HTTP 200 can represent not_found or a partial batch, so retry only omitted items.

tools.name: Search Companies
tools.description: Search ranked companies by name or domain, firmographics, industry, and location. Returned records consume Search Fair Use records and tokens, while every call counts against the request limit; there is no free count-only mode. Returns one offset page. Free accounts can request at most 10 records per page; eligible paid plans can request up to 25. HTTP 200 status=not_found is a successful miss.

tools.name: Search People
tools.description: Search ranked people and current companies with positive and exclusion filters. This is billable against Search Fair Use: returned records consume search records and tokens, every call counts as a request, exclusions apply before billing, and Free accounts can request at most 10 results per page (25 on eligible plans). Returns one offset page and treats status=not_found as a successful empty result.
