name: Notra
description: Create and manage content, AI agents, feedback workflows, and generative engine optimization data with Notra.

tools.name: Approve GEO Content Brief
tools.description: Irreversibly approve a draft or failed brief and queue the paid Notra writer. This claims the brief and books writer work.

tools.name: Cancel Post Schedule
tools.description: Destructively cancel every post destination that has not started and clear failed destinations. A destination already publishing cannot be interrupted; it finishes and is not retried, and in_progress reports this case.

tools.name: Create Agent Session
tools.description: Starts a durable paid AI agent session with an initial user message and returns its session ID. Read subsequent output from the session event stream. This can consume credits and produce unbounded streamed model output; do not retry blindly after an ambiguous failure.

tools.name: Create Chat
tools.description: Create a paid Notra chat, persist the first message, and wait for the full assistant stream. The response is newline-delimited stream text rather than parsed message parts and may run for an unbounded model/tool duration. Limited with chat messages to 30 requests per minute per organization; retrying creates another chat and may repeat tool side effects.

tools.name: Create Event Trigger
tools.description: Creates a persistent GitHub event automation that generates the selected content type for matching releases or pushes and can publish the result automatically. This is a paid operation.

tools.name: Create GEO Project
tools.description: Create a persistent GEO project linked to a brand identity. Requires an active paid plan or positive AI credit balance and a GEO plan.

tools.name: Create GEO Prompt
tools.description: Persist a custom prompt for future GEO scans. Requires paid access and an active GEO plan.

tools.name: Create GEO Scan
tools.description: Irreversibly queue a paid GEO scan that records checks against configured answer engines. The scan record is created before hand-off; poll the returned status URL. Requires sufficient plan or AI credits, rejects concurrent scans with 409, and is limited to 4 requests per hour per organization.

tools.name: Create GEO Sequence
tools.description: Persist a one-to-five-turn GEO prompt sequence for tracked runs. Requires paid GEO access.

tools.name: Create GitHub Integration
tools.description: Connect a GitHub repository to Notra, enabling changelog generation and creating a webhook secret. This paid operation stores a supplied personal access token for private repositories; never pass a token unless required. Limited to 20 requests per minute per API key.

tools.name: Create Post
tools.description: Create a draft or published Notra post directly from supplied content without invoking AI generation.

tools.name: Create Schedule
tools.description: Creates a recurring schedule that generates one content type from the selected GitHub integrations. Times are in UTC. A schedule with the same source, targets, output, and lookback settings as an existing one is rejected with 409. This paid operation creates a persistent recurring automation that may generate and auto-publish content on future runs; review enabled and auto_publish before calling.

tools.name: Create Skill
tools.description: Creates a custom skill. Names must be unique within the organization. This paid operation creates a persistent agent skill.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Create a paid outbound webhook subscription that causes persistent external deliveries. The signing secret is returned only once and must be stored securely.

tools.name: Delete Brand Identity
tools.description: Permanently delete a non-default brand identity and disable every schedule or event trigger that references it. The default identity cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete Event Trigger
tools.description: Delete an event trigger. Permanently delete an event trigger and stop future matching events from running it.

tools.name: Delete GEO Competitor
tools.description: Permanently stop tracking a competitor and return the remaining competitor list.

tools.name: Delete GEO Project
tools.description: Permanently delete a GEO project and cascade-delete its settings, prompts, sequences, competitors, scans, checks, and reports, while cancelling pending scans. Feedback is detached, not deleted. The last project or a project with hosted Sites cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete GEO Prompt
tools.description: Permanently stop tracking a GEO prompt. This destructive change removes it from future scans and requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: Delete GEO Sequence
tools.description: Permanently delete a tracked GEO prompt sequence so it can no longer be run.

tools.name: Delete Integration
tools.description: Permanently delete a Notra GitHub or Linear integration and disable every schedule or event trigger that targets it.

tools.name: Delete Post
tools.description: Permanently delete one Notra post by ID. Use only when the post is no longer needed; this operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Schedule
tools.description: Deletes the schedule and stops future runs. Posts generated by earlier runs are kept. Permanently delete a schedule and stop future runs; posts from previous runs remain.

tools.name: Delete Skill
tools.description: Deletes a custom skill. System skills cannot be deleted. Permanently delete an agent skill.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove a Notra webhook subscription and cancel all deliveries that have not yet been sent.

tools.name: Generate Brand Identity
tools.description: Create a brand identity immediately and queue a paid, irreversible website-analysis job that fills its company, tone, and audience fields. Poll NOTRA_GET_BRAND_IDENTITY_GENERATION; limited to 5 requests per minute per API key.

tools.name: Generate Post
tools.description: Queue a paid, irreversible AI post-generation job. The call consumes plan capacity or credits even if later generation fails. Poll NOTRA_GET_POST_GENERATION until terminal; limited to 10 requests per minute per API key.

tools.name: Get Brand Identity
tools.description: Get one Notra brand identity by ID. A missing identity is represented by a successful response with brand_identity set to null.

tools.name: Get Brand Identity Generation
tools.description: Get a brand identity analysis job. Poll until status is completed or failed, then fetch job.brand_identity_id with NOTRA_GET_BRAND_IDENTITY.

tools.name: Get Chat
tools.description: Get one Notra chat and its complete message history by chat ID.

tools.name: Get Chat By External Channel
tools.description: Find the Notra chat linked to a Discord or Slack channel ID.

tools.name: Get Event Trigger
tools.description: Returns one GitHub event trigger with its event filters, monitored repositories, generated content type, and publishing settings.

tools.name: Get Feedback
tools.description: Returns one feedback entry with its classification, triage status, submission context, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get GEO Agent Readiness
tools.description: Get the latest stored agent-readiness report, any newer run state, score history, and comparison for a GEO project's website without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Competitor Share
tools.description: Read paid-plan competitor share-of-voice metrics without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Competitor Visibility
tools.description: Read one competitor's paid-plan mention history without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Content Brief
tools.description: Read one stored paid-plan GEO content brief without approving or starting writer work.

tools.name: Get GEO Ingest Setup
tools.description: Read paid-plan traffic installation snippets and endpoints. This does not issue or rotate credentials, but deploying the returned setup changes external traffic collection.

tools.name: Get GEO Language Share
tools.description: Read paid-plan GEO visibility by language without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Project
tools.description: Get one GEO project. All GEO endpoints require an active GEO plan.

tools.name: Get GEO Prompt History
tools.description: Read stored paid-plan checks for a tracked prompt without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Prompt Result Detail
tools.description: Read one stored paid-plan prompt result without starting a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Prompt Results
tools.description: Read stored paid-plan prompt answers and grounding data without starting or billing a scan.

tools.name: Get GEO Scan
tools.description: Get one GEO scan's status, progress and mentions by engine, including safe failure metadata. Legacy scans may have null planned totals. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: Get GEO Sentiment
tools.description: Read current and previous paid-plan GEO sentiment metrics without starting billed analysis.

tools.name: Get GEO Sentiment Analysis
tools.description: Read cached paid-plan thematic sentiment analysis. This never starts or bills a model run.

tools.name: Get GEO Settings
tools.description: Get the complete GEO configuration and current scan state for a project. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: Get GEO Traffic Journey
tools.description: Read the paid-plan events in one AI traffic journey without changing tracking setup.

tools.name: Get GEO Traffic Log
tools.description: Read a bounded set of recent paid-plan AI traffic events without changing tracking setup.

tools.name: Get GEO Traffic Overview
tools.description: Get AI crawler, citation, referral, and conversion traffic totals, source breakdowns, and daily points for a GEO project.

tools.name: Get GEO Visibility Overview
tools.description: Get mention rates, checks, citations, visibility, and average positions by answer engine for a GEO project and date window.

tools.name: Get GEO Visibility Timeseries
tools.description: Read paid-plan daily GEO visibility metrics. This does not start a scan or bill an analysis job.

tools.name: Get Post
tools.description: Get one Notra post by ID, including its rendered content, markdown source, metadata, and publication status. A missing post is returned as post=null.

tools.name: Get Post Generation
tools.description: Get a post generation job and event log. Poll until status is completed, failed, or skipped; when completed, fetch job.post_id with NOTRA_GET_POST.

tools.name: Get Post Schedule
tools.description: Get a post's current publishing schedule and the state of every destination, or null when no schedule exists.

tools.name: Get Public API Status
tools.description: Check whether Notra's public API is reachable and discover its authentication metadata without a connected credential.

tools.name: Get Skill
tools.description: Returns a skill by name, including its full instructions and whether it is built into Notra.

tools.name: Get Webhook Delivery
tools.description: Get one Notra webhook delivery, including its serialized payload and complete attempt history.

tools.name: Get Workspace Context
tools.description: Return the workspace and authentication context bound to the connected Notra credential, optionally including pending workspace invitations.

tools.name: Import GEO Competitors
tools.description: Bulk create or update a project's persistent competitor list from up to 2,000 rows or CSV. Existing names are updated rather than duplicated; send the whole list in one request. Paid GEO operation limited to 10 requests per 10 minutes per organization.

tools.name: Import GEO Prompts
tools.description: Bulk-persist up to 500 tracked prompts from rows or CSV. Existing prompts are skipped rather than duplicated. Requires paid GEO access and is limited to 10 requests per 10 minutes per organization.

tools.name: Issue Geo Ingest Token
tools.description: Returns the current tracking token together with the install snippets. Pass `projectId` for a project-specific token; without it, the legacy token only accepts the organization's oldest project's hosts. Issuing does not invalidate previously issued tokens; use rotation for that. Issue a sensitive GEO ingest bearer token. Store the returned token securely and never log or expose it.

tools.name: List Agent Sessions
tools.description: Returns recent agent sessions and their linked chat IDs, origin surfaces, statuses, and timestamps. Results can contain sensitive conversation metadata.

tools.name: List Brand Identities
tools.description: List the workspace's brand identities, with the default first, for selecting brand context in content and GEO workflows.

tools.name: List Chats
tools.description: List the workspace's Notra chat sessions without loading message histories.

tools.name: List Event Triggers
tools.description: Returns the organization's GitHub event triggers, optionally filtered to triggers monitoring any of the supplied repository IDs.

tools.name: List Feedback
tools.description: List workspace feedback with optional triage-status, kind, and project filters.

tools.name: List GEO Changes
tools.description: Compare the two latest stored paid-plan GEO scans without starting a new scan.

tools.name: List GEO Competitors
tools.description: List competitors tracked for a GEO project. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: List GEO Content Briefs
tools.description: List stored paid-plan GEO briefs. This read does not plan, approve, or bill work.

tools.name: List GEO Content Gaps
tools.description: Read paid-plan content opportunities and linked briefs. This does not plan, approve, or bill content work.

tools.name: List GEO Projects
tools.description: List the connected workspace's paid GEO projects and their brand associations.

tools.name: List GEO Prompt Result Summaries
tools.description: Return one bounded page of stored paid-plan prompt result summaries; no scan is started.

tools.name: List GEO Prompts
tools.description: List custom and automatically derived prompts tracked for a GEO project. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: List GEO Scans
tools.description: List paginated GEO scans with planned, completed, mentioned, and failed check totals by engine plus safe failure metadata. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: List GEO Sentiment Evidence
tools.description: Return one bounded page of stored paid-plan sentiment evidence without starting analysis.

tools.name: List GEO Sequences
tools.description: List tracked multi-turn GEO prompt sequences. Requires an active GEO plan.

tools.name: List GEO Shelf Sources
tools.description: Return one bounded page of paid-plan cited and tracked GEO sources without starting a scan.

tools.name: List GEO Traffic Journeys
tools.description: List a bounded set of paid-plan AI traffic journeys without changing tracking setup.

tools.name: List GEO Traffic Pages
tools.description: List a bounded paid-plan ranking of pages visited by AI traffic without changing tracking setup.

tools.name: List Integrations
tools.description: List enabled GitHub and Linear integrations and their IDs for use as Notra content-generation sources. The Slack list is always empty.

tools.name: List Post Authors
tools.description: List Notra post authors and their IDs for assigning authors to blog posts and changelogs.

tools.name: List Posts
tools.description: List the connected workspace's posts, with filters for publication status, content type, and brand identity. Notra returns published posts only unless statuses includes both draft and published.

tools.name: List Schedules
tools.description: Returns the organization's cron schedules, newest first. repositoryMap maps each targeted GitHub integration ID to an owner/repo label.

tools.name: List Skills
tools.description: Returns the organization's skills sorted by name, including built-in system skills (isSystem: true). Skill content is omitted; use GET /v1/skills/{name} to read it.

tools.name: List Webhook Deliveries
tools.description: List Notra webhook delivery history at a specific offset, optionally filtered by delivery status. Increase offset to continue when has_more is true.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: List Notra outbound webhook subscriptions without exposing their signing secrets.

tools.name: Plan GEO Content Brief
tools.description: Plan and save a GEO content brief. This paid operation books AI credits; autoApprove also starts the billed writer. A 409 after four minutes may still finish, so do not retry; list briefs instead.

tools.name: Post Chat Message
tools.description: Persist a message or tool-approval decisions in an existing paid Notra chat and wait for the full assistant stream. Earlier history is included automatically. The response is newline-delimited stream text and may run for an unbounded model/tool duration. Tool approvals can trigger external mutations; retrying can duplicate them. Limited with chat creation to 30 requests per minute per organization.

tools.name: Retry Webhook Delivery
tools.description: Queue a paid redelivery of a failed webhook while retaining its prior attempt history. This sends the payload to the external endpoint again and can duplicate downstream effects.

tools.name: Rotate Geo Ingest Token
tools.description: Invalidates every tracking token previously issued for this organization and returns a fresh one. Deployments still sending the old token stop being accepted immediately. Irreversibly rotate the sensitive GEO ingest bearer token, immediately invalidating the previous token. Store the replacement securely and never log or expose it.

tools.name: Run GEO Sequence
tools.description: Irreversibly execute every turn of a tracked sequence against every available answer engine and record checks, consuming paid Notra model capacity. The synchronous call may take minutes and is limited to 10 runs per 10 minutes per organization. A 409 after four minutes means work continues; do not retry and instead read project GEO checks.

tools.name: Schedule Post
tools.description: Schedule a paid future publication that marks the saved post published in Notra and can create and merge a GitHub pull request or post to X or LinkedIn. Replaces any schedule that has not started; later post edits are included. Publishing occurs within about one minute and transient failures retry automatically.

tools.name: Send Agent Session Message
tools.description: Sends the next turn of an agent session. The server binds the session's stored continuation token, so the client-provided one is ignored. Answer input.requested events (tool approvals, questions) from the event stream via inputResponses. Send a paid message to an AI agent session. This can consume credits and produce unbounded streamed model output; do not retry blindly after an ambiguous failure.

tools.name: Start GEO Agent Readiness Scan
tools.description: Queue a paid readiness scan of the project's linked website. This starts external scanning work; an identical in-flight scan may be reused.

tools.name: Stream Agent Session Events
tools.description: Fetch and parse the durable NDJSON event response for an agent session after Notra closes the response, including input.requested events for tool approvals. This call does not deliver events incrementally and returned events can contain sensitive conversation content.

tools.name: Submit Feedback
tools.description: Record feedback for the organization that owns the credential. Requires an API key with the feedback.write scope. Agents and MCP servers should post to the organization's feedback URL instead. Submit persistent workspace feedback. This paid write has no delete endpoint.

tools.name: Submit Organization Feedback
tools.description: Record feedback from an AI agent or integration by posting to the organization's feedback URL, as shown on the Feedback page in the dashboard. No credentials are required. Limited per source IP and per organization. Submit persistent feedback without authentication. This paid write has no delete endpoint and is rate-limited by source IP and organization.

tools.name: Suggest GEO Competitors
tools.description: Use Notra's paid discovery operation to suggest competitors for a domain. Results are cached per organization and domain; requests are limited to 10 per 10 minutes per organization.

tools.name: Update Brand Identity
tools.description: Update selected fields of a Notra brand identity. This paid mutation can also change the organization's default identity by setting is_default to true.

tools.name: Update Event Trigger
tools.description: Replaces an existing GitHub event trigger's filters, monitored repositories, generated content type, and publishing settings. This paid operation changes future automation behavior.

tools.name: Update Feedback
tools.description: Changes a feedback entry's triage status and returns the updated entry. This is a paid write operation.

tools.name: Update GEO Project
tools.description: Rename a GEO project or relink its brand identity. This changes persistent project configuration and requires paid access and a GEO plan.

tools.name: Update GEO Prompt
tools.description: Enable or disable a tracked prompt, or replace labels on a custom prompt. This changes future scan coverage and requires paid GEO access.

tools.name: Update GEO Sequence
tools.description: Change a tracked sequence's name, turns, or enabled state. This affects future paid GEO runs.

tools.name: Replace GEO Settings
tools.description: Replace the project's GEO settings and re-arm its recurring scan. Unknown engines or languages are rejected; hidden engine selections are retained, the prompt language remains tracked, and ZDR is disabled without its add-on. This persistent scheduling change requires paid access and a GEO plan.

tools.name: Update Post
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing Notra post. Markdown changes re-render content; when title is omitted, Notra derives it from the first markdown heading or keeps the existing title if there is no heading. Status changes can publish or unpublish the post, and content or metadata changes may sync a linked GitHub pull request.

tools.name: Update Schedule
tools.description: Replaces the schedule. Send the full schedule body; fields that are omitted are not preserved from the existing schedule. This paid operation replaces the schedule configuration and can change future generation or automatic publishing behavior.

tools.name: Update Skill
tools.description: Updates the name, description, or content of a skill. System skills can be edited but not renamed. This paid operation changes an existing agent skill.

tools.name: Upsert GEO Competitor
tools.description: Create, update, or rename a persistent tracked competitor, matching names case-insensitively, and return the full list. Requires paid GEO access.

name: Npm
description: npm is the default package manager for JavaScript and Node.js, facilitating the sharing and reuse of code, managing dependencies, and streamlining project workflows.

tools.name: Delete User Token (Legacy)
tools.description: Tool to delete a user authentication token using the legacy endpoint. Use when you need to revoke or remove a specific token from the npm registry.

tools.name: Get All Packages Download Count Point
tools.description: Get total npm registry download statistics for all packages for a specified time period. Returns aggregate download counts across the entire npm registry with start/end dates. Supports preset periods (last-day, last-week, last-month, last-year) or custom date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: Get NPM Download Counts Point
tools.description: Get npm package download statistics for a specified time period. Returns total download counts with start/end dates for single packages, scoped packages, or bulk queries (up to 128 packages). Supports preset periods (last-day, last-week, last-month, last-year) or custom date ranges (YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: Get NPM Package Download Counts Over Date Range
tools.description: Tool to get download counts for an npm package over a specified date range. Use when you need historical daily download data.

tools.name: Get All NPM Packages Download Counts by Period
tools.description: Tool to get daily download counts for all npm packages over a specified period. Use when you need aggregate download statistics across the entire npm registry.

tools.name: Get Registry Changes Feed
tools.description: Tool to get a stream of registry changes for replication purposes. Returns CouchDB-style change feed for following registry updates.

tools.name: Get NPM Registry Meta
tools.description: Retrieves npm registry metadata via meta endpoints. Use 'ping' to verify registry connectivity or 'whoami' to get the authenticated username.

tools.name: Get NPM Package Version Downloads (Last 7 Days)
tools.description: Tool to get download counts for specific versions of a package over the last 7 days. Use when you need to understand which versions are most popular.

tools.name: Query Bulk Security Advisories
tools.description: Tool to bulk query security advisories for multiple npm packages. Use when you need to check vulnerability information for multiple packages and versions at once.

tools.name: Get NPM Package Metadata
tools.description: Tool to fetch metadata for a specified npm package. Use after confirming the exact package name, including scope. Responses can be large; prefer reading top-level fields like 'dist-tags', 'description', and 'license' rather than scanning the entire object.

tools.name: Get NPM Registry Root Metadata
tools.description: Fetches npm registry root metadata including total package count and update sequence. Returns database statistics from the npm replication service. No parameters required. Use this to get current registry statistics like the total number of packages available.

tools.name: Search NPM Packages
tools.description: Tool to search for packages in the npm registry. Use when you need to find packages matching a search term. Results are returned in an 'objects' array; each element contains package metadata under a 'package' field and weekly download estimates under 'downloads.weekly'.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The access token generated from your npm account, used for authenticating API requests.

name: Ntfy
description: Send push notifications to your phone or desktop via PUT/POST

tools.name: Create NTFY Account
tools.description: Tool to register a new user account on ntfy. Use when you need to create a new user account on the ntfy.sh hosted service. Note: This endpoint is not available on self-hosted instances unless signup is explicitly enabled in the server configuration.

tools.name: Create Web Push Subscription
tools.description: Tool to register a web push subscription for browser notifications. Use when you need to enable push notifications from ntfy topics through a browser's native push notification system.

tools.name: Delete Web Push Subscription
tools.description: Tool to unregister a web push subscription from the ntfy server. Use when you need to remove browser push notifications for a previously registered endpoint.

tools.name: Fetch Scheduled Messages
tools.description: Tool to fetch messages scheduled for later delivery from a topic. Use when you need to retrieve messages that are set to be delivered at a future date. The poll=1 and scheduled=1 parameters are automatically set to retrieve cached scheduled messages in a single request.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account data for authenticated user or anonymous user. Use when you need to get account information, limits, statistics, or tier details.

tools.name: Get Server Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve server statistics including message counts and publishing rates. Use when you need to monitor ntfy server activity and get metrics about message volume.

tools.name: Get Service Tiers
tools.description: Tool to list all available ntfy service tiers with their limits and features. Use when you need to retrieve subscription tier information including pricing and usage limits. Requires that payments are enabled on the server.

tools.name: Get File Attachment Metadata
tools.description: Tool to get file attachment metadata from a message without downloading the file content. Use when you need to check file size, content type, or verify file existence in the ntfy attachment cache.

tools.name: Check NTFY Service Health
tools.description: Tool to check the health status of the ntfy service. Use when you need to verify if the ntfy service is operational and responding correctly.

tools.name: Publish Message to Topic
tools.description: Tool to publish a message to a ntfy topic. Use when you need to send notifications or alerts to a topic. Topics are created dynamically if they don't exist.

tools.name: Publish Message via GET
tools.description: Tool to publish messages to ntfy via GET request with URL parameters. Use when PUT/POST methods are unavailable or for simple webhook integration. Supports all message parameters as query strings. Without parameters, sends 'triggered' as message.

tools.name: Subscribe to Topic (Raw Stream)
tools.description: Tool to subscribe to a topic and receive message bodies as raw text stream. Use when you need to retrieve messages without metadata like priority, tags, or titles. Each line in the response contains only the message body. Empty lines represent keepalive messages. In streaming mode, the connection remains open to receive new messages. With poll=1, cached messages are returned and the connection closes.

required.description: Your ntfy username for authentication

required.description: Your ntfy password for authentication

name: Nutrient Document Web Services API
description: Process, convert, OCR, redact, sign, and analyze documents with Nutrient Document Web Services.

tools.name: Analyze Build Request (Deprecated)
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility tool for the original ANALYZE_BUILD contract. Use ANALYZE_BUILD_COST for typed Build instructions.

tools.name: Analyze Build Cost
tools.description: Estimate the credits and Processor features required by Build API instructions without executing the document job or consuming credits.

tools.name: Build Document
tools.description: Synchronously create one document from remote files, remote HTML, new pages, and composable safe actions, returning its filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. Use this for multi-part or multi-step workflows; applied redaction and JSON-content output are not supported. This consumes Processor credits; run ANALYZE_BUILD_COST and check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: Convert Markdown to PDF
tools.description: Convert CommonMark or GitHub-Flavored Markdown text into a PDF using optional built-in styling, custom CSS, page layout, and syntax highlighting settings. Returns the filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. This consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: Create JWT Token
tools.description: Create a short-lived restricted Nutrient bearer token. This compatibility tool returns secret credential material; revoke it with REVOKE_JWT_TOKEN when it is no longer needed. Prefer the connected API key for normal server-side document processing.

tools.name: Create PDF from Web Page
tools.description: Render an HTML web page at a public URL, with optional page layout settings, into a PDF. Returns the filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. This consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Return the connected Nutrient account's subscription type, status, and estimated remaining credits.

tools.name: Get Processor Usage
tools.description: Return the connected account's Processor subscription status and credit usage counters.

tools.name: Make PDF Accessible
tools.description: Auto-tag a PDF at a remote URL for PDF/UA screen-reader accessibility and return the result's filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. This consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: OCR PDF
tools.description: Apply optical character recognition to a PDF at a remote URL and return a searchable PDF's filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. This consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: Revoke JWT Token
tools.description: Immediately revoke a bearer token created by CREATE_JWT_TOKEN using its ID. Use this when a generated token is no longer needed or may be compromised.

tools.name: Stage PDF Redactions
tools.description: Find matching content in a remote PDF and return a review PDF's filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB with unapplied redaction marks. This action cannot permanently apply redactions. It consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may be watermarked.

tools.name: Watermark PDF
tools.description: Add a positioned text or image watermark to every page of a PDF at a public URL and return the copy's filename, media type, and Base64 content up to 4 MB. This consumes Processor credits; check GET_PROCESSOR_USAGE first. Free-tier output may also include Nutrient's watermark.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to the Nutrient dashboard and copy a key from API Keys at https://dashboard.nutrient.io/api/api_keys/. Production keys start with pdf_live_ and test keys start with pdf_test_.

name: Nutshell
description: Nutshell is a flexible CRM and email marketing platform that helps small businesses manage contacts, sales pipelines, and customer relationships.

tools.name: Create Accounts
tools.description: Tool to create one or more accounts in Nutshell. Use when you need to add new company accounts. Each account must have at least one of: name, phone, email, address, or url.

tools.name: Create Custom Field for Accounts
tools.description: Tool to create a custom field for accounts in Nutshell. Use when you need to add new custom fields to track additional information on company accounts. Supports Text, LongText, Currency, Date, and Decision field types.

tools.name: Create Activities
tools.description: Tool to create one or more activities in Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to log a completed activity or schedule a future activity such as phone calls, meetings, emails, or notes. All activity fields are optional except the activities array itself. At minimum, provide a name or activityType for meaningful activities.

tools.name: Create Contacts
tools.description: Tool to create one or more contacts in Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to add new contacts to the system. Each contact must have at least one identifier field (name, phone, email, address, or url).

tools.name: Create Lead
tools.description: Tool to create a lead in Nutshell CRM using the JSON-RPC API. Use when you need to add a new lead to the system. The description field is required, while other fields like manualValue, dueTime, customFields, and links are optional.

tools.name: Create Custom Field for Leads
tools.description: Tool to create a custom field for leads in Nutshell. Use when you need to add new custom fields to track additional information on leads. Supports Text, Email, Currency, and Date field types.

tools.name: Create Notes
tools.description: Tool to create a note in Nutshell. Use when you need to add notes to contacts, leads, accounts, or other entities in Nutshell CRM. The note will be attached to the specified parent entity.

tools.name: Create Sources
tools.description: Tool to create new sources in Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to add source tracking for leads or contacts. Sources help categorize where leads originate (e.g., organic search, paid ads).

tools.name: Create Tags
tools.description: Tool to create one or more tags in Nutshell. Use when you need to create new tags for categorizing leads, contacts, or accounts. Each tag requires a name and tagType (1=leads, 2=contacts, 3=accounts).

tools.name: Delete Account
tools.description: Tool to delete an account from Nutshell. Use when you need to permanently remove an account. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Tool to delete a contact by ID. Use when you need to remove a contact from Nutshell. Returns success confirmation upon deletion.

tools.name: Delete Lead
tools.description: Tool to delete a lead from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to remove a lead. Note: Nutshell soft-deletes leads by default, allowing for potential recovery.

tools.name: Delete Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a note from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to permanently remove a note. Returns the deleted note information including deletion timestamp.

tools.name: Delete Product Map
tools.description: Tool to delete a product on a lead. Use when you need to remove a product mapping from a lead. The deletion is permanent and returns the details of the deleted product map.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Tool to delete a task from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to remove a task. Note: Nutshell soft-deletes tasks by default, allowing for potential recovery.

tools.name: Edit Nutshell Account
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing account in Nutshell CRM. Updates specified fields of an account using the account ID and revision identifier. Supports file uploads via two-step process: specify file in request, receive upload URI in response, POST file to URI. Use when you need to modify account details like name, description, tags, contact information, or associations.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an account from Nutshell. Use when you need to get details about a specific account. Supports retrieving multiple accounts by providing comma-separated IDs.

tools.name: Get Account Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom fields for a specific account in Nutshell. Use when you need to view custom field definitions and values associated with an account.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single activity by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get details about a specific activity. The activity ID must be in the format '{integer}-activities' (e.g., '7-activities').

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific contact by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get detailed information about a contact.

tools.name: Get Contact Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom fields for a specific contact in Nutshell. Use when you need to view custom field definitions and values associated with a contact.

tools.name: Get Lead
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific lead by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get detailed information about a lead.

tools.name: Get Lead's Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom fields for a specific lead in Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get all custom field data associated with a lead. The lead ID must be in the format '{integer}-leads' (e.g., '1003-leads').

tools.name: Get Note
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single note by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get details about a specific note. The note ID must be in the format '{integer}-notes' (e.g., '3-notes').

tools.name: Get Product Category
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single product category by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get details about a specific product category. The product category ID must be in the format '{integer}-productCategories' (e.g., '3-productCategories').

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single task by ID from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to get details about a specific task. The task ID must be in the format '{integer}-tasks' (e.g., '7-tasks').

tools.description: Tool to get saved filters from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to retrieve saved filters for reports or entity lists (leads, contacts, accounts).

tools.description: Tool to get a list of invoices from Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to retrieve invoices with optional filtering by lead, date range, and pagination.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve all applicable custom field attributes for leads in Nutshell CRM. Use when you need to see available custom field definitions, types, and configuration for leads.
