name: Quiltt
description: Quiltt provides financial data aggregation APIs for managing Profiles, connections, accounts, transactions, statements, and webhooks.

tools.name: Create Profile
tools.description: Create a Profile in the Quiltt Environment with optional identity, contact, address, and custom metadata fields.

tools.name: Create Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Create a webhook subscription that sends selected Quiltt events to an HTTPS callback URL; this registers the callback but does not verify delivery.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Permanently remove one webhook subscription so Quiltt stops sending events to its callback URL.

tools.name: Get Profile
tools.description: Retrieve one Profile by its Quiltt Profile ID or UUID.

tools.name: List Finicity Remote Data
tools.description: List one page of Quiltt resource IDs with Finicity Remote Data for the selected resource type. Requires Finicity to be provisioned in the Quiltt Environment.

tools.name: List Profiles
tools.description: Return one page of Profiles in the Quiltt Environment and a cursor for the next page.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions
tools.description: Return one page of webhook subscriptions and a cursor for the next page, including callback URLs, event types, and disabled state.

tools.name: Search Institutions
tools.description: Find financial institutions associated with a US Federal Reserve routing number.

tools.name: Update Profile
tools.description: Update explicitly supplied contact, legal identity, address, or custom metadata fields on an existing Quiltt Profile. Null clears a nullable field.

tools.name: Update Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Update explicitly supplied fields on a Quiltt webhook subscription, including its name, HTTPS callback URL, or event types.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your server-side Quiltt Environment API Key secret. In the Quiltt Dashboard, open API Keys at https://dashboard.quiltt.dev/api-keys and copy the secret for the Environment you want to connect. Never use a Profile Session token or public Connector ID here.

name: QuintaDB
description: QuintaDB is a no-code online database and application builder for managing databases, forms, fields, records, reports, and files.

tools.name: Create Record
tools.description: Create one record in a QuintaDB form using values keyed by field ID. The tool supplies QuintaDB's required entity_id inside the nested values body.

tools.name: Create Records
tools.description: Create 2-100 QuintaDB records using sequential individual API calls in input order. This is not atomic: some records can succeed while others fail, and every item returns its own outcome.

tools.name: Delete Records By ID
tools.description: Permanently delete only the explicitly supplied QuintaDB record IDs from one form. This tool never supports delete-all or filter-based deletion.

tools.name: Get Database
tools.description: Get metadata and resource counts for one allowed QuintaDB database by app ID. Use this instead of global database discovery when the API key is restricted to selected apps.

tools.name: Get Record
tools.description: Get one record by exact ID from an allowed QuintaDB database. Values are returned under their field IDs for reliable use with QuintaDB schema and record tools.

tools.name: List Fields
tools.description: List the fields in a QuintaDB form, including field IDs and types. Use these IDs as keys in record values and search predicates.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: List forms/tables in an allowed QuintaDB database, including IDs and record counts needed for field and record operations.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: Return one page of records from a QuintaDB form, optionally constrained to a report. Record values remain keyed by field ID for reliable use with schema and write tools.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: List QuintaDB reports/views for a form. Use a returned report ID to constrain record listing or search.

tools.name: Search Records
tools.description: Search records in one QuintaDB form using explicit field or system-column predicates. Groups are combined with OR; predicates inside each group are combined with AND.

tools.name: Update Record
tools.description: Update selected fields on one QuintaDB record using a field-ID keyed values object.

tools.name: Update Records By ID
tools.description: Update 2-100 exact QuintaDB record IDs using sequential individual API calls in input order. This is not atomic: some updates can succeed while others fail, and every item returns its own outcome.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your QuintaDB REST API key. Sign in to QuintaDB, open the API menu at the top right of the page, and copy the REST API key shown there. Keep this key secret.

required.name: generic_id
required.description: The QuintaDB database ID this API key can access. Open the database in QuintaDB and copy the value after /apps/ in its URL.

name: Quire
description: Quire is a collaborative project management platform for organizing projects, tasks, documents, discussions, and team workflows.

tools.name: Add Insight Field
tools.description: Add a custom field to an insight by OID or by owner ID plus insight ID. Quire allows only formula and lookup fields on insights. The OID route explicitly requires the Admin app permission; the ID route has no named app permission in Quire's specification and uses normal resource authorization.

tools.name: Add Project Approval Category
tools.description: Add an approval category to a Quire project by project ID or OID. The ID route has no named app permission in Quire's specification and uses normal project authorization. The OID route explicitly requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Add Project Field
tools.description: Add a custom-field definition to a Quire project by project ID or OID. The ID route has no named app permission in Quire's specification and uses normal resource authorization. The OID route explicitly requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Add Task Timelog
tools.description: Add a time log to a Quire task identified by task OID or by project ID plus task ID. Returns the task's complete, fixed-shape timelogs array.

tools.name: Attach File to Comment
tools.description: Upload a file as a raw-byte attachment to an existing Quire comment.

tools.name: Attach File to Task
tools.description: Upload raw file bytes as an attachment to a task identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: Bulk Create Tasks
tools.description: Atomically create one to 300 Quire root, child, or sibling tasks in submitted order. The body is a top-level array. Any item error rolls back the whole batch and retains its `items[i]:` index. Dry-run performs the same validation without persistence; its returned identifiers are disposable. Normal calls cost one rate-limit unit per item and dry runs cost ceil(items / 2), minimum one.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Tasks
tools.description: Atomically delete 1 to 300 Quire tasks from a project selected by ID or OID. The request and response are top-level arrays in submitted order. Malformed references and permission failures roll back the whole batch, while unresolved or already-deleted references produce null slots, making retries idempotent. Dry-run performs the same checks without persistence. Real calls cost one rate-limit unit per submitted item even when skipped; dry-runs cost max(1, ceil(items / 2)). The response is always identifier-only.

tools.name: Bulk Move Tasks
tools.description: Atomically move or reorder 1 to 300 Quire tasks within one project, selected by project ID or OID. Quire moves resolvable items in submitted order as a sliding chain, returns null for unresolved item references, and rolls back the entire batch on validation, permission, cycle, or database errors. Use dry_run to validate without persistence. A real request costs one rate-limit unit per item; dry-run costs max(1, ceil(items / 2)). Cross-project moves require the bulk-transfer tool.

tools.name: Bulk Set Task Approvals
tools.description: Atomically apply one approval transition to up to 300 Quire tasks in a project selected by ID or OID. Missing tasks preserve null result slots; any validation or permission failure rolls back the whole batch. Supports non-persisting dry runs and full or compact responses.

tools.name: Bulk Transfer Tasks
tools.description: Atomically transfer 1 to 300 Quire tasks from one project to a different target project using ID or OID routing. The body is a top-level mixed-reference array. Transfers preserve OIDs, assign target-project IDs, and preserve submitted order; by default Quire may invite assignees and add or remap missing tags, statuses, and non-empty custom fields in the target project; set those controls to false to prevent those additional effects. unresolved source items produce null slots. Validation, permission, or database errors retain `items[i]:` and roll back both projects. Dry-run performs the same checks without persistence. Calls cost N units for N submitted items; dry-run costs ceil(N / 2), minimum one, charged before processing even for skipped items.

tools.name: Bulk Update Tasks
tools.description: Atomically update one to 300 Quire tasks in a project selected by ID or OID. Each item selects exactly one task by ID or OID and may apply the full task update surface, including flattened project custom fields and explicit nulls that clear supported values. Missing tasks preserve null response slots; any validation, permission, conflict, or database error rolls back the whole batch and identifies the failing `items[i]`. Supports non-persisting dry runs and full or compact responses. Real calls cost one rate-limit unit per item; dry runs cost max(1, ceil(items / 2)).

tools.name: Create Chat Channel
tools.description: Create a chat under a project using its human-readable ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Chat Comment
tools.description: Add a Markdown comment to a chat identified by its OID or by project ID plus chat ID.

tools.name: Create Dashboard
tools.description: Create a dashboard container under a project, organization, folder, or smart folder using the owner's human-readable ID or OID. Dashboard widgets cannot be configured through this operation.

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Create a document under a project, organization, folder, or smart folder using the owner's human-readable ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Insight
tools.description: Create an insight view under a project, organization, folder, or smart folder using the owner's human-readable ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Status
tools.description: Create a task status in a project identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Sublist
tools.description: Create a sublist under a project, organization, folder, or smart folder using the owner's human-readable ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a tag in a project identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create a Quire root task or a child/sibling task using a project ID, a project ID plus task ID, or a project/task OID. Supports nested subtasks and project-defined custom fields.

tools.name: Create Task Comment
tools.description: Add a Markdown comment to a task identified by task OID or by project ID plus task ID.

tools.name: Delete Chat Channel
tools.description: Remove one Quire chat channel by its OID or by its owner ID and chat ID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the chat no longer exists. A deleted chat may be restorable with RESTORE_CHAT.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Remove one Quire comment by its OID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the comment no longer exists. A deleted comment may be restorable with RESTORE_COMMENT when that action is available.

tools.name: Delete Dashboard
tools.description: Remove one Quire dashboard by its OID or by its owner ID and dashboard ID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the dashboard no longer exists. A deleted dashboard may be restorable with RESTORE_DASHBOARD.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Remove one Quire document by its OID or by its owner ID and document ID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the document no longer exists. A deleted document may be restorable with RESTORE_DOC.

tools.name: Delete Insight
tools.description: Remove one Quire insight by its OID or by its owner ID and insight ID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the insight no longer exists.

tools.name: Delete Status
tools.description: Delete one project task status by numeric value using the project ID or OID. The operation is idempotent: Quire returns 204 No Content even when the status does not exist.

tools.name: Delete Storage Value
tools.description: Delete one access-token-scoped app storage value by key name. The operation is idempotent: Quire returns 204 No Content whether or not the key exists.

tools.name: Delete Sublist
tools.description: Remove one Quire sublist by its OID or by its owner ID and sublist ID. Deletion is idempotent: Quire returns success even if the sublist no longer exists.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Delete one Quire tag by its OID. The operation is idempotent: Quire returns 204 No Content even when the tag does not exist.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Remove one Quire task by task OID or by project ID plus numeric task ID. WARNING: Quire also removes every subtask beneath the selected task. The task may be recoverable with RESTORE_TASK while Quire retains the removed record. Deletion is idempotent: both routes return 204 No Content even when the task does not exist.

tools.name: Export Project CSV
tools.description: Export a Quire project and its filtered tasks and related data as a CSV file, selecting the project by ID or OID. Requires the Professional plan or above. The request costs 5 + max(1, ceil(filtered tasks / 100)) rate-limit units.

tools.name: Export Project JSON
tools.description: Export a Quire project, all tasks, and related data as JSON, selecting the project by ID or OID. Requires the Professional plan or above. The request costs 5 + max(1, ceil(tasks / 100)) rate-limit units. The API does not document filters for this endpoint.

tools.name: Get Chat Channel
tools.description: Get one chat by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Get one comment by its OID.

tools.name: Get Dashboard
tools.description: Get one dashboard by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Get Document

tools.name: Get Insight
tools.description: Get one insight by OID or by owner ID plus insight ID.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Get organization details by ID or OID, including subscription plan when available.

tools.name: Get Partner
tools.description: Get one external team partner by OID.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Get one complete project record by ID or OID, including plan details.

tools.name: Get Rate Limit
tools.description: Return current minute and hourly API usage for an organization or personal project by ID or OID. This inspection request consumes no rate-limit units.

tools.name: Get Status
tools.description: Get one project task status by numeric value.

tools.name: Get Storage Value
tools.description: Get one application storage value by key name. Values are scoped to the connected Quire access token and returned without changing their JSON type.

tools.name: Get Sublist
tools.description: Get one sublist by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Get Tag
tools.description: Return one tag identified by its OID.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Get one complete Quire task by task OID or by project ID plus numeric task ID. Returns identifiers, Markdown and plain-text content, relationships, assignment, scheduling, status, approval, time-log, attachment, and audit data.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get a user by human-readable ID, email address, `me`, or OID.

tools.name: List Chat Comments
tools.description: List all comments on a chat identified by chat OID or by project ID plus chat ID.

tools.name: List Chat Channels
tools.description: List chats under a supported owner identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Dashboards
tools.description: List dashboards under a supported owner identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Documents
tools.description: List documents under a supported owner identified by ID or OID. Quire returns each document's full Markdown body plus rendered text and HTML, so results may be large.

tools.name: List Insights
tools.description: List insights under an owner identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: List organizations visible to the connected user.

tools.name: List Project Partners
tools.description: List external team partners for a project identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List projects authorized for the current application, globally or within one organization selected by ID or OID, with optional archived and add-task filters.

tools.name: List Statuses
tools.description: List task statuses for a project identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Storage Values
tools.description: List up to 20 app storage values ordered by key, either across all keys or restricted to a prefix. Returns an object whose dynamic keys are storage names and whose values may be any JSON value; empty storage returns `{}`.

tools.name: List Sublists
tools.description: List sublists under a supported owner identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List tags in a project identified by ID or OID.

tools.name: List Task Comments
tools.description: List all comments on a task identified by task OID or by project ID plus task ID.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: List Quire project roots or a task's direct children or paid deep subtree by project/task ID or OID. Supports status filtering, full or compact records, and one-page opaque cursor continuation. Deep traversal requires Professional or above and is capped at 500 nodes on Professional, 2,000 on Premium, and the response-size limit on Enterprise; cropped markers identify partial levels.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List users visible to the app globally or within a project selected by ID or OID. The optional contacts permission controls which colleagues and member details are visible; the current user is always first.

tools.name: Move Insight Field
tools.description: Reorder a custom field on an insight identified by OID or by owner ID plus insight ID. Omit `before` to move it to the end. The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Move Project Field
tools.description: Reorder a custom field on a Quire project identified by ID or OID. Omit before to move the field to the end. The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Move Task
tools.description: Reparent or reorder one Quire task within its current project, selected by project ID plus numeric task ID or by task OID. Move it under a destination task, immediately before or after that task, or to the project root.

tools.name: Remove Insight Field
tools.description: Remove a named custom field from a Quire insight by OID or by owner ID plus insight ID. The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission. Removal is idempotent: Quire returns success when the field is already absent.

tools.name: Remove Project Approval Category
tools.description: Remove an approval category from a Quire project by project ID or OID. Any task approval that references the category is cleared. The ID route uses normal resource authorization; the OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission. Removal is idempotent: Quire returns success when the category is already absent.

tools.name: Remove Project Field
tools.description: Remove a named custom field from a Quire project by project ID or OID. The ID route uses normal resource authorization; the OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission. Removal is idempotent: Quire returns success when the field is already absent.

tools.name: Remove Task Timelog
tools.description: Remove the task time log matching an exact start, end, and optional user, identifying the task by OID or by project ID plus integer task ID. Quire truncates sub-second timestamp precision before matching and returns all remaining time logs.

tools.name: Rename Insight Field
tools.description: Rename a custom field on an insight identified by OID or by owner ID plus insight ID while preserving the field's content. The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Rename Project Field
tools.description: Rename a custom field on a project identified by ID or OID while preserving the field content and migrating task values. The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

tools.name: Restore Chat Channel
tools.description: Restore a previously removed chat by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Restore Comment
tools.description: Restore a previously removed comment by OID.

tools.name: Restore Dashboard
tools.description: Restore a previously removed dashboard by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Restore Document
tools.description: Restore a previously removed document by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Restore Insight
tools.description: Restore a previously removed insight by its OID or by owner ID plus insight ID. If the insight is not removed, Quire returns it unchanged.

tools.name: Restore Sublist
tools.description: Restore a previously removed sublist by its OID or by owner ID plus resource ID.

tools.name: Restore Task
tools.description: Restore a previously removed Quire task by project ID plus numeric task ID, or by task OID. Restoring an active task is an idempotent no-op.

tools.name: Revoke Task Approval
tools.description: Cancel a Quire task's current approval by task OID or by project ID plus integer task ID. For awaiting or changes states, Quire clears the approval. For approved or rejected states, Quire rolls it back to awaiting and preserves the original requester. Call the action again to clear that approval. The operation is idempotent when no approval is set.

tools.name: Run Insight
tools.description: Run a project-scoped insight by OID or by project ID plus insight ID and return its computed grouped table. Available on every Quire plan. A run costs 1 + max(0, ceil(tasks loaded / 250) - 1) rate-limit units after the status filter. Rows sort by group name, with the null group last. Project-wide task-collection tokens in formula columns evaluate to null; other cells in the row remain available.

tools.name: Search Tasks
tools.description: Search tasks in one project, folder, or organization selected by ID or OID. Supports each route's documented full-text, regex, people, tag, activity, date, project-only, and project-ID-only filters, including dynamic project custom fields. Returns one page and exposes Quire's documented cursor. Folder and organization searches require Professional or above. Rate-limit cost is max(1, ceil(items returned / 100)).

tools.name: Send Notification
tools.description: Irreversibly send a Quire notification to the authorizing user, selected visible users, or every user visible to the app. Sending cannot be undone. Using recipients=['*'] is a broadcast to all visible users, whose breadth depends on whether the app has access-to-contacts permission.

tools.name: Set Storage Value
tools.description: Create or replace one access-token-scoped app storage value by key. The value may be an object, array, string, number, or boolean. Use DELETE_STORAGE_VALUE to delete a key. New keys are subject to the Quire plan's storage record cap, and each write is limited to 4 KiB.

tools.name: Set Task Approval
tools.description: Request, approve, reject, or request changes for a task approval category, selecting the task by OID or by project ID plus task ID. The caller must be an allowed claimer to request approval or an allowed approver to decide it. Optionally creates a prefixed companion comment; use the revoke-approval action instead to cancel an approval.

tools.name: Transfer Task
tools.description: Transfer one existing Quire task from its current project to a different project using an ID or OID route. The transfer removes it from the source project, preserves its OID, assigns a new numeric ID from the target project, and can place it at the target root or relative to a target task. By default, Quire may invite assignees and add missing tags, statuses, and non-empty custom fields to the target project; set the corresponding controls to `false` to prevent those side effects.

tools.name: Update Project Approval Category
tools.description: Update an approval category on a Quire project identified by ID or OID. Omitted changes preserve their current values. The ID route uses normal resource authorization; the OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission.

The OID route requires the Quire app's Admin permission; the ID route uses normal resource authorization and has no named app permission. Use the dedicated rename or move actions to rename or reorder a field.

tools.name: Delete Tax
tools.description: Permanently delete one quote tax definition by ID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook Subscription
tools.description: Permanently cancel one webhook subscription by its subscription ID.

tools.description: Return one full Qwilr page, with optional metadata and real or preview acceptance details.

tools.name: List Pages
tools.description: Return one cursor-controlled page of visible Qwilr page summaries, optionally filtered by status, tags, folder, owner, or creation order.

tools.name: List Payment Gateways
tools.description: Return configured Qwilr Pay gateways whose IDs can be assigned to page payment settings.

tools.name: List Saved Blocks
tools.description: Return saved block IDs, names, and types for constructing or replacing pages.

tools.name: List Taxes
tools.description: Return all quote tax definitions and their nullable percentage rates.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Return account users with IDs, email addresses, roles, and team names for resolving page owner IDs.

tools.name: List Webhook Subscriptions
tools.description: Return API-created webhook subscriptions with their IDs, event types, and callback URLs.

Accepted or disabled pages support only folder_id, skip_if_template_default_folder, and add_tags. If folder_id was sent, Qwilr applies the folder move first and does not roll it back when a later requested change fails; inspect the page before retrying.

tools.name: Update Tax
tools.description: Change a quote tax definition's name, percentage rate, or both; sending rate null clears the rate.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate an API access token in Qwilr at Account settings > Qwilr API (https://app.qwilr.com/#/settings/api). Qwilr shows the full-account token only once, so store it securely.

name: Radar

tools.name: Autocomplete Address or Place
tools.description: Tool to autocomplete partial addresses and place names based on relevance and proximity. Use after a user inputs a partial address/place to get suggestions, optionally biased by location.

tools.name: Create Beacon
tools.description: Tool to create a new beacon in Radar. Use when you need to register a physical beacon device (iBeacon or Eddystone) for location tracking.

tools.name: Create Trip
tools.description: Tool to create a new trip. Use after gathering origin and destination details to start tracking a trip.

tools.name: Delete Beacon
tools.description: Tool to delete a beacon by its Radar ID. Use when supplying a beacon's unique identifier to remove it.

tools.name: Delete Geofence
tools.description: Tool to delete a geofence by ID. Use when supplying a geofence’s unique identifier to remove it.

tools.name: Delete Geofence By Tag
