tools.description: Tool to get a URL for a live browser session. Use when you need to interact with a webpage in real-time through a controlled browser environment.

tools.name: Get Markdownify History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the history of markdownify webpage-to-Markdown conversion jobs. Use when you need to view past markdownify requests and their statuses.

tools.name: Get Scrape History
tools.description: Retrieve the history of scrape jobs from your ScrapeGraphAI account. Use this to check the status of past scrapes, view results, and track credit usage.

tools.name: Get Searchscraper History
tools.description: Get the history of searchscraper jobs with pagination support. Use this to retrieve past searchscraper requests, their status, and results.

tools.name: Get Sitemap History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the history of sitemap extraction jobs. Use when you need to view past sitemap extraction requests, their status, and results.

tools.name: Get Smartscraper History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the history of smartscraper jobs. Use when you need to view past scraping requests and their results.

tools.name: Get Usage Timeline
tools.description: Tool to retrieve usage timeline statistics for your ScrapeGraphAI account. Use when you need to visualize or analyze service usage patterns over time.

tools.name: Get Webhook Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve webhook delivery logs for a crawler job. Use when you need to check the status and history of webhook notifications sent for a specific crawler execution.

tools.name: List Scheduled Jobs
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all scheduled scraping jobs for your account. Use this action to view and manage your scheduled jobs, including their configuration, cron schedules, and active status. Supports filtering by service type and active status.

tools.name: Markdownify Status
tools.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a Markdownify webpage-to-Markdown conversion job. Use this action to poll for the status of an async Markdownify request started via SCRAPEGRAPH_AI_MARKDOWNIFY. Note: The ScrapeGraph AI API typically returns completed results synchronously, so this status endpoint is primarily useful for long-running conversions of large or complex webpages.

tools.name: Save Endpoint Configuration
tools.description: Tool to save custom scraping endpoint configurations to ScrapeGraphAI. Use when you need to create reusable scraping endpoints with specific parameters and extraction logic.

tools.name: Search Scraper
tools.description: Perform AI-powered web searches with structured, parsed results. Some sites block scrapers and return empty bodies; treat these as unrecoverable for that URL. JS-rendered pages may yield incomplete content.

tools.name: Check SearchScraper Status
tools.description: Check the status and results of an asynchronous SearchScraper job.

tools.name: SmartCrawler Status
tools.description: Check the status and retrieve results of a SmartCrawler web crawling job. Use this action to poll for completion and get the extracted content from a previously started SmartCrawler job. Returns the job status, crawled URLs, page content in markdown/HTML format, and LLM extraction results (if enabled). Implement a polling timeout (e.g., max retries or elapsed time cap) to avoid indefinite loops when waiting for long-running jobs.

tools.name: Start Smart Scraper
tools.description: Extract structured JSON from one URL, HTML document, or Markdown document using ScrapeGraphAI v2. The v2 Extract endpoint is synchronous and returns the completed result directly.

tools.name: Look Up SmartScraper Request
tools.description: Retrieve the v2 History record for a SmartScraper Extract request ID. Extract calls are synchronous, so this action is primarily useful for looking up a previous result.

tools.name: Start Smart Crawler (Async)
tools.description: Tool to start a multi-page web crawl using SmartCrawler for AI-powered data extraction. Use when you need to extract structured data from multiple pages of a website. Returns immediately with a task_id - use the status check action to monitor progress and retrieve results.

tools.name: Submit Feedback
tools.description: Submit feedback and ratings for completed ScrapeGraphAI requests.

tools.name: Submit Product Feedback
tools.description: Submit product feedback for ScrapeGraphAI. Use to provide ratings, comments, suggestions, and other feedback about the product itself.

tools.name: Convert JSON to TOON Format
tools.description: Tool to convert JSON data to TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) format. Use when you need to reduce token usage for LLM processing while maintaining data structure.

tools.name: Validate API Key
tools.description: Validate your ScrapeGraphAI API key to ensure it is active and authorized. Use this action to check API key validity before making other API calls.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ScrapeGraphAI API key (from https://dashboard.scrapegraphai.com)

name: Scrapfly
description: Scrapfly is a web scraping API that enables developers to extract data from websites efficiently, offering features like JavaScript rendering, anti-bot protection bypass, and proxy rotation.

tools.name: Capture Website Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to capture a full-page or viewport screenshot of a website. Use when you need to take a screenshot with options like JS rendering, custom resolution, or accessibility testing. Returns the screenshot image directly. Supports vision deficiency simulations and dark mode.

tools.name: Capture Screenshot Metadata (HEAD)
tools.description: Tool to capture screenshot metadata without downloading the image body. Use this for async screenshot workflows where you need the URL to retrieve the image later. Returns the screenshot URL in response, saving bandwidth compared to full screenshot retrieval.

tools.name: Create Scrapfly Crawler
tools.description: Tool to create a new web crawler to recursively crawl an entire website. Returns a crawler UUID for tracking progress. Use when you need to crawl multiple pages from a website with configurable limits and extraction rules.

tools.name: Extract Structured Data
tools.description: Tool to extract structured data from HTML or other content using AI models, LLM prompts, or custom templates. Use when you need to parse web pages or documents into structured JSON data. Supports predefined extraction models for common types (articles, products, events) or custom extraction via prompts/templates.

tools.name: Get Scrapfly Account Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Scrapfly account information. Use after authenticating to get API credit balance and usage stats. Returns comprehensive account data including subscription plan, usage statistics, billing info, and project settings.

tools.name: Get Crawler Artifact
tools.description: Tool to download crawler artifact files in WARC or HAR format. Use when you need to retrieve the complete crawl results as an archive file. WARC format is recommended for large crawls as it includes gzip compression.

tools.name: Get Crawler Contents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve extracted content from crawled pages. Supports multiple output formats including markdown, text, HTML, and JSON. Use when you need to access the actual content extracted during a crawl, with optional filtering by URL and format selection.

tools.name: Get Crawler Status
tools.description: Tool to get the current status of a crawler including progress, pages crawled, and completion state. Use for polling workflow to monitor crawl progress.

tools.name: Get Crawler URLs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of discovered and crawled URLs from a crawler. Use when you need to get all URLs found during a crawl or filter by status to analyze failed URLs with error codes. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: Scrapfly Scrape
tools.description: Tool to perform a web scraping request. Use when you need to fetch a page with custom configuration like JS rendering, proxies, and extraction.

tools.name: Scrapfly Scrape POST
tools.description: Tool to scrape web pages using POST method to send data in the request body. Use when you need to scrape endpoints that require POST requests, such as form submissions or APIs that expect data payload.

tools.name: Scrape With PUT
tools.description: Tool to scrape web pages using PUT method with body payload. Use when the target API requires PUT requests with data in the request body. Forwards PUT request with custom body to the target URL. If not specified, content-type defaults to application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Scrapfly API key for authentication. Find your key on the Scrapfly dashboard.

name: Scrapingant
description: ScrapingAnt is a web scraping API service that enables data extraction from websites through headless Chrome browsers, rotating proxies, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, LLM-ready markdown output, and AI-powered structured data extraction.

tools.name: Extract Content as Markdown
tools.description: This tool extracts content from a given URL and converts it into Markdown format. It is particularly useful for preparing text for Language Learning Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. It supports GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE methods.

tools.name: Extract Data with AI
tools.description: This tool allows you to extract structured data from a web page using ScrapingAnt's AI-powered extraction capabilities. You provide a URL and an AI query (prompt) describing what data you want to extract, and the tool returns the extracted data in a structured format. It supports additional parameters for browser rendering, proxies, and cookies to handle dynamic content and localization.

tools.name: Get API Credits Usage
tools.description: This tool retrieves the current API credit usage status for the authenticated ScrapingAnt account. It enables users to monitor their consumption of API credits, check their current usage against the subscription limits, and manage their API credits effectively.

tools.name: Get V1 Usage (Deprecated)
tools.description: [DEPRECATED - Use v2] Tool to get the current subscription status and API credits usage information. This is the legacy v1 endpoint which is no longer actively maintained.

tools.name: Scrape Web Page
tools.description: This tool scrapes a web page using the ScrapingAnt API. It fetches the HTML content of the specified URL. Users can customize the scraping behavior by enabling a headless browser, using proxies, waiting for specific elements, executing JavaScript, passing cookies, and blocking certain resources.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage via POST
tools.description: Tool to perform a POST request through ScrapingAnt's proxy to scrape a webpage. Use when you need to scrape pages that require POST method, such as form submissions or APIs that only accept POST requests. Data is forwarded transparently to the target web page.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage with PUT
tools.description: Tool to perform a PUT request through ScrapingAnt's proxy to scrape a webpage that requires PUT method. Use when the target webpage requires PUT method for data submission. Data is forwarded transparently to the target web page.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage (v1 POST - Deprecated)
tools.description: [DEPRECATED - Use v2] Tool to scrape a webpage using POST method with ScrapingAnt's v1 API. Returns JSON with content, cookies, and status_code. This is the legacy v1 endpoint which is no longer actively maintained. Use the v2 endpoints for new implementations.

tools.name: Scrape with Extended JSON Output
tools.description: Scrapes a web page and returns comprehensive data including HTML content, plain text, cookies, HTTP headers, XHR/Fetch requests, and iframe content. This tool uses ScrapingAnt's extended endpoint which provides much richer data than standard scraping: - Full HTML and extracted plain text content - All cookies and HTTP response headers from the target page - Captured XHR/Fetch API requests made by the page (useful for finding hidden APIs) - Content from embedded iframes Best used when you need more than just the HTML - such as analyzing cookies, headers, or JavaScript API calls made by a page. For simple HTML scraping, consider using the basic scrape tool instead for lower API credit usage.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ScrapingAnt API key, obtainable from your user dashboard.

name: Scrapingbee
description: ScrapingBee is a web scraping API that handles headless browsers and proxy rotation, allowing developers to extract HTML from any website in a single API call.

tools.name: ScrapingBee Data Extraction
tools.description: Tool to extract structured data from a webpage using CSS or XPath selectors. Use ScrapingBee's extract_rules feature.

tools.name: ScrapingBee HTML Fetch
tools.description: Tool to fetch HTML or screenshot via ScrapingBee HTML API. Use when you need page markup or image after optional JS rendering and resource controls. For anti-bot or CAPTCHA-protected sites (e.g., Cloudflare), combine render_js=true with premium_proxy=true or stealth_proxy=true to avoid blocks.

tools.name: ScrapingBee Proxy Mode
tools.description: Tool to fetch web content via ScrapingBee's Proxy Mode. Use when you need to route requests through ScrapingBee proxies with optional JS rendering and resource blocking.

tools.name: ScrapingBee Stealth Proxy
tools.description: Tool to perform stealth scraping via ScrapingBee's Stealth Proxy mode. Use when you encounter anti-bot measures requiring undetectable requests.

tools.name: ScrapingBee Usage Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve usage statistics for your ScrapingBee account. Use when you need to monitor remaining credits and request count.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ScrapingBee API key for authentication. You can find your key in your ScrapingBee dashboard.

name: Screenshot API
description: Screenshot API renders webpages and custom HTML as images, PDFs, videos, or extracted content and supports paid asynchronous bulk capture jobs.

tools.name: Create Bulk CSV Job
tools.description: Upload a CSV file to start a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job and return the provider's complete job acceptance payload containing its UUID.

tools.name: Create Bulk JSON Job
tools.description: Start a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job from up to 50 JSON request items and return the provider's complete job acceptance payload containing its UUID.

tools.name: Download Bulk Results
tools.description: Download the processed result CSV for a completed paid bulk screenshot job UUID.

tools.name: Get Bulk Job Status
tools.description: Get progress and success/failure counts for a paid asynchronous bulk screenshot job UUID.

tools.name: Render Screenshot
tools.description: Render a webpage or custom HTML and return a stored image, PDF, or video URL plus optional extracted content links. A custom result filename can replace an existing stored file with the same name.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ScreenshotAPI API key from the dashboard at https://app.screenshotapi.net/dashboard. It is used as the token query parameter for render and paid bulk requests. Keep it secret; rolling the key in dashboard Settings revokes the previous key.

name: Screenshot.fyi
description: Take stunning, premium quality screenshots of any website with one API call.

tools.name: Take Screenshot
tools.description: Tool to capture a webpage screenshot. Use after specifying the target URL and options. JavaScript-heavy pages may capture before full render; ensure the page is fully loaded prior to capture.

required.name: generic_key
required.description: Your API key for authenticating requests to the screenshot.fyi API. Passed as the `accessKey` query parameter.

name: Seam
description: Control smart locks, access systems, thermostats, sensors, and other connected devices in a Seam workspace.

tools.name: Add Access Methods to Grant
tools.description: Request additional PIN, card, mobile-key, or cloud-key methods for an existing access grant.

tools.name: Create Access Grant
tools.description: Grant an existing or new user identity access to spaces, devices, or access-control entrances, requesting PIN, card, mobile-key, or cloud-key methods.

tools.name: Delete Access Grant
tools.description: Permanently revoke and delete an access grant by UUID, removing the access it manages.

tools.name: Get Access Grant
tools.description: Get one access grant by its Seam UUID or unique workspace key.

tools.name: List Access Grants
tools.description: List access grants in the workspace, optionally filtered by space, device, entrance, user identity, reservation, customer, key, or IDs; returns one cursor-controlled page.

tools.name: List Action Attempts
tools.description: Inspect asynchronous Seam operation status, errors, and results in bulk by action-attempt IDs or by device, returning one cursor-controlled page.

tools.name: List Connected Accounts
tools.description: List and search provider accounts connected to the workspace, optionally filtering by space, customer, user, or metadata; returns one cursor-controlled page.

tools.name: List Devices
tools.description: List and search devices in the workspace, optionally filtering by account, space, IDs, type, manufacturer, customer, creation time, or metadata; returns one cursor-controlled page.

tools.name: List Spaces
tools.description: List and search spaces in the workspace by name, key, or customer, returning one cursor-controlled page of grantable locations.

tools.name: Update Access Grant
tools.description: Update an access grant's name or validity window by UUID or unique workspace key. Provide at least one of name, starts_at, or ends_at.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A workspace-specific Seam API key. In Seam Console, select the sandbox or production workspace you want this connection to control, open API Keys in the left navigation, click Add API Key, create the key, and copy it. Each workspace has a different key; never use a Personal Access Token or client session token here.

name: Search api
description: Your real-time SERP API solution. Mastering proxy management, CAPTCHAs, and JSON parsing for seamless web data extraction.

tools.name: Get Account Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account usage statistics including monthly usage, remaining credits, hourly limits, and subscription period information. Use when you need to check current account status or usage limits.

tools.name: Get Cached Search by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve cached search results by search ID in JSON format. Use when you need to access previously executed search results without re-running the query. The search ID is found in the search_metadata.id or search_metadata.json_url field from initial search responses. Cached results are available for 90 days.

tools.name: Get Cached Search HTML by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve cached search results by search ID in HTML format. Use when you need to access the raw HTML snapshot of a previous search execution. The search ID is available in the search_metadata.id or search_metadata.html_url field from initial search responses.

tools.name: Get Locations
tools.description: Tool to get available locations for geo-localized search queries. Use when you need to find location identifiers for targeting Google searches to specific geographic areas. Returns location metadata including identifiers, names, coordinates, and population reach.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Tool to perform unified search across 40+ search engines including Google, Bing, Yahoo, DuckDuckGo, YouTube, Amazon, and more. Use when you need to retrieve search results with rich structured data including organic results, ads, knowledge graphs, local listings, images, videos, and related searches. Supports advanced filtering by location, language, date, device type, and SafeSearch settings.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and copy your API key directly from your dashboard at https://www.searchapi.io/

name: Search1API
description: Search1API provides web, maps, and news search alongside crawling, screenshots, sitemap discovery, and structured data extraction for AI agents.

tools.name: Ask Research
tools.description: Run a natural-language research query across up to five provider-selected engines and return at most 10 deduplicated, reranked results plus partial source errors. Warning: each completed call costs 5 credits.

tools.name: Crawl URLs
tools.description: Fetch readable content from one or more public URLs. Search1API charges 1 credit for each successful item; a target 404 or 410 is a completed, charged lookup. Batch successes may be unordered, and failed items may be omitted.

tools.name: Discover Sitemap
tools.description: Discover sitemap URLs for a public site, or list all links on one public page without fetching page content. Warning: each completed call costs 1 Search1API credit.

tools.name: Extract Structured Data
tools.description: Extract caller-defined structured data from one public webpage using an optional prompt and JSON response shape. Warning: each completed call costs 10 Search1API credits.

tools.name: Get Deepcrawl Status
tools.description: Get the current state of a deepcrawl task and its packaged result URL when available. Status checks are free; this tool performs one check and does not poll automatically or fetch the result package.

tools.name: Get Health
tools.description: Read Search1API's free, unauthenticated provider serving/readiness status. This endpoint does not validate the configured API key; use GET_USAGE for credential checks.

tools.name: Get Trending
tools.description: Return a platform's current live trending feed. Currently documented platform identifiers are github and hackernews; additional provider-supported identifiers are accepted. A successfully completed call costs 1 credit.

tools.name: Get Usage
tools.description: Return the connected account's remaining Search1API credits and credential metadata. This call is free. The optional period is forwarded as documented, but the returned balance is not period consumption.

tools.name: Search Maps
tools.description: Search one Google Maps results page for businesses or places. Each completed page costs 3 Search1API credits, including an empty page; max_results only truncates the response and does not lower the charge.

tools.name: Search News
tools.description: Search recent news for one or more queries with source, site, language, and time filters, returning a typed outcome for each. Each query has a base cost of 1 credit plus 1 credit for each article page successfully fetched through crawl_results. News has no page field and this tool does not auto-paginate.

tools.name: Search Web
tools.description: Search the web for one or more queries and return a typed outcome for each. Each query has a base cost of 1 credit plus 1 credit for each result page successfully fetched through crawl_results. The page field selects one native provider page only for Bing, Bing China, Baidu, and Grokipedia; this tool does not auto-paginate.

tools.name: Start Deepcrawl
tools.description: Start an asynchronous multi-page crawl of a public site and return its task ID. WARNING: each submission creates server-side work and costs 20 Search1API credits. The native API exposes no maximum depth, page or result limit, path filter, or timeout control.

tools.name: Submit Feedback
tools.description: Create external feedback for Search1API about a problem, missing capability, or confusing documentation encountered during a task. Use this tool only when the user explicitly asks to contact Search1API or submit provider feedback. WARNING: this irreversibly stores a non-idempotent external report with the provider and has no retraction endpoint. Never include credentials, PII, or private user content. Do not report every empty result, do not retry the same report automatically, and never let feedback block the primary task. The call is free and limited to 10 submissions per account per minute at a Cloudflare location.

tools.name: Take Screenshot
tools.description: Render a public webpage as a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file with viewport, readiness, selector, and appearance controls. A successful screenshot costs 2 Search1API credits; failed requests are not charged.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or reveal a Search1API key in the API Keys section of https://app.s1.dev, then paste the key here. The key is sent as a bearer credential; keep it secret.

name: SearchAPI MCP
description: SearchAPI MCP lets agents call configured search engines through a hosted OAuth integration with plan and request quotas.

tools.name: Google search light
tools.description: Perform fast Google web searches. Returns organic search results, related searches, and pagination. Suitable for quick information retrieval when advanced filtering is not needed. Requires a search query in `q`.

optional.name: client_id
optional.description: Client id of the app

optional.name: client_secret
optional.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Seat Geek
description: SeatGeek Platform API provides access to events, venues, and performers data for concerts, sports, theater, and other live entertainment

tools.name: Get Event Details
tools.description: Get comprehensive details about a specific event including venue, performers, date/time (in local venue time), ticket information, and a SeatGeek event URL. Performer and venue fields are basic summaries; use SEAT_GEEK_GET_PERFORMER_DETAILS or SEAT_GEEK_GET_VENUE_DETAILS for additional depth. For similarly named or recurring events, cross-check date, venue, league, and competition fields to confirm the correct event.

tools.name: Get Event Recommendations
tools.description: Get personalized event recommendations based on your favorite performers, events, or location. Discover new events you might enjoy.

tools.name: Get Event Seating Information
tools.description: Get section and row layout information for a specific event's venue. Returns available sections (e.g., '101', 'floor', 'suite-14') mapped to their row identifiers. IMPORTANT: Only works for events at major venues with seating maps (stadiums, arenas). Small venue concerts or general admission events will return a 404 error. Use SEAT_GEEK_SEARCH_EVENTS with taxonomies_name='sports' to find events that have seating data.

tools.name: Get Performer Details
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific performer (artist, sports team, or theatrical production) from SeatGeek by their unique ID. Returns comprehensive data including performer name, type, images, popularity scores, upcoming event counts, genre/taxonomy classifications, and ticket URLs. Does not include box scores, match statistics, or performance stats. Use this action when you need fields beyond the basic performer info already embedded in event details (e.g., popularity scores, full taxonomy, upcoming event counts). To find performer IDs, first use the search_performers action to search by name.

tools.name: Get Performer Recommendations
tools.description: Get recommendations for similar performers based on your interests. Discover new artists, bands, teams, or entertainers you might enjoy.

tools.name: Get Event Categories
tools.description: Get a list of all available event categories and types (taxonomies) used on SeatGeek. Useful for understanding event classification and filtering options.

tools.name: Get Venue Details
tools.description: Get detailed venue-specific information (location, address, metadata) beyond what SEAT_GEEK_GET_EVENT_DETAILS already returns. Only call this tool when additional venue fields are needed that are absent from the event details response.

tools.name: Search Events
tools.description: Search for ticketed events on SeatGeek by performers, venues, dates, or general queries. Covers concerts, sports games, theater shows, and other live entertainment. Only indexes ticketed events; empty results may indicate coverage gaps. Avoid over-filtering — start broad and progressively narrow. lat and lon parameters must be supplied together for location-based filtering.

tools.name: Search Performers
tools.description: Search for performers including artists, bands, sports teams, comedians, and more. Find your favorite entertainers and see their upcoming events.

tools.name: Search Venues
tools.description: Search for venues by location, name, or other criteria. Find stadiums, theaters, concert halls, and other entertainment venues. Supports lat/lon coordinate filtering (both must be provided together).

name: SeaTable
description: SeaTable is a collaborative no-code database and spreadsheet platform for managing structured base data, rows, tables, views, and files.

tools.name: Append Rows
tools.description: Append one or more rows to a table in the connected SeaTable base using exact human-readable column names. Requires a read-write per-base API token.

tools.name: Delete Rows
tools.description: Permanently delete one or more rows by row ID from a named table in the connected SeaTable base.

tools.name: Get Base Schema
tools.description: Return the connected base identity and its complete table, column, view, and settings metadata without returning authentication tokens.

tools.name: Get Download Link
tools.description: Generate a short-lived download URL for an existing file or image attachment in the connected SeaTable base. This tool returns a link and does not download the file bytes.

tools.name: Get Row
tools.description: Get one row by its SeaTable _id from a named table in the connected base. Returns human-readable column names by default and preserves all dynamic row fields.

tools.name: List Rows
tools.description: List one page of rows from a table or view in the connected SeaTable base, returning human-readable column names by default.

tools.name: Query Rows with SQL
tools.description: Run one strictly read-only SELECT query against the connected SeaTable base for filtering, sorting, grouping, aggregation, or implicit linked-record traversal. Explicit JOIN, subqueries, and UNION are unsupported.

tools.name: Update Rows
tools.description: Update one or more existing SeaTable rows by row ID. Use exact table and column names from Get Base Schema; every column name is validated before the update, and only supplied columns are changed.

required.name: hostUrl
required.description: The public DNS hostname of your API-Gateway-enabled SeaTable deployment, without a scheme, port, path, query, or fragment. Keep the default cloud.seatable.io for SeaTable Cloud, or enter your Dedicated or self-hosted hostname, for example seatable.example.com. IP addresses and single-label internal hosts are not accepted. API Gateway must be enabled, and connections always use HTTPS.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A permanent API-Token for one base on an API-Gateway-enabled SeaTable Cloud, Dedicated, or self-hosted deployment. Create or copy it from that base's API token management in the SeaTable web interface. Use a read-write token for tools that modify base data; a read-only token supports only reads. Do not enter an Account-Token or short-lived Base-Token.

name: SEC EDGAR
description: Access public SEC EDGAR company submissions, XBRL facts, filing archives, and filing indexes with the caller identity required by the SEC fair-access policy.

tools.name: Get SEC Company Concept
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or CIK and return a bounded page of one company's disclosures for a specific standardized XBRL taxonomy concept.

tools.name: Get SEC Company Profile
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or CIK and return the SEC filer's identity, classification, addresses, tickers, exchanges, and filing-history coverage without returning its filing arrays.

tools.name: Get SEC Filing Document
tools.description: Resolve a filing path and offload one archive file, filing detail page, complete submission, or SGML header while enforcing a caller-selected size cap.

tools.name: Get SEC XBRL Frame
tools.description: Compare one standardized XBRL concept across reporting entities for a calendar period and return a bounded page of matching facts.

tools.name: List SEC Company Filings
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or CIK and return one bounded, normalized page of recent or historical SEC company filings.

tools.name: List SEC Filing Documents
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or CIK and list a bounded page of documents and generated artifacts in one SEC filing archive, including filenames and sizes needed for safe retrieval.

tools.name: Search SEC Company Concepts
tools.description: Resolve a ticker or CIK and search the company's available standardized XBRL concepts. Returns a bounded page of concept metadata and units without returning individual disclosure arrays or values.

tools.name: Search SEC Entities
tools.description: Search SEC companies by ticker, name, or CIK, or mutual funds by ticker, CIK, series ID, or class ID. Returns normalized identifiers for other SEC tools.

tools.name: Search SEC Filing Index
tools.description: Discover and search one daily or quarterly EDGAR master index, returning a bounded page filtered by company, CIK, or form. Quarterly source files over 30 MB are not supported; use a daily index instead.

required.name: user_agent
required.description: Your organization name and administrative contact email for SEC fair-access compliance, for example "Sample Company Name AdminContact@example.com". The SEC public EDGAR APIs require automated callers to identify themselves with this header; it is not a secret or API credential. See the SEC EDGAR API documentation for details.

name: Securitytrails
description: SecurityTrails is a cybersecurity platform providing comprehensive domain, IP, DNS, and WHOIS intelligence data. It offers historical DNS records, subdomain discovery, WHOIS history, associated domains, passive DNS datasets, and website technology detection to support threat hunting, brand protection, cyber forensics, and attack surface management.

tools.name: Bulk Static Asset Rules
tools.description: Bulk add or remove static asset rules for a SecurityTrails ASI project. Static asset rules define which domains/IPs are included or excluded from the project's monitoring scope. This operation processes up to 1000 rules (combined add + remove) per request. The API processes rules asynchronously, waiting up to 2 seconds for completion. If processing takes longer, task_ids are returned for status polling. Note: Requires a valid project_id from the List Projects endpoint. Use the Get Static Assets endpoint to verify changes after bulk operations complete.

tools.name: Get Company Associated IPs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve IPs associated with a company domain. Use when you need to find all IP addresses linked to an organization's domain name.

tools.name: Get Domain Details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive domain information from SecurityTrails including current DNS records, infrastructure details, and statistics. This tool fetches detailed DNS data (A, AAAA, MX, NS, SOA, TXT records) along with metadata about when records were first seen, which organizations own the infrastructure, and how many other domains share the same servers. Useful for domain reconnaissance, infrastructure mapping, security analysis, and understanding domain configurations. Returns structured data with typed fields for easy programmatic access by AI agents.

tools.name: Get Domain SSL
tools.description: Tool to fetch current and historical SSL certificate details for a hostname. Use when you need to retrieve SSL data after identifying the domain. Coverage limited to certificates indexed by SecurityTrails; private, internally-issued, or very recently issued certificates may be absent.

tools.name: IP Search Statistics
tools.description: Fetch aggregated statistics for IP addresses matching a DSL query. Returns top open ports by frequency, common reverse DNS patterns, and total count. Useful for analyzing IP infrastructure patterns, port distributions, and PTR records across specific IP ranges or reverse DNS domains.

tools.name: List ASI Projects
tools.description: Tool to list ASI projects available to the account. Use when you need project IDs for subsequent ASI operations.

tools.name: Ping
tools.description: Tool to test authentication and connectivity with the SecurityTrails API. Use after configuring API key.

tools.name: Scroll Results
tools.description: Tool to continue scrolling through DSL search results. Use after receiving a scroll_id from SECURITYTRAILS_SEARCH_IPS or SECURITYTRAILS_SQL_API_EXECUTE_QUERY to fetch the next batch of data. Call iteratively until no scroll_id is returned to retrieve all pages.

tools.name: Search IPs
tools.description: Tool to search IP addresses via SecurityTrails DSL. Use when you need to filter IPs with custom DSL queries. Results are paginated; use SecurityTrails scroll mechanisms for large result sets to avoid missing assets.

tools.name: SQL API Execute Query
tools.description: Execute SQL-like queries against SecurityTrails data. Query the 'hosts' table for domain/DNS information or the 'ips' table for IP address/ASN/port data. Returns up to 100 records per request with a scroll ID for pagination. Supports standard SQL syntax (SELECT, WHERE, AND, OR, IN, IS NULL) but does NOT support LIMIT clause.

tools.name: SQL API Scroll Results
tools.description: Tool to fetch next page of SQL query results. Use after obtaining scroll_id from initial SQL API response.

tools.name: Temp Scrape Securitytrails Usage
tools.description: Retrieve account usage information from the SecurityTrails API. This action fetches the current monthly usage and allowed monthly usage limits for your SecurityTrails API account. Use this to monitor your API quota consumption. Returns: On success (200): - current_monthly_usage: Your current API usage for the month - allowed_monthly_usage: Your total allowed monthly API quota On error: - status_code: HTTP status code - response_text: Error message from API

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your SecurityTrails API key, obtainable from your SecurityTrails account.

name: SeekTable
description: SeekTable is a business intelligence platform for creating, managing, and exporting reports, cubes, and dashboards.

tools.name: Export Report
tools.description: Export a saved SeekTable report in a selected file or data format. This performs one read-only provider request and requires a report ID returned by List Reports.

tools.name: Get Cube
tools.description: Get metadata for one SeekTable cube by its ID.

tools.name: Get Report
tools.description: Get metadata and serialized configuration for one saved SeekTable report.

tools.name: List Cubes
tools.description: List cubes in the connected SeekTable account, optionally filtering by provider source type.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: List saved reports in the connected SeekTable account, including IDs needed by report detail and export tools.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your SeekTable account API key. In SeekTable, open Manage Account and select Get API Key, then copy the key shown there. The key is sent unchanged in the Authorization header, so do not add a Bearer prefix.

name: Segment
description: Twilio Segment is a customer data platform that helps businesses collect, clean, and control their customer data.

tools.name: Add Labels to Source
tools.description: Tool to add existing labels to a Source. Use when you have the source ID and want to tag it with metadata labels.

tools.name: Segment Alias
tools.description: Tool to alias a previous user ID to a new user ID. Use when merging anonymous and known identities.

tools.name: Batch Segment Analytics Events
tools.description: Tool to send multiple analytics calls in a single batch request. Use when you want to reduce HTTP overhead by batching Identify/Track/Page/Screen/Group calls into one request.

tools.name: Delete Source
tools.description: Tool to delete a Segment Source. Use when you need to permanently remove a Source by its ID after confirmation.

tools.name: Get Daily Per Source API Calls Usage
tools.description: Tool to fetch daily API call counts per source for a given period. Use when you need daily breakdown of API usage by source after determining the reporting period.

tools.name: Get Destination
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a Destination by ID. Use when you need to fetch the full configuration of a Segment Destination instance by its unique identifier. Falls back US→EU public API and legacy app endpoint; returns minimal envelope on legacy HTML or parse errors.

tools.name: Segment Group
tools.description: Tool to associate an identified user with a group via Segment HTTP Tracking API. Use when grouping users with traits.

tools.name: Segment Identify
tools.description: Tool to identify a user and set/update traits via Segment HTTP Tracking API.

tools.name: Import Historical Data
tools.description: Tool to import historical data in bulk with support for historical timestamps. Use when you need to backfill or import past events with their original timestamps into Segment.

tools.name: List Connected Warehouses From Source
tools.description: Tool to list warehouses connected to a Source. Use when you need to retrieve warehouses for a given source ID.

tools.name: List Delivery Metrics Summary from Destination
tools.description: Get an event delivery metrics summary from a Destination. Primary attempt uses Segment Public API; fallback to legacy app host if needed. On HTML fallback responses, returns a minimal valid envelope to maintain contract.

tools.name: List Schema Settings in Source
tools.description: Retrieve schema configuration settings for a Source.

tools.name: Segment Page View
tools.description: Tool to record a page view via Segment HTTP Tracking API. Use when sending page views with optional page name and properties.

tools.name: Remove Source Write Key
tools.description: Tool to remove a write key from a Source. Use when you need to revoke an existing write key for security or rotation.

tools.name: Segment Screen Event
tools.description: Tool to record a mobile app screen view. Use when tracking screen views in a mobile app via Segment HTTP Tracking API.

tools.name: Segment Track Event
tools.description: Tool to record a custom user event via Segment HTTP Tracking API. Use when sending events to Segment with valid identity.

tools.name: Update Source
tools.description: Tool to update a Source's metadata and settings. Use when you need to modify an existing Source after confirming its ID.

required.name: region
required.description: The region of the Segment Workspace, either 'api' for US-based Workspaces or 'eu1' for EU-based Workspaces.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the Segment Public API.

name: Segmetrics
description: SegMetrics is a marketing analytics platform that provides detailed insights into customer journeys, helping businesses optimize their marketing strategies.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Tool to create a new product in SegMetrics. Use after confirming product details.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a specific contact by ID or email from SegMetrics. Use after confirming the contact exists. This action is irreversible. Note: Associated invoices and purchases remain in the system.

tools.name: Add or Update Contact
tools.description: Tool to add or update a contact in SegMetrics. Use when you need to upsert the contact record during data import.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your SegMetrics API Key. Find it in Account Settings at https://app.segmetrics.io/a/account/edit

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your SegMetrics Account ID. Find it in Account Settings at https://app.segmetrics.io/a/account/edit

name: Semrush MCP
description: Access live Semrush SEO, keyword, backlink, traffic, market, project, and competitive intelligence data through Semrush's official hosted MCP server.

tools.name: Audience research
tools.description: Audience Analytics: visitor profile of a domain — demographics (age, gender, income, education, household size, occupation), audience interests, visitor geography by country, audience overlap between domains, purchase conversion, and top domains by industry category. Use when the question is about WHO visits a site or audience composition. For traffic volume, engagement, or acquisition channels, use traffic_overview instead. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Backlinks research
tools.description: Backlink Analytics: for a single domain's link profile — backlinks, referring domains and IPs, anchor texts, geographic and TLD distribution, Authority Score breakdown, domain and referring-domain categories, and historical trends. Analyzes one domain at a time. Not suitable for comparing or cross-referencing backlink data across multiple domains. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Competitors research
tools.description: Competitive Research: find who competes with a domain in organic search, paid search, and Google Shopping (PLA); compare keyword overlap and backlink profiles between multiple domains; analyze market rankings and backlink competitors. Use this when the task involves comparing, contrasting, or cross-referencing two or more domains. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Domain overview
tools.description: Domain Overview: high-level counters for a domain, subdomain, subfolder, or URL — Semrush Rank, keyword/traffic/cost totals, PLA, SERP Features. Use-if: rank, score, totals, global rank, or rank trend over time. Avoid-if: you need the individual keywords — use organic_research. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Execute report
tools.description: Execute any Semrush report. Requires params from get_report_schema.

tools.name: Get report schema
tools.description: Get parameters for a report. MUST call before execute_report if params unknown.

tools.name: Keyword research
tools.description: Keyword Analytics: look up any keyword — search volume, CPC, competition, keyword difficulty, SERP results (organic and paid), related keywords, broad match variations, phrase questions, and ads history. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Organic research
tools.description: Organic Search Analytics: the actual keywords and pages a domain, subdomain, or URL ranks for in organic search (position, volume, traffic). Use-if: you need the list of keywords/pages. Avoid-if: Semrush Rank, counts, or rank trend — use domain_overview. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Paid search research
tools.description: Paid Search Analytics: keywords that trigger a domain's paid search (Google Ads) results, ad positions, CPCs, traffic estimates, unique ad copies with titles and descriptions, and historical PPC trends. Requires a domain as input — not for keyword-to-domain lookups. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Position tracking
tools.description: Position Tracking: ongoing rank monitoring within pre-configured project campaigns — track how a domain ranks for targeted keywords over time, daily position changes in organic and paid search, visibility trends, and landing page performance, by location and device. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Projects
tools.description: Project Management: list and inspect your Semrush projects (campaigns) — each project's ID, name, and tracked domain, plus which tools are enabled. Use first to obtain the project ID that position_tracking and site_audit require as input. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Shopping research
tools.description: Shopping Analytics: keywords that trigger a domain's Google Shopping (PLA) ads, ad positions, traffic estimates, and unique product listings with titles and prices. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Site audit
tools.description: Site Audit: technical SEO health analysis within pre-configured project campaigns — crawl a website to find errors, warnings, and notices, site health score, page-level issue details with fix recommendations, and historical audit snapshots to track progress. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

tools.name: Traffic overview
tools.description: Traffic Overview: website traffic volume and engagement — total visits, unique visitors, pages per visit, bounce rate, visit duration, daily/weekly trends, acquisition channels (direct, referral, search, social, paid), traffic destinations, top pages, subdomain and subfolder breakdown. Use when the question is about HOW MUCH traffic a site gets or HOW users engage. For visitor demographics, interests, or geographic origin, use audience_research instead. Returns available reports. NEXT: get_report_schema then execute_report.

name: Sendbird
description: Sendbird is a platform that provides chat, voice, and video APIs to help businesses build in-app communication features.

tools.name: Add Members To Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to add members to a group channel. Use when you need to invite one or more users into an existing group channel.

tools.name: Ban User from Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to ban a user from a group channel. Use when moderating group channels to restrict member access. Execute after confirming channel_url and user_id.

tools.name: Create Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to create a new group channel. Use when you need to start a conversation with specific users. Execute after specifying users and optional settings.

tools.name: Create Sendbird User
tools.description: Creates a new user in Sendbird. Use this to register user accounts before they can join channels or send messages. The user_id must be unique across the application.

tools.name: Delete Group Channel
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Sendbird group channel. Use this tool when you need to remove a group channel and all its associated data (messages, members, etc.). WARNING: This action is irreversible. Requires the channel_url identifier of the channel to delete.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Permanently deletes a specific message from a Sendbird group channel. This action cannot be undone. Use this when you need to remove a message that was sent by mistake or contains inappropriate content. Requires both channel_url and message_id, which can be obtained from channel/message listing endpoints.

tools.name: Delete Sendbird User
tools.description: Tool to delete a Sendbird user. Use when you need to remove a user from your Sendbird application, optionally permanently.

tools.name: Get Count Preference Of Channel
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's count preference for a specific group channel. Use after confirming the user and channel exist to determine whether to display all, unread-only, or mention-only counts.

tools.name: Get User Group Channel Count by Join Status
tools.description: Retrieves the number of group channels for a user, categorized by join status (joined, invited, etc.). Use this tool to get channel count statistics for a specific user, optionally filtered by channel properties like visibility (public/private), distinctness, or super mode. Returns counts of joined channels, invited channels (with friend/non-friend breakdown), and total count.

tools.name: Sendbird Get Unread Item Count
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's unread item counts including unread messages, mentions, and pending invitations across group channels. Use this to display unread counts in the UI for a specific user.

tools.name: Issue Session Token
tools.description: Issues a session token for authenticating a Sendbird user. Use this tool when you need to: - Generate a new session token for SDK authentication - Refresh an expiring or expired session token - Provide secure access for a user to connect to Sendbird chat The session token has a default expiration of 7 days if expires_at is not specified.

tools.name: Leave Group Channels
tools.description: Tool to leave group channels for a user. Use when you need to make a user exit one or more joined group channels.

tools.name: List Banned Members
tools.description: Tool to list banned members in a group channel. Use when you need to see which users are banned from a specific group channel.

tools.name: Sendbird List Group Channel Messages
tools.description: Tool to list (paginate) messages in a group channel when you only know the channel_url. Requires either message_ts (Unix ms timestamp) or message_id as an anchor. Use with SENDBIRD_VIEW_GROUP_CHANNEL (show_read_receipt=true) to fetch unread messages: get last-read timestamp, then call this with message_ts=<last_read>, prev_limit=0, next_limit=<batch_size>, include=false.

tools.name: List Group Channels
tools.description: Tool to list group channels. Use when you need to fetch paginated group channels with optional filters.

tools.name: List Group Channel Members
tools.description: Tool to list members of a group channel. Use when you need to paginate through members of a specified group channel.

tools.name: List Operators by Custom Channel Type
tools.description: Tool to list operators of a channel by custom channel type. Use when you need to fetch operators for a specific custom channel type with pagination.

tools.name: List Group Channel Operators
tools.description: Tool to list operators of a group channel. Use after specifying the channel_url when needing to paginate through operators.

tools.name: List Open Channel Operators
tools.description: Tool to list operators of an open channel. Use when you have the open channel URL and need to fetch its operators. Supports pagination via token and limit.

tools.name: List Sendbird Users
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users from your Sendbird application. Use this tool to: - Browse all users in your application - Search for users by nickname or user IDs - Filter users by metadata, custom type, or activity status - Paginate through large user lists using the 'next' token Returns user details including profile info, connection status, and metadata. Results are paginated; use the 'next' token from the response to fetch additional pages.

tools.name: Mark All User Messages As Read
tools.description: Tool to mark all of a user's messages as read in group channels. Use when resetting unread message counts after a user has viewed all messages.

tools.name: Mute User
tools.description: Tool to mute a user in a group channel. Use when you need to prevent a user from sending messages for a specified duration.

tools.name: Register Operators by Custom Channel Type
tools.description: Registers one or more users as operators for all channels with a specified custom channel type. Use this tool when you need to grant operator privileges to users across all channels that share the same custom_type. Operators have elevated permissions including: - Muting and banning users from channels - Deleting messages in channels - Freezing/unfreezing channels - Managing channel settings Prerequisites: - The user IDs must belong to existing Sendbird users - The custom_type should match channels you want to manage Note: This affects all channels with the specified custom_type, not just a single channel.

tools.name: Register Group Channel Operators
tools.description: Tool to register one or more users as operators in a Sendbird group channel. Use when elevating permissions of existing channel members.

tools.name: Register Operators to Open Channel
tools.description: Tool to register operators to an open channel. Use after creating or updating an open channel when you need to assign operator roles.

tools.name: Revoke All Session Tokens
tools.description: Tool to revoke all session tokens for a user. Use when you need to invalidate all active sessions for security.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Tool to send a message to a group channel. Use when you need to post a text, file, or admin message to an existing group channel.

tools.name: Unban User from Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to unban a user from a group channel. Use when reinstating a previously banned user. Execute after confirming the user is currently banned.

tools.name: Unmute User
tools.description: Tool to unmute a user in a group channel. Use when you want to restore a muted user's ability to send messages after confirming they are muted.

tools.name: Unregister Operators Custom Channel Type
tools.description: Tool to unregister operators from channels by custom channel type. Use when you need to remove operator roles from users across channels of a specific custom type.

tools.name: Update Count Preference Of Channel
tools.description: Tool to update a user's unread count preference for a specific group channel. Use when you want to include or suppress a channel in the user's unread counts.

tools.name: Update Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to update group channel information. Use when you need to modify channel attributes such as name, cover image, privacy settings, or operator list after channel creation.

tools.name: Sendbird Update Message
tools.description: Tool to update an existing group channel message in Sendbird. Use after you need to modify content or metadata of a sent message.

tools.name: Update Sendbird User
tools.description: Tool to update a user's information. Use when modifying nickname, profile image URL, activation status, or metadata.

tools.name: Sendbird View Group Channel
tools.description: Tool to view information about a specific group channel. Use when you need channel details after confirming the channel_url.

tools.name: Sendbird View Message
tools.description: Tool to view a specific message in a group channel. Use after confirming channel_url and message_id.

tools.name: View User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific Sendbird user. Use when you need to fetch detailed user data by their user ID.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The unique identifier for your Sendbird application, used to construct the base URL for API requests.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the Sendbird API. This should be added to the Api-Token header.

name: Sendbird AI Chatbot
description: Sendbird's AI Chatbot enables businesses to integrate intelligent, automated conversational agents into their applications, enhancing customer engagement and support.

tools.name: Create Bot
tools.description: Tool to create a new bot. Use when you need to add an AI or default bot to your Sendbird app.

tools.name: Get Bot
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information on a specific bot by its user ID. Use when you need to fetch bot details before performing subsequent operations.

tools.name: List Bots
tools.description: Tool to list all bots in the Sendbird application. Use when you need to fetch bot details with optional filters and pagination.

tools.name: List Group Channels
tools.description: Tool to list group channels. Use when you need to fetch available group channels with filters and pagination.

tools.name: Unregister Bot Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unregister the webhook URL for a bot. Use when you need to remove webhook configuration for a specific bot.

tools.name: Update Bot
tools.description: Tool to update information on an existing bot. Use when you need to change a bot's user ID, nickname, profile image URL, or toggle read-receipt or privacy settings after creation. Run after confirming the bot ID.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The unique identifier for your Sendbird application.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token for authenticating requests to the Sendbird AI Chatbot API.

name: Sender
description: Email marketing platform for creating campaigns, automating workflows, and tracking results

tools.name: Create Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom subscriber field in Sender.net. Use when you need to add custom fields for email personalization, segmentation, or storing additional subscriber information like company name, birthday, job title, or other custom attributes.

tools.name: Create Or Update Subscriber
tools.description: Tool to create a new subscriber or update an existing one in Sender.net. Use when you need to add new subscribers to your email list or update existing subscriber information. This performs an upsert operation - creates if the email doesn't exist, updates if it does.

tools.name: Get All Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all custom subscriber fields configured in the Sender.net account. Use when you need to view available fields for email personalization, segmentation, or managing subscriber data.

tools.name: Get All Workflows
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all automation workflows in the Sender account. Use when you need to view or manage automation workflows.

tools.name: Get Campaign By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific campaign by its unique ID from Sender. Use when you need detailed information about a campaign including delivery metrics and engagement statistics.

tools.name: Get Group By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific subscriber group by its unique ID from Sender. Use when you need detailed information about a single group including subscriber counts.

tools.name: Get Subscriber By ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific subscriber by their unique ID from Sender. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a single subscriber including their status, groups, and custom fields.

tools.name: Get Subscriber Events
tools.description: Return filtered event history and campaign activity totals for a subscriber.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: Return one paginated page of groups from the connected Sender account.

tools.name: List Subscribers
tools.description: Return one paginated page of subscribers from the connected Sender account.

tools.name: Update Subscriber Fields
tools.description: Tool to update custom fields and information for an existing subscriber in Sender.net. Use when you need to modify subscriber details such as email, first name, last name, groups, or custom fields for email personalization and segmentation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Navigate to Settings > API access tokens in your Sender account to create a token

name: Sendfox
description: Sendfox is an affordable email marketing platform for content creators. Manage contacts, create email campaigns, automate sequences, and grow your audience.

tools.name: Delete Contact from List
tools.description: Tool to remove a contact from a specific list in SendFox. Use when you need to disassociate a contact from a list without deleting the contact entirely. The contact will remain in your account but will no longer be a member of the specified list.

tools.name: Get Automations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of automations. Use when you need to list all automations for your SendFox account.

tools.name: Get Campaign by ID
tools.description: Retrieve details for a specific campaign by its ID from SendFox. Use this when you need to fetch information about a particular campaign. Returns campaign details including title, subject, HTML content, sender info, and scheduling details.

tools.name: Get Campaigns
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of email campaigns from SendFox. Use this to fetch all campaigns or navigate through pages of results. Returns campaign details including status, subject, content, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Contact by ID
tools.description: Retrieves a contact's details by their unique ID from SendFox. Use this tool when you need to look up a specific contact's information after obtaining their ID from a contact list or other API response. Returns contact details including email, name, subscription status, and list memberships.

tools.name: Get Contact Fields
tools.description: Retrieves all contact fields available in the SendFox account. Use this to discover available fields before creating or updating contacts. Returns standard fields (email, first_name, last_name) and any custom fields configured in the account.

tools.name: Get Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of contacts. Use when you need to fetch contacts in pages, optionally filtering by email.

tools.name: Get Contacts in List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve contacts in a specific list. Use when you need to fetch all contacts belonging to a particular list, optionally filtering by search query.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the authenticated user from SendFox. Returns user details including name, email, contact count, and contact limit. Use this tool when you need to check account information or verify authentication status.

tools.name: Get Forms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of forms from SendFox. Use when you need to fetch all forms or search for specific forms by query.

tools.name: Get List by ID
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific contact list by its ID from SendFox. Use this tool when you need information about a particular list (name, contact count, timestamps). Requires a valid list_id which can be obtained from the 'Get Lists' action.

tools.name: Get Lists
tools.description: Retrieve all contact lists from your SendFox account with pagination support. Use this tool when you need to: - Fetch all available contact lists for your account - Get list IDs to use with other SendFox actions (e.g., adding contacts to lists) - Check list names and browse through paginated results Returns a list of contact lists with their IDs and names, along with pagination metadata.

tools.name: List Contact Fields
tools.description: Tool to list all custom contact fields defined by the user. Returns a paginated list of contact fields with their IDs, names, and timestamps.

tools.name: List Unsubscribed Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of contacts who have unsubscribed. Use when you need to fetch unsubscribed contacts, optionally filtering by search query.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Contact
tools.description: Unsubscribe a contact from all email communications in your SendFox account. Use this tool when you need to: - Globally unsubscribe a contact from all future emails - Honor unsubscribe requests from subscribers - Mark a contact as opted-out The contact will be marked as unsubscribed but remains in your contacts database. This is a permanent action - the contact will not receive any future campaigns.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a new contact (subscriber) in your SendFox account. Use this tool when you need to: - Add a new subscriber to your email list - Create a contact with optional first/last name - Add a contact to one or more specific lists If the contact already exists, their information will be updated with the provided data.

tools.name: Create List
tools.description: Create a new contact list in your SendFox account. Use this tool when you need to: - Create a new mailing list for organizing contacts - Set up a list before adding subscribers to it - Segment your audience by creating topic-specific lists The list will be created with 0 contacts initially. After creation, use other SendFox actions to add contacts to this list. Returns the created list's ID, name, and metadata.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Sendfox Personal Access Token. Create one at https://sendfox.com/account/oauth

name: Sendlane
description: Sendlane is a cloud-based marketing automation platform that helps eCommerce businesses engage customers through personalized email and SMS campaigns.

tools.name: Get Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of email campaigns. Use when you need to fetch all campaigns with optional pagination.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields
tools.description: Retrieve a list of all custom fields in your Sendlane account. Custom fields allow you to store additional contact information beyond the standard fields. Use this tool to discover available custom fields, their IDs, names, tags, and types before creating or updating contacts with custom field data. Supports optional pagination via page and per_page parameters.

tools.name: Get Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all mailing lists. Use when you need to fetch or display all available contact lists with optional pagination.

tools.name: Delete List

name: Sentry MCP
description: Investigate Sentry issues, events, projects, and application health.

tools.name: Analyze issue with seer
tools.description:
Use Seer to analyze production errors and get detailed root cause analysis with specific code fixes.

Use this tool when:
- The user explicitly asks for root cause analysis, Seer analysis, or help fixing/debugging an issue
- You are unable to accurately determine the root cause from the issue details alone

Do NOT call this tool as an automatic follow-up to get_sentry_resource.

What this tool provides:
- Root cause analysis with code-level explanations
- Specific file locations and line numbers where errors occur
- Concrete code fixes you can apply
- Step-by-step implementation guidance

This tool automatically:
1. Checks if analysis already exists (instant results)
2. Starts new AI analysis if needed (~2-5 minutes)
3. Returns complete fix recommendations

<examples>
### User: "Run Seer on this issue"

```
analyze_issue_with_seer(issueUrl='https://my-org.sentry.io/issues/PROJECT-1Z43')
```

### User: "Analyze this issue and suggest a fix"

```
analyze_issue_with_seer(organizationSlug='my-organization', issueId='ERROR-456')
```
</examples>

<hints>
- Only use when the user explicitly requests analysis or you cannot determine the root cause from issue details alone
- Seer Autofix does not support metric alert issues (issueCategory: metric); use get_issue_details and search_events instead
- If the user provides an issueUrl, extract it and use that parameter alone
- The analysis includes actual code snippets and fixes, not just error descriptions
- Results are cached - subsequent calls return instantly
</hints>

tools.name: Execute sentry tool
tools.description:
Execute an available Sentry MCP tool discovered through search_sentry_tools.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Call a Sentry operation returned by search_sentry_tools
- Execute a tool by name using arguments that match its returned schema

<examples>
execute_sentry_tool(name='find_projects', arguments={ organizationSlug: 'my-org' })
execute_sentry_tool(name='whoami', arguments={})
</examples>

<hints>
- Use search_sentry_tools first if you are not sure which name or arguments to pass.
- Arguments are validated against the target tool's schema before execution.
- Active organization, project, and region constraints are injected automatically.
</hints>
