tools.name: Get sentry resource
tools.description:
Fetch a Sentry resource by URL, or by resourceType plus resourceId.
Pass a Sentry URL directly when possible; the resource type is auto-detected.

Supports issues, events, traces, spans, agent conversations, replays, monitors, preprod snapshots, and snapshot images.
Trace lookups return a condensed overview by default.

Agent Conversations: A conversation is a set of spans sharing the same gen_ai.conversation.id. Use resourceType='ai_conversation' with a conversation ID, or pass a Sentry conversation URL, to fetch the transcript/details. To discover or list conversations, use search_agent_conversations. Conversations are NOT issues — do not use search_issues for conversation queries.

For preprod snapshot URLs (matching 'sentry.io/preprod/snapshots/'):
- Without ?selectedSnapshot=: returns the snapshot diff summary (changed, added, removed images)
- With ?selectedSnapshot=<image_file_name>: returns the image preview and metadata. Use the Sentry tool `get_snapshot_image` for full-resolution image bytes.

Resource IDs:
- monitor: <monitorSlug>
- snapshot: <snapshotId>

<examples>
get_sentry_resource(url='https://sentry.io/issues/PROJECT-123/')
get_sentry_resource(resourceType='issue', organizationSlug='my-org', resourceId='PROJECT-123')
get_sentry_resource(resourceType='ai_conversation', organizationSlug='my-org', resourceId='conversation-123')
get_sentry_resource(url='https://sentry.sentry.io/preprod/snapshots/123/')
get_sentry_resource(url='https://sentry.sentry.io/preprod/snapshots/123/?selectedSnapshot=login_screen.png')
</examples>

tools.name: Search events
tools.description:
Search Sentry events and replays. Use for event counts/statistics.

`query` can be natural language or Sentry search syntax. With an agent configured, it fixes dataset, query, fields, and sort before running.

Supports TWO query types:
1. AGGREGATIONS (counts, sums, averages): 'how many errors', 'total tokens'
2. Individual events with timestamps: 'error logs from last hour'

Datasets:
- errors: Exception/crash events with stack traces, usually grouped into issues
- logs: Application log entries, including error-severity log messages
- spans: Raw trace/span events for performance, AI/LLM calls, requests, and operations
- metrics: Metric rows and aggregates: counters, gauges, distributions, values
- profiles: Transaction/continuous profile results, profile IDs, profiled transactions
- replays: Session replay results: rage clicks, dead clicks, visited pages, replay users
If the user says logs, log messages, error logs, or warning logs, choose logs instead of errors.

Replay searches return replay lists only; replay count()/avg()/sum() are not supported.

NOT for grouped issue lists (use search_issues) or app screenshots/images (use get_latest_base_snapshot).

<examples>
search_events(organizationSlug='my-org', query='how many errors today')
search_events(organizationSlug='my-org', dataset='errors', query='level:error')
search_events(organizationSlug='my-org', dataset='errors', fields=['issue', 'count()'], sort='-count()')
search_events(organizationSlug='my-org', dataset='spans', query='span.op:db', sort='-span.duration')
search_events(organizationSlug='my-org', dataset='replays', query='count_errors:>0', sort='-count_errors')
</examples>

<hints>
- If the user passes a parameter in the form of name/otherName, it's likely in the format of <organizationSlug>/<projectSlug>.
- Parse org/project notation directly without calling find_organizations or find_projects.
- Use fields with aggregate functions like count(), avg(), sum() for statistics
- Sort by -count() for most common, -timestamp for newest
</hints>

tools.name: Search issues
tools.description:
Search for grouped issues/problems in Sentry - returns a LIST of issues, NOT counts or aggregations.

Provide `query` as natural language or Sentry issue search syntax. When an embedded agent is configured, it fixes query and sort before running while preserving explicit Sentry search syntax.

Returns grouped issues with metadata like title, status, and user count.

Common Query Syntax:
- is:unresolved / is:resolved / is:ignored / is:for_review / is:new / is:regressed / is:escalating
- level:error / level:warning
- firstSeen:-24h / lastSeen:-7d
- assigned:me / assigned_or_suggested:me
- release:latest
- issue.category:feedback
- issue.priority:high
- environment:production
- userCount:>100

DO NOT USE FOR COUNTS/AGGREGATIONS → use search_events
DO NOT USE FOR individual events with timestamps → use search_events
DO NOT USE FOR details about a specific issue → use get_sentry_resource

<examples>
search_issues(organizationSlug='my-org', query='critical bugs from last week')
search_issues(organizationSlug='my-org', query='is:unresolved is:unassigned', sort='freq')
search_issues(organizationSlug='my-org', query='level:error firstSeen:-24h', projectSlugOrId='my-project')
</examples>

<hints>
- If the user passes a parameter in the form of name/otherName, it's likely in the format of <organizationSlug>/<projectSlugOrId>.
- Parse org/project notation directly without calling find_organizations or find_projects.
- The projectSlugOrId parameter accepts both project slugs (e.g., 'my-project') and numeric IDs (e.g., '123456').
</hints>

tools.name: Search sentry tools
tools.description:
Search the available Sentry MCP tool catalog by name and description.

Many Sentry operations are intentionally not exposed as top-level tools. Use this for any Sentry-related task when you do not see an obvious direct tool, including long-tail inspection, project management, documentation lookup, preprod snapshots, attachments, DSNs, releases, teams, and issue-specific pivots.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Find the right Sentry operation for a task
- Discover catalog tools and their schemas for a task
- Inspect the executable JSON input schema for an available tool

<examples>
search_sentry_tools(query='list projects')
search_sentry_tools(query='issue details')
search_sentry_tools(query='find dsn', limit=5)
search_sentry_tools(query='snapshot image')
</examples>

<hints>
- Results only include tools available in the current session.
- If a Sentry operation is not listed as a direct tool, search here before deciding it is unavailable.
- Returned schemas already account for active organization, project, and region constraints.
- Use the returned name and schema when executing a catalog result.
- This tool returns structured JSON. Do not parse markdown from its text content.
</hints>

tools.name: Update issue
tools.description:
Update a Sentry issue's status or assignment.

Use this to resolve, reopen, assign, or ignore an issue.

<examples>
```
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', status='resolved')
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', assignedTo='user:123456')
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', status='ignored')
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', status='ignored', ignoreMode='forever')
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', status='ignored', ignoreMode='untilOccurrenceCount', ignoreCount=100, ignoreWindowMinutes=60)
update_issue(organizationSlug='my-org', issueId='PROJECT-123', status='ignored', reason='Ignoring because this is expected noise from the staging deploy')
```
</examples>

<hints>
- Provide `issueUrl` or `organizationSlug` + `issueId`.
- At least one of `status` or `assignedTo` is required.
- `assignedTo` format: `user:ID` or `team:ID_OR_SLUG`.
- Use `execute_sentry_tool(name='whoami', arguments={})` to find your user ID for self-assignment.
- Status values: `resolved`, `resolvedInNextRelease`, `unresolved`, `ignored`.
- `status='ignored'` defaults to `ignoreMode='untilEscalating'`.
- Ignore modes: `untilEscalating`, `forever`, `forDuration`, `untilOccurrenceCount`, `untilUserCount`.
- Matching ignore inputs are `ignoreDurationMinutes`, `ignoreCount` + optional `ignoreWindowMinutes`, or `ignoreUserCount` + optional `ignoreUserWindowMinutes`.
- To switch an already ignored issue between `untilEscalating`, `forever`, and condition-based ignore modes, first set `status='unresolved'`, then ignore it again with the new rule.
- `reason` is optional. When provided, it will be posted as a comment on the issue's activity feed explaining why the action was taken.
</hints>

tools.description: Submit one website for an asynchronous SEO audit. Every successful submission consumes one paid monthly report credit. Do not retry an ambiguous outcome, because a duplicate submission can consume another credit. Use the returned report ID with Get Audit Report.

tools.name: Get Audit Report
tools.description: Return the current state of an SEO audit report by ID. A report still running is returned as processing with a 60-second retry hint; completed reports include all template-dependent audit checks and recommendations.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your unique SEOptimer SEO Audit API key. In the SEOptimer dashboard, open the API main menu, select API, and copy the key shown in the API panel. An active SEO API plan is required. Keep this key secret.

name: Seqera
description: Seqera Platform is an intuitive, centralized command post that enables data analysis at scale, allowing users to launch, manage, and monitor scalable Nextflow pipelines and compute environments on-premises or across cloud providers.

tools.name: Create Wave Container
tools.description: Tool to submit a request to Wave for accessing a private container registry or building a container image on-the-fly. Use when you need to provision containers via Wave with Dockerfile, Conda recipe, or package specifications. Returns the name of the container made available by Wave.

tools.name: Get Organization Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific organization.

tools.name: Get Service Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the Seqera API service. Use when you need to check the service version and commit ID for troubleshooting.

tools.name: Get User Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the authenticated user. Use when you need to fetch details of the current user after authentication.

tools.name: Get Wave Build Logs
tools.description: Tool to get logs for a container build by build ID. Use when you need to troubleshoot or inspect the build process of a Wave container.

tools.name: Get Wave Build Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status of a Wave container build by build ID. Use when you need to check if a container build is completed and whether it succeeded.

tools.name: Inspect Wave Container
tools.description: Tool to inspect container image metadata via Wave. Use when you need registry, manifest, digest, configuration, and OCI compatibility information about a container image.

tools.name: List Action Event Types
tools.description: Tool to list supported action event types. Use when you need to discover available triggers for pipelines, optionally filtered by workspace.

tools.name: List Compute Environments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of compute environments. Use when you need to page, sort, or filter compute environments accessible to your account.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: Tool to list all organizations. Use after authentication to retrieve accessible Seqera organizations.

tools.name: List Pipelines
tools.description: Tool to list all pipelines accessible to the authenticated user. Use when you need to browse pipelines with optional pagination, sorting, or search filters.

tools.name: List Workflows
tools.description: Tool to list workflows. Use when you need to retrieve workflows filtered by workspace and paginated.

tools.name: Validate Action Name
tools.description: Tool to validate action name. Use when you need to confirm if an action name is valid and available before creating an action. Returns validation status with details.

tools.name: Validate Pipeline Name
tools.description: Tool to validate a pipeline name. Use when you need to check if a given pipeline name is valid and available before creating or updating one.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The access token used for authenticating API requests to Seqera Platform.

name: Sequenzy
description: Sequenzy is an email marketing and automation platform for managing subscribers, campaigns, sequences, transactional email, analytics, and related workspace resources.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a reusable subscriber tag definition; Sequenzy normalizes its name to lowercase and replaces spaces with hyphens.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Permanently delete a non-system tag definition and remove it from every subscriber. Do not use this on system tags; Sequenzy also rejects tags referenced by sequences.

tools.name: Get Email Metrics
tools.description: Return workspace-wide email delivery and engagement totals and rates for a sliding window or custom range, optionally filtered by email type or mailbox provider. Mailbox-provider filtering reports replies as 0 and omits commerce forecasts.

tools.name: Get Subscriber
tools.description: Retrieve one subscriber by email with list memberships, sequence enrollments, notes, engagement totals, and recent activity.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Discover campaigns in the connected workspace, optionally filtered by delivery status or label, without scheduling or sending them.

tools.name: List Sequences
tools.description: Discover automation sequences and inspect whether they accept new enrollments or process existing ones, without activating or enrolling anyone.

tools.name: List Subscriber Lists
tools.description: Return the reusable subscriber lists available for audience filtering and membership workflows.

tools.name: List Subscribers
tools.description: Search and filter subscribers in the connected workspace, returning one stable cursor page for audience review or export.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: Return reusable subscriber tag definitions, including which tags are protected system tags.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Discover reusable email templates and campaign-backed email bodies by label, returning one page with localization metadata.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A Sequenzy workspace API key beginning with seq_live_. In the Sequenzy dashboard, open Workspace Settings -> API Keys, create a key with account:read (required to verify the connection) plus the narrowest permissions needed by the tools you plan to use, and copy it when shown because it will not be displayed again. Account keys beginning with seq_user_ are not supported by this connection type.

name: Serpdog
description: Serpdog provides APIs for scraping Google search results and related services, enabling developers to access real-time data from Google Search, Maps, Scholar, and more. Note: Serpdog has merged with Scrapingdog but continues to operate independently at api.serpdog.io.

tools.name: Screenshot API
tools.description: Tool to capture a screenshot of a webpage. Use when you need a visual snapshot of a page; supports full-page, device emulation, delays, and dark mode.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: This is your API key for Serpdog. You can find it in your Serpdog dashboard.

name: Serper
description: Serper provides real-time Google search results, place data, autocomplete suggestions, and webpage extraction through a structured API.

tools.name: Batch Search the Web
tools.description: Run 1-10 independent first-page Google web searches in one native Serper request. Each query costs 1 credit for 1-10 results or 2 credits for 11-100 results. Result envelopes preserve input order. Use SERPER_SEARCH_WEB separately when page continuation is needed.

price.description: $0.001 per credit (1 credit/query for 1-10 results; 2 credits/query for 11-100; 1-10 queries/batch)

tools.name: Get Search Suggestions
tools.description: Return Google autocomplete suggestions for a partial search query without running a full search.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: Find canonical Serper location names and country codes for localizing search requests; this lookup is free.

tools.name: List Place Reviews
tools.description: Return paginated Google reviews for one place identified by Place ID, feature ID, or CID, with optional sorting and topic filtering.

tools.name: Scrape Webpage
tools.description: Ask Serper to fetch one webpage and return extracted text, metadata, and optionally markdown, links, images, and videos. Costs 2 credits; difficult pages may cost 6 or 10 credits.

price.description: $0.001 per scrape credit (2, 6, or 10 per page)

tools.name: Search Images
tools.description: Search Google Images and return one page of source pages, full image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions, and positions. Requesting 100 results costs 2 credits instead of 1.

price.description: $0.001 per image-search credits (100 results use 2 credits)

tools.name: Search with Google Lens
tools.description: Reverse-search one public image URL with Google Lens and return visual matches. This action accepts no text query, result-count, or pagination input. Each request costs 3 credits and is subject to Serper's account-specific rate limit, advertised at up to 300 requests per second.

tools.name: Search Maps
tools.description: Search Google Maps by text, Place ID, or CID, optionally constrained to a viewport, and return one page of rich place identifiers and contact details. Charged per page.

tools.name: Search News
tools.description: Search recent Google News coverage and return one page of article titles, links, sources, publication times, snippets, and images when available.

tools.name: Search Patents
tools.description: Search Google Patents and return typed patent records and figures. Each page costs 1 credit and is subject to the connected Serper account's specific rate limit, up to 300 requests per second.

tools.name: Search Places
tools.description: Search Google Places and return one page of local businesses and places. Use this lower-priced text search for place discovery; use SERPER_SEARCH_MAPS for direct Place ID or CID lookup and map-viewport searches. Charged per request and subject to the account-specific rate limit, advertised at up to 300 requests per second.

tools.name: Search Scholar
tools.description: Search Google Scholar and return one page of academic publications with citation counts, publication metadata, snippets, and PDF links when available.

tools.name: Search Shopping
tools.description: Search Google Shopping and return one page of products, prices, merchants, offers, ratings, images, and product IDs. Each page costs 2 credits.

tools.name: Search Videos
tools.description: Search Google Videos and return one page of titles, source links, thumbnail and video URLs, durations, channels, dates, and positions. Each request/page costs 1 credit and is subject to the account-specific rate limit advertised at up to 300 requests per second.

tools.name: Search the Web
tools.description: Search Google web results and return one page of organic links plus available answer, knowledge, question, related-search, and top-story sections.

price.description: $0.001 per credit used for web searches

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Serper API key. Sign in at https://serper.dev/api-keys, create or copy an API key, and enter it exactly as shown. The key is sent in the X-API-KEY header; keep it secret.

name: Serphouse
description: High Volume API for SEO companies, data mining services, and SEO Tool Suite as a SaaS.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account information including active plan, credit usage, and account details. Use when you need to check account status, remaining credits, or active subscription plans.

tools.name: Get Domain List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve comprehensive list of search engine domains supported by the SERP API including Google, Bing, and Yahoo. Use when you need to know which domains are available for search queries.

tools.name: Google Jobs Search
tools.description: Tool to perform real-time Google Jobs search to retrieve job listings. Use when you need to search for job postings on Google with specific query terms, location, and filters.

tools.name: Schedule Google SERP Advanced Search
tools.description: Tool to schedule Google SERP scraping tasks that fetch up to 100 results by iterating through multiple result pages. Use when you need comprehensive search results beyond Google's 10-result limit. Credits are reserved upfront based on max_pages (1 page = 1 credit), with automatic refunds for unused pages.

tools.name: Get Language List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full list of languages supported by Google, Bing, and Yahoo for SERP requests. Use when you need language codes for making SERP API requests or when configuring language-specific searches.

tools.name: Search Locations
tools.description: Tool to search and retrieve available locations for SERP API from Google or Bing geographical targeting data. Use when you need to find valid location targets before making SERP API requests.

tools.name: Check SERP Task Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a previously submitted SERP task. Use when monitoring task completion progress or verifying whether a SERP task has finished processing.

tools.name: SERP Live Search (GET)
tools.description: Tool to execute real-time search requests and retrieve search engine results immediately via HTTP GET. Use when you need to perform searches on Google, Bing, or Yahoo and get instant SERP data.

tools.name: Execute SERP Live POST Search
tools.description: Tool to execute real-time search requests and retrieve search engine results immediately using HTTP POST method. Use when you need to get fresh SERP data from Google, Bing, or Yahoo with specific location and device targeting. Supports web, news, image, and shopping search types with advanced filtering options.

tools.name: Schedule SERP Tasks
tools.description: Tool to schedule SERP search tasks for asynchronous processing. Use when you need to queue multiple search tasks (up to 100 at once) for later execution. Results can be retrieved via webhook or polling.

tools.name: Get Trends Categories List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full list of categories and subcategories for Google Trends searches. Use when you need category IDs for filtering trends analysis.

tools.name: Check Trend Search Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a previously submitted trend search task. Use when you need to monitor completion progress of a trend search.

tools.name: Get Trends Country List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full list of countries and states for Google Trends searches. Use when you need geographic targeting options for trends analysis.

tools.name: Get Trend Search Results
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the results of a completed trend search query. Use when you need to fetch trend data for a specific task ID that was previously submitted. The task must be completed before results are available.

tools.name: Get Trends Language List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full list of supported languages for Google Trends searches. Use when you need to identify valid language codes for trend search requests.

tools.name: Schedule Google Trends Search
tools.description: Tool to schedule Google Trends search tasks with configuration for keywords, time ranges, and geographic locations. Use when you need to collect Google Trends data for specific keywords, time periods, or regions. Supports batch processing of up to 100 tasks.

tools.name: Perform Google Trends Search
tools.description: Tool to perform real-time Google Trends search to retrieve trend data for specified keywords. Use when you need to analyze keyword popularity across time periods and geographic locations.

tools.name: Get Trends Timezone List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve full list of timezones and offset values for use in Google Trend search requests. Use when you need timezone information for trend analysis or when configuring timezone-specific trend searches.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in and copy your API key from your dashboard at https://app.serphouse.com/home

name: Serply
description: Serply is a fast and accurate search API that provides real-time Google search results, SERP data, and web scraping capabilities. Access Google Search, Bing Search, Google Jobs, Google Scholar, Google News, and more via simple API calls.

tools.name: Perform Image Search
tools.description: Performs an image search using the Serply API to find images matching a text query. This tool searches for images on the web and returns results with image URLs, thumbnails, dimensions, titles, and source information. Ideal for finding visual content, gathering image references, or discovering images related to specific topics or keywords. Use this when you need to: - Find images matching specific descriptions or keywords - Gather visual references for a topic - Retrieve image URLs for display or download - Search for images with specific characteristics Supports pagination, localization (language/country), and safe search filtering.

tools.name: Perform Maps Search
tools.description: Tool to perform a maps search. Use when you need to find geographic locations for a given query.

tools.name: Perform Scholar Search
tools.description: Tool to perform an academic scholar search via Serply. Use when you need scholarly literature search results for a specific query.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by Serply for authenticating API requests.

name: Serveravatar
description: ServerAvatar is a server management system that helps you manage servers, applications, databases, and deployments through an intuitive API.

tools.name: Destroy Backups
tools.description: Tool to delete one or more backups from the cloud storage provider. Use when you need to remove specific backups by their IDs from an organization.

tools.name: Get organization details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific organization by ID. Use when you need to fetch information about an organization.

tools.name: List Applications
tools.description: Tool to list applications for a specific organization in ServerAvatar. Use when you need to retrieve all applications associated with an organization ID.

tools.name: List Backups
tools.description: Tool to list all backups in a ServerAvatar organization. Use when you need to retrieve backup information including status, size, and expiration dates.

tools.name: List Archived Backups
tools.description: Tool to list archived backups for an organization by type. Use when you need to retrieve archived backups filtered by type (filesystem, database, or application).

tools.name: List Backups for Deleted Servers
tools.description: Tool to get list of deleted servers with available backups. Use when you need to retrieve information about servers that have been deleted but still have backup data in the archive.

tools.name: List Backup Presets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve backup preset schedules and retention periods for a server. Use when you need to view available backup scheduling options and retention period configurations.

tools.name: List Cloud Server Providers
tools.description: Tool to list connected cloud server provider accounts for an organization. Use when you need to retrieve all connected provider accounts like DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, Hetzner, or AWS Lightsail.

tools.name: List Cloud Storage Providers
tools.description: Tool to list all configured cloud storage providers for an organization. Use when you need to retrieve available storage provider configurations for backups or file storage.

tools.name: List Cronjobs Presets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available cronjob presets for a server. Use when you need to get standard cron expressions for scheduling tasks at various intervals.

tools.name: List Databases
tools.description: Tool to list databases for a given organization. Use when you need to retrieve all databases or filter by name.

tools.name: List Git Providers
tools.description: Tool to list git providers for a specific organization. Use when you need to retrieve all git providers configured for an organization.

tools.name: List Organization Members
tools.description: Tool to list members of a specific organization in ServerAvatar. Use when you need to retrieve all members associated with an organization ID, including their roles and user details.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: Tool to list all organizations associated with the authenticated user account. Use when you need to retrieve all organizations the user has access to.

tools.name: List Servers
tools.description: Tool to list all servers in an organization with pagination support. Use when you need to retrieve servers for a specific organization.

tools.name: List Timezones
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available timezones with their UTC offsets. Use when you need to get timezone options for creating or configuring applications.

tools.name: List WordPress Languages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available WordPress languages. Use when you need to get the list of supported languages for WordPress installation or configuration.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your ServerAvatar API token. Generate it from Account -> API Access in your ServerAvatar dashboard.

name: ServiceTitan
description: ServiceTitan is field service management software for home and commercial service contractors, covering customers, jobs, dispatch, estimates, invoicing, inventory, memberships, payroll, and reporting.

tools.name: Activate Employee Account
tools.description: Activate a ServiceTitan employee's login account.

tools.name: Activate Technician Account
tools.description: Activate a ServiceTitan technician's login account with the required license type and, optionally, assign a truck.

tools.name: Add Credit Memo Splits
tools.description: Apply a credit memo to one or more invoices in ServiceTitan by adding splits, each an invoice id and an amount. Splits are added to the memo's existing ones; this operation does not remove or replace them.

tools.name: Add Customer Tag
tools.description: Add one tag type to one customer in ServiceTitan. Both ids go in the path and no request body is sent; use ADD_TAGS_TO_CUSTOMERS for several at once.

tools.name: Add Equipment to Equipment System
tools.description: Attach existing installed equipment to a ServiceTitan equipment system, by system id and a list of installed equipment ids. Returns the updated system.

tools.name: Add Location Tag
tools.description: Add one tag type to one location in ServiceTitan. Both ids go in the path and no request body is sent. There is no bulk variant for locations; call once per location and tag.

tools.name: Add Tags To Customers
tools.description: Add one or more tag types to several customers in ServiceTitan in one call. Every tag type listed is added to every customer listed; use ADD_CUSTOMER_TAG for a single customer and tag.

tools.name: Approve Purchase Order Request
tools.description: Approve a ServiceTitan purchase order request by its request id. Takes the request id from LIST_PURCHASE_ORDER_REQUESTS, not a purchase order id. No way to withdraw an approval is documented.

tools.name: Assign Technician Skills
tools.description: Assign existing skills to a ServiceTitan technician. With replace_existing_skills true the technician's current skills are replaced by the given list; with false the list is added.

tools.name: Assign Technicians to Appointment
tools.description: Assign one or more technicians to a ServiceTitan job appointment. Returns the appointment.

tools.name: Attach Job Equipment
tools.description: Attach one or more equipment items to a ServiceTitan job. Returns the full list of equipment IDs attached after the change. The spec does not say which equipment ids these are; they are not the equipment system ids of the equipment-system tools, and whether installed-equipment ids (LIST_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT) or pricebook equipment ids (LIST_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT) are meant is unverified.

tools.name: Attach Job to Project
tools.description: Attach an existing ServiceTitan job to a project. Takes no body.

tools.name: Bulk Create Installed Equipment
tools.description: Create up to 1000 installed equipment records in ServiceTitan in one atomic request. If any record is invalid the whole batch is rolled back and nothing is created.

tools.name: Bulk Create Pricebook Items
tools.description: Create many ServiceTitan pricebook items in one request: services, equipment, materials, and discounts and fees. At least one of those four collections must contain an item. Give each item a customId; links inside the same request (serviceMaterials, recommendations, upgrades) can point to it by customId, and the response maps each customId to its new id.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Technician Shifts
tools.description: Delete every ServiceTitan technician shift in a date range, for all technicians. The only criteria are start and end; there is no technician filter, so check the range with List Technician Shifts first.

tools.name: Bulk Update Pricebook Items
tools.description: Update many ServiceTitan pricebook items in one request: services, equipment, materials, and discounts and fees. At least one of those four collections must contain an item. Each item must carry its id and the documented full set of fields, not just the changed ones.

tools.name: Cancel Inventory Receipt
tools.description: Cancel a ServiceTitan inventory receipt by id, optionally recording a cancellation reason. This cannot be undone through the API: no way to reopen a canceled inventory receipt is documented.

tools.name: Cancel Inventory Return
tools.description: Cancel a ServiceTitan vendor return by id, optionally recording a cancellation reason. This cannot be undone through the API: no way to reopen a canceled vendor return is documented.

tools.name: Cancel Job
tools.description: Cancel a ServiceTitan job with a cancel reason and memo. Jobs cannot be deleted, only canceled; get the reason ID from List Job Cancel Reasons.

tools.name: Cancel Purchase Order
tools.description: Cancel a ServiceTitan purchase order by id, optionally recording a cancellation reason. This cannot be undone through the API: no way to reopen a canceled purchase order is documented.

tools.name: Cancel Report Data Query
tools.description: Cancel a long-running report data query in ServiceTitan and release its query_token. Succeeds even if the query had already finished; the result can no longer be fetched afterwards.

tools.name: Confirm Appointment
tools.description: Mark a ServiceTitan job appointment as confirmed. Takes no body; the appointment's isConfirmed flag becomes true.

tools.name: Create Adjustment Invoice
tools.description: Create an adjustment invoice against an existing invoice in ServiceTitan, for example a refund or a write-off; adjustment_to_id names the invoice being adjusted. It cannot create an ordinary job invoice, and the response is a bare integer that the spec does not describe.

tools.name: Create Appointment
tools.description: Add a new appointment to an existing ServiceTitan job, with start and end times and optional technicians. A job's first appointment is created by Create Job; use this only for additional visits.

tools.name: Create Arrival Window
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan arrival window with a start time and duration for a set of business units.

tools.name: Create Booking
tools.description: Create a booking in ServiceTitan, an incoming request that office staff later book as a job or dismiss. It does not create a job; send at least one phone or email in contacts so staff can follow up.

tools.name: Create Booking Contact
tools.description: Add a contact entry (phone, email or fax) to a booking in ServiceTitan for a given booking provider. This is the booking's own contact list, separate from the GUID person contacts managed with CREATE_CONTACT and CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD.

tools.name: Create Booking Provider Tag
tools.description: Create a booking provider tag in ServiceTitan, the label that identifies one source of bookings. Both tag_name and description are required.

tools.name: Create Budget Code
tools.description: Create a full ServiceTitan budget code from a list of segment item IDs. Use Create Partial Budget Code when some segments have no item chosen.

tools.name: Create Business Hours
tools.description: Set the ServiceTitan business hours by sending the open time ranges for weekdays, Saturday and Sunday. All three lists are required; whether this replaces existing hours is not documented.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create a marketing campaign in ServiceTitan. name, business_unit_id, category_id and active are required.

tools.name: Create Campaign Category
tools.description: Create a marketing campaign category in ServiceTitan. Returns only the new category's id.

tools.name: Create Campaign Cost
tools.description: Create the cost record of a marketing campaign for one month in ServiceTitan. The amount is given as a daily cost, not a monthly total.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a contact (a person record with name and title) in ServiceTitan. It is not linked to anything yet; add phone or email with CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD and link it with CREATE_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIP.

tools.name: Create Contact Method
tools.description: Add a contact method (phone, mobile phone, email or fax) to a contact in ServiceTitan. contact_id is the GUID of a person contact from CREATE_CONTACT or LIST_CONTACTS; to add a phone or email directly to a customer, location or booking use CREATE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT, CREATE_LOCATION_CONTACT or CREATE_BOOKING_CONTACT.

tools.name: Create Contact Relationship
tools.description: Link a contact to a customer, location or booking in ServiceTitan. All three values go in the path and no request body is sent.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Create a customer in ServiceTitan together with its first location or locations. name, address and at least one entry in locations are required; merging or deactivating customers is not available through the API.

tools.name: Create Customer Contact
tools.description: Add a contact entry (phone, mobile phone, email or fax) to a customer in ServiceTitan. It is not copied to the customer's locations. This is the customer's own contact list, separate from the GUID person contacts managed with CREATE_CONTACT and CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD.

tools.name: Create Customer Note
tools.description: Add a note to a customer in ServiceTitan. Set add_to_locations to copy the same note to the customer's active locations.

tools.name: Create Employee
tools.description: Create an office employee in ServiceTitan with a role and positions; returns the new employee id. account_creation_method picks CreateLater, SendInvite or AssignLoginAndPassword; the spec does not describe what each one does.

tools.name: Create Equipment System
tools.description: Create an equipment system at a ServiceTitan customer location, optionally attaching installed equipment to it. The name must be unique within the location.

tools.name: Create Equipment Type
tools.description: Create an equipment type in ServiceTitan for classifying installed equipment.

tools.name: Create Estimate
tools.description: Create an estimate in ServiceTitan on a job or project, with its line items. Use it to quote work before it is sold; every field is optional in the spec, and which ones ServiceTitan actually needs (such as job_id or project_id) is not documented.

tools.name: Create Estimate Template
tools.description: Create an estimate template in ServiceTitan from a list of pricebook items. Static templates need a unitPrice on every item; Dynamic templates take prices from the pricebook.

tools.name: Create External Call Attribution
tools.description: Attribute a phone call tracked by outside call-tracking software to a web session in ServiceTitan Marketing Ads. It records attribution only; it does not create a call, lead or job.

tools.name: Create Finding
tools.description: Create a finding in ServiceTitan to record an issue or observation at a customer location, with an urgency level and optional links to installed equipment and the job where it was found. Attachments link file URLs; no file content is uploaded.

tools.name: Create Finding Attachment
tools.description: Add an attachment to a ServiceTitan finding by linking a file URL with a file name and media type. No file content is sent; the spec expects the URL returned by ServiceTitan's findings upload endpoint, which is not available as a tool.

tools.name: Create GL Account
tools.description: Create a general ledger (GL) account in ServiceTitan and return the created account. The spec marks no field as required; use LIST_GL_ACCOUNT_TYPES for valid type names.

tools.name: Create GPS Pings
tools.description: Send GPS location pings for technician vehicles or units to ServiceTitan for a configured GPS provider, so they plot on the Dispatch Map. Returns a per-ping result; a ping can fail while the call succeeds.

tools.name: Create Gross Pay Item
tools.description: Create a gross pay item inside an existing payroll in ServiceTitan and return its id. payroll_id, amount, activity_code_id and date are required; find the payroll id with LIST_PAYROLLS.

tools.name: Create Installed Equipment
tools.description: Create a record of equipment installed at a ServiceTitan customer location, with serial number, warranty dates, and an optional parent equipment or system. Only location_id is required.

tools.name: Create Inventory Adjustment
tools.description: Create an inventory adjustment in ServiceTitan that changes stock quantities at one inventory location. Only the types Adjustment, BeginningBalance, and Consignment can be created; item quantities may be negative.

tools.name: Create Inventory Receipt
tools.description: Record a receipt of items against an existing ServiceTitan purchase order. items lists each SKU received with its quantity and cost.

tools.name: Create Inventory Return
tools.description: Create a vendor return in ServiceTitan inventory, recording items sent back to a vendor from an inventory location.

tools.name: Create Inventory Return Type
tools.description: Create a vendor return type in ServiceTitan inventory, with its vendor-credit, sales-tax and default settings. Its id is the return_type_id that CREATE_INVENTORY_RETURN requires.

tools.name: Create Invoice Task
tools.description: Create a task on an invoice in ServiceTitan from a task template. template_id is required and no tool in this toolkit lists invoice task templates, so the id must come from the user or from an existing task's template_id. This is an invoice workflow task, not a Task Management task (CREATE_TASK).

tools.name: Create Invoice Template
tools.description: Create a membership invoice template in ServiceTitan from a list of line items; returns the new template id. Memberships bill from these templates and recurring service jobs are invoiced from them.

tools.name: Create Job
tools.description: Book a new ServiceTitan job for a customer and location, with at least one appointment. Customer and location must already exist; the job's first appointment is created from the appointments list.

tools.name: Create Job Attribution
tools.description: Attribute an existing job to a web session in ServiceTitan Marketing Ads. It records attribution only; the job must already exist.

tools.name: Create Job Note
tools.description: Add a note to a ServiceTitan job, optionally pinned to the top.

tools.name: Create Job Type
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan job type with its name, priority, duration, business units, skills and default tags.

tools.name: Create Journal Entry
tools.description: Create a journal entry with debit and credit lines in ServiceTitan; it is marked external automatically. status and version_id are required (the spec does not document what version_id a new entry should carry; unverified without a live account), and the documented response has no body, so the new id is not returned: find the entry with LIST_JOURNAL_ENTRIES.

tools.name: Create Labor Type
tools.description: Create a payroll labor type in ServiceTitan and return its id. name, code and active are all required.

tools.name: Create Lead
tools.description: Create a lead in ServiceTitan. campaign_id and summary are required, and one of call_reason_id or follow_up_date must be sent; passing booking_id irreversibly dismisses that booking and turns it into this lead; ServiceTitan documents no operation to undo the dismissal. For a web-form style lead with just a name and contact details and no campaign id, use SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM.

tools.name: Create Lead Follow Up
tools.description: Schedule a follow-up on a lead in ServiceTitan by setting the next follow-up date, with an optional note.

tools.name: Create Lead Note
tools.description: Add a note to a lead in ServiceTitan.

tools.name: Create Location
tools.description: Create a location (service address) in ServiceTitan under an existing customer. name, address and customer_id are required.

tools.name: Create Location Contact
tools.description: Add a contact entry (phone, mobile phone, email or fax) to a location in ServiceTitan. The provider guide says an entry added to a new location is also copied to its customer. This is the location's own contact list, separate from the GUID person contacts managed with CREATE_CONTACT and CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD.

tools.name: Create Location Note
tools.description: Add a note to a location in ServiceTitan. Set add_to_customer to copy the same note to the location's customer.

tools.name: Create Membership Sale Invoice
tools.description: Sell a membership to a customer in ServiceTitan by creating a membership sale invoice; returns the new invoice id and customer membership id. It creates a real invoice and membership together, so call it only once the sale is confirmed. Setting recurring_service_action=None deletes the customer's existing recurring services.

tools.name: Create Non Job Appointment
tools.description: Block time on a ServiceTitan technician's schedule for a non-customer activity such as a meeting, training or time off, optionally repeating. For a customer visit use Create Appointment.

tools.name: Create Opt Outs
tools.description: Opt one or more phone numbers out of contact in ServiceTitan. The whole request fails if any number cannot be parsed, and a number already opted out globally cannot be opted out for marketing.

tools.name: Create Partial Budget Code
tools.description: Create a partial ServiceTitan budget code from segment bindings, where a segment may be left without an item. Use Create Budget Code when every segment has an item.

tools.name: Create Payroll Adjustment
tools.description: Create a payroll adjustment, a manual earning or deduction for one employee or technician, in ServiceTitan and return its id. employee_type must match the kind of id given in employee_id.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Category
tools.description: Create a category in the ServiceTitan pricebook, as a Services or Materials category. Set parent_id to create it as a subcategory.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Discount or Fee
tools.description: Create a discount or a fee in the ServiceTitan pricebook. The type field decides which one, and amount_type decides whether the amount is a percentage or a fixed value.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: Create an equipment item in the ServiceTitan pricebook catalog, with pricing, warranty, vendors, and categories. This does not record equipment installed at a location; use CREATE_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT for that.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Material
tools.description: Create a material in the ServiceTitan pricebook, with cost, pricing, vendors, and categories. Only code and description are required.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Material Markup
tools.description: Create a material markup tier in the ServiceTitan pricebook: a from/to range and the markup percent applied to it. The documented body also requires an id value.

tools.name: Create Pricebook Service
tools.description: Create a service in the ServiceTitan pricebook, with pricing, warranty, categories, and linked materials and equipment. Only code and description are required.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan project at a location to group related jobs. Only the location is required; jobs are added afterwards with Attach Job To Project.

tools.name: Create Project Note
tools.description: Add a note to a ServiceTitan project, optionally pinned to the top.

tools.name: Create Proposal Template
tools.description: Create a proposal template in ServiceTitan that assigns an estimate template to each option of a proposal type. Each proposal type option may appear only once in estimate_assignments.

tools.name: Create Purchase Order
tools.description: Create a purchase order in ServiceTitan for items ordered from a vendor. vendor_id, type_id, business_unit_id and inventory_location_id name existing records, and only the id of the new purchase order is returned.

tools.name: Create Purchase Order Markup
tools.description: Create a purchase order markup tier in ServiceTitan: a from/to range and the markup percent applied to it.

tools.name: Create Purchase Order Type
tools.description: Create a purchase order type in ServiceTitan, with its receiving, tax, payroll, and alert settings. Most settings are required, not optional.

tools.name: Create Subtask
tools.description: Create a subtask under an existing task in ServiceTitan Task Management, assigned to an employee. The documented response has no subtask id; it returns parent_task_id and subtask_number.

tools.name: Create Tag Type
tools.description: Create a tag type in ServiceTitan with a name and a hex color; returns the new tag type id. Keep the name to 30 characters or fewer.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create an office task in ServiceTitan Task Management, assigned to an employee. The type, source, business unit and employee ids come from GET_TASK_REFERENCE_DATA. These are Task Management tasks, not the invoice workflow tasks of CREATE_INVOICE_TASK / LIST_INVOICE_TASKS.

tools.name: Create Team
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan dispatch team with a name and active flag.

tools.name: Create Technician
tools.description: Create a field technician in ServiceTitan with a role, positions and license type; returns the new technician id. Get role_id from LIST_USER_ROLES.

tools.name: Create Technician Rating
tools.description: Record a rating from 0 to 10 for a technician on a specific job in ServiceTitan. If that technician and job already have a rating, it is overwritten with the new score.

tools.name: Create Technician Shift
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan shift (Normal, OnCall or TimeOff) for one or more technicians, optionally repeating daily or weekly. Returns the list of shifts created.

tools.name: Create Technician Skill
tools.description: Create a new skill in ServiceTitan and assign it to one technician in the same call. To give a technician skills that already exist use Assign Technician Skills.

tools.name: Create Timesheet Activity
tools.description: Create a timesheet activity, a block of recorded time for one employee or technician, in ServiceTitan and return its id. employee_id, employee_type, activity_type_id, start_time and tag_type_ids are required; end_time is optional.

tools.name: Create Truck
tools.description: Create a truck inventory location in ServiceTitan. warehouse_id and name are required.

tools.name: Create Vendor
tools.description: Create an inventory vendor (supplier) in ServiceTitan. The vendor's main address is required.

tools.name: Create Web Booking Attribution
tools.description: Attribute an existing booking to a web session in ServiceTitan Marketing Ads. It records attribution only; the booking must already exist.

tools.name: Create Web Lead Form Attribution
tools.description: Attribute an existing lead captured from a web form to a web session in ServiceTitan Marketing Ads. It records attribution only; the lead must already exist.

tools.name: Create Zone
tools.description: Create a ServiceTitan dispatch zone from zip codes, cities, territory numbers, service days and business units.

tools.name: Deactivate Employee Account
tools.description: Deactivate a ServiceTitan employee's login account.

tools.name: Deactivate Estimate Template
tools.description: Deactivate an estimate template in ServiceTitan. The template is not removed: it becomes inactive and stops appearing in active-only lists.

tools.name: Deactivate Proposal Template
tools.description: Deactivate a proposal template in ServiceTitan. The template is not removed and can be reactivated by updating it with active true.

tools.name: Deactivate Technician Account
tools.description: Deactivate a ServiceTitan technician's login account.

tools.name: Delete Appointment
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan job appointment by ID. The API refuses to delete the only appointment on a job or one with timesheets; an individual appointment cannot be canceled, only deleted.

tools.name: Delete Booking Contact
tools.description: Remove one contact entry from a booking in ServiceTitan for a given booking provider. The booking itself is kept.

tools.name: Delete Contact
tools.description: Delete a contact in ServiceTitan by its GUID. To keep the record but hide it, set is_archived with UPDATE_CONTACT instead.

tools.name: Delete Contact Method
tools.description: Delete one contact method from a contact in ServiceTitan. contact_id is the GUID of a person contact from CREATE_CONTACT or LIST_CONTACTS; to add a phone or email directly to a customer, location or booking use CREATE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT, CREATE_LOCATION_CONTACT or CREATE_BOOKING_CONTACT.

tools.name: Delete Contact Relationship
tools.description: Remove the link between a contact and a customer, location or booking in ServiceTitan. The contact itself is kept.

tools.name: Delete Customer Contact
tools.description: Remove one contact entry from a customer in ServiceTitan.

tools.name: Delete Customer Note
tools.description: Delete one note from a customer in ServiceTitan.

tools.name: Delete Equipment System
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan equipment system by id.

tools.name: Delete Estimate Item
tools.description: Remove one line item from an estimate in ServiceTitan. The removal is permanent.

tools.name: Delete Finding Attachment
tools.description: Remove an attachment from a ServiceTitan finding, by finding id and attachment id.

tools.name: Delete Gross Pay Item
tools.description: Delete a gross pay item in ServiceTitan by its id. The spec documents no response body and no way to restore a deleted item.

tools.name: Delete Invoice Item
tools.description: Delete one line item from an invoice in ServiceTitan. The item is removed from the invoice and its totals; the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Delete Job Attachment
tools.description: Delete one attachment from a job in ServiceTitan. The spec documents no way to restore a deleted attachment.

tools.name: Delete Journal Entry
tools.description: Delete a journal entry in ServiceTitan. Only external entries, those created through the API, can be deleted; the spec documents no way to restore one.

tools.name: Delete Location Contact
tools.description: Remove one contact entry from a location in ServiceTitan.

tools.name: Delete Location Note
tools.description: Delete one note from a location in ServiceTitan.

tools.name: Delete Non Job Appointment
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan non-job appointment by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Payroll Adjustment
tools.description: Delete a payroll adjustment in ServiceTitan by its id. employee_type is required and must match the adjustment's owner; the spec documents no way to restore it.

tools.name: Delete Pricebook Category
tools.description: Delete a category from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. To hide a category without deleting it, use UPDATE_PRICEBOOK_CATEGORY with active set to false.

tools.name: Delete Pricebook Discount or Fee
tools.description: Delete a discount or fee from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. To hide it without deleting, use UPDATE_PRICEBOOK_DISCOUNT_OR_FEE with active set to false.

tools.name: Delete Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: Delete an equipment item from the ServiceTitan pricebook catalog by id. To hide it without deleting, use UPDATE_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT with active set to false.

tools.name: Delete Pricebook Material
tools.description: Delete a material from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. To hide it without deleting, use UPDATE_PRICEBOOK_MATERIAL with active set to false.

tools.name: Delete Pricebook Service
tools.description: Delete a service from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. To hide it without deleting, use UPDATE_PRICEBOOK_SERVICE with active set to false.

tools.name: Delete Project Daily Log Attachment
tools.description: Delete one attachment from a ServiceTitan project daily log. The file is removed from the log.

tools.name: Delete Purchase Order Markup
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan purchase order markup tier by id.

tools.name: Delete Team
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan dispatch team by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Technician Shift
tools.description: Delete one ServiceTitan technician shift by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Technician Skill
tools.description: Remove a skill from a ServiceTitan technician by deleting the technician-skill association, whose ID has the form {technicianId}_{skillId}.

tools.name: Delete Timesheet Activity
tools.description: Delete a timesheet activity in ServiceTitan by its id. The recorded time is removed; the spec documents no way to restore it.

tools.name: Delete Zone
tools.description: Delete a ServiceTitan dispatch zone by its ID.

tools.name: Detach Job Equipment
tools.description: Detach one or more equipment items from a ServiceTitan job in a single call. Returns no content. The spec does not say which equipment ids these are; they are not the equipment system ids of the equipment-system tools, and whether installed-equipment ids (LIST_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT) or pricebook equipment ids (LIST_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT) are meant is unverified.

tools.name: Detach Job from Project
tools.description: Detach a ServiceTitan job from whichever project it belongs to. Only the job ID is given; the project is not named.

tools.name: Dismiss Booking
tools.description: Dismiss a booking in ServiceTitan for a given booking provider, marking it as not converted to a job. Optionally record a call reason and a memo; no way to undo this is documented.

tools.name: Dismiss Estimate
tools.description: Mark an estimate as dismissed in ServiceTitan, for a quote the customer will not accept. The estimate is kept, with status Dismissed. No operation to reopen a dismissed estimate is documented; UPDATE_ESTIMATE takes a status field, but whether setting it to Open undoes a dismissal is not documented.

tools.name: Dismiss Lead
tools.description: Dismiss a lead in ServiceTitan so it needs no further follow-up. A call reason id is required as the dismissal reason; no way to reopen a lead is documented.

tools.name: Export Appointment Assignments
tools.description: Export ServiceTitan technician-to-appointment assignments in bulk as a continuation feed. Use it for full or incremental sync; use List Appointment Assignments when you need filters.

tools.name: Export Appointments
tools.description: Export ServiceTitan job appointments in bulk as a continuation feed. Use it for full or incremental sync; use List Appointments when you need filters beyond active status.

tools.name: Export Bookings
tools.description: Export bookings from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch; use LIST_BOOKINGS for filtered lookups.

tools.name: Export Business Units
tools.description: Export feed of business units from ServiceTitan for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_BUSINESS_UNITS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Calls
tools.description: Export feed of phone calls from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_CALLS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Customer Contacts
tools.description: Export customer contact entries from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch. Use LIST_CUSTOMER_CONTACTS for a filtered lookup across customers, or LIST_CUSTOMER_CONTACTS for one customer.

tools.name: Export Customers
tools.description: Export customers from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch; use LIST_CUSTOMERS for filtered lookups.

tools.name: Export Employees
tools.description: Export feed of employees from ServiceTitan for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_EMPLOYEES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Equipment Systems
tools.description: Export equipment systems from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; set include_recent_changes to receive the most recent changes sooner. Use LIST_EQUIPMENT_SYSTEMS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Estimates
tools.description: Export estimates from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_ESTIMATES for filtered lookups.

tools.name: Export Gross Pay Items
tools.description: Export gross pay items from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_GROSS_PAY_ITEMS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Installed Equipment
tools.description: Export installed equipment records from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; set include_recent_changes to receive the most recent changes sooner. Use LIST_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Inventory Adjustments
tools.description: Export inventory adjustments from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync, with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; use LIST_INVENTORY_ADJUSTMENTS for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Inventory Bills
tools.description: Export inventory bills from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync: returns active, inactive and deleted records with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_INVENTORY_BILLS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Inventory Returns
tools.description: Export vendor returns from ServiceTitan inventory as a continuation feed for bulk sync, with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch. Use LIST_INVENTORY_RETURNS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Inventory Transfers
tools.description: Export inventory transfers from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync, with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch. Use LIST_INVENTORY_TRANSFERS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Invoice Items
tools.description: Export invoice line items from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync: returns active, inactive and deleted records with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call and keep it to pick up later changes.

tools.name: Export Invoices
tools.description: Export invoices from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync: returns active, inactive and deleted records with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_INVOICES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Invoice Templates
tools.description: Export feed of membership invoice templates from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the only way to enumerate templates without knowing their ids. The feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag; pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_INVOICE_TEMPLATES or GET_INVOICE_TEMPLATE when the template ids are already known.

tools.name: Export Job Canceled Logs
tools.description: Export ServiceTitan job canceled logs (who canceled which job, when, and why) in bulk as a continuation feed. For the canceled logs of one job use LIST_JOB_CANCELED_LOGS.

tools.name: Export Job History
tools.description: Export the status history of all ServiceTitan jobs in bulk as a continuation feed. For one job use Get Job History.

tools.name: Export Job Notes
tools.description: Export notes from all ServiceTitan jobs in bulk as a continuation feed. For the notes of one job use List Job Notes.

tools.name: Export Jobs
tools.description: Export ServiceTitan jobs in bulk as a continuation feed that includes active, inactive and deleted records. Use it for full or incremental sync; use List Jobs when you need filters.

tools.name: Export Leads
tools.description: Export leads from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch; use LIST_LEADS for filtered lookups.

tools.name: Export Location Contacts
tools.description: Export location contact entries from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch. Use LIST_LOCATION_CONTACTS for a filtered lookup across locations, or LIST_LOCATION_CONTACTS for one location.

tools.name: Export Locations
tools.description: Export locations from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch; use LIST_LOCATIONS for filtered lookups.

tools.name: Export Memberships
tools.description: Export feed of customer memberships from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag and a status. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_MEMBERSHIPS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Membership Status Changes
tools.description: Export feed of customer membership status changes from ServiceTitan, across all memberships; each record gives the old and new status. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. For the history of one membership use LIST_MEMBERSHIP_STATUS_CHANGES.

tools.name: Export Membership Types
tools.description: Export feed of membership types from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_MEMBERSHIP_TYPES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Payments
tools.description: Export customer payments from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync: returns active, inactive and deleted records with no filters. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYMENTS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Payroll Activity Codes
tools.description: Export payroll activity codes (earning codes) from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYROLL_ACTIVITY_CODES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Payroll Adjustments
tools.description: Export payroll adjustments from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYROLL_ADJUSTMENTS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Payroll Job Splits
tools.description: Export payroll job splits (each technician's split of a job) from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_SPLITS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Payroll Job Timesheets
tools.description: Export job timesheets (technician dispatch, arrival and completion times on job appointments) from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Payroll Settings
tools.description: Export employee and technician payroll settings from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_PAYROLL_SETTINGS instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Pricebook Categories
tools.description: Export pricebook categories from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; records appear about 15 minutes after a change unless include_recent_changes is true. Use LIST_PRICEBOOK_CATEGORIES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: Export pricebook equipment items from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; records appear about 15 minutes after a change unless include_recent_changes is true. Use LIST_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Pricebook Materials
tools.description: Export pricebook materials from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; records appear about 15 minutes after a change unless include_recent_changes is true. Use LIST_PRICEBOOK_MATERIALS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Pricebook Services
tools.description: Export pricebook services from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch; records appear about 15 minutes after a change unless include_recent_changes is true. Use LIST_PRICEBOOK_SERVICES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Project Notes
tools.description: Export notes from all ServiceTitan projects in bulk as a continuation feed. For the notes of one project use List Project Notes.

tools.name: Export Projects
tools.description: Export ServiceTitan projects in bulk as a continuation feed that includes active, inactive and deleted records. Use it for full or incremental sync; use List Projects when you need filters.

tools.name: Export Purchase Orders
tools.description: Export purchase orders from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; use LIST_PURCHASE_ORDERS when you need filters. Pass the returned continue_from token back to get the next batch.

tools.name: Export Receipts
tools.description: Export inventory receipts from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync. Pass continue_from from each response to get the next batch. Use LIST_INVENTORY_RECEIPTS for filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Recurring Service Events
tools.description: Export feed of recurring service events from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters, and an event with active false has been deleted. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_RECURRING_SERVICE_EVENTS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Recurring Services
tools.description: Export feed of location recurring services from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_RECURRING_SERVICES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Recurring Service Types
tools.description: Export feed of recurring service types from ServiceTitan for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_RECURRING_SERVICE_TYPES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Service Agreements
tools.description: Export feed of service agreements from ServiceTitan for bulk sync. Returns active, inactive and deleted records; pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_SERVICE_AGREEMENTS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Tag Types
tools.description: Export feed of tag types from ServiceTitan for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_TAG_TYPES instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Technician Ratings
tools.description: Export technician ratings from ServiceTitan as a change feed for bulk sync, one batch per call. Pass the returned continue_from back to get the next batch. Use LIST_TECHNICIAN_RATINGS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Technicians
tools.description: Export feed of technicians from ServiceTitan for bulk sync. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call, and has_more false means the feed is caught up. Use LIST_TECHNICIANS instead for a filtered, paged lookup.

tools.name: Export Timesheet Activities
tools.description: Export timesheet activities from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITIES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Timesheet Activity Categories
tools.description: Export timesheet activity categories from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_CATEGORIES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Timesheet Activity Types
tools.description: Export timesheet activity types from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_TYPES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Export Timesheet Codes
tools.description: Export timesheet codes from ServiceTitan as a continuation feed for bulk sync; the feed takes no filters and each record carries an active flag. Pass the returned continue_from on the next call; use LIST_TIMESHEET_CODES instead for a filtered lookup.

tools.name: Get AP Bill
tools.description: Get one accounts-payable (vendor) bill in ServiceTitan by its id, including items and expense items. Use LIST_AP_BILLS to find the id.

tools.name: Get Appointment
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan job appointment by its ID, including its schedule, arrival window, status and confirmation flag. Use List Appointments to find the ID from a job or project.

tools.name: Get Arrival Window
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan arrival window by its ID.

tools.name: Get Arrival Window Configuration
tools.description: Get the tenant-wide ServiceTitan arrival window setting: whether a job's default start time is the start or the end of the chosen arrival window.

tools.name: Get Booking
tools.description: Get one booking in ServiceTitan by id, across all booking providers. Use GET_PROVIDER_BOOKING when the connection is restricted to a single booking provider tag.

tools.name: Get Booking Provider Tag
tools.description: Get one booking provider tag in ServiceTitan by its id.

tools.name: Get Business Hours
tools.description: Get the ServiceTitan business hours: the open time ranges for weekdays, Saturday and Sunday. Returns one object, not a list.

tools.name: Get Business Unit
tools.description: Get one business unit in ServiceTitan by id, including its name, address, email and phone.

tools.name: Get Call
tools.description: Get one phone call in ServiceTitan by id, with the linked job, customer, campaign and agent.

tools.name: Get Call Recording
tools.description: Download the audio recording of one call from ServiceTitan as an audio/mpeg file. Use it for a call whose recording_url is set; the response for a call with no recording is not documented.

tools.name: Get Call Voicemail
tools.description: Download the voicemail audio left on one call from ServiceTitan as an audio/mpeg file. Use it for a call whose voicemail URL is set; the response for a call with no voicemail is not documented.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Get one marketing campaign in ServiceTitan by id.

tools.name: Get Campaign Category
tools.description: Get one marketing campaign category in ServiceTitan by id.

tools.name: Get Campaign Cost
tools.description: Get one campaign cost record in ServiceTitan by the cost record's id, not the campaign id.

tools.name: Get Campaign Cost Summary
tools.description: Get the total cost of each marketing campaign in ServiceTitan over a date range. Both from_date and to_date are required; the result is not paged.

tools.name: Get Cancel Reasons by Job IDs
tools.description: Get the cancel reason recorded on each of the given ServiceTitan jobs. Requires job IDs; for the catalogue of available reasons use List Job Cancel Reasons.

tools.name: Get Capacity
tools.description: Calculate real-time ServiceTitan capacity and technician availability for a time frame, optionally for given business units and a job type. Read-only even though it is a POST; use it before booking a job to find open slots.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Get one contact (a person record with name and title) in ServiceTitan by its GUID. Phone numbers and emails are not included; read them with LIST_CONTACT_METHODS.

tools.name: Get Contact Method
tools.description: Get one contact method of a contact in ServiceTitan. Both ids are GUIDs.

tools.name: Get Contact Method Preference
tools.description: Get one communication preference of a contact method in ServiceTitan by preference name. Names come from LIST_CONTACT_PREFERENCE_TYPES.

tools.name: Get Customer
tools.description: Get one customer in ServiceTitan by id, including bill-to address, balance, custom fields and tags.

tools.name: Get Email Channel Cost
tools.description: Get the cost of the email marketing channel in ServiceTitan over a date range. Both from_date and to_date are required.
