tools.name: Get Employee
tools.description: Get one office employee in ServiceTitan by id, including name, email, phone, role and positions.

tools.name: Get Employee Payroll Settings
tools.description: Get the payroll settings of one office employee in ServiceTitan. Use GET_TECHNICIAN_PAYROLL_SETTINGS for a technician.

tools.name: Get Equipment System
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan equipment system by id, including the installed equipment attached to it.

tools.name: Get Equipment Type
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan equipment type by id.

tools.name: Get Estimate
tools.description: Get one estimate in ServiceTitan by its id, including its status, totals and line items.

tools.name: Get Estimate Template
tools.description: Get one estimate template in ServiceTitan by its id, with its items.

tools.name: Get Expense Transaction
tools.description: Get one expense transaction in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_EXPENSE_TRANSACTIONS to find the id.

tools.name: Get Finding
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan finding by id.

tools.name: Get Finding Attachment
tools.description: Get one attachment of a ServiceTitan finding, by finding id and attachment id.

tools.name: Get GL Account
tools.description: Get one general ledger (GL) account in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_GL_ACCOUNTS to find the id.

tools.name: Get Hold Reasons by Job IDs
tools.description: Get the hold reason recorded on each of the given ServiceTitan jobs and on their appointments. Requires job IDs; for the catalogue of available reasons use List Job Hold Reasons.

tools.name: Get Installed Equipment
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan installed equipment record by id.

tools.name: Get Invoice Template
tools.description: Get one membership invoice template in ServiceTitan by its id, with its line items and total.

tools.name: Get Job
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan job by its ID, including customer, location, job type, status and first and last appointment IDs.

tools.name: Get Job Booked Log
tools.description: Get the booked log of one ServiceTitan job: when it was booked, by whom, and the originally booked appointment start and arrival window.

tools.name: Get Job Equipment
tools.description: Get the IDs of the equipment items attached to one ServiceTitan job. Returns IDs only. The spec does not say which equipment ids these are; they are not the equipment system ids of the equipment-system tools, and whether installed-equipment ids (LIST_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT) or pricebook equipment ids (LIST_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT) are meant is unverified.

tools.name: Get Job History
tools.description: Get the history entries of one ServiceTitan job: each event with its type, date, employee and memo. Returns the whole history in one response.

tools.name: Get Job Type
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan job type by its ID.

tools.name: Get Journal Entry
tools.description: Get one journal entry in ServiceTitan by its id. It returns the entry header; use LIST_JOURNAL_ENTRY_DETAILS or LIST_JOURNAL_ENTRY_SUMMARY for its line amounts.

tools.name: Get Labor Type
tools.description: Get one payroll labor type in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_LABOR_TYPES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Lead
tools.description: Get one lead in ServiceTitan by id. A lead is an opportunity to book a job that has not converted yet.

tools.name: Get Location
tools.description: Get one location in ServiceTitan by id. A location is the service address where work is done and belongs to exactly one customer.

tools.name: Get Location Preferred Technician
tools.description: Get the id of the preferred technician of a location in ServiceTitan. Returns only the technician id, or null when none is set.

tools.name: Get Membership
tools.description: Get one customer membership in ServiceTitan by its id, including status, dates, billing template and payment settings.

tools.name: Get Membership Type
tools.description: Get one membership type in ServiceTitan by its id. The spec gives this operation no include flags and does not say whether duration_billing, discounts, recurring_services and tag_type_ids are filled; null means not loaded. LIST_MEMBERSHIP_TYPES with ids and the include_ flags returns them.

tools.name: Get Non Job Appointment
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan non-job appointment by its ID. A non-job appointment blocks a technician's time for something that is not customer work, such as training or time off.

tools.name: Get Payment Term
tools.description: Get one payment term (for example net 30) in ServiceTitan by its id. Payment terms are read-only through the API.

tools.name: Get Payment Type
tools.description: Get one payment type in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_PAYMENT_TYPES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Payroll Activity Code
tools.description: Get one payroll activity code (earning code) in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_PAYROLL_ACTIVITY_CODES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Payroll Adjustment
tools.description: Get one payroll adjustment in ServiceTitan by its id. employee_type is required and must match the adjustment's owner (Technician or Employee).

tools.name: Get Pricebook Category
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan pricebook category by id, including its subcategories.

tools.name: Get Pricebook Discount or Fee
tools.description: Get one discount or fee from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id.

tools.name: Get Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: Get one equipment item from the ServiceTitan pricebook catalog by id.

tools.name: Get Pricebook Material
tools.description: Get one material from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id.

tools.name: Get Pricebook Material Markup
tools.description: Get one material markup tier from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id.

tools.name: Get Pricebook Service
tools.description: Get one service from the ServiceTitan pricebook by id, including its linked materials and equipment.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan project by its ID, including status, customer, location, managers and key dates.

tools.name: Get Project Daily Log
tools.description: Get one daily log of a ServiceTitan project by its ID, with health, section notes, summaries and the attachment list.

tools.name: Get Project Status
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan project status definition by its ID. This is the status catalogue entry, not the status of a project.

tools.name: Get Project Sub Status
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan project sub status definition by its ID.

tools.name: Get Project Type
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan project type by its ID.

tools.name: Get Proposal Template
tools.description: Get one proposal template in ServiceTitan by its id, with its estimate assignments.

tools.name: Get Provider Booking
tools.description: Get one booking in ServiceTitan that belongs to a given booking provider. Works only when the connection was granted the booking provider tag passed as booking_provider_id.

tools.name: Get Purchase Order
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan purchase order by id, including its items and current status.

tools.name: Get Purchase Order Markup
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan purchase order markup tier by id.

tools.name: Get Recurring Service
tools.description: Get one location recurring service in ServiceTitan by its id, including its recurrence schedule and invoice template ids.

tools.name: Get Recurring Service Type
tools.description: Get one recurring service type in ServiceTitan by its id.

tools.name: Get Remittance Vendor
tools.description: Get one remittance vendor in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_REMITTANCE_VENDORS to find the id.

tools.name: Get Report
tools.description: Get a report's definition in ServiceTitan: the input parameters it expects and the fields it returns. Read it before requesting data, because report owners can change the definition.

tools.name: Get Report Data
tools.description: Run a report in ServiceTitan and return one page of rows with the column headers. Rate limit: 1 call of the same report per minute per tenant, so ask for a large page_size (up to 25000) rather than many small pages; for slow reports use START_REPORT_DATA_QUERY and poll GET_REPORT_DATA_QUERY_RESULT.

tools.name: Get Report Data Query Result
tools.description: Poll a long-running report data query in ServiceTitan by its query_token. Returns the rows when the query has finished, or a status of NotStarted or InProgress when it has not, in which case wait and call again.

tools.name: Get Router Performance
tools.description: Get performance counts for one Scheduling Pro router in ServiceTitan over a time window: sessions opened and interacted with, split by scheduler. Both window bounds are required.

tools.name: Get Scheduler Performance
tools.description: Get performance metrics for one Scheduling Pro scheduler in ServiceTitan over a time window, such as sessions, completion rates and jobs booked. Both window bounds are required.

tools.name: Get Service Agreement
tools.description: Get one service agreement in ServiceTitan by id, with its price, dates, status and terms.

tools.name: Get Task
tools.description: Get one task in ServiceTitan Task Management by id, with its comments and attachments. Set include_subtasks to true to also return its subtasks.

tools.name: Get Task Reference Data
tools.description: Get the reference data needed to create tasks in ServiceTitan: employees, business units, task types, sources, resolutions, priorities and statuses. Call it first to get the ids the create task tool requires.

tools.name: Get Team
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan dispatch team by its ID.

tools.name: Get Technician
tools.description: Get one technician in ServiceTitan by id, including name, contact details, home address, zones and license type.

tools.name: Get Technician Payroll Settings
tools.description: Get the payroll settings of one technician in ServiceTitan. Use GET_EMPLOYEE_PAYROLL_SETTINGS for an office employee.

tools.name: Get Technician Shift
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan technician shift by its ID.

tools.name: Get Technician Skill
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan technician skill by its ID, which is a string of the form {technicianId}_{skillId}.

tools.name: Get Technician Tracking URL
tools.description: Get the ServiceTitan tracking URL for one technician on one appointment, which shows the technician's progress toward the customer. Both the technician and appointment IDs are required.

tools.name: Get Timesheet Activity
tools.description: Get one timesheet activity in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITIES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Timesheet Activity Category
tools.description: Get one timesheet activity category in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_CATEGORIES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Timesheet Activity Type
tools.description: Get one timesheet activity type in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITY_TYPES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Timesheet Code
tools.description: Get one timesheet code in ServiceTitan by its id. Use LIST_TIMESHEET_CODES to find the id.

tools.name: Get Vendor
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan inventory vendor by id, including contact details, tax rate, and delivery option.

tools.name: Get Well Known GL Accounts
tools.description: Get the ids of the tenant's default general ledger accounts in ServiceTitan: credit card payable and uncategorized expense. Each id is null when that default account is not configured.

tools.name: Get Zone
tools.description: Get one ServiceTitan dispatch zone by its ID, including its zip codes, cities, service days, business units and technicians.

tools.name: Hold Appointment
tools.description: Put a ServiceTitan job appointment on hold with a hold reason and memo. Get the reason ID from List Job Hold Reasons.

tools.name: Import Sms Opt Ins
tools.description: Record SMS marketing opt-ins in ServiceTitan for phone numbers whose consent was collected outside it. Send only numbers whose owners agreed to receive text messages.

tools.name: List Ad Performance
tools.description: List ad performance rows from ServiceTitan Marketing Ads for a time window, segmented by campaign, ad group or keyword, one page per call. from_utc, to_utc and segmentation_type are required.

tools.name: List AP Bill Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for AP bills in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_AP_BILL_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List AP Bills
tools.description: List accounts-payable (vendor) bills in ServiceTitan with their line items, one page per call. Filter by bill number, status, sync status, source, cost or dates; bill_type defaults to Procurement, so pass ApBill to see standalone AP bills.

tools.name: List AP Credit Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for AP credits in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_AP_CREDIT_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List AP Credits
tools.description: List accounts-payable credits (vendor credits) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by ids, sync status, or created or modified dates.

tools.name: List AP Payment Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for AP payments in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_AP_PAYMENT_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List AP Payments
tools.description: List accounts-payable payments (payments made to vendors) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. These are outgoing vendor payments; use LIST_PAYMENTS for payments received from customers.

tools.name: List Appointment Assignments
tools.description: List technician-to-appointment assignments in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by appointment, job, technician or appointment start range. Use it to see who is assigned to an appointment.

tools.name: List Appointments
tools.description: List ServiceTitan job appointments, one page per call, filtered by job, project, technician, customer, status or start/modified date ranges. Use this to find all appointments of a job or project.

tools.name: List Arrival Windows
tools.description: List the arrival windows configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call. An arrival window is a time range, per business unit, offered to customers when booking.

tools.name: List Attributed Leads
tools.description: List leads with their marketing attribution in ServiceTitan for a time window, one page per call. from_utc and to_utc are required.

tools.name: List Bank Deposits
tools.description: List bank deposits in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by deposit date, review status, deposit status, sync status or gross amount.

tools.name: List Bank Deposit Transactions
tools.description: List the transactions (payments and journal entries) that make up one bank deposit in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use LIST_BANK_DEPOSITS to find the deposit id.

tools.name: List Booking Contacts
tools.description: List the contact entries (phone, email, fax) on one booking in ServiceTitan, one page per call. This is the tenant-wide path; it needs a connection with no booking provider restriction. Use LIST_PROVIDER_BOOKING_CONTACTS when the connection is restricted to a single booking provider tag.

tools.name: List Booking Provider Tags
tools.description: List booking provider tags in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the tag id that the provider-scoped booking tools take as booking_provider_id.

tools.name: List Bookings
tools.description: List bookings in ServiceTitan across all booking providers, one page per call. Use LIST_PROVIDER_BOOKINGS when the connection is restricted to a single booking provider tag.

tools.name: List Budget Codes
tools.description: List company-level ServiceTitan budget codes, one page per call, optionally filtered by budget code, segment or segment item IDs.

tools.name: List Budget Code Segment Item Children
tools.description: List the child items under one item of a company-level budget code segment in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Budget Code Segment Items
tools.description: List the items of one company-level budget code segment in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Set include_children to get nested child items.

tools.name: List Budget Code Segments
tools.description: List the company-level budget code segments of the ServiceTitan work breakdown structure. For the segments of one project use List Project Budget Code Segments.

tools.name: List Business Units
tools.description: List business units in ServiceTitan, the divisions of the company that revenue and work are tracked and reported under.

tools.name: List Call Reasons
tools.description: List call reasons in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the reason id needed to dismiss a lead or booking or to create a lead.

tools.name: List Calls
tools.description: List phone calls recorded in ServiceTitan, inbound and outbound, filtered by campaign, agent, phone number, minimum duration, tag or created/modified time.

tools.name: List Campaign Categories
tools.description: List marketing campaign categories in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Categories group campaigns; they are not pricebook categories.

tools.name: List Campaign Costs
tools.description: List monthly campaign cost records in ServiceTitan across all campaigns, one page per call, filtered by year, month or campaign. Each record holds a daily cost for one campaign and month.

tools.name: List Campaign Costs For Campaign
tools.description: List the monthly cost records of one marketing campaign in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use LIST_CAMPAIGN_COSTS to read costs across all campaigns.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: List marketing campaigns in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by name, tracking phone number, ids or dates. Only active campaigns are returned unless active is set to False or Any.

tools.name: List Capacity Warnings
tools.description: List all capacity awareness warnings of ServiceTitan Marketing Ads, which flag campaigns whose business units are near their capacity threshold. Returns everything in one call; it takes no filters.

tools.name: List Client Specific Pricing Rate Sheets
tools.description: List client-specific pricing rate sheets in the ServiceTitan pricebook, each with its per-SKU price exceptions. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Contact Method Preferences
tools.description: List the communication preferences set on one contact method in ServiceTitan. Returns the full list in one call; it is not paged.

tools.name: List Contact Methods
tools.description: List contact methods across ServiceTitan contacts, one page per call. Pass contact_id for one contact, or filter across contacts by value, type, reference id, or date.

tools.name: List Contact Preference Types
tools.description: List the communication preference types that can be set on a contact method in ServiceTitan, with each one's name and data type. Returns the full list in one call; it is not paged.

tools.name: List Contact Relationships
tools.description: List the customers, locations and bookings a contact is linked to in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: List contacts (person records with name and title) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. These are the GUID-keyed contacts; for the phone and email entries on a customer use LIST_CUSTOMER_CONTACTS.

tools.name: List Contacts For Relationship
tools.description: List the contacts in ServiceTitan attached to one relationship id, one page per call. Relationship ids come from LIST_CONTACT_RELATIONSHIPS.

tools.name: List Credit Memo Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for credit memos in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_CREDIT_MEMO_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List Credit Memo Items
tools.description: List credit memo line items across credit memos in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Pass credit_memo_ids with one ID for a single credit memo or a provider-formatted multi-ID string for several; without it, items of every credit memo are returned.

tools.name: List Credit Memos
tools.description: List customer credit memos in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by the invoices they were applied to, dates, status, batch, business unit, total or balance; filtering by custom field is not supported.

tools.name: List Customer Contacts
tools.description: List contact entries for one or more ServiceTitan customers, or by modified-date range, one page per call. Pass one customer ID for the single-customer case. A location's contacts are separate records; use LIST_LOCATION_CONTACTS for them.

tools.name: List Customer Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for customers in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the type_id needed when setting custom_fields on a customer.

tools.name: List Customer Notes
tools.description: List the notes on one customer in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Customers
tools.description: List customers in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by name, address, phone, ids or dates. Only active customers are returned unless active is set to False or Any.

tools.name: List Dynamic Value Set Values
tools.description: List the allowed values of a report parameter's dynamic value set in ServiceTitan, as rows of key and display name. Use it when a report's parameter description gives a dynamic_set_id instead of a fixed list of values.

tools.name: List Employee Payrolls
tools.description: List the payrolls (pay period records) of one office employee in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use LIST_TECHNICIAN_PAYROLLS for a technician.

tools.name: List Employees
tools.description: List employees in ServiceTitan, the office staff such as CSRs, dispatchers and bookkeepers, filtered by name, email or user id. Field technicians are a separate resource.

tools.name: List Equipment Systems
tools.description: List equipment systems in ServiceTitan, the named groups of installed equipment at a customer location (for example one HVAC system), filtered by location or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Equipment Types
tools.description: List the equipment types defined in ServiceTitan for classifying installed equipment, filtered by name or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Estimate Items
tools.description: List estimate line items in ServiceTitan across estimates, or for one estimate when estimate_id is given.

tools.name: List Estimates
tools.description: List estimates in ServiceTitan, filtered by job, project, location, seller, status, total amount, or sold/created/modified time.

tools.name: List Estimate Status Changes
tools.description: Return the status change history of one estimate in ServiceTitan, each with its UTC timestamp. Not paged.

tools.name: List Estimate Templates
tools.description: List estimate templates in ServiceTitan, the reusable sets of pricebook items that estimates and proposal templates are built from.

tools.name: List Expense Transaction Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for expense transactions in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_EXPENSE_TRANSACTION_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List Expense Transactions
tools.description: List expense transactions (for example card expenses) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by number, vendor name, employee, status, source system, cost or transaction date; the NotSet expense status is rejected with 400.

tools.name: List Finding Attachments
tools.description: List the attachments of one ServiceTitan finding, by finding id. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Findings
tools.description: List findings in ServiceTitan, the issues or observations recorded at customer locations, filtered by location, installed equipment, source job, or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: List form definitions in ServiceTitan, filtered by name, published status, or whether they have conditional logic or triggers. Returns the forms themselves, not what people filled in.

tools.name: List Form Submissions
tools.description: List filled-in form submissions in ServiceTitan with their answers, filtered by form, status, submitter, submission time, or the record the form is attached to (job, customer, location and so on).

tools.name: List GL Accounts
tools.description: List general ledger (GL) accounts in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by ids, names, numbers, types, subtypes, description text, source or active status; only active accounts are returned unless active is set.

tools.name: List GL Account Types
tools.description: List general ledger account types in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the type names accepted when creating or filtering GL accounts.

tools.name: List Gross Pay Items
tools.description: List gross pay items (earnings such as timesheet time, bonuses, salary and reimbursements) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by employee, payroll or date to get the earnings of a pay period. These are computed earnings, not the raw clock times in LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS or LIST_NON_JOB_TIMESHEETS.

tools.name: List Installed Equipment
tools.description: List equipment installed at ServiceTitan customer locations, filtered by location, equipment system, parent, or date range. For catalog equipment in the pricebook use LIST_PRICEBOOK_EQUIPMENT. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Installed Equipment Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for ServiceTitan installed equipment, with each type's data type and options. The descending flag is required. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Intacct Business Unit Mappings
tools.description: List how ServiceTitan business units map to Sage Intacct locations, departments and classes. Only useful for tenants with the Intacct accounting integration; page, page_size and include_total are all required here.

tools.name: List Inventory Adjustments
tools.description: List inventory adjustments in ServiceTitan, filtered by type, inventory location, business unit, invoice, batch, sync status, or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Inventory Bill Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for inventory bills in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_INVENTORY_BILL_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List Inventory Bills
tools.description: List inventory bills (vendor bills created from purchase orders and receipts) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by bill number, purchase order, job number, sync status, cost or dates; bills are read-only apart from custom fields and the exported mark.

tools.name: List Inventory Receipts
tools.description: List inventory receipts in ServiceTitan, the records of items received against purchase orders, filtered by purchase order, vendor, bill, inventory location, or received date. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Inventory Returns
tools.description: List vendor returns in ServiceTitan inventory, filtered by vendor, purchase order, job, inventory location, business unit, or return date. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Inventory Return Types
tools.description: List vendor return types in ServiceTitan inventory; a return type id is required to create a return. The active_only flag is required. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Inventory Templates
tools.description: List ServiceTitan inventory templates with their items, each item carrying a minimum and maximum quantity. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Inventory Transfers
tools.description: List inventory transfers in ServiceTitan, the movements of stock between inventory locations, filtered by status, source or destination location, transfer type, job, or date. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Invoice Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for invoices in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_INVOICE_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: List customer invoices in ServiceTitan, one page per call; every invoice type (job, membership, project, point of sale, adjustment) comes from this one tool. Invoices of every status are returned unless statuses is set; the spec does not document which active state applies when active_state is left out.

tools.name: List Invoice Tasks
tools.description: List the workflow tasks attached to one invoice in ServiceTitan, one page per call. These are invoice tasks created from templates, not Task Management tasks.

tools.name: List Invoice Templates
tools.description: Look up membership invoice templates in ServiceTitan by id (ids is required, max 50). It cannot enumerate all templates: to browse every template use EXPORT_INVOICE_TEMPLATES; otherwise take ids from a customer membership's billing template or a recurring service's invoice template.

tools.name: List Job Attachments
tools.description: List the files attached to one job in ServiceTitan. The spec documents no response schema, so the body is returned unchanged under data.

tools.name: List Job Canceled Logs
tools.description: List the canceled-log entries of one ServiceTitan job, one page per call; each entry records a cancellation of that job.

tools.name: List Job Cancel Reasons
tools.description: List the cancel reasons configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to pick the reason_id for Cancel Job; it does not say why a given job was canceled.

tools.name: List Job Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types available for ServiceTitan jobs, one page per call. Use the returned IDs as type_id in the custom_fields of Create Job or Update Job.

tools.name: List Job Hold Reasons
tools.description: List the hold reasons configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to pick the reason_id for Hold Appointment; it does not say why a given job is on hold.

tools.name: List Job Notes
tools.description: List the notes on one ServiceTitan job, one page per call.

tools.name: List Jobs
tools.description: List ServiceTitan jobs, one page per call, filtered by status, customer, location, project, technician, job type or date ranges for creation, modification, completion and appointments.

tools.name: List Job Types
tools.description: List ServiceTitan job types, one page per call, filtered by name, priority, duration or dates. Use it to find the job_type_id for Create Job.

tools.name: List Journal Entries
tools.description: List journal entries in ServiceTitan, one page per call (page_size max 500). Filter by posting, transaction or export dates, number range, status, sync status, transaction type, names, business units or reference numbers or custom fields.

tools.name: List Journal Entry Details
tools.description: List one journal entry's amounts in ServiceTitan aggregated by GL account, business unit, transaction and pricebook item, one page per call (page_size max 500). Use LIST_JOURNAL_ENTRY_SUMMARY for totals per account only.

tools.name: List Journal Entry Summary
tools.description: List one journal entry's amounts in ServiceTitan aggregated by GL account and business unit, one page per call (page_size max 500). Use LIST_JOURNAL_ENTRY_DETAILS for the finer breakdown by transaction and pricebook item.

tools.name: List Labor Types
tools.description: List payroll labor types in ServiceTitan, one page per call. A labor type classifies paid time and can map to a labor service in the pricebook.

tools.name: List Lead Notes
tools.description: List the notes on one lead in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Leads
tools.description: List leads in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by status, customer, dates or the name and phone given on the lead. Use status Open to find leads that still need follow-up.

tools.name: List Location Contacts
tools.description: List contact entries for one or more ServiceTitan locations, or by created or modified date range, one page per call. Pass one location ID for the single-location case. A customer's contacts are separate records; use LIST_CUSTOMER_CONTACTS for them.

tools.name: List Location Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for locations in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the type_id needed when setting custom_fields on a location.

tools.name: List Location Labor Rates
tools.description: List the hourly labor rates set per customer location and labor type in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Pass location_ids to limit the result to specific locations.

tools.name: List Location Notes
tools.description: List the notes on one location in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Locations
tools.description: List locations in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by customer, name, address, ids or dates. Only active locations are returned unless active is set to False or Any.

tools.name: List Membership Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for customer memberships in ServiceTitan. Returns field definitions (id, name, data type), not the values stored on a membership.

tools.name: List Memberships
tools.description: List customer memberships in ServiceTitan, filtered by customer, status, duration, billing frequency or created/modified time. A customer membership is one customer's instance of a membership type; use the membership types tools for the templates themselves.

tools.name: List Membership Status Changes
tools.description: Return the status change history of one customer membership in ServiceTitan. Not paged: every change for that membership comes back in one call.

tools.name: List Membership Type Discounts
tools.description: List the discounts granted by one membership type in ServiceTitan. Not paged.

tools.name: List Membership Type Duration Billing Items
tools.description: List the duration and billing options of one membership type in ServiceTitan, with their prices. Each option's id is the duration_billing_id needed to sell a membership. Not paged.

tools.name: List Membership Type Recurring Service Items
tools.description: List the recurring services included in one membership type in ServiceTitan. Not paged.

tools.name: List Membership Types
tools.description: List membership types in ServiceTitan, the templates that memberships are sold from. Discounts, duration/billing options, recurring services and tags are left out unless the matching include_ flag is true.

tools.name: List Non Job Appointments
tools.description: List ServiceTitan non-job appointments (technician time blocked for non-customer activities), one page per call, filtered by technician, start range or timesheet code. For customer job visits use List Appointments.

tools.name: List Non Job Timesheets
tools.description: List non-job timesheets (time recorded against timesheet codes) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by employee_id, employee_type, dates or active status. Covers time not on a job; for dispatch-to-done time on job appointments use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS.

tools.name: List Opt Outs
tools.description: Return every phone number that has opted out of contact in ServiceTitan, with its opt-out type. Not paged; numbers come back in E.164 format.

tools.name: List Payment Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field type definitions available for payments in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find valid custom field names before setting them with UPDATE_PAYMENT_CUSTOM_FIELDS.

tools.name: List Payments
tools.description: List payments received from customers in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by the invoices they were applied to, customer, deposit, paid date, status or total; use LIST_AP_PAYMENTS for payments made to vendors.

tools.name: List Payment Terms
tools.description: List payment terms (the due-date rules attached to invoices and bills) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Payment terms are read-only through the API.

tools.name: List Payment Types
tools.description: List payment types (for example cash, check, credit card) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the type_id needed by UPDATE_PAYMENT.

tools.name: List Payroll Activity Codes
tools.description: List payroll activity codes (earning codes that map earnings to a payroll processor's codes) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. These are not timesheet activities; use LIST_TIMESHEET_ACTIVITIES for recorded time.

tools.name: List Payroll Adjustments
tools.description: List payroll adjustments (manually entered earnings or deductions) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by employee ids or posted date.

tools.name: List Payroll Job Splits
tools.description: List payroll job splits across jobs in ServiceTitan, one page per call: one record per technician and job with that technician's split. Pass job_ids with one ID for a single job or a provider-formatted multi-ID string for several jobs.

tools.name: List Payroll Job Timesheets
tools.description: List technician job timesheets across jobs in ServiceTitan (dispatch, arrive, cancel and done times), one page per call. job_ids limits the result to given jobs, but its format is not documented; use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS_FOR_JOB for one job. Covers time on job appointments only; time on non-job codes (meetings, training) is in LIST_NON_JOB_TIMESHEETS, and paid earnings are in LIST_GROSS_PAY_ITEMS.

tools.name: List Payroll Job Timesheets for Job
tools.description: List the technician timesheets recorded on one job in ServiceTitan (dispatch, arrive, cancel and done times), one page per call. Use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS to read across jobs.

tools.name: List Payrolls
tools.description: List payrolls (one employee's or technician's pay period record) across all staff in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by employee type, period dates, approval date or status.

tools.name: List Payroll Settings
tools.description: List the payroll settings (hourly rate, hire date, manager, external payroll id) of employees and technicians in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Filter by employee type or active status.

tools.name: List Pricebook Categories
tools.description: List pricebook categories in ServiceTitan, optionally only Services or Materials categories. Each category carries its nested subcategories. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Pricebook Discounts and Fees
tools.description: List discounts and fees in the ServiceTitan pricebook, with optional search text and category filters. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: List equipment items in the ServiceTitan pricebook (sellable catalog entries such as furnaces), with optional search text and category filters. For equipment installed at a customer location use LIST_INSTALLED_EQUIPMENT. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Pricebook Material Cost Types
tools.description: List the cost types that can be assigned to materials in the ServiceTitan pricebook. Takes no inputs and returns a single page.

tools.name: List Pricebook Material Markups
tools.description: List the material markup tiers in the ServiceTitan pricebook, each a from/to range with the markup percent applied to it. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Pricebook Materials
tools.description: List materials in the ServiceTitan pricebook, with optional search text, category, and cost type filters. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Pricebook Services
tools.description: List services in the ServiceTitan pricebook, with optional search text and category filters. Set calculate_prices to apply current dynamic pricing rules. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Project Budget Codes
tools.description: List the budget codes of one ServiceTitan project, one page per call, optionally filtered by budget code, segment or segment item IDs.

tools.name: List Project Budget Code Segment Item Children
tools.description: List the child items under one item of a budget code segment within a ServiceTitan project, one page per call.

tools.name: List Project Budget Code Segment Items
tools.description: List the items of one budget code segment within a ServiceTitan project, one page per call.

tools.name: List Project Budget Code Segments
tools.description: List the budget code segments of one ServiceTitan project's work breakdown structure.

tools.name: List Project Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types available for ServiceTitan projects, one page per call. Use the returned IDs as type_id in the custom_fields of Create Project or Update Project.

tools.name: List Project Daily Logs
tools.description: List the daily logs of one ServiceTitan project, one page per call, optionally limited to a date range. Returns summaries; use Get Project Daily Log for the full log.

tools.name: List Project Notes
tools.description: List the notes on one ServiceTitan project, one page per call.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List ServiceTitan projects, one page per call, filtered by customer, location, status, job, technician, manager or date ranges. Use job_id to find the project a job belongs to.

tools.name: List Project Statuses
tools.description: List the project statuses configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use the IDs as status_id on a project.

tools.name: List Project Sub Statuses
tools.description: List the project sub statuses configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call, optionally for one parent status.

tools.name: List Project Types
tools.description: List the project types configured in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use the IDs as project_type_id on a project.

tools.name: List Proposal Templates
tools.description: List proposal templates in ServiceTitan, which map the options of a proposal type to estimate templates.

tools.name: List Proposal Types
tools.description: List proposal types in ServiceTitan with their options. Use it to get the proposal_type_id and proposal_type_option_id values that proposal templates need. Not paged.

tools.name: List Provider Booking Contacts
tools.description: List the contact entries on one booking in ServiceTitan that belongs to a given booking provider, one page per call. Works only when the connection was granted the booking provider tag passed as booking_provider_id. Use LIST_BOOKING_CONTACTS when the connection has no booking provider restriction.

tools.name: List Provider Bookings
tools.description: List the bookings in ServiceTitan that belong to one booking provider, one page per call. Works only when the connection was granted the booking provider tag passed as booking_provider_id.

tools.name: List Purchase Order Markups
tools.description: List the purchase order markup tiers in ServiceTitan, each a from/to range with the markup percent applied to it. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Purchase Order Requests
tools.description: List purchase order requests in ServiceTitan, filtered by request status, number, job, project, technician, or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Purchase Orders
tools.description: List purchase orders in ServiceTitan, filtered by status, number, job, project, technician, inventory location, or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Purchase Order Types
tools.description: List purchase order types in ServiceTitan; a type id is required to create a purchase order. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Recurring Service Events
tools.description: List recurring service events in ServiceTitan, the visits generated from a location's recurring services, filtered by location, job, follow-up status or created/modified time.

tools.name: List Recurring Services
tools.description: List location recurring services in ServiceTitan (a recurring service type applied to one location), filtered by membership, location or created/modified time. Technician ids are left out unless include_technicians is true.

tools.name: List Recurring Service Types
tools.description: List recurring service types in ServiceTitan, the templates that location recurring services are created from, filtered by membership type, recurrence type or duration type.

tools.name: List Remittance Vendors
tools.description: List remittance vendors (the pay-to parties for vendor payments) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. These are not the inventory vendors that purchase orders are placed with.

tools.name: List Report Categories
tools.description: List the report categories in ServiceTitan. Start here: every other report tool needs a category id.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: List the reports in one report category in ServiceTitan, with id, name and description.

tools.name: List Reviews
tools.description: List customer reviews collected by ServiceTitan Marketing Reputation, one page per call, filtered by date, rating, source, technician, campaign or location. Several filters take numeric codes whose meanings the spec does not document.

tools.name: List Router Sessions
tools.description: List the customer booking sessions that went through one Scheduling Pro router in ServiceTitan, with outcome, customer details and any job or booking created.

tools.name: List Schedulers
tools.description: List the online booking schedulers set up in ServiceTitan Scheduling Pro, with their status and default flag. Each record also carries data_api_key, the scheduler's web-install key; it is sensitive, so do not repeat it to the user unless asked.

tools.name: List Scheduler Sessions
tools.description: List the customer booking sessions of one Scheduling Pro scheduler in ServiceTitan, with customer details, outcome and any job or booking created.

tools.name: List Service Agreement Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for service agreements in ServiceTitan. Returns field definitions, not the values stored on an agreement.

tools.name: List Service Agreements
tools.description: List service agreements in ServiceTitan, the maintenance contracts for commercial customers, filtered by customer, business unit, status or created/modified time. Read-only: the API has no way to create or change an agreement.

tools.name: List Tag Types
tools.description: List tag types in ServiceTitan, the labels that can be put on customers, jobs, locations and other records. The tag type ids are what other tools take as tag_type_ids.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: List office tasks in ServiceTitan Task Management, one page per call, filtered by status, priority, assignee, customer, job, project or dates. Set include_subtasks to true to also return each task's subtasks. These are Task Management tasks, not the invoice workflow tasks of CREATE_INVOICE_TASK / LIST_INVOICE_TASKS.

tools.name: List Tax Zones
tools.description: List tax zones and their tax rates in ServiceTitan, one page per call; with no filter every active tax zone is returned. Tax zones are read-only through the API.

tools.name: List Teams
tools.description: List ServiceTitan dispatch teams, one page per call. Inactive teams are left out unless include_inactive is true.

tools.name: List Technician Payrolls
tools.description: List the payrolls (pay period records) of one technician in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use LIST_EMPLOYEE_PAYROLLS for an office employee.

tools.name: List Technician Ratings
tools.description: List technician ratings in ServiceTitan, one page per call, filtered by technician, job or dates. Each rating is tied to one technician and one job.

tools.name: List Technicians
tools.description: List technicians in ServiceTitan, the field staff who work jobs, filtered by name or user id. Office employees are a separate resource.

tools.name: List Technician Shifts
tools.description: List ServiceTitan technician shifts, one page per call, filtered by technician, shift type (Normal, OnCall, TimeOff), time range, or text in the title or note.

tools.name: List Technician Skills
tools.description: List ServiceTitan technician skills, one page per call, optionally for one technician. Each entry is one skill held by one technician.

tools.name: List Timesheet Activities
tools.description: List timesheet activities (blocks of time recorded against an activity type, from the Timesheets API) in ServiceTitan, one page per call. It filters only by job, project, active status and created or modified dates, not by employee or work date; for job dispatch/arrive/done times use LIST_PAYROLL_JOB_TIMESHEETS, for time booked to payroll timesheet codes use LIST_NON_JOB_TIMESHEETS, and for paid earnings use LIST_GROSS_PAY_ITEMS.

tools.name: List Timesheet Activity Categories
tools.description: List timesheet activity categories, the groups that activity types belong to, in ServiceTitan, one page per call.

tools.name: List Timesheet Activity Types
tools.description: List timesheet activity types in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Use it to find the activity_type_id needed to create a timesheet activity.

tools.name: List Timesheet Codes
tools.description: List timesheet codes in ServiceTitan, one page per call. Each code says which employee type it applies to and whether it is unpaid, paid, clock in/out or paid time off. Codes are the categories used by LIST_NON_JOB_TIMESHEETS; they are not payroll activity codes (LIST_PAYROLL_ACTIVITY_CODES).

tools.name: List Trucks
tools.description: List trucks in ServiceTitan inventory, the vehicle inventory locations assigned to technicians. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List User Roles
tools.description: List user roles in ServiceTitan, the permission sets assigned to employees and technicians. Use it to get the role_id needed to create an employee or technician.

tools.name: List Vehicle Events
tools.description: List historical driving events for FleetPro vehicles in ServiceTitan, by VIN and time window. Only data older than 7 days is available, the window may span at most 24 hours, at most 50 VINs per call, and results are capped at 10,000 records.

tools.name: List Vehicle GPS Records
tools.description: List historical GPS positions for FleetPro vehicles in ServiceTitan, by VIN and time window. Only data older than 7 days is available, the window may span at most 24 hours, at most 50 VINs per call, and results are capped at 10,000 records.

tools.name: List Vehicles
tools.description: List every FleetPro vehicle in ServiceTitan with its VIN, name and driver. Use it to get the VINs that the vehicle GPS and event tools filter by. Not paged.

tools.name: List Vendor Custom Field Types
tools.description: List the custom field types defined for ServiceTitan vendors, with each type's data type and options. Use it to find valid custom field names before writing vendor custom fields. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Vendors
tools.description: List inventory vendors (suppliers) in ServiceTitan, filtered by name, ids, active status, external data, or date range. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true. For the pay-to parties of vendor payments use LIST_REMITTANCE_VENDORS.

tools.name: List Warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses in ServiceTitan inventory; warehouse ids are used as inventory locations on purchase orders, returns, and trucks. Returns one page per call; request the next page while has_more is true.

tools.name: List Zones
tools.description: List ServiceTitan dispatch zones, one page per call. A zone groups zip codes, cities or territories and the business units and technicians that serve them.

tools.name: Lookup Opt Outs
tools.description: Check the opt-out status of specific phone numbers in ServiceTitan. Numbers with no opt-out are left out of the result, and the whole request fails if any number cannot be parsed.

tools.name: Mark AP Bills as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more AP bills as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. No operation to undo the mark is documented.

tools.name: Mark AP Credits as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more AP credits as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. No operation to undo the mark is documented.

tools.name: Mark AP Payments as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more AP payments as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. No operation to undo the mark is documented.

tools.name: Mark Bank Deposits as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more bank deposits as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Unlike the other mark-as-exported tools, the documented response has no body, so there is no per-id result to check. ServiceTitan documents no operation to undo the exported mark.

tools.name: Mark Credit Memos as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more credit memos as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. No operation to undo the mark is documented.

tools.name: Mark Expense Transactions as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more expense transactions as exported in ServiceTitan. Only an expense in the Posted state moves to Exported; an id that is missing or not Posted comes back as a failure row while the call itself still succeeds. ServiceTitan documents no operation to undo a successful exported mark.

tools.name: Mark Inventory Bills as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more inventory bills as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. ServiceTitan documents no operation to undo a successful exported mark.

tools.name: Mark Invoices as Exported
tools.description: Mark one or more invoices as exported to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan. Returns one result row per id with a success flag and error message, so check each row: a failed id does not fail the call. No operation to undo the mark is documented.

tools.name: Mark Recurring Service Event Complete
tools.description: Mark a recurring service event complete in ServiceTitan by linking it to a job. It also copies the recurring service's invoice template items onto that job's invoice.

tools.name: Mark Recurring Service Event Incomplete
tools.description: Mark a recurring service event incomplete in ServiceTitan by unlinking it from a job. It also deletes the invoice items that were copied onto the job's invoice when the event was completed.

tools.name: Match Budget Codes
tools.description: Check budget code strings against the company-level ServiceTitan budget codes; each input code comes back with a validity flag and the budget codes it matches. Read-only.

tools.name: Match Project Budget Codes
tools.description: Check budget code strings against the budget codes of one ServiceTitan project; each input code comes back with a validity flag and the budget codes it matches. Read-only.

tools.name: Reject Purchase Order Request
tools.description: Reject a ServiceTitan purchase order request by its request id, with a required rejection reason. Takes the request id from LIST_PURCHASE_ORDER_REQUESTS, not a purchase order id. No way to withdraw a rejection is documented.

tools.name: Remove Appointment Confirmation
tools.description: Remove the confirmation from a ServiceTitan job appointment, returning it to unconfirmed.

tools.name: Remove Appointment Hold
tools.description: Remove the hold from a ServiceTitan job appointment that was put on hold.

tools.name: Remove Customer Tag
tools.description: Remove one tag type from one customer in ServiceTitan. The tag type itself is kept. Use REMOVE_TAGS_FROM_CUSTOMERS for several customers or tags at once.

tools.name: Remove Equipment from Equipment System
tools.description: Detach installed equipment from a ServiceTitan equipment system, by system id and a list of installed equipment ids. The equipment records themselves are not deleted.

tools.name: Remove Job Cancellation
tools.description: Undo the cancellation of a ServiceTitan job that was canceled.

tools.name: Remove Location Tag
tools.description: Remove one tag type from one location in ServiceTitan. The tag type itself is kept.

tools.name: Remove Tags From Customers
tools.description: Remove one or more tag types from several customers in ServiceTitan in one call. Every tag type listed is removed from every customer listed. Use REMOVE_CUSTOMER_TAG for a single customer and tag.

tools.name: Replace Contact
tools.description: Replace a contact in ServiceTitan with the values sent. is_archived is required, and name, title or reference_id left out are cleared; use UPDATE_CONTACT to change only some fields.

tools.name: Replace Contact Method
tools.description: Replace a contact method of a contact in ServiceTitan with the values sent. type and value are required, and optional fields left out are cleared; use UPDATE_CONTACT_METHOD to change only some fields.

tools.name: Replace Journal Entry
tools.description: Replace an external journal entry in ServiceTitan, including all of its lines. Only entries created through the API (external) can be replaced, and lines are overwritten: send every line to keep, because any line left out is deleted.

tools.name: Reschedule Appointment
tools.description: Move a ServiceTitan job appointment to a new start and end time, and optionally a new arrival window. It changes only the schedule, not the assigned technicians.

tools.name: Sell Estimate
tools.description: Mark an estimate as sold in ServiceTitan and credit the sale to a technician. sold_by_id must be a managed technician, and an estimate sold this way is set to 'perform work later', so the job still has to be booked.

tools.name: Send Employee Account Invite
tools.description: Send an account invitation to a ServiceTitan employee. The sent invitation cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Send Employee Password Reset Link
tools.description: Send a password reset link to a ServiceTitan employee. The sent link cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Send Technician Account Invite
tools.description: Send an account invitation to a ServiceTitan technician. The sent invitation cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Send Technician Password Reset Link
tools.description: Send a password reset link to a ServiceTitan technician. The sent link cannot be recalled.

tools.name: Set Appointment Summary
tools.description: Set the work-performed summary for one technician on a ServiceTitan job appointment. Private preview: available to specific accounts only, so expect an error on tenants without it.

tools.name: Set Arrival Window Active
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a ServiceTitan arrival window by setting its active flag.

tools.name: Set Business Unit External Data
tools.description: Attach external data (key/value pairs owned by an application GUID) to a business unit in ServiceTitan. It cannot change the unit's name, address or other settings.

tools.name: Start Report Data Query
tools.description: Start a long-running report data query in ServiceTitan. If it finishes within about 10 seconds the rows come back directly; otherwise it returns a status and a query_token to poll for the result. Rate limit: 1 call of the same report per minute per tenant. Use GET_REPORT_DATA for fast reports that return within one call.

tools.name: Submit Lead Form
tools.description: Submit a lead form to ServiceTitan with a person's name and optional email, phone, address and summary, creating a lead and returning its id. Use CREATE_LEAD when you already have a campaign id and want to set lead fields directly.

tools.name: Unassign Technicians from Appointment
tools.description: Remove one or more technicians from a ServiceTitan job appointment. Returns the appointment.

tools.name: Unsell Estimate
tools.description: Revert a sold estimate to unsold in ServiceTitan. It only works when no signature has been collected and the estimate has not been booked out into a job.

tools.name: Update AP Bill Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more AP bills in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one AP bill id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update AP Credit Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more AP credits in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one AP credit id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update AP Payment Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more AP payments in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one AP payment id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Appointment Special Instructions
tools.description: Replace the special instructions text on a ServiceTitan job appointment. The new text overwrites the existing instructions.

tools.name: Update Arrival Window
tools.description: Replace the start time, duration and business units of a ServiceTitan arrival window. All three fields are required. To turn a window on or off use Set Arrival Window Active.

tools.name: Update Arrival Window Configuration
tools.description: Change the tenant-wide ServiceTitan arrival window setting that decides whether a job's default start time is the start or the end of the chosen arrival window. Affects all future bookings.

tools.name: Update Booking
tools.description: Update fields of an existing booking in ServiceTitan for a given booking provider. Only the fields sent are changed; if address is sent, all six of its fields are required.

tools.name: Update Booking Contact
tools.description: Update one contact entry on a booking in ServiceTitan for a given booking provider. Only the fields sent are changed.

tools.name: Update Booking Provider Tag
tools.description: Update the name or description of a booking provider tag in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed.

tools.name: Update Call
tools.description: Update a call record in ServiceTitan: its call type, reason, excuse memo, tag and linked customer, location, job, campaign or agent. This is a PUT and excuse_memo, reason, customer, location and tag are required on every call; GET_CALL does not return the current location, excuse memo or tag, so have those values ready before calling.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Update a marketing campaign in ServiceTitan. The spec requires name, business_unit_id, category_id and active on every call, so read the campaign first and send its current values for fields you are not changing.

tools.name: Update Campaign Category
tools.description: Rename a marketing campaign category in ServiceTitan or change its active flag. name is required on every call, even when only active changes.

tools.name: Update Campaign Cost
tools.description: Change the daily cost of an existing campaign cost record in ServiceTitan. The campaign, year and month of the record cannot be changed.

tools.name: Update Client Specific Pricing Rate Sheet
tools.description: Update the per-SKU price exceptions of a client-specific pricing rate sheet in the ServiceTitan pricebook, by rate sheet id. The spec does not say whether the exceptions sent replace the sheet's current list or are merged into it.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update a contact's name, title, reference id or archived flag in ServiceTitan. The spec lists is_archived as required even though this is a partial update. Use REPLACE_CONTACT to overwrite every field.

tools.name: Update Contact Method
tools.description: Update the value or memo of a contact method in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed; the type cannot be changed here. Use REPLACE_CONTACT_METHOD to overwrite every field, including type. contact_id is the GUID of a person contact from CREATE_CONTACT or LIST_CONTACTS; to add a phone or email directly to a customer, location or booking use CREATE_CUSTOMER_CONTACT, CREATE_LOCATION_CONTACT or CREATE_BOOKING_CONTACT.

tools.name: Update Contact Method Preference
tools.description: Set the value of one communication preference on a contact method in ServiceTitan. The value is sent as a string whatever the preference's data type.

tools.name: Update Credit Memo
tools.description: Update a credit memo's summary, date, business unit or active flag in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. It cannot change amounts or applications: use ADD_CREDIT_MEMO_SPLITS to apply the memo to invoices.

tools.name: Update Credit Memo Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more credit memos in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one credit memo id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Customer
tools.description: Update fields of a customer in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed, but custom_fields and tag_type_ids are treated as full lists: send every value you want to keep. To add or remove one tag, use ADD_CUSTOMER_TAG or REMOVE_CUSTOMER_TAG.

tools.name: Update Customer Contact
tools.description: Update one contact entry on a customer in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed; if preferences is sent, all five of its flags are required. This is the customer's own contact list, separate from the GUID person contacts managed with CREATE_CONTACT and CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD.

tools.name: Update Employee
tools.description: Update an office employee in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. business_unit_access_ids is a full replacement, and account_locked sets whether the account is locked.

tools.name: Update Employee Payroll Settings
tools.description: Update the payroll settings of one office employee in ServiceTitan. hourly_rate is required on every call; the spec does not say whether other omitted fields are kept or cleared.

tools.name: Update Equipment System
tools.description: Update a ServiceTitan equipment system by id. Omitted fields are left unchanged; equipment_ids, when sent, replaces the system's whole equipment list (use ADD_EQUIPMENT_TO_EQUIPMENT_SYSTEM or REMOVE_EQUIPMENT_FROM_EQUIPMENT_SYSTEM to change one item), and an empty list for tags or custom fields clears them.

tools.name: Update Equipment Type
tools.description: Rename a ServiceTitan equipment type or change its active status, by id.

tools.name: Update Estimate
tools.description: Update an estimate in ServiceTitan. This is a PUT with every field optional; whether omitted fields and items are kept or cleared is not documented, so read the estimate first and send the full intended values.

tools.name: Update Estimate Template
tools.description: Update an estimate template in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. Sending items replaces every item on the template, and summary and business_unit_id cannot be cleared once set.

tools.name: Update Expense Transaction Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more expense transactions in ServiceTitan. The request is all-or-nothing: an unknown custom field name or expense id returns 422 and no update is saved.

tools.name: Update Finding
tools.description: Update a ServiceTitan finding by id: its text fields, urgency level, or archived and active status. The location, equipment, and source job cannot be changed through this tool. Send only the fields to change; the spec marks none of them required.

tools.name: Update Finding Attachment
tools.description: Update the file name, URL, or media type of an attachment on a ServiceTitan finding. Send only the fields to change; the spec marks none of them required.

tools.name: Update GL Account
tools.description: Update a general ledger (GL) account in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. Set active to false to deactivate the account, which is the only form of deletion: an account cannot be removed permanently.

tools.name: Update Gross Pay Item
tools.description: Update a gross pay item in ServiceTitan and return its id. This is a PUT: payroll_id, amount, activity_code_id and date are required on every call, and the spec does not say whether optional fields left out are kept or cleared.

tools.name: Update Installed Equipment
tools.description: Update fields of a ServiceTitan installed equipment record by id. Send only the fields to change; the spec marks none of them required. List fields such as custom_fields and tag_type_ids are sent as the lists you give.

tools.name: Update Inventory Adjustment
tools.description: Update fields of an existing ServiceTitan inventory adjustment by id. Only the fields you send are changed, but items is sent as the full list: lines left out of it are removed.

tools.name: Update Inventory Adjustment Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more ServiceTitan inventory adjustments in a single request. Each operation names the adjustment by objectId and the custom fields to write; the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Inventory Bill Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more inventory bills in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one inventory bill id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Inventory Receipt Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more ServiceTitan inventory receipts in a single request. Each operation names the receipt by objectId and the custom fields to write; the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Inventory Return
tools.description: Update fields of an existing ServiceTitan vendor return by id. Only the fields you send are changed.

tools.name: Update Inventory Return Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more ServiceTitan inventory returns in a single request. Each operation names the return by objectId and the custom fields to write; the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Inventory Return Type
tools.description: Update a ServiceTitan vendor return type by id. Only the fields you send are changed.

tools.name: Update Inventory Transfer
tools.description: Update an existing ServiceTitan inventory transfer by id. The source location, transfer type, and date can only be changed while the transfer is Pending.

tools.name: Update Inventory Transfer Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more ServiceTitan inventory transfers in a single request. Each operation names the transfer by objectId and the custom fields to write.

tools.name: Update Invoice
tools.description: Update an invoice's header fields, line items or payment settlement status in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. Each entry in items needs description and quantity, and the documented response has no body, so read the invoice back with LIST_INVOICES to confirm.

tools.name: Update Invoice Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more invoices in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one invoice id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Invoice Item
tools.description: Update one line item on an invoice in ServiceTitan; item_id names the item to change, and description and quantity are required on every call.

tools.name: Update Invoice Task
tools.description: Update the name, status, assignee, due date or description of a task on an invoice in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. task_id is a string id from LIST_INVOICE_TASKS. This is an invoice workflow task, not a Task Management task (CREATE_TASK).

tools.name: Update Invoice Template
tools.description: Update a membership invoice template in ServiceTitan; only the top-level fields sent are changed. Whether items replaces or merges with the existing items is not documented, so read the template first and send the full intended item list.

tools.name: Update Job
tools.description: Update fields of a ServiceTitan job; only the fields sent are changed, and job status cannot be changed here. custom_fields and tag_type_ids replace the whole list, so include every value you want to keep.

tools.name: Update Job Type
tools.description: Update fields of a ServiceTitan job type; only the fields sent are changed. custom_field_type_ids replaces the assigned list unless custom_fields_update_mode is Merge.

tools.name: Update Journal Entry
tools.description: Update a journal entry's status (Open or Closed) and custom fields in ServiceTitan. It cannot change lines or amounts; use REPLACE_JOURNAL_ENTRY for that. Custom fields not named are left as they are; a named custom field can be set to null but not deleted.

tools.name: Update Journal Entry Sync Status
tools.description: Record the result of syncing a journal entry to an external accounting system in ServiceTitan by setting its sync status. version_id is required when the status is Synced and must match the entry version that was synced.

tools.name: Update Labor Type
tools.description: Replace a payroll labor type in ServiceTitan. This is a full update: name, code and active are required on every call, and leaving out service_code_id clears the labor type's service code.

tools.name: Update Lead
tools.description: Update fields of a lead in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed; status is not set here, use DISMISS_LEAD to dismiss.

tools.name: Update Location
tools.description: Update fields of a location in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed, but custom_fields and tag_type_ids replace the full lists, so anything left out of them is removed.

tools.name: Update Location Contact
tools.description: Update one contact entry on a location in ServiceTitan. Only the fields sent are changed; if preferences is sent, all five of its flags are required. This is the location's own contact list, separate from the GUID person contacts managed with CREATE_CONTACT and CREATE_CONTACT_METHOD.

tools.name: Update Location Preferred Technician
tools.description: Set the preferred technician of a location in ServiceTitan. Both ids go in the path and no request body is sent; it replaces any technician set before.

tools.name: Update Membership
tools.description: Update a customer membership in ServiceTitan; only the fields sent are changed. status takes Active, Suspended, Expired, Canceled or Deleted, and recurring_service_action None deletes the membership's existing recurring services. Explicit null clears to_date, location_id and recurring_location_id.

tools.name: Update Non Job Appointment
tools.description: Replace a ServiceTitan non-job appointment. This is a full update: technician, start, duration and name are required every time.

tools.name: Update Payment
tools.description: Update a customer payment record in ServiceTitan: type, paid date, memo, status and how it is split across invoices. type_id and splits are required on every call even though this is a PATCH.

tools.name: Update Payment Custom Fields
tools.description: Set custom field values on one or more payments in ServiceTitan. Each operation names one payment id and the fields to set; a field name must already exist as a custom field type, and the documented response has no body.

tools.name: Update Payment Status
tools.description: Set the status (Pending, Posted or Exported) of one or more customer payments in ServiceTitan in one call. The documented response has no body, so read the payments back with LIST_PAYMENTS to confirm.

tools.name: Update Payroll Adjustment
tools.description: Update a payroll adjustment in ServiceTitan with a PUT. employee_id and posted_on are required on every call along with the employee_type query value; the spec does not say what happens to optional fields that are left out.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Category
tools.description: Update fields of a ServiceTitan pricebook category by id and return the updated category. Every body field is optional.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Discount or Fee
tools.description: Update fields of a discount or fee in the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. Every body field is optional and only the fields you pass are sent; categories and assets are sent as the lists you give.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Equipment
tools.description: Update fields of an equipment item in the ServiceTitan pricebook catalog by id. Every body field is optional and only the fields you pass are sent; list fields such as categories and assets are sent as the lists you give.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Material
tools.description: Update fields of a material in the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. Every body field is optional; a field left out is not sent.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Material Markup
tools.description: Replace a material markup tier in the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. This is a full replacement: range_from, range_to, and percent are all required.

tools.name: Update Pricebook Service
tools.description: Update fields of a service in the ServiceTitan pricebook by id. Send only the fields to change; the spec marks none of them required.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Update fields of a ServiceTitan project; only the fields sent are changed.
