name: Shorten.REST
description: Shorten.REST is a link shortening and management app that allows you to generate unique, branded URLs with advanced tracking capabilities.

tools.name: Create Alias
tools.description: Tool to create a new alias (short URL) under a specified domain. Use when you need to shorten a URL. If no domain is specified, the alias will be attached to the default domain Short.fyi. You can override domain-level Meta Tags and Tracking Snippets by specifying them for each URL.

tools.name: Delete Alias
tools.description: Tool to delete a single alias by providing alias and domain. Use when you need to remove an existing shortened URL. If no domain is provided, the API searches for the matching alias within the Short.fyi domain.

tools.name: Get Aliases
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all URL aliases of the authenticated user. Use when you need to list existing aliases (supports pagination).

tools.name: Get click data for aliases
tools.description: Tool to retrieve click data for shortened URLs. Use to check click analytics for your aliases. Returns a list of click records which may be empty if no clicks have occurred yet. Returned records may represent a limited window or subset of historical clicks rather than complete per-click logs.

tools.name: List aliases by domain
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all alias names associated with your account and a given domain. Results are in descending order by creation date. Use when you need to list alias names (not full details) for a specific domain with pagination support.

tools.name: Update Alias
tools.description: Tool to update an existing short URL alias by providing its alias name and domain. Use when you need to modify destinations, metatags, or snippets for an existing alias. IMPORTANT: When updating array properties (like destinations), the entire array is replaced, so you must include all existing records you want to keep.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key required for authenticating requests to the Shorten.REST API.

name: Shortpixel
description: ShortPixel is an image optimization and compression service that offers APIs and plugins to enhance website performance by reducing image sizes without compromising quality.

tools.name: Add CDN Domain
tools.description: Tool to add a new domain to the ShortPixel CDN system and associate it with your API key. Use when you need to register a domain for CDN services. If the domain already exists without a user, it will be associated with your API key.

tools.name: Bulk Purge ShortPixel Storage
tools.description: Tool to purge all files stored on ShortPixel storage servers for a domain. Use when you need to remove all stored files for a site in bulk.

tools.name: Check Image Status
tools.description: Tool to check the optimization status of an image being processed by ShortPixel. Returns current status of queued images including URLs and size information.

tools.name: Clean Up Image
tools.description: Tool to remove images from the processing queue. Use when you need to optimize another image with the same URL but different contents within the next hour.

tools.name: Get Adaptive Image via CDN
tools.description: Tool to optimize images on-the-fly via ShortPixel CDN. Transform images by URL with parameters for width, height, cropping, quality, and format conversion. Returns the optimized image directly without CDN caching.

tools.name: Get API Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current status of your API key, including available credits. Use when you need to monitor your account usage before making additional API calls.

tools.name: Get CDN Usage Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed CDN usage statistics for a domain including traffic, API calls, monthly quota, remaining credits, and historical usage breakdown by date. Use when you need to monitor CDN consumption or check quota status.

tools.name: Optimize Images by URL
tools.description: Tool to optimize images by providing their URLs. Use when you need to compress and optimize images accessible online.

tools.name: Read CDN Domain Status

tools.name: Revoke CDN Domain

tools.name: Set CDN Domain
tools.description: Tool to associate an API key with an existing domain. Unlike add-domain, this does not create a new domain - it only associates a user ID if not already associated. Use when you need to claim unassociated domains.

tools.name: Upload and Optimize Images
tools.description: Tool to upload and optimize images that are not accessible online. Uses multipart form data to upload files directly and applies optimization parameters like compression type, resize options, and format conversion.

name: Shotstack
description: Shotstack is a cloud-based platform that enables developers, marketers, and designers to automate the generation of videos, images, and audio at scale using a RESTful API.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new template for video editing. Use when you want to save a reusable timeline configuration as a template. Template changes do not retroactively affect past renders.

tools.name: Create Template (v2)

tools.name: Delete Ingested Media

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific Shotstack template by its ID. Use when you need to remove a template permanently.

tools.name: Delete Shotstack Workflow
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific Shotstack workflow. Use when you need to permanently remove a workflow after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Fetch Source
tools.description: Tool to fetch a remote media file and store it as a source asset. Operation is asynchronous — poll SHOTSTACK_GET_INGEST_STATUS or SHOTSTACK_INSPECT_MEDIA until the asset is ready before passing it to SHOTSTACK_RENDER_VIDEO or other downstream tools. Use when you need to ingest a file before rendering.

tools.name: Get Asset
tools.description: Tool to fetch details of a hosted asset by its unique identifier. Use when you need to retrieve information about videos, images, audio files, thumbnails, or poster images hosted on Shotstack's CDN.

tools.name: Get Assets by Render ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve hosted assets by render ID. Use when you need to fetch one or more files (video, thumbnail, poster image) generated by a specific render job.

tools.name: Get Ingest Status (Deprecated)
tools.description: DEPRECATED: Use SHOTSTACK_GET_SOURCE instead. Tool to retrieve the status and details of an ingested media asset. Poll until the asset status is 'ready' before using it in SHOTSTACK_RENDER_VIDEO; rendering against an unprocessed asset causes missing clips or failed renders.

tools.name: Get Render Callback
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the webhook/callback URL configuration for a specific render job. Returns only callback settings (URL, method, headers), not render status or output URLs — use a separate render-status check to obtain final results.

tools.name: Get Render Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current status and details of a Shotstack render job by render ID. Use when polling a render until done or failed, typically after creating a render with SHOTSTACK_RENDER_VIDEO.

tools.name: Get Source Details
tools.description: Tool to fetch the details of a specific source asset. Use when you need to inspect a source after uploading, check its status, or diagnose ingest/render failures—such as unsupported codecs, corrupt files, or bad URLs—before retrying.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific template. Use when you have the ID of an existing template and need its metadata.

tools.name: Get Template By Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a template by template id and API version. Use when you need to fetch template details from a specific Edit API version.

tools.name: Get Upload URL
tools.description: Tool to request a signed URL for direct file upload to Shotstack. Use when you need to upload a file to Shotstack storage. The response returns a signed URL that you use to upload the file using a PUT request with the binary file.

tools.name: Inspect Media
tools.description: Tool to inspect media metadata. Use before rendering to retrieve duration, resolution, frame rate, and format of an online media file — clip timecodes, trim points, and audio sync calculations depend on these values. Mixing assets without prior inspection can cause letterboxing, jitter, or audio sync issues in the final output.

tools.name: List Sources
tools.description: Tool to list all source assets. Use when you need to retrieve source entries with optional pagination.

tools.name: List Sources (with Environment)
tools.description: Tool to list all ingested source files with environment selection. Use when you need to retrieve sources from stage (sandbox) or v1 (production) environment with optional pagination.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all Shotstack templates for the account. Use after creating or updating templates to view your available templates.

tools.name: List Templates with Environment
tools.description: Tool to list all Shotstack templates for the specified environment. Use when you need to retrieve templates from a specific environment (stage or production).

tools.name: Request Upload URL
tools.description: Tool to request a signed URL for direct file upload. Use when you need to upload a file to Shotstack storage. The response returns a signed URL that expires in one hour.

tools.name: Render Video
tools.description: Tool to initiate a new video render job. Use when you have defined a timeline and output settings and want to start rendering.

tools.name: Transfer Asset
tools.description: Tool to transfer a file from any publicly available URL to one or more Serve API destinations. Use when you need to copy a file from an external source to Shotstack's hosting service or other configured destinations.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing template by its ID. Use when you need to modify a template's name or edit configuration. Both name and complete template definition must be provided.

required.name: version
required.description: The environment to use for the API request, either 'stage' for the staging environment or 'v1' for the production environment.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key provided by Shotstack for authenticating API requests.

name: Signpath
description: SignPath is a code signing service that integrates with your build system to automate the signing of your software artifacts, ensuring their authenticity and integrity.

tools.name: Get Health Check
tools.description: Tool to check if the SignPath API is healthy and operational. Use this to verify API availability before performing other operations.

tools.name: List Certificates
tools.description: Retrieve all certificates available in a SignPath organization. Use this to discover certificate IDs needed for signing operations. Requires a valid organization_id which can be obtained from your SignPath account settings.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: Tool to list all projects for an organization. Use after confirming the organization ID to retrieve and paginate project records.

tools.name: Retrieve Signing Policy Details
tools.description: Retrieve signing policy details for code signing operations. Returns certificate info, RSA key parameters, and policy metadata for the authenticated user's accessible signing policies. Without filters, returns all policies where the user is assigned as Submitter.

tools.name: Retrieve System Info
tools.description: Retrieves SignPath system information including the application version and the web UI base URL. Use this tool to verify the SignPath installation version or to obtain the web interface URL.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your SignPath organization ID. This can be found in the SignPath web application URL or in your signing policy details.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to SignPath's API. Generate this from your user profile or CI user settings.

name: Signwell
description: SignWell is an electronic signature tool for legally binding e-signatures and faster document signing.

tools.name: Create Document
tools.description: Tool to create and optionally send a new document for signing. Use when you have files and recipients defined and want to programmatically submit a signature request in one call.

tools.name: Create Document from Template
tools.description: Tool to create and optionally send a new document for signing from a template. Use when you need to generate a document using a pre-configured template with placeholders. If draft is set to true the document will not be sent.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to register a webhook callback URL. Use when you need to receive document event notifications.

tools.name: Delete Document

tools.name: List Webhooks

tools.name: Send Reminder

tools.name: Update and Send Document

tools.name: Update Template

name: Simla.com
description: Simla.com is an omnichannel CRM platform with AI for automating communications, measuring team performance, managing customer data, and integrating delivery services and order management.

tools.name: Add Customer Interaction Favorite
tools.description: Tool to add a product offer to a customer's list of favorites. Use when you need to save a specific product to a customer's favorites on a particular site.

tools.name: Combine Customers
tools.description: Tool to combine multiple customers into one. The specified customers will be merged into the result customer and then deleted. Use when you need to consolidate multiple customer records. Note: This operation is performed asynchronously - use /api/v5/customers/history to track the result.

tools.name: Combine Corporate Customers
tools.description: Tool to combine multiple corporate customers into one. The specified customers will be merged into the result customer and then deleted. Use when you need to consolidate multiple corporate customer records. Note: This operation is performed asynchronously - use /api/v5/customers-corporate/history to track the result.

tools.name: Combine Orders
tools.description: Tool to combine two orders into one. The source order will be merged into the result order using the specified technique. Use when you need to consolidate order data from one order into another.

tools.name: Create Cost
tools.description: Create a new cost record in Simla CRM. Use this to track business expenses with period dates, amounts, and cost categories. Required fields: dateFrom (start date), dateTo (end date), summ (amount), and costItem (category code). The cost amount must be positive and costItem must match an existing cost item in the system. Optionally associate the cost with specific stores or users.

tools.name: Create Customer
tools.description: Creates a new customer in Simla.com. All customer fields are optional - provide at least one field (e.g., firstName, email, or phone) to create a customer. Returns the customer ID upon successful creation.

tools.name: Create Corporate Customer
tools.description: Creates a new corporate customer in Simla.com. Use when you need to add a new business or organization as a customer. At least one field (typically nickName or externalId) should be provided. Returns the corporate customer ID upon successful creation.

tools.name: Create Customer Interaction Cart Set
tools.description: Tool to create or overwrite shopping cart data for a customer. Use when you need to set cart contents for customer interaction tracking. This overwrites any existing cart data for the specified customer.

tools.name: Create Corporate Customer Address
tools.description: Creates a new address for a corporate customer in Simla.com. Use when adding a delivery or billing address to an existing corporate customer account. The address can be specified as simple text or with detailed components (street, city, region, etc.).

tools.name: Create Corporate Customer Company
tools.description: Tool to create a company for a corporate customer in Simla.com. Use when you need to add a new company to an existing corporate customer record. Returns the newly created company ID on success.

tools.name: Create Corporate Customer Contact
tools.description: Tool to create a link between a corporate customer and a contact person. Use when you need to associate an existing customer as a contact for a corporate customer entity.

tools.name: Create Corporate Customer Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note for a corporate customer. Use when you need to add notes or comments to corporate customer records. Requires either customer ID or external ID to identify the corporate customer.

tools.name: Create Customer Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note for a customer. Use when you need to add notes or comments to customer records. Requires either customer ID or external ID to identify the customer.

tools.name: Create Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to create a custom field for a specified entity in Simla. Use when you need to extend orders, customers, corporate customers, or companies with custom metadata fields.

tools.name: Create Custom Fields Dictionary
tools.description: Tool to create a custom fields dictionary with elements. Use when you need to create a new directory for dictionary-type or multiselect_dictionary-type custom fields.

tools.name: Calculate Loyalty Discount
tools.description: Tool to calculate maximum loyalty discount and bonuses for an order. Use when you need to preview loyalty benefits before order creation or show customers potential savings based on their loyalty status.

tools.name: Create Order
tools.description: Create a new order in Simla with customer details and line items. This action registers an order with customer information, items (with offer IDs), delivery address, and optional metadata. The API automatically creates customers and offers if they don't exist. Returns complete order details including assigned order ID and number. Key requirements: - At least one item with a valid offer identifier (id, externalId, or xmlId) - Quantity must be greater than 0 - Customer contact info (name/phone/email) is optional but recommended

tools.name: Create Orders Link
tools.description: Tool to create a link between multiple orders in Simla. Use when you need to associate two or more orders together with an optional comment.

tools.name: Create Order Pack
tools.description: Tool to create a new order pack in Simla. Use when you need to register pack shipment details for an order item, including store location, quantity, shipment date, and invoice/delivery note numbers.

tools.name: Create Order Payment
tools.description: Create a new payment record for an order in Simla CRM. Use when recording payments received for orders. Required fields: type (payment type code), amount (must be positive), and order reference (id or externalId). The payment type must match an existing payment type in the system (e.g., 'cash', 'bank-card'). Use this to track payment transactions against specific orders.

tools.name: Create Reference Courier
tools.description: Tool to create a new courier in Simla.com. Use when you need to add a new courier to the system for delivery management. Returns the courier ID upon successful creation.

tools.name: Create Reference Currency
tools.description: Tool to create a new currency in Simla.com. Use when you need to add a new currency to the system for financial operations and multi-currency support.

tools.name: Create Store Inventories Upload
tools.description: Tool to batch update inventory quantities and purchase prices across warehouses/stores. Use when you need to sync stock levels and cost pricing for offers. Updates leftover stocks (available quantity) and purchasing prices for existing offers in the system.

tools.name: Create Store Product Groups
tools.description: Tool to create a new product group in Simla.com store. Use when you need to add a new product group for organizing products. Returns the product group ID upon successful creation.

tools.name: Batch Create Store Products
tools.description: Tool to batch create products and services in the store catalog. Use when you need to create multiple products at once. Each product requires a name, article (SKU), and catalogId that matches the catalog parameter.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task. Use after gathering task details and assignees.

tools.name: Create Web Analytics Visits Upload
tools.description: Tool to batch upload web analytics visit records to Simla CRM. Use when tracking customer visits with traffic source attribution. Each visit must include site code, customer identifier, timestamp, and traffic source/medium information.

tools.name: Delete Cost
tools.description: Tool to delete a cost by ID. Use when you need to remove a cost record from the system.

tools.name: Delete Corporate Customer Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a corporate customer note by ID. Use when you need to remove a note record from a corporate customer.

tools.name: Delete Customer Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a customer note by ID. Use when you need to remove a note record from a customer.

tools.name: Delete Order Payment
tools.description: Tool to delete an order payment by ID. Use when you need to remove a payment record from an order.

tools.name: Edit Cost
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing cost record by ID. Use when you need to update cost details such as amount, dates, cost item, or attribution information for expense tracking and analysis.

tools.name: Edit Customer
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing customer. Use when you need to update customer details by external ID.

tools.name: Edit Corporate Customer
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing corporate customer. Use when you need to update corporate customer details such as nickname, discount, VIP status, or custom fields by external ID.

tools.name: Edit Corporate Customer Address
tools.description: Tool to edit an address for a corporate customer. Use when you need to update address details (name, city, street, building, etc.) for a specific corporate customer address by its external ID.

tools.name: Edit Corporate Customer Company
tools.description: Tool to edit a company associated with a corporate customer. Use when you need to update company details such as name or main status for a corporate customer's company entity.

tools.name: Edit Corporate Customer Contact
tools.description: Tool to edit the link between a corporate customer and a contact person. Use when you need to update contact properties such as marking a contact as the main contact person for a corporate customer.

tools.name: Edit Custom Field
tools.description: Edit an existing custom field's properties by entity type and field code. Use this to modify custom field settings such as display name, description, type, visibility flags, sort order, default values, or settings (for dictionary-type fields). At least one property besides entity and code must be provided. The field must already exist.

tools.name: Edit Custom Fields Dictionary
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing custom fields directory by code. Use when you need to update the directory name or modify its elements (add, remove, or reorder entries).

tools.name: Edit Delivery Generic Setting
tools.description: Tool to register or edit a delivery service integration configuration. Use when you need to create a new delivery service integration or update existing delivery settings including API endpoints, statuses, custom fields, and integration metadata.

tools.name: Edit File
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing file by ID. Use when you need to update file properties such as filename.

tools.name: Edit Integration Module
tools.description: Tool to create or edit an integration module configuration. Use when you need to register or update an integration module with its base URL, client ID, and display settings.

tools.name: Edit Order
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing order by external ID. Use when you need to update order details by external ID.

tools.name: Edit Orders Payment
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing order payment. Use when you need to update payment details such as amount, status, or type.

tools.name: Edit Reference Cost Group
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing cost group by code. Use when you need to update cost group properties such as name, color, active status, or display ordering.

tools.name: Edit Reference Cost Item
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing cost item reference by code. Use when you need to update cost item properties such as name, group, type, or activation status in the system's cost item directory.

tools.name: Edit Reference Courier
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing courier by ID. Use when you need to update courier details such as name, email, phone, or active status.

tools.name: Edit Reference Currency
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing currency configuration by ID. Use when you need to update currency properties such as base currency status, auto-conversion settings, or conversion rates.

tools.name: Edit Reference Delivery Service
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing delivery service by code. Use when you need to update delivery service properties such as name, code, or active status.

tools.name: Edit Reference Delivery Type
tools.description: Tool to create or edit a delivery type in Simla.com. Use when you need to add a new delivery type or modify an existing one. This endpoint handles both creation (if the code doesn't exist) and updates (if it does). Provide at least the name and active status.

tools.name: Edit Reference Order Method
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing order method reference by code. Use when you need to update order method properties such as name, active status, or default settings in the system's order method directory.

tools.name: Edit Reference Order Type
tools.description: Tool to create or edit an order type by code. Use when you need to create a new order type or update properties of an existing one such as name, active status, or default settings.

tools.name: Edit Reference Payment Status
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing payment status reference by code. Use when you need to update payment status properties such as name, active status, or default settings in the system's payment status directory.

tools.name: Edit Reference Payment Type
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing payment type or create a new one by code. Use when you need to update payment type properties such as name, code, active status, description, ordering, or default settings.

tools.name: Edit Reference Price Type
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing price type in the reference data. Use when you need to update price type properties such as name, active status, default flag, or associated customer groups.

tools.name: Edit Product Status
tools.description: Tool to create or edit product status in the reference directory. Use when you need to add a new product status or update an existing one. Set code to 'new' when creating a new status, or use the existing status code to edit.

tools.name: Edit Reference Statuses
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing order status reference by code. Use when you need to update order status properties such as name, active status, display ordering, or group classification in the system's status directory.

tools.name: Edit Reference Stores
tools.description: Tool to create or edit a warehouse/store by code. Use when you need to update store information such as name, contact details, address, or active status.

tools.name: Edit Reference Subscription
tools.description: Tool to create or edit a subscription category in Simla. Use when you need to configure subscription categories for different communication channels (email, sms, waba). Creates a new subscription category if the code doesn't exist, or updates an existing one.

tools.name: Edit Reference Unit
tools.description: Tool to create or edit a unit of measurement reference by code. Use when you need to add new units or update existing unit properties such as name or symbol in the system's unit directory.

tools.name: Edit Store Product Group
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing product group by external ID. Use when you need to update product group details such as name, site, or active status.

tools.name: Edit Store Products Batch
tools.description: Tool to batch edit multiple products and services at once. Use when you need to update multiple products in a single operation. This action allows updating multiple product fields (name, price, quantity, active status, etc.) for multiple products in a single API call. Each product must be identified by its internal ID. Returns the count of successfully processed products and any products that were not found.

tools.name: Edit Store Setting
tools.description: Tool to register or update warehouse system configuration in Simla. Use when you need to configure a warehouse integration with name, code, and account URL.

tools.name: Edit Task
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing task. Use after confirming task ID and fields to update. Updates only provided fields on the task.

tools.name: Edit Telephony Setting
tools.description: Tool to create or edit a telephony integration setting in Simla. Use when you need to register or update a telephony integration with its configuration including client ID, name, active status, and optional webhook URLs for call handling.

tools.name: Fix Corporate Customers External IDs

Accepts an array of corporate customer ID mappings and assigns external IDs to the corresponding corporate customers.

tools.name: Fix Customers External IDs
tools.description: Tool to perform mass recording of customer external IDs in Simla. Use when you need to map internal customer IDs to external system identifiers in bulk. Accepts an array of customer ID mappings and assigns external IDs to the corresponding customers.

tools.name: Fix Orders External IDs

tools.name: Get Customer

tools.name: Get Corporate Customer

Returns comprehensive corporate customer data including tags, custom fields, order statistics, and discount information. Use this when you need complete corporate customer details for a known external identifier.

tools.name: Get Customer Interaction Favorites
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of favorite product offers for a specific customer. Use when you need to fetch customer's saved favorites from a particular site.

tools.name: Get Customers

tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of corporate customers matching the specified filters. Use after setting optional filters (managers, manager groups, discount card, IDs) to fetch paginated corporate customer data.

tools.name: Get Corporate Customer Companies

tools.name: Get Corporate Customers History

tools.name: Get Corporate Customers Notes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of corporate customer notes. Use when you need to fetch notes with optional filters (note IDs, corporate customer IDs, manager IDs, text search, date range) and pagination.

tools.name: Get Customers History
tools.description: Tool to retrieve customer change history for synchronization or audit purposes. Use when tracking customer modifications over time or implementing incremental data sync with sinceId.

tools.name: Get Customers Notes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of customer notes. Use when you need to fetch notes with optional filters (note IDs, customer IDs, manager IDs, text search, date range) and pagination.

tools.name: Get Custom Field
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific custom field by entity and code. Use when you need to get properties and settings of a particular custom field.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields
tools.description: Tool to list custom fields. Use when retrieving custom field definitions with optional filtering by entity or code.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields Dictionaries
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of custom dictionaries. Use when you need to get available custom directory definitions with their elements and codes.

tools.name: Get Custom Fields Dictionary
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a custom fields dictionary by its code identifier. Use when you need to get detailed information about a specific dictionary including its name, code, and all elements.

tools.name: Get Delivery Generic Setting
tools.description: Tool to retrieve integration configuration for a delivery module instance. Use when you need to fetch delivery service settings including metadata, supported actions, and status mappings.

tools.name: Get Delivery Shipments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of delivery shipments. Use when you need to fetch shipments with optional date filters and pagination.

tools.name: Get Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of files. Use when you need to fetch files with optional filters like IDs and pagination.

tools.name: Get Loyalty Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of customer loyalty program accounts. Use when you need to fetch loyalty accounts with optional filters (loyalty program IDs, phone number) and pagination.

tools.name: Get Loyalty Bonus Operations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the history of bonus account operations for all participations. Use when you need to fetch loyalty bonus transaction history with optional date range and type filters.

tools.name: Get Loyalty Loyalties
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of loyalty programs. Use when you need to fetch available loyalty programs with optional pagination.

tools.name: Get Order
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific order. Use when you need to fetch full order data by external ID before further processing.

tools.name: Get Orders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of orders. Use when you need to fetch orders with optional filters (order numbers, custom fields) and pagination.

tools.name: Get Orders History

tools.name: Get Reference Countries

tools.name: Get Reference Couriers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of available couriers. Use when you need to fetch courier information or get courier codes for deliveries.

tools.name: Get Reference Currencies
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of all configured currencies in the system. Use when you need to discover available currencies for order creation or financial operations.

tools.name: Get Reference Delivery Services
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all configured delivery services in the system. Use when you need to discover available delivery services for order creation or to get delivery service codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Delivery Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of delivery types from the system. Use when you need to discover available delivery types for order management or to get delivery type codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Legal Entities
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all configured legal entities in the system. Use when you need to get available legal entity codes or legal entity details for business operations.

tools.name: Get MessageGateway Channels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all MessageGateway channels in the system. Use when you need to discover available messaging channels for communication.

tools.name: Get Reference Order Methods
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all available order methods in the system. Use when you need to discover available order methods for order creation or to get order method codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Order Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of order types from the system. Use when you need to discover available order types for order management or to get order type codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Payment Statuses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of payment statuses configured in the system. Use when you need to discover available payment statuses or get payment status codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Payment Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all configured payment types in the system. Use when you need to discover available payment methods for orders or to get payment type codes.

tools.name: Get Reference Price Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of price types from the reference data. Use when you need to discover available price types for order or product pricing.

tools.name: Get Product Statuses

tools.name: Get Reference Units
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of units of measurement from the system. Use when you need to discover available units for product management or to get unit codes.

tools.name: Get Store Offers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of store offers with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch available offers from the store catalog.

tools.description: Tool to retrieve product property values from the store. Use when you need to list property values with optional filters.

tools.name: Get Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of tasks with optional filters. Use when you need to fetch tasks after specifying filter criteria like IDs, status, or date range.

tools.name: Update User Status

tools.name: Upload Store Prices

description: Skyfire enables AI agents to autonomously transact and pay for services, creating a seamless payment infrastructure for AI applications.

tools.name: Charge Skyfire Token
tools.description: Charge a buyer's token (seller-side operation). REQUIRES SELLER API KEY: This action requires your seller agent API key, not the buyer's key. The buyer creates and sends you a pay/kya+pay token JWT, you provide the service, then call this endpoint to collect payment. Flow: Buyer creates token → Buyer calls your service with token → You validate token → You provide service → You call this to charge. Common errors: - 401: Invalid/expired token OR wrong API key (must use seller key) - 402: Charge amount exceeds token value

tools.name: Get Services by Tags
tools.description: Filter services by tags to find exactly what you need. More efficient than browsing all services when you know the category. Chain: GetAllServiceTags → GetServicesByTags → CreatePayToken.

tools.name: Get Skyfire Token Charges
tools.description: Audit charges for a specific token. Shows exactly what sellers charged against your token and when. Use for reconciliation: "I authorized $5 max, what did they actually charge?"

tools.name: Introspect Skyfire Token
tools.description: Check if a token is still valid before calling a seller service. Prevents wasted API calls with expired tokens. Use after creating tokens if there's a delay before calling the seller, or when debugging payment issues.

name: SlidesGPT MCP
description: Generate presentations and slide decks from a prompt and export them to PowerPoint.

tools.name: Apply theme
tools.description:
Apply a visual theme to re-style the entire presentation.

WHEN TO USE:
- User says "apply Tokyo Dark theme", "change theme to Paris", etc.
- User wants to customize the presentation appearance

AVAILABLE THEMES (18 total):
• Urban: copenhagen, tokyo, paris, berlin, new-york, la, zurich, shanghai (each has -light and -dark variants)
• Gradient: cosmic-pulse-light/dark

REQUIRES: presentation_id from previous slide creation. This re-renders all slides with the new theme.

tools.name: Create slides
tools.description:
Create one or more professional presentation slides. Pass a single slide in the array for one slide, or multiple slides for a full deck.

Use when the user asks for slides, a presentation, or a deck. If the request is ambiguous about count, default to 2-3 slides.

ATTACHED PDFs / DOCUMENTS: Claude ingests user-attached files as document content blocks directly in the conversation. Read the document content from the conversation and pass the relevant material (topic, structure, key points) into this tool's slides argument — there is no separate file upload step.

USAGE NOTES:
- Pass all slides for one request in a single call rather than multiple sequential calls.
- To add to an existing presentation, pass the presentation_id from the previous response. For a new presentation, pass an empty string.
- EDITING an existing slide: pass ONLY that slide, with its existing slidenum (from the previous response) and force_edit: true, plus the same presentation_id. This overwrites the slide in place. Do NOT resend the whole deck and do NOT omit force_edit, or a duplicate slide will be appended instead.

IMAGES: Provide image_caption for every slide — describe the ideal slide image in 5-6 words (subject, setting, mood). Leave image_id empty; the system uses your caption to find the best matching photo.

THEMES: If the user asked for a specific theme, pass theme_id here rather than calling apply_theme separately afterwards.

LAYOUT VARIETY (for multi-slide decks):
- Use a variety of layouts across the deck, matching each layout to the slide's content.
- Prefer "title_and_two_columns" (image layout) for the first content slide.
- Use "title_and_body" for at most 1 slide (conclusion only), and avoid repeating the same layout on consecutive slides.
- Use metric_rings only for percentage-based metrics (0-100).
- Mix image slides, charts, timelines, grids, and text slides.

LAYOUT OPTIONS (set layout for every slide):
- "title_and_two_columns": Content with image alongside bullets (IMAGE LAYOUT)
- "title_and_two_to_four_columns_with_icons": 2-4 key points with icons (good default)
- "title_and_body": Single-column bullets (use sparingly — AT MOST 1 per deck, conclusion only)
- "title_and_subtitle": Section divider or transition slide (title + subtitle only, minimal body)
- "image_full_width": Full-width image with optional text below (IMAGE LAYOUT)
- "image_left_text_right": Image on the left with bullet points on the right (IMAGE LAYOUT)
- "quadrant_grid": EXACTLY 4 comparable items — SWOT, 2x2 matrices, pros/cons
- "data_table": Structured comparisons in tabular format (key:value pairs in description)
- "timeline_horizontal": Chronological events, milestones, or history (dates in point, short descriptions)
- "layered_pyramid": Hierarchical structures with 3-6 levels (MUST include icon with fa- prefix per item)
- "phase_roadmap": Project phases with milestones — point MUST use "Period: Title" format (e.g., "Q1 2024: Launch")
- "metric_rings": KPIs, completion rates, market share (1-4 metrics, values 0-100 as percentages)

CONTENT REQUIREMENTS:
- 3-5 substantial bullet points per slide
- Each bullet description: 2-4 lines with specific data, evidence, or actionable insights
- Content should be PhD-level, detailed, and evidence-driven
- Use FontAwesome 5.15 icons (e.g., fa-bolt, fa-chart-line, fa-lightbulb)
- EVERY body item MUST include "value" (0-100) — enables chart rendering and layout switching

LAYOUT-SPECIFIC FORMATTING:
- quadrant_grid: EXACTLY 4 items. "point" under 15 chars, "description" under 80 chars
- timeline_horizontal: Dates/years in "point" (max 15 chars). "description" max 50 chars
- layered_pyramid: "icon" with fa- prefix REQUIRED (fa-star, fa-check, fa-rocket). 3-6 items
- phase_roadmap: "point" = "Period: Title" (e.g., "Q1 2024: Launch"). Max 4 phases. "description" = milestones separated by "; "
- metric_rings: 1-4 items. For part-of-whole metrics (market share), values sum to ~100. For standalone KPIs (NPS, satisfaction), each value stands alone
- data_table: "description" should use structured key:value pairs

SCHEMA: Use only the documented schema fields — do not invent custom properties like "left_content", "right_content", "table", "rows", or "headers". For tables, use the data_table layout with key:value pairs in body[].description.

tools.description: Update a SmartHR recruitment type by ID. Recruitment types used by pending future-dated employee updates cannot be changed. The connected API access token must have the recruitment type resource Update permission.

tools.description: Update the supplied fields of a sensitive SmartHR tax-withholding group by ID. SmartHR does not allow updates after the group is fixed. The connected API access token must have the tax-withholding-group resource Update permission.

tools.name: Update Tax Withholding Slip
tools.description: Update a sensitive SmartHR tax-withholding slip. The full body is required: structured updates require the complete identity, payer, tax-year, and payment body, and sparse field updates are rejected by SmartHR. Confirmed slips cannot be updated, and switching between file-backed and field-backed data requires deleting and recreating the slip. The connected API access token must have the tax-withholding-slip resource Update permission.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The subdomain from your SmartHR production URL. For example, enter "example" when your SmartHR URL is https://example.smarthr.jp. Do not enter the full URL or a sandbox (*.daruma.space) subdomain.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: An API access token issued by a SmartHR administrator under Common Settings > External System Integration > Access Tokens. Ensure the token has the Reference and Update permissions required for the SmartHR resources you intend to use.

name: Smartlead
description: Smartlead is a sales engagement platform for managing cold email campaigns, leads, sending accounts, inbox activity, deliverability, prospecting, and sender provisioning.

tools.name: Add Campaign Leads
tools.description: Import up to 400 leads into a Smartlead campaign with optional duplicate, block-list, unsubscribe-list, and bounce-list controls. Adding leads to an ACTIVE campaign starts outreach to them immediately.

tools.name: Create Draft Campaign
tools.description: Create a new campaign in DRAFTED status. This creates persistent account data but does not send email or start the campaign.

tools.name: Create Smart Delivery Folder
tools.description: Create an organizational folder for Smart Delivery tests. This creates persistent data but does not run or send a test.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Permanently delete a campaign and all associated sequences, mappings, and statistics. This is irreversible and requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Delete Campaign Lead
tools.description: Remove one lead from a selected campaign without deleting the campaign.

tools.name: Delete Smart Delivery Folder
tools.description: Delete an empty Smart Delivery folder. The folder must contain no tests, and deletion requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Get configuration and performance summary for one Smartlead campaign by ID.

tools.name: Get Campaign Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve lifetime campaign performance analytics, or date-bounded analytics when start and end dates are supplied together.

tools.name: Get Campaigns
tools.description: Get configuration and performance summaries for 1-20 Smartlead campaigns. Returns one success or failure result per campaign ID.

tools.name: Get Campaign Sequences
tools.description: Get a campaign's ordered email sequence steps, including message content, delays, and A/B test variants.

tools.name: Get Campaign Statistics
tools.description: Return one offset-paginated page of email-level campaign statistics, optionally filtered by sequence step, engagement status, or sent time.

tools.name: Get Day-Wise Overall Stats
tools.description: Retrieve account-wide daily Smartlead email engagement metrics for an inclusive date range and timezone.

tools.name: Get Smart Delivery Test
tools.description: Get the documented configuration for one Smart Delivery spam test by ID.

tools.name: Get Email Account Warmup Statistics
tools.description: Retrieve recent daily warmup performance statistics for one Smartlead sending account.

tools.name: Get Inbox Conversation
tools.description: Retrieve one Master Inbox conversation by campaign-lead-map ID, including its complete message history when the thread contains messages.

tools.name: Get Lead
tools.description: Retrieve a global Smartlead lead by numeric ID.

tools.name: Get Lead by Email
tools.description: Find an account-wide Smartlead lead by exact email address and return its contact details and campaign memberships.

tools.name: Get Lead Campaign Overview
tools.description: Retrieve a Smartlead lead by ID with every campaign membership, campaign status, and current sequence position.

tools.name: Get Lead Message History
tools.description: Get a campaign lead's email conversation history, optionally filtering by time and including plain text bodies.

tools.name: Get Mailbox Health Metrics
tools.description: Retrieve date-bounded health and performance metrics for individual Smartlead sending mailboxes.

tools.name: Get Overall Analytics
tools.description: Retrieve account-wide Smartlead email performance counts and rates for an inclusive date range.

tools.name: Get Smart Prospect Usage
tools.description: Get Smart Prospect lead-search metrics, fetch counts, daily limits, and available credit balance. This read does not consume credits.

tools.name: List Account Leads
tools.description: Return one filtered, offset- or cursor-paginated page of leads across the connected Smartlead account without requiring a campaign.

tools.name: List Campaign Leads
tools.description: Return one offset-paginated page of leads in a campaign with optional status, category, engagement, and date filters.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns visible to the connected Smartlead account, optionally for one client.

tools.name: List Campaign Webhooks
tools.description: Return webhook registrations configured for a Smartlead campaign.

tools.name: List Smart Delivery Folders
tools.description: List folders used to organize Smart Delivery tests.

tools.name: List Smart Delivery Tests
tools.description: List Smart Delivery spam and inbox-placement tests. This POST endpoint is read-only and does not create or send a test.

tools.name: List Domain Block Entries
tools.description: Return one offset-paginated page of email addresses and domains excluded from Smartlead outreach, optionally filtered by client or search text.

tools.name: List Email Accounts
tools.description: List connected sending accounts with health, warmup, usage, provider, and campaign filters. Credential-like response fields are always removed.

tools.name: List Inbox Replies
tools.description: List lead replies across campaigns from Master Inbox using bounded filters and one page at a time. This reads email content but does not send or modify messages.

tools.name: List Smart Prospect Industries
tools.description: List and search Smart Prospect industry filter values without searching contacts or consuming contact-fetch credits.

tools.name: List Purchased Smart Senders Domains
tools.description: List domains already purchased through Smart Senders. This is read-only and does not purchase domains or provision mailboxes.

tools.name: List Saved Smart Prospect Searches
tools.description: List saved Smart Prospect search definitions without executing them or consuming contact-search credits.

tools.name: List Smart Senders Vendors
tools.description: List Smart Senders marketplace vendors and current domain/mailbox pricing without placing an order.

tools.name: Pause Campaign Lead
tools.description: Pause scheduled outreach for one lead in a campaign.

tools.name: Resume Campaign Lead
tools.description: Resume a paused lead in a campaign, optionally after a delay.

tools.name: Save Campaign Webhook
tools.description: Create a webhook for campaign events, or update an existing webhook when webhook_id is supplied.

tools.name: Search Available Smart Senders Domains
tools.description: Check Smart Senders marketplace domain availability for a vendor. This read-only search does not purchase a domain, place an order, or provision mailboxes.

tools.name: Search Campaign Leads
tools.description: Search one cursor-paginated page of campaign leads by text, status, category, sequence, sender, source, and manual-completion filters.

tools.name: Search Smart Prospect Contacts (Consumes Credits)
tools.description: Search one page of Smart Prospect contacts. The initial call and every explicit continuation may consume credits; inspect usage first, choose the smallest useful limit, and confirm each page.

tools.name: Send Single Email
tools.description: Immediately send one email outside a campaign from a connected Smartlead sender account. This externally visible action cannot be undone.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Campaign Lead
tools.description: Permanently unsubscribe a campaign lead from future email. This cannot be undone through the Smartlead API.

tools.name: Update Campaign Lead
tools.description: Update one campaign lead's contact information and merge custom fields using Smartlead's current campaign-lead endpoint.

tools.name: Update Campaign Sequences
tools.description: Create or update a draft or paused campaign's ordered email sequence steps, including delays and documented A/B test variants.

tools.name: Update Campaign Settings
tools.description: Change settings for future campaign sends; in-progress leads keep their existing settings. Omitted settings remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Campaign Status
tools.description: Start, pause, stop, or archive a campaign. STOPPED is permanent and cannot be undone; START can begin sending emails.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your account-level Smartlead API key. In Smartlead, open your profile Settings, go to API Keys or API Key Management, create or activate an admin API key, and copy it when shown. The key is sent securely as the api_key query parameter.

name: Smartproxy
description: Smartproxy (now Decodo) offers a comprehensive suite of proxy and web scraping solutions, providing users with access to a vast network of residential, datacenter, ISP, and mobile proxies, along with scraping APIs for efficient data collection.

tools.name: Delete Whitelisted IP
tools.description: Tool to delete a specified whitelisted IP by its ID. Use when you need to remove an IP address from the whitelist. Returns success confirmation on completion.

tools.name: Generate Back Connect Endpoints
tools.description: Tool to generate custom back connect endpoints for Residential subscription proxies. Use when you need to create proxy connection strings with specific configuration parameters like session type, location, and authentication credentials.

tools.name: Generate Custom Endpoints
tools.description: Tool to generate custom proxy endpoints for Residential and Datacenter Pay per GB subscriptions. Use when you need to create configured proxy endpoints with specific authentication, session, and location parameters.

tools.name: Get API Key
tools.description: Tool to instruct how to obtain Smartproxy API key. Use when you need to authenticate API requests but don't have your key (manual dashboard process).

tools.name: Get Endpoints By Type
tools.description: Tool to retrieve proxy endpoints by type (random or sticky) for Residential subscription. Returns location, hostname, and port_range for each endpoint. Use when you need specific endpoint configuration for a particular proxy type.

tools.name: List Endpoints and Ports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available proxy endpoints and corresponding ports. Use when you need to fetch the full inventory of Smartproxy endpoints.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key generated from the Smartproxy dashboard, used for authenticating API requests.

name: Smartsheet
description: Smartsheet is a collaborative work management platform for organizing projects, sheets, reports, dashboards, workflows, and teams.

tools.name: Add Alternate Emails
tools.description: Add one or more alternate email addresses for a user. Available only to System Admins on Enterprise plans with the feature activated by Support.

tools.name: Add Attachment Version
tools.description: Upload a new binary or multipart version of an existing sheet or row file attachment. Files are limited to 30 MB; attachment uploads cost 10 rate-limit units.

tools.name: Add Cell Image
tools.description: Upload image bytes to a specific Smartsheet cell using the binary file marker contract.

tools.name: Add Columns
tools.description: Inserts one or more columns into a sheet.

tools.name: Add Favorites
tools.description: Adds one or more items to the user's Smartsheet favorites.

tools.name: Add Group
tools.description: Creates a new organization group. Requires group administrator or system administrator access.

tools.name: Add Group Members
tools.description: Adds one or more members to a group asynchronously. Requires group administrator or system administrator access.

tools.name: Add Report Columns
tools.description: Add columns to a report.

tools.name: Add Report Scope
tools.description: Add source sheets to a report by sheet or parent workspace.

tools.name: Add Rows
tools.description: Insert one row or a batch of up to 500 rows, preserving Smartsheet location specifiers for top, bottom, parent, and sibling placement.

tools.name: Add Summary Field Image
tools.description: Uploads raw image bytes to a sheet summary field.

tools.name: Add Summary Fields
tools.description: Creates one or more summary fields on a sheet.

tools.name: Add User
tools.description: Add a user to the organization account. Requires a qualifying paid plan and System Admin permission.

tools.name: Attach To Comment
tools.description: Attach a file or supported provider URL to a comment. Files are limited to 30 MB; uploads cost 10 rate-limit units and are limited to 30 calls per minute per token.

tools.name: Attach To Proof
tools.description: Attaches a file of up to 30 MB to a proof. Uploads cost 10 rate-limit units and are limited to 30 calls per minute per token.

tools.name: Attach To Row
tools.description: Attach a file or supported provider URL to a row. Files are limited to 30 MB; uploads cost 10 rate-limit units and are limited to 30 calls per minute per token.

tools.name: Attach To Sheet
tools.description: Attach a file or supported provider URL to a sheet. Files are limited to 30 MB; uploads cost 10 rate-limit units and are limited to 30 calls per minute per token.

tools.name: Check Favorite
tools.description: Checks whether a specific Smartsheet item is a favorite.

tools.name: Copy Dashboard
tools.description: Creates a copy of a specified Smartsheet dashboard.

tools.name: Copy Folder
tools.description: Copies a Smartsheet folder. Cell history is not copied.

tools.name: Copy Rows To Another Sheet
tools.description: Copy selected rows to the bottom of another Smartsheet sheet.

tools.name: Copy Sheet
tools.description: Creates a copy of the specified sheet.

tools.name: Copy Workspace
tools.description: Copies a Smartsheet workspace. Cell history is not copied.

tools.name: Create Cross Sheet References
tools.description: Creates a cross-sheet reference and defines its source range.

tools.name: Create Discussion Comment
tools.description: Adds a comment to a discussion using JSON or multipart upload.

tools.name: Create Folder In Folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder inside an existing Smartsheet folder.

tools.name: Create Folder In Home
tools.description: Creates a folder in Home. This Smartsheet endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Create Folder In Workspace
tools.description: Creates a new folder at the top level of a Smartsheet workspace.

tools.name: Create Proof
tools.description: Creates a proof on a row from an application/octet-stream file upload.

tools.name: Create Proof Discussion
tools.description: Creates a discussion on a proof using exactly application/json or multipart/form-data.

tools.name: Create Proof Request
tools.description: Creates and sends a proof request. Sending the request is an irreversible external effect.

tools.name: Create Proof Version
tools.description: Creates a proof version from a binary file upload.

tools.name: Create Report
tools.description: Create a report from a scope, columns, definition, and destination.

tools.name: Create Row Discussion
tools.description: Creates a discussion on a row using JSON or multipart upload.

tools.name: Create Sheet Discussion
tools.description: Creates a discussion on a sheet using JSON or multipart upload.

tools.name: Create Sheet In Folder
tools.description: Creates a sheet from scratch or from the specified template in the specified folder.

tools.name: Create Sheet In Sheets Folder
tools.description: Creates a sheet from scratch or from the specified template in the user's Sheets folder (Home). Deprecated by Smartsheet but retained for API 2.0 parity.

tools.name: Create Sheet In Workspace
tools.description: Creates a sheet from scratch or from the specified template at the top-level of the specified workspace.

tools.name: Create Update Request
tools.description: Creates an update request and sends or schedules its email notification. This has an irreversible external effect.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Creates an inactive webhook owned by the connected API-token user. Requires a personal API access token; activate it later with Update Webhook.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Creates a new Smartsheet workspace.

tools.name: Deactivate User
tools.description: Deactivate a user in the current plan, blocking all Smartsheet use without changing existing item permissions. Requires System Admin permission, is unavailable for Smartsheet Gov, and cannot deactivate externally managed or common-ISP-domain users.

tools.name: Delete Alternate Email
tools.description: Delete an alternate email. Available only to System Admins on Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plans with the feature activated by Support.

tools.name: Delete Asset Share
tools.description: Deletes a share for a Smartsheet asset.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Delete an attachment from a Smartsheet sheet.

tools.name: Delete Attachment Versions
tools.description: Delete every version of an attachment, effectively removing a multi-version attachment from its parent object.

tools.name: Delete Automation Rule
tools.description: Deletes an automation rule from a sheet.

tools.name: Delete Column
tools.description: Deletes a column from a sheet.

tools.name: Delete Comment
tools.description: Deletes the specified comment.

tools.name: Delete Dashboard
tools.description: Deletes a specified Smartsheet dashboard.

tools.name: Delete Discussion
tools.description: Deletes the specified discussion.

tools.name: Delete Favorite
tools.description: Removes one item from the user's Smartsheet favorites.

tools.name: Delete Folder
tools.description: Deletes a Smartsheet folder.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Deletes a group asynchronously. Members may briefly retain sharing access after the call returns.

tools.name: Delete Group Members
tools.description: Removes a member from a group asynchronously. Requires group administrator or system administrator access.

tools.name: Delete Multiple Favorites
tools.description: Removes multiple favorites of one type.

tools.name: Delete Proof
tools.description: Deletes an original proof and all its versions.

tools.name: Delete Proof Requests
tools.description: Deletes all requests in a proof.

tools.name: Delete Proof Version
tools.description: Deletes the current proof version identified by proof ID.

tools.name: Delete Report
tools.description: Delete a report by ID.

tools.name: Delete Report Column
tools.description: Delete a column from a report.

tools.name: Delete Rows
tools.description: Delete one or more rows from a Smartsheet sheet.

tools.name: Delete Sent Update Request
tools.description: Deletes a sent update request only while it is pending; completed requests cannot be deleted.

tools.name: Delete Sheet
tools.description: Deletes the sheet specified in the URL.

tools.name: Delete Summary Fields
tools.description: Deletes one or more summary fields from a sheet.

tools.name: Delete Update Request
tools.description: Terminates future scheduled delivery of an update request.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a webhook owned by the connected API-token user. Requires a personal API access token; disable temporarily with Update Webhook instead.

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Permanently deletes a Smartsheet workspace.

tools.name: Downgrade User
tools.description: Irreversibly downgrade a user's seat in a specified plan. GUEST is valid only for external users. Requires System Admin permission.

tools.name: Edit Comment
tools.description: Updates comment text. Only the user who created a comment may update it.

tools.name: Get Alternate Email
tools.description: Get one alternate email. Available only to System Admins on Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plans with the feature activated by Support.

tools.name: Get Asset Share
tools.description: Retrieves a specific share for a Smartsheet asset.

tools.name: Get Attachment
tools.description: Fetch attachment metadata and, for files, a temporary download URL and its lifetime.

tools.name: Get Automation Rule
tools.description: Returns an automation rule, including its action values.

tools.name: Get Column
tools.description: Gets the definition of a sheet column.

tools.name: Get Comment
tools.description: Gets the comment specified by comment ID.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Get a specified Smartsheet contact by contact ID.

tools.name: Get Cross Sheet Reference
tools.description: Gets a cross-sheet reference by ID.

tools.name: Get Current User
tools.description: Get the connected Smartsheet user's profile. OAuth permits this identity operation without a dedicated scope.

tools.name: Get Dashboard
tools.description: Gets a specified Smartsheet dashboard and its widgets.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Path
tools.description: Gets the hierarchical folder and workspace path of a dashboard.

tools.name: Get Dashboard Publish Status
tools.description: Gets the publish settings for a Smartsheet dashboard.

tools.name: Get Discussion
tools.description: Gets the discussion specified by discussion ID.

tools.name: Get Folder Metadata
tools.description: Gets the metadata of a Smartsheet folder.

tools.name: Get Folder Path
tools.description: Gets the hierarchical path of a folder within its workspace.

tools.name: Get Group
tools.description: Gets a group and its members.

tools.name: Get Image URLs
tools.description: Generate temporary read URLs for specified Smartsheet cell images. The returned URLs expire after the reported lifetime.

tools.name: Get Proof
tools.description: Gets a proof, optionally including attachments or discussions.

tools.name: Get Report
tools.description: Get one report as a paged JSON object or an offloaded Excel or CSV file.

tools.name: Get Report Column
tools.description: Get one report column by its virtual ID.

tools.name: Get Report Definition
tools.description: Get a report's filters, grouping, summarizing, and sorting definition.

tools.name: Get Report Path
tools.description: Get the report's hierarchical folder and workspace path.

tools.name: Get Report Publish Status
tools.description: Get a report's publishing settings.

tools.name: Get Row
tools.description: Get a Smartsheet row by sheet and row ID, with optional related row data.

tools.name: Get Sent Update Request
tools.description: Gets the specified sent update request on the sheet.

tools.name: Get Server Info
tools.description: Get Smartsheet application constants, formats, and supported locales.

tools.name: Get Sheet
tools.description: Gets a sheet in the format specified, based on the sheet Id. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: Get Sheet Path
tools.description: Gets the hierarchical path of the sheet, showing its location within folders and workspace, if workspace-level access is provided.

tools.name: Get Sheet Publish Status
tools.description: Gets the sheet's 'Publish' settings.

tools.name: Get Sheet Summary
tools.description: Returns all summary fields defined on a sheet, including requested format or writer details.

tools.name: Get Sheet Version
tools.description: Gets the sheet version without loading the entire sheet. The following actions increment sheet version: add/modify cell value add/modify discussion/comment add/modify row add/remove/update version attachment cell updated via cell link change formatting.

tools.name: Get Update Request
tools.description: Gets an update request that has a future delivery schedule.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get a Smartsheet user by ID.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Gets a webhook owned by the connected API-token user, including its configured event patterns. Requires a personal API access token.

tools.name: Get Workspace Metadata
tools.description: Gets metadata for a specified Smartsheet workspace.

tools.name: Import Sheet From Csv Xlsx
tools.description: Imports CSV or XLSX data into a new sheet in the top-level "Sheets" folder. Deprecated by Smartsheet but retained for API 2.0 parity.

tools.name: Import Sheet Into Folder
tools.description: Imports CSV or XLSX data into a new sheet in the specified folder.

tools.name: Import Sheet Into Workspace
tools.description: Imports CSV or XLSX data into a new sheet in the specified workspace.

tools.name: List Alternate Emails
tools.description: List a user's alternate email addresses. Available only to System Admins on Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plans with the feature activated by Support.

tools.name: List Asset Shares
tools.description: Retrieves one page of users and groups an asset is shared with and their access levels.

tools.name: List Attachment Versions
tools.description: Get one page of an attachment's versions, ordered from newest to oldest.

tools.name: List Automation Rules
tools.description: Returns one page of automation rules associated with a sheet.

tools.name: List Cell History
tools.description: Return one page of cell modification history. This resource-intensive endpoint consumes 10 rate-limit units, so avoid parallel calls and wait at least 60 seconds after a 429.

tools.name: List Columns
tools.description: Gets one page of columns belonging to a sheet.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Get one page of the connected user's Smartsheet contacts and return a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Cross Sheet References
tools.description: Lists one page of cross-sheet references for a sheet.

tools.name: List Dashboards
tools.description: Gets one page of dashboards the connected user can access.

tools.name: List Discussion Attachments
tools.description: Get one page of attachments in a Smartsheet discussion.

tools.name: List Events
tools.description: Fetch Smartsheet organization events for a System Admin. Requires the Event Reporting premium add-on.

tools.name: List Favorites
tools.description: Gets the user's favorites and returns one page with a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Filtered Events
tools.description: Fetch events related to selected Smartsheet sheets and workspaces for a non-admin user. Requires the Event Reporting premium add-on.

tools.name: List Folder Children
tools.description: Returns one page of immediate resources inside a Smartsheet folder.

tools.name: List Folders In Home
tools.description: Lists folders in the Sheets folder. This Smartsheet endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: List Home Contents
tools.description: Gets all Home objects shared to the user. This Smartsheet endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: List Org Groups
tools.description: Gets one page of all groups in an organization account, with a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Org Sheets
tools.description: Gets a summarized list of all sheets owned by the members of the organization account. Plan or role restrictions apply; see plan_role_constraints.

tools.name: List Proof Attachments
tools.description: Gets one page of non-discussion attachments in a proof.

tools.name: List Proof Discussions
tools.description: Gets one page of discussions in a proof.

tools.name: List Proof Request Actions
tools.description: Gets one page of summarized request actions for a proof.

tools.name: List Proofs
tools.description: Gets one page of proofs for a sheet.

tools.name: List Proof Versions
tools.description: Gets one page of proof versions from newest to oldest.

tools.name: List Report Columns
tools.description: List one page of columns for a report.

tools.name: List Reports
tools.description: List all reports accessible to the connected user.

tools.name: List Report Scope
tools.description: List one page of source sheets and workspaces in a report's scope.

tools.name: List Row Attachments
tools.description: Get one page of row- and row-discussion-level attachments on a Smartsheet row.

tools.name: List Row Discussions
tools.description: Gets one page of discussions associated with a row.

tools.name: List Sent Update Requests
tools.description: Lists summarized sent update requests on the sheet. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Sheet Attachments
tools.description: Get one page of sheet-, row-, and discussion-level attachments on a sheet.

tools.name: List Sheet Discussions
tools.description: Gets one page of discussions associated with a sheet.

tools.name: List Sheets
tools.description: Gets a list of all sheets that the user has access to. The list contains an abbreviated Sheet object for each sheet. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Summary Fields
tools.description: Returns one page of sheet summary fields and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Update Requests
tools.description: Gets one page of update requests with future schedules and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List User Plans
tools.description: List one token-paginated page of plans to which a user belongs.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List organization users with optional email, plan, and seat filters. Organization directory access can require a qualifying plan and System Admin role.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Gets one page of webhooks owned by the connected API-token user. Requires a personal API access token because OAuth access is shared across the third-party app.

tools.name: List Workspace Children
tools.description: Retrieves one page of immediate child resources from a specified Smartsheet workspace.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Retrieves one page of workspace metadata for workspaces the connected user can access.

tools.name: Make Alternate Email Primary
tools.description: Make a confirmed alternate address the user's primary email. The current primary domain must be validated, and the alternate address must be confirmed or its domain validated. Available only to System Admins on Enterprise or Advanced Work Management plans with the feature activated by Support.

tools.name: Move Dashboard
tools.description: Moves a specified Smartsheet dashboard to another container.

tools.name: Move Folder
tools.description: Moves a Smartsheet folder to another container.

tools.name: Move Rows To Another Sheet
tools.description: Move selected rows to the bottom of another Smartsheet sheet.

tools.name: Move Sheet
tools.description: Moves the specified sheet to a new location.

tools.name: Reactivate User
tools.description: Reactivate a user deactivated less than 30 days ago. Requires System Admin permission, is unavailable for Smartsheet Gov, and cannot reactivate external, out-of-plan, or common-ISP-domain users.

tools.name: Remove Report Scope
tools.description: Remove source sheets from a report by sheet or parent workspace.

tools.name: Remove User From Organization
tools.description: Remove a user from the organization, optionally removing shares or transferring assets. Requires System Admin permission and can fail for managed users, main contacts, or invalid transfer recipients.

tools.name: Remove User From Plan
tools.description: Deactivate a user's membership in a plan while preserving ownership and read-only access. This operation is unavailable to legacy plans and requires an eligible System Admin caller.

tools.name: Reset Webhook Shared Secret
tools.description: Irreversibly rotates a webhook secret owned by the connected API-token user after explicit confirmation. Requires a personal API access token.

tools.name: Search Everything
tools.description: Searches all sheets that the user can access, for the specified text.

tools.name: Search Sheet
tools.description: Gets a list of the user's search results in a sheet, based on a query.

tools.name: Send Report By Email
tools.description: Send a report attachment by email. This has an irreversible external effect.

tools.name: Send Rows By Email
tools.description: Send selected Smartsheet rows by email. This operation has an irreversible external effect.

tools.name: Send Sheet By Email
tools.description: Sends the sheet as a PDF attachment via email to the designated recipients. This operation has an irreversible external effect.

tools.name: Set Dashboard Publish Status
tools.description: Publishes or unpublishes a Smartsheet dashboard.

tools.name: Set Report Publish Status
tools.description: Set report publishing status and return the resulting public URL when enabled.

tools.name: Set Sheet Publish Status
tools.description: Sets the publish status of the sheet and returns the new status, including the URLs of any enabled publishings.

tools.name: Share Asset
tools.description: Shares a Smartsheet asset with specified users or groups.

tools.name: Sort Rows In Sheet
tools.description: Sort all rows in a Smartsheet sheet by one or more prioritized column criteria.

tools.name: Update Asset Share
tools.description: Updates the access level of a share for a Smartsheet asset.

tools.name: Update Automation Rule
tools.description: Updates an existing automation rule.

tools.name: Update Column
tools.description: Updates, moves, or renames a sheet column.

tools.name: Update Dashboard
tools.description: Renames a specified Smartsheet dashboard.

tools.name: Update Folder
