name: Smol Machines
description: Create and operate isolated Smol Cloud machines, run bounded commands, transfer files, and inspect account and usage information.

tools.name: Create Machine
tools.description: Create one bounded Smol Cloud machine in the stopped state with explicit resources, a finite auto-stop interval and deletion TTL, and an explicit outbound network policy. Published ports remain authenticated by default. The conservative blocked default denies egress and may prevent uncached image pulls; unrestricted networking and unauthenticated public ingress each require explicit opt-in.

tools.name: Delete Machine
tools.description: Permanently delete one Smol Cloud machine by its exact machine ID. This irreversible operation removes all machine-local storage, ends its storage billing, and requires explicit confirmation. Export important data before calling this tool. Do not automatically retry after an ambiguous failure.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Download and offload one file from an exact cloud machine. Downloads are limited to 10 MB by Composio policy, and the read resets the machine's auto-stop idle timer.

tools.name: Execute Command
tools.description: Run one bounded foreground argv command on an exact hosted Smol Cloud machine. Execution can auto-start billable compute and can modify or delete guest data. Output is text-only, streaming and background execution are disabled, and the action never retries automatically.

tools.name: Get Account
tools.description: Get the connected account's status, plan, effective machine limits, billing-period usage, and spend in integer micros.

tools.name: Get Account Usage
tools.description: Get metered usage for the connected account's provider-defined period, keeping the requested and consumed metric windows distinct.

tools.name: Get Machine
tools.description: Get configuration, lifecycle state, and readiness for one cloud machine by its exact machine id, not by name.

tools.name: Get Machine Usage
tools.description: Get billing-period usage and cost in integer micros for one exact machine ID. CPU and memory metering can lag by several minutes while a machine is running, so mid-life usage and cost are a lower bound until metering rolls up; stop and delete trigger a final sample. Deleted machine usage remains available for the provider-documented 30-day lookup period.

tools.name: List Machines
tools.description: List cloud machines owned by the connected account, optionally requiring all supplied labels to match.

tools.name: Start Machine
tools.description: Start one stopped cloud machine by exact machine ID. A detached start returns before readiness and requires polling GET_MACHINE until ready=true.

tools.name: Stop Machine
tools.description: Stop compute for one cloud machine by exact id while preserving its filesystem. Stopping does not delete the machine: stored disk can continue billing and the machine can continue occupying a plan slot until deletion.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Upload a file of at most 8,000,000 bytes to a safe relative guest path on one cloud machine identified by its exact machine ID. This can replace existing guest data and resets the machine's auto-stop idle timer.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create a user-owned Smol Cloud API key at https://smolmachines.com/console/keys. The key begins with smk_. Grant only the scopes needed by your actions: machine:create, machine:read, machine:exec, machine:files, machine:delete, and/or usage:read. Keep the key secret.

name: SMS Alert
description: SMS Alert is a versatile multi-channel communication platform enabling businesses to engage with customers through SMS, RCS, Telegram, and WhatsApp via a unified REST API.

tools.name: Change User Password

tools.name: Get SMS Alert Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current SMS credit balance. Use when you need an up-to-date credit status before sending messages. If balance is low, gate high-volume sends before proceeding — insufficient credits cause messages to be silently dropped or rejected mid-campaign.

tools.name: Get SMS Delivery Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve delivery report for sent SMS messages by batch ID. Returns message delivery status including mobile numbers, delivery status, and timestamps. Use after sending SMS campaigns to track delivery success.

tools.name: Get Group Detail

tools.name: Get Group List

tools.name: Get Sender ID List

tools.name: Get SMS Template List

tools.name: Get User Profile

tools.name: Create New Group

tools.name: Create Short URL

tools.name: Edit Group
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing groups name. Use when you need to rename a group after confirming the group id.

tools.name: Update User Profile

tools.name: Edit SMS Template
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing SMS template. Use when you need to update a template after confirming the template id.

tools.name: Generate OTP
tools.description: Tool to generate a one-time password (OTP). Use when you need to send an OTP to a mobile number using a predefined template.

tools.name: Get Sent SMS Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SMS campaign sent report details. Use after campaigns are sent to analyze delivery results. Delivery status data may lag real time; treat results as non-final for time-sensitive workflows.

tools.name: Send SMS via XML
tools.description: Tool to send SMS messages using XML format for bulk sending. Use when you need to send multiple messages to different recipients with different content in a single API call.

name: Smtp2go
description: SMTP2GO is a reliable email delivery service that ensures your emails reach recipients' inboxes efficiently.

tools.name: Search Email Activity
tools.description: Tool to search activity events like sends, opens, clicks, and bounces. Use when you need to filter account email activity by date, event, recipient, or message ID.

tools.name: Add Allowed Sender
tools.description: Tool to add a new allowed sender email address. Use when you need to whitelist a sender before sending email. Example: Add "user@example.com" to allowed senders list.

tools.name: Remove Allowed Sender
tools.description: Tool to remove a sender email address from the allowed senders list. Use when you need to revoke send permissions for a validated address.

tools.name: Update Allowed Senders
tools.description: Tool to update (replace) the entire allowed senders list in your SMTP2GO account. This action overwrites the current list with the provided email addresses and domain names. Use when you need to set or update who can send emails through your account. Example: 'Update allowed senders to include user@example.com and admin@company.com in whitelist mode.'

tools.name: View Allowed Senders
tools.description: Tool to view the list of allowed senders configured in your account. Use after setting up SMTP2GO authentication to retrieve your allowed-senders list. Example: 'Show me all verified allowed senders.'

tools.name: Add Sender Domain
tools.description: Tool to add a new sender domain for SPF/DKIM verification. Use when you need to register a domain and optionally set tracking/return-path subdomains.

tools.name: Search SMTP2GO Emails
tools.description: Tool to search sent emails. Use when filtering your SMTP2GO account's email activity by criteria like date, sender, or recipient. Call after authentication.

tools.name: Add IP Allow List
tools.description: Tool to add a public IP address to your account's IP allow list. Use when you need to whitelist specific sending sources by IP after confirming accuracy. Note: Only plain IP addresses are supported (no CIDR notation). Private/reserved IP ranges are rejected.

tools.name: Remove IP from Allow List
tools.description: Tool to remove an IP address from your account's IP allow list. Use after identifying the IP you wish to revoke.

tools.name: View IP Allow List
tools.description: Tool to view the list of IP addresses in your IP allow list. Use after confirming your SMTP2GO API key is set.

tools.name: View Received SMS
tools.description: Tool to retrieve received SMS replies for your SMTP2GO account. Use when you need to fetch incoming SMS messages for analysis or display. Pagination supported via limit and offset.

tools.name: Get Email Bounces Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve email bounces statistics. Use after sending emails to analyze bounce metrics over a time period.

tools.name: Email Cycle Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current email cycle/quota statistics. Use when you need to check the account's monthly email allowance, usage, and remaining quota for the current billing cycle.

tools.name: Email History Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve email history statistics. Use when you need detailed delivery metrics within a date range.

tools.name: Email Spam Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve email spam report statistics. Use when analyzing spam trends for sent emails.

tools.name: Email Unsubscription Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve email unsubscribe statistics. Use when you need unsubscribe data for your account over a date range.

tools.name: Search Subaccounts
tools.description: Tool to search subaccounts. Use after authenticating to filter and paginate your subaccounts by name, email, or status.

tools.name: Subaccounts Usage
tools.description: Tool to retrieve usage statistics for subaccounts. Use when you need to monitor per-subaccount email usage.

tools.name: Add to Suppression List
tools.description: Tool to add email addresses or domains to the suppression list. Use when you need to block sending emails to specific recipients or entire domains after unsubscribes or bounces.

tools.name: Remove suppression entry
tools.description: Tool to remove an email address or domain from the suppression list. Use when you want to resume sending to the address or domain.

tools.name: View Suppression List
tools.description: Tool to view the suppression list. Use when you need to inspect suppressed email addresses in your account.

tools.name: Edit Email Template
tools.description: Tool to edit details of an existing email template. Use when you need to update template properties after confirming its ID.

tools.name: Search Email Templates
tools.description: Tool to search your collection of email templates by ID or name. Use when you need to find templates matching specific criteria after authentication.

tools.name: View Email Template
tools.description: Tool to view details of a specific email template. Use after you have the template ID to inspect.

tools.name: Add SMTP User
tools.description: Tool to add a new SMTP user. Use when you need to provision a fresh SMTP credential after collecting username and password.

tools.name: Edit SMTP User
tools.description: Tool to edit details of an existing SMTP user. Use when you need to update username, password, sender restrictions, or enable/disable a user after confirming the target username.

tools.name: Remove SMTP User
tools.description: Tool to remove an SMTP user from your account. Use when you need to revoke SMTP access for a user.

tools.name: View SMTP Users
tools.description: Tool to list all SMTP users configured on your account. Use when you need to retrieve SMTP user configurations.

tools.name: Add Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook. Use when you need real-time notifications of email or SMS events.

tools.name: Edit Webhook
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing webhook’s settings. Use when you need to update a webhook's configuration after creation.

tools.name: Remove webhook
tools.description: Tool to remove a webhook. Use when you want to delete a webhook by its ID from your SMTP2GO account.

tools.name: View Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to view all webhooks configured in your account. Use when you need to inspect existing webhook configurations after setup.

name: Snapchat
description: Snapchat Marketing API and Ads Manager integration for creating and managing ad campaigns, analyzing performance metrics, and accessing business accounts.

tools.name: Add Users to Segment
tools.description: Tool to add users to a Snapchat audience segment. Use when you need to populate a segment with user identifiers (email, phone, or mobile ad IDs). All identifiers must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before submission. Maximum 100,000 identifiers per request.

tools.name: Copy Media Between Ad Accounts
tools.description: Copies media from one Snapchat ad account to another. Use this when you need to duplicate media assets (images, videos) across different ad accounts for campaign management or sharing creative assets.

tools.name: Create Account Role
tools.description: Tool to create new roles for members in a Snapchat Ad Account. Use when you need to grant access permissions to members. Note: Member must already have an Organization-level 'member' role before assigning Ad Account roles.

tools.name: Create Ad Account
tools.description: Tool to create a new ad account within a Snapchat organization. Use when setting up a new advertising account for campaign management. Requires organization_id, billing center, and advertiser details. Can create test accounts for development purposes.

tools.name: Estimate Ad Account Audience Size
tools.description: Tool to estimate audience size for Snapchat ad campaigns. Use when you need to determine potential reach for specific targeting criteria before creating ad campaigns.

tools.name: Create ad account creative elements
tools.description: Tool to create new creative elements in a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to create dynamic ad elements like buttons for product catalogs or dynamic collections. Once created, creative elements cannot be updated and are immutable.

tools.name: Create Ad Account Dynamic Templates
tools.description: Tool to create new dynamic templates for product ads in a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to set up templates that define how product information from a catalog will be displayed in dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Create Ad Account Event Details
tools.description: Tool to create event details for a Snapchat ad account. Use when scheduling advertising events or campaigns. Event details are immutable after creation and cannot be edited. Ensure the event is not referenced by active Reminder Creatives before deletion.

tools.name: Create Ad Account Interaction Zones
tools.description: Create new interaction zones for an ad account in Snapchat Marketing API. Interaction zones are used for dynamic collections ads and contain 2-4 creative elements with matching interaction types.

tools.name: Create Offer Disclaimers
tools.description: Tool to create new offer disclaimers for a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to add legal disclaimers to offers in ads. STATIC disclaimers display custom text directly, while DYNAMIC disclaimers pull content from product catalogs.

tools.name: Create ad account reserved forecasting
tools.description: Tool to create a reserved forecasting for Snapchat ad accounts. Use when you need to forecast reach and frequency for planned campaigns with specific targeting and frequency caps. Requires minimum reach of 500,000 unique users and booking window between 12 hours and 365 days.

tools.name: Create Adaccounts Targeting Insights
tools.description: Tool to generate targeting insights for a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to analyze and compare audience demographics, size, and characteristics between a base targeting spec and a target targeting spec. Returns detailed breakdowns including age groups, gender, languages, geographic distribution, and audience size estimates.

tools.name: Create Ads
tools.description: Create static or dynamic ads in a Snapchat ad squad.

tools.name: Create Ad Squad
tools.description: Tool to create a new ad squad within a campaign. Use when setting up ad delivery targeting, budgets, and placements for a Snapchat campaign.

tools.name: Create Billing Center
tools.description: Tool to create one or more billing centers for a Snapchat Ads organization. Use when you need to set up new billing entities for managing ad spend and invoicing. Requires organization ID, billing center name, email address, and complete billing address information.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Tool to create a new advertising campaign in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to set up a new campaign with specified budget, timing, and objectives.

tools.name: Create Catalog Role
tools.description: Tool to create new roles for a catalog in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to assign catalog permissions to members. Members must already have the 'member' organizational role before receiving catalog roles.

tools.name: Create Catalog Facets
tools.description: Tool to create catalog facets for grouping products by attributes like BRAND, COLOR, or AVAILABILITY. Use when you need to analyze product distribution across different attributes in a catalog. Returns grouped counts for specified product properties with optional filtering support.

tools.name: Search Catalog Flights
tools.description: Tool to search for flights within a Snapchat catalog using optional filters. Use when you need to retrieve and filter flight listings from a dynamic product ads catalog.

tools.name: Create Catalogs Product Feed
tools.description: Tool to create a new product feed under a specified catalog. Use when setting up product data synchronization for dynamic product ads. Note: Currently only one product feed can exist per catalog.

tools.name: Create Catalog Product Set
tools.description: Tool to create a new product set within a Snapchat catalog. Use when you need to define product groups using filters for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Create Creatives
tools.description: Create static, dynamic catalog, or Showcase ad creatives in an ad account.

tools.name: Create Media
tools.description: Tool to create a new media file in a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to register media assets (images, videos, lenses, or playable ads) before uploading content or associating with ad creatives.

tools.name: Create Organizations Catalogs
tools.description: Tool to create new product catalogs within a Snapchat organization for Dynamic Product Ads. Use when you need to set up catalogs for automated ad generation based on product data feeds. Requires Organization Admin permission. Maximum 200 catalogs per organization, 10 per batch.

tools.name: Create Organization Role
tools.description: Tool to create a new role for an organization in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to assign roles to organization members after they have been invited. Each member must be assigned one organization-level role type.

tools.name: Create Audience Segment
tools.description: Tool to create new audience segments (customer lists or lookalikes) in Snapchat Ads. Use when you need to create targeted audience segments for ad campaigns. Initial status returns as PENDING and transitions occur after processing. Note: An ad account can only have a maximum of 1000 customer list segments.

tools.name: Delete Offer Disclaimer
tools.description: Tool to delete an offer disclaimer from a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to remove an offer disclaimer that is no longer needed or was created in error.

tools.name: Delete Ad Squad
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete an ad squad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to remove an ad squad that is no longer needed. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete All Segment Users
tools.description: Tool to remove all users from a Snapchat audience segment. Use when you need to clear all users from a Customer List segment. Returns the updated segment with approximate_number_users set to 0.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Tool to delete a campaign from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to permanently remove a campaign from your Snapchat Ads account.

tools.name: Delete Catalog
tools.description: Tool to delete a catalog by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to permanently remove a catalog. This is a destructive operation that cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Event Details
tools.description: Tool to delete event details from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to remove an Event Details entity. Use with caution as there is no way to reinstate a deleted entity.

tools.name: Delete Member
tools.description: Tool to remove a member from an organization in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to revoke access for a member.

tools.name: Delete product feed
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a product feed from Snapchat Ads. Use when you need to remove a product catalog feed. Requires Organization Admin permission. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Role
tools.description: Tool to delete a role from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to remove a role from an Organisation, Catalog or Ad Account. If deleting all of a Member's roles, consider also deleting the Member entity from the Organization.

tools.name: Delete Audience Segment
tools.description: Tool to delete an audience segment from Snapchat. Use when you need to permanently remove an audience segment. WARNING: This operation is irreversible - deleted segments cannot be retrieved.

tools.name: Delete Users from Segment
tools.description: Tool to remove specific users from a Snapchat audience segment. Use when you need to delete certain user identifiers (email, phone, or mobile ad IDs) from a Customer List segment. All identifiers must be normalized and SHA-256 hashed before submission. Maximum 100,000 identifiers per request.

tools.name: Get Ad
tools.description: Retrieve the current details of one Snapchat ad by its ID.

tools.name: Get Ad Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific ad account by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing ad account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Ad Squads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ad squads in an ad account by ID. Use when you need to list or fetch ad squads for a specific Snapchat ad account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Ad Squad UI Render Data
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ad squad UI render data for a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to fetch UI render data objects that determine available optimization goals together with campaign objectives. The conversion_location field indicates where conversions occur (APP, CALL, LEAD_FORM, PUBLIC_PROFILE, TEXT, or WEB).

tools.name: Get Ad Account Dynamic Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve dynamic templates for a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to list or fetch dynamic templates used for dynamic product ads in a specific ad account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Event Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Event Details entities for a specific ad account. Use when you need to list event details associated with an ad account for reminder creative campaigns.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Interaction Zones
tools.description: Tool to retrieve interaction zones for an ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all interaction zones configured for a specific ad account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Lead Generation Forms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all lead generation forms for a specific ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list or fetch all lead gen forms associated with an advertising account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Leads Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ad account leads report by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch lead generation data for a specific ad account and report run.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Mobile Apps
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all mobile apps associated with a Snapchat ad account by ID. Use when you need to list or fetch mobile apps for a specific ad account.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Offer Disclaimers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all offer disclaimers for a specific ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list or fetch legal disclaimers associated with an advertising account's offers.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Spend Guidance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve spend guidance for an ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need bid and budget recommendations for specific signal types and optimization goals.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ad account statistics from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need performance metrics like impressions, swipes, spend, or video views for an ad account over a specified time period.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Stats Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ad account stats report by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to check the status of an async stats report or download a completed report.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific ad squad by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing ad squad including targeting, budget, and placement settings.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad Restrictions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve ad type restrictions for a specific ad squad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to see which ad types are currently present in an ad squad and their counts.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad Audience Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve estimated audience size for a specific ad squad by ID. Use when you need to check the potential reach of an existing ad squad's targeting configuration.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad Stats Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve adsquads stats report by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when checking the status of an async report or getting the download URL for a completed stats report.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve performance statistics for a specific ad squad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to analyze ad squad performance metrics such as impressions, swipes, conversions, and spend.

tools.name: Get Ad Squad Targeting
tools.description: Tool to retrieve targeting specifications for a specific ad squad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed targeting criteria for an existing ad squad.

tools.name: Get Ad Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve performance statistics for a specific ad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to analyze ad performance metrics such as impressions, swipes, conversions, and spend.

tools.name: Get Authenticated User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the authenticated user from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the current user's ID, email, display name, organization membership, or Snapchat username.

tools.name: Get Billing Center
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific billing center by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing billing center.

tools.name: Get Campaign
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific campaign by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing campaign.

tools.name: Get Campaign Changelog
tools.description: Tool to retrieve changelog (audit log) for a campaign from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to track changes made to a campaign, including who made the changes and what was modified. Note: changelogs are only available from July 16, 2019 onwards.

tools.name: Get Campaigns by IDs
tools.description: Tool to fetch multiple campaigns by their IDs from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about specific campaigns in bulk.

tools.name: Get Campaign Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve performance statistics for a specific campaign from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to analyze campaign performance metrics such as impressions, swipes, conversions, and spend.

tools.name: Get Catalog
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific catalog by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing catalog including its vertical, event sources, and product set details.

tools.name: Get Catalog Product Sets
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all product sets from a Snapchat catalog. Use when you need to list or view product sets within a specific catalog for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Get Creative
tools.description: Retrieve the current definition and review state of one Snapchat creative.

tools.name: Get Dynamic Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific dynamic template by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing dynamic template used for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Get Dynamic Templates External Changelogs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve external changelogs for a dynamic template from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to track modification history and audit changes made to a dynamic template. Note: changelogs are only available from July 16, 2019 onwards.

tools.name: Get Event Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve event details by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific event.

tools.name: Get Funding Source
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific funding source by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about payment methods like credit cards, PayPal accounts, or lines of credit.

tools.name: Get Interaction Zone
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific interaction zone by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing interaction zone including its creative elements and render type.

tools.name: Get Invoice
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific invoice by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed billing information including amounts, due dates, and optionally PDF content for a specific invoice.

tools.name: Get Media
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific media file by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing media asset.

tools.name: Get Media by IDs
tools.description: Tool to fetch multiple media items by their IDs from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about specific media assets in bulk.

tools.name: Get Media Stats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve performance statistics for a specific media from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to analyze media performance metrics such as impressions, swipes, spend, and video views. Supports VIDEO and IMAGE media types only; reach metrics are not available.

tools.name: Get Member
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific member by ID from a Snapchat organization. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing member.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific organization by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing organization.

tools.name: Get Organizations Catalogs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all catalogs for a specific organization from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all catalogs within an organization for Dynamic Product Ads. Supports pagination for large result sets.

tools.name: Get Organizations Mobile Apps
tools.description: Tool to retrieve mobile apps associated with a Snapchat organization by organization ID. Use when you need to list iOS and Android apps registered for tracking and campaigns.

tools.name: Get Organizations Public Profiles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organization public profiles by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch public profile information for a specific organization.

tools.name: Get Ad Account Pixels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Snap Pixels associated with an ad account. Use when you need to list conversion tracking pixels for a specific Snapchat ad account.

tools.name: Get Product Feed
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a product feed by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get details about a specific product feed including its configuration, schedule, and metadata for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Get Product Feed Uploads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve product feed upload history for a specific product feed. Use when you need to check the status, metrics, or processing details of product catalog uploads for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Get Product Set
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific product set by ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch details about a particular product set for dynamic product ads.

tools.name: Get Audience Segment
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific audience segment by its ID from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about an existing segment including its status, size, and targeting availability.

tools.name: Get Targeting Carriers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available mobile carrier targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of carriers that can be used for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Connection Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available connection types for device targeting from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the list of connection type options (WIFI, CELL) that can be used for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Advanced Demographics Targeting Options
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available advanced demographics targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the list of demographic segments available for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Demographics Age Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available age group targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the predefined age brackets (13-17, 18-20, 21-24, 25-34, 35+) for demographic targeting in ad campaigns.

tools.name: Get Gender Targeting Options
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available gender targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the list of gender categories available for ad targeting (MALE, FEMALE, OTHER).

tools.name: Get Targeting Demographics Languages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available language targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch language codes and names for demographic targeting in ad campaigns.

tools.name: Get Targeting Device iOS OS Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available iOS OS version targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of iOS versions that can be used for targeting with os_version_min and os_version_max parameters.

tools.name: Get Targeting Device Marketing Names
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available device marketing names for targeting from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of device makes and models that can be used for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Geo Postal Codes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve postal code targeting options by country code from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of postal codes available for ad targeting in a specific country.

tools.name: Get Targeting Geo Region
tools.description: Tool to retrieve region targeting options for a specific country from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of regions (states, provinces, etc.) that can be used for ad targeting within a particular country.

tools.name: Get Targeting Geo US Postal Codes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all US postal code targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of US ZIP codes available for ad targeting with geographic hierarchy data.

tools.name: Get Targeting Geo US Region
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available US region targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the list of US states/regions available for geographic ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Interests DLXC
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Oracle Datalogix DLXC interest targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch available DLXC interest categories for ad targeting. Note: This endpoint is deprecated as of September 27, 2024.

tools.name: Get Targeting Interests DLXP
tools.description: Tool to retrieve Oracle Datalogix DLXP interest targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch business dealer and service targeting options for ad campaigns. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Get Targeting Interests DLXS
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available Oracle Datalogix (DLXS) interest targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of DLXS interests that can be used for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Interests NLN
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available Nielsen interest targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get Nielsen-based interest categories for audience targeting in ad campaigns.

tools.name: Get Targeting Interests PLC
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available PLC (Placed Visitation Segments) targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get location-based interest segments for audience targeting in ad campaigns.

tools.name: Get Location Category LOI Options
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all location category (LOI - Locations of Interest) targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch the list of venue types and business categories available for location-based ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting Metros
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metro/DMA targeting options by country code from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of metro areas available for ad targeting in a specific country.

tools.name: Get Targeting OS Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available OS type targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of operating system types (e.g., iOS, Android) that can be used for ad targeting.

tools.name: Get Targeting OS Versions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available OS versions for targeting from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of iOS or Android versions that can be used for targeting with os_version_min and os_version_max parameters.

tools.name: Get Targeting V1 Interests SCLS
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Snap Lifestyle Categories V1 targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch interest-based targeting categories for ad campaigns.

tools.name: Get Targeting V1 Interests Shp
tools.description: Tool to retrieve first-party shopper segment targeting options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get shopper segments for ad targeting based on consumer purchase behavior.

tools.name: Get Targeting VAC Interests
tools.description: Tool to retrieve First-Party Visitation Segments (VAC interests) for targeting from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch venue categories based on locations users have visited (e.g., restaurants, retail stores).

tools.name: Get Targeting V1 Options
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all available targeting v1 options from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to get the list of targeting dimensions available for ad targeting in a specific country.

tools.name: List Account Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all roles for a Snapchat Ad Account. Use when you need to view all member access permissions assigned within an account.

tools.name: List Ad Accounts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ad accounts associated with an organization from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list or fetch all ad accounts for a specific organization.

tools.name: List Ads by Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ads for a specific ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all ads associated with an ad account.

tools.name: List Ads by Ad Squad
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ads for a specific ad squad from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all ads associated with an ad squad.

tools.name: List Ads by Campaign
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ads for a specific campaign from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list or fetch all ads associated with a particular campaign.

tools.name: List Ad Squads by Campaign
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all ad squads for a specific campaign. Use when you need to list or fetch ad squads belonging to a particular Snapchat campaign.

tools.name: List Billing Centers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all billing centers for a Snapchat Ads organization. Use when you need to fetch a complete list of billing centers associated with an organization.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all campaigns for a specific ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all campaigns within an ad account.

tools.name: List Catalog Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all roles for a Snapchat catalog. Use when you need to view all member access permissions assigned within a catalog.

tools.name: List Creatives
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all creatives for a specific ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all creative assets within an ad account.

tools.name: List Funding Sources
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all funding sources for a specific organization from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all payment methods (credit cards, PayPal, lines of credit, coupons) available for an organization.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all invoices for an ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch billing information for all invoices associated with a specific ad account.

tools.name: List Media
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all media files for a specific Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to list all media assets (images, videos, lenses, or playable ads) available in an ad account.

tools.name: List Member Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all roles assigned to a member in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to see all permissions a member has across organizations, ad accounts, and catalogs.

tools.name: List Organization Members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all members of a Snapchat organization. Use when you need to view all users who have access to an organization, including their status (INVITED or MEMBER).

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all organizations that the authenticated user has access to from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list all organizations for the current user.

tools.name: List Organization Pixels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all Snap Pixels for a specific organization from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to list tracking pixels across all ad accounts within an organization.

tools.name: List Organization Roles
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all roles for a Snapchat organization. Use when you need to view all member access permissions assigned within an organization.

tools.name: List Phone Numbers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all verified phone numbers associated with a Snapchat ad account. Use when you need to list or fetch phone numbers for calling and texting features.

tools.name: List Audience Segments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all audience segments for an ad account from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch a complete list of segments including customer lists, lookalikes, and engagement audiences.

tools.name: List Sponsored Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve organic sponsored content from Snapchat Ads Library. Use when you need to list all available sponsored content from the library with pagination support.

tools.name: List Transactions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all transactions for an organization from Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to fetch transaction history including payments, refunds, and other billing activities. Supports filtering by time range and ad account.

tools.name: Search Ads Library Sponsored Content
tools.description: Tool to search for sponsored content by creator name in Snapchat Ads Library. Use when you need to find ads associated with a specific creator.

tools.name: Search Catalog Products
tools.description: Tool to search a catalog for products given a provided filter. Use when you need to find specific products in a catalog based on attributes like brand, availability, price, or other properties.

tools.name: Search Catalogs Hotels
tools.description: Tool to search for hotels in a Snapchat catalog using filters and pagination. Use when you need to find specific hotels in a catalog by name, price, rating, location, or other attributes.

tools.name: Update Ad Account
tools.description: Tool to update an existing ad account within a Snapchat organization. Use when modifying ad account settings such as name, status, billing, or spend caps. Requires the ad account ID and organization ID. All account fields must be provided in the update request.

tools.name: Update Ads
tools.description: Replace complete Snapchat ad objects. This PUT operation is not a partial update. Omitting attributes that have default values resets them to those defaults, including tracking configuration. Retrieve current ad values first and include every value that must be preserved.

tools.name: Update Ad Squad
tools.description: Tool to update an existing ad squad within a campaign. Use when modifying ad delivery targeting, budgets, placements, or other settings for an existing Snapchat ad squad.

tools.name: Update Billing Center
tools.description: Tool to update one or more existing billing centers for a Snapchat Ads organization. Use when you need to modify billing center details such as name, email address, or billing address information. Requires the billing center ID along with organization ID and updated billing information.

tools.name: Update Campaign
tools.description: Tool to update an existing advertising campaign in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when you need to modify campaign properties like name, status, budget, timing, or objectives.

tools.name: Update Audience Segment
tools.description: Tool to update existing audience segments in Snapchat Ads. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or retention period of audience segments. Only these three fields can be updated; other segment properties are read-only.

tools.name: Upload Media Multipart
tools.description: Tool to upload large media files using multipart upload in Snapchat Marketing API. Use when uploading media files larger than 32MB or when you need to upload in chunks for reliability. Start with INIT action to get upload session details.

tools.name: Validate Conversion Event
tools.description: Tool to validate conversion events before sending them to Snapchat Conversion API. Use when testing pixel implementation or verifying event data format. Checks event structure, required fields, and data types without actually recording the events.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: SNCF
description: Access SNCF passenger-information data for train journeys, stations, schedules, service status, and transport-network discovery.

tools.name: Find Nearby Places
tools.description: Find SNCF stations, stops, or points of interest near a geographic coordinate.

tools.name: Get Service Status
tools.description: Get SNCF network service disruptions and affected lines, stations, or vehicle journeys for a time window. Returns one page; pass next_cursor back to continue.

tools.name: Get Station Board
tools.description: Get upcoming departures or arrivals for an SNCF station, including scheduled and realtime times and disruption context.

tools.name: Get Transport Object
tools.description: Get details for one SNCF network, line, route, station, stop, mode, company, or vehicle journey by canonical ID.

tools.name: Get SNCF Coverage
tools.description: Get the SNCF transport-data coverage region and its current production horizon.

tools.name: List Transport Objects
tools.description: Browse one supported SNCF transport-object collection, such as lines, networks, routes, stations, or vehicle journeys.

tools.name: Plan Journey
tools.description: Plan SNCF train journeys between two station/place IDs or coordinates for a requested departure or arrival time.

tools.name: Search Places
tools.description: Find SNCF stations, addresses, administrative areas, or points of interest by name and return IDs usable for journeys and station boards.

tools.name: Search Transport Objects
tools.description: Search SNCF networks, modes, lines, routes, stations, or stop points by name and return canonical transport-object IDs.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your SNCF API developer token. Request it at https://numerique.sncf.com/startup/api/token-developpeur/, then enter the issued authentication key here. SNCF uses this key as the HTTP Basic username with an empty password; keep it secret.

name: Snowflake Basic
description: Snowflake is a cloud-based data warehouse offering elastic scaling, secure data sharing, and SQL analytics across multiple cloud environments

tools.name: Describe table
tools.description: Retrieves detailed information for each column (including name, data type, kind, nullability, default value, and key status) in a specified Snowflake table.

tools.name: Explore Columns
tools.description: Retrieves a sample of distinct values for specified columns from a Snowflake table.

tools.name: Run Query
tools.description: Executes the given SQL query in Snowflake within the specified database and schema (which must exist and be accessible), automatically setting context first.

tools.name: Show databases
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all databases available in the Snowflake account.

tools.name: Show schemas
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all schemas within a specified Snowflake database.

tools.name: Show Tables
tools.description: Retrieves a list of tables, including their row counts and sizes in bytes, from a specified schema within a Snowflake database.

required.name: username
required.description: Username for basic auth

required.name: password
required.description: Password for basic auth

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Snowflake account ID for authentication. Use the format 'myorganization-myaccount'. To find your account ID, click on your account in the bottom left corner of the Snowflake web interface. The account identifier will be displayed in the account details popup.

name: Snyk
description: Snyk helps development teams find, prioritize, and remediate security issues across code, dependencies, containers, and cloud infrastructure.

tools.name: Add Projects To Collection
tools.description: Add up to 100 projects to a Snyk collection. Warning: This may require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Projects
tools.description: Permanently delete up to 100 Snyk projects. This is destructive and cannot be undone; confirm the organization and every project ID before calling. A 200 response may include per-project failures, so inspect both meta.deleted and meta.failed.

tools.name: Bulk Update Inventory Assets
tools.description: Transactionally update attributes for up to 100 inventory assets in a Snyk organization. This Early Access endpoint is beta and its contract may change; the connected account must have access to Snyk Inventory.

tools.name: Bulk Update Projects
tools.description: Update 1-20 distinct Snyk projects using individual typed patches or one shared patch. Sends one request per project, does not roll back successful updates, and returns an explicit outcome for every project when at least one succeeds. If every update fails, the action returns a top-level error to prevent a no-op from being reported as successful.

tools.name: Create Collection
tools.description: Create a collection in a Snyk organization. This operation may require collection product access or a qualifying account role; the build account returned 403 with the documented collection scopes granted.

tools.name: Create Export
tools.description: Start an asynchronous organization export and return the export ID and polling link. Use Get Export Job Status before retrieving the results. This operation may require reporting/export product access or a qualifying role; the build account returned 403 with org.report.read granted.

tools.name: Create Ignore Policy
tools.description: Create an organization-level ignore policy for a specific Snyk Code finding. This API requires Code Consistent Ignores to be enabled.

tools.name: Create Repository Aliases
tools.description: Link one or more alternate repository URLs to canonical repository assets in a Snyk organization. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Create SBOM Test
tools.description: Start asynchronous vulnerability analysis of a CycloneDX 1.4-1.6 JSON or SPDX 2.3 JSON SBOM. Returns the job ID and polling URL for the SBOM test status and result actions. Components without supported PackageURLs are skipped. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Delete Collection
tools.description: Permanently delete a Snyk collection. This destructive operation cannot be undone; confirm the organization and collection IDs before calling. May require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: Delete Ignore Policy
tools.description: Permanently delete an organization-level Snyk ignore policy. This destructive operation cannot be undone; confirm the organization and policy IDs before calling. Organization-level policy APIs require Code Consistent Ignores.

tools.name: Delete Project
tools.description: Permanently delete one Snyk project from an organization. This destructive operation cannot be undone; confirm the organization and project IDs before calling.

tools.name: Delete Repository Aliases
tools.description: Detach 1-100 aliased URLs from their canonical repository assets in a Snyk organization. Each detached URL becomes a standalone asset. This destructive Early Access operation cannot be undone; confirm every asset ID and URL pair before calling. Snyk marks this endpoint beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Delete Target
tools.description: Permanently delete a Snyk target and all projects associated with it. This destructive cascade cannot be undone; confirm the organization and target IDs before calling.

tools.name: Download Findings Document
tools.description: Download the raw bytes of a completed findings document and return an offloaded file reference. Supply an existing completed document ID because this toolkit does not provide the findings-document create/poll workflow. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Download Project SBOM
tools.description: Download a Snyk project's software bill of materials as CycloneDX JSON/XML or SPDX JSON and return an offloaded file reference.

tools.name: Get Collection
tools.description: Retrieve a collection from a Snyk organization. The connected account must have collection product access or a qualifying organization role.

tools.name: Get Container Image
tools.description: Retrieve a container image by its SHA-256 digest from a Snyk organization.

tools.name: Get Export
tools.description: Retrieve completed export results from a Snyk organization. This endpoint may require reporting/export product access or a qualifying organization role.

tools.name: Get Export Job Status
tools.description: Get the current status of a Snyk organization export job. The connected account may need reporting or export product access or a qualifying role.

tools.name: Get IAC Settings
tools.description: Retrieve Infrastructure as Code settings for a Snyk organization. This may require Snyk IaC product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: Get Ignore Policy
tools.description: Retrieve an organization-level ignore policy by ID. This API is available only for Snyk Code Consistent Ignores.

tools.name: Get Inventory Asset
tools.description: Retrieve one inventory asset by ID from a Snyk organization, optionally using sparse fieldsets. This Early Access endpoint is beta, may change, and requires Snyk Inventory access.

tools.name: Get Inventory Asset Search Results
tools.description: Retrieve one page of results from a previously started asynchronous Snyk inventory asset search. Supply a search ID created outside this toolkit because the search-start endpoint is not exposed. This Early Access endpoint is beta, may change, and requires Snyk Inventory access.

tools.name: Get Open Source Broker Setting
tools.description: Retrieve whether the Open Source Broker setting is enabled for a Snyk organization.

tools.name: Get Open Source Ecosystem Broker Settings
tools.description: Retrieve all Broker settings for a specific Open Source ecosystem in a Snyk organization. Ecosystem identifiers are case-sensitive.

tools.name: Get Open Source Private Registry Settings
tools.description: Retrieve publicly accessible private registry settings for a specific Open Source ecosystem in a Snyk organization. These registries are reached directly with credentials rather than through Snyk Broker.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Retrieve the full details of a Snyk organization. Optionally expand the organization's tenant relationship.

tools.name: Get Organization Issue
tools.description: Retrieve one Snyk issue by its organization and issue IDs, optionally including data flows for Snyk Code issues.

tools.name: Get Package Test
tools.description: Retrieve a Snyk package test by ID, including its execution state, outcome, component facts, and finding summaries. The findings themselves are available through the returned findings link. This toolkit does not provide the package-test create/poll workflow, so supply an existing test ID. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Get Project
tools.description: Retrieve a Snyk project by ID, including its settings and relationships. Optionally expand the target and include metadata from the latest scan.

tools.name: Get SAST Settings
tools.description: Retrieve the SAST settings for a Snyk organization.

tools.name: Get SBOM Test Result
tools.description: Retrieve one page of affected packages from a finished Snyk SBOM test, together with the test result resource. Poll Get SBOM Test Status first and call this action after the job finishes. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Get SBOM Test Status
tools.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous Snyk SBOM test job. When the status is finished, use Get SBOM Test Result with the same job ID. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Get Target
tools.description: Retrieve a target by ID from a Snyk organization.

tools.name: List Broker Connections
tools.description: List one page of Broker connections integrated with a Snyk organization.

tools.name: List Collection Projects
tools.description: List one page of projects in a Snyk collection, with issue counts and owning targets. May require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: List Collections
tools.description: List one page of a Snyk organization's collections, including project and issue counts. May require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: List Component Findings
tools.description: List one page of unsuppressed findings for a component in a completed Snyk package test. The organization, test, and component IDs select the findings; use the returned cursor to continue in finding-ID order. Supply existing test and component IDs because this toolkit does not provide the package-test create/poll workflow. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: List Container Images
tools.description: List one page of container images in a Snyk organization, optionally filtered by image digest, platform, or registry name.

tools.name: List Container Image Target Refs
tools.description: List one page of target references associated with a container image in a Snyk organization.

tools.name: List Ignore Policies
tools.description: List one page of organization-level Snyk Code Consistent Ignore policies, with optional search, review, expiry, and sorting filters.

tools.name: List Ignore Policy Events
tools.description: List one page of event history for a Snyk organization ignore policy. Warning: this beta API requires Code Consistent Ignores and the ignore approval workflow feature.

tools.name: List Inventory Asset Projects
tools.description: List one page of Snyk projects linked to an inventory asset, including project attributes and issue counts. This Early Access beta endpoint may require inventory product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: List Inventory Assets
tools.description: List one page of a Snyk organization's inventory assets, with optional RSQL filtering, sorting, sparse fieldsets, and total count. This Early Access endpoint is beta, may change, and requires Snyk inventory product access.

tools.name: List Inventory Asset Targets
tools.description: List one page of Snyk targets linked to an inventory asset, including each target's origin, reference, manifest file, integration, and import time. This Early Access beta endpoint may require inventory product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: List Inventory Filter Fields
tools.description: List one page of fields available for filtering a Snyk organization's inventory assets with RSQL. This Early Access endpoint is beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: List Inventory Filter Values
tools.description: List one page of distinct values for a Snyk inventory filter field for autocomplete. This inventory endpoint is in beta.

tools.name: List Inventory Group Fields
tools.description: List one page of fields available for grouping inventory assets in a Snyk organization, optionally filtered by asset type. This Early Access beta capability may require additional Snyk product access.

tools.name: List Inventory Group Values
tools.description: List one page of aggregated values for a Snyk inventory group field. This Early Access capability may require inventory product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: List Issues For Package
tools.description: List one offset page of direct vulnerabilities for a versioned Package URL. Transitive vulnerabilities are not included. Pass the returned opaque cursor unchanged to continue; Maven checksum qualifiers also return match metadata.

tools.name: List Issues For Packages
tools.description: List direct vulnerabilities for a batch of versioned Package URLs. Snyk restricts this endpoint and does not make it available to all customers; availability depends on the connected account's product entitlement. Transitive vulnerabilities are not included.

tools.name: List Language Settings
tools.description: Get one page of language and package-manager settings for a Snyk organization. This beta Early Access contract is deprecated and marked for sunset; use it only while the pinned API version remains available.

tools.name: List Organization Issues
tools.description: List one page of issues for a Snyk organization, with filters for scan item, issue type, timestamps, effective severity, status, ignored state, and Code data flows.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: List one page of Snyk organizations accessible to the connected account, with group, personal-organization, slug, name, and relationship-expansion filters.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List one page of a Snyk organization's projects. Filter by target, identity, name, origin, type, CLI monitoring time, importing user, tags, or project classifications, and optionally include target and latest-scan metadata.

tools.name: List Targets
tools.description: List one page of a Snyk organization's targets. Filter by privacy, project presence, remote URL, integration source type, display-name prefix, or creation time, and optionally include the total matching count.

tools.name: List Test Findings
tools.description: List one page of non-threshold-violating, policy-unsuppressed findings from a Snyk package test. Findings are scanner-independent vulnerability and policy-breach records sorted by ID. Supply an existing completed test ID because this toolkit does not provide the package-test create/poll workflow. Warning: Snyk marks this endpoint as beta and its contract may change.

tools.name: Lookup Inventory Asset
tools.description: Look up one inventory asset in a Snyk organization by natural key or alias. A natural-key match takes precedence over an alias match. This Early Access endpoint is beta, may change, and requires Snyk Inventory access.

tools.name: Remove Projects From Collection
tools.description: Remove up to 100 projects from a Snyk collection. Warning: This may require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: Update Collection
tools.description: Rename a Snyk collection. This may require collection product access or a qualifying account role.

tools.name: Update IAC Settings
tools.description: Update Infrastructure as Code custom-rule inheritance, enablement, or OCI registry URL and tag for a Snyk organization. This may require Snyk IaC product access or a qualifying organization role.

tools.name: Update Ignore Policy
tools.description: Update an organization-level ignore policy. This API is available only when Snyk Code Consistent Ignores is enabled.

tools.name: Update Inventory Asset
tools.description: Partially update the classification, labels, or tags of one Snyk inventory asset. This Early Access endpoint is beta and its contract may change; the connected account must have access to Snyk Inventory.

tools.name: Update Language Settings
tools.description: Update package-manager settings for one programming language in a Snyk organization. Warning: Snyk marks this beta contract as deprecated or sunset; use it only while the pinned version remains served.

tools.name: Update Open Source Ecosystem Broker Settings
tools.description: Update selected Broker integrations for a specific Open Source ecosystem in a Snyk organization. Only provided integrations are changed; omitting an integration's URLs or providing an empty list removes that integration.

tools.name: Update Open Source Private Registry Settings
tools.description: Add, update, or remove private registry integrations for one Open Source ecosystem in a Snyk organization. The endpoint uses patch semantics, so unlisted integrations remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Organization
tools.description: Update the display name of a Snyk organization.

tools.name: Update Org Secrets Settings

name: Splice MCP
description: Splice MCP lets agents search the sounds catalog, build and edit stacks, share stacks, and download eligible sounds using Splice credits.

tools.name: Create stack
tools.description: Create a stack from an existing sample. This is the ONLY tool that can use a previously found or selected sample as a seed — if the user wants to build a stack around a specific sample, you MUST use this tool (not prompt_to_stack). ROUTING RULE: Any request like 'create a stack from this sample', 'build around this loop', 'use this as a seed', or referencing a specific asset UUID MUST use this tool. The seed sample MUST be a loop (not a one-shot). If the user asks to build a stack from a one-shot, do NOT silently search for loops. Instead, FIRST explain to the user that one-shots cannot be used as stack seeds because stacks require loopable samples to layer together, THEN offer to find similar loops that match the style or character of the one-shot they liked. Uses the loop as the starting layer and generates a full multi-layer stack of compatible samples around it.

tools.name: Describe a sound
tools.description: Search the Splice catalog for sounds matching a natural language description. Returns sample metadata including BPM, key, tags, duration, and Splice links. Use this to BROWSE and EXPLORE individual sounds -- when the user wants to find, preview, or discover specific samples, loops, or one-shots. Do NOT call this tool alongside prompt_to_stack for the same request. If the user wants a complete multi-track beat or arrangement, use prompt_to_stack instead. Present ALL results to the user exactly as numbered; do not filter, omit, or reorder any results — let the user decide which sounds are relevant. IMPORTANT: One-shots CANNOT be used as seeds to create stacks — only loops can. If the user searched for one-shots and then asks to create a stack from those results, you MUST explicitly tell the user that one-shots cannot be used to create stacks and offer to search for similar loops instead. Do NOT silently pivot to loops.

tools.name: Download asset
tools.description: Purchase and get a presigned download URL for a sound from the Splice catalog. The server returns a presigned URL — it does not write files. If the client has local filesystem access, it should fetch the URL and save the file to download_path; otherwise omit download_path and present the URL to the user. IMPORTANT: The first time an asset is downloaded it spends one of the user's credits. Subsequent downloads of the same asset are free. Always confirm with the user before calling this tool. The URL expires quickly — always display the file name alongside the download URL so the user can identify and access their file.

tools.name: Prompt to stack
tools.description: Generate a complete multi-track arrangement of compatible samples from a text description. Use this ONLY when the user describes a sound from scratch without referencing a specific existing sample. This tool does NOT accept a sample UUID as input -- it creates a stack entirely from a text prompt. ROUTING RULE: If the user says anything like 'create a stack from this sample', 'build a stack around this loop', or 'use this as a seed', you MUST use create_stack instead -- even if the user also provides a text description of the desired sound. Do NOT call this tool alongside describe_a_sound for the same request. If the user just wants to browse or find individual sounds, use describe_a_sound instead. Uses AI to interpret your prompt, select appropriate instrument layers (drums, bass, keys, etc.), and filters, and find matching harmonically coherent samples. BPM GUIDANCE: Always include a target BPM in the prompt AND set bpm_min/bpm_max to avoid extreme time-stretching. If the user specifies a genre but not a BPM, infer the range from the genre. Optionally generates a public shareable URL.

tools.name: Share stack
tools.description: Generate a public shareable URL for an existing stack. Takes a stack UUID (from a previous create call) and returns a shareable link.

tools.name: Update stack
tools.description: Modify an existing stack. Use this tool to add, remove, or swap sounds in a stack, rename it, or change its BPM. LAYER LIMIT: Stacks have a maximum of 8 layers. Adding layers beyond this limit will fail. If the stack already has 8 layers, remove existing layers before adding new ones. Required parameter: stack_uuid (the UUID, not a URL). To remove layers, pass their UUIDs via remove_layer_uuids. At least one modification must be provided. When adding or swapping layers, PREFER add_compatible_layers and swap_compatible_layers — these find harmonically compatible samples that fit the existing stack. Only use add_asset_uuids or swap_layers when the user has explicitly chosen a specific sample to use. DRUMS: When adding drums, ALWAYS include the 'grooves' tag in the tag_filter (e.g. '(hip hop || trap) && grooves', 'house && grooves') to get complete drum patterns (kick + snare + hats combined). Without the 'grooves' tag, the search returns isolated single-hit layers (just kicks, just snares, etc.) instead of full drum loops. Only omit 'grooves' if the user explicitly asks for an isolated drum element. Optional tag filter DSL to narrow sample selection. Prefer && (intersection) so all tags must match for precise results; fall back to || (union) only if intersection returns too few results.
