name: Supadata
description: Supadata is a web and video-to-text API that extracts transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X (Twitter) and video files, retrieves social media metadata, and converts web content to markdown for AI training and content analysis.

tools.name: Get Account Information
tools.description: Retrieve organization details, plan information, and credit usage for the authenticated account. Use this to check account status, credit balance, and subscription plan.

tools.name: Get Media Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve unified metadata for supported social-media content. Supports YouTube videos, TikTok videos, Instagram reels and posts, Twitter/X posts, and Facebook videos and posts. Engagement statistics may be cached for up to about 10 minutes. HTTP 429 responses are plan-dependent and can indicate either the request-rate limit or usage-credit quota was exceeded.

tools.name: Get Video Transcript
tools.description: Get transcript from a video on supported platforms or from a file URL. Use this tool when you need to: - Retrieve transcripts from YouTube, TikTok, Twitter, Instagram, or Facebook videos - Extract transcript from video file URLs - Get transcripts in specific languages - Choose between native captions or AI-generated transcripts Some connections support only explicit mode=native on HTTPS YouTube video URLs; AI generation, file URLs, other platforms and job polling are unavailable there. For large videos, the API returns a job ID. You'll need to poll the /transcript/{jobId} endpoint to get the final result. For smaller videos, the transcript is returned immediately. The response varies based on the 'text' parameter: - text=true: Returns plain text transcript as a string - text=false: Returns structured list of chunks with timestamps and text

tools.name: Get Transcript by Job ID
tools.description: Get results for a transcript job by job ID. Use this to retrieve results of asynchronous transcript processing. Check the status field to determine if the job is complete.

tools.name: Get Video Extraction Result
tools.description: Retrieve the current status and result of a video extraction job. Call this action repeatedly, waiting about one second between calls, until status is completed or failed. Polling is free. Completed results expire after one hour and then return HTTP 404, so retrieve and store them promptly. HTTP 429 responses are plan-dependent and can indicate a request-rate limit or usage-credit quota was exceeded.

tools.name: Get Web Crawl Result
tools.description: Poll a web crawl and retrieve its pages. Polling is free. Repeat while status is scraping; completed, failed, and cancelled are terminal. When next is returned, continue with the skip value from that URL. Requests may return HTTP 429 according to plan limits.

tools.name: Website URL Map
tools.description: Crawl a website and extract all URLs/links found on it. Use this to create a sitemap, discover all pages of a website, or prepare for content scraping across multiple pages. Returns a list of all URLs discovered during the crawl.

tools.name: Scrape Web Page
tools.description: Extract content from any webpage and convert it to Markdown format. Use this tool when you need to: - Read and extract text content from a web page - Get metadata (title, description) from a webpage - Discover links on a webpage - Get character counts of page content The tool returns the page content in Markdown format, making it easy to process and understand.

tools.name: Get YouTube Batch Result
tools.description: Poll a transcript or video metadata batch. Polling is free; repeat until status is completed or failed. An unfinished, abandoned job can age out with errorCode=job-expired. Use limit and offset to page completed results. Requests may return HTTP 429 according to plan limits.

tools.name: Get YouTube Channel Metadata
tools.description: Fetches metadata for a YouTube channel including name, description, subscriber count, video count, view count, and channel images. Accepts channel IDs, handles, or full YouTube URLs.

tools.name: Get YouTube Channel Videos
tools.description: Tool to retrieve video IDs from a YouTube channel. Returns lists of regular video IDs, YouTube Shorts IDs, and live stream IDs. Videos are ordered latest first. Use this to get video IDs that can be passed to the Get YouTube Video endpoint for full metadata.

tools.name: Get YouTube Playlist Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for a YouTube playlist including title, description, video count, view count, last updated timestamp, and channel information. Use this when you need playlist-level information. For the list of videos in a playlist, use the Get YouTube Playlist Videos action instead.

tools.name: Get YouTube Playlist Videos
tools.description: Tool to retrieve video IDs from a YouTube playlist. Returns lists of standard video IDs, YouTube Shorts IDs, and live stream IDs contained in the playlist.

tools.name: Get YouTube Video Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive metadata for a YouTube video by its ID. Use this tool when you need to get details about a specific YouTube video including: - Title, description, and tags - Channel information - View and like counts - Upload date and duration - Live stream status - Available transcript languages The video_id is the 11-character identifier found in YouTube URLs (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ' from 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ').

tools.name: Search YouTube
tools.description: Search YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists by keyword. Returns matching content with metadata like titles, thumbnails, view counts, and channel information.

tools.name: Start Video Extraction
tools.description: Start asynchronous structured extraction from a supported public video. Supadata analyzes what is seen and heard in public YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X (Twitter), and Facebook videos or public media files. Supported files are MP4, WEBM, MP3, FLAC, MPEG, MPGA, M4A, OGG, and WAV, up to 200 MB; videos longer than 55 minutes are unsupported. Extraction always returns a job ID for polling. Charged per started video minute, with a one-minute minimum; polling is free. HTTP 429 responses are plan-dependent and can indicate either the plan's request-rate limit or usage-credit quota was exceeded.

tools.name: Start Web Crawl
tools.description: Start an asynchronous website crawl. This Pro+ operation follows child links under the supplied URL. Respect the site's robots.txt and terms of service. Charged per crawled page: an estimate is charged when the job is submitted and settled to the actual page count when the crawl completes. Polling is free. Plan-dependent HTTP 429 responses can indicate a request-rate limit or usage-credit quota was exceeded.

tools.name: Start YouTube Transcript Batch
tools.description: Start an asynchronous YouTube transcript batch from exactly one list of video IDs, playlist, or channel. This feature requires Supadata Pro or above. Charged per requested video at submission, then settles to the actual video count when processing finishes. Unavailable transcripts remain billed; videos that fail for other reasons are not billed. Plan rate or usage limits can return HTTP 429.

tools.name: Start YouTube Video Metadata Batch
tools.description: Start an asynchronous YouTube video metadata batch. This feature requires a Pro plan or above and accepts exactly one source: video IDs, a playlist, or a channel. Playlist and channel batches process regular videos only. Charged per requested video at submission; the charge settles to the actual result count when processing finishes; polling is free. HTTP 429 responses are plan-dependent and can indicate either the plan's request-rate limit or usage-credit quota was exceeded.

tools.name: Translate YouTube Transcript
tools.description: Translate a YouTube transcript into a requested ISO 639-1 language. Provide exactly one YouTube URL or video ID. This feature requires Supadata Pro or above, costs 30 credits per transcript minute, and may take 20 or more seconds. HTTP 429 responses indicate a plan-dependent rate or usage limit was exceeded.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Supadata API key for authenticating requests. You can obtain this from your Supadata dashboard.

name: Superchat
description: Superchat is a unified messaging platform that enables businesses to communicate with customers across multiple channels, including WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, Email, and more.

tools.name: Create Contact
tools.description: Create a new contact in Superchat with phone or email handles. Use this tool to register contact details before sending messages. You must provide at least one handle (phone or email). Optional fields include first name, last name, gender, and custom attributes (if predefined in your account settings).

tools.name: Create Template Folder
tools.description: Create a new template folder in SuperChat for organizing message templates. Template folders help organize WhatsApp and other messaging templates into logical groups (e.g., Marketing, Sales, Customer Support). Use this action before creating templates when you want to keep them organized.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific webhook by its ID. Use when you need to remove an obsolete or unwanted webhook subscription. First use SUPERCHAT_LIST_WEBHOOKS to retrieve the webhook ID, then use this action to delete it. Example: Delete webhook wh_UPYSN0Etofjl7lhhQ9yhL.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Retrieve a specific contact's details by ID. Returns the contact's name, handles (phone, email, social), custom attributes, and timestamps. Use this to look up contact information before sending messages or updating contact details. Example: "Get contact details for co_abc123" or "Fetch info for contact co_xyz789".

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for a specific file by its ID. Returns file details including the file name, MIME type, API resource URL, and a temporary download link with expiration. Use this to get information about uploaded files before downloading or processing them.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Retrieve details of a specific user in the Superchat workspace by their user ID. Use this tool when you need to fetch profile information for a known user. Note: You can obtain user IDs by first calling the List Users action. Example user_id format: 'us_abc123xyz'

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: Lists all communication channels in your Superchat workspace. Channels represent different messaging mediums (WhatsApp, email, SMS, Telegram, Instagram, Facebook) through which conversations occur. Results are sorted by creation date (newest first) and can be paginated using 'limit', 'after', or 'before' parameters.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: List all contacts in the Superchat workspace with cursor-based pagination. Use this tool to browse contacts, find contact IDs, or export contact data. Results are sorted by creation date (newest first).

tools.name: List Conversations
tools.description: Retrieves a paginated list of all conversations in your Superchat account. Each conversation includes channel info, status (open/snoozed/done), assigned users, contacts, labels, and inbox details. Use this to browse conversations, find specific ones by status or channel, or get conversation IDs for further operations. Supports cursor-based pagination to handle large result sets.

tools.name: List Custom Attributes
tools.description: List all custom attributes defined for contacts in your Superchat account. Custom attributes are user-defined fields that extend contact data beyond standard fields like name and email. Use this action to discover available custom attributes before reading or updating contact information. Supports cursor-based pagination for accounts with many custom attributes. Common use cases: - Discover available custom fields before updating contacts - Retrieve custom attribute types (string, number, date, select, etc.) - Get custom attribute IDs for use in other API calls

tools.name: List Inboxes
tools.description: Tool to list all inboxes. Use when you need to retrieve inbox IDs and metadata before sending or organizing messages.

tools.name: List Labels
tools.description: List all labels in the Superchat workspace. Labels are used to categorize and organize conversations. Use this tool to retrieve available labels and their IDs, which can then be used to assign labels to conversations via the update conversation endpoint. Supports cursor-based pagination for workspaces with many labels.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to list all message templates. Use when you need to fetch available message templates.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Retrieve all users in the workspace. Returns user profiles including names, emails, roles, and contact info. Supports pagination for large workspaces. Use cases: - Get a directory of all workspace members - Find user IDs for other API operations - Audit user roles and permissions

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to list all webhooks configured in the workspace. Use this tool to: - Retrieve all active and paused webhooks - Get webhook IDs for use with update or delete operations - Check webhook status and event subscriptions Supports pagination via 'limit', 'after', and 'before' parameters.

tools.name: Update Contact
tools.description: Update information for a specific contact in Superchat. Use this tool to modify a contact's name, gender, handles (phone/email), or custom attributes. Requires the contact_id (prefixed with 'ct_') which can be obtained from List Contacts or Create Contact. Examples: - Update first name: {"contact_id": "ct_abc123", "first_name": "Jane"} - Update gender: {"contact_id": "ct_abc123", "gender": "female"} - Update phone handle: {"contact_id": "ct_abc123", "handles": [{"type": "phone", "value": "+1234567890"}]}

tools.name: Update Webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook's target URL and/or event subscriptions. Use this tool to: - Change the webhook delivery URL - Add or remove event subscriptions - Update event types the webhook listens to Note: Webhook status (ACTIVE/PAUSED) is automatically managed by the API and cannot be manually changed. Webhooks become PAUSED after 7 days of consistent delivery failures.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the Superchat API. You can find it in Superchat web application under 'Settings > API'.

name: Supermemory
description: Supermemory is a memory and context API for ingesting, organizing, searching, and recalling information across applications.

tools.name: Add Document
tools.description: Ingest text or a public URL as a Supermemory document and return its document ID and initial processing status.

tools.name: Add Documents
tools.description: Add 1 to 600 documents in one request, with explicit per-document metadata and processing options. HTTP 200 may contain partial failures; callers must inspect failed, success, and every result rather than treating 200 as complete batch success. The API does not guarantee atomicity or result ordering.

tools.name: Add Namespace Document
tools.description: Add text or a supported URL as searchable, evolving memory in an isolated namespace. Supply a new document ID to create a document, or reuse an existing ID to append information while preserving history. Ingestion is asynchronous: inspect the returned processing status and retrieve the document to check completion.

tools.name: Add Namespace Documents
tools.description: Ingest 1 to 600 text or URL documents in an isolated namespace. Existing caller-defined IDs append information with single-document ingestion semantics. Acceptance is asynchronous, not completed processing. HTTP 200 may contain partial failures: inspect count, failed, and each result's error, details, and url. Accepted results precede failures; match by id or failed-item url, not position. An all-failed batch raises an error.

tools.name: Bulk Delete Documents
tools.description: Deprecated provider v3 endpoint; shuts down December 31, 2026. Use v5 namespace document deletion (DELETE /ns/{namespace}/document) instead. Delete up to 100 documents by ID, all documents in selected container tags, or documents matching a filepath. Container-tag and filepath selectors can delete many documents. Inspect success, deleted_count, and errors for the actual outcome; an HTTP 200 alone does not prove every document was deleted.

tools.name: Configure Automatic Top-Ups
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Configure automatic paid USD credit purchases for the connected organization. Enabling reloads can cause financial charges when the credit balance is low. Requires an unscoped organization API key with admin or owner access; paid-plan and saved-payment-method requirements apply when enabling. Supply the full console configuration explicitly, including when disabling. Purchase limits do not cap total usage or the full invoice.

tools.name: Configure Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 namespace connectors API for new integrations. Configure selected resources for an existing legacy connection; currently only GitHub supports resource configuration. Returns the provider's success flag, outcome message, and optional registered-webhook count.

tools.name: Count Namespace Document Memories
tools.description: Count live memories in a namespace for up to 100 public document IDs. Missing or inaccessible documents are omitted, not reported as zero.

tools.name: Create Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use CREATE_CONNECTOR for v5 namespace-scoped connectors. Initialize a provider connection and return its ID and any authorization URL. This does not open the URL or complete user authorization; the user must authorize separately before the connection can import documents.

tools.name: Create Connector
tools.description: Connect an external source to a namespace. Choose the provider-specific connector settings. OAuth providers return an authorization URL to send the user to; config-authenticated providers start syncing immediately.

tools.name: Create Memory
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider; v3/v4 APIs shut down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 namespace document ingestion for new integrations. Create 1 to 100 memories directly in an existing container, bypassing document ingestion. Generates embeddings and makes the memories immediately searchable.

tools.name: Create Scoped Key
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 route; provider shutdown is December 31, 2026. No v5 scoped-key creation alternative is documented. Create an API key restricted to one namespace or a fixed list of namespaces, using an organization API key; scoped keys cannot mint further keys. Writable scoped keys can update and delete content within their namespaces. Returns a secret credential: store it securely and do not log it.

tools.name: Delete Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use DELETE_CONNECTOR for v5 namespace-scoped connector deletion instead. Delete a specific connection by ID. By default this also deletes documents imported by the connection; set deleteDocuments to 'false' to retain them. Returns deleted connection IDs and providers.

tools.name: Delete Connector
tools.description: Disconnect a connector in a namespace and stop its webhooks. Imported documents are also deleted by default. Set deleteDocuments to false to preserve those documents.

tools.name: Delete Container Tag
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 DELETE /ns/{namespace} to delete a namespace instead. Delete a container tag and all its documents and memories. Only organization owners and admins can perform this destructive action.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Permanently delete one document by ID. This does not remove the document's container-tag settings record.

tools.name: Delete Namespace
tools.description: Retire a namespace and permanently delete its documents and memories. Optionally set moveTo to preserve its content by moving everything into another namespace first. A queued response only acknowledges an asynchronous move, not completed deletion; a deleted response confirms permanent removal.

tools.name: Delete Namespace Documents
tools.description: Permanently delete 1 to 100 documents and their derived knowledge from a namespace by document ID or caller-defined ID. Each identifier is handled independently; successful deletions are preserved if others fail. Inspect count and every errors entry: HTTP 200 does not mean all documents were deleted.

tools.name: Delete Namespace Profile Buckets
tools.description: Remove 1 to 50 profile bucket categories created specifically for a namespace and return its updated effective bucket definitions. Unknown names are safely ignored. Organization-wide buckets are protected and cannot be removed with this action. Requires namespace write access.

tools.name: Delete Provider Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use DELETE_CONNECTOR for v5 namespace-scoped connector deletion by connector ID instead. Delete connections for a specific provider and container tags. Returns the deleted connection IDs and providers.

tools.name: Forget Matching Memories
tools.description: Deprecated by Supermemory: legacy v3/v4 APIs shut down December 31, 2026. Use v5 DELETE /ns/{namespace}/memories/semantic for semantic forgetting, or DELETE /ns/{namespace}/memories for exact IDs. Soft-delete memories in one container matching a natural-language instruction or exact IDs. Set dry_run=true to preview first; omission defaults to real forgetting. Semantic matches may change between preview and apply; use exact IDs for a reviewable selection.

tools.name: Forget Memory
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider; v3/v4 APIs shut down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 DELETE /ns/{namespace}/memories for new integrations. Soft-delete a memory by ID or exact content within a required container tag. The memory is marked as forgotten, not permanently deleted.

tools.name: Forget Namespace Memories
tools.description: Remove 1 to 500 exact memories from normal recall in a namespace by stable memory ID, preserving their audit history. Each ID is handled independently: missing or ineligible memories are reported without rolling back successful changes. Inspect count, errors, and matches; HTTP 200 does not mean every requested memory was forgotten.

tools.name: Forget Namespace Memories Semantically
tools.description: Preview or forget memories in a namespace using a natural-language query. Explicitly set dryRun to true to preview or false to apply forgetting. For a reviewable, drift-free workflow, preview here and pass the returned memory IDs to the exact-ID forget action instead of rerunning the query. Inspect count, matches, and errors for the provider-reported outcome.

tools.name: Get Account Status
tools.description: Return the connected Supermemory organization's plan, credit balance, high-level usage, and reset date.

tools.name: Get Automatic Top-Ups
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Get the connected organization's automatic credit top-up configuration and payment-method availability without changing billing settings or purchasing credits. Requires an unscoped organization API key; scoped API keys cannot read billing.

tools.name: Get Billing Usage
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API; provider shutdown is December 31, 2026. Retrieve the connected organization's per-feature billing usage, limits, units, and period bounds when available. Requires an organization API key; scoped API keys cannot read billing. Console usage estimates are not authoritative invoices.

tools.name: Get Billing Usage Events
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Get daily billing meter events for the connected organization, including per-feature consumption and Memory versus SuperRAG token totals. Optional ISO 8601 start and end override the billing period. Requires an organization API key; scoped API keys cannot read billing. Console usage is an estimate; invoice line items are authoritative.

tools.name: Get Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 GET /ns/{namespace}/connectors/{id} endpoint for new integrations. Retrieve a legacy connection by ID, including available provider metadata and the latest sync run status.

tools.name: Get Connector
tools.description: Read a connector in a namespace, including its setup, selection, and latest sync status. Optionally include the 10 most recent sync runs with failed items or a one-time hosted picker URL. Requesting picker requires admin write access because the link allows changing what syncs.

tools.name: Get Container Tag
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 GET /ns/{namespace} for namespace settings instead. Get a container tag's display name, entity context, memory filesystem paths, profile buckets, and creation and update timestamps.

tools.name: Get Container Tag Merge
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Get the status and progress of a queued container tag merge by its merge job ID, including copied rows, renamed custom IDs, and the last error. This read does not start or retry a merge.

tools.name: Get Document
tools.description: Get one document's content, metadata, source details, and processing status by document ID.

tools.name: Get Document Chunks
tools.description: Return the ordered extracted chunks for one processed document.

tools.name: Get Document File URL
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy endpoint shuts down December 31, 2026. Get a fresh presigned download URL for a document's uploaded file. The URL is valid for 24 hours. Returns an error if the document does not exist or has no file.

tools.name: Get Error Analytics
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 endpoint scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Retrieve organization-wide error analytics, including request-type summaries, HTTP error breakdowns, hourly trends, and per-key metrics for a time window. Returns one page; increment page using the returned pagination metadata.

tools.name: Get Namespace Settings
tools.description: Read a namespace's supporting context and lifecycle timestamps. Supporting context helps Supermemory understand content and form better memories inside this namespace.

tools.name: Get Namespace Document
tools.description: Retrieve a document's canonical content, metadata, and processing state by document ID or caller-defined ID within a namespace. Optionally include source chunks, derived memories, or both. Processing status done does not necessarily mean memory generation is complete; inspect dreamingStatus separately.

tools.name: Get Namespace Memory
tools.description: Retrieve one memory by ID within a namespace, including its text, metadata, version, and recall flags. Optionally include version history up to three steps away (nearest first), direct extends and derives links, and source documents. relatedLimit caps each related list separately.

tools.name: Get Namespace Profile
tools.description: Read the continuously maintained profile of a namespace's subject without a search query. Returns stable facts, evolving context, and custom buckets; optionally restrict contributing memories with metadata filters or select buckets.

tools.name: Get Namespace Profile Buckets
tools.description: Inspect the profile taxonomy active in a Supermemory namespace. Returns a name-to-description map combining organization-wide profile buckets with namespace-owned additions.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Read the connected organization's shared background that guides memory formation across all namespaces, together with its active namespace count. This action takes no parameters and does not change organization settings.

tools.name: Get Profile
tools.description: Retrieve the static, dynamic, or bucketed profile learned for one container tag, optionally with matching search results.

tools.name: Get Profile Buckets
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v4 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 GET /ns/{namespace}/profile/buckets instead. Return the effective profile bucket definitions for a container tag, merging organization-level buckets with container-tag-level additions.

tools.name: Get Provider Connection
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 LIST_CONNECTORS to find namespace connectors and GET_CONNECTOR to retrieve one by ID. Retrieve a legacy connection by provider and container tags, including its latest synchronization status when available. This POST only reads connection details.

tools.name: Get Settings
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 organization and namespace settings APIs for new integrations. Retrieve the connected organization's ingestion filters, connector OAuth configuration, chunk size, and profile buckets. Connector client secrets are omitted from the response.

tools.name: Get Usage Analytics
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. Get organization-wide request usage analytics, including counts by request type, hourly performance, per-API-key metrics, and total memories. Filter by a relative period or ISO 8601 from_ and to bounds. Returns one page; use pagination to request further pages. Recorded tokensUsed is not the billable ingestion-token meter.

tools.name: Ingest Conversation
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the v3/v4 API shuts down December 31, 2026. For new integrations, ingest a conversation transcript through v5 POST /ns/{namespace}/document instead. Ingest or update a conversation by its conversationId using structured messages, optional container tags, and metadata. Returns the backing document ID and processing status, not a guarantee that asynchronous processing has finished.

tools.name: List All Connectors
tools.description: List one page of connectors across every namespace the API key can read, optionally filtered by provider. Use for admin views spanning users or projects. Pending connectors are not listed. Increment page up to pagination.totalPages to retrieve subsequent pages.

tools.name: List Connection Documents
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. For v5 document listing, use LIST_NAMESPACE_RESOURCES with type documents; v5 connectors are namespace-scoped. List documents indexed for a connected provider, optionally filtered by container tags. Returns document IDs, processing statuses, titles, summaries, types, and timestamps.

tools.name: List Connection Resources
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. List one page of accessible resources for a connection; only GitHub is currently documented as supported. Use page and per_page to request additional pages, and parent_id to scope resources to a parent.

tools.name: List Connections
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 LIST_CONNECTORS for namespace connectors or LIST_ALL_CONNECTORS across namespaces. List all legacy connections, optionally filtered by container tags, including the latest synchronization status when available.

tools.name: List Connectors
tools.description: List one page of connectors that sync into a namespace, optionally filtered by provider. Pending authorization connectors are not listed. Use page and limit with the returned pagination metadata to retrieve subsequent pages.

tools.name: List Container Tags
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 namespace listing API for new integrations. List all container tags, optionally restricted by a comma-separated filter, including summaries, Nova flags, document and memory counts, and active merge details.

tools.name: List Documents
tools.description: List documents, optionally filtered by containers, metadata, or filepath, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Inferred Memories
tools.description: List a namespace's inferred memories awaiting review. This review route is still served under v3; pass the namespace as containerTag. Returns up to 50 memories ordered by parentCount descending, then createdAt descending, excluding forgotten, expired, or reviewed memories. No pagination is documented; total can exceed the returned count. Unknown or empty namespaces return an empty list and zero total. No v5 replacement is documented.

tools.name: List Invoices
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 API, scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. List the connected Supermemory organization's billing invoices without changing billing settings or purchasing credits. Requires an unscoped organization API key; scoped API keys cannot read billing.

tools.name: List Memories
tools.description: List extracted memory entries for one or more container tags, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Namespace Resources
tools.description: Browse one page of documents, extracted chunks, or learned memories in a namespace. The other collection arrays are empty. Use pagination.totalPages and page to retrieve further pages. Position sorting is for chunks only; include.content and include.memoryCount apply to documents, and include.forgotten applies to memories.

tools.name: List Namespaces
tools.description: List namespaces available to the caller, newest first, including their purpose, document and memory counts, and lifecycle timestamps. Optionally filter names with q. Returns one page; use page and the returned pagination to fetch more.

tools.name: List Processing Documents
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 namespace document listing API for new integrations. List the live processing queue, all unfinished documents, or unfinished and failed documents. For view=all, fetch subsequent pages using page and limit and inspect the returned pagination information.

tools.name: List Request Logs
tools.description: Deprecated legacy v3 endpoint scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. List one page of organization-wide request logs filtered by time. Use pagination metadata and increment page to continue. Outputs are compacted and may be truncated. The ordinary tracker skips HTTP 402, 404, and 500 responses, so logs are not a complete audit trail. Historical retention is not guaranteed. Request type, status code, and API key filters are not supported.

tools.name: Merge Container Tags
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Queue a merge of exactly two container tags into a target tag. All source documents are updated to reference the target, and source tags are deleted after a successful merge. Requires an organization admin or owner. The response confirms queuing, not completion; use GET_CONTAINER_TAG_MERGE with the returned mergeId to check progress.

tools.name: Replace Namespace File
tools.description: Replace an existing document with a new file within an isolated namespace, keeping its stable document ID. Content and caller metadata are overwritten and the document is reprocessed asynchronously. The returned status reports processing state, not guaranteed completion. Requires namespace write access.

tools.name: Reset Organization Data
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Destructively reset the ENTIRE connected organization's content: delete documents, memories, spaces except the default project, connections, and organization settings, and clear the default space context. Preserves the organization itself, members, and billing. This is not scoped to an individual document, container tag, or namespace. Only call with explicit authorization to delete the entire organization's data.

tools.name: Review Inferred Memory
tools.description: Provider deprecation notice: legacy v3/v4 APIs are scheduled to shut down December 31, 2026. These review routes still serve namespaces under v3; no v5 replacement is documented. Approve, decline, or undo a review of one inferred memory in a namespace. Approve confirms the fact; decline forgets it and removes it from search; undo restores the unreviewed inferred state, including un-forgetting a declined memory. Requires a key with write access to the namespace. A non-reviewable memory or an undo without a prior review returns 409.

tools.name: Revoke Scoped Key
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy v3 endpoint shuts down on December 31, 2026. Revoke a scoped API key using the ID returned at creation. Subsequent requests using the revoked key receive 401. Memories and namespaces are not deleted. Authenticate with an organization API key, not a scoped key.

tools.name: Search Memory
tools.description: Semantically search Supermemory memories, document chunks, or both, with optional container and metadata filters.

tools.name: Search Documents
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: legacy v3/v4 APIs shut down December 31, 2026. Use v5 namespace search (POST /ns/{namespace}/search) for new integrations. Search documents and their content chunks with optional container, document, metadata, and filepath filters. Returns one bounded result set with relevance scores and optional full content or summaries.

tools.name: Search Namespace
tools.description: Recall relevant learned context and source passages from an isolated namespace. Hybrid search combines memories and document chunks by default. Supports typed metadata filters (up to five levels), query rewriting, reranking, and optional source documents and related memories.

tools.name: Send Feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, documentation problem, or other feedback to the Supermemory team. This contacts real engineers and consumes the organization's quota of three submissions per UTC day, subject to a shared authenticated pool of 200 per day. Do not automatically retry uncertain deliveries, including HTTP 502: delivery may already have occurred.

tools.name: Suggest Profile Buckets
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Suggest profile bucket definitions using the organization's saved context prompt. Returns 3 to 6 suggestions tailored to that context without saving bucket definitions. Fails when no organization context is available.

tools.name: Sync Connection
tools.description: Deprecated provider v3 API; shuts down December 31, 2026. For v5, use SYNC_CONNECTOR with a namespace and connector ID instead. Initiate a manual sync of connections for a provider, optionally filtered by container tags. The acknowledgement means importing was accepted, not that sync has finished.

tools.name: Sync Connector
tools.description: Start a sync now for a connector in a namespace. Returns the connector ID and queued status, not a completed sync result. Returns a conflict if a sync for this connector is already running. Use Get Connector to inspect sync progress and results.

tools.name: Update Connector
tools.description: Change what a connector syncs in a namespace or its maximum document count. A supplied selection replaces the old selection and starts a sync. Only send selection for providers that support choosing resources. Returns the updated connector and its latest sync status.

tools.name: Update Container Tag
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 namespace settings API (PATCH /ns/{namespace}) for new integrations. Update an existing container tag's display name, document processing context, memory filesystem paths, or tag-level profile buckets. Omitted fields remain unchanged; explicit nulls are sent for fields that support them.

tools.name: Update Document
tools.description: Update the content, metadata, container, or processing configuration of one existing document. When metadata is supplied, it completely replaces the document's metadata, so omitted metadata keys are removed.

tools.name: Update Memory
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider; v3/v4 APIs shut down on December 31, 2026. Use v5 namespace document updates for document-backed memory changes in new integrations. Update a memory by ID or exact content within a container, creating a new version. The original memory is preserved with isLatest=false. Omitted metadata and expiry inherit from the previous version; explicit null forgetAfter clears the expiry.

tools.name: Update Namespace
tools.description: Update the background context used during ingestion and memory formation in an existing namespace. Omit supportingContext to leave it unchanged, or explicitly set it to null to clear it. Requires write access.

tools.name: Update Namespace Document
tools.description: Partially update an existing document in an isolated namespace without changing its stable ID. Supplied content replaces canonical content and is reprocessed; omitted fields remain unchanged. Returns the document ID and processing state, not a guarantee of completed processing.

tools.name: Update Namespace File
tools.description: Partially update a file-backed document in an isolated namespace. Supply a file to replace canonical content, or update metadata and processing context without a file. Omitted metadata and processing context remain unchanged. Returns the document ID and current processing state, not a guarantee of completed processing.

tools.name: Update Organization
tools.description: Update organization-wide background that guides content interpretation and memory formation across every namespace. Provide organizationalContext as a nonempty string to set it, or null to remove the existing context. Requires admin access.

tools.name: Update Settings
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: the legacy v3 API shuts down December 31, 2026. Use v5 organization and namespace settings APIs for new integrations. Update the connected organization's settings, including filtering, custom connector OAuth credentials, chunk size, and profile buckets. Omitted fields are unchanged; explicit nulls are sent to the provider. This changes live organization configuration. Connector client secrets are accepted as input but omitted from the response.

tools.name: Upload Document File
tools.description: Deprecated by the provider: this legacy endpoint shuts down December 31, 2026. Use the v5 namespace file upload endpoint POST /ns/{namespace}/document/file for new integrations. Upload a file as a document for processing, with optional container tags, metadata, and extraction settings. The returned status reports processing state and does not guarantee processing has finished.

tools.name: Upload Namespace File
tools.description: Upload a file into an isolated Supermemory namespace to form searchable knowledge and learned memory. Ingestion returns once safely queued; extraction and memory formation continue asynchronously. The returned status is the document's current processing state, not a guarantee that processing has completed. Use task_type=superrag for retrieval without generating memories.

tools.name: Add or Update Namespace Profile Buckets
tools.description: Add or update namespace-owned profile bucket definitions that guide memory classification. Omitted buckets remain unchanged. Organization-wide buckets are protected and cannot be changed. Returns the effective definitions, including organization buckets. Requires namespace write access.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Open the Supermemory Developer Platform at https://console.supermemory.ai, create or select an organization API key, and copy the key beginning with "sm_". Use an organization key for this toolkit's full cloud REST API access, not a container-scoped key.

name: Supersaas
description: Appointment Scheduling for Every Situation

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in SuperSaaS. Use when you need to add a user to the account. The username is required; all other fields are optional. If a foreign_key is provided, SuperSaaS will use it instead of generating its own ID. Set duplicate='raise' to prevent creating duplicate users with the same foreign key.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a SuperSaaS user by their ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a user from the system.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to read a single user by ID from SuperSaaS. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific user.

tools.name: List Field List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve available fields on Schedule or User objects. Use when you need to discover what custom fields are configured for a schedule or user profile.

tools.name: List User Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user groups defined in a SuperSaaS account. Use when you need to list groups for managing user access or organizing users.

tools.name: List Promotions
tools.description: Tool to list all promotional coupon codes in the account or retrieve a single promotion by code. Use when you need to view available promotions or check details of a specific promotion code.

tools.name: List Schedules
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all schedules in a SuperSaaS account with their IDs and names. Use when you need to list available schedules or get schedule IDs for other operations.

tools.name: List Form Definitions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all form definitions in a SuperSaaS account with their IDs and names. Use when you need to list available forms or get form IDs for other operations.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to list all users in the SuperSaaS account. Use when you need to retrieve users with optional pagination using limit and offset parameters.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing SuperSaaS user by ID. Use when you need to modify user details like name, email, phone, or role.

required.name: username
required.description: Your SuperSaaS account name

required.name: password
required.description: Your API key (used as password for Basic Auth)

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your API key, found in Account Info section of your settings

required.name: generic_id
required.description: Your SuperSaaS account name, found in Account Info section of your settings

name: Supportbee
description: SupportBee is a web-based email support tool that helps businesses organize their customer support emails efficiently.

tools.name: Add Label to Ticket
tools.description: Tool to add a label to a ticket. Use when you need to categorize or tag a ticket with a specific label. The label must already exist in your SupportBee account before adding it to a ticket.

tools.name: Archive SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Tool to archive a SupportBee ticket by its ID. Use when you want to move resolved tickets to the archive.

tools.name: Assign Ticket to Team
tools.description: Assigns a ticket to a team in SupportBee. Use when you need to route a support ticket to a specific team for handling. Note: If the ticket is already assigned to a team and a user, reassigning to another team will remove the user assignee.

tools.name: Create Ticket Comment
tools.description: Creates an internal comment on a ticket in SupportBee. Comments are private notes visible only to agents, not to customers. Use this to add internal notes, observations, or collaborate with team members on a ticket.

tools.name: Create Consequence
tools.description: Creates a new consequence for rules automation in SupportBee. Use when setting up automated actions that should be triggered by rules (e.g., auto-assign tickets, archive, or mark as spam).

tools.name: Create Forwarding Email
tools.description: Create a new forwarding email address for the company in SupportBee. Use this to add new support email addresses that will forward incoming emails to your SupportBee account as tickets.

tools.name: Create Filter
tools.description: Creates a filter in SupportBee by linking a rule with a consequence. Use this after creating both a rule (defining match conditions) and a consequence (defining actions to perform).

tools.name: Create Rule
tools.description: Creates a new automation rule in SupportBee to automatically process tickets based on conditions. Rules allow you to automate ticket workflows by: - Matching tickets based on field conditions (subject, sender, body, etc.) - Automatically applying actions like labeling, archiving, assigning, or setting priority Use this after fetching available labels/teams to get valid IDs for actions. The rule will be evaluated for all new and existing tickets matching the conditions. Returns the created rule's unique ID.

tools.name: Create Snippet
tools.description: Create a reusable snippet (canned response) in SupportBee. Snippets are pre-written text templates that agents can quickly insert into ticket replies. Use this to create standard responses for common customer inquiries like refunds, FAQs, or welcome messages.

tools.name: Create SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Creates a new support ticket in SupportBee with a subject, content, and requester details. Use this action to: - Create tickets from customer inquiries or issues - Assign tickets to specific agents or teams during creation - Add tags and labels for better ticket organization - Include CC recipients to keep stakeholders informed The ticket will be created in an unanswered state and will appear in the inbox unless marked as spam.

tools.name: Create Ticket Reply
tools.description: Create a reply to a support ticket in SupportBee. Replies are sent to customers via email and are visible to them. Use this when you need to respond to a customer's ticket with information, updates, or solutions. Provide the ticket ID and HTML-formatted content for your reply.

tools.name: Create SupportBee User
tools.description: Invites a new user to your SupportBee account. The user will receive an email invitation and can be assigned as an agent (handles tickets), admin (full access), or collaborator (view/comment only). Use this when you need to add team members to your helpdesk programmatically.

tools.name: Delete Snippet
tools.description: Permanently delete a snippet by its ID from SupportBee. Use this action when you need to remove an unwanted or outdated snippet (canned response template). This action is destructive and cannot be undone. To find snippet IDs, use the 'Fetch Snippets' action first.

tools.name: Delete SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Permanently delete a trashed ticket from SupportBee. The ticket must first be moved to trash using the Trash Ticket action before it can be permanently deleted. Only admins can delete trashed tickets. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Fetch Forwarding Emails
tools.description: Retrieve all forwarding email addresses configured for the company. Use this tool to list the support email addresses that forward emails to SupportBee.

tools.name: Fetch SupportBee Labels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom labels. Use when you need to list labels for ticket categorization.

tools.name: Fetch Snippets
tools.description: Fetches saved response snippets (canned responses/templates) from SupportBee. Snippets are reusable text templates that can be inserted into ticket replies. Use this to list available snippets for quick responses.

tools.name: Fetch SupportBee Teams
tools.description: Retrieves all teams in the SupportBee account. Use this to list available teams before assigning tickets to teams or filtering tickets by team. Returns team IDs, names, descriptions, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Avg First Response Time Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve average first response time data points over time. Use when analyzing first-response performance metrics for support tickets. Returns time-series data with response times in seconds and Unix timestamps. Reports require admin API token access. Data is limited to a maximum 30-day window per request.

tools.name: Get Replies Count Report
tools.description: Retrieves replies count report data for the company. Returns time-series data points showing the number of replies over time. The report provides aggregate metrics for the entire company account and includes type information (company/user/team), the entity ID, and the metric name. Requires admin-level API access. Use this to analyze reply volume trends and patterns.

tools.name: Get Ticket
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific SupportBee ticket by its ID. Returns complete ticket details including subject, content, requester, assignee, labels, and reply/comment counts. Use when you need to fetch full details of a single ticket.

tools.name: Get Tickets Count Report
tools.description: Tool to get ticket count data points over time. Use when analyzing ticket volume trends within a specific date range. Supports optional filtering by agent, team, or label.

tools.name: List Ticket Comments
tools.description: Retrieves all internal comments (private agent notes) for a specific ticket. Comments are visible only to agents within the helpdesk, not to customers. Use this to review internal discussion history on a ticket.

tools.name: List Ticket Replies
tools.description: Lists all replies on a specific support ticket in SupportBee. Returns reply content, replier details, timestamps, and attachments. Use this to view the conversation history on a ticket. Returns an empty list if the ticket has no replies yet.

tools.name: List Tickets
tools.description: Tool to list tickets from SupportBee. Returns a paginated list of tickets with optional filters for spam, trash, archived, assigned user/group, labels, and more. Use when you need to retrieve and browse tickets in the helpdesk.

tools.name: List SupportBee Users
tools.description: Retrieves all users and customer groups in your SupportBee company. Use this when you need to list team members, filter by user type (agents/admins vs customer groups), or include invited users who haven't confirmed their accounts yet.

tools.name: Mark SupportBee Ticket as Answered
tools.description: Marks a SupportBee ticket as answered by adding the 'answered' status. Use this after sending a response to a customer to indicate the ticket has been addressed. This action is idempotent - calling it on an already answered ticket has no adverse effect.

tools.name: Mark SupportBee Ticket as Spam
tools.description: Tool to mark a SupportBee ticket as spam. Use when you need to flag unwanted or malicious ticket submissions after obtaining the ticket ID.

tools.name: Mark SupportBee Ticket as Unanswered
tools.description: Marks a SupportBee ticket as unanswered by removing its 'answered' status. Use this to revert a ticket's status after it was previously marked as answered, typically when additional follow-up is needed from the support team. This action is idempotent - calling it on an already unanswered ticket has no adverse effect.

tools.name: Remove Label From Ticket
tools.description: Tool to remove a label from a ticket. Use when you need to unlabel or uncategorize a ticket by removing an existing label.

tools.name: Search SupportBee Tickets
tools.description: Tool to search SupportBee tickets. Use when you need to find tickets by query with pagination.

tools.name: Show Ticket Reply
tools.description: Tool to fetch a specific reply for a SupportBee ticket. Use when you need details of a single reply by ticket and reply IDs.

tools.name: Show SupportBee User or Customer Group
tools.description: Retrieves details of a SupportBee user (agent/admin) or customer group by their ID. Use this action when you need to fetch profile information like name, email, role, or timestamps for a specific user whose ID you already have (e.g., from a ticket response).

tools.name: Trash SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Tool to trash a SupportBee ticket by its ID. Use when you need to remove a ticket into the trash folder.

tools.name: Unarchive SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Tool to unarchive a SupportBee ticket by its ID. Use when you need to restore an archived ticket back to active status.

tools.name: Unassign Ticket from Team
tools.description: Tool to un-assign a ticket from its assigned team. Use when you need to remove the current team ownership before reassigning or closing the ticket.

tools.name: Unassign User From Ticket
tools.description: Tool to un-assign a ticket from its assigned user/agent. Use when you need to remove the current user ownership before reassigning to a different user or closing the ticket.

tools.name: Unmark SupportBee Ticket as Spam
tools.description: Tool to unmark a SupportBee ticket as spam. Use when a ticket was incorrectly flagged as spam.

tools.name: Untrash SupportBee Ticket
tools.description: Restores a trashed SupportBee ticket back to active status. Use when you need to recover a ticket that was previously moved to trash.

tools.name: Update Snippet
tools.description: Update an existing snippet (canned response) in SupportBee. Use this to modify the name, content, or tags of a snippet. To find snippet IDs, use the 'Fetch Snippets' action first.

tools.name: Update SupportBee User
tools.description: Update an existing SupportBee user's profile information including name, email, role, avatar, or signature. This action modifies user account details via the SupportBee API. You can update one or multiple fields in a single request. Commonly used to change user roles (agent/admin), update contact information, or customize user profiles. Requirements: - Valid user ID (obtain from SUPPORTBEE_CREATE_USER_OR_CUSTOMER_GROUP or other user-related actions) - At least one field to update (name, email, role, avatar_url, or signature) Common use cases: - Promote an agent to admin by updating the role field - Update user email addresses when they change - Customize user signatures for support ticket replies

required.name: subdomain
required.description: The account name used as the subdomain for your SupportBee instance (e.g., in https://{account_name}.supportbee.com).

required.name: generic_token
required.description: The API token used for authenticating requests to the SupportBee API.

name: Supportivekoala
description: Supportivekoala is a platform that automates image generation using customizable templates, enabling users to create visual content programmatically through API integration.

tools.name: Create Image
tools.description: Tool to create a new image based on a template. Use when you have selected your template and prepared modifications.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new template for image generation. Use after gathering template details.

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Tool to list images associated with the authenticated user. Use after confirming authentication.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all templates. Use when you need to list all templates for the authenticated user.

tools.name: Register User
tools.description: Tool to register a new user account. Use after collecting valid user credentials.

tools.name: Retrieve Template by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a template by ID. Use when you have a valid template ID and need full template details. Use after confirming this detail.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the Supportivekoala API.

name: SureContact
description: SureContact is a marketing automation and CRM platform for managing contacts, companies, deals, campaigns, lists, forms, purchases, reports, and related workflows.

tools.name: Create Campaign Draft
tools.description: Create a campaign in draft status without sending or scheduling email. Optionally configure content, sender details, tracking, and recipient filters for later review in SureContact.

tools.name: Create Landing Page Draft
tools.description: Create a landing page in draft status without publishing it or making a public URL live. Optionally initialize the draft from page-builder design JSON or an existing page template.

tools.name: Create Segment
tools.description: Create a tag or contact list. A dynamic list continuously evaluates its filters; a static list is manually managed.

tools.name: Create Task
tools.description: Create an actionable workspace task linked to one or more contacts and optionally assign it. Workspace notification settings may notify the assignee.

tools.name: Enroll Contact In Sequence
tools.description: Enroll one contact in an active sequence by UUID or email. This irreversible operation is asynchronous and can trigger sequence actions, including real external email, shortly after the request is accepted.

tools.name: Get Campaign Performance
tools.description: Get campaign details, live sending progress, or one page of per-contact delivery and engagement results without changing campaign state.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Retrieve one contact by UUID or email address without changing it.

tools.name: Get Report
tools.description: Read one SureContact analytics report for a selected date range: overview, contact growth, email sending, email engagement, link clicks, unsubscribes, bounces, ecommerce revenue, products, or campaign summary.

tools.name: List Campaigns
tools.description: Search and page through email campaigns by lifecycle status without changing them.

tools.name: List Contacts
tools.description: Search and page through contacts in the connected workspace without changing them.

tools.name: List Contact Timeline
tools.description: Page through either notes or activities for one contact, newest first, without changing the timeline.

tools.name: List Form Submissions
tools.description: Search and page through submissions captured by one form without changing them.

tools.name: List Marketing Assets
tools.description: List one page of forms, email templates, or landing pages available for campaigns and lead capture.

tools.name: List Purchases
tools.description: Page through tracked purchases with optional contact, status, and source filters.

tools.name: List Segments
tools.description: List tags or lists used to segment contacts, with search and archive filtering where supported.

tools.name: List Tasks
tools.description: Page through workspace tasks without changing completion or assignment state.

tools.name: List Workflows
tools.description: List automations or email sequences available in the workspace without starting them.

tools.name: Log Contact Interaction
tools.description: Create a note or activity on a contact's timeline. This permanently adds workspace-visible history attributed to the API-key owner.

tools.name: Record Purchase
tools.description: Record an external purchase in SureContact without charging a payment method. Identifying the buyer by email may create a new contact.

tools.name: Send Email
tools.description: Queue one email for immediate asynchronous delivery to one external recipient. Executing this action sends a real external email and may create engagement tracking events; it does not create a draft or preview and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Set Contact Status
tools.description: Change a contact's deliverability or subscription status. Setting unsubscribed, bounced, invalid, or complained can stop future messaging.

tools.name: Set Task Completion
tools.description: Mark a task done or reopen it as not done. This immediately changes the task's completion state.

tools.name: Start Contact Automation
tools.description: Start an active automation for one contact. This irreversible operation is asynchronous and can trigger actions, including real external email, shortly after the request is accepted; it does not wait for those actions to finish.

tools.name: Unenroll Contact From Sequence
tools.description: Synchronously cancel a contact's active executions in a sequence and mark its subscriber state as cancelled. The response reports cancelled_executions; zero means the idempotent request found no active execution. Actions already sent or completed cannot be undone.

tools.name: Update Contact Memberships
tools.description: Attach or detach one or more tags or lists from a contact. This immediately changes segmentation and can affect campaign or automation targeting.

tools.name: Upsert Contact
tools.description: Create a contact when the email is new or update the existing contact with supplied fields. Supplied tag and list UUIDs are appended and never replace existing memberships.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Log in to SureContact, open Profile in the top bar, then select API Keys and create a key. Always enable the read ability because SureContact validates the connection with the read-protected contacts endpoint. Also enable write or delete for tools that require those abilities, and copy the key immediately because SureContact will not show it again.

name: Surf
description: Surf provides AI-ready financial, crypto, prediction-market, equity, on-chain, news, search, and web data through a unified API.

tools.name: Cancel Asynchronous Blockchain SQL Job
tools.description: Durably request cancellation of an asynchronous blockchain SQL job and return its current state. Queued jobs become canceled immediately; running queries stop asynchronously, so poll the job until it is canceled or failed.

tools.name: Submit Asynchronous Blockchain SQL Job
tools.description: Submit a read-only ClickHouse SQL query for durable background execution and return its stable job and query identifiers immediately. Equivalent retained queries with the same max_rows, or requests reusing an Idempotency-Key, return the existing job.

tools.name: DEX Token OHLCV Price
tools.description: Return USD DEX-pool-weighted OHLCV bars for one token identified by chain and contract address. Use this for DEX-native or newly launched tokens; use the standard market price action for major listed assets.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Equity Balance Sheet
tools.description: Return standardized balance-sheet periods for a US-listed equity. Each metric includes an availability status, and unavailable values are null.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 6 credits ($0.036) per request

tools.name: Equity Price Candles
tools.description: Return historical OHLCV candles and the latest traded price for a US-listed equity. Candles are ordered by timestamp ascending; historical data and the latest price use independent freshness windows.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Equity Cash Flow
tools.description: Return paginated standardized cash-flow periods for a US-listed equity. The response preserves serving-layer values, status, origin, and period metadata.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 6 credits ($0.036) per request

tools.name: Equity Profile
tools.description: Return a standardized stock company profile or ETF product profile, including its business description and source-update metadata.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Equity Financial Metrics
tools.description: Return paginated standardized financial ratios, growth measures, per-share values, and valuation metrics for a US-listed equity.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Equity Income Statement
tools.description: Return standardized income-statement periods for a US-listed equity. The API passes through available periods and does not synthesize missing periods or financial values.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 6 credits ($0.036) per request

tools.name: Latest Equity Filings
tools.description: Return the most recently accepted periodic SEC filings across US equities. Includes 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F, 40-F and amendments, excludes 8-K, and returns one filing per reporting series.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Latest Equity Financials
tools.description: Return the most recently published current-serving TTM financials across US equities, optionally filtered by a minimum current market capitalization. Results contain one company per reporting series.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Equity Metadata
tools.description: Return lightweight identity, logo, and latest USD price metadata for one or more US-listed stocks or ETFs. Symbols are returned in request order. Company and fund identity is cached for 24 hours; prices are cached independently for 1 minute.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Equity Financial Overview
tools.description: Return a paginated financial overview for a US-listed equity. Values are served as reported or derived by the financial-data serving layer; missing values remain explicit nulls and are not recalculated by this API.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Exchange Order Book Depth
tools.description: Return bid and ask order-book levels for an exchange market, including spread, spread percentage, mid-price, and total bid and ask depth.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange Funding Rate History
tools.description: Return historical funding rate records for a perpetual contract.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange OHLCV Candlesticks
tools.description: Return exchange OHLCV candlesticks with high, low, and total-volume statistics for the returned period. Set `type` to a perpetual-market variant to query perpetual contracts instead of spot markets.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange Long/Short Ratio History
tools.description: Return historical long/short ratios for a perpetual contract.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange Trading Pairs
tools.description: Return trading pairs available on an exchange, including base and quote currencies, market type, active status, and default fee rates. Use the returned pair values with other exchange actions.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange Perpetual Contract Snapshot
tools.description: Return a perpetual futures snapshot for a trading pair, including current funding, open interest, mark price, and index price data.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Exchange Ticker Price
tools.description: Return the real-time ticker for an exchange trading pair, including the last price, best bid and ask, 24-hour high, low, volume, and price change.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Fund Profile Detail
tools.description: Return a crypto VC fund's full profile, including its description, jurisdiction, unique invested-project count, links, X accounts, team members, and recent research. This does not return individual investments.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Account Portfolio
tools.description: Return a Hyperliquid wallet's point-in-time portfolio across perpetuals, spot, vaults, and HYPE staking. Use total_value_usd for the best-effort whole-account value and unpriced_token_count to determine whether it excludes unpriced spot holdings.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 3 credits ($0.018) per request

tools.name: Market Candles
tools.description: Return Hyperliquid market OHLCV candles ordered by open time ascending for a required half-open [from_, to) window. The window may contain at most 5,000 candles, so use a larger interval or narrower dates for long histories. This market-data action does not require a wallet address.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Open & Recent Orders
tools.description: Return a wallet's live resting orders and recent terminal orders. Use the open section to inspect active stops, take-profits, and limits, and the historical section for final filled, canceled, or rejected statuses.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Trading Performance
tools.description: Return a wallet's lifetime funding-excluded realized trading performance, live open positions, unrealized PnL, and perpetual clearinghouse equity. This point-in-time summary has no date window or trade list; use account portfolio data when spot and vault equity must be included.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 3 credits ($0.018) per request

tools.name: Open Positions
tools.description: Return a wallet's open Hyperliquid perpetual positions with leverage, unrealized PnL, ROE, funding, liquidation risk, and its cross-margin summary. When a cross position has no liquidation price, use the account-level margin_ratio as the liquidation-proximity signal.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Closed Trade Funding and Leverage
tools.description: Return immutable funding and leverage context for one closed Hyperliquid trade using the composite key from the trades action. Use funding_status to distinguish a real zero from unavailable funding history; leverage fields may be omitted when the completed-trade source has no value.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Closed Trades Aggregate
tools.description: Aggregate a wallet's closed Hyperliquid trades by UTC day, symbol, direction, notional-size tier, or holding-time tier. Returns server-side P&L, fee, funding-coverage, win-rate, and volume rollups in one bounded, non-paginated response; use daily groups for a realized equity curve.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 4 credits ($0.024) per request

tools.name: Kalshi Open Interest History
tools.description: Return daily open-interest history for one Kalshi market over a selected time window. Data refreshes approximately every 30 minutes.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Kalshi Price History
tools.description: Return hourly or daily OHLC price history for one Kalshi market, or the latest price from recent trades. Surf refreshes this data about every 30 minutes.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Kalshi Volume History
tools.description: Return daily notional trading-volume history for one Kalshi market over a selected time window. Surf refreshes this data about every 30 minutes.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: ETF Flow History
tools.description: Return daily spot ETF flow history for BTC, ETH, XRP, SOL, or HYPE, including net USD flow, closing token price, settlement status, and per-ticker flow breakdowns.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Fear & Greed Index History
tools.description: Return Bitcoin Fear and Greed Index history, including each 0-100 index value, its classification, and the Bitcoin price at that time. Results are sorted newest first and can be bounded by a date or Unix-time range.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Futures Market Overview
tools.description: Return a single ranked snapshot of futures market data across all tracked tokens, including open interest, funding rate, long/short ratio, and 24-hour volume. The endpoint returns the complete list and does not support symbol filtering or pagination.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Liquidation Chart
tools.description: Return time-bucketed aggregate long- and short-side liquidation volumes for a token on a specific exchange and interval.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Liquidation by Exchange
tools.description: Return a single ranked snapshot of total, long-side, and short-side liquidation volumes by exchange for a token and aggregation window.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: On-Chain Indicator
tools.description: Return daily on-chain indicator history for BTC or ETH, including NUPL, SOPR, MVRV, Puell Multiple, NVM, NVT, NVT Golden Cross, and exchange-flow metrics. Responses are capped at about 100 points; when meta.has_more is true, split the requested date range into smaller windows.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Options Market Data
tools.description: Return options market data for one supported token, including open interest, 24-hour volume, put/call ratio, and max pain price by exchange.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Token Price History
tools.description: Return historical prices for one listed token in a selected quote currency. Use a predefined window or paired custom bounds; Surf automatically chooses 5-minute, hourly, or daily granularity based on the range.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Technical Indicator
tools.description: Return a technical indicator for a trading pair on a given exchange and candlestick interval. Omit from_ and to for the latest value, or provide a time range for a bounded series.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 1 credit ($0.006) per request

tools.name: Public Sale / Crowdsale
tools.description: Return public sale information for a project resolved by Surf UUID, name, or token symbol, including sale type, status, dates, token price, funds raised, supply allocation, launchpad, and all-time-high ROI.

price.description: $0.006 per credit used; typically 2 credits ($0.012) per request

tools.name: Token Generation Event
