required.description: Your current Typecast Developer API key. Create or copy it from the Typecast API Console at https://studio.typecast.ai/developers/api, then enter it here exactly as shown. It is sent verbatim in the X-API-KEY header without a Bearer prefix.

name: Typeform
description: Build beautiful, interactive forms that people love to fill out. Collect data, accept payments, and integrate with your favorite tools.

tools.name: Create Account Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in a specific Typeform account. Use when you need to create a workspace within a particular account using the account ID.

tools.name: Create Form
tools.description: Tool to create a new Typeform form with customizable fields, logic, and settings. Use when you need to programmatically create a form with specific questions, welcome screens, thank you screens, and conditional logic.

tools.name: Create Image
tools.description: Tool to upload a new image to your Typeform account via base64 encoding or URL. Use when you need to add images for forms or presentations. Either 'image' (base64) or 'url' parameter must be provided.

tools.name: Create or Update Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook or update an existing one for a specified Typeform. Use when you need to configure webhooks to receive form response notifications at a specified URL.

tools.name: Create Theme
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom theme in Typeform with colors, fonts, background, and layout settings. Use when you need to create a theme for branding and styling Typeform forms.

tools.name: Create Workspace
tools.description: Tool to create a new workspace in Typeform. Use when organizing forms into separate workspaces for teams or projects.

tools.name: Delete Form
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a Typeform and all of its responses. Use when you need to remove a form completely from the account.

tools.name: Delete Image
tools.description: Tool to delete an image from your Typeform account. Use when you need to remove an image that is no longer needed. Returns a success status once the image has been deleted (204 No Content).

tools.name: Delete Responses
tools.description: Tool to delete specific responses from a Typeform by response IDs. Use when you need to remove response data from a form. Deletion is asynchronous - a 200 status means the deletion request was registered, not that deletion is complete. Maximum 1000 response IDs can be deleted per request.

tools.name: Delete Theme
tools.description: Tool to delete a theme from your Typeform account. Use when you need to permanently remove a theme. This operation cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook configuration from a Typeform form. Use when you need to remove a webhook from a specific form. The operation returns 204 No Content on success and 404 if the webhook is not found.

tools.name: Delete Workspace
tools.description: Tool to delete a workspace from your Typeform account. Use when you need to remove a workspace. Note: The default 'My Workspace' cannot be deleted, and workspaces containing forms cannot be deleted (will return an error).

tools.name: Get About Me
tools.description: Get information about the owner account in Typeform.

tools.name: Get All Response Files
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a compressed archive containing all files that respondents uploaded for a specified form. Use when you need to download all file uploads from a Typeform form as a ZIP archive.

tools.name: Get Background By Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a background image by size from Typeform. Use when you need to get a background image in a specific size (default, tablet, mobile, or thumbnail). Images are scaled and cropped from top-left alignment to fill the screen properly.

tools.name: Get Choice Image By Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a choice image by size from Typeform. Use when you need to download images used in picture_choice question options at specific sizes.

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific form's complete configuration including fields, logic, settings, and theme. Use when you need to get detailed information about a Typeform form.

tools.name: Get Form Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom messages for a Typeform including button labels, error messages, and UI text. Use when you need to get the current message configuration for a form.

tools.name: Get Form Responses
tools.description: Tool to retrieve form responses from Typeform with filtering by date, pagination, search, and response type. Use when you need to get responses for a specific form including timestamps of when users landed on and submitted the form. Note: Recent responses may take up to 30 minutes to appear.

tools.name: Get Image By Size
tools.description: Tool to retrieve an image in a specific size from Typeform. Use when you need to get a Typeform image optimized for different display contexts (default for desktop, mobile for mobile devices, or thumbnail for previews).

tools.name: Get Theme
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific theme's configuration including colors, fonts, and layout settings. Use when you need to get the design settings of a Typeform theme.

tools.name: Get Webhook
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a single webhook by specifying both the form ID and webhook tag. Use when you need to get details about a specific webhook configuration.

tools.name: Get Workspace
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific workspace including its name, forms, and team members. Use when you need to get workspace details or check member access.

tools.name: List Forms
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all forms in your Typeform account with filtering, pagination, and sorting options. Use when you need to list, search, or browse forms across workspaces. Supports filtering by search terms, workspace, and sorting by creation or modification date.

tools.name: List Images
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all images in your Typeform account in reverse-chronological order. Use when you need to list or browse available images.

tools.name: List Typeform Themes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of themes in your Typeform account. Use when you need to access available themes for form styling. Returns both public and private themes with their styling configurations.

tools.name: List Form Webhooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks associated with a specified typeform. Use when you need to view webhook configurations for a form. Returns webhook IDs, URLs, enabled status, event types, and timestamps.

tools.name: List Workspaces
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all workspaces in a Typeform account with their IDs, names, form counts, and members. Use when you need to list available workspaces or search for specific workspaces by name.

tools.name: Patch Form
tools.description: Tool to partially update a Typeform using JSON Patch operations. Use when you need to modify specific fields without replacing the entire form. Supports updating title, settings, theme, workspace, and other form properties.

tools.name: Update Theme (Partial)
tools.description: Tool to partially update a Typeform theme by ID. Updates only the specified properties while leaving other theme settings unchanged. Each provided field must be complete (e.g., if updating colors, all color subfields must be provided). Cannot modify Typeform's public built-in themes.

tools.name: Update Form
tools.description: Tool to update an existing Typeform by completely replacing its configuration. PUT request overwrites the entire form - any fields not included will be deleted along with their response data. Always retrieve the form first using Get Form, modify the desired properties, then send the complete updated form definition.

tools.name: Update Form Messages
tools.description: Tool to update custom messages for form UI elements like buttons, errors, and placeholders in Typeform. Use when you need to customize the text displayed to form respondents.

tools.name: Update Theme
tools.description: Tool to update a theme's complete definition in Typeform. Use when you need to update all aspects of a theme including colors, fonts, and visual properties. This is a full update (PUT) operation that requires name, font, and colors to be provided. For partial updates, use PATCH instead.

tools.name: Update Workspace
tools.description: Tool to update a workspace's name or manage team member access (add/remove members) in Typeform. Use when you need to rename a workspace or modify its member list using JSON Patch operations.

tools.name: Upload Video
tools.description: Initiate a video upload to Typeform by obtaining a signed upload URL. Use this action to prepare for uploading a video file to a specific form field. After receiving the upload_url, use it to upload the actual video file via a PUT request.

triggers.name: New Form Response
triggers.description: Triggers when a respondent completes and submits the form.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Typless
description: Typless is an AI-powered document extraction platform that automates manual data entry from various documents using a simple API.

tools.name: Get Document Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all document types available in the account. Use when you need to view or select schemas for document processing.

tools.name: Get User Profile
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated user profile. Use after authentication to confirm account details.

tools.name: Update User Profile
tools.description: Updates the authenticated user's Typless profile information. Use this tool when the user wants to change their full name or newsletter subscription preference. Note: Only full_name and newsletter_subscription can be modified. Other fields like email, company, phone_number are read-only and cannot be changed via this endpoint. Example prompts: "Update my name to John Smith", "Unsubscribe me from the newsletter"

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Typless API key used for authentication.

name: U301
description: U301 provides an API to manage all U301 resources, currently under development.

tools.name: Delete a shortened link
tools.description: Tool to delete a shortened link by its link identifier. Use when you need to remove a shortened link from the system.

tools.name: List available domains for URL shortening
tools.description: Tool to list available domains for URL shortening, including public domains and custom domains. Use when you need to see what domains are available for creating short links. Supports pagination and filtering by visibility type.

tools.name: Shorten a long URL
tools.description: Tool to shorten a long URL into a compact short link. Use after obtaining the long URL when you need a shareable link.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the U301 API.

name: UniFi
description: Monitor UniFi Site Manager inventory, internet health metrics, and SD-WAN configurations across the connected UI account's sites. This toolkit excludes arbitrary Cloud Connector requests and all local Network, Protect, Mobility, Carrier Fabric, and InnerSpace API surfaces.

tools.name: Get Host
tools.description: Get detailed information for one UniFi host by the Site Manager host ID returned by List Hosts.

tools.name: Get ISP Metrics
tools.description: Get ISP performance metrics for all accessible sites, optionally limited by a relative duration or explicit timestamp bounds.

tools.name: Get SD-WAN Config
tools.description: Get the topology and settings of one SD-WAN configuration by ID.

tools.name: Get SD-WAN Config Status
tools.description: Get deployment, generation, WAN, tunnel, warning, and error status for one SD-WAN configuration.

tools.name: List Devices
tools.description: List UniFi devices managed by hosts where the connected UI account is an owner or super admin. Results are grouped by host and can be filtered by host ID or by the last processed device timestamp.

tools.name: List Hosts
tools.description: List UniFi hosts associated with the connected UI account. Use the returned host IDs with device filters, site metrics, and host detail tools.

tools.name: List SD-WAN Configs
tools.description: List the SD-WAN configurations associated with the connected UI account.

tools.name: List Sites
tools.description: List sites from UniFi Network applications associated with the connected UI account. Use returned host and site IDs for selected-site ISP metrics.

tools.name: Query ISP Metrics
tools.description: Get ISP performance metrics for selected host/site pairs. Each site can specify its own RFC3339 time bounds. Always inspect partial_success, status, and message: UniFi can return usable metrics for only the accessible subset with HTTP 200.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy a cloud API key at https://unifi.ui.com/settings/api-keys while signed in to the UI account whose UniFi hosts and sites you want to monitor. This toolkit uses the key only for the direct Site Manager inventory, ISP metrics, and SD-WAN operations on api.ui.com; do not enter a local UniFi application key or Carrier Fabric ISP key.

name: Unione
description: UniOne is an email delivery service offering a versatile Web API and SMTP API for sending transactional and marketing emails.

tools.name: Delete Event Dump
tools.description: Tool to delete an event dump file and remove it from the queue or storage. Use when you need to clean up an existing event dump by its dump_id.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Tool to delete a template by ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a template from the account.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook event notification handler by its URL. Use when you need to stop receiving callback notifications for a specific webhook.

tools.name: UniOne Email Balance
tools.description: Tool to retrieve current account balance. Use when you need to check your email usage and limits before sending large campaigns.

tools.name: Cancel Scheduled Email
tools.description: Tool to cancel a scheduled transactional email by its job ID. Use when you need to stop a pending email send before it's dispatched.

tools.name: UniOne Email Domain Management
tools.description: Tool to manage sender domains in UniOne. Use when you need DNS records for verification, trigger verification or DKIM checks, list domains, or delete a domain.

tools.name: Get Email Event
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific email event by its ID. Use when you need event information for auditing or diagnostics.

tools.name: Get Email Send Job
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific email send job. Use when you need its delivery metrics and history.

tools.name: UniOne Email List (Export)
tools.description: Tool to export email events within a specified time frame. It creates an asynchronous event dump which can later be downloaded and parsed using UNIONE_EVENT_DUMP_GET.

tools.name: Resend Sent Email
tools.description: Tool to resend a previously sent email by its job ID. Use when you need to trigger a resend of an email that has already been sent and you have the original job ID.

tools.name: UniOne Email Resubscribe
tools.description: Tool to resubscribe a recipient who previously unsubscribed. Use when you need to restore a user's subscription status after they opt in again.

tools.name: Resume Paused Email
tools.description: Tool to resume a paused transactional email by its job ID. Use when you need to restart a paused pending email send.

tools.name: UniOne Email SMTP Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve SMTP server details and credentials. Use when you need to configure your mail client or library for SMTP sending.

tools.name: UniOne Email Statistics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve email sending statistics over a specified time range. This action uses UniOne's event-dump aggregate API under the hood to compute daily statistics.

tools.name: UniOne Email Unsubscribe
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe an email from future emails. Use when you need to stop all further transactional emails.

tools.name: Batch Email Validation
tools.description: Tool to validate multiple email addresses in a batch. Use when you need to verify deliverability for a list of emails at once.

tools.name: Remove Email from Suppression List
tools.description: Tool to remove an email from the suppression list. Use when you need to re-enable sending emails to an address that was previously unsubscribed or suppressed.

tools.name: Retry Email Validation
tools.description: Tool to retry an email validation request. Updated to re-run validation via the official single validation endpoint using the provided email address.

tools.name: UniOne Email Webhook Types
tools.description: Tool to retrieve supported email webhook event types. Use when configuring your webhook callbacks.

tools.name: Create Event Dump
tools.description: Tool to create an asynchronous CSV event dump. Use when you need to export transactional email events for a specified time window.

tools.name: UniOne Event Dump List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full list of event dumps. Use when you need to view all existing event-dump tasks.

tools.name: Get Event Dump
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status and download URLs of an event dump. Use when you need to check if a dump is ready and get its files.

tools.name: Get Email Suppression Details
tools.description: Tool to check if an email is suppressed and retrieve the reason and date. Use when verifying why an email cannot receive messages.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Tool to get template properties by ID. Use when you need to retrieve the full template configuration and content for a specific template.

tools.name: Get Webhook Configuration
tools.description: Tool to retrieve webhook configuration by its URL. Use when you need to check the current settings of an event notification handler.

tools.name: Schedule Email
tools.description: Tool to schedule a transactional email up to 24 hours ahead. Use when you need to send an email at a specific future time.

tools.name: Suppression List
tools.description: Tool to return the suppression list since a given date. Use when auditing bounced, unsubscribed, or blocked recipients.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific tag. Use when you have confirmed the tag ID you wish to remove.

tools.name: UniOne Tag List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user-defined tags. Use when you need to fetch the full list of tags after authentication.

tools.name: UniOne Template List
tools.description: Tool to list email templates. Use when you need to retrieve available templates for transactional emails.

tools.name: Set Template
tools.description: Tool to set or update an email template. Use when you need to create or modify transactional email templates before sending messages.

tools.name: Set Webhook
tools.description: Tool to set or edit a webhook event notification handler. Use when you need to configure your webhook for event callbacks.

required.name: region
required.description: The region-specific subdomain for the UniOne API, such as 'us1' for the USA or 'eu1' for Europe.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key for authenticating requests to the UniOne API.

name: Unipile
description: Unipile provides a unified API for messaging, email, calendar, and social platform accounts.

tools.name: List Accounts
tools.description: List provider accounts connected to the Unipile deployment, including their IDs and source health statuses.

required.name: hostUrl
required.description: Copy your DSN from the Unipile v1 dashboard. Enter only the customer API host and its custom port when shown, for example api1.unipile.com:13111. Do not include https://, a path, query parameters, or a trailing slash.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate or copy your v1 Access Token from https://dashboard.unipile.com/access-tokens. Unipile treats this token as an API key with broad privileges, so keep it secret and do not expose it in client-side code or public repositories.

name: Unisender
description: UniSender is a simple and easy-to-use service for email and SMS marketing campaigns

tools.name: Check Email Status
tools.description: Tool to check the delivery status of emails sent via sendEmail method. Use when you need to verify email delivery status by email IDs. Statuses are stored for approximately one month. Rate limited to 300 requests per 60 seconds.

tools.name: Create Email Template
tools.description: Tool to create a new email template for mass campaigns in UniSender. Use when you need to create a reusable email template with customizable title, subject, body content, and sender information.

tools.name: Create Field
tools.description: Tool to create a new custom field for contact data in UniSender. Use when you need to add a custom field that can store additional contact information and be used in email message substitutions.

tools.name: Create List
tools.description: Tool to create a new contact list for organizing thematic email campaigns in UniSender. Use when you need to create a new mailing list with a unique title. The list title must be unique within the account.

tools.name: Create Subscriber Note
tools.description: Tool to create a note for a subscriber contact in UniSender. Use when you need to add a new note to a subscriber's profile. Notes created via API have an 'origin' field set to 'api'.

tools.name: Delete Field
tools.description: Tool to remove a custom field from the Unisender system. Use when you need to permanently delete a custom field and all its associated contact data.

tools.name: Delete List
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a contact list from your UniSender account. Use when you need to remove a mailing list by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Subscriber Note
tools.description: Tool to delete a subscriber note from UniSender by its ID. Use when you need to remove a note associated with a subscriber/contact from the system.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Tool to delete a tag by its ID and remove it from all associated contacts. Use when you need to remove a tag from your UniSender account.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Tool to remove a template from the UniSender account. Use when you need to permanently delete a template by its ID.

tools.name: Exclude Contact from Lists
tools.description: Tool to remove contacts from specified lists or all lists in UniSender. Use when you need to exclude a contact (email or phone) from mailing lists. Unlike unsubscribe, exclude actually removes the contact from lists, allowing them to be re-added later using the subscribe method. Recommended when subscription management is performed by sender's initiative.

tools.name: Export Contacts
tools.description: Tool to export contact data from UniSender lists for synchronization. Use when you need to export email addresses, phone numbers, and custom fields from lists. This method works asynchronously - the response contains a task_uuid for tracking export status.

tools.name: Get Campaigns
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of campaigns from Unisender within a specified date range. Use when you need to fetch email campaign information with optional filtering by date and pagination support. Returns up to 10,000 campaigns per request.

tools.name: Get Campaign Status
tools.description: Tool to check the current status of a campaign in UniSender. Use when you need to verify campaign progress or completion status. Returns detailed status information including creation time and start time.

tools.name: Get Contact
tools.description: Tool to get information about a single contact from UniSender. Use when you need to retrieve detailed contact data including email/phone status, custom fields, list memberships, and engagement statistics. Either email or contact_id must be provided.

tools.name: Get Contact Field Values
tools.description: Tool to retrieve custom field values for a specific contact identified by email address. Use when you need to get additional field data associated with a contact. You can optionally specify which fields to retrieve by providing field IDs.

tools.name: Get Fields
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom user-defined fields for contact personalization and data management. Use when creating integrations to map fields between systems or to retrieve available custom fields for contacts.

tools.name: Get Lists
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all existing mailing lists associated with the account. Use when you need to get list IDs and titles before sending emails or SMS to a list, or to display available contact lists.

tools.name: Get Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of all messages with body and attachments. Use when you need complete message information including content and attachments, unlike listMessages which returns only metadata.

tools.name: Get Sender Domain List
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about sender domains and their DKIM status. Use when you need to check which domains are registered for sending emails and their verification status.

tools.name: Get Tags
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom tags/labels for contact segmentation. Use when you need to list all available tags in the Unisender account.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific email template by its ID. Use when you need to fetch template details including metadata, content, creation details, and formatting information.

tools.name: Get Templates
tools.description: Tool to retrieve list of all templates with full content including body. Use when you need complete template information including raw_body and body fields, unlike listTemplates which returns templates without body content.

tools.name: Import Contacts (Bulk)
tools.description: Tool to bulk import contacts to UniSender with maximum 500 contacts per call. Use when you need to import multiple contacts at once with their fields, list subscriptions, and tags. Supports creating new contacts, updating existing ones, and managing list subscriptions. UniSender automatically validates emails and filters spam-traps.

tools.name: Check if Contact is in Lists
tools.description: Tool to check if a contact exists in specified mailing lists based on and/or conditions. Use when you need to verify whether a contact is a member of specific lists. The condition parameter allows checking if the contact is in all lists (and) or at least one list (or).

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Tool to list all messages without body and attachments. Use when you need to browse available messages created via API or web interface.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Tool to list email templates without body content. Use when you need to browse available templates created via API or web interface.

tools.name: Subscribe Contact to Lists
tools.description: Tool to add contacts to one or multiple mailing lists with optional tags and field values. Use when you need to subscribe a contact (email and/or phone) to Unisender lists. This method adds contacts individually and can override existing contact data based on the overwrite parameter. Contacts previously excluded can be re-added using this action.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Contact
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe contacts from mailing lists in UniSender. Use when a contact initiates opt-out from campaigns. This marks contacts as 'unsubscribed' rather than excluding them - the active status can only be restored by the contact clicking an activation link.

tools.name: Update Email Template
tools.description: Tool to update an existing email template for mass campaigns. Use when you need to modify template properties like title, subject, body content, sender information, or language settings. Only the fields you specify will be updated.

tools.name: Update Field
tools.description: Tool to modify parameters of an existing custom field in UniSender. Use when you need to change field properties like name, display name, type, visibility, or display position.

tools.name: Update List
tools.description: Tool to update the parameters of an existing contact list in UniSender. Use when you need to change the title, pre-subscription URL, or post-subscription URL of an existing mailing list.

tools.name: Update Subscriber Note
tools.description: Tool to update the content of an existing subscriber note in UniSender. Use when you need to edit or modify the content of a previously created note attached to a subscriber.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Access your API key in the "Integration and API" section of your UniSender account at https://cp.unisender.com/en/v5/user/info/api

name: Uniswap Api
description: Uniswap Trading API for executing swaps and managing liquidity across 25+ blockchain networks

tools.name: Check Token Approval
tools.description: Tool to check if a wallet has sufficient token approval for a specified transaction amount. Returns an approval transaction if needed, or null if approval already exists. Use this before executing a swap to verify or obtain the necessary token approval.

tools.name: Check Wallet Delegation
tools.description: Get the current delegation status and message for a smart contract wallet across different chains. Returns delegation information for each chain ID in the request, including whether the wallet is delegated, the delegate address, and delegator information. Use when checking if a smart contract wallet has delegated its swap permissions to another address or if someone has delegated to it.

tools.name: Encode 7702 transactions
tools.description: Encode a list of transactions into a single transaction for smart contract wallet execution (EIP-7702). All transactions must have the same chainId. Use when you need to batch multiple transactions into a single smart contract wallet transaction for atomic execution.

tools.name: Get Gasless Orders
tools.description: Retrieve one or more gasless orders from Uniswap, optionally filtered by query parameters. Must include at least one of: orderId, orderIds, orderStatus, swapper, or filler. Use when you need to check the status or details of Uniswap gasless orders (UniswapX orders).

tools.name: Get Quote
tools.description: Requests a quote according to the specified swap parameters. This endpoint may be used to get a quote for a swap, a bridge, or a wrap/unwrap. The resulting response includes a quote for the swap and the proposed route by which the quote was achieved, along with estimated gas fees. Use when you need to get a quote for a token swap before executing the transaction.

tools.name: Get swappable tokens
tools.description: Returns the list of destination bridge chains for a given token on a given chain. Useful for discovering cross-chain swap/bridge options. Returns tokens that are available for swapping/bridging from the specified source token.

tools.name: Get Swap Status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current status of swap or bridge transactions on the Uniswap trading platform. Use when you need to check if a swap transaction has been confirmed, is pending, or has failed. Provide the transaction hash(es) to get the status of one or more swap transactions.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Uniswap API key from https://developers.uniswap.org/dashboard/

name: Unleash
description: Unleash is a feature management platform for creating, configuring, and governing feature flags across projects and environments.

tools.name: Configure project access
tools.description: Configure project access for groups and single users. The provided users and groups will be given the roles specified in the payload.

tools.name: This endpoint will add a comment to a change request
tools.description: This endpoint will add a comment to a change request for the user making the request.

tools.name: Set environment-default strategy
tools.description: Sets a default strategy for this environment. Unleash will use this strategy by default when enabling a feature flag. Use the wild card "*" for `:environment` to add to all environments.

tools.name: Add environments to a project
tools.description: Sequentially associate multiple environments with one project after rejecting duplicates and existing associations. On the first failure, attempts to remove only additions acknowledged during this run in reverse order. This is a non-atomic compensating workflow that can execute deletions; the response reports forward progress, cleanup attempts, cleanup failures, and possible partial state. A definitive 4xx rejects the failed item, while a 5xx or transport failure leaves that item's outcome unknown because Unleash may have committed it.

tools.name: Add an environment to a project
tools.description: Associate one existing environment with a project, optionally configure change requests, and optionally create the default activation strategy used when enabling feature flags in that project environment.

tools.name: Add feature dependencies
tools.description: Add multiple parent dependencies to one child feature flag in order. The action rejects existing dependencies before mutation and compensates a failed batch in reverse order by deleting additions made during this run. This non-atomic compensating workflow can execute deletions; inspect complete, partial_state, failed_item_outcome, and rollback_failures. A definitive 4xx rejects the failed item, while a 5xx or transport failure leaves its outcome unknown because Unleash may have committed it.

tools.name: Add a feature dependency
tools.description: Add a dependency to a parent feature. Each environment will resolve corresponding dependency independently.

tools.name: Add Feature Strategy
tools.description: Add one activation strategy configuration to a feature flag in an environment.

tools.name: Add a release plan
tools.description: Adds a release plan to a specific feature flag and environment.

tools.name: Add and remove tags across features
tools.description: Add and remove the supplied tags on every listed feature in a project, creating added tags when needed. Both tags.addedTags and tags.removedTags are required and may be empty; additions are applied before removals.

tools.name: Approve a user access request
tools.description: Approves a pending user access request, creating a new user with the specified role.

tools.name: Archive Feature
tools.description: Archive a feature flag in a project. The feature can be revived in Unleash, but revival is not performed by this action.

tools.name: Archives a list of features
tools.description: This endpoint archives the specified features. Any features that are already archived or that don't exist are ignored. All existing features (whether already archived or not) that are provided must belong to the specified project.

tools.name: Archive a release template
tools.description: Archives a global release template or a template scoped to one project. The project branch is a beta API.

tools.name: Create or update a milestone progression
tools.description: Creates or updates a milestone progression by source milestone ID. If a progression with the given source milestone exists, it will be updated; otherwise, a new one will be created.

tools.name: Change your own password
tools.description: Immediately replaces the connected user's password after verifying the old password and confirmation. Treat credentials as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: Move feature to project
tools.description: Moves the specified feature to the new project in the request schema. Requires you to have permissions to move the feature flag in both projects. Features that are included in any active change requests can not be moved.

tools.name: Create/Add change to a change request
tools.description: Add one or more typed changes to the caller's existing draft change request for the project environment, or create a draft when none exists.

tools.name: Change password for a user
tools.description: Immediately replaces a user's password as an administrator. Treat credentials as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: Check dependencies exist
tools.description: Check if any dependencies exist in this Unleash instance

tools.name: Validates the Unleash license
tools.description: Check the current Enterprise license and return whether it is valid, along with any provider status message and its info, warning, or error severity.

tools.name: Clones an environment
tools.description: Given an existing environment name and a set of options, this will create a copy of that environment

tools.name: Clone a feature flag
tools.description: Creates a copy of the specified feature flag. The copy can be created in any project.

tools.name: [BETA] Create an action set
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Creates a new action set.

tools.name: Create a new addon
tools.description: Create an external event integration. If enabled is true, Unleash starts sending the selected project and environment events to the configured external provider; create it disabled to configure delivery without starting it.

tools.name: Create API token
tools.description: Create a backend, frontend, or deprecated client API token with optional project, environment, and expiry restrictions. The response can reveal the token secret only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Create an application to connect reported metrics
tools.description: Create an application record with its loaded activation strategies and optional URL, color, and icon metadata. This operation does not report an SDK name or version.

tools.name: Create a banner
tools.description: Creates a new banner.

tools.name: Create Context Field
tools.description: Create a root context field or a project context field. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Creates a new environment
tools.description: Uses the details provided in the payload to create a new environment

tools.name: Create Feature
tools.description: Create a feature flag in a project without enabling it in any environment.

tools.name: Create a feature link
tools.description: Create a new link for a feature.

tools.name: Create a new group
tools.description: Creates an Enterprise user group for role-based access control, with optional SSO mappings, predefined root role, and initial user membership.

tools.name: Create a new personal access token (PAT) for the current user
tools.description: Creates a new [personal access token](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#personal-access-tokens (PAT) belonging to the current user. The response may contain secret material that is shown only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Create project
tools.description: Create a new [Unleash project](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/projects).

tools.name: Create a project API token
tools.description: Create an API token scoped to the specified project. The response can reveal the token secret only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Create a public signup token
tools.description: Lets administrators create a invite link to share with colleagues. People that join using the public invite are assigned the `Viewer` role. The response may contain secret material that is shown only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Create a release template
tools.description: Creates and returns a release template with its name, optional nullable description, and optional milestone configuration. Project scope uses a beta API.

tools.name: Create a new role
tools.description: Create a new custom role for Role-Based Access Control.

tools.name: Create Segment
tools.description: Create a reusable segment from a name and complete constraint list.

tools.name: Create a service account
tools.description: Creates a new service account.

tools.name: Create a token for a service account
tools.description: Creates a new token for the service account identified by the id. The response may contain secret material that is shown only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: [BETA] Create a signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Creates a new signal endpoint.

tools.name: [BETA] Create a signal endpoint token for a specific signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Creates a new signal endpoint token for a specific signal endpoint, identified by its ID. The response may contain a one-time authentication token; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Create a strategy
tools.description: Creates a custom strategy type based on the supplied data.

tools.name: Create a new tag
tools.description: Create a new tag with the specified data.

tools.name: Create a tag type
tools.description: Create a new tag type.

tools.name: Create a new user
tools.description: Creates a new user with the given root role. By default, Unleash sends the user an irreversible welcome email containing a login link; set send_email=false to suppress it.

tools.name: [BETA] Delete an action set
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Deletes an existing action set identified by its id.

tools.name: Delete an addon
tools.description: Delete the addon specified by the ID in the request path.

tools.name: Delete an application
tools.description: Delete the application specified in the request URL. Returns 200 OK if the application was successfully deleted or if it didn't exist

tools.name: Delete a banner
tools.description: Deletes an existing banner identified by its id.

tools.name: Discards a change from a change request by change id
tools.description: This endpoint will discard one change from a change request if it matches the provided id.

tools.name: Deletes a change request by id
tools.description: This endpoint will delete one change request if it matches the provided id.

tools.name: Delete Context Field
tools.description: Permanently delete a root or project context field without removing its existing use in strategy configuration. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Delete Context Field Legal Value
tools.description: Permanently delete a legal value from a root or project context field without removing its existing use in constraints. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Delete an environment
tools.description: Delete an environment identified by name.

tools.name: Deletes an archived feature
tools.description: Permanently this endpoint deletes the specified feature if it is archived. If the feature is not archived, it is left unchanged.

tools.name: Delete feature dependencies
tools.description: Remove all parent feature dependencies from one child feature flag.

tools.name: Delete a feature dependency
tools.description: Remove one named parent feature dependency from a child feature flag.

tools.name: Delete a feature link
tools.description: Delete a feature link by id.

tools.name: Deletes a list of features
tools.description: Permanently this endpoint deletes the specified features, that are in archive.

tools.name: Delete Feature Strategy
tools.description: Permanently delete one activation strategy instance from a feature flag in an environment.

tools.name: Delete a single group
tools.description: Delete a single user group by group id. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete impact metric configuration
tools.description: Permanently delete one impact metric chart configuration by config_id from the instance-level collection or from one feature flag.

tools.name: Deletes inactive users
tools.description: Deletes only the explicitly supplied IDs of users who have not logged in during the last 180 days. It does not delete every inactive user automatically. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete a milestone progression
tools.description: Deletes an existing milestone progression by source milestone ID.

tools.name: Delete a personal access token (PAT) for the current user
tools.description: Permanently and immediately revoke one personal access token belonging to the current user by its numeric PAT ID. The credential stops authenticating at once. Composio cannot compare its opaque connection credential with provider token IDs, so the caller must independently verify that this PAT does not back the current Composio connection and explicitly confirm that check.

tools.name: Delete project
tools.description: Permanently delete the provided project. All feature flags in the project must be archived before you can delete it. This permanently deletes the project and its archived flags. It can not be undone.

tools.name: Delete a release plan
tools.description: Delete a release plan from a specific feature flag and environment.

tools.name: Delete a release template
tools.description: Permanently deletes a global release template or a template scoped to one project. The project branch is a beta API.

tools.name: Delete a custom role
tools.description: Delete a custom role by id. You cannot delete built-in roles or roles that are in use. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete safeguard
tools.description: Permanently delete one safeguard by safeguard_id from a feature environment or from one release plan. Set target to release_plan and provide plan_id for a release-plan safeguard; omit plan_id for feature_environment.

tools.name: Delete all SCIM groups
tools.description: Deletes all groups managed by SCIM. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete all SCIM users
tools.description: Deletes all users managed by SCIM. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete Segment
tools.description: Permanently delete a segment by numeric ID. Unleash rejects deletion while the segment is in use.

tools.name: Delete a service account
tools.description: Deletes an existing service account identified by its id. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Delete a token for a service account
tools.description: Permanently and immediately revoke one service account token by service account ID and token ID. Workloads using that credential lose authentication immediately and cannot recover the deleted token. Composio cannot compare its opaque connection credential with provider token IDs, so the caller must independently verify that this token does not back the current Composio connection and explicitly confirm that check.

tools.name: [BETA] Delete a signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Deletes an existing signal endpoint identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] Delete a signal endpoint token
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Deletes an existing signal endpoint token identified by its id.

tools.name: Delete a strategy
tools.description: Deletes the specified strategy definition

tools.name: Delete a tag
tools.description: Delete a tag by type and value. When a tag is deleted all references to the tag are removed.

tools.name: Delete a tag type
tools.description: Deletes a tag type. If any features have tags of this type, those tags will be deleted.

tools.name: Delete a user
tools.description: Deletes the user with the given userId. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: [BETA] Disconnect all clients
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Disconnects all streaming clients.

tools.name: Export feature flags from an environment
tools.description: Export feature flag configuration from one environment, selecting by exactly one of feature names, tag, or project. The result contains feature definitions and strategies plus applicable environment configuration, context fields, tags, tag types, segments, dependencies, and links. Results are JSON; download_file=true delivers that JSON as a downloadable file, not CSV.

tools.name: Generates a new SCIM API token
tools.description: Generates a new SCIM API token. Previously generated tokens will be invalidated. The response may contain secret material that is shown only when issued; store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Gets access overview
tools.description: Gets an overview of what access all users have to all projects and groups.

tools.name: Get the number of change requests you can do something with
tools.description: Returns the number of change requests in this project that your user can move into the next stage by approving or applying them.

tools.name: Get a specific addon
tools.description: Retrieve information about the addon whose ID matches the ID in the request URL.

tools.name: Get total count of admin accounts
tools.description: Get a total count of admins with password, without password and admin service accounts.

tools.name: Batch evaluate an Unleash context against a set of environments and projects
tools.description: Use the provided `context`, `environments`, and `projects` to evaluate toggles on this Unleash instance. You can use comma-separated values to provide multiple values to each context field. Returns a combinatorial list of all toggles that match the parameters and what they evaluate to. The response also contains the input parameters that were provided.

tools.name: Get application data
tools.description: Returns data about the specified application (`appName`). The data contains information on the name of the application, sdkVersion (which sdk reported these metrics, typically `unleash-client-node:3.4.1` or `unleash-client-java:7.1.0`), as well as data about how to display this application in a list.

tools.name: Get application environment instances (Last 24h)
tools.description: Returns an overview of the instances for the given `appName` and `environment` that have received traffic in the last 24 hours.

tools.name: Get application overview
tools.description: Return an application's projects, feature count, environment and SDK activity, and missing-feature, outdated-SDK, or missing-strategy issues.

tools.name: Get basic user and group information
tools.description: Get a subset of user and group information eligible even for non-admin users.

tools.name: Retrieves one change request by id
tools.description: This endpoint will retrieve one change request if it matches the provided id.

tools.name: Evaluate an Unleash context against a change request preview
tools.description: Use the provided `context` to evaluate toggles on this Unleash instance with a change request applied in preview mode. You can use comma-separated values to provide multiple values to each context field. Returns a combinatorial list of all toggles that match the parameters and what they evaluate to.

tools.name: Retrieves number of project change requests in each state
tools.description: This endpoint will retrieve the number of project change requests that are: approved, applied, rejected, scheduled or awaiting review

tools.name: [BETA] Get aggregated metered connections for a given time period
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Gets metered connections count for the selected period, either aggregated by day or by month.

tools.name: Get Context Field
tools.description: Get one root or project context field by name. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Get Detailed Invoices
tools.description: Return detailed Enterprise billing data: plan price and currency plus invoice dates, totals, tax, status, invoice links, primary package or seat line items, and usage, consumption, or overage line items.

tools.name: Get the environment with `name`
tools.description: Retrieves the environment with `name` if it exists in this Unleash instance

tools.name: Get variants for a feature in an environment
tools.description: Returns the variants for a feature in a specific environment. If the feature has no variants it will return an empty array of variants

tools.name: Get the external impact-metrics source
tools.description: Returns the current configuration of the external impact-metrics source (any Prometheus-compatible endpoint).

tools.name: Get Feature
tools.description: Get one feature flag with its metadata, lifecycle, dependencies, tags, environment enablement, and strategy configurations.

tools.name: Get Feature Environment
tools.description: Get a feature flag's enablement state, complete strategy configurations, variants, release plans, and safeguards in one environment.

tools.name: Get feature lifecycle
tools.description: Return the selected feature flag's lifecycle history, including each recorded stage, when the feature entered it, and any detailed stage status. Use this instead of the feature-detail read when the full sequence of lifecycle transitions is needed rather than only the current lifecycle state.

tools.name: Get feature flag strategies
tools.description: Get strategies defined for a feature flag in the specified environment.

tools.name: Get a strategy configuration
tools.description: Get a strategy configuration for an environment in a feature flag.

tools.name: Last hour of usage and a list of applications that have reported seeing this feature flag
tools.description: Separate counts for yes (enabled), no (disabled), as well as how many times each variant was selected during the last hour

tools.name: Get a single group
tools.description: Get a single user group by group id.

tools.name: Instance usage statistics
tools.description: Provides statistics about various features of Unleash to allow for reporting of usage for self-hosted customers. The response contains data such as the number of users, groups, features, strategies, versions, etc.

tools.name: Instance usage statistics
tools.description: Download a CSV file of self-hosted instance usage statistics, including counts and version data for users, groups, feature flags, and strategies.

tools.name: Get instance information
tools.description: Gets high level information about the usage of this Unleash instance, including user, project, and flag information.

tools.name: Get licensed user statistics
tools.description: Return the available seat count, current license usage, and monthly licensed-user count history for this Unleash instance.

tools.name: Get lifecycle trends
tools.description: Gets lifecycle trends information showing feature flag progression across development, production, and cleanup stages.

tools.name: Get maintenance mode status
tools.description: Tells you whether maintenance mode is enabled or disabled

tools.name: Get your own user details
tools.description: Detailed information about the current user, user permissions and user feedback.

tools.name: Get OIDC auth settings
tools.description: Returns the current settings for OIDC Authentication.

tools.name: Retrieves pending change requests in configured environments
tools.description: This endpoint will retrieve the pending change requests in the configured environments for the project, for the current user performing the request.

tools.name: Get Plausible analytics data
tools.description: Fetches analytics data from Plausible API for favorite events over the last 7 days.

tools.name: Get your own user profile
tools.description: Detailed information about the current user root role and project membership.

tools.name: Get users and groups in project
tools.description: Get all groups, users and their roles, and available roles for the given project.

tools.name: Get api tokens for project
tools.description: Returns the project-specific [API tokens](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys) that have been created for this project.

tools.name: Retrieves change request configuration for a project
tools.description: Given a projectId, this endpoint will retrieve change request configuration for the project

tools.name: Get an overview of a project
tools.description: This endpoint returns an overview of the specified projects stats, project health, number of members, which environments are configured, and the features types in the project.

tools.name: Get project status
tools.description: This endpoint returns information on the status the project, including activities, health, resources, and aggregated flag lifecycle data.

tools.name: Get feature metrics
tools.description: Get usage metrics for a specific feature for the last 48 hours, grouped by hour

tools.name: Get a release template
tools.description: Returns a global release template or a template scoped to one project. The project branch is a beta API.

tools.name: Get remote MCP server settings
tools.description: Returns the current settings for the remote MCP server.

tools.name: [BETA] Get aggregated metered requests for a given time period
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Gets metered requests count for the selected period, either aggregated by day or by month.

tools.name: Gets usage data
tools.description: Gets usage data per app/endpoint from a prometheus compatible metrics endpoint

tools.name: Get a single role
tools.description: Get a single role by role id.

tools.name: Get project-role mappings
tools.description: For the provided role, retrieves a list of projects that use this role. For each project it also contains information about how the role used in that project, such as how many users, groups, or service accounts that use the role.

tools.name: Get SAML auth settings
tools.description: Returns the current settings for SAML authentication.

tools.name: Get scheduled change requests matching a query
tools.description: List scheduled change requests that touch the supplied feature flag name or activation strategy ID. At least one criterion is required; when both are supplied, Unleash returns requests matching either criterion.

tools.name: Get SCIM settings
tools.description: Returns the current settings for SCIM provisioning.

tools.name: Get Segment
tools.description: Get one reusable segment and its complete constraint definition by numeric ID.

tools.name: Returns the list of permissions for the service account
tools.description: Gets a list of permissions for a service account. Project and environment can be specified.

tools.name: Get Simple auth settings
tools.description: Is simple authentication (username/password) enabled for this server.

tools.name: Get strategies that use a context field
tools.description: Retrieves strategies using a root context field or a project context field. A missing context field returns an empty strategy list; the project branch is a beta API.

tools.name: Get a strategy definition
tools.description: Retrieves the definition of the strategy specified in the URL

tools.name: Get a tag by type and value
tools.description: Get a tag by type and value. Can be used to check whether a given tag already exists in Unleash or not.

tools.name: Get a tag type
tools.description: Get a tag type by name.

tools.name: Get telemetry settings
tools.description: Provides the configured settings for [telemetry information collection](https://docs.getunleash.io/privacy-and-compliance/data-privacy)

tools.name: Get aggregated traffic data for a given time period
tools.description: Gets traffic usage data for the selected period, either aggregated by day or by month.

tools.name: Get user
tools.description: Will return a single user by id.

tools.name: Import feature flags
tools.description: Import exported JSON feature flag configuration into the target project and environment. This can create or replace feature definitions, strategies, variants, tags, dependencies, context-field references, and environment state; when change requests are enabled, Unleash creates a draft change request instead of applying changes immediately.

tools.name: [BETA] List events for an action set
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Returns a list of action events triggered by a specific action set, identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] List action sets
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Returns the list of all action sets.

tools.name: Get all addons and providers
tools.description: Retrieve all addons and providers that are defined on this Unleash instance.

tools.name: Get all environments
tools.description: Retrieves all environments that exist in this Unleash instance.

tools.name: Get all feature types
tools.description: Retrieves all feature types that exist in this Unleash instance, along with their descriptions and lifetimes.

tools.name: List API tokens
tools.description: Retrieves all API tokens that exist in the Unleash instance. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: List API tokens by name
tools.description: Retrieves all API tokens that match a given token name. Because token names are not unique, this endpoint will always return a list. If no tokens with the provided name exist, the list will be empty. Otherwise, it will contain all the tokens with the given name. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: Get all applications
tools.description: Returns one page of applications across the Unleash instance or for one project, with a route-bound cursor for continuation.

tools.name: List available change request reviewers
tools.description: List users who are available to review or approve a change request in the specified project environment.

tools.name: List available impact metrics
tools.description: Returns all available impact metrics and their metadata.

tools.name: Get all banners
tools.description: Returns a list of all configured banners.

tools.name: List requested change request reviewers
tools.description: Get the users currently requested to review a change request. These are requested reviewers, not users who have already approved it.

tools.name: List change requests for a project
tools.description: This endpoint will retrieve all change requests regardless of status for a given project. There's an upper limit of last 300 change requests ordered by creation date.

tools.name: List Context Fields
tools.description: List configured root context fields or project context fields. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Get a list of all users that have created events
tools.description: Returns a list of all users that have created events in the system.

tools.name: Get all features lifecycle stage count
tools.description: Return instance-wide feature flag counts grouped into the initial, pre-live, live, completed, and archived lifecycle stages. Each value is the number of feature flags currently in that stage.

tools.name: List Features
tools.description: List every feature flag in one project with its high-level state in each environment.

tools.name: Get all tags for a feature
tools.description: Retrieves all the tags for a feature name. If the feature does not exist it returns an empty list.

tools.name: Get a list of groups
tools.description: Get a list of user groups for Role-Based Access Control.

tools.name: List impact metric configurations
tools.description: List impact metric chart configurations for either the Unleash instance (not associated with a feature flag) or one feature flag.

tools.name: List inactive users
tools.description: Gets all inactive users. An inactive user is a user that has not logged in in the last 180 days.

tools.name: List integration events for a specific integration configuration
tools.description: Returns a list of integration events belonging to a specific integration configuration, identified by its id.

tools.name: List invoices
tools.description: Return Enterprise invoice summaries for billing review, including formatted amount due, paid state, current status, optional due date, and links to view or download each invoice as PDF. Use GET_DETAILED_INVOICES when plan pricing and line-item breakdowns are needed.

tools.name: Get all login events
tools.description: Return all login and logout events in the Unleash system as structured JSON, including success, client, and failure details when available.

tools.name: List notifications
tools.description: A user may get relevant notifications from the projects they are a member of

tools.name: List outdated SDKs
tools.description: Lists outdated SDK versions and the applications using them across the instance or in one project.

tools.name: List parent options
tools.description: List available parents who have no transitive dependencies.

tools.name: List parent feature variants
tools.description: List available parent variants across all strategy variants and feature environment variants.

tools.name: Get all personal access tokens (PATs) for the current user
tools.description: Returns all of the [personal access tokens](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/api-tokens-and-client-keys#personal-access-tokens) (PATs) belonging to the current user. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: List pending change requests referencing a feature
tools.description: This endpoint will retrieve all pending change requests (change requests with a status of Draft | In review | Approved) referencing the given feature flag name.

tools.name: List available permissions
tools.description: Returns a list of available permissions.

tools.name: List Project Environments
tools.description: List environments available to a project with project-specific visibility and enabled-toggle counts.

tools.name: Get a list of all flag creators for a project
tools.description: This endpoint returns every user who created a flag in the project.

tools.name: List Projects
tools.description: List projects available to the connected Admin API principal, optionally including archived projects.

tools.name: List public signup tokens
tools.description: Retrieves all existing public signup tokens. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: List release plans
tools.description: Returns a list of all release plans for a specific feature flag and environment.

tools.name: List release templates
tools.description: Lists global release templates or templates for one project. The project branch is a beta API; set include_global to include global templates with project results.

tools.name: Get a list of roles
tools.description: Get a list of project, root and custom roles for Role-Based Access Control.

tools.name: List Segments
tools.description: List all reusable segments in the Unleash instance with their constraints and usage counts.

tools.name: List strategy segments
tools.description: Retrieve all segments that are referenced by the specified strategy. Returns an empty list of segments if the strategy ID doesn't exist.

tools.name: List service accounts
tools.description: Returns the list of all service accounts.

tools.name: List all tokens for a service account
tools.description: Returns the list of all tokens for a service account identified by the id. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

tools.name: [BETA] List signal endpoints
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Returns a list of all configured signal endpoints.

tools.name: [BETA] List signals from a specific signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Returns a list of signals originated from a specific signal endpoint, identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] List tokens for a specific signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Returns a list of all configured signal endpoint tokens for a specific signal endpoint, identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] List signals
tools.description: **[BETA]** Returns one page of signals in the requested creation-date range. The API may change or be removed; pass next_cursor unchanged to continue the same query.

tools.name: List strategies that reference a segment
tools.description: Retrieve all strategies that reference the specified segment.

tools.name: List Strategy Types
tools.description: List predefined and custom strategy types available for feature configuration.

tools.name: List all tags
tools.description: List all tags available in Unleash.

tools.name: List all tags of a given type
tools.description: List all tags of a given type. If the tag type does not exist it returns an empty list.

tools.name: Get all tag types
tools.description: Get a list of all available tag types.

tools.name: List unknown flags
tools.description: Returns a list of unknown flag reports from the last 24 hours, if any. Maximum of 1000.

tools.name: Get all pending user access requests
tools.description: Returns a list of all pending user access requests.

tools.name: List roles for the currently logged-in user
tools.description: Gets roles assigned to currently logged in user. Both explicitly and transitively through group memberships.

tools.name: Get all users and [root roles](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/rbac#predefined-roles)
tools.description: Will return all users and all available root roles for the Unleash instance.

tools.name: Mark notifications as read
tools.description: Allow to select which notifications were read and saving a read date

tools.name: Create (overwrite) variants for a feature in an environment
tools.description: Replace the feature flag's complete variant list in one environment. An empty variants list removes all variants. If variants are supplied, at least one must use variable weight; fixed weights must total less than 1000, and Unleash distributes the remainder among variable-weight variants.

tools.name: Create (overwrite) variants for a feature flag in multiple environments
tools.description: Replace the feature flag's complete variant list in every environment named by environments. The same list is written to all targets; an empty variants list removes all variants from every named environment.

tools.name: Patch a feature's variants in an environment
tools.description: Apply a list of patches to the features environments in the specified environment. The patch objects should conform to the [JSON-patch format (RFC 6902)](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc6902).

tools.name: Modify a feature flag
tools.description: Change specific properties of a feature flag.

tools.name: Change specific properties of a strategy
tools.description: Change specific properties of a strategy configuration in a feature flag.

tools.name: Query impact metrics time series data
tools.description: Queries an impact metric source for time series data based on the provided metric name, time range, and aggregation mode.

tools.name: Reads the Unleash license
tools.description: Reads the Unleash license. Only available for self-hosted Enterprise customers.

tools.name: Register a new impact metric
tools.description: Registers a new impact metric by pushing 0-values.

tools.name: Reject a user access request
tools.description: Rejects an existing user access request identified by its id. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Remove an environment from a project
tools.description: This endpoint removes the specified environment from the project.

tools.name: Remove project access for a group
tools.description: Removes project access for a group by removing all of its roles for the project.

tools.name: Remove project access for a user
tools.description: Removes project access for a user by removing all of its roles for the project.

tools.name: Generate user password-reset URL
tools.description: Generates and returns a password-reset URL for the user identified by email; it does not change the password. Treat the returned URL as secret material: store it securely and never log it.

tools.name: Resume paused milestone progressions
tools.description: Resumes all paused milestone progressions for a release plan

tools.name: Revives a feature
tools.description: This endpoint revives the specified feature from archive.

tools.name: Revives a list of features
tools.description: This endpoint revives the specified features.

tools.name: Save impact metric configuration
tools.description: Create or update an instance-level or feature-level impact metric chart configuration. Omit id to create one; provide its id to update it.

tools.name: Search change requests
tools.description: Search and filter change requests by creator and approver.

tools.name: Search for events
tools.description: Allows searching for events that match the query parameter criteria.

tools.name: Search Features
tools.description: Search and filter feature flags across projects. Returns one offset-paginated page; pass cursor unchanged to continue the same search.

tools.name: Search users
tools.description: It will preform a simple search based on name and email matching the given query. Requires minimum 2 characters.

tools.name: Set Action Set State
tools.description: Enable or disable one project action set.

tools.name: Set Banner State
tools.description: Enable or disable an instance banner.

tools.name: Set change request reviewers
tools.description: Replace the requested reviewers for a change request with the complete supplied user-ID list. Omitted existing IDs are removed, an empty list removes every reviewer, and at most 10 reviewers are allowed.

tools.name: Sets allowed CORS origins
tools.description: Sets Cross-Origin Resource Sharing headers for Frontend SDK API.

tools.name: Set Email Subscription
tools.description: Subscribe or unsubscribe the current principal from an email notification category.

tools.name: Set Environment State
tools.description: Enable or disable an environment across the Unleash instance.

tools.name: Set the external impact-metrics source
tools.description: Updates the configuration of the external impact-metrics source (any Prometheus-compatible endpoint).

tools.name: Set Feature Environment State
tools.description: Enable or disable one feature flag in one environment.

tools.name: Set Feature Favorite
tools.description: Add or remove one feature flag from the current principal's favorites.

tools.name: Set Feature Lifecycle Completion
tools.description: Mark a feature lifecycle as completed with a kept or discarded outcome, or mark it incomplete again.

tools.name: Set Features Environment State
tools.description: Enable or disable the supplied feature flags in one project environment.

tools.name: Mark features as stale / not stale
tools.description: This endpoint marks the provided list of features as either [stale](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/technical-debt#stale-and-potentially-stale-flags) or not stale depending on the request body you send. Any provided features that don't exist are ignored.

tools.name: Enable or disable maintenance mode
tools.description: Enable or disable maintenance mode for the entire Unleash instance. Enabling it makes the instance mostly read-only and blocks all users from changing configuration. The effect is reversible: disabling maintenance mode restores configuration writes without undoing existing configuration.

tools.name: Set OIDC settings
tools.description: Configure or partially update OpenID Connect login, user auto-creation, roles, group syncing, PKCE, and scopes. Disabling OIDC or replacing invalid credentials can immediately prevent users from signing in; treat the client secret as sensitive.

tools.name: Set users and groups to roles in the current project
tools.description: Replaces the complete project access configuration with the supplied role assignments. Existing assignments omitted from roles are removed; an empty roles list removes all project access assignments. Within a role, an empty users or groups list removes every assignment of that type for that role.

tools.name: Set Project Archived
tools.description: Archive or revive one project; archiving requires all project flags to be archived first.

tools.name: Set Project Favorite
tools.description: Add or remove one project from the current principal's favorites.

tools.name: Toggle remote MCP server settings
tools.description: Toggles the remote MCP server for this Unleash instance.

tools.name: Sets roles for group
tools.description: Replace all project roles assigned to a group. Pass the complete desired role ID list; an empty list removes all of the group's roles and its project access.

tools.name: Sets roles for user
tools.description: Replace all project roles assigned directly to a user. Pass the complete desired role ID list; an empty list removes all direct roles and therefore the user's direct project access.

tools.name: Update SAML auth settings
tools.description: Configure or partially update SAML login, certificates, user auto-creation, roles, and group syncing. Disabling SAML or replacing invalid identity-provider settings can immediately prevent users from signing in.

tools.name: Set SCIM settings
tools.description: Sets new settings for SCIM provisioning. This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Set Signal Endpoint State
tools.description: Enable or disable one outbound signal endpoint.

tools.name: Update Simple auth settings
tools.description: Enable or disable simple authentication (username/password). This operation changes access or identity state and may be destructive or immediately disruptive.

tools.name: Set Strategy Deprecated
tools.description: Deprecate or reactivate one custom strategy type.

tools.name: Set strategy sort order
tools.description: Replace the sort order for the complete supplied list of strategy instances in this feature environment.

tools.name: Start a release plan milestone
