tools.description: Starts a release plan milestone, advancing a one-way release transition that may apply the milestone's rollout configuration and cannot simply be undone.

tools.name: [BETA] Update an action set
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Updates an existing action set identified by its id.

tools.name: Update an addon
tools.description: Replace an external event integration configuration. Provide the provider, description, enabled state, complete event filter, complete project filter, complete environment filter, and all provider parameters required for that provider. Unleash masks stored webhook URLs and other secrets, so callers must resend the real URL or credential on every update. Changing destination configuration or filters redirects future deliveries; setting enabled to true starts delivery and false stops it. Passing null for description clears it to an empty string; empty project or environment lists select all.

tools.name: Update a banner
tools.description: Updates an existing banner identified by its id.

tools.name: Edits a single change in a change request
tools.description: Replace one change in a change request. Unleash removes the selected change and inserts the typed replacement, so its old change ID becomes invalid; use the returned request's latest change ID for subsequent edits.

tools.name: This endpoint will update the state of a change request
tools.description: Move a change request to Draft, In review, Approved, Cancelled, or Applied when Unleash's transition rules allow it. Approval requires at least one change and enough approvals. Applied and Cancelled are terminal and cannot be changed afterward; editing an Approved request returns it to In review and clears its approvals.

tools.name: This endpoint will update the custom title of a change request
tools.description: Replace a change request's custom title. Pass an empty title to clear it and restore display of Unleash's generated default, such as Change Request #1.

tools.name: Update Context Field
tools.description: Update supplied settings of a root or project context field. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Updates an environment by name
tools.description: Given an environment by name updates the environment with the given payload. Note that `name`, `enabled` and `protected` cannot be changed by this API

tools.name: Update environment sort orders
tools.description: Updates sort orders for the named environments. Environments not specified are unaffected.

tools.name: Update Feature
tools.description: Update supplied description, type, stale or archive state, or impression-data setting on an existing feature flag. Setting archived to true moves the flag into the archive; omitted fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update a feature link
tools.description: Update an existing feature link.

tools.name: Update Feature Strategy
tools.description: Replace supplied configuration fields on one feature strategy instance.

tools.name: Update strategy segments
tools.description: Sets the segments of the strategy specified to be exactly the ones passed in the payload. Any segments that were used by the strategy before will be removed if they are not in the provided list of segments.

tools.name: Update feature tags
tools.description: Sync one or many feature tags with PUT, add one tag with POST, or remove one tag with DELETE. Sync requires both added_tags and removed_tags, applies additions before removals, and accepts an empty list for either effect.

tools.name: Update feature type lifetime
tools.description: Updates the lifetime configuration for the specified [feature flag type](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/feature-flags#feature-flag-types). The expected lifetime is an integer representing the number of days before Unleash marks a feature flag of that type as potentially stale. If set to `null` or `0`, then feature flags of that particular type will never be marked as potentially stale. When a feature flag type's expected lifetime is changed, this will also cause any feature flags of this type to be reevaluated for potential staleness.

tools.name: Update a group
tools.description: Update existing user group by group id. It overrides previous group details.

tools.name: Set a new Unleash license
tools.description: Set a new Unleash license. Only available for self-hosted Enterprise customers.

tools.name: Update project
tools.description: Update a project's name and optionally its description, access mode, or default stickiness. The complete new name is always required; omitted optional fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Updates change request configuration for an environment in the project
tools.description: This endpoint will change the change request configuration for a given environment, set it to either on/off and optionally configure the number of approvals needed. The minimum number of approvals is 1 and the maximum number is 10. If you provide a number higher than 10 or lower than 1, Unleash will clamp it to the allowed range.

tools.name: Update project enterprise settings
tools.description: Update project enterprise settings with new values. Any fields not provided are ignored.

tools.name: Update a milestone strategy
tools.description: Update a milestone strategy configuration for a feature flag in the specified environment.

tools.name: Update a release template
tools.description: Updates a release template's name, description, and replacement milestone configuration. Unleash will delete and rebuild existing milestones from the supplied `milestones` body field, so this cannot simply be undone. Project scope uses a beta API.

tools.name: Update a role
tools.description: Update a custom role by its role ID. The provider requires the role name on every update; supplied permissions replace the role's assigned permission list.

tools.name: Update Segment
tools.description: Update a segment by replacing its required name and complete constraint list plus optional metadata.

tools.name: Update a service account
tools.description: Updates an existing service account identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] Update a signal endpoint
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Updates an existing signal endpoint identified by its id.

tools.name: [BETA] Update a signal endpoint token
tools.description: **[BETA]** This API is in beta state, which means it may change or be removed in the future. Updates an existing signal endpoint token identified by its id.

tools.name: Update a strategy type
tools.description: Update a custom strategy type's optional description and replace its complete parameter definition list. Parameters are always required by Unleash; pass an empty list to remove all parameter definitions.

tools.name: Update a tag type
tools.description: Update the configuration for the specified tag type.

tools.name: Update a user
tools.description: Only the explicitly specified fields get updated.

tools.name: Upsert Context Field Legal Value
tools.description: Add a legal value to a root or project context field, or update its description when the value already exists. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Create or update safeguard
tools.description: Create or update a metric-threshold safeguard for a feature environment or for one release plan. Set target to release_plan and provide plan_id for a release-plan safeguard; omit plan_id for feature_environment. Returns the saved safeguard and its ID for DELETE_SAFEGUARD.

tools.name: Validates archive features
tools.description: Preview the consequences of archiving the named feature flags. Returns parent features that would leave unarchived child features orphaned and whether the archive would delete feature dependencies; it does not archive anything.

tools.name: Validate constraint
tools.description: Validates a constraint definition. Checks whether the context field exists and whether the applied configuration is valid. Additional properties are not allowed on data objects that you send to this endpoint.

tools.name: Validate Context Field Name
tools.description: Check whether a proposed name can be used for a root or project context field. Invalid names produce an Unleash validation error. The project scope uses Unleash's beta project-context API.

tools.name: Validates if an environment name exists
tools.description: Checks whether an environment name is already in use.

tools.name: Validate an external impact-metrics source URL
tools.description: Tests an external impact-metrics source URL on the fly without persisting it. Returns the list of metric names found at the URL on success, or an `error` string explaining what went wrong. Always responds with 200; failures are reported in the body.

tools.name: Validate a feature flag name
tools.description: Validates a feature flag name: checks whether the name is URL-friendly and whether a feature with the given name already exists. Returns 200 if the feature name is compliant and unused.

tools.name: Validate feature import data
tools.description: Validates a feature flag data set. Checks whether the data can be imported into the specified project and environment. The returned value is an object that contains errors, warnings, and permissions required to perform the import, as described in the [import documentation](https://docs.getunleash.io/concepts/import-export#import-feature-flags).

tools.name: Validate project ID
tools.description: Validate a project ID against Unleash's rules

tools.name: Validate a role
tools.description: Check if the role matches schema and has a unique name.

tools.name: Validates if a segment name exists
tools.description: Checks whether a segment name is already in use.

tools.name: Validate a tag type
tools.description: Validates whether if the body of the request is a valid tag and whether the a tag type with that name already exists or not. If a tag type with the same name exists, this operation will return a 409 status code.

tools.name: Validate password for a user
tools.description: Validate the password strength. Minimum 10 characters, uppercase letter, number, special character. Treat token or credential values as secrets and never log them.

required.name: full
required.description: The full URL of your Unleash instance, such as https://app.unleash-hosted.com/example or https://unleash.example.com. Unleash Cloud profile URLs ending in /personal are normalized while preserving the tenant path. For self-hosted instances, enter the canonical HTTP or HTTPS base URL without a trailing slash, credentials, query, or fragment.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: A service account token (recommended for Enterprise automation) from Admin settings > Service accounts, or a personal access token from Profile > View profile settings > Personal API tokens. The token must have roles permitting the Admin API operations you intend to use.

name: Updown.io
description: updown.io is a simple and inexpensive website monitoring service that checks the availability and performance of your websites and APIs.

tools.name: List All Checks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all monitoring checks on your updown.io account. Use when you need to view all configured checks including their status, uptime, and settings.

tools.name: List Node IPs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all updown.io server IP addresses. Use when configuring firewalls or IP allowlists to permit updown.io monitoring.

tools.name: List node IPv4 addresses
tools.description: Tool to list all updown.io server IPv4 addresses. Use when you need to retrieve the current set of updown.io node IPv4 addresses.

tools.name: List IPv6 nodes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all updown.io server IPv6 addresses. Use when you need to enumerate available IPv6 monitoring nodes.

tools.name: List Monitoring Nodes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all updown.io monitoring servers. Use when you need to discover available monitoring nodes.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your updown.io API key used for authenticating API requests.

name: Uplisting
description: Uplisting is a vacation rental property management platform for managing properties, availability, bookings, calendars, and webhooks.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Register a public callback URL for one booking or property event and return the new webhook ID.

tools.name: Delete Webhook
tools.description: Permanently remove one Uplisting webhook subscription by its ID. This is destructive and stops future event deliveries to that subscription.

tools.name: Get Calendar
tools.description: Return up to 12 months of daily availability, rates, and stay restrictions for one property.

tools.name: Get Current Account
tools.description: Return the name and stable UID of the Uplisting account connected by the current API key.

tools.name: Get Property
tools.description: Return one Uplisting property by ID with the related resources supplied by the API.

tools.name: List Bookings
tools.description: Return one explicitly selected 0-based page of bookings for a property and optional date range, with total and total-page metadata.

tools.name: List Properties
tools.description: Return all properties in the connected Uplisting account, including the related resources supplied by the API.

tools.name: List Webhooks
tools.description: Return the webhook subscriptions registered for the connected Uplisting account.

tools.name: Search Availability
tools.description: Find Uplisting properties available for optional stay dates, guest count, city, and nightly price bounds.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Asynchronously change availability, rates, or stay restrictions for dated days or date ranges on one property. HTTP 202 only means the update was accepted; it may take several minutes to propagate. Use Get Calendar later to verify the resulting state.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your raw Uplisting account API key. Generate or copy it from Connect > API in Uplisting. Enter the raw key exactly as shown; do not Base64-encode it first. See https://support.uplisting.io/en/article/api-webhooks-vzlowi/.

name: Upload to URL
description: Upload files to public CDN URLs, retrieve or delete uploaded file metadata, and publish HTML pages.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Permanently delete a previously uploaded file from storage and its public CDN location.

tools.name: Get File Metadata
tools.description: Retrieve current metadata and the public CDN URL for a file previously uploaded by the connected account.

tools.name: Get Supported Formats
tools.description: Return the file extensions Upload to URL accepts or blocks, current plan size limits, and advertised upload security checks. Use this before uploading an unfamiliar file type.

tools.name: Publish HTML
tools.description: Publish raw HTML at a public URL under a chosen page path. This irreversible public side effect consumes one monthly credit, and the API provides no way to delete the published page.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Upload one file and return its public CDN URL, file ID, expiration, and remaining monthly credits. Each successful call consumes one upload credit.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Upload to URL developer API key. Sign in to the Upload to URL dashboard and generate or copy a key from the API key settings. New users can create an account at https://accounts.uploadtourl.com/sign-up. The key is sent in the x-api-key header; keep it secret.

name: Upload-Post
description: Upload-Post publishes, schedules, and manages content across social networks through one API.

tools.name: Cancel Scheduled Post
tools.description: Permanently cancel a scheduled post before publication and delete its staged assets.

tools.name: Create Profile
tools.description: Create an Upload-Post profile for a unique caller-owned username; this does not connect any social platform.

tools.name: Enqueue Post
tools.description: Insert one video, photo carousel, or text post into a profile's external publication queue.

tools.name: Get Upload Status
tools.description: Get the processing status and per-platform results for an asynchronous or scheduled upload.

tools.name: List Cached Post Analytics
tools.description: Return one page of cached per-post analytics for a profile without consuming the live platform-analytics request limit.

tools.name: List Platform Destinations
tools.description: List selectable Facebook Pages, LinkedIn organizations, Pinterest boards, or Google Business locations for an already connected profile.

tools.name: List Profiles
tools.description: List Upload-Post profiles and their connected social accounts. Use this before publishing to verify the profile exists and inspect platform connection or reauthentication prerequisites.

tools.name: List Scheduled Posts
tools.description: Return one page of pending scheduled posts and the job IDs needed to edit or cancel them.

tools.name: List Upload History
tools.description: Return one page of past and in-progress Upload-Post uploads, including platform post IDs, URLs, request IDs, and failures.

tools.name: Publish Post
tools.description: Immediately publish one video, photo carousel, or text post to external connected platforms.

tools.name: Schedule Post
tools.description: Schedule one video, photo carousel, or text post for future external publication to connected platforms.

tools.name: Update Scheduled Post
tools.description: Change the future publication time, title, or caption of an existing scheduled post.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Generate or copy your account API key from the Upload-Post dashboard after signing in. This is the durable account key used for the REST API, not a short-lived profile JWT.

name: Uploadcare
description: Uploadcare is a comprehensive file handling service that offers uploading, storage, processing, and delivery solutions for web and mobile applications.

tools.name: Check AWS Rekognition Moderation Status
tools.description: Tool to check the execution status of AWS Rekognition Moderation labels detection. Use after initiating a moderation check to monitor progress and determine when results are ready.

tools.name: Check Remove.bg Status
tools.description: Tool to check Remove.bg execution status and get the UUID of the file with removed background. Use after requesting background removal to poll for completion and retrieve the processed file UUID.

tools.name: Copy Uploadcare File to Local Storage
tools.description: Tool to copy a file to local storage within the same Uploadcare project. Use when you need to create a duplicate of an existing file.

tools.name: Create File Group (Upload API)
tools.description: Tool to create a file group from already uploaded files using Uploadcare's Upload API. Use after files have been uploaded to group them together.

tools.name: Create Uploadcare webhook
tools.description: Create a new webhook subscription to receive notifications when file events occur. Use this to get real-time callbacks at your URL when files are uploaded, stored, deleted, or flagged. The project is automatically determined by your API credentials. Note: Each target_url must be unique per event type within your project.

tools.name: Delete File Metadata Key
tools.description: Tool to delete a specific metadata key from an Uploadcare file. Use when you need to remove obsolete metadata after file processing.

tools.name: Batch Delete Uploadcare Files
tools.description: Tool to delete multiple files from Uploadcare storage in a single request. Use when you need to remove up to 100 files at once. Invalid UUIDs or missing files will be reported in the problems field.

tools.name: Delete Uploadcare Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a file group. Use when you need to remove a group from the project. Note that files within the group are not deleted, only the group itself.

tools.name: Delete Uploadcare File
tools.description: Tool to delete a single file from Uploadcare storage by UUID. Use when you need to permanently remove a file from storage (note: file may remain in CDN cache).

tools.name: Delete Uploadcare Webhook
tools.description: Permanently deletes a webhook subscription from your Uploadcare project. Use the List Webhooks action first to obtain the webhook ID. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Uploadcare Webhook by URL
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook subscription by its target URL. Use when you know the webhook's target URL but not its ID.

tools.name: Execute ClamAV virus scan
tools.description: Tool to execute ClamAV virus scan on an uploaded file. Use this when you need to check if a file contains viruses or malware. The scan runs asynchronously - you receive a request_id to track the scan status. Results can be retrieved from file info or via webhooks.

tools.name: Get AWS Rekognition Execution Status
tools.description: Tool to check AWS Rekognition execution status for label detection. Use after initiating an AWS Rekognition add-on execution to monitor job progress.

tools.name: Get ClamAV Scan Status
tools.description: Tool to check the execution status of a ClamAV virus scan. Use after initiating a ClamAV scan to monitor its progress and determine when results are available.

tools.name: Get File Group Info (Upload API)
tools.description: Tool to get information about a file group from the Upload API. Use when you need to retrieve group details including file metadata from the upload endpoint.

tools.name: Get Uploadcare File Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about a specific file. Use after uploading a file to retrieve detailed metadata and usage information.

tools.name: Get File Metadata
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all metadata key-value pairs associated with an Uploadcare file. Use when you need to inspect custom metadata attached to a file.

tools.name: Get File Metadata Key Value
tools.description: Tool to get the value of a specific metadata key for an Uploadcare file. Use when you need to retrieve custom metadata associated with a file.

tools.name: Get Uploadcare Group Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about a specific file group. Use when you need to retrieve detailed metadata about a group and its contained files.

tools.name: Get Uploadcare Project Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about the current Uploadcare project. Use when you need to retrieve project configuration details.

tools.name: Get Uploaded File Info
tools.description: Tool to get information about an uploaded file using Uploadcare's Upload API. Use this to retrieve file metadata including size, MIME type, and content information immediately after upload.

tools.name: Get URL Upload Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of a URL upload task. Use after initiating a file upload from a URL to monitor progress or verify completion.

tools.name: Mirror Uploadcare Image
tools.description: Tool to mirror an image horizontally via Uploadcare CDN. Use when you need the URL of a horizontally flipped image.

tools.name: List Uploadcare Files
tools.description: List files in an Uploadcare project with pagination and optional filtering. Use this tool to retrieve uploaded files. Supports filtering by storage status, removal status, and date range. Results are paginated with optional ordering.

tools.name: List Uploadcare Groups
tools.description: Tool to list groups in the project. Use when you need to retrieve paginated groups of files.

tools.name: List Uploadcare Webhooks
tools.description: Retrieves all webhook subscriptions for the authenticated Uploadcare project. Use this tool to view configured webhooks that receive notifications for file events (uploads, deletions, storage, etc.). Returns an array of webhook objects with their IDs, target URLs, event types, and active status.

tools.name: Rotate Image
tools.description: Tool to rotate an image by specified degrees counterclockwise. Use when you need to rotate an uploaded image by 90, 180, or 270 degrees. Use after confirming the file UUID.

tools.name: Start Multipart Upload
tools.description: Tool to start a multipart upload session for files larger than 100MB. Use when you need to upload large files that exceed the direct upload size limit. Returns presigned URLs for uploading file parts.

tools.name: Batch Store Files
tools.description: Tool to store multiple files in one request. Use when you need to mark up to 100 files as permanently stored in bulk.

tools.name: Store Uploadcare File
tools.description: Tool to mark an Uploadcare file as permanently stored. Use after uploading a file when you need to store it permanently.

tools.name: Store Single Uploadcare File
tools.description: Tool to store a single file by UUID permanently. Use when you need to make an uploaded file available permanently (stored files are retained indefinitely).

tools.name: Update File Metadata Key
tools.description: Tool to update or set the value of a specific metadata key for a file. Use when you need to add or modify file metadata.

tools.name: Update Uploadcare webhook
tools.description: Update an existing webhook subscription by its ID. Use this to modify the target URL, event type, active status, or signing secret of a webhook. Only provide the fields you want to update - all fields are optional except the webhook ID.

tools.name: Upload File from URL
tools.description: Tool to upload a file from a publicly available URL to Uploadcare. Use when you need to import files from external URLs into your Uploadcare project.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The public API key identifying your Uploadcare project. Used in Authorization header for requests.

required.name: generic_secret
required.description: The secret API key used to generate HMAC signature for authenticated Uploadcare API requests.

name: Uptimerobot
description: UptimeRobot is a service that monitors the uptime and performance of websites, applications, and services, providing real-time alerts and detailed logs.

tools.name: Add Monitor
tools.description: Tool to create a new monitor. Use when you need to start monitoring a URL or service; call after obtaining a valid API key.

tools.name: Delete Monitor
tools.description: Tool to delete a monitor. Use when you need to remove an existing monitor by its ID; use after confirming the monitor ID.

tools.name: Edit Maintenance Window
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing maintenance window. Use when you need to update its name, timing, recurrence, or duration after confirming the window ID.

tools.name: Edit Monitor
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing monitor. Use after confirming the monitor ID exists.

tools.name: Edit Public Status Page
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing public status page. Use after confirming the page ID. Updates friendly name, monitor set, domain, and status options in one call.

tools.name: Get Account Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve account details. Use after authenticating with a valid API key to fetch account metrics.

tools.name: Get Alert Contacts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all alert contacts configured for the account. Use when you need to list available notification channels.

tools.name: Get Maintenance Window
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific maintenance window by ID. Use when you need to get detailed information about a single maintenance window.

tools.name: Get Maintenance Windows
tools.description: Tool to retrieve maintenance windows. Use after confirming a valid API key.

tools.name: Get Monitors
tools.description: Tool to fetch monitor details and status. Use after confirming account connection.

tools.name: Get Public Status Pages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve public status pages. Use after confirming API credentials to list all public status pages for an account. Supports pagination.

tools.name: List Integrations
tools.description: Tool to list all integrations. Use to retrieve configured integrations for the account.

tools.name: List Public Status Pages (v3)
tools.description: Tool to list public status pages using the v3 API. Use to retrieve all PSPs with cursor-based pagination.

tools.name: New Maintenance Window
tools.description: Tool to create a new maintenance window. Use after confirming window parameters.

tools.name: New Public Status Page
tools.description: Tool to create a new public status page. Use when you want to publish a public status page for selected monitors after specifying a friendly name.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the UptimeRobot API.

name: urlscan.io
description: Submit and retrieve website scans, search urlscan.io data, and manage urlscan Pro resources for threat intelligence and security investigations.

tools.name: Close Incident
tools.description: Stop ongoing scans for an active urlscan Pro incident and transition it to the closed state. Closing does not delete the incident or its history, and the incident can later be restarted.

tools.name: Copy Incident
tools.description: Create a separate urlscan Pro incident from an existing incident's configuration. This create operation can consume incident capacity and does not copy the source incident's stored state history; use the distinct fork operation when history must be preserved. The provider does not document whether the copied incident immediately activates ongoing scans or alerts.

tools.name: Create Notification Channel
tools.description: Create a Pro notification channel. This operation configures external effects: active webhook channels send requests to the supplied secret URL, and active email channels send messages to the supplied recipients. Confirm the destination and activation settings before calling.

tools.name: Create Incident
tools.description: Create a Pro incident that persistently monitors an observable. This high-impact operation starts ongoing external scans and can send alerts through every supplied notification channel; confirm the observable, visibility, channels, cadence, and expiration settings before calling. The operation is contract-only because the connected build account lacks the urlscan Pro Incidents entitlement.

tools.name: Run Blocking Live Scan
tools.description: Run a temporary Live Scan synchronously and return only after the provider finishes the scan. This requires the separate Live Scanning product.

tools.name: Create Live Scan Task
tools.description: Start a non-blocking temporary Live Scan on a selected scanner and return its UUID immediately without waiting for completion. This external scan side effect requires the separate urlscan.io Live Scanning entitlement; a generic Pro plan may not include it.

tools.name: Create Saved Search
tools.description: Create a reusable scans or hostnames search definition. This operation creates a persistent saved search and requires urlscan Pro; the hostnames datasource may require an additional product entitlement.

tools.name: Create Alert Subscription
tools.description: Create a persistent scheduled or live alert subscription for saved searches. This Pro-only operation has external notification side effects: an active subscription can send email, invoke configured channels or webhooks, and create incidents. Confirm all recipients and channel or incident settings before calling.

tools.name: Delete Scan Result
tools.description: Permanently delete a scan owned by the connected user or team. This destructive operation cannot be reversed and requires urlscan Pro.

tools.name: Delete Saved Search
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved search by ID. This destructive operation cannot be undone and requires urlscan Pro saved-search access plus ownership or team write permission. Use it only for a saved search created or explicitly selected by the current workflow.

tools.name: Delete Alert Subscription
tools.description: Permanently delete an alert subscription by ID. This destructive operation cannot be undone and requires urlscan Pro subscriptions access plus ownership or team write permission. Use it only for a subscription created or explicitly selected by the current workflow.

tools.name: Download Captured File
tools.description: Retrieve a captured binary file by its SHA-256 hash as a password-encrypted ZIP archive. This operation requires urlscan Pro access.

tools.name: Fork Incident
tools.description: Create a new Pro incident by copying an existing incident's configuration and complete stored state history. This creates a separate persistent incident; history volume and whether monitoring starts immediately are not documented.

tools.name: Get Account Capabilities
tools.description: Get non-sensitive plan, product, feature, visibility, submission, and limit information for the connected urlscan.io API key.

tools.name: Get Brand Summary
tools.description: Return detectable brands with detected-page totals and latest hits. This operation requires urlscan Pro access and uses the official contract only; the provider does not document its response fields.

tools.name: Get Notification Channel
tools.description: Get one urlscan Pro notification channel by ID while preserving provider-specific metadata and removing webhook destinations or credentials.

tools.name: Get Data Dump Download Link
tools.description: Generate a temporary download URL for a path returned by LIST_DATA_DUMPS. Data Dumps require an Enterprise or Ultimate urlscan.io plan.

tools.name: Get Scan DOM
tools.description: Return the plain-text DOM snapshot captured for a completed scan.

tools.name: Get Hostname History
tools.description: Return one page of historical Pro Hostnames observations for a hostname.

tools.name: Get Incident
tools.description: Get one incident's configuration, source, runtime state, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Incident States
tools.description: Retrieve the stored state history for an incident.

tools.name: Get Live Scan Resource
tools.description: Retrieve one temporary result, DOM, screenshot, captured response, or download from the separate urlscan.io Live Scanning product. JSON and text are returned inline; binary content is offloaded as a downloadable file.

tools.name: Get Deprecated Phishing Feed
tools.description: Retrieve the deprecated urlscan Pro phishing feed in JSON, CSV, or TSV. Prefer SEARCH_SCANS for new workflows, as recommended by urlscan.io.

tools.name: Get API Quotas
tools.description: Get current products, features, query capabilities, and per-action minute, hour, and day quota usage.

tools.name: Get Captured Response Content
tools.description: Return textual content captured in a scan response, addressed by its SHA-256 hash.

tools.name: Get Scan Result
tools.description: Retrieve the complete metadata and captured request data for a completed scan UUID.

tools.name: Get Saved Search Results
tools.description: Run a urlscan Pro saved search and return its current Search API results. The provider redirect is followed automatically; this operation does not expose pagination controls.

tools.name: Get Scan Screenshot
tools.description: Retrieve a completed urlscan.io scan screenshot as a downloadable PNG file reference.

tools.name: Get Similar Scan Results
tools.description: Find one page of scan results structurally similar to a specified scan. Requires urlscan Pro access.

tools.name: Get Subscription Results
tools.description: Resolve a urlscan Pro alert subscription and datasource to its current Search API results. The provider redirect is followed automatically; this operation does not expose pagination controls.

tools.name: Get Available Brands
tools.description: List brand identifiers and metadata tracked by urlscan.io brand and phishing detection. Requires urlscan Pro brand/phishing access; the exact product and minimum plan are not documented.

tools.name: Get Available Scan Countries
tools.description: List scanner country codes currently accepted by the Scan API.

tools.name: List Notification Channels
tools.description: List email and webhook notification channels for the current user without returning webhook URLs or embedded credentials. This operation requires urlscan Pro channels access.

tools.name: List Data Dumps
tools.description: List available urlscan.io data-dump files for a time window, file type, and date. Requires an Enterprise or Ultimate plan; availability can vary by window and file type.

tools.name: List Live Scanners
tools.description: List Live Scanning nodes available to the connected account and their current metadata. This requires the separate urlscan.io Live Scanning product; a generic urlscan Pro plan may not include it.

tools.name: List Saved Searches
tools.description: List saved searches owned by or shared with the current user. This operation requires urlscan Pro saved-search access.

tools.name: List Alert Subscriptions
tools.description: List alert subscriptions configured for the current user. This operation requires urlscan Pro subscriptions access.

tools.name: Get Scan User Agents
tools.description: List grouped browser user-agent strings available for scan submission.

tools.name: Get Watchable Incident Attributes
tools.description: List attribute values accepted when configuring incident change monitoring. Requires urlscan Pro Incidents capability; the exact minimum plan or product is not documented.

tools.name: Lookup Malicious Observable
tools.description: Look up malicious-scan occurrence counts and first/last seen timestamps for an IP, hostname, domain, or exact URL. Requires urlscan Pro malicious-observable access.

tools.name: Purge Live Scan Result
tools.description: Permanently delete a temporary result from the separate urlscan.io Live Scanning product before its normal expiration. This destructive operation cannot be undone; only use it to clean up a temporary result created by the current workflow.

tools.name: Reset Scan Visibility
tools.description: Remove an owned scan's visibility override and restore the visibility originally assigned at submission. This resets an override; it does not delete the scan. Requires urlscan Pro.

tools.name: Restart Incident
tools.description: Restart a closed urlscan Pro incident and extend its expiry. This resumes ongoing external monitoring, begins recording new incident states, and can resume alerts through the incident's configured notification channels; confirm the incident should become active again before calling. This operation is contract-only because the connected build account lacks Pro Incidents access.

tools.name: Search Scans
tools.description: Search urlscan.io data with Elasticsearch Query String syntax and return one controllable page of results.

tools.name: Store Live Scan Result
tools.description: Permanently store an existing temporary Live Scan result with the selected visibility. This updates the temporary result into a durable snapshot and requires the separate urlscan.io Live Scanning entitlement; a generic urlscan Pro plan may not include it.

tools.name: Submit Scan
tools.description: Submit a URL for asynchronous external scanning, creating persistent result state and consuming quota. Visibility defaults to public, and free accounts have no cleanup operation. Returns the scan UUID for result and asset retrieval.

tools.name: Update Notification Channel
tools.description: Replace the complete configuration of an existing Pro notification channel. This operation can redirect external effects: active webhook channels send requests to the supplied secret URL, and active email channels send messages to the supplied recipients. Confirm the complete destination and activation settings before calling.

tools.name: Update Incident
tools.description: Replace an existing incident's monitoring configuration and runtime options. This Pro-only PUT requires observable, visibility, and the complete channel set, not only changed values. Updating it changes ongoing external scanning and can redirect or trigger future channel alerts; confirm the complete replacement configuration before calling.

tools.name: Update Scan Visibility
tools.description: Change the visibility of a scan owned by the connected user or team. This operation requires a paid urlscan Pro entitlement and is contract-only, not live verified. Use DELETE_RESULT for permanent deletion.

tools.name: Update Saved Search
tools.description: Replace the complete definition and metadata of an existing saved search. This PUT operation requires urlscan Pro saved-search access and write permission; the hostnames datasource may require an additional entitlement.

tools.name: Update Alert Subscription
tools.description: Replace the complete configuration of an existing alert subscription. This Pro-only PUT requires every mandatory field, not only changed values. It has external notification side effects: activating the subscription or changing recipients, channels, webhooks, or incident settings can send notifications or create incidents. Confirm the complete replacement configuration before calling.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Create or copy your urlscan.io API key after signing in and opening Settings & API (https://urlscan.io/user/profile/). To create one, select New API key. The operations available to the key depend on your urlscan.io plan and team entitlements.

name: Userflow
description: User onboarding software. Build product tours, checklists and more. No coding needed.

tools.name: Create or Update a Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group or update an existing group (also referred to as companies in the Userflow UI). Use when you need to create a new group or update attributes of an existing group by providing the group ID.

tools.name: Create or Update a User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user or update an existing user in Userflow. Use when you need to synchronize user data from your back-end to Userflow. If the user ID exists, attributes will be merged; otherwise a new user is created.

tools.name: Delete a Content Session
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a content session including its associated progress and survey answers. Use when you need to remove a content session from the system. This action cannot be undone. This operation is idempotent and will succeed even if the content session already doesn't exist.

tools.name: Delete a Group
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a group including all their attributes, memberships and events. Use when you need to remove a group from the system. This action cannot be undone, but users who were members of the group will remain intact. This operation is idempotent and will succeed even if the group already doesn't exist.

tools.name: Delete a User
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a user including all their attributes, memberships, events and flow history. Use when you need to remove a user from the system. This action cannot be undone, but groups that the user was a member of will remain intact. This operation is idempotent and will succeed even if the user already doesn't exist.

tools.name: Get a Content Object
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific content object (flow, checklist, or launcher) by ID. Use when you need to get information about a single content object, including its draft and published versions.

tools.name: Get a Content Version
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific content version by ID. Use when you need to get information about a versioned content object, including its questions (for surveys) or tasks (for checklists).

tools.name: Get a Group
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific group (company) by group_id. Use when you need to get information about a group including their attributes, creation timestamp, and optionally expanded relationships like memberships and users. Note: Groups are called 'Companies' in the Userflow UI, but the API uses 'groups' terminology.

tools.name: Get a User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific user by user_id. Use when you need to get information about a user including their attributes, creation timestamp, and optionally expanded relationships like memberships and groups.

tools.name: List Attribute Definitions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all attribute definitions for users and groups tracked by Userflow. Use when you need to see what attributes are being tracked. Attribute definitions are automatically created when new attributes are sent.

tools.name: List Content
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all content (flows, checklists, and launchers) in your Userflow account. Use when you need to check what content is available for users to start in your application.

tools.name: List Content Sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all content sessions tracking user interactions with content. Use when you need to see user journeys through flows, checklists, or launchers, including their progress and survey answers.

tools.name: List Content Versions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all versions of content including survey questions and checklist tasks. Use when you need to see the version history of flows, checklists, or launchers to track changes over time.

tools.name: List Event Definitions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all event definitions tracked in Userflow. Use when you need to see what events are being tracked. Event definitions are automatically created when new events are tracked.

tools.name: List Groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all groups (companies) in your Userflow account with pagination and filtering support. Use when you need to list groups or search for specific groups based on attributes. Note: Groups are called 'Companies' in the Userflow UI.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of all users. Use when you need to list users with optional filtering, sorting, and expansion of related objects like memberships and groups.

tools.name: Remove a User from a Group
tools.description: Tool to remove a user from a group (group membership). Use when you need to revoke a user's membership in a specific group. This operation is idempotent and will succeed even if the user is not already a member of the group.

tools.name: Track an Event
tools.description: Tool to record a custom event for a user or group for analytics and personalization. Use when you need to track user actions or behaviors. Events can be associated with just a user, just a group, or both a user and a group.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in to Userflow and copy your API Key from "Settings" > "API". Use Environment API Keys for Users API or Personal API Keys for Accounts API.

name: Userlist
description: Userlist is a full-stack email automation platform designed for SaaS companies, enabling targeted behavior-based campaigns through email and in-app messages.

tools.name: Delete Company from Userlist
tools.description: Tool to delete a company from Userlist. Use when you need to remove a company by its unique identifier after verifying it.

tools.name: Push User-Company Relationship
tools.description: Tool to create or update a relationship between a user and a company in Userlist. Use after confirming valid user and company identifiers.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The Push API key used for authenticating requests to the Userlist API.

name: V0
description: v0 is an AI-powered web development assistant built by Vercel, designed to generate real, production-ready code for modern web applications.

tools.name: Assign Chat To Project
tools.description: Tool to assign a chat to a project. Use when you need to group a conversation under a shared project context for better organization.

tools.name: V0 Chat Completions
tools.description: Tool to generate a chat model response given a list of messages. Use when you need AI-powered conversational replies via the v0 API. Note: This action uses the POST /chats endpoint which creates a persistent chat session in the user's v0 account. Each call will create a new chat that can be viewed at the returned webUrl or accessed via the apiUrl.

tools.name: Create Webhook
tools.description: Tool to create a new webhook subscription for receiving event notifications. Use when you need to listen for chat or message events from v0.

tools.name: Create V0 Project
tools.description: Tool to create a new v0 project container for chats and code generation. Use when you need to start a clean project with specific configuration.

tools.name: Create Project Environment Variables
tools.description: Tool to create new environment variables for a v0 project. Use when you need to add environment variables to a project. By default, fails if any keys already exist unless upsert is set to true.

tools.name: Create Vercel Project
tools.description: Tool to link a Vercel project to an existing v0 project. Use when you need to enable Vercel-related features and deployment integration for a v0 project.

tools.name: Delete Chat
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a specific chat by ID. Use when you need to remove a chat and all its contents irreversibly.

tools.name: Delete Deployment
tools.description: Tool to delete a deployment by ID from Vercel. Use when you need to remove a specific deployment permanently.

tools.name: Delete Hook
tools.description: Tool to delete a webhook by its ID. Use when you need to remove a webhook subscription. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete Project Environment Variables
tools.description: Tool to delete multiple environment variables from a project by their IDs. Use when you need to remove environment variables from a v0 project.

tools.name: Delete V0 Project
tools.description: Tool to permanently delete a v0 project by its ID. Use when you need to remove a project and optionally all its associated chats. This operation is irreversible.

tools.name: Deploy Project
tools.description: Tool to deploy a specific v0 chat version to Vercel. Use when you need to create a live deployment with public URLs after generating code via v0.

tools.name: Download Chat Version
tools.description: Tool to download all files for a specific chat version as a zip or tarball archive. Use when you need to retrieve a complete downloadable archive of a version's files, optionally including deployment configuration files.

tools.name: Export Project Code
tools.description: Tool to export a deployable snapshot of a v0 chat version by retrieving all files (including default/deployment files). Use when you need to get the complete generated code for a specific version, ready for local deployment or artifact creation.

tools.name: Favorite Chat
tools.description: Tool to mark a chat as favorite or remove the favorite status. Use when you need to organize and quickly access important chats.

tools.name: Find Chats
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of chats. Use when you need to list user chats with pagination and optional favorite filtering after authentication.

tools.name: Find Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of projects associated with the authenticated user. Use after obtaining a valid API key.

tools.name: Find Vercel Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of Vercel projects linked to the user's v0 workspace. Use when you need to discover available Vercel projects for deployment or integration purposes.

tools.name: Fork Chat
tools.description: Tool to create a fork (copy) of an existing chat. Use when you need to explore alternative directions without modifying the original conversation.

tools.name: Get Chat
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the full details of a specific chat using its chatId. Use when you need to access chat messages, metadata, and configuration for a specific chat.

tools.name: Get Chat Project
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the v0 project associated with a given chat. Use when you need to determine the context or scope of a chat session.

tools.name: Get Deployment Errors
tools.description: Tool to retrieve errors for a specific deployment. Use when diagnosing and debugging deployment issues.

tools.name: Get Deployment Logs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve logs for a specific deployment. Use when you need to debug or monitor deployment behavior by fetching log entries, optionally filtered by timestamp.

tools.name: Get Hook
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific webhook by its ID. Use when you need to inspect webhook configuration, subscribed events, or target URL.

tools.name: Get Chat Message
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific message within a chat. Use when you need to access message content, metadata, attachments, or model configuration for a known message ID.

tools.name: Get Project by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the details of a specific v0 project by its ID, including associated chats and metadata. Use when you need to inspect project configuration or access related chats.

tools.name: Get Project Environment Variable
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific environment variable for a given project by its ID, including its value. Use when you need to get the details of a particular environment variable for a project.

tools.name: Get Rate Limits
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the current rate limits for the authenticated user. Use when you need to monitor usage limits and avoid throttling.

tools.name: Get Usage Report
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed usage events including costs, models used, and metadata. Use when you need to access usage data from the dashboard, filter by chat/user, or analyze costs.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the currently authenticated user's information. Use when you need to get the user's ID, name, email, avatar, or account metadata.

tools.name: Get User Billing
tools.description: Tool to fetch billing usage and quota information for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check the user's billing details or usage metrics. Can be scoped to a specific project or namespace.

tools.name: Get User Plan
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the authenticated user's subscription plan details including billing cycle and balance. Use to check plan status and usage limits.

tools.name: Get User Scopes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all accessible scopes for the authenticated user, such as personal workspaces or shared teams. Use when you need to understand which workspaces the user can access.

tools.name: Initialize Chat
tools.description: Tool to initialize a new chat from source content such as files, repositories, registries, zip archives, or templates. Use when you need to start a new v0 chat session with pre-populated content. Initialization uses no tokens.

tools.name: List Chat Versions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all versions (iterations) for a specific chat, ordered by creation date (newest first). Use when you need to view the history of a chat's generated versions with cursor-based pagination support.

tools.name: List Deployments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of deployments for a given project, chat, and version. Use when you need to check existing deployments for specific project versions.

tools.name: List Hooks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all webhooks tied to chat events or deployments. Use when you need to list configured webhooks after authentication.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all messages within a specific chat. Use when you need to list messages with content, role, and type information. Supports pagination for chats with many messages.

tools.name: List Project Environment Variables
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all environment variables for a project with optional decryption. Use when you need to view project configuration or secrets.

tools.name: Update Chat
tools.description: Tool to update metadata of an existing v0 chat. Use when you need to rename a chat or change its privacy setting after creation.

tools.name: Update Chat Version Files
tools.description: Tool to update source files of a specific chat version. Use when you need to manually edit generated files through the API.

tools.name: Update V0 Webhook
tools.description: Tool to update the configuration of an existing webhook, including its name, event subscriptions, or target URL. Use when you need to modify webhook settings after creation.

tools.name: Update V0 Project
tools.description: Tool to update the metadata of an existing v0 project using its projectId. Use when you need to change the project name, description, instructions, or privacy setting.

tools.name: Update Project Environment Variables
tools.description: Tool to update environment variables for a v0 project. Use when you need to modify the values of existing environment variables.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your v0 API key, obtainable from your v0 account settings at https://v0.dev/chat/settings/keys

name: Vantage MCP
description: Vantage MCP lets agents analyze authorized cloud costs, reports, resources, tags, budgets, anomalies, and optimization recommendations, and perform supported FinOps management actions.

tools.name: Add-team-member
tools.description: Add a user to a Team by email address and assign their Team role.

tools.name: Create-annotation
tools.description: Create an Annotation on one or more Cost Reports for a specific date. Use this tool when a user asks to add a note, explanation, or event marker to Cost Reports.

tools.name: Create-billing-rule
tools.description:
Creates a new Billing Rule. Billing rules allow you to adjust, exclude, credit, charge, or apply custom modifications to your cost data.
The required fields depend on the rule type:
- Exclusion rules require charge_type.
- Adjustment rules require percentage. Optionally accepts service and category to scope the adjustment.
- Charge and Credit rules require service, category, sub_category, amount, and start_date.
- Custom rules require sql_query.

tools.name: Create-budget
tools.description:
Creates a budget based on the parameters specified. This is useful if you have been tasked with managing budgets
or you are building a cost report with budgets in mind.

tools.name: Create-budget-alert
tools.description: Create a Budget Alert that notifies users or connected channels when one or more Budgets reach a percentage threshold during a monthly time window.

tools.name: Create-canvas
tools.description:
Creates a Canvas based on the parameters specified. A Canvas is an AI-generated cost analysis view created from a natural language prompt.
The prompt describes what cost data to analyze (e.g. "Show me monthly costs by provider"). Creating a canvas triggers an asynchronous refresh to generate the data.

tools.name: Create-cost-alert
tools.description:
Create a new Cost Alert in Vantage. Cost Alerts are threshold-based spending alerts for one or more Cost Reports.

Use this tool when a user asks to create, add, or set up a cost alert, spending alert, budget alert, threshold alert, or spend-limit notification.

Do not use this for Report Notifications, scheduled report summaries, or recurring Cost Report delivery.

tools.name: Create-cost-report
tools.description:
Create a new Cost Report in Vantage.

Cost Reports are saved queries that can be used to track and analyze spending over time. They can be filtered using VQL (Vantage Query Language) and configured with various display options.

VQL Filtering Guide:
All costs originate from a Cost Provider (generally a cloud company like AWS, Azure, Datadog) and then filter on a service that they provide (like EC2, S3, etc).
A cost provider is required on every VQL query.
VQL is always in parenthesis. Always use single quotes around names that are being queried.

Basic VQL Syntax:
- Query on a cost provider: (costs.provider = '<provider name>')
- Query on a service: (costs.provider = '<provider name>' AND costs.service = '<service name>')
- Multiple providers: ((costs.provider = 'aws') OR (costs.provider = 'azure'))
- Multiple services: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND costs.service IN ('AWSQueueService', 'AWSLambda'))
- Filter by region: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND costs.region = 'us-east-1')
- Filter by account: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND costs.account_id = '1000000717')

Tag Filtering:
- Tag with specific value: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND tags.name = 'environment' AND tags.value = 'production')
- Any value of a tag: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND tags.name = 'environment')
- Resources without a tag: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND tags.name = NULL)
- Multiple tag values: (costs.provider = 'aws' AND tags.name = 'environment' AND (tags.value = 'dev' OR tags.value = 'staging'))

Use get-myself to find available workspaces and list-cost-providers/list-cost-services to find valid provider and service names for your VQL queries.

tools.name: Create-dashboard
tools.description:
Create a new Dashboard in Vantage.

Dashboards are collections of widgets that visualize cost data. You can optionally attach widgets (by
their widgetable_token) and saved filters, and you can control the time range using either:
- date_interval (recommended), or
- start_date + end_date (custom range)

Note: start_date/end_date are incompatible with date_interval.

The list of supported widgets is:
- cost reports
- usage reports
- resource reports
- kubernetes efficiency reports
- financial commitment reports
- recommendation saved views

The token returned in the response can be used to link to the Dashboard in the Vantage Web UI:
https://console.vantage.sh/go/<token>

tools.name: Create-financial-commitment-report
tools.description:
Create a new Financial Commitment Report in Vantage.

Financial Commitment Reports track committed spend and on-demand costs over time. They can be filtered
using VQL and grouped by dimensions such as commitment type, service, region, or tags.

VQL Filtering Guide:
Financial Commitment Report VQL uses the financial_commitments namespace. A provider filter should be
included in each query, and string values should be wrapped in single quotes.

Basic VQL Syntax:
- Query on a provider: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws')
- Query on a service: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws' AND financial_commitments.service = 'AmazonEC2')
- Multiple services: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws' AND financial_commitments.service IN ('AmazonEC2','AmazonRDS'))
- Filter by billing account: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws' AND financial_commitments.provider_account_id = '123456789012')
- Filter by region: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws' AND financial_commitments.region = 'us-east-1')
- Filter by tag: (financial_commitments.provider = 'aws' AND financial_commitments.resource_tags->>'environment' = 'production')

Use get-myself to find available workspaces. Use the VQL for Financial Commitment Reports resource for
the full list of available financial_commitments fields and examples.

tools.name: Create-folder
tools.description: Create a folder for organizing Cost Reports or Resource Reports. Set type to CostFolder for Cost Reports or ProviderResourceFolder for Resource Reports.

tools.name: Create-network-flow-report
tools.description: Creates a saved Network Flow Report for analyzing cloud network traffic by cost or bytes.

tools.name: Create-recommendation-view
tools.description:
Create a new Recommendation View in Vantage.

Recommendation Views are saved filters for recommendations. They can be scoped by provider,
billing account, cloud account, region, recommendation type, tags, creation date, and minimum
potential savings.

Use get-myself to find available workspaces. Use list-recommendations to discover valid provider
IDs, recommendation types, accounts, regions, tags, and savings ranges before creating a view.

Filter examples:
- AWS recommendations in production: provider_ids ["aws"], tag_key "environment", tag_value "production"
- High-savings recommendations: min_savings 100
- Recommendations created in a date range: start_date "2024-01-01", end_date "2024-06-30"

tools.name: Create-report-forecast
tools.description:
Create a scenario-model ReportForecast for a Cost Report.
Provide at least one of scenario_model_tokens or business_metric_token. Use list-scenario-models and list-business-metrics to discover tokens.
Requires Scenario Models (Enterprise). A 403 means the account is not entitled or the caller cannot update the Cost Report.

tools.name: Create-report-notification
tools.description:
Create a new Report Notification in Vantage.

Report Notifications send scheduled Cost Report summaries to configured users, Slack channels, or Microsoft Teams channels on a daily, weekly, or monthly cadence. Use this tool when a user asks to create, add, or set up scheduled report delivery for an existing Cost Report.

Do not use this for Cost Alerts, budget alerts, threshold alerts, or spend-limit notifications. Cost Alerts notify users when spend crosses a configured threshold; Report Notifications deliver scheduled report summaries.

tools.name: Create-resource-report
tools.description:
Create a saved Resource Report in Vantage. Resource Reports persist a VQL filter over cloud infrastructure resources so the view can be reopened, shared, added to dashboards, and queried later with list-provider-resources via resource_report_token. Returns the report token; link users to https://console.vantage.sh/go/<token>.

Resource Report VQL uses the resources and tags namespaces — not Cost Report costs VQL (create-cost-report). Use list-provider-resources for one-off resource queries without saving a report; use list-resource-reports to browse existing reports.

tools.name: Create-scenario-model
tools.description:
Create a ScenarioModel with optional periods and provider/service filters.
Assign created ScenarioModels to Cost Report forecasts with create-report-forecast or update-report-forecast.
Requires Scenario Models (Enterprise). A 403 means the account is not entitled or the caller cannot create models.

tools.name: Create-team
tools.description: Create a Team and optionally associate it with Workspaces, users, and a default Dashboard.

tools.name: Create-virtual-tag-config
tools.description:
Creates a new Virtual Tag (Virtual Tag Config) in Vantage.
Do not use this to edit an existing Virtual Tag Config; use update-virtual-tag-config for config settings or value order, and the Virtual Tag Config Value tools for individual values.

Virtual Tag Configs define a derived (virtual) tag key and a set of values determined by VQL filters.
This is useful for normalizing cost attribution (e.g., mapping multiple provider tag formats into a
single tag), collapsing noisy tag keys, and optionally overriding provider-supplied tags.

You can optionally:
- backfill_until: backfill the virtual tag values to an earliest month
- collapsed_tag_keys: collapse values for specific underlying tag keys (optionally scoped by provider)
- values: define named values via VQL filters, optionally linked to Business Metrics and/or cost metrics

tools.name: Create-virtual-tag-config-value
tools.description: Adds a new mapping/value to an existing Virtual Tag Config without replacing its other values. Use this to append a mapping while editing a Virtual Tag; new values are added after existing values.

tools.name: Create-workspace
tools.description: Create a new Workspace in Vantage. Workspaces are isolated environments for organizing cost data and access control across teams.

tools.name: Delete-annotation
tools.description: Delete an Annotation by its token. This action is irreversible. Use list-annotations to find the annotation_token.

tools.name: Delete-billing-rule
tools.description: Deletes a Billing Rule by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-budget
tools.description: Deletes a Budget by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-budget-alert
tools.description: Delete a Budget Alert by token. This permanently removes the alert without deleting its monitored Budgets.

tools.name: Delete-canvas
tools.description: Deletes a Canvas by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-cost-alert
tools.description: Deletes a Cost Alert by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-cost-report
tools.description: Deletes a cost report by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-dashboard
tools.description: Deletes a Dashboard by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-financial-commitment-report
tools.description: Deletes a financial commitment report by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-folder
tools.description: Deletes a Folder. Reports within the Folder will not be deleted.

tools.name: Delete-network-flow-report
tools.description: Deletes a Network Flow Report by token.

tools.name: Delete-recommendation-view
tools.description: Deletes a recommendation view by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-report-forecast
tools.description:
Delete a scenario-model ReportForecast by token. This action is irreversible.
Requires Scenario Models (Enterprise). A 403 means the account is not entitled or the caller cannot update the Cost Report.

tools.name: Delete-report-notification
tools.description:
Deletes a Report Notification by its token. This action is irreversible and stops the scheduled Cost Report summary from being delivered.

Use this tool when a user asks to delete, remove, disable, or stop a scheduled report notification. Do not use this for deleting Cost Alerts, budget alerts, threshold alerts, or spend-limit notifications.

tools.name: Delete-resource-report
tools.description: Deletes a resource report by its token. This action is irreversible.

tools.name: Delete-scenario-model
tools.description:
Delete a ScenarioModel by token. This action is irreversible and regenerates forecasts that referenced the model.
Requires Scenario Models (Enterprise). A 403 means the account is not entitled or the caller cannot delete the model.

tools.name: Delete-team
tools.description: Delete a Team.

tools.name: Delete-virtual-tag-config
tools.description: Deletes an entire Virtual Tag Config and all of its mappings/values. To remove only one mapping, use delete-virtual-tag-config-value instead.

tools.name: Delete-virtual-tag-config-value
tools.description: Deletes exactly one mapping/value from an existing Virtual Tag Config, not the containing tag. Remaining values are preserved without replacement or reordering.

tools.name: Get-anomaly
tools.description: Gets a specific anomaly alert by its token.

tools.name: Get-billing-rule
tools.description: Gets a specific Billing Rule by its token. Returns details about the rule including its type, configuration, and applicable dates.

tools.name: Get-budget
tools.description:
Gets a specific Budget by its token. Optionally includes performance data showing actual spend vs. budget amounts by period.
The token of a budget can be used to link the user to the budget in the Vantage Web UI. Build the link like this: https://console.vantage.sh/go/<BudgetToken>

tools.name: Get-budget-alert
tools.description: Get a specific Budget Alert by token. Budget Alerts monitor Budget objects.

tools.name: Get-business-metric
tools.description:
Get a specific BusinessMetric by token.
BusinessMetrics can be attached to Cost Reports for per-unit cost analysis, and their values can be retrieved with get-business-metric-values or get-business-metric-forecasted-values.

tools.name: Get-business-metric-forecasted-values
tools.description:
Get forecasted values for a BusinessMetric.
Values are returned in descending date order by the Vantage API and can include optional labels.
Use start_date to limit results to values on or after a YYYY-MM-DD date.
This endpoint is paginated. If the user asks for all values, complete data, or values for a date range such as a month, keep calling this tool with pagination.nextPage until pagination.hasNextPage is false before answering.
The API only supports a start_date lower bound. For bounded ranges, such as a specific month, fetch all pages from the requested start date and then filter the returned values to the requested end date locally.

tools.name: Get-business-metric-values
tools.description:
Get historical values for a BusinessMetric.
Values default to monthly sums grouped by label. Use day for daily sums or raw to preserve original timestamps, including hourly values; binned sums may not suit gauges or percentages.
Values are returned in descending date order by the Vantage API and can include optional labels.
When a request depends on labels but exact values are not confirmed, call list-business-metric-labels first and pass the selected values through label_values. Skip label discovery when exact values are already supplied.
Use start_date to limit results to values on or after a YYYY-MM-DD date.
This endpoint is paginated. If the user asks for all values, complete data, or values for a date range such as a month, keep calling this tool with pagination.nextPage until pagination.hasNextPage is false before answering.
The API only supports a start_date lower bound. For bounded ranges, such as a specific month, fetch all pages from the requested start date and then filter the returned values to the requested end date locally.

tools.name: Get-canvas
tools.description:
Gets a specific Canvas by its token. Returns the canvas details including its title, prompt, status, and structured table data.
The token of a canvas can be used to link the user to the canvas in the Vantage Web UI. Build the link like this: https://console.vantage.sh/go/<CanvasToken>

tools.name: Get-cost-alert
tools.description:
Gets a specific Cost Alert by its token.

Use this tool when you already have a cost alert token, such as one returned by list-cost-alerts or referenced in Vantage. Cost Alerts are threshold-based spending alerts for Cost Reports.

Do not use this for Report Notifications, scheduled report summaries, or recurring Cost Report delivery.

tools.name: Get-cost-alert-event
tools.description: Gets a specific Cost Alert event by its token. Use after list-cost-alert-events when you need the full trigger record.

tools.name: Get-cost-provider-accounts
tools.description:
Get Cost Provider Accounts in a workspace with human-readable titles.
Useful for mapping account IDs to names, or looking up an account_id for VQL.

tools.name: Get-cost-report
tools.description:
Gets a specific cost report by its token. The token of a report can be used to generate a link to the report in the Vantage Web UI: https://console.vantage.sh/go/<token>
The same token can be used with the get-cost-report-forecast tool to retrieve forecasted future costs for the report.

tools.name: Get-cost-report-forecast
tools.description:
Given a Cost Report Token, Vantage can forecast the costs for a given time range. Vantage will return costs that are *predicted*, but have not yet been actually incurred.
If the user does not set a date, best to pick the next month as the default.
The report token can be used to link the user to the report in the Vantage Web UI. Build the link like this: https://console.vantage.sh/go/<CostReportToken>

tools.name: Get-dashboard
tools.description: Gets a specific dashboard by its token. The token of a dashboard can be used to generate a link to the dashboard in the Vantage Web UI: https://console.vantage.sh/go/<token>

tools.name: Get-financial-commitment-report
tools.description:
Gets a specific financial commitment report by its token.

Use this tool when you already have a financial commitment report token, such as one returned by
Vantage or referenced in the Vantage console. The response includes the report's title, workspace,
date range, grouping, cost scope, and filter configuration. Use query-financial-commitment-report-costs
with the same token to retrieve cost data for the report.

tools.name: Get-folder
tools.description: Gets a specific Folder by its token.

tools.name: Get-myself
tools.description:
Get data that is available to the current auth token.
This includes the list of Workspaces they have access to.

default_workspace_token: The token of the workspace that is set as the default for the user and can be used for queries unless told otherwise.

tools.name: Get-network-flow-report
tools.description: Gets a saved Network Flow Report by token. Open in the console at https://console.vantage.sh/go/<token>.

tools.name: Get-provider-resource
tools.description:
Get detailed information about a specific provider resource using its token or UUID.

This returns comprehensive details about the resource including:
- Resource metadata (instance type, size, configuration, etc.)
- Account and billing account information
- Provider and region details
- Creation timestamp
- Optional cost breakdown by category

The resource_token can be either a Vantage token (starting with prvdr_rsrc) or the resource's UUID/ARN from the cloud provider.
Set include_cost to true to get cost information broken down by category.

tools.name: Get-recommendation-details
tools.description:
Get comprehensive details about a specific cost optimization recommendation using its unique token.

This tool provides in-depth information about a single recommendation including:
- Full description of the optimization opportunity
- Exact potential cost savings amount and currency
- Current status (open, resolved, dismissed)
- Category and type of recommendation (e.g., ec2_rightsizing_recommender, unused_financial_commitments)
- Cloud provider and provider account information
- Service being optimized (e.g., EC2, RDS, S3)
- Number of resources that would be affected
- Creation and last updated timestamps
- Additional metadata specific to the recommendation type

Use this tool after getting a recommendation token from list-recommendations to understand exactly what optimization is being suggested and the potential impact.

The recommendation token can also be used with get-recommendation-resources to see the specific infrastructure resources involved.

tools.name: Get-recommendation-resource-details
tools.description:
Get comprehensive details about a specific infrastructure resource within a cost optimization recommendation, including the exact actions recommended for that resource.

This tool provides the deepest level of detail about a single resource that's part of a recommendation. The response includes:
- Complete resource identification (resource ID, type, region, account)
- Current configuration and specifications
- Resource utilization metrics and patterns
- Specific recommendation actions for this resource
- Estimated cost savings for implementing the recommendations
- CLI command for remediating the recommendation
- Implementation complexity and effort estimates
- Detailed metadata specific to the resource type and recommendation category

Use this tool when you need to understand exactly what should be done with a specific resource. For example:
- For rightsizing recommendations: shows current vs. recommended instance types, CPU/memory utilization data
- For unused resources: shows usage patterns, last activity, and safe termination recommendations
- For storage optimization: shows current vs. recommended volume types, IOPS usage, throughput patterns
