Use this action when integrating Workday's person v4 API and you need to patch this specific resource. Secured by: Person Data: Work Address, Self-Service: Work Address. Scope: Contact Information.

tools.name: Update Work Contact Change Email Address
tools.description: Partially update an existing email address that is staged for update by the parent business process event. Use this action when integrating Workday's person v4 API and you need to patch this specific resource. Secured by: Person Data: Work Email, Self-Service: Work Email. Scope: Contact Information.

tools.name: Update Work Contact Change Instant Messenger
tools.description: Partially update an existing instant messenger that is staged for update by the parent business process event. Use this action when integrating Workday's person v4 API and you need to patch this specific resource. Secured by: Person Data: Work Instant Messenger, Self-Service: Work Instant Messenger. Scope: Contact Information.

tools.name: Update Work Contact Change Web Address
tools.description: Partially update an existing web address that is staged for update by the parent business process event. Use this action when integrating Workday's person v4 API and you need to patch this specific resource. Secured by: Person Data: Work Web Address, Self-Service: Work Web Address. Scope: Contact Information.

tools.name: Update Work Contact Phone Number
tools.description: Partially updates an existing phone number staged for update by the parent Work Contact Information Change business process event. Only include the fields you want to change. Note: you cannot change a primary phone to additional or vice versa, and you cannot change the Usage Type of an existing phone.

tools.name: Update Worker Check-In
tools.description: Partially updates an existing Check-In instance. Equivalent to the "Edit Check-In" task in Workday. Can only be performed by the creator or participant of the Check-In. Passing ``archive=True`` calls the ``?type=archive`` variant of the PATCH endpoint, which archives the Check-In rather than applying a normal partial update. Secured by: Self-Service: Check-Ins Scope: Performance Enablement

tools.name: Update Worker Check-In Topic
tools.description: Partially updates an existing Check-In topic instance. Equivalent to the "Edit Check-In Topic" task in Workday. Can only be performed by the creator or participant of the Check-In. Passing ``archive=True`` calls the ``?type=archive`` variant of the PATCH endpoint, which archives the topic rather than applying a normal partial update. Secured by: Self-Service: Check-Ins Scope: Performance Enablement

tools.name: Validate Phone Number
tools.description: Validates phone number data to ensure it is valid for Workday. Returns 201 if the completePhoneNumber is valid, or 400 with a validation error message otherwise. Assumes Allowed Phone Validations are enabled for the country on the Tenant Setup - Global configuration.

triggers.name: Absence Balance Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a worker's absence balance changes.

This trigger monitors a specific worker's absence plan balance and detects any changes
to the balance details including quantity available, effective date, position, or other
related fields. Uses snapshot-based diffing to detect meaningful changes.

triggers.name: Balance Details Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when details of a specific balance change (quantity, accruals, adjustments, etc.).

This trigger monitors a specific worker's absence plan balance and detects any changes
to the balance details including quantity available, effective date, position, or other
related fields. Uses snapshot-based diffing to detect meaningful field changes.

triggers.name: Interview Feedback Submitted or Updated
triggers.description:
Triggers when interview feedback is submitted or updated for a specific interview.
This trigger monitors a specific interview and fires when new feedback entries are detected
or existing feedback is modified.

triggers.name: Job Posting Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a specific job posting's details change (title, status, posting dates, location, etc.).
This trigger monitors a single job posting and fires when any of its fields are modified.

triggers.name: Job Posting Questionnaire Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a job posting's candidate questionnaire is added or changed.

This trigger monitors a specific job posting's questionnaires and detects any changes
including additions, removals, or modifications to questionnaires and questions.
Uses snapshot-based diffing to detect meaningful changes.

triggers.name: New Absence Balance
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new absence balance record becomes available for a worker.

This trigger monitors a specific worker's absence balances and detects when new
balance records appear (e.g., a new plan/bucket becomes available). Uses snapshot-based
diffing to compare balance record IDs between polls.

triggers.name: New Interview Scheduled
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new interview is scheduled/created in Workday.
This trigger monitors interviews and fires when new interview records are detected.

triggers.name: New Job Posting
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new job posting appears (newly published/opened) in Workday.
This trigger monitors job postings and fires when new postings are detected.

triggers.name: Prospect Profile Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a specific prospect's profile details change (contact info, status, type, source, level, tags, etc.).
This trigger monitors a single prospect and fires when any of its core profile fields are modified.

triggers.name: New Prospect Resume Attachment Added
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new resume/attachment is added to a specific prospect profile.
This trigger monitors a prospect's resume attachments and fires when new attachments are detected.

triggers.name: Worker Eligible Absence Type Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a worker becomes eligible or ineligible for an absence type.

This trigger monitors the list of eligible absence types for a specific worker
and detects when new absence types are added (worker becomes eligible) or when
absence types are removed (worker becomes ineligible). Uses snapshot-based diffing
to compare the list of absence type IDs between polls.

Note: Due to Workday security permissions, this endpoint typically only allows
access to the authenticated user's own data.

triggers.name: Worker Leave of Absence Changed
triggers.description:
Triggers when a worker's leave of absence record changes.

This trigger monitors all leaves of absence for a specific worker and detects:
- New leave requests created
- Changes to existing leaves (status, dates, comments, etc.)
- Deleted or rescinded leaves

Uses snapshot-based diffing to track changes between polling intervals.

triggers.name: Worker Leave of Absence Created
triggers.description:
Triggers when a new leave of absence record is created for a worker.

This trigger monitors a specific worker's leaves of absence and detects when new
leave records appear (e.g., when a leave is initiated/recorded). Uses snapshot-based
diffing to compare leave record IDs between polls.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

required.name: full
required.description: The base URL for Workday REST API requests for your tenant (e.g., https://wd2-impl-services1.workday.com/ccx/api/v1/tenant_name)

required.name: authorizationUrl
required.description: The authorization URL for Workday OAuth2 authentication (e.g., https://wd2-impl-services1.workday.com/ccx/oauth2/tenant_name/authorize)

required.name: tokenUrl
required.description: The token URL for Workday OAuth2 authentication (e.g., https://wd2-impl-services1.workday.com/ccx/oauth2/tenant_name/token)

name: Workday RaaS
description: Run web-service-enabled Workday Reports as a Service (RaaS) reports with a dedicated least-privilege Workday account.

tools.name: Get Latest Stock Grant
tools.description: Retrieve sensitive compensation data from an authorized tenant-defined Workday RaaS stock-grant report and return its unique latest row by the exact report-output grant/effective-date field verified by the caller from the tenant report as ordering grant recency. Requires tenant report and domain access through the connected Workday account. Rejects missing or malformed dates, mixed date and offset-aware date-time representations, timezone-less date-times, and ties for latest.

tools.name: Get W-2 Report
tools.description: Retrieve W-2 records from a tenant-defined Workday customreport2 or systemreport2 report using controlled company, one or more tax-year, and optional worker prompts. Each requested tax year is fetched separately and returned both per year and as one ordered aggregate. A worker prompt alias can clear a copied worker filter without replacement.

tools.name: Run RaaS Report
tools.description: Run a Workday customreport2 or systemreport2 report from its full tenant URL and return its dynamic JSON output, using an optional map of exact Prompt XML Alias names to values.

required.name: full
required.description: Your Workday tenant HTTPS origin, such as https://wd2-impl-services1.workday.com. Copy the origin from a working RaaS report URL and omit /ccx/service and everything after it.

required.name: suffix.one
required.description: The exact tenant identifier in your RaaS report URL immediately after /customreport2/ or /systemreport2/.

required.name: username
required.description: The username of a dedicated least-privilege Workday integration account or ISU that has access only to the intended web-service-enabled reports and their secured data.

required.name: password
required.description: The password for the dedicated least-privilege Workday integration account or ISU. Enter the current account password and keep it secret.

name: Workiz
description: Workiz is a field service management platform for scheduling jobs, managing leads and teams, and recording payments.

tools.name: Add Client Note
tools.description: Add a text note to a Workiz client and optionally pin it.

tools.name: Assign Technician
tools.description: Assign a technician to a Workiz job or lead, optionally replacing the existing technician when the account disallows multiple technicians.

tools.name: Assign Technicians
tools.description: Assign up to 25 technicians to one Workiz job or lead on a multi-technician account and return a separate success or failure result for each technician.

tools.name: Convert Lead to Job
tools.description: Irreversibly convert an existing Workiz lead into a job and return the resulting job. This operational transition cannot be undone and creates a persistent job record. Never use this action merely to inspect a lead.

tools.name: Create Job
tools.description: Create a scheduled or unscheduled Workiz job for an existing client, or match or create an inline client and create the job for them.

tools.name: Create Lead
tools.description: Create a scheduled or unscheduled Workiz lead for an existing client, or match or create an inline client and create the lead for them.

tools.name: Get Client
tools.description: Retrieve one Workiz client with service and billing addresses, contacts, tags, notes, custom fields, and other detail fields.

tools.name: Get Invoice or Estimate
tools.description: Retrieve one Workiz invoice or estimate with line items, payments, client and job links, totals, and status.

tools.name: Get Job or Lead
tools.description: Retrieve one Workiz job or lead, selected by record_type, including its client, schedule, status, and resource-specific detail fields.

tools.name: List Assigned Technicians
tools.description: List one page of technicians assigned to a Workiz job or lead.

tools.name: List Client Notes
tools.description: List one page of notes recorded on a Workiz client, ordered by creation date descending.

tools.name: List Clients
tools.description: List and search Workiz clients with balance, tag, created-date, and sort filters. Returns one page and a cursor for controlled continuation.

tools.name: List Invoices or Estimates
tools.description: List Workiz invoices or estimates with optional created or updated date filtering. Returns one page and a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Jobs or Leads
tools.description: List one page of Workiz jobs or leads, selected by record_type, with optional open-state, date, and sort filters, and return a continuation cursor.

tools.name: List Workiz Reference Data
tools.description: List IDs and names needed to create or update Workiz records, such as job types, ad groups, tags, statuses, and custom fields.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List Workiz users and technicians for assignment and attribution workflows. Returns one page and a cursor for controlled continuation.

tools.name: Remove Technician
tools.description: Remove a technician assignment from a Workiz job or lead.

tools.name: Search Workiz Records
tools.description: Search jobs, leads, clients, and invoices by a name, phone, email, address, serial number, or custom-field value.

tools.name: Set Primary Technician
tools.description: Make an already assigned technician the primary technician on a Workiz job or lead. All other assigned technicians become non-primary.

tools.name: Update Job
tools.description: Update only the selected fields of an existing Workiz job. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

tools.name: Update Lead
tools.description: Update only selected fields of an existing Workiz lead, including status, schedule, client details, tags, and custom fields. Unspecified fields remain unchanged.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Enable the Developer API add-on in Workiz, then open https://app.workiz.com/root/developer and copy the raw API key. Do not include the Bearer prefix; it is added automatically.

name: WorkOS
description: WorkOS provides enterprise identity and user management APIs for organizations, directory sync, connections, invitations, and users.

tools.name: Create Organization
tools.description: Create a WorkOS organization in the connected environment.

tools.name: Create Organization Membership
tools.description: Grant an AuthKit user active membership in an organization. An existing inactive membership for the same user and organization is reactivated.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Create a passwordless AuthKit user record in the connected WorkOS environment. This tool does not accept plaintext or hashed passwords.

tools.name: Delete Organization
tools.description: Permanently delete a WorkOS organization. This cannot be undone and should only target a confirmed organization ID.

tools.name: Delete Organization Membership
tools.description: Permanently remove an organization membership and its access. Prefer deactivation when access may need to be restored.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Permanently delete an AuthKit user. This cannot be undone and may remove the user's access.

tools.name: Get Connection
tools.description: Get one WorkOS connection by ID.

tools.name: Get Directory
tools.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync directory by ID.

tools.name: Get Directory Group
tools.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync group by its exact group ID.

tools.name: Get Directory User
tools.description: Get one WorkOS Directory Sync user by exact ID, including identity-provider attributes, roles, and any groups returned by WorkOS. For complete group memberships, use List Directory Groups filtered by this directory user ID.

tools.name: Get Invitation
tools.description: Get WorkOS AuthKit invitation status and metadata by invitation ID without exposing acceptance credentials.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Get one WorkOS organization by its WorkOS ID or external ID.

tools.name: Get Organization Membership
tools.description: Get one WorkOS AuthKit organization membership by ID.

tools.name: Get User
tools.description: Get one WorkOS AuthKit user by WorkOS ID or external ID.

tools.name: List Connections
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS SSO and OAuth connections, optionally filtered by connection type, domain, organization, or name.

tools.name: List Directories
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync directories, optionally filtered by organization, directory name, or domain.

tools.name: List Directory Groups
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync groups for a directory, a directory user, or both.

tools.name: List Directory Users
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS Directory Sync users for a directory or group, optionally filtering a directory by exact identity-provider ID or primary email. WorkOS limits this endpoint to 4 requests per second per directory; on HTTP 429, honor Retry-After before retrying.

tools.name: List Invitations
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS AuthKit invitations by organization or exact recipient email without exposing acceptance credentials.

tools.name: List Organization Memberships
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS AuthKit organization memberships for a specific organization or user, optionally including inactive or pending memberships.

tools.name: List Organizations
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS organizations, optionally filtered by domain or organization name.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List one page of WorkOS AuthKit users, optionally filtered by organization or exact email address.

tools.name: Resend Invitation
tools.description: Send another real invitation email to the existing recipient of a pending WorkOS AuthKit invitation. This externally visible email delivery cannot be undone. The response excludes the invitation token and acceptance URL.

tools.name: Revoke Invitation
tools.description: Revoke a pending AuthKit invitation so it can no longer be accepted.

tools.name: Send Invitation
tools.description: Create an AuthKit invitation and immediately send a real invitation email to the recipient. This externally visible email delivery cannot be undone. Use only when the recipient and delivery are intentional. The output omits the sensitive acceptance token and acceptance URL.

tools.name: Set Organization Membership Status
tools.description: Activate or deactivate a WorkOS organization membership without deleting it. Deactivation removes access but can be reversed by setting the status to active.

tools.name: Update Organization
tools.description: Update selected properties of an existing WorkOS organization.

tools.name: Update Organization Membership Roles
tools.description: Replace the role assignment on an existing WorkOS organization membership.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Update selected profile fields on an AuthKit user without invoking email delivery flows.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your environment-scoped WorkOS secret API key, beginning with sk_. In the WorkOS Dashboard, select the staging or production environment you want this connection to access, then open API Keys at https://dashboard.workos.com/api-keys and copy a secret key. Requests and resources are isolated to that key's environment.

name: Worksnaps
description: Worksnaps is a time-tracking service designed for remote work that offers detailed project and user activity insights.

tools.name: Create Project
tools.description: Creates a new project in Worksnaps for tracking time and tasks. Use this tool when you need to set up a new project for time tracking. Projects serve as containers for tasks and time entries. Each project must have a unique name within the account. Note: Account plan limits may restrict the number of projects that can be created.

tools.name: Create task
tools.description: Tool to create a new task in a specified project. Use after confirming project ID exists.

tools.name: Delete Task
tools.description: Permanently deletes a task from a Worksnaps project. This action is destructive and cannot be undone. Use GET_TASKS first to find the task_id, and GET_PROJECTS to find the project_id. Returns success=true if the task was deleted. Returns 404 error if project or task does not exist.

tools.name: Get Project Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific project. Use when you have a project_id and need its details.

tools.name: Get Project Report
tools.description: Retrieves time entries for a specific project using the Worksnaps Time Entries API. Returns individual time tracking records showing when users worked on the project. Use this to get detailed time tracking data for a project within a timestamp range. Timestamps must be Unix timestamps at 10-minute interval boundaries.

tools.name: Get Projects
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a paginated list of projects. Use after authenticating to list accessible projects.

tools.name: Get Task Details
tools.description: Tool to retrieve details of a specific task within a project. Use after confirming project_id and task_id.

tools.name: Get Project Tasks
tools.description: Tool to retrieve tasks for a specific project. Use when you have a project ID and need its tasks. Example: 'Get tasks for project 42'.

tools.name: Get User Account
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about a specific user account. Use after confirming the user_id.

tools.name: Get User Assignments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of all user assignments for a specific project. Returns details about users assigned to the project including their roles, permissions, and contact information.

tools.name: Get Users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of all users in the Worksnaps account. Returns user details including id, login, name, email, time zone, and active status. Use this to get user IDs for other user-related operations.

tools.name: Update Project
tools.description: Tool to update an existing project. Use when you have project_id and fields to modify.

tools.name: Update Task
tools.description: Tool to update details of an existing task. Use when you have project_id, task_id, and fields to update.

tools.name: Update User Account
tools.description: Tool to update information for a specific user account. Use when modifying user details after confirming the user exists. Note: This can only be done by the user himself or by a trusted partner using partner's API token.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Worksnaps API token. This will be used as the username in HTTP Basic Authentication.

name: World News API
description: The World News API gives you access to thousands of news sources in over 50 languages from over 150 countries.

tools.name: Extract News Article
tools.description: Extract structured content from a public article URL. The call costs 2 quota points, plus 2 additional points when analyze is true. Paywalled or login-protected pages may return incomplete content.

tools.name: Extract News Links
tools.description: Extract article links from a news homepage or section page. The call costs 1 quota point, and an empty link list is a successful result.

tools.name: Generate RSS Feed
tools.description: Generate an RSS 2.0 XML feed from a public news homepage or section URL. Returns raw XML text. The call costs 1 quota point, plus 0.5 points per feed item when extract_news is true.

tools.name: Get Geo Coordinates
tools.description: Resolve a place name or address to latitude and longitude for use in Search News location_filter. Costs 1 quota point.

tools.name: Get News by IDs
tools.description: Retrieve full article records for IDs returned by Search News or Get Top News. Costs 0.1 quota points per returned article.

tools.name: Get Top News
tools.description: Return relevance-ranked top-news clusters for a country, language, and optional date. Costs 1 quota point; Free accounts can request about one month of history.

tools.name: Search News
tools.description: Search indexed news articles. Provide at least one anchor filter: text, source country, language, news sources, authors, categories, entities, or location. Date, sentiment, and text-match fields only refine an anchored search. Returns one offset page and costs 1 point plus 0.01 points per returned article; Free accounts can search about one month of history.

tools.name: Search News Sources
tools.description: Search monitored news sources by partial name and report matching source URLs and languages. Costs 1 quota point.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Sign in at https://worldnewsapi.com/console/, open "Profile & API Key", and reveal or generate your API key. The same key covers the direct API surface; endpoint availability depends on your World News API plan. Keep this key secret.

name: Writer
description: Writer is a full-stack generative AI platform for enterprises, offering tools to build and deploy AI applications integrated with their suite of LLMs, graph-based RAG tools, and AI guardrails.

tools.name: Add File to Knowledge Graph
tools.description: Tool to add a file to a knowledge graph for indexing and retrieval. Use when you need to add an uploaded file to an existing knowledge graph for RAG applications.

tools.name: Analyze Images
tools.description: Tool to analyze images using Writer's vision capabilities. Use when you need image understanding, text extraction from images, or visual question answering. Images must be uploaded via POST /v1/files before analysis.

tools.name: Ask Question to Knowledge Graph
tools.description: Tool to send a question to the knowledge graph and retrieve the answer. Use after defining your question and optional context.

tools.name: Chat Completion
tools.description: Tool to generate chat-based completions. Use when you need conversational AI responses; call after assembling system and user messages.

tools.name: Create Knowledge Graph
tools.description: Tool to create a new knowledge graph. Use when you need to create an empty graph that files can be added to.

tools.name: Delete File
tools.description: Tool to delete a file by its ID. Use when you need to permanently remove a file from Writer with no recovery option available.

tools.name: Delete Graph
tools.description: Tool to delete a knowledge graph by its ID. Use when you need to remove a graph after confirming its identifier.

tools.name: Detect AI Content
tools.description: Tool to detect whether content was generated by AI. Returns a classification label and confidence score indicating the likelihood of AI-generated content. Use when you need to verify content authenticity or identify AI-written text.

tools.name: Download File
tools.description: Tool to download the binary content of a file. Use when you need to retrieve file data from the Writer platform. The response contains the file in its original format.

tools.name: Get File
tools.description: Tool to retrieve detailed information about a specific file by its ID. Use when you need to check a file's metadata, processing status, or associated knowledge graphs.

tools.name: List Applications
tools.description: Tool to list all no-code agent applications. Use when you need to retrieve all registered applications.

tools.name: List Files
tools.description: Tool to list all uploaded files. Use when you need to retrieve a paginated set of user files, optionally filtered by status, graph, or type. Use after uploading files to inspect available files.

tools.name: List Knowledge Graphs
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a list of knowledge graphs. Use when you need an overview of existing graphs.

tools.name: List Models
tools.description: Tool to list all available language models. Use when you need to discover which models can be used for completions.

tools.name: Medical Text Comprehension
tools.description: Tool to extract medical entities and concepts from unstructured clinical text. Use when you need to label medical text with standardized codes such as SNOMED CT.

tools.name: Parse PDF
tools.description: Tool to parse and extract text content from a previously uploaded PDF file. Use when you need to convert PDF documents to text or markdown format for further processing.

tools.name: Remove File From Graph
tools.description: Tool to remove a file from a Knowledge Graph. Use when you need to unlink a specific file from a graph by providing both graph and file identifiers.

tools.name: Retrieve Knowledge Graph
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a knowledge graph by its ID. Use when you need details of an existing graph.

tools.name: Text Generation
tools.description: Tool to generate text based on a given prompt. Use when you need model-driven completions after crafting a prompt.

tools.name: Translate Text
tools.description: Tool to translate text from one language to another with support for formality, length control, and profanity masking. Use when you need to convert text between different languages.

tools.name: Update Knowledge Graph
tools.description: Tool to update an existing knowledge graph. Use after confirming the graph_id. Specify at least one of name or description to modify.

tools.name: Upload File
tools.description: Tool to upload a file to Writer. Use when you need to add files for Knowledge Graphs, PDF parsing, or other file-based operations. Files can be associated with Knowledge Graphs for RAG applications.

tools.name: Web Search
tools.description: Tool to perform a web search. Use when you need relevant web page results for a given query.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: The API key used for authenticating requests to the Writer API.

name: Wufoo
description: Wufoo is an online form builder for collecting entries, managing reports, and integrating form submissions with other services.

tools.name: Count Entries
tools.description: Count entries for either a Wufoo form or report without downloading them.

tools.name: Get Fields
tools.description: Return field definitions and API field IDs for a Wufoo form or for the form underlying a report.

tools.name: Get Form
tools.description: Get metadata for one Wufoo form by its permanent hash or title identifier.

tools.name: List Entries
tools.description: List entries from a Wufoo form or report. Form entries may also be filtered and sorted.

name: Yelp
description: Yelp Fusion API provides access to business search, reviews, ratings, and local business information with rich data for location-based services

tools.name: Autocomplete Search
tools.description: Get autocomplete suggestions for businesses, categories, and search terms on Yelp based on partial text input. Returns matching businesses with their Yelp IDs, relevant category suggestions, and additional search term recommendations. Use this action when users are typing search queries and need real-time suggestions to refine their search before executing a full business search. Location coordinates (latitude/longitude) are optional but can improve suggestion relevance for geographic searches.

tools.name: Get Business Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific business on Yelp using its business ID or alias. Returns comprehensive business information including hours (in the business's local timezone), photos, reviews, and location details. The returned `url` field is the Yelp listing page, not the business's own website. Response fields such as `phone` and `website` may be null; handle missing values explicitly. Avoid many parallel calls — HTTP 429 throttling applies; limit concurrency to ~5 parallel requests with exponential backoff.

tools.name: Get Business Reviews
tools.description: Get reviews for a specific business on Yelp using its business ID or alias. Returns up to 3 review excerpts for the business.

tools.name: Get Category Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Yelp category by its alias. Returns category metadata including the human-readable title, parent categories, and country availability lists. Use this action when you need to understand category hierarchies, check category availability by country, or get the proper display name for a category alias. The alias parameter must be a valid Yelp category identifier — use the list categories endpoint to discover available aliases.

tools.name: Get Event Details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Yelp event using its event ID. Returns comprehensive event information including dates, location, cost, attendance counts, and associated business details. Use this action when you need to retrieve full details about a specific event that you already have the ID for. Event IDs can be obtained from the search events or featured events endpoints.

tools.name: Get Featured Event
tools.description: Get the featured event for a given location on Yelp. Featured events are chosen by Yelp's community managers and represent notable happenings in the specified area. Use this action when you need to discover the highlighted or recommended event for a specific city, region, or coordinates. The returned `event_site_url` is the Yelp event page, not the event's own external website. Response fields such as `business_id`, `cost`, and `tickets_url` may be null; handle missing values explicitly.

tools.name: Get Review Highlights
tools.description: Get review highlights for a specific business on Yelp using its business ID or alias. Returns summarized key points and themes from customer reviews. IMPORTANT: This endpoint requires Yelp Places API Premium Plan access. Without Premium Plan, requests will return a 403 NOT_AUTHORIZED error. For basic review access, consider using the Get Business Reviews action instead, which is available on Enhanced and Premium plans. Note: Get Business Reviews returns at most 3 recent reviews per call, while this action synthesizes themes across the full review history.

tools.name: List Categories
tools.description: List all Yelp business categories across all locales by default. Returns category aliases, titles, parent relationships, and geographic availability. Use this action when you need to discover valid category aliases for filtering business searches or when building category-based navigation. The locale parameter allows filtering to categories available in specific regions while translating category names to the local language.

tools.name: Search and Chat
tools.description: Chat with Yelp's AI assistant to search for businesses, get recommendations, and ask questions. This action provides a conversational interface to Yelp's AI that can: - Search for businesses by type, location, and criteria (e.g., "best Italian restaurants near Times Square") - Answer questions about specific businesses (e.g., "what are the hours for The Purple Pig?") - Provide recommendations based on user preferences - Maintain conversation context when chat_id is provided for follow-up questions The response includes the AI's natural language answer along with detailed business data including ratings, reviews, locations, photos, and attributes for any mentioned businesses.

tools.name: Search Businesses
tools.description: Search for businesses on Yelp by location, term, categories, and other filters. Returns at most 50 results per call; use offset to paginate. Overly restrictive filter combinations (categories, price, radius) can yield zero results — loosen iteratively. Results may include businesses from adjacent areas; post-process on location.city or distance for strict boundaries. The returned url field is the Yelp listing page, not the business's own website. Rapid parallel calls can trigger HTTP 429 — apply exponential backoff.

tools.name: Search Business by Phone
tools.description: Search for a business by phone number on Yelp. Returns business data including business_id, required by YELP_GET_BUSINESS_DETAILS, YELP_GET_BUSINESS_REVIEWS, and YELP_GET_REVIEW_HIGHLIGHTS. Empty results are inconclusive due to incomplete Yelp coverage.

tools.name: Search Events
tools.description: Search for events on Yelp by location, categories, and other filters. Returns events happening in the specified area with details like time, cost, and attendance. Use this action when you need to find local events, activities, or happenings in a specific geographic area. Events can be filtered by category (music, food, sports), cost (free or paid), and time range. Results are sorted by popularity or start time and can be paginated using limit and offset parameters.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your private Yelp Places API key. Create an app and select a plan, then copy the key from the Yelp Manage App page at https://www.yelp.com/developers/v3/manage_app. Keep this key secret.

name: YouTube Transcript
description: Retrieve and store captions for one video or a bounded batch, read job and batch status, access stored transcripts and languages, and resolve playlist or channel video metadata through the YouTube Transcript REST API.

tools.name: Get Stored Transcript
tools.description: Read a transcript already stored in the connected account without submitting new transcription work or consuming retrieval credits.

tools.name: Get Video Transcript
tools.description: Fetch captions for one YouTube video and store the resulting transcript in the connected account. This consumes provider credits, but never starts ASR. The tool waits up to 20 seconds for asynchronous caption jobs; if one is still processing, use GET_VIDEO_TRANSCRIPT_JOB_STATUS with the job_id from the timeout.

tools.name: Get Video Transcript Job Status
tools.description: Read one transcript job's current processing, completed, failed, or requires-ASR-confirmation state without creating work or waiting. Use this one-shot read when GET_VIDEO_TRANSCRIPT times out, passing the same include flags to recover the requested transcript shape.

tools.name: Get Video Transcripts Batch
tools.description: Fetch and store captions for 1-10 YouTube videos. Each uncached video can consume provider credits, so cost scales with the request size. ASR never starts. This creates one batch and waits up to 20 seconds for a terminal result; if it is still processing, use GET_VIDEO_TRANSCRIPTS_BATCH_STATUS with the batch_id from the timeout.

tools.name: Get Video Transcripts Batch Status
tools.description: Read the current state and available per-video results for a transcript batch without creating work or waiting. Use this one-shot read to recover when GET_VIDEO_TRANSCRIPTS_BATCH times out while the provider is still processing.

tools.name: List Stored Transcripts
tools.description: List and search transcripts already stored in the connected account, one bounded page at a time.

tools.name: List Transcript Languages
tools.description: List stored languages and YouTube translation target languages for one owned video transcript.

tools.name: Resolve Channel Videos
tools.description: Requires Basic or higher. Resolve a YouTube channel into bounded upload metadata without transcribing the videos. This may count against the account's monthly channel allowance.

tools.name: Resolve Playlist Videos
tools.description: Requires Basic or higher. Resolve a YouTube playlist into bounded video metadata without transcribing the videos. This may count against the account's monthly playlist allowance.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your YouTube Transcript API key. Sign in at https://www.youtubetranscript.dev/dashboard/account and copy the key from your account dashboard. It typically starts with yt_sk_live_; keep it secret.

name: Zep
description: The Foundational Memory Layer for AI. Equip your agents with the knowledge to complete tasks, from the mundane to monumental.

tools.name: Add Fact Triple
tools.description: Tool to add a manually specified fact triple (subject-predicate-object) to the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to add explicit relationships between entities. Returns a task_id to monitor processing status.

tools.name: Add Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to add memory messages to a specified Zep session. Use when you need to store conversation history or context in a session.

tools.name: Add Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to add chat messages to a thread in Zep and ingest them into the user knowledge graph. Use when you need to add conversation history to a thread - for best results, add messages on every chat turn in the order they were created.

tools.name: Clone Graph
tools.description: Tool to clone a user or group graph with new identifiers in Zep. Use when you need to create test copies of user data, migrate user graphs to new identifiers, or set up template graphs for new users. This is an asynchronous operation that returns a task_id for tracking progress.

tools.name: Create Graph
tools.description: Tool to create a new graph by adding data to Zep. Use when you need to add text, message, or JSON data to a user's graph or a specific graph. The data is processed and an episode node is created in the graph.

tools.name: Create Group
tools.description: Tool to create a new group in Zep for multi-user graph management. Use when you need to create a namespace for shared context across multiple users.

tools.name: Create Session
tools.description: Tool to create a new session in Zep for storing conversation memory. Use when you need to establish a new conversation context linked to an existing user. The user must be created first before creating a session.

tools.name: Create Thread
tools.description: Tool to create a new thread in Zep for a specific user. Use when you need to start a new conversation thread. The user must be created first before creating a thread. Zep automatically warms the cache for that user's graph data in the background to improve query latency.

tools.name: Create User
tools.description: Tool to create a new user in Zep with properties like user_id, email, and metadata. Use when you need to add a new user to the system. It is recommended to provide at least first_name and ideally last_name for better user association.

tools.name: Delete Graph
tools.description: Tool to delete a graph from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a graph and all associated data.

tools.name: Delete Group
tools.description: Tool to delete a group from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a group and its associated data.

tools.name: Delete Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to delete a session and its memory from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove all memory data associated with a specific session.

tools.name: Delete Thread
tools.description: Tool to delete a thread and its messages from Zep. Note that deleting a thread removes the thread and its messages from the thread history but does not delete associated data in the user's knowledge graph.

tools.name: Delete User
tools.description: Tool to delete a user and all associated threads and artifacts from Zep. Use when you need to permanently remove a user and handle Right To Be Forgotten requests. Deleting a user will delete all threads and thread artifacts associated with that user.

tools.name: Get Edge by UUID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific edge by its UUID from the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a relationship between nodes, including the semantic fact, connected nodes, and temporal metadata.

tools.name: Get Graph by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a graph by its unique identifier from Zep. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific graph including its name, description, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get Group by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a group by ID from Zep. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific group including its configuration and metadata.

tools.name: Get Node Entity Edges
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all entity edges for a specific node in the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to fetch relationship information, facts, and connections for a given node UUID.

tools.name: Get Project Info
tools.description: Tool to retrieve project information based on the provided API key. Use when you need to fetch project details including UUID, name, description, and creation timestamp.

tools.name: Get Session by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a session by its unique identifier from Zep. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific session including user association, timestamps, classifications, and metadata.

tools.name: Get Session Memory
tools.description: Tool to retrieve memory for a given session including relevant facts and entities. Use when you need contextual information and historical data from a session.

tools.name: Get Session Message by UUID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a specific message by UUID from a Zep session. Use when you need to fetch a single message's details by its unique identifier from a particular session.

tools.name: Get Session Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve messages for a given session from Zep. Use when you need to fetch the message history for a specific session with optional pagination support.

tools.name: Get Task Status
tools.description: Tool to check the status of asynchronous operations in Zep. Use when monitoring batch adds, clone operations, or fact triple additions. Returns comprehensive task information including status, progress, timestamps, and error details if applicable.

tools.name: Get Thread Messages
tools.description: Tool to retrieve conversation history for a specific thread from Zep. Use when you need to fetch the chat message history with optional pagination support via limit, cursor, or lastn parameters.

tools.name: Get Thread User Context
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the most relevant user context from the user graph based on thread messages. Use when you need to get context including memory from past threads that is most relevant to the current thread.

tools.name: Get User by ID
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user by their user ID from Zep. Use when you need to fetch detailed information about a specific user including their profile, metadata, and configuration settings.

tools.name: Get User Node
tools.description: Tool to retrieve a user's graph node and summary from Zep. Use when you need to access the user summary generated from instructions, build custom context blocks, or retrieve facts and information associated with a specific user.

tools.name: Get User Nodes
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all nodes for a specific user from their graph in Zep. Use when you need to fetch entity information, preferences, and knowledge graph data for a user. Supports pagination via limit and uuid_cursor parameters.

tools.name: Get User Sessions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all sessions for a user from Zep. Use when you need to fetch session history for a specific user ID. Returns an array of session objects with metadata, classifications, and timestamps.

tools.name: Get User Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all threads for a specific user from Zep. Use when you need to fetch thread history for a specific user ID. Returns an array of thread objects with identifiers and timestamps.

tools.name: Graph Search
tools.description: Tool to perform hybrid graph search combining semantic similarity and BM25 full-text search across the Zep knowledge graph. Use when you need to search for entities, relationships, or episodes within a user, group, or specific graph. Supports various reranking methods and filtering options.

tools.name: List Groups Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all groups from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of groups with optional pagination via pageNumber and pageSize parameters.

tools.name: List Sessions Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all sessions from Zep with pagination and ordering support. Use when you need to fetch a list of sessions with optional pagination via page_number and page_size parameters.

tools.name: List Threads
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all threads from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of threads with optional pagination and sorting via page_number, page_size, order_by, and asc parameters.

tools.name: List Users Ordered
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all users from Zep with pagination support. Use when you need to fetch a list of users with optional pagination via pageNumber and pageSize parameters.

tools.name: Update Graph
tools.description: Tool to update graph information in Zep including name and description. Use when you need to modify graph properties after creation.

tools.name: Update Group
tools.description: Tool to update group information in Zep including name, description, and fact rating instructions. Use when you need to modify an existing group's properties.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Tool to update a message in a Zep thread. Use when you need to modify message content, metadata, role, or other properties of an existing message. Particularly useful for adding or modifying metadata after a message has been created.

tools.name: Update Session Metadata
tools.description: Tool to update session metadata in Zep. Use when you need to modify or add metadata to an existing session. Metadata is merged, so existing keys are preserved unless explicitly overwritten.

tools.name: Update User
tools.description: Tool to update an existing user's information in Zep including email, metadata, and ontology settings. Use when you need to modify user properties after creation.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zep API key. For Zep Cloud, create an API key in Project Settings under Project Keys. Keys starting with "z_" use Api-Key format, others use Bearer format.

name: Zeplin
description: Zeplin is a design delivery platform that connects designers and developers, enabling access to design resources like projects, screens, components, and assets.

tools.name: Start OAuth authorization (PKCE)
tools.description: Tool to start OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow for Zeplin apps. Use when initiating user authorization; call before exchanging the code.

tools.name: List Project Connected Components
tools.description: Tool to list connected components in a Zeplin project. Use when you have the project_id and need to retrieve connected components in a specific project.

tools.name: List Project Colors
tools.description: Tool to list colors in a Zeplin project. Use when you need to fetch defined color tokens at the project level after obtaining the project ID.

tools.name: Update Project Color

tools.name: Posts create
tools.description:
Create a social media post. Can be saved as DRAFT, SCHEDULED, or PUBLISHED immediately.

⚠️ IMPORTANT - Choose the correct mode based on user intent:

**DRAFT MODE (is_draft=True)**
Use when user says: "draft", "borrador", "save for later", "don't publish", "save it", "guardar"
→ Post is saved but NOT published and NOT scheduled. User can edit it later.

**IMMEDIATE MODE (publish_now=True)**
Use when user says: "publish now", "post now", "publica ya", "immediately", "right now", "ahora"
→ Post goes live IMMEDIATELY.

**SCHEDULED MODE (default)**
Use when user says: "schedule", "programar", "in X minutes/hours", "at 3pm", "tomorrow"
→ Post is scheduled for future publication. Use schedule_minutes to set the delay.

⚠️ MULTI-ACCOUNT USERS (agencies, multi-client setups):
If the user has more than one account on the target platform, you MUST pass
`account_id`. Call `accounts_list` (or `profiles_list` then `accounts_list`)
first to discover the right ID. If you omit account_id when multiple accounts
exist, the tool returns an error listing the candidates - use it to retry.

Examples:
- "Create a draft tweet" → is_draft=True
- "Post this to Twitter now" → publish_now=True
- "Schedule a LinkedIn post for 2 hours from now" → schedule_minutes=120
- "Post this to Acme's Twitter" → call accounts_list, find Acme's twitter ID, pass account_id

tools.name: Posts cross post
tools.description:
Post the same content to multiple platforms at once.

⚠️ IMPORTANT - Choose the correct mode based on user intent:

**DRAFT MODE (is_draft=True)**
Use when user says: "draft", "borrador", "save for later", "don't publish"
→ Posts are saved but NOT published. User can edit them later.

**IMMEDIATE MODE (publish_now=True)**
Use when user says: "publish now", "post now", "immediately"
→ Posts go live IMMEDIATELY on all platforms.

**SCHEDULED MODE (default)**
Use when user says: "schedule", "programar", "in X hours"
→ Posts are scheduled for 1 hour from now.

⚠️ MULTI-ACCOUNT USERS:
- To pick a specific account per platform, pass `account_ids` parallel to
  `platforms` (same order, comma-separated). Use empty string for a position
  to fall back to profile/auto-resolution.
- To target multiple accounts of the SAME platform in one call, repeat the
  platform: platforms='twitter,twitter', account_ids='acc_a,acc_b'.
- If you omit account_ids and the user has multiple accounts for any of the
  requested platforms, the tool errors with the candidate list - use it to retry.

tools.name: Usage get usage
tools.description:
Usage snapshot (default) or billed-spend metering (with params)

    Args:
        reconcile: Snapshot mode only. For Stripe subscription users, `true` forces a
subscription reconciliation pass even when cached plan data looks
complete.
        range: Window to report. `cycle` / `prev-cycle` resolve to the customer's
real billing-period bounds (falling back to a trailing 30 days when
no invoice exists yet); `7d`…`12mo` are trailing windows; `custom`
uses `from` / `to`.
        from_: Inclusive start (UTC date). Required when `range=custom`.
        to: Inclusive end (UTC date). Required when `range=custom`. Max span 366 days.
        granularity: Bucketing of the `days` series: `day` (one row per UTC day),
`month` (one row per calendar month, dated to the 1st), or `total`
(no series, read `totals`). Does not affect `totals`.
        group_by: Metering mode. Adds `attribution`: the window's spend split per profile or per account (keys are ids; resolve names via `GET /v1/profiles` / `GET /v1/accounts`).
        profile_id: Metering mode (pair with `range`). Project the payload onto this profile's attributed share. Mutually exclusive with `accountId`, and `groupBy` (if given) must be `profile`; 404 when the profile is not in your team (or outside a scoped key's profiles).
        account_id: Metering mode (pair with `range`). Project the payload onto this account's attributed share. Mutually exclusive with `profileId`, and `groupBy` (if given) must be `account`; 404 when the account is not visible to the caller.

tools.name: List Resource Bookings
tools.description: Return bookings for selected rooms in a paid Zoho Resource Booking branch. This endpoint is not paginated and requires an inclusive MM/DD/YYYY start and end date, matching Zoho's official request example.

tools.name: List Resource Booking Branches
tools.description: Return all branches from paid Zoho Resource Booking, including their buildings and floors. Resource Booking must be enabled for the connected account. Zoho documents this endpoint as an unpaginated bare list.

tools.name: List Calendars
tools.description: Return calendars visible to the connected user, optionally by documented category and hidden status.

tools.name: List Calendar Shares
tools.description: Return user and group sharing entries for one calendar.

tools.name: List Event Instances
tools.description: Return recurrence instances for one repeating event in a required range of at most 90 days. This endpoint is not paginated.

tools.name: List Events
tools.description: Return events in one calendar for a required range of at most 31 days. This endpoint is not paginated.

tools.name: List Favorite Resources
tools.description: Return the connected user's favorite room resources from paid Zoho Resource Booking. Zoho returns the complete, unpaginated Resource array as a JSON-encoded string, which this action preserves exactly.

tools.name: Get Group Attendee Statuses
tools.description: Return member RSVP statuses for one group attendee on an event.

tools.name: List My Resource Bookings
tools.description: Return the connected user's room bookings for an exact date range. This unpaginated action requires a paid Zoho plan with Resource Booking enabled and preserves Zoho's JSON-encoded resources and bookings strings exactly.

tools.name: List Resource Availability
tools.description: Return room resources and availability for a branch, optional building or floor, and an exact date/time range. This unpaginated endpoint requires a paid Zoho plan with Resource Booking enabled, and the date span cannot exceed the administrator-configured booking duration.

tools.name: List Resource Booking User Settings
tools.description: List user settings for at least one branch, building, or floor in paid Zoho Resource Booking. The connected account must have organization administrator access. Zoho documents this endpoint as unpaginated.

tools.name: List Resource Features
tools.description: Return all feature definitions from paid Zoho Resource Booking. Resource Booking must be enabled for the connected account. Zoho documents this endpoint as an unpaginated bare list.

tools.name: List Resources
tools.description: Return room resources for at least one branch, building, or floor. This endpoint requires a paid Zoho plan with Resource Booking enabled and is not paginated. Set include_current_time to select Zoho's resources/current_time response wrapper; otherwise the response is a bare resource array.

tools.name: Move Event
tools.description: Move an event between personal or group calendars, optionally changing documented event details; shared and app calendars are unsupported and recurrence changes affect all occurrences. Notification modes 1 and 2 immediately send attendee or attendee-and-organizer notifications that cannot be recalled. To attach a file while moving, first call UPLOAD_EVENT_ATTACHMENT, then pass its returned ID in event_data.attach.file_ids.

tools.name: Replace Event
tools.description: Replace an event using complete date/time data and its latest ETag, without adding Zoho Meeting conferencing. Supplying event_data.attach.remove_attachment_ids permanently removes those attachments; DELETE_EVENT_ATTACHMENTS remains available for dedicated removal. Notification modes 1 and 2 immediately send attendee or attendee-and-organizer notifications that cannot be recalled. To add attachments, first call UPLOAD_EVENT_ATTACHMENT, then pass its returned IDs in event_data.attach.file_ids.

tools.name: Unfavorite Resource
tools.description: Remove one room from the connected user's favorites. This requires a paid Zoho plan with Resource Booking enabled. It only removes the favorite marker; it does not delete the resource or its bookings.

tools.name: Update Resource Booking
tools.description: Update a room booking or selected recurrence occurrences in paid Zoho Resource Booking. Every update must include title, date/time, and resources. Attendee and group arrays apply participant changes rather than replacing the complete lists: omitted participants remain, and deleted=true removes one. Notification modes 1 and 2 immediately send attendee notifications that cannot be recalled. Room availability and administrator-configured booking range limits apply.

tools.name: Update Resource Booking Branch
tools.description: Update a branch or add or remove its buildings and floors in paid Zoho Resource Booking. The connected user must have Resource Booking administration permission. Removing a building or floor is permanent and can fail while the target is occupied or otherwise in use. Because this endpoint supports permanent removal, ordinary branch edits are also gated as irreversible.

tools.name: Update Calendar
tools.description: Update one or more documented properties of an existing calendar.

tools.name: Update Calendar Settings
tools.description: Update a non-empty set of the connected user's documented Calendar preferences.

tools.name: Update Calendar Share
tools.description: Supports add, edit, and revoke modes for one user or group calendar share; operation='delete' revokes access, so every call is pessimistically gated as destructive.

tools.name: Update Event
tools.description: Partially update event fields or attendee data using exactly one documented payload. Supplying event_data.attach.remove_attachment_ids permanently removes those attachments; DELETE_EVENT_ATTACHMENTS remains available for dedicated removal. Notification modes 1 and 2 immediately send attendee or attendee-and-organizer notifications that cannot be recalled. To add attachments, first call UPLOAD_EVENT_ATTACHMENT, then pass its returned IDs in event_data.attach.file_ids.

tools.name: Update Resource
tools.description: Update a room, its feature assignments, or its visibility in paid Zoho Resource Booking. The connected user must have Resource Booking administration permission. Room image upload is not exposed because Zoho does not document the photo transport encoding; its paired image file name is therefore not settable either.

tools.name: Update Resource Booking Organization Settings
tools.description: Update organization-wide booking limits in paid Zoho Resource Booking. The connected user must be a Zoho organization administrator.

tools.name: Update Resource Booking User Settings
tools.description: Update user preferences in paid Zoho Resource Booking. By default this targets the connected user; supplying another user's user_id requires organization administrator access.

tools.name: Update Resource Feature
tools.description: Rename or hide a feature in paid Zoho Resource Booking. The connected user must have Resource Booking administration permission, and the feature type cannot be changed.

tools.name: Upload Event Attachment
tools.description: Upload one file of at most 10,240 kB. This only uploads the file: next pass the returned fileId as file_ids in the attach object of CREATE_EVENT, UPDATE_EVENT, REPLACE_EVENT, or MOVE_EVENT to associate it with an event.

name: Zoho Campaigns
description: Manage Zoho Campaigns mailing lists, contacts, campaigns, reports, topics, tags, custom fields, and segments through the management API.

tools.name: Add Contacts to Mailing List
tools.description: Add between one and ten email addresses to an existing Zoho Campaigns mailing list in one request.

tools.name: Add Mailing List and Contacts
tools.description: Create a Zoho Campaigns mailing list and optionally add up to ten email addresses in the same call.

tools.name: Associate Tag with Contact
tools.description: Associate an existing Zoho Campaigns contact tag with one contact email address. Zoho performs this state-changing operation through an HTTP GET request, so do not treat it as a safe read.

tools.name: Clone Campaign
tools.description: Clone an existing campaign into a new draft with a new name and subject. This action creates a draft and does not send it.

tools.name: Count Mailing List Contacts
tools.description: Count contacts in a mailing list for one subscription, bounce, or spam status.

tools.name: Create Campaign
tools.description: Create an email campaign draft for mailing-list or segment recipients. This action creates a draft only and does not send or schedule the campaign.

tools.name: Create Contact Field
tools.description: Create a custom contact field in Zoho Campaigns. The documented API does not provide an update or delete operation for custom fields.

tools.name: Call Deprecated Create Merge Tag
tools.description: Call Zoho Campaigns' deprecated merge-tag endpoint for compatibility. Live provider evidence confirms that it creates nothing and only reports that merge tags are generated automatically for contact fields. Use List Contact Fields to discover those fields instead.

tools.name: Create Tag
tools.description: Create a Zoho Campaigns contact tag with a description and color.

tools.name: Create Topic
tools.description: Create a brand topic or brand-product topic. Zoho Campaigns documents no API endpoint for deleting a topic, so this action may leave durable account state.

tools.name: Delete Campaign
tools.description: Permanently delete one Zoho Campaigns campaign by exact campaign key. This destructive operation cannot be undone. Verify the campaign and obtain explicit confirmation before calling it.

tools.name: Delete Mailing List
tools.description: Permanently delete a mailing list. Contacts remain in the organization by default; setting delete_contacts to true also permanently deletes them and is more destructive, so that mode requires confirm_delete_contacts=true.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Permanently delete one Zoho Campaigns contact tag by exact name. Zoho performs this destructive operation through an HTTP GET request, so do not treat it as a safe read. Verify the tag and obtain explicit confirmation before calling it.

tools.name: Dissociate Tag from Contact
tools.description: Remove an existing Zoho Campaigns contact-tag association without deleting the tag or contact.

tools.name: Get Campaign Details
tools.description: Get a campaign's status, sender, recipients, reach, and summary report data.

tools.name: Get Campaign Report
tools.description: Get aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for one campaign.

tools.name: Get Coupon Details
tools.description: Get a coupon's code, recipient, campaign, sent and expiry dates, and current status.

tools.name: Get Last Campaign Report
tools.description: Get aggregate delivery, open, click, bounce, and reach metrics for the organization's most recently sent campaign. Fails clearly when the account has no sent campaigns.

tools.name: Get Mailing List Details
tools.description: Get a mailing list's contact statistics, client and device breakdowns, and optionally filtered campaign details one page at a time.

tools.name: Get Segment Details
tools.description: Get the filtering criteria and metadata for a segment in a mailing list.

tools.name: List Campaign Recipients
tools.description: List recipients in one campaign delivery or engagement state, one page at a time. Pagination is provisional because no sent campaign was available to verify successful page output.

tools.name: List Contact Fields
tools.description: List standard and custom contact fields available to the connected Campaigns organization.

tools.name: List Mailing List Contacts
tools.description: List contacts in a mailing list, optionally filtered by subscription or bounce status, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Mailing Lists
tools.description: List mailing lists and their contact, ownership, segment, and status metadata one page at a time.

tools.name: List Open Workflows
tools.description: List open custom workflows one page at a time.

tools.name: List Recent Campaigns
tools.description: List recent campaigns filtered by lifecycle status, one page at a time.

tools.name: List Recently Sent Campaigns
tools.description: Return up to a requested number of the most recently sent campaigns; an account with no sent campaigns returns an empty list.

tools.name: List Segment Contacts
tools.description: List contacts belonging to a Zoho Campaigns segment one page at a time. Pagination is provisional because no live segment fixture was available during probing.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List all Zoho Campaigns contact tags and their metadata. Zoho requires contact UPDATE permission even though this action only reads.

tools.name: List Topic Products
tools.description: List products available for brand-product topics one page at a time. Organizations using the brand topic model receive an explicit incompatibility error because that model has no topic products.

tools.name: List Topics
tools.description: List subscription topics for the organization one page at a time.

tools.name: Mark Coupon Used
tools.description: Irreversibly mark a Zoho Campaigns coupon as used. The documented API provides no action to restore the coupon's prior status, so use this only after the user explicitly confirms the state change.

tools.name: Move Contact to Do-Not-Mail
tools.description: Permanently suppress one email address across the connected Zoho Campaigns organization by moving it to the Do-Not-Mail registry. This is broader than unsubscribing from one mailing list, cannot be reversed through the documented API, and was not live-tested because even a test call creates durable suppression. Requires confirm_permanent_suppression=true after the user explicitly confirms this consequence.

tools.name: Schedule Campaign
tools.description: Schedule a reviewed campaign for future delivery. This commits the campaign to sending, and this toolkit has no cancellation action; call only after the user confirms the campaign, date, time, and time zone.

tools.name: Send Campaign
tools.description: Immediately and irreversibly send a reviewed Zoho Campaigns campaign to its entire configured audience. This is not a preview, test, draft, or scheduling operation. Delivery cannot be canceled or undone after the call, so use only after the user explicitly confirms the campaign and audience are final.

tools.name: Subscribe Contact
tools.description: Add or update one contact in a mailing list. Depending on the mailing-list settings, Zoho Campaigns may send the contact a confirmation email.

tools.name: Trigger Workflow Contacts
tools.description: Add between one and 200 contacts to a Zoho Campaigns custom workflow. Triggering contacts can run the workflow's downstream automations, so this action requires confirm_trigger=true after the user confirms that effect.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Contact
tools.description: Unsubscribe one contact from a mailing list or topic. This is a reversible, list-level opt-out and does not add the address to the organization-wide Do-Not-Mail registry.

tools.name: Update Mailing List
tools.description: Rename a mailing list and set its signup form visibility.

tools.name: Update Issue Comment

tools.name: Update Issue Resolution (V3.1 PATCH)

tools.name: Update Project Export

tools.name: Update Project Group

tools.name: Update Project User Details
