name: Zoho Recruit
description: Zoho Recruit is an applicant tracking and recruitment platform for managing candidates, job openings, interviews, applications, and hiring workflows.

tools.name: Add Tags To Records
tools.description: Add existing tags by name to one or up to 500 records in a Zoho Recruit module. One record uses the live-verified single route; multiple records use the documented bulk route. Inspect every outcome because item failures can appear inside an HTTP success response.

tools.name: Associate Candidates With Jobs
tools.description: Associate candidate IDs with job-opening IDs and optionally add a comment. Returns every provider outcome because Zoho can report item-level failures inside a successful HTTP response. This documented mutation was not live-probed.

tools.name: Cancel Interview
tools.description: Cancel one scheduled Zoho Recruit interview with an optional reason and feedback. Cancellation is irreversible. Returns the provider outcome because locked candidates, submitted recorded-video interviews, and blueprint-managed interviews cannot be cancelled. This documented mutation was not live-probed.

tools.name: Change Job Opening Pipeline
tools.description: Assign a different hiring pipeline to one Zoho Recruit job opening and choose whether to migrate its existing stage history. History migration may be irreversible. Returns every provider outcome because business validation can be reported inline.

tools.name: Change Offer Status
tools.description: Change one Zoho Recruit Offer record's status. Valid status values and additional required fields depend on the organization's Offer workflow. The transition may irreversibly trigger workflows, approvals, or notifications. Returns every item outcome because validation errors can appear inside an HTTP 202 response.

tools.name: Change Record Status
tools.description: Change Candidate, Application, or Job Opening status for one or more record IDs. Returns every provider outcome because Zoho Recruit can report item errors inside a successful HTTP response. Status transitions may irreversibly trigger workflows, approvals, blueprints, or notifications. This documented mutation was not live-probed.

tools.name: Create Assessments
tools.description: Create one or more Zoho Recruit assessment definitions, including optional sections and questions, through the v2.1 Assessments API. Inspect every outcome because item validation errors may appear inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Create Notes
tools.description: Create one or more notes attached to Zoho Recruit records. Creating a note with a new title may also create a matching note type. Inspect every outcome because Zoho Recruit can report item validation failures in a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Create Pipeline
tools.description: Create one organization-wide Job Openings hiring pipeline from existing stage and status IDs. The pipeline persists until explicitly changed or deleted; this action does not provide automatic rollback. Setting default to true replaces the organization's current default pipeline. Include the mandatory Hired, Rejected, and Archived mappings, and inspect every outcome because Zoho Recruit can report validation failures inside a 2xx response.

tools.name: Create Records
tools.description: Create up to 100 records in a supported Zoho Recruit module. Returns every per-record outcome because Zoho may report validation failures inside an HTTP 200 or 202 response.

tools.name: Create Reviews
tools.description: Create candidate, recruiter, or interviewer reviews with dynamic assessment answers. A review can also change candidate, application, or interview status through $status_info, which may trigger irreversible workflow effects. Inspect every outcome because Zoho Recruit can return validation or permission failures inside HTTP 202 responses.

tools.name: Create Stage
tools.description: Create one organization-wide Zoho Recruit hiring stage. This persistent configuration change has no automatic rollback. Zoho Recruit allows at most 10 stages and requires each stage to use a unique name and color combination. Inspect every outcome because limit and duplicate failures can be returned inside an HTTP 202 response.

tools.name: Create Submissions
tools.description: Submit candidates or applications to a client contact or hiring manager. The selected medium can send email or share content externally, and the toolkit has no proven way to retract it. Inspect every outcome because Zoho Recruit can report item validation errors inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Create Tags
tools.description: Create one or more tags for a Zoho Recruit module. Tag names are limited to 25 characters. Inspect every outcome because Zoho can report item validation failures in a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Delete Attachment
tools.description: Delete one attachment from a Zoho Recruit record. Returns every provider outcome and preserves the caller-supplied attachment ID as a string. Inspect all_succeeded because item failure can appear inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Delete Notes
tools.description: Delete one or more Zoho Recruit notes. One ID uses the single-note route and multiple IDs use the bulk route. Returns every provider outcome; inspect all_succeeded because item failures may appear inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Delete Photo
tools.description: Delete the photo from a Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact record.

tools.name: Delete Records
tools.description: Delete one record or up to 100 records from a Zoho Recruit module. One ID uses the single-record route and multiple IDs use the bulk route. Inspect every outcome because Zoho may report per-record failures inside an HTTP success response.

tools.name: Delete Stage
tools.description: Permanently delete one Zoho Recruit hiring stage. This destructive action cannot be undone and may affect configured hiring pipelines. Zoho Recruit refuses to delete the organization's last remaining stage. Inspect every outcome because a validation failure can be returned inside HTTP 202.

tools.name: Delete Tag
tools.description: Delete one tag from Zoho Recruit settings and return the provider's singular deletion outcome.

tools.name: Download Attachment
tools.description: Download a file attachment from a Zoho Recruit record. Linked URL attachments cannot be downloaded with this action. Binary success follows the provider's documented contract but was not live-probed.

tools.name: Download Photo
tools.description: Download the photo for one Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact. Returns no file when the record has no photo.

tools.name: Get Application Pipeline Transitions
tools.description: Get stage-grouped hiring-pipeline transitions for one Zoho Recruit application. Zoho may require account feature or user permissions beyond the documented OAuth grant for this operation.

tools.name: Get Custom Views
tools.description: List a Zoho Recruit module's custom views or return one custom view with its criteria, sharing details, and selected fields.

tools.name: Get Module Metadata
tools.description: Get one Zoho Recruit module's capabilities, layouts, attachment categories, custom views, and related-list metadata. Use List Fields for field definitions.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Return identity, locale, currency, company, and license details for the connected Zoho Recruit organization.

tools.name: Get Profiles
tools.description: List Zoho Recruit permission profiles or return one profile with detailed permissions by ID.

tools.name: Get Record
tools.description: Get one Zoho Recruit record, including subform details, by module and record ID.

tools.name: Get Roles
tools.description: List all Recruit organization roles or return one role by ID.

tools.name: Get Tag Record Count
tools.description: Get the number of Zoho Recruit records using a tag and optionally return the areas where the tag is configured.

tools.name: Import Candidate Document
tools.description: Import one resume document into the Zoho Recruit candidate parser using the filename parameter and a base64-encoded multipart document field. Parsing may create candidate records, and the provider does not guarantee that their IDs are returned for cleanup. The complete JSON response object is returned.

tools.name: List Associated Records
tools.description: List one page of job openings associated with a candidate or candidates associated with a job opening.

tools.name: List Attachments
tools.description: List attachments and linked URLs on one Zoho Recruit record.

tools.name: List Deleted Records
tools.description: Return one provider page of recycle-bin or permanently deleted records from a Zoho Recruit module.

tools.name: List Fields
tools.description: List field API names and metadata for a Zoho Recruit module across layouts. Runtime create validation may impose additional layout requirements.

tools.name: List Hiring Pipeline History
tools.description: Return one page of hiring-pipeline history for a Candidate, Application, or Job Opening.

tools.name: List Modules
tools.description: List modules available to the connected user with their API names, access profiles, display fields, and supported operations.

tools.name: List Notes
tools.description: Return one page of Zoho Recruit notes.

tools.name: List Note Types
tools.description: Return one page of configured Zoho Recruit note types.

tools.name: List Records
tools.description: Return one page of records from a supported Zoho Recruit module. Empty modules return an empty data list.

tools.name: List Related Lists
tools.description: Discover related-list API names and route templates available for a Zoho Recruit module.

tools.name: List Related Records
tools.description: Return one page from a named related list such as Notes, Attachments, Interviews, Contacts, or Reviews.

tools.name: List Stages
tools.description: Return one page of Zoho Recruit hiring stages and the statuses mapped to each stage. Unmapped statuses appear under the Others stage.

tools.name: List Tags
tools.description: List tags configured for a Recruit module, including counts and the module's allowed tag count.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: List Recruit users by status group or return the connected current user.

tools.name: Merge Tags
tools.description: Irreversibly merge two Zoho Recruit tags and move their associated records under the resulting tag. Provide the primary tag as tag_id and the second tag as conflict_id. Returns the provider outcome.

tools.name: Remove Tags From Records
tools.description: Remove named tags from one Zoho Recruit record or up to 500 records in a module. Returns every provider outcome; details.tags names the affected tags rather than the tags remaining on each record.

tools.name: Review Submission
tools.description: Approve or reject one Zoho Recruit submission with a rating and optional reviewer details. The review decision is not reversible. Returns the provider outcome because archived, previously reviewed, or invalid rating/status combinations may be reported inline.

tools.name: Revoke Blueprint
tools.description: Irreversibly remove one Zoho Recruit record from its active blueprint process. This cannot be undone. Returns every provider outcome because Zoho Recruit can report CANNOT_PERFORM_ACTION inside a successful HTTP response when the record is not in a blueprint process.

tools.name: Search Records
tools.description: Search one Zoho Recruit module using exactly one selector and return one provider page of up to 49 matching records.

tools.name: Transfer and Delete Pipeline
tools.description: Permanently delete one Zoho Recruit hiring pipeline after transferring all of its associated stages, statuses, and records to a different pipeline. This destructive operation cannot be undone and may run asynchronously.

tools.name: Update Assessments
tools.description: Update one Zoho Recruit assessment by path ID or multiple assessments carrying their own IDs through Recruit v2.1. Returns every provider outcome; inspect all_succeeded because item errors can appear inside a successful HTTP response. This documented mutation was not live-probed because no guaranteed assessment cleanup operation is available.

tools.name: Update Notes
tools.description: Update one Zoho Recruit note by ID. Returns every provider outcome because note validation failures may be reported within a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Update Note Type
tools.description: Rename one configured Zoho Recruit note type. Inspect every outcome because duplicate names and validation failures may be reported in a successful HTTP response. This documented mutation was not live-probed to avoid renaming account configuration.

tools.name: Update Pipelines
tools.description: Update one Zoho Recruit hiring pipeline by path ID or update pipeline definitions carrying their own IDs through the collection route. This can rename pipelines, change the organization default, and add, remove, or reorder stage and status mappings. These configuration changes may be irreversible. Inspect all_succeeded because validation failures can appear inside successful HTTP responses.

tools.name: Update Records
tools.description: Update one Zoho Recruit record by path ID or up to 100 records carrying their own IDs. Returns every provider validation outcome; inspect all_succeeded rather than assuming an HTTP 2xx response means every item passed.

tools.name: Update Reviews
tools.description: Update one owned Zoho Recruit review by path ID or multiple owned reviews carrying their own IDs. Returns every provider outcome because review validation failures may be reported within a successful HTTP response. This documented mutation was not live-probed because it requires probe-owned review fixtures.

tools.name: Update Stage
tools.description: Rename or recolor one existing Zoho Recruit hiring stage. This changes organization-wide configuration and does not provide automatic rollback. Inspect every outcome because validation failures can be returned in a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Update Tag
tools.description: Rename or recolor one tag in a Zoho Recruit module. Inspect every outcome because validation failures may be returned inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Upload Attachment
tools.description: Attach either one file or one public URL to a Zoho Recruit record. Choose the attachment category by ID, label, or both. URL mode is live verified; multipart file mode follows the provider's documented transport contract. Inspect every outcome because Zoho Recruit can report item failures inside a successful HTTP response.

tools.name: Upload Photo
tools.description: Upload one image as the photo for a Zoho Recruit Candidate or Contact. The file is sent as multipart/form-data field file. The multipart success contract is documented but has not been live verified.

tools.name: Upsert Records
tools.description: Insert or update up to 100 Zoho Recruit records by duplicate-check fields without changing record status.

name: Zoho Sign
description: Zoho Sign provides electronic signature workflows for creating, sending, tracking, and managing documents, templates, recipients, and account resources.

tools.name: Create Folder
tools.description: Create a persistent Zoho Sign folder. Zoho Sign provides no folder-delete API endpoint, so this action cannot automatically clean up the folder.

tools.name: Create Request
tools.description: Upload 1-40 PDF documents and create a Zoho Sign draft request. This action does not send the request to recipients.

tools.name: Create Request From Merged Templates
tools.description: Create one Zoho Sign request from two or more compatible templates. quick_send=true immediately submits the request and irreversibly emails external recipients, requiring a paid API-capable plan and submission credits. This endpoint's page does not guarantee that quick_send=false creates a draft, so use false only when that uncertainty is acceptable.

tools.name: Create Request From Template
tools.description: Create a Zoho Sign request from a template. quick_send must be chosen explicitly: true irreversibly emails external recipients and requires a paid API-capable plan and send credits; false creates an editable draft.

tools.name: Create Request Type
tools.description: Create a persistent Zoho Sign document/request type. Zoho Sign provides no request-type delete API endpoint, so this action cannot automatically clean up the request type.

tools.name: Create Signer Group
tools.description: Create a persistent Zoho Sign signer group with named email recipients. Zoho Sign provides no signer-group delete API endpoint, so this action cannot automatically clean up the group.

tools.name: Create Template
tools.description: Upload 1-40 PDF documents and create a reusable Zoho Sign template with recipient roles and signer fields.

tools.name: Delete Document
tools.description: Permanently delete one document file from an owned Zoho Sign request. This destructive action cannot be undone and does not delete the whole request.

tools.name: Delete Request
tools.description: Destructively move an owned Zoho Sign request to trash. This is a soft delete rather than immediate permanent erasure. Optionally recall an in-progress request first, which stops its remaining signing process.

tools.name: Delete Template
tools.description: Destructively move an owned reusable Zoho Sign template to trash. This is a soft delete rather than immediate permanent erasure.

tools.name: Download Completion Certificate
tools.description: Download the PDF completion certificate for a fully signed request. Draft and in-progress requests do not have a certificate; completing a request through the API requires a paid API-capable Zoho Sign plan and credits.

tools.name: Download Document
tools.description: Download one PDF document from a Zoho Sign request.

tools.name: Download Request
tools.description: Download all documents in a Zoho Sign request as a PDF or ZIP, optionally merged and including the completion certificate.

tools.name: Email Completed Request
tools.description: Immediately email an owned completed Zoho Sign request to one to three addresses. The request must have completed signing, which generally depends on the paid API submission workflow. This sends real external email; confirm every destination before calling, and check delivery before retrying to avoid duplicate messages.

tools.name: Extend Request
tools.description: Extend the signing-link expiration date of an owned sent request. The request must already have been submitted through Zoho Sign's paid, credit-consuming API-send workflow.

tools.name: Generate Embedded Signing URL
tools.description: Generate a one-time URL for a human to sign one recipient action from a previously submitted request. The recipient must have been configured as an embedded SIGN action before submission; API submission requires a paid Zoho Sign plan and send credits. This action does not sign the document. Hand the URL to the intended signer immediately because it must be opened within two minutes and can be used only once.

tools.name: Generate Request Embedded Send URL
tools.description: Generate a short-lived, human-facing embedded editor URL for an owned active draft request. Open the URL within two minutes to start a one-hour session. This action only creates the handoff URL; it does not send the request.

tools.name: Generate Template Embedded Send URL
tools.description: Generate a short-lived embedded editor and sending URL for an owned Zoho Sign template. Open the URL within two minutes to start a one-hour human editing session. Generating the URL does not itself send a request; a completed send may require paid API entitlement and credits.

tools.name: Get Organization
tools.description: Get the connected Zoho Sign organization, license label, administrative context, and relevant template, embedded-workflow, and signer-group feature flags.

tools.name: Get Request
tools.description: Get one request's status, documents, recipient actions, and signer fields.

tools.name: Get Request Field Data
tools.description: Get recipient-entered field labels and values from a completed Zoho Sign request. Draft and in-progress requests do not have completed field data.

tools.name: Get Request Reminder Settings
tools.description: Get automatic email reminder settings for an owned Zoho Sign request.

tools.name: Get Template
tools.description: Get one Zoho Sign template's documents, reusable recipient roles, signer fields, and prefill fields.

tools.name: List Field Types
tools.description: List account-specific Zoho Sign field type IDs, names, categories, and mandatory defaults for use when placing signer fields.

tools.name: List Folders
tools.description: Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign folders.

tools.name: List My Requests
tools.description: Return one controllable page of requests assigned to or pending for the connected Zoho Sign user.

tools.name: List Requests
tools.description: Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign document requests, optionally filtered by status and search columns.

tools.name: List Request Types
tools.description: Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign document request types.

tools.name: List Signer Group Recipients
tools.description: Return one page of recipients for a Zoho Sign signer group. An empty result does not prove that the signer group exists.

tools.name: List Signer Groups
tools.description: Return one controllable page of Zoho Sign signer groups, optionally filtered by group name.

tools.name: List Templates
tools.description: Return one controllable page of reusable Zoho Sign templates.

tools.name: List Users
tools.description: Return one controllable page of users in the connected Zoho Sign organization without email addresses or profile photos.

tools.name: Mark Request For Correction
tools.description: Move an owned in-progress request into correction mode before any signer completes. The request must have been submitted through a paid, credit-consuming API-send workflow.

tools.name: Merge Templates Into Request
tools.description: Merge at least two owned templates into an existing owned Zoho Sign draft request. This updates the draft but does not submit it or send it to recipients.

tools.name: Preview Template Merge
tools.description: Preview whether two or more Zoho Sign templates are compatible for merging and retrieve the merged fields and recipient roles. This read-only preview does not create a request or send anything.

tools.name: Recall Request
tools.description: Irreversibly recall an owned sent Zoho Sign request and cancel its remaining signing process. Recipients can no longer view or sign the request after recall. The request must already have been submitted through the paid, credit-consuming API-send workflow.

tools.name: Remind Request Recipients
tools.description: Immediately send a real reminder email to every pending recipient of an owned sent request. This externally visible action requires the paid API-send workflow, and repeated calls send additional email reminders.

tools.name: Self Sign Request
tools.description: Irreversibly apply the connected user's legal signature and complete an owned Zoho Sign self-sign request. The request must already be configured for self-signing and in a signable state. This requires an API-capable paid plan; confirm the request and field values before calling because signing cannot be undone.

tools.name: Submit Request
tools.description: Irreversibly send an owned Zoho Sign draft request to its recipients after applying final signer fields. This requires an API-capable paid plan and send credits; Zoho documents a cost of five credits per envelope submission.

tools.name: Update Request
tools.description: Update an owned draft or correction-mode request, including settings, recipients, fields, and optional added files. This does not send the request.

tools.name: Update Request Type
tools.description: Rename or change the description of an existing Zoho Sign document request type.

tools.name: Update Signer Group
tools.description: Rename an owned Zoho Sign signer group, add recipients, and remove existing recipients by ID.

tools.name: Update Template
tools.description: Update an owned Zoho Sign template's settings, reusable roles, signer fields, field removals, and optional added PDF documents.

name: Zoho WorkDrive
description: Zoho WorkDrive is a cloud file management and team collaboration platform for organizing, sharing, searching, and governing business content.

tools.name: Abort Workflow for a File/Folder
tools.description: Abort an active workflow instance permanently after exact-ID confirmation; an aborted instance cannot be resumed.

tools.name: Create Comment
tools.description: Create a new top-level comment on a WorkDrive file.

tools.name: Add Folder Customization
tools.description: Enable customization for an existing WorkDrive folder.

tools.name: Add Member to Group
tools.description: Add one Zoho user to a WorkDrive group with a specified group role.

tools.name: Create Reply
tools.description: Create a reply to an existing WorkDrive comment.

tools.name: Add Label to File or Folder
tools.description: Apply a WorkDrive label to a file or folder.

tools.name: Enable Team Folder File Conversion
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic document conversion for a team folder.

tools.name: Enable External Sharing
tools.description: Enable or disable external sharing for a team folder.

tools.name: Enable My Folders File Conversion
tools.description: Enable or disable automatic document conversion for a member's My Folders space.

tools.name: Allow Viewer to Download
tools.description: Allow or prevent viewer-level users from downloading team-folder files.

tools.name: Archive Team Folder
tools.description: Archive a team folder while preserving its data, roles, and sharing permissions.

tools.name: Associate File/Folder to Data Template
tools.description: Associate one file or folder with a data template and field values.

tools.name: Associate Multiple Files/Folders to Data Template
tools.description: Associate multiple files or folders with data templates in one request.

tools.name: Get File/Folder Breadcrumbs
tools.description: Fetch the location and folder hierarchy of a WorkDrive file or folder.

tools.name: Change Data Template Description
tools.description: Change the description of an existing data template.

tools.name: Change Label Color
tools.description: Change only the color of an existing WorkDrive label.

tools.name: Change Preferred Team
tools.description: Set a WorkDrive team as the authenticated user's preferred team, which becomes the default team shown after login.

tools.name: Check out File
tools.description: Check out a WorkDrive file to restrict other users from editing it.

tools.name: Commit Session for Revision Upload
tools.description: Commit a completed chunk upload session as the top version of an existing WorkDrive file.

tools.name: Create Session for Revision Upload
tools.description: Create a chunk upload session for a new top version of an existing WorkDrive file.

tools.name: Commit Session (Normal Upload)
tools.description: Commit a completed chunk upload session and create or update its file.

tools.name: Create Session (Normal Upload)
tools.description: Create a WorkDrive chunk upload session for a new file.

tools.name: Upload Session Progress
tools.description: Return progress details for an ongoing WorkDrive chunk upload session.

tools.name: Copy File or Folder
tools.description: Copy one WorkDrive file or folder into a destination folder.

tools.name: Create Custom Field

name: Zoom Team Chat
description: Zoom Team Chat is Zoom's persistent messaging product: channels, direct messages, threads, reactions, file sharing, reminders and shared spaces, all accessible through the Zoom REST API as the connected user

tools.name: Add Shared Space Members
tools.description: Add members to a Zoom Team Chat shared space by email address or Zoom user ID. Zoom processes each member independently and returns HTTP 200/201 even when every add fails, so success must be judged from successful_operations_count / unsuccessful_operations_count and each entry's operation_status - not the HTTP status.

tools.name: Archive or Unarchive Channels
tools.description: Archive or unarchive up to 10 Zoom Team Chat channels in one call. Returns per-channel failures; success requires failed_channels to be empty.

tools.name: Bookmark or Unbookmark Message
tools.description: Add or remove a bookmark on a Zoom Team Chat message. Identify the message by message_id plus the conversation it lives in: provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel message) or to_contact (a 1:1 message). Set action to 'add_bookmark' (default) or 'remove_bookmark'. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Create Channel
tools.description: Create a new Zoom Team Chat channel for the authenticated user, optionally inviting initial members by email.

tools.name: Create Message Reminder
tools.description: Set a reminder on a Zoom Team Chat message, either after a delay (delay_seconds) or at an absolute time (remind_time). Exactly one of to_channel or to_contact must identify where the message lives, and exactly one of delay_seconds or remind_time must set the timing.

tools.name: Create Shared Space
tools.description: Create a Zoom Team Chat shared space (a container that groups related channels). A 'general' channel is auto-created with it.

tools.name: Delete Channel
tools.description: Delete a Zoom Team Chat channel the user owns or is a member of. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Delete a Zoom Team Chat message the connected user sent, identified by message_id plus the conversation it lives in. Provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel message) or to_contact (a 1:1 message). Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Delete Message Reminder
tools.description: Delete the reminder set on a Zoom Team Chat message. Reminders have no id of their own — they are identified by the message_id they belong to. Provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel message) or to_contact (a 1:1 message) to locate the message. Returns {success: true} on success; the API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Delete Scheduled Message
tools.description: Delete a scheduled (draft) Zoom Team Chat message before it is sent, identified by draft_id plus the conversation it is addressed to. Provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel draft) or to_contact (a 1:1 draft). Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Delete Shared Space
tools.description: Delete a Zoom Team Chat shared space. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body. NOTE: the space's auto-created 'general' channel SURVIVES as a regular channel and must be deleted separately with DELETE_CHANNEL.

tools.name: Get Channel
tools.description: Get full information about a Zoom Team Chat channel, including its settings.

tools.name: Get Chat Contact
tools.description: Get a single Zoom Team Chat contact by email or user ID, optionally with live presence status.

tools.name: Get Message
tools.description: Get a single Zoom Team Chat message by ID, including its deep-link URL.

tools.name: Get Message Thread
tools.description: Retrieve a Zoom Team Chat message's thread: the parent message plus its replies since a given time.

tools.name: Get Shared Space
tools.description: Get details of a Zoom Team Chat shared space, including its owner and settings.

tools.name: Invite Channel Members
tools.description: Invite members to a Zoom Team Chat channel by email address. Returns only an invitation timestamp - Zoom does not echo per-member results, and external invitees stay invisible in the member list until they accept.

tools.name: Join Channel
tools.description: Join a public Zoom Team Chat channel as the authenticated user. Only public (type 3 or 5) channels can be joined this way; private and invite-only channels require an invitation.

tools.name: Leave Channel
tools.description: Leave a Zoom Team Chat channel. WARNING: if the channel OWNER leaves an invite-only channel they cannot rejoin or delete it afterwards — the channel is orphaned. Owners should delete the channel instead. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: List Bookmarks
tools.description: List the authenticated user's bookmarked Zoom Team Chat messages, optionally filtered to one channel (to_channel) or one 1:1 contact (to_contact). Omit both filters to list bookmarks across all conversations.

tools.name: List Channel Members
tools.description: List the members of a Zoom Team Chat channel.

tools.name: List Channels
tools.description: List the Zoom Team Chat channels the authenticated user is a member of.

tools.name: List Chat Contacts
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Zoom Team Chat contacts. Zoom returns company contacts by default; pass type='external' for external contacts. The user themself appears as a contact, and each contact's id can be used as a to_contact value for 1:1 messaging.

tools.name: List Messages
tools.description: List Zoom Team Chat messages exchanged in a channel or a 1:1 conversation, newest first (defaults to today). Provide exactly one of to_channel or to_contact.

tools.name: List Pinned Messages
tools.description: List the pinned messages of a Zoom Team Chat channel. Set include_history to also return previously-pinned (now unpinned) history messages.

tools.name: List Reminders
tools.description: List the authenticated user's Zoom Team Chat message reminders. Optionally filter by a channel (to_channel) or a 1:1 contact (to_contact); omit both to list all reminders.

tools.name: List Scheduled Messages
tools.description: List the user's scheduled (draft) Zoom Team Chat messages queued to send to a channel or a 1:1 contact. Provide exactly one of to_channel or to_contact.

tools.name: List Chat Sessions
tools.description: List the user's recent Zoom Team Chat sessions (channels and 1:1 conversations) within a time window. Defaults to today; groupchat sessions are channels and 1:1 sessions carry peer contact info.

tools.name: List Shared Space Channels
tools.description: List the channels grouped inside a Zoom Team Chat shared space.

tools.name: List Shared Space Members
tools.description: List the members and administrators of a Zoom Team Chat shared space.

tools.name: List Shared Spaces
tools.description: List the Zoom Team Chat shared spaces the authenticated user belongs to.

tools.name: Mark Message Read or Unread
tools.description: Mark a Zoom Team Chat message as read or unread. Identify the message by message_id plus the conversation it lives in: provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel message) or to_contact (a 1:1 message). Set action to 'read' (default) or 'unread'. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Move Channels Into/Out of Shared Space
tools.description: Move existing Zoom Team Chat channels into or out of a shared space. Returns per-channel results; success requires every channel to report is_moved=true.

tools.name: Pin or Unpin Message
tools.description: Pin or unpin a message in a Zoom Team Chat channel. Set action to 'pin' or 'unpin', and identify the message by message_id plus the channel_id it belongs to. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: React to Message
tools.description: Add or remove an emoji reaction on a Zoom Team Chat message. Identify the message by message_id plus the conversation it lives in: provide exactly one of to_channel (a channel message) or to_contact (a 1:1 message). The emoji is a Unicode codepoint string without a 'U+' prefix (e.g. '1F44D'). Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Remove Channel Member
tools.description: Remove a single member from a Zoom Team Chat channel. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body. Removing someone who is not a member of the channel fails with a 404 (code 1001).

tools.name: Remove Shared Space Members
tools.description: Remove members or administrators from a Zoom Team Chat shared space by user ID or member ID (the shared space owner cannot be removed). Zoom processes each identifier independently and returns HTTP 200 even when every removal fails, so success must be judged from successful_operations_count / unsuccessful_operations_count and each entry's operation_status - not the HTTP status.

tools.name: Search Channels
tools.description: Search Zoom Team Chat channels by name — fuzzy keywords or an exact channel name — across the channels the user has joined or the org's public channels. Returns one page of matches (max 20) plus a next_page_token cursor.

tools.name: Search Company Contacts
tools.description: Search the connected user's organization directory for contacts by keyword (first name, last name, or email address). Optionally include each contact's presence status.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Send a Zoom Team Chat message to a channel or a 1:1 contact, optionally as a thread reply (reply_main_message_id) or scheduled for later (scheduled_time). Exactly one of to_channel or to_contact must be provided.

tools.name: Star or Unstar Conversation
tools.description: Star or unstar a Zoom Team Chat channel or contact for the authenticated user. Set target_type to 'channel' or 'contact' and target_id to the channel ID, contact user ID, or contact member ID. Returns {success: true} on success; the underlying API responds with HTTP 204 and an empty body.

tools.name: Update Channel
tools.description: Rename a Zoom Team Chat channel or update its type/settings.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Edit the text of an existing Zoom Team Chat message.

tools.name: Update Shared Space
tools.description: Update a Zoom Team Chat shared space's name, description, or settings.

required.name: client_id
required.description: Client id of the app

required.name: client_secret
required.description: Client secret of the app

optional.name: oauth_redirect_uri
optional.description: Add this Redirect URL to your app's OAuth allow list.

optional.name: scopes
optional.description: Scopes to request from the user, comma separated

name: Zulip
description: Chat for distributed teams. Zulip combines the immediacy of real-time chat with an email threading model.

tools.name: Add Alert Words
tools.description: Tool to add alert words to the current user's configuration. Use when you need to configure words that trigger notifications for the user. Alert words are case insensitive and duplicates are automatically ignored.

tools.name: Add APNs Device Token
tools.description: Tool to add an APNs (Apple Push Notification service) device token to Zulip. Use when registering an iOS device for push notifications.

tools.name: Add Default Stream
tools.description: Tool to add a channel as a default stream in Zulip. Use when you want to configure a channel to be automatically subscribed for all new users joining the organization.

tools.name: Add Linkifier
tools.description: Tool to add a linkifier to a Zulip realm. Use when you need to automatically convert text patterns (like issue numbers or ticket IDs) into clickable links in messages.

tools.name: Add Navigation View
tools.description: Tool to add a navigation view in Zulip. Use when you need to create a custom navigation view or configure a built-in view for display in the sidebar.

tools.name: Add Reaction
tools.description: Tool to add an emoji reaction to a Zulip message. Use when you want to react to a message with an emoji.

tools.name: Archive Channel
tools.description: Tool to archive a channel in Zulip. Use when you need to permanently archive a channel by its ID.

tools.name: Check Messages Match Narrow
tools.description: Tool to check if specific messages match a narrow filter. Use when you need to determine whether messages satisfy complex search criteria that the client cannot evaluate locally.

tools.name: Create BigBlueButton video call
tools.description: Tool to create a BigBlueButton video call in Zulip. Use when you need to generate a video conference link for team meetings or discussions.

tools.name: Create Channel
tools.description: Tool to create a new channel in Zulip. Use when you need to set up a new communication channel with specified subscribers. Channels organize conversations by topic within Zulip.

tools.name: Create Channel Folder
tools.description: Tool to create a new channel folder in Zulip. Use when you need to organize channels into folders for better management.

tools.name: Create custom profile field
tools.description: Tool to create a custom profile field in Zulip. Use when you need to add custom user profile fields for organization members.

tools.name: Create Drafts
tools.description: Tool to create one or more draft messages in Zulip. Use when you need to save message drafts for later editing or sending.

tools.name: Create reusable invitation link
tools.description: Tool to create a reusable invitation link for the Zulip organization. Use when you need to generate an invite link that can be shared with multiple users to join the organization.

tools.name: Create Message Reminder
tools.description: Tool to create a message reminder in Zulip. Use when you need to set up a reminder for a specific message that will be sent at a scheduled time via the Notification Bot.

tools.name: Create Saved Snippet
tools.description: Tool to create a saved snippet in Zulip. Use when you need to save reusable text content that can be quickly inserted into messages.

tools.name: Create Scheduled Message
tools.description: Tool to create a scheduled message in Zulip. Use when you need to schedule a message to be sent at a future time to channels or direct messages.

tools.name: Delete Draft
tools.description: Tool to delete a draft in Zulip. Use when you need to remove a saved draft message.

tools.name: Delete Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a message in Zulip. Use when you need to remove a message from a stream or direct message conversation.

tools.name: Delete Event Queue
tools.description: Tool to delete an event queue previously registered via POST /api/v1/register. Use when you need to clean up a queue that is no longer needed.

tools.name: Delete Reminder
tools.description: Tool to delete a reminder from Zulip. Use when you need to remove a scheduled reminder by its ID.

tools.name: Delete Saved Snippet
tools.description: Tool to delete a saved snippet by its ID. Use when you need to remove a snippet from saved snippets.

tools.name: Delete Scheduled Message
tools.description: Tool to delete a scheduled message in Zulip. Use when you need to cancel a message that was scheduled to be sent later. This is permanent and cannot be undone.

tools.name: Delete Topic
tools.description: Tool to delete a topic from a Zulip channel/stream. Use when you need to permanently remove a topic and all its messages from a specific stream. Note: This operation is irreversible and will delete all messages in the topic.

tools.name: Edit Draft
tools.description: Tool to edit an existing draft message in Zulip. Use when you need to update the content, topic, recipients, or other properties of a saved draft.

tools.name: Edit Navigation View
tools.description: Tool to update a navigation view in Zulip. Use when you need to pin/unpin a view or rename a custom navigation view.

tools.name: Edit Saved Snippet
tools.description: Tool to edit a saved snippet by updating its title and/or content. Use when you need to modify an existing snippet.

tools.name: Export Realm
tools.description: Tool to create a Zulip realm data export. Use when you need to export organization data. The export is created asynchronously and can be downloaded later.

tools.name: Get alert words
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all configured alert words for the authenticated user. Use when you need to check which words or phrases trigger notifications.

tools.name: Get Another User Presence
tools.description: Tool to get the presence status for a specific user in Zulip. Use when you need to check if a user is currently active, idle, or offline. This endpoint is designed for embedding presence data in external applications. If the timestamp is more than a few minutes old, the user should be considered offline.

tools.name: Get Attachments
tools.description: Tool to retrieve metadata on files uploaded by the requesting user. Use when you need to list all attachments with their details including file names, sizes, and associated messages.

tools.name: Get Channel Folders
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all channel folders in the organization, sorted by display order. Use when you need to list or organize channel folders.

tools.name: Get custom emoji
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all custom emoji configured in the Zulip realm. Use when you need to get the list of available custom emoji including their names, IDs, and source URLs.

tools.name: Get custom profile fields
tools.description: Tool to get all custom profile fields configured for the Zulip realm. Use when you need to retrieve the list of custom profile fields including their types, names, and configuration.

tools.name: Get drafts
tools.description: Tool to fetch all drafts for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve all saved draft messages, which are returned in order of last edit time (most recent first).

tools.name: Get Events
tools.description: Tool to get events from a Zulip event queue. Use when you need to retrieve new events after registering a queue.

tools.name: Get file temporary URL
tools.description: Tool to get a public temporary URL for an uploaded file in Zulip. Use when you need to access or share a file that was previously uploaded to the Zulip organization.

tools.name: Get realm icon
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the URL of the Zulip realm's icon. Use when you need to get the organization's icon image URL.

tools.name: Get all invitations
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all unexpired invitations for the Zulip organization. Use when you need to list all active email invitations and reusable invitation links that can be managed by the user.

tools.name: Get user group membership status
tools.description: Tool to check if a user is a member of a specific user group. Use when you need to verify user group membership status.

tools.name: Get linkifiers
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all configured linkifiers in the Zulip realm. Use when you need to get the list of regex patterns that are automatically converted to links in messages and topics.

tools.name: Get message
tools.description: Tool to fetch a single message by ID from Zulip. Use when you need to retrieve the full details of a specific message including its content, sender, reactions, and edit history.

tools.name: Get Message History
tools.description: Tool to fetch the complete edit history of a Zulip message. Use when you need to see all changes made to a message over time, including content edits, topic changes, and channel moves. Returns snapshots in chronological order from oldest to newest.

tools.name: Get Messages
tools.description: Tool to fetch messages from Zulip. Use when you need to retrieve messages using various filters like anchor position, narrow queries, or specific message IDs. Supports pagination via num_before/num_after parameters.

tools.name: Get Navigation Views
tools.description: Tool to fetch all navigation views for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve all configured custom navigation views, which are displayed in the sidebar or 'More Views' menu.

tools.name: Get own user
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the profile information for the authenticated user. Use when you need to get details about the current user such as email, full name, role, timezone, or other profile data.

tools.name: Get Read Receipts
tools.description: Tool to retrieve read receipts for a message in Zulip. Use when you need to see which users have read a specific message.

tools.name: Get realm export consents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve data export consent state for users in a realm. Use when you need to check which users have consented for their private data to be exported by organization administrators.

tools.name: Get all data exports
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all data exports for the Zulip organization. Use when you need to list all data exports, including their status (pending, completed, or failed) and download URLs. Requires organization administrator access.

tools.name: Get Realm Presence
tools.description: Tool to get the presence status for all users in the Zulip realm. Use when you need to check which users are currently active, idle, or offline across the entire organization. If a user's timestamp is more than a few minutes old, they should be considered offline.

tools.name: Get reminders
tools.description: Tool to fetch all undelivered reminders for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve scheduled reminders, which are returned in order of scheduled delivery time. This feature is available in Zulip 11.0+ (feature level 399).

tools.name: Get Saved Snippets
tools.description: Tool to fetch all saved snippets for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve reusable text content that can be quickly inserted into messages.

tools.name: Get Scheduled Messages
tools.description: Tool to fetch all scheduled messages for the authenticated user. Use when you need to retrieve all undelivered scheduled messages, which are returned in order of scheduled delivery time (earliest first).

tools.name: Get server settings
tools.description: Tool to retrieve server configuration and available authentication methods. Use when you need to discover server capabilities, version information, or available login options before authentication.

tools.name: Get Channel by ID
tools.description: Tool to get detailed information about a Zulip channel by its ID. Use when you need to retrieve complete channel details including permissions, settings, and metadata.

tools.name: Get channel email address
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the email address for a Zulip channel. Use when you need to get the email address that can be used to send messages to a specific channel via email.

tools.name: Get Channel ID
tools.description: Tool to get a channel's unique ID by its name. Use when you need to retrieve the numeric identifier for a channel given its human-readable name.

tools.name: Get All Channels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all channels (streams) in Zulip that match specified filters. Use when you need to list available channels, discover public channels, or find channels the user has access to. Returns detailed metadata for each channel including permissions and settings.

tools.name: Get stream topics
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all topics in a Zulip channel. Use when you need to get the list of discussion topics within a specific channel, along with the maximum message ID for each topic.

tools.name: Get Channel Subscribers
tools.description: Tool to get all subscribers of a Zulip channel. Use when you need to retrieve the list of user IDs subscribed to a specific channel.

tools.name: Get Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all channels (streams) the authenticated user is subscribed to. Use when you need to list subscribed channels with their details including names, IDs, and optionally subscriber lists.

tools.name: Get subscription status
tools.description: Tool to check whether a specific user is subscribed to a particular channel (stream). Use when you need to verify subscription status of a user for a given channel.

tools.name: Get user by email
tools.description: Tool to fetch a user by email address from Zulip. Use when you need to retrieve detailed information about a specific user including their profile, role, and status.

tools.name: Get user channels
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the list of channel IDs that a specific user is subscribed to. Use when you need to get a user's subscribed channels.

tools.name: Get user group members
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all members of a specific user group. Use when you need to get the list of user IDs who are members of a user group.

tools.name: Get user groups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve all user groups in the Zulip organization. Use when you need to list user groups with their members, subgroups, and permission settings.

tools.name: Get user group subgroups
tools.description: Tool to retrieve subgroups of a user group. Use when you need to get the list of subgroup IDs for a specific user group.

tools.name: Get user status
tools.description: Tool to retrieve the status currently set by a user in the Zulip organization. Use when you need to get a user's custom status message, emoji, or away status. Available in Zulip 9.0+ (feature level 262).

tools.name: Mark All Messages as Read
tools.description: Tool to mark all messages as read for the authenticated user. Use when you need to clear all unread message indicators. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Mark Stream as Read
tools.description: Tool to mark all messages in a Zulip channel as read. Use when you need to mark all unread messages in a specific channel as read.

tools.name: Mark Topic as Read
tools.description: Tool to mark all messages in a topic as read. Use when you need to clear unread status for all messages within a specific topic in a channel.

tools.name: Mute Topic
tools.description: Tool to mute or unmute a topic in a Zulip channel. Use when you want to control topic notifications by muting or unmuting specific topics.

tools.name: Reactivate User
tools.description: Tool to reactivate a deactivated user in Zulip. Use when you need to restore access for a previously deactivated user account.

tools.name: Register Push Device
tools.description: Tool to register an E2EE (end-to-end encrypted) push device for mobile notifications. Use when setting up push notifications with encrypted payloads for mobile clients.

tools.name: Register Event Queue
tools.description: Tool to register an event queue for receiving Zulip events. Use when you need to set up an event queue to receive real-time updates about messages, subscriptions, and other realm events.

tools.name: Remove Alert Words
tools.description: Tool to remove alert words from the current user's configuration. Use when you need to delete words that trigger notifications for the user. Words not in the user's set are automatically ignored.

tools.name: Remove Attachment
tools.description: Tool to delete an attachment in Zulip. Use when you need to remove a file attachment that was previously uploaded.

tools.name: Remove Code Playground
tools.description: Tool to remove a code playground from a Zulip realm. Use when you need to delete an existing code playground configuration.

tools.name: Remove Default Stream
tools.description: Tool to remove a channel from default streams in Zulip. Use when you want to stop a channel from being automatically subscribed to all new users joining the organization.

tools.name: Remove FCM Token
tools.description: Tool to remove an FCM registration token for Android push notifications. Use when unregistering a device from push notifications in Zulip. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Remove Linkifier
tools.description: Tool to remove a linkifier from a Zulip realm. Use when you need to delete an existing linkifier that automatically converts text patterns into clickable links.

tools.name: Remove Navigation View
tools.description: Tool to remove a navigation view in Zulip. Use when you need to delete a custom navigation view from the sidebar.

tools.name: Remove Reaction
tools.description: Tool to remove an emoji reaction from a Zulip message. Use when you want to remove a previously added reaction from a message.

tools.name: Render Message
tools.description: Tool to render a message to HTML in Zulip. Use when you need to preview how a message will appear when rendered from Markdown to HTML format.

tools.name: Reorder Channel Folders
tools.description: Tool to reorder channel folders in Zulip. Use when you need to change the display order of channel folders. The order list must include all organization channel folder IDs.

tools.name: Reorder Custom Profile Fields
tools.description: Tool to reorder custom profile fields in Zulip. Use when you need to change the display order of custom profile fields in user profiles and settings. The order list must include all custom profile field IDs.

tools.name: Reorder Linkifiers
tools.description: Tool to reorder linkifiers in Zulip. Use when you need to change the processing order of linkifiers in a realm. The order matters when patterns overlap.

tools.name: Revoke Email Invitation
tools.description: Tool to revoke an email invitation in Zulip. Use when you need to cancel a pending invitation that has not yet been accepted.

tools.name: Revoke reusable invitation link
tools.description: Tool to revoke a reusable invitation link for the Zulip organization. Use when you need to invalidate an invite link that was previously created.

tools.name: Send Message
tools.description: Tool to send a message in Zulip. Use when you need to send a direct message to users or post a message to a channel/stream.

tools.name: Send Test Notification
tools.description: Tool to send a test notification to mobile device(s). Use when testing push notifications for mobile clients. Note: This endpoint is deprecated.

tools.name: Set Typing Status
tools.description: Tool to set typing status in Zulip. Use when you want to indicate that a user is typing or has stopped typing a message.

tools.name: Set Typing Status for Message Edit
tools.description: Tool to set typing status when editing a message in Zulip. Use when you want to indicate that a user is editing or has stopped editing a specific message.

tools.name: Subscribe to Channel
tools.description: Tool to subscribe users to one or more Zulip channels. Use when you need to add users to channels. If a channel doesn't exist, it will be created automatically. By default, subscribes the authenticated user.

tools.name: Test Welcome Bot Custom Message
tools.description: Tool to test welcome bot custom message in Zulip. Use when you need to preview how a custom welcome message will appear before setting it as the default for new users.

tools.name: Unsubscribe From Channel
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from one or more channels (streams) in Zulip. Use when you need to remove users from channels or unsubscribe the authenticated user from channels.

tools.name: Update Channel Folder
tools.description: Tool to update a channel folder in Zulip. Use when you need to modify the name, description, or archive status of an existing channel folder.

tools.name: Update Linkifier
tools.description: Tool to update a linkifier in a Zulip realm. Use when you need to modify the pattern or URL template of an existing linkifier that automatically converts text patterns into clickable links.

tools.name: Update Message
tools.description: Tool to edit a message in Zulip. Use when you need to update message content, move messages to a different topic or channel, or resolve topics.

tools.name: Update Message Flags
tools.description: Tool to update personal message flags in Zulip. Use when you need to mark messages as read/unread, starred/unstarred, or modify other personal message flags. This allows bulk operations on multiple messages at once.

tools.name: Update Message Flags for Narrow
tools.description: Tool to update personal message flags (e.g., read, starred) for messages matching a narrow filter. Use when you need to mark messages as read/unread or starred/unstarred within a specific conversation, channel, or search criteria.

tools.name: Update Realm User Settings Defaults
tools.description: Tool to update realm-level defaults of user settings in Zulip. Use when you need to configure organization-wide default settings for new users. At least one setting parameter must be provided.

tools.name: Update Scheduled Message
tools.description: Tool to edit a scheduled message in Zulip. Use when you need to modify the content, delivery time, or target audience of a message scheduled to be sent later.

tools.name: Update Settings
tools.description: Tool to update user settings in Zulip. Use when you need to modify user preferences including display settings, notification preferences, privacy settings, and web/desktop app behavior. Can update multiple settings in a single request.

tools.name: Update Status
tools.description: Tool to update your status in Zulip. Use when you need to set or clear your custom status message, emoji, or away status.

tools.name: Update status for user
tools.description: Tool to update the status for a specific user in the Zulip organization. Use when you need to set or clear a user's custom status message and emoji.

tools.name: Update Channel
tools.description: Tool to update a channel in Zulip. Use when you need to modify channel properties such as name, description, permissions, or settings. All parameters are optional - provide only the fields you want to update.

tools.name: Update Subscriptions
tools.description: Tool to update channel subscriptions by subscribing to new channels or unsubscribing from existing ones. Use when you need to add the user to channels (with optional channel creation) or remove them from channels.

tools.name: Update Subscription Settings
tools.description: Tool to update the user's personal settings for channels they are subscribed to. Use when you need to modify channel properties like muting, color, pinning, or per-channel notification settings.

tools.name: Update user by email
tools.description: Tool to update a user by email address in Zulip. Use when you need to modify user properties such as full name, email, role, or custom profile fields.

tools.name: Update User Topic
tools.description: Tool to update personal preferences for a topic in a Zulip channel. Use when you want to control topic visibility by muting, unmuting, or following specific topics.

required.name: subdomain
required.description: Your Zulip domain (e.g., "your-org" for your-org.zulipchat.com)

required.name: username
required.description: Your Zulip email address

required.name: password
required.description: Your Zulip API key from Personal Settings > Account & Privacy

name: Zylvie
description: High-converting cart software for solopreneurs to sell digital products and subscriptions.

tools.name: Create Product
tools.description: Tool to create a new product. Use when you need to add a product with detailed custom options in Zylvie platform.

tools.name: Get Authenticating User
tools.description: Tool to retrieve information about the currently authenticated user. Use when you have a valid Bearer token and need to fetch the authenticated user's profile.

tools.name: Subscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to subscribe to a webhook event by creating a workflow object. Use when you need to set up webhook notifications for sale, lead, affiliate, subscription, or cancel events. If a workflow with the same webhook URL already exists, returns the pre-existing workflow object.

tools.name: Unsubscribe Webhook
tools.description: Tool to unsubscribe from a webhook by deleting the workflow object associated with the specified webhook URL. Use after confirming the webhook URL to remove.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zylvie API key, found under your Settings > API page.

name: Zyte Api
description: Zyte API is a web scraping solution that automates data extraction from websites, handling challenges like bans and dynamic content.

tools.name: Fetch Active Scheduled Maintenances
tools.description: Retrieves currently active scheduled maintenances that are in 'In Progress' or 'Verifying' state. Use this to check for ongoing maintenance events that may affect Zyte API availability. Returns an empty list if no maintenances are currently active.

tools.name: Zyte API Components
tools.description: Retrieves all Zyte service components with their current operational status. Returns component details including status (operational, degraded_performance, partial_outage, major_outage), descriptions, groupings, and metadata. Useful for monitoring service health and identifying issues. No parameters required - provides a real-time snapshot of all Zyte infrastructure components.

tools.name: Extract Data from URL
tools.description: Tool to extract data from URLs using Zyte API's HTTP, browser, and AI-powered extraction capabilities. Use when you need to scrape web pages, extract structured data (products, articles, jobs, etc.), capture screenshots, or perform browser automation. Supports geolocation targeting and custom extraction schemas.

tools.name: Get scheduled maintenances
tools.description: Tool to get the 50 most recent scheduled maintenances (upcoming and completed) from Zyte status API. Use after confirming you need the latest maintenance schedule for monitoring.

tools.name: Zyte API: Get Unresolved Incidents
tools.description: Tool to retrieve unresolved incidents from Zyte status API. Use when you need to check currently open incidents.

tools.name: List Zyte API status incidents
tools.description: Retrieves the 50 most recent incidents from the Zyte API status page, including both resolved and unresolved incidents. Use this tool to check current API health, review incident history, or get detailed information about service disruptions affecting Zyte services.

tools.name: Get Zyte API Status Rollup
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive operational status for all Zyte services. Returns current status of components (Zyte API, Smart Proxy Manager, Scrapy Cloud, etc.), active incidents, and scheduled maintenance windows. Use this to check service health before making API calls or to diagnose issues.

required.name: generic_api_key
required.description: Your Zyte API key used for authentication. Find it at https://app.zyte.com/o/zyte-api/api-access.
